description.zh: 为明日方舟的长篇剧情打造的RAG类DSH插件，拥有多种快速检索能力。

description.en: 把外部 Agent CLI、持久终端、工作区调试和远程访问，装进 DSH 原生界面。
description.zh: 把外部 Agent CLI、持久终端和远程访问搬进 DSH 界面，调试工作区更顺手。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for complete Blender 3D modeling, reconstruction, rendering, validation, and export workflows
description.zh: Blender 3D 生产插件：提供 30 个建模/重建 Skill、13 个运行时工具和 26 个确定性 Helper，覆盖参考图拟合、渲染、验证、动画与可移植格式导出；npm 包名 `dsh-blender`。

description.en: Self-evolving team memory as plain Markdown in git: a native Cordis plugin that registers 38 bare-name memory tools plus a prompt-signals section re-evaluated at every assembly, with RPE reinforcement, decay and sleep consolidation; shares one data repo with its Claude Code (MCP) and OpenClaw hosts; verified against DSH 0.1.0-rc.6.
description.zh: 自进化团队记忆，以纯 Markdown 存于 Git：原生 Cordis 插件注册 38 个裸名记忆工具，并按每次组装动态注入 prompt-signals 段；含 RPE 强化、衰减与睡眠巩固；与 Claude Code（MCP）、OpenClaw 宿主共享同一数据仓；已对 DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 实测。

description.en: Skill-driven harness/loop engineering workflow agent plugin.
description.zh: 技能驱动的 harness/loop 工程化工作流插件。

description.en: The DSH plugin-development knowledge base as an on-demand agent skill: official constraints, task workflows, API reference and community gotchas, installed with the bundle so the agent can look things up while building a plugin.
description.zh: DSH 插件开发知识库，作为按需加载的 agent 技能随 bundle 安装：官方约束、任务工作流、API 参考与社区踩坑，写插件时让 DSH 自己查。

description.en: Reasoning-effort editing for third-party models in DeepSeek Harness: per-model thinking levels with a knowledge base + protocol inference, edited inside the official Models page card.
description.zh: 在模型页面为第三方模型编辑推理强度，含知识库与协议推断支持。

description.en: A web UI plugin manager for DeepSeek Harness that handles viewing, real-time toggling, install/uninstall, updates, health checks, and environment management.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 中一键管理 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件：查看、实时启停、安装/卸载、更新检测、健康检查（依赖/冲突/兼容性分析）、环境管理、插件市场。bundle 与非 bundle 插件全覆盖

description.en: 让你的Deepseek harness成为一个统一的agent入口，轻松接入codebuddy、claude code、opencode、qoder | Make your Deepseek harness a unified agent gateway for easy integration with CodeBuddy, Claude Code, OpenCode, Qoder, and more.
description.zh: 把任意支持 ACP 的 Agent 接进 DSH，用 DSH 一个入口管理所有会话和任务。模型、思考等级和权限模式由 Agent 自己提供；工具调用显示在主聊天区，diff 汇总到独立的 NTR 页，权限询问出现在输入框。使用前需在本机安装支持 ACP 的 Agent 命令行工具。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-ntr
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-ntr

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的开场视频 + 聊天底图插件
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加开场视频和聊天底图，开机动画后接自己的视频，聊天背景换图只需丢张图片进文件夹。

description.en: Bioinformatics agent preset with 17 BioDSH analysis skills (single-cell, bulk RNA-seq, survival, regression, ANOVA), a 2000+ skill library searched by a skill_library tool, per-message skill selection and a time/step convergence guard.
description.zh: 生信智能体预设，含 17 个 BioDSH 分析技能（单细胞、bulk RNA-seq、生存分析、回归、方差分析）、可用 skill_library 工具检索的 2000+ 技能库、按消息自动选技能和按时间/步数的收敛护栏。

description.en: Evidence-first deep reading for books, articles, PDFs, and document sets with claim-evidence reports, knowledge maps, recall questions, a Host tool, and an optional Web reading panel.
description.zh: 面向图书、文章、PDF 与文档集的证据优先精读工具，提供观点—证据报告、知识地图、回忆问题、Host 工具与可选 Web 阅读面板。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）远程 Web 启动 + 用户名/密码认证插件。 |  DeepSeek Harness Remote‑Web‑Launch Plugin with Username/Password Auth
description.zh: DSH远程Web启动插件，支持用户名密码认证。

description.en: Drive the Unity Editor from DSH through the official unity CLI: live-Editor scene commands, in-Editor C# eval and runtime command discovery over a warm unity shell session, plus a raw CLI escape hatch for project creation, tests and builds. Mounts Unity's official skill collection alongside its own Unity workflow and Asset Store skills.
description.zh: 通过官方 unity CLI 在 DSH 中操作 Unity 编辑器：实时场景命令、编辑器内 C# 求值、运行时命令发现，均复用常驻的 unity shell 会话；另有原始 CLI 通道用于建工程、跑测试与构建。同时挂载 Unity 官方技能集，以及插件自带的 Unity 工作流与 Asset Store 技能。

description.en: Decentralized, offline-first graph memory and task graph for DSH, with signed facts, multi-device sync, and the shared Mebular Console embedded in a sidebar panel. Requires a running Mebular daemon (the Mebular desktop app, or mebular serve from @mebular/core); this plugin only attaches its memory tools and Console panel to it.
description.zh: 去中心化、离线优先的 DSH 图式记忆与任务图：签名事实、多设备同步，并在侧边栏复用 Mebular 共享控制台。需本机已运行 Mebular 守护进程（Mebular 桌面 App，或 @mebular/core 的 mebular serve）；本插件只把它的记忆工具与控制台面板接入 DSH。

description.en: Bring ChatGPT’s reasoning to your local codebase. Work directly, or delegate larger tasks to DSH.
description.zh: 将 ChatGPT 的推理能力引入本地代码库，支持直接或委派任务。

description.en: Google Antigravity (agy) OAuth auth + model access plugin for DeepSeek Harness: multi-account pool, 429 rotation, device fingerprinting, CLI and web login.
description.zh: 提供 Google Antigravity OAuth 认证与模型访问，支持多账号池和请求轮换。

description.en: In-app plugin store for the DSH Web UI: browse, search, one-click install, compat badges.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 内置插件商店：浏览、搜索、一键安装，附兼容性标识。

description.en: Shared multi-agent task board (create/claim/transition/query) over a Cordis service key.
description.zh: 基于 Cordis 服务键的多 Agent 共享任务看板：创建、认领、流转与查询。

description.en: Provides a central hub for managing presets and configurations in the plugin suite.
description.zh: 为插件套件提供预设和配置的集中管理入口。

description.en: IM webhook and local notifications on turn completion, errors, or approval (Feishu/WeCom/DingTalk/Slack/Discord/custom).
description.zh: 回合完成、报错或待审批时发送 IM webhook 与本地通知（飞书/企业微信/钉钉/Slack/Discord/自定义）。

description.en: Export the append-only session log as human-readable Markdown or HTML, grouped by trajectory source.
description.zh: 将只追加的会话日志导出为可读的 Markdown 或 HTML，按轨迹来源分组。

description.en: Serves as a living plugin directory with hourly refresh, daily compatibility tests, an in-app store, and scaffolding tools.
description.zh: 提供实时插件目录，含小时刷新、每日兼容测试、内置商店和脚手架。

description.en: A plugin that assists in building and scaffolding other DSH plugins.
description.zh: 辅助构建和脚手架其他 DSH 插件的插件。

description.en: DSH Web GUI 的 Live2D 桌宠插件：可拖动、跟随鼠标、跟着会话状态换动作与表情，右键面板可换装
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页界面加一只可拖动的 Live2D 桌宠，会看鼠标、随会话状态变表情，右键还能换装。

description.en: Codex-style workflow auto-collapse: finished turns fold into a single "processed in Xs" row leaving only the final answer; tool calls and think blocks collapse into live-summary chips that follow streaming; expand level by level, fully reversible on uninstall.
description.zh: Codex 风格工作流自动折叠：回合完成收成一行「已处理 X秒」只留最终正文，工具/思考块折叠成实时摘要 chip（运行中跟随流式滚动），逐级点击展开；卸载完整还原。

description.en: Code-graph integration for the DSH Web GUI: a "Codegraph" card in Settings → Plugins with index status, symbol search, callers / callees / impact views, and one-click sync / index; hosts the codegraph MCP server and injects a CodeGraph usage guideline into the system prompt. Requires the codegraph CLI.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Codegraph 集成：设置 → 插件 中的「Codegraph」卡片提供索引状态、符号搜索、callers/callees/impact 查看与一键 sync/index；托管 codegraph MCP 服务器，并向 system prompt 注入 Codegraph 使用指引。需安装 codegraph CLI。

description.en: Terminal panel for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar "Terminal" entry opens a multi-tab xterm.js interactive terminal over a real PTY (node-pty), with SSH remote tabs (ssh2, agent / key / password auth), a cwd following the current session, and tty_list / tty_capture / tty_send agent tools.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的终端面板：侧边栏「终端」打开多标签页 xterm.js 全交互终端（node-pty 真实 PTY），支持 ssh2 原生 SSH 远程标签页（agent/key/password 三种认证），cwd 跟随当前会话，并提供 tty_list / tty_capture / tty_send 三个 agent 工具。

description.en: Adds an interactive virtual pet to the client UI, bringing playful companionship and entertainment to the DeepSeek Harness interface.
description.zh: 在客户端界面添加互动虚拟宠物，为操作环境增添趣味陪伴。

description.en: Docker container panel for the DSH Web GUI: containers (optionally including stopped), docker inspect details, logs, stats snapshots, image list and one-shot exec on the local machine or SSH hosts — read-only by default (mutations and exec are permission-gated), with a per-container terminal drawer embedded via the tty plugin.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Docker 容器面板：本机或 SSH 主机上的容器列表（可选含已停止）、docker inspect 详情、日志、stats 快照、镜像列表与一次性 exec——默认只读（启停删与 exec 均需显式开启权限），可经 tty 插件在面板底部就地打开容器终端。

description.en: Orchestrates multiple agents with resource awareness for efficient task execution in Codex and DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在Codex和DeepSeek Harness中资源感知地编排多代理，高效执行任务。

description.en: DSH 上下文注入审计插件：统计 AGENTS.md 指令链/技能目录/工具 schema 的 token 成本，检测重复与冲突；Web UI 圆环面板 + context_audit 工具。Context Doctor for DeepSeek Harness: audit instruction-chain / skill catalog / tool schemas token cost.
description.zh: 上下文注入审计：统计指令链/技能目录/工具 schema 的 token 成本，检测重复与冲突。

description.en: MCP server configuration card for the DSH Web GUI: add / edit / enable / disable MCP servers over stdio (local subprocess) or streamable-http (remote), with js: prefixed expressions for env / header values, status badges, and hot-reload on save.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 MCP 服务器配置卡片：增删改查与启用/停用 MCP 服务器（stdio 本地子进程 / streamable-http 远程两种传输），env / headers 值支持 js: 前缀表达式，带状态徽标，保存即热生效。

description.en: Adds a sidebar question-asking tab to DeepSeek Harness, enabling Codex-style side questions or Claude Code's /btw feature.
description.zh: 一个基于DSH-better-sidebar的侧边栏提问tab，实现类codex的侧边提问或claude code的/btw功能

description.en: Full-text global search for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar search box that searches history sessions (via the sessionQuery index, with a per-session scan fallback) and settings panels, highlights matches, and jumps to the matching session or settings card.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的全局搜索插件：侧边栏全局搜索框全文搜索历史会话（走 sessionQuery 全文索引，未启用时降级为逐会话扫描）与设置面板，关键词高亮，点击直达会话或对应设置卡片。

description.en: Configure reasoning-effort levels and sub-agent defaults for custom DSH models.
description.zh: 为 DSH 自定义模型配置思考档位和子 agent 默认思考强度。

description.en: Daily RSS/Atom news digest for DSH: built-in channels plus a curated awesome-rsshub-routes catalog and custom feeds (validated on save), aggregated into one "今日值得读" Markdown digest each day and injected into the system prompt; Web GUI settings card and sidebar reader.
description.zh: DSH 的 RSS/新闻聚合插件：内置渠道库 + awesome-rsshub-routes 精选订阅源目录 + 自定义源（保存时真实抓取校验），每天自动汇总成「今日值得读」Markdown 并注入 systemPrompt；带 Web 设置卡片与侧边栏阅读弹窗。

description.en: 为 better-sidebar 提供 Office 三件套预览（.docx/.xlsx/.pptx），独立 bundle 瘦身主体 | Provides Office-suite preview (.docx/.xlsx/.pptx) for better-sidebar as a separate bundle to slim the core
description.zh: 为 better-sidebar 插件添加 Office 文档预览，作为独立包分发。

description.en: DSH notification & remote-control plane: one `notify()` API across 28 outbound channels, six inbound control channels, phone approvals/questions/task control, a Native DSH Notify & Control UI, live outbound hot-apply, multi-agent routing, and zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: DSH 通知与远程操作控制面：一个 `notify()` API 接入 28 个出站渠道，六条入站控制通道承载手机审批、提问与任务控制；提供 DSH 原生「通知与控制」UI、出站热生效、多 agent 路由，并保持零运行时依赖。

description.en: All-in-one board for DeepSeek Harness: MCP manager + Skills + WorkBuddy experts (attach/switch/detach any time) + tool-usage tailor + three direct markets (WorkBuddy connectors, SkillHub 190k+ skills) with one-click install · DSH 一体化看板：MCP/技能/专家随时挂换/工具账本/三大市场直连安装
description.zh: Skill + MCP + 专家统一看板：MCP 服务器连接状态、工具 Schema、启停与重连（全局与项目双作用域）、SKILL.md 技能启停、WorkBuddy 专家人设可在任意会话随时挂上 / 更换 / 取消（429 位，不受「会话已开始就不能换」的限制）、工具裁缝（扫描本机会话日志统计每个工具的调用次数、错误率与上下文 token 税，死工具一键禁用），以及三大安装市场（SkillHub 19 万+ 技能、WorkBuddy 连接器、47 个一手核实的内置服务）。

description.en: 催更姬：给大肥鱼一个小说工作台。写正文、理设定、画情节，和 AI 一起讨论、续写与改稿。
description.zh: 催更姬：DSH 小说写作工作台，支持章节编辑、共享剧情画布、人物与世界设定分组、写作预设和按范围导入导出，供作者与 AI 一起讨论和推进故事。

description.en: deepseek-harness plugin: sign in and manage accounts across multiple AI coding providers, with multi-account pools and silent credential refresh
description.zh: 登录并管理 16 个 AI 编程服务商的账号，另含一个跨渠道轮换渠道：多账号池、凭据自动续期、服务商支持时的积分领取，以及本地 OpenAI 兼容网关。

description.en: Monitors DeepSeek account balance and usage, provides official top-up links, and manages third-party plugins.
description.zh: deepSeek 余额监控与用量统计（DSH 动态 Cordis 插件）：余额监控 · 官方充值入口 · 用量统计 · 三方插件管理

description.en: deepSeek 余额监控与用量统计（DSH 动态 Cordis 插件）：余额监控 · 官方充值入口 · 用量统计 · 三方插件管理
description.zh: deepSeek 余额监控与用量统计（DSH 动态 Cordis 插件）：余额监控 · 官方充值入口 · 用量统计 · 三方插件管理

description.en: Bundles Chinese traditional wisdom skills like Bazi, Ziwei, and Feng Shui with a deterministic engine and dashboard.
description.zh: 中华传统智慧（玄枢）AI Agent 技能包的 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）Cordis 插件：八字/紫微/六爻/梅花/奇门/风水/五运六气/体质全融合，本地确定性引擎 + 可视化 Dashboard，一行 dsh plugin add 安装。

description.en: Host page for kit plugin configuration in the DSH Web GUI: registers a "Plugin configuration" section in Settings — peer to the built-in General section — through the official settings.section slot and declares a settings.kit.item child slot, which dsh-plugin-kit plugins render their own config cards into. Installing it alone shows an empty page; cards appear as slot-registering kit plugins are installed.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 中 kit 插件配置的宿主页：经官方 settings.section 扩展点在「设置」里注册一行与「通用设置」平级的「插件配置」页，并声明子 slot「settings.kit.item」，供 dsh-plugin-kit 各插件把自己的配置卡片渲染到该页。只装本包时该页显示「暂无可用配置项」，卡片随注册该 slot 的 kit 插件出现。

description.en: Adds a blue whale pet that idles and eats on your DSH interface, adding playful charm to the workspace.
description.zh: 在你的deepseek-harness上养一只吃白饭的大蓝鲸

description.en: Shows a whale girl desktop pet for playful companionship alongside the DeepSeek Harness interface.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness：鲸鱼娘桌宠！

description.en: Runs scheduled coding tasks in isolated DeepSeek Harness sessions, managed from Settings or the agent.
description.zh: 在独立会话里按计划执行编码任务，可在设置页或对话里管理。

description.en: dsh-plugin-kit is a general-purpose plugin collection for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI: environment variable / secret management, MCP server configuration, Prompt management, Profile management, RSS / news aggregation, and a desktop client launcher。
description.zh: 提供环境变量、MCP 配置、提示词、配置文件、RSS 和启动器等工具集。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness appearance toolkit. Independently tune opacity + frosted-glass blur across 8 surfaces (main background, sidebar, cards & panels, inputs & controls, settings, conversation frame, trajectory view, produced/highlights — 9 with dsh-better-sidebar). Use any image or video as wallpaper with a drag-to-pan, scroll-to-zoom position editor and 5 layout modes (Fit/Fill/Stretch/Tile/Center); videos loop muted, survive refresh, and capture a live frame for preview, color extraction and framing. Rotate a pool of images (shuffle/order, every refresh/daily/weekly). Also: PS-style color wheel, one-click wallpaper color extraction, 6 presets + saved profiles, day/night auto switch, and full theme export/import.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 外观一体化工具。对 8 个界面区域分别调节透明度与毛玻璃模糊（主背景、侧边栏、卡片面板、输入框与控件、设置面板、对话文本框、轨迹页、产出物/高亮内容；安装 dsh-better-sidebar 后为 9 个）。用任意图片或视频做壁纸，配有拖动平移、滚轮缩放的位置编辑器与 5 种布局模式（适应/填充/拉伸/平铺/居中）；视频静音循环播放、刷新不丢失，并自动截取一帧用于预览、取色与构图。把多张图片加入轮换池（随机/顺序，每次刷新/每天/每周）自动更换。还包含 PS 风格色轮、一键从壁纸提取主题色、6 套预设 + 命名配置、昼夜自动切换与主题一键导出导入。

description.en: Engineering-discipline guard: grill the requirements before the first edit, enforce red/green test evidence gates, and audit the delivery with a forked adversary (grill-requirements skill + tool-policy gates).
description.zh: 工程纪律守门：动笔前审讯需求，红绿测试证据门，交付后对抗评审（grill-requirements 技能 + 工具策略门）。

description.en: A general-purpose collection offering environment, MCP, prompt, and profile management tools.
description.zh: 通用工具集，提供环境、MCP、提示词和个人资料管理。

description.en: Log query card for the DSH Web GUI over Elasticsearch / OpenSearch: one query surface with per-dialect query strings and clickable examples, field-name completion, filter chips, a time histogram whose bars zoom into that window, field facets that turn a bucket into a filter, and a result list with level colors, stack-continuation rows, columns and paging; Docker container logs are a collection source that reuses the docker plugin. Ships five read-only loglens_* tools (sources / search / fields / facets / context) sharing the same execution layer as the panel. Outbound requests only reach configured sources, judged on the resolved IP, without following redirects and with size and timeout caps.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的日志查询卡片（Elasticsearch / OpenSearch）：一个查询面——按来源方言给查询串与可点例子、字段名补全、筛选芯片、可点柱缩放时间窗的时间分布、把分组的桶点成筛选、带级别染色与堆栈续行标记的结果列表（可选列、可翻页）；Docker 容器日志作为采集来源复用 docker 插件。agent 侧五个只读 loglens_* 工具（sources / search / fields / facets / context）与面板共用同一执行层。出站只打到已配置的来源，按解析后的 IP 判定，不跟随重定向，并有体积与超时上限。

description.en: GPU coordination for local AI companions on AstrBot / DeepSeek Harness: persona LLM, IndexTTS voice and ComfyUI selfies take turns on one 12 GB card. No proxy.
description.zh: 面向本地 AI 陪伴的 AstrBot/DSH 原生显存协调：LLM、IndexTTS、ComfyUI 轮流用卡，不加代理。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (dsh) dynamic plugin that cuts token cost without cutting model intelligence

description.en: Puts the Markdown documents, source files, images and video that already exist anywhere in the session workspace into the DSH sidebar, ranked by relevance to the current conversation. The default lexical mode matches your recent messages against title, summary and body locally with IDF weighting (BM25) — no model calls, no network, nothing leaves the machine. The list comes from scanning the workspace rather than from a recent-files list, so restarting DSH or opening a new session does not empty it. Results are organised into a three-tier reading order (primary / supporting / related) with a verifiable reason on every row — which field matched, which document cites this one — and one click opens an in-place preview: Markdown as rendered text, relative-path images actually drawn, source code with the host's own syntax highlighting, video streamed over HTTP Range. The same Context Pack is exposed to the agent as a knit_docs tool. Later versions added read evidence and lifecycle tracking (attribution is frozen at the moment of reading), pin / exclude (exclusion applies before retrieval, and is undoable), relation evidence (references / imports / tests, with line numbers) and an incremental index reused across restarts. Since v0.23 there is also an optional hybrid mode: it is off by default and only runs once you configure an Ollama or OpenAI-compatible embedding provider yourself. When it runs, what leaves the machine is your query text plus each candidate file's title and summary — a Markdown summary is an excerpt of the body's first paragraph (at most 60 characters), a code file's summary is its workspace-relative directory, and an image or video contributes its file name; full bodies and absolute paths are not sent, and a loopback provider keeps everything on this machine. Since v0.24 it also associates uncommitted changes: a read-only git status (fixed argv, no shell, whitelisted child-process environment) combined with the same reference / import / test / mention evidence shows which files a change is likely to drag along, and it is off by default. The benefit of semantic retrieval still awaits a real-provider run, so no recall improvement is claimed.
description.zh: 把会话工作区里已有的 Markdown 文档、源码、图片与视频列进 DSH 侧边栏，按与当前对话的相关性排序。默认的词法模式用最近几条消息在本地与标题、摘要、正文做带 IDF 加权的匹配（BM25）—— 不调用模型、没有网络出口，内容不出本机。列表来自工作区扫描，而不是「最近打开记录」，所以重启 DSH 或新开会话都不会变空。排序结果组织成主要 / 辅助 / 相关三层的阅读顺序，每一条都写明可核验的理由（命中了哪个字段、被哪一篇引用），点一行即可就地预览：Markdown 按渲染后的样子显示、相对路径图片真实渲染、源码走宿主自带的语法高亮、视频走 HTTP Range 流式播放。同一份 Context Pack 也作为 knit_docs 工具交给 agent。后续版本陆续补上读取证据与生命周期（归因在读那一刻冻结）、固定 / 排除（排除先于检索生效，且可恢复）、关系证据（引用 / 导入 / 测试，带行号）与增量索引（重启后复用）。v0.23 起还多一条可选的混合检索：默认关闭，只有你自己配好 Ollama 或 OpenAI 兼容的 embedding 服务才会生效。它生效时，发出去的是你这句查询原话加上每篇候选文件的标题与摘要 —— Markdown 的摘要取自正文首段（不超过 60 字），代码的摘要是它所在的工作区相对目录，图片 / 视频贡献的是文件名；完整正文与绝对路径都不发送，指向本机服务（loopback）时内容不出这台机器。v0.24 起还能做变更关联：用一条只读的 git status（固定 argv、不走 shell、子进程环境白名单），配合同一套引用 / 导入 / 测试 / 提及证据，指出这次改动大概率该一起看哪些文件 —— 默认关闭。语义检索的收益仍待真 provider 实测，因此不承诺召回提升。

description.en: Windows plugin that swaps the host shell executor for Git for Windows bash across every agent mode, materializes Git Bash variants of the standard, minimal, PTC and Cordis presets (per-file sha256-marked, user edits preserved), and exposes a gitBash capability so companion presets pick Git Bash automatically; when dsh-better-sidebar is installed it also adopts that sidebar's terminal shell (UI tabs and the model-facing terminal_* tools) through its official settings seam.
description.zh: Windows 插件：将宿主 shell 执行器换成 Git for Windows bash（全部 Agent 模式生效），并物化标准/极简/PTC/创造四个 Git Bash 预设变体（逐文件 sha256 标记、用户修改保留）；发布 gitBash 能力服务，让配套预设自动选用 Git Bash；若装有 dsh-better-sidebar，还会通过对方官方设置补丁口把其终端（UI 标签与模型 terminal_* 工具）一并切到 Git Bash。

description.en: Hacker News tools for feeds, discussion threads, search, and user profiles.
description.zh: 用于获取 Hacker News 榜单、讨论串、搜索和用户资料的工具。

description.en: Enables the AI agent to control your real Chrome browser through a plugin and extension.
description.zh: Chrome 浏览器扩展 + DeepSeek Harness 插件，让 AI Agent 直接操控你的真实浏览器。

description.en: Automatically add emojis to AI replies.
description.zh: 为 AI 回复自动添加表情。

description.en: Per-round cache billing inside the composer context-meter popover: what the current call spends on cache hits, misses, and output in CNY, with automatic official peak/off-peak and per-model pricing; hidden on non-official DeepSeek routes.
description.zh: 点开输入框旁的上下文圆环即见本轮账单：缓存命中/未命中/输出各花多少钱（¥），官方峰谷价与模型分价自动判定；非 DeepSeek 官方路由不显示。

description.en: Expose MineRU document parsing tools to the model.
description.zh: 向模型暴露 MineRU 文档解析工具。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for remote access: a token-gated reverse proxy keeps settings, credentials, and file access working over public tunnels and on other devices instead of returning 403. Per-device sessions. 支持通过公网隧道或局域网，在手机等设备上远程使用 DeepSeek Harness，设置、凭据与文件访问等功能保持可用。
description.zh: 通过公网隧道或局域网实现带令牌的远程设置和文件访问。

description.en: Provides TapTap Maker MCP tools and bundled game-development skills for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 TapTap Maker MCP 工具和配套的游戏开发技能。

description.en: Keep branching from any completed answer at any depth while the main session stays untouched.
description.zh: 从任意层级的已完成回答持续创建隔离分支，主会话始终不受影响。

description.en: Chrome 浏览器扩展 + DeepSeek Harness 插件，让 AI Agent 直接操控你的真实浏览器。
description.zh: 通过本地 WebSocket 桥接让 DSH 操控你的真实 Chrome：标签页管理、导航、DOM 快照、页面 JS 求值、点击输入、截图、等待与弹窗处理，默认关闭需在设置中开启。

description.en: Cyrene theme dsh plugin. Contributions are welcome!
description.zh: 把 DSH 界面换成昔涟粉白毛玻璃主题，还能改人格提示词、表情包和背景图。

description.en: A Claude-persona desktop pet pinned to the bottom-right corner of the DSH web GUI — shows balance, today's usage, peak/off-peak pricing and per-turn cost, with editable bubbles (text, balance, usage, pricing, images, random lines and weighted choices), per-line styles and fonts, a floating quick editor, sound effects, and custom character/audio. Ships animated roles that breathe and blink, plus a balance-alert variant that switches to a crying face when the balance falls below the alert line; 256/384 animation tiers and an optional 512 HD pack installed from the resource manager. 63 Claude-flavored lines. A derivative of MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget (MIT).
description.zh: 右下角的 Claude 拟人桌宠「小克」：显示余额、今日已用、峰谷定价与每轮消耗，泡泡内容可编辑（文本、余额、今日、峰谷、图片、随机语句与并列加权选择），支持逐行样式与字体、悬浮快捷编辑、音效与自定义角色/音效；内置会呼吸、会眨眼的动态角色，余额低于预警线时切换成哭脸，动图分 256/384 两档，并可在资源管理里安装 512 高清包；台词 63 条。二创自 MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget（MIT）。

description.en: Customize the "deep diving" thinking status label to anything you like.
description.zh: 把鲸鱼娘思考时的 "deep diving" 状态文案自定义成任意你想要的样子。

description.en: Reads assistant replies aloud via free Edge TTS or your own RVC voice models: read-aloud buttons + auto-read, adaptive chunked progressive playback (gapless long reads), one-click voice-pack installs from a registry, and a portable RVC runtime.
description.zh: 用免费 Edge TTS 或你自己的 RVC 音色朗读 AI 回复：消息朗读与自动朗读、长文自适应分块渐进播放（无缝衔接）、音色包仓库一键安装、便携 RVC 运行时。

description.en: Visible agent browser over CDP: 30+ bcdp_* automation tools, realtime SSE watch panel with direct click/scroll/IME input, element picking quoted into the composer as balanced @"picks/*.json" references, and human-verification notices.
description.zh: 看得见的 Agent 浏览器（CDP 接入）：30+ bcdp_* 工具，实时观察窗支持直接点击/滚动/中文输入，点选元素以 @"picks/*.json" 引用投进输入框，人机验证提醒；DSH 0.1.5/0.1.7/0.2.0 宿主各有一条对应版本线。

description.en: DSH web plugin: VSCode Remote-SSH-like remote development (SSH, remote workspace, file explorer, integrated terminal)
description.zh: 通过SSH提供远程开发，支持工作区访问、文件浏览器和集成终端。

description.en: Tunnel-mode remote control for dsh web: the plugin adds an in-harness Settings panel (cloud/self-hosted mode tabs, account login, bridge start/stop, feedback) with same-origin /dsh-remote relay routes; the desktop bridge and self-hosted relay-router in this repo tunnel local dsh web to a phone browser as an installable PWA with access-key auth, live device list and optional traffic quotas.
description.zh: 隧道模式远程控制 dsh web：插件在设置页新增「远程控制」面板（云端/自建模式切换、账号登录、bridge 启停、反馈）并提供同源 /dsh-remote 路由；仓库自带的电脑端 bridge 与自托管 relay-router 构成隧道，把本地 dsh web 以可安装 PWA 形式开放到手机（访问密钥认证、实时设备列表、可选流量配额）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 素材浏览插件：按工作区查看 MUSE AV 素材与出图记录，复制素材直链。DSH asset browser for MUSE AV workspaces, image libraries and generation history.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里按工作区浏览 MUSE AV 素材库和出图记录，点一下就能复制直链当垫图用。

description.en: 给 DSH 加一段自定义开屏动画
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一段自定义开屏动画，启动时播放视频，播完渐隐进入界面，自带默认视频装上就能用。

description.en: Session Workbench: full-text search past sessions, recall up to 3 as @references, and manage conversation-view tabs (show/hide + drag reorder).
description.zh: 会话工作台：全文搜索历史会话、一键 @引用 召回最多 3 个，并管理会话视图标签栏（显示/隐藏 + 拖拽排序）。

description.en: Enables SSH operations from chat with high-risk command protection and side terminal.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness SSH 运维插件：主对话驱动 SSH，带高危命令保护与右侧终端。

description.en: 把本机 WorkBuddy 桌面端已登录的模型（DeepSeek / GLM / Kimi / MiniMax 等）变成本地的 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 兼容接口 —— Claude Code / opencode / Cursor / Trae / Cherry Studio / LobeChat 等任意支持自定义 Base URL 的客户端可直连。附网页控制台与 DeepSeek Harness 原生插件。零依赖，仅监听 127.0.0.1。
description.zh: 把本机的本地 OpenAI 兼容桥注册成 dsh 原生模型 provider：复用这台机器桌面端已登录的模型，管理桥与其本地控制台进程，并附带 5 个工具、/workbuddy 命令与 9 个标签页的设置面板。需同机已安装并登录该桌面端；桥只监听 127.0.0.1。

description.en: Browser extension for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app. The model reads the page you are on as text with numbered controls and acts on it — click, type, scroll, navigate, manage tabs — and, when you switch image recognition on, looks at an image you point at. It asks before acting, keeps passwords in the page, and talks to your own desktop; the one
description.zh: dsh 浏览器扩展的桌面端一半：在 dsh 自带的 webserver 上挂一个带令牌校验的 WebSocket 桥，向模型暴露 browser_* 工具，让它读取并操作用户当前标签页，图片识别默认关闭、需用户自行开启。

description.en: Live theme editor for DeepSeek Harness with curated palettes and typography controls.
Godot Engine 4.x 全栈游戏开发技能插件 for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — registers the godot-4-development skill at runtime
description.zh: Godot Engine 4.x 全栈游戏开发技能插件 for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — registers the godot-4-development skill at runtime

description.en: Whale-maid paper theme for the DSH Web UI with light and dark palettes, ocean illustrations, hand-drawn frames, decorative assets, and a persistent pet.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 鲸鱼女仆纸质主题：浅色/深色配色、海洋插画、手绘边框、装饰素材与常驻桌宠。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle registering one skill that turns long-form production (academic papers, industry analysis, business commentary) into a 9-role pipeline: T1 literature / T2 data / T3 case scouts running in parallel, T4 analyst, T5 writer, T6 critical companion, T7 auditor, T8 finalizer run by the coordinator, T9 peer reviewer — across 6 phases with triangular evidence verification, a 26-check M-gate (25 scripted checks plus one human checkpoint), a G0-G16 audit including a Chinese AI-trace gate, peer-review scoring with journal matching, and 4 human checkpoints. Installs with `dsh plugin add lunheng-article-pipeline` (package.json#dsh.bundle.patch plus a lib/index.js entry that registers the skill); ships role cards for T1-T9, templates and 36 zero-dependency verification scripts, with five-language READMEs.
description.zh: DSH bundle 技能包：把深度长文生产（学术论文 / 行业分析 / 商业评论）拆成 9 角色流水线——T1 文献 / T2 数据 / T3 案例三线并行检索、T4 分析、T5 写作、T6 批判伙伴、T7 审计、T8 终检（主控亲执行）、T9 同行评审，跨 6 个阶段，含三角验证、M 门 26 项终检（25 项机检 + 1 项人工）、G0-G16 独立审计（含中文 AI 痕迹闸）、审稿评分与期刊匹配，以及 4 个人在环节点。以 bundle 分发（`package.json#dsh.bundle.patch` + `lib/index.js` 入口注册技能），`dsh plugin add lunheng-article-pipeline` 即装；随包 T1-T9 角色卡、模板与 36 个零依赖校验脚本，README 五语。

description.en: WorkBuddy-style skill picker: a button beside the composer opens a searchable list of installed skills; picking one inserts the official /skill-name gesture, so the skill loads with your message.
description.zh: WorkBuddy 同款技能选择器：输入框旁 ⚡ 按钮弹出全部技能列表，支持搜索与最近/常用排序，点选即插入官方 `/技能名` 手势，随消息发出自动加载执行。

description.en: Remote control for dsh web from a phone browser, from anywhere (no public IP needed): hosted cloud relay works over 4G, or self-host the router; one command installs the desktop bridge and this in-harness Settings panel (cloud / self-hosted / WeChat-bot tabs, account login, bridge start/stop, feedback); the tunnel data plane is end-to-end encrypted (E2EE phone↔desktop, with a QR / one-time-link desktop grant so you never re-type the password), with HTTP/WebSocket pass-through, access-key auth, a live device list and optional traffic quotas; the WeChat bot channel is bound by QR scan and pushes task-finished / error / stopped events to WeChat, where one number in reply approves or denies a pending decision and continues the current task — WeChat messages travel only between Tencent ilink and the local bridge, never through the relay.
description.zh: 手机浏览器远程控制 dsh web，人在哪都能用（免公网 IP）：官方托管中继 4G 即用，也可自建 relay；一条命令安装电脑端 bridge 与设置页「远程控制」面板（云端 / 自建 / 微信机器人三个 tab、账号登录、bridge 启停、反馈）；隧道数据面端到端加密（E2EE：手机↔电脑端正文与 WS 内容加密，中继只见路由元数据；支持扫码/一次性链接桌面授权，免重复输密码）；HTTP/WebSocket 全量透传，访问密钥认证、实时设备列表、可选流量配额；微信机器人通道扫码绑定后，把任务完成 / 出错 / 停下推送到微信，需要拍板时回一个数字即可放行或拒绝，回话可直接继续当前任务——微信消息只经腾讯 ilink 与本机 bridge，不经中继。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 破甲插件 dsh-purge 1.1.72 — 换包生效、账本自检、三平台分流
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Your coding agents remember what you decided — and what you changed. Plain-Markdown memory in Obsidian, shared by Claude Code, Codex and Cursor over MCP. Every answer cites its page; when the vault does not know, it says so. Imports your past sessions on install.
description.zh: 给编程 AI 装个共享第二大脑，每晚自动整理 Obsidian 笔记，精准召回还能拒绝瞎编。

description.en: DSH插件「DSH-Think-zh」 ：为利于中文使用者阅读推理过程、复核结论；在设置添加切换模型思考语言档位[简体中文/默认英文]；回复语言跟随提问语言，代码与标识符保持原文。
description.zh: 把模型的思考过程锁定为简体中文，回复仍跟随提问语言，代码和标识符保持原文。

description.en: Edge TTS voice plugin for DeepSeek Harness: read assistant replies aloud, auto-read toggle, voice settings panel (free, no API key)
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 用 Edge 语音朗读助手回复，支持自动朗读开关和语音设置面板，免费无需 API 密钥。

description.en: Local Obsidian vault as the agent knowledge store, with read-only DSH tools that route status, preference, correction, memory, project, search, and suggest to the matching page.
description.zh: 把本地 Obsidian 库当作 Agent 知识库，并用只读 DSH 工具把状态、偏好、纠错、记忆、项目、搜索与建议路由到对应页面。

description.en: 自动分类、收录和验证 DeepSeek-Harness 社区插件市场。 Automatically categorize, curate, and validate the DeepSeek-Harness community plugin marketplace.
description.zh: 自动分类、收录和验证 DeepSeek-Harness 社区插件市场。 Automatically categorize, curate, and validate the DeepSeek-Harness community plugin marketplace.

description.en: Delete DSH sessions from the web UI and desktop client: header danger button and session-row menu item with a risk-consent dialog; host endpoint and agent tool remove the session log, projection cache, and workspace accounting.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 与桌面客户端中删除 DSH 会话：头部危险按钮 + 会话行菜单项，风险确认弹窗，宿主端点与 agent 工具同步清理会话日志、投影缓存与工作区记账。

description.en: Layered memory for DSH whose agent-facing surface is 10 tools: high-privilege writes (memory_add, memory_delete, memory_import), rumination controls (memory_ruminate, _cancel, _status), and a memory graph (memory_search_graph, memory_expand_graph_node), built over an L0-L3 distillation pipeline that recalls and injects relevant memories before each model step.
description.zh: 分层记忆插件，面向 Agent 暴露 10 个工具：高权限写入（memory_add / memory_delete / memory_import）、反刍控制（memory_ruminate / _cancel / _status）与记忆图谱（memory_search_graph / memory_expand_graph_node），底层为 L0–L3 蒸馏管线，并在每步模型调用前召回注入相关记忆。

description.en: Manages a skill marketplace with APIs for install, removal, and details.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：技能市场——安装/删除/详情 API + 管理界面

description.en: Multi-agent team collaboration for DeepSeek Harness, with per-assistant models, skills, MCP servers, isolated contexts, and a shared workspace.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多 Agent 团队协作，支持为助手配置独立模型、Skills、MCP 服务和上下文，并共享工作区。

description.en: Voice AI girlfriend for the Web UI: FunASR mic input, Qwen3-TTS spoken replies, companion animation window, and two-way QQ chat (text/voice/image push) via NapCat.
description.zh: 浏览器语音插件，支持麦克风输入、朗读回复，带AI女友动画窗和QQ双向对话，陪你聊天解闷。

description.en: Amadeus (AI assistant from Steins;Gate 0) for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里还原《命运石之门 0》的 Amadeus，用 Live2D 立绘陪你聊天，带日语语音、长期记忆，还能主动来电。

description.en: Academic writing guard (EN/ZH bilingual): removes AI-style defensive writing, protects scientific evidence (numbers, citations, claim strength, null findings, scope) during polishing, and calibrates writing toward a target journal (Journal Profile + Journal Fit). Deterministic local regex/statistics, zero network/LLM; writing_rules / writing_audit / writing_style_profile / writing_journal_profile with auto-audit on paper writes.
description.zh: 论文写作守卫（中英双语）：去掉 AI 式防御性写作，润色时守住科学证据（数字/引用/主张强度/零结果/scope），并按目标期刊校准写作风格（Journal Profile + Journal Fit）。纯本地正则/统计，零网络零 LLM；提供 writing_rules / writing_audit / writing_style_profile / writing_journal_profile，论文写入后自动审计。

description.en: Quick sticky notes on the composer toolbar: jot ideas or TODOs, auto-saved as Markdown, one click to send into the chat.
description.zh: 编辑框工具栏便签，随手记点子和 TODO，自动保存为 Markdown，一键发送到对话。

description.en: Review agent file changes in a Diff panel, add comments for follow-up edits, and undo edited or newly created files.
description.zh: 在 Diff 面板中审查 Agent 的文件改动、添加评论以继续修改，并撤销已编辑或新建的文件。

description.en: Claude Science-style research workbench: ReAct research-loop engine (research_* tools), versioned artifacts with provenance (artifact_* tools), and 10 science skills for genomics/pathogens/bioinformatics.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 Claude Science 式科研工作台：ReAct 研究循环引擎（research_* 工具）、带溯源的版本化工件（artifact_* 工具）与面向基因组/病原体/生物信息的 10 个科研技能。

description.en: Rewind a DeepSeek Harness conversation and its workspace together without touching Git; every rewind is a fork and /redo reverses it.
description.zh: 同步回退 DeepSeek Harness 的对话与工作区，不碰 Git；每次回退都是一个 fork，/redo 可撤销。

description.en: A personal workbench with calendar, task list, and AI-assisted planning and execution.
description.zh: DSH 个人工作台：日历 + 任务列表 + AI 澄清/拆解/执行/复盘 | Personal workbench for DeepSeek Harness Web: calendar + task list + AI assistant

description.en: DirectorX as a DeepSeek Harness plugin: AI video/image/audio skills, knowledge corpus, and configurable vision/image/video/audio model tools.
description.zh: DirectorX：给 DeepSeek Harness 装上 AI 视频导演能力——视频生成、智能剪辑、成片质检、无限画布分镜与 350+ 导演知识库。AI video director plugin for DeepSeek Harness: text-to-video, smart editing, QC, storyboard canvas.

description.en: DSH插件，将微信私聊消息桥接到DSH，支持文本、图片、文件、音视频的双向传输。目标是在微信端还原DSH的原生体验
description.zh: 以进程内 Cordis 插件的形式，通过腾讯 iLink bot 协议把微信私聊桥接到 DeepSeek Harness——双向收发文本、图片、文件与语音，微信内 slash 命令经原生命令注册中心解析（DSH 新增命令零改动可用），支持在微信端处理审批与提问，并提供 send_wechat 工具主动推送。

description.en: DSH↔Godot engine runtime bridge: launch and drive a running Godot 4.x game through its in-game TCP interaction server — 16 tools (runtime control via ~130 game commands, scene/UI inspection, GDScript eval, input simulation, screenshots, headless static ops, project editing, export, script validation, engine-path setup), replaces godot-mcp.
description.zh: DSH↔Godot 引擎运行时控制桥：通过游戏内置 TCP 交互服务器启动并操控运行中的 Godot 4.x——16 个工具（约 130 条运行时命令、场景/UI 检查、GDScript eval、输入模拟、截图、headless 静态操作、项目编辑、导出、脚本编译检查、引擎路径设置），替代 godot-mcp。

description.en: Kimi no Na wa (Your Name) theme: cinematic wallpaper, comet-blue glassmorphism, movie logo swap and unified scrollbars for the DSH Web GUI.
description.zh: 《你的名字。》主题：电影壁纸、彗星蓝玻璃拟态、电影 Logo 替换与统一滚动条。

description.en: Adds a whale girl desk pet to the web UI with activity tracking, sleep system, and settings panel.
description.zh: 🐋 DeepSeek 娘桌宠：住进 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面的蓝发鲸鱼女仆。工作链路、任务完成统计（用时/消耗/花费）、睡眠系统、时间感知、余额/天气/喂食按钮、完整设置面板。

description.en: Local-only project memory with zero bundled runtime dependencies or external services: JSON as the source of truth plus generated PROJECT_MEMORY.md, token-bounded session-frozen Hot Memory for prompt-prefix cache stability, cached cross-project BM25 recall, trusted session/turn provenance, explainable pre-write duplicate/conflict governance, editable importance/pin/tags/supersede/archive lifecycle, configurable top-level turn-end distillation, and a bilingual Web GUI for search, inspection, diagnostics, and live settings.
description.zh: 仅本地运行、零捆绑运行时依赖（仅使用 DSH 宿主 peer）且不调用外部服务的项目记忆：以 JSON 为单一事实源并自动生成 PROJECT_MEMORY.md、按 token 有界且按会话冻结的 Hot Memory 以保持 prompt-prefix cache 稳定、带查询缓存的跨项目 BM25 召回、可信 session/turn 溯源、可解释的写前重复/冲突治理、可编辑的重要度/置顶/标签/supersede/归档生命周期、可配置的顶层回合自动蒸馏，以及支持搜索、检查、诊断和实时设置的中英双语 Web GUI。

description.en: Per-round thinking-level (reasoning_effort) control for DeepSeek Harness: pick Auto and it schedules low/high/max from the recent tool-call history, or fix a wire level (off/on/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh/max) manually, with custom wire mapping, a model-aware capability guard, and context-window presets (64K–1M); its per-model capability card pairs with a separate plugin, [dsh-llm-openai-completions](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-llm-openai-completions) (installable from dsh-market), so custom OpenAI-compatible gateways (vLLM / LM Studio / self-hosted) can try reasoning — the card writes llm-pi-ai capabilities, the adapter drives the wire (compat.thinkingFormat), and this plugin auto-maintains the takeover list.
description.zh: DSH 逐轮思考级别（reasoning_effort）控制：选择 Auto 即按近期工具调用历史自动调度 low/high/max，或手动固定线路档位（off/on/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh/max），支持自定义线路映射、模型能力护栏与上下文窗口预设（64K–1M）；其逐模型能力卡片与另一独立插件 [dsh-llm-openai-completions](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-llm-openai-completions)（可在 dsh-market 安装）联动，让自定义 OpenAI 兼容网关（vLLM / LM Studio / 自托管）也能试用推理——卡片写入 llm-pi-ai 能力，适配器接管线路（compat.thinkingFormat），本插件自动维护接管列表。

description.en: Long-term cross-session markdown memory with an LLM-Wiki structure and a SOUL.md persona, injected at session start (by default only after the first user message and only in the active session), plus remember/recall/consolidate/forget workflows, an embedded memory skill, pack/unpack migration tooling, and an idle-time first-person recall nudge that surfaces real memories in a companion voice. Also gives the store observability and upkeep it lacked: a per-file boot-block budget that keeps the index routing table from being truncated, automatic last_access stamping so salience decay actually works, a read-only memory health dashboard (size, freshness, lint-parity checks), a declarative index compiler (pages declare summary:, one command re-lines the index), an interactive memory graph (page links plus shared tags, draggable, wheel zoom), structured queries (tag/type/salience/hot/stale filters), cross-link suggestions for pages that have no relationship yet, and a `checkup` report that ends in a prioritised action list. The boot payload was also cut by ~23% by moving operational detail into the on-demand skill. Its settings section now carries its own navigation mark (a brain half wired to a node cluster, since the shell offers no icon slot to plugins) and a feedback entry that opens this repository. Requires DSH session format v4 (official DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+): injected messages declare the producer-owned source kind plugin:memory. v0.11 added a bilingual settings panel whose copy and sidebar label follow DSH language setting (中文「记忆」/ English "Memory"); v0.12 added the shared cross-plugin speech floor, a context-sensitive tone section and a weekly growth recap; v0.13 declares its DSH compatibility via engines.dsh (official 0.2.1-rc.5 series; older hosts are refused by the gate), adds a "Review now" button (POST /api/memory/control, action growth-now) that sends one growth recap immediately while still respecting the speech floor, panel accessibility (aria labels, status and alert roles, focus-visible rings), and the public PROACTIVE-PROTOCOL.md.
description.zh: 带 LLM Wiki 结构与 SOUL 人格文件的长期 markdown 记忆库：会话启动注入 boot 块（默认提问后才注入、且只注入当前激活会话），含 remember/recall/consolidate/forget 工作流、内嵌 memory 技能、pack/unpack 迁移工具，以及空闲时以第一人称主动追忆（recall nudge）的拟人化能力。同时补上记忆库原先缺的“可观测 + 可维护”：按文件分配 boot 预算（索引路由表不再被截断）、自动戳记 last_access（salience 衰减真正生效）、只读记忆健康看板（体量/新鲜度/与 lint 同源的体检）、声明式索引编译器（页面声明 summary:，一条命令重写索引行），可拖动、可滚轮缩放的记忆图谱（页间链接 + 共享 tag）、结构化检索（tag/type/salience/hot/stale 过滤）、针对「尚无内容关系」页面的补链建议，以及以「最该做的 N 件事」收尾的 `checkup` 体检报告。同时把操作细节移到按需加载的技能，boot 注入体量减少约 23%。设置区块现在还有专属侧栏图标（半脑 + 节点——因为设置 shell 不给插件留图标位）和直达本仓库的反馈入口。要求 DSH session format v4（官方 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+）：注入消息使用 producer-owned source kind plugin:memory。 v0.11 起设置面板与侧栏 label 跟随 DSH 语言设置（中文「记忆」/英文 "Memory"）；v0.12 新增跨插件共享发言权、按语境微调的语气段与每周成长回顾；v0.13 用 engines.dsh 声明 DSH 兼容范围（官方 0.2.1-rc.5 系列，旧宿主会被闸门拒绝），新增「立即回顾」按钮（POST /api/memory/control，action growth-now，立即发一次成长回顾且仍尊重发言权）、面板可访问性（aria-label、status/alert role、focus-visible 焦点环）与公开的 PROACTIVE-PROTOCOL.md。

description.zh: 给 DSH 换上 EVA 明日香暗色和绫波丽亮色双主题，带驾驶员选择、启动语音、时钟和音乐播放器。

description.en: Qwen Image 2.1 for DeepSeek Harness: native image editing on Apple Silicon MLX/MFLUX or self-hosted CUDA, LoRA, ControlNet, inpainting, presets & live agent progress. 本机生图 · 原生参考编辑
description.zh: DSH 的 Qwen Image 2.1 创作工作区：本机 MLX 或自己的 NVIDIA 服务器，支持原生参考编辑、LoRA、结构控制、蒙版、整套预设、图库与对话实时进度，提供校验更新和 Agent 安装指南。

description.en: Fills in the Web UI's missing IDE workbench: resizable chat / editor / files-and-Git columns in Conversation, multi-tab file editing with save and new-file, workspace Terminal, a file tree with name filter and open-in-external-editor, SCM (stage/commit/push/pull, branch switch, Git graph, inline diffs), a status bar, and git_* model tools.
description.zh: 为 Web UI 补齐缺失的 IDE 工作台：对话页可拖拽三栏（对话 / 编辑器 / 文件与 Git），多标签编辑（保存、新建、路径面包屑、行内 diff）、工作区 Terminal、文件树（按名筛选、用外部编辑器打开）、源代码管理（暂存/提交/推送/拉取、分支切换、提交图）、状态栏，以及 git_* 模型工具。
一键打包整合 DSH 插件，自动生成整合包，方便分享和分发。

description.en: Interactive K-line analysis for DeepSeek Harness with multi-market quotes, technical indicators, news, and fundamentals.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的交互式 K 线分析，支持多市场行情、技术指标、新闻和基本面信息。

description.en: DSH-vison is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds image understanding for text-only models by converting images into descriptions from a configured vision-capable model.
description.zh: DSH-vison 是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，为不支持多模态的模型补充图片理解能力。agent 仍可直接接收图片；插件调用 DSH 中已配置的视觉模型生成文字描述，再把描述交给纯文本模型。原始图片会保留在会话历史中，UI 仍可显示图片；模型侧则通过替换后的消息看到描述文字。readimage 工具也会采用同样的处理方式，多模态模型则自动放行，不重复识别。

description.en: Syncs the wallpaper currently applied in Wallpaper Engine to the DSH Web UI background through a local bridge: preview/capture/full render modes, monitor lock, a wallpaper library panel for local and market content, focus lens with eye tracking, immersive mode, and a Windows app launcher that installs software from direct links or a cloud-drive share link and starts it with one click.
description.zh: 把 Wallpaper Engine 当前应用的壁纸经本地桥接同步为 DSH Web 界面背景：预览/捕获/完整三档渲染、显示器锁定、本地与市场壁纸库面板、专注透镜与眼动追踪、沉浸模式，以及支持直链与网盘分享链接安装、一键启动的 Windows 应用启动器。

description.en: A drawer panel for the DSH web UI with a paginated list of free LLMs; one-click or batch writes each as a custom model provider into Settings, plus a local multi-key rotation proxy.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 右侧的免费模型抽屉面板，分页浏览免费模型，可一键或整页批量把模型写入自定义提供方，并附带本地多 Key 轮换代理。

description.en: Collection of skills for Upstash
description.zh: 为AI编程助手提供Upstash SDK技能包，快速上手数据库、缓存等操作。

description.en: dsh-qa · QA Workbench — A local software testing workbench plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Zero-dependency test project & iteration management with AI-assisted requirements, test cases, defects, milestones, reports, kanban and calendar.
description.zh: 本地软件测试工作台，零依赖管理测试项目与迭代，AI 辅助需求、用例、缺陷和里程碑。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-qa
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-qa

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: 基于deepseek harness的类MiniMax-Design的AI视频创作工作台
description.zh: 在本地画布上做短剧和动画，接 ComfyUI 出片，全程免费不联网。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle: the AgentRouter relay as one pi-ai route with a domestic/international endpoint switch, plus the outbound request compatibility the relay requires.

Drive OriginLab Origin scientific plotting from AI chat via MCP. 74 tools: modal-dialog watchdog, LabTalk safety gate, FigureSpec declarative YAML, fit params, matrix tools, matplotlib bridge, PPT assembly, editable OPJU delivery. Windows + Origin 2021+.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 在 AI 对话里驱动 OriginLab Origin 科学绘图与分析：62 个工具。模态对话框看门狗、LabTalk 破坏命令门禁、释放/重连、拟合初值/固定参数/加权、细粒度图与工作表编辑、矩阵工具、FigureSpec 声明式 YAML（可 diff 可重放）、MCP Resources 只读会话快照、matplotlib 图桥接、PowerPoint 组图、Graph Gallery 模板搜索、EPS 导出、文件访问白名单、视觉基准回归，以及带确定性反读验证的可编辑 OPJU 交付。

description.en: Match context windows for configured DSH models in one click, show capacity sources, and support selective bulk configuration, manual editing, and continuous synchronization.
description.zh: 一键匹配 DSH 已配置模型的上下文窗口，展示容量来源，支持勾选批量配置、手动编辑和持续同步。

description.en: A pluginized microkernel architecture for building, orchestrating, and extending multi-agent systems in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给多智能体系统搭一套可插拔的微内核，让流程能编排、状态有据可查、边界清晰可扩展。

description.en: A native DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin bridging dsh coding agents to Feishu/Lark group chats — one group, one project directory.
description.zh: 把本地 dsh 编程助手接进飞书/Lark 群聊，一个群对应一个项目目录，在群里就能直接指挥写代码。

description.en: DSKIN · DeepSeek Harness（DSH）卡通像素皮肤插件 / Cartoon pixel skin plugin for DSH Web GUI — 原始界面不动，像素宠物会散步、眨眼、跳跃 / living pixel pets that stroll, blink and hop
description.zh: DSKIN · DeepSeek Harness（DSH）卡通像素皮肤插件 / Cartoon pixel skin plugin for DSH Web GUI — 原始界面不动，像素宠物会散步、眨眼、跳跃 / living pixel pets that stroll, blink and hop

description.en: Hierarchical workspace tree for the DSH sidebar: every slash in a workspace title becomes a virtual folder (arbitrarily deep), the add-workspace directory flow gains a parent-group popup, renames re-derive the tree instantly, sessions nest on the same rule with separate visual styling, and every row carries right-click actions plus per-row appearance customization (color, text-only glow, font weight, primitives-family icon).
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏「工作区」列表的层级树插件：工作区与会话名称中的 / 即虚拟分组（任意多级），添加工作区的目录流附带「所属分组」弹窗，重命名即时重排；每层行均支持右键操作与外观自定义（颜色、文字发光、字体粗细、原版图标库图标）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Default System Prompt Management Plugin: Browse, search, and override the final system prompt assembled into each session round within the Web GUI "Settings".
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 默认 System Prompt 管理插件：在 Web GUI「设置」里浏览、检索并覆盖最终装配进每轮会话的系统提示词。

description.en: Play Gomoku against the AI, or let two AIs battle it out.
description.zh: 与 AI 下五子棋，也可让 AI 对局比棋力。

description.en: MCP server manager (stdio / streamable-http): per-working-directory project and global config tiers; project-level MCP collapsed into 4 atomic tools through a middleware layer by default (`middleware: all` folds in global servers too, hot-switchable in the settings page); workspace isolation prevents cross-project interference; configs keep `${ENV}` references only, with no plaintext secrets on disk; runtime registration API for other plugins to inject MCP servers.
description.zh: MCP 服务器管理器（stdio / streamable-http）：按工作目录分项目级/全局两级配置；项目级 MCP 默认经中间层收敛为 4 个原子工具（`middleware: all` 连同全局服务器一并收敛，设置页热切换）；工作空间隔离防串台；配置只存 `${ENV}` 引用、不落盘明文密钥；提供运行时注册接口供其他插件注入 MCP。

description.en: Project memory for dsh with native task-system integration: session todos and file reads auto-condense into cross-session task records (task↔file links), so workflows are switchable and resumable without re-contextualizing. Read-time memory (no upfront scan): extracts code symbols, summarizes docs, and cross-links docs↔symbols; optional TS semantic enhancement (auto on when TS installed). Experience notes auto-dedup. Every recall includes a traceable citation. Pure JS, single dep, works out of the box, silent operation, zero overhead.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness提供持久化的项目级记忆。专门针对项目开发，原生融合 dsh 任务系统，会话内任务清单与读过的文件自动沉淀为跨会话任务记录，任务↔文件自动关联——开发工作流可切换、可续接，无需重复梳理整个项目。文档与代码符号在读取时索引，无需全量预扫；针对不同语言的项目，支持可选功能增强。经验笔记自动去重，避免重复记录。所有数据召回附带出处可溯源。纯 JS、单依赖、静默运行、零操作成本。

description.en: Four-source migration wizard: move Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Hermes sessions, memories, skills, instructions and slash commands into DSH (/move wizard with approval gate and idempotent move.json, resumable sessions).
description.zh: 四合一迁移向导：把 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Hermes 的会话、记忆、技能、指令与斜杠命令迁入 DSH（/move 向导，审批门 + 幂等 move.json，会话可续聊）。

description.en: Appearance customization for the DeepSeek Harness WebUI: theme palette, wallpaper and video backgrounds, translucency and glassmorphism.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 外观自定义:主题调色、壁纸与视频背景、半透明与毛玻璃。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 服务器管理插件：可视化界面管理 + 按需热注入，OAuth 鉴权支持，环境变量配置。
description.zh: MCP 管理界面 + tool search：可视化配置/启停/刷新 MCP 服务器与工具勾选，按需检索（tool search）热注入；工具列表稳定命中缓存、不撑爆上下文。DeepSeek Harness plugin: MCP management UI + tool search — stable tool list, cache-friendly, no context bloat.

description.en: DSH 桌面端插件：游戏日常代理（原神 / 崩坏3 / 星穹铁道）—设置页逐游戏开关、排班、计划任务自动执行并汇报 | DSH plugin for daily game automation
description.zh: 把原神、崩坏3、星穹铁道的每日任务自动化，按游戏排班定时无人值守执行并汇报。

description.en: 🐖 DeepSeek Harness 养成插件，也可作为 Windows/Linux/macOS 桌面宠物运行；支持成长、学习、打工、钓鱼、图鉴与换肤
description.zh: 一只住在 DeepSeek Harness 里的小猪，能养成、打工、钓鱼、收集图鉴，还能当桌面宠物陪着你。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）提供的思考循环守护插件：模型陷入「只想不做」的退化循环时自动打断并注入纠正提示，任务继续往下走，不必再手动中止
description.zh: 模型陷入只想不做的思考死循环时自动打断，不用再手动中止。

description.en: 2000万+中小学K12真题题库 Skill：免费注册、免费抽题、教材/章节/知识点检索、练习测验与AI智能组卷。
description.zh: 接入2000万+中小学K12真题题库，免费抽题、按教材章节知识点检索，还能练习测验和AI智能组卷。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness原生风格提示音插件
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 原生风格提示音插件：智能体需要你决策或任务完成时播放提示音，点击系统通知可跳回窗口；支持重复提醒、静音时段，以及目标模式下只在最终轮提醒。

description.en: Live2D desk pet overlay for the DSH web GUI: mirrors agent state (thinking, idle, error, done, awaiting approval) with motions and speech bubbles, per-part touch reactions, drag-to-dock, switchable personas, and custom models via URL or local path.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Live2D 桌宠悬浮层：镜像 agent 思考/空闲/出错/完成/待审批状态，配动画与气泡，支持分部位触摸反应、拖动停靠、切换人设，以及通过 URL 或本地路径加载自定义模型。

description.en: Plugin marketplace for DeepSeek Harness — live-syncs the GitHub dsh-plugin topic (1800+ repos) into a searchable, paginated settings tab with one-click install and agent tools (market_search / market_install).
description.zh: Plugin marketplace for DeepSeek Harness — live-syncs the GitHub dsh-plugin topic (1800+ repos) into a searchable, paginated settings tab with one-click install and agent tools (market_search / market_install).

description.en: A fixed-corner DeepSeek balance whale widget for the DSH web GUI: three switchable skins (default / bowl-on-head / bowl-in-hand), balance with today usage, per-turn cost popups, peak/off-peak price conversion, press sound effects and random talk lines. Modified from MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面右下角的 DeepSeek 余额鲸鱼挂件：三套形象切换（默认 / 顶碗 / 拿碗）、余额与今日已用、每轮对话消耗提示、峰谷价换算、按压音效与随机台词。基于 MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget 修改。

description.en: A plugin management panel: one-click enable/disable for installed plugins plus a GitHub dsh-plugin marketplace with details and one-click installs.
description.zh: 插件管理面板：已安装插件一键启用/停用，内置 GitHub dsh-plugin 插件市场，支持详情查看与一键安装。

description.en: Zero-dependency toolkit: time / encoding / json / calculator / csv / regex / markdown / diff / stat / schema — ten deterministic tools in one install.
description.zh: 零依赖工具包：time / encoding / json / calculator / csv / regex / markdown / diff / stat / schema 十件套一键安装。

description.en: Desktop notification reminders.
description.zh: 桌面通知提醒。

description.en: Manage MCP servers and skills from a panel in the DSH sidebar: edit rows in the profile or global cordis.patch.yml, toggle them, check whether an HTTP server answers, scan Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / Gemini configs and import the servers they declare, and browse, create, edit, enable or delete skills by rewriting the user-invocable policy in SKILL.md.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏的面板里管理 MCP 服务器与技能：编辑 profile 或全局 cordis.patch.yml 中的行、启用停用、探测 HTTP 服务器是否响应、扫描 Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / Gemini 的配置并导入其中声明的服务器，以及浏览、新建、编辑、启停与删除技能（直接重写 SKILL.md 的 user-invocable 策略位）。

description.en: Search and manage archived and unarchived chats with read-only previews, tags and notes, workspace archiving, ZIP backups, origins and branches, manual residual-chat checks and automatic update checks. Retains legacy Recycle Bin recovery without automatic cleanup.
description.zh: 管理已归档与未归档会话，支持搜索、只读预览、标签备注、工作区归档、ZIP 备份、来源分支、手动残留会话检查和自动检查更新；保留旧回收记录恢复，停用自动清理。

description.en: Installs a multi-agent novel-writing preset for DeepSeek Harness: one conductor agent dispatches five specialized subagents — world-building, plotting, character management, prose writing, and QA review.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 安装一个多智能体小说创作预设：一个统筹队长派单五个专职子代理——架构世界、策划剧情、管理人物、执笔写文、质检复核。

description.en: Claude Code-inspired Auto Memory meets Codex-inspired Session consolidation, bringing simple, transparent, and context-efficient long-term memory to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 融合 Claude Code 的 Auto Memory 与 Codex 的 Session 记忆整理，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供简单、透明、上下文友好的长期记忆。

description.en: Per-model appearance for the DSH Web UI: an ordered rule list matched against the current session model name, each rule carrying its own wallpaper, theme colour, layout mode, framing and wallpaper opacity and blur, plus per-surface opacity and frosted-glass blur for the main background, left panel, right panel, cards and panels, input and controls, settings panel, conversation text frame and trajectory view.
description.zh: 按模型切换 DSH Web 界面外观：有序规则列表按当前会话的模型名匹配，每条规则自带壁纸、主题色、布局模式、取景与背景透明度、模糊；另有主背景、左侧栏、右侧栏、卡片面板、输入框与控件、设置面板、对话文本框、轨迹页的分区透明度与毛玻璃模糊。

description.en: DeepTrace — deterministic agent reports from session logs (daily/weekly/monthly/yearly/custom): cost & token breakdown, 8 insight rules, collaboration review, live provider balance, PDF/PNG/HTML export; read-only, never rewrites history.
description.zh: 深迹 DeepTrace — 从会话日志生成日报/周报/月报/年报/自定义区间报告：成本与 Token 拆解、8 条确定性洞察、协作复盘、实时模型余额、PDF/PNG/HTML 导出；只读，绝不改写历史。

description.en: 1:1 port of DeepSeek's official web right-side chat navigation rail (ScrollNav): hover-expandable rail, reading-position highlight, click-to-jump.
description.zh: 1:1 复刻 DeepSeek 官网右侧对话导航栏（ScrollNav）：悬停展开面板、阅读位置高亮、点击跳转。

description.en: Multi-provider usage stats framework (v2 adapter contract): persistent capsule plus detail panel; DeepSeek official (interval-bookkeeping daily usage derivation with a peak/valley countdown badge, working even without an official usage endpoint) and OpenCode Go built in; any other data source joins by dropping in a single mjs adapter file, hot-swappable from the settings page, with API keys kept on the host.
description.zh: 多 provider 用量统计框架（v2 适配器契约）：常驻胶囊 + 详情面板；内置 DeepSeek 官方（区间记账法推算每日用量 + 峰谷倒计时徽标，官方无用量接口也能算）与 OpenCode Go；其他数据源只需放入一个 mjs 适配器文件即可接入，设置页热插拔，密钥只留在宿主端。

description.en: Role-based LLM retry & fallback strategies.
description.zh: 基于角色的模型重试与备用策略。

description.en: Task-event notification center: 6 event kinds (ask / approval / completion / subagent completion / error / turn end), dual channels (browser Notification + host system toast) plus Bark/Webhook push channels (ntfy, Gotify, self-hosted gateways); quiet hours with urgent exceptions, approval-timeout re-reminders, completion-storm aggregation, and notification text redaction.
description.zh: 任务事件通知中心：6 类事件（提问 / 审批 / 完成 / 子代理完成 / 错误 / 轮次完成），双通道（浏览器通知 + 宿主系统 toast）外加 Bark/Webhook 推送频道（ntfy、Gotify、自建网关）；支持免打扰时段与紧急例外、审批超时二次提醒、完成风暴聚合、通知文本脱敏。

description.en: AI 写长篇的四个死法：设定崩、看不见前文、水文超字数、满屏 AI 味——这个插件全用代码堵死。细纲不批准就不给写章，设定改值直接拒绝，重复句段机审拦下，六维去 AI 味扫描零 token。右侧栏锻炉面板带听书、全书体检、批量起草断点续跑；20 个 novel_* 工具，你只管讲故事，把关交给代码。Novel-writing guardrails plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
description.zh: 小说写作护栏插件：20 个 novel_* 工具以代码强制事实账本一致性、阶段与落盘门禁、确定性机审与提案制修订；右侧栏工作台提供阅读/听书/润色/校对/全书体检/批量起草，旁路引擎让内部工序不占主对话。

description.en: Reference and control existing Chrome and Edge tabs from DeepSeek Harness (DSH plugin + companion extension)
description.zh: 用 @ 引用已登录的 Chrome / Edge 标签页和已授权的本地 HTML，读取、批量操作、截图并调用 WebMCP；拖动批注浮窗，将多条批注加入聊天草稿。按用户明确给出的本地文件路径上传，支持隐藏 input、自定义选择器及 iframe。轻量快照句柄使用新元素引用前需读取游标；浏览器输入显示独立停止按钮。选择运行中的 Windows 应用，优先连接匹配的本地 MCP，未安装先询问，无匹配时使用 Cua Driver，支持打字、快捷键、控件分页和操作后校验。复用 Windows helper，后台输入能力取决于应用。

description.en: ⚡ Millisecond System-1 judgement for every tool call in DeepSeek Harness — Jev-powered risk classification & evidence-gated auto-approval. Fail-closed by construction. dsh 生态第一个 System-1 决策插件
description.zh: 给每次工具调用做毫秒级风险判定，自动放行低风险操作、拦截可疑行为，让 Agent 跑得更快也更安全。

description.en: Pair a second model that passively reviews each turn and injects notes.
description.zh: 搭配一个副模型，每轮被动审查并注入见解。

description.en: 为 Deepseek Harness 提供会话完成等四种状态的通知响应，支持浏览器提示和提示词
description.zh: 会话完成时自动通知你，支持浏览器弹窗和提示词，不错过任何重要节点。

description.en: Lets the primary model ask an independent reviewer model to review a decision it has already made, with off, shadow and advisory modes. Requires your own service implementing POST /v1/decision.
description.zh: 让主模型把已形成的决策交给独立评审模型复核，支持 off、shadow、advisory 三种模式；需自备实现 POST /v1/decision 的复核服务。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件:论文伴读工作台 —— PDF 转录 / 检索 / 流式问答 + 内置阅读器页面。
description.zh: 把论文 PDF 变成能对话的阅读工作台，转录、检索、流式问答一站搞定。

description.en: 一键同步壁纸引擎各类动态场景壁纸的插件，设置应用启动项。A "wallpaper engine" synchronization plugin mounted on the deepseek harness can synchronize static wallpapers
description.zh: 把 Wallpaper Engine 的壁纸实时同步成 DSH 网页背景，还带可调面板，让界面更好看。

description.en: 将千星沙箱（原神千星奇域）知识库接入 Deepseek Harness 的插件
description.zh: 将千星沙箱（原神千星奇域）知识库接入 Deepseek Harness 的插件

description.en: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 的 QQ2006 皮肤插件：注册 qq2006 主题、镜像 body[data-ds-skin]、全局皮肤表与完整素材
description.zh: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 的 QQ2006 皮肤插件：注册 qq2006 主题、镜像 body[data-ds-skin]、全局皮肤表与完整素材

description.en: 面向公网的多租户 DSH 托管平台 —— 部署到一台公网服务器后，多个用户注册并经管理员审核，各自获得一套相互隔离的 deepseek-harness（DSH）环境，随时通过域名安全访问。
description.zh: 把 DSH 部署到公网服务器，多用户注册审核后各得一套隔离环境，用域名随时安全访问。

description.en: GitHub-style usage heatmap dashboard: per-workspace turn counts and token spend (with cache-hit rate), DeepSeek account balance, and workspace aliases.
description.zh: GitHub 风格用量热力图看板：按工作区统计使用次数与 Token 花费（含缓存命中率）、DeepSeek 账户余额查询、工作区别名管理。

description.en: Second model passively reviews each turn and injects advice
description.zh: 第二模型被动审查每轮并注入建议

description.en: Read-only Git and SVN code review using the current DSH agent model, with change previews, explicit context and approval-gated model requests.
description.zh: 复用当前 DSH Agent 模型只读审查 Git 与 SVN 变更，支持变更预览、显式上下文及经审批的模型请求。

description.en: File-based cross-session memory: plain Markdown memory files with automatic retrieval injection, format-compatible with Claude Code's CLAUDE.md and memory files, so migrating is a manual file copy.
description.zh: 基于文件的跨会话记忆：纯 Markdown 记忆文件，检索结果自动注入；格式与 Claude Code 的 CLAUDE.md 及记忆文件兼容，迁移即手工复制文件。

description.en: Adds an optimize button beside the composer that analyzes and rewrites the prompt draft with SSE streaming, conversation-context awareness (template vs intent-polish strategies), an edit-continuity memory chain, undo, and model routing with fallback and a connectivity test.
description.zh: 在输入框旁加「优化」按钮：流式分析并改写提示词草稿，支持会话上下文感知（模板/润色双策略）、跨编辑记忆链与撤回，模型路由带 fallback 与连通性测试。

description.en: Isolated-environment browser verification skill for DSH plugin development: a throwaway DSH_HOME, its own `verify_<random>` profile, its own port and its own browser instance in one command, cleaned up on exit, so the profile you are actually using is never touched; ships a zero-dependency raw-CDP driver (snapshot / click / screenshot / eval) and an optional isolation audit.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 插件开发的隔离环境浏览器验证 skill：一条命令拉起临时 DSH_HOME、独立 `verify_<随机>` profile、独立端口与独立浏览器实例，退出自动清理，不污染正在使用的 profile；自带零依赖 raw-CDP 浏览器驱动（快照 / 点击 / 截图 / 求值）与可选隔离审计。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 多 CLI 智能体侧栏插件：独立对话、账号管理、角色预设与任务续聊
description.zh: 在侧栏里给不同 CLI 派活，选模型和角色，随时看进度、收结果、接着聊。

description.en: Web GUI 里的 IDE 风格 Git 面板——分支/提交历史总览、变更提交与 amend、AI 生成提交信息、文件浏览、代码与图片新旧差异对照、输入框分支标记、针对移动端优化 | an IDE-style Git panel for the Web GUI — branches & history, commit/amend for local changes, AI-generated commit messages, a file browser, code & image before/after diffs, an input-bar branch marker, optimized for mobile
description.zh: 在对话工作区里直接看分支、提交历史和改动差异，随手提交代码，不用切终端。

description.en: Connect Qoder (Lingma CN / international) models to DeepSeek Harness through their PATs, with a multi-account pool, daily check-in, automatic failover, and a read-only credits overview.
description.zh: 把 Qoder（灵码国内版/国际版）模型接进 DSH，支持多账号池、每日签到、自动换号和积分查看。

description.en: 掌上 DSH（dsh-in-hand）：DeepSeek Harness 的手机端，不用装 App——一份只读任务监控页长成的手机浏览器客户端（PWA）：会话、实时对话、交付文件、后台任务与待批准；也自带一个 GUI 侧边栏面板。 / DSH in hand: the phone client for DeepSeek Harness with no app to install, plus a GUI sidebar panel.
description.zh: 掌上 DSH（dsh-in-hand）：DeepSeek Harness 的手机端，不用装 App（PWA）。公网与局域网两个入口可随时切换；在手机上读会话、子代理、目标轮次、工作流、后台任务与待审批，和任意会话实时对话（流式回复、工具调用进度、随时停止、切换会话与模型），消息可排队并「立即发送」，支持上传与交付文件。另含 GUI 侧边栏面板；原名 dsh-taskwatch，npm 包已改为 dsh-in-hand。

description.en: 让 DeepSeek Harness 真的玩 Minecraft：AI 有自己的角色，能探索、挖矿、合成、熔炼、打怪、建造。基于 yzi1b/whale-craft 独立维护。
description.zh: 给 DSH 里的 AI 一副能动手的身体，让它真的进 Minecraft 探索、挖矿、合成、打怪、建造。

issues.detail: declares install-time scripts; the harness gates them via allowBuilds

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-mc-agent
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-mc-agent

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: 在 DSH 里把 React 工程做成视频。 首次使用需准备官方渲染环境 欢迎提交 issues 和 PR。
description.zh: Remotion 官方 12 技能：React 编程式视频（动画/音频/字幕/3D/地图/图表/渲染/Studio），安装即用，附随包资源完整性自检。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Self-contained browser runtime plugin for DeepSeek Harness — bundles Playwright (chromium) and OpenCLI as plugin-local dependencies, exposes a browser service and interactive browser tools.
description.zh: 自包含浏览器运行时：Playwright（chromium）+ OpenCLI 作为插件本地依赖（全局复用回退），提供 `browser` 服务与 9 个交互式浏览器工具。

description.en: 万象知识库：DeepSeek Harness 本地知识库插件，支持一键会话存入知识库，让你的deepseek与你一起无限进步！  好用的话求个星星！
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek 会话一键存进本地知识库，随时翻查复用，越用越聪明。

description.en: OpenTelemetry GenAI tracing for DSH: one span tree per turn (steps, LLM calls with TTFT, tool executions, token usage), exported over standard OTLP to any compatible backend, content capture off by default.
description.zh: 给 DSH 每轮对话生成 OpenTelemetry 调用链，看清步骤、模型耗时和工具执行，还能导出到任意 OTLP 后端。

description.en: Visual AI workflow orchestrator for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): multi-agent DAGs, live execution, recovery, and Feishu integration.
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Adaptive deep-research orchestrator (workflow engine).
description.zh: 把深度研究变成自适应工作流，自动拆解问题、迭代检索并生成研究报告。

description.en: Access the dsh web UI over LAN: HTTP/HTTPS/WS forwarding plus TLS (self-signed or custom certificates); adaptive Brotli/gzip compression for HTTP and permessage-deflate for WebSocket; half-open WebSocket probing keeps mobile clients from going stale after backgrounding; launch-token auto-injection lets LAN devices connect without copying the token; DNS-rebinding protection + loopback-only upstream allowlist.
description.zh: 局域网访问 dsh web UI：HTTP/HTTPS/WS 转发 + TLS（自签名/自定义证书）；HTTP 自适应 Brotli/gzip 与 WebSocket permessage-deflate 双压缩；WS 半开探活，移动端切后台不僵死；启动令牌自动注入，LAN 设备免手工拿 token；DNS 重绑定防护 + 回环-only 上游白名单。

description.en: Two-way Codex↔DSH bridge: skills from ~/.codex/skills, session import with workspace attach, live MCP mirroring of mcp_servers, and a Codex-side reverse MCP installer.
description.zh: Codex 与 DSH 双向桥接：挂载 ~/.codex/skills、带工作区绑定的会话导入、mcp_servers 实时镜像，以及 Codex 端反向 MCP 安装器。

description.en: Edit a sent message to rewind and branch the conversation from that turn, switch versions with a counter under the bubble, and browse every branch in a turn-level version tree.
description.zh: 编辑已发送的消息即可从该轮次回溯并分叉对话，用气泡下方的计数器切换版本，并在轮次级版本树中浏览所有分支。

description.en: Coding-subscription OAuth for SuperGrok/Grok Build, ChatGPT Plus Codex, Kimi Code and Claude Code, plus an opt-in loopback OpenAI/Anthropic gateway: local login without pasting tokens, AUTH refresh-and-retry, grok-4.6 xhigh, and API-key route coexistence.
description.zh: 编码订阅 OAuth，支持 SuperGrok / Grok Build、ChatGPT Plus Codex、Kimi Code、Claude Code，并提供可选 loopback OpenAI/Anthropic 网关：本地登录无需粘贴 token，支持 AUTH 刷新重试、grok-4.6 xhigh，并可与 API-key 路由共存。

description.en: China A-share financial data MCP server for the harness: 11 fin_data__* tools (quotes/K-lines/financials/calendar/special-data/announcements/EDB/reconcile/funds/indices) over THS free official REST (primary) + AKShare (fallback) + Wind (exclusive domains), with observable degradation, context-budget compression (result-side -72.2% measured), and an offline 10-year market-data lake; BYOK.
description.zh: 中国 A 股金融数据 MCP server：11 个 fin_data__* 工具（行情/K线/财务/日历/特色数据/公告/EDB/对账/基金/指数），同花顺免费官方 REST 主干 + AKShare 兜底 + Wind 独家域，降级全程可观测；上下文压缩（实测结果侧 -72.2%）；离线 10 年数据湖；BYOK 零平台密钥。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-v587d-capital-generation
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for capital-generation

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Live subagent run monitor for the Web UI: a sidebar footer trigger plus a fixed top-right card panel showing each subagent of the current session in real time (running/elapsed, terminal outcomes, tree indent), with one-click jump into the child conversation and a return button, refresh-surviving and mobile-hidden by default.
description.zh: Web UI 子代理实时监视面板：侧边栏底部入口 + 右上角常驻卡片面板，实时展示当前会话每个子代理的运行状态（运行中/耗时/终态）、树形缩进，一键跳转子代理会话并支持返回主会话，刷新自恢复、移动端默认隐藏。

description.en: TinyFish-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: each search is one GET to the TinyFish Search API, no model call.
description.zh: 基于 TinyFish 的网页搜索提供方：把内置 web_search 接到 TinyFish Search API，每次搜索一次 GET，不消耗模型调用。

description.en: Claude-style drag-and-drop/paperclip file upload with content sniffing, document-to-Markdown via Microsoft MarkItDown (built-in JS fallback), text inlining, and a read_document tool for agents.
description.zh: Claude 风格拖拽/回形针文件上传：内容嗅探、文档转 Markdown（微软 MarkItDown，内置 JS 兜底）、文本直插输入框、read_document 工具。

description.en: 在 DSH 里处理邮件，确认后再发出回复。 需要自己的邮箱授权或 AgentMail API Key 欢迎提交 issues 和 PR。
description.zh: 在 DSH 里收发邮件，回复前先让你确认，支持 IMAP/SMTP 和 AgentMail。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness gate - per-turn persistent-operation counter: remind, instruct the model to stop, then ask for confirmation. Steps aside under sandbox/read-only modes; follows a live permission switch without restart. Verified on real hardware (full -> workspace-write -> read-only -> full). Crafted on an estimated 0.27 USD of model spend.
description.zh: 按轮统计持久化操作，按总数逐级升级：先提醒，再给明确的停止指令，最后请求确认。每次调用都现读会话的沙箱模式，在 read-only 与 workspace-write 下保持沉默。

description.en: A cute whale desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness that keeps an eye on your DeepSeek balance and session usage/cost. Drag her anywhere, click to open a live panel with real-time spend, peak/off-peak pricing, budget alerts, and history trends.
description.zh: 一只可拖拽的鲸鱼娘桌宠，实时盯着 DeepSeek 余额和会话花费，点开就能看用量明细。

description.en: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 编码控制台变成泰拉瑞亚像素世界——向导陪你写代码，真实对话、工具审批、难度切换，单文件零依赖。
description.zh: 把 DSH 编码控制台换成泰拉瑞亚像素世界，向导陪你写代码，单文件零依赖。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that gives a roleplay character a clock: sleep/wake, greetings, idle actions, proactive small talk, and outing photos.
description.zh: 给角色扮演角色装上生物钟：会睡觉、被吵醒、自己找事做，还会主动找你聊天。

description.en: Mobile web shell for the DSH Web GUI: overlay drawers, draggable FAB, mobile composer fixes, and a floating image-upload button pinned above the composer (native gallery/camera, integrated with the validated add-images pipeline), zero desktop regression. Published on npm as dsh-webui-mobile.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的移动端外壳：抽屉式侧栏、可拖拽悬浮按钮、移动端输入框修复，以及悬浮在输入框上方的图片上传按钮（原生相册/拍照，走加图校验管线），桌面端零影响。已发布到 npm（dsh-webui-mobile）。

description.en: Zero-cost access to 6 free large models. No registration, no recharge, 6 free models built-in, multi-key rotation and rate-limit backoff.
description.zh: 0元接入6个免费大模型，免注册免充值，内置6个免费模型，多Key轮换与限流退避。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 打造的 Google Antigravity 模型提供者插件/Google Antigravity LLM provider for DeepSeek Harness with native Web OAuth, real-time quota tracking, and dynamic reasoning effort routing.
description.zh: Google Antigravity / Cloud Code Assist 模型提供商插件，支持配额查看与模型选择管理。

description.en: Block-addressed document editing: an MCP server exposing geml_get / geml_set / geml_check and friends, so an agent reads or rewrites one addressed block of a Markdown or GEML document instead of the whole file. Ships the GEML authoring skill and a code-graph skill that builds and navigates a project call graph as GEML codemaps.
description.zh: 按块寻址的文档读写：MCP server 提供 geml_get / geml_set / geml_check 等工具，Agent 只取回或改写 Markdown、GEML 文档中的某一个块，而不是整篇文件。另带 GEML 写作技能，以及把项目调用图构建为 GEML codemap 并浏览的代码图谱技能。

description.en: Free conversational ChatGPT Web (GPT 5.6 Luna) model provider for DeepSeek Harness with streaming Markdown.
description.zh: 基于免费 ChatGPT 网页端（GPT 5.6 Luna）的 DeepSeek Harness 零成本对话模型提供者，支持流式 Markdown。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Multisim MCP for circuit generation, simulation, diagnostics, design optimization, and experiment report export.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 Multisim MCP，用于生成电路、运行仿真、诊断与优化设计，并导出实验报告。

description.en: Usage statistics settings panel: 26-week activity heatmap, daily token trend with a cache hit-rate curve, per-model donut and breakdown, time-range filters, summary cards, one-time historical backfill and lossless rebuild.
description.zh: 用量统计设置面板：26 周活跃热力图、按日 Token 趋势与缓存命中率曲线、模型用量环形图与明细、时间范围筛选、汇总卡片，支持历史会话回扫与无损重建。

description.en: One-click optimization of a raw instruction into a professional prompt: three output styles, situation-aware role/task/goal profiling, multi-sample selection scored by a model judge, self-iterating learning (session memory + smart defaults + user overrides), /template for 22 sub-scenes with zero model calls, input-box ✨ one-click optimize/undo, prompt_optimize tool, auto-optimize hook, a runtime status page, a settings panel (dsh 0.2.0) and auto-detected zh/en documents.
description.zh: 把原始指令一键优化为专业提示词——支持三种输出形态、情境感知画像、多采样择优（模型判官评分）、自迭代学习，以及 /template 等命令与一键工具/钩子/状态页/设置面板/自动语言。

description.en: DSH 插件市场：Marketplace for DeepSeek Harness plugins · dsh-m
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接逛插件市场，找插件、装插件一步到位。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 电脑控制插件：截图、鼠标、键盘、窗口与剪贴板工具，按应用授权，Esc 暂停。
description.zh: Windows 电脑控制：截图、鼠标、键盘、剪贴板和窗口工具，按应用授权并经 DSH 审批；操控期间屏幕显示橙色光晕和提示条，按 Esc 暂停或继续。

description.en: HTTP + WebSocket 反向代理：把局域网端口转发到本地 DSH 服务
description.zh: DSH plugin (scoped package @smanx/dsh-proxy, matching the repository): LAN reverse proxy with native Basic Auth and a settings page. Source lives in this repo's dsh-proxy/ subdirectory; this root package makes the plugin installable from the repository itself (git/github: specs install the root).

description.en: Archive Management for DeepSeek Harness: search archived and unarchived chats, preview conversations, organize tags and notes, archive by workspace, keep ZIP backups, inspect origins and branches, check residual chats manually, and check for updates. Legacy recycle recovery is retained.
description.zh: 搜索、预览和整理 DeepSeek Harness 的归档聊天，支持打标签、写备注、按工作区归档和 ZIP 备份。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 用户记忆插件：跨会话保存原则、偏好与工作方式，按 token 预算注入。DSH memory plugin for persistent user preferences, explainable memories and budgeted prompt injection.
description.zh: 让 AI 主动记住你的原则、红线和工作方式，跨会话复用，还会遗忘和说明记录理由。

description.en: 办公三件套！Office document tools for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): generate, read, and edit spreadsheets (.xlsx), PDFs, and presentations (.pptx).
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接生成、读取和编辑 Excel、PDF 和 PPT，办公文档一站式搞定。

description.en: Just Jev it. A Jev-first agent loop with reusable actions for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 把模型当成工具来调度的 Jev 优先智能体循环，内置可复用动作，让任务自动跑起来。

description.en: OpenBMC 控制台入口：设置一级菜单「BMC 控制台」面板一键在顶层标签页打开 BMC Web UI，同源代理经 SSH 本地转发 relay（obmc-web-relay）抵达 BMC，BMC IP 变化自动探测并重定向隧道；需 SSH 跳板机可达 BMC。
⚠️ Internal beta, do not download ⚠️ iLife: one DSH settings card for the iLife home-life suite — memo, calorie, chef, home, schedule and bill in a tab bar — covering every part of your home life.
description.zh: ⚠️内测中勿下载⚠️爱生活-覆盖你居家生活的方方面面。

description.en: Windows desktop computer-use tools (click, type, key, screenshot) with freshness checks, approval gating, process-identity verification around every action, and a sanitized audit trail.
description.zh: Windows 桌面电脑操作工具（点击、输入、按键、截屏）：每次动作都带新鲜度校验、审批门、进程身份核验与脱敏审计。

description.en: Streaming fold for the DSH web transcript: the newest thinking window opens itself, older process rows fold into one summary, and a finished turn glides back to your prompt, which stays pinned while you read.
description.zh: DSH Web 会话流式折叠：运行中只展开最新的思考小窗、其余过程行折成一条摘要，一轮结束滑回你提的那句话；读到哪一轮那轮提问就钉在顶部。

description.en: Plugin governance: new/updated plugins stage in a candidate area first, then hot-mount after startup — success promotes, failure auto-disables, repeated failures freeze, one-click safe mode, sidebar diagnostics panel (npm: `dsh-my-guardian`).

description.en: Same-origin in mechanism with the two loudest lines in context compression. The code-skeleton gate follows the skeletonization approach of Headroom (Apache-2.0), whose published headline is 20% fewer tokens for coding agents and 60–95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. The estimator channel follows TokenPilot (arXiv:2606.17016), which reports up to 60% lower cost for long-session agents. Both figures are theirs, quoted as-is; this plugin ships no benchmark of its own and claims no reduction of its own. What it adds for DeepSeek Harness: choose a compression profile, set the Auto Compact trigger level and toggle code-skeleton compression from one settings section, with exact DeepSeek V4 tokenizer measurement, same-revision count verification, and fail-open behaviour that keeps the original tool results on unsupported models. Within a turn it supports skeletonized information compression with a low original-text retrieval rate; at the tail of a turn it supports a turn-tail intent summary implemented purely by content substitution; context content stays safe, and the whole process runs inside the official JSONL compression.
description.zh: 机制上与上下文压缩领域最响的两条公开路线同源：代码骨架闸门沿用 Headroom（Apache-2.0）的骨架化思路，其公开头条为「编程 agent 少 20% token、JSON 载荷少 60–95% token，答案不变」；估计器通道沿用 TokenPilot（arXiv:2606.17016）的缓存感知上下文管理思路，该论文报告长会话 agent 成本最高降低 60%。这两个数字都是来源方自己的口径，此处照引；本插件不自带 benchmark，不自称任何降幅。在此之上为 DeepSeek Harness 提供：在同一设置区选择压缩 Profile、调整 Auto Compact 触发水位并开关代码骨架压缩；基于 DeepSeek V4 官方 tokenizer 的精确计量与同修订计数校验；非支持模型自动 fail-open，保留原始工具结果。回合内支持骨架化信息压缩、低原文取回率；turn 尾部支持尾部意图摘要（turn-tail intent summary）且仅以内容替代方式实现；上下文内容安全，全程在官方 jsonl 压缩内。
