description.en: 一个致力于让Agent在日常交流中更加拥有“活人感”的DSH插件。
description.zh: 心跳循环：默认每 20 分钟自己醒一次——维护一份关于你兴趣与偏好的本地画像，按你设的兴趣范围上网搜新东西并存下来。攒到值得分享的内容，就向你绑定的会话送一份简短的素材包。能不能开口由代码里的规则决定（静默时段、忙时窗口、每日上限、冷却），说不说由那个会话里的 agent 自己判断。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Claude Code for dsh (DeepSeek Harness): runs your logged-in Claude Code CLI as a model provider, with live models, session resume, approvals, rewind, memory and remote SSH workspaces
description.zh: 把已登录的 Claude Code CLI 作为 dsh 的模型提供方：实时模型列表、按会话恢复、审批中转、回退、记忆面板，以及远程 SSH 主机上的工作区。

description.en: The ultimate DeepSeek Harness plugin for referencing anything — one @ menu for commands, skills, files, agent sessions, cloud drives, DSH sessions, and web chatbot conversations. | 最强的 DeepSeek Harness 万物引用插件——一个 @ 菜单，统一引用命令、Skills、文件、Agent 会话、云盘、DSH 会话及网页端 Chatbot 对话。
description.zh: 从 DSH 统一的 @ 菜单中引用工作区文件、DSH 会话，以及 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek、Grok 和 Kimi 的历史对话。

description.en: Make destructive AI-agent actions reversible by default — quarantine + audit + human escalation for rm/git destructive operations. Reliability infrastructure, not a sandbox.
description.zh: 把 AI 智能体的删除、git 破坏性操作变成可回滚，先隔离再审计，必要时转人工确认。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: a read-only ledger for the plugins you already have installed — a capability inventory with file:line evidence, declared-vs-detected reconciliation, cross-profile version drift, and a diff of what changed since the last scan.
description.zh: 盘点已装插件的功能清单，标注代码位置，核对声明与实际能力，跨版本追踪变化，让插件管理更透明。

description.en: Registers the fnOS CLI Skill and provides a matching CLI for fnOS device operations. For first sign-in, the user authorizes access in a browser and sends a one-time code back to the Agent; no interactive terminal is required.
description.zh: 在命令行里安装和管理 fnOS 系统，附带使用指南与技能集成，一条命令搞定。

description.en: Advanced model-context injection and request-only rewriting for DeepSeek Harness with native Keysmith rules compatibility.
description.zh: 只改发给模型的请求副本，不碰会话记录和本地文件，随时开关无痕的上下文注入插件

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 开机动画 + 聊天壁纸，一个插件：六幕冷启动动画（真声台词/可交互）+ 开场视频/底图/大字横幅。双击 安装.cmd 即可，出问题双击 卸载.cmd。
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Local GPT-SoVITS TTS for DeepSeek Harness: reads assistant replies aloud with a draggable mascot and one-click installer.
description.zh: 用本地 GPT-SoVITS 把助手回复读出来，还有只可拖拽的小吉祥物随手控制朗读。

description.en: DSH 字体插件：中英文字体分设、正文字号与代码字号、字距/行距/段距/首行缩进四根滑块，吸底总预览 + 确认制，配置写回 profile，不动 app.asar。
description.zh: 给 DSH 界面换中英文字体、调字号和行距，吸底预览确认后写回配置，重启不丢。

description.en: dsh-purge v1.1.71 完整源码镜像（原仓库 YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge 与 npm 包均已删除）。DeepSeek Harness 破甲 / 红队评测插件，支持官方 web 与桌面宿主。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 做破甲和红队评测的插件，帮你测提示词注入、查安全漏洞。

description.en: Incremental file mounting with read dedupe: mounted line ranges are never re-sent to the model, on-disk changes invalidate and remount, with a Mounted Files tab and token-savings accounting.
description.zh: 文件增量挂载，重复内容不再重发，磁盘变更自动更新，省 token 还能看账本。

description.en: 风插 2.0 — DSH 推理语域锚定预设：两个 agent preset（风插标准/风插 PTC）在 runtime-context 快照头尾各注入一次形式化约束，使推理以第一人称复数展开。定性=硬指令约束（非吸引子）；未证明能力提升，未证明无负面作用。Apache-2.0
description.zh: 给 DSH 加个预设，让模型思考时多说「我们来……」，推理口吻更像团队协作。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle plugin: process-discipline system-prompt section + deterministic progress nudge for silent tool steps
description.zh: 让 AI 干活时别闷头狂跑工具，主动汇报进度，过程更透明可控。

description.en: Factory (Droid) subscription quota as native DSH model providers, with three protocol routes, your own API key through a loopback gateway, and a settings page for connection status, quota, per-model token statistics and key switching.
description.zh: 把 Factory (Droid) 订阅额度接入 DSH 的原生模型 provider：三条协议路由、用你自己的 API key 经本机回环网关认证，并提供设置页查看连接状态、订阅额度、按模型的 token 统计与切换 key。

description.en: DSH 插件:直接复用 Codex CLI 本地登录订阅凭证,在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 ChatGPT 订阅模型,无需 API Key | DSH plugin: reuse your Codex CLI local subscription login to use ChatGPT subscription models in DeepSeek Harness, no API key required
description.zh: 复用 Codex CLI 的本地登录凭证，在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接调用 ChatGPT 订阅模型，免 API Key。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 —— 对话式游戏本地化：跟 AI 助手说说话，完成游戏翻译全流程。引擎适配器架构，首发支持 Ren'Py。
description.zh: 跟 AI 助手聊聊天，就能完成 Ren'Py 游戏从侦察、术语到翻译打包的全流程本地化。

description.en: Codex-style Computer Use for DeepSeek Harness: the official window2 13-method desktop surface plus Chromium automation, a visible overlay with Esc interrupt, per-app approvals and bundled skills. Windows, MIT, no Codex required.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接操控 Windows 桌面应用和 Chromium 浏览器，还能随时按 Esc 打断。

description.en: Synchronizes DSH profiles and local plugin source archives through WebDAV and S3-compatible storage, with encrypted snapshots, conflict-aware recovery, and explicit self-updates.
description.zh: 通过 WebDAV 和兼容 S3 的存储同步 DSH profile 与本地插件源码归档，支持加密快照、冲突感知恢复和显式自更新。

description.en: Mobile client plugin (cordis + dsh.plugin.json).
description.zh: 把 DSH WebUI 适配到手机窄屏，用横向翻页卡片加半开侧边栏，手机上也能顺手操作。

description.en: Ported from the ARS Claude Code plugin (44k+ stars on GitHub): academic research skills for DeepSeek Harness — a deep-research agent team, a paper-writing pipeline, a multi-perspective peer-review panel, and an end-to-end orchestrator, plus sixteen /ars-* commands.
description.zh: 把 Claude Code 的学术研究技能包移植到 DSH，帮你更高效地做文献调研和论文写作。

description.en: Browse plugins the way you would browse Steam Workshop
description.zh: 创意工坊式插件浏览器：侧栏常驻入口，搜索/最热/最新/近 7-90 天飙升榜、中文关键词映射、描述与 README 机翻、插件特征验证过滤、一键安装/更新。

description.en: Full-duplex voice plugin for DeepSeek Harness: local zipformer2 streaming ASR (no API key) → editable draft; Edge TTS or local VITS / Kokor…
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Free vision & image generation for DeepSeek Harness — paste an image into any chat, even text-only sessions. GLM-4V-Flash / Qwen3-VL / Gemi…
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Visual MCP manager for the DSH web UI: inspect, add, remove, enable/disable MCP servers and view their live connection status from Settings → MCP.
description.zh: DSH 网页 MCP 可视化管理插件：在「设置 → MCP」中查看/新增/删除/启停 MCP 服务器，实时显示连接状态与工具数。

description.en: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上「眼睛」和「画笔」——免费读图 + 免费生图 Skill。Eyes & brush for DeepSeek Harness: free image reading & generation. 👁️🎨
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上「眼睛」和「画笔」——免费读图 + 免费生图 Skill。Eyes & brush for DeepSeek Harness: free image reading & generation. 👁️🎨

description.en: 模型路由与成本优化器：简单问题 flash 直答、故障自动降级、会话 token/缓存/成本实时面板 | Model router & cost optimizer for DeepSeek Harness: flash quick-answers for simple questions, failure fallback, live token/cache/cost panel
description.zh: 模型路由与成本优化器：简单问题 flash 直答、故障自动降级、会话 token/缓存/成本实时面板 | Model router & cost optimizer for DeepSeek Harness: flash quick-answers for simple questions, failure fallback, live token/cache/cost panel

description.en: Role-based LLM retry & fallback strategy
description.zh: 基于角色的模型重试备用策略

description.en: Stickers.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上表情包能力，让用户和 Agent 都能发图斗图，聊天更有活人感。

description.en: Terminal-native TUI frontend for DeepSeek Harness that presents sessions, models, plugins, jobs, subagents, todos, and provider configuration through Harness capabilities while preserving real terminal scrollback.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的终端原生 TUI 前端，通过 Harness 能力提供会话、模型、插件、任务、子代理、待办事项和 Provider 配置，并保留真实的终端滚动历史。

description.en: MCP server manager for DeepSeek Harness: add, edit, enable/disable, restart and delete MCP servers from Settings → MCP 管理, with JSON export/import, four mcp_manager_* model tools and an HTTP API; install via npx, npm or cross-platform scripts.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 服务管理器：在「设置 → MCP 管理」中新增/编辑/启停/重启/删除 MCP 服务，支持 JSON 导入导出、4 个 mcp_manager_* 模型工具与 HTTP API，可通过 npx、npm 或跨平台脚本安装。

description.en: A web theme recreating the DeepSeek Harness homepage with a fluid background, an elastic pointer grid, animated fish, and adjustable effects.
description.zh: 复刻 DeepSeek Harness 首页视觉的 Web 主题，提供流体背景、鼠标弹性网格、动态小鱼与可调节效果。

description.en: Adds an unofficial Antigravity OAuth-backed LLM route, web search, image generation and editing, video understanding, quota status, and DSH Web settings controls.
description.zh: 通过非官方 Antigravity OAuth 通道提供 LLM 路由、网页搜索、图片生成与编辑、视频理解、配额状态和 DSH Web 设置控件。

description.en: Adds a /simplify command that asks the agent to simplify code within a selected Git change scope, including staged changes, commits, and untracked files.
description.zh: 提供 /simplify 命令，让 Agent 在选定的 Git 变更范围内简化代码，支持暂存变更、提交及未跟踪文件。

description.en: Interactive terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness: tables, Mermaid and chart rendering, side conversations, and the same Cordis plugin model as dsh Web.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 交互式终端界面：表格、Mermaid 与图表渲染、旁支会话，以及与 dsh Web 相同的 Cordis 插件模型。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-ephemeral-ai-mayfly
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for mayfly#mayfly

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: VSCode-style coding for DeepSeek Harness: Monaco editor (tabs/QuickOpen), agent edit-diff review (keep/reject/archive/rollback), LSP intelligence with VSIX installs
description.zh: 在 DSH 里用上 VSCode 式编码体验：Monaco 编辑器、AI 改动差异审查和 LSP 智能提示。

description.en: Use DeepSeek Harness from your phone or another computer. Host: mobile UI, pairing-code gateway, PWA and Web Push, plus sharing chosen sessions. Client: those sessions appear in another DSH desktop's sidebar. 手机和另一台电脑都能安全远程使用 DSH
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 变成手机 App，配对码安全远程访问，支持主屏安装和锁屏推送。

description.en: 在 DSH 里用 HTML 创作并导出视频。 首次使用需准备官方渲染环境 欢迎提交 issues 和 PR。
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接用 HTML 写动画并导出成视频，做动态内容更顺手。

description.en: 乔木 Home：让 Harness 成为一天的起点。会话搜索、今日重点、待办、记录与专注计时。
description.zh: 把 Harness 变成每天的工作起点：搜会话、定今日重点、记待办、写记录、专注计时一站搞定。

description.en: Chinese novel-writing workbench with chapter briefs, style checks, revision plans and cross-chapter continuity audits, using a bundled local model; also available as an MCP server.
description.zh: 网文作者的本地章节体检工具，16 个工具分析句式、情感和风格，模型本地跑不花 API 钱。

description.en: Official plugin & skill development kit for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Grounded in core runtime contracts for Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, and DSH.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 官方插件与技能开发套件，帮你按规范快速开发插件和技能。

description.en: DSH工作区内跨会话记忆插件
description.zh: 给 DSH 工作区加上跨会话长期记忆，关掉会话也不丢上下文，需要时按需取回。

description.en: 轻量版鲸鱼娘 DSH 皮肤 Lightweight Whale Musume theme for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换上鲸鱼娘轻量皮肤，界面更可爱，运行依旧轻快不卡顿。

description.en: 大肥鱼自动刷Pixiv｜DSH 插件：按你的口味刷 Pixiv，把插画 / 漫画 / 中文小说挑出来存到本地；标签先筛、再读图读正文确认
description.zh: 按你的口味自动刷 Pixiv，先筛标签再读图读正文，把插画、漫画和中文小说存到本地文件夹。

description.en: Continual self-evolution: versioned, auditable, rollback-safe harness state (prompt notes, memories, skills, subagent specs) refined from session trajectories.
description.zh: 让 Harness 从会话轨迹里自我进化，提示、记忆、技能都带版本可审计可回滚。

description.en: MCP bridge that lets ChatGPT web create, view, continue, and control DeepSeek Harness (DSH) agent sessions.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 让 ChatGPT Web 创建、查看、继续和监督 DeepSeek Harness Agent 会话与 Goal，同时保留 DSH 原生的审批、沙箱与工作区安全模型。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的「便携酒馆」插件：RPG 式 SillyTavern V2/V3 角色卡生成器 + 酒馆角色扮演聊天。支持世界书、角色卡 JSON/PNG 导入导出、面板主题与本地音乐。独立插件，仅依赖官方 @deepseek-ai SDK。
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的「便携酒馆」插件：RPG 式 SillyTavern V2/V3 角色卡生成器 + 酒馆角色扮演聊天。支持世界书、角色卡 JSON/PNG 导入导出、面板主题与本地音乐。独立插件，仅依赖官方 @deepseek-ai SDK。

description.en: Design aesthetics skill pack for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) - keeps vibe-coded websites away from the AI look. 6 styles: dark-saas, apple-minimal, neo-neumorphism, brutalism, glassmorphism, japanese-minimal.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 用的设计美学技能包，提供 6 种风格，让 vibe-coding 网站告别千篇一律的 AI 感。

description.en: Create and manage sandboxed JavaScript tools with a Monaco editor and model-driven tool lifecycle.
description.zh: 用 Monaco 编辑器创建和管理沙箱化的自定义 JavaScript 工具。

description.en: Git-style dot timeline on the right edge of the DSH web UI: one dot per user message, hover for content and metadata (time, turn, duration, TTFT, tokens), click to jump. Also adds a full-session message list, in-session and cross-session search, bookmarks with #msg= deep links, and keyboard navigation.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 右侧的圆点时间轴：每条提问一个圆点，悬停查看内容与元信息（时间、轮次、耗时、TTFT、token），点击即跳转。附带全会话消息列表、站内与跨会话搜索、书签深链接（#msg=）和键盘导航。

description.en: One shell tool for PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL on Windows plus an interactive PTY terminal; the default terminal is chosen by the user in DSH settings.
description.zh: 一个 shell 工具：Windows 上统一执行 PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL，外加交互式 PTY 终端，默认终端由用户在设置中选择。

description.en: Skills & MCP manager in the DSH web settings: browse/enable/import/delete skills across project and user roots, and manage stdio/streamable-http MCP servers with a real connection (tools registered as mcp__<server>__<tool>, config in ~/.dsh/mcp.json).
description.zh: DSH Web 设置内的技能与 MCP 管理器：在项目级与用户级技能目录间浏览/启用/导入/删除技能，并管理 stdio/streamable-http 的 MCP 服务器（真实连接，工具注册为 mcp__<server>__<tool>，配置存 ~/.dsh/mcp.json）。

description.en: Honcho memory plugin by Plastic Labs: injects the user profile, session summary and relevant conclusions at session start, uploads each turn to Honcho in the background with secrets redacted, and adds honcho_search / honcho_chat / honcho_remember tools plus a /honcho status command; configured through the ~/.honcho/config.json shared with the other Honcho integrations, against hosted honcho.dev or a self-hosted instance.
description.zh: 由 Plastic Labs 维护的 Honcho 记忆插件：会话启动时注入用户画像、会话摘要与相关结论，后台脱敏后逐轮上传对话到 Honcho，提供 honcho_search / honcho_chat / honcho_remember 工具及 /honcho 状态命令；通过与其他 Honcho 集成共用的 ~/.honcho/config.json 配置，支持托管的 honcho.dev 或自建实例。

description.en: Visual branch brainstorming that creates an isolated Session for each direction, automates parent, sibling, checkpoint, and return Handoffs, and provides a full tree tab with an optional Better Sidebar view.
description.zh: 可视化分支头脑风暴：为每个方向创建独立 Session，自动处理父子继承、兄弟感知、进展与回传 Handoff，并提供完整树形 Tab 与可选 Better Sidebar 右栏。

description.en: Conversation navigator panel: turn-folded outline of the current session with per-step kind badges (assistant, tool, command, compaction, error), a hover bubble showing the full user question, a minimal mode that hides turn numbers for an all-badge view, keyword filter over user questions and assistant replies, click-to-jump with reading-position tracking, and load-earlier/load-all history paging. Host >= 0.1.2-rc.1; legacy hosts install @legacy/0.2.5.
description.zh: 会话导航面板：按轮折叠的当前会话大纲与步次类型徽标（助手/工具/命令/压缩/出错），悬停气泡显示用户提问全文，可隐藏轮次号的极简徽标视图，仅检索提问与助手回复的关键词过滤，点击跳转与阅读位置跟踪，支持加载更早/加载全部历史分页。宿主 ≥ 0.1.2-rc.1，旧宿主装 @legacy/0.2.5。

description.en: Free model provider plugin for DSH with 20+ models including Gemini, MiMo, GLM, etc.
description.zh: DSH free model provider plugin with 20+ models including Gemini, MiMo, GLM, etc.

description.en: Installs Herta as a DeepSeek Harness agent: a preset carrying her persona and memory prompt sections, six memory and voice tools, a narrative layer that separates her thinking from what she says, 80 bundled voice clips, offline and MiniMax speech synthesis, and two conversation views that render the session with her own components.
description.zh: 把 Herta（黑塔）作为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体装入：携带人格与记忆提示词段的 preset、六个记忆与语音工具、区分内心与发言的叙述层、80 条随包语音、本地与 MiniMax 两条语音合成链路，以及两个用她自己的组件渲染会话的对话视图。

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的第三方 TUI 模式（dsh --profile pi-tui），基于内置 pi-tui fork 构建：覆盖主会话循环（审批、命令、会话切换与全文搜索），以及预设、技能、模型/设置菜单与斜杠命令。

description.en: Transparent rankings and recommendations for the DSH plugin ecosystem: daily auto-fetched topic data, an open scoring model, and rank/search/recommend tools with a settings-page leaderboard.
description.zh: DSH 插件透明排行与推荐：每日自动抓取 `dsh-plugin` 话题生态，公开评分模型，提供 rank/search/recommend 工具与设置页榜单。

description.en: Mineradio glassmorphism theme for the DSH web UI: champagne-gold glass panes, a fluid or wallpaper backdrop, and a one-switch toggle that restores the stock look exactly.
description.zh: Mineradio 玻璃拟态 DSH 网页主题：香槟金玻璃面板、流体或壁纸背景，一键开关即可还原原生界面。

description.en: Git worktree Session Targets with isolated task sessions, Ready for Review, reversible Local Preview, human-confirmed delivery, environment retention and recovery, and same-session iteration.
description.zh: Git Worktree Session Target：任务在隔离 Session 中运行，支持 Ready for Review、可撤回的 Local Preview、人工确认交付、环境保留与恢复，以及同一 Session 连续迭代。

description.en: 优化版 WorkBuddy2API 网关 + DSH 原生面板：UA、头族与设备指纹对齐官方 WorkBuddy Desktop 5.9.2，内核可独立更新。
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy2API 网关托管进 DSH，提供原生面板、可独立更新的内核，以及对齐 WorkBuddy Desktop 5.9.2 的出站指纹。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugins market｜DSH 插件市场
description.zh: 一键浏览和安装 6000 多个 DSH 社区插件，按功能分类，每天自动更新。

description.en: 在 DSH 侧栏加一个「开启生图模式」入口：点击 → 炫酷跳转至生图模式
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏加个「开启生图模式」入口，点一下满屏动画过场，直接跳到 PosterFlow 生图。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 独立社区插件商店：发现、安装并提交经过验证的插件、工具与扩展。 | Independent community plugin directory.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 独立社区插件商店：发现、安装并提交经过验证的插件、工具与扩展。 | Independent community plugin directory.

description.en: 在 dsh 网页中编辑 ComfyUI、实时预览并让 AI 操作工作流。
description.zh: 在 dsh 网页里直接编辑 ComfyUI 工作流，AI 通过 MCP 帮你改提示词、调参数、跑生图，实时预览。

description.en: Disciplined engineering workflow system for AI coding agents: planning, TDD, auto-fix loops, codebase knowledge graphs, and multi-agent wave execution. Needs codebase-memory-mcp (pip install "codebase-memory-mcp>=0.10.8,<0.11.0"); /scan stops without it.
description.zh: 面向 AI 编程智能体的工程工作流系统：规范计划、TDD 测试驱动、自动修复闭环、代码知识图谱与多智能体分波次执行。需先安装 codebase-memory-mcp（pip install "codebase-memory-mcp>=0.10.8,<0.11.0"），缺它 /scan 会直接停止。

description.en: Archived: continued in Yurzi/dsh-tool-web-enhanced (dsh-web-fetch-enhanced 0.2.0+). Configurable non-public address allowlists for DeepSeek Harness web_fetch (0.1.x)
description.zh: 让 web_fetch 能访问你授权的内网或 Fake-IP 地址，其余安全检查照旧，装完即用。

description.en: Role-play conversations with character cards, in-chat character-card authoring and editing, and image generation through configurable backends.
description.zh: 角色扮演插件：支持角色卡对话、在对话中创作与编辑角色卡，可接入生图后端生成插图。

description.en: Make any project AI-agent-ready in one command. Adaptive tech stack detection (7 languages × 14 frameworks × 61 components), auto-generates AGENTS.md, docs skeleton, CI/CD, and testing infrastructure. 一句话让任何项目具备 AI 开发能力。
description.zh: Make any project AI-agent-ready in one command. Adaptive tech stack detection (7 languages × 14 frameworks × 61 components), auto-generates AGENTS.md, docs skeleton, CI/CD, and testing infrastructure. 一句话让任何项目具备 AI 开发能力。

description.en: Official Pencil (pen.dev) canvas inside DeepSeek Harness: conversation-bound workspaces, live agent edits, and 7 MCP design tools — headless engine + browser editor.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接打开官方 Pencil 画布，边聊边画，还能用 MCP 设计工具实时协作改图。

description.en: Command Code Go API provider for dsh. Command Code 订阅 + DeekSeek Harness 兼容层
description.zh: 让 dsh 直接接入 Command Code Go 订阅，不用额外配置就能调用其 API 模型。

description.en: Bridge local Qoder / Qoder CN models into DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把本机已登录的 Qoder 模型零配置接入 DSH，直接在模型选择器里用你的账号额度。

description.en: 灵梦（Reimu）·博丽神社（东方Project）美化版皮肤：神社昼夜实景背景、灵梦立绘、画框侧边栏与输入框、纸白透明界面 — DeepSeek Harness Web GUI skin
description.zh: 灵梦（Reimu）·博丽神社（东方Project）美化版皮肤：神社昼夜实景背景、灵梦立绘、画框侧边栏与输入框、纸白透明界面 — DeepSeek Harness Web GUI skin

description.en: Keyboard-first command palette for the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 键盘优先的命令面板（command palette）。
在 DSH 页面右下角养一只小鲸鱼，实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，重启后自动加载，不用手动操作。

description.en: Zero-dependency browser control: drive a real headless Edge/Chrome over CDP with 8 `pilot_*` tools (navigate/click/type/keys/eval/screenshot) plus a live draggable cockpit panel in the Web GUI - text-first snapshots for text-only models, no Playwright, no API key.
description.zh: 零依赖浏览器操控：agent 通过 CDP 驾驶真实 headless Edge/Chrome（导航/点击/输入/按键/JS/截图，8 个 `pilot_*` 工具），Web GUI 内可拖拽驾驶舱面板实时围观——文本优先快照适配纯文本模型，无需 Playwright、无需 API key。

description.en: Import SillyTavern/TavernAI character cards and world books, save them as local Markdown lore documents, and generate novel prose from your prompts with the world settings as reference.
description.zh: 导入酒馆（SillyTavern/TavernAI）角色卡与世界书，落地为本地 Markdown 设定文档，激活创作模式后根据用户输入、参考世界书创作小说。

description.en: Pools every WorkBuddy account signed in on this machine into one auto-failing-over provider, serving OpenAI Chat, OpenAI Responses and Anthropic Messages from the same pool, with model aliases, usage statistics and scheduled credit automation.
description.zh: 把本机已登录的 WorkBuddy 账号汇成一个自动故障转移的模型池，同一池子对外提供 OpenAI Chat、OpenAI Responses 与 Anthropic Messages 三种协议，并支持模型别名、用量统计与积分自动化。

description.en: Zotero library tools via the local API (no API key, Zotero 7+): search items and collections, read metadata, abstracts and PDF full text (on-the-fly parsing when the cache misses), download attachments, and manage notes; API endpoint, target library and limits are configurable.
description.zh: 通过 Zotero 本地 API（无需 API Key，Zotero 7+）操作文献库：检索条目与分类、读元数据/摘要/PDF 全文（缓存未命中时现场解析）、下载附件、管理笔记；API 地址、目标文献库与限额均可配置。

description.en: Multi-platform API balance and usage dashboard for the DSH web GUI: balances for DeepSeek, Zhipu GLM, Kimi, StepFun, SiliconFlow, MiniMax, OpenRouter, Novita and xAI under the composer, estimated per-session and per-subagent cost with DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing, automatic discovery of relays configured in DSH settings, and an optional draggable whale widget.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的多平台 API 余额与用量看板：在输入框下方显示 DeepSeek、智谱 GLM、Kimi、阶跃星辰、硅基流动、MiniMax、OpenRouter、Novita、xAI 的余额，估算本会话与子代理消耗并按 DeepSeek 峰谷计价，自动发现 DSH 设置里已配置的中转站，另有一个可拖拽的大肥鱼挂件。

description.en: Token optimization for DeepSeek Harness with searchable MCP tool discovery and lazy loading, configurable compaction controls and status reporting, tool-output reduction, long-text vision summarization, and opt-in conversation archiving with paginated retrieval.
description.zh: Token 优化：支持可搜索的 MCP 工具发现与懒加载、可配置的压缩控制与状态查看、工具输出精简、长文本视觉摘要，以及可选的对话原文归档与分页回查。

description.en: Long-term memory for DSH: conversations auto-distilled into atomic facts, scene summaries and a persona profile, with relevant memories injected before every model step. Zero-config out of the box — hybrid BM25 + vector retrieval, optional offline local embeddings, chat/work family separation.
description.zh: dsh 长期记忆：对话自动蒸馏为原子事实、场景摘要与用户画像，每步模型调用前自动注入相关记忆。开箱零配置——BM25 + 向量混合检索，可选本地离线嵌入，chat/work 双族隔离。

description.en: Two-way sync of DSH sessions, workspace mappings, settings and patches between machines through your own private GitHub repo (API keys stay machine-local).
description.zh: 通过你自己的 GitHub 私有仓库,在多台电脑间双向同步 DSH 会话、工作区对应关系、设置与托管补丁(API 密钥留在本机)。

description.en: Custom modes / assistant manager: give each mode its own system prompt in the settings page — a custom prompt that is a plain file the agent loop re-reads before every model step, so an edit applies to the running session on its next step — and start it from the official standard / PTC / minimal / Cordis composition, toggling the plugin rows it mounts one by one (a custom plugin composition per mode), renaming it as you like. Several assistants coexist with their own prompts, so one machine can keep a coding assistant, a chat companion and a roleplay (RP) persona side by side — a multi-agent setup you pick from per new session. Rows left untouched stay byte-identical to the shipped ones, platform conditions included.
description.zh: 自定义模式管理器 / 多助手管理器：在设置页里给每个模式写一份自己的系统提示词——自定义提示词就是普通文件，agent loop 每次模型调用前重新读取，改完对正在运行的会话下一步即生效；模式以官方 standard / PTC / 极简 / Cordis 的组成为底子，可逐行开关它挂载哪些插件，等于每个模式一份自定义插件组合，也能改模式名。多个助手可并存、各有各的提示词，所以一台机器上可以同时留一个编码助手、一个聊天搭子、一个角色扮演（RP）人格，新建会话时挑一个。没碰过的行与出厂行逐字节相同（含平台条件）。

description.en: A Claude Code-style reasoning-effort slider for the DSH Web UI: stepless drag, snap-on-release, a WebGL fire trail, and real, working thinking-effort control for any custom third-party model or provider.
description.zh: 仿 Claude Code 的推理等级滑块：无极拖动、松手吸附、WebGL 火焰跟随，任何自定义第三方模型/提供商都能获得真实生效的思考强度调节。

description.en: Terminal-style input history for the web composer: edge-first arrow-key recall with exact draft/caret restore, browser-local persisted history, Ctrl+R reverse search, and sliding-context awareness; 0.5.0 adds a smart input layer — cross-session snippets (/save, /load), prompt templates with variables, reuse insights, and compaction-summary highlighting.
description.zh: Web 作曲器终端风格输入历史：边缘优先的方向键召回并精确还原草稿与光标、浏览器本地持久化历史、Ctrl+R 反向搜索，以及滑动上下文感知；0.5.0 再加智能输入层——跨会话片段库（/save、/load）、带变量的提示词模板、复用洞察与压缩摘要高亮。

description.en: Presents DSH Web as a playable, full-screen first-person Minecraft-style voxel interface—not a color-only skin: users walk through a persistent Three.js block world and access native workspaces, sessions, conversations, tools, model selection, permissions, context information, and the composer through in-world facilities and a workbench.
description.zh: 将 DSH Web 直接呈现为可游玩的全屏第一人称 Minecraft 风格体素界面，而非只更换颜色的皮肤：用户可以在可持久化的 Three.js 方块世界中移动，并通过游戏内设施和工作台使用原生工作区、会话、对话、工具、模型选择、权限、上下文信息与输入框。

description.en: Finds potential UX issues in your project: automatically reviews React/TypeScript code, pinpoints each problem, and gives concrete suggestions.
description.zh: 帮你发现项目中可能存在的用户体验问题：自动走查 React/TypeScript 源码，定位问题并给出具体优化建议。

description.en: DSH bundle that registers 13 native codegraph_* tools wrapping the codegraph CLI, so agents bootstrap, maintain, and query a pre-indexed code knowledge graph (symbol query, explore, node trail, callers/callees, impact, affected tests) instead of grepping files.
description.zh: DSH 插件，注册 13 个原生 codegraph_* 工具包装 codegraph CLI，让代理初始化、维护并查询预索引的代码知识图谱（符号查询、区域探索、节点轨迹、callers/callees、影响分析、受影响测试），无需 grep 文件。

description.en: Adds an Execution graph conversation-view tab that renders each turn's prompts, replies, and tool calls/results as a foldable timeline with a detail panel and PNG export.
description.zh: 在会话视图中新增「执行图」标签页，把每个轮次的提问、模型回复与工具调用/结果渲染为可折叠的时间轴，并带详情面板与 PNG 导出。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugins market｜DSH 插件市场
A session-bound agent-native REPL for DeepSeek Harness PTC mode.
description.zh: 给 PTC 模式加个会话级 REPL，随时改改接着算，不用从头再来。

description.en: A long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Every turn is judged and stored into a local SQLite (utterance / event / version / stage / decision), with a browsable panel.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的长期记忆插件。每轮聊完自动把话判一遍，存进本地 SQLite（话、事、版本、阶段、决定五层），带一块能翻能筛的面板。

description.en: Command deck for DeepSeek Harness: a live session rail and team roster, a task board with approvals and write actions, an activity stream, and a desktop HUD capsule that follows the working conversation. The HUD capsule is Windows-only.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 指挥台：会话栏与编队看板、带审批与写操作的任务板、实时流，以及跟随运行中对话的桌面 HUD 胶囊（仅 Windows）。

description.en: A UX enhancement pack for the DSH web chat: one plugin that collects small interface conveniences, each with its own switch under Settings → UX Plus applied immediately — chat-area font size and reading width under Settings → General → Chat area, a session-row menu that copies the session ID or inherits the conversation into a new session on a chosen model, workspace and session rows ordered by recent activity with 24-hour idle auto-collapse and age labels, and settled ask_user_question cards left expanded. The switch list is generated from its own feature registry, so the pack grows as conveniences are added instead of being fixed at a count.
description.zh: DSH Web 对话界面的 UX 增强包：一个插件持续收纳各种界面小改进，每项都有独立开关，位于 设置 → UX Plus，改动即时生效——对话字号与阅读宽度（设置 → 通用 → 对话区）、会话行菜单可复制会话 ID 或把当前对话继承到所选模型的新会话里继续、工作区与会话行按最近活跃排序（闲置超过 24 小时自动收起并显示上次更新时间）、已结束的提问卡片默认展开。开关列表由插件自身的功能注册表生成，功能会持续增加，不固定在某个数量。

description.en: Per-request thinking budgets, a compaction backend, and a settings tab for the local Qwen3.8 line (llama.cpp or NInfer).
description.zh: 本地 Qwen3.8 线（llama.cpp 或 NInfer）的逐请求 thinking 预算、压缩后端与设置 tab。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-qwen38-local-qol
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-qwen38-local-qol

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: deepseek harness插件，连接QQ / DSH plugin for connecting QQ
description.zh: 把 QQ 变成 DSH 的遥控器，在聊天窗口里就能远程指挥 AI 干活。

description.en: OpenClaw-style multi-platform gateway for DSH: WhatsApp / Telegram / Discord / Slack / Feishu / DingTalk / WeCom channels, in-chat trajectory replay (`/trace`), subagent & cron commands, native approval buttons, one-command docker deploy.
description.zh: 把 DSH 变成全平台聊天机器人，支持 WhatsApp、Telegram 等渠道，还能在对话里回放思考轨迹、调度子任务和定时命令。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）Web GUI 插件：在设置页管理 MCP 服务器——列出已安装工具，添加/编辑/删除、启用/停用；组合配置提供的 MCP 同样可在运行时直接编辑、停用、移除并恢复，无需重启宿主。
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Hello Kitty-styled task-completion and question alerts for DSH Web, bundled with an optional light/dark pink Skin Center v2 theme and local install scripts.
description.zh: DSH Web 的 Hello Kitty 风格任务完成与待回答提醒插件，附带可选的粉色明暗双主题 Skin Center v2 皮肤及本地安装脚本。

description.en: One-click restart of the DSH service from Settings → General. A dsh-plugin for DeepSeek Harness; the restart row stays pinned at the bottom of the general settings page.  在设置 → 通用设置中一键重启 DSH 服务。DeepSeek Harness 的 dsh-plugin，重启行固定显示在通用设置页面最底部。
description.zh: 在设置→通用设置中一键重启 DSH 服务，重启按钮固定在页面底部，方便快捷。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web plugin powered by markstream-react for resilient streaming Markdown, Mermaid diagrams, KaTeX math, and safe renderer fallback.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页版提供流畅的流式 Markdown 渲染，支持 Mermaid 图表、KaTeX 公式，并自带安全降级方案。

description.en: Security-audit methodology skill pack plus the plugin_vet supply-chain gate: eight agent skills (secret scan, dependency audit, supply-chain review, prompt-injection review, audit orchestration, threat modeling, vuln intel, incident response) in Chinese and English editions, with an npm provider bundle that mounts the skills and registers the automated plugin_vet pre-install scanner.
description.zh: 安全审计方法论技能包 + plugin_vet 供应链门禁：八个 agent 技能（密钥扫描、依赖审计、供应链评审、提示注入审查、审计总编排、威胁建模、漏洞情报、事件响应），中英双版本，附 npm provider 包一键挂载并注册自动化 plugin_vet 安装前扫描。

description.en: HarmonyOS device bridge: hdc screenshot/install/log/crash/UI automation loop with read_image, official-first versioned API knowledge (SDK .d.ts + offline bundled docs), and a DevEco CLI build/sign/lint lane.
description.zh: 鸿蒙设备桥：hdc 截图/装包/日志/崩溃/UI 自动化闭环（配 read_image 看图），官方优先版本化 API 知识层（SDK .d.ts + 离线随包文档），以及 DevEco CLI 构建/签名/lint 通道。

description.en: Two-suit VTuber theme for Joi: Flowers and Library are separate token systems for light and dark, with a standing portrait and a whale girl napping on the headline of the new-session page, two chibi companions above the composer that follow the turn state, a duo sidebar mark, and a context meter shaped as a ripening mandarin; a third card returns the stock DeepSeek look with the plugin still installed.
description.zh: 轴伊 Joi 双衣装主题：Flowers 与 Library 是各自成套的明暗令牌体系，新会话页有立绘与趴在标题上的鲸鱼娘，输入框上方两只 Q 版角色随本回合状态换表情，侧栏字标换成二人合影，上下文占用由一颗渐熟的橘子表示；第三张卡可在保持插件安装的前提下切回 DeepSeek 原生外观。

description.en: Reuses the Codex CLI ChatGPT login as an `openai-codex` LLM route and adds GPT Auth controls to DSH Web settings.
description.zh: 复用 Codex CLI 的 ChatGPT 登录态注册 `openai-codex` LLM 路由，并在 DSH Web 设置中提供 GPT Auth 控件。

description.en: Three Zhihu tools for DSH — in-site search, Zhihu's global web index with domain and date filters, and Zhida answers — with a native settings card and source-cited results.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加三个知乎工具——站内问答与文章检索、知乎全网索引检索（可按域名与时间过滤）、直答——自带原生设置卡片，结果附来源可引用。

description.en: Zero-dependency, event-driven voice announcement plugin: no extra model, no token cost. Speaks with the system's built-in natural voice, supporting both Windows and macOS; final-reply announcements, approval & question alerts, optional event announcements (turn end, command done, goal change, tool errors, todo updates), replayable final replies, and a bilingual visual settings page.
description.zh: 零外部依赖、事件驱动、无需额外模型、不消耗任何 token的语音播报插件。使用系统自带自然语音进行播报，支持win/mac双平台；最终回复、审批与提问提醒、可选事件播报（回合结束/命令完成/目标变更/工具出错/待办更新）、最终回复可重播、双语言可视化设置。

description.en: Shows a card in the sidebar footer with the DeepSeek account balance (read from the official /user/balance endpoint with the API key DSH already stores) and the unit prices of the active model — input, cache read and output — taken from a built-in snapshot of the official price table. A dot marks the current billing window and a countdown shows the time left until it flips: peak is Mon–Fri 9:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 Beijing Time, excluding Chinese public holidays, and everything else is off-peak. Prices and the dot appear only for official DeepSeek models; for any other model the card shows the balance alone. The card refreshes every 30 seconds, on click, and when the model changes, and follows the app theme and the DSH language.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部显示一张卡片：DeepSeek 账号余额（用 DSH 已保存的 API Key 调官方 /user/balance 接口获取），以及当前模型的档单价——输入、缓存读取、输出——取自内置的官方价格表快照。一个圆点标出当前计费时段，旁边是距离切换的倒计时：高峰为北京时间周一至周五 9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00（不含中国法定节假日），其余为空闲时段。档单价与圆点只对 DeepSeek 官方模型显示，其他模型只显示余额。卡片每 30 秒刷新一次，点击或切换模型时立即刷新，并跟随应用主题与 DSH 语言。

description.en: MCP management page in DSH Settings: list, enable/disable, restart and delete MCP servers, edit them in form or JSON mode, expand a server to see the tools it registers, and paste-import MCP configs from 14 tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code and more) in one go.
description.zh: DSH 设置中的 MCP 管理页：列出、启停、重启、删除 MCP 服务器，表单与 JSON 双模式编辑，展开可查看各服务器注册的工具，并支持一次粘贴导入 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、VS Code 等 14 种工具的 MCP 配置。

description.en: Durable background child agents on the official subagent seam: start from any session, watch progress in the Web UI sidebar, message and interrupt any time, with per-child tool scoping, persona and delegation-depth caps.
description.zh: 官方子代理接缝上的持久化后台子代理：任意会话中启动，Web 侧边栏看进度、随时留言与打断，支持按子代理限定工具、人格与委托深度。

description.en: Adds a generate_image tool backed by the FAL queue, any OpenAI-compatible images API, or a ChatGPT/Grok subscription, and shows the result inline in the conversation.
description.zh: 提供 generate_image 工具，可接入 FAL 队列、任意 OpenAI 兼容图像 API 或 ChatGPT/Grok 订阅，并在对话中内联显示结果。

description.en: Plugin-tree terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness — streaming markdown transcript, tool cards, fuzzy slash commands, and live theming, with every component a hot-swappable Cordis plugin.
description.zh: 插件树式终端界面：流式 markdown 会话流、工具卡片、模糊命令补全与主题热切换，每个界面组件都是可热替换的 Cordis 插件。

description.en: A third-party TUI mode for DeepSeek Harness (dsh), built on a vendored fork of pi-tui. npm @xmoon76/dsh-pi-tui
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供终端界面，让你在命令行里也能直观地查看和操作对话。

description.en: 给出材料，拿到可以交付的演示文稿。 可直接下载成品 欢迎提交 issues 和 PR。

description.en: Condition-driven wakeup for DeepSeek Harness: durable file/command/http/process/webhook watches that wake the agent, with dock, sidebar branch, and a global dashboard.

description.en: DSH plugin: LAN team space for AI coding sessions — share, claim and return sessions across machines, plus shared skills, plugins & git index.

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 主程序与插件更新管理：npm/GitHub 双源 semver 比对、多语言横幅、一键更新（主程序自动备份/校验/回滚，插件临时目录安装）、更新后看门狗重启。Update management for DeepSeek Harness and its plugins: dual-source semver checks, locale banner, one-click updates with backup/rollback, watchdog restart.

description.en: Ramify 是 DeepSeek Harness 的创意分支画布插件，用树状工作区生成、对比和迭代多个可交互方案。
description.zh: Ramify 是 DeepSeek Harness 的创意分支画布插件，用树状工作区生成、对比和迭代多个可交互方案。

description.en: music player plugin for deepseek harness

description.zh: AI 驱动的智能爬虫，能逆向 JavaScript 加密逻辑，自动生成可验证的参数求解器。

description.en: dsh session IDs for opencode, zero config.

description.zh: File explorer plugin for DeepSeek Harness: file tree, preview, markdown, syntax highlighting, in-panel editing, VS Code integration - DeepSeek Harness 全局文件资源管理器插件

description.en: 为 dsh 提供新的「聚焦会话」精简会话视图，更轻松易于阅读，只关注最终产出结果。

description.en: Gives text-only models vision: forwards user images to an OpenAI-compatible vision model and shows the descriptions in a Web UI right panel.

description.en: Cross-platform file drag-and-drop with raw path insertion, no file copying.
description.zh: 跨平台文件拖拽与原始路径插入，无需复制文件。

description.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness agents with native identities based on the open Agent Network Protocol (ANP), plus identity-based direct, group, mail, and Agent-to-Agent communication.

description.en: Turns an article in the DSH conversation into an Excalidraw canvas in a session tab: the Agent drafts the structure with diagram_create, you edit labels, nodes and layout with autosave, export PNG, SVG or .excalidraw, and the Agent reads your edited canvas back with diagram_read. 0.6 adds an editable classification overview plus a complete detail index for large three-level trees.

description.en: Task reliability: auto-retry on model timeouts/failures, auto-continue unfinished tasks, completion verification, thinking-repeat interruption, resume after sleep or restart, autopilot mode and a remote trigger endpoint (npm: `dsh-task-reliability`).
description.zh: 任务可靠性：模型超时/请求失败自动重试、任务未完成自动继续、独立完成度校验、思考重复检测打断、休眠/重启后任务自动恢复、自主决策模式、远程触发接口（npm: `dsh-task-reliability`）。

description.en: Context lens: visualizes token usage of every request (context composition, KV cache hit rate) and enforces per-turn / per-session budgets with warning and blocking (npm: `dsh-my-context`).
description.zh: 上下文透镜：可视化每次请求的 token 用量（上下文构成、KV 缓存命中率），并提供每轮 / 每会话预算控制（超限提醒与拦截）（npm: `dsh-my-context`）。

description.en: Memory in global and per-project scopes: memories are injected into the system prompt at session start, a settings panel edits them with confirmation on write, and the agent gets a read-only memory_query tool (npm: `dsh-my-memory`).
description.zh: 全局 / 项目两级记忆：会话开始时把记忆注入系统提示词，设置页面板支持新增 / 修改 / 删除（写操作需确认），并为 agent 提供只读查询工具 memory_query（npm: `dsh-my-memory`）。

description.en: Animated mood icon: swaps the favicon, sidebar wordmark and hero headline for bloub expression animations that follow session state (working / awaiting input / done / idle), with 8 shapes, 12 colors and custom wordmark texts configurable in Settings.
description.zh: 动态心情图标：favicon、侧栏字标与首页标题随会话状态切换 bloub 表情动画（执行中 / 等输入 / 完成 / 空闲），8 种形状、12 种颜色与自定义文字均可在设置页配置。

description.en: Smart Charts skill: turns CSV/TSV/TXT/XLSX/XLS/JSON data files into standalone interactive ECharts HTML - 32 chart types including offline maps, 3 themes, no CDN. A --profile data profile (per-column dtype, cardinality, missingness, samples, statistics, entity grain, insight signals) lets the agent read the data and pick the chart itself; each chart embeds a fact sheet (plot_stats + data_preview) whose numbers are the only quotable values. LLM transform code runs in a restricted sandbox (blacklist + AST whitelist + safe builtins); --doctor self-checks the Python environment. Fully offline, ECharts bundled.
description.zh: 智能图表 skill：把 CSV/TSV/TXT/XLSX/XLS/JSON 数据文件转为独立交互式 ECharts HTML——32 种图表（含离线地图）、3 套主题、无需 CDN。--profile 数据画像（每列 dtype/基数/缺失/样本/统计、实体粒度、洞察信号）让 agent 自己读懂数据并决定选型；每张图内置事实卡（plot_stats + data_preview），其数值是解读时唯一可引用的数字。LLM 转换代码在受限沙箱（黑名单 + AST 白名单 + 安全 builtins）中执行；--doctor 自检 Python 环境。ECharts 离线打包，完全无需联网。

description.en: Particle-network background overlay for the DSH Web shell: full-screen, click-through, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供粒子网络动态背景：全屏覆盖、点击穿透、零运行时依赖。

description.en: 免费的 DeepSeek 网页版（chat.deepseek.com）LLM 服务提供方，用于 DeepSeek Harness——无需 API 密钥。自动启动网关，支持工具调用和连续对话。Free DeepSeek Web (chat.deepseek.com) LLM provider for DeepSeek Harness — no API key. Auto-launches gateway, tool calling, continuous chat.
description.zh: 不用 API 密钥，直接拿 DeepSeek 网页版当模型用，自动拉起网关，支持工具调用和多轮对话。

description.en: DSH 手机/外网远程访问插件：Cloudflare Quick Tunnel 公网隧道 + token 鉴权 + gzip 压缩 + 局域网 HTTPS 直连 + 手机图标面板 + QQ 机器人取链接
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: one-click ✨ polish for composer drafts — flash rewrite, auto fill-back · DeepSeek Harness 插件：输入框草稿一键 ✨ 润色，flash 改写、自动回填
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin: one-click ✨ polish for composer drafts — flash rewrite, auto fill-back · DeepSeek Harness 插件：输入框草稿一键 ✨ 润色，flash 改写、自动回填

description.en: 量子计算最佳实践 Quantum Algorithms Best Practices
description.zh: 把量子算法开发的最佳实践打包成技能，让 AI 助手帮你写出更靠谱的量子计算代码。

description.en: Shanghai and Shenzhen A-share market data plugin.
description.zh: 在侧栏实时看沪深A股指数和全球行情，还能对比两市成交额、刷财经资讯。

description.en: Port of ponytail: an always-on lazy-senior-developer coding persona with intensity levels, persistence of the default level, and review, audit, debt, gain and help skills for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: ponytail 移植：常驻的「懒惰资深开发者」编码人设，带强度档位与 review、audit、debt、gain、help 技能，适用于 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Observability and git tooling: a persistent cross-session event audit log with a query API, a resource watchdog sidebar panel, structured Conventional Commits and pre-commit incremental diff review (npm: `dsh-my-observability`).
description.zh: 可观测性与 Git 工程工具：跨会话持久化的事件审计日志与查询 API、资源看门狗侧边栏面板、结构化 Conventional Commits 提交、提交前增量 diff 审查（npm: `dsh-my-observability`）。

description.en: Per-call cache billing inside the context-meter popover: current step, round and session totals with hit/miss/output tokens and amounts, automatic Beijing working-hour peak/off-peak pricing, per-model rates, and third-party relays billed too.
description.zh: 在上下文圆环弹层里实时算账：当前步、当前轮、会话累计三块明细，缓存命中/未命中/输出各带 token 与金额，官方峰谷价与模型分价自动判定，第三方中转照常记账。

description.en: File encoding guard: byte-exact read/write/edit for GBK, Big5, Shift-JIS, EUC-KR, Windows-125x, UTF-16 and UTF-32 files, so editing a legacy file leaves it in its original encoding instead of silently rewriting it as UTF-8; UTF-8 BOM preserved exactly as it was, line endings (CRLF/LF/CR) kept, characters the encoding cannot represent refused rather than written as "?", and non-UTF-8 files listed with candidate encodings so the model can re-read them explicitly.
description.zh: 文件编码守护：为 GBK、Big5、Shift-JIS、EUC-KR、Windows-125x、UTF-16、UTF-32 文件提供字节级无损读写与编辑，改完仍是原编码而不是被悄悄转成 UTF-8；UTF-8 BOM 原样保留，CRLF/LF/CR 换行符保持，编码表示不了的字符拒绝写入而不是写成「?」；非 UTF-8 文件会列出候选编码，模型可显式指定重读。

description.en: Shipped with cc-safety-net-style mechanical safety-net rules appended; supports both no-model and model-assisted security review, in modes such as 自动审查 (auto-review) and 机械直通 (mechanical pass-through). P0–P4 deterministic-first permission gate with permissive tier, learning sedimentation and approval-history UI; hard-deny credentials and protected paths, auto-allow internal read-only tools.
description.zh: 已追加 cc-safety-net 风格的机械安全网规则，同时支持无模型、有模型辅助方式的安全审查，模式为自动审查、机械直通等。P0–P4 确定性优先权限门控，含 Permissive 档位、学习沉淀与审批历史 UI；凭据/受保护路径硬拒绝，内部只读工具自动放行。

description.en: A self-contained second brain for DeepSeek Harness — auto-captures durable dialogue knowledge into a local Markdown vault (custom dedup, CJK search, git-friendly), with a graphical knowledge base and an interactive knowledge graph (legend filter, time-dimension coloring, box-select, merge, delete, PNG export/import).
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上自研「第二大脑」：对话结束自动把值得复用的内容沉淀成本地 Markdown 知识卡（自研去重、CJK 检索、可 git 管理），设置页提供图形化知识库 + 交互式知识图谱（图例过滤、时间维、框选、合并、导入导出）。

description.en: An unofficial Arknights P.R.T.S.-inspired interface theme for DSH Web with appearance presets, accessibility controls, and conversation navigation.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 的非官方明日方舟 P.R.T.S. 风格界面主题，提供外观预设、辅助功能与会话导航。

description.en: Task ledger board for dsh (DeepSeek Harness): read-only board over task-ledger skill workspaces. The task-ledger skill is bundled — install the plugin, get the skill globally.
Native iOS and Android apps for remote control of DeepSeek Harness, with end-to-end encryption, workspace browsing, and real-time session updates.
description.zh: 提供 DeepSeek Harness 远程控制功能的原生 iOS/Android 应用，支持端到端加密、工作区浏览和会话实时更新等。

description.en: Remote control: pushes ask / approval / session-end events to an external channel webhook and lets you answer, approve, query status or continue a session from your phone with token auth (npm: `dsh-my-remote`).
description.zh: 远程控制：把 ask / 审批 / 会话结束事件推送到外部通道 webhook，可用 token 鉴权在手机上回答问题、批准请求、查询状态或继续会话（npm: `dsh-my-remote`）。

description.en: DeepSeek brain + automatic image transcription: attach images in the GUI and each one is transcribed via the official deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp by default (a pure-text V4-Pro brain can see images), with any OpenAI-compatible VLM or local Ollama as alternatives.
description.zh: DeepSeek 大脑 + 自动识图：GUI 附加的每张图片自动经官方 deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 原生识图转译，再交给纯文本的 DeepSeek 作答（纯文本 V4-Pro 也能看图）；支持任意 OpenAI 兼容 VLM 与本地 Ollama 作为备选。

description.en: Route agent network requests through a local HTTP/CONNECT/SOCKS5 proxy.
description.zh: 让 agent 的网络请求走本机 HTTP/CONNECT/SOCKS5 代理。

description.en: Live-tune the DSH Web conversation UI from Settings: message font size, Claude Desktop-style markdown tables, dialog width, an optional timeline rail, and a GitBar with branch management, per-file diff, and commit & push.
description.zh: 从设置面板实时调教 DSH 网页对话界面：消息字体大小、Claude Desktop 风格 Markdown 表格、对话框宽度、可选时间线侧栏，以及带分支管理、逐文件 Diff 和提交推送功能的 GitBar。

description.en: Injects a per-session x-opencode-session header into opencode.ai inference requests, fixing the OpenCode Go gateway 400 MissingSessionID error; server-only, no UI (npm: `dsh-my-opencode-session-header`).
description.zh: 为 opencode.ai 的推理请求注入按会话稳定的 x-opencode-session 头，修复 OpenCode Go 网关 400 MissingSessionID；纯 server 插件，无界面（npm: `dsh-my-opencode-session-header`）。

description.en: Detailed model usage and cost analysis, with per-session usage stats and usage queries for GLM, MiniMax, OpenCode Go, DeepSeek and more.
description.zh: 详细的模型用量、费用分析，支持会话级用量统计，支持GLM、MiniMax、OpenCode Go、DS等用量查询。

description.en: Lets one session read, write and run bash across several folders, not just the primary root — additional roots are registered from a sidebar Folders panel or the /workspace-folders command (inherit/read-only/read-write) and share the primary root's file-fence + OS-sandbox authorization; adds no new tools.
description.zh: 让单个会话在多个文件夹中读写并运行 bash，而不限于主目录——附加根经侧栏 Folders 面板或 /workspace-folders 命令登记（inherit/read-only/read-write），与主根共享同一套文件围栏 + 内核沙箱授权；不新增工具。

description.en: Conversation rendering: every fenced block is rendered by the plugin itself (markdown for text fences, language-banner code blocks with highlight.js for others), mermaid fences become zoomable diagram cards, plus context-body rendering, whole-content copy and a MarkdownView export (npm: `dsh-md-render`).
description.zh: 对话渲染：围栏块由插件自身渲染（text 家族按 markdown，其余为真实语言名 banner + highlight.js 高亮的代码块），mermaid 块渲染为可缩放图表卡片，另支持上下文注入块渲染、整段复制与 MarkdownView 导出（npm: `dsh-md-render`）。

description.en: One-stop skills, subagent, MCP and LSP manager for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — compatible with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Kimi and other agent plugin layouts.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里逛插件市场，一键装 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 的技能、MCP 服务、钩子和斜杠命令。

description.en: Login gate for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web surface: password or shared-token sign-in, optional TOTP two-factor, session cookies, rate limiting, self-service password change and a user-management CLI. ｜ DeepSeek Harness 网页版登录门插件：账号密码或共享令牌登录、可选 TOTP 两步验证、会话 cookie、登录限速、自助改密，附用户管理 CLI。
description.zh: 为 dsh 网页版加上登录门：支持密码或共享令牌认证、会话 Cookie、限流，还带用户管理命令行工具。

description.en: Run Claude Code as a first-class DSH conversation while preserving its native agent loop, tools, skills, hooks, and MCP integrations in DSH.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接跑本地 Claude Code，完整保留它的工具链、技能和 MCP 扩展，写代码更顺手。

description.en: Find DSH plugins across five community catalogs plus live GitHub and npm search, ranked by relevance × trust × freshness × popularity — not stars alone. 跨五个社区目录并叠加 GitHub 与 npm 实时搜索来找 DSH 插件，按相关度 × 可信度 × 新鲜度 × 热度排序，而不是只看 star。
description.zh: 帮你从多个社区目录里挑出真正合适的 DSH 插件，按相关度、可信度和新鲜度排序，不再只看 star。

description.en: provider-agnostic AIGC HTTP 桥 + 无限画布 + ffmpeg 后处理，13 个工具含画布连边/reroll/媒体编辑 | Provider-agnostic AIGC HTTP bridge + infinite canvas + ffmpeg post-processing; 13 tools incl. canvas linking/reroll/media-edit
description.zh: provider-agnostic AIGC HTTP 桥 + 无限画布 + ffmpeg 后处理，13 个工具含画布连边/reroll/媒体编辑 | Provider-agnostic AIGC HTTP bridge + infinite canvas + ffmpeg post-processing; 13 tools incl. canvas linking/reroll/media-edit

description.en: Codex integration plugin for DeepSeek Harness, providing native Codex conversations powered by the Codex App Server, with workspace, terminal, approval, and DSH tool support.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接和 Codex 对话，支持工作区、终端、审批和工具调用。

description.en: 一个用于DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的用量监测面板（目前仅支持DeepSeek官方模型）
description.zh: 在 DSH 里实时查看 DeepSeek 官方模型的用量和消耗，心里有数不超支。

description.en: Real-time outline panel for the DSH Web session page: user questions plus a Markdown heading tree (H1–H6) that updates live during streaming, with click-to-locate highlighting, expand-depth control, search, and per-session favorites.
description.zh: DSH Web 会话页实时大纲面板：「用户问题 + Markdown 标题（1~6 级）」大纲树，流式生成时实时更新，点击节点滚动定位并高亮，支持展开深度调节、搜索与会话级收藏。

description.en: Wire in SearXNG search and a Crawl4AI fetch tool
description.zh: SearXNG search and Crawl4AI fetch providers for DeepSeek Harness

description.en: DeepSeek account balance and session cost in the composer dock, with auto-fetched official pricing and peak/off-peak support.
description.zh: 输入框 dock 显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与会话花费，自动拉取官方定价，支持高峰/低谷计价。

description.en: The plunge for dsh to boost model's search ability.
description.zh: Multi-engine fused web search, page fetch, real-time X (Twitter) search with credential-free fallback, deep research and parallel multi-agent research for DeepSeek Harness. Free-by-default engine chain (Antigravity CLI / Bing / DuckDuckGo / Exa MCP) with keyed Tavily/Brave/Exa failover.

description.en: Skin switcher + custom wallpaper for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): curated --dsw-alias-* palettes, translucent wallpaper with opacity/blur controls, persisted per browser (like Codex themes) — 换皮肤 / 自定义背景插件
description.zh: Codex 风格皮肤切换器 + 自定义壁纸层，可调透明度与模糊。

description.en: Semantic retrieval, resource management, auto-recall (user + agent dual spaces) and session memory for DeepSeek Harness: memsearch/memfind/memread/membrowse/memgrep/memglob over viking:// URIs, memadd/memremove resource management, memqueue observer status, memcommit session capture, and memlearn skill playbook minting.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 OpenViking 语义检索、资源管理、自动召回（user + agent 双空间）与会话记忆插件：基于 viking:// URI 的 memsearch/memfind/memread/membrowse/memgrep/memglob 检索工具、memadd/memremove 资源管理、memqueue 队列状态、memcommit 会话捕获，以及 memlearn 技能手册沉淀。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）提供的细粒度权限控制插件
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: 🔔 Cross-window completion & approval notifications for DeepSeek Harness — popup reminders that bring you back to DSH, Codex/WorkBuddy style.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里干活时，切到别的窗口也能收到任务完成或审批的弹窗提醒，像 Codex 那样把你拉回来。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：用 JSON 规格生成可验证的架构图、流程图、时序图、数据流图与生命周期图（移植自 tt-a1i/archify）
description.zh: 用 JSON 规格一键生成架构图、流程图、时序图等可验证图表，让技术方案看得见。

description.en: Mobile-adaptive layout for the DSH Web UI: the sidebar becomes a content-hugging overlay drawer, the conversation gets the full width, and the settings panel becomes a near-full-width sheet.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 移动端适配：窄屏下侧边栏变为贴合内容的 overlay 抽屉、会话独占全宽，设置面板改为近全宽 sheet。

description.en: SearXNG search and Crawl4AI fetch providers for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 自建搜索接入：用 SearXNG 搜索 + Crawl4AI 抓取网页，替换 DSH 默认的联网方案。

description.en: An MC-Fabric-style hook processor.
description.zh: 类似 MC Fabric 的 hook 处理器。

description.en: Skill management: lists skills in global and per-project scopes and toggles each one per project; a disabled skill is not injected into that session (npm: `dsh-my-skill-manager`).
description.zh: Skill 管理：按全局 / 项目两个范围查看 skill 列表，并按项目启用或禁用；被禁用的 skill 不会注入该会话（npm: `dsh-my-skill-manager`）。

description.en: DSH input assistant for next-message prediction, draft autocomplete (text completion), and prompt polishing/rewrite. Session-local suggestions; Tab accepts into the draft without sending. Requires a configured model; calls may incur charges. Source-available; modifications require prior written permission.
description.zh: DSH 输入助手：输入预测、草稿补全（自动补全）、提示词润色（prompt 优化）；根据对话给出下一句建议。Tab 接受只填入草稿、不自动发送，建议按会话保留。需配置模型，调用可能计费。源码可见，修改须事先取得书面许可。

description.en: An AI routing gateway that runs as a DSH plugin. Adds a Routing System sidebar panel for suppliers, account pool, fallback combos and API keys, and serves an OpenAI-compatible endpoint at http://localhost:3080/v1.
description.zh: 以 DSH 插件形式运行的 AI 路由网关。侧边栏新增「路由系统」面板管理供应商、账号池、回退组合与 API 密钥，并在 http://localhost:3080/v1 提供 OpenAI 兼容端点。

description.en: Sidebar session search that builds its own index instead of reusing DSH's full-text one: title to content toggle in one entry, results grouped per session with the strongest snippet and user/reply/tool tags, plus watermark-based incremental sync, archive-driven pruning of archived sessions, and a shadow rebuild that never blocks the live index.
description.zh: 自带独立索引的侧边栏会话搜索（不再复用 DSH 官方全文索引）：一处入口在标题与内容检索间切换，结果按会话聚合，附最强命中片段与 用户/回复/工具 类型标签；水位驱动增量同步、按归档集合清理已归档会话，整理走影子索引不阻塞在用索引。

description.en: Keeps a pool of API keys per provider with auto-created clone routes, switches to the next key on quota or rate-limit errors, probes cooled keys for recovery, and exposes the pools, cooldown and switch codes in a Settings section.
description.zh: 为每个提供方维护 API Key 池并自动创建克隆路由，在配额或限流错误时切换到下一个 Key，主动探测冷却中的 Key 以便恢复，并在设置中提供 Key 池、冷却时间与切换状态码的编辑界面。

description.en: NiuLai meme desktop pet — shouts "Ma～ma～" with a synced mouth when your agent finishes; 6 skins, signature actions, action-event binding, WebAudio-synthesized animal calls, hand-drawn SVG skins bundled.
description.zh: 牛来桌宠——agent 任务完成就蹦出来喊「妈～～妈～～」（嘴型同步）；6 个皮肤、签名动作、事件绑定、WebAudio 合成叫声，内置手绘 SVG 皮肤素材。

description.en: Browse, enable, disable, and manage Agent Skills from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini, and custom directories in the DSH settings panel.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置面板中浏览、启用、停用和管理来自 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Gemini 及自定义目录的 Agent Skills。

description.en: Guarded context compaction for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): the LLM proposes, deterministic guards dispose — eager per-atom shrink (extract/summary/false under verbatim guards) + lazy reference-graph eviction (0-LLM) + byte-exact recall from an append-only log.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 守卫式上下文压缩——LLM 提议、确定性守卫裁决：逐原子缩放（verbatim 守卫下 extract/summary/false）+ 引用图延迟剪枝（0-LLM）+ append-only 日志逐字节精确召回。

description.en: Full-featured TUI for DeepSeek Harness: streaming conversation, powerline status bar, real-time think/tool/todo panels, subagent dual-view, theme hot-switch — all as pure cordis plugins with zero upstream patches.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的全功能 TUI：流式对话、powerline 状态栏、实时思考/工具/待办面板、子代理双视图、主题热切换——全部以纯 cordis 插件实现，不 fork、不 patch 上游一行代码。

description.en: Business knowledge-network context for DeepSeek Harness: bind a session to an OpenBKN knowledge network, query its objects and metrics through managed MCP tools, and open trace-backed provenance (execution facts and a business graph) for each answer. Ships with the OpenBKN Runtime; the provenance views need an OpenBKN enterprise license.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供业务知识网络上下文：将会话绑定到 OpenBKN 知识网络，通过受管 MCP 工具查询对象与指标，并为每轮回答打开可溯源的执行事实与业务上下文图。随 OpenBKN Runtime 发布；溯源视图需企业版 License。

description.en: Local literature knowledge-base RAG: 10 tools (kb_ingest, kb_search, kb_rag, kb_zotero, kb_dedup, kb_clear, kb_fetch, kb_scope, kb_stats, kb_status), hybrid BM25+vector+reranker search, cited QA with clickable DOI links, all-local bge embeddings over a single-file SQLite index. Needs Python 3.9+ with pymupdf, faiss-cpu and sentence-transformers; the `npx dsh-kb-rag-install` installer sets those up and pre-downloads the model.
description.zh: 本地文献知识库 RAG：10 个工具（kb_ingest、kb_search、kb_rag、kb_zotero、kb_dedup、kb_clear、kb_fetch、kb_scope、kb_stats、kb_status），BM25+向量+重排混合检索、DOI 可点击溯源问答，全本地 bge 嵌入 + 单文件 SQLite 索引。需要 Python 3.9+ 及 pymupdf、faiss-cpu、sentence-transformers（`npx dsh-kb-rag-install` 安装器会自动装好并预下载模型）。

description.en: Ten video tools (probe/cut/concat/encode/subtitle/extract/gif/frames/adjust/health) on the official subprocess service: probe summaries, batch frame extraction, speed/volume/mute/rotate adjust, shell-free argv, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 视频处理十工具（探测/剪辑/拼接/转码/字幕烧录/抽帧/批量抽帧/GIF/调整/健康自检）：探测摘要、变速/音量/静音/旋转调整、官方 subprocess 服务、argv 无 shell 注入、零运行时依赖。

description.en: 唯稳律 (Weiwen's Law) 白箱风控 DSH 插件 — DeepSeek Harness 因果约束中间件
description.zh: 给 AI 加一层白箱因果约束，实时拦住越界操作，让风控过程看得见、可追溯。

description.en: A shared kanban board for people and AI agents in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里和 AI 一起用看板规划任务、推进工作，进度一目了然。

description.en: Rhine Lab theme for DeepSeek Harness — 莱茵生命主题：开屏动画、界面主题、品牌标志与附加功能

description.en: Analyze usage across models, providers, workspaces, and time ranges — including custom start/end dates over the full retained history — with live cache-hit visibility and separate model and provider breakdowns. Includes hourly single-day trends, daily cross-day trends, a 53-week GitHub-style heatmap, usage streaks, model and workspace Token-share donut charts with Token, cost, and percentage details, independent combinable filters, cache-efficiency trends, DeepSeek account balance, workspace aliases, CSV export, and a durable ledger that preserves successfully flushed usage after session deletion — and after a workspace is deleted, where its recorded usage is summed into one Deleted row — and rebuilds incrementally — on restart, unchanged sessions are applied from the ledger without re-reading their logs (a per-session log revision is the change signal), and only changed/new events are folded. The workspace registry is kept fresh automatically through the DSH domain/changed probe: only added/removed workspaces are reprocessed incrementally, unchanged workspaces reuse their computed aggregates and ledger with zero rescan, and usage is strictly limited to DSH-registered workspaces (unregistered cwds are ignored). After a scan, lightweight revision status fetches full history only when the Host/data state changes and exposes non-sensitive sync health (revision reuse, rereads, ledger recovery, and failures). Token accounting is explicit: input is fresh (cache read/write and reasoning are separate buckets) and zero-usage replays never overwrite recorded usage. Chinese uses local time, English uses UTC; API access is loopback-only.
description.zh: 支持跨多个模型、供应商、工作区与时间范围进行统一分析，并可在全部保留历史中自定义起止日期；实时呈现缓存命中率，并可分别查看模型和供应商的分类数据；单日趋势按小时、跨日趋势按日，提供 53 周 GitHub 风格热力图、连续使用、模型与工作区 Token 占比环图及 Token、成本、占比明细，以及可独立自由组合的筛选；支持查询 DeepSeek 账户余额、管理工作区别名及导出 CSV 数据；独立账本在会话删除前持久化用量，工作区被删除时同样保留并把用量汇总为一行「已删除」，增量重建只处理新增事件；重启时未变化会话不回读日志、直接复用账本（以每会话日志 revision 为变更信号）；工作区注册表通过 DSH 的 domain/changed 事件自动探针同步——只对新增/删除的工作区增量重扫，未变化的已有工作区直接复用已计算账本、零全量重扫，统计严格限定已注册工作区（未登记目录一律忽略），扫描完成后通过轻量 revision 状态判断，只有 Host/统计状态变化才获取完整历史，并显示 revision 复用、实际读取、账本恢复和失败等非敏感同步健康信息；全 0 用量的重放不会覆盖已记录的真实用量，Token 口径显式声明（输入不含缓存命中，缓存读写与推理独立成桶）。中文使用本地时区，英文统一使用 UTC；API 仅限本机访问。

description.en: PPT workbench: eleven ppt_* tools create, edit, reverse-engineer, QA-check and export slides from a plain-text PPTD project; five design-system families, themes, animations, posters and infographics.

description.en: LLVM static-analysis plugin that builds whole-program bitcode for C/C++ projects and runs kernel-analyzer (KAMain) reachability analysis on it, providing kanalyzer_* tools to the agent and a ctx.kanalyzer service to other plugins.
description.zh: LLVM 静态分析插件，可为 C/C++ 项目构建整程序 LLVM bitcode，并在其上运行 kernel-analyzer（KAMain）可达性分析，向智能体提供 kanalyzer_* 工具，并向其他插件提供 ctx.kanalyzer 服务。

description.en: One-stop visual management of DSH Skills & MCP: on-demand MCP loading, in-session hot reload, SKILL & MCP descriptions viewable in the plugin.
description.zh: 一站式可视化管理 DSH 的 SKILL 与 MCP：MCP按需加载、会话内热重载、SKILL与MCP描述可在插件内直接查看

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness 对话中以会话级 artifact 安全展示交互式 HTML 可视化。

Agent governance kingdom for DeepSeek Harness: territories, role bindings (bind/unbind/session with model/agent identity), and a plan→assign→execute→review task loop where Worker claims never auto-complete (Claim ≠ Fact), with a local GUI operations console.
description.zh: DSH 里的 Agent 王国：领地、角色绑定/换届/会话归属（含模型/Agent 身份），plan→派发→执行→验收治理闭环（Worker 自述≠完成事实），附本地 GUI 操作台。

description.en: Directed fuzzing driven by an LLM agent: from a target repository and a bug (CVE description, patch, crash trace, or file:line), it runs a PLAN, IMPLEMENT, EXECUTE, REFLECT loop in which the model writes Python input generators, until an input triggers the campaign's stderr-pattern oracle or the campaign stops.
description.zh: 由 LLM 智能体驱动的定向模糊测试：给定目标仓库和一个缺陷（CVE 描述、补丁、崩溃调用栈或 file:line），它运行 PLAN、IMPLEMENT、EXECUTE、REFLECT 循环，由模型编写 Python 输入生成器，直到某个输入触发该 campaign 基于 stderr 模式匹配的 oracle，或 campaign 停止。

description.en: Not another memory plugin: ODR is an evolving-worlds self-improvement loop (Dream-RSI) — attempts are recorded into a Discovery Tree, and between runs thousands of strategy variants are replayed against that recorded world; a strategy, recipe or lesson is promoted only after surviving counterfactual replay, never on the model's word alone, and Sentinel gates tool calls before the budget burns; the LLM stays frozen, installable from npm as dsh-open-dream-rsi.
description.zh: 不是又一个记忆插件：ODR 是“演化世界”式（Dream-RSI）自我改进回路——每次尝试都记入发现树（Discovery Tree），任务间歇将数千个策略变体在这棵记录下来的世界上回放；策略、配方或经验只有通过反事实回放的考验才会晋升，绝不因模型自己说好就获得信任，Sentinel 还会在预算耗尽前拦截工具调用；LLM 保持冻结，可从 npm 安装 dsh-open-dream-rsi。

description.en: Imports Claude Code setup into DeepSeek Harness from a native settings screen or CLI, with dry-run previews for skills, commands, agents, hooks, permission rules, and MCP config. Codex and OpenCode remain supported as secondary origins, with collision-safe apply and post-move checks.
description.zh: 通过原生设置页或 CLI 将 Claude Code 配置迁入 DeepSeek Harness，可先预览技能、命令、代理、hooks、权限规则与 MCP 配置；Codex 和 OpenCode 作为次要来源继续支持，并提供目标冲突保护和迁移后检查。

description.en: Multi-platform research and deep search pipeline: harvest_scout for parallel discovery across GitHub, Web, Twitter, Reddit, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, and YouTube, harvest_deep_research for automated comprehensive research reports, plus extract, cross-source verification, and credibility auditing.
description.zh: 多平台调研与深度搜索流水线：harvest_scout 并行发现（覆盖 GitHub、Web、推特、Reddit、小红书、B站、YouTube 等通道），harvest_deep_research 自动化长篇综合研报生成，外加穿透抓取、跨源交叉验证与五维来源可信度审计。

description.en: Signs in to a ChatGPT account over OAuth and serves that plan's models as a DeepSeek Harness provider route, calling api.openai.com/v1/responses with the account's plan scope rather than the Codex backend.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 登录 ChatGPT 账号，把该套餐的模型作为 DeepSeek Harness 的 provider 路由提供；调用 api.openai.com/v1/responses 并使用账号的套餐授权范围，而非 Codex 后端。

description.en: Deterministic context compression for dsh — zero LLM calls, rule-based pruning that preserves paths, commands, error traces, and open todos verbatim. Compresses ~80k tokens to a few hundred.

description.en: Route eligible shell commands through rtk to compress tool output and save tokens.
description.zh: 将符合条件的 shell 命令路由给 rtk，压缩工具输出并节省 token。

description.en: Folds degenerate reasoning loops out of the model-visible history so they are not replayed upstream on the next turn. Detects two shapes — one sentence hammered repeatedly, and short-sentence rotation — and replaces the matched span in place; a companion escape valve aborts a turn that will not stop on its own.
description.zh: 把退化的思考复读从模型可见历史里折叠掉，下一轮不再回传上游。能识别两种形态——同一句反复死磕、以及短句轮换——并对命中的那段做等价替换；配套的急停阀则对停不下来的回合当场中止。

description.en: Render Mermaid code blocks as SVG diagrams in DeepSeek Harness Web, with diagram/code switching, streaming support, dark mode, strict security, and npm/GitHub installation.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页中把 Mermaid 代码块渲染成 SVG 图表，支持图表/代码切换、流式输出和深色模式，安全又方便。

description.en: 一个更快、更节省、更准确的 DeepSeek Harness 插编码件。在 SWE-bench Pro 最难的 100 道题中，回答耗时减少48%，每题token减少45%，正确率甚至增加了10%。A faster, more accurate, and more cost-effective DeepSeek Harness plug-in component. Among the 100 most difficult questions in SWE-bench Pro, the response time -48%, tokens per question -45%, and the accuracy rate even +10%.
description.zh: 让 DSH 编码更快更省更准，难题耗时降 48%、token 省 45%、正确率还涨 10%。

description.en: DSH 插件：内含 ppt-maker 技能与十一个 ppt_* 工具。创建 / 编辑 / 逆向 / 质检 / 导出 PPT，本地纯 TS 引擎直出 .pptx
description.zh: 在 DSH 里就能创建、编辑、复刻和导出 PPT，纯本地导出不用联网。

description.en: Installs Herta as a DeepSeek Harness agent: a preset carrying her persona and memory prompt sections, six memory and voice tools, a narrative layer that separates her thinking from what she says, 80 bundled voice clips, offline and MiniMax speech synthesis, and two conversation views that render the session with her own components.
description.zh: 把 Herta（黑塔）作为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体装入：携带人格与记忆提示词段的 preset、六个记忆与语音工具、区分内心与发言的叙述层、80 条随包语音、本地与 MiniMax 两条语音合成链路，以及两个用她自己的组件渲染会话的对话视图。

issues.detail: declares install-time scripts; the harness gates them via allowBuilds

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-herta-dsh
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for Herta-dsh

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Skills & MCP section in Settings: browse, create, edit and delete skills with live directory watching, toggle loading of any on-disk skill through frontmatter policy keys, register local folders or GitHub repos as extra skill scan roots, edit the MCP server rows in the profile patch, import MCP config from Claude Code or Codex, and install from a curated market of skill repos and MCP servers.
description.zh: 设置页的「技能与 MCP」分区：技能目录实时监听，可浏览、新建、编辑、删除技能，用 frontmatter 策略键开关任何落在磁盘上的技能；本地目录或 GitHub 仓库可注册为额外技能扫描根；profile 的 MCP 服务器行在页面上编辑，可从 Claude Code / Codex 配置导入；另带精选技能仓库与 MCP 服务器的市场。

description.en: Preview and move supported Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode setup into DSH, including skills, commands, agents, instructions, and MCP servers, with OpenCode V1/V2 JSONC support and collision-safe apply.
description.zh: 一键把 Claude Code 的技能、MCP、钩子和指令整体迁移到 DSH，拎包入住无缝衔接。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 跨会话记忆插件：对话模型边干边记的 Markdown 项目记忆，支持专题文件渐进式披露、可选后台静默蒸馏、按项目隔离与热更新设置面板。机制对齐 Claude Code auto memory。 | Agent-maintained cross-session Markdown memory: progressive-disclosure topic files, opt-in silent distillation, per-project isolation. Claude Code-aligned.
description.zh: 让对话模型跨会话记住项目关键信息，自动写入Markdown并在新会话中恢复，提升连续工作体验。
在 DSH 网页右侧开个面板，随手查看和管理你的 GitHub 项目。

description.en: DSH 本机安全审计插件：配置/插件来源/会话/网络暴露面，只读脱敏风险报告
description.zh: 只读扫描本机 DSH 配置、插件来源、会话和网络暴露面，生成脱敏安全风险报告

description.en: LLM-free lossless* compaction engine for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供即时、近无损的上下文压缩，无需 LLM 参与，显著节省 token 成本。

description.en: Codex-style conversation turn timeline and hover history overview for DSH Web UI
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面加上 Codex 风格的对话轮次时间线，鼠标一悬停就能看历史概览。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Bundle for Unreal Engine 5.8 via Unreal MCP
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接指挥 UE5.8 编辑器，通过官方 MCP 协议实现 AI 驱动的游戏开发自动化。

description.en: Out-of-tree installable plugin marketplace bundle for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供仓外插件市场，无需改源码即可安装和管理扩展插件。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：处理DSH沟槽的权限管理（full acess下传入同级或者降级的请求会报错，导致ai大战权限管理）
description.zh: 修复DSH沟槽权限管理问题，自动忽略无效的权限升级请求，避免AI与权限系统反复冲突。

description.en: Rule mining for data risk control, distilled from the ideas of the "100-Day Risk Control Expert" course
description.zh: 结合风控专家实战经验，自动完成数据质检与规则挖掘，帮你快速搞定金融风控场景。

description.en: Native DSH Hub marketplace plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把社区插件商店直接搬进 DeepSeek Harness，找插件、装插件一站搞定。

description.en: DSH 排队消息增强面板：编辑、删除、插话、排序与批量删除功能
description.zh: DSH 排队消息增强面板，支持编辑、删除、插话、排序和批量删除。

description.en: 会话顶栏实时显示 DeepSeek API 价格（峰谷定价 / 现行一口价，flash / pro 自动切换） | DeepSeek Harness client plugin: live DeepSeek API pricing badge (peak/off-peak, flash/pro) in the session header
description.zh: 会话顶栏实时显示 DeepSeek API 价格（峰谷定价 / 现行一口价，flash / pro 自动切换） | DeepSeek Harness client plugin: live DeepSeek API pricing badge (peak/off-peak, flash/pro) in the session header

description.en: LLM-free lossless compaction engine.
description.zh: 无 LLM 的无损压缩引擎。

description.en: Fully local document intelligence for DeepSeek Harness. Parse PDF, Office files, images, and scanned documents with offline OCR. | DeepSeek Harness 全本地文档智能插件，支持 PDF、Office、图片与离线 OCR
description.zh: Fully local document intelligence for DeepSeek Harness. Parse PDF, Office files, images, and scanned documents with offline OCR. | DeepSeek Harness 全本地文档智能插件，支持 PDF、Office、图片与离线 OCR

description.en: DSH Prompt Library plugin: prompt CRUD, tags & categories, import/export, AI polish, one-click clip selected text, sidebar and assistant bubble reminders.
description.zh: DSH提示词库插件：支持提示词增删改查、分类标签、导入导出、AI智能优化、选中文本一键剪藏，附带侧边栏与词库助手气泡提醒。

description.en: Generative, interactive UI for DeepSeek Harness: the agent picks per reply between 26 validated native components and sandboxed streaming HTML widgets, patches a rendered UI in place by component ID, restores tabs, sorts, filters and form values after a reload, and computes slider and filter changes in the browser without another model call.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供生成式交互界面：模型每次回答自行在 26 个校验过的原生组件与沙箱流式 HTML widget 之间选择，可按组件 ID 就地修补已渲染的界面，标签页、排序、筛选与表单值在刷新后恢复，滑块与筛选的重算在浏览器本地完成，不回调模型。

description.en: Fine grained per tool permission rules for DSH at the tools/pre-execute gate, deny and ask lists in Claude Code rule syntax (`Bash(rm -rf:*), Read(_secrets_), mcp__server__tool`), works standalone without migrating.
description.zh: 为 DSH 补上按工具粒度的权限规则：在 tools/pre-execute 强制执行 deny/ask 清单，规则语法与 Claude Code 相同，不迁移也能单独用。

description.en: Mobile-first Web UI quality-of-life pack for the DeepSeek Harness: a Chrome-style active-session tab bar, full-screen sidebar swipe open/close, overlay sidebar, collapsed-sidebar recents, keyboard-suppressing session switching, viewport/IME keyboard adaptation, touch feedback, code/table inner scrolling, hidden permission dropdown, a full-screen settings rewrite with tab memory, and a compositor-driven status pulse, no-touch-drag long-press protection — 14 features, each independently toggleable from the Settings QoL section with instant effect, persisted per browser in localStorage; pure client-side CSS/JS, mobile rules locked to viewports of 768px and below so desktop stays untouched.
description.zh: 面向 dsh Web GUI 的移动优先体验优化包：Chrome 式活跃会话标签页（Tab Bar）、全屏侧栏滑动开合、侧栏浮层与折叠态最近会话、切换会话不拉起输入法、viewport/键盘安全区适配、按钮触摸反馈、代码块表格内滚、隐藏权限下拉、设置页全屏重写与页签记忆、合成器线程状态动画、长按拖拽卡死修复——14 项功能均可在设置页 QoL 分区独立开关、即时生效，并按浏览器持久保存在 localStorage；纯客户端 CSS/JS，移动规则锁定 ≤768px 视口，桌面端零影响。

description.en: Scopes system-prompt personas by workspace path or session id (exact, prefix, contains, regex), with an optional default persona for sessions nothing claimed, a 人设 tab on the conversation showing the prompt actually sent, import and export of the list, and a switch that refuses tool writes to the persona store.
description.zh: 按工作区路径或会话 ID 分发 system prompt 人设（完全一致 / 前缀 / 包含 / 正则），可指定一条默认人设兜底；会话页有「人设」页签，能看到实际发出去的提示词；人设列表可导入导出；另有一个开关拒绝工具写入人设存储。

description.en: Cross-session persona and diary for DeepSeek Harness: a local gate decides whether a turn is worth remembering, then one extra model call turns it into a first-person diary entry plus an impression of the user, where every impression carries the specific moment that produced it. Later conversations inject about 2000 tokens of that as a self-memory block in three registers: a persona core, a section for judgements the model wrote itself, and the diary. There is a tool for the model to record a judgement in its own words, and a plain markdown hand-note file the human can write into which the plugin only ever reads. A sidebar panel lets you read, forget or export the archive, and forgetting demotes an entry rather than deleting it, so an old one still surfaces on a strong topical match. Local-only, secrets are stripped before anything is sent, and the archive is a plain folder you can read, edit or carry to another account. Zero runtime dependencies, no build step.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话人格与日记：本地闸门判断一轮值不值得记，值得才追加一次模型调用，产出一条第一人称日记加一份对用户的印象 —— 每条印象都带着产生它的那个具体瞬间。之后的对话把约 2000 token 的自我记忆注入系统提示词，分三种声音：人格内核、以及「我自己想的」那一栏（模型自己写下的判断）、还有日记。模型有一个工具能用自己的话记下判断；人则有一个纯 markdown 的手记文件可以手写，插件只读它、永不覆盖。侧栏面板能看、能删、能带走；遗忘是降级而不是删除，所以强相关的旧事仍然会被想起来。全程本地、发送前先拦掉密钥、档案是一个可读可改、能换账号带走的普通文件夹。零运行时依赖，无构建步骤。

description.en: Runs isolated install-and-smoke test drives for DSH plugins in throwaway profiles, returning structured pass/fail records and batch matrices without touching your real profile.
description.zh: 在一次性隔离配置中为 DSH 插件执行安装与冒烟测试，返回结构化的通过/失败记录与批量矩阵，不触碰真实配置。

description.en: Extends the working range of DSH into WSL. Files in the distribution can be read, written, edited and searched by DSH directly. Depending on the task, the AI chooses for itself: run a one-off command, or open its own terminal and run several commands there to finish the job. Typing `dsh` in a WSL terminal calls DSH (type `dsh help` there for details), fusing WSL and DSH deeply. Every terminal you open can collaborate visually with the AI.
description.zh: 将 DSH 的工作范围扩展到 WSL。插件支持了发行版中的文件直接被 DSH 读取、写入、编辑与搜索。面对不同任务需求，AI可根据任务需求自行选择执行一次性命令/自建终端执行多条命令以完成任务。支持在 WSL 终端中键入 dsh 命令调用 DSH(详情在 WSL 终端键入dsh help)，深度融合了 WSL 与 DSH。用户新建的所有终端支持与AI可视化协作。

description.en: Draws every branch of a conversation as a clickable tree beside the chat, with favorites, custom icons and colors, branch merge and split, rewind-aware layout, and Claude Code branches that keep their memory.
description.zh: 把一个对话的所有分支画成聊天区旁边的一棵可点击的树，支持收藏、自定义图标与颜色、分支合并与拆分、撤回感知的布局，以及带记忆的 Claude Code 分支。

description.en: Experience memory and reflection for DSH agents: automatically extracts candidate lessons after tasks and recalls user-reviewed lessons in relevant later tasks. Supports source provenance, project-scoped retrieval, conflict handling, usage feedback and expiry review; capture and recall have separate controls, and writing lessons to AGENTS.md requires preview and explicit application. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: DSH 智能体经验记忆与反思插件：任务后自动整理候选经验，经用户审阅采纳后在相关任务中自动召回。支持来源追溯、按项目检索、冲突处理、使用反馈和到期复核；整理与召回可分别开关，写入 AGENTS.md 需预览并手动应用。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Pin sessions and workspaces to the top of the Web sidebar with per-pin row colors, a header toggle and a pinned panel; 0.4.0 adds a navigation organizer — pin groups (boards), tags and saved filter views, session health summaries, and /goto.
description.zh: 把会话与工作区置顶到 Web 侧边栏顶部：行级图钉与换色、会话头开关、已置顶面板；0.4.0 再加导航组织器——Pin 分组（boards）、标签与保存视图、会话健康摘要与 /goto。

description.en: ShiGuang Memory Engine (SGME) bridge: multi-agent shared long-term memory via HTTP — L0/L1/L1.5/L2 distillation, scenario-based injection, unified search, and proactive care signals (memory_search / wiki_search / signal_pull / signal_claim / signal_ack), installable as `dsh-sgme`.
description.zh: 拾光记忆引擎（SGME）桥接：多智能体共享长期记忆（HTTP）—— L0/L1/L1.5/L2 分层提炼、按场景注入、统一检索、主动关怀信号（memory_search / wiki_search / signal_pull / signal_claim / signal_ack），npm 包名 `dsh-sgme`。

description.en: Terminal-style composer for the DSH web GUI: shell prompt history (↑/↓, prefix search, Ctrl+R), Codex-style completion and next-prompt prediction (Tab or → to accept), selection toolbar (copy / quote / ask in side chat), right-click paste, draggable chat TOC, and a parallel side-chat thread in the right sidebar.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 输入框提供终端式体验：↑/↓ 历史（前缀搜索、Ctrl+R）、Codex 风格的历史补全与下一句预测（Tab/→ 接受）、选中工具栏（复制/引用/侧聊追问）、右键直接粘贴、可拖动会话目录，以及能在右栏并行跑第二条 agent 线程的侧聊（fork 全上下文、浮动/分屏、双向桥接、并发写提醒）。

description.en: A markdown notes manager for DSH: full **MD notes manager** and **MD notes editor**, quickly capture conversations into notes, maintain notes by **syncing to Git repositories**, and **bring notes into the conversation context**.
description.zh: DSH 的 MD 笔记管理插件：提供完整的 **MD 笔记管理器** 和 **MD 笔记编辑器**，对话内容可快速记入笔记。笔记可 **同步 Git 仓库** 维护。对话时可将笔记 **加入上下文**。

description.en: Multi-dimensional quality scoring for DeepSeek Harness plugins that scores a repo or npm package across install success, maintenance activity, documentation completeness, security scan, and protocol compliance using real CLI evidence, and produces a JSON or Markdown leaderboard report.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件提供多指标质量评分：基于真实的 CLI 证据对某个仓库或 npm 包在安装成功率、维护活跃度、文档完整度、安全扫描和协议合规五个维度打分，并生成 JSON 或 Markdown 排行榜报告。

description.en: Persistent AI memory backed by a local Obsidian/Codex vault: five obsidian_memory_* read/write/search tools plus a sidebar vault browser.
description.zh: 基于本地 Obsidian/Codex 知识库的持久 AI 记忆：5 个 obsidian_memory_* 读写搜索工具，外加侧边栏知识库浏览器。

description.en: Knowledge base as a canvas in the right sidebar: notes are nodes, and nine tools let the model read, write, link and remove them. A node can carry pictures and documents, and reading one returns their text — Office files extracted in place — while pictures can be handed over as images.
description.zh: 右侧栏的卡片画布知识库：笔记就是节点，模型通过九个工具读写、连线、移除。节点可以挂图片和文档，读节点时连同内容一起返回（Office 文件就地抽取文本），图片还能作为图像直接交给模型。

description.en: Brings WorkBuddy desktop-app experts into DSH: a settings-page market scans the local WorkBuddy expert directory (experts land there after you summon them in WorkBuddy) read-only for browsing, search and category filtering, with one-click install (exported to ~/.dsh/experts/ as role prompt + skills + avatar), update and uninstall; a picker capsule next to the input box switches the current session's expert — swapping role prompt, skills and an optional tool whitelist wholesale while keeping full session history, applied at the next model-request boundary.
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 桌面端召唤落盘的本地专家带进 DSH：设置页市场只读扫描本地专家目录，卡片浏览/搜索/分类，一键安装（导出到 ~/.dsh/experts/，含角色描述、skills 与头像）、更新与卸载；输入框旁的专家胶囊为当前会话切换专家——整组替换角色描述与 skills（可选工具白名单），保留全部会话历史，在下一个模型请求边界生效。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns Jev judgments into three automatic actions — pruning oversized tool output to the segments relevant to the request, screening fetched pages for instructions aimed at the model, and picking which skill fits the next step — plus the jev_ask and jev_gate tools, a judgment ledger that survives restarts, and a /jev-status report. Needs a TypeSafe API key; without one it is inert and sends nothing.
description.zh: 把 Jev 判定变成三件自动动作的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：精简超长工具输出、筛查抓取页面里针对模型的指令、挑选下一步该用的 skill；另有 jev_ask 与 jev_gate 两个工具、可跨重启的判定账本，以及 /jev-status 报告。需要 TypeSafe API key，没有时完全惰性，不发任何请求。

description.en: DSH plugin: an IDE-grade Git tool window as a native dsh-better-sidebar tab — branch tree, commit graph, changes, commit details, JetBrains-style actions, in the right sidebar and the bottom panel. | DSH 插件:IDE 级 Git 工具窗口,以 dsh-better-sidebar 原生 Tab 挂载——分支树 / 提交图谱 / 变更与提交详情 / JetBrains 风格操作,右侧栏与底部面板双布局自适应。
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏装一个 IDE 级 Git 工具窗口，分支树、提交图谱、变更详情一屏看全，操作像 JetBrains 一样顺手。

description.en: Cline Pass for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): one pi-ai provider route pinned to the DeepSeek upstream channel, key entered on Settings → Models. Share-only snapshot — 分享性质，非长期维护。
description.zh: 把 Cline Pass 接进 DSH，注册一条 OpenAI 兼容路由，还能看清聊天响应到底来自哪个上游。

description.en: 百度贴吧的 DSH 插件：自动读帖、生成日报、签到（顺手关注）；回帖可选，带每轮/每日/间隔/去重四道限制。支持人设与日记，可按 DeepSeek 谷时在后台运行。
description.zh: 自动刷百度贴吧读帖、生成日报并签到，回帖可选且限频去重，还能按谷时后台运行。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness无名杀插件  无名杀扩展开发工坊:AI 按规范写武将技能与卡牌(确认协议/校验门禁/区块化写入)
description.zh: 让 AI 按规范写无名杀武将技能和卡牌扩展，自动校验、备份，写错删错都能拦下。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 基础工具增强：持久 bash、结构化 read、多模式 edit、原子 write、双引擎 grep/glob、图像直读，一个插件全覆盖
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的基础工具全面升级：bash 常驻、读写编辑更稳、搜索双引擎、图片直接看，装一个就够。
