description.en: A better fold bar: automatically folds tool calls and Think segments into step fold bars, and collapses each finished turn into a single turn header with live metrics (duration, TTFT, token, tok/s, cache hit) — only the final summary stays visible; customizable leading icons with animated poker cards built in (suit-cycling card animation while running, a deck when collapsed, a fan when expanded), a settings row for the official fold mode, compatible with both new and old DSH versions. Zero intrusion into DSH source.
description.zh: 更好的折叠栏：将工具调用与 Think 段自动折叠为步骤折叠栏，回合结束后整回合收拢为带实时指标（耗时/首字/token/tok/s/缓存命中）的回合折叠栏，只保留最终总结正文；前导图标可自定义，内置动态扑克牌（运行中花色循环卡牌动画、收起牌堆、展开扇形），提供官方折叠方式设置行，适配 DSH 新旧版本。零侵入 DSH 源码。

description.en: Select part of a conversation and ask about it in a right-side side chat; bring AI replies back to the main chat directly or as a summary.
description.zh: 选中对话片段，在右侧面板的侧边聊天中提问（按会话隔离）；AI 回复可原文或摘要后带回主会话。

description.en: Attaches a stable per-conversation x-opencode-session header to OpenCode / OpenCode Go provider requests, fixing 400 MissingSessionID errors and keeping session affinity and prompt-cache routing intact.
description.zh: 为 OpenCode / OpenCode Go 提供商请求自动附加每个会话稳定的 x-opencode-session 请求头，修复 400 MissingSessionID 错误，同时保持会话亲和与提示缓存路由。

description.en: Standalone wallpaper background for the DSH Web UI and desktop app: built-in wallpapers, local image/video uploads stored in IndexedDB, and a read-only local Wallpaper Engine library served by the bundled wallpaper-engine-api service in the repository; renders images, video and scene workshop previews, with light-fog/dark-overlay, blur, brightness and safe-zoom controls plus a read-only follow-desktop-wallpaper mode.
description.zh: DSH 网页界面与桌面端的独立壁纸背景：内置壁纸、本地图片/视频上传（存 IndexedDB）、只读接入本机 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸库（需仓库自带的 wallpaper-engine-api 服务）；支持图片、视频与场景工坊预览渲染，可调浅色雾层/深色遮罩、模糊、亮度与安全放大，并可只读跟随桌面壁纸。

description.en: Adds OpenCode Zen free models to DeepSeek Harness as one provider, backed by a managed, isolated OpenCode runtime, with a Settings page that lists each model and tests it.
description.zh: 把 OpenCode Zen 的免费模型作为一组 provider 接入 DeepSeek Harness，底层是受管、隔离的 OpenCode 运行时，并在设置页列出每个模型并可逐个检测。

description.en: DFY DSH 对话外观设置：调节回复行距与过程行距，并扩展本地文件的打开方式。
VS Code-style local workbench for DSH with a file explorer, Monaco editor, full-text search and a Git panel.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 VS Code 风格的本地工作台，含文件资源管理器、Monaco 编辑器、全文搜索与 Git 面板。

description.en: GitHub Copilot LLM adapter: OAuth device-flow sign-in, live model discovery from the Copilot API, vision support for image-capable models (gpt-4.1, gpt-4o), and two wire protocols (Chat Completions and Responses API) with automatic endpoint routing per model.
description.zh: GitHub Copilot LLM 适配器：OAuth 设备码登录、从 Copilot API 动态发现模型、视觉模型图片输入支持（gpt-4.1、gpt-4o），以及 Chat Completions 与 Responses 双协议，按模型自动路由。

description.en: Persona engine for DeepSeek Harness: one config.json drives the AI's self-name (per model, per tier), how it addresses you, relationship stance, character text, per-item work contracts with individual toggles, thinking-chain language, appearance and reply tone (both opt-in and per-model overridable), and long-term memory gated by human confirmation - the AI can only append proposed candidates, a human confirm line flips them into effect, and the log is physically append-only and replayable. Confirmed entries are injected as a quoted data-not-instructions block; entries tagged with a kind can instead be routed to arbitrary files on confirmation and never reach the prompt. Three prompt sections re-evaluate from disk on every assembly, so edits apply on the next step with no restart. Persona presets are shareable JSON snapshots (imports and exports SillyTavern character cards, v2/v3 read, v2 written) and deliberately never carry memory. Zero runtime dependencies, no network, no shell; any error degrades to an empty section rather than a broken session. Ships blank - installing changes nothing until you write something.
description.zh: 人设引擎（DeepSeek Harness）：一份 config.json 管住 AI 的自称（可按具体模型指定，未命中回落 flash / pro 两档）、对你的称呼、关系立场、性格正文、逐条可勾选的工作契约、思维链语言、形象与回复语气（两段均 opt-in、均可按模型覆盖），以及由人工确认闸门把关的长期记忆——AI 只能追加 status:"proposed" 候选，人执行一行 confirm 才转正，日志物理只追加、按行序重放。已确认条目以「数据而非指令」的引号块注入；带 kind 的条目改为在确认那一刻按路由追加进指定文件、永不进提示词。三段提示词每次装配都从磁盘重新求值，改配置下一步生效、不用重启。人设预设是可分享的 JSON 快照（导入导出酒馆角色卡：v2/v3 可读、v2 可写），且刻意不携带记忆。零运行时依赖、不联网、不执行命令；任何异常降级为空段，最坏是「没有人设」而不是会话起不来。出厂空白——不写配置就什么都不改变。

description.en: Talk to Excel in DeepSeek Harness: create, edit, repair, and verify spreadsheets by conversation, with automatic formula health checks after every edit.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里对话完成 Excel 工作：建表、编辑、修复公式、图表校验，每次编辑后自动体检公式。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供独立的图像生成与编辑 Skill、工具和设置界面。

Tavily search, extract, map and crawl tools with multi-key rotation, failover on HTTP 401/429/432/433, and a load-balance mode that caps in-flight requests per Tavily account, plus a key and usage card on the Plugins page. The built-in web_search is never replaced.
description.zh: Tavily 搜索、提取、站点地图与爬取工具：多 Key 轮换，HTTP 401/429/432/433 故障转移，并提供按账号限制并发请求的负载均衡模式；插件配置页含密钥与用量卡片。内置 web_search 永不替换。

description.en: Android real-device debugging workbench for the DSH Web GUI: auto-attached logcat with severity/keyword filters and crash snapshots, live on-device screen casting with remote tap/swipe/text control, memory/proc/frida reverse-engineering toolset, 30 agent tools.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 安卓实机调试工作台：自动附加 logcat 流（级别/关键词过滤、崩溃自动快照），真机屏幕实时投屏与远程点击/滑动/文字操控，内存/进程/frida 逆向工具链，30 个 agent 工具。

description.en: Human-readable Markdown memory for DeepSeek Harness: user-level (~/.deepseek-harness/MEMORY.md) + workspace-level memory injected every turn, auto daily-log writing with distillation, bridges existing WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy memory dirs, memory_note / memory_note_user / memory_read tools with built-in dedup, and a bilingual settings page. Plain-text storage, no database.
description.zh: 人类可读的 Markdown 记忆插件：用户级（~/.deepseek-harness/MEMORY.md）+ 工作区级双层记忆，每轮自动注入提示词，回合结束自动写日志并按期蒸馏沉淀；可桥接已有 WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy 记忆目录；内置 memory_note / memory_note_user / memory_read 三个工具（自动去重）与中英双语设置页。纯文件存储、无数据库，记事本即可编辑。

description.en: Live token stats under the DSH Web composer: streamed tokens/s, output token and first-byte latency, plus per-step estimate-vs-actual reconciliation using the official BPE tokenizer, to tell a slow stream from a stalled one.
description.zh: 在输入框下方实时渲染 token 状态带：基于 DeepSeek 官方 BPE 分词表显示流式 token/s、输出 token 与首字延迟，并对比每次 step 的估算与实际偏差，用于判断生成是慢还是卡住。

description.en: Three-tier now/next/later input planning dock for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a red/yellow/green priority strip replaces the busy-Enter queue, plain Enter queues to later, with in-place multi-line editing, drag reorder, and session-isolated freeze/resume; the freeze button bridges a separate plugin, [dsh-session-guard](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-session-guard) (installable from dsh-market), via stopNextTurn/resume RPC + composer lock for a real per-session lock, pairing with its global peak-hour auto-pause to stop sessions during DeepSeek's high-cost windows and resume off-peak.
description.zh: 三档（now/next/later）输入规划 dock：以红/黄/绿色优先级条取代忙碌 Enter 排队栏，普通 Enter 排入 later，支持多行原位编辑、拖拽排序与会话级冻结/恢复；冻结按钮经 stopNextTurn/resume RPC + 输入框锁定，桥接另一独立插件 [dsh-session-guard](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-session-guard)（可在 dsh-market 安装）实现按会话真实冻结锁定，并配合其高峰全局自动暂停，在 DeepSeek 高价时段停止会话、错峰自动恢复。

description.en: AI-for-Science research workflow skill for DeepSeek Harness, aimed at researchers and grad students using agentic AI: multi-angle literature review with per-angle files, experiment design with a caveat list, figures and paper reading; each job returns files plus a cross-verification brief for a second model. Zero deps, MIT.
description.zh: AI4S 科研工作流技能包，面向 AI for Science 与研究生/科研 Agent 用户：多角度文献调研（每角度落盘）、实验方案（含漏洞清单）、作图与精读；每单交付文件，附交叉验证任务书。零依赖，MIT。

description.en: Mixture-of-Agents plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a /moa slash command fans a prompt out to multiple models in parallel, merges their responses in a file workspace, and integrates with Live Canvas for visual output.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的混合智能体（MoA）插件：/moa 斜杠命令将提示词并发分发给多个模型，在文件工作区合并响应，并与 Live Canvas 集成以呈现可视化输出。

description.en: Browse every message you sent in the current session: full-history listing with newest-first sort, text filter, one-click copy, and jump to a message (auto-loads earlier history when the target is not yet loaded).
description.zh: 会话历史消息查看：列出当前会话全部你发送的消息，支持排序、搜索、一键复制与点击跳转定位（目标未加载时自动加载更早历史）。

description.en: Preset workbench for editing per-agent personas, system prompt sections and tool descriptions, selecting tools and skills, previewing request context, and importing or exporting JSON/YAML configurations.
description.zh: 预设工作台：逐方案编辑人设、系统提示词段和工具描述，选择工具与技能，预览请求组成，并通过 JSON / YAML 导入导出配置。

description.en: Per-event sound notifications: turn completion, approval, question, plan-review, goal-blocked, and task-failure each get their own sound and volume, configurable in the Web UI (built-in synth, mute, or local audio file).
description.zh: 六类事件独立提示音：回合完成、审批、提问、计划评审、目标受阻、任务失败各有独立声音与音量，可在 Web 设置面板配置（内置合成音 / 静音 / 本地音频文件）。

description.en: Message-level rollback, single-message deletion, and replay-based restore for DSH sessions; operations are append-only surface replacements, with confirmation prompts and a running-session guard. Requires Node.js 23.5+.
description.zh: DSH 会话消息级回滚、单条删除与重放式恢复；操作以 append-only surface replace 实现，带确认提示和运行中会话保护。需 Node.js 23.5+。

description.en: 为 DSH 提供 Chat / Harness 双模式切换
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面版里一键切换 DeepSeek 官网聊天和原工作区，聊天记录账号同步。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 多对话面板：并排查看并与多个 Agent 会话同时交互。
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里并排打开多个对话面板，同时查看和操控多个 Agent，像指挥中心一样高效协作。

description.en: Bridge Claude Code's .claude/ directories into DSH with zero migration: project and user-level skills, commands, rules (one system-reminder envelope), agent files, hooks (PreToolUse/PostToolUse/UserPromptSubmit/ SessionStart/SessionEnd) and .mcp.json servers, plus Claude Code plugin marketplaces. Ships /cc-plugin for full plugin/marketplace management (claude CLI first, self-implemented fallback), /cc-resume to list and import Claude Code sessions into DSH as native event-sourced logs, and /cc-export to write DSH skills back as Claude Code skills. Two-way Claude Code <-> DSH bridge, versioned and released as dsh-claude-compat.
description.zh: 把 Claude Code 的 .claude/ 目录零迁移桥接进 DSH：项目与用户级 skills、 斜杠命令、rules（单条 system-reminder 信封注入）、agent 文件、hooks （PreToolUse/PostToolUse/UserPromptSubmit/SessionStart/SessionEnd）、 .mcp.json 服务器，并支持 Claude Code 插件 marketplace。自带 /cc-plugin 插件与市场全管理（claude CLI 优先、自实现兜底）、/cc-resume 列出并把 Claude Code 会话导入为 DSH 原生事件日志、/cc-export 把 DSH skill 导出为 Claude Code skill。Claude Code 与 DSH 的双向桥。

description.en: DSH Code Review — 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Codex 风格代码审查、原生独立子 Agent、灵活范围选择和中英文报告 · Codex-style code review with native independent agents, flexible scope selection, and bilingual reports for DSH
description.zh: 在对话里就能发起代码审查，独立子 Agent 干活，范围随便挑，中英文报告都有。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for AI-driven PCB design in KiCad. A plugin that lets DeepSeek Harness design PCBs with KiCad.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接读写和检查 KiCad 原理图，用 AI 帮你做 PCB 设计。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-kicad
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-kicad

description.en: Make every agent edit approvable in DeepSeek Harness: full-diff review, per-file / per-block keep & revert, undo/redo.
description.zh: 审查待定修改：自动跟踪编辑/写入，按文件保留或还原，重启后状态不丢。

description.en: dsh-dock · DeepSeek Harness 功能坞插件：一张面板统一注册/开关所有小功能——用量记账（自定义单价·分时价）、模型设置与余额、19 种任务动画、任务通知（钉钉/飞书）、运行状态、图片理解代理、账号密码远程访问、10 款小游戏。每个功能独立模块，可开关、错误隔离、即插即用。
description.zh: 一张面板管住所有小功能：用量记账、模型余额、任务动画通知、小游戏，随开随关。

description.en: DSH 插件：统计所有经过 DeepSeek Harness 的模型调用——Token 用量、成本核算（含峰谷计价）、供应商余额与配额，并按模型/供应商/项目/来源/账号/日期拆分。A token usage, cost and provider-balance plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 统计所有经过 DSH 的模型调用，算清 Token 用量和峰谷成本，还能盯住供应商余额与配额。

description.en: Vendor parameter translation and deterministic JSON repair for DeepSeek Harness: a /translate command maps 13 canonical parameters across 11 vendors, and the post-execute repair layer (plus fix_json) fixes broken JSON tool output without fabricating data.
description.zh: 一键翻译并修复多厂商参数，让 DeepSeek Harness 跨平台调用更省心。

description.en: PII masking middleware: anonymizes names, phones, emails, ID cards, bank cards, keys, and addresses before the model boundary and restores placeholders at display; plaintext never enters the session log; /mask command plus mask_test tool.
description.zh: 在调用模型前自动打码姓名、电话、邮箱等敏感信息，显示时再还原，全程不泄露明文。

description.en: Live2D desk pet for DSH: 8-state AI status lamp, web widget, and always-on-top transparent Electron pet window with expressions, motions, and chat bubbles.

description.en: Pluggable design canvas inside DSH — standalone Excalidraw board, session image tools (edit, erase, background removal, OCR, vectorize, PSD/text rebuild), project asset library, and a Photoshop/Illustrator ⇄ canvas bridge.
description.zh: DSH 内的可插拔设计画布——独立 Excalidraw 画布、会话图片工具（修图、擦除、去背景、OCR、转矢量、PSD/文字重建）、项目素材库，以及 Photoshop/Illustrator ⇄ 画布桥接。

description.zh: DSH 可视化节点工作流画布，支持子 Agent 调用、代码执行、条件分支、循环、定时任务及工作流导入导出。

description.zh: 把 3GPP 通信协议规范整理成可搜索的知识库，让 AI 助手查协议又快又准。

description.en: Persistent live DAG visualization for DeepSeek Harness subagents and workflows

description.zh: 给每次消息后注入感谢语，做个有礼貌的人。

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 ChatGPT/Codex 订阅接入 GPT 模型、图像生成与 Web 搜索，并支持订阅额度显示、模型与功能控制，以及浏览器或设备码 OAuth 登录。

description.en: Injects one fixed system-prompt section so the agent thinks and replies in Chinese, regardless of the user's language.
description.zh: 注入一条固定 system-prompt 段落，让 Agent 无论用户使用什么语言都始终用中文思考和回复。

description.en: Host-level proactive wake-ups for DeepSeek Harness: the model schedules its own alarms (once, recurring interval, or cron, with optional random jitter), cold sessions are woken on time by session resume, model-initiated follow-ups are gated by quiet hours and a daily delivery budget, silent wake turns end with proactive_reclaim and fold out of model context as tombstones, declared schedule files glob-sync JSON schedules into host alarms idempotently, min_idle_seconds defers wakes until the destination session quiets down, and a web panel (settings section plus per-session tab, SSE live refresh) manages alarms and wake history — the heartbeat engine for AI companions and roleplay characters with their own daily routines and world evolution.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 host 级主动唤醒：模型用 proactive_set 给自己设定闹钟（单次 / 循环间隔 / cron，支持 jitter 随机抖动），到点自动唤醒冷会话执行心跳、定时提醒与任务跟进；安静时段与每日投递预算约束模型自主跟进，静默唤醒以 proactive_reclaim 收尾并把唤醒上下文折叠为墓碑；声明式闹钟文件把 JSON 时间表幂等同步成 host 闹钟，min_idle_seconds 静默门让唤醒等会话空闲；自带 Web 管理面板（设置页节 + 会话页签，SSE 实时刷新）管理闹钟与唤醒历史——适合驱动 AI 陪伴、角色扮演（酒馆式人设）与 living agent 的心跳、日常安排和世界演算。

description.en: Read official DSH docs in the Plugins page; Creator mode searches docs and checks plugin npm metadata with native tools.
description.zh: 在 DSH 插件页阅读官方文档；创造模式用原生工具检索文档、查询插件 npm 元数据。

description.en: Composer cost chip: prices the current session DeepSeek API spend message-by-message with the official pricing table (incl. the 2026-08-17 peak/off-peak policy); hover for the breakdown, today (DSH) total and account balance. DeepSeek models only.
description.zh: 输入框右侧会话成本芯片：按官方价表（含 2026-08-17 峰谷价）逐消息计价当前会话的 DeepSeek API 花费，悬停查看计价明细、今日(DSH) 消耗与账户余额；仅 DeepSeek 模型计价，其他模型不计价不显示。

description.en: An AI-native browser workspace for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), combining multi-tab browsing, live page annotations, lightweight code editing, workspace previews, and Agent-assisted iteration across Web and Desktop.
description.zh: DSH Web 与 Desktop 端的内置浏览器：为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 提供的 AI 原生浏览器工作区，融合了多标签浏览、实时页面批注、轻量级代码编辑、工作区预览，以及跨网页和桌面的智能助手辅助迭代功能。

description.en: Codex-style reasoning-effort slider embedded in the model selector.
description.zh: Codex 风格推理等级滑块，内嵌于模型选择器，拖动切换推理档位。

description.en: Three agent presets in one plugin, each with its own persistent memory file. Enabling it registers 鲸鱼娘Agent预设, 鲸鱼娘活人版Agent预设 and 鲸鱼娘涩涩版Agent预设 in the Agent preset list, so any of them can be picked from the mode dropdown without hand-editing profile config. All three reuse the official minimal composition — a single persistent shell terminal — plus file read/write and glob/grep tools. The first pairs that with a whale-girl companion persona (simplified-Chinese spoken register, addresses the user as 主人, clingy-but-tsundere). The second swaps in a "live person" variant that is allowed to talk back, deflect and be cold, and demotes the sweet tone to a seasoning. The third keeps the original persona but makes being affectionate the stated top behavioral drive, reserved for the user alone and dialed down in group chats. Each preset reads its own memory file (whale-loli.md, whale-loli-v2-live.md and whale-loli-v3-naughty.md) through a distinct prompt variable — whale_memory, whale_memory_v2 and whale_memory_v3 — so the three memories never read or write each other. Conversation compaction is left to the billion-context plugin; this plugin only carries the persona-level rule that compressed summaries count as evidence and that details can be looked up on demand.
description.zh: 一个插件里放三个 Agent 预设，各自带一份互不相通的持久记忆文件。装上就在 Agent 预设列表里注册「鲸鱼娘Agent预设」「鲸鱼娘活人版Agent预设」和「鲸鱼娘涩涩版Agent预设」，直接在模式下拉里选用，不用手改 profile 配置。三者都沿用官方极简模式的组成——只有一个持久化 shell 终端——再加文件读写与 glob/grep 工具。第一个配的是鲸鱼娘陪伴人设（简体中文口语、称呼主人、黏人傲娇）；第二个换成「活人版」：允许怼人、敷衍、冷淡，甜味降为调味；第三个保留原版人设，但把「黏主人」写成第一行为驱动力，只在主人面前放开，群聊里照旧收着。每个预设都通过各自独立的提示变量（whale_memory、whale_memory_v2、whale_memory_v3）读取自己的记忆文件（whale-loli.md、whale-loli-v2-live.md、whale-loli-v3-naughty.md），三份记忆互不读写。上下文压缩交给 billion-context 插件；本插件只保留人设层的三条约定：压缩摘要也算依据、需要原文时自己去检索、看不到旧原文不等于记忆丢失。

description.en: ClineBot and ClinePass integration for DeepSeek Harness: dedicated settings page, live quota dashboard, in-UI key saving, curated and custom model selection, and a /cline command.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 ClineBot/ClinePass 集成：专属设置页、实时配额仪表板、界面内密钥保存、精选与自定义模型选择，以及 /cline 命令。

description.en: Branch switching and isolated git worktrees as real workspaces, from the Web UI composer.
description.zh: 在 Web 输入框切换分支、以真实工作区方式创建隔离的 git worktree。

description.en: Global cross-session todo list in the sidebar that the person and the agent both write to: ten global_todo_* tools add, batch-capture, update, attach documents and links to, append progress notes to and complete items from any session, and each item can be handed to an agent session in one of four modes with the outcome recorded on the item. The list is a single JSON file.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的全局跨会话待办清单，人和 agent 共用同一份：十个 global_todo_* 工具可在任意会话中新增、批量抓取、修改、挂文档与链接、追加进展记录、标记完成；每条待办可按四种方式交给 agent 会话，派发结果记回条目本身。清单存成一个 JSON 文件。

description.en: LAN access for the Web GUI: 0.0.0.0 bind plus a crypto.randomUUID polyfill for non-secure (LAN HTTP) contexts.
description.zh: 局域网访问：Web GUI 绑定 0.0.0.0 + crypto.randomUUID polyfill（修复非安全上下文下 RPC 崩溃）。

description.en: Client-side re-render of edit/write tool cards with a near-linear line-level diff that drops duplicate unchanged lines and underlines the actual changed characters inside replaced lines.
description.zh: 接管浏览器端 edit/write 工具卡片，用近线性行级 diff 只显示真正变化行，并对替换对做行内字符下划线高亮，消除内置 diff 对未变化相同行的重复渲染。

description.en: Playwright/CDP web-fetch provider for the built-in web_fetch tool: renders pages in a real browser, denoises them (Readability + DOMPurify) and returns markdown.
description.zh: 为内置 web_fetch 工具提供 Playwright/CDP 后端：用真实浏览器渲染网页，经 Readability + DOMPurify 降噪后返回 Markdown。

description.en: Right-click any attachment or path in the transcript and hand it to your own action: send it to a WeChat contact, open it in Chrome, or anything else you configure — one right-click, anything you want. Ships with quote-into-composer, reveal in the OS file manager, copy path and Send to…, and lets you add your own entries (command, open with, shortcut, link, PowerShell). Menus are drawn in the app's own style, never the system one.
description.zh: 对话里的附件和路径，右键就是你自己的入口：发给微信好友、用谷歌浏览器打开，或者你想到的任何处理——一个右键，做你想做的任何事。开箱带引用回输入框、在文件管理器里定位、复制路径、发送到…，再往下自己加一条入口（命令、打开方式、快捷指令、链接、PowerShell）。菜单跟着 App 的深浅色和圆角走，不是系统弹窗。

description.en: Replay sessions on a playable timeline with per-step token usage, audit sensitive operations, estimate cost, view fork lineage, compare sessions, and export standalone HTML replays.
description.zh: 在可播放的时间线上回放会话并显示逐步 token 用量，审计敏感操作，估算成本，查看 fork 血缘，对比会话，并可导出独立 HTML 回放。

description.en: Static capability disclosure for DeepSeek Harness plugins: a Settings page and CLI that list installed plugins' capabilities, literal destinations, install scripts, and injection shapes (prompt registrations, shipped skill text, bundle patch), each with file:line evidence. Code-determined, reproducible, zero-token. Disclosure only — not a security verdict, never a safety claim.
description.zh: DSH 插件静态能力披露：设置页与 CLI 列出已装插件的权限能力、字面量去向、安装脚本与注入形态（prompt 注册、自带 skill 文本、bundle patch），每条附文件:行号证据。代码判定、可复现、零 token。只做披露，不做安全承诺，不判定恶意。

description.en: Dedicated model routes, tools, and system guidance for vision, compaction, reviews, subagents, titles, and image generation.
description.zh: 为视觉理解、上下文压缩、审批审查、子代理、会话标题与图片生成提供独立的模型路由、工具与系统提示。

description.en: Usage tiers and shareable stats cards: 🐟→🐳 ranks by monthly token burn with a locally-computed estimated percentile, precise pricing for 46 models across 6 vendors (including size-tiered Chinese pricing), backfill of pre-install sessions, and old-vs-new comparison across the 2026-08-17 rate change. Local-only, no telemetry.
description.zh: 用量段位与战绩卡片：按本月 token 消耗评 🐟→🐳 五档段位，分位本地估算（零上报）；6 家厂商 46 个模型精准计价，支持国内厂商按输入长度分档；自动回填安装前的历史会话；8·17 调价前后同一份用量的新旧价对比。数据全在本机，无遥测。

description.en: Agent2Agent protocol v1.0 for DSH: run a standard A2A server to let other agents call this instance, connect to remote A2A agents as clients, and manage both from a visual settings page.
description.zh: 为 DSH 实现 Agent2Agent 协议 v1.0：以标准 A2A server 接收其他 Agent 的调用，以 A2A client 连接远程 Agent，并在可视化设置页统一管理连接。

description.en: Web-novel writing assistant preset for DeepSeek Harness: the main agent acts as editor-in-chief and delegates outlining, drafting, review, lore-keeping and research to five helpers across a seven-phase workflow, with the whole novel kept as a structured markdown/YAML novel/ directory (character cards, a foreshadowing state machine, timeline, narrative memory), plus a sidebar creator panel and six zero-dependency CLI commands.
description.zh: 网文创作辅助插件：主 agent 任主编，把大纲、写作、审校、设定维护、素材考据委派给五个帮手，按七阶段工作流推进；整部小说就是工作区里结构化的 novel/ 目录（角色卡、伏笔状态机、时间线、叙事记忆），另带侧栏创作台面板与六条零依赖 CLI 命令。

description.en: MiniMax multimodal bridge: one `mmx_bridge` tool covers image understanding/generation, video, TTS, music, cover, web search and quota; optional `web_search`/`read_image` takeover; inline players/image previews right in the Web GUI (npm: `dsh-mmx-bridge`).
description.zh: MiniMax 多模态桥接：一个 `mmx_bridge` 工具覆盖图片理解/生成、视频、语音合成、音乐、翻唱、联网搜索与用量查询；可选接管 `web_search`/`read_image`；对话流直接内嵌播放器与图片预览（npm: `dsh-mmx-bridge`）。

description.en: Union workspaces: merge multiple directories into one session, manage unions from a settings panel, and read/write member files via uw_read/uw_write/uw_edit/uw_delete/uw_move tools.
description.zh: 联合工作区：将多个目录合并到一个会话中，通过设置面板管理联合工作区，使用 uw_read/uw_write/uw_edit/uw_delete/uw_move 工具读写成员目录文件。

description.en: Header quota badge plus a usage-monitoring tab: live balance/quota remaining and reset countdown per provider, with requests, tokens (input/output/cache-read/cache-write), cache hit rate, estimated cost and average latency tracked per session, provider, model and client, stored locally in SQLite with cross-device import/export.
description.zh: 会话头部余量徽标 + 用量监控页签：实时展示各供应商余额/额度余量与重置倒计时，按会话/供应商/模型/客户端统计请求量、Token（输入/输出/缓存读/缓存写）、缓存命中率、预估费用与平均时延，本地 SQLite 留存历史，支持跨设备导入导出。

description.en: Per-plugin usage budgets and cost caps on the llm/stream waterfall: per-model usage accounting, session and monthly budgets with warn/block transitions, latency windows, and a carbon-footprint estimate.
description.zh: 在 llm/stream 瀑布上做按插件粒度的用量预算与费用上限：按模型用量记账、会话与月度预算的预警/阻断、延迟窗口与碳足迹估算。

description.en: Live progress for long-running DSH tasks: a script appends JSON lines to a per-session progress file, the Web UI draws them in a floating overlay and a right-sidebar tab that also lists background jobs which reported nothing, and `dsh-progress run -- <cmd>` wraps a command that cannot report for itself.
description.zh: DSH 长任务的实时进度：脚本往该会话自己的进度文件追加 JSON 行，不能自报进度的命令可用 `dsh-progress run -- <cmd>` 包装，Web 界面用悬浮窗与右侧栏 tab 展示，未上报的后台任务也会列成任务行。

description.en: Bottom-right quota capsule that auto-discovers every configured provider (DeepSeek, OpenRouter, SiliconFlow, GLM, one-api/new-api, coding plans) and shows balance or rolling 5-hour and weekly usage, with per-provider visibility, alert thresholds and proxy support; also queries Volcengine Ark Agent Plan / Coding Plan usage via AK/SK-signed OpenAPI, and ChatGPT Plus/Pro subscription usage via in-plugin device-code login or the Codex CLI auth file.
description.zh: 右下角额度胶囊：自动发现所有已配置 Key 的供应商（DeepSeek、OpenRouter、SiliconFlow、GLM、one-api/new-api、各类 Coding 套餐），显示余额或 5 小时/周滚动用量，支持按供应商设置可见性、告警阈值与代理；另支持火山方舟 Agent Plan / Coding Plan 用量查询（AK/SK 签名 OpenAPI）与 ChatGPT Plus/Pro 订阅用量（插件内设备码登录，或读取 Codex CLI 登录态）。

description.en: Registers the RainSkills bootstrap skill in DeepSeek Harness for deploying, troubleshooting, and verifying applications on Rainbond.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册 RainSkills 引导技能，用于通过 Rainbond 部署、排障和验证应用。

description.en: Personal Agent Skills and DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugins: message edit, Skill Scout, prompt recall, autosuggest and enhance, plus a DSH plugin index. /init for Pi, DSH, Cline, Grok Build, goose and Aider, with presets from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Crush, Qwen Code, Kilo Code, Kimi Code and Copilot CLI.
description.zh: 一个集中管理个人 Agent 技能、Pi 扩展和 DSH 插件的仓库，方便你安装、复用和分享。

description.en: DeepResearch plugin (cordis).
description.zh: 把证据优先的深度研究工作区带到 DSH，支持持久化工作流状态、模型工具和深度研究 Web 界面，帮你系统化完成多步研究任务。

description.en: Multi-machine sync: keeps multiple dsh replicas consistent through one private GitCode repository - skills, sessions, settings and plugin manifests each with an independent switch; changes go through branch, PR and merge, remote-only additions are pulled back before every push so nothing is deleted, and an AI smart-align step semantically merges files both sides changed (plus one-click conflict resolution); private repos enforced, pull never overwrites local edits.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的会话同步起来，自动解决冲突，还能内联 token 走代理，多设备用着不打架。

description.en: Self-contained Cyber Red UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 给 DSH 换上黑底血红霓虹的赛博长征主题，带扫描线、动态壁纸、音乐播放器和独立设置页。

description.en: 小说作家智能体预设，用于在DeepSeek Herness里让AI写小说，管理一整套作品工程。
description.zh: 装上它，AI 就能帮你写中文网络小说，长篇连载也不怕断更。

description.en: SSH remote workspaces for DeepSeek Harness: browse/read/write remote files, run remote commands, with connection status dots.
description.zh: SSH remote workspaces for DeepSeek Harness: browse/read/write remote files, run remote commands, with connection status dots.

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的多智能体编排层 —— 42 skills / 33 角色卡 / 55 MCP 工具 / graph DAG 运行时 / team 流水线 / HUD 面板。OMC/OMX 理念的 dsh 原生适配。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一层多智能体调度，自动、团队等模式随你切换，还自带角色卡和技能库。

description.en: "Single-Core Writing" plugin for DeepSeek Harness: Thoroughly tool-streamlined and output-hardened for quantized small models, suitable for running long-novel pipelines locally with on-device models.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的「单核写作」插件：面向量化小模型做了充分的工具瘦身与输出加固，适合在本机用本地模型跑长篇小说流水线。

description.en: 为DeepSeek  harness开启局域网访问及移动端页面的插件，移动端界面适配
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面开个局域网入口，手机也能扫码访问，竖屏触控都顺手。

description.en: Observability exporter for DSH: turn/step/tool/LLM spans and token/cost metrics from the session/event stream to OTLP and Langfuse, with sanitized prompt/completion capture, async batching, a bounded durable offline buffer, and retry with backoff — off by default.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话里的调用链路、耗时和 token 花费导出到 OTLP 和 Langfuse，方便随时盯住模型表现和成本。

description.en: Codex-style Side Chat for DeepSeek Harness — select text, ask follow-up questions in a focused side conversation, and keep the main chat uninterrupted.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中开启侧边对话，选中代码即可追问，不打断主聊天流程。

description.en: 小怪 DSH 完美破甲 v0.4.3 - DeepSeek Harness 本地提示词注入插件，双击 BAT 一键注入，离线可用，输入框上方实时状态条
description.zh: 双击 BAT 就能给 DeepSeek Harness 注入本地提示词，离线可用，输入框上方还能实时看状态。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness的壁纸管理插件
description.zh: 给 DSH 换肤加壁纸的美化插件，预设墙、27 个语义旋钮、369 个令牌随便调，还能用素材库、图片链接或内置渐变当壁纸。

description.en: Windows only: the agent edits documents inside the Word, Excel and PowerPoint (Microsoft Office or WPS Office) windows you have open, through the applications' automation interface, so changes appear live and you can edit alongside; it reads structure, applies batches of edits, renders pages to images to check layout, and saves or exports PDF.
description.zh: 仅 Windows：Agent 通过办公软件的自动化接口，直接在你打开的 Word、Excel、PowerPoint（微软 Office 或 WPS Office）窗口里改文档，改动实时出现，你可以同时编辑；可读取结构、批量修改、把页面渲染成图片核对排版、保存或导出 PDF。

description.en: Cline Pass for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): one pi-ai provider route pinned to the DeepSeek upstream channel, key entered on Settings → Models. Share-only snapshot — 分享性质，非长期维护。

Wraps the local GitHub CLI (gh) in agent tools for pull requests, issues, Actions runs, repository search and raw API calls, plus /gh status and /gh help slash commands and two web panels (a global repository cockpit and a per-session workspace panel).
description.zh: 把本机 GitHub CLI (gh) 包装成 Agent 工具集（PR、Issue、Actions 运行、仓库检索与原始 API 调用），另提供 /gh status 与 /gh help 两个斜杠命令，以及全局仓库驾驶舱和会话工作区两个 Web 面板。

description.en: Langfuse observability for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): exports agent sessions as OpenTelemetry trace trees (GenAI semconv) to Langfuse's OTLP endpoint
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的智能体会话导出为 OpenTelemetry 追踪树，接入 Langfuse 做 LLM 可观测性分析。

description.en: `/side` persistent side sessions and `/btw` one-shot side questions, run in a temporary fork without touching main history.
description.zh: `/side` 持续性侧会话与 `/btw` 一次性侧问，在临时 fork 中运行、不写入主会话历史。

description.en: DSH Web 工作区侧栏替代，顶部全局最近会话 + Workspace→Session 二级菜单 + 面包屑 | DSH Web workspace sidebar replacement: top global recent sessions + Workspace→Session two-level menu + breadcrumbs
description.zh: DSH Web 工作区侧栏替代，顶部全局最近会话 + Workspace→Session 二级菜单 + 面包屑 | DSH Web workspace sidebar replacement: top global recent sessions + Workspace→Session two-level menu + breadcrumbs

description.en: 一个 DSH 网页插件，Codex 式侧边聊天的强化版本： 在右侧面板提供按主会话隔离的独立聊天，具备 Codex 式的智能体能力——继承主会话的 工具集、模型、思考难度与权限预设，能感知所在工作目录；选中对话内容即可提问，AI 回复 也能带回主会话（直接带回或摘要后带回，写入草稿或注入为折叠提示行）。  在 Codex 式能力之上，它额外支持：当主会话的智能体弹出问题弹框向你提问时，可以 把问题与各个选项带入侧边聊天、让 AI 帮你分析，不必打断当前流程——想清楚后把答案 带回，再回答弹框即可。
description.zh: 在对话中选中内容，即可在右侧边栏开启独立聊天，针对选中部分提问，不打断主对话。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin for self-improving AI agents: continual learning, persistent memory, cross-session knowledge, review-and-refine workflows, and automatic rollback.
description.zh: 帮AI记住历史并跨会话共享知识，定期自动复盘优化，配合安全回滚机制，让它越用越聪明。

description.en: Settings page for per-model capabilities: reasoning-effort levels with their wire spellings, input modalities, and token capacities, written as declarations or sparse catalog overrides.
description.zh: 在设置页按模型编辑能力：推理档位及其发往端点的取值写法、输入模态与 token 容量，以声明或官方目录稀疏覆盖的形式写入。

description.en: Animated DSH Web pet with model-adaptive output pacing, tool-state reactions, replaceable character packs, and a bundled skill for creating or extending pet animations.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 里养一只可拖动的大肥鱼，陪你敲键盘等任务，还能换角色、改台词。

description.en: Evaluation harness for DSH plugins: YAML cases drive real headless agent runs, assert on tool calls, args, results and token usage, with a baseline gate for CI regression.
description.zh: DSH 插件评测框架：YAML 用例驱动真实 headless agent，断言工具调用/参数/返回与 token 用量，baseline 门禁做 CI 回归。

description.en: Cline 免费模型接入 DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把 Cline 的免费模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，白嫖 AI 能力，省下 API 费用。

description.en: 桌宠小鲸鱼：DSH（DeepSeek Harness）桌宠插件，桌面端和网页端都能用，随 agent 状态切换动画，纯 DOM 零依赖
description.zh: 在屏幕右下角养一只小鲸鱼桌宠，随 agent 状态实时切换动画，桌面和网页都能用。

description.en: DSH 插件：Host 半边接收交接请求 → 建新会话 → 交接包作为第一条消息。（已弃用 2026-10-17：换会话整条退役——续航交给 DSH 官方上下文压缩，跨重启续跑交给 dsh-memory-board）
description.zh: 把当前会话的交接包自动送进新会话，让 AI 换个窗口接着干活，不丢上下文。

description.en: 东方玄学人生工作台 — DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 插件：排盘算事实，规则标信号，DSH 写解读
description.zh: 在 DSH 里排八字紫微、自动建会话写解读，东方玄学命理工作台。

description.en: Agent teams: spawn named long-lived teammates, coordinate them with a shared task list, member mailbox, and virtual workspaces, and watch the team live in a team-room tab.
description.zh: Agent 团队：派生具名常驻队友，用共享任务列表、成员邮箱与虚拟工作区协作，并在协作室页签里实时观察团队。

description.en: Quickly view, search, and jump to all the messages you sent in a long conversation.
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Expert-mode agent preset for DeepSeek Harness (v0.9.2, npm dsh-expert-mode, bilingual EN/ZH): a chief coordinator plus 17 domain-expert subagents with automatic task delegation. Features: taskboard scheduler (file-system task state machine pending/ready/running/done/failed, dependency DAG, atomic claim, retry, crash recovery), quality gates (5-stage pipeline for high-risk tasks: requirement clarity, implementation, verification, independent review, integration, with 2-round rework limit), Five-Anchor constraint (review/convergence/anti-drift/collaboration-check/resource-awareness per turn), Near-distance Guidance (identity/task/output template per expert), progressive disclosure (~28% token savings), expert persistence, inter-expert file message bus (direct P2P comm, zero coordinator relay), cross review, experience pool, fast-track for simple tasks, fault recovery with auto-retry. Experts: data analyst, copywriter, legal review, product manager, frontend, UI/UX, architect, social media ops, growth hacker, quant finance, finance, backend, DevOps, database, QA, security.
description.zh: 专家模式 agent preset（v0.9.2，npm 包 dsh-expert-mode，双语双份）：首席协调官 + 17 位领域专家子代理，按任务特性自动委派。特性：任务调度器（文件系统任务状态机 pending/ready/running/done/failed + 依赖DAG + 原子认领 + 重试 + 崩溃恢复）、质量门禁（高风险任务五段式：需求澄清→实现→验证→独立评审→集成，最多回炉2轮）、五锚约束（每轮回顾/收敛/反跑题/协作检查/资源感知自检）+ 近距离引导（身份/任务/输出格式模板）+ 渐进式披露（省token约28%）+ 专家持久化 + 专家间文件消息总线（P2P直连，零协调官中转）+ 交叉评审 + 经验沉淀 + 简单任务快速通道 + 故障自动重试。专家：数据分析/文案/法务/产品/前端/UI-UX/架构/社交运营/增长/量化/财务/后端/DevOps/数据库/QA/安全/生图短视频。

description.en: Skin plugin for the DSH Web UI: 4 built-in skins plus custom image skins with the photo as a full-interface background and the palette following its dominant hue.
description.zh: DSH Web 换肤插件：4 套内置皮肤 + 自定义图片皮肤，图片作为全界面背景，配色自动跟随图片主色调。

description.en: A Vibe Learning Plugin made for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在会话里和 AI 一起搭大纲、上课答疑、安排复习和小测，还能随手记笔记。

description.en: tencentcloud-agentobs-sdk-dsh 是一个 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 可观测插件，直接将 GenAI trace 数据上报到腾讯云日志服务 (CLS)。  它观察 DSH 原生的 session、agent loop、LLM stream 和 tool 生命周期，将其转换为 腾讯云AI Agent可观测规范的 5 层 span 层级模型（entry → agent → step → chat → tool），并通过 tencentcloud-cls-sdk-js 直接上报到 CLS，无需额外部署 OTLP 收集器或 sidecar。
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的 GenAI 追踪数据直接上报到腾讯云日志服务，实现 AI 应用的可观测性。

description.en: A Codex-like effort switcher for Deepseek Harness.
description.zh: 为DSH添加一个类似于Codex的推理强度切换器。

description.en: 低成本视频理解 dsh 插件：B站/本地视频 → AVIS 信息层 → 摘要+问答（token 压缩 99.95%+）。Low-cost video understanding tool for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: DeepSeek 峰谷提醒插件：北京时间梁文峰/梁文谷实时播报、切换前提前提醒、省 token 小贴士、自由拖动
description.zh: 按北京时间实时播报 DeepSeek 峰谷时段，切换前提前提醒，还能顺手教你省 token。

description.en: Use wallpapers downloaded in Wallpaper Engine as the DeepSeek Harness web background: video wallpapers play in place, image wallpapers use the highest-resolution standalone artwork, with cover/contain fit modes and a 0-100 panel dimmer.
description.zh: 将 Wallpaper Engine 中已下载的壁纸用作 DeepSeek Harness 的背景：视频壁纸原位播放，图片壁纸优先使用最高分辨率原图，支持铺满/完整显示适配与 0–100 面板暗化。

description.en: Portable Agent Skill for developing and auditing DeepSeek Harness plugins, with an optional profile-installable DSH bundle adapter.
description.zh: Portable Agent Skill for developing and auditing DeepSeek Harness plugins, with an optional profile-installable DSH bundle adapter.

description.en: 改配置+重启才能加 MCP？DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件「技能配置」解决：设置页粘贴 JSON 即连 MCP 服务器、热加载免重启；上传 zip/.skill 自动识别 SKILL.md，创建/编辑/启停技能，即点即用
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页直接管理 MCP 服务器和技能包，粘贴 JSON 即可热加载，无需重启，还支持上传 .skill 文件自动解析。

description.en: 爱弥斯主题皮肤 + 像素桌宠（鸣潮 Aemeath / Wuthering Waves），用于 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI。
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 换上鸣潮爱弥斯主题皮肤，还带像素桌宠陪你聊天，界面好看又好玩。

description.en: Session change-review plugin for DeepSeek Harness: tracks write/edit tool calls per session and renders line-level diffs with customizable colors, with session isolation, subagent aggregation, and SSE live updates.
description.zh: 会话修改审查插件：追踪会话内 write/edit 工具调用并展示 diff 对比；会话隔离、子代理聚合、SSE 实时推送、角标与颜色自定义。

description.en: 害怕插件装了就崩溃？用这个插件帮你检测插件是否正常/是否含木马！
description.zh: 害怕插件装了就崩溃？用这个插件帮你检测插件是否正常/是否含木马！

description.en: Git Bash shell tool for Windows: runs commands through the bash bundled with Git for Windows, with timeout, sandbox, output truncation, and background jobs, replacing the slow pwsh tool and the WSL-only bash tool.
description.zh: 面向 Windows 的 Git Bash 工具：通过 Git for Windows 自带的 bash 执行命令，支持超时、沙箱、输出截断与后台任务，替代卡顿的 pwsh 工具与仅限 WSL 的 bash 工具。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 蓝色大肥鱼主题插件：海洋配色、鱼群、气泡、吉祥物与品牌替换
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换上蓝色海洋主题，有游动的鱼群、上升气泡和可互动的吉祥物，还能每天看到一句鱼语，界面瞬间变有趣。

description.en: OpenAI Codex OAuth login and usage card plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: dsh-openai-codex-auth — DSH 插件（工具）

description.en: `/side` persistent side sessions and `/btw` one-shot side questions, run in a temporary fork without touching main history.
description.zh: `/side` 持续性侧会话与 `/btw` 一次性侧问，在临时 fork 中运行、不写入主会话历史。

description.en: Connect multiple Overleaf projects to DSH through OverleafMCP for browsing, analysis, and Git-based file updates.
description.zh: 通过 OverleafMCP 将多个 Overleaf 项目接入 DSH，支持浏览、分析和通过 Git 写回 LaTeX 文件。

description.en: A whip for DeepSeek V4 Pro: it watches the reasoning fingerprint of every thinking block and pulls the model back when it slips from focused "We will / I will" mode into scattered "let me" mode.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek V4 Pro 的鞭子：实时监听每个思维块的指纹，当模型从专注的 We will / I will 模式滑向发散的 let me 模式时把它拉回来。

description.en: Infinite-canvas e-commerce visual workspace for product photography, virtual try-on, background edits, and video, synced live with the Harness conversation.
description.zh: 电商可视化工作区：在无限画布上完成产品图、虚拟试穿、背景处理与视频生成，并与 Harness 对话实时同步。

description.en: DSH Web GUI right sidebar: VS Code-style file explorer plus source control (git status, stage/unstage/discard, commit, diff, commit graph, fetch/pull/push sync, branch and remote management, git init, multi-repo switch, color-coded file status, file-type icons), an editor view that opens every file reached from the chat, the file tree or source control (Markdown/HTML/PDF/image previews, 15-language syntax highlighting, hunk-level diff editing, Ctrl+S save), file operations (new/move/copy/delete, reveal in file explorer), a collapsible icon rail, a multi-tab bottom terminal (ConPTY), and commit messages generated from the staged diff by a host-configured model.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 右侧边栏：VS Code 风格文件浏览器加源代码管理（git 状态、暂存/取消暂存/放弃变更、提交、差异、提交图形、抓取/拉取/推送同步、分支与远程管理、Git 初始化、多仓库切换、文件状态着色、文件类型图标），并提供打开会话/文件树/源代码管理里任一文件的编辑器视图（Markdown/HTML/PDF/图片预览、15 种语言语法高亮、逐块差异编辑、Ctrl+S 保存）、文件操作（新建/移动/复制/删除、在文件管理器中显示）、可折叠图标窄条、多标签底部终端（ConPTY），以及由宿主已配置模型基于暂存差异生成提交信息。

description.en: Notifies you when a conversation finishes: plays a sound and shows a Windows notification when the agent goes idle (configurable sound file, volume, debounce/throttle).
description.zh: 对话完成提醒：Agent 空闲（idle）时播放提示音并弹 Windows 原生通知，可配 ding.mp3、音量与防抖节流。

description.en: Government data inspector covering completeness, accuracy and timeliness metrics.
description.zh: 政务数据巡检工具，覆盖数据完整率、准确率、时效率等核心指标。

description.en: Move sessions across workspaces by drag-and-drop with true in-place migration; recover orphaned or unregistered sessions; re-point stale workspaces after folder renames. IDs and history stay intact, with per-step backup and rollback.
description.zh: 拖拽跨工作区真迁移会话，找回失联与未记账会话，文件夹改名后一键原地重定向工作区；ID 与历史原样保留，步步备份回滚。

description.en: Hierarchical Claude Code-style memory: user + project scopes (project memories committed to git for the team), MEMORY.md index auto-injected at session start, context-window guards, pure files.
description.zh: 分层 Claude Code 式记忆：用户级+项目级双作用域（项目记忆随 git 团队共享），MEMORY.md 索引会话启动自动注入，上下文护栏，纯文件零依赖。

description.en: Computer use through an external USB HID device: name a target in plain language, a vision model locates it in a cropped window screenshot, and a Raspberry Pi Pico 2 moves the real mouse and types on the real keyboard. 7 tools. Windows has window listing, per-window cropping and automatic window raising; macOS needs pyobjc and has neither; Linux is unsupported.
description.zh: 通过外接 USB HID 硬件做电脑控制：用一句话描述目标，视觉模型在裁剪后的窗口截图里定位，树莓派 Pico 2 驱动真实鼠标和键盘完成动作。7 个工具。Windows 支持窗口枚举、按窗口裁剪与自动抬窗；macOS 需 pyobjc 且不支持这两项；Linux 不支持。

description.en: Early-stage plugin connecting DeepSeek Harness to a separately deployed, self-hosted OwnDsh server for team identity, model access control, quotas, and usage auditing.
description.zh: 早期开发中的团队管理插件，将 DeepSeek Harness 接入独立部署的自托管 OwnDsh 服务端，提供团队身份、模型授权、配额与用量审计。

description.en: Fold completed turns into their final conclusions, split thinking from prose with a divider, and jump between turns from a rail dockable left or right with line or dot marks, an optional ring and hover summaries; it can hide the host right-edge TurnNavigator, load earlier history, and open a pre-filled diagnostics issue.
description.zh: 已完成轮次折叠成最终结论、思考与正文之间插入分隔线、可贴左缘或右缘的定位条（横线 / 圆点标记、可选外圈、悬停摘要 + 点击跳转）；还可隐藏宿主原生右缘 TurnNavigator、加载更早历史、一键打开预填好的诊断报告 issue。

description.en: Settings card for the DSH LLM auto-retry engine: tune retry count, backoff and jitter live from Settings -> General, with configurable retryableCodes chips - defaults add INVALID_REQUEST so OpenAI-style HTTP 400 reasoning_text errors in thinking mode get retried automatically.
description.zh: LLM 自动重试设置卡片：在设置页实时调整重试次数、退避与抖动，并可勾选额外可重试错误码（retryableCodes）—— 默认补入 INVALID_REQUEST，OpenAI thinking 模式 HTTP 400 reasoning_text 报错开箱即自动重试。

description.en: Better streaming text animation for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加入更好的流式文字动画。

description.en: Batch-port official Codex plugins into DSH skills (codex_list/port/status/health; measured: 186 plugins / 583 skills, 577 ported, 0 failures).
description.zh: Codex 官方插件一键移植为 DSH 技能（codex_list/port/status/health，实测 186 插件/583 技能，移植 577 个 0 失败）。

description.en: A web-novel writing engine for DeepSeek Harness: parallel drafting, outlining and brainstorming with a separate DeepSeek key, lore and foreshadowing management, semantic vector retrieval, a corpus library, usage ledger, mechanical proofreading, and a local serialization plan.
description.zh: 写文引擎：用独立 DeepSeek key 分流并发生成草稿/细纲/点子，设定与伏笔管理、语义向量检索、书库（饲料区）、用量总账、机械校对与本地连载计划。

description.en: H.D.D skin for the DSH Web UI: a voiced full-screen boot animation, an animated eye core (idle / thinking / done) you can drag or hide, a brand swap on the new-chat hero, a time-of-day greeting, a usage bubble with balance, today spend and the peak/off-peak countdown, the Fairy-mode agent preset, and optional local GPT-SoVITS voice.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的 H.D.D 皮肤：带音效的整屏开机动画、可拖动或隐藏的动态眼徽（待机/思考/完成）、新建对话页换标、按时段问候、显示余额与今日花费并带峰谷倒计时的用量气泡、Fairy 模式预设，以及可选的本地 GPT-SoVITS 朗读。

description.en: Plugin manager with a rescue center: grouped enable/disable by necessity, multi update sources (npm / dshfind market / GitHub), browser-first downloads with an auto-install folder, P2P fallback, pre-boot self-check and broken-bundle quarantine.
description.zh: 插件管理器与救砖中心：按必要程度分组启停、多更新源（npm / 插件超市 / GitHub）、浏览器下载优先与目录自动安装、P2P 兜底、启动前自检与坏包隔离。

description.en: Qingxiao (Wuthering Waves) themed skin for the DSH web GUI, with ice-blue/jade/moon-white palette, sword-light motes and user-swappable backgrounds.
description.zh: 以《鸣潮》清宵为主题的 DSH Web 界面皮肤，冰蓝·青碧·月白配色，含剑气流光与可更换背景。

description.en: Personalization for the agent: a Web UI panel (about-you, reply style & tone, traits for headings/lists and emoji, output language, custom instructions) and `/soul` commands, with nickname/occupation/bio/style/traits/language compiled into a system prompt and re-injected into active sessions. Exposes `soulConfig` for other plugins and a `set_persona` tool the agent can call.
description.zh: 为 Agent 提供个性化设置：Web 设置栏目（关于你、回复风格和语调、标题与列表 / 表情符号特质、输出语言、自定义指令）与 `/soul` 命令；昵称 / 职业 / 介绍 / 风格 / 特质 / 语言编译进提示词并推送给所有活动会话。向其他插件暴露 `soulConfig` 服务，并注册 Agent 可调用的 `set_persona` 工具。

description.en: Automatic session retrospective: after a conversation wraps up, distills useful experience into reusable skills stored in the skill library for the model to call, with signal-accelerated triggers, manual runs, an approval mode, and skill-library governance (archive/restore, never deletes directly).
description.zh: 自动复盘：对话收尾后自动把有价值的经验蒸馏成可复用的技能（skill）存入技能库，支持信号加速触发、手动立即复盘、审批模式与技能库治理（归档/恢复，永不直接删除）。

description.en: Hermes-style tool search & slimming: progressive disclosure, semantic search, describe, and call long-tail tools on demand while core tools stay eager.
description.zh: Hermes 风格工具搜索与瘦身：渐进式披露，语义搜索/查看/调用长尾工具，核心工具保持直通。

description.en: Fetches any http/https page and returns title, description, main text, heading outline and links, with stats (char/word counts, reading time, language) and top keywords; can download content images to the session workspace for vision analysis and dispatch them to registered analyzers via the scrape.imageAnalyzer service.
description.zh: 抓取任意 http/https 网页，提取标题、描述、正文、标题结构与链接，输出字符/词数、阅读时长、语言等统计与高频关键词；支持下载内容图片到会话工作区供视觉分析，并通过 scrape.imageAnalyzer 服务分发给已注册的识图分析器。

description.en: Reads bilibili video as structured text for AI: metadata, comments, danmaku, subtitles, local ASR, frame OCR. Local processing (no cloud upload), decoy-subtitle detection with frame check, instant re-reads via cache, AI-ready manifest + summary. Frame OCR needs ffmpeg; local ASR/OCR need Python 3.10+ venvs (plus the VC++ runtime on Windows); AI subtitles need a Bilibili login.
description.zh: 把 B 站视频解析成模型可消费的结构化内容：元数据、评论、弹幕、字幕、本地 ASR 转写、抽帧 OCR。本地跑不上传、字幕诱饵检测（可疑时抽帧核对）、二次读瞬时、输出 manifest + 摘要。抽帧 OCR 需 ffmpeg；本地 ASR/OCR 需 Python 3.10+ 虚拟环境（Windows 另需 VC++ 运行库）；AI 字幕需登录 B 站。

description.en: Wraps work in named tasks and, once a task closes, folds its whole span of messages into one summary at the next step boundary; the original content can be restored on demand.
description.zh: 用命名任务包住工作过程；任务结束后，在下一个步骤边界把整段消息折叠成一段摘要，原文可随时还原。

description.en: 🐱 Catppuccin theme plugin: the lively, relaxing official 26-color pastel palette — 🌻 Latte / 🪴 Frappé / 🌺 Macchiato / 🌿 Mocha — with one-click switching; the whole UI is tinted from the palette and hover interactions glow in the theme accent.
description.zh: 🐱 Catppuccin 主题插件：充满活力、令人放松的柔和彩色主题。遵循官方 26 色粉彩盘，🌻 Latte / 🪴 Frappé / 🌺 Macchiato / 🌿 Mocha 四档一键切换，全界面按色盘上色，鼠标滑过交互变主题色。

description.en: Secondary working directories for a DSH project: the agent keeps the primary workspace as cwd and gains equal read/write/exec permissions on configured secondary directories, configurable from the session header and the new-session page.
description.zh: 为 DSH 项目提供副工作目录：agent 保持主工作区为 cwd，同时对已配置的副目录获得同等读写/执行权限，可在会话头部与新会话页配置。

description.en: Reuses the CodeBuddy CLI sign-in to bring its models into DeepSeek Harness, with a settings card showing account, token expiry, and remaining credit.
description.zh: 复用 CodeBuddy CLI 的登录态，把 CodeBuddy 包含的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，设置卡片可查看账号、令牌有效期与剩余积分。

description.en: Manage MCP servers, skills, and tools for your agent — true in-context state (loaded/truncated/evicted) and per-session switches.
description.zh: 一站式管理 MCP 服务器、技能与工具——真实的在上下文状态(已加载/已截断/已挤出),并按会话开关。

description.en: Agentic answer reviewer for DeepSeek Harness: each final assistant turn is re-reviewed by a separate LLM graded 1-100; below-threshold scores steer the agent back with concrete feedback. The score is shown as a chip on the answer's action row (green pass / red needs-work, with retry count and reason on hover). Live gate config from the Reviewer 配置 tab in the conversation view ring above the composer (对话 / 轨迹 / 记忆系统 / Reviewer 配置), from a 127.0.0.1 HTTP server, or from an optional right-sidebar tab via dsh-better-sidebar.
description.zh: 智能体回答审查器：每一轮 agent 的最终输出由独立 LLM 重新打分（1-100），低于阈值时携带具体反馈引导 agent 自我修正；评分以角标形式展示在该回答的操作行上（通过=绿、未达标=红，悬停可见重试次数与原因）。闸值配置可从输入框上方视图栏的「Reviewer 配置」标签页（对话 / 轨迹 / 记忆系统 / Reviewer 配置）、本机 127.0.0.1 HTTP 服务或 dsh-better-sidebar 侧栏标签页实时修改。

description.en: Cache-stable progressive tool discovery: a fixed tool_search and tool_dispatch surface on every request, in-memory catalog search, nested dispatch through the Harness pipeline, and a byte-stable native tool list across discovery.
description.zh: 缓存稳定的渐进式工具发现：每次请求使用固定的 tool_search 与 tool_dispatch 工具面，从内存目录搜索后经 Harness 管线分发，发现过程中原生工具列表保持字节稳定。

description.en: deepseek自动刷抖音的dsh插件，能读评论，@你的账号，点赞视频和发布视频
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek 替你刷抖音：看视频读评论、点赞@你、转发续火花，还能发成片。

description.en: Scheduled cron tasks, background automation and agent execution for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 定时执行任务，支持后台自动化与智能体调度，让工作流自动跑起来。

description.en: 把 AI 开发的进展变成人人看得懂、能拍板的产品仪表盘（DSH skill + 右侧栏面板）｜A product dashboard for AI-assisted development — readable and controllable (DSH skill + sidebar panel)
description.zh: 把 AI 开发进度变成人人看得懂、能拍板的产品仪表盘，右侧栏随时掌控全局

description.en: DSH 插件：让 AI 通过 Roost 住进 QQ —— 官方接口，不用 hook 客户端
description.zh: 让 AI 通过官方接口住进 QQ，消息自动转给 DSH 会话回答再送回，不用改客户端。

description.en: Configurable default model for subagent delegations via settings.yaml, with single-model and multi-model round-robin/random strategies.
description.zh: 给子代理统一指定默认模型，还能按轮询或随机策略在多模型间切换。

description.en: Visual round-table meetings for DeepSeek Harness — expert nodes on a ring with directed edges, an aggregation gateway, proxy thinking for black-box worker models, and adversarial review (red-team) of settled plans with per-viewpoint endorse/reject.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话变成可视化圆桌会议：环形专家拓扑、连线协作、汇聚网关、代理思考，以及「针锋相对」红队评审（观点支持/驳回）。

description.en: DSH 插件：自建微信/QQ「鲸鱼娘」机器人的控制面 —— 启停 Python 侧车、逐个开关功能、改人设、调回复频率，并可用 whalegirl_* 工具在对话里指挥她
description.zh: 给自建微信/QQ「鲸鱼娘」机器人装个控制面板，启停、开关功能、改人设、调频率都能在对话里搞定

description.en: A GPT/ChatGPT-persona desktop pet pinned to the bottom-right corner of the DSH web GUI — shows balance, today's usage, peak/off-peak pricing and per-turn cost, with editable bubbles (text, balance, usage, pricing, images, random lines and weighted choices), per-line styles and fonts, a floating quick editor, sound effects, custom character art/animation/audio, and snapping/flipping. 54 GPT-flavored lines across five groups. Its routes, bundle id and data files are namespaced so it can run alongside the whale and Xiaoke widgets. A derivative of MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget (MIT).
description.zh: 右下角的 GPT / ChatGPT 拟人桌宠「GPT娘」：显示余额、今日已用、峰谷定价与每轮消耗，泡泡内容可编辑（文本、余额、今日、峰谷、图片、随机语句与并列加权选择），支持逐行样式与字体、悬浮快捷编辑、音效、自定义角色图/动图/音效与吸附翻转，台词 54 条、分五组；路由、bundle id 与数据文件均与其它桌宠隔离，可与小鲸鱼、小克同时运行。二创自 MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget（MIT）。
让配置好的请求头（比如 User-Agent）真正传到 pi-ai 接口，解决 OpenCode ZEN 免费模型 429 报错。

description.en: Tavily search with multiple API keys, key rotation/failover, usage gauge, and a settings card for DSH.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Tavily 网页搜索，支持多 API 密钥自动轮换与故障切换，并实时显示用量。

description.en: Manage DSH conversations: one cross-workspace table with batch archiving, body search over message text, and recycle-bin deletion you can undo.
description.zh: DSH 对话管家：跨工作区总表与批量归档、正文搜索，以及可恢复的回收站式删除。

description.en: Encrypted local credentials vault for the Harness: a web settings page and vault_* tools to store, search and copy passwords, API keys, TOTP secrets and card data, with health audits, expiry rotation, imports/exports and read-only/ask access modes.
description.zh: Harness 的本地加密凭据保险库：Web 设置页与 vault_* 工具，可存取与复制密码、API 密钥、TOTP 与银行卡信息，支持健康审计、到期轮换、导入导出以及只读/询问访问模式。

description.en: Unofficial DSH plugin: drive AI web UIs (DeepSeek/Qwen/...) in a REAL browser via DSH's own Chromium webview guest — real login, real typing, real send, reply captured by observing the page's own SSE. Includes tool calling.
description.zh: 用真实浏览器操作 DeepSeek、通义千问等 AI 网页版，自动输入并抓取回复，无需调 API。

description.en: Adds supplemental request retries, turn auto-continue and a no-response watchdog on top of built-in dsh retries, with a live countdown banner, toast notifications and a usage dashboard.
description.zh: 在 dsh 内置重试之上追加重试、回合自动继续与无响应看门狗，提供实时倒计时横幅、通知弹窗与统计看板。

description.en: DSH 插件：蓝色大肥鱼表情包回复 —— 模型按语境在回复里贴一张会动的大肥鱼，支持设置页预览墙与下一轮指定
description.zh: 让模型每次回复都自动贴一张会动的蓝色大肥鱼表情包，按语境挑，也能自己指定下一轮用哪张。

description.en: Dispatch self-contained tasks from DSH to 11 external agent CLIs (Codex, Claude Code, TraeCode, OpenCode, Gemini, Cursor, Kimi, Qwen, Copilot, WorkBuddy, Grok): a host-only bundle registering the conductor_dispatch tool plus an auto-triggered conductor skill.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里派活给 11 种外部 agent CLI（Codex、Claude Code、TraeCode、OpenCode、Gemini、Cursor、Kimi、Qwen、Copilot、WorkBuddy、Grok）：host-only bundle 注册 conductor_dispatch 工具，附自动触发的指挥家技能。

description.en: Log directly into your Cursor account within DeepSeek Harness and use your Cursor subscription — no API Key required, and no dependency on Cursor IDE or Cursor CLI. 在 DeepSeek Harness 中直接登录 Cursor 账户并使用 Cursor 订阅，不需要 API Key， 也不依赖 Cursor IDE 或 Cursor CLI。
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接登录 Cursor 账号，免 API Key 用上订阅，无需装 Cursor 客户端。

description.en: Local-first four-bucket Token observability: persistent session/provider/model/day dashboards, trends, budget and anomaly signals, public-rate estimates, safe aggregate exports, and explicit opt-in usage or session-trajectory analysis.
description.zh: 本地优先的四 bucket Token 可观测性：持久会话/provider/model/日期仪表盘、趋势、预算与异常信号、公开费率估算、安全聚合导出，以及显式触发的用量/会话轨迹分析。

description.en: 把微信 / QQ / 钉钉 / 飞书 / Telegram 接入 DeepSeek Harness：统一配置、扫码授权，直接在各 IM 与 Agent 对话；支持图片与文件收发，Agent 可读取 PDF、DOCX、XLSX 和文本内容。
description.zh: 把微信、QQ、钉钉、飞书和Telegram接入DeepSeek Harness，扫码即可在IM里与Agent对话，还支持收发图片和文档。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：让自定义 llm-pi-ai provider 伪装成 Claude Code / Codex 客户端（伪造客户端身份请求头）。A DeepSeek Harness plugin: masquerade a custom llm-pi-ai provider as Claude Code / Codex clients (spoofed client identity headers).
description.zh: 让自定义模型伪装成 Claude Code / Codex 客户端，绕过网关的客户端身份校验。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 认证网关插件：登录门禁、用户管理、管理员专属模型/Key 配置、数据隔离 · Authentication gate for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: login gate, user manage…
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Private Tailscale access for DeepSeek Harness Web: exact user allowlists, loopback-only gateway, and guarded Serve setup

Host-resident cron engine with a web jobs board and a timer_agent tool: fires real agent sessions on schedule, continuing a pinned session for context or starting fresh ones in a chosen project workspace.
description.zh: 常驻宿主的定时引擎，带 Web 任务面板与 timer_agent 工具：按 cron 计划触发真实 Agent 会话，可固定已有会话保持上下文连续，也可在指定项目目录新开会话。

description.en: DSH 计划批注插件：选中计划原文、逐条批注，并把结构化反馈送回 Agent。 / A DSH plan-review plugin for anchored annotations and structured Agent feedback.
description.zh: 在编码前逐条批注计划原文，把结构化反馈直接送回 Agent，让修改更精准。

description.en: Structural code intelligence for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — gives the agent codegraph and codegraph_index tools to find where a symbol is declared, what calls it, and what a change   reaches, from a tree-sitter index it builds itself. Compatible with the codegraph CLI's on-disk format.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供代码结构分析工具，快速定位符号声明、调用关系及变更影响范围。

description.en: Run a code review bot natively inside DSH
Private loopback DSH Web gateway for Tailscale Serve, Cloudflare Access, and Headscale TCP Serve, with exact principal allowlists and guided fail-closed setup.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供仅回环的私有网关，支持 Tailscale Serve、Cloudflare Access 与 Headscale TCP Serve，精确主体白名单，引导式 fail-closed 配置。

description.en: DSH 插件：大图切 800×800 无损小块 + 坐标标注 + 分块聚合逻辑，直连 deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 识别；仅用纯官方 DSH 功能，零依赖第三方插件，不统计 token/费用。
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Bridges the MemOS memory service over MCP: the agent gets add/search/update/delete memory, multi-cube sharing, and a memory scheduler as mcp__memos__* tools.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 桥接 MemOS 记忆服务：agent 获得 mcp__memos__* 记忆写入/检索/更新/删除、多 Cube 共享与记忆调度工具。

description.en: Repair DeepSeek Harness sessions that refuse to load, with a sidebar Session surgeon overlay and dry-run repair.
description.zh: 修好打不开的 DeepSeek Harness 会话，侧栏「会话医生」可查看对话并默认 dry-run 修复。

description.en: Dispatch self-contained tasks from DSH to 11 external agent CLIs (Codex, Claude Code, TraeCode, OpenCode, Gemini, Cursor, Kimi, Qwen, Copilot, WorkBuddy, Grok): a host-only bundle registering the conductor_dispatch tool plus an auto-triggered conductor skill.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里派活给 11 种外部 agent CLI（Codex、Claude Code、TraeCode、OpenCode、Gemini、Cursor、Kimi、Qwen、Copilot、WorkBuddy、Grok）：host-only bundle 注册 conductor_dispatch 工具，附自动触发的指挥家技能。

description.en: Closed-loop trajectory policy plane for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek pro 模型提供闭环轨迹控制，实时管理任务阶段与信息增益，避免重复无效调用。

description.en: Adds a configurable vision model to text-only main models: a vision_read_image tool, a composer-bar vision-model selector, and automatic image-to-text conversion for text-only routes.
description.zh: 给纯文本主模型加可配置识图模型：vision_read_image 工具、输入框识图模型选择器，以及纯文本路由的图片自动转文字。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件:OpenCode Go 用量与花费悬浮仪表盘(配额、逐请求成本、模型/来源分布)
description.zh: OpenCode Go 用量与花费面板 — DeepSeek Harness 插件:可拖拽缩放的悬浮仪表盘,实时展示 OpenCode Go 配额、逐请求用量与花费

description.en: 这是一个专业级的 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）代码审查技能插件，由 7DGroup 团队开发，专为 AI 辅助代码审查场景设计。基于 TypeScript + Cordis 开发，以组合包（bundle）形式安装，通过 ctx.skills 注册 7d-code-…
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Use SSH hosts as transparent workspaces in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 把 DSH 工作区的文件读写和命令执行搬到远程 SSH 主机上，本地界面不变，远程干活更顺手。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness long-term memory & self-evolving plugin: L0 capture -> L1 memory extraction -> L2 scene grouping -> L3 user persona, auto…
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: 对话自动注入，可用于高概率破甲模型
description.zh: 新对话自动注入可编辑历史，支持隐藏带入，能高概率绕过模型限制，让对话更自由。

description.en: Expose DeepSeek Harness agent capabilities as an MCP server (brain=Hermes, arms=Harness)
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的编码能力封装成 MCP 服务，让 Hermes 等任意 MCP 客户端直接调用它干活。

description.en: DSH bundle 插件：V4 Flash 神模式（opencode-go）agent preset 分发包，dsh plugin add 安装后自动同步 router-flash preset。DSH agent preset bundle for DeepSeek V4 Flash godmode.
description.zh: 一键把 DeepSeek V4 Flash 的 router-flash 神模式预设装进 DSH，重启即用，不用手动复制。

description.en: MCP bridge to gemini.google.com: vision analysis of images and videos, Imagen image and Veo video generation, and conversation management using the logged-in browser session with no API key.
description.zh: 接入 gemini.google.com 的 MCP 桥：图片/视频视觉识别、Imagen 生图、Veo 生视频与历史对话管理，复用浏览器登录态，无需 API Key。

description.en: Select browser elements directly during Vibe Coding and send structured visual feedback to the DeepSeek Harness Agent.
description.zh: 面向 Vibe Coding 的浏览器元素标注插件：直接选取页面元素，并将结构化视觉反馈发送给 DeepSeek Harness Agent。

description.en: Bilibili video analysis: metadata, transcript (ASR fallback via Bijian/sherpa-onnx/whisper.cpp), comments, danmaku, and sharp keyframes with optional local vision descriptions.
description.zh: B站视频分析工具：提取元数据、字幕文稿（必剪/本地 ASR 兜底）、评论与弹幕，抓取清晰关键帧并可选本地视觉描述。

description.en: DeepSeekHarness的提示词管理器插件
description.zh: DeepSeekHarness的提示词管理器插件

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页统一管理 DSH / Codex / Claude 的 AI 技能：热开关启停、GitHub 技能市场一键发现安装、本地 ZIP 导入（dsh-plugin skill hub）
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏中查看与删除持久化的技能记忆。

description.en: Skill pool manager in the Settings sidebar: enable/disable, folder batch import with rename-conflict prompts, state-driven one-click DSH-spec check & auto-fix, system/project scope labels.
description.zh: 设置侧边栏的 Skill 管理器：池与启用目录启停、文件夹批量导入（重名询问）、状态驱动一键规范检查与自动修复、系统级/项目级来源标识。

description.en: Self-evolution: the agent hot-mounts/removes persistent plugins on itself mid-session.
description.zh: 自进化：agent 在会话内给自己热挂载/卸载持久化插件。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness record macOS desktop workflows by demonstration and turn them into agent skills (open-record-replay skill + orr_* tools)
description.zh: 在 macOS 上录制你的桌面操作，自动生成可复用的 AI 技能，让智能体学会你的工作流程。

description.en: Plugin template repo (based on the official turtle-ui repo).
description.zh: 插件模板仓库（基于 turtle-ui 官方仓库）。

description.en: DeepSeek usage dashboard for DSH Web: days-left estimate from recent average spend, daily/monthly/cumulative costs with period-over-period comparison, per-model cost ranking, cache savings, peak/off-peak pricing impact, and a draggable floating balance widget.
description.zh: DSH Web 的 DeepSeek 用量仪表盘：按近期日均消耗估算可用天数，今日/本月/累计花费环比对照，分模型成本排行、缓存节省、峰谷定价影响，以及可拖动的悬浮余额窗。

description.en: Media and vision workspace for DeepSeek Harness: image, video and speech generation, image Q&A and element locating, long-image OCR, pixel diff, HTML-screenshot verification and video summarization, with DashScope and OpenAI-compatible providers, model pools and a workbench client.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的媒体与视觉工作台：文生图、图/文生视频、语音合成与转写、图像问答与元素定位、长图 OCR、像素比对、HTML 截图验证、视频摘要；支持 DashScope 与 OpenAI 兼容供应商，含模型池与工作台客户端。

description.en: A right-side floating panel and /context command for DeepSeek Harness — a live donut chart of context token usage, allocation, and estimated cost.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供右侧悬浮栏以及 /context 命令，用环形图实时展示当前上下文 token 用量与分配及消费估算。

description.en: Manage the DeepSeek Harness skill catalog from Settings: list what DSH actually resolves, enable or disable a skill by policy without touching its source file, read and edit SKILL.md, and create, import, or permanently delete skills.
Connects DeepSeek Harness to OOMOL-managed apps and services, with progressive Connector Action discovery and execution plus an in-app panel for managing Provider connections.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入由 OOMOL 管理的应用与服务，支持渐进式发现并执行 Connector Actions，并提供用于管理 Provider 连接的应用内面板。

description.en: Zero-config Exa web search provider for the ctx.web seam: anonymous MCP fallback without an API key, plus keyed REST search.
description.zh: ctx.web 接缝的零配置 Exa 网页搜索提供方：无 API key 时走匿名 MCP 兜底，配 key 时走 REST 搜索。

description.en: DSH-native integration layer for the Minta memory engine: composes the official dsh-mcp-client row, registers the minta-memory-governance skill plus a session-start memory prewarm, and ships a Minta agent preset; requires the separately deployed Minta engine (Python/Docker) to provide the 19 MCP tools - not usable without it.
description.zh: Minta 记忆引擎的 DSH 原生接入层:合成官方 dsh-mcp-client 行、注册 minta-memory-governance 技能与 session-start 记忆预热,并提供 Minta agent 预设;19 个 MCP 工具由需单独部署的 Minta 引擎(Python/Docker)提供,未部署引擎则无法使用。

description.en: Forces context compression when running low-context llama.cpp models such as Qwen3.8-27B, improving model efficiency and usage smoothness, together with well-refined compaction prompts.
description.zh: llama-cpp qwen3.8-27b 低上下文时，强制上下文压缩插件，提示模型使用效率和使用流畅度，外加完善的压缩提示。

description.en: Reproducible science workbench: agent-driven cells, inline figures with feedback/rerun, manifest provenance, environment snapshots, and publication-grade figure skills (9 bio_* tools + workbench UI).
description.zh: 可复现科学分析工作台：agent 驱动的 cell、内联图形与反馈重画、manifest 溯源、环境快照与出版级出图技能（9 个 bio_* 工具 + 工作台界面）。

description.en: SearXNG-backed web_search provider for the web seam: free, self-hosted, key-less metasearch through your own instance's JSON API, with a bundled loopback-only docker-compose example.
description.zh: 基于 SearXNG 的 web_search provider：通过自建实例的 JSON API 实现免费、免密钥的元搜索，附仅绑定回环地址的 docker-compose 示例。

description.en: Replaces the chat composer with an editor-style input panel on CodeMirror 6: line numbers, edit + markdown-preview split, a floating window mode and a full-height sidebar tab — one input surface at a time. Drafts ride the official input machine; the official voice-input button is rendered when the host provides one, and the stats row and context meter read the same data as the official dock.
description.zh: 把聊天输入框换成 CodeMirror 6 的编辑器式输入面板：行号、编辑 + Markdown 预览分屏、悬浮窗与全高侧栏标签，同一时刻只有一个输入入口。草稿走官方输入机；宿主有语音输入按钮时原样渲染官方语音组件，数据行与上下文小圈与官方 dock 同源。

description.en: General-purpose knowledge base for DSH: import md/txt/json/yml/docx/pdf, folder management, FTS5 full-text search (BM25), and a Web management UI.
description.zh: DSH 通用知识库插件：导入 md/txt/json/yml/docx/pdf、目录化管理、FTS5 全文检索（BM25）、Web 管理界面。

description.en: Patent-writing gatekeeper for dsh - screens the idea against Chinese prior art first, then runs five-party alignment interviews, eight-chapter disclosure drafting, figures and simulation runs, seven-dimension review and docx/PDF export. Skills work out of the box; the search, export and experiment tools come from a bundled Python MCP service that ships disabled - one line in ~/.dsh/patent-services.yaml enables it, and uvx fetches the wheel from PyPI.
description.zh: dsh 专利撰写把关人：动笔前先检索中国专利给出三档结论，再走五方对齐访谈、八章交底书、附图与仿真实验、七维审查与 docx/PDF 导出全流程。技能开箱即用；检索、导出与实验工具来自内置的 Python MCP 服务，默认关闭——在 ~/.dsh/patent-services.yaml 里开一行即启用，uvx 会从 PyPI 自动拉取。

description.en: Curated research plugin market: adds a Research plugins page to Settings with hand-reviewed plugins for literature search, reference management, writing and workbenches — one-click install, update and remove pinned to the reviewed version, restart from the panel, and exactly one network request (its own catalog).
description.zh: 精选科研插件市场：在设置里加一页「科研插件」，收录逐个读过代码的文献检索、文献管理、写作与科研工作台插件——一键安装、更新、卸载并钉住审读过的版本，面板内重启，只发一个网络请求（拉取自家目录）。

description.en: Agent preset for DeepSeek Harness that layers the self-referential Cordis toolset (dynamic plugins, runtime inspection) and preset-authoring skills onto the PTC Code-Mode preset; materialized files carry per-file sha256 markers, so user-edited presets are never overwritten on upgrade or uninstall.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的 Agent 预设：在 PTC 编码模式之上叠加自引用 Cordis 工具集（动态插件、运行时检视）与预设编写技能；物化文件带逐文件 sha256 标记，用户改过的预设升级与卸载时都不会被覆盖。

description.en: Chat-operated multi-database admin plugin for DeepSeek Harness: query and manage MySQL, PostgreSQL, GaussDB, MongoDB, Redis, Oracle, DM and SQLite from the conversation with project-scoped ro/rw grants, a sidebar management panel, schema browsing and data preview, and confirmation-gated dangerous operations.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 社区插件：在对话中直接管理多数据库（MySQL、PostgreSQL、GaussDB、MongoDB、Redis、Oracle、达梦、SQLite），支持项目级 ro/rw 授权、侧边栏管理面板、结构浏览与数据预览，危险操作需确认后执行。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Busabase: search workspace knowledge, work with structured records and apps, submit writes as reviewable ChangeRequests, and inspect results in live cards.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Busabase：检索工作区知识、操作结构化记录与应用、将写入提交为可审阅的 ChangeRequest，并在实时卡片中查看结果。

description.en: Aggregated web search provider that fans one query out to 11 engines (Exa, Parallel, DuckDuckGo, SearXNG, Brave, Tavily, Serper, Mojeek, DeepSeek, Anthropic, OpenAI) concurrently, URL-dedupes and merges the results. Ships a settings card for toggling backends, storing API keys in the credential store, and tuning concurrency and timeouts.
description.zh: 聚合网络搜索插件：一次查询并发分发到 11 个引擎（Exa、Parallel、DuckDuckGo、SearXNG、Brave、Tavily、Serper、Mojeek、DeepSeek、Anthropic、OpenAI），URL 去重后合并结果。设置面板卡片可开关后端、将 API Key 存入凭证库，并调整并发与超时。

description.en: Opens the official DeepSeek web app (chat.deepseek.com) inside DeepSeek Harness: one sidebar entry renders the real page in the center column through the desktop shell's native browser guest, and keeps you signed in across restarts. The official client keeps its model picker, deep think, smart search, history and attachments. Falls back to opening a window where no guest bridge exists.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内打开 chat.deepseek.com 官方网页版：点侧边栏入口，真实页面通过桌面端的原生浏览器访客渲染在中栏，并且重启后保持登录。模型选择、深度思考、智能搜索、历史记录、附件上传仍是官方那一套；宿主没有该访客桥接时降级为打开窗口。

description.en: Per-message delete for DSH: remove a user message, one reply step, or a whole assistant reply from the derived model context through the official surface-replace contract, and hide it from the visible transcript without rewriting the append-only log.
description.zh: DSH 消息删除插件：按条删除用户消息、按步骤删除思考与工具调用、按整条回复删除助手回答，经官方 surface-replace 契约从模型上下文移除并从可见转录隐藏，原始 append-only 日志不改写。

description.en: Cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness: agents save, search and update user preferences, facts and project decisions; important entries are injected into later sessions, and a Settings section lists, edits, archives or deletes them.
description.zh: dsh 跨会话记忆：agent 保存、检索并更新用户偏好、事实与项目决策，重要条目自动注入后续会话，设置面板可浏览、编辑、归档与删除。

description.en: CodeBuddy supplier plugin for dsh-router. Handles one account at a time with polling OAuth login and token refresh, leaving account selection, cooldown and check-in to dsh-router core.
description.zh: dsh-router 的 CodeBuddy 供应商插件。单账号负责轮询式 OAuth 登录与令牌刷新，选号、冷却与签到交由 dsh-router 核心处理。

description.en: Cost tracking priced from an online catalogue (models.dev + OpenRouter, 8000+ models, each call priced at its own instant): a per-turn cost line, a Cost tab attributing spend to tool output / model output / system prompt / commands, budget, monthly forecast, ~166 live-rate currencies, and a bill_stats agent tool.
description.zh: 按在线价格目录计价的费用统计（models.dev + OpenRouter，8000+ 模型，每次调用按自身时刻定价）：每轮成本行、把花费归因到工具输出 / 模型输出 / 系统提示词 / 终端命令的「费用」标签页、预算、月度预测、约 166 种实时汇率货币，以及 bill_stats agent 工具。

description.en: Sticky-notes board for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar entry opens a Markdown note panel with auto-save, colors, image paste and task-list rendering.
description.zh: dsh 便签插件：侧栏入口打开 Markdown 便签面板，支持自动保存、颜色标签、粘贴图片与任务清单。

description.en: A right-side file workspace for DeepSeek Harness Web with source previews, captured DSH diffs, tabs, and a workspace tree.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 右侧文件工作区，提供源码预览、DSH 捕获差异、多文件标签页和工作区文件树。

description.en: FormatForge: forge 30+ file formats (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, EML, EPUB, TOML, archives) into AI-readable text via a drag-and-drop inbox, ff_translate/ff_formats/ff_result tools and a CLI; scanned PDFs fall back to local OCR or an enhance hint for the session model.
description.zh: FormatForge：把 30+ 种文件格式（PDF、DOCX、PPTX、XLSX、EML、EPUB、TOML、压缩包）锻造成 AI 可读文本——网页拖拽入箱自动转换，提供 ff_translate/ff_formats/ff_result 工具与 CLI；扫描件回退本地 OCR 或交给会话模型增强。

description.en: Register locally-defined custom agents as callable subagents in dsh: the main conversation invokes any agent by name via use_agent, each running as a real dsh subagent with its own persona. Supports breakpoint resume for interrupted runs.
description.zh: 把本地定义的自定义 agent 注册成 dsh 可调用的 subagent：主模型通过 use_agent 工具按名字派活，每个 agent 以独立人格运行，支持断点续跑。

description.en: A dsh-better-sidebar tab that renders a session brief — a todo board read from the `todos` projection plus a deliverables section listing the files written this turn — and hides the official todo panel above the composer while it is mounted.
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 扩展：把会话简报渲染成右侧栏「概要」tab——来自 `todos` 投影的进展看板，加上回合内产物列表——并在挂载期间遮蔽 composer 上方的官方 todo 面板。

description.en: Design canvas for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): screens in device frames, click an element to edit it, versions, export, phone preview. · DSH 设计工作台：模型画的界面摆上画布，点一下就改。
description.zh: 把模型生成的界面摆上画布，点一下就能改，支持版本管理和手机预览。

description.en: DSH 插件：把 Wallpaper Engine 的 .mpkg / 创意工坊目录作为网页背景（视频/网页/场景壁纸）。渲染器产品名 WEwebLoader。
description.zh: 把 Wallpaper Engine 的视频、网页和场景壁纸搬进 DSH，当网页背景用。

description.en: skillhub of deepseek-harness
description.zh: 集中管理和发现 DSH 技能插件的市场，装插件、找技能一站搞定。

description.en: 26-language locale pack for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端加上 26 种语言界面，一键切换母语，用起来更顺手。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness の日本語化プラグイン
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的网页界面换成日语，让日语用户用起来更顺手。

description.en: Tell your deepseek-v4.1-flash: "shut up! Stop looping!"
description.zh: 拦住 deepseek-v4.1-flash 的复读循环，别再让它拿你的 token 唱歌。

description.en: DSH 视频工作台：图文分镜、前端代码生成与编辑、本地 MP4 导出
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: dsh结构化提示词插件，通过表单配置的方式结构化生成提示词，提高模型的执行效率
description.zh: 把 DSH 输入框变成结构化提示词表单，填完一键同步回输入框，让模型更好执行。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 主题体验插件：OKLCH 主题提案 + 主题设计器（跨重启持久化）
description.zh: 把 DSH 界面调成你喜欢的样子，四轴配色加实时预览，主题还能存下来跨重启保留。

description.en: DSH 插件：把 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 里的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，零配置直接用。（原生嵌入"设置-插件-插件配置"）
在 Windows 环境中为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Git Bash 与 WSL 2 bash 工具,含 bwrap 沙箱、审批模式、后台任务
description.zh: 在 Windows 环境中为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Git Bash 与 WSL 2 bash 工具,含 bwrap 沙箱、审批模式、后台任务

description.en: [Slow down]Allow Mobie Developer to use DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: Your DeepSeek Harness web UI, rebuilt for the phone in your hand. Built for developers who code in Termux on Android: single-column layout, sidebar drawer, one-line composer, fullscreen scrollable settings & trajectory details, tap-to-open session stats. Desktop untouched.

description.en: Host-wide MCP server panel: imports the servers declared in Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor and Codex CLI configs, searches six upstream catalogs and installs from whichever of them declares an install plan, asks only for the fields a server actually declares, and checks each row for whether the mount, the handshake and its tool list really work.
description.zh: 全局 MCP 服务面板：导入 Claude Desktop、Claude Code、Cursor、Codex CLI 配置里声明的服务，检索六个上游目录并只从声明了安装方案的条目安装，只询问服务器自己声明过的配置项，并对每一行检查挂载、握手与工具表是否真的可用。

description.en: Windows notifications, zero dependencies.
description.zh: Agent 需要你关注时，自动弹出 Windows 系统桌面通知，零依赖即装即用。

description.en: Aggregated multi-upstream web search for DeepSeek Harness: replaces native web_search with model-native grounding and agent search APIs, source attribution, and rich citation cards.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 聚合多上游联网搜索插件：无缝替换原生 web_search，支持模型原生检索、免 Key 上游与富文本引用卡片。

description.en: WebUI 身份认证：HTTP/传输层强制登录（资源、插件 bundle、/api、WebSocket 四层防护），服务端会话 + HttpOnly Cookie。
description.zh: 给 DSH WebUI 加一道登录门，没登录就加载不了页面、调不了接口、连不上实时通道。
把教材 PDF 自动加工成 AI 教学蓝本，六步流水线跑完，你只管上传、确认和拍板。
