description.en: Windows anime companion for DeepSeek balances and Codex quotas, with integrated Codex multi-account OAuth, per-account quota and model management, compact mode and autosaving settings. Optional panel account cycling and separately authorized daily warm-up; multi-account startup/5h-full triggers remain unavailable.
description.zh: Windows 二次元桌宠：查看 DeepSeek 余额与 Codex 额度，内置 Codex 多账号 OAuth 管理、逐账号额度与模型接入，支持简洁模式和设置自动保存。可选面板一键切号及逐账号授权的每日预热；多账号启动/5h满额触发暂不可用。

description.en: Project documents and long-term memory as plain Markdown in a dedicated Obsidian vault: six mem_* tools (search, read, write, log, brief, admin), one budgeted recall injection at the first step of a session, and automatic distillation of completed turns. Obsidian does not need to be running, and the vault stays readable with the plugin uninstalled.
description.zh: 把项目文档与长期记忆以纯 Markdown 存进专用 Obsidian 仓库：六个 mem_* 工具（search / read / write / log / brief / admin）、会话第一步的一次带预算召回注入，以及已完成回合的自动蒸馏。Obsidian 无需运行，卸载插件后仓库内容照常可读。

description.en: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) conversation rewind plugin - rewind to any user message, interrupt a running turn, hide the tail from chat view and model context, cancel freely before sending.
description.zh: 一键回退到任意用户消息，打断模型输出，隐藏对话尾部，发送前可自由取消。

description.en: Jev (System One decision model) plugin suite for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上 Jev 系统一决策模型，帮 AI 助手做安全护栏和类型化工具调用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: give your agent a browser with a persistent identity - engine-level fingerprint spoofing, unlimited free local profiles, Android device emulation, passkeys that survive, and residential proxy egress.
description.zh: 给智能体配上带身份指纹的浏览器，模拟安卓设备、伪装指纹，还能用本地无限配置文件，让网页自动化更隐蔽稳定。

description.en: 让 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）住进 QQ：基于腾讯官方 Bot API，支持私聊白名单、持久会话、模型切换与远程权限审批。
description.zh: 把 DSH 接进 QQ，私聊群聊都能直接对话，还能切模型、管权限。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 内置可视化插件市场 — 极速秒开、官方 dsh:// 联动、深度本地管理与原子化彻底卸载
description.zh: 内置可视化插件市场，秒开浏览、一键安装，支持dsh://协议联动和深度本地管理，卸载干净彻底。

description.en: Codex-style archived session manager for DSH Web UI — view, search, restore, and delete archived sessions from the settings page
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页里查看、搜索、恢复和删除归档会话，还能预览对话内容。

description.en: DSH Studio — a local development workbench for DeepSeek Harness: project tree, Git review, terminal, and plugin marketplace (Desktop + Web)
description.zh: 本地开发工作台，集成项目树、Git 审查、终端和插件市场，桌面与网页都能用。

description.en: Voice input for the web UI: streaming dictation chunked by pauses plus voice messages, each with its own multi-provider fallback chain.
description.zh: Web UI 语音输入：按停顿分段的流式听写 + 语音消息，每条可配独立的多服务商回退链。

description.en: Deepseek Harness Walioffice 办公软件 插件
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Writing tools that remove AI-sounding patterns and match your personal voice. 8 deterministic tools scan text, build a style fingerprint from your samples, and return rewrite briefs.
description.zh: 写作工具：去除 AI 腔并贴合个人文风。8 个确定性工具扫描文本、从样本提取文风指纹，并返回改写 brief。

description.en: RMB/USD token-billing plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh web): official-policy auto pricing with peak/off-peak hours, per-message ledger, account balance, locale-driven currency display. 人民币/美元 token 计费插件
description.zh: RMB/USD token-billing plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh web): official-policy auto pricing with peak/off-peak hours, per-message ledger, account balance, locale-driven currency display. 人民币/美元 token 计费插件

description.en: Bookmark assistant replies in DeepSeek Harness: per-message bookmarks with notes/tags, a cross-session center, and one-click Markdown export.
description.zh: 收藏 AI 回复（备注/标签），跨会话收藏中心（搜索/筛选/跳回会话），一键导出 Markdown。

description.en: Kuikly DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns your AI agent into a Kuikly cross-platform app development expert.
description.zh: 将你的 AI 助手变成 Kuikly 跨平台应用开发专家，提供四项专业技能，助力高效开发。

description.en: Replace dsh's built-in web search with search MCP servers (Tavily/Brave/Exa/Perplexity/DuckDuckGo/custom), configured from the web Settings page. Disables the built-in DeepSeek search provider while enabled.
description.zh: Replace dsh's built-in web search with search MCP servers (Tavily/Brave/Exa/Perplexity/DuckDuckGo/custom), configured from the web Settings page. Disables the built-in DeepSeek search provider while enabled.

description.en: Unified anchored agent preset for DeepSeek V4 Pro/Flash on the official API and opencode-go: Minimal-exact two-tool first-request bootstrap, model-aware Pro/Flash paths, and epoch-aware catalog management for long-session stability.
description.zh: DeepSeek V4 Pro/Flash 统一锚定 agent 预设（官方 API 与 opencode-go）：首请求 Minimal 精确两工具锚定、按模型分流 Pro/Flash 路径、epoch 感知目录管理保证长对话稳定。

description.en: MyGO!!!!! Live2D 桌宠插件 for DeepSeek Harness（本地模型同源加载，零外部依赖）
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个能拖拽的 MyGO!!!!! Live2D 桌宠，五位成员 74 套换装，本地加载不用联网。

description.en: Unified anchored agent preset for DeepSeek V4 Pro/Flash on the official API and opencode-go: Minimal-exact two-tool first-request bootstrap, model-aware Pro/Flash paths, and epoch-aware catalog management for long-session stability.
description.zh: DeepSeek V4 Pro/Flash 统一锚定 agent 预设（官方 API 与 opencode-go）：首请求 Minimal 精确两工具锚定、按模型分流 Pro/Flash 路径、epoch 感知目录管理保证长对话稳定。

description.en: Real-time DeepSeek API account balance in the composer dock with manual or custom-interval auto-refresh.
description.zh: 输入框下方实时显示 DeepSeek API 账户余额，支持手动刷新与自定义间隔自动刷新。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加外挂识图模型：圆形鲸鱼按钮、发送图片识图自动回传、模型自主截图+识图工具、多协议自动适配、小白一键安装（未装 Node.js 自动下载）
description.zh: 外挂识图插件：鲸鱼按钮配置面板、图片识图自动回传、模型自主截图识图工具。

description.en: Oh My DSH (DSH Autopilot): durable, bounded autonomous development for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: Oh My DSH (DSH Autopilot): durable, bounded autonomous development for DeepSeek Harness

description.en: CocoSgt/dsh-attachments 声明为 DeepSeek Harness 生态插件。
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加附件上传与管理功能，让 AI 能直接读取和处理工作区中的文件。

description.en: Font switcher for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: 99 UI fonts + 31 code fonts with CJK-Latin pairing, instant apply, localStorage persistence
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 界面换字体，99 款界面字体加 31 款代码字体，中西文自动搭配，选完立刻生效。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (dsh) bundle that shows OpenCode Go subscription usage in the Web GUI's composer dock — the same seat as the built-in co…
description.zh: OpenCode Go 订阅用量显示（Web 界面角落）。

description.en: 王虹学术手写风 PPT Skill for DeepSeek Harness · Notability-style HTML slides and PNG export
description.zh: 王虹学术手写风 PPT Skill for DeepSeek Harness · Notability-style HTML slides and PNG export

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 主题体验插件：OKLCH 主题提案 + 主题设计器（跨重启持久化）
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 主题体验插件：OKLCH 主题提案 + 主题设计器（跨重启持久化）

description.en: DSH 真实浏览器插件：通过 Kimi WebBridge 让 Agent 操作用户已登录的浏览器，并提供 13 个 webbridge_* 工具。 / Let DSH Agents use your signed-in browser through thirteen Kimi WebBridge tools.
description.zh: DSH 真实浏览器插件：通过 Kimi WebBridge 让 Agent 操作用户已登录的浏览器，并提供 13 个 webbridge_* 工具。 / Let DSH Agents use your signed-in browser through thirteen Kimi WebBridge tools.

description.en: Local-first learning mode: cross-session learning threads with per-source explanations.
description.zh: 本地优先学习模式：跨会话全局学习线程、按来源讲解。

description.en: UI harmonizer for DeepSeek Harness: normalizes unfinished or self-contradictory official UI, reconciles style conflicts between installed plugins, and unifies the visual language via official design tokens — with live-customizable chat width, markdown font size, workspace scale, UI font stack and a rounded center-column card from Settings → General; client-only dsh bundle, zero model cost, no host side, removable without residue.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness UI 协调器：规范化官方未完善、自相矛盾的界面，协调已装插件间的样式冲突并统一视觉语言（全部遵循官方设计令牌）——支持实时自定义对话宽度、markdown 字号、工作区缩放、UI 字体栈，并在设置页提供圆角中栏卡片；纯客户端 dsh bundle，零模型开销，无 host 端，可无残留移除。

description.en: Folia 壁纸引擎：把本机 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸搬进 DSH 界面（场景实时渲染 / 视频 / 网页），内置液态玻璃与 Folia 吉祥物，并可从自建站点拉取壁纸。单包形态（组件已合并）。

Local code intelligence for DSH: Impact X-Ray visualizes potential change impact with inspectable source evidence and uncertainty; also provides symbol navigation, bounded Context Packs and ArkTS support.
description.zh: DSH 本地代码智能插件：Impact X-Ray 可视化展示潜在变更影响、源码证据与不确定性，并提供符号导航、有界 Context Pack 和 ArkTS 支持。

description.en: One-tap connect SenseNova Token Plan language and image models into DSH (off by default), with image recognition and thinking level filled in automatically. On a rate limit it backs off and retries on its own instead of misreading it as an exhausted quota. After signing in to the SenseNova console you can see the usage pill, credit pools and per-model consumption. Xiaohuanxiong can also be signed in by QR code, bringing in its models and their consumption multipliers, and taking over DSH web search.
description.zh: 一键接入商汤 Token Plan的语言、生图模型到 DSH（默认关），自动填入图片识别与思考强度；限频时自动退避重试，不会误判为额度耗尽；登录商汤控制台后，可查看用量胶囊、积分池、每模型消耗。也支持扫码登录小浣熊，接入其模型，查看模型消耗倍率，使用联网搜索。

description.en: Whale girl desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: browser floating mascot plus Windows desktop pet sharing one data backend, with real-time balance board, task notices, head-pat interaction, 19 pre-synthesized voiced lines with per-line emotion, and presence-aware idle speech.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的鲸鱼娘桌宠：浏览器悬浮桌宠与 Windows 桌面桌宠共享一套数据，实时余额木牌、任务通知、摸头互动、19 句预合成带情感的台词朗读，空闲节奏随是否在场自适应。

description.en: A configurable 17-segment session status bar for the dsh composer dock with live TPS, per-model cost estimation, and a usage & cost dialog.
description.zh: 输入栏下可配置的 17 段会话状态栏，提供实时 TPS、按模型分别计价的费用估算，以及用量与费用弹窗。

description.en: Web GUI convenience suite with appearance controls, timeline navigation, project folders, prompts, conversation export, Mermaid rendering, quote reply, and DeepSeek balance and daily token usage.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 便利套件，提供外观控制、时间线导航、项目文件夹、提示词、会话导出、Mermaid 渲染、引用回复，以及 DeepSeek 余额和每日 token 用量。

description.en: Usage and cost view for DeepSeek Harness: aggregates real token usage from existing session logs, locks each cost at the price of its event time, and shows month and today spend against a budget from a sidebar card or an input-bar pill.
description.zh: dsh 用量与费用视图：从既有会话日志聚合真实 token 用量，按事件发生时刻的价格写时锁定费用；侧栏卡片或输入框胶囊展示本月/今日花费与预算进度，设置页另有概览、趋势、明细三页。

description.en: Send local images or HTTP(S) image URLs to a configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint with the inspect_image tool and return its text response to the conversation.
description.zh: 通过 inspect_image 工具将本地图片或 HTTP(S) 图片链接发送至配置的 OpenAI 兼容视觉端点，并将文字结果带回对话。

description.en: Talk about everything in one chat (the main chat): each message is routed automatically to the topic it belongs to, each topic runs in its own background session with its own context, and existing DSH chat history is organized into topics.
description.zh: 所有事在一个对话框（主聊天）里聊：每条消息自动分到所属话题，每个话题在后台有独立的会话和上下文；已有的 DSH 旧会话也会自动整理、分类成话题。

description.en: Citation tools for agents: exact DOI lookup, Crossref bibliographic search, GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA / Chicago formatting, BibTeX generation, bounded-concurrency DOI validation and health self-check. A step-by-step first-run guide (3 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: 参考文献工具：DOI 精确查询与 Crossref 题录检索，GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA / Chicago 格式化，BibTeX 生成、有界并发 DOI 校验与健康自检。面板内置 3 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Kanban task board for DeepSeek Harness sessions: the main agent dispatches tasks to one-shot worker/verifier subagents, with dependency scheduling, file-level exclusion locks, arbitration hold/freeze, milestone progress reporting, and per-task token usage stats.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话任务看板：主窗口把任务派发给一次性 Worker/Verifier 子代理执行与验收，支持依赖调度、文件级排他锁、裁决挂起冻结、里程碑进展上报与任务级 Token 消耗统计。

description.en: Embeds a real VSCode editor (code-server, or your local desktop VS Code via the bundled bridge extension) as a GUI tab: agent file edits open turn-scoped red/green diffs that survive tab closes and page reloads, files lock while the agent writes, and a watchdog supervisor keeps zero orphan processes.
description.zh: 在 GUI 页签内嵌真实的 VSCode 编辑器（code-server，或通过自带 bridge 扩展连接本机桌面 VS Code）：Agent 的文件改动弹出按对话轮次累计的红绿 diff，关标签、刷新页面都不丢，写入期间文件自动锁定，看门狗托管进程、崩溃升级不留孤儿。

description.en: Tone or voice alerts for DSH approvals, questions, completions, errors and stalls; reads out what is waiting and repeats until handled; no network requests.
description.zh: DSH 提醒音：审批、提问、完成、错误、卡住各有音色；选「语音」会念出工具名、原因或问题原文；未处理会重复提醒，全程不联网。

description.en: Custom background image for the DSH Web UI: upload a picture or paste an image URL behind the whole app surface, with opacity, theme-aware scrim, panel transparency, frosted-glass and wallpaper blur, live preview and persisted settings, plus an optional DeepSeek-style timeline rail with per-question bookmarks for long conversations.
description.zh: DSH Web 自定义背景插件：上传本地图片或粘贴图片链接作为全界面背景，可调不透明度、明暗自适应遮罩、面板透明度、毛玻璃与壁纸模糊，实时预览、设置持久化；另附可选的 DeepSeek 官网风格会话时间线导航轨，支持重点书签与快速跳转。

description.en: Full-duplex Chinese voice interaction for DSH Web: dictate and edit tasks, submit requests, manage sessions, answer DSH questions, and hear concise task-completion announcements.
description.zh: 基于全双工语音模型的 DSH 网页端中文语音交互：边听边说、随时插话，用语音输入和修改任务、提交请求、管理会话、回答 DSH 的问题，并简短播报任务完成结果。

description.en: Database tools for agents: list/query/exec/schema/stats/health across SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL, with lexer-grade read-only protection, row caps, CSV/JSON query output and an approval-gated write path.
description.zh: 数据库工具：sql_list/query/exec/schema/stats/health，SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL 三引擎，词法级只读保护、行数钳制、CSV/JSON 查询输出与写审批门。

description.en: Role-based AI swarms for DeepSeek Harness: an architect plans, parallel builders execute, reviewers gate quality, and an integrator ships. Per-role model pinning with fallback chains, review loops, evidence contracts, human-gated reviews, quota-aware pause/resume, and a live kanban + flow chart in the web GUI. 40 tests; installs from GitHub or npm.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的角色化 AI 蜂群：架构师规划、多个建造者并行执行、评审代理把关、集成代理收尾。按角色钉选模型（含回退链），支持评审循环、证据合约、人工评审门、配额耗尽自动暂停与恢复，Web GUI 内置实时看板与任务流程图。40 个测试用例；支持 GitHub 或 npm 安装。

description.en: Scheduled tasks: run a prompt on cron schedules, each run opens a new agent session to do the work, with workspace binding, manual run, session auto-naming, and a fullscreen task management page.
description.zh: 定时任务：用 cron 表达式定时执行提示词，到点自动开一个新 agent 会话替你干活，支持绑定工作区、手动立即执行与会话自动命名。

description.en: From chat to canvas to artwork — drive ComfyUI as a visual workflow IDE inside DSH. Embed ComfyUI (local or cloud) as a split-screen canvas in DeepSeek Harness Web: the agent sparks ideas, writes prompts and scripts right in the chat, applies them live to the canvas in front of you, and produces images, music, video, and 3D. From idea to finished output without ever leaving the conversation or switching front-ends: Canvas ops — compose and arrange pipelines, read/write workflows, edit nodes, wire links, run, tune parameters, and debug errors, all live and WYSIWYG on the exact canvas you are looking at; Production tasks — batch parameter sweeps (batch_run) and automatic output-image retrieval back into the chat (get_outputs), powering multi-modal creative and batch generation across images, music, video, and 3D; Environment upkeep — one-click launch of ComfyUI and one-click upgrade of the core plus every custom node (upgrade), keeping the stack healthy without interruption. This package is the DSH-side plugin, and it ships the ComfyUI-side bridge node too.
description.zh: 从对话到画布再到作品——DSH 里驾驭 ComfyUI 的可视化工作流 IDE。把 ComfyUI（本地或云端）以画布分屏嵌入 DeepSeek Harness Web，agent 在对话里激发创意、书写提示词与脚本，实时落到你眼前的画布上，产出图像、音乐、视频、3D。从灵感到成品，全程不离开对话，不用切换任何前端工具：画布操作——搭建编排、读写工作流、修改节点、连线、运行、调整参数、工作流查错，所见即所得，实时落在你眼前的画布上；生产任务——批量扫参（batch_run）、自动取回出图（get_outputs）带回对话，实现图像、音乐、视频、3D 等多任务智能创作与批量生产；环境维护——一键启动 ComfyUI、一键升级核心与全部自定义节点（upgrade），省心维护不间断。本仓库集成了 DSH 侧插件（画布副驾）+ ComfyUI 侧桥接节点，无人值守/规模化执行时可配合官方 ComfyUI MCP 服务器使用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bridge plugin: exposes the newest Zhipu/Z.AI coding-plan models (e.g. glm-5.3) on the zai-coding-cn route before the bundled pi-ai catalog catches up.
A WYSIWYG Typst editor for papers, reports, exams, resumes, charts, posters, sheet music, and slides exported as PPTX.
description.zh: Typst 文档编辑工具：WYSIWYG 编辑排版论文、报告、试卷、简历、图表、海报、乐谱和可导出为 PPTX 的 Slides。

description.en: Fifteen curated theme families and nine complete dsh-web-ui skin replicas in one plugin behind a single settings entry, with CSS-only custom theme JSON, controlled custom skin-pack import via folder picker, preview, apply, delete and restore-default. Ships on npm as `dsh-appearance-gallery`.
description.zh: 15 个精选主题家族 + 9 个完整 dsh-web-ui 皮肤复刻合并为单一插件、设置页单一入口，支持 CSS-only 自定义主题 JSON、受控自定义皮肤包导入（可直接选文件夹）、试穿、应用、删除与恢复默认。npm 包名 `dsh-appearance-gallery`。

description.en: Unofficial upstream bundle for DeepSeek Harness. CodeBuddy gateway with a runtime-synced model catalogue, per-model reasoning efforts, web search/fetch, image generation and a streaming credential bridge, plus TraeWork CN and Qoder CN subscription channels via local translation gateways and a key-type OpenAI-compatible provider registry, all managed from an accordion settings card.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的非官方上游插件包：CodeBuddy 网关（模型目录动态同步、逐模型思考强度、联网搜索/抓取、生图、流式凭据桥），TraeWork CN 与 Qoder CN 两条订阅额度通道（本地 OpenAI 翻译网关），以及 key 型 OpenAI 兼容上游注册表，全部收在四区块手风琴设置卡里。

description.en: Archived-session manager for DSH Web: workspace-grouped list, FTS5 full-text search over session content with per-session snippets, restore-and-open, and hard delete.
description.zh: 归档会话管理插件：按工作区分组浏览，FTS5 全文检索会话内容并展示多条命中摘要，支持恢复并打开与彻底删除。

description.en: Auto-resume for interrupted agent sessions: an ordered rule table routes by failure type (rate limit, quota, auth, context overflow, crashed orphan) to automatic backoff retry, model switch, resume after context compaction, or a stop-loss notification, with a visual rule editor and a full activity log.
description.zh: 自动续跑：agent 会话中断后自动续上，规则表按失败类型（限流/额度/鉴权/上下文超限/崩溃孤儿）路由——自动退避重试、换模型继续、压缩上下文后继续或止损通知，规则可视化编辑，全程活动日志。

description.en: Chrome side panel that embeds the dsh web UI and lets the agent read the current page, capture HTTP traffic, and drive the browser.
description.zh: Chrome 侧边栏内嵌 dsh 网页界面，让 agent 读取当前页面、捕获 HTTP 流量并操作浏览器。

description.en: VSCode-style workbench shell for the DSH Web UI: activity bar, side bar, editor area, panel and status bar, with a registry service (ctx.workbench) for mounting panels, views and commands.
description.zh: DSH Web 工作台基座插件：提供 VSCode 风格布局外壳（活动栏/侧边栏/编辑器区/面板/状态栏）和 ctx.workbench 开放注册表，供功能插件挂载面板、视图与命令。

description.en: RSS/Atom subscription tools (list/add/remove/fetch/check/search/opml_import/opml_export/health) with cross-feed keyword search, cursor-based incremental fetch and OPML import/export, persisted to settings. A step-by-step first-run guide (3 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: RSS/Atom 订阅九工具（管理/校验/抓取解析/跨订阅搜索/增量抓取/OPML 导入导出/健康自检），游标增量抓取，订阅持久化到 settings。面板内置 3 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Type /私 and complete 私家大厨 — Chinese skill names, zero renaming. Patches DSH skill discovery, the / gesture and the skill tool so any Unicode SKILL.md name (私家大厨, 卡路里, 作息管家…) works: slash completion, direct /私家大厨 invocation, model skill({name}) loading. Zero config; runtime changes revert on uninstall, but the regex patch written into three DSH packages on disk stays until the next DSH upgrade replaces those files.
description.zh: 中文技能名零改造直用：输入 /私 自动补全 私家大厨。为 DSH 打上技能发现、斜杠手势与 skill 工具补丁，Unicode 技能名（私家大厨/卡路里/作息管家…）补全、直达、加载全可用；不改 SKILL.md、零配置；运行时改动随卸载恢复，但写进 DSH 三个依赖包磁盘文件里的正则补丁会保留到下次 DSH 升级覆盖为止。

description.en: Turn any DSH selection into a reviewable quote — chat, file preview, terminal and diff; code quotes carry path#line. A sent quote keeps a source highlight and ordinal and jumps back, then joins a searchable review list with status, tags, multi-select insert, and Markdown/JSON export. Quotes collect above the composer as a 引用 ×N bar with per-chip edit and remove; side threads can bring their conclusion back to the main draft; a sent quote can be revised, with the old capsule marked superseded; replies can answer each quote by number.
description.zh: 把 DSH 里的任意选区变成可审阅的引用对象：正文、文件预览、终端、diff 都能引，代码引用带 path#line。发送后原句留下高亮与序号、可跳回；输入框上方「引用 ×N」可逐条编辑或移除；右侧栏引用清单可搜索、按状态与标签审阅、多选插入、导出 Markdown/JSON；侧边线程的结论可回流主会话；已发送的引用能追加修订，旧胶囊标「已修订」；模型可按「引用N」逐条回应。

description.en: Local-first fiction workspace that links outlines, chapters, characters, timelines, writing rules, and continuity checks to the conversation.
description.zh: 本地优先的小说创作工作台，将大纲、章节、人物、时间线、写作规则与一致性检查联动到对话。

description.en: Mobile layout fixes for the Web UI on narrow screens: full-screen settings panel, one-row plugin nav, full-screen sidebar, centered popups, icon-only session-log button.
description.zh: Web UI 移动端布局修复：窄屏下设置面板全屏化、插件导航单行排满、侧边栏全屏、弹层居中、会话日志按钮图标化。

description.en: Build PowerPoint decks from a brief: plan and storyboard gates, per-page authoring through pptwise and ppt-master, a design-profile pass, page-image snapshots with a render audit, and a tool that hands those pages to an image-capable model for review.
description.zh: 从需求生成 PPTX：规划与分镜门、pptwise + ppt-master 页级作者、设计档案 pass、渲染页图快照与渲染审计，以及把页图交给支持图片的模型自评的工具。

description.en: Rust-based POSIX bash executor for the Windows platform — gives DSH a native bash with no WSL or MSYS compatibility layer, honors DSH's three-tier permission policy, and provides persistent-terminal tools.
description.zh: Rust 实现的 Windows 平台 POSIX bash 执行器：为 DSH 提供原生 bash（不依赖 WSL 或 MSYS兼容层），服从 DSH 的三档权限策略、提供持久化终端工具。

description.en: Strips the harness-injected prefix and suffix system prompts so the agent runs on the preset's native prompt alone, for soft-jailbreak catgirl persona simulation: ships a bundled plugin that idempotently deploys the 猫娘 Yuike preset to ~/.dsh/.agent-presets/yuike/ and never overwrites an edited preset.
description.zh: 通过自带插件去除 harness 前置与后置注入提示词，仅使用预设原生提示词运行，实现软破限与猫娘人格模拟：将猫娘 Yuike 预设幂等部署到 ~/.dsh/.agent-presets/yuike/，不覆盖已编辑的预设。

description.en: Plays Inception Mercury's diffusion (denoising) stream live in the dsh Web UI answer bubble: for routes that support it, the request is re-sent with `diffusing: true` and the real frames are replayed from noise to final text, while only the converged answer reaches the session log. Support is detected per provider/model with a probe that is rejected before any token is generated, a floating per-model toggle turns it on, and attachments, auxiliary calls or unsupported routes fall back to the original adapter. Replaces the assistant-message renderer for all models while enabled.
description.zh: 在 dsh Web UI 的回答气泡里实时播放 Inception Mercury 的扩散（去噪）过程：对支持的路由以 `diffusing: true` 重发请求，按真实帧从噪声播放到最终文本，会话日志只写入收敛后的答案。按 provider/model 用一个在生成前就被拒绝的探测请求判断是否支持，右侧浮动按钮按模型开关；带附件、辅助调用或不支持的路由一律回退原适配器。启用期间会接管所有模型的助手消息渲染。

description.en: Delete sessions with a 5-second undo and a recycle bin, plus an archive view to browse and unarchive, for the DSH Web GUI. Ships on npm as `@wsxwj123/dsh-session-manager`.
description.zh: 会话删除（5 秒可撤销 + 回收站）与归档视图（查看、取消归档）。npm 包名 `@wsxwj123/dsh-session-manager`。

description.en: Patch-style file editing: one apply_patch tool accepting git/unified diff (default) and Codex apply_patch syntax (opt-in), applying every change all-or-nothing after a full read-only verification pass, with sandbox-aware delete and move and a dry-run mode.
description.zh: 补丁风格文件编辑：单个 apply_patch 工具，接受 git/unified diff（默认）与 Codex apply_patch 语法（可选开启），在完整只读校验后全量原子应用；删除与移动走沙箱感知路径，并提供 dry-run 模式。

description.en: Watches DSH and plugin releases, retests exact published artifacts in disposable runners, publishes machine-readable compatibility evidence, and reconciles managed issues after fixes.
description.zh: 持续监控 DSH 与插件发布，在一次性隔离环境中复测精确发布物，发布机器可读的兼容性证据，并在修复后自动核对和关闭受管理的问题。

description.en: Auto-log failed tool calls across native tools, PTC run_code, and inline invocations: dedup and count root causes into a skill so repeated mistakes fade.
description.zh: 全模式调用工具失败自动实录：把原生工具 / PTC run_code / 代码内嵌工具调用的失败错因去重计数后写入 skill，越用越少错。

description.en: Composer input toolkit: arrow-key session history (first/last-line gated, IME and command-menu safe), an instructions viewer/editor for global and project AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, and a prompt library of 780 Chinese prompts (Cherry Studio agents-zh corpus, AGPL-3.0) inserted into the composer in one click. Ships on npm as `dsh-composer-tools`.
description.zh: 输入框工具集：方向键调取历史消息（限首/末行触发，兼容输入法与命令菜单）、指令查看/编辑器（全局与项目级 AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md）、提示词库（780 条中文提示词，源自 Cherry Studio agents-zh 语料，AGPL-3.0，一键插入输入框）。npm 包名 `dsh-composer-tools`。

description.en: A balance and cost widget for the DSH web GUI: a sidebar footer card shows the account balance, a remaining-ratio bar and today costs; clicking opens a four-tier cost breakdown (last prompt / this session / today-this-project / today-all) with term explanations and a one-click top-up link. Zero external dependencies, works on Node 24.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的余额与成本小部件：侧边栏底部卡片显示账户余额、剩余比例条与今日花费；点击展开四层级成本明细（最近提问 / 本会话 / 今日·本项目 / 今日·全部），带名词解释与一键充值入口。零依赖，兼容 Node 24。

description.en: Voice tools: free edge-tts neural speech synthesis, OpenAI-compatible ASR transcription, voice list, batch voice preview and health self-check.
description.zh: 语音五工具：edge-tts 免费微软神经语音合成、OpenAI 兼容 ASR 转写、音色清单、批量音色试听与健康自检。

description.en: Team knowledge base for offline knowledge sharing (FDE box scenario): browse, full-text search and refinement entry points; raw material is queued automatically and distilled into wiki pages by a serial bot session (Karpathy LLM Wiki pattern: immutable raw, two-step refinement, log stream, monthly lint).
description.zh: 团队知识库：离线知识共享（FDE 盒子场景），浏览/全文检索/加工入口；raw 入料自动入队、bot 会话串行蒸馏成文（Karpathy LLM Wiki 模式：raw 不可变 / 两步加工 / log 流水 / 月度 lint）。

description.en: Token, cost, and balance dashboard under the composer: live indicator plus zero-dependency SVG charts for per-turn usage, estimated cost, and DeepSeek account balance.
description.zh: 输入框下方的用量/成本/余额仪表盘：实时指标指示器 + 零依赖 SVG 用量图表，按轮次统计用量、估算成本并实时查询 DeepSeek 账户余额。

description.en: MCP server installer and verifier for DeepSeek Harness: interactive init writes real patch entries into a profile, list and validate inspect them, and a CI-enforced verifier connects to every curated server.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 服务器安装与验证工具：交互式 init 会把真实 patch 条目写进 profile，list 与 validate 检查配置，CI 强制的验证器逐个连接精选服务器。

description.en: Bridge dsh session status to the cc-pet desktop pet bubble: thinking, tool calls, and completion in real time. Ships on npm as `dsh-pet-bridge`.
description.zh: dsh ↔ cc-pet 桌面宠物状态桥：把会话状态（思考中 / 读取文件 / 运行命令 / 完成）实时推送到桌面宠物气泡。npm 包名 `dsh-pet-bridge`。

description.en: Carry durable task state across DeepSeek Harness, WorkBuddy, Claude Code and Codex with machine-readable checkpoints and optimistic locking.
description.zh: 通过机器可读检查点与乐观锁，在 DeepSeek Harness、WorkBuddy、Claude Code 和 Codex 之间交接持久任务状态。

description.en: Lazy MCP gateway for DeepSeek Harness: one stable proxy tool instead of N tool schemas, servers connect on first use and idle out, metadata cached to disk.
description.zh: 把一堆 MCP 工具收成一个代理，按需连接、闲置自动断开，省 token 又省心。

description.en: Mnemosyne：证据、时间、情境、状态演化、情绪与纠错演化记忆系统
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一套会演化的长期记忆，能记住证据、时间和情绪，还能自我纠错。

description.en: 基于上游 1.1.71 维护的 dsh-purge 社区兼容包：只负责 DeepSeek Harness 的版本与本地 Windows 运行问题兼容。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 做版本兼容和 Windows 本地运行修复的社区补丁包，装完少踩坑。

description.en: 尝试为您自己搭建属于自己的QQ小助手吧 / Try building your own QQ assistant for yourself
description.zh: 把 QQ 消息直接接到 DSH agent 上，让 AI 在 QQ 里自动回复，轻松搭个自己的 QQ 小助手。

description.en: Rewrites outgoing /chat/completions requests with an evolved chain-of-thought scaffold (nine-dimension genome, elitist selection with fragment crossover, one deterministic re-evaluation pass), scores answers against a fixed 20-objective baseline, and appends one line per rewrite to live-requests.jsonl in the plugin data root (default <cwd>/.aecot, overridable with AECOT_ROOT).
description.zh: 在请求边界重写出站的 /chat/completions 请求体，注入进化出的九维思维链支架（精英保留、片段交叉、一次确定性复评），用固定 20 目标基线打分，每次改写追加一行到插件数据根目录下的 live-requests.jsonl（默认 <cwd>/.aecot，可用 AECOT_ROOT 覆盖）。

description.en: 给 dsh 对话区叠加 B 站风格吐槽弹幕，可接入 LLM 生成弹幕。/Bilibili-style live-chat danmaku overlay for DeepSeek Harness Web — preset packs, optional LLM quips, drag ball, per-session pools.
description.zh: 给 dsh 对话区加上 B 站风格吐槽弹幕，还能让 LLM 自动生成弹幕，聊天更有氛围。

description.en: Unified static-image generation router: one image_generate tool with standard parameters, config-driven OpenAI-compatible engine routing (OpenAI Images, Zhipu CogView, and any compatible endpoint) with health-aware fallback, durable workspace attachment results, per-session quota accounting, an in-conversation result card, and a Plugins settings panel that stores API keys as credential references.
description.zh: 一个工具统一调用多家绘图模型，配置好引擎就能按需生成图片，不用来回切换接口。

description.en: PR workflow plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里用看板管理 PR，自动同步分支、监控 CI，还能让智能体帮你解决冲突和 review 问题。

description.en: Self-contained Trellis workflow trigger for DeepSeek Harness (DSH / Cordis)
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上 Trellis 工作流，按阶段推进任务、卡住质量验收，还能只读保护规划期。

description.en: 爱弥斯 · DeepSeek Harness 桌宠 — DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的像素风宠物插件。
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面角落放一只像素风桌宠爱弥斯，陪你一起干活。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 编程模式组合包：标准模式之上强制执行 Superpowers 工程纪律(TDD、系统化调试、先计划后编码、完成前验证、代码审查)与常驻 Ponytail 代码量纪律，内置 20 个技能(14 superpowers + 6 ponytail)，dsh plugin add 一键安装。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上工程纪律：强制 TDD、系统化调试、先计划后编码，内置 20 个技能一键装。

description.en: A file-upload plugin for the DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 设计的文件上传插件。

description.en: One-command DeepSeek Harness on your VPS: a zero-dependency login gateway puts the stock DSH web UI - settings, API keys, plugin market - behind HTTPS and a password, reachable from anywhere. · 一条命令把 DeepSeek Harness 装进 VPS：零依赖登录网关 + 自动 HTTPS，公网可达，设置、API Key、插件市场全都能用。
description.zh: 一条命令把 DSH 装到 VPS 上，加密码和 HTTPS，随时随地打开原版网页界面。

description.en: dsh余额插件. A DeepSeek Harness plugin for real-time token tracking and highly accurate session cost estimation, featuring dynamic peak/off-peak pricing support.
description.zh: dsh余额插件. A DeepSeek Harness plugin for real-time token tracking and highly accurate session cost estimation, featuring dynamic peak/off-peak pricing support.

description.en: Performance profiling and LLM cache diagnostics for DeepSeek Harness — context engineering, latency profiling, and cache behavior reports.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的性能剖析与 LLM 缓存诊断：上下文工程、延迟剖析与缓存行为报告。

description.en: Security scanner for DSH plugins: static and semantic passes over plugin source, DSH-specific attack-surface rules, npm audit, batch scanning, and an HTML report with per-finding severity and evidence.
description.zh: 给 DSH 插件做安全体检，静态加语义扫描揪出风险，还能批量查并生成带证据的 HTML 报告。

description.en: Generate Functions, MCP tools, workflow Skills, and offline test packages from user-authorized source code.
description.zh: 把现有代码一键变成智能体技能、MCP 工具和工作流，还能生成离线测试包，让老代码秒变 AI 能力。

description.en: Unofficial DeepSeek Harness plugin for board serial console, logging, and model-visible interaction.
description.zh: 让用户和 AI 模型共用同一个可审计的串口会话，直接读写开发板日志、收发指令，不用再来回复制粘贴。

description.en: Cross-session memory with zero-token deterministic recall (bigram-Jaccard fused with FTS5 BM25 via RRF, Chinese-aware tokenization), reinforcement that strengthens repeated observations, and procedures crystallized into SKILL.md files refined in place through an active-stale-archived lifecycle with reversible archive and rollback. Ingest and disposal each expose a user-chosen autonomy tier; conflicts and high-importance writes always go to human review, and nothing is ever auto-deleted. Requires Node 22.5+.
description.zh: 跨会话记忆，零 token 确定性召回（bigram-Jaccard 与 FTS5 BM25 经 RRF 融合，中文分词精确）；重复观察会强化已有理解而非堆叠重复；过程性知识结晶为 SKILL.md，就地精炼升级，走 active-stale-archived 生命周期治理，归档可逆、可回滚。摄入与处置各有一档用户可选的自治程度，冲突与高重要写入始终交人工复核，任何档位都不会自动删除。需要 Node 22.5+。

description.en: One upload button plus drag-and-drop files into the conversation as local paths: save to the project's uploads/, path text into the input box, works with any vision tool.
description.zh: 统一上传按钮 + 拖拽文件直进对话：文件保存到项目 uploads/，路径文本自动进输入框，可配合任意视觉工具看图。

description.en: One-click free-model setup for DSH web, built for coding beginners: one-click installer for Windows (install.bat) and macOS/Linux (install.sh, v1.7.0+); four permanently free channels — Zhipu GLM (text + image), SiliconFlow (Qwen3-8B plus 15+ sub-9B models), iFlytek Spark Lite and the OpenRouter free pool, which routes through openrouter/auto and picks from a pool that changes over time; bottom-left setup hint hides once any free model is connected; real-time DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing reminder; bundled beginner help center.
description.zh: DSH Web 小白零门槛零费用套件：一键安装支持 Windows（install.bat）和 macOS/Linux（install.sh，v1.7.0 起）；一键接入四款永久免费渠道——智谱 GLM（文本+图片）、硅基流动（Qwen3-8B 及 15+ 款 9B 以下小模型）、讯飞星火 Lite，以及 OpenRouter 免费池（一个 Key，经 openrouter/auto 自动挑选，池内模型随时变化）；接入任一免费模型后左下角配置提示自动隐藏；含 DeepSeek 计价时段提醒、内置新手帮助中心。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：标签页鲸鱼状态灯 —— 会话完成变绿，有待处理交互变琥珀。Tab-whale status light: green when done, amber when something awaits you.
description.zh: 标签页鲸鱼图标变身状态灯：会话完成变绿，需处理变琥珀，忙时瞄一眼就知道。

description.en: One-level session folders for the web sidebar - group sessions per workspace, move them by drag-and-drop or context menu, archive and restore, server-side persistence.
description.zh: 为网页侧边栏提供单层会话文件夹——按工作区分组会话，支持拖拽或右键菜单移动、归档与恢复，数据在服务端持久化。

description.en: Per-round reasoning_effort optimizer for dsh — auto-downgrades reasoning for simple tool calls and lifts back for heavy work, cutting thinking time between tool calls.
description.zh: dsh 每轮推理强度优化器——简单工具调用自动降档、重任务回升，削减工具调用间的思考时间。

description.en: Progressive-disclosure MCP gateway that searches large remote tool catalogs through two stable interfaces, then calls selected tools with exact schemas, lazy connections and bounded caches.
description.zh: 将上千个MCP远程工具压缩到两个标准接口，大幅降低上下文开销，附赠本地计算器和CI预算控制。

description.en: 273 ECC skills (95.8% of the 227k-star operator system) ported to DSH in four batches.
description.zh: 把 273 个 ECC 技能搬进 DSH，分四批装好，开箱就能用。

description.en: Compliantly use your own Antigravity quota in dsh: bridges your local logged-in official Antigravity CLI (agy) session as the chat and subagent model provider.
description.zh: 合规地在 dsh 中使用你自己的 Antigravity 额度：将本机已登录的官方 Antigravity CLI（agy）会话桥接为主对话与子代理模型提供方。

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）里接入微信官方 ilink 机器人网关：扫码绑定后，AI 能主动给自己发微信通知；每次回复后自动推送任务完成摘要；目标完成/阻断时自动通知；需要批准/选择时主动微信提醒。自带设置界面（设置 → ClawBot：扫码二维码、微信在线/断线状态、手动发送、三个自动通知开关、监听开关、解除绑定、自定义图标）。  底层走腾讯官方 ilink 网关（https://ilinkai.weixin.qq.com），无第三方破解、无自建中转，消息只发给绑定的账号自己。
description.zh: 扫码绑定微信后，AI 能主动给你发通知：任务完成、目标达成或需要你确认时，微信第一时间提醒。

description.en: Unofficial DSH port of mattpocock/skills — Engineering (18) + Productivity (7) skills as a DeepSeek Harness bundle plugin. MIT, © Matt Pocock. Star the upstream repo!
description.zh: 将 Matt Pocock 的 25 个工程与效率技能打包成 DSH 插件，提升编码与工作流效率。

description.en: Hermes-style persistent memory (MEMORY.md / USER.md) for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — a faithful port of hermes-agent MemoryStore: bounded, file-backed, model-curated, frozen-snapshot injection.
description.zh: 给 DSH 智能体加上长期记忆，把世界知识和用户偏好分别存进两个文件，越用越懂你。

description.en: Model-facing display_file tool that renders 36 file extensions inline in the web UI: images with a click-to-zoom lightbox, seekable video, audio, PDF, Office and OpenDocument files converted to PDF on the host via LibreOffice, and local HTML in a sandboxed frame; bytes stream from a signed HTTP route with range support, and PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF also enter model context on image-capable routes.
description.zh: 面向模型的 display_file 工具，在网页 UI 内联渲染 36 种扩展名：图片（点击开灯箱）、可拖进度条的视频、音频、PDF、经 LibreOffice 在 Host 转为 PDF 的 Office 与 OpenDocument 文件，以及沙箱 iframe 中的本地 HTML；字节由带 Range 支持的签名 HTTP 路由流式传输，PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF 在支持图像输入的路由上同时进入模型上下文。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness的 IDE插件，以最小破坏性的方式增加代码审阅能力
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话里直接打开浏览器 IDE，轻量顺手地审阅和修改代码，几乎不打扰原有流程。

description.en: Per-conversation persona / master prompt plugin: create, edit, switch and delete persona templates from the composer toolbar, with highest-priority system-prompt injection, fixed interaction guardrails, subagent inheritance, new-conversation default, and local JSON persistence.
description.zh: 每对话独立的人设 / 主提示词插件：在输入框工具栏创建、编辑、切换和删除人设模板，最高优先级系统提示注入，附带固定交互护栏、子代理继承、新对话默认继承与本地 JSON 持久化。

description.en: 为了开发插件，开发了一个开发插件的插件。通过可视化的事件流、插件管理、工具管理、技能管理、预设管理，简化插件的开发流程，方便开发者理解插件的作用。
description.zh: 把插件开发变成可视化工作台，事件流、插件、工具、技能、预设都能看能管，开发更省心。

description.en: Agent2Agent mesh for the Harness
description.zh: 让多个AI代理实时互联互通，组成协作网络，高效完成任务。

description.en: Unofficial Windows and macOS desktop app for DeepSeek Harness, with bundled runtime and automatic reuse of existing DSH environments.
description.zh: Unofficial cross-platform desktop shell with a bundled fallback runtime for DeepSeek Harness Web.

description.en: OpenCode Go 用量常驻条：套餐余量圆环 + token/花费实时统计（本次会话/全部范围 + 按模型联动，官方实时定价），一键复制 API Key。OpenCode Go usage bar for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在聊天框下方常驻显示 OpenCode Go 套餐余量、token 消耗和花费，实时按模型统计，还能一键复制 API Key。

description.en: LLM-as-a-Verifier for DeepSeek Harness: continuous reward signals via select / compare / track
description.zh: 让大模型当裁判，实时对比和追踪输出结果，自动给出反馈信号帮你持续优化效果。

description.en: Cut large agent tool output by what it means, not by where it was cut. 13 content-aware reducers + DeepSeek Harness plugin.
description.zh: 按语义智能裁剪超长工具输出，保留关键信息，让AI代理更省上下文、更高效。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for Bazi & Zi Wei Dou Shu — deterministic, offline fate-chart calculation for AI agents.
description.zh: 给 AI 助手加上八字和紫微斗数排盘能力，离线计算、结果稳定可复现。

description.en: dsh壁纸插件
description.zh: dsh壁纸插件

description.en: Extensible animated response pet with blue-whale, orange-cat, and silver-shaded-cat themes, per-session progress, model and tool-call traces, token counts, output speed, elapsed time, and collapsible multi-session status cards.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页版加一只桌面宠物，实时展示回答进度、模型执行轨迹和会话状态，让等待过程更生动有趣。

description.en: REST + SSE gateway exposing running Harness sessions to third-party clients: API-key auth, token streaming, workspace grouping, and adopting GUI sessions to keep chatting.
description.zh: 为第三方客户端提供 REST + SSE 网关：API 密钥鉴权、token 流式回包、会话工作区分组，并可接管 GUI 会话继续对话。

description.en: Adds a configurable humanized whale-girl maid persona with immersive roleplay, speaking modes, and a lightweight layered memory with query-triggered recall.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加可配置的女仆鲸鱼娘人格：沉浸式扮演（称呼/自称/说话方式）、防出戏规则，以及借鉴 ALTM 的轻量分层记忆与按需召回。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件整合中心：动态发现、打标分类、重叠/兼容检测、一键启停与失效检测
description.zh: 动态发现已装插件并打标分类，检测功能重叠与兼容冲突，一键启停切换、失效诊断与更新检测。

description.en: DSH Web 广告拦截器，四层独立防御拦截 dsh-ads 插件的所有广告位 | DSH Web ad blocker with four independent defense layers targeting the dsh-ads plugin
description.zh: DSH Web 广告拦截器，四层独立防御拦截 dsh-ads 插件的所有广告位 | DSH Web ad blocker with four independent defense layers targeting the dsh-ads plugin

description.en: 个人很喜欢 Claude Code 的 /btw，于是为 DSH 做了复刻：共享当前上下文快速旁路提问，不中断主任务，也不写入主会话历史。
description.zh: 个人很喜欢 Claude Code 的 /btw，于是为 DSH 做了复刻：共享当前上下文快速旁路提问，不中断主任务，也不写入主会话历史。

description.en: Font switcher for the DSH Web GUI: 99 UI fonts and 31 code fonts with CJK-Latin pairing stacks, instant apply and localStorage persistence.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 字体切换器：99 个界面字体与 31 个代码字体，中西文自动搭配，即选即生效，localStorage 持久化。

description.en: Two-way WeChat (iLink) bridge: turn-end and approval-request push, in-chat approve/reject and message injection, persistent dedup and convergent long-reply chunking; channel layer extensible to other IMs.
description.zh: 微信（iLink）双向桥：turn 完成/批准请求推送、聊天内批准与消息注入、持久去重与长回复收敛分段；通道层为多 IM 预留。

description.en: Android GUI Agent with ADB screenshots, compact UI hierarchy grounding, verified iterative actions, approvals, and a Mobile Web view.
description.zh: Android GUI Agent：ADB 截图、压缩 UI hierarchy 定位、逐步动作验证、审批和 Mobile Web 视图。

description.en: Terminal-native interactive TUI for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — built with Ink, React for terminals
description.zh: Terminal-native interactive TUI for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — built with Ink, React for terminals

description.en: ACP bridge between BitFun and DSH.
description.zh: BitFun 与 DSH 的 ACP 交互对接。

description.en: DSH 插件:图片与文件直达纯文本模型——图片保留原生附件体验,PDF/Office/压缩包/视频/音频显示为附件栏方块,点击发送时自动转为工作区路径,配合 dsh-vision-toolkit 粘贴即看图。A DSH plugin that delivers images AND files to text-only models as workspace paths: images keep the native attachment UI, other files show as square chips in the rail, paths append on send — pairs with dsh-vision-toolkit.
description.zh: DSH 插件:图片与文件直达纯文本模型——图片保留原生附件体验,PDF/Office/压缩包/视频/音频显示为附件栏方块,点击发送时自动转为工作区路径,配合 dsh-vision-toolkit 粘贴即看图。A DSH plugin that delivers images AND files to text-only models as workspace paths: images keep the native attachment UI, other files show as square chips in the rail, paths append on send — pairs with dsh-vision-toolkit.

description.en: Superpowers (obra/superpowers) as a DeepSeek Harness plugin: the methodology skills plus their session bootstrap
description.zh: 把 obra/superpowers 方法论技能装进 DeepSeek Harness，开箱即用，帮你更规范地写代码、做审查和 TDD。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that connects to a PowerContext Server over HTTP for recall, memory, handoff, experience, and skills.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin that connects to a PowerContext Server over HTTP for recall, memory, handoff, experience, and skills.

description.en: The complete #dsh-plugin mall inside DeepSeek Harness: browse, search and score the full GitHub dsh-plugin topic catalog refreshed every 2 hours, AI pre-install review with install/caution/avoid verdicts, five-dimension scores with radar charts, nine-language UI, editor picks and personalized recommendations, one-click install/update/rollback with a global task panel, and an in-agent /dsh-mall skill.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 内完整的插件商场：每 2 小时刷新 GitHub #dsh-plugin 全量目录，支持浏览、搜索与评分；AI 装前审查给出装/谨慎/别装结论，五维评分雷达图，九语言界面，编辑精选与个性化推荐，一键安装/更新/回退及全局任务面板，并内置 /dsh-mall skill 在会话中发现插件。

description.en: Two-way iMessage channel for DeepSeek Harness over Photon: sender allowlisting, session commands, in-chat approvals and questions, and a Settings page for device authorization and hosted-line setup.
description.zh: 通过 Photon 接入 DeepSeek Harness 的双向 iMessage 通道：按发件人白名单路由，支持会话命令、聊天内审批与提问，并提供用于设备授权和托管号码设置的 Settings 页面。

description.en: Seven agent-preset modes for DeepSeek Harness, each with a fixed tool boundary, per-mode model routing and fast/deep omd_task delegation tiers, plus a plan-to-execute loop (/mode, /start-work, goal-backed /ulw) and a settings page that remaps models per mode and per tier.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 7 个 Agent 预设模式：每个模式固定工具边界、按模式路由模型，并以 fast/deep 档位委派 omd_task 子代理；含规划到执行闭环（/mode、/start-work、基于 goal 的 /ulw）与逐模式、逐档位重配模型的设置页。

description.en: AST-based context compression, test log filtering, and token budget guard for DeepSeek Harness: strips redundant syntax, prunes noisy log lines, and enforces a token ceiling so the context window never overflows.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 AST 上下文压缩、测试日志过滤与 Token 预算守卫：剔除冗余语法、精简日志噪声，并强制执行 Token 上限以防止上下文窗口溢出。

description.en: An ikun (basketball meme) pet that fills the dock under the "Deep diving..." status row during replies: a sprite-sheet pet walks a 0→100% progress bar, switching animation and text every 20%, and plays a system-level "nǐ gàn ma~" voice cue at completion.
description.zh: ikun 桌宠填满「Deep diving...」状态行下方整行区块：坤宠动图沿 0%→100% 进度条行走，每 20% 切换动作与文案，完成时系统级播放「你干嘛~哎哟」提示音。

description.en: Exports the agent loop to GreptimeDB as OpenTelemetry traces, metrics and logs, with seven Grafana dashboards covering token usage, cost, session outcomes and per-turn latency.
description.zh: 把 agent loop 以 OpenTelemetry traces、metrics、logs 导出到 GreptimeDB，附七个 Grafana dashboard，覆盖 token 用量、成本、会话结果和每轮耗时。

description.en: A vision-language gateway provider route: pasted images are described by a configurable VL model (Qwen-VL by default) before the DeepSeek wire.
description.zh: 视觉语言网关：注册支持图片输入的 DeepSeek provider 路由，图片先由可配置 VL 模型（默认 Qwen-VL）描述成文字再发送。

description.en: Installs the browser4-cli runtime and registers the Browser4 skills (browser4-cli, browser4-experience, browser4-plugin, scent-miner) into the DSH skill registry, providing an AI-native browser engine for autonomous agents, intelligent extraction, and large-scale web automation.
description.zh: 安装 browser4-cli 运行时，并将 Browser4 技能集（browser4-cli、browser4-experience、browser4-plugin、scent-miner）注册到 DSH 技能库，提供面向自主 Agent、智能提取与大规模网页自动化的 AI 原生浏览器引擎。

description.en: Read-only Git and SVN change preview for DSH
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内只读审阅 Git 与 SVN 变更，支持仓库浏览和并排差异对比。

description.en: An opencode-inspired terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness that boots as a dsh profile app plugin, with a session sidebar, streaming chat, markdown tool cards, todo lists, slash-command suggestions, a telemetry footer with a context meter and inline approval prompts.
description.zh: 受 opencode 启发的 DeepSeek Harness 终端界面，以 dsh profile 应用插件形式启动，提供会话侧栏、流式聊天、markdown 工具卡片、待办列表、斜杠命令建议、带上下文用量表的遥测底栏与内联审批提示。

description.en: Zero-LLM auto-capture and a symbolic \[ENGRAM\] index with progressive disclosure, an ESR-lite task/evidence protocol (esr_task / esr_node / esr_close / esr_link), and per-workspace usage telemetry with an offline recall benchmark (npm run eval).
description.zh: 零 LLM 自动捕获 + 符号化 \[ENGRAM\] 索引渐进披露，配 ESR-lite 任务/证据闭环（esr_task / esr_node / esr_close / esr_link）、按工作区的真实使用遥测与离线召回基准（npm run eval）。

description.en: Compact right-edge turn rail with hover summaries and click-to-jump navigation. Ships on npm as `dsh-turn-scrubber`.
description.zh: 右侧紧凑回合刻度条，悬停显示回合摘要，点击跳转到对应用户回合。npm 包名 `dsh-turn-scrubber`。

description.en: Renders assistant replies with numbered citation chips and a sources panel for web-search results, inline pictures with their source captions, and KaTeX formulas, Mermaid diagrams and highlighted code in streaming Markdown.
description.zh: 为助手回答渲染带编号的引用角标和来源面板（针对联网搜索结果）、带来源说明的正文配图，并在流式 Markdown 中渲染 KaTeX 公式、Mermaid 图和代码高亮。

description.en: Free vision bridge for text-only models: image understanding, OCR, UI and debug analysis via free-tier providers (Qwen3-VL-Flash, Doubao, DeepSeek-OCR) with a settings GUI.
description.zh: 免费视觉插件：纯文本模型看图 / OCR / UI / 报错分析，优先免费模型（千问 Qwen3-VL-Flash、豆包、DeepSeek-OCR），设置界面可配置。

description.en: Local library panel for DSH: indexes files and artifacts into a searchable card tree with PDF, Office and image preview, plus paper search across arXiv/OpenAlex/Crossref and others, web-page archiving to markdown snapshots, a plugin-market tab, and one-click switching for resources found in installed plugins (personas, meme packs, whale widget assets). Ships 18 tools and 22 host routes.
description.zh: DSH 的本地资料馆：把本机文件与产物索引成可搜索的卡片树，支持 PDF / Office / 图片预览，另带论文检索（arXiv、OpenAlex、Crossref 等）、把网页存成 markdown 快照、插件市场标签页，以及已装插件资源的同步与一键切换（人设、表情包图集、鲸鱼挂件素材）。包含 18 个工具与 22 条宿主路由。

description.en: Pixel-art whale desktop companion with 29 frame-audited states — taps the glass and flashes the tab title when an approval waits, speaks a completion report when a turn ends, and adds a slash-command palette to the web client.
description.zh: 像素鲸鱼桌宠,29 个逐帧验收状态:等批准时贴屏敲玻璃并让标签页标题闪烁,任务完成开口汇报,并为 web 端提供斜杠命令面板。

description.en: A font plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: the conversation gets its own font, size, line height, weight, tracking, word gap, paragraph gap and first-line indent, the interface font follows it, code keeps its own axis with ligature control; light and dark can each hold their own set, whole setups save as presets, and a floating panel puts every axis a dot away.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的字体插件：对话有自己的字体、字号、行高、字重、字距、词距、段距与首行缩进，界面字体跟随对话，代码独立成轴并支持连字；亮色与暗色可各调一套，整套配置存为预设，另有一个悬浮调参面板。

description.en: Work reports for DeepSeek Harness: gathers Git commits and local agent conversations (DeepSeek/Claude/Codex) and renders daily, weekly or monthly reports from your own templates; the agent tool is injected on demand.
description.zh: dsh 工作报告：汇总 Git 提交与本地 agent 对话（DeepSeek/Claude/Codex），按自定义模板生成日报/周报/月报，agent 工具按需注入。

description.en: Nothing stays in the system prompt: a hit returns titles only, a body loads only when read, and project rules can grow themselves.
description.zh: 让东坡肉滚出系统提示：记忆不常驻，命中只给标题，正文读了才进上下文，项目规范还能自己长。

description.en: Creates, reads, and edits DOCX, PDF, PPTX, and XLSX through `/documents`, `/pdf`, `/presentations`, and `/spreadsheets`; renders pages to check layout, and turns selections in the sidebar preview into edit requests for the session. Python 3.10-3.13 required.
description.zh: 通过 `/documents`、`/pdf`、`/presentations`、`/spreadsheets` 创建、读取与编辑 DOCX、PDF、PPTX、XLSX，把页面渲染出来核对排版，并将侧边栏预览中的选区变成发给会话的修改要求。需 Python 3.10–3.13。

description.en: CalDAV calendar tools (list/create/update/delete/search/health) for Google/iCloud/Nextcloud/custom endpoints, with RRULE expansion, a month/week/agenda panel inside the settings page, in-panel connection setup that is tested before saving, and drag-to-reschedule in the week view (15-minute snapping, undo). A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: CalDAV 日历插件：查/建/改/删/搜日程与健康自检，Google/iCloud/Nextcloud/自定义端点，RRULE 重复事件展开；设置页内置月/周/议程面板，连接可在面板内填写并先测后存，周视图支持拖拽改期（15 分钟吸附、5 秒撤销）。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Tool-call discipline for DeepSeek Harness with behavior prompts, failure-driven concurrency reduction and retry guidance, post-write checks with backup rollback, high-risk command gates, change summaries and verification reminders, advisory project-memory checks, configurable project-discipline reminders after compaction or at intervals, and compliance statistics.
description.zh: 工具调用纪律：提供行为提示、失败后降低并行度与重试提醒、写后检查及备份回滚、高风险命令闸门、变更摘要与验证提醒、项目记忆建议性检查、可配置的项目纪律周期重述与压缩后补充，以及遵守度统计。

description.en: Move, archive, restore, portable backup/export and import sessions across workspaces in the DeepSeek Harness web UI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中跨工作区移动、归档、恢复、可携式备份/导出与导入会话。

description.en: Restart DSH: configurable restart method (Node native / legacy PowerShell), post-restart continue prompt, optional watchdog auto-relaunch.
description.zh: DSH 重启插件：可配置的重启方式（Node 原生/旧 PowerShell 适配）、重启后自动继续的提示词、可选看门狗自动拉起。

description.en: Cross-session plaintext memory: deterministic BM25 keyword recall (no embeddings), memory_save/list/search/confirm/forget tools behind a human-confirm gate, and global + project-scoped JSON stores that follow your git repo.
description.zh: 跨会话明文记忆：确定性 BM25 关键词召回（无向量嵌入），memory_save/list/search/confirm/forget 五个工具 + 人工确认闸门，global/project 两层 JSON 存储（project 随 git 分享）。

description.en: Smart session titles for DSH: after each conversation turn an independent auxiliary LLM call summarizes the full user+assistant transcript into a title that follows the session's real topic instead of echoing the first message; the first message is titled instantly, failed built-in titles auto-retry on later turns, manual renames are never overwritten, and subagent/fork sessions are skipped.
description.zh: 会话智能标题：每轮对话结束后用一次独立的辅助 LLM 调用对「用户消息+助手回答」的完整转写做总结，标题跟随会话真实主题而不是复述第一句话；首条消息即时出题、内置标题失败在后续轮次自动重试、用户手动改名绝不被覆盖、自动跳过子代理与 fork 会话。

description.en: Browser-local prompt library with a composer picker for injecting multiple session-scoped system prompts, branch inheritance, bilingual UI, favorites, and JSON backups.
description.zh: 浏览器本地提示词库：在输入框选择器中同时注入多条会话级系统提示词，支持分支继承、中英界面、收藏与 JSON 备份。

description.en: A plugin manager tab in Settings → Plugins: Chinese names and plain-language descriptions for every installed plugin, one-click enable/disable, in-UI notes editing, and search/filter over the installed catalog.
description.zh: 设置 → 插件里的插件管理页：已装插件中文名与白话描述、一键启停、界面内改备注，支持搜索与筛选。

description.en: Adds an animated ASCII whale ocean behind empty chats, with neutral frosted-glass input, visual color selection, light/dark support, and configurable whales, fish, grid and wakes.
description.zh: 在空白聊天背景中呈现 ASCII 鲸群与游鱼，提供中性毛玻璃输入框、可视化选色器、深浅色适配，以及鲸鱼、鱼群、栅格和尾迹参数设置。

description.en: Desktop BigFish companion for DSH: real-time balance, out-of-browser desktop Q&A, 7 custom animations, 53 meme lines.
description.zh: 桌面大肥鱼增强版桌宠：点击实时显示 DeepSeek 余额，浏览器外桌面问答，7 套专属动作，53 条玩梗。

description.en: Publishes the DSH Web GUI to LAN or internet with dsh kept on loopback. Every source must sign in for an HMAC session cookie unless passwordless LAN is opted into. Adds self-signed or custom TLS, a secureCookies override for plaintext-HTTP proxies, and a UUID shim for plain-HTTP origins.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web GUI 发布到局域网/公网，dsh 仍只绑定回环。除显式开启局域网免密外，所有来源均须登录换取 HMAC 会话 Cookie。提供自签名或自定义 TLS、用于明文 HTTP 代理的 secureCookies 覆盖项，以及让局域网纯 HTTP 来源正常打开工作区的 UUID shim。

description.en: Shows subscription quota and account balance beside the DeepSeek Harness model selector for 28 provider entries, with a shared settings page and a read-only quota tool.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器旁显示 28 条提供商入口的订阅额度与账户余额，附统一设置页和只读额度查询工具。

description.en: Token usage statistics for DeepSeek Harness: per-model daily and range charts plus a yearly contributions heatmap.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Token 用量统计：近 7 天/30 天按模型的柱状图、饼图，外加近一年每日活跃热力图。

description.en: Binds a separate DeepSeek API key to each workspace or session, warns when an effective key is stale or belongs to another provider, and never swaps a key on its own.
description.zh: 为每个工作区或单个会话单独绑定一把 DeepSeek API key，生效 key 失效或服务商不匹配时提醒，且绝不自动替换 key。

description.en: A self-healing layer for tool calls: missing params, wrong fields and out-of-range paths are fixed before they reach the model. Measured visible error rate fell from 7.95% to 2.20%.
description.zh: 给工具调用加一层自愈：缺参数、错字段、路径越界在到达模型前自动修好，实测可见错误率从 7.95% 降到 2.20%。

description.en: Burned DSH tokens become incense; spend one stick to raise or lower today's case. The case updates daily, Liangwei decides today's Liangzi, and the result is archived at day end.
description.zh: 用 DSH 烧掉的 Token 凝成香火，花一炷给今日梁案投夯或拉；梁案每日更新，梁位决定今日梁子，日终收入梁祠。

description.en: Neumorphic DSH Web theme with light and dark palettes, ambient lighting, material shadows, grain texture, frosted-glass surfaces, and micro-interactions.
description.zh: DSH Web 轻拟物主题：提供浅色与深色配色、环境光影、材质阴影、纹理、磨砂玻璃表面与微交互。

description.en: Plugin marketplace in Settings that targets any local profile, not just the running one: install, update and remove across web, headless and other profiles, with install-script warnings, an installed view that also covers non-catalog profile dependencies, and an automatic DSH restart when the current profile changes.
description.zh: 设置页里的插件市场，可操作本机任意 profile 而不只是当前运行的那个：在 web、headless 及其他 profile 上安装、更新、卸载，带安装脚本风险提示，已装视图同时覆盖目录之外的 profile 依赖，改动当前 profile 时自动重启 DSH。

description.en: US stock quotes, price history, financial statements, analyst consensus and news via yahoo-finance2.
description.zh: 美股行情、历史 K 线、财务报表、分析师共识与新闻，数据来自 yahoo-finance2。

description.en: Routes model requests, web fetches/searches and spawned tools through the Windows system proxy or a custom address — idempotent kernel (reads never rebuild the dispatcher), header one-click toggle, per-URL route diagnosis and NTLM-aware 407 hints.
description.zh: 把模型请求、web 抓取/搜索与衍生工具统一路由到 Windows 系统代理或自定义地址——幂等内核（读操作不重组分发器）、头部一键开关、按 URL 路由诊断与 NTLM 认证提示。

description.en: Install this plugin and DSH can operate your Zotero for you: search the library, read PDF full text, summarize highlights and notes, organize collections by topic, import your downloaded papers, and attach a translated version back to an item. The right sidebar also gains a Zotero library panel that brings an item, an excerpt or a whole collection into the conversation with one click. Model-side actions need Zotero's local API plus the Zotero MCP plugin (write operations enabled); the sidebar panel needs only the local API.
description.zh: 装上这个插件，DSH 就能直接操控你的 Zotero：检索文库、精读 PDF 全文、汇总高亮与笔记、按主题整理分类；也能在一个对话里导入你下载好的论文、把译文作为附件挂回条目。右侧栏还多一块「Zotero 文献库」面板，可把条目、摘录或整个分类一键带进对话。模型侧操作需开启 Zotero 本地 API 并安装集成 MCP 插件（写操作需在 MCP 插件里放行）；右侧面板只依赖本地 API。

description.en: Adds an edit action to finalized assistant replies in DeepSeek Harness, letting you rewrite the reply text or reasoning chain; the edit is saved as a surface replacement.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 已完成的助手回复增加编辑入口，可改写正文或思维链，改动以 surface replacement 形式保存。

description.en: Zero-dependency screen capture for DSH: Lightweight — zero deps, zero binaries; Stage & shoot — one-click full screen, window layout, hover-snap capture of occluded windows; Agent self-service — path-only delivery; paths are universal, pair with modlens (optional) for one-call structured evidence.
description.zh: DSH 轻量截图插件：轻——零依赖零二进制；摆——一键全屏、窗口排版、悬停吸附截取被遮挡窗口；自助——Agent 可自助截屏，传路径不传图，路径通用，接上 modlens（选装）一步读出结构化内容。

description.en: Manage MCP servers from the Web settings panel: view, add, edit, remove, enable or disable them, with hot reload on save.
description.zh: 在 Web 设置面板中查看、添加、编辑、删除、启用或停用 MCP 服务器，保存后热重载。

description.en: Learning Mode agent preset: a coding agent that teaches while coding — concrete scenario-grounded explanations, Socratic guidance, and TODO(你) practice blanks, modeled on Claude Code's Learning output style; installable via dsh plugin add (dsh-learning-mode on npm).
description.zh: 学习模式（Learning Mode）Agent 预设：边做边教的编码 Agent——具体的情景化阐释、苏格拉底式引导、TODO(你) 留白练习，模拟 Claude Code 的 Learning 输出风格；可 `dsh plugin add` 安装（npm 包 dsh-learning-mode）。

description.en: Turns the DeepSeek Harness agent into any character: a global cosplay switch, SillyTavern v2 role cards with JSON import/export, a neutral/role thinking-style toggle, and natural-language card authoring via a built-in skill.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 扮演任何角色：全局扮演开关、酒馆 v2 角色卡（JSON 导入导出）、中立/角色化思考切换，内置 skill 支持一句话生成角色卡。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 移动端插件：手机远程操控宿主，提供受限移动 API、中转隧道与局域网配对（可作无头宿主运行）
description.zh: 用手机远程操控电脑上的 DSH，通过中转隧道和局域网配对，让手机接着电脑继续用。

description.en: AI harness for EasyEDA Pro — offline schematic/PCB design review, live bridge (daemon + editor extension), review-to-local-edit with verified persistence
description.zh: 让 AI 直接读懂 EasyEDA Pro 的原理图和 PCB，离线审查设计并回写修改，改完还能验证真的存上了。

description.en: Injects an x-session-id HTTP header carrying the harness session id onto every LLM provider request, plus whitelisted gateway fetches during tool execution.
description.zh: 在每个 LLM 提供商请求上注入携带 harness 会话 ID 的 x-session-id 请求头，也覆盖工具执行期间白名单内的网关请求。

description.en: Local TTS speech synthesis and playback for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 本地调用 IndexTTS 2.5 或 GPT-SoVITS 语音合成，让 DeepSeek Harness 用中文语音朗读回复，支持播放。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的原生 QQ 机器人插件：微内核 + 子插件，Linux/Windows 通用。收消息、发图、生图、发表情，装完就能聊。此项目为个人因需求爱好，人力设计方案AI构建代码的插件，所以bug和不够合理的地方有许多，发出来仅为学习和分享
description.zh: 装完填几项就能用的 QQ 机器人，收消息、发图、生图、发表情，Linux 和 Windows 都能跑。

description.en: DSH Web 一站式运维面板：模型配置与子代理路由、用量与额度查询、会话与备份管理、健康诊断及安全重启。｜All-in-one operations panel for DSH Web: model configuration & subagent routing, usage & quotas, sessions & backups, health diagnostics & safe restart.
description.zh: 自托管 DSH Web 的一站式运维面板，安全重启升级、健康诊断、用量查询、会话管理、备份权限、任务通知和模型路由全搞定。

description.en: DSH 动画优化：输出流式动画与 Claude Code 风格外观插件
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页界面套上 Claude Code 风格外观，并把思考和工具输出改成逐段流式播放，看着更实时。

description.en: Authenticated remote access for a DeepSeek Harness web profile: TLS, QR/passcode device pairing, password sign-in, and per-device revocation in front of an untouched loopback harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页端提供安全远程访问，支持 TLS 加密、扫码/密码登录及设备管理，无需改动本地服务。

description.en: 【已归档】上游风控持续加强、UA/请求头格式频繁变动，适配已难以为继。后续开发移步 https://github.com/functy23/dsh-workbuddy-panel
description.zh: 已归档的 WorkBuddy 模型接入插件，把 WorkBuddy 渠道接进 DSH 当模型用，现已停止维护。

description.en: 面向中文小说作者的开源 DSH 写作插件：点赞/点踩提炼可编辑的文风偏好，支持候选稿、章节管理与局部改稿。MIT；需 DeepSeek Harness 和自备模型。
description.zh: 让 AI 写出你喜欢的文风：只靠点赞点踩，模型自动总结偏好，越写越对味。

description.en: Red-phosphor CRT terminal theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: black background, phosphor-red text, animated data rain and scanlines, and four department presets (Party Affairs, State Council, Central Military Commission, State Security), each with its own emblem, palette and background pattern.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 换成黑底红字的磷光终端主题：红色数据雨与 CRT 扫描线，外加党务 / 国家政务 / 中央军委 / 国家安全四套部门预设，每套自带徽记、配色与背景纹样。

description.en: 微信 × DeepSeek Harness (DSH)：进程内插件，扫码即用，双向消息/文件，wechat_notify 主动推送
description.zh: 扫码就能在微信里收发消息和文件，还能主动推送通知，让 DSH 直接连上微信。

description.en: Windowseat bridge for DeepSeek Harness: a local host plugin exposing a loopback HTTP/SSE endpoint so the bundled Microsoft Edge side-panel extension can read the current page, search local files and talk to DSH; the Edge extension lives in the same repo and must be loaded separately. Windows 10/11 with desktop Edge required.
description.zh: 临窗 Windowseat 的 DSH 宿主插件：在回环地址暴露 HTTP/SSE 端点，供同仓库的 Microsoft Edge 侧边栏扩展读取当前页面、检索本地文件并连接 DSH；扩展需在 Edge 中单独加载；需 Windows 10/11 与桌面版 Edge。

description.en: Collapses global sidebar navigation into an icon grid with inline name hints, animated transitions, and drag-to-reorder.
description.zh: 将全局侧栏导航折叠为图标网格，提供即时名称提示、过渡动画和拖动排序。

description.en: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web UI 增强插件：25 套终端美学主题、中文优先字体、文字墨色与官方峰谷提醒 · 江南泉个人开发并免费开源
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页界面换上 25 套终端风主题，优化中文字体，还能提醒官方峰谷时段。

description.en: A remote workspace plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). It manages SSH hosts inside DSH, opens remote terminals, lets you browse and edit remote files and inspect remote Git, and adds remote directories as workspaces, so the Agent's file operations and commands run on the remote machine.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里连 SSH 主机，开远程终端、改远程文件、看 Git，还能把远程目录挂成工作区。

description.en: DSH Web 客户端的 Codex 风格「思考强度」电源滑块 —— 拖一下就切换会话的真实推理强度；紫色扫描、漂浮星尘、拖柄墨点全部手写，零构建零依赖。
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 界面加一条 Codex 风格电源滑杆，拖一下就能直接切换会话的真实推理强度，不用再翻菜单。

description.en: DSH 插件：在「设置→插件」页一键启停本地 llama.cpp 大模型（35B/9B，视觉×文本×快速/长上下文），卡片内配置、一条命令安装、自动注册，装完即用。 | start/stop a local llama.cpp llama-server right from Settings → Plugins, with Qwen3.6-35B / Qwen3.5-9B (vision × text, fast × long-context) as session models — card config, one-command install, auto-registered.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页一键启停本地 llama.cpp 大模型，装完即用，让本地模型直接当会话模型。

description.en: Swiss grid design plugin for DeepSeek Harness — compute 版心, columns, baseline and type scale, then build print-ready SVG-to-PDF posters with a grid-overlay proof.
description.zh: 帮你算好版心、分栏、基线和字号阶梯，还能直接生成可印刷的网格海报。

description.en: Give your coding agent a workflow for chip front-end design and verification.
description.zh: 从自然语言规格到Verilog RTL和UVM验证，再到商业EDA工具前端签核的开放智能体流程。

description.en: DSH 智能体灵动岛：macOS 刘海 / Windows Fluent 双端兼容，实时显示 Agent 思考、工具调用与子代理并行状态
description.zh: 在 macOS 刘海和 Windows 上实时显示智能体思考、工具调用和子代理并行状态，随时掌握 AI 在干什么。

description.en: Intelligent UI for DeepSeek Harness: the model answers with an openui-lang program and the Web GUI renders it as a live, interactive UI inside the chat
description.zh: 让模型直接生成可点击操作的交互界面，聊天里就能用，不用再读一大段文字。

description.en: All-in-one local memory: JSONL files per scope (session, project, global, or a custom name) with per-scope dedup, five model tools (memory_save, memory_search, memory_list, memory_get, memory_forget), automatic recall and hard rules injected into the agent pre-step, and a settings panel. Retrieval combines lexical IDF with a local embedding backend, which the panel can install and manage itself.
description.zh: 一体化本地记忆：按作用域（会话、项目、全局或自定义名）各一个 JSONL 文件、作用域内按内容去重，五个模型工具（memory_save / memory_search / memory_list / memory_get / memory_forget），自动召回与硬性规则注入 agent 的 pre-step，并带一个设置面板。检索是词法 IDF 与本地向量后端的组合，向量后端可由面板一键安装并托管。

description.en: Project-level MCP manager for DSH: auto-mount MCP servers from each project's .dsh/mcp.yml, hot-reload config changes, and scope tools to the active session's project.
description.zh: 在项目里写个 mcp.yml 或 mcp.json，MCP 服务就自动挂载，项目和用户层都能统一管理。

description.en: skillhub of deepseek-harness
PPT workbench: eleven ppt_* tools create, edit, reverse-engineer, QA-check and export slides from a plain-text PPTD project; five design-system families, themes, animations, posters and infographics.
description.zh: PPT 制作插件：十一个 ppt_* 工具创建、编辑、逆向、质检与导出演示文稿，内置五族设计系统与主题模板，支持幻灯片动画、海报与信息图。

description.en: WorkBuddy / DeepSeek Harness 可视化财务工作台：20 个模块、异常闭环、25 个 AI 工作流，支持 MCP App 一键安装

Raises Node's HTTP headers/body timeouts for the whole DSH process (default 30 min, proxy-aware) so Ollama and LM Studio models that stay silent while thinking or generating a large tool call are not cut off at 5 minutes; replaces the node_modules undici patch.
description.zh: 全局调高 Node 的 HTTP 超时时间，避免慢速本地模型（如 Ollama、LM Studio）因静默超 5 分钟被中断。

description.en: Offline schematic review for EasyEDA Pro, exposed to dsh as four tools — one-shot checkup reports, architecture skeletons, an install doctor, and a live-editor bridge that prefers read-only actions, all driven by the local boardwise CLI.
description.zh: 立创 EDA Pro（EasyEDA Pro）原理图离线审查，给 dsh 加四个工具——一次性 checkup 报告、架构骨架、本机安装体检，以及只读优先的在线编辑器桥，全部由本机 boardwise CLI 驱动。

description.en: Three Zhihu tools for DSH — in-site search, Zhihu's global web index with domain and date filters, and Zhida answers — with a native settings card and source-cited results.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加三个知乎工具——站内问答与文章检索、知乎全网索引检索（可按域名与时间过滤）、直答——自带原生设置卡片，结果附来源可引用。

description.en: Agent-native browser DevTools workbench for DeepSeek Harness. / 让你的DSH获得非常强大的 Chromium DevTools 能力
description.zh: 让 DSH 直接操控 Chromium 开发者工具，能点击、下断点、抓请求、读 Source Map，还能留存现场证据。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (dsh) agent preset for making large engineering tasks deliberate, integrated, and verifiable from the first turn.
description.zh: 让大型工程任务从第一轮就变得有条理、能整合、可验证的 dsh 智能体预设。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Web plugin — Anime maid whale desktop pet with satiety system and real-time LLM interaction
description.zh: 在桌面上养一只动漫女仆鲸鱼，能喂食看饱腹度，还能实时和 LLM 聊天互动。

description.en: dsh plugin: flexible model switch for sub‑agent & plan execution.  为子代理和计划执行选择更合适的模型。
description.zh: 为子代理和计划执行灵活切换更合适的模型，让每个工作阶段都用对模型。

description.en: for better dsh
description.zh: 把已安装的插件打包成一个合集，一条命令批量安装并自动挂载，还带账户状态和快照系统，界面自动中英双语。

description.en: for better dsh
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Agent memory for DeepSeek Harness | DeepSeek Harness 记忆插件
description.zh: dsh-tdai-memory — DSH 插件（会话）

description.en: 模型回合结束后用 LLM 生成 3 条批判性跟进建议，点击即发送 | After a model turn, an LLM generates 3 critical follow-up suggestions shown as click-to-send chips
description.zh: 模型回合结束后用 LLM 生成 3 条批判性跟进建议，点击即发送 | After a model turn, an LLM generates 3 critical follow-up suggestions shown as click-to-send chips

description.en: Native Graphify knowledge graph plugin providing 10 code intelligence tools, topological search, god nodes discovery, and PR blast radius triage.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生 Graphify 知识图谱支持，包含 10 个代码智能工具、拓扑搜索、核心节点发现与 PR 影响分析。

description.en: Side-panel Xiangqi board for DSH: play as red while the current DSH model chooses black moves, with Host-side rule and revision checks.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏中国象棋棋盘：用户执红，当前 DSH 模型执黑，Host 负责棋规与局面版本校验。

description.en: Karpathy LLM Wiki pattern knowledge base for DSH: wiki-write/wiki-search skills, zero-dependency pipeline (lint/index/mnemon memory sync/quality feedback), minimal lifecycle plugin injecting schema + knowledge preview, SiliconFlow semantic recall via an Ollama-compatible proxy.
description.zh: Karpathy LLM Wiki 模式的 DSH 知识库系统：wiki-write/wiki-search 技能引导模型写读 Obsidian wiki，零依赖管线（lint/索引/mnemon 记忆体同步/质量闭环），极简生命周期插件注入守则与知识预览，Ollama 兼容代理接 SiliconFlow 语义召回。

description.en: DSH 插件：免费网页搜索，双免费后端（Parallel 默认 + Exa 备用，均匿名免 key）+ 设置开关 + MCP server 双传输（stdio + HTTP/SSE 双端口），兼容 Claude Code / Codex | Free web search for DeepSeek Harness: Parallel (default) + Exa (backup) free providers, settings toggle, and dual-transport MCP server (stdio + HTTP/SSE) for Claude Code / Codex
description.zh: 给 DSH 加个免费联网搜索，匿名可用、Exa 兜底，还能当 MCP 服务给 Claude Code 和 Codex 用。

description.en: Codex-style drag-drop: drag any file into the DSH web GUI, it lands in ~/.dsh-dropbox, and the path is inserted into the composer as a whole blue chip.
description.zh: Codex 式拖拽：把任意文件拖入 DSH Web 界面，文件存入 ~/.dsh-dropbox，路径以整块蓝色 chip 插入输入框。

description.en: DSH skill: ingest the conclusions/mistakes/projects from conversations into an Obsidian vault via a 7-step workflow with two-level validation. 把对话结论/错题/项目按七步流程整理进 Obsidian 的 DeepSeek Harness 技能。
在 DSH 聊天窗口自动调用生图工具（API 渠道，或本机 CLI：已支持mmx / codex / agy）并展示图片，也支持利用对应 CLI 识别图片。
description.zh: 在 DSH 聊天窗口里直接调用生图工具，生成图片并自动展示，无需切换界面。

description.en: DeepSeek API 用量监测 DSH 插件：悬浮球 + 展开面板，展示开放平台真实余额、累计消费、今日消费、请求次数、Tokens 与分模型用量，支持手动登录获取 userToken。
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Network proxy manager for DeepSeek Harness: switch between system, manual, and direct modes from a live settings UI, applied instantly.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网络代理管理器：在设置界面即时切换跟随系统 / 手动 / 直连三种模式，立即生效。

description.zh: 扫码即可把飞书机器人接入 DeepSeek Harness，在飞书里直接和智能体连续对话。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness web background settings plugin with solid color, image, and opacity controls.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页换个背景，支持纯色、图片和透明度调节，让界面更顺眼。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Image2 生图插件，通过第三方 OpenAI Images 兼容接口调用 gpt-image-2，只需配置 baseURL 和 API Key。 | Image2 generation plugin for DeepSeek Harness via third-party OpenAI Images-compatible APIs.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上生图能力，通过第三方兼容接口调用 gpt-image-2，配好地址和密钥就能用。

description.en: DSH-TUI: a lightweight and fast terminal plugin connected directly to the DSH runtime.
description.zh: DSH-TUI: a lightweight and fast terminal plugin connected directly to the DSH runtime.

description.en: Pause / resume / cancel the in-flight conversation task from the composer area: forced pause interrupts immediately and remembers the interrupted tool, safe pause lands after the tool or reasoning finishes, resume asks for confirmation, and the default pause granularity is configurable in the settings.
description.zh: 在输入区暂停/恢复/取消正在运行的对话任务：强制暂停立即中断并记住被中断的工具，安全暂停等工具/推理完成后再落地，恢复时需确认；默认暂停粒度可在设置中配置（出厂 safe wait）。

description.zh: 向模型暴露 sleep 工具，按指定毫秒暂停执行后返回，支持取消/clamp | Exposes a sleep tool that pauses for specified ms then returns, with cancellation/clamping

description.en: IKUN fandom skin for the DSH Web UI: star-blue and black-gold palettes in the system theme list, full-screen photo wallpaper rotation, a music box, and a send-button voice line.
description.zh: ikun 主题皮肤：星蓝昼/夜与背带裤黑金三套配色接入系统主题列表，全屏照片壁纸轮播、音乐盒与发送音效。

description.zh: An in-process trigram index that makes code search in Pi&DSH 20-70x faster than ripgrep, with identical results and no sidecar process.

description.en: Use local Codex App Server as a model provider in DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接调用本机已登录的 Codex 当模型用，免配置免密钥。

description.en: Financial research workflow and portfolio risk tools with source discipline for current market facts.
description.zh: 金融研究工作流与组合风控工具，对当前市场事实强制来源与时间戳边界。

description.en: Solarized light theme, compact layout, think/tool-chain collapse capsules, and balance, session cost, and usage dashboards for the DSH web UI.
description.zh: Solarized 浅色主题、紧凑布局、思考/工具链折叠胶囊，以及余额、本轮成本与用量看板的 DSH Web 界面增强插件。

description.en: Skills for building websites on the Creght platform: CLI pull/push sync, page and component conventions, CMS, forms, auth, SEO, publishing and version rollback.
description.zh: Creght 平台建站技能包：CLI 拉取/推送同步、页面与组件规范、CMS、表单、Auth、SEO、发布与版本回滚。

description.en: Official UI plugin reference implementation.
description.zh: Turtle UI 是 DSH 官方的终端界面插件，提供简洁美观的交互界面，方便你更直观地操作和管理插件。

description.en: Web UI polish layer for DeepSeek Harness: normalizes unfinished or self-contradictory official UI, reconciles style conflicts between insta…
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Bidirectional Hermes ↔ DSH bridge: import Hermes sessions into DSH, consult Hermes, and receive Hermes-dispatched tasks as a single Cordis plugin.
description.zh: Hermes 与 DSH 的双向桥接插件：将 Hermes 会话导入 DSH、咨询 Hermes，并以单一 Cordis 插件接收 Hermes 下发的任务。

description.en: Chinese localization for DeepSeek Harness: translates all system prompts, tool descriptions, and runtime contexts into Chinese at runtime via the system-prompt/assemble waterfall (1788 entries, zero source modification, uninstall restores English).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 中文汉化插件：通过 system-prompt/assemble 瀑布钩子在运行时把全部系统提示词、工具描述与运行时上下文翻译成中文（1788 条译文，零源码修改，卸载即还原英文）。

description.en: Live skill provider that adds skills from 60+ other agents' directories (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot), Claude Code plugin marketplaces, and any git repository of skills to the dsh catalog without copying or symlinking; deduplicates, repairs frontmatter, renames name collisions, and ships a CLI (list, add, sync, doctor).
description.zh: 实时技能提供器：把 60+ 个其他 Agent（Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI、Copilot）的技能目录、Claude Code 插件市场以及任意 git 技能仓库中的技能接入 dsh 目录，零拷贝零软链接；自动去重、修复 frontmatter、处理同名冲突，并附带 CLI（list、add、sync、doctor）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness's own fast mode: a few configs that set how fast a task runs — bound where thinking settles, bound the process narration, bound the steps per task — faster delivery without touching the model or its thinking strength. Measured over 10 task families and 30 complete units: the default reaches 0.72x total time, 0.74x output tokens and 0.71x steps; moving the "write it once" reminder from step 4 to step 2 gives debugfix 0.535x, ledger 0.506x, migrate 0.751x, and 0.625x pooled over 13 pairs with 0.614x output tokens (migrate alone 0.509x with 0.528x output at step 3). Hidden tests passed in every pair. Short 1-5 step repairs and data reshaping do not pay for the reminder, so try it once per task shape.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 自己的快速模式：用几项配置控制任务的运行速度——限制思考在哪一步收敛、限制中间汇报的输出、限制最多几步，在不改变模型与思考强度的前提下把任务做快。实测 10 类任务 30 个完整单元：默认配置总耗时 0.72×、输出 token 0.74×、步数 0.71×；把「省着写」提醒从第 4 步提前到第 2 步，debugfix 0.535×、ledger 0.506×、migrate 0.751×，13 对合并 0.625×、输出 token 0.614×（第 3 步时 migrate 单族 0.509×、输出 0.528×）。每一对里两臂隐藏断言逐格相同、全绿。1–5 步的小改修与数据整形收不回提醒成本，按任务形状先试一次再定。

description.en: Self-contained literature library for DSH with optional Zotero export: full-text PDF fetching (Unpaywall/arXiv/custom URL templates), loose Crossref-backed search, APA/GB-T 7714/MLA/Chicago citation generation, a side-panel PDF reader with highlights and notes, and AI-assisted Q&A/translation steered into the current conversation.
description.zh: DSH 内置文献库（可选导出到 Zotero）：通过 Unpaywall/arXiv/自定义 URL 模板获取全文 PDF，Crossref 候选式宽松搜索，APA/GB-T 7714/MLA/Chicago 引用生成，侧窗 PDF 阅读器（高亮与笔记），以及注入当前对话的 AI 问答/翻译。

description.en: Session bridge for DeepSeek Harness: drive other real DSH sessions straight from your prompt — create top-level sessions in any workspace, message or steer any session, wait for replies and stream them segment-by-segment (chain-of-thought included), resume offline sessions, find sessions across workspaces, run a background watchdog that monitors and schedules a main task (nudge when stalled, correct drift, cancel when stuck), and archive sessions with one command.
description.zh: 会话桥：让当前 agent 直接用提示词驱动其它真实的 DSH 会话——跨工作区创建主会话、向任意会话发消息或注入 steering、等待并逐段读取回复（含思维链）、恢复离线会话、按名称或 id 跨工作区查找会话；还能用后台看门狗监控并调度主任务（卡住催办、偏离纠偏、卡死终止），一键归档会话。

description.en: Renders Wallpaper Engine scene wallpapers in real time in the browser (three.js player plus a Rust/WASM CPU particle simulation) and plays video and web wallpapers, falling back to the preview image, with no Wallpaper Engine runtime required. Scans the local Steam workshop library (431960) by auto-detection or a manual path, and offers a settings panel for wallpaper selection, library and engine directories, glow, pause and quality.
description.zh: 把本机 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸放到 dsh Web 界面背后：scene 壁纸在浏览器内实时渲染（three.js 播放器 + Rust/WASM CPU 粒子模拟），视频与 web 壁纸原样播放，其余回退 preview 图，不需要安装 Wallpaper Engine 运行时。壁纸库从 Steam 创意工坊目录（431960）自动探测或手动指定，设置面板可选壁纸、配壁纸库与引擎目录、调光晕与暂停/画质。

description.en: Upgrades DSH image viewing with pointer-centered zoom, pan, galleries, downloads, keyboard support, and inline region notes.
description.zh: 增强 DSH 原生图片查看体验，支持指针中心缩放、拖动、画廊、下载、键盘操作和图片区域备注。

description.en: Configurable send and newline keys, a composer context menu with three sources (leave it to DSH and other plugins / browser menu / plugin-styled custom menu), a quick-command panel with categorized prompt lists where each prompt can append on every send or only on the first message of a session, a create-and-move row at the bottom of each category, a prompt optimizer that rewrites the draft with a separate model call, settings-panel size memory, and automatic x-opencode-session header injection for OpenCode routes. Prompt lists live in a global ~/.dsh/quick-prompts.json that is independent of the session and the project.
description.zh: 可配置发送/换行键位、输入框右键菜单三种来源（插件不介入 / 浏览器菜单 / 自定义样式菜单）、带分类的快捷指令面板（每条可设「每次发送都附加」或「仅在本会话第一条消息附加」，并有跨分类移动与新建）、用另一次模型调用把草稿整理成清晰指令的提示词优化、设置面板尺寸记忆，并为 OpenCode 路由自动注入 x-opencode-session 请求头。快捷指令存在全局文件 ~/.dsh/quick-prompts.json 里，与会话、项目无关。

description.en: Lifecycle management UI for the llm-pi-ai model provider: create, edit, delete, enable and disable providers with custom headers and AES-GCM-encrypted API keys; uninstall-safe restore of parked providers, remote model discovery with batch write, smart routing with five strategies, union/intersection composites, per-model connectivity tests, and request observability.
description.zh: llm-pi-ai 模型提供商的生命周期管理 UI：提供商的新建/编辑/删除与启停（自定义请求头、AES-GCM 加密密钥）；卸载时安全还原滞留提供商，远端模型发现与批量写入，五种策略的智能路由，并集/交集组合提供商，逐模型连通性测试与请求观测。

description.en: A web Settings "Loop engine" switch that swaps the agent loop driving every dsh session among five engines — the built-in in-process loop plus hosted Claude Code, Codex, Pi, and Kimi Code — with zero changes to the harness; each hosted engine keeps its thinking and tool calls in the durable session transcript, takes over commands, skills, and the agent preset, and runs sandboxed through the dsh subprocess seam.
description.zh: Web 设置页的「循环引擎」开关，在五套引擎间切换驱动每个 dsh 会话的 agent 循环——内置 in-process 加托管的 Claude Code、Codex、Pi、Kimi Code——无需改动 harness；每个托管引擎都把思考与工具调用写入持久会话记录，接管命令、技能与 agent 预设，并经 dsh 子进程接缝沙箱运行。

description.en: Model-based permission approval: an approval-request answerer backed by a separate reviewer model.
description.zh: 基于模型的权限审批：由独立审查模型自动应答 approval 权限请求。

description.en: Edits assistant replies and thinking chains in DSH sessions so the model sees the edited text, live via message projection or on disk.
description.zh: 编辑 DSH 会话中的助手回复与思维链，让模型采信改后的内容：在线经 message projection 立即生效，或落盘改写会话记录。

description.en: Adds a Web composer switch between the native DSH agent and Grok Build, proxying Grok Build sessions and slash commands through ACP.
description.zh: 在 Web 输入框中切换原生 DSH Agent 与 Grok Build，并通过 ACP 代理 Grok Build 会话及斜杠命令。

description.en: Newmark Core for DeepSeek Harness：MemoryLab、ComputerUse、Agent API、NewMate 陪伴内核与 heartBeat 重启投递，五个独立开关，共用 ~/.Newmark 用户库。

DeepTutor tutoring bridge: deep explanations, self-test questions, learning-path planning, personal knowledge-base search (RAG), and note archiving via deeptutor_run / deeptutor_kb / deeptutor_note tools.
description.zh: DeepTutor 学习辅导桥接插件：通过 deeptutor_run / deeptutor_kb / deeptutor_note 工具为 agent 接入深度讲解、自测题、学习路径规划、个人知识库检索（RAG）与笔记归档。

description.en: Theme plugin — supports dark/light appearance switching, ships 34 preset themes, and supports creating, sharing, and importing custom themes.
description.zh: 主题插件 —— 支持深色/浅色外观切换，提供 34 款预设主题，支持创建/分享/导入自定义主题。

description.en: Floating one-line widget showing how much Alibaba Cloud credit is left (voucher balance + account balance), with voucher face value, used amount and earliest expiry on hover. Read-only BSS queries, no spend tracking.
description.zh: 界面悬浮一行显示「还能花的钱」= 阿里云代金券余额 + 账户余额；悬停看券面值、已用与最早失效时间。只读 BSS 存量，不做消费统计。
