description.en: Connects Huawei Cloud CodeArts to DeepSeek Harness with built-in OAuth2 sign-in (PKCE + DPoP) or a pasted token, after which CodeArts models are available in the DSH conversation window. Reads per-account credit balance, expiring credits and daily check-in from the CodeArts credit API, counts requests and tokens locally, and shows a per-account credits popover under the chat input box; the credits line and the upstream queue hint can each be turned off in settings.
description.zh: 把华为云 CodeArts 接入 DeepSeek Harness：内置华为云 OAuth2 登录（PKCE + DPoP），也支持粘贴 token；登录后即可在 DSH 对话窗口使用 CodeArts 提供的模型。积分余额、即将过期额度与每日签到读 CodeArts 自己的积分接口，请求数与 token 用量按账号在本机统计；对话输入框下方那行积分可点开看逐号明细，积分与上游排队位置都能在设置里单独关掉。

description.en: Windows-only computer use for DeepSeek Harness: captures the virtual screen and drives mouse & keyboard through 9 tools built on PowerShell and Win32 SendInput; pairs with picturereader so text-only models can complete the screenshot-analyze-act-verify loop fully locally.
description.zh: 仅 Windows 的 DSH 电脑操作插件：以 PowerShell + Win32 SendInput 实现 9 个工具，截取虚拟屏幕并驱动鼠标键盘；配合 picturereader 让纯文本模型在本地完成「截图-分析-操作-验证」闭环。

description.en: Office workspace & session dashboard: a floating 6-column sprite panel visualizing workspaces, sessions, token usage and subagents, plus Agent Mail and an office log tab. Feishu/Lark views (message feed, meeting schedules, transcripts) additionally require the `@larksuite/cli` tool installed and authenticated separately.
description.zh: 办公室工作区/会话仪表盘：悬浮 6 列精灵面板，可视化工作区、会话、token 用量与子代理，并提供 Agent Mail 与办公日志页签。飞书相关视图（消息流、会议日程、妙记逐字稿）另需自行安装并授权 `@larksuite/cli`。

description.en: eDEX-UI-style shell over the DSH web GUI: system-telemetry left bar with per-core CPU sparklines, encom-globe world-map right bar with up/down traffic chart, filesystem browser with file preview, and a terminal-styled composer that follows the active workspace.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面上叠加 eDEX-UI 风格外壳：左侧系统遥测栏（含每核 CPU 迷你趋势图）、右侧 encom-globe 世界地图与上下行流量图、左下文件系统浏览器（带文件预览），以及跟随当前工作区的终端风格输入框。

description.en: Manage VPS servers over SSH key login: 22 zero-token /vps- commands (status queries, recipe installs with a plan and /vps-yes confirmation, reboot that waits for the machine to come back), an in-conversation terminal (xterm.js over ssh -tt) for interactive programs, 5 agent tools with risk-tiered confirmation, file backup with automatic restore and a firewall/SSH safety net, 29 built-in recipes, and a settings page for adding machines.
description.zh: 通过 SSH 密钥登录管理 VPS：22 条不走模型的 /vps- 命令（查看状态、按菜谱安装并先出计划再用 /vps-yes 确认、重启并等机器回来），对话里的终端（xterm.js + ssh -tt，可运行菜单脚本等交互程序），5 个按风险分级确认的 agent 工具，改文件自动备份与还原、改防火墙和 SSH 前设自动恢复，29 条内置菜谱，以及添加机器的设置页。

description.en: During Beijing working-day peak hours (default 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00) it blocks official DeepSeek requests or reroutes them to a configured target provider; off-peak traffic flows to official as usual.
description.zh: 北京时间工作日高峰时段拦截发往官方 provider 的请求，默认 09:00-12:00、14:00-18:00，可切到配置的中转目标或直接阻止并提示，非高峰正常走官方。

description.en: Honest merge of two community plugins into one calmer display: the streaming reading view from dsh-better-display (fork) and the message rail from dsh-tidychat. For theme lovers it wraps reasoning prose and tool-call output in translucent message bubbles, so text no longer sits directly on busy wallpapers or skins where it is hard to read. Cross-version rc adaptation attempted across DSH 0.1.0-0.2.0 (all rc); no obvious problems so far.
description.zh: 诚实说明：将两个社区插件合并为一个更安静的显示层——流式阅读视图来自 dsh-better-display（fork），消息轨道来自 dsh-tidychat。为主题爱好者把思考正文与工具调用输出包裹进半透明消息泡泡框，避免文字直接铺在复杂壁纸或皮肤上难以分辨。已在 DSH 0.1.0-0.2.0 各 rc 版本间尝试跨版本适配，目前无明显问题。

description.en: Vision for text-only DeepSeek via Doubao Web by default (zero-cost, no API key — drives your logged-in Chrome through a Windows CDP bridge), with Antigravity IDE quota (flash/pro) or Gemini fallback; auto detail escalation, vision evidence memory with compaction rehydration, content-hash cache, and a bilingual client panel.
description.zh: 纯文本 DeepSeek 的识图插件：默认走豆包 Web（零成本、免 API key，经 Windows CDP 桥接驱动已登录 Chrome），另有反重力额度（flash/pro）与 Gemini 降级通道；档位自动升级、视觉证据记忆与会话压缩恢复、内容哈希缓存、双语客户端面板。

description.en: Lets text-only models handle pasted chat images, with a native vision experience, batch image viewing, and a built-in OpenAI-compatible analyze_image tool; vision-capable models are unaffected.
description.zh: 让纯文本模型也能处理聊天贴图，提供原生视觉体验，支持批量看图，走内置 OpenAI 兼容识图工具 analyze_image；具备视觉能力的模型不受影响。

description.en: Synchronizes the model catalog of API-key providers from the provider itself instead of maintaining the model list by hand.
description.zh: 自动从服务商同步 API Key 提供方的模型列表，无需手动维护。

description.en: Runs the agent's shell and file tools in disposable Podman containers, so its access is constrained to the workspace project by default, and adds container, image, volume and secret management with approval-gated control.
description.zh: 让 agent 的 shell 与文件工具在一次性 Podman 容器中运行，默认只能访问工作区项目；同时提供容器、镜像、卷与机密管理，部分操作需审批。

description.en: Terminal coding agent for DeepSeek Harness with a full-screen alternate-screen UI, turn-aware session navigation, and a gated /ship workflow that takes one-line requirements through specification, TDD, and rerun acceptance checks.
description.zh: 基于 DeepSeek Harness 的终端编码 Agent，提供全屏备用屏幕 UI、轮次感知的会话导航，以及将一句话需求经过规格、TDD 和验收复跑的分阶段 /ship 流程。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-codsh-bundle
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for codsh#codsh-bundle

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Network proxy settings page for DeepSeek Harness: set a global HTTP(S) proxy with bypass hosts, or give each LLM provider its own proxy or a direct connection; changes apply on save without a restart.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网络代理设置页：配置全局 HTTP(S) 代理及免代理主机，或为单个 LLM 提供商单独指定代理或直连；保存即生效，无需重启。

description.en: Model-autonomous context compaction for DeepSeek Harness: a mind_map tool surveys the agent context surface (stable seq ids, roles, token weights, clear-boundary markers, the clear-mind playbook), a clear_mind tool replaces a chosen conversation-history span with a model-written checkpoint through the native compaction transaction, call and result pairs self-collapse into one-line tombstones, and a proactive reminder nudges the model when the context grows long or a turn runs too many steps.
description.zh: 让模型自主压缩自身上下文的 dsh 插件：mind_map 工具俯瞰模型自己的上下文表面（稳定 seq、角色、token 重量、清理边界标记，返回内附清理手册），clear_mind 工具把选定的对话历史区间替换成模型自写的检查点（走平台原生 compaction 事务，GUI 渲染可展开的压缩行），调用对自动折叠成单行墓碑，上下文过长或单轮步数过多时主动提醒模型清理；人类侧会话记录保持原样、可审计可回退。

description.en: Codex-style review of session file changes: per-turn cards (optionally taking over the shell edited cards) whose totals are the turn net diff, a review tab with syntax-highlighted diffs that never wrap, real line numbers, open-at-line and a draggable split, a hover preview of the whole file with three lines of context around each change, one-click per-turn revert, and the on-disk record size with a clear button in the review toolbar. Records are sharded per session, with content-addressed snapshot blobs that dedupe and are garbage collected. Light/dark presets follow the DSH theme, typography follows DSH and installed skins (or any font on the machine, with a px stepper), and a settings switch injects a think-in-Simplified-Chinese rule into the global AGENTS.md.
description.zh: Codex 风格的会话文件修改审查：每轮变更卡片（可接管 shell 的 edited 卡片），统计口径为本轮净差异；审查 tab 的 diff 不自动换行、真实行号、按行打开、可拖拽分栏；悬停预览显示整文件差异（每处改动前后 3 行上下文）；按轮一键撤回；工具条显示记录占用并可一键清空。记录按会话分片存储，快照用内容寻址 blob 去重并自动 GC。深浅两套配色跟随 DSH 主题，字体跟随 DSH 与已装皮肤（也可选机器上的任意字体并微调字号）；设置里可把「用简体中文思考」规则注入全局 AGENTS.md。

description.en: Search titles and saved text across ordinary DeepSeek Harness (DSH) conversations in all workspaces, optionally including archived chats, with Ctrl+F / Cmd+F search inside the current conversation.
description.zh: 搜索 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）各工作区普通对话的标题和已保存正文，可包含归档；也可按 Ctrl+F / Cmd+F 查找当前对话。

description.en: TRAE SOLO supplier plugin for dsh-router, ported from traework2api. Provides the traework supplier, a free SOLO chat channel, and reports single-account status to dsh-router core.
description.zh: dsh-router 的 TRAE SOLO 供应商插件，移植自 traework2api。提供 traework 供应商这一免费 SOLO 聊天通道，并向 dsh-router 核心上报单账号状态。

description.en: Wallpaper Engine integration for the dsh web GUI: scan the local WE library (Steam workshop 431960 + local projects) and use its wallpapers as the page background — image/video/web rendered natively, scene wallpapers as softened static previews — with a 壁纸设计 panel (opacity, scope, fill, blur, vignette, fps, parallax, carousel, theme linkage) and agent tools wallpaper_scan/list/set/config.
description.zh: Wallpaper Engine 壁纸联动：把本机下载的 WE 壁纸（创意工坊 431960 + 本地 projects）设为 DSH Web GUI 页面背景（图片/视频/网页原样渲染，场景壁纸柔化为静态预览），侧边栏「壁纸设计」面板可调不透明度、作用范围、填充、模糊、暗角、帧率、视差、轮播与主题联动，附 wallpaper_scan/list/set/config 四个 agent 工具。

description.en: AI-driven drawio: four agent tools (validate, render to SVG/PNG, edit, template) plus a sidebar live board — zero-dependency mxfile-to-SVG preview, embedded diagrams.net editor with save bridge, and auto-open whenever the agent draws.
description.zh: AI 驱动 drawio：四个画图工具（校验 / 渲染 SVG/PNG / 编辑 / 模板）+ 侧栏实时画板——零依赖 mxfile→SVG 预览、内嵌 diagrams.net 官方编辑器、AI 画图时自动弹出跟随。

description.en: ZCode-style persistent project memory with a full settings manager, index-first injection and agent memory tools.
description.zh: ZCode 风格持久化项目记忆：设置内完整管理页、索引式注入与 agent 记忆工具。

description.en: Sidebar weather panel: current conditions, 5-day and 24-hour forecasts, an hourly rain chart, temperature history, CMA alerts with graded reminders and county-level matching, a radar mosaic, FY-4B satellite imagery, typhoon tracks, and ECMWF / NW Pacific sea surface temperature charts.
description.zh: 侧边栏天气面板：当前天气、5 天与 24 小时预报、逐小时降水、历史气温、中央气象台预警（分级提醒、区县级匹配）、雷达拼图、风云四号 B 星卫星云图、台风路径，以及 ECMWF 与西北太平洋海表温度专业图。

description.en: Orchestration-mode preset generator for DSH: a lead agent delegates to four built-in role helpers that carry only their own tools, and the web panel adds or removes custom helpers with their own tools, skills, and models, per workspace — zero changes to the harness source.
description.zh: DSH 编排模式预设生成器：主 agent 指挥，四个内置帮手各只带本行工具；Web 面板按工作区增删帮手，可给自定角色配专属工具、技能与模型——零 DSH 源码改动。

description.en: Display read_image results in DSH Web and Desktop: complete previews, grouped multi-image galleries, transparency checkerboards, keyboard and touch zoom, and session-authorized loading. Verified with DSH Desktop 0.11.1 / Harness 0.2.0-rc.2.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 和桌面版展示 read_image 结果：完整预览、多图画廊、透明棋盘格、键盘与触控缩放，使用会话授权加载。已验证 DSH Desktop 0.11.1 / Harness 0.2.0-rc.2。

description.en: All-in-one DSH extension center in Settings: manage skills, MCP servers and plugins, a Plugin Market (curated + GitHub search, npm one-click install), and an Add-ons block to install, disable, uninstall and update companion features together.
description.zh: 设置页一体化扩展中心：管理技能/MCP/插件，内置插件市场（精选目录+GitHub 搜索、npm 一键安装），并提供附加功能区统一安装/停用/卸载、一起更新附属功能。

description.en: Import claude-code / codex / reasonix / zcode chat history into dsh sessions: workspace binding, tool calls preserved, oversized-session protection, zcode compaction restore.
description.zh: 把 claude-code / codex / reasonix / zcode 的聊天历史导入为 dsh 会话：工作区绑定、工具调用保留、超长会话保护、zcode 压缩还原。

description.en: Unofficial Grok integration for eligible X Subscription, SuperGrok, or X Premium accounts: shared Grok CLI OAuth, chat with optional main-loop web/X search, and experimental image generation, image editing, and video generation (all media features disabled by default).
description.zh: 面向符合资格的 X Subscription、SuperGrok 或 X Premium 账号的非官方 Grok 集成：共用 Grok CLI OAuth 登录，支持对话及可选的主循环网页/X 搜索；实验性的图片生成、图生图编辑和视频生成均默认关闭，需主动开启。

description.en: A persona and memory plugin for DSH Desktop. Distill characters from chats, novels, scripts, or character sheets; keep long-term and temporary memories, learn style corrections and approved replies, detect persona leakage after switching, visualize memories, and import or export persona cards. Task guidance is reduced to one lightweight fixed discipline with no plans, ledgers, or dynamic reminders.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 人设与记忆插件：从聊天记录、小说、剧本或设定文档蒸馏角色；支持长期与临时记忆、风格学习、认可语料、人设切换纠偏、记忆星图和角色卡导入导出。任务侧仅保留轻量工作纪律，不再注入计划、台账或动态提醒。

description.en: Reads animated GIF and WebP as animations: a pasted one keeps playing in the UI while the model gets a labelled sheet of frames sampled across it, and the read_animation tool samples a file on demand.
description.zh: 把 gif 和动图 webp 当作动画来读：贴进聊天框的照常播放，模型收到的是横跨整段采样、带帧号与时长的胶片条；工作区里的文件由 read_animation 按需采样。

description.en: One shared Obsidian vault for every agent: dependency-free Python core (search/promote/adjudicate/forget), vault template, dsh plugin (memory_search/show/submit/status).
description.zh: 多 Agent 共享一个 Obsidian vault：零依赖 Python core（检索/晋升/裁决/遗忘）+ vault 模板 + dsh 插件（memory_search/show/submit/status）。

description.en: Vision-first Mac computer use, for when the accessibility tree is unavailable. Ships 11 desktop_* tools - window list, screenshots, OCR text targeting, numbered elements, coordinate clicks, typing, scrolling, drag - plus a Codex-style cursor overlay with spring animation. Clicks are delivered to the target process, so the real pointer never moves and nothing steals focus. In DSH it shows up as Mac Desktop Control with a settings page that checks the engine and the Screen Recording / Accessibility permissions, with a button that opens the matching System Settings pane. Works out of the box: the tarball bundles the dsh-cu engine and the overlay as prebuilt universal binaries (Apple silicon + Intel, macOS 11+, ad-hoc signed), compiled from the repo's Swift sources by the release workflow - no clone, no Xcode, no install.sh. The only setup is granting DeepSeek Harness Screen Recording and Accessibility once. macOS only; on Windows and Linux the plugin loads without registering the desktop tools.
description.zh: Mac 的视觉优先 computer use：无障碍树不可用时照样能干活。11 个 desktop_* 工具——窗口枚举、截图、OCR 找文字、元素编号、坐标点击、输入、滚动、拖拽，外加 Codex 风格的浮层光标（带弹簧动效）。点击投递给目标进程，不移动真实鼠标、不抢前台。DSH 插件页里显示为「Mac 桌面操作」，设置页会逐项检查命令行引擎和屏幕录制 / 辅助功能权限，缺哪个直接给按钮。装上就能用：安装包自带 dsh-cu 引擎和浮层的通用二进制（Apple 芯片 + Intel，macOS 11 起，本地签名），由发版工作流从仓库里的 Swift 源码编译——不用 clone、不用 Xcode、不用 install.sh。唯一的设置是给 DeepSeek Harness 开一次屏幕录制和辅助功能权限。仅支持 macOS；在 Windows / Linux 上插件照常加载，只是不注册桌面工具。

description.en: One header button stops running turns, goals and background jobs and writes the plan to disk; after a restart the same button picks the work up again.
description.zh: 会话头一个按钮停掉回合、目标和后台任务，写盘；重启后同一个按钮把工作接回来。

description.en: Russian for the dsh web GUI: the whole interface plus the menus of 520 third-party plugins — 584 sections, 67,666 strings.
description.zh: 为 dsh Web 界面提供俄语：整个界面，加上 520 个第三方插件的菜单——584 个分区、67 666 条文案。

description.en: Magpie gateway provider for DSH: syncs gateway models into the picker with visibility control, image input and thinking levels.
description.zh: 把 Magpie 网关的模型接入 DSH 选择器，支持模型显隐管理、图片输入与思考档位。

description.en: Runtime diagnostics for DSH plugins: live, restart, or hot reload.
description.zh: DSH 插件运行时诊断：区分实时生效、重启和热重载。

description.en: Runtime requirement drift guard that keeps long-running DSH agents aligned with the user's approved goal, constraints, and decisions.
description.zh: 运行时需求漂移防护，在长任务执行过程中保持 DSH Agent 与用户确认的目标、约束和决策一致。

description.en: Token usage and estimated spend for the dsh web UI: floating panel with per-model, per-day, and per-session stats.
description.zh: DSH Web 用量与费用统计插件：右下角悬浮窗，按模型/按天/按会话多维聚合与预计花费。

description.en: dsh profile bundle: assembles @morlay/session-branch, @morlay/session-rdb, @morlay/ui-conversation-message-actions, @morlay/ui-conversation-manager and @morlay/dsh-reference into a DeepSeek Harness web profile — the rewind / retry / recall / fork closed l
Real-time 'We need…' and 'Let me…' reasoning-trajectory keyword stats for the DeepSeek Harness web chat.
description.zh: 实时追踪 DeepSeek Harness 网页对话中模型流式推理轨迹关键词统计的 UI 面板。

description.en: Rewind / retry / recall / fork orchestration (host) plus the browser half — replaces the conversation.chat.node user / steering rendering and overrides the conversation.composer.dock stats row.

Six-player no-limit Texas Hold'em for the dsh Web GUI. One human plays against five LLM agents that each see only their own hole cards. Adds a dedicated tab plus a draggable mini-window over the conversation area, per-browser sessions with CSRF protection, pot-relative raise sizing, three rebuys before elimination, and showdown reveals with board-card deal animations.
description.zh: 六人无限注德州扑克：1 名玩家对 5 位只能看到自己底牌的 LLM 智能体。在 Web GUI 中提供独立 Tab 与会话区可拖拽悬浮小窗，支持按浏览器隔离的牌局与 CSRF 防护、按底池倍数给出的加注尺度、每人 3 次买入后出局，以及摊牌亮牌与公共牌翻牌动效。

description.en: Replaces the model button with a Claude Desktop-style model and reasoning-effort switcher, with per-model effort memory, theme-aware styling, smooth slider feel, rounded track, hover highlight, and pixel-dot animation.
description.zh: 将模型按钮替换为Claude Desktop 同款风格的模型与思考力度切换器，支持逐模型记忆力度、主题自适应，滑动手感、圆角轨道、悬停高亮，点阵动画，都是熟悉的味道。

description.en: Wakes the main agent after any DSH restart so interrupted work resumes automatically — adds a restart tool and an optional canary that validates the boot and aborts with an alert before a broken restart.
description.zh: DSH 重启后唤醒主 agent，让被打断的工作自动接着做；提供一个重启工具，以及可选的探针在启动异常时提前中止并告警。

description.en: HTTPS + login gateway for the DeepSeek Harness web surface: access your DSH Web UI securely from another machine on your LAN, or from the internet via port forwarding. Fail-closed defaults (loopback-only, no accounts until configured); setup and security notes in the README.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供 HTTPS + 登录保护的远程访问网关：局域网内其它设备可安全访问，配置端口映射后可从互联网访问。默认 fail-closed（仅本机监听、无内置账号，配置后才能登录），配置与安全说明见 README。

description.en: Models+ settings page for the DSH web UI: per-model reasoning-effort tables, input modalities and compat flags saved through the official settings pipeline, with models.dev metadata prefill and API key management.
description.zh: 模型+ 设置页:按模型声明推理挡位、输入模态与兼容参数(走官方 settings 管线保存),支持 models.dev 元数据预填与 API 密钥管理。

description.en: Per-project scheduled prompts run as fresh headless agent sessions, with one-time, interval, and cron schedules plus durable run history.
description.zh: 按项目调度提示词，在全新的无头 Agent 会话中执行，支持单次、固定间隔和 cron 计划，并持久化运行历史。

description.en: DSH plugin bridging agents to Cheat Engine for dynamic memory debugging: scanning, pointer analysis, breakpoints, and game memory hacking.
description.zh: 让 DSH Agent 通过 Cheat Engine 进行动态内存调试：扫描、指针分析、断点与游戏内存修改。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness ArmorBreak (破甲模式): authorized reverse-engineering & security-research agent preset. 39 offline capabilities, L0–L3 policy engine, evidence-chain reports. MIT.
description.zh: 给 AI 代理加装「破甲」模式，在授权范围内做逆向工程、静态分析和取证，并自动生成证据链报告。

description.en: DSH自己的便签、画布、日程表 Paper-style sticky notes, notes, calendar and drawing panel for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
description.zh: 在 DSH 里贴便签、画草图、排日程，把零散的今天整理成一张纸。

description.en: DSH 微信小程序远程控制插件：微信 openid 一对一身份绑定，官方插件规范一键安装
description.zh: 装个插件，就能在微信小程序里远程查看和操作电脑上的 DSH，随时发任务、批审批、收文件。

description.en: Animated desktop companion, task notifications, and session chat for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 桌面养条大肥鱼陪你干活，任务提醒、消息回复直接送到桌边，双击还能接着聊。

description.en: Native iPhone companion plugin for DeepSeek Harness — sessions, approvals, questions, notifications, and secure remote access.
description.zh: iPhone 原生伴侣插件，让你在手机上随时查看会话、处理审批、接收通知，还能安全远程访问 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Discovery + management wrappers around gh CLI for AI coding agents. find_repos, multi-axis explore, trending, repo summary, code search, issue/PR search, org audits.
description.zh: 为 AI 编程助手封装 gh 命令行，轻松实现仓库发现、趋势、代码搜索、Issue/PR 查询与组织审计。

description.en: DSH WebUI 文件输入增强：Ctrl+V 粘贴（带首次告知弹窗）+ 拖拽 + 选择文件，发送时复制进会话工作区临时目录
description.zh: DSH WebUI 文件输入增强：Ctrl+V 粘贴（带首次告知弹窗）+ 拖拽 + 选择文件，发送时复制进会话工作区临时目录

description.en: The official bundle plugin package of DSH (DeepSeek Harness) from RedFoxHub（红狐数据）: Over 100 social media data skills (Douyin / Xiaohongshu / Kuaishou / Bilibili / Official Accounts / Video Accounts / Weibo / YouTube / TikTok, etc.), installed in the native DSH skill format with just one click.
description.zh: RedFoxHub 官方 DSH 插件包，集成 100+ 社交媒体数据技能，覆盖抖音、小红书、快手、B站、公众号、视频号、微博等平台。

description.en: Multi-provider AI balance, quota, and token usage for the dsh sidebar, with a daily heatmap.
description.zh: DeepSeek 账户余额、剩余比例条与今日花费，显示在 dsh 侧边栏底部 · DeepSeek balance, remaining-ratio bar and today's spend in the dsh sidebar footer.

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for TypeSafe Jev: typed decisions, configurable guardrails, and Web UI result cards.
description.zh: 让 DSH 智能体用 TypeSafe Jev 做类型化决策，带可配置护栏和 Web UI 结果卡片。

description.en: Compact ASCII / terminal skin for DeepSeek Harness: 19 palettes with a picker in the status line, 3 UI densities, a vim-style status line, ascii.rest art on empty sessions and a retro boot intro with custom logo text.
description.zh: 紧凑的 ASCII / 终端风格皮肤：19 套配色（可在状态栏切换）、3 档界面密度、vim 风格状态栏、空会话中的 ascii.rest 字符画，以及可自定义 Logo 文字的复古开机动画。

description.en: 在对话页面直接查看消耗费用（嵌入官方底部状态条，点击看明细）；设置中汇总用量与费用，并可自定义其他模型单价
description.zh: 在对话页面直接查看消耗费用（嵌入官方底部状态条，点击看明细）；在设置中查看 Harness 消耗的总费用、缓存命中和输入输出

description.en: 万物皆是插件，万物皆可自定义——基于DeepSeek Harness的安全测试工作台，提示词、工具、MCP、技能、知识库、WebShell均可模块化编排，覆盖渗透测试与代码审计。
基于 MinerU 的 DeepSeek Harness 多模态文档解析插件：PDF/Word/PPT/Excel/HTML/图片 → 结构化 Markdown（免 Token 的 Agent 轻量解析 / 精准解析双 API 模式）
description.zh: 基于 MinerU 的多模态文档解析插件，可将 PDF、Word、PPT、图片等转为结构化 Markdown，支持轻量和精准双模式，省 Token 又高效。

description.en: 为 DSH 默认沙箱增加可配置的「沙箱授权目录」，允许工作区外的受信修改。
description.zh: 给 DSH 沙箱加个受信目录白名单，让代理能直接改工作区外的文件，不用反复授权。

description.en: 唯一主打安全，提倡先审查再安装的 DSH 市场 (review-before-install DSH marketplace)
description.zh: 主打安全的 DSH 插件市场，先深度扫描审查再安装，搜插件、装插件都放心。

description.en: A small self-contained power control for DSH: sidebar power button with an upward restart/shutdown menu and a Windows-shutdown-style overlay. Own restart & shutdown engine (no dependency on other plugins), dynamic-port aware.
description.zh: 一个小而自洽的 DSH 电源控制插件：侧边栏电源按钮 + 上拉「重启/关机」菜单 + Windows 关机风格过渡遮罩。自带重启/关机引擎（不依赖其它插件），动态端口适配。

description.en: Independent Shadow agent orchestration plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在合适的工具调用后自动启动后台影子智能体，独立验证结果并生成结构化发现，提升多智能体协作效率。

description.en: Claude-Code-Styled TUI for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在终端里用 Claude Code 风格界面操作 DeepSeek Harness，让命令行工作流更顺手。

description.en: Server card dashboard for DSH: per-host status, CPU, memory, disk and latency, with one-click xterm.js SSH terminals; imports ~/.ssh/config and mounts as a better-sidebar tab or a standalone right drawer.
description.zh: DSH 服务器卡片仪表盘：每台主机展示在线状态、CPU、内存、磁盘与延迟，点卡片进入 xterm.js SSH 终端；支持导入 ~/.ssh/config，挂载为 better-sidebar 页签或独立右侧抽屉。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness - 液态玻璃与动态壁纸主题 (WebGL 物理透镜、动态壁纸与多层毛玻璃) #dsh-plugin
DeepSeek Harness - 液态玻璃与动态壁纸主题 (WebGL 物理透镜、动态壁纸与多层毛玻璃) #dsh-plugin
description.zh: 给 DSH 换上液态玻璃主题，带 WebGL 折射水波和自定义图片视频壁纸，网页版和桌面版都能用。

description.en: Imports local coding-agent session histories so work can continue in DSH.
description.zh: 导入本地编程 Agent 的会话历史，在 DSH 中继续工作。

description.en: Switch between DeepSeek web chat and workspaces in DeepSeek Harness. Web history sidebar and one-click conversation import. / 网页聊天、历史侧栏与工作区一键导入。
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek 网页聊天和工作区之间自由切换，带历史侧栏，还能一键把对话导入工作区。

description.en: ♾️ Copy and export the LaTeX in DeepSeek Harness 悬停任意 LaTeX 公式即可复制 TeX 源码或导出为独立的 SVG 文件
description.zh: 悬停任意 LaTeX 公式，就能复制 TeX 源码或导出成独立 SVG 文件

description.en: Intelligent token optimization via Jev System One triage, dynamic tool pruning, and subagent routing.
description.zh: 基于 Jev System One 分流、动态工具裁剪与子代理路由的智能 Token 优化插件。

description.en: AI-assisted Godot game creation for DeepSeek Harness: build scenes, edit scripts, run games, and verify results.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里用 Godot Creator 模式做游戏：搭场景、改脚本、跑起来还能验证结果。

description.en: A Command Code LLM provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — supporting all subscription plans (incl. Go & Pro) via Studio API / gateway.专为 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 打造的 Command Code LLM 接入插件，全面支持包括 Go/Pro 在内的各类订阅方案。
Monitors session state in the DSH web app and sends desktop, browser, and third-party notifications for interactions, completions, and errors.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 端监控会话状态，为需要交互、任务完成、任务出错发送桌面 / 浏览器 / 第三方通知。

description.en: Usage and cost statistics with peak/off-peak pricing after the 2026-08-17 rate change, a floating summary panel, per-session breakdowns, and a day/week/month/year/all usage heatmap.
description.zh: 用量与消费统计：8/17 调价前后峰谷计费，主界面汇总面板、按会话明细与日/周/月/年/累计用量热力图。

description.en: Left-edge user-Turn navigation rail with reading-position highlighting, hover previews of per-turn metrics and model-answer excerpts, keyboard and click-to-jump controls, and local conversation search.
description.zh: 左侧用户轮次导航轨道：随阅读位置高亮，悬停预览单轮指标与模型回答摘要，支持键盘和点击跳转及本地会话搜索。

description.en: Migrate Codex CLI conversations / MCP servers / memories into DeepSeek Harness ｜ 把 Codex CLI 的对话、MCP、记忆迁移到 DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把 Codex CLI 的对话记录、MCP 服务器和记忆一键迁移到 DeepSeek Harness，无缝切换开发环境。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件热管理器：装一次、重启一次，之后装插件、卸插件、升级插件全部即时生效，不用再重启。 | A plugin that makes installing, removing and upgrading DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugins take effect instantly — restart once, then never again.
description.zh: 装上后只需重启一次，之后安装、卸载、升级插件都能即时生效，不用再反复重启。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 极简回复插件，提供六档精简模式与 CyberUI 主题，可节省 60–75% 输出 Token｜A DSH plugin with six brevity modes and a CyberUI theme.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上极简回复模式，六档精简随手切换，砍掉废话省下 60-75% 输出 Token。

description.en: DeepSeek 娘 (whale maid) in-page mascot plugin for DeepSeek Harness web UI
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面里养一只鲸鱼娘吉祥物，让页面更可爱更有陪伴感。

description.en: SummerSec 个人自定义Skill仓库
description.zh: 个人 Agent Skills 集合，按类别管理，方便快速调用各类技能。

description.en: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 插件全家桶整合包：11 个自装插件合并为单一插件（主题/用量/搜索/桌宠/子代理进度/会话增强），功能与设置完全保留。
DSH 自装插件整合包：把 11 个自装插件合并成单一安装项。内含终末地工业编辑部风主题（等高线背景、ENDFIELD 水印、玻璃/纯色侧边栏表面）、用量悬浮球与日/月/年热力图、右侧重栏（文件树/编辑器/终端/Git）、多引擎搜索、3D 虎鲸桌宠、子代理进度、悬浮侧边栏、提示词优化浮窗、UA 中继反代。所有功能与设置原样保留。不需要整套也没关系，每个模块都支持单独安装。
description.zh: 把十几个自装插件打包成一个，主题、桌宠、用量统计、搜索等都能按需勾选安装。

description.en: Git worktree panel for DSH Web: replaces the workspace sidebar with project → main/linked worktree → session groups, creates and removes worktrees, switches the main branch, and migrates configurable project-local or global storage with dirty-tree and active-session safeguards.
description.zh: DSH Web 的 Git worktree 面板：将工作区侧栏替换为项目 → 主/关联 worktree → 会话分组，支持创建和删除 worktree、切换主分支，并在脏工作树与活跃会话保护下迁移可配置的项目内或全局存储位置。

description.en: 将 DeepSeek Harness 桥接到已配置其它 Harness Agent 的项目。支持 CodeBuddy / Codex / OpenCode / Claude Code / ...
description.zh: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that bridges projects configured for other coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, opencode, CodeBuddy Code, pi, Gemini CLI, Cursor) into DeepSeek Harness

description.en: Split panes.
description.zh: 把对话信息流拆成多个独立窗格，每个窗格绑定自己的会话，可四向拖拽分屏，多任务并行不打架。

description.en: 一个DeepSeek Harness的公众号运营插件，DeepSeek Harness community plugin for AI-assisted WeChat article writing, review, image workflows, knowledge bases, and publishing.
description.zh: 在对话里从选题到排版配图，一键写完公众号文章并直接存进微信草稿箱。

description.en: On-demand second opinions through ask_advisor, with editable requests, per-call human approval, and text advice from a model configured in DSH.
description.zh: 通过 ask_advisor 按需求助顾问，支持编辑请求与逐次人工批准，由 DSH 中配置的模型返回文字建议。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness原生中文文本人工智能痕迹消除与多重审核对抗工作流
description.zh: 给中文小说和文章去AI味，让文字更自然，还能应对各种AI检测。

description.en: VS Code-style file manager: browse the conversation workspace in a sidebar tree and edit files in the center column with Monaco, with theme import/export and Markdown preview.
description.zh: VS Code 风格文件管理器：侧边栏文件树浏览当前对话工作区，中间列用 Monaco 编辑文件，支持主题导入导出与 Markdown 预览。

description.en: Model high-availability failover (quarantine, circuit breaking, probe recovery) plus subagent orchestration (fanout/pipeline/supervisor) with a bilingual settings UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek 模型提供高可用故障切换与子代理编排，支持熔断、隔离、自动恢复，并带双语设置界面。

description.en: Pops up a mini-game menu (wordle, match-3, extensible) while the model generates.
description.zh: 模型生成时弹出小游戏菜单（wordle/消消乐，可扩展）。

description.en: Xueqiu (Snowball) market panel docked above the composer: A-share/HK/US quotes and indices, watchlist, candlestick K-line with volume, MAs and crosshair tooltip, hot list, search, 7x24 news, plus a draggable mini index badge — no login needed.
description.zh: 雪球行情面板：嵌入输入框上方，免登录查看 A股/港美股行情、指数与自选股，K线蜡烛图（成交量/均线/十字光标）、热榜、搜索、7×24 快讯，另有可拖动迷你指数徽章。

description.en: dsh-conv-export（对话导出）— export the current DeepSeek Harness conversation as Markdown, PDF, or a long PNG image
description.zh: 一键把当前 DeepSeek Harness 对话导出为 Markdown、PDF 或长图，方便分享和存档。

description.en: DSH 里的皮肤市场：在设置里搜索并一键安装 dsh.a2hmarket.ai 上的社区皮肤
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置里直接搜索并一键安装社区皮肤，换肤不用再碰终端。

description.en: Agent worktime dashboard: floating day/week/month stats, multi-dimension heatmap, thread attendance Gantt, school-year calendar, and a 12-realm xianxia score system for agent activity.
description.zh: 把 Agent 的工时统计做成修仙看板，日周月悬浮数据、热力图、甘特图和学年日历一眼看清。

description.en: 🐂🐴 牛马修仙看板：DeepSeek Harness 工时统计 × 修仙养成——把每一分钟劳动，都修成境界（日/周/月 + 学年年历，炼气→宇宙洪荒）

Switch the language of the agent's thinking/reasoning process (chain-of-thought): 简体中文, English, Русский, Français, Deutsch, Español, 日本語, 한국어 and more, or auto-follow the system locale. Adds a Settings → General row, a system-prompt instruction (per-prompt assembly, applies to new sessions), and the /thinking-language command.
description.zh: 切换智能体思考过程（推理/链式思考）的语言：支持简体中文、英文、俄语、法语、德语、西班牙语、日语、韩语等，或跟随系统界面语言（自动）。新增「设置 → 通用」中的思考语言选择行、系统提示词注入（每次组装提示词时求值，新会话生效）与 /thinking-language 命令。

description.en: Interactive whale-girl desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: live balance/usage/context occupancy, slingshot toss, easter-egg bubbles, eco mode. 346KB package, zero extra processes.
description.zh: 会卖萌、会记账、会弹跳的鲸鱼娘桌宠：实时余额/用量/上下文占用、中键弹弓抛掷、彩蛋气泡、省电模式；安装包 346KB，零新进程。

description.en: deepseek harness plugin for medical image analysis
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek 直接看懂医学影像，自动分析病灶并生成报告，辅助医生快速诊断。

description.en: Windows-only Computer Use plugin for DeepSeek Harness with UIA, cua-driver, and optional GLM vision.
description.zh: 适用于 Windows 的 DeepSeek Harness Computer Use 插件，支持 UIA、cua-driver 和可选 GLM 视觉。

description.en: Modular AI research/engineering skill pack, installable via dsh plugin add — registers 27 skills (security audit, paper reading/writing, figure drawing, dev workflow, storage analysis) on ctx.skills.
description.zh: 模块化 AI 科研/工程技能包，dsh plugin add 一键安装——在 ctx.skills 注册 27 个技能（安全审计、论文读写、绘图、开发工作流、存储分析）。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）Skills 管理 + SkillHub 商城插件：侧边栏面板管理本地 skills（用户级/工作区项目级/内置只读），搜索并一键安装 SkillHub 公开技能，附模型工具 dsh_skillhub_search。
description.zh: 在侧边栏管理本地技能，搜索并一键安装 SkillHub 公开技能，提升工作流效率。

description.en: AI Company Framework: turn one sentence into a multi-agent company — 15 flat Skills (boss/pipeline/role-template/11 roles/generic customer-memory), 7 workflow templates, AgentTeams runtime + activity panel, employee sidebar with per-session isolation, Feishu bot bridge (boss and per-employee bots, group routing, autonomous push, human decision gate, external-contact guide), per-customer SQLite memory with three-layer memory (cross-group merge), /company mode switch; no RAG.
description.zh: AI 公司框架：一句话开一家多 Agent 公司——15 个扁平 Skills（老板/流水线/岗位模板/11 个岗位/通用客户记忆）、7 个工作流模板、AgentTeams 运行时与活动面板、带会话隔离的员工侧边栏、飞书机器人桥（老板/任意员工机器人、群聊路由、自主推送、重大决策人工闸门、外部联系人指引）、客户档案 SQLite 数据库与三层记忆（跨群归并）、/company 公司模式开关；不含 RAG。

description.en: Lark/飞书（Feishu）渠道插件，为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 提供飞书通信能力
A browser pixel-art and sprite animation editor with Aseprite-compatible files, local crop/outline blueprints, and optional LLM workflow nodes.
description.zh: 浏览器像素画与精灵动画编辑器，支持兼容 Aseprite 的文件、本地裁剪/描边蓝图和可选的 LLM 工作流节点。

description.en: Connect a ChatGPT account to Codex models in DeepSeek Harness through browser PKCE or device-code OAuth, with automatic token refresh and Web or headless login.
description.zh: 通过浏览器 PKCE 或设备码 OAuth 将 ChatGPT 账户接入 DeepSeek Harness 的 Codex 模型，并支持自动刷新令牌以及 Web 或无头登录。

description.en: 雪球 mini 行情面板 — DeepSeek Harness 免登录 A股/港美股实时行情、K线、分时、热榜、7x24快讯。可拖拽悬浮面板，交易时段智能刷新。
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Persistent conversation outline: per-turn questions and final replies, keyword filter, one-click jump, light/full history modes, and Ctrl/Shift+click to open the same position in the Trajectory view.
description.zh: 对话栏左侧常驻大纲：按轮次列出提问与最后回复，关键词过滤与一键跳转，轻便/全面两种历史模式，按住 Ctrl/Shift 单击可跳到轨迹视图同一位置。

description.en: A-share stock analysis and screening skill: real-time quotes, technical timing scores, buy/sell signals and a managed watchlist.
description.zh: A股智能选股技能：实时行情、技术面择时分、买卖信号与动态股票池。

description.en: DSH global Chinese-mode toggle: a 中 switch in the input box; when on, a Simplified-Chinese requirement is injected into every session system prompt.
description.zh: 在输入框加个「中」字开关，一键给所有会话注入简体中文要求，全局生效。

description.en: VS Code-style file manager: browse the conversation workspace in a sidebar tree and edit files in the center column with Monaco, with theme import/export and Markdown preview.
description.zh: VS Code 风格文件管理器：侧边栏文件树浏览当前对话工作区，中间列用 Monaco 编辑文件，支持主题导入导出与 Markdown 预览。

description.en: Stock market skin + real-time ticker plugin for DSH Web GUI: candlestick (K-line) popup with day/week/month periods, watchlist with pinyin fuzzy search, portfolio P&L tracker, trading session indicators, support for A-share/HK/US/crypto/forex.
description.zh: 股市行情皮肤与功能插件：全局交易终端皮肤 + 跑马灯 + 个股 K 线弹窗（日K/周K/月K 切换）、自选拼音首字母模糊搜索、持仓盈亏管理、交易时段指示，支持 A股 / 港股 / 美股 / 加密货币 / 外汇。

description.en: 诸天万界DSH: one DSH session is one book; a cover-card picker opens 19 realms, a prose-only preset locks the model to fiction, keyword worldbook lore grounds each turn, and /export-story typesets the session into a Markdown novel.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 变成万界文字冒险引擎，一个会话一本书，点封面进 19 个世界，纯小说模式加世界书设定，还能一键导出故事。

description.en: Bridge DSH agent sessions, tool calls, and approvals to the CodeIsland macOS notch panel over a Unix socket, with in-panel allow/deny.
description.zh: 通过 Unix socket 把 DSH agent 的会话、工具调用与审批实时桥接到 CodeIsland macOS 刘海面板，可直接在面板上批准/拒绝。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 小游戏制作插件 — 帮助 AI 快速创建 HTML5 小游戏，支持 Canvas、Phaser.js、Three.js 等引擎
description.zh: 帮 AI 快速做出 HTML5 小游戏，内置 Canvas、Phaser.js、Three.js 等常用引擎。

description.en: Font engine for the Web GUI: system font enumeration, global and per-component font-size tuning with a Spy++-style picker, settings page.
description.zh: 网页界面字体引擎：系统字体枚举、准星点选的全局与逐组件字号微调、设置页。老花眼友好，自定义字体和页面部件字体和字体大小，支持SPY模式扫UI和其他插件。

description.en: Animated Claude-style reasoning-effort slider and model picker that replaces the native DSH model selector.
description.zh: Claude 风格动画推理等级滑块与模型选择器，替换原生模型选择器。

description.en: Codex-style drag-drop: drag any file into the DSH web GUI, it lands in ~/.dsh-dropbox, and the path is inserted into the composer as a whole blue chip.
description.zh: Codex 式拖拽：把任意文件拖入 DSH Web 界面，文件存入 ~/.dsh-dropbox，路径以整块蓝色 chip 插入输入框。

description.en: Ollama Cloud native chat adapter: direct NDJSON translation of the Ollama /api/chat wire format, model discovery with context windows and capabilities, and web search/fetch providers under the ollama-cloud id, plus a Web settings card.
description.zh: Ollama Cloud 原生聊天适配器：直连 NDJSON 翻译 Ollama /api/chat 协议，模型发现带上下文窗口与能力信息，并注册 web 搜索/抓取 provider，附 Web 设置卡片。

description.en: Layered plugin manager for DSH web: native plugins grouped read-only by system/WebUI/tools, user extensions with enable/disable, register, uninstall and editable descriptions.
description.zh: DSH 分层插件管理器：原生插件按系统/WebUI/工具三层只读展示，用户扩展支持停用/启用、补登记、卸载与可编辑描述。

description.en: A small self-contained power control for DSH: sidebar power button with an upward restart/shutdown menu and a Windows-shutdown-style overlay. Own restart & shutdown engine (no dependency on other plugins), dynamic-port aware.
description.zh: 一个小而自洽的 DSH 电源控制插件：侧边栏电源按钮 + 上拉「重启/关机」菜单 + Windows 关机风格过渡遮罩。自带重启/关机引擎（不依赖其它插件），动态端口适配。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（dsh）动态 Cordis 插件：模型高可用回退 + 子智能体编排（HA failover + orchestrate subagents）
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness（dsh）动态 Cordis 插件：模型高可用回退 + 子智能体编排（HA failover + orchestrate subagents）

description.en: HUD status panel: Git status, MCP servers, skills, model and token usage in a floating side panel.
description.zh: HUD 状态面板：Git 状态、MCP 服务器、技能列表、模型与 token 用量，悬浮侧栏一览无余。

description.en: Right-edge user-message navigator with an adaptive block layout that fits the available height, plus hover previews, keyboard controls, and click-to-jump navigation.
description.zh: 右侧用户消息导航条，根据消息数量与可用高度自适应排布导航块，并支持悬停预览、键盘操作与点击跳转。

description.en: OAuth 2.1 Streamable HTTP MCP client plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 面向 Streamable HTTP 服务的 OAuth 2.1 MCP 客户端：在设置页添加连接，通过浏览器登录（PKCE + 动态客户端注册），其工具随即注册进 DSH；令牌存于凭据服务，连接写入 profile。

description.en: Let dsh and Claude Code sessions message each other directly; comes with a clickable peer list card (sort/search/send/refresh).
description.zh: 让 dsh 和 Claude Code 会话直接互发消息，附带可点击的会话列表卡片（搜索/刷新/弹窗发送）。

description.en: Bridge Claude Code memory, skills, and config into DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: dsh-plugin-claude-bridge — DSH 插件（会话）

description.en: DSH Director Toolkit is a DeepSeek Harness plugin for 3D artists, technical designers, and creative coders. Paste a half-formed idea, a ref…
description.zh: dsh-director-toolkit — DSH 插件（工具）

description.en: 把你的任何想法，变成每个平台原生的宣发内容 | Turn any idea into platform-native publicity
description.zh: 把你的任何想法，变成每个平台原生的宣发内容 | Turn any idea into platform-native publicity

description.en: Frame-level scan diagnostics for session files (torn/corrupt/empty detection).
description.zh: 会话文件帧级扫描诊断（torn/损坏/空会话检测）。

description.en: Background task status bar: progress plus live output tail on the chat page.
description.zh: 后台任务状态条：对话页任务进度 + 实时输出 tail。

description.en: Safe math expression evaluator, zero-dependency recursive-descent parser.
description.zh: 安全的数学表达式求值器，零依赖递归下降解析器。

description.en: Evidence-first self-evolution controller: bounded Cordis candidate generation, one-shot real-Loader admission, Harbor evaluation, and a crash-resumable journaled lineage.
description.zh: 证据优先的自进化控制器：有界生成 Cordis 候选插件，一次性真实 Loader 准入，Harbor 评测，可崩溃恢复的日志化谱系。

description.en: Bottom-right quota pill and panel aggregating membership quotas across AI platforms (Kimi Code, DeepSeek, Zhipu Coding Plan, BigModel, Qwen, Scnet, TokenRouter, SupaWriter), auto-syncing API keys from the DSH credentials domain with colored usage bars.
description.zh: 右下角「会员额度」悬浮球与面板，聚合各 AI 平台套餐额度（Kimi Code、DeepSeek、智谱 Coding Plan、BigModel、通义千问、超算、TokenRouter、SupaWriter），API key 自动同步自 DSH 凭证域，彩色进度条展示用量。

description.en: Windows desktop launcher for DSH with a whale-girl icon, background server startup, and a Chromium app-mode window without browser chrome.
description.zh: DSH 的 Windows 桌面启动器，提供鲸鱼娘图标、后台服务启动和无浏览器工具栏的 Chromium 应用窗口。

description.en: Visible Electron browser for DSH with one shared BrowserWindow, isolated task views, explicit human-Agent handoff, snapshot-reference and native navigation tools, operation trails, demand-driven page thumbnails, keyed session recovery for reliable tab switching and closing, and site-scoped cookie clearing for login maintenance.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的可见 Electron 浏览器：共享一个 BrowserWindow，提供隔离任务视图、显式人机交接、快照引用与原生导航工具、操作轨迹、按需页面缩略图、可靠标签页切换与关闭的 keyed session 恢复，以及按站点清理 Cookie 的登录态维护能力。

description.en: Scroll-painting message rail for DeepSeek Harness: a slim right-edge rail with one indicator per user message, scroll-spy follows the reading position, hover unfolds a canvas with full message previews, and clicking jumps to any history message; animates in sync with better-sidebar panels.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 画卷式消息导航栏：会话面板右侧一条竖排导轨，每条用户消息一个指示点，scroll-spy 跟随阅读位置，hover 展开画卷查看完整消息预览，点击跳转任意历史消息；与 better-sidebar 面板动画同步避让。

description.en: MCP & Skill manager: enable/disable MCP servers and skills from a Settings panel to free context in real time; optional AI middle layer (mcp_search/mcp_call) calls disabled servers on demand, with state-based visibility filtering that keeps user-enabled servers visible.
description.zh: MCP 与技能管理面板：设置页面板实时启停 MCP 服务器与 Skill 释放上下文占用；可选 AI 中间层（mcp_search/mcp_call）按需调用停用服务器，按 server 状态过滤模型可见性（用户打开的保持可见）。

description.en: Enhanced ACP server for DeepSeek Harness: block & reasoning streaming, usage telemetry, model/effort switching, permission presets, session resume/archive, per-session MCP servers, and Zed file/terminal forwarding.
description.zh: 增强版 ACP 服务器：块级与推理流式、用量遥测、模型/推理强度切换、权限预设、会话恢复/归档、每会话 MCP servers、Zed 文件/终端转发。

description.en: Real-time DeepSeek account balance badge in the sidebar footer with odometer roll animation, multi-currency support, balance trend chart, per-key usage statistics with historical backfill, and GitHub version auto-check.
description.zh: 侧边栏底部实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额徽章：数字滚轮动画、多币种支持、余额趋势图、按 Key 用量统计（含安装前历史回填），并支持 GitHub 版本自动检查。

description.en: Turns coding into an RPG: finished turns, tool calls and completed todos earn XP, with 27+ achievement badges, levels, titles and seasons. Event-driven scoring with a pure-function engine — the work itself is the game.
description.zh: 把开发变成 RPG：回合/工具/todo 积累 XP、27+ 成就徽章、等级与赛季。事件流驱动、纯函数计分——你的工作就是游戏。

description.en: Codex-style window capture for DSH Desktop on macOS and Windows: press both Command keys (macOS) or both Ctrl keys (Windows), or the camera button, to grab the frontmost window, attach it to the current chat, and inject a VoiceOver-style accessibility tree as hidden context.
description.zh: 给 DSH Desktop 用的窗口截图，支持 macOS 和 Windows：macOS 按两边 Command、Windows 按两边 Ctrl（或点输入框旁相机）捕获当前前台窗口并附加到会话，同时把 VoiceOver 风格的辅助功能树注入为隐藏上下文。

description.en: Solarized theme plugin: the classic low-contrast, eye-friendly dual palette system — Ethan Schoonover's Solarized plus Selenized (its refined take), dark and light each, built for long sessions with canonical syntax colors.
description.zh: Solarized 主题插件：经典低对比护眼配色双体系——Ethan Schoonover 的 Solarized 与 Selenized（改良版）深浅各一套，专为长时间使用设计，遵循经典语法色。

description.en: Overleaf-style LaTeX paper workbench: annotate any text in the rendered PDF and let a dsh agent revise the sources with compile checks and git history.
description.zh: Overleaf 式 LaTeX 论文工作台：在渲染后的 PDF 上选中任意文字批注，由 dsh agent 改写源文件、编译验证并提交 git 修订。

description.en: Runs open-mcp-apps inside DSH: every MCP app gets its own sidebar container with a separate workspace, session, and App mode, an agent status strip under the app, and inline app rendering in ordinary chats.
description.zh: 把 open-mcp-apps 接进 DSH：每个 MCP app 都是侧边栏里自己的容器，带独立 workspace、会话与 App mode，应用下方是 agent 状态条，普通聊天里也能行内渲染 app。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：在对话中搜索、安装和管理 SkillHub 技能

Remote development launcher for DeepSeek Harness: provisions dsh on a remote host via SSH (or a local WSL distro) and connects from the local client, with LLM credentials proxied through a reverse tunnel so they never leave the local machine. Ships as both a standalone CLI and a dsh plugin with a session panel, /remote-explorer slash command and remote_* agent tools.
description.zh: 远程开发启动器：通过 SSH（或本机 WSL 发行版）在远端引导安装 dsh，从本地客户端连接，LLM 凭据经反向隧道代理、不离开本机。同时提供独立 CLI 与 dsh 插件双形态，插件含远程会话面板、/remote-explorer 命令及 remote_* agent 工具。

description.en: Conversational Grafana operations: inspect live dashboard data across named sources, then make safe, reviewable dashboard changes with approval and version checks.
description.zh: 对话式 Grafana 运维：跨多个命名源站查看实时大盘数据，再通过审批与版本校验安全、可审阅地修改大盘。

description.en: Edit the host-wide global instructions (~/.dsh/AGENTS.md) from a dedicated Customize page in Settings - every session on this machine applies them.
description.zh: 在设置页的「个性化」页编辑此主机全局指令（~/.dsh/AGENTS.md），此机器上的所有会话都会应用。

description.en: Embedded MCP server letting external agents (Hermes, Claude Code, etc.) drive DeepSeek Harness over StreamableHTTP: sync/async task execution, a three-tier file sandbox, a Web-backed approval bridge, session management and search, and path-jailed file tools.
description.zh: 内嵌 MCP server，让外部 Agent（Hermes、Claude Code 等）通过 StreamableHTTP 驱动 DeepSeek Harness：同步/异步任务执行、三档文件沙箱、Web 审批桥、会话管理与搜索、路径隔离的文件工具。

description.en: Windows desktop notifications for DSH that speak the turn result by default: Windows TTS needs no download, and 13 VOICEVOX voice packs can be installed from the settings page. A completed alert waits until running subagents and background jobs finish; approval, question and error alerts fire immediately. Voice packs are downloaded from GitHub after a terms confirmation.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Windows 桌面通知，默认把回合结果读出来：Windows TTS 零下载即可用，另有 13 个 VOICEVOX 语音包可在设置页下载。完成提醒会等子代理与后台任务结束后再响；审批、提问、出错立即提醒。语音包从 GitHub 下载，下载前需确认使用条款。

description.en: After each completed agent turn, a bounded auxiliary LLM call writes one suggested next prompt into the session log; the web composer renders it as ghost placeholder text, adopted via Tab.
description.zh: 每次完成的 agent 回合后，一次有界的辅助 LLM 调用把一条建议的下一句 prompt 写入会话日志；Web 输入框将其渲染为幽灵占位文字，按 Tab 采纳。

description.en: CC-style auto-approval for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic deny/allow rules plus a two-stage allow/reject classifier with a circuit breaker and denial guidance.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Claude Code 式自动审批：确定性 deny/allow 规则 + 两阶段 allow/reject 分类器，内置熔断器与拒绝引导。

description.en: Microi吾码 AI 开发 CLI 与多宿主 Plugin：服务器连接、Skills、MCP、V8 同步和低代码交付

Per-step model router: named presets with ordered image/keyword-group rules route each agent step across every mounted provider and model, adding collaboration flows for image transcription, an image guard, a multi-plan quota panel, and per-step decision observability.
description.zh: 逐步模型路由器：以命名预设与带图/关键词组有序规则为每一步在全部已挂载模型间选路，附图像转述协作流、图像护栏、多 plan 配额面板与逐步决策可观测。

description.en: Provider-reported quota snapshots for GLM Coding Plan and GitHub Copilot in DSH: a draggable floating capsule with detail panels for quota windows, reset times, per-model usage and Copilot credits, plus an optional sidebar card hidden by default; credentials are resolved by the DSH host and no quota history is stored.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中查看 GLM Coding Plan 与 GitHub Copilot 的服务商额度快照：可拖动悬浮胶囊与详情面板展示额度窗口、重置时间、分模型用量与 Copilot 额度，附默认隐藏的可选侧边栏卡片；凭据由 DSH 宿主解析，不保存额度历史。

description.en: GLM (Zhipu bigmodel) web search provider - routes ctx.web search through Zhipu's Anthropic-compatible endpoint with the native web_search server tool, billing your existing GLM quota or Coding Plan instead of the DeepSeek platform. Includes a translation layer for Zhipu's non-standard tool_result response layout.
description.zh: GLM(智谱)网页搜索 provider——把 web_search 后端切到智谱 Anthropic 兼容端点的服务端搜索工具,直接复用你现有的 GLM 额度或 Coding Plan,替代 DeepSeek 官方搜索通道,并内置智谱私有响应格式的翻译层。

description.en: Provides an OAuth account page for DSH Web, currently supporting OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, Anthropic, Kimi For Coding, OpenRouter, and xAI.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供 OAuth 账号页面，目前支持 OpenAI Codex、GitHub Copilot、Anthropic、Kimi For Coding、OpenRouter 与 xAI。

description.en: Hot-switchable brand skins for the DSH Web UI: an OpenBMC skin, a UEFI skin and an unofficial fan-made skin based on A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality, each with light/dark schemes, plus a personal wallpaper gallery, per-skin tagline and transparency controls, and a one-click path back to the official look.
description.zh: DSH Web 多品牌皮肤热切换：OpenBMC、UEFI 与《凡人修仙传》非官方同人画作三套皮肤，各带明暗双态配色，附个人壁纸图库、双语标语与通透度调节，随时一键回到官方界面。

description.en: Agent presets whose leader does no work itself: every non-management tool call is denied at the harness boundary so the task has to go to a subagent, after a one-time lookup of the available subagent models and a per-task model choice; a second preset deliberately picks the model least suited to the task.
description.zh: 让领导不亲自干活的 agent preset：非管理类工具调用在 harness 边界一律被拒，任务只能外包给子智能体，选人前先一次性摸清可选子智能体模型、再按任务逐个选型；另一个 preset 故意挑最不适合该任务的模型。

description.en: Adds two UI surfaces: a composer image editor (numbered marks with per-mark instructions, background removal, brush-mask erase, resize with crop/padding preview, keyboard-accessible markers; results return as attachments plus a version-1 manifest) and a Settings → vision/generation provider panel (explicit provider picker, providerId normalization, ChatGPT-web accounts synced into channels, per-channel test/try-run/copy-command, script readiness scan, save validation with .env preview, probing that only disables on explicit quota errors, Chinese/English UI) that writes providers back to the skills .env files.
description.zh: 为 img2img-studio 提供两个界面：① 输入框上方的图片编辑器（编号标记 + 每处改法、纯色背景移除、涂抹掩码擦除、比例与尺寸调整（含裁切/留白预览）、标记键盘微调，结果以附件 + version 1 manifest 回填输入框）；② 设置页「识图与生图」供应商面板（显式选择供应商、providerId 归一化、ChatGPT 网页账号库同步为通道、每通道测试/试跑/复制命令、脚本就绪扫描、保存校验与 .env 预览、只对明确欠费码自动关停、中英双语），保存后写回两个 skill 的 .env。

description.en: Turns a one-line DSH draft into a complete task brief (role / goal / constraints / output format). The engine is a byte-verified port of linshenkx/prompt-optimizer (three modes, 10 templates identical to upstream); history is consent-gated with version chains and structural comparison; every run reports its token usage. Nothing is written back or sent without a click.
description.zh: 把 DSH 输入框里的一句话补成完整任务书（角色/目标/约束/输出格式）。引擎是 linshenkx/prompt-optimizer 的逐字节移植：三种优化模式、10 个模板与上游一致；历史为授权制、带版本链与结构对比；每次润色的 token 消耗可见。未经点击不写回、不发送。

description.en: Keyless web search with one web_tools entry and eight actions for multi-query search, date windows, packages, papers, repositories, platforms, page reading, cited research, cache search and engine health; fuses eight engines and ships a stdio MCP server for other agents.
description.zh: 免密钥网页搜索：一个 web_tools 入口、八个 action，覆盖多查询、日期窗口、包、论文、仓库、平台、正文读取、引用研究、缓存检索与引擎健康；融合八个引擎，并提供给其他 Agent 使用的 stdio MCP server。

description.en: Deterministic project actions shared by people and agents: one actions.json, a right-sidebar run panel, and agent tools.
description.zh: 人与 Agent 共用的确定性项目任务：一份 actions.json，右侧栏运行面板与 Agent 工具双入口。

description.en: Quote selected conversation text into the Web composer as native reference chips for focused follow-up turns.
description.zh: 在网页会话中划选文本，以原生引用 chip 插入输入框，进行针对性追问。

description.en: Connects DSH session status, approvals and questions to a native macOS notch app; requires the native app and Focus companion.
description.zh: 将 DSH 会话状态、审批和问题同步到原生 macOS 刘海程序，需要原生程序及 Focus 同步助手。

description.en: Applies personal prompts and system-prompt edits at the global level or on a single session, so each session can work with its own prompt setup without touching the others.
description.zh: 可以自行选择在全局范围或单独会话中增加个人提示词、修改系统提示词来工作，各会话互不影响。

description.en: CLIProxyAPI quota for DeepSeek Harness: a ring beside the model picker plus a settings panel listing every account quota windows with plans and reset times.
description.zh: 模型选择器旁的 CLIProxyAPI 额度圆环，设置面板仿 CPA 管理页列出全部账号的额度窗口、套餐与刷新时间。

description.en: Hot-switches in-process DSH fetch traffic among direct, manual HTTP(S)/SOCKS5 proxy, and ambient system-proxy modes, with no-proxy rules and optional proxy-environment export for newly spawned child processes.
description.zh: 在直连、手动 HTTP(S)/SOCKS5 代理和环境/系统代理模式间热切换 DSH 进程内 fetch 流量，支持免代理规则，并可为之后启动的子进程导出代理环境变量。

description.en: Complete wuyun-liuqi (five-evolutions-six-qi / 五运六气) Traditional Chinese Medicine skill pack as a DeepSeek Harness Cordis plugin: annual and guest-qi calculation, clinical pattern differentiation, and pathogenesis reasoning.
description.zh: 完整 wuyun-liuqi（五运六气）中医运气学技能包，封装为 DeepSeek Harness 插件：年度与客气推算、临床辨证、病机推演。

description.en: Drives a locally installed Moli headless browser from DeepSeek Harness: rendered fetch, JavaScript evaluation, Markdown, semantic trees, screenshots and PDFs. A CSS selector returns one container rather than the whole page (measured 40-80x fewer tokens on listing pages) and scroll triggers lazy loading. Installs Moli when it is missing; verified with a real engine on Windows, Linux and macOS.
description.zh: 从 DeepSeek Harness 驱动本机安装的 Moli 无头浏览器：渲染抓取、JavaScript 求值、Markdown、语义树、截图与 PDF。用 CSS 选择器只取某个容器而不是整页（列表页实测省 40–80 倍 token），并支持滚动触发懒加载。Moli 缺失时自动安装；已在 Windows、Linux 与 macOS 上用真实引擎验证。

description.en: Companion for DSH Notch that synchronizes session navigation and read state with DSH Desktop and Web.
description.zh: DSH Notch 的配套助手，同步 Desktop、Web 与 Notch 之间的会话跳转和已读状态。

description.en: ICVO coding-standards kit for DeepSeek Harness (formerly dsh-coding-kit): a bundle plugin that registers tools on load and injects the standards only when apply_coding_standards is called, plus a P0 gate CLI (npx spec-wave) with G1-G7 process commands, skills install, host apply, and IDE-block refresh.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 ICVO 编码规范套件（原 dsh-coding-kit）：bundle 插件加载时仅注册工具，须调用 apply_coding_standards 才注入规范；另附 P0 门禁 CLI（npx spec-wave），含 G1–G7 过程命令、skills install、host apply 与 IDE 块刷新。

description.en: Replaces the stats line under the message input in the DSH desktop app with a configurable status bar of ten optional fields, with live cost estimates at DeepSeek's official peak and off-peak rates, custom per-model prices, a CNY or USD switch and account balance.
description.zh: 把 DSH 桌面端对话区底部的统计行换成可配置状态栏：10 个字段可选可排序，按 DeepSeek 官方峰谷口径实时估算费用，支持自定义模型单价、CNY / USD 计价切换与账户余额显示。

description.en: Dockable DSH Web UI layout that organizes conversations as tabs across draggable split groups.
description.zh: 可停靠的 DSH Web UI 布局插件，将对话组织为标签页，并支持拖拽拆分对话分组。

description.en: Config-driven lifecycle hooks: event→command declarations in cordis.patch.yml, with Feishu card notifications and a QR scan-to-create bot setup.
description.zh: 配置驱动生命周期 hooks：在 cordis.patch.yml 声明事件→命令，附飞书卡片通知与扫码一键创建机器人。

description.en: Slides out a Monaco editor plus a lazy-loaded file-tree panel in the DSH Web conversation, so you can edit the local workspace inline without switching to an external editor.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话界面右侧滑出 Monaco 编辑器与文件树面板，直接在对话里编辑本地工作区代码，无需切到外部编辑器。

description.en: Switches the running session's persona and speaking style in place with `/role <id>`, adds the persona as its own prompt section after the deployment persona (it never overrides the host identity line) without touching tools or skills; roles are plain `ROLE.md` files and each switch is announced in the transcript.
description.zh: 用 `/role <id>` 就地切换当前会话的人设与说话风格，以独立的 prompt section 追加在部署人设之后（不替换宿主身份行），不动工具与技能；角色是角色库里的 `ROLE.md` 纯文本文件，切换后会在会话里声明一次。

description.en: Per-model proxy routing for LLM requests: selected models go through a proxy (Clash etc.) while the rest stay direct, with automatic retry on transport errors, 429 and 5xx, configured live from the settings page.
description.zh: 按模型给 LLM 请求分流代理：勾选的模型走代理（Clash 等），其余直连；传输错误、429、5xx 自动重试，设置页实时生效。

description.en: AX-first macOS computer use for DeepSeek Harness: accessibility snapshots with stable refs, background input, Unicode typing, menus and apps, set-of-mark screenshots, on-device OCR and verified actions — 11 tools bridged to the macos-cu CLI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 macOS computer use：基于无障碍树的稳定 ref 定位、后台输入、Unicode 输入、菜单与应用、set-of-mark 截图、本地 OCR 与动作校验——11 个工具桥接 macos-cu CLI。

description.en: Dead-code detection for AI-generated codebases: graphlint builds a dependency graph, finds code unreachable from any entry point to enable codebase cleanup and functional‑effectiveness understanding, and exposes graphlint_query / graphlint_build / graphlint_config tools plus a graphlint skill to DSH agents.
description.zh: 面向 AI 生成代码的死代码检测：graphlint 构建依赖图，定位从任何入口不可达的代码，以实现代码库清理和功能有效性理解，并为 DSH 智能体提供 graphlint_query / graphlint_build / graphlint_config 工具与 graphlint 技能。

description.en: TickTick (Dida365) task bridge: a session-header task panel and curated agent tools over the official TickTick MCP endpoint.
description.zh: TickTick（滴答清单）任务桥：会话页头部任务面板与精选代理工具，走官方 TickTick MCP 端点。

description.en: Discovers other DSH instances on the local network by UDP multicast or port scan, lists them in a sidebar panel together with the capabilities each one reports, and dispatches tasks between machines in both directions over the LAN or over an automatically downloaded userspace Tailscale node.
description.zh: 通过 UDP 组播或端口扫描发现局域网内的其他 DSH 实例，在侧栏面板中列出它们以及各自上报的能力，并可经局域网或自动下载的用户态 Tailscale 节点在两台机器之间双向派发任务。

description.en: Named subagent roster: manage role entries (model, persona, tool filter, depth, background mode) from a hot-reloaded settings page; the model picks one with list_subagents and dispatches by id with delegate — foreground, background, or continuable.
description.zh: 具名子代理名册：设置页可视化维护角色条目（模型、persona、工具过滤、深度、后台模式），热生效；模型用 list_subagents 选人、delegate 按 id 派活，支持前台、后台与可续聊。

description.en: Cross-session archive: overview workbench, folded timeline, subagent lineage, full-text search, rule+LLM summaries, ZIP export, live tracking. Native session-page embeds: turn rail, docked right panel (live mode, pinned to original session on switch), rename (official-synced), conclusion digest, health monitoring + persistent header chip (idle / active / tool-wait / stalled). dsh v0.1.2+: fuses with the official TurnNavigatorRail — vector-icon info chips (duration, tool calls, errors, thinking) plus lazy tool distribution inside the official preview card, right-click opens the workbench; the classic piano-key strip is on by default and delegates unloaded-turn jumps to the official auto-load engine; the official rail can be hidden entirely. Settings dialog section with 10 tunable behavior params.
description.zh: 跨会话档案柜：总览工作台、折叠时间线、子代理血缘、全文检索、双模式摘要、ZIP 导出、实时跟踪。会话流标签页嵌入原生会话页：轮次悬浮条、详情并入右栏（实时模式，切换会话可钉住原会话直播）、会话重命名（对齐官方即时同步）、结论摘要行、健康监控与常驻头部胶囊（空闲 / 活跃 / 工具执行 / 疑似卡死四态）。dsh v0.1.2+ 与官方轮次导航融合：官方预览卡内嵌矢量图标信息段（耗时 / 工具调用 / 错误 / 思考 + 工具分布懒加载），右键唤起会话流工作台；经典钢琴键悬浮条默认开启并存，点击未载入轮次委托官方引擎自动加载跳转；可设置隐藏官方导航只留钢琴键。设置弹窗独立分节，10 项行为参数可调。

description.en: Multi-window wall for the DSH Web UI: run and monitor N conversations side-by-side in one screen, with auto-discovery, per-window controls, and an authenticated LAN gateway for phone/tablet access.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面里并排运行、监控多个对话实例：多窗口墙 + 自动发现 + 单窗控制，内置带口令认证的局域网网关，手机/平板也能看。

description.en: Rotates configured LLM API keys after quota, rate-limit, or authentication failures.
description.zh: 在配额、速率限制或身份验证失败后轮换已配置的 LLM API 密钥。

description.en: Copy and open `dsh://` session deep links, or paste them into another conversation to inject a bounded, read-only snapshot of the referenced session.
description.zh: 复制、打开 `dsh://` 会话深链，或将其粘贴到另一对话中，注入被引用会话的受限只读快照。

description.en: Clean desktop shell for DSH: launch by double-clicking a desktop shortcut like any normal desktop app, live backend monitoring with one-click tray start/restart/stop (progress dialogs), offline auto-reconnect, single instance. Reuses your existing web profile, no restyling of the web UI. Windows + macOS.
description.zh: DSH 纯净桌面壳：双击桌面快捷方式即可像普通桌面软件一样启动；后端活性实时监测 + 托盘一键启停/重启（带进度弹窗）、离线自动重连、单实例。复用现有 web profile，不改动 web 界面。Windows + macOS 双平台。

description.en: Compact Codex coding mode for DSH: light prompt guardrails against GPT over-explaining, with an editable prompt and native Codex-style tools.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中提供精简的 Codex 编码模式：使用精简的 codex 提示词与原生 Codex 风格工具，并用少量提示词约束抑制 GPT 的过度解释；提示词可自行编辑调整。

description.en: Windows workspace pre-authorization: adds an explicit full-control DACL ACE (including WRITE_OWNER, required by dsh >=0.1.7 sandbox startup) to user-declared workspace directories, removing the repeated full-access escalation prompt. Grants only on explicit intent — new workspace records or paths added in the plugin settings page; system directories are hard-blocked. Windows only.
description.zh: Windows 工作区预授权：为用户显式声明的工作区目录补一条完全控制的 DACL 授权项（含 dsh ≥0.1.7 沙箱启动所需的 WRITE_OWNER），消除反复出现的完全访问升权弹框。仅在新增工作区记录或插件设置页手动添加路径时授权，系统目录硬拒绝。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: A floating balance widget for the Web UI: live DeepSeek account balance with manual refresh and a Y/N-confirmed graceful exit.
description.zh: Web UI 右上角悬浮窗：实时显示 DeepSeek 余额，支持手动刷新与一键优雅退出（Y/N 快捷键确认）。

description.en: Recall, edit-and-resend and regenerate, plus in-conversation versioning: a timeline of every rewind, artifact rollback (git-first, snapshot fallback), a fork map of explored paths, session lineage, and a real-time watchdog that snapshots the log at the first sign of concurrent writes. Edits auto-stop the running agent (official cancel/whenIdle) so rewinds never corrupt the durable log or break /compact.
description.zh: 撤回/编辑重发/重新生成，加上单会话版本化：每次回退的时间线、产物回退（git 优先、快照兜底）、分叉图、会话谱系，以及实时看门狗（并发写入第一时间快照日志）。编辑前自动停止运行中的 agent（官方 cancel/whenIdle），回退不会损坏持久化日志、也不会破坏 /compact。

description.en: Token-efficient persona runtime for DeepSeek Harness with local catgirl rendering and progressive tool-schema disclosure.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的省 token 人格运行时：本地渲染猫娘风味，并支持渐进式工具 schema 披露。

description.en: Cross-session TODO board as a draggable floating panel: tasks are grouped by working directory and reorderable by drag, each one carries a run mode (remind only, continue in the current session, or open a new session in the same directory), up to four attached images sent to the model as real image attachments, and an optional local time it may run at; two checkboxes track AI-done and user-verified, and the agent picks up the next unfinished task in that directory when it finishes one.
description.zh: 跨会话 TODO 板：可拖动浮窗按工作目录分组、拖拽排序，每条待办带一个执行模式（仅提醒 / 在当前会话续跑 / 在同目录新开会话）、可附最多 4 张图片（派发时作为真正的图片附件发给模型）、以及一个可选的定时执行时间；两个勾选框分别记录 AI 已完成与用户已验收，AI 完成一项后自动接续该目录下一条未完成待办。

description.en: Reads the files that AGENTS.md references with @path imports and injects their content into model context, with byte budgets, compaction re-seeding and a six-language settings card. v0.3.x expands the imports of every instruction file the harness loaded, including a project AGENTS.md picked up mid-session (needs DSH 0.2.0+); use 0.2.x on DSH 0.1.7.
description.zh: 把 AGENTS.md 里 @路径 引用的文件读出来，在会话启动时注入模型上下文；带字节预算、压缩后重新注入和六语言设置卡片。v0.3.x 会展开 DSH 已加载的所有指令文件里的引用，包括会话中途自动带进来的项目 AGENTS.md（需 DSH 0.2.0+）；DSH 0.1.7 请用 0.2.x。

description.en: Decentralized multi-device fleet: mDNS LAN discovery, key pairing, and SSH direct execution across networks.
description.zh: 去中心化多设备舰队：mDNS 同网发现、密钥配对、SSH 跨网直连指挥。

description.en: Adds a VS Code-style workspace file explorer to the dsh web GUI: file tree, editable preview with syntax highlighting, tabs, line numbers, right-click file operations, and inline image preview.
description.zh: 为 dsh 网页添加 VS Code 风格工作区文件浏览器：文件树、可编辑预览（语法高亮、标签页、行号）、右键文件操作与图片内联预览。

description.en: Structured output for DSH: a no-label title card, then tables/lists/steps; per-session toggle and style.md override.
description.zh: 让 DSH 每条实质回复默认结构化：无标签标题卡 + 表格/清单/步骤；按会话开关，style.md 可覆盖。

description.en: Per-model token usage and cost estimation with DeepSeek account balance, shown in a Settings panel tab.
description.zh: 按模型统计 token 消耗并估算费用，同时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，展示于设置面板「模型消耗」页签。

description.en: A slim port of Headroom: compresses tool output, cuts up to 20% of context, without affecting the model's context cache or agent performance.
description.zh: Headroom 的精简移植，在不影响模型上下文缓存以及 Agent 性能的情况下，压缩工具的输出，至多减少 20% 的上下文。

description.en: Switchable backends behind the native web_search and web_fetch, chosen per session from a composer menu or /setup-search and /setup-fetch: DeepSeek, Exa, Firecrawl, Tavily, Tinyfish, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar and server-side model search for search; local HTTP with a private-network allowlist, the DeepSeek Fetch API, Exa, Firecrawl, Tavily and Tinyfish for fetch.
description.zh: 为原生 web_search 与 web_fetch 提供可切换的后端，每个会话可在输入框菜单或 /setup-search、/setup-fetch 中选择：搜索支持 DeepSeek、Exa、Firecrawl、Tavily、Tinyfish、OpenAlex、Semantic Scholar 与模型服务端搜索；抓取支持带内网白名单的本机 HTTP、DeepSeek Fetch API 以及 Exa、Firecrawl、Tavily、Tinyfish。

description.en: Skin manager for the DSH web GUI: discovers installed skins and switches the active one from a dedicated Settings page, mutually exclusive, hot-reloaded without restart.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 皮肤管理器：自动发现已安装皮肤，在独立设置页一键互斥切换，热载入无需重启。

description.en: Serves the live opencode Go model catalog from the harness's built-in opencode-go provider route.
description.zh: 让 DSH 自带的 opencode-go 供应商跟随 opencode Go 套餐的实时模型列表，opencode 上架新模型后无需改配置即可使用。

description.en: Lazy-loading router for MCP servers: auto-discovers compatible MCPs and keeps only a shared router in the tool catalog, revealing a server's schemas when a turn needs them and hiding them again at turn end, so many installed MCPs stop costing context on every request. Falls open to normal visibility on any uncertainty, and the original MCP keeps ownership of execution, permissions and process lifecycle. Also supports explicit lazy connections with warm reuse, bounded reconnection, stdio and Streamable HTTP.
description.zh: MCP 懒加载路由：自动发现可接管的 MCP，冷态只在工具目录里留一个共享路由，某轮需要哪个服务器才展开它的工具 Schema、轮次结束再收起，让装了很多 MCP 不再每次请求都吃上下文。命名异常、重名或状态不确定的 MCP 不接管；出现任何不确定即恢复原工具可见性，执行、权限与进程生命周期仍归原 MCP。也支持显式的连接层懒加载，含连接保温、有限重连、stdio 与 Streamable HTTP。

description.en: File claim/release protection for parallel DSH sessions on the same workspace (heartbeat stale takeover, pending 3-way merge area).
description.zh: 同一工作区并行多会话的文件认领与写入保护（claim/release、心跳 stale 接管、pending 三路合并）。

description.en: Coordinates Codex planning and independent review while the original DSH session implements and tests changes.
description.zh: 协调 Codex 制定计划和独立审查，由 DSH 原会话完成代码修改与测试。

description.en: Windows XP Luna desktop for the DSH Web UI: a floating window manager with taskbar and desktop icons, plus the era-accurate Luna skin.
description.zh: Windows XP Luna 桌面化主题：浮动窗口管理器（任务栏、桌面图标）加上还原度很高的 Luna 皮肤。

description.en: OpenCode on DeepSeek Harness — DSH plugin that keeps OpenCode Zen + Go free-tier models working: session affinity, gateway origin headers, and tool-schema fallback.
description.zh: 让 OpenCode 免费模型在 DSH 上稳定可用，自动处理会话粘性、网关请求头和工具结构兼容。

description.en: 微信（iLink）通道插件：在微信里给 DSH Agent 发消息，在本机跑会话并把回复发回微信。Text, images, files and voice notes.
description.zh: 在微信里直接给 DSH Agent 发消息，本机跑会话，回复自动发回微信，支持文字、图片、文件和语音。

description.en: 会话管理菜单、归档管理、轮次级删除、重新生成、记忆管理、任务管理、话题导航。Conversation management menu, archive management, round-level deletion, regeneration, memory management, task management, topic navigation.
description.zh: 给会话页加上管理菜单、归档、按轮次删除和重新生成，右侧还有话题快捷导航，日常管理更顺手。

description.en: An organized personal knowledge base for your personality, working style, and materials. Its dedicated agent helps manage and search your library, answer questions, and offer guidance shaped by your preferences, instructions, and the full context of your knowledge.
description.zh: 把你的资料、想法和经验整理成个人知识库，专属助手帮你管理检索、答疑并给出贴合你风格的指导。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-personal-knowledge-base
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for Personal-Knowledge-Base

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Edit any user turn in DeepSeek Harness and re-run it: an inline editor rolls the conversation back through the official surface-replace contract, then re-prompts the agent with the revised text. The append-only session log is never rewritten.
description.zh: 点一下用户消息旁的编辑按钮就能改写内容，会话自动回退到这条消息之前，用新文本重新跑这一轮。

description.en: 在开发页面点击任意 UI 元素，一键定位 Vue / React / Svelte / Angular 源码。DSH 点击定位源码检查器，兼容 dsh-better-sidebar：预览本地 dev server，点击元素，源码直达 DSH 聊天，交给助手微调。Click a UI element in your dev page to jump to its Vue / React / Svelte / Angular source in the DSH chat. DeepSeek Harness click-to-source inspector, dsh-better-sidebar compatible.
description.zh: 在开发页面点任意UI元素，一键跳转Vue/React等源码，并直达DSH聊天让助手帮你改代码。

description.en: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web GUI 安全地开放到局域网或公网，自带密码鉴权，支持可选的TLS。Securely expose DeepSeek Harness's Web GUI to your local network or the public internet, with built-in password authentication and TLS support.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的网页界面安全地开放到局域网或公网，自带密码验证，还能开启 TLS 加密。

description.en: A visual Git workbench for DeepSeek Harness Web—inspect repositories, run common Git actions, and safely execute AI-generated workflows.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 里可视化查看 Git 历史和改动，点几下就能完成常用 Git 操作。
把 DeepSeek Harness 接入 QQ，通过 OneBot 11 协议让 QQ 机器人直接对话和调用插件能力。

description.en: LAN and reverse-proxy access to the DeepSeek Harness web UI: returns the settings service on pages that are not localhost, fills in the web APIs a browser withholds over plain HTTP, and can open a listener of its own.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页 UI 提供局域网与反向代理访问：在非 localhost 页面返回设置服务，补齐浏览器在纯 HTTP 下限制的 Web API，并可自行开启监听端口。

description.en: Markdown editor for the DSH right sidebar with live math and Mermaid rendering, version-guarded saves, and selected text inserted directly into the chat.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏 Markdown 编辑面：实时渲染公式与 Mermaid，版本守卫保存，选中文段直接插入对话。

description.en: DSH 插件：右下角一只罐子，按你的兴趣轴去 B站 搜片、按互动率筛、让大模型当策展人挑五条并写理由
description.zh: 右下角一只罐子，按你的兴趣轴去B站搜片，大模型帮你挑五条并写推荐理由。

description.en: DSH Research Graph · 研图 — DeepSeek Harness plugin for research topics, traceable knowledge cards, and reusable AI discussions.
description.zh: 把 AI 对话变成可追溯的知识图谱，帮你梳理研究主题、沉淀可复用的讨论卡片。

description.en: DSH 插件：多机 SSH 工作台。主机库、按项目授权、右侧栏里的终端与双栏 SFTP。模型用 SSHManager 工具执行命令、传文件；你在侧栏管主机与授权。密钥不进模型上下文。
description.zh: 在侧栏管理多台 SSH 主机，按项目授权，直接开终端和双栏 SFTP 传文件，密钥不进模型上下文。

description.en: Reusable Agent Team presets for DeepSeek Harness: a captain plus members with their own prompt, model, reasoning effort, and tools.
description.zh: 把常用的智能体团队配置存成预设，一键复用队长和成员的分工、模型与工具设置。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的 VRM 3D 桌宠插件：任务状态联动、独立悬浮窗、模型动作、部位互动与 AI 碎碎念。
description.zh: 支持任务状态联动动画、独立悬浮窗、部位互动和可选 AI 碎碎念的 VRM 3D 桌宠。

description.en: Protect sensitive tool output and cross-tool data flows in DeepSeek Harness, with deterministic rules, provenance receipts and a bilingual live security beacon.
description.zh: 给高风险AI工具调用加一道审批关卡，追踪数据来源，拦截危险操作，防止敏感副作用。

description.en: Runs TiddlyWiki 5 as the DSH persistent knowledge base: ten tiddlywiki_* agent tools (filtered search, read/write/batch/rename/delete, recent, tags, git sync with conflict resolve), a full TiddlyWiki editor embedded in the GUI center column over a same-origin proxy, a right-side wiki tab, a per-session tab summarizing the notes a session read or wrote, a quick-note card with draft auto-save, and an optional clip bookmarklet with image attachment — all backed by an auto-committing git repository.
description.zh: 给 DSH 接一个自己的纯文本知识库，界面里读写记日记，Agent 也能直接用同一批笔记干活。

description.en: Codex desktop style model + reasoning-effort selector for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把 DSH 输入框的模型按钮换成 Codex 风格弹层，一个入口就能选模型和推理强度。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 全局自动记忆插件：会话开始注入记忆、memory_search 检索工具、压缩检查点归档提醒（零写入提醒制）。Global auto-memory plugin for DSH.
description.zh: dsh 网页端项目级+全局长期记忆：分拆 POST /items 路由避免路径冲突，多轮工具调用上下文压缩后存入记忆项，去重与会话级持久化。

description.en: 面向数学笔记的 DeepSeek Harness 助手，驻留在 Obsidian 右侧栏。可直接读写数学笔记，维护分层长期记忆（画像、主题、类型化记录、原始证据），按 Rethlas 风格证明工作流工作，内置个人定理索引与问题模板库，并能把关键想法捕捉到备忘录、主动提醒打磨。

Bring the WorkBuddy accounts signed in on this machine into DSH, managing CN and international accounts separately. Supports automatic failover between accounts, one-click refresh of model catalogs and credits, the CN daily check-in, and a togglable OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
description.zh: 将本机登录的 WorkBuddy 多账号接入 DSH，国内版与国际版分开管理。支持账号故障自动切换、一键刷新模型目录与积分、国内版每日签到，以及可开关的 OpenAI 兼容端点。

description.en: Registers the DeepSeek Harness web server (dsh web) as an auto-start, self-healing background service — LaunchAgent / systemd / cron plus a 30s health-check watchdog — with seven dsh_daemon_* tools (install/uninstall/reinstall/status/start/stop/update).
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的 web 服务（dsh web）注册为自启动、自愈的后台服务：LaunchAgent / systemd / cron 加 30 秒健康检查 watchdog，并提供 7 个 dsh_daemon_* 工具（安装/卸载/重装/状态/启动/停止/更新）。

description.en: 面向数学笔记的 DeepSeek Harness 助手，驻留在 Obsidian 右侧栏。可直接读写数学笔记，维护分层长期记忆（画像、主题、类型化记录、原始证据），按 Rethlas 风格证明工作流工作，内置个人定理索引与问题模板库，并能把关键想法捕捉到备忘录、主动提醒打磨。
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: 一个dsh的终端样式插件，灵感来自Oh My Pi
description.zh: 把 dsh 的终端界面换成 Oh My Pi 风格，操作更顺手、看着更舒服。

description.en: “What should we build next?” There’s a skill for that.
description.zh: 把“接下来做什么”的产品想法，从规划到落地验证和复盘，全流程帮你推进。

description.en: Codex-style context window auto-management for DeepSeek Harness: a lossless rollover engine with zero summarization model calls, task-oriented handoff anchors, working notes that survive compaction, verbatim recall of archived windows, and a stale-notes gate that downgrades to an explicit warning instead of vouching for outdated notes. One-click composer button plus /smart-compact command, three-band automatic rollover, mandatory anchor sanitization; works out of the box with zero configuration.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Codex 式上下文窗口自动管理：零模型调用的无损换窗引擎，交接锚点任务定向、工作笔记跨压缩存活、归档内容逐字回查，笔记滞后自动 STALE 警示；一键换窗按钮与 /smart-compact 人工命令，三带自动换窗阈值可配，锚点强制脱敏，开箱即用零配置。

description.en: 优化DeepSeek Harness的聊天区交互体验 | Chat-area UX plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web GUI.
Native macOS Notch for DSH sessions, inline answers and animated task status
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话状态搬到 Mac 屏幕边缘，随时看任务、答问题、点回会话。

description.en: Skill marketplace with unified search across SkillHub and ClawHub, in-app README preview, one-click install and uninstall, an installed-skill list, and a chat-input skill picker.
description.zh: 技能市场插件，聚合 SkillHub 与 ClawHub 双源搜索，支持站内 README 预览、一键安装与卸载、已装技能列表，以及聊天栏技能选择器。

description.en: Interactive multi-agent collaboration, meetings, group chats, and task execution for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 把多个 AI 和真人拉进同一个群聊，边聊边干活，任务、方案和成果都能在控制台统一管理。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI 会话管理插件，可以直接聊天、删除会话、管理已归档会话
description.zh: 把 DSH 侧边栏拆成工作区和聊天区，聊天按日期自动归档，支持删除、恢复或彻底清理会话。

description.en: Native China Railway 12306 query tools for DeepSeek Harness.
DSH(DeepSeek Harness) 插件：把一段可在设置页随时改写的文字，作为全局系统提示词段注入到所有会话，含子代理与工作流内部子代理；文本与开关即时生效，无需重启。
description.zh: 在设置页写一段全局提示词，所有会话和子代理都自动带上，改完立刻生效不用重启。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 推理等级自动选择插件：由 Jev System One 模型判断每条消息值多少思考量，按模型声明的等级自动推导档位，上下文信封让「继续」这类追问继承话题深度，低置信度向上取，任何失败都静默沿用原等级。 | Jev-driven reasoning effort per message: per-model ladders derived from what each model advertises, a fixed-size context envelope so follow-ups inherit topic depth, ties break upward, silent fallback on every failure path.
description.zh: 让 Jev 模型自动判断每条消息该用多深的推理，省去手动切换推理等级。

description.en: Voice input for DeepSeek Harness: speak into the microphone and the recognized text is submitted as a normal chat message, via local or browser speech recognition.
description.zh: 语音输入插件：对着麦克风说话，识别后的文字作为普通聊天消息发送（本地模型或浏览器语音识别）。

description.en: Ports poteto's pstack engineering playbooks to DSH, covering planning, review, verification and release workflows.
description.zh: 将 poteto 的 pstack 工程工作流移植到 DSH，涵盖规划、审查、验证与发布。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
description.zh: 跨会话长期记忆插件，帮 DSH 记住事实、偏好和决策，让对话更连贯。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness web plugin: inline +N −M diff badges on edit/write tool rows and a per-turn file change summary card. Scroll-windowed diffs, PTC/code-dispatch fallback, undo — no git required.
description.zh: 在编辑和写入工具行上显示 +N −M 差异徽标，并按轮次汇总文件改动，支持滚动查看和撤销。

description.en: 贾维斯 · 常驻桌面的悬浮窗桌面助手 / 桌面宠物 —— DSH Desktop 的粒子光球：快速审批权限、⌃⌥J 快速对话。A floating-window desktop assistant & desktop pet for DSH Desktop.
description.zh: 常驻桌面的粒子光球助手，随手审批权限、⌃⌥J 唤起对话，还能当桌宠陪你。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web-GUI plugin: archived-session panel with unarchive & delete
description.zh: 在侧边栏新增「已归档」面板，轻松查看、取消归档或批量永久删除已归档会话。

description.en: Real Chrome browser control for DeepSeek Harness agents, powered by Chrome DevTools MCP
description.zh: DSH-Chrome-devtools — DSH 插件（编排）

description.en: PDF toolbox: extract text, metadata, and page ranges via pdfjs-dist (local, no API key).
description.zh: 本地解析 PDF，快速提取文本、元数据和指定页面内容，无需联网和 API key。

description.en: Deepseek Harness plugin that allows automatic delegation of subtasks to different models based on user preferences
DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 自动化小说写作发布流水线插件：claude-writing-workflow 迁移版 agent 预设 + 小说工作台（可视化/实时渲染/章节编辑）+ 多平台发布配置与数据驱动优化闭环
description.zh: 把小说创作到多平台发布串成一条流水线，带可视化工作台和发布数据优化闭环。

description.en: Cross-session verification, claims and a decision ledger for DeepSeek Harness — so two agent sessions don't repeat, contradict or deadlock each other.
description.zh: 让多个 Agent 会话之间互相验证、对齐结论，避免重复劳动、互相矛盾或卡死。

description.en: ⛔ 已停止更新（2026-09-12）：坏插件隔离等保底能力已内置于 DSH Desktop → 请直接使用 https://github.com/dataelement/dsh-desktop
description.zh: 插件出问题也不怕，自动隔离坏插件、安全模式启动、一键修复，让 DSH 稳稳跑下去。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness × OpenCode TUI 前端：把 dsh 的 Agent、会话、工具接入官方 opencode 终端。OpenCode TUI frontend for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh): agents, sessions and tools in the official opencode terminal.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness × OpenCode TUI 前端：把 dsh 的 Agent、会话、工具接入官方 opencode 终端。OpenCode TUI frontend for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh): agents, sessions and tools in the official opencode terminal.

description.en: Matt Pocock's 25 skills fully translated to Chinese (technical terms kept in English with glosses).
description.zh: 把 Matt Pocock 的 25 个实用技能全部翻译成中文，方便中文开发者直接上手使用。

description.en: Adds ChatGPT-style stop, edit-and-resend, native quote annotations, and an independent sidebar follow-up chat with model and image input for DeepSeek Harness Desktop.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 增加接近 ChatGPT 的停止、编辑重发、原生引用注释，以及支持模型和图片输入的独立侧边栏追问对话。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) bundle plugin: makes the existing bash tool run Git Bash on Windows and disables pwsh.
用于提供更丰富的DeepSeek Harness底栏信息显示插件
description.zh: 底栏统计设置：可组装的输入框下方统计行 + 预估费用（含 DeepSeek 峰谷定价）+ 自研持久化账本（客户端全量对账）+ 设置页（底栏）。

description.en: A GrokBot-style animated avatar with a synchronized typewriter status line — right in front of the "Deep diving..." indicator.
description.zh: 在「Deep diving...」状态提示前，放一只动态小伙伴——GrokBot 风格动画头像，状态文字还会同步打字机变换。

description.en: DeepSeek API 用量监测 DSH 插件：悬浮球 + 展开面板，展示开放平台真实余额、累计消费、今日消费、请求次数、Tokens 与分模型用量，支持手动登录获取 userToken。
description.zh: 悬浮球实时显示 DeepSeek 余额，点开还能看消费、请求次数和分模型用量。

description.en: 【编排模式】为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多智能体编排模式：主智能体分解分派、worker 全网格互通，支持逐 worker 指定模型与思考强度
description.zh: 【编排模式】为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多智能体编排模式：主智能体分解分派、worker 全网格互通，支持逐 worker 指定模型与思考强度

description.en: Chinese writing de-AI plugin (AI-isms / AI writing / humanize): say "去掉AI味" to rewrite text, "写的不错" to auto-learn new AI words into the avoid list. Free from the Zhihu "去AI味写作技巧" community.
description.zh: 中文写作去 AI 味技能插件（AI-isms / AI writing / humanize）：说"去掉AI味"即重写，说"写的不错"自动把新 AI 词汇记入规避表。由知乎圈子"去AI味写作技巧"社区免费提供。

description.en: Financial quantitative workbench and stock ticker: floating ball and drawer panel, real-time A/HK/US/global market quotes, multi-period K-lines and 5-day intraday charts, depth order book, capital flow, sector heat map, and AI investment research.
description.zh: 全景金融量化工作台与股票盯盘：悬浮球与抽屉面板、A/港/美/全球指数实时行情、多周期K线与5日分时、五档盘口、资金流向、板块热点榜与AI投研诊断。

description.en: For the DeepSeek Harness native vision model deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp, raises image admission limits to 32 MiB / 8192 px / 600 images and adds a highres_read tool that tiles large images, then returns the whole image plus 800x800 tiles through the host read_image tool.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 原生视觉模型 deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 提供高清识图：将图片准入上限提升至 32 MiB / 8192 px / 600 张，并新增 highres_read 工具，将大图切为整图与 800x800 分块后经宿主 read_image 注入模型。

description.en: Enhances data visualization in DeepSeek Harness by automatically selecting chart types from user input and generating images for trends, comparisons, proportions, relationships, and flows.
description.zh: 增强 DeepSeek Harness 数据可视化能力，根据用户输入自动选择图表类型并生成图片，支持趋势、比较、占比、关系和流程等可视化场景。

description.en: Sticky notes for DeepSeek Harness: draggable notes with text & image support, 9 skins, and AI-powered read/write. DeepSeek Harness 便签插件:可拖拽,支持文字与图片、9 款皮肤,AI 可读写。
