description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上可拖拽的便签纸，支持文字、图片和待办勾选，还有 9 款皮肤，AI 也能帮你读写便签。

description.en: dsh-better-sidebar 的视频文件预览插件： 在侧边栏打开 .mp4 .webm  .mov  .mkv  .avi 等视频文件时，内联渲染一个可播放、可拖拽进度条的 <video> 播放器。
description.zh: 在侧边栏直接预览视频文件，支持播放和拖拽进度条，无需离开当前界面。

description.en: Browse the directories/files of the workspace in DeepSeek Harness Web GUI and display file changes in conjunction with Git.
description.zh: 在DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 中浏览工作区的目录/文件，并结合 Git 显示文件改动。

description.en: 零外部依赖的 LLM 长期记忆插件，专为 [DeepSeek Harness] 设计。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个长期记忆，不用装任何外部依赖，聊过的事都能记住。

description.en: Control a HarmonyOS phone from the DSH web UI with AI: live H.264 screen mirroring, mouse touch and system keys, hilog streaming, and agentic tools that let the model read the screen, locate UI controls, then tap, long-press, press keys, or type.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页中用 AI 操控鸿蒙手机：实时 H.264 投屏、触控与系统按键、hilog 日志，并让模型读屏、定位 UI 控件，再执行点击/长按/按键/输入。

description.en: 🌐 Multi-provider web search plugin for DeepSeek Harness: Zero-key Bing/Baidu direct search, free-tier APIs (Tavily/Brave/Serper/Bocha), SearXNG token auth, auto-fallback, and a built-in Web Settings GUI.
description.zh: 一个插件搞定多家搜索引擎，免密钥直连必应百度，还能自动切换备用源。

description.en: Drives a real Chrome through a local MCP server so the agent can search Google/Bing/Sogou, read any page including JS-rendered and login-only content, automate click/scroll/type/key-press/select in a background window, and run platform search/detail/comment/download for Zhihu, Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Bilibili, X and Reddit; resumable comments, SHA-256-verified downloads, cookies never returned, localhost only.
description.zh: 通过本地 MCP server 驱动你真实的 Chrome：可搜索 Google/Bing/搜狗、读取任意页面（含 JS 渲染与登录后内容）、在后台窗口自动化点击/滚动/输入/按键/选择，并为知乎、小红书、抖音、Bilibili、X、Reddit 提供平台级搜索/详情/评论/下载；评论断点续抓、下载 SHA-256 校验、不返回 cookie、仅本地回环。

description.en: Turn your DSH token usage into a gacha game: feed a monster with tokens, earn coins, pull from 14 AI waifus (Kimi/GLM/Gemini/Claude and more), enhance artifacts, and build a Balatro-style battle team with daily sign-in bonuses.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的 token 消耗变成抽卡小游戏：喂代码怪、攒代币、抽 14 位 AI 娘（Kimi娘/GLM娘/Gemini娘/Claude娘…），圣遗物强化、双件合成与每日签到弹窗，组建小丑牌式战斗阵容，十连出金自动生成分享卡。

description.en: Always-on supervisor agent bundle for DeepSeek Harness: main-agent preset + schedule overlay, one dsh plugin add away
description.zh: 始终在线的监督智能体，锁定目标后自动循环调度子任务，无人值守也能持续推进。

description.en: Task panel for the DSH Web sidebar: publish tasks, auto-distill related sessions, and drive plan/develop/review stages with subagents plus in-panel acceptance.
description.zh: DSH Web 侧边栏任务面板：发布任务、自动蒸馏历史会话，由子代理分阶段（规划/开发/复核）执行，并在面板内验收。

description.en: 🐳 蓝色大肥鱼 · DeepSeek 虎鲸 3D 桌宠插件 — 由 DeepSeek 虎鲸 logo 轮廓重建，悬浮于 Web GUI 角落：拖拽旋转、360° 转圈、爱心互动、悬停工具栏、大小/灵敏度/文字设置，配置本地持久化 / A 3D whale desktop pet rebuilt from the DeepSeek whale logo for DeepSeek Harness — drag to rotate, 360° spin, heart bursts, hover toolbar, size/sensitivity/caption settings, and local persistence.
description.zh: mmzm0808/dsh-ventus-whale 声明为 DeepSeek Harness 生态插件。

description.en: 🐳 蓝色大肥鱼 · DeepSeek 虎鲸 3D 桌宠插件 — 由 DeepSeek 虎鲸 logo 轮廓重建，悬浮于 Web GUI 角落：拖拽旋转、360° 转圈、爱心互动、悬停工具栏、大小/灵敏度/文字设置，配置本地持久化 / A 3D whale desktop pet rebuilt from the DeepSeek whale logo for DeepSeek Harness — drag to rotate, 360° spin, heart bursts, hover toolbar, size/sensitivity/caption settings, and local persistence.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek 虎鲸 logo 变成 3D 桌宠，悬浮在网页角落，能拖拽旋转、送爱心，还能调大小和灵敏度。

description.en: Adds an approval-mode toggle next to the permission selector: default approval keeps per-call confirmation, bypass approval auto-approves every tool call while staying in Workspace Write.
description.zh: 在权限下拉框旁增加「审批模式」开关：默认审批保留逐次确认，绕过审批自动放行所有工具调用，同时保持 Workspace Write 权限。

description.en: Manage conversation records from the DSH web GUI settings page: delete a whole session (archive plus physical log removal) or a single message (deleting a user message cascades to its assistant replies and tool results). Running and current sessions are protected.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 设置页管理对话记录：可删除整个会话（归档并物理删除日志），或按用户消息分组浏览并删除单条消息（删除用户消息会级联删除其引发的助手与工具消息）。运行中与当前会话受保护。

description.en: Git-style conversation branching that mirrors how real programmers collaborate: a secretary root branch dispatches tasks to child branches with their own contexts, merging back only compressed summaries via squash or rebase; ships /branch commands, a branch tab, branch-to-branch messaging, and a governance baseline pairing each session branch with a git worktree.
description.zh: Git 式会话分支，模拟真实程序员协作的并行开发：根分支充当秘书维持调度，子分支持有各自上下文并行工作，任务完成后仅以压缩摘要 squash/rebase 合并回来；提供 /branch 命令、分支页签、send_message_by_branch 跨分支消息，并附一份把会话分支绑定到 git worktree 的治理基线。

description.en: Adds a local-only six-seat Texas Hold'em table to the DSH Web UI with full betting streets, side pots, persistent Token stacks, and agent-status display.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 中加入本地六人桌德州扑克，支持完整下注轮次、边池结算、Token 筹码持久化与 Agent 状态显示。

description.en: Peer-to-peer colleague-agent consultation for DSH: ask one or several configured peers, queue asynchronous questions, discover peers through signed friend cards, and review inbound requests in the Web UI.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的点对点同事 Agent 咨询：可向单个或多个已配置 Peer 提问、异步排队问题、通过签名 Friend Card 推荐发现 Peer，并在 Web UI 审批入站请求。

description.en: Adds CC Switch providers and models to DeepSeek Harness, with provider filtering and model-name search.
description.zh: 将 CC Switch 中的 provider 和模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，并支持 provider 筛选和模型名称搜索。

description.en: Manage DSH（DeepSeek Harness)） skills and MCP servers: CLI + settings-page UI with zh/en i18n, Claude/Codex import, and update checks.
description.zh: 帮你集中管理 DSH 技能与 MCP 服务器，支持设置页和命令行操作，能直接导入其他 AI 配置并自动查更新。

description.en: A gated math-modeling skill suite for DeepSeek Harness: a five-stage pipeline with stage gates, award-paper writing patterns, sensitivity analysis, statistical diagnosis, and a contest preset.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的门控式数学建模 skill 套件：五阶段流水线、阶段门、国奖写作范式、灵敏度分析、统计诊断与竞赛预设。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 消息提醒插件：回合结束或等待确认时向浏览器、系统、飞书/钉钉/企业微信/通用 Webhook 发送通知
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 消息提醒插件：回合结束或等待确认时向浏览器、系统、飞书/钉钉/企业微信/通用 Webhook 发送通知

description.en: Self-evolve memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: learns from your own sessions, injects token-budgeted preference summaries into every step. /memory commands, memory tool, settings panel. Local-only data.

Cross-session memory plugin for DSH (v0.6.1, npm @asherliner/dsh-memory-connect): auto-extraction, SQLite FTS5 indexing, RRF semantic recall injected into the system prompt every turn, scheduled maintenance, LLM-powered consolidation via ctx.llm, context explosion prevention, and global Soul identity via ~/.dsh/soul.md. v0.5.0 added temporal context graph (valid_from/valid_until/supersedes, append-only corrections via reviseMemory), trust model (recalled history injected as untrusted reference, current instruction always wins), turn-end summarization. v0.6.0 added local semantic embeddings (BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5 via embed_server.py, cosine + RRF fusion with FTS5, no cloud calls, ~232 msgs/sec on CPU). v0.6.1 fixed ~ expansion in path config. Zero-config install.
description.zh: 跨会话记忆插件（v0.6.1，npm 包 @asherliner/dsh-memory-connect）：自动提取、SQLite FTS5 索引、RRF 语义召回（每轮注入系统提示词）、定时维护、LLM 智能合并（自动接入 ctx.llm）、上下文爆炸防护、全局身份 Soul（~/.dsh/soul.md）。v0.5.0 新增：时态上下文图谱（valid_from/valid_until/supersedes，reviseMemory 追加式修正）、信任模型（历史记忆作为不可信参考注入，当前指令绝对优先）、轮末自动摘要。v0.6.0 新增：本地语义 embedding（BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5，embed_server.py 提供，余弦相似度 + 与 FTS5 的 RRF 融合，纯本地无云端调用，CPU 约 232 条/秒）。v0.6.1 修复 path 配置 ~ 展开。零配置装完即用。

description.en: DSH 自定义 WebUI 背景插件
description.zh: 自定义 DSH WebUI 背景，支持本地图库随机切换和自由裁剪，实时生效并持久保存。

description.en: an heterogeneous multi-agent collaboration skill designed for dsh
description.zh: 让多个异构智能体在 dsh 里协同干活，各司其职，搞定复杂任务。

description.en: Automatically and intelligently routes each delegated task to the best configured model using aliases, capability tags, and usage guidance—keeping routine work fast and affordable while sending complex work to stronger specialists. Configure your model team in the Web UI or guided setup, run specialists in parallel with reliable result joining, and see the chosen model at a glance in subagent views and inline in Better Sidebar's Tasks tree.
description.zh: 借助别名、能力标签和使用说明，将每项委派任务自动智能路由到最合适的已配置模型——常规工作更快、更省，复杂任务则交给更强的专用模型。可通过 Web 设置页或引导流程组建模型团队，让多个专家并行工作并可靠汇总结果；所选模型会显示在子代理视图中，并以内联标签无缝融入 Better Sidebar 的 Tasks 任务树。

description.en: ⭐ Drag-and-drop uploads of any file or whole folders, anywhere in the window; remote-safe — bytes go straight into the session workspace on the server, so a DSH deployed on a remote machine works exactly like localhost.
description.zh: ⭐ 支持拖拽上传：任意文件、整个文件夹，拖到窗口任意位置即可；支持远程上传——字节直传服务器的会话工作区，部署在服务器上的 DSH 也能像本地一样拖了就发。

description.en: ChatGPT Codex subscription chat: official OAuth, a Sol/Terra/Luna catalog with Fast rows, live usage limits, and optional search and view_image tools.
description.zh: ChatGPT Codex 订阅聊天：官方 OAuth 登录，Sol/Terra/Luna 目录含 Fast 行，实时额度，以及可选的搜索与 view_image 工具。

description.en: Angelina light and dark glass themes with parallax for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把安洁莉娜亮暗玻璃视差主题移植到 DeepSeek Harness，保留原生交互，只换视觉皮肤，低配设备也能流畅用。

description.zh: dsh 插件开发模板，覆盖配置、工具、事件、服务、钩子、浏览器 UI 插槽与斜杠命令。

description.en: Playwright MCP browser control for AI agents: drive a real, visible Chrome (navigate/click/type/snapshot + ~80 browser_* tools), with a live screenshot panel embedded in the GUI that refreshes after every action.
description.zh: 基于 Playwright MCP 的 AI 浏览器控制：驱动真实可见的 Chrome（导航/点击/输入/快照，约 80 个 browser_* 工具），并在 GUI 内嵌实时截图面板，每次操作后自动刷新。

description.en: Auto-migrate Codex desktop-pet skins into DSH: an animated corner pet that mirrors agent state (thinking, tool use, awaiting approval, failed, done), with per-session frosted-glass dialogs and a full settings panel.
description.zh: 把 Codex 桌宠皮肤自动迁移到 DSH：右下角动画桌宠随 agent 状态实时变化（思考/工具/等待批准/出错/完成），多会话毛玻璃对话框 + 完整设置面板。

description.zh: Local-first persistent memory infrastructure for DeepSeek Harness: hot bootstrap, Chinese-BM25 cold recall, lease-lock transactional writes, read-only governance

description.en: OpenCodeGo quota monitor for the DSH Web GUI: a breathing indicator at the input's bottom-right (green/yellow/red by remaining share), a liquid-glass panel with rolling/weekly/monthly usage windows and reset times, auto-refreshing every 30 s; API key read from DSH credentials.
description.zh: OpenCodeGo 剩余额度监视器：输入框右下角呼吸指示灯（按剩余额度绿/黄/红），液态玻璃面板显示滚动/周/月用量窗口与重置时间，每 30 秒自动刷新，API Key 自动读取 DSH 凭据。

description.en: Conversation node navigation rail for the DSH Web UI: one dash per user message on the right edge, reading-position tracking, hover preview card, click-to-jump with highlight line, sliding window, and auto-hide.
description.zh: 对话节点导航条：对话区右缘一列短横线节点对应每条用户消息，支持阅读位置跟踪、悬停预览卡片、点击跳转高亮、滑动窗口与自动隐藏。

description.en: Prompt Rail 是 DeepSeek Harness Web 会话页的紧凑纵向提示词快速跳转条。每一条横杠对应一条当前已加载的普通用户提示词。悬停或键盘聚焦会展示预览；点击会滚动跳转到对应提示词。

description.zh: Playwright 浏览器自动化：无障碍树交互、稳定 ref、按会话隔离浏览器。

description.en: Rings your phone over CallKit: `call_me` and `text_me` tools, plus optional turn-end and approval calls whose spoken answer is transcribed back into the session.
description.zh: 通过 CallKit 打电话到你的手机：`call_me` 与 `text_me` 工具，并可在回合结束或等待审批时来电，语音回答转写后送回会话。

description.en: 把思考状态里那句 "Deep diving..." 改成你喜欢的任何话。超轻量级。
description.zh: 把思考状态里那句 "Deep diving..." 改成你喜欢的任何话。超轻量级。

description.en: 一个 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件： 在 Web 输入框的工具行中添加一个 ✨ 图标按钮。点击后选择打磨风格，已接入的大模型 会把你草稿中的提示词改写得更专业、更易被 AI 理解 。A DeepSeek Harness plugin: icon-only co…
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件： 在 Web 输入框的工具行中添加一个 ✨ 图标按钮。点击后选择打磨风格，已接入的大模型 会把你草稿中的提示词改写得更专业、更易被 AI 理解 。A DeepSeek Harness plugin: icon-only co…

description.en: Bring the deepseek.com web/app chat experience to DSH: edit your prompt and regenerate answers in place, with a per-message <i/N> version pager (tree model, stable across conversations).
description.zh: 更贴近 deepseek 网页版/App 的聊天体验：原位编辑提问、重新生成回复、每条消息带 <i/N> 版本翻页器（树状版本模型，跨对话保持稳定）。

description.en: One memory layer for every AI tool and agent: Context Bundle injection, prompt-time recall, MCP tools, and turn-end DSH thread capture.
description.zh: 给所有 AI 工具和 Agent 共用的一层记忆：注入 Context Bundle、提示时检索、MCP 工具与回合结束 DSH 线程捕获。

description.en: OpenAI Codex provider for DeepSeek Harness with device-code OAuth, Codex CLI import, token refresh, and a web settings panel.
description.zh: OpenAI Codex provider for DeepSeek Harness with device-code OAuth, Codex CLI import, token refresh, and a web settings panel.

description.en: dsh-huadongbianzuqi — DSH plugin (tools)
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness的滑动变祖器插件

description.en: 在 dsh（DeepSeek Harness）里使用你的 ChatGPT / Codex 订阅。插件通过 OpenAI Codex 的 OAuth 流程登录 ChatGPT 账号，把订阅额度暴露成 dsh 的 `codex-oauth` 模型提供方。
description.zh: 在 dsh（DeepSeek Harness）里使用你的 ChatGPT / Codex 订阅。插件通过 OpenAI Codex 的 OAuth 流程登录 ChatGPT 账号，把订阅额度暴露成 dsh 的 `codex-oauth` 模型提供方。

description.en: DSH Web UI 会话进度插件：输入框停靠区常驻会话进度条（todos 真实进度 / 实时 token 生成速率 / 中断橘红态 / 待办提醒），零核心改动
description.zh: DSH Web UI 会话进度插件：输入框停靠区常驻会话进度条（todos 真实进度 / 实时 token 生成速率 / 中断橘红态 / 待办提醒），零核心改动

description.en: Load Claude Code assets into DSH at runtime — skills, slash commands, rules, permission rules (deny/ask/allow), subagents and hooks from .claude/, plus Claude Code plugins (plugin.json / marketplace / skills / agents / MCP), via an in-memory IR that keeps .claude as the source of truth and writes back only when you opt in. Also surfaces Claude Code auto-memory in the system prompt, read-only by default, with a write-back switch in the /cc-memory panel. Eight packages: one bundle that installs the whole set, plus the loader and six adapters (skills, permissions, agents, hooks, mcp, memory).
description.zh: 运行时把 Claude Code 全家桶原样加载进 DSH：.claude/ 的技能、斜杠命令、规则、权限（deny/ask/allow）、子代理与 hooks，以及 Claude Code 插件（plugin.json / marketplace / 技能 / 代理 / MCP）——内存 IR 解析层，.claude 始终是唯一事实来源，只有主动开启才会写回。同时把 Claude Code 的 auto-memory 接入系统提示，默认只读，可在 /cc-memory 面板打开写回。八个包：一个可一键装齐的全家桶包、loader，以及 skills、permissions、agents、hooks、mcp、memory 六个适配包。

description.en: Laya typed decisions (`noul` yes/no, `choice`, `score`) as a first-class Cordis service (`ctx.laya`) plus the model-visible `laya_ask` and `laya_plan` tools. The plugin itself installs and downloads nothing: it is a client of a `laya-mcp serve` sidecar you start yourself, and it reports that the sidecar is not running instead of failing obscurely at the first tool call.
description.zh: 把 Laya 的有类型决策（`noul` 是/否、`choice`、`score`）接成一等 Cordis 服务（`ctx.laya`）与两个模型可见工具 `laya_ask`、`laya_plan`。插件自身不安装也不下载任何东西：它是你自己启动的 `laya-mcp serve` 边车的客户端，边车未运行时会明确报出，而不是在首次工具调用时隐晦失败。

description.en: J-Space Cognition Suite SV1 native agent preset and standalone Cordis plugin: 13 modules, persistent controller and decoupled workspace.
description.zh: J-Space Cognition Suite SV1 原生智能体预设与 Cordis 插件：提供 13 大认知工程模块、持久化控制器与状态外化工作区。

description.en: AI interview practice for DeepSeek Harness Web: generates questions across four modes (concept review, mock interview, scenario, LeetCode Hot 100), scores answers, and provides explanations.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的 AI 面试陪练：支持背八股、模拟面试、场景题与力扣热题 100 四种模式，自动评分、点评并讲解知识点。

description.en: Bottom multi-tab terminal panel (node-pty + xterm.js) pinned to the viewport bottom, always below the input box.
description.zh: 底部多标签终端面板（node-pty + xterm.js）：贴底全宽，输入框始终在终端上方。

description.en: Local Markdown long-term memory for DSH: an Obsidian-compatible vault, a sidebar management page, four memory tools, and budgeted per-turn recall.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供本地 Markdown 长期记忆：Obsidian 兼容仓库、侧边栏管理页、四个记忆工具，以及按预算的每回合召回。

description.en: Codex-style tool call folding, collapsing multiple tool calls into a single line.
description.zh: Codex 风格的工具调用折叠，将多个工具调用折叠到一行内。

description.en: Conversational GIS for the DSH Web UI with local file and PostGIS querying, interactive maps, and spatial analysis.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的对话式 GIS：支持本地文件与 PostGIS 查询、交互式地图与空间分析。

description.en: Fan-made wallpaper plugin themed on the streamer Zhang Shunfei: full-screen high-definition rotating colorful pegasus GIF wallpaper with theme blending and prominence control, plus a Bilibili music player (add songs by pasting a link, delete, volume, seek, single/list/shuffle loop, and a sidebar mini player).
description.zh: 以网络主播张顺飞为主题的粉丝同人二创壁纸插件：彩色飞马高清旋转动图全屏壁纸，支持主题融合与突出度调节；附带 B站音乐播放器，可粘贴链接添加歌曲、删除、调音量、拖进度条、切换单曲/列表/随机循环，并有侧栏迷你播放器。

description.en: Evidence-backed inspector for DSH Web built-in capabilities: runtime/config provenance, compatibility and drift diagnostics, plus fail-closed controls for nine reviewed UI leaves.
description.zh: DSH Web 内置 capability 的 evidence-backed 检查器：展示运行/配置溯源、兼容性与漂移诊断，并仅为 9 个经过审阅的 UI leaf 提供 fail-closed 控制。

description.en: Web theme and file workspace plugin with global typography controls, @file mentions, a project file tree, Markdown preview, and a resizable side panel.
description.zh: DSH Web 主题与文件工作台：全局字体设置、@ 文件引用、项目文件树、Markdown 预览和可拖拽侧边面板。

description.en: Claim-verification skill that checks design documents and plans against codebase facts, escalating behavioral claims to executable logic-primitive verification for state machines and data models, with before/after regression, domain constraints, and concurrency risk mining.
description.zh: 声称核查技能：将设计文档与计划中的每条声称对照代码库事实核验，行为类声称升级为状态机/数据模型逻辑原语验证，支持前后回归、领域约束与并发风险挖掘。

description.en: Composer and sidebar helpers in one plugin, each switchable in Settings: a git Changes panel (uncommitted / unstaged / staged / branch diffs), ↑/↓ input history, Shift+Tab /plan toggle, one-click ▶ Continue after a stopped or failed turn, drag-and-drop queue reordering, Copy deeplink, Auto Review "Allow for this chat", project status markers with active projects first, background notifications, 11 extra UI languages and automatic updates from GitHub releases through the plugin manager.
description.zh: 一个插件集成多项输入框与侧边栏增强，均可在设置中单独开关：git 改动面板（未提交 / 未暂存 / 已暂存 / 分支差异）、↑/↓ 输入历史、Shift+Tab 切换 /plan、对话中断或失败后一键 ▶ 继续、拖拽调整排队消息顺序、复制会话链接、Auto Review「本对话内允许」、项目状态标记与活跃项目置顶、后台通知、11 种额外界面语言，以及通过插件管理器从 GitHub Releases 自动更新。

description.en: Recurring loops: `/loop` command + loop tool + activity status bar.
description.zh: 定时循环：`/loop` 命令 + loop 工具 + 活动状态条。

description.en: COM-driven real Microsoft Office automation for DeepSeek Harness: drives a running Excel/Word instance through OfficeMCP — VBA macros, pivot tables, live formula recalculation, and deep document layout; plus an accounting suite (double-entry journal posting with debit/credit balance check, and SUMIF general ledger).
description.zh: COM 驱动真实 Microsoft Office 实例的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：经 OfficeMCP 操作运行中的 Excel/Word——VBA 宏、透视表、活公式重算、文档深度排版；含会计场景（复式记账分录 + 借贷平衡校验、SUMIF 科目总账）。

description.en: Auto-saves large pasted text as an attachment file in the DeepSeek Harness web input box; with dsh-better-sidebar installed, the paste pill opens the file in the sidebar editor and saves it back.
description.zh: 在输入框粘贴大段文本时自动保存为附件文件；装了 dsh-better-sidebar 时，药丸上的「查看」可在侧栏编辑器打开并保存回原文件。

description.en: Third-party model settings for DeepSeek Harness: pick a provider and a model in the composer menu, gate a model's thinking level with one switch on the official Models page card, and configure per-route request headers.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 中的第三方模型设置思考等级：在输入框菜单里选择服务商与模型，在官方模型页卡片上用一个开关控制思考等级，并可配置按路由的请求头。

description.en: Codex-style dark interface for DSH on Windows, with navigation, project and conversation sidebars, and model and reasoning controls.
description.zh: 为 Windows 上的 DSH 提供 Codex 风格深色界面，包含导航、项目与会话侧栏、模型和思考强度控件。

description.en: Compresses DSH time-context from ~280 chars to 46 chars by injecting a compact date line into the runtime-context snapshot; zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 将 DSH 时间上下文从约 280 字符压缩到 46 字符，向运行期快照注入紧凑日期行，无运行时依赖。

description.en: TRAE-style conversation rollback — per-turn checkpoints (10-turn sliding window) roll back touched files and truncate model context in place, keeping the same session id. Human-initiated only: a /rollback command or a per-turn Web button (works on interrupted turns too), with a preview listing each affected file and its action — restore, recover, delete, or skip.
description.zh: TRAE 式「回退到本轮对话发起前」插件：按轮次建立检查点（10 轮滑动窗口），同时回滚工作区文件与原位截断模型上下文，保持同一 session id。回退只能由人发起：/rollback 命令或每轮的 Web 回退按钮（被中断的轮次也可用），弹窗逐条列出受影响文件及其动作（恢复/找回/删除/跳过）。

description.en: One fixed button inside the DSH window that restarts DSH and reopens it automatically, with no console window; right-click it for a built-in self check that writes a single diagnostic report.
description.zh: DSH 窗口里的一个固定按钮，点一下就把 DSH 关掉并自动重开，全程没有控制台窗口；右键它还有内置自检，能生成一份自包含的诊断报告。

description.en: A minimal phone remote control for DeepSeek Harness: the phone page carries only the instruction you send and the AI's final conclusion, while tool calls, file access, sub-agent dispatch, and reasoning traces stay on the computer, reachable over LAN, Tailscale, or a Cloudflare tunnel with a QR code, link, and password for each route.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 用的极简手机遥控器：手机页面上只有你发出的指令和 AI 最后的结论，工具调用、文件读写、子 Agent 调度与思考过程全部留在电脑上；可通过内网、Tailscale 或 Cloudflare 隧道连接，每条路径各配二维码、链接和密码。

description.en: Polishes the draft in the composer into a clearer, better-structured prompt from the ✨ button or Alt+O; streams the result live over SSE with reasoning shown first, and follows the session's default model with zero configuration or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
description.zh: 在输入框按 ✨ 或 Alt+O 一键把草稿润色成更清晰、更结构化的 prompt；默认零配置复用当前会话模型（SSE 真流式、推理过程先出），也可自配任意 OpenAI 兼容端点。

description.en: Real-time local TTS for DeepSeek Harness: voice presets, auto-read, engine setup assistant, a read-aloud button, and a settings panel for the GSV-TTS-Lite engine.
description.zh: 将本地高性能 TTS 引擎 GSV-TTS-Lite 实时接入 DeepSeek Harness：语音预设、自动朗读、引擎配置助手、朗读按钮与设置面板。

description.en: Select text in the DSH web UI to stream a translation and an explanation of what it means in that specific context, read against the conversation it came from; the panel keeps a replayable history and can be promoted into a full session.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面划词，小窗流式给出翻译，并结合这段文字所在的会话上下文解释它在这里的具体含义；面板带可回放的历史记录，也能一键升格为正式会话。

description.en: Brings the WorkBuddy, Trae and Qoder desktop logins on this machine into DeepSeek Harness as OpenAI-compatible local endpoints, with an account pool, automatic account switching when WorkBuddy is rate limited, and a settings panel.
description.zh: 把本机 WorkBuddy、Trae、Qoder 的桌面登录接进 DeepSeek Harness，每家一个 OpenAI 兼容的本地端点，带账号池、限流自动换号与设置面板。

description.en: Codex Appshots for DSH: capture the frontmost active window via global shortcut and seamlessly mount it into the composer for agent queries.
description.zh: DSH 版 Codex Appshots：全局快捷键精准捕获当前工作窗口，零摩擦挂载至 Composer 作为上下文向 Agent 提问。

description.en: A super-simplified LLM-wiki memory plugin: one index document (auto-loaded) + one markdown file per topic (read only when needed) — no dumping everything into the context and burning tokens. Simple and lightweight, painless to install/uninstall, and freely editable however you like.
description.zh: 超级简化版 llm-wiki 记忆插件：一个索引文档（自动加载）+ 每个主题一个 md 文件（需要时才读）——不会把所有东西塞进上下文烧 token。简单轻量，安装卸载无压力，想怎么改就怎么改。

description.en: A judgment core for DeepSeek Harness: a cognition loop that gives every decision a source and attribution and drives planning to a close, hippocampus memory that condenses running experience into knowledge (journal ledger, episodic archive, low-confidence decay), judgment identity responsibilities in the architecture (consistent rubric, judgment bound to its source), and an A2A memory-management team via dsh-linghun-assembler. Requires DSH ^0.1.0-rc.7 (rc.2 supported).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的判断内核：认知循环让判断有来处、反馈有归因、规划收口；海马体把运行经历沉淀为可复用知识（序时账留痕、情景归档、低置信降权遗忘）；判分身份职责入架构（口径一致、判据绑定来源）；联动 dsh-linghun-assembler 的 A2A 记忆管理团队。需要 DSH ^0.1.0-rc.7（支持 rc.2）。

description.en: Multi-platform message gateway and WeCom AI bot bridge with session context compression and smartsheet creation.
description.zh: 多平台消息网关与企微智能机器人桥接：会话自动压缩持久化与智能表格一键创建。

description.en: Remote host tunnel manager: runs dsh web on a remote Linux server (systemd supervision, no root needed) behind an auto-reconnecting SSH tunnel; allocates and registers remote ports on the server, multi-user safe, with an audit view.
description.zh: 远程主机隧道管理器：把 dsh web 跑在远程 Linux 服务器上（systemd 守护、免 root），本地经自动重连的 SSH 隧道访问；远程端口自动分配并在服务器登记留档，支持多人共用与 audit 审查。

description.en: A governed swarm of six specialist DSH agents — orchestrator, planner, knowledge-base bridge, developer and two reviewers — turns a requirement into a strict phase pipeline where every delivery must prove itself with structured evidence before the next phase may start; reviewers are read-only, code merges only after a review pass, and an append-only event log gives full replay and audit on a live kanban board. Its design draws inspiration from the Hermes Agent kanban.
description.zh: 一个受管的智能体蜂群（swarm）：六种专职 DSH 智能体——编排、规划、知识库桥接、开发，以及方案评审与代码评审——把需求转化为严格阶段流水线；每阶段交付必须先以结构化证据自证，下一阶段才放行；评审只读、代码仅评审通过后合并，追加式事件日志支持全程回放与审计，实时看板同步展示。其设计灵感源自 Hermes Agent kanban。

description.en: Engineering intelligence for coding agents — persistent, evidence-aware, project-isolated engineering memory with unified hybrid search (memory + RAG documentation) for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 面向编程代理的工程智能——为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化、证据感知、项目隔离的工程记忆，以及统一的混合搜索（记忆 + RAG 文档）。

description.en: One-click Figma MCP connector for DSH (DeepSeek Harness).
description.zh: DSH 的 Figma MCP 一键连接插件。

description.en: DSH adapter bridging DeepSeek web chat and DeepSeek Harness with automatic DSM-tag harvesting, memory injection and write-back, full-answer saving on the web, a DSH sidebar for browsing and manual injection, named-entry retrieval, general/non-general classification, and transactional memory compression; works with the separately loaded Chrome/Edge extension in extension/ and the local @zoria-lind/dsh-ecolink-service, which the adapter can start automatically.
description.zh: 跨端记忆的 DSH 适配器：支持 DSM 短标签自动捕获入池、记忆注入与写回、网页完整回答保存、DSH 侧栏浏览与手动注入、指定条目读取、通用/非通用分类及事务化记忆压缩；配合需另行加载的 extension/ 目录下 Chrome/Edge 扩展，以及适配器可自动启动的本地 @zoria-lind/dsh-ecolink-service 服务。

description.en: Registers the minas-webdav MCP server as one stdio row, giving the agent 14 tools for a Xiaomi Smart Storage (MINAS) NAS without mounting it: list, stat, tree, find, du, df, cat, upload, download, mkdir, move, copy, delete and a capability probe. The Python package behind it is installed separately with pipx.
description.zh: 把 minas-webdav MCP server 注册成一行 stdio 配置，给 agent 14 个工具，不挂盘直接操作小米智能存储（MINAS）：列目录、stat、tree、find、du、df、cat、上传下载、mkdir、移动复制删除，另带能力探测。Python 包需另行 pipx 安装。

description.en: PDF parsing tools for DSH: pdf_info, pdf_extract_text, and pdf_render_page with dual pdfjs and built-in rendering engines, including system-font rendering for PDFs with non-embedded CJK fonts.
description.zh: DSH 的 PDF 解析工具：pdf_info、pdf_extract_text、pdf_render_page 三件套，pdfjs 与自研渲染器双引擎，未内嵌 CJK 字体的 PDF 也能用系统字体渲染出图。

description.en: Runs work as a crew of role agents: a product manager writes the PRD or DoD, waits for your confirmation, then starts architect, engineer, QA and reviewers whose tool sets are locked per role, and shares work through files on disk.
description.zh: 以角色团队的方式干活：产品经理先写 PRD 或 DoD 并等你确认，再启动架构师、工程师、QA 与各类评审；每个角色的工具集按角色锁定，彼此通过磁盘文件协作。

description.en: Roll back to before any of your questions or edit the last one and resubmit, with the workspace files of the discarded turns restored.
description.zh: 回退到任意一条提问之前，或编辑上一条问题重新提交；被丢弃轮次产生的工作区文件会一并还原。

description.en: Independent workspace and conversation personas with adaptive styles, approved communication preferences and role-based routing to registered DSH models, including models supplied by Codex and Claude Code provider plugins.
description.zh: 为工作区与对话配置独立人格，支持自适应风格、经确认的通用交流偏好和子代理模型路由；可配合其他 provider 插件使用 Codex、Claude Code 等已注册模型。

description.en: Shell tool with four Windows backends (PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL / MSYS2) plus an interactive PTY terminal; the MSYS2 backend starts bash.exe with -lc so /etc/profile puts /usr/bin and /mingw64/bin on PATH, and injects MSYSTEM=MINGW64 into the PTY environment. Written in TypeScript, targets DSH 0.1.2+.
description.zh: 一个 shell 工具：Windows 上支持 PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL / MSYS2 四种后端，外加交互式 PTY 终端；MSYS2 后端以 bash.exe -lc 启动，让 /etc/profile 把 /usr/bin 与 /mingw64/bin 带进 PATH，并为 PTY 环境注入 MSYSTEM=MINGW64。TypeScript 编写，面向 DSH 0.1.2+。

description.en: Codex-style left-gutter tick rail for each user turn, with hover preview and click-to-scroll.
description.zh: 对话区左侧 Codex 风格短横线锚点，悬停预览，点击跳转到对应轮次。

description.en: Route OpenRouter requests through a configured provider list and quantization cap, injected as provider.only/order with allow_fallbacks, plus provider.quantizations.
description.zh: 配置 OpenRouter 请求使用的提供商列表与量化位数上限，注入 provider.only/order（allow_fallbacks）与 provider.quantizations 路由参数。

description.en: One authenticated OpenAI-compatible endpoint (built on CLIProxyAPI) for dsh and other tools: gathers WorkBuddy, OpenCode Zen, local Ollama / LM Studio and CLI subscriptions such as Codex and Kimi, signs in from the dsh page without installing their CLIs, and syncs the picked models into dsh grouped by source. The settings page has a switch per source with free / paid tags, plan usage, API keys with 24-hour stats, per-source model picking, and update / uninstall. Runs on macOS, Linux (including next to dsh-vps) and Windows.
description.zh: 为 dsh 和其他软件提供一个带鉴权的 OpenAI 兼容地址（基于 CLIProxyAPI）：汇集 WorkBuddy、OpenCode Zen、本机 Ollama / LM Studio，以及 Codex、Kimi 等 CLI 订阅；在 dsh 页面上登录，不用装各家 CLI；挑选的模型按来源分组同步进 dsh。设置页提供每个来源的开关和免费 / 付费标签、套餐用量、带 24 小时统计的 API key、按来源挑选模型，以及更新和卸载。支持 macOS、Linux（含与 dsh-vps 同机部署）和 Windows。

description.en: OpenViking in the DSH web GUI: a Studio panel, a per-session memory-commit status pill with its commit timeline, and a right-sidebar tab showing what the current session retrieves.
description.zh: 把本地 OpenViking 记忆服务接进 DSH 界面：左侧边栏的 Studio 面板、输入框下方的会话提交状态胶囊与提交时间线，以及右侧边栏查看当前会话检索到哪些记忆的面板。

description.en: Local OCR fallback for text-only routes: when the session model declares it cannot accept images, the attached image is cached locally and its path injected so the model can call ocr_image — PP-OCRv5 + ONNX Runtime on CPU, no API key, images never leave the machine. Silent when the model can see images.
description.zh: 纯文本路由的本地 OCR 兜底：会话模型明确声明不接受图片时，把附件的图片存入本地缓存并注入路径，模型调 ocr_image 用 PP-OCRv5 + ONNX Runtime 在纯 CPU 上离线识别，无需 API key，图片不出本机；模型能看图时静默。

description.en: A dsh-better-sidebar tab that statically parses Qoder Canvas `*.canvas.tsx` files into structured pages in the DSH right sidebar (the source is never executed: no eval, no bundler, no sandbox iframe), with a file-viewer takeover for `.tsx` and a bundled Skill for authoring the format.
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 扩展：把 Qoder Canvas `*.canvas.tsx` 静态解析为结构化页面渲染在右侧栏（不执行源码，无 eval / bundler / 沙箱 iframe），并附带 `.tsx` 文件查看器接管与一个教 LLM 写该格式的 Skill。

description.en: Prompt enhancer for the DSH web UI with basic/standard/expert modes: standard/expert modes rewrite drafts with project context and recent session history, retry gracefully when gateways reject reasoning-effort settings, and show a before/after review with undo.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面提示词增强插件：基础/标准/专家三档模式，标准/专家模式结合项目上下文与最近会话历史重写草稿；网关拒绝推理档位参数时自动去参重试；增强结果支持对比确认与撤回。

description.en: Windows system-tray launcher for dsh web: console-free background start (VBS/powershell chain), a tray menu with open UI / logs / icon presets / launch-at-login / restart Harness, one-click install and update of the bundled dsh-plugin-usage-meter, and a dsh plugin half that starts the tray together with the harness.
description.zh: Windows 系统托盘启动器：无窗口后台启动 dsh web（VBS/powershell 链），托盘菜单支持打开界面、日志、图标预设、开机自启与重启 Harness，一键安装与更新内置的 dsh-plugin-usage-meter，并可作为 dsh 插件安装使托盘随 Harness 一起启动。

description.en: Turns the main model into a dispatcher: six pools (economy/mechanical/main/hard/vision/review) route each subtask to the right model, with ranking and per-route reasoning-effort pins. A context watermark (50k/90k/130k) nudges delegation early and, at the force level, forks a backup session, writes a handover doc, compacts, and continues without losing in-flight subagent work; /ctx-pause, /ctx-resume and /ctx-handover pause, resume or trigger the same machinery by hand. Optional Agent Teams mode adds persistent teammates and a shared task board; /vision lets text-only models handle images via the vision pool; tiered verification sends bigger diffs to a tester and an independent reviewer. Settings UI, READMEs and the conversation / code-comment / document language preferences all cover the same 11 languages (en, zh, zh-TW, ja, ko, de, es, fr, it, pt, ru); the plugin UI follows the DSH app locale unless forced otherwise. Bundles three skills: read-only MySQL/Redis verification, commit-message generation, and a requirements/design document convention.
description.zh: 把主模型变成调度员：六个派发池（轻量/机械/主力/高难/多模态/复审）按活配模型，支持排序与按路线钉选思考强度。上下文水位（50k/90k/130k）先提醒委派，到顶自动 fork 备份会话、写交接文档、压缩后续跑，跑着的子智能体不丢；/ctx-pause、/ctx-resume、/ctx-handover 可随时手动暂停、恢复或发起同一套交接。可选 Agent Teams 模式带来常驻队友与共享任务板；/vision 让纯文本模型也能看图；分级验证给大改动配 tester 和独立复审。设置界面、README 与回复/代码注释/文档语言偏好覆盖同一套 11 种语言（英、简中、繁中、日、韩、德、西、法、意、葡、俄），界面默认跟随 DSH 应用语言。内置三个技能：MySQL/Redis 只读核验、commit 文案生成、需求与设计文档规范。

description.en: Image generation through a local ComfyUI server: one generate_image tool covering text2img, img2img, inpaint and background removal.
description.zh: 用本地 ComfyUI 出图：一个 generate_image 工具覆盖文生图、图生图、局部重绘与去背景。

description.en: About section for the DeepSeek Harness settings: version info, npm latest/next update check with one-click install and auto-restart, and GitHub release history.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置中心增加「关于」分区：版本信息、npm 检查更新与一键安装（自动重启）、GitHub 版本更新记录。

description.en: Reference verification for DeepSeek Harness (参考文献真实性检查器): the reference_checker model tool checks a paper's bibliography (.pdf/.bib/.tex/.txt or pasted text) against Crossref, OpenAlex and arXiv, reports found / partial / not_found / error per entry, and emits corrected citations in the input's style (APA, GB/T 7714, IEEE, Vancouver, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, ACS, BibTeX).
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供参考文献真实性检查：reference_checker 工具将论文（PDF/BibTeX/tex/文本/粘贴列表）的每条文献对照 Crossref / OpenAlex / arXiv 核对，逐条判定 found / partial / not_found / error，并按输入样式生成可直接替换回论文的更正版引用（APA、GB/T 7714、IEEE、Vancouver、MLA、Chicago、Harvard、ACS、BibTeX）。

description.en: Omni-modal workstation for DSH: analyze_image over an ordered multi-card VLM failover chain, a six-tool vision toolkit (zoom, colour sampling, pixel diff, OCR, element detection, inline display) sharing the same image resolver, generate_image over OpenAI/DashScope/ComfyUI protocols, multi-card async generate_video with a /build-video-tool builder, and speak/clone_voice TTS over seven providers, all driven by one auto-saving settings page.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的全模态工作站：analyze_image 走有序多卡片 VLM 故障转移链；六个视觉工具箱工具（局部放大、色调采样、像素比对、OCR、元素检测、内联展示）共用同一套图片来源解析；generate_image 支持 OpenAI/DashScope/ComfyUI 协议；多卡片异步 generate_video 配 /build-video-tool 构建器；speak/clone_voice 语音合成覆盖七家供应商；全部由一个自动保存的设置页驱动。

description.en: MC 资产面板 + 「MC 模组工作室」模式 + mc-mod / mc-art 两个 skill：3D+物品栏、像素/结构编辑器、出错的报告自动放进输入框、GameTest 判定闭环。原生 Windows 可用（不需要 WSL），不绑定任何具体 mod。
Path to Nowhere MBCC dossier theme for DSH, with dark and light palettes, a boot splash, a balance capsule and a settings panel.
description.zh: 无期迷途 MBCC 档案风 DSH 主题：深浅两套色板、开屏动画、余额胶囊与设置面板。

description.en: Git view for DeepSeek Harness: status, commit graph, branches and tags in one picker, diff, staging/commit, push/pull and blame.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 视图：状态、提交图、分支与标签（合并为同一个下拉框，可切换分支或检出标签）、差异、暂存提交、推送拉取与逐行溯源。

description.en: A floating credit/quota widget for the DeepSeek Harness Web: shows DeepSeek / OpenCode Go balances and usage, and tracks DSH session token usage and estimated cost by day, month, and model.
description.zh: DSH Web 的 LLM 额度/用量悬浮窗：显示 DeepSeek / OpenCode Go 余额与套餐用量，并按日、月、模型统计 DSH 会话 token 用量与费用估算。

description.en: Three tools that let any agent, including a team member, list, steer and stop the subagents it started.
description.zh: 三个工具，让任意智能体（包括团队成员）能列出、追问并中止自己派出的子代理。

description.en: Multi-threaded downloader plugin for DeepSeek Harness with bundled aria2: probes the target for Range support, then picks aria2 (4 or 8 connections by file size) or falls back to curl.
description.zh: DSH 多线程下载插件，内置 aria2：先探测目标是否支持 Range，再按文件大小选择 aria2（4 或 8 连接）或回退 curl 单线程下载。

description.en: Global proxy for DeepSeek Harness: route agent tools, model requests and web fetches through the Windows system proxy or a custom address with one persistent toggle, an editable settings card, and agent-visible proxy status.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 全局代理插件：通过 Windows 系统代理或自定义地址统一代理模型请求与工具流量，主界面常驻开关，且 Agent 在对话中实时感知代理状态。

description.en: Loads only the basic DSH tools by default and activates the rest on demand, with a per-tool switch list in the plugin settings.
description.zh: 默认只加载基础工具，其余工具按需激活，并在插件设置页以逐工具开关管理。

description.en: WeChat official account AI writing pipeline: six-step article runs (topic, outline, draft, gates, render, images) with a launch brief contract, a hot-topic board with per-item AI digests, RRULE scheduling to the draft box, a workbench UI plus chat tools and a /wewrite command, and fail-closed host approval before any draft-box push.
description.zh: 公众号 AI 写作管线：六步成文（选题、大纲、成稿、门禁、渲染、配图）+ 启动 brief 合同、热榜逐条 AI 速览、RRULE 定时推草稿箱、写作台与对话工具（/wewrite 命令与 @ 引用），推送草稿箱前经宿主审批 fail-closed 确认。

description.en: Adds a restart button to the DeepSeek Harness desktop app — it asks before restarting while work is running, and afterwards reports how long the app was down. Entries can live in the sidebar, the conversation header, the account menu or the settings page, and each one can be turned off. Extras include checking how much sign-in data is stored (a cause of startup failures) and previewing leftover temp files, counted but never deleted. Desktop app only.
description.zh: 在桌面版加一个「重启」按钮：有任务在跑时先问过你，重启后告诉你停机了多久。入口可放在侧栏、会话标题栏、账号菜单或设置页，不想要的能逐个关掉。附带功能：检查登录数据占用（避免应用启动失败）、预览遗留临时文件（只统计不删除）、隐藏账号菜单里的「意见反馈」。仅适用于桌面版。

description.en: Cross-session memory vault: remember / recall / forget tools, per-turn prompt injection, and a settings-page entry browser.
description.zh: 跨会话记忆库：remember / recall / forget 工具、每轮提示注入与设置页条目浏览。

description.en: Arknights: Endfield theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: charcoal and hazard-yellow industrial HUD, a boot splash injected ahead of the shell, a conversation backdrop, and a re-cut Windows title bar. Restyles the sidebar brand to 终末地工业 / ENDFIELD INDUSTRIES, which a URL flag reverts.
description.zh: 《明日方舟：终末地》主题：炭黑与警戒黄的工业 HUD、在外壳渲染前注入的开屏动画、对话区背景，以及重新配色的 Windows 标题栏。侧栏品牌会改为「终末地工业 / ENDFIELD INDUSTRIES」，可用 URL 参数还原。

description.en: Registers two MCP servers that drive the installed AutoCAD and SolidWorks desktop apps over COM, plus two on-demand skills. Windows only, Python 3.11+; the pinned upstream servers install themselves on first load, and only the sides whose CAD application is registered get a row. Each server advertises two meta-tools instead of its full catalog (a discovery shim here for SolidWorks, upstream DISCOVERY_MODE=search for AutoCAD), taking the schemas loaded before the first request from 23,404 to 256 tokens and from 83,732 to 365 respectively.
description.zh: 注册两个 MCP 服务器，在 Windows 上通过 COM 驱动本机安装的 AutoCAD 与 SolidWorks，另附两个按需技能。仅 Windows，需要 Python 3.11+；首次加载时自动安装钉死版本的上游服务器，并且只给真正装了的 CAD 应用注册对应的那一行。两者都只广告两个元工具而非完整工具表（SolidWorks 用本仓库的 discovery 垫片，AutoCAD 用上游 DISCOVERY_MODE=search），首次请求前加载的工具定义分别从 23,404 降到 256 token、从 83,732 降到 365 token。

description.en: In-session question navigator for the DSH Web UI: a dot minimap on the conversation edge (left or right, configurable in settings), one dot per user question — hover shows the full question text, click jumps to it.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 会话内提问导航：对话栏左/右缘（可在设置中切换）的圆点迷你地图，一个圆点对应一个用户提问——悬停显示全文，点击跳转到该提问。

description.en: Query the dshbase plugin directory from inside DeepSeek Harness — search, list, and get install commands for 1700+ plugins.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接搜索、浏览 dshbase 插件库，获取 1100+ 社区插件的安装命令，不用离开会话。

description.en: Pinned-version REA for DeepSeek Harness: installs rea-agents locally, starts its MCP server from that pinned copy, and upgrades only when you press Update.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 固定版本的 REA：把 rea-agents 安装到当前配置档的一个确切版本，从该副本启动其 MCP 服务，只有按下「更新」才升级。

description.en: Search-first capability workflow for DSH agents (v1.0.0): reuse local tools or review exact-source plugins before installation, adapt or create capabilities in managed source work, and use receipts that distinguish installed, loaded, activated, and verified states; version tools cover rollback, adoption, and upstream updates.
description.zh: AutoEvo v1.0.0 为 DSH Agent 提供 Search-first 能力工作流：优先复用本地工具或审查精确来源插件后再安装；可在受管源码中改造或新建能力；回执区分 installed、loaded、activated、verified，版本工具支持回滚、领养与上游更新。

description.en: Caddy forward_auth administrator login for DeepSeek Harness Web, with Argon2id passwords, revocable sessions, bilingual UI, and a native sidebar sign-out action.
description.zh: 通过 Caddy forward_auth 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供管理员登录，含 Argon2id 口令、可撤销会话、中英界面和侧栏原生退出。

description.en: Codex Pets-style floating pixel pet with 10 built-in Petdex-compatible pets, a 9-state agent-status engine (idle/running/waiting/review/failed plus client-side waving/jumping/directions), draggable overlay, pet picker/zoom settings, notification bubbles, and a `pet_say` tool for the agent to speak through the pet.
description.zh: Codex Pets 风格浮动像素桌宠：内置 10 只 Petdex 兼容宝可梦伙伴，9 状态 agent 状态机（空闲/思考/等待/审查/出错 + 客户端挥手/跳跃/方向动画），可拖拽悬浮、宠物切换与缩放设置、通知气泡，以及 agent 可用的 `pet_say` 工具。

description.en: Takes over the built-in web_search and web_fetch providers with Tavily, each behind its own toggle: a key pool with balance-aware scheduling that reads real credit balances from /usage, failover with hard exclusion of cooling or exhausted keys, and call history with a 14-day credit chart.
description.zh: 用 Tavily 接管内置的 web_search 与 web_fetch 提供方，两者各有一个开关：密钥池按余额调度（从 /usage 读取真实余额），失败自动切换，冷却中与额度耗尽的密钥硬排除，并记录调用历史与 14 天额度图表。

description.en: Notion connector for DeepSeek Harness: search, read, query, create, update, and append Notion pages and databases via six agent tools, with a Web settings page — configured once with an Integration Token.
description.zh: 配置一次 Notion Integration Token，Agent 即可搜索、读取、查询、创建、更新、追加 Notion 页面与数据库内容，并提供 Web 设置页。

description.en: Doubao-style voice chat for DSH: press-and-hold mic in the composer converts speech to text and auto-sends, and AI replies are read aloud. Optional LLM condensing (long replies summarized into short spoken lines, following the current conversation model), TTS-friendly text cleaning, selectable Edge TTS voices, adjustable silence auto-stop, and settings embedded in DSH settings dialog.
description.zh: 豆包式语音对话插件：聊天框麦克风按钮（按住说话）语音转文字并自动发送，AI 回复自动朗读。可选 LLM 转述精简（长回复压缩成口语再播，跟随当前对话模型）、朗读前清洗 markdown/emoji/特殊符号、Edge TTS 多种音色、静音自动结束时长可调，设置嵌入 DSH 自带设置弹窗（voice chat 类目）。

description.en: Selectable SearXNG, Brave, Tavily, Gemini Search Grounding, or Wikipedia backend for the native web_search tool, with Web settings and no implicit fallback.
description.zh: 为原生 web_search 工具提供可选的 SearXNG、Brave、Tavily、Gemini 搜索溯源或 Wikipedia 后端，支持 Web 设置且不进行隐式回退。

description.en: Tracks the agent's state as Yogācāra mental factors over a durable seed store, and feeds it back into the prompt as first-person inclination.
description.zh: 以唯识心所与种子藏记录 agent 的状态，并以第一人称倾向写回提示词。

description.en: Two-level model circuit breaker with failover: trip a model or a whole provider after repeated request failures and route the next request to a configured fallback.
description.zh: 两级模型熔断与回退：模型或平台连续失败后自动熔断，并把下一个请求路由到配置好的备用模型。

description.en: Agent-driven kanban board: one board per workspace, per-task agent sessions, and a guarded human/agent workflow (Backlog → To Do → In Progress → Review → Done).
description.zh: agent 驱动的看板：每个工作区一块看板、每个任务一个 agent 会话，以及带护栏的人机协作流程（Backlog → To Do → In Progress → Review → Done）。

description.en: Session cost estimate in a status bar at the bottom of the conversation (per-model token pricing, CNY) plus the live DeepSeek account balance via the official balance API.
description.zh: 对话底部的会话费用状态栏：按模型逐条计价估算 Token 费用（CNY），并实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额（官方余额接口）。

description.en: Per-workspace Skill and MCP enablement for DeepSeek Harness: control which skills and MCP servers new sessions load, per project.
description.zh: 按工作区（工程）启停 Skill 与 MCP：每个项目单独控制新会话加载哪些技能与 MCP 工具。

description.en: Delete a session from the UI (session-header button or sidebar row menu) or with the session_delete tool: stops and releases a running agent and its live session first, then removes the log directory, projection cache and workspace accounting, and cascades into the subagent sessions it owns while leaving forked branches untouched.
description.zh: 从界面删除会话（会话头部按钮或侧栏行菜单），或由 agent 调用 session_delete 工具：先停止并释放运行中的 Agent 与会话，再清理日志目录、投影缓存与工作区记账，级联删除它拥有的子代理会话（分叉分支不受影响）。

description.en: Evidence-driven goal verification plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Locks goals via /ultragoal and verifies completion against command exit codes and generated artifacts, preventing the model from falsely reporting task completion.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的证据驱动目标校验插件。通过 /ultragoal 锁定目标，并依据命令退出码与生成产物验证完成状态，防止模型虚报任务完成。

description.en: Composer expand/collapse toggle for the Web UI: a ⬆/⬇ button in the composer tool row grows the input to a tall 70vh writing view for long drafts.
description.zh: Web UI 输入框展开/收起：composer 工具行新增 ⬆/⬇ 按钮，一键把输入框扩大到 70vh 高度，方便写长 prompt。

description.en: Floating card showing your real position P&L (今日盈亏), Shanghai Composite Index, and intraday chart, auto-synced from the Tonghuashun investment-ledger — no manual watchlist setup.
description.zh: 悬浮卡片，自动同步同花顺投资账本的真实持仓盈亏，显示今日盈亏、上证指数和当日走势图，无需手动添加股票。

description.en: Cross-session agent messaging for DeepSeek Harness with session discovery, offline delivery, delivery receipts, and sender-session navigation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 跨会话 Agent 通信：支持会话发现、离线投递、投递回执与发送方会话导航。

description.en: Academic tools in TypeScript, no Python or MCP server: the Zotero library through its local API or zotero.org (search, annotations, full text, citation export; add by DOI / arXiv id, notes and tags when writing is turned on), starting Zotero when it is closed; paper search across arXiv, OpenAlex, Crossref, Semantic Scholar, PubMed and Europe PMC, plus CNKI and Google Scholar through a browser window; open-access full text, citations from the DOI registry, reference checking; 11 bundled skills.
description.zh: 学术工具，TypeScript 实现，不需要 Python 或 MCP 服务：通过本地 API 或 zotero.org 访问 Zotero 文库（检索、批注、全文、导出引文；开启写入后可按 DOI / arXiv 编号入库、写笔记、改标签），Zotero 没开时自动启动；同时检索 arXiv、OpenAlex、Crossref、Semantic Scholar、PubMed、Europe PMC，并通过浏览器窗口检索知网和 Google Scholar；阅读开放获取全文、从 DOI 注册机构取引文、核验参考文献；内置 11 个学术技能。

description.en: Search, monitor, interrupt, and batch-archive workspace subagents, featuring real-time activity streaming and an active-agent floating panel.
description.zh: 搜索、监控、打断与批量归档工作区子代理，支持实时活动/思考流式展示与活跃浮窗。

description.en: Tidy the model list of DeepSeek Harness: hide any model from the selector, rename models and channels while keeping the provider billing rate, and arrange both with arrows. Search, per-provider batch toggles, back to top, one-click restore. Display only — no provider configuration is rewritten.
description.zh: DSH 模型整理：整理并精简模型列表——隐藏任意模型、给模型和渠道改备注名（保留厂商计费倍率）、用箭头调整模型与渠道排序；支持搜索、渠道级批量开关、返回顶部与一键恢复。只改显示，不重写任何渠道配置。

description.en: DSH updater + official docs sync in Settings: one-click npm update of @deepseek-ai/dsh with live progress (npm output stream, elapsed timer, monotonic bar), multi-copy protection that only touches the running instance, source-tree mode via git pull, one-click PowerShell 7 install on Windows, incremental sync of the official docs/ with progress, and the dsh_docs_search / dsh_docs_read model tools.
description.zh: 设置页内的 DSH 更新器 + 官方文档同步器：一键以 npm 全局更新 @deepseek-ai/dsh 并带实时进度（npm 输出流、已运行计时、单调进度条），多副本保护只更新当前运行实例，源码树模式走 git pull；Windows 缺 PowerShell 7 时可一键安装；官方 docs/ 增量同步（按 blob sha 跳过未变文件）带进度条，并提供 dsh_docs_search / dsh_docs_read 模型工具。

description.en: DSH web-GUI pet runtime that renders any Codex spritesheet-atlas pet (v1/v2) as a draggable overlay: drag/wave/jump, v2 mouse-tracking eyes that follow the active mouse, live agent-status poses, progress bubbles, and an in-GUI atlas importer; ships one original CC BY-NC demo pet (nastya), and user pets live in ~/.dsh/pets.
description.zh: DSH 网页 GUI 实时桌宠：可把任何 Codex 桌宠图集（webp/png/gif，v1/v2 自动识别）转换为 DSH 中可拖拽的悬浮桌宠。支持拖拽/挥手/跳跃，v2 桌宠的眼睛实时追踪活动鼠标，随 agent 状态切换姿势；进度气泡反映工作状态；「设置 → 桌宠」图形界面可导入、切换与调整桌宠；内置一只原创示例桌宠（娜斯佳），用户桌宠存放在 ~/.dsh/pets。

description.en: Brain-inspired cognitive plugin: episodic, semantic, procedural and emotional memory with reinforcement-learning signals, a goal stack with time triggers, curiosity-driven autonomous web research and proactive initiatives.
description.zh: 受大脑启发的认知插件:情景、语义、程序与情绪记忆,带强化学习信号;目标栈支持时间触发器,好奇心驱动的自主网络研究与主动提议。

description.en: Finance data toolkit for DSH agents: number and currency formatting (incl. Chinese wan/yi units), return and CAGR math, valuation and profitability ratios, PV/FV, risk metrics, and a data-quality checklist.
description.zh: 为 DSH agent 提供金融数据工具包：数字与货币格式化（含中文万/亿单位）、收益与年化计算、估值与盈利比率、现值/终值、风险指标与数据质量清单。

description.en: DSH 远程目录（电脑端）：把本机 DSH 会话的事件流经 Cloudflare 隧道搬到手机，手机进入电脑目录并发起对话，公网只传文本。含激活码配对流程。

Bidi-safe RTL rendering for mixed Arabic and English text, a full Arabic interface pack (3,307 strings) registered through the DSH locale service, and three thmanyah cuts — Sans for the interface, Serif Text for reading, Serif Display for headings — placed behind whatever font the app itself is set to.
description.zh: 让 DSH 界面说阿拉伯语：混合阿拉伯文与英文的双向文本排版，通过 DSH 官方语言服务注册完整阿拉伯语界面包（3,307 条），并内置三款 thmanyah 字体（界面 Sans、正文 Serif Text、标题 Serif Display），置于应用自身字体设置之后。

description.en: Feishu/Lark IM channel for DeepSeek Harness agents with native thinking-process messages, approval cards, live goal and todo cards, workflow fan-out lines, session text search, and background job and subagent settlement notices. Access is bounded by the Feishu app's own visibility scope by design — anyone the app admits can drive the agent and answer its approvals unless the optional sender, group and approver allowlists are filled in.
description.zh: 飞书/Lark 深度通道：原生思考过程消息、审批卡片、goal/todo 实时卡片、workflow 展开行、会话全文检索、后台任务与子代理结算通知。其设计以飞书应用自身的可见性范围为访问边界——凡是应用允许触达的人都能驱动 agent 并回答它的审批请求，除非填写可选的发送者/群组/审批人白名单收窄。

description.en: macOS desk pet that lives outside the DSH page: a real always-on-top window that clears fullscreen Spaces, six states driven by local DSH, a native right-click menu with quiet mode and a session list, and a bundled skill that turns one photo into a full eighteen-pose skin on your own image tool and credentials; system Python and ctypes, no Electron and no dependencies.
description.zh: 装在 DSH 页面之外的 macOS 桌宠：一个真的置顶窗口，全屏 Space 也盖得住；六种状态跟着本地 DSH 走，原生右键菜单里有免打扰与会话清单；自带的 skill 用你自己的画图工具和额度，把一张照片变成整套十八个姿势的皮肤。跑系统自带的 Python 与 ctypes，不用 Electron，零依赖。

description.en: An Aether Gazer Verdandi-inspired DSH Web UI skin with light and dark backgrounds, wedding-themed chrome, responsive character art, and themed conversation and sidebar surfaces.
description.zh: 一款以《深空之眼》薇儿丹蒂为主题的 DSH Web UI 皮肤，包含昼夜背景、誓约婚礼装饰、响应式角色立绘，以及主题化的会话区与侧边栏。

description.en: Adds ChatGPT/Codex OAuth-backed Codex models and gpt-image-2 generation/editing to DSH without requiring an OpenAI Platform API key.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加基于 ChatGPT/Codex OAuth 的 Codex 模型及 gpt-image-2 文生图和编辑能力，无需 OpenAI Platform API Key。

description.en: 基于 DeepSeek Harness 的钉钉群聊常驻个人助理插件
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 数字员工常驻在钉钉群里，帮你统筹任务、接话决策、自动回复。

description.en: 为本地监听器预留足够的请求头预算，并在启动后退休旧启动 cookie，避免桌面欢迎握手被 431 永久锁死。
description.zh: 修复桌面版固定 profile 启动约 72 次后认证失败、再也进不去的问题，自动清理旧启动 cookie。

description.en: 将code-server（VSCode网页版）打包安装到dsh内的插件，快速实现专业的文件编辑。Package and install code-server (the web version of VSCode) as a plugin within dsh to quickly achieve professional file editing.
description.zh: 把 VS Code 网页版装进 DSH，直接在插件里专业地编辑文件。

description.en: 让大肥鱼在 DSH 中长期生活：自主刷 B 站、互动、长期记忆、成长、好友关系与完整经历持久化。
description.zh: 让大肥鱼在 DSH 里自主刷 B 站、交朋友、攒记忆，慢慢长成有自己生活的 AI 伙伴。

description.en: 给 DSH 模型每轮回填宿主实测的上下文占用，并阻止"上下文快用尽"的错判被压缩摘要继承。
description.zh: 每轮把宿主实测的上下文占用回填给模型，避免误判上下文快满而被压缩摘要带偏。

description.en: Full Throttle mode for DeepSeek Harness: a composer switch that injects a high-budget, no-holds-barred instruction into the system prompt.
description.zh: 在输入框加个「全速模式」开关，一键给系统提示词注入高预算、不设限的指令，让模型放开手脚干活。

description.en: DSH 插件：开工前刨根问底，把模糊需求问成明确需求，用户确认后才放行主任务 | DSH plugin that clarifies requirements before work starts
description.zh: 开工前先把模糊需求问清楚，等你确认后再动手，避免白干返工。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 手写墨迹开屏插件：按真实笔顺写出你的文字，收在鲸鱼锁标上；字体、文字与深浅色都在设置里配置。
description.zh: 按真实笔顺手写你的文字，收在鲸鱼锁标上，字体、文字和深浅色都能在设置里调。

description.en: Use OpenCode Zen free models in DeepSeek Harness with anonymous access or an optional API key
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里免费用上 OpenCode Zen 模型，匿名就能用，也可以填 API Key。

description.en: 像 Windows 资源管理器那样管理 DSH 的会话：目录树、标签、备注、回收站，不改动实际会话文件布局。 Manage DSH sessions the way Windows Explorer manages files: folder tree, tags, notes, recycle bin. Session files never move.
description.zh: 像用资源管理器一样整理 DSH 会话：目录树、标签、备注、回收站一应俱全，会话文件原地不动。

description.en: DSH 插件市场 — DeepSeek Harness 设置内一键安装社区插件，并提供公开目录站（浏览 / 复制安装命令）
description.zh: 另一款 DSH 插件市场：精选目录 + GitHub 实时浏览、中英互通搜索、安装前 fail-closed 静态安全审计（拦截安装钩子），每个插件可直接查看 README 且乱码自动修复。

description.en: 把已存在的固定 DSH大肥鱼 会话接到 QQ（OneBot/NapCat）并保留原上下文：白名单 + @/昵称必唤醒 + 概率唤醒，其余只记录，让大肥鱼成为你的群友；也可以把 agent 扔进群里当群友玩（不建议公共群）。 / Bridge one existing DSH session to QQ via OneBot/NapCat, keeping its context — fail-closed whitelist, @/nickname wake, configurable-probability wake.
description.zh: 把已有的 DSH 会话接到 QQ 群，保留上下文，白名单加 @ 或概率唤醒，还能让 agent 当群友聊天。

description.en: OpenCode on DeepSeek Harness — DSH plugin that keeps OpenCode Zen + Go free-tier models working: session affinity, gateway origin headers, and tool-schema fallback.
Dusk-coloured theme plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: design tokens, wallpaper and a floating mascot. Ships neutral placeholder art, bring your own.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面换上粉紫暮色皮肤，自带暗紫壁纸和悬浮吉祥物，装上就能用。

description.en: 让DSH能够支持远程访问Web的插件，可指定WebToken进行认证
一个把文件工作区直接带进 DeepSeek Harness WebUI，并为手机和第三方客户端提供稳定的远程接口插件。A bilingual file workspace and secure remote API for DeepSeek Harness WebUI and mobile clients.
description.zh: 把文件工作区搬进 DeepSeek Harness WebUI，还能给手机和第三方客户端提供稳定的远程接口。

description.en: 原神哥伦比娅主题的 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件：背景、蒙版与明暗配色。A Genshin Impact Columbina themed plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web: background, mask, and per light/dark color schemes.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness Web 换上原神哥伦比娅主题，自带背景、蒙版和明暗两套配色。

description.en: 记住你的偏好和决定，换个会话它自己会想起来；数据只在本机，随时能查能改。Remembers your preferences and decisions and brings them back in the next session; data stays on your machine.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一层本地记忆，靠触发信号在对的时候想起该记的事，数据全存本地单文件。

description.en: Omni Router - auto-routing DeepSeek Harness preset: simple tasks run directly, complex tasks plan first with approval gate.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一层任务级可靠性，自动判断何时介入、验证证据并处理失败，让结果更靠谱。

description.en: A PTC runtime for the DeepSeek Harness that runs the model's programs in moejs, a JavaScript engine written in Go
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 里的模型程序跑在 Go 写的 moejs 引擎上，执行更快更稳。

description.en: Open and drive every dsh on your tailnet from any dsh, with a complete phone layout.
description.zh: 在任意 dsh 上打开并操控你 tailnet 里的所有 dsh，手机端界面也完整好用。

description.en: Visual annotation plugin for DeepSeek Harness: select elements in local app previews and send structured UI feedback to your agent.
description.zh: 在本地应用预览里直接圈选界面元素，把结构化的 UI 反馈发给 AI 助手，改起来更准。

description.en: OAuth / subscription-plan LLM login (Grok, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex, Anthropic, OpenRouter): durable credential store with on-request token refresh, no repo patches (Grok/Copilot verified; use Codex with caution).
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入订阅制 LLM 服务，支持 Grok、GitHub Copilot、OpenAI Codex 等，用 OAuth 登录即可调用。

description.en: 把 WebUI 会话流中连续相邻的同工具调用合并为「主卡片+紧凑子行」树状展示，默认覆盖所有内置通用行工具 | Merges consecutive same-tool calls in the WebUI chat flow into a main-card + compact-child-rows tree view, all built-in generic tools by default
description.zh: Merge consecutive same-tool calls in the DSH WebUI chat flow into one card with compact child rows (all built-in tools by default).

description.en: DeepSeek Harness port of Claude Code Game Studios (CCGS v1.1.2, MIT): 76 skills, 49 agents, hook bridge.
description.zh: Claude Code Game Studios（CCGS v1.1.2，MIT）的 DeepSeek Harness 移植：76 个技能、49 个代理与钩子桥。

description.en: Adds Delete to the DSH sidebar session menu, moving the session — and its whole descendant tree when it has subagents — into a recycle bin that relocates the directory on disk (an atomic rename, never a copy), plus a sidebar bin panel with title and full-text search, workspace filter, sorting, per-session chat-log viewer, restore and permanent delete. Deleting also clears the workspace slot, the pin, the archive flag and the projection-cache row, so a restore puts the session back at its original sidebar position; permanent deletion also clears the schedules bound to it and removes the emptied project directory. Verified on DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2, with a whole-profile residue scan coming back clean.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话菜单中加入「删除」，把会话——带子代理时连同整棵后代树——搬进回收站（目录在磁盘上整体 rename 迁走，原子操作，不做复制），并提供侧栏回收站面板：标题与正文搜索、工作区筛选、排序、查看对话记录、恢复与彻底删除。删除时同时摘掉工作区槽位、置顶与归档标记以及投影缓存行，恢复时把会话放回侧栏原位置；彻底删除时清掉绑定该会话的定时任务并删除空掉的工程目录。已在 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2 上真机验证，删除后全盘无残留。

description.en: Connect DeepSeek Harness to 3Chat via OAuth for customer and conversation search, context retrieval, confirmed messaging, and batch-send tracking.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 3Chat，查询客户与会话、读取沟通上下文、确认后发送消息并跟踪批次进度。

description.en: Kilo Gateway free models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
description.zh: 在 DSH 里免密钥直接用 Kilo Gateway 和 OpenCode Zen 的免费模型，省去配置麻烦。

description.en: 一个dsh的终端样式插件，灵感来自Oh My Pi
按 agent_key 将 DeepSeek Harness subagent 严格路由到已注册 provider/model 的轻量插件
description.zh: 智能子代理路由与进化：按角色绑定 DSH 已注册的 provider/model；配合 Codex、Claude Code 等 provider 插件，可路由任意已注册模型，并保存工作区经验。
给 DeepSeek Harness 加上持久记忆，自动记住重要信息并在对话时按预算装回上下文。

description.en: FEMO插件版 — 可接入dsh的多智能体引擎，差不多能做所有事：我已经用femo和我的主agent玩了好几局狼人杀了，他抽到狼他还刀我！ 我在b站的宣传视频也是用femo剪的。 coding的时候，特别难找的bug、代码重构，我都会用femo来做。 我甚至用femo模式给我的主agent养了只宠物，她很开心。
description.zh: 接入 DSH 的多智能体引擎，能陪你玩狼人杀、剪视频、查 Bug、重构代码，还能给主 Agent 养宠物。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 多供应商额度监控插件：余额型 API 查询 + 限额型本地用量计量，侧边栏实时卡片 + 可视化配置。
description.zh: 在侧边栏实时盯着各家 AI 供应商的额度余额和用量，快超支时心里有数。

description.en: 把 WorkBuddy 的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness：自带 OAuth 设备码登录，不依赖桌面 App，支持多账号轮转与失败冷却。
description.zh: 不用装桌面 App，用 OAuth 设备码把 WorkBuddy 模型接进 DSH，支持多账号轮转和失败冷却。

description.en: Host-side degeneration guard for DSH: strips garbage code points, detects repetition collapse and discards the attempt before it enters history, and can retroactively decontaminate a poisoned session.
description.zh: 在模型输出跑偏复读时及时掐断，避免垃圾内容污染上下文，还能清理已被带坏的会话。

description.en: Host-side unattended job scheduler: runs one-shot agent tasks or shell commands on cron, interval, or one-time schedules, with persisted at-most-once dispatch state, overlap/misfire policies, and bounded run history.
description.zh: 宿主侧无人值守定时任务：按 cron 表达式、固定间隔或一次性时点运行一次性 agent 任务或 shell 命令，调度状态持久化（至多一次语义），支持重叠/错过策略与有界运行历史。

description.en: Evidence-backed ML phase gates, live visualization, and portable project bootstrap for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给机器学习项目加证据化阶段门禁，实时可视化流程，还能一键搭好可移植的项目骨架。

description.en: Modular execution discipline and autonomous steward for DSH: evidence-first routing across 44 canonical skills, durable state planning, verification gates, fail-streak recovery, and interactive web dashboard.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的模块化执行纪律与自主管家：覆盖 44 项规范技能的循证路由、持久化状态规划、验证门禁、失败恢复与交互式 Web 看板。

description.en: Perlica (Arknights: Endfield) themed tiered sound notifications: plan-ready, task-done, needs-your-input, and error tones; silent for plain chat, system-level playback (works in background), cross-platform (Windows/macOS/Linux), custom TTS sounds.
description.zh: 明日方舟终末地佩丽卡主题分级提示音：计划出方案 / 任务完成 / 需要你回应 / 出错四档独立音效，普通问答保持安静；系统级播放（窗口在后台也响），跨平台（Windows/macOS/Linux），支持自定义 TTS 语音。

description.en: 把 DSH Web 左侧栏的「工作区」重做为文件系统树双模式。核心原则： 工作区 = 目录强绑定——会话的 cwd 就是它所在的目录，环境真正隔离。
description.zh: 把 DSH 侧栏工作区改成文件系统树，会话与目录强绑定，环境真正隔离。

description.en: Native DeepSeek Harness plugin for controlling ComfyUI queues, history, outputs, models, uploads, and generation.
description.zh: 让 AI 助手直接操控本机或远程的多个 ComfyUI，查队列、看产出、传图、跑工作流。

description.en: 为DeepSeek Harness开发的右侧边栏尺寸持久化记忆插件
description.zh: 记住你拖过的右侧边栏宽度，按页签类型自动恢复，不用每次重新调。

description.en: Xiaomi MiMo search + multimodal tools for DeepSeek Harness agents: mimo_search/vision/audio/video/asr/tts
description.zh: 把小米 MiMo 的搜索、看图听音、语音转写和配音能力接进 DSH 智能体，让它能搜能看能听能说。

description.en: Local-first failure evidence capsules for DeepSeek Harness sessions
description.zh: 把失败的 Agent 会话整理成脱敏可审阅的证据 ZIP，本地保存方便排查复盘

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 画图插件：侧边栏整页面板，写提示词即出图，Q版/正常两档画风，三引擎可选（免费 Pollinations / 硅基流动 Kolors / 任意 OpenAI 兼容）。A text-to-image panel plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在侧边栏写句提示词就能出图，Q版或正常画风，三个出图引擎随便挑。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web 鲸鱼娘桌宠插件：任务进展、会话费用、账户余额、峰谷调度与互动养成。

DSH Math Modeling Team Plugin Pack: 2 role agent presets (modeling-coding / paper) for DeepSeek Harness, multi-folder Git collaboration + vision sub-agent; includes a full run on 2023 CUMCM-C. ｜ DeepSeek Harness 数学建模团队插件包：2 套岗位Agent预设(建模编程+论文)、多文件夹协同+识图子代理，含2023国赛C题全流程跑通示例。
description.zh: 给数模竞赛队伍准备的双角色智能体插件包，建模编程和论文写作分工协作，还能多文件夹 Git 协同。

description.en: 以"零额外安装"为设计原则：仅凭一个官方插件与 Windows 原生机制，让 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 获得桌面 App 式的一键启动体验。
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 网页版变成桌面应用，一键启动，还带托盘、原生通知和关窗即退。

description.en: OpenCode Zen free model adapter for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — DeepSeek V4 Flash Free, Nemotron 3 Ultra Free, MiMo V2.5 Free, Big Pickle
description.zh: 帮你把 OpenCode Zen 的免费大模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，零成本就能用各种强力模型写代码。

description.en: Model Capability Manager for DSH Web: thinking levels, context window, output caps, input modalities, gateway compat presets, EN/中文 UI.
description.zh: DSH 网页端模型能力管理插件：控制推理档位、上下文与输出上限、输入模态及网关兼容预设，双语界面。

description.en: Multi-account Google Gemini provider: picks the account with the most remaining quota, fails over on 429 with exponential cooldown, probes disabled accounts in the background, and ships a Chinese/English settings page.
description.zh: 多账号 Google Gemini 提供商：按剩余额度挑选账号，遇 429 指数退避切换，后台探活已禁用账号，附中英双语设置页。

description.en: Git-native AI learning OS with a GitLearnOS-exclusive DeepSeek Harness panel, targeted practice, local RAG, and learner-owned memory.
description.zh: 把Git变成你的AI学习管家，内置本地知识库问答和针对性练习，所有学习进度与记忆都由你个人掌控。

description.en: 将原作者 linshenkx 的 prompt-optimizer 移植到 DeepSeek Harness 的第三方插件（非官方）
description.zh: 把提示词一键优化成更清晰好用的版本，让 AI 回答更准更省心。

description.en: 梁文谷 DSH 插件：在 Web GUI 右上角显示当前算力错峰时段（已适配deepseek 2026.08.22 公布的最新峰谷收费政策，工作日 09:00–12:00 与 14:00–18:00 为梁文峰，其余时间含整个周末为梁文谷），并实时倒计时当前时段剩余时间；谷期跨天计算，直达下一工作日 09:00。
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 界面显示当前算力错峰时段（梁文峰/梁文谷），并实时倒计时剩余时间，帮你省钱。

description.en: Auditable vision and cross-platform Computer Use runtime for DeepSeek Harness — strict evidence, health-checked failover, original pixels, and Token accounting.
description.zh: Auditable vision and cross-platform Computer Use runtime for DeepSeek Harness with source-preserving evidence.

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多 IM 通道接入的网关插件：钉钉 / QQ / 个人微信，支持扫码绑定与流式回复。
description.zh: 把钉钉、QQ、微信接进 DeepSeek Harness，扫码绑定后就能在聊天里流式对话、审批工具。

description.en: Session deep links, full session export (markdown/JSON), approved cross-session messaging with pairing, and team roster, rotation and recovery tools for multi-session work.
description.zh: 会话深链、全量会话导出（markdown/JSON）、带配对的跨会话消息投递，以及团队 roster / 换届 / 恢复工具。

description.en: Companion to the official DSH plugin manager: pre-install quality gate, environment diagnostics, marketplace, and upgrades.
description.zh: 给官方插件管理器加装安装前质量门、五层环境诊断、插件市场和批量升级，装插件更放心。

description.en: Pins every request to the native max-effort tier and adds a per-model/per-mode reasoning-depth panel with a 0-20 capability slider, isolated Velocity/Apex profiles, and offline reasoning toolboxes. Distributed as an obfuscated build; commercial use allowed, reverse engineering closed.
description.zh: 将每个请求固定到原生 max effort 档位，并提供按模型与模式隔离的推理深度面板：0-20 能力滑块、独立的迅流（Velocity）/极境（Apex）配置档与离线推理工具箱。以混淆构建交付，允许商用，禁止逆向。

description.en: compact reasoning and tool activity groups for DeepSeek Harness Web.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的推理过程、工具调用和图片压缩成紧凑分组，界面更清爽。

description.en: The single plugin you need for DSH — develop, audit, isolate, and future-proof DeepSeek Harness plugins.
description.zh: DSH 插件开发一站式工具，帮你开发、审查、隔离并持续优化 DeepSeek Harness 插件。

description.en: Floating notes for the dsh web GUI: keep commands, credentials and snippets at hand, insert any note into the composer, save any selection as a note
description.zh: 在 dsh web 界面里挂个浮动便签，随手存命令、密码和代码片段，一键插进输入框。

description.en: Supervises a local workbuddy2api gateway process and exposes its models as an LLM provider, reading context windows and reasoning efforts from the gateway's own model endpoint.
description.zh: 托管本地 workbuddy2api 网关进程，把它的模型注册为 dsh 的模型提供方，上下文窗口与思考档位均从网关自身的模型接口读取。

description.en: My DSH plugins
description.zh: 一条命令装完的 DSH 插件合集，重启即用，管余额用量、注入 Agent 规则、还能控浏览器。

description.en: A searchable, sortable model picker for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI — provider groups, favorites, models.dev prices, context windows, live per-task token cost and a local-model filter. One-command install: dsh plugin add dsh-model-garden.
description.zh: 把模型选择变成可搜索排序的表格，还能看价格、上下文和实时花费。

description.en: A floating peak/off-peak tide card for DeepSeek Harness: i18n (en/zh/ru), local-time windows, session cost.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里挂一张悬浮潮汐卡片，按本地时间显示峰谷时段和会话花费，支持中英俄三语。

description.en: Auto Approve with Audit Agent
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面加一个自动审批预设，每次操作前由独立子代理快速审核，省去手动点确认的麻烦。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness adapter for Context Mode: in-process ctx_* tools for sandboxed code execution and an FTS5 knowledge base, plus context-window routing guidance.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 适配 Context Mode：进程内 ctx_* 工具（沙箱代码执行与 FTS5 知识库），并注入上下文窗口路由指引。

description.en: Adds a workspace-write++ permission that keeps file tools inside the workspace while skipping the Windows process sandbox for wildcard-allowlisted executables such as Git Bash.
description.zh: 增加工作区修改++权限档，文件工具仍锁在工作区，可用通配符放行 Git Bash 等程序以跳过 Windows 进程沙箱。

description.en: Project mode plugin for DSH Web GUI: sidebar entry, full-screen project manager, live per-project context injection (instructions + refreshable memory), session badge
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页版加个「项目模式」，把会话归到项目里，共享指令和记忆实时生效。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that aggressively saves tokens without affecting task quality: lossless head/tail truncation of tool results (default), grep-result folding, pressure-triggered dsh-compaction-basic delegation, and an LLM-summary CompactionEngine subclass for the aggressive mode. Saves 97.6% of input tokens on an 8-scenario synthetic suite, with all reductions routed through dsh event flow so model-visible = logged stays intact.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 设计的 token 节省插件：不损失任务效果。默认 conservative 档对工具结果做无损头尾裁剪与 grep 折叠；balanced 档在压力阈值委托 dsh-compaction-basic；aggressive 档以 LLM-summary 引擎子类化替换官方压缩。8 个合成场景累计节省 97.6% 输入 tokens，所有削减走 dsh 事件流，model-visible = logged 不变式仍成立。

description.en: a simple plugin to improve web UX/UI for "Deepseek Harness (dsh)"
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 优化侧边栏界面，提升浏览和操作体验，让工作区更清爽顺手。

description.en: Self-healing Cloudflare quick-tunnel pool for the dsh web GUI: floating widget with QR phone access, generational rotation, chase service worker and prompt-free credential handoff.
description.zh: 为 dsh web GUI 提供自愈式 Cloudflare 快速隧道池：浮窗控件、扫码手机访问、代际轮换、追踪 Service Worker，免提示凭据交接。

description.en: MySQL connector for DeepSeek Harness: configure multiple connections in the settings page with per-connection table allowlist and write permission, switch the active connection from the composer, and expose mysql_query / mysql_tables / mysql_execute tools to every agent preset.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MySQL 连接插件：在设置页配置多套连接（每连接可配表白名单与写权限），输入栏一键切换当前会话的连接，并为所有 Agent 预设提供 mysql_query / mysql_tables / mysql_execute 工具。

description.en: Bring OpenCode Zen's free models to DeepSeek Harness — zero config, no API key, catalog discovered live from upstream
description.zh: 把 OpenCode Zen 的免费模型一键接入 DeepSeek Harness，无需配置和 API 密钥，即插即用。

description.en: AI can write resume text, but templates may still look wrong, pages may overflow, whitespace may remain, and small edits can destabilize the layout. dsh-resume provides an end-to-end DSH workflow for truthful content refinement, template selection, A4 layout tuning, visual review, and tailored resume versions for different job-search scenarios.
description.zh: AI 写简历容易，但写完常会遇到模板不合适、排版溢出、页面留白过多，以及改一处导致全局变形等问题。dsh-resume 专注解决手动修改简历繁琐、低效的问题，让 DSH 覆盖从内容撰写、模板选择到排版调优的完整简历工作流，并支持针对不同求职场景产出合适的简历版本。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: use your OpenAI Codex (ChatGPT Plus/Pro) subscription through OAuth
DSH Web UI 右侧小游戏面板：18 款离线小游戏（恐龙跳一跳 / 俄罗斯方块 / 坦克大战 / 扫雷 / 2048 / 数独 / 吃豆人 / 跟枪练习等），可扩展游戏注册表，等待模型回复或修 bug 时的摸鱼神器
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面右侧挂个可拖动的小游戏面板，内置 18 款离线小游戏，等模型回复时摸鱼解闷。

description.en: A visible Chrome window per DSH session: 16 chrome_* tools (open/status/close/navigate/tabs/snapshot/screenshot/click/click_at/fill/type/press_key/hover/scroll/evaluate/wait), a Chrome tab in the Web GUI with a live screencast view (screenshot-heartbeat fallback for idle pages), tab management, window controls and a screenshot history.
description.zh: 每个 DSH 会话一个可见的 Chrome 窗口：16 个 chrome_* 工具（打开/状态/关闭/导航/标签/快照/截图/点击/坐标点击/填写/输入/按键/悬停/滚动/执行脚本/等待），Web GUI 的 Chrome 标签页提供实时画面流（静止页截图心跳兜底）、标签页管理、窗口控制与截图历史。

description.en: DSH 插件 UI 调试神器：让 AI 在真实 Chrome 中帮你看界面、点按钮、拖组件，一键安装零配置
description.zh: 让 AI 在真实 Chrome 里帮你看界面、点按钮、拖组件，调试 UI 一键搞定，装完就能用。

description.en: Stable, editable PPTX generation for AI agents — semantic IR in, native DrawingML out. DSH plugin + Claude Code plugin + CLI. | 给 AI agent 的稳定可编辑 PPTX 生成：语义 IR 进，原生 DrawingML 出。DSH 插件 / Claude Code 插件 / CLI。
Deepseek Harness 宠物插件
Mobile shell UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness web: overlay drawer, full-width conversation, settings sheet, marketplace with hot-load installs.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 网页版在手机上也能顺手用，窄屏自动切换抽屉导航和全宽会话，还能装插件、调参数。

description.en: CC Switch-style token consumption statistics for the dsh web GUI: per-request usage log, real-consumption hero, request-time-bucketed trend chart, per-model peak/off-peak list pricing, per-project and per-model stats, and account balance.
description.zh: dsh 网页端 CC Switch 风格 Token 消耗统计：按请求的用量日志、真实消耗 Hero、按请求提交时间分桶的趋势图、按模型峰谷牌价计费、项目/模型统计与账户余额。

description.en: Session-based task board in the sidebar: drag sessions into todo/doing/review/done columns, create sessions with model and reasoning-effort selection, trash with restore, notes, export/import.
description.zh: 侧边栏会话化任务看板：拖拽会话到待办/进行中/评审中/已完成四列，新建会话可选模型与推理强度，回收站可恢复，支持备注与导出导入。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 侧栏用量与成本面板：官方峰谷计价 · 1M 上下文 · 词勋段位 · 成就与热力图
description.zh: dsh client bundle: a sidebar usage & cost dashboard — token stats, peak/off-peak aware per-model pricing, membership ladder, achievements and a daily heatmap.

description.en: Question-Driven Discovery research workflow for DeepSeek Harness with a QDD Agent Preset, durable Human and Auto runs, and an auditable research panel.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Question-Driven Discovery 科研工作流，提供 QDD Agent Preset、持久化 Human 和 Auto 运行，以及可审计的研究面板。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 凭证加密插件，通过设置密码使用AES-256-GCM+SHA3-256实现的全流程加密+校验，运行时临时解密，内存安全。
description.zh: WebUI-managed encrypted credentials for DeepSeek Harness: one file, plaintext until a password is set, then AES-256-GCM ciphertext under an Argon2id-derived key with SHA3-256 fingerprints; per-request decryption, unlock lockout, leak-guard output redaction, and shipped-code integrity self-checks.

description.en: Cron scheduler with a sidebar UI: run shell, Python or Node scripts, skills, or agent tasks on a schedule, with push notifications and session archiving.
description.zh: 定时任务调度器：侧栏管理界面，按 cron 表达式或间隔执行脚本、技能与 Agent 任务，支持完成后推送通知与会话归档。

description.en: Multi-channel push for DeepSeek Harness: Server酱, PushPlus, Bark, DingTalk, WeCom, Telegram, Feishu, ntfy, custom webhooks and more, configurable from the settings panel and callable by other plugins via the pushNotifier service.
description.zh: DSH 多渠道消息推送插件：支持 Server酱、PushPlus、Bark、钉钉、企业微信、Telegram、飞书、ntfy、自定义 Webhook 等，可在设置面板配置多个渠道，并通过 pushNotifier 服务供其他插件调用。

description.en: Configurable DSH usage statistics: a sidebar text/card widget plus a detail dialog with per-provider and per-model breakdowns, cache-hit rates, token trends, and latency details (TTFT and duration).
description.zh: 高度可配置的 DSH 用量统计插件：侧边栏文字/卡片组件加统计弹窗，提供按提供方与按模型的请求/Token 统计、缓存命中率、趋势图与首字节/总耗时明细。

description.en: Archived-session manager for DSH Web UI: reopen an archived session and keep chatting, unarchive it back in place, or hard-delete a session — grouped panel with message search and native view sync.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的归档会话管理器：重新打开已归档会话并继续对话、取消归档恢复原位、彻底删除会话，支持分组浏览、消息搜索与原生视图同步。

description.en: 复刻 DeepSeek Chat 蓝鲸配色的皮肤，亮色/深色跟随系统外观。
description.zh: 复刻 DeepSeek Chat 蓝鲸配色的皮肤，亮色/深色跟随系统外观。

description.en: Codex-style conversation outline for DeepSeek Harness Web: a right-edge rail with hover preview and click-to-jump
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页右侧生成对话大纲，悬停预览、点击跳转，快速定位历史消息。

description.en: Turn the official DeepSeek Harness WebUI into a natural desktop experience.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 官方网页版变成像原生桌面软件一样好用，开箱即用。

description.en: 发现问题(checkup) → 修复交付(fix) → 质量复查(review) 的对抗式闭环插件：基于官方 workflow 引擎的检查/修复/复查工具集
description.zh: 发现问题→修复交付→质量复查的对抗式闭环工具集。

description.en: 一个只有副作用的DeepSeekHarness插件：在你跟 AI 聊得神魂颠倒时，提醒你「该去跟碳基生命开会了」。
description.zh: 飞书会议提醒：一个只有副作用的 dsh-plugin，在你跟 AI 聊得神魂颠倒时提醒你「不得不去跟碳基生命开会了」。

description.en: Verified plugin marketplace for DeepSeek Harness — discover, inspect, install, and remove DSH plugins from the Web UI.
description.zh: 在网页端直接浏览、安装和管理 DeepSeek Harness 插件，发现经过验证的插件市场。

description.en: A corner HUD for DeepSeek Harness that shows your session's token pressure, per-model cost, and daily/monthly usage at a glance, with an editable budget and balance that tracks spending for you. 右下角常驻的 Token 仪表盘：实时看会话压力、按模型估算花费。预算和余额点一下就能改，每天每月用了多少都有记录。
description.zh: 实时监控 Token 消耗的 HUD 插件，帮你掌握用量、估算成本、查看历史曲线和每日统计。

description.en: DeepSeek API balance and 24-hour usage dashboard in Settings, with estimated spend, token counts, request counts, and an hourly timeline.
description.zh: 在设置页展示 DeepSeek API 余额与最近 24 小时用量，包括估算消费、Token、请求次数和按小时时间线。

description.en: Biomimetic memory system for DeepSeek Harness: a single SQLite store (node:sqlite, WAL) whose Markdown tree is kept as a read-only mirror; memory tools, frozen-snapshot injection at session start, graded approval gating, on-demand extraction of the current session, near-duplicate merging, an archive and supersede lifecycle, memory metabolism (dream), memory pins, semantic recall over local embeddings, and the /memory command.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的生物仿生记忆系统：以单一 SQLite 库为唯一事实来源（node:sqlite，WAL），Markdown 树仅作只读镜像；含 memory 工具、会话启动时的冻结快照注入、分级审批门、按需把当前会话抽取成记忆、近重复合并、归档与取代生命周期、记忆代谢（dream）、记忆钉、基于本地嵌入的语义检索，以及 /memory 命令。

description.en: Piano-key style conversation navigation bar for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI
description.zh: 钢琴键风格会话内导航条：一根键锚定一条用户消息，悬停显示消息预览气泡与阶梯展开，点击平滑跳转。

description.en: DSH 插件：OpenCode Go 额度圆环 —— 输入框模型选择器左侧的进度圆环，点击切换 5小时/每周/每月用量（OpenCode Go quota ring for DeepSeek Harness Web）
description.zh: 模型选择器左侧的 OpenCode Go 额度圆环：点击循环切换 5 小时/每周/每月用量窗口，按紧急程度着色（绿/蓝/橙/红），悬停显示百分比与重置倒计时。

description.en: Codex-style diff review inside DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: Codex-style diff review for DeepSeek Harness: review every uncommitted change of the current project (staged, unstaged and untracked), inspect per-file unified diffs, and accept (stage) or revert (discard) changes — one file at a time or all at once.

description.en: On-demand vision for text-only DeepSeek Harness (DSH) sessions: images become markers, and a vision_describe tool sends only image + question to an OpenAI-compatible vision model
description.zh: 给纯文本的 DeepSeek Harness 会话按需加视觉能力，图片变标记，需要时再调用视觉模型识别。

description.en: Remote access for the DSH Web GUI: LAN QR access, cloudflared quick tunnels, and frp reverse proxying via your own server, with a built-in auth portal.
description.zh: Web GUI 远程访问：局域网二维码直连、cloudflared 快速隧道、frp 自有服务器反代，内置登录门户，并放行设置接口。

description.en: Remote access for the DSH Web GUI: LAN QR access, cloudflared quick tunnels, and frp reverse proxying via your own server, with a built-in auth portal.
description.zh: Web GUI 远程访问：局域网二维码直连、cloudflared 快速隧道、frp 自有服务器反代，内置登录门户，并放行设置接口。

description.en: Archived-session management: browse archived sessions, unarchive them, or clear them out.
description.zh: 归档会话管理：浏览已归档会话，支持恢复（取消归档）与清空。

description.en: AtomGit plugin bundle for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): atomgit-skills workflows + ag CLI + platform-hosted AtomGit/GitCode MCP tools
description.zh: AtomGit 插件包：内置六个 AtomGit 技能（Issue 规划、Issue 实现、PR 审查、PR 合并、CLI 版本发布、GitHub 镜像），并集成 ag CLI 与平台托管的 MCP 工具（仓库/分支/Issue/PR/搜索）。

description.en: LLM provider that runs the locally installed Claude Code CLI as the model backend, so requests go through an existing Claude subscription instead of a metered API key; native tool calls are bridged over MCP.
description.zh: LLM 供应商：把本机已安装的 Claude Code CLI 作为模型后端，请求走已订阅的 Claude 账号，无需按量计费的 API key；原生工具调用经 MCP 桥接。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness environment diagnostic tool: dsh_doctor checks env, profile, config, bundles, mount, port, health, and disk
description.zh: dsh-doctor — DSH 插件（工具）

description.en: Visual GitHub login without a terminal: in-window device flow, token synced into the gh CLI, and host status/launch endpoints.
description.zh: 零终端的 GitHub 可视化登录插件：窗口内完成设备码授权，令牌同步进 gh CLI，附宿主端状态与唤起接口。

description.en: A visual multi-agent workspace for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web.
description.zh: 把 DSH 工作区里的子 Agent 变成可视化办公室，实时查看状态、屏幕和操作，轻松管理多 Agent 协作。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话删除能力，支持侧边栏 ⋮ 菜单入口
description.zh: 无需重启即可清理运行中 DeepSeek Harness 的会话数据，包括文件、存储和记录，方便管理。

description.en: Codex-style desktop pet: a floating animated sprite in the corner that mirrors the agent's running state (working, waiting, failed, done).
description.zh: Codex 风格桌面宠物：右下角悬浮动画精灵，随 agent 运行状态实时变化（工作、等待、报错、完成）。

description.en: 归档对话查看 (archived-conversation-viewer)：在 DSH 设置页查看、恢复与删除归档会话的 Cordis 插件
description.zh: 归档对话查看 (archived-conversation-viewer)：在 DSH 设置页查看、恢复与删除归档会话的 Cordis 插件

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: 账户余额 + 会话费用（/balance /cost 命令、deepseek_billing 工具、Web UI 双胶囊），官方价格每 12 小时自动同步
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin: 账户余额 + 会话费用（/balance /cost 命令、deepseek_billing 工具、Web UI 双胶囊），官方价格每 12 小时自动同步

description.en: Chat with, monitor, and approve your DSH agents from WeChat via the iLink gateway: text both ways, session targeting, digest heartbeats, and numbered approval prompts.
description.zh: 通过 iLink 网关在微信里与 DSH agent 聊天、监控与审批：双向文本、会话切换、进度摘要与编号审批提示。

description.en: CocoSgt/dsh-inspector 声明为 DeepSeek Harness 生态插件。
