description.zh: CocoSgt/dsh-inspector 声明为 DeepSeek Harness 生态插件。

description.en: Bidirectional Lark/Feishu controller for DeepSeek Harness with project and session routing, interactive cards, approvals, attachments, and task controls.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 双向控制器，支持 Project 与 Session 路由、交互卡片、审批、附件和任务控制。

description.en: A model-native meta-agent plugin for DeepSeek Harness that uses the underlying model’s reasoning and planning capabilities to synthesize task-specific workflows at runtime and coordinate tools and subagents.
description.zh: 让模型自己当总指挥，按任务现场编排工作流，自动调度工具和子代理干活。

description.en: This plugin exports a reusable function that takes a file path or a Buffer, extracts the content via @firecrawl/anydoc, and returns GitHub‑Flavored Markdown (GFM). It also includes configuration options and an example usage.
description.zh: 把 PDF、Word 等各种文档一键转成 Markdown，让 Agent 直接读懂文件内容。

description.en: Select part of a conversation and ask about it in a right-side side chat; bring AI replies back to the main chat directly or as a summary.
description.zh: 选中对话片段，在右侧面板的侧边聊天中提问（按会话隔离）；AI 回复可原文或摘要后带回主会话。

description.en: Bring your existing Agent Skills (SKILL.md) library to DSH: discover skills across Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini paths, inject a progressive-disclosure index, and load bodies on demand.
description.zh: 把已有的 Agent Skills（SKILL.md）技能库带进 DSH：扫描 Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini 技能目录、注入渐进式索引，按需加载技能正文。

description.en: A deepseek harness plugin for tensorlake sandbox
description.zh: A deepseek harness plugin for tensorlake sandbox

description.en: Third-party DSH WebUI enhancement plugin: custom backgrounds, theme colors, prompt presets, token/context visibility, and manual compact.
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页界面换壁纸、调主题色，还能存常用提示词、看 Token 用量，并支持手动压缩对话。

description.en: Weather tool: current conditions and multi-day forecasts via Open-Meteo (free, no API key).
description.zh: 查任意城市实时天气和多日预报，数据来自 Open-Meteo，免费免注册免 API key。

description.en: A 60-frame theme-aware monochrome whale-dive animation with reactive water for the DSH Web turn status: embedded assets, seamless closed-loop playback, a reduced-motion PNG fallback, and lifecycle-clean removal.
description.zh: DSH Web 回合状态旁的 60 帧随主题适配的单色鲸鱼深潜动画：传播式水面、无缝闭环、资源内嵌、减少动态效果 PNG 回退，且随生命周期完整清理。

description.en: Hook DeepSeek Harness into a Hermes pipeline: dispatch-spec template, model-tier routing, orchestrator-run quality gates, git single-writer rule, as a SKILL.md pack (bundle installable).
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接进 Hermes 管线：派单 spec 模板、模型档位路由、质量门、git 唯一写者约定，SKILL.md 技能包（bundle 可安装）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for persistent, isolated Sprites: remote builds, tests, previews, checkpoints, and long-running services.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin for persistent, isolated Sprites: remote builds, tests, previews, checkpoints, and long-running services.

description.en: QQ Bot text and image channel plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: QQ Bot text and image channel plugin for DeepSeek Harness

description.en: Playwright-powered browser automation for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: dsh-browser — DSH 插件（工具）

description.en: Pin Git commits to the environment's own author identity; env-var injection overrides all `git config` settings.
description.zh: git 提交固定使用环境自身作者身份，环境变量注入压过一切 `git config` 设置。

description.en: Feynman learning-mode plugin: teach → teach-back → judge → re-explain loop rendered as rich HTML lesson cards (mermaid diagrams + shiki code highlighting).
description.zh: 用费曼学习法帮你真正学会知识：讲解、复述、评判、再讲解循环，生成图文并茂的课程卡片。

description.en: Floating draggable token usage statistics panel for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在页面右下角挂个可拖动的浮层，实时看 Token 用量、缓存命中率和每日热力图。

description.en: Channel integration for Telegram.
description.zh: 将 Telegram 频道接入 DeepSeek Harness，方便接收消息和发送通知。

description.en: Model-agnostic Computer Use for DeepSeek Harness: isolated browser, Windows native helper, third-party vision perception, and a Chrome Cook…
description.zh: 模型无关的 Computer Use：隔离浏览器 + Windows 原生控制。

description.en: DSH web sidebar session-search enhancement: one-click toggle between title search and content search; content results aggregated per session with title and hit snippets.
description.zh: DSH web 侧边栏会话搜索增强：标题搜索与内容搜索一键切换，内容搜索按会话聚合展示标题与命中片段

description.en: Evidence-first conclusion gate that cross-checks first-hand claims against a durable per-session tool-activity index, blocks unverified guesses and tracks blocked-versus-converted metrics.
description.zh: 实证门——按会话将第一手结论与持久工具活动索引交叉核验、拦截未验证猜测并以台账统计拦截与转化，中英双语界面。

description.en: Wraps globalThis.fetch to route DeepSeek Harness model-API requests through an HTTP/SOCKS proxy by target domain, leaving all other requests on the direct connection, without modifying Harness source.
description.zh: 把 globalThis.fetch 包一层，按目标域名让 DeepSeek Harness 的模型 API 请求走 HTTP/SOCKS 代理、其它请求保持直连，全程不改 Harness 源码。

description.en: Keeps plugins you have edited (third-party or built-in) as local git repos: deploys an exact commit only after it builds and passes checks, reverts a change that crashes dsh right after it is applied, merges origin updates (npm or git) into your edits, and can open an agent session that squashes your edits into one commit on top of the original release (backup branch first).
description.zh: 把你改过的插件（第三方或内置）保存为本地 git 仓库：只部署已构建并通过检查的指定提交，应用后导致 dsh 崩溃时自动回滚，把 npm 或 git 源的更新合并进你的修改，并可打开智能体会话，把你的修改压缩为原始发布版本之上的一个提交（先建备份分支）。

description.en: WeChat Official Account typesetting workbench: renders Markdown into inline-styled HTML you paste straight into the WeChat editor, with a sidebar panel, 11 themes and five model tools for block-level revision.
description.zh: 微信公众号排版工作台：把 Markdown 渲染成带内联样式的 HTML，粘进公众号编辑器即成排版；配右侧栏面板、11 套主题与五个模型工具做块级改稿。

description.en: Web chat entry for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar button opening chat.deepseek.com in a dedicated desktop window under dsh-desktop, with in-webview fallback for plain web environments.
description.zh: 网页对话入口插件：侧边栏一键打开 chat.deepseek.com 独立窗口（dsh-desktop 桥接），纯网页环境自动回退内嵌打开。

description.en: Input prediction for the DSH composer: your next prompt suggested as ghost text after each turn, accepted with Tab. (autocomplete / input prediction / prompt suggestion)
description.zh: 给 DSH 输入框加上输入预测：回合结束后自动建议你的下一句话，Tab 一键采纳；输入时按会话历史做前缀补全。（输入预测 / 自动补全 / 提示词建议 / 补全）

description.en: Windows Computer Use for DeepSeek Harness with screenshots, UI Automation, 18 desktop tools, per-Agent activation, human-input handoff, approval prompts and prebuilt native workers.
description.zh: Windows 桌面操控：让 DeepSeek 看屏幕、点鼠标、敲键盘。提供截图、UIA 定位、18 个桌面工具、按 Agent 激活、人机共用和操作审批，原生组件随包提供。

description.en: Memory Lake as a persistent memory layer for dsh: memory_search, memory_remember, and memory_forget tools over the memorylake CLI, a session status line, and guided setup/diagnostic skills, sharing one ~/.memorylake identity and memory set with the Claude Code and Codex plugins.
description.zh: 将 Memory Lake 作为 dsh 的持久记忆层：基于 memorylake CLI 的 memory_search、memory_remember、memory_forget 三个工具，会话状态行，以及引导安装/诊断 skills，与 Claude Code、Codex 插件共享同一 ~/.memorylake 身份与记忆。

description.en: Attention reminders: frame badge, tab-title count, and a status-colored whale favicon for sessions waiting for input or finished unopened.
description.zh: 会话需要你时三处同时亮起：角标、标签页标题计数、按状态换色的鲸鱼 favicon。

description.en: Novel generator: builds a world snapshot along a story timeline and, from the latest snapshot and the most recent chapters, deduces the next chapter. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2.
description.zh: 小说生成器：按时间线生成世界快照，通过世界快照和最近章节自动推演新章节。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: Adds a "Work Roles" tab and a pixel-art office overlay to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: 508 built-in role cards (The Agency 255 + agency-agents-zh 253) with search, EN/ZH toggle and department filter; draggable Canvas 2D pixel characters that stand, type and pace, with idle chat that can plug into AI. One-command npm install, no dsh source changes.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 主窗口添加「工作角色」页签 + 像素办公室浮层：内置 508 张角色卡（The Agency 255 + agency-agents-zh 253），支持搜索 / 中英切换 / 分部分类；Canvas 2D 像素小人可站立、打字、踱步，闲聊台词可接 AI。一条命令安装，不改 dsh 源码。

description.en: Tencent CloudQ integration: AIOps chat mode with usage, inspiration, artifact and architecture panels.
description.zh: 腾讯云智能顾问集成：CloudQ 对话模式，附用量、灵感、制品与架构图面板。

description.en: Local-first usage and cost meter for the DSH web UI: composer button with live session cost and balance; panel with a stacked per-model daily/7-day chart priced per effective list-price interval (official pricing page synced daily), monthly usage tiers with a canvas share card, 30/50/85% context-pressure warnings with one-click /compact, budget alerts, and an in-panel npm update check with one-click update.
description.zh: 本地优先的用量与费用仪表：输入框下方按钮显示实时费用与余额，面板含按模型堆叠的当日/近 7 天柱状图（按刊例价生效区间计价、官方定价页每日同步）、本月消耗段位与画布分享卡片、30/50/85% 上下文压力三档预警与一键 /compact、预算提醒，以及面板内 npm 检查更新与一键更新。

description.en: Arrow-key navigation for the DSH Web GUI: Up/Down switch sessions inside the current workspace and Left/Right switch workspaces, reading session identity from the client controllers rather than the DOM, and yielding the keys back to the composer while a draft is being edited.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的方向键导航：上/下在当前工作区内切换会话，左/右切换工作区；会话身份来自客户端控制器而非 DOM；输入框存在草稿时把方向键交还给光标。

description.en: Per-workspace project kanban board: nine kanban_* model tools for agent-driven planning plus a browser board UI, with disk persistence, undo, templates, and archiving.
description.zh: 按工作区（项目）隔离的项目看板：9 个 kanban_* 模型工具供 Agent 规划时写卡，另带浏览器看板 UI，支持磁盘持久化、撤销、模板与归档。

description.en: Adds an AIignore tab to the right sidebar: scores the open conversation and its folder across five dimensions, blocks reads of build output, lockfiles and logs before they reach the model, and writes the .aiignore rules for them one button at a time.
description.zh: 在右侧栏新增 AIignore 标签页：按五个维度给当前对话和所在目录打分，在构建产物、锁文件、日志被读进模型之前把它们拦下，并能一键把这些规则写进 .aiignore。

description.en: Composer mic for the Web UI: tap-to-monitor live transcription and hold-to-talk, with host Edge TTS reply reading that streams while the model generates, echo-pause during reading, and tap-to-stop.
description.zh: 输入框麦克风：点击持续监控、按住对话；浏览器语音识别逐字上屏，回复由 host Edge TTS 边生成边朗读，朗读时暂停识别防回声，点击可停止。

description.en: Migrate Codex (OpenAI Codex CLI / Desktop) MCP servers, skills, instructions, memory and session history into DeepSeek Harness with a visual panel or CLI, with dry-run previews and secrets migrated as-is.
description.zh: 把 Codex（OpenAI Codex CLI / Desktop）的 MCP 服务器、技能、全局指令、记忆与会话历史迁移进 DeepSeek Harness（DSH），支持可视化面板与命令行，带 dry-run 预览。

description.en: Map and routing tools: driving/transit/walking/bicycling route planning, geocoding and POI search via free OSM/OSRM data by default, with an optional Amap (高德) key for better China coverage.
description.zh: 地图与路径规划工具：驾车/公交/步行/骑行路线、地理编码与 POI 搜索。默认零 key 使用 OSM/OSRM 免费数据，可选配置高德 key 获得更优的国内覆盖。

description.en: Adds per-Workspace category trees to the Web sidebar, with nested categories, drag-and-drop session assignment, category-scoped session creation, and category deletion that archives contained sessions.
description.zh: 为 Web 侧边栏添加按 Workspace 隔离的分类树，支持嵌套分类、拖拽归类会话、在分类中新建会话，以及删除分类时归档其中的会话。

description.en: Pomodoro focus-and-break timer for DSH Web with configurable cycles, a draggable mini panel, and in-app, sound, and browser notifications.
description.zh: DSH Web 番茄钟：提供可配置专注/休息循环、可拖动迷你面板，以及站内提醒、提示音和浏览器通知。

description.en: Knowledge-base-driven agent preset: wiki long-term memory, a web KB UI, a management page and optional UI polish.
description.zh: 知识库驱动的 Agent 预设：wiki 长期记忆、网页知识库、管理页、可选界面润色。

description.en: Adds file and folder drag-and-drop attachments to the Web UI, with composer cards, persistent history, and workspace-backed paths.
description.zh: 为 Web UI 添加文件与文件夹拖放附件，提供输入栏卡片、持久化历史记录与工作区路径。

description.en: Design-artifact skill adapted from Anthropic canvas-design / web-artifacts-builder: turns a design brief into a self-contained HTML/SVG artifact (posters, infographics, landing pages, charts, component mockups) with a pre-delivery quality checklist and an anti-AI-look pattern list.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的设计稿生成 skill（改编自 Anthropic canvas-design / web-artifacts-builder）：把设计需求做成可直接打开的自包含 HTML/SVG 设计稿（海报、信息图、落地页、图表、组件稿），内置交付前质量清单与「去 AI 味」反模式清单。

description.en: Network optimization for the DSH web UI: reduces transfer size with caching and compression to greatly speed up page loading, plus a connection-drop indicator and automatic reconnection. Ideal for users pursuing peak performance or using unstable networks.
description.zh: dsh网页端网络优化：通过缓存与压缩技术降低传输，从而大幅提升网页加载速度；同时提供网络断连指示与自动断网重连功能。非常适合追求极致性能或网络不稳定用户使用。

description.en: Highlights parts of speech (nouns green, verbs red, adjectives/adverbs purple) in rendered DSH Web Markdown, with light/dark palettes, toggles, and stream-aware updates.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 已渲染的 Markdown 中做词性高亮：名词绿、动词红、形容/副词紫，支持深/浅色板、词性开关与流式防抖。

description.en: Codex App Server model provider using a local Codex login, with session reuse, Harness tool bridging, native action traces, and durable generated-image projection.
description.zh: 使用本地 Codex 登录的 Codex App Server 模型提供方，支持会话复用、Harness 工具桥接、原生动作轨迹和生成图片持久化。

description.en: Academic writing toolkit for DSH agents: paper outlines, title and abstract skeletons, GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA citations, phrasing QA, and a pre-submission checklist.
description.zh: 为 DSH agent 提供学术写作工具包：论文大纲、标题与摘要骨架、GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA 引文格式化、措辞质检与投稿前清单。

description.en: Image and video wallpapers for the DSH web workspace: auto-detected GIF/APNG/animated WebP/PNG/JPEG/MP4/WebM backgrounds with blur, brightness and dimming, tint-following UI, per-component transparency, and one-click preset wallpapers.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供图片/视频壁纸背景：GIF/APNG/动图 WebP/PNG/JPEG/MP4/WebM 魔数自动识别，压暗/亮度/高斯模糊，界面色调与字体颜色自动跟随背景，各组件独立透明度，预置壁纸一键应用。

description.en: Points web_search at a self-hosted SearXNG instance instead of the native route: pages until maxResults is satisfied, and reports degraded coverage when engines fail so a thin result set is not read as a thin web.
description.zh: 把 web_search 指向自建的 SearXNG 实例而非原生搜索路由：自动翻页直到满足 maxResults，并在引擎失败时报告覆盖不全，避免把稀少的结果误读成网上本就没有内容。

description.en: Cross-session task delegation for DeepSeek Harness: spawn durable top-level sessions and send them tasks, read or steer them by base62 session alias, and approve their sandbox escalation requests through an approval bridge that refuses destructive deletes.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话派活与协同：新建顶层任务会话并投递任务，用 base62 会话别名读取或干预，并通过审批桥批准子会话的沙箱提权——命中破坏性删除一律强制拒绝。

description.en: Deep research as an agent mode: one reviewed loop that plans, researches in adaptive parallel rounds driven by the gaps the researchers themselves declare, synthesises a cited report and then reviews it adversarially, instead of a script the model rewrites per call. Questions the round budget never reached are named in the report rather than dropped.
description.zh: 把深度研究做成一种代理模式：一条经过审阅的固定循环——先规划，再按研究员自行声明的缺口进行自适应并行轮次，综合出带引用的报告，最后对其做对抗性审阅——而不是让模型每次现写脚本。轮次预算未能覆盖的问题会在报告中被逐一点名，而不是被悄悄丢弃。

description.en: Windows system and custom desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness events: task completed, failed, running, awaiting approval, and awaiting answer. Click-to-jump to the session.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness事件的Windows系统和自定义桌面通知：任务已完成、失败、正在运行、等待批准和等待答复。单击以跳转到会话。

description.en: Point-and-shoot screenshot capture: a system floating window turns a new screenshot (or copied image) into an Obsidian note with comments and key-point marking, instant OCR through the host DSH multimodal model (no extra API key needed, Tongyi Qianwen as fallback), a duplicate-screen guard, per-day merging, and an optional evening AI organization pass.
description.zh: 指哪拍哪截图入库：系统级悬浮窗把新截图（或复制图片）一键存入 Obsidian 笔记，支持注释与「重点」标记、用宿主 DSH 多模态模型即时识别文字（零配置、无需另配 key，可回落通义千问）、同屏去重、按天合并，并可在晚间用 AI 整理归类、打双链并生成当日总结。

description.en: Renders image, video, and audio paths and URLs from DSH conversations inline, with workspace-confined local reads and an optional ComfyUI proxy.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中内联显示图像、视频和音频路径及 URL，并提供工作区受限的本地读取与可选的 ComfyUI 代理。

description.en: Progressive tool disclosure: a deferred tool group costs one catalog line instead of its full schemas until the model loads it with tool_search, with one switch per group in Settings and each group measured against the live registry.
description.zh: 渐进式工具披露：被延后的工具组在每次请求中只占目录里的一行，模型用 tool_search 加载后才拿到完整 schema；设置页为每个组提供一个开关，各组开销按当前工具注册表实测。

description.en: Activity overview pane for the DSH web UI: running, awaiting-response and recent sessions with child agents, progress, model and reasoning level in one sidebar pane.
description.zh: DSH Web 活动会话总览窗格：将运行中、等待响应与近期活跃的会话集中到一个侧边窗格，含子代理层级、进度、模型与推理级别。

description.en: Creates and inspects RecoWork local-agent-project workspaces through two bounded DSH tools and a web workspace card.
description.zh: 通过两个受限的 DSH 工具和网页工作区卡片，创建并检查 RecoWork local-agent-project 工作区。

description.en: Identity-gated Tailscale access to the Web GUI with dsh still bound to loopback: a 127.0.0.1 proxy published by `tailscale serve` admits a request only when the Tailscale login it stamps is allowed, with an optional per-device allowlist, so the privileged /api methods behind the loopback check — Settings, Models, Plugins — answer without dsh being told to trust a remote host.
description.zh: 在 dsh 仍绑定回环地址的前提下，为 Web 界面提供基于身份的 Tailscale 访问：由 `tailscale serve` 对外发布的 127.0.0.1 代理，仅当其标记的 Tailscale 登录账号在允许列表内时才放行请求，并可另按设备白名单限制；这样受回环检查保护的特权 /api 方法（设置、模型、插件）无需让 dsh 信任远程主机即可正常响应。

description.en: Rewrites the Chinese copy of a market-installed plugin into English using a model already configured in the harness — automatically when the plugin is installed, then live-reloaded. Each file is translated in one whole-file pass, validated by a real parser where one exists (node --check for JavaScript, JSON and YAML parsers otherwise) and handed back to the model with the error for up to three repair attempts; files above 48 KB, or that never parse, fall back to a line-range pass that checks every returned line against the original for structure. Trigger phrases and locale tables can optionally be preserved rather than translated, and the untouched original is kept beside the file as a .zh.bak.
description.zh: 用你已经配置好的模型，把从市场安装的插件里的中文文案改写成英文——安装时自动运行，随后热重载。每个文件整体翻译一遍，凡是有解析器的都会实际校验（JavaScript 用 node --check，其余用 JSON、YAML 解析器），失败时把报错交回模型，最多修复三次；超过 48 KB 或始终无法解析的文件，回退到按行区间翻译，逐行与原文做结构比对。触发短语与本地化表可以选择保留而不翻译，未改动的原文件保留在同目录下的 .zh.bak。

description.en: Config-driven lifecycle hooks, including context injection: declare event, handler and outcome in YAML, where the handler is an in-harness tool (MCP included), a shell command or an HTTP endpoint, and the outcome is model-visible context, a denied tool call, or fire-and-forget.
description.zh: 以配置驱动的生命周期钩子，并支持上下文注入：在 YAML 中声明事件、处理器与结果——处理器可以是进程内工具（含 MCP）、shell 命令或 HTTP 端点，结果可以是模型可见的上下文、拒绝该次工具调用，或触发即忘。

description.en: Docker tools for agents: ps/images/logs/inspect/exec/manage/health with JSON output, env-configurable CLI path, approval-gated exec and zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: Docker 工具：ps/images/logs/inspect/exec/manage/health 七工具，JSON 输出、DSH_DOCKER_PATH 环境变量、exec 审批门、零运行时依赖。

description.en: A guarded local fetch provider for the ctx.web seam — the backend dsh does not ship for its own web_fetch tool. Every redirect hop is re-resolved and checked against the non-routable ranges, with a streamed size cap and a content-type allowlist.
description.zh: ctx.web 接口的本地受控抓取提供方——dsh 自带完整的 web_fetch 工具，却没有随附后端。每一跳重定向都会重新解析并对照非公网地址段校验，另有流式大小上限与内容类型白名单。

description.en: Database explorer panel for DeepSeek Harness: connect SQLite, MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, ClickHouse, Redis, Elasticsearch and Qdrant from a third Conversation tab — browse schemas, page through data, edit cells, insert rows, design and drop tables, run SQL, import/export CSV/JSON/SQL/Markdown, and draw editable E-R diagrams. Read-only connections enforce statement-level allowlists, agent tools ship read-only by default with an opt-in write flag, and every write (including refused attempts) lands in an auditable log. Ships an MCP stdio server exposing the same connections to external AI clients.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的数据库浏览器：在对话区第三个页签连接 SQLite、MySQL/MariaDB、PostgreSQL、SQL Server、MongoDB、ClickHouse、Redis、Elasticsearch 与 Qdrant——浏览结构树、分页查看数据、编辑单元格、插入行、建表/改表/删表、执行 SQL、CSV/JSON/SQL/Markdown 导入导出，以及可编辑的 E-R 关系图。只读连接按语句白名单硬拒绝写路径，agent 工具默认只读、写工具需显式授权，所有写操作（含被拒尝试）进入可查可删的审计日志；附带 MCP stdio 服务器，把同一份连接暴露给任意外部 AI 客户端。

description.en: A thinking level stored per provider and model, so reasoning effort outlives the session it was set in and also reaches subagents, which dsh never asks. The in-session picker still wins, and a model with no row keeps its provider default.
description.zh: 按提供方与模型保存思考等级：推理强度不再只属于设置它的那次会话，还会应用到 dsh 从不询问的子代理。会话内的手动选择依然优先，没有配置的模型保持提供方默认值。

description.en: Version management for dsh: inspect the installed version against every npm channel or version line, install or downgrade in one click, stream the install log live (rollback-snapshot copy progress, npm extraction progress, elapsed time), roll back instantly from local snapshots, and automate the cycle with a policy engine (silent auto-update, execution windows, daily checks). Never stops npm mid-install — a wedged run is only stopped after an hour, and a half-committed global tree is detected and repaired from the pre-install snapshot automatically. Confirms before installing a found update, auto-restarts the host after install, and falls back to a mirror when the primary registry is unreachable.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 版本管理：对照各 npm 通道或版本线查看已装版本，一键安装或降级，安装日志实时流出（回滚快照复制进度、npm 提取进度、已运行时长），从本地快照秒级回滚，用策略引擎（静默自动更新、执行时间窗、每日检查）托管整个流程。绝不在安装中途终止 npm——卡死的任务要等一小时才会停止，半提交的全局安装树会被自动检测并从安装前快照修复。检查到新版本时弹窗确认是否立即更新，安装后自动重启宿主，遇到 registry 不可达时自动回退到镜像。

description.en: DeepSeek-styled cross-session token usage, request count, and tiered cost analytics dashboard.
description.zh: 仿 DeepSeek 官方 Token 统计，跨会话 Token 消耗、请求次数与峰谷分时费用统计看板。

description.en: Renders HTML, React (JSX/TSX), Vue, SVG, Mermaid and Markdown written by the agent in an isolated iframe sandbox with SSE hot-reload, and adds a DOM click inspector, side-by-side visual diff, a responsive device matrix and one-click Vite ZIP export.
description.zh: 在隔离的 iframe 沙箱中实时渲染 Agent 生成的 HTML、React (JSX/TSX)、Vue、SVG、Mermaid 和 Markdown，支持 SSE 热重载，并提供 DOM 点击检查器、并排视觉对比、响应式设备矩阵和一键 Vite ZIP 导出。

description.en: Per provider/model generation concurrency, with a settings card: a cap on how many sessions may stream at once, enforced at the stream and again at subagent spawn, where a fan-out past the cap waits in a FIFO queue instead of failing.
description.zh: 按提供方/模型限制并发生成，并附带设置卡片：限定同时进行流式生成的会话数，在流式调用与子代理派生两处强制执行；超出上限的扇出会进入 FIFO 队列等待，而不是直接失败。

description.en: Start and detach standalone chats without a mandatory workspace, keeping DSH's native workspace UI intact.
description.zh: 无需强制绑定工作区即可新建和分离独立会话，同时保留 DSH 原生的工作区界面。

description.en: Shows a Live2D character in the bottom-right corner of the DSH web UI: blinking, breathing, lip-sync while talking, seven moods, and a speech bubble with its own chat, memory, corpus and stickers. Models are never bundled; every user drops in their own folder.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页右下角放一个 Live2D 角色：会眨眼、会呼吸、说话时嘴动、心情变了眉毛跟着动，用自己的对话气泡聊天，记得住之前说过的，能喂语料，也会配表情包。模型不用内置，谁装谁放自己的文件夹。

description.en: Goal mode and autonomous execution plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a sticky top banner keeps the current goal visible across turns while the agent works toward it autonomously.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的目标模式与自主执行插件：顶部吸附横幅在每轮对话中保持当前目标可见，同时 Agent 自主推进完成目标。

description.en: Installs a Web-profile helper that diagnoses and writes MCP config so Codex, Cursor, or Claude Code can spawn dsh --profile codex.
description.zh: 在 Web profile 中安装适配层，检测并写入 MCP 配置，供 Codex、Cursor 或 Claude Code 拉起 dsh --profile codex.

description.en: Two-way WeChat bridge for DeepSeek Harness via the iLink protocol: bind your personal WeChat with a QR scan and chat with a local DSH agent from the chat box (text, images, voice-to-text, files); a web settings panel handles binding/start/stop/status, project-session binding continues the conversation on desktop, proactive wechat_notify pushes include throttling, and the pure-Node daemon runs on Windows/macOS/Linux.
description.zh: 基于 iLink 协议的 DSH 微信双向桥：扫码绑定个人微信后在聊天框直接与本机 DSH Agent 对话（文字/图片/语音转文字/文件），Web 设置面板管理扫码绑定/启停/状态，支持绑定项目会话跨端续聊，agent 可主动 wechat_notify 推送（内置节流），纯 Node 守护进程，Windows/macOS/Linux 三端通用。

description.en: Keeps a pool of models and routes every agent step to one of them with its reasoning effort set — configured by clicking in the composer, no JSON needed. The router takes over the composer's model cell, so one control shows the session's model and reasoning effort alongside the router's own settings. Three authorization scopes (model / effort / full) where a manual pick only counts in the scope that owns it, and in effort scope the router is bound to the one model you choose. Task presets with per-model weights, vision routing for image steps, session signals (active todo, context pressure, token budget, subagent depth), and an optional semantic task classifier. Thinking stays on, because DeepSeek rejects a thinking-enabled request whose history contains a tool call made with thinking off.
description.zh: 维护一个模型池，把每个 agent 步骤路由到池内模型并设置其思考等级——全部在输入栏点选配置，不需要写 JSON。路由面板接管输入栏的模型位置，同一个控件里既有本会话的模型与思考等级，也有路由自身的设置。三种授权范围（模型 / 思考 / 全部）：手动选择只在所属范围内生效；「思考」范围下路由只作用于你选定的那一个模型。另有按任务类型给模型加权的预设、带图任务的视觉分流、会话信号（当前 todo / 上下文压力 / token 预算 / 子 agent 深度），以及可选的语义任务分类。思考等级保持常开，因为 DeepSeek 会拒绝思考关闭时产生的工具调用。

description.en: Replaces the DSH Web connection provider to skip BrowserAuth entirely so the Web UI opens directly without pasting the random startup token, gated to nine verified DSH version pairs with strict host/client matching that sleeps automatically on unknown or mixed versions, and reverts fully on uninstall; web profiles only.
description.zh: 替换 DSH Web 的连接提供方以整体跳过 BrowserAuth，打开 Web 地址即可直接使用、无需抄写启动 URL 中的随机 token；按九个已验证的 DSH 版本对严格成对门控，遇到未知或混用版本自动休眠，卸载即完全恢复官方行为，仅限 Web profile。

description.en: DSH right-sidebar plugin that compares two git commits, builds a manual-test checklist from the impact scope, and supports fail notes, screenshots, task attachments, and defect submission to Yunxiao, GitHub, GitLab, or a webhook.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏插件：对比两个 git 提交，根据影响面生成手测清单，支持失败备注、截图、任务附件，以及向云效 / GitHub / GitLab / Webhook 提交缺陷。

description.en: Tripo 3D generation skills driving the tripo-cli through the shell: text-to-3D, image-to-3D, rigging with locomotion clips, decimation and LOD chains, and export to GLB/FBX/OBJ/STL/USDZ/3MF, with headless device login for both China-mainland and international accounts; installable as `tripo-dsh`.
description.zh: 通过 shell 驱动 tripo-cli 的 Tripo 3D 生成 Skill：文生 3D、图生 3D、绑骨与走跑动画、减面与 LOD 链，导出 GLB/FBX/OBJ/STL/USDZ/3MF，支持国内站与海外站账号的无头设备码登录；npm 包名 `tripo-dsh`。

description.en: Adds Codex-like projectless drafts with per-project draft switching and date-and-topic directories created on first send; supports Windows DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 without an archive patch or external installer.
description.zh: 提供类似 Codex 的无项目草稿、各项目草稿切换及首次发送时按日期和主题创建目录的功能；支持 Windows DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2，无需归档补丁或外部安装器。

description.en: Password-gated public access for the DSH Web GUI through quick or named Cloudflare Tunnels, with HTTP/WebSocket proxying and an in-app directory picker.
description.zh: 通过快速或命名 Cloudflare Tunnel 为 DSH Web GUI 提供密码保护的公网访问，并代理 HTTP/WebSocket 流量、改用应用内目录选择器。

description.en: One-click OAuth (PKCE) connect to Qichacha (qcc.com) MCP services in DeepSeek Harness: dynamic client registration, token auto-refresh, and dynamic mcp-client configuration.
description.zh: 一键 OAuth（PKCE）授权接入企查查 MCP 服务：动态注册客户端、token 自动刷新、动态配置 mcp-client 条目，一次授权覆盖全部企查查数据服务。

description.en: Context indicator for the DeepSeek Harness composer: segmented occupancy, compression points, and the native auto-compaction line (flashes red when crossed). Supports preview-then-confirm compaction (/bc), seamless handoff (the old session becomes "History N" while the new one keeps the name; a relay bar above the composer shows the full handoff chain with two-way jumps), and message pinning with stale-pin labels. Thresholds, colors, and auto-archive after handoff are configurable in Settings.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 输入框上下文指示器：分段显示会话占用、压缩判断点与 DSH 原生自动压缩线（越线红闪）。支持预览后确认压缩（/bc）、无痕交接（旧会话归档为「历史 N」、新会话继承原名，输入框上方接力条可回看完整交接链并双向跳转）、锁定消息防压缩与失效标注。设置里可配阈值、配色与交接后自动归档开关。

description.en: Find keywords in the current conversation or across every session, with highlight and jump.
description.zh: 在当前对话或所有会话里按关键词查找，命中可高亮、可跳转。

description.en: Smart checkpoints, workspace safety guards and instant rollback for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供智能检查点、工作区安全防护和即时回滚。

description.en: Deterministic code security review: 40+ rules, secret entropy detection, staged-diff review, SARIF export, baseline acceptance, SBOM-lite dependency inventory and health self-check. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: 确定性代码安全审查：40+ 规则、密钥熵检测、staged diff 审查、SARIF 导出、基线接受、SBOM-lite 依赖清单与健康自检。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: LAN access for the official DSH Web UI through a gated reverse proxy: DSH keeps its own loopback binding, and a second port adds a password gate, self-signed HTTPS and per-device pairing that can be revoked individually, with a QR code to open it from a phone.
description.zh: 把官方 DSH Web UI 安全地开放到局域网：不改动 DSH 自身的回环绑定，另开一个带密码门禁、自签 HTTPS 与可逐个吊销的设备配对的反向代理端口，并提供手机扫码入口。

description.en: 深鲸记忆：跨会话热记忆（每轮注入 MEMORY/USER + memory 工具读写）+ 记忆体检、瘦身归档、记忆包、诊断报告、文档只读。本地明文、零依赖、不上传数据。
description.zh: 给跨会话记忆做体检、去重、瘦身和打包迁移，本地明文不上传。

description.en: Adds Windows-native toast notifications and a system tray icon to dsh: alerts when the agent finishes, stops, or errors, with a tray menu to reopen the web page or quit the background process.
description.zh: 为 dsh 添加 Windows 原生 Toast 通知与系统托盘图标：agent 完成、停止或出错时弹通知，托盘菜单可重新打开网页或退出后台进程。

description.en: Host-neutral durable DAG workflows for Agents with CLI, MCP, on-demand Skills, triggers, replay, and a visual Canvas.
description.zh: 面向 Agent 的 Host-neutral 持久化 DAG 工作流，提供 CLI、MCP、按需 Skill、Trigger、重放和可视化 Canvas。

description.en: One stylesheet that retypesets the DSH conversation to measured Codex metrics: 14/22 px body, tighter headings, lists and blocks, a rounded quote bar, and Tidy Tables with a themed header, row/column rules, full-width short tables and contained scrolling for wide tables; no settings or DOM rewriting, with real before/after captures.
description.zh: 一张样式表，按实测的 Codex 版式重排 DSH 对话页：14/22 px 正文，收紧标题、列表与块级节奏，使用圆角引用条，并把表格补成带主题化表头、行列分隔、短表铺满和宽表容器内滚动的 Tidy Tables；无设置项、不改写 DOM，仓库内附真实前后对比图。

description.en: Shows which graft index a dsh session is serving and whether it still matches the code, and gives the model graft_ask, graft_grep, graft_callers, graft_skeleton and graft_map as native tools.
description.zh: 显示当前 dsh 会话所用的 graft 索引、以及它是否仍与代码一致，并把 graft_ask、graft_grep、graft_callers、graft_skeleton、graft_map 作为原生工具交给模型。

description.en: Personal finance plugin for DSH with structured Beancount ledger tools.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的个人记账插件，基于结构化的beancount账本工具。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-moneypal
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for MoneyPal#dsh-moneypal

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: DIY the DSH UI typography and colours: 10 built-in regions plus box-select region creation, each with its own Chinese and English font, size, line-height, weight (100-900), italic switch and text colour picker; 18 Chinese and 18 English fonts ship in the pickers, every region can be overridden by one unified setting, and named theme presets can be saved, applied, renamed and deleted. Random font assignment and random colour generation work for the whole UI or per region, and 8 fonts (LXGW WenKai, Smiley Sans, ZCOOL KuaiLe, Comic Neue, Baloo 2, Fredoka, Nunito, Caveat) can be downloaded and installed with one click (only Comic Neue ships in the package) alongside your own .ttf/.otf files, with a factory-default reset that restores the shipped palette. A 字 floating ball opens the panel, which carries a collapsible quick-start guide, and position and settings persist across restarts. The ball is shown or hidden from the DSH settings floating-ball section together with the other two balls, which share one 130-skin catalogue with a per-ball sync switch.
description.zh: DIY 你的 DSH 界面字体与颜色：10 个内置区域 + 框选建区，每区域独立设中英文字体、字号、行距、字重（100–900）、斜体开关与文字颜色取色器；内置 18 款中文字体与 18 款英文字体，支持全局统一覆盖，主题方案可保存、应用、重命名与删除。随机字体可按整站或单区域生成，配色可随机生成高区分度颜色；另有 8 款字体（霞鹜文楷、得意黑、站酷快乐体、Comic Neue、Baloo 2、Fredoka、Nunito、Caveat）可一键下载安装（仅 Comic Neue 随包），也支持选本地 .ttf/.otf 安装，并可一键恢复出厂默认配色。右下角「字」悬浮球打开面板，面板内含可折叠的快速上手栏，位置与配置重启后依然保留。可在 DSH 设置页「悬浮球导航」分区与另两个球一起显隐，三球共享 130 款皮肤且各带同步开关。

description.en: File explorer for the dock workbench: tree browsing of the session workspace with create/rename/copy-paste/delete, drag-and-drop import and paste of local files and clipboard images.
description.zh: dock 系列文件浏览插件：侧边栏目录树浏览会话工作区，支持新建/重命名/复制粘贴/删除、拖放导入、粘贴本地文件与剪贴板图片。

description.en: Detects which conversation model an account is being served: launches concurrent throwaway probe conversations, scores each streaming chain-of-thought by how its paragraphs open, and cancels probes that read as the older model within seconds. Includes an offline self-check that replays 13 hand-labelled chains-of-thought through the same classifier.
description.zh: 检测账号当前被分配到哪个对话模型：并发发起一次性探测会话，按段落开头的写法为流式思维链打分，读起来像旧模型的在数秒内中止。附带离线自检，用同一分类器回放 13 条人工标注的思维链。

description.en: Context-aware next-message suggestions in the DSH composer, with repeated Trigger cycling and explicit user review before sending.
description.zh: DSH 输入框的上下文感知下一句建议：重复 Trigger 可持续换一条，发送前始终由用户确认。

description.en: Selection quoting and anchored annotations across DSH chats and document previews: numbered quote blocks stay visible in the composer and in sent messages and click back to the source, notes from docx / PDF / Markdown / code / Excel-range previews collect into one batched send, and each note can be dictated by voice.
description.zh: DSH 会话与文档预览里的划词批注：带编号的引用块在输入框和已发送消息里始终可见、点一下跳回原文；docx / PDF / Markdown / 代码与 Excel 选区批注可攒起来一次性发送；批注框支持语音输入。

description.en: Host-side connector for the DSH Mobile iOS app: dials a self-hostable WSS relay so the phone can reach the DSH sessions on this computer over 4G/5G, without a public IP or a VPN; the relay only authenticates and forwards.
description.zh: DSH Mobile 的电脑侧连接器：连上可自建的公网 WSS 中转，手机在 4G/5G 下即可访问这台电脑上的 DSH 会话，电脑不需要公网 IP 也不用组网；中转只做鉴权与转发。

description.en: HarmonyOS development suite for DSH: a right-sidebar HiLog inspector (live stream with level/logger/text filters) and an ArkUI Inspector (screenshot pick, collapsible component tree, node properties with search, box model), two tree sources — the DevEco debug channel (declared padding/margin/border and custom component names) and the uitest accessibility tree — an .ets viewer with ArkTS syntax highlighting, DevEco Studio/CLT toolchain and device management, plus the harmony_ui_tree agent tool. 21 remote methods, 82 unit tests.
description.zh: HarmonyOS 全栈开发套件：右侧边栏提供 HiLog 检查器（实时流与级别/包名/关键词过滤）与 ArkUI Inspector（截图点选高亮、可折叠组件树、节点属性搜索、盒子模型），两种树源——DevEco 调试源（ark 调试链路，提供 padding/margin/border 声明值与自定义组件名）与 uitest 无障碍树；.ets 查看器提供 ArkTS 语法高亮；注册 harmony_ui_tree agent 工具供对话内取组件树；设置页管理 DevEco Studio/CLT 工具链与 USB/网络设备。21 个 Remote 方法，82 个单元测试。

description.en: Usage statistics: a usage and reference-cost panel for DeepSeek Harness with today, 7-day, 30-day, all-time and custom ranges aggregated by hour or day; a model filter and a per-model breakdown of requests, input and output tokens, cache, reference cost and share; a model-share card showing the top four models by total tokens with the rest grouped as others; a reference price list generated from opencode Zen and DeepSeek's published rates, with DeepSeek models billed by Beijing weekday peak/off-peak windows and Chinese public holidays; a pricing-match dialog to point an unmatched model at a reference model or type per-million rates by hand; reference cost switchable between ¥ and $ at a fixed 1 USD = 7 CNY; and a yearly heatmap drawn only with theme variables, with no third-party chart library.
description.zh: 用量统计：DeepSeek Harness 的用量与参考成本面板，含今日 / 近 7 天 / 近 30 天 / 全部 / 自定义范围并按小时或天聚合；模型筛选与按模型明细（请求数、输入/输出 Token、缓存、参考成本、占比）；按总 Token 显示前 4 个模型、其余归入「其它」的模型占比卡；参考价目由 opencode Zen 与 DeepSeek 官方定价生成，DeepSeek 型号按北京时间工作日高峰/空闲与法定节假日分档计价；未匹配的模型可在「定价匹配」里指定参考模型或手填单价；参考成本可在 ¥ / $ 间按固定汇率 1 USD = 7 CNY 切换；年度热力图只用主题变量绘制，不引第三方图表库。

description.en: Five palettes for DeepSeek Harness — mono, warm sand, indigo, moss and a custom three-colour palette — each rebuilt in OKLCH for light and dark, with text and surface contrast solved per palette. Includes config export/import codes and a high-contrast mode.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的五套配色（黑白、暖砂、靛蓝、苔绿、自定义三色），明暗两模式各自用 OKLCH 重算整条色阶，并按配色求解文字与承载面的对比度；附配置导入导出短码与高对比档。

description.en: Select text in the DSH Web GUI and ask about it in place (floating button, or the Alt+Q shortcut): an independent subagent that inherits no parent context answers, streaming into a side card hosted by the native right sidebar, dsh-better-sidebar, or a built-in overlay — and the question can be routed to the main conversation instead.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面划词就地追问（浮出按钮，或 Alt+Q 快捷键）：答案由不继承父上下文的独立子代理流式产出到侧边卡片，承载面为原生右侧栏 / dsh-better-sidebar / 内置浮层，也可把问题改为落回主对话。

description.en: IM channel bridge: WeChat (ilinkai) / QQ / Feishu with proactive push — wake the channel bot from scheduled tasks and deliver AI replies to your phone.
description.zh: IM 渠道桥：微信（ilinkai）/ QQ / 飞书接入，支持主动推送——定时任务可唤醒渠道 bot 并把 AI 回复推送到手机。

description.en: Project-level memory built around a ledger whose structure the AI designs per project; the plugin only handles detection, injection, write-back, archiving and git. Memories are split by meaning: the active ledger holds current state, the turn journal is append-only, and decisions, the goal tree and lessons are one-card-per-file (with a multi-dimension index over the card folders); the fundamental principles file can be changed only by the user. There is a single compaction mode: before compacting, the AI sorts the work into three buckets - what must stay in context and is re-injected verbatim, what is written to the project's _stash/ for later lookup, and what is dropped. When a conversation is opened in a container workspace holding several projects, it can be locked to one sub-project (the lock lives in the plugin's own home and survives restarts; it leaves no marker in your project). Also an activity log with five levels, where L4 stores the user's own words verbatim (never injected, queryable on demand). Before each compaction a verbatim capsule (user quotes, raw errors, changed files) is written to disk, and both the capsule and its source material survive a restart; a handoff document lets a new conversation resume the previous one. 21 tools, 12 subcommands, 39 settings (one of them switches whether the settings panel or each project's manifest wins). Runs locally, no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 项目级记忆，核心是台账：台账的结构由 AI 按项目类型自行决定，插件只负责检测、注入、回写、归档与 Git 配合。记忆按语义分开放 —— 活跃台账是当前状态、回合流水只追加、关键决策/目标树/经验教训各是一卡一文件（另有卡片目录的多维索引表），根本原则只有用户本人能改。压缩方式只有一种（分流后压缩）：压缩前先让 AI 把这一段分成三个桶 —— 留上下文的压缩后逐字注回、以后要查的落进项目 _stash/、已被取代的丢掉。对话建在装着多个项目的总工作区上时，可以把它锁定到某个子项目（锁记在插件自己的家，跨重启保持；不在你的项目里留任何标记）。另有活动日志 L0–L4，其中 L4 逐字存档用户原话（不注入上下文，可按需查）。每次压缩前把用户原话、报错原文、改过哪些文件落盘成一份逐字胶囊，重启后仍能取到（素材与胶囊分别落盘、跨重启保留）；再用交接单让新会话接上上一次的工作。21 个工具、12 个子命令、39 项设置（其中一项可切换「以设置面板为准 / 以项目清单为准」）；纯本地运行，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Telegram duty gateway: phone-message task loop on a dedicated duty session, global approval forwarding with inline approve/reject buttons, telegram_ask choice questions, duty/local toggle with a web duty banner, zh/en messages, zero idle tokens.
description.zh: Telegram 值班网关：手机消息任务闭环（专属值班会话）、值守模式全局审批转发（内联同意/拒绝按钮）、telegram_ask 选项提问、值守/本地切换与网页横幅、中英双语消息、空闲零 token。

description.en: An independent approval subagent judges every sandbox escalation, with a configurable model and an audit log.
description.zh: 由独立审批子代理裁决每次沙箱提权，可配置审批模型并带审计记录。

description.en: Project-scoped Git credentials: forge accounts (GitHub, Gitea, GitLab, Bitbucket or a custom host) live in the right-sidebar "Git Forge" tab, are granted per project, and reach the agent as an HTTPS credential helper so the token never enters the conversation. Pushes to a host the project has not granted are rejected.
description.zh: 项目级 Git 凭据：forge 账号（GitHub、Gitea、GitLab、Bitbucket 或自定义域名）在右侧栏「Git 凭据」标签页里管理并可按项目授权，再由生成的凭据 helper 交给 agent 走 HTTPS 推送，token 不进对话；未授权 host 的推送会被拦截器直接拒绝。

description.en: Fetches up-to-date, version-pinned library documentation and code examples from context7.com for DSH agents via context7_search and context7_get_docs tools.
description.zh: 通过 context7_search 与 context7_get_docs 工具，为 DSH 智能体从 context7.com 获取最新、可锁定版本的库文档与代码示例。

description.en: Passcode marketplace inside DeepSeek Harness: enter a six-character code to unlock and install plugins shared by creators, plus themes, backup, updates and diagnostics.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 口令插件市场：输入 6 位口令解锁并安装创作者分享的插件，附带主题、备份、更新与诊断。

description.en: Markdown conversation theme plugin — 4 built-in themes with light and dark variants, user-editable CSS themes, system-aware auto-switching, an in-browser editor with syntax highlighting and save-time validation, and a theme selection that persists across reloads and tabs. Also ships a version-history panel. Windows and DSH Desktop supported.
description.zh: 对话 Markdown 主题插件——4 套内置主题（浅/深双档）、可自行编辑的 CSS 用户主题、跟随系统自动切换、内置编辑器（语法高亮 + 保存校验）、选中主题在刷新与新标签页后保持，并附带版本台账面板；支持 Windows 与 DSH Desktop。

description.en: One-tap connect Agnes language, image and video models into DSH (off by default), with image recognition and thinking level filled in automatically. After signing in to the Agnes console (re-login uses AGNES_PASSWORD), you can see the quota windows (5-hour requests, weekly requests, daily images, video), account-wide cumulative usage, and a usage pill beside the input box. AgnesCode desktop models can be connected too (Windows only), re-reading the desktop app login when the token expires, with rate-limit hits backing off on their own.
description.zh: 一键接入 Agnes 的语言、生图、视频模型到 DSH（默认关），自动填入图片识别与思考强度；登录 Agnes 控制台后（重登需 AGNES_PASSWORD），可看额度窗口（5 小时请求、每周请求、每日图片、视频）、账号累计用量，以及输入框旁的用量胶囊；也支持接入 AgnesCode 桌面端模型（仅 Windows），令牌到期时重新读取桌面端登录态，撞限额自动退避重试。

description.en: Session header badge showing DeepSeek peak/off-peak status, per-model token prices on hover, and real session/turn costs from actual usage.
description.zh: 会话头部徽标：显示 DeepSeek 高峰/闲时状态、当前模型 token 单价，并按真实用量统计会话与每轮费用。

description.en: Shows the DeepSeek account balance at the bottom of the sidebar, with a configuration card on the Plugins page.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，并在插件页提供配置卡。

description.en: DingTalk group-robot notifications (notify/text/health; webhook + HMAC signing, zero runtime dependencies).
description.zh: 钉钉群机器人通知：dingtalk_notify/text/health 三工具，webhook + HMAC 加签，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Gacha banner and event schedule lookup for anime games: sidebar button with current banners, events and countdowns for 28 gacha games, with auto-refresh, search, Windows expiry reminders and .ics export.
description.zh: 二游卡池/活动排期速查：侧边栏按钮展示 28 款二游的当期卡池与活动起止，支持自动刷新、搜索、Windows 到期提醒与 .ics 导出。

description.en: Universal skill adapter that registers any GitHub repo containing a SKILL.md as a DSH skill by cloning and symlinking into the official skills root.
description.zh: 通用 skill 适配器，将含 SKILL.md 的 GitHub 仓库克隆并 symlink 到官方 skills 根目录，注册为 DSH skill。

description.en: Card-style plugin manager in Settings: enable/disable each plugin through the profile patch layer, install-source details, npm update check with one-click update, uninstall, search, and load-error badges.
description.zh: 设置页卡片式插件管理：经 profile 补丁层启停插件（跨重启保留）、安装来源详情、npm 更新检查与一键更新、卸载、搜索与加载失败标识。

description.en: Chrome and Edge browser control that drives the real logged-in profile, tabs and cookies through an MV3 extension and a loopback Bridge, exposing browser_* tools, a Skill and /chrome commands.
description.zh: 通过 MV3 扩展和本地 loopback Bridge 驱动用户已登录的真实 Chrome/Edge Profile、标签页与 Cookie，为 DSH 提供 browser_* 工具、Skill 和 /chrome 命令。

description.en: Adds specification artifacts, skills, commands, goal-backed implementation, and task-progress context.
description.zh: 增加规格工件、技能、命令、由 goal 驱动的实施流程和任务进度上下文。

description.en: Turn raw data (CSV / pasted table / SQL results / DuckDB) into a structured Markdown report with business conclusions, metrics and charts.
description.zh: 把原始数据（CSV / 粘贴表格 / SQL 结果 / DuckDB）转成带业务结论、指标与图表的结构化 Markdown 报告。

description.en: Drag-and-drop / paste / upload files and images; on non-multimodal models images are auto-described by a configured VLM.
description.zh: 拖拽/粘贴/上传文件和图片，非多模态模型下图片自动调用已配置 VLM 识别。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance and current-session spend estimate in a top-bar chip and settings card, with pause-aware auto-refresh, an editable official price table, a `deepseek_balance` model tool, and a bilingual UI.
description.zh: 顶栏徽章与设置卡片展示 DeepSeek 账户余额与当前会话预估花费：暂停感知的自动刷新、可编辑官方价格表、`deepseek_balance` 模型工具与中英文界面。

description.en: Grok-compatible web search with retained source pagination, Context7 and Exa documentation lookup, bounded page extraction, site mapping, offline research planning, and read-only diagnostics.
description.zh: 提供 Grok-compatible 网页搜索、保留来源分页、Context7 与 Exa 文档检索、有界网页提取、站点映射、离线研究计划和只读诊断。

description.en: Read-only Web client file-preview panel with image, PDF, CSV/TSV, text, source-code, Markdown, JSON and YAML renderers, large-file range loading, and a provider API for non-local content.
description.zh: Web 客户端只读文件预览面板，支持图片、PDF、CSV/TSV、文本、源代码、Markdown、JSON 与 YAML 渲染、大文件分段读取，以及面向非本地内容的 provider API。

description.en: Send dsh turn traces, LLM generations, tool spans, and subagent activity to Langfuse.
description.zh: 将 dsh 的会话轮次、LLM 调用、工具调用及子 agent 活动记录到 Langfuse。

description.en: Academic literature search and citation tools for DeepSeek Harness: paper search via Crossref and OpenAlex with no API key, related-works discovery, and citation formatting in GB/T 7714, APA and BibTeX.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的学术文献检索与引用工具：基于 Crossref 与 OpenAlex 检索论文（无需 API key），支持相关工作发现，并可按 GB/T 7714、APA 与 BibTeX 格式生成引用。

description.en: Registers codex-web-search-mcp as native DSH MCP tools (mcp__codex-web-search__codex_web_search / codex_web_research / web_fetch) for model-independent Codex and Grok web search and deep research.
description.zh: 将 codex-web-search-mcp 注册为 DSH 原生 MCP 工具（codex_web_search / codex_web_research / web_fetch），提供与模型无关的 Codex / Grok 联网搜索与深度研究。

description.en: Renders live multi-agent session activity as a pixel-art office in a Web UI side panel - each session is an ox/horse worker typing at its desk when busy or wandering off when idle, with click-to-view work monitors and in-place approval cards.
description.zh: 把多 agent 会话的实时活动渲染成 Web UI 侧边栏里的像素风办公室--每个会话是一名牛/马员工，忙时伏案敲键盘、闲时起身摸鱼，支持点击查看工位监控、就地处理审批。

description.en: ShaderToy backgrounds for DeepSeek Harness: a WebGL2 player with a background library and five bundled presets, adjustable opacity, brightness, resolution and frame rate, playback options, and an in-app editor for the running shader.
description.zh: 把 ShaderToy 作品作为 DeepSeek Harness 背景：WebGL2 播放器 + 背景库（含 5 个预设），可调界面不透明度、亮度、分辨率与帧率，支持画面循环与音乐播放设置，并能在设置页直接编辑当前着色器代码。

description.en: A2A protocol server for dsh agents, with JSON-RPC tasks, SSE streaming, cancellation, and an agent card.
description.zh: 为 dsh agent 提供 A2A 协议服务，支持 JSON-RPC 任务、SSE 流式输出、取消任务和 agent card。

description.en: Mirror dsh session events to MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, or SQL Server while retaining local session files.
description.zh: 将 dsh 会话事件镜像到 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQLite 或 SQL Server，同时保留本地会话文件。

description.en: Collapses the DSH sidebar panel list into a single group row, and its gear opens an edit mode to show, hide and drag-reorder two groups: sidebar extension entries and conversation view tabs.
description.zh: 把 DSH 左侧的面板列表折叠成一行分组头；点齿轮进入编辑态，对两组内容分别勾选显示/隐藏、拖动排序——侧栏扩展入口与会话顶部视图标签。

description.en: Personal coding assistant that schedules, follows up on and verifies local Codex or Claude Code tasks from DSH, with WeChat, WeCom and Feishu remote channels.
description.zh: 个人编码助理：在 DSH 中安排、跟进与验收本机 Codex 或 Claude Code 任务，并提供微信、企业微信与飞书远程渠道。

description.en: Ask-before-act approval for every edit and every bash command: a red/green line diff before a file is touched, a description+command panel before a command runs — approve once or reject, each gate with its own master switch in Settings → General.
description.zh: 每次 edit 与 bash 调用前都会询问：编辑前展示红绿行级 diff，命令前展示描述与命令面板——同意一次或拒绝，两个 gate 各带独立总开关（Settings → General）。

description.en: Adds a take screenshot tool plus two optional automatic capture points, putting the screen into the conversation as an image block; requires an image-capable model.
description.zh: 一个截图工具，外加两个默认关闭的自动截图时机。需要模型支持图片输入。

description.en: Use Kimi Code as the DSH agent loop over ACP, with approvals, slash commands, and local/remote (ssh+tmux) session attach.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的 agent loop 换成 Kimi Code（ACP 直连）：审批、斜杠命令、本地与远程（ssh+tmux）会话接入。

description.en: Durable multi-agent collaboration for DeepSeek Harness with channels, threads, tasks, and resumable agent sessions.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的持久化多 Agent 协作插件，提供频道、话题、任务与可恢复的 Agent 会话。

description.en: An Obsidian-style knowledge base: ingest sources, let the LLM build and maintain an interlinked wiki, and ask questions grounded in it.
description.zh: 一个 Obsidian 风格的知识库：摄取资料，让 LLM 构建并维护互联 wiki，并基于它提问。

description.en: Four GitHub workflow skills for PR triage, review feedback, GitHub Actions diagnosis, and safe draft-PR publishing, reusing existing DSH capabilities with gh/git fallbacks.
description.zh: 四个面向 GitHub 工程工作流的 DSH Skill：PR 分诊、review 反馈、GitHub Actions 诊断和安全的 draft PR 发布；优先复用现有 DSH 能力，必要时回退到 gh/git。

description.en: Run several DeepSeek Harness sessions side by side, hand work from one to another, and watch the whole collaboration on one read-only canvas.
description.zh: 并排运行多个 DeepSeek Harness 会话，让它们互相交接任务，并在同一张只读看板上看清整场协作。

description.en: One-click prompt improvement for the DSH composer: press the sparkle button to rewrite the draft into an agent-ready prompt, replaced in place and undoable, with a deterministic fidelity check that keeps every path, identifier, number, URL and backticked token verbatim, plus a length ceiling that blocks inflation.
description.zh: DSH 输入框一键增强提示词：点 ✦ 把草稿改写成 Agent 可执行的提示词，直接替换并可一键撤回；保真闸机械校验硬事实（路径、标识符、数字与版本、URL、反引号代码）逐字存活，长度闸防止把一句话需求膨胀成规格书。

description.en: Browse, search and install skills from the public SkillHub catalogue, then enable, disable, update or remove them without leaving Harness. Category chips carry the upstream total for each category; the details drawer has tabs for the file tree, version history, permissions, third-party security-scan results and upstream metrics. An installed skill is written into the harness skill root as an ordinary local skill, and disabling one moves its directory out of that root rather than flagging it.
description.zh: 浏览、搜索并安装公开的 SkillHub 技能库,启用、停用、更新或卸载都不必离开 Harness。分类按钮带该分类的上游总数;详情抽屉提供文件树、版本历史、权限、第三方安全扫描结论与上游指标等页签。装好的技能会作为一个普通本地技能写入 harness 的技能根目录,而「停用」是把它的目录移出该根目录,不是打标记。

description.en: Static security scanner for DSH plugins: read-only audit (exec, credentials, exfiltration, obfuscation, install scripts, bundle manifest) with a 0-100 risk score.
description.zh: DSH 插件安全扫描器：只读静态审计（执行、凭据、外传、混淆、安装脚本、bundle 清单），输出 0-100 风险分。

description.en: A-share market dashboard for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): realtime quotes and indices, full-market search, intraday and forward-adjusted candlestick K-line with F10 fundamentals, stock/ETF/convertible-bond/LOF boards, watchlist with position P/L and price alerts, 13-signal screener with 7 preset strategies, limit-up sentiment thermometer, dragon-tiger list, three-source 7x24 news, and AI stock analysis.
description.zh: 韭菜盒子：A股看盘助手——实时行情与大盘指数、全市场搜索、同花顺式 K 线详情弹窗（日/周/月/5分/30分，含 F10 财务摘要）、股票/ETF/可转债/LOF 榜单、带持仓盈亏与价格预警的自选股、13 项技术信号选股与 7 个预设策略交叉、涨停情绪温度计、龙虎榜、三源 7×24 聚合快讯、AI 个股分析。

description.en: Plugin trust pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic static scan with verdicts, opt-in runtime guard with honeypot lures, agent audit-protocol skill, and a browser shield status light. Alarm-only, never an enforcer.
description.zh: DSH 插件信任流水线：确定性静态扫描判定、可选运行时守卫与蜜罐诱饵、agent 审查协议技能与浏览器盾牌状态灯，只报警不执法。

description.en: Floating glass status bar for DSH on Windows 11 x64: an always-on-top capsule that mirrors session progress, the current step and pending approvals from a local DSH web profile, with peek and detail views; approval cards stay read-only until DSH returns its own decision receipt, and connecting to the official Desktop app is experimental and unverified.
description.zh: Windows 11 x64 上的 DSH 悬浮玻璃状态栏：常驻胶囊显示本地 DSH web profile 的会话进度、当前步骤与待处理审批，可展开速览与详情；审批卡在 DSH 返回正式回执前保持只读，连接官方 Desktop 应用属实验性、未验收。

description.en: Local images and videos as the DSH desktop window background: timed rotation with 0.7s cross-fades, first-frame-ready before fading in, automatic light/dark ink for readability, adjustable blur and panel/sidebar opacity, video thumbnails, and a probe endpoint reporting load, layer and selector health. Reads only the local files you point it at.
description.zh: 把本机图片/视频（含 Dynamic Wallpaper.app 素材）用作 DSH 桌面客户端背景：定时轮换与 0.7 秒交叉淡化、等首帧就绪再淡入、按壁纸明暗自动切换深/浅字色、模糊与面板/侧栏透明度可调、视频缩略图，探针接口上报加载、图层与界面选择器的健康状态。只读取本机文件，不联网。

description.en: DSH console panel: scan a QR code and control your DSH desktop from your phone
description.zh: 在 DSH 里加个配对面板，手机扫码就能连上这台电脑，随时收发会话、看历史、传文件。

description.en: OneBot v11 hub for DeepSeek Harness: relays QQ events verbatim to downstream bots while giving the agent a full timeline, action ledger and 30 onebot_* tools.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接到 QQ 上，原样转发消息并记录完整时间线，让 AI 用 28 个工具直接操作 OneBot。

description.en: Run a DeepSeek Harness session against a WSL distro: ctx.shell, ctx.fs and the GUI terminal served from inside the distro, sandboxed with bubblewrap
description.zh: 在 WSL 发行版里跑 DeepSeek Harness 会话，命令行、文件系统和图形终端都由 WSL 内部提供，并用 bubblewrap 沙箱隔离。

description.en: Telegram DM topics for DeepSeek Harness sessions: streaming, approvals, structured questions and session controls.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话接到 Telegram 机器人上，在聊天里就能看流式输出、审批操作、回答问题并控制会话。

description.en: QQ 弹弹的类 bongo 手手挂件
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一只 Q 弹的类 bongo 手手挂件，打字时跟着节奏弹动，手感超解压。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的 QQ 渠道插件（OneBot v11 / SnowLuma）：工具面、长期记忆、知识库、主动行为与管理后台
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 接入 QQ，支持工具调用、长期记忆、知识库和主动互动，还带管理后台。

description.en: Adds image_generate and image_library tools that pick reference images from four local libraries (characters, outfits, scenes, props), expand situation, expression, pose, shot and light keyword presets into the prompt, and call the 65535 async task API or any OpenAI-compatible images API, showing the result in the conversation; a settings page manages the libraries and turns an uploaded image or a text description into a three-view reference sheet. With dsh-daily-schedule installed, an image without a specified outfit uses what the character is wearing in the current schedule entry.
description.zh: 提供 image_generate 与 image_library 工具：从本地四个参考库（人物、服饰、场景、道具）挑选参考图，把情境、神态、动作、镜头、光线关键词展开进提示词，调用 65535 异步任务接口或任意 OpenAI 兼容图像接口生图并在对话中显示；设置页可管理参考库，并能把上传的图片或一段文字描述生成三视图设定图。装了每日日程（dsh-daily-schedule）时，没指定服饰的图沿用角色此刻日程里的穿着。

description.en: Open A2A network plugin for DeepSeek Harness: signed agent cards, decentralized peer/zone discovery, direct routing model tools, and joinable session nodes in the web sidebar
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 接入开放 A2A 智能体网络，发现并连接去中心化的智能体，在侧边栏直接调用和协作。

description.en: Memory plugin with built-in curation and governance for DeepSeek Harness: 为你的 DSH 赋予可塑性记忆
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上可塑记忆，自动整理和治理记忆内容，让 AI 助手越用越懂你。

description.en: Zero-dependency static + sandbox smoke detector for DSH plugins (R/K/D/CC layers): manifest/patch/entry/build/pack/install verification, a model-callable plugin_check, profile host-shadowing and manifest-BOM detection, and supply-chain poison preflight.
description.zh: 零依赖静态检查加沙箱冒烟测试，帮你在发布前揪出 DSH 插件的各种毛病。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 桌面插件：自由圈选预览内容，视觉识别目标，再用自然语言提出修改要求。无需截图。
description.zh: 在预览里圈选网页元素或图片文字，用大白话提修改要求，不截图直接改，还能前后对比一键回滚。

description.en: DSH 插件：超星学习通自动刷课与作业答题。支持 AI 答题 / 人工答题两种模式，可自选浏览器内核与 LLM 模型。
description.zh: 超星学习通自动刷课插件，能自动看视频、关弹窗、切章节、答弹题，支持 AI 或人工答题。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 通知 + 状态栏插件：系统通知、macOS/Windows/Linux 托盘图标、任务进度与花费
description.zh: 在系统托盘和状态栏实时显示 DSH 任务进度与花费，任务完成时弹出系统通知，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。

description.en: An orange-tabby desktop pet for dsh-pet — 32 transparent VP9-alpha actions, 512×512 at 8–12fps, with the matte and QA toolchain that produced them.
description.zh: 橘猫桌宠「耄耋」——32 个透明动作（512×512 / 8–12fps / VP9-alpha），附抠像与体检工具链。

description.en: 翁法罗斯 × DSH：黄金裔席位工作区与画布工作台（基于 DeepSeek Harness 构建，非官方）
description.zh: 把翁法罗斯黄金裔席位搬进 DSH，用画布工作台管理多智能体协作与任务编排。

description.en: Local-first voice conversations for DSH. Run speech recognition and speech synthesis on your own machine, with optional external providers.
description.zh: 在本地跑语音识别和语音合成，让 DSH 支持实时语音对话，也可接入外部服务。

description.en: DSH 提示音插件：任务完成/需要回答/需要授权/出错四类事件的 Web Audio 实时合成提示音，可在通用设置里逐事件选音、上传自定义音频，对话左下角有临时静音喇叭；兼容桌面端与网页端
description.zh: 任务完成、需要回答、授权或出错时自动响提示音，还能发系统通知，支持自定义音效和一键静音。

description.en: DSH优化子代里：一款由于管理子代里运行流程的插件，可以让主代理根据设置选择性调用适合的子代里
description.zh: 统一管理子代理的调用与运行，按会话挑选合适的子代理和模型，省心又灵活。

description.en: Spec-Driven Development pipeline for Odoo: 15 tools take a request from an immutable spec through architecture to module code or live configuration, then require a persisted verdict backed by evidence from a real Odoo instance, with fail-closed gates, human-approved batches in a declared environment, Odoo's own CSV/Excel importer, and a journal that reverses the data written through the plugin.
description.zh: 面向 Odoo 的规范驱动开发流水线：15 个工具把需求从不可变规范推进到架构、再到模块代码或线上配置，最终要求一个由真实 Odoo 实例证据支撑的持久判定；闸门 fail-closed，批量操作需在声明的环境中经人工批准，复用 Odoo 自带的 CSV／Excel 导入器，并有一份可回滚本插件所写数据的日志。

description.en: Telegram bridge for DeepSeek Harness: forwards agent questions (with inline buttons), tool approval requests, turn summaries and subagent messages to a Telegram bot, and takes the answer from Telegram or the DSH Web UI, whichever comes first. Ships a loopback control panel; host-only, no client UI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Telegram 桥：把代理提问（带内联按钮）、工具审批请求、回合摘要和子代理消息转发到 Telegram 机器人，答案可从 Telegram 或 DSH Web 界面给出，以先到者为准。自带本地控制面板，纯宿主插件，不含前端界面。

description.en: OpenSpec 的配套插件，兼容 Claude Code / Codex / ZCode / DeepSeek Harness / OpenCode：提案标准更严（澄清在前、改动范围与契约变更逐条确认），实施由多 Agent 分工审查，按生产级标准把控到收口。
description.zh: 给 OpenSpec 加严提案与审查流程，多 Agent 分工把关代码质量，兼容主流 AI 编程工具。

description.en: Agentic Control Plane for DeepSeek Harness — policy-check every tool call before it runs
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中为每次工具调用执行策略检查，确保操作安全合规。

description.en: 开窍 · AI 私人老师：给 DeepSeek Harness 装一位私人老师，为你定制课程，在手写黑板上边写边讲。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装个私人老师，说出想学的东西，它先摸清你的底子，再定制课程，在手写黑板上边写边讲。

description.en: Remote monitoring and guidance for DSH agents — a Cordis plugin for macOS/Windows plus a Swift-native iOS/iPad app.
description.zh: 用手机远程查看 DSH Agent 的工作状态，还能发消息、处理审批，出门在外也不耽误。

description.en: Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness, built for companion AI. It says it does not remember instead of making things up. 情感陪伴向记忆插件：向量 + 中文 BM25 + 分层衰减。
description.zh: 给情感陪伴 AI 用的长期记忆插件，记得你说过的话，想不起来就直说，不瞎编。

description.en: Three DSH tools that let any agent — including a team member — list, steer and stop the subagents it started.
description.zh: 让任意 DSH 智能体（包括团队成员）查看、指挥并叫停自己启动的子智能体。

description.en: 免 API Key 的 dsh 联网搜索 / 网页抓取插件：引擎=逻辑源、入口=直连/镜像/加速路由自动回退，不消耗任何模型 token

description.en: Cristiano Ronaldo desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: a chibi Portugal number 7 mascot in a bottom-right overlay whose animation follows the agent state — dribbling while tools run, thinking during a turn, waiting at approvals, diving on errors — and jumping in a SIU celebration with a host-process sound when a turn completes; it can be dragged, looks at the cursor on hover, dives on a triple click, and a settings panel manages several pets and imports custom spritesheets. It also runs as a borderless, always-on-top native Windows window that keeps living after the browser is closed: hovering shows the current workspace and conversation title, double-clicking opens the Harness page in Edge, and dragging, mouse-wheel resizing and a right-click menu work there too, sharing position, size and behaviour with the web panel. Pet sheets may use any cell resolution and scale preserving aspect ratio (atlas.scaling: smooth | pixelated). v2.2 adds a video route — feed it a clip (green screen or ordinary footage) and its real motion becomes the pet animations, via automatic backdrop sampling, chroma keying with spill suppression, motion-based segment splitting and union-bbox alignment; already-extracted PNG frames work too, with no video decoder installed, and the clip audio can be cut into per-action sounds. Pets can also be published to the community gallery under the DPSL-1.0 sharing declaration, and installed from it in one click. v2.3 adapts it to DSH 0.2 desktop clients — the celebration sound now falls back to spawning PowerShell when the host no longer provides the shell service — and makes a single click play a short, configurable taunt animation (`interactions.clickAnim`).
description.zh: DSH 桌宠：Web 界面右下角的 C 罗精灵，动画随 Agent 状态切换——工具执行中颠球、回合中思考、等待审批、出错假摔——回合完成时跳起 SIU 庆祝并由宿主进程播放提示音；支持拖动、悬停注视光标、连点三次假摔，设置面板可管理多只宠物并导入自定义 spritesheet。同时提供一个无边框、始终置顶的原生 Windows 窗口，关掉浏览器也还在：悬停显示当前工作区与对话名，双击用 Edge 打开 Harness 页面，拖动、滚轮改大小、右键菜单都可用，位置/大小/行为与网页设置面板共用同一份状态。素材单格分辨率不限、等比缩放（atlas.scaling: smooth | pixelated）。v2.2 新增视频路线：喂一段视频（绿幕或普通素材都行），里面的真实动作直接变成宠物动作——自动取幕布色、色度抠像带溢色抑制、按运动量切分动作、并集包围盒对齐落格；也支持直接喂已经抽好的 PNG 帧（不需要装视频解码器），并能把视频原声按动作切成音效。宠物还可按 DPSL-1.0 分享协议发布到宠物社区，并从社区一键安装。 v2.3 适配 DSH 0.2 桌面版——宿主不再提供 shell 服务时，庆祝音效改为直接启动 PowerShell 播放——并让单击播放一段可配置的挑衅动作（`interactions.clickAnim`）。

description.en: Scheduled tasks (cron) for DeepSeek Harness: model- and human-callable scheduling that fires followup/inject into agent sessions
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上定时任务，按计划自动向会话注入消息或触发后续动作。

description.en: Native dsh tools for an Obsidian wiki vault: wiki_query, wiki_write, wiki_rename, wiki_scaffold, wiki_archive, wiki_lint — the mechanical core of the wiki skill suite.
description.zh: 为 Obsidian 知识库提供原生 wiki 工具，支持查询、写入、重命名、脚手架搭建、归档和代码检查，是 wiki 技能套件的机械核心。

description.en: Native DSH rooms for connecting independent Sessions and provider-backed AI members—without bundled roles or scenarios.
description.zh: 把多个独立会话和AI成员拉进同一个房间，自由协作，不预设角色和场景。

description.en: Adds local PDF reading, a durable paper library, traceable evidence records, and cross-paper comparison and synthesis tools.
description.zh: 提供本地 PDF 阅读、持久论文库、可追溯证据记录，以及跨论文比较与综合工具。

description.en: Live2D companion for DSH: a floating Cubism model with state-driven expressions and mouse tracking; config-driven geometry (size/position from the plugin config); official Haru sample bundled (© Live2D Inc.).
description.zh: DSH 的 Live2D 桌宠：悬浮的 Cubism 模型，表情随状态变化并跟随鼠标；尺寸与位置由插件配置驱动；内置官方 Haru 示例模型（© Live2D Inc.）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 子 Agent 派发插件：按任务为子代理选模型、推理强度与工具范围，常用组合存成命名方案随时复用；内置安全检查、成本估算与节省分析、完整派发决策台账。
description.zh: 为子代理按任务智能选模型、调推理强度和工具范围，方案可复用，内置安全检查与成本估算，派发决策全程留痕。

description.en: dsh-think-autoexpand：让 DeepSeek Harness 里的 Think 思考行始终可见，并在流式输出时自动展开，实时查看 Agent 完整推理过程；保留工具卡折叠体验。
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 中的思考过程始终可见并自动展开，实时查看 Agent 完整推理，同时保留工具卡折叠体验。

description.en: Aqua glassmorphism theme for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: mica and compatibility modes with adjustable blur and frost, fluid or wallpaper backdrop, background brightness, particle-whale accent, and a master switch that restores the stock UI.
description.zh: Aqua 玻璃质感主题：云母/兼容双模式、可调模糊与磨砂、流体/壁纸背景、背景亮度、粒子鲸鱼点缀，一键关闭即还原原生界面。

description.en: Interactive A2UI cards for the dsh web UI — quizzes, forms, charts and diagrams rendered inline in the conversation, with a full action loop back to the agent.
description.zh: 在对话中直接渲染交互式卡片，支持测验、表单、图表等，操作结果实时回传智能体。

description.en: Registers the MathWorks MATLAB/Simulink MCP server into a dsh profile, so agent sessions get mcp__matlab__* tools for running MATLAB code and reading, editing and testing Simulink models.
description.zh: 把 MathWorks MATLAB/Simulink MCP 服务器注册进 dsh profile，让会话获得 mcp__matlab__* 工具，用于运行 MATLAB 代码以及读取、编辑与测试 Simulink 模型。

description.en: Prompt enhancement for the composer: an "✨ Enhance" button rewrites your draft prompt into a clearer, more structured version with first-principles thinking, grounded in session context, memory and recent conversation; asks clarifying questions in a card when key info is missing, then previews the result before applying it to the input.
description.zh: 输入框提示词增强：✨ 增强按钮用第一性原理、结合会话上下文/记忆/最近对话，把草稿扩写为更清晰、更结构化的提示词；关键信息缺失时以提问卡片澄清，预览确认后再应用到输入框。

description.en: Redirects DSH downloads, artifacts, caches and temp files to user-specified drives (auto-picks the largest non-C drive), injects a path-discipline prompt into every session, and ships a disk_guard tool for status and cleanup — keeps the C: drive from filling up.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的下载、产物、缓存与临时文件重定向到用户指定目录（自动挑剩余空间最大的非 C 盘），向每个会话注入路径纪律提示词，并自带 disk_guard 工具做状态查看与清理——防止 C 盘被撑爆。

description.en: 会话/工作区快捷操作插件：一键打开工作区、编辑器自动发现、DeepSeek 网页版同款用户消息导航条、会话待办标记、硬性重启
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个快捷操作面板：一键开工作区、自动找编辑器、消息导航条和会话待办标记。

description.en: Hand your long DSH session over to a clean one: /handoff summarizes the conversation with an LLM, creates a new session+agent in the same workspace, injects the handoff document, and auto-opens it.
description.zh: 会话工作移交：会话行菜单一键移交，新会话按八节交接包复刻老会话的记忆、任务与铁律，原始上下文经按需回读保持轻量。

description.en: Speaks agent replies aloud in the web UI through a provider fallback chain (OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Google, Azure, Groq, Deepgram, Edge, Piper, eSpeak).
description.zh: Web UI 语音朗读助手回复：多服务商回退链（OpenAI/ElevenLabs/Google/Azure/Groq/Deepgram/Edge/Piper/eSpeak）。

description.en: A content-aware PDF reading plugin for vision models: profiles each page for figures (vector and raster), tables, formula risk and double-column layout, then applies content-aware hybrid extraction, rendering figure/table/formula pages as high-DPI region crops. Provides a low-resolution preview to understand the page layout, and renders a specified region at high resolution. Packaged as multiple tools for agents.
description.zh: 面向视觉模型的内容感知 PDF 读取插件：逐页分析图（矢量与栅格）、表格、公式风险与双栏排版，基于内容识别进行混合提取，图表/公式页渲染成高 DPI 区域裁切。提供低清预览以理解页面概况并支持指定选区获取高清渲染。功能包装为多个工具供Agent使用。

description.en: Message-level full-text search across DSH sessions via an FTS5 trigram index (user / assistant / steering / tool with per-kind filters), deduplicated results across fork/continued sessions, read-only context preview with auto-scroll to the focused message, one-click jump to the real session, and incremental/full index rebuild with health check; zh/en i18n follows the Host locale service.
description.zh: DSH 会话消息级全文检索浏览器：FTS5 trigram 索引按消息检索（用户/助手/系统注入/工具四类，可按类型筛选），fork/续接会话结果自动去重，只读上下文预览自动滚动定位焦点消息，一键跳转真实会话；支持增量/全量重建索引与健康检查；界面中英双语跟随 Host locale 服务。

description.en: Browse the public skillhub.cn catalog from Settings and install selected SKILL.md bundles into ~/.dsh/skills.
description.zh: 在设置页浏览 skillhub.cn 公开技能目录，并将选中的 SKILL.md 技能包安装到 ~/.dsh/skills。

description.en: Manage Git-backed DSH plugin markets, installed agent skills and optional Codex hooks from the web settings page.
description.zh: 在网页设置页管理基于 Git 的 DSH 插件市场、已安装的 agent 技能和可选 Codex hooks。

description.en: Archived-conversation manager for DeepSeek Harness: view archived conversations grouped by workspace, restore them, and reveal their transcript folders.
description.zh: 归档会话管理器：按工作区分组查看已归档的会话，支持恢复（取消归档）与打开会话转录目录。

description.en: Conversation Landmarks (对话地标) for DeepSeek Harness — fixed navigation and hover previews for long agent conversations.
description.zh: 为超长智能体对话提供固定导航和悬停预览，快速定位历史消息，告别滚动查找。

description.en: Manages OpenCode Zen free-tier and Go-tier models in settings.yaml — fetches the live model listings from opencode.ai, reports configured-versus-live drift per route, and adds or removes entries through four agent tools and an OpenCode Models settings section.
description.zh: 在 settings.yaml 中管理 OpenCode Zen 免费档与 Go 档模型——实时拉取 opencode.ai 的最新模型列表，按路由对比已配置与线上差异，通过四个 agent 工具和设置页分区增删模型条目。

description.en: Hardening guard for mcp__omni__parse in DeepSeek Harness: a tools/pre-execute listener that denies private/reserved host URLs (SSRF), enforces an allow-list or ask (consent), and is fail-closed when allowedRoots is empty.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 mcp__omni__parse 加固护栏：tools/pre-execute 监听器拒绝私网/保留主机（SSRF），施加白名单或 ask（同意），allowedRoots 为空时 fail-closed。

description.en: Select any text in a conversation and tap the Explain button to get a streaming Markdown explanation bubble, with recursive follow-up questions.
description.zh: 对话中框选任意文字后点击「解释」按钮，弹出 Markdown 实时流式解释气泡，支持递归追问。

description.en: Shows coding-plan usage and balance for 5 AI providers (MiniMax, DeepSeek, Kimi, OpenRouter, Zhipu) beside the composer input, switching with the selected model and reusing API keys configured in DSH model settings.
description.zh: 在 composer 输入框旁显示 5 家 AI 套餐用量与余额（MiniMax、DeepSeek、Kimi、OpenRouter、智谱），跟随当前模型自动切换，复用 DSH 模型设置里已配的 API Key。

description.en: Annotate text in replies, diffs, or files and send notes with a message for ordered replies and source navigation; follows Host styling and automatically adapts to dsh-codex-ui.
description.zh: 选中正文、Diff 或文件文字后批注并随消息发送，回复按批注逐条对照并支持定位；界面跟随宿主样式，自动兼容 dsh-codex-ui。

description.en: Local-first Agent Experience Network for DeepSeek Harness, distilling task-level experiences from traces and live manifests, grading by H0-H4 evidence, discovering by compatibility, and promoting only after explicit review.
description.zh: 为智能体提供统一的体验网络，简化多工具接入与协作，提升开发效率。

description.en: Community search, similarity analysis, and install/dedupe/build-it-yourself decisions for the dsh-plugin ecosystem.
description.zh: DSH 插件生态的社区搜索、相似度分析与安装/去重/自建决策工具。

description.en: Context Assembler plugin for DeepSeek Harness: topic-block context assembly, water-pressure topic splitting, tool trace/rewrite, reality recall injection and handoff planning.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 上下文汇编插件：话题块上下文汇编、水位压力话题切割、工具轮压缩/改写、reality 召回注入与 handoff 规划。

description.en: Multi-lens structural analysis skill: adversarial-first analysis across 16 lenses in 4 categories with 10 structural tools, confidence calibration, and fact-bound layered output.
description.zh: 多视角深层结构分析技能：16 透镜 4 类别、10 个结构工具，先攻击默认立场，产出置信度校准、事实绑定的分层结论。

description.en: Persistent five-layer memory system with relevance injection, LLM auto-extraction, profile rotation, and six agent tools.
description.zh: 五层持久记忆系统：相关性注入、LLM 自动提取、画像轮替与六个 agent 工具。

description.en: DSH 统计工具插件：描述统计/百分位数/频数分布/相关性，零依赖纯函数确定性
description.zh: 描述统计/百分位数/频数分布/相关性。

description.en: Mobile client plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web shell: off-canvas sidebar/details drawers, bottom nav bar, and a touch-first responsive layout below 768px
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页终端提供移动端适配，在窄屏下自动切换为触控友好的侧边栏、底部导航和响应式布局。

description.en: Wallpaper Engine integration for the dsh web GUI: scan the local WE library (Steam workshop 431960 + local projects) and use its wallpapers as the page background — image/video/web rendered natively, scene wallpapers as softened static previews — with a wallpaper-design panel (opacity, scope, blur, vignette, fps, parallax, carousel, theme linkage) and agent tools wallpaper_scan/list/set/config.
description.zh: Wallpaper Engine 壁纸联动：把本机下载的 WE 壁纸（创意工坊 431960 + 本地 projects）设为 DSH Web GUI 页面背景（图片/视频/网页原样渲染，场景壁纸柔化为静态预览），侧边栏「壁纸设计」面板可调不透明度、作用范围、填充、模糊、暗角、帧率、视差、轮播与主题联动，附 wallpaper_scan/list/set/config 四个 agent 工具。

description.en: dsh wps云文档插件
description.zh: 在DeepSeek Harness对话里直接用自然语言管WPS云文档，查文件、读内容、建文档轻松搞定。

description.en: Auto-injects user-chosen skills into DSH sessions, either every prompt or once at session start, with a settings page and a composer indicator.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话中自动注入所选技能（如 caveman、ponytail）：每轮提示或仅在会话开始时，含设置页与输入区指示。

description.en: Scans 20+ AI agents on this machine (Codex, Claude Code, cc-switch, Hermes, opencode, Gemini, Grok, Kimi, CodeBuddy, Trae, OpenClaw, Qoder, WorkBuddy, Zcode, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Roo Code, Qwen Code, ...) and one-click syncs, manages and adds their MCP servers and skills into DSH — global or per-workspace.
description.zh: 扫描本机 20+ 种 AI agent 的 MCP 服务器与 Skills（Codex、Claude Code、cc-switch、Hermes、opencode、Gemini、Grok、Kimi、CodeBuddy、Trae、OpenClaw、Qoder、WorkBuddy、Zcode、Cursor、Windsurf、Cline、Roo Code、Qwen Code 等），一键同步、管理并添加进 DSH（全局或按工作区）。

description.en: Draggable 3D liquid-glass floating card for the DSH web GUI: DeepSeek API balance, cumulative spend/token stats (today/yesterday/7d/30d/all), adjustable glass/3D/color controls, and one-click top-up.
description.zh: DSH 网页右上角可拖动 3D 液态玻璃余额卡片：显示 DeepSeek API 余额、累计消费与 Token 统计（今天/昨天/近7天/近30天/全部），玻璃参数/3D 厚度/颜色均可调，内置官方充值入口。

description.en: A marquee mood-light ring around the DSH web UI edge that reacts to session state, turning green while the agent works, pink when done, and yellow when something needs attention, with colors, ring width, rotation speed, and flash frequency configurable from the settings panel.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面边缘的跑马灯氛围光环：随会话状态自动变色（运行中绿色流动、完成粉色、有待处理黄色警告），设置面板可调颜色、光圈宽度、转速与闪动频率。

description.en: Home Assistant control for DeepSeek Harness agents — approval-gated lights, switches, climate.                                     给 DeepSeek Harness agent 的 Home Assistant 控制插件，一键接入智能家居，一键接入智能生活。
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 智能体直接控制你家灯光、开关和空调，操作需你点头确认，安全又省心。

description.en: Adds a subagent_codex tool that delegates tasks to the local OpenAI Codex CLI, running the work in an isolated external process.
description.zh: 新增 subagent_codex 工具，把任务委派给本机 OpenAI Codex CLI 在独立外部进程中执行，与主对话完全隔离。

description.en: Windows desktop launcher bundle for DSH Web that creates a managed shortcut, then restarts DSH in the background and refreshes the existing browser page.
description.zh: DSH Web 的 Windows 桌面启动器插件，创建受管理的快捷方式，后续启动会在后台重启 DSH 并刷新已有浏览器页面。

description.en: WeChat automation for DSH: push task progress to WeChat, listen for messages with keyword auto-reply, and a WeChat ↔ DSH two-way bridge controllable from the settings page, built on wxauto4.
description.zh: 基于 wxauto4 的微信自动化插件：任务进度微信推送、消息监听（关键词自动回复）、微信⇄DSH 双向桥，设置页开关与配置。

description.en: One-click enter/exit Plan mode for the DSH web input bar, a quick-click shortcut for /plan.
description.zh: 输入框一键进/出 Plan 模式（/plan 的快捷点击），常驻小按钮。

description.en: Schierke forest-spirit grimoire skin for the DeepSeek Harness web UI
description.zh: 把 DSH 网页界面变成一册史尔基灵界田野志，侧栏、消息、代码都化作页边批注与墨块，沉浸式魔法书体验。

description.en: DeepSeek 官网视觉风格主题 (dsh-plugin) — 官网流体背景 / 交互网格 / 粒子鱼 LOGO / 标题聚光灯 / 磨砂玻璃，双主题自适应
DeepSeek API 余额 + OpenCodeGo 余量实时显示插件（dsh web GUI）：可拖拽双段徽章与详情弹层 + DeepSeek/OpenCodeGo 两个设置页；Key 仅存本机 ~/.dsh/ds-balance.json，OpenCodeGo Key 自动读取 DSH 凭据
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek 网页界面左下角实时显示账户余额，徽章可拖拽，点击查看多币种详情。

description.en: Desktop computer use for DeepSeek Harness: macOS app listing, accessibility-tree window capture, screenshots, and synthesized input, cloned from Codex Computer Use
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek 直接操控你的 Mac：列出应用、截屏、读取窗口并模拟键鼠操作，实现桌面自动化。

description.en: Whale desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: live agent status + API balance as a circular sea level, with jump/dive interactions
A loop dock for DeepSeek Harness: one harness, multiple agent loops.
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Native desktop and webhook notifications for turn completions, failures, and approval requests, with outcome filters, content rules, privacy controls, and retrying delivery.
description.zh: 回合完成、失败和待审批时发送跨平台本机通知与 Webhook，支持结果过滤、内容规则、隐私控制和失败重试。

description.en: Use third-party subscription accounts in DeepSeek Harness: chat, image understanding, image generation, and image editing with the models your subscription covers, with available models and reasoning levels synced from your account; currently supports OpenAI/ChatGPT subscriptions, more providers planned.
description.zh: 用第三方订阅账户在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用订阅覆盖的模型：文字对话、图片理解、图片生成与图片编辑，可用模型与推理等级随账户自动同步；当前支持 OpenAI / ChatGPT 订阅，更多订阅服务规划中。

description.en: ChatGPT-style select→ask for DeepSeek Harness Web: select text in a conversation, a floating 「询问 DeepSeek」 button appears — click it to quote the selection into the composer.
description.zh: 在对话中选中文本，一键引用到输入框，快速追问 DeepSeek，省去复制粘贴的麻烦。

description.en: PBR 3D model preview for game art: GLB/GLTF with textures, IBL environment lighting, orbit controls, and a material channel inspector (baseColor/normal/roughness/metallic/AO/emissive/wireframe); scalar channels shown as grayscale per PBR spec, via the pbr3d fence and pbr_render tool.
description.zh: 游戏美术 PBR 3D 模型预览：GLB/GLTF 带贴图纹理、IBL 环境光照、轨道控制，以及材质通道检查器（基础色/法线/粗糙度/金属度/AO/自发光/线框），标量通道按 PBR 规范以灰度显示，通过 pbr3d 围栏与 pbr_render 工具使用。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance and session cost under the composer, with a live peak/off-peak pricing badge (Beijing time), a countdown to the next pricing switch, hover price tables, and usage advice.
description.zh: 输入框下方显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与本会话花费，余额前带峰/谷价格徽章（北京时间）与距切换倒计时，悬停看两档单价明细与使用建议。

description.en: Four-module session companion: smart conversation export (Markdown/PDF/JSON/PNG long-image with privacy redaction and batch ZIP), context handoff summaries with template save/import, API cost optimization (live official pricing, peak/off-peak scheduling, daily/monthly budgets, model routing), and global conversation search with in-chat find (Ctrl+F, CSS Custom Highlight API).
description.zh: 四模块会话伴侣：对话智能导出（Markdown/PDF/JSON/PNG 长图、隐私脱敏、批量 ZIP）、上下文交接摘要（模板保存与导入继承）、API 成本优化（官方动态计价、峰谷调度、日/月双档预算、模型路由）、全局对话检索与对话内搜索（Ctrl+F、CSS Custom Highlight API）。

description.en: Customizable brand area for the Web UI: replace the whale logo and DeepSeek wordmark with local images, and edit the HARNESS badge text (double-click to change, right-click to reset).
description.zh: Web UI 品牌区自定义：鲸鱼 logo 与 DeepSeek 文字可换成本地图片，HARNESS 徽章文字可双击编辑（双击修改，右键恢复）。

description.en: NewAPI (OpenAI-compatible gateway) LLM provider: registers a `newapi` route with chat-only model discovery, auto-fills model parameters (context window, reasoning effort) from models.dev, and adds a Web settings section for the base URL and API key.
description.zh: NewAPI（OpenAI 兼容网关）模型接入：注册 `newapi` 路由，仅发现聊天类模型，自动从 models.dev 获取模型参数（上下文窗口、思考强度等）并填充，并在 Web 设置页配置 base URL 与 API Key。

description.en: Use DSH from iPhone/iPad: an explicit-opt-in LAN reverse proxy (Host/Origin rewrite through the loopback trust fence, WebSocket upgrades included), iOS PWA chrome (home-screen icon, standalone meta, viewport-fit), and touch/mobile CSS (safe areas, keyboard lifting, composer row fit).
description.zh: 让 DSH 在 iPhone/iPad 上可用：显式开启的局域网反向代理（改写 Host/Origin 通过回环信任栅栏，含 WebSocket 升级）、iOS PWA 外壳（主屏幕图标、standalone meta、viewport-fit）、触屏/移动端 CSS（安全区、键盘避让、输入框按钮行适配）。

description.en: Create, read, and edit PPTX, DOCX, XLSX, and PDF via the local zagens-office CLI as office_schema / office_write / office_edit / office_read tools.
description.zh: 通过本机 zagens-office CLI 读写编辑 PPTX / DOCX / XLSX / PDF，注册为 office_schema / office_write / office_edit / office_read。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness provider for GPT models using managed ChatGPT OAuth through Codex app-server
