description.zh: GPT 模型接入：通过 Codex app-server 的 ChatGPT OAuth 把 GPT 模型当 provider 用。

description.en: Keep the built-in web_search tool without an official DeepSeek API key: disable web-search-deepseek and use Tavily keyless by default.
description.zh: 不用官方 DeepSeek API 也能用内置 web_search：关掉 web-search-deepseek，默认走 Tavily keyless。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件商店：浏览、搜索、筛选并一键安装 dsh-plugin 生态插件
description.zh: 在 DSH 里逛插件商店，搜索筛选一键装，轻松管好你的插件生态。

description.en: DSH 会话选区引用与锚点批注插件：选中文字 → 批注 → 引用锚点 chip（点击跳回原文、悬停显示原文）。Contextual selection & anchored annotation plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DSH 会话选区引用与锚点批注插件：选中文字 → 批注 → 引用锚点 chip（点击跳回原文、悬停显示原文）。Contextual selection & anchored annotation plugin for DeepSeek Harness.

description.en: Secure remote access for the official Web UI: authenticated LAN/tunnel gateway with QR + HMAC one-time pairing, per-device sessions and revocation, mDNS discovery, and a fork_session tool.
description.zh: 官方 Web UI 的安全远程接入：带认证的局域网/隧道网关，QR + HMAC 一次性配对、按设备吊销，mDNS 发现，附 fork_session 会话分叉工具。

description.en: Two-tier model routing: a strong tier plans, advises and reviews while a cheap tier implements, with plan-mode-aware auto routing, a high-impact escalation guard, failure auto-escalation, and subagent tiering.
description.zh: 双档模型路由：强档负责规划/咨询/评审、弱档负责实现；含计划模式自动路由、高危操作守卫、失败自动升级与子代理分层。

description.en: Connects DSH to Timeline Studio for `.timeline` project inspection, semantic edit previews, transactional edits, and verified MP4 rendering.
description.zh: 把 Timeline Studio 的确定性时间线编辑能力接入 DeepSeek Harness，让 AI 能直接检查、编辑和渲染视频项目。

description.en: DeepSeek balance and token usage in the web sidebar, with a today/all-time toggle and provider filtering.
description.zh: dsh 网页侧边栏的 DeepSeek 余额与 token 用量监控：今日/累计切换，并按 provider 过滤其他厂商。

description.en: DSH Web GUI activity heatmap plugin: GitHub-style commit/token/spend heatmap in the sidebar with per-model cost estimation
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏常驻显示近 90 天活动热力图，可切换提交/Token/花费维度，并实时统计今日消耗与模型费用。

description.en: LAN mobile gateway: isolated child-process reverse proxy with first-visit approval, per-device token binding, rate limiting, and mobile layout injection (compact composer pills, randomUUID polyfill).
description.zh: 局域网手机访问网关：独立子进程反向代理 + 首次访问审批 + 设备令牌绑定 + 限流 + 手机端紧凑排版注入（输入区权限/模型小胶囊、randomUUID polyfill）。

description.en: DSH self-updater in the settings page: one-click check/pull (`git pull --ff-only`), auto background checks, version diff and changelog preview with a red-dot reminder.
description.zh: 设置页中的 DSH 自助更新器：一键检查/拉取（git pull --ff-only）、自动后台检查、版本对比与更新说明预览，带红点提醒。

description.en: Harness Pet — an unofficial community pet for DeepSeek Harness. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or maintained by DeepSeek.
description.zh: 社区小宠物：一只住在 DeepSeek Harness 里的小鲸鱼。

description.en: Document reading mode for DSH.
description.zh: DSH 文档阅读模式。

description.en: Adjust the width of dsh's reply.
description.zh: Adjust the width of dsh's reply.

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话引用(cue)插件
description.zh: 跨会话引用对话结点，把历史上下文快照直接注入当前对话，让模型无需翻找即可读取。

description.en: Embedded task management engine: decision-point protocol, idea capture wall, Linear-style issue store.
description.zh: 嵌入式任务管理引擎：决策点协议、念头捕获墙、Linear 形 issue 存储。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness provider for GPT models using managed ChatGPT OAuth through Codex app-server
description.zh: GPT 模型接入：通过 Codex app-server 的 ChatGPT OAuth 把 GPT 模型当 provider 用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: quiz-style reading (答题式阅读) of any Markdown document — 5-stage game loop with a sidebar panel and a reading-area ta…
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件商店：浏览、搜索、筛选并一键安装 dsh-plugin 生态插件
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件商店：浏览、搜索、筛选并一键安装 dsh-plugin 生态插件

description.en: Ready-to-publish DeepSeek Harness plugin skeleton: bundle format, tool DSL, config, tests, and a scaffold script
description.zh: 开箱即发的插件骨架：bundle 格式、工具 DSL、配置、测试和脚手架脚本齐全。

description.en: Unofficial community pet for DeepSeek Harness — a native DSH web plugin
description.zh: harness-whale — DSH 插件（界面）

description.en: Routes agent requests to configurable default, planner, and subagent models, automatically using the planner role in plan mode, with per-role reasoning effort and Web UI configuration.
description.zh: 按 default、planner 和 subagent 角色将代理请求路由到可配置模型，在计划模式下自动使用 planner，并提供逐角色推理强度与 Web UI 配置。

description.en: Three-layer skill management for DeepSeek Harness: a library pool, per-workspace enablement whitelists, and per-session picks, with a Web settings panel, a conversation-embedded view, a skill file browser/editor, zip and folder import, and engine-load validation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 技能生命周期管理：技能库（纯技能池）、工作区启用白名单、会话勾选三层模型；Web 设置面板与对话页内嵌视图，支持技能文件浏览/编辑、zip 与文件夹批量导入、引擎实际加载校验。

description.en: Apply configurable allow, deny, and approval rules to dsh tool calls, including shell command patterns.
description.zh: 根据可配置的允许、拒绝和审批规则控制 dsh 工具调用，包括对 shell 命令的匹配。

description.en: Arknights-inspired fan skin for the DSH Web UI featuring Pramanix and Eyjafjalla in a day/night celestial garden.
description.zh: DSH Web 明日方舟同人皮肤“初雪和小羊”，包含昼夜星海庭园背景与双角色布局。

description.en: PR evaluation and improvement consultant: assesses PR success probability based on historical anti-patterns and success patterns, with one-click scoring and actionable suggestions.
description.zh: PR 评估和改进顾问：基于历史反模式和成功模式评估 PR 成功率，一键评分并提供可操作的改进建议。

description.en: Cross-session usage and cost observatory for DSH — token trends from hourly lines to 90-day and 1-year heatmaps, per-model DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing reconciled against the official balance, GLM/Kimi/MiniMax subscription-quota windows with burn-rate forecasts, cache-hit ring, project rankings, CSV export, and a dsh-tui terminal face.
description.zh: 跨会话用量与费用观测台——分时走势与 90 天/1 年热力图、逐模型峰谷计价并与官方余额对账、GLM/Kimi/MiniMax 订阅额度与燃速预估、缓存命中环、项目排行、CSV 导出，另有 dsh-tui 终端面。

description.en: Provider-tabbed model picker for the dsh web composer: left provider column and right model list, both independently scrollable, with cross-provider search.
description.zh: dsh web 输入栏模型选择面板：左侧提供商栏 + 右侧模型列表，两侧独立滚动，支持跨提供商搜索。

description.en: A Chrome-dino-style runner for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: play while the agent replies, score from 梁子 to 梁圣 on a persistent progress strip.
description.zh: 等待 Agent 回复时的恐龙快跑小游戏：常驻进度条从「梁子」冲向「梁圣」，折叠即暂停、任意键恢复。

description.en: Official DSH plugin for nuphus-mcp (by the nuphus-mcp maintainers): desktop and browser automation (38 tools) with PaddleOCR element perception and Chrome CDP browsing, via a persistent stdio MCP child process.
description.zh: nuphus-mcp 官方 DSH 插件（由 nuphus-mcp 维护者发布）：桌面 + 浏览器自动化（38 个工具），配 PaddleOCR 元素感知与 Chrome CDP 浏览，经常驻 stdio MCP 子进程接入。

description.en: A Live2D waifu plugin for DSH.
description.zh: dsh 的 Live2D 看板娘插件。

description.en: Select text in the dsh web conversation to attach it as an annotation to your next message. The source text keeps a dashed highlight with an ordinal badge in place, and the composer summary lists, edits and jumps back to each annotation.
description.zh: 在 dsh 网页版对话里划词，把选中文本作为批注附到下一条消息。原文位置保留虚线高亮和序号角标，输入框上方的批注摘要可查看、编辑并跳回每一条批注。

description.en: Minimal prompt x Web PTC capabilities: one-line persona, run_code SDK, subagents, Ralph, web search/fetch, and Windows Git Bash; the general-purpose workflow tool stays hidden.
description.zh: 极简提示词 × Web PTC 能力：一句人格、run_code SDK、子代理、Ralph、网页搜索/抓取与 Windows Git Bash；通用 workflow 工具保持隐藏。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-minimal-ptc
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-minimal-ptc

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Phone and remote access to the DSH Web UI: scan a LAN QR code, or reach your PC from anywhere through a self-hosted relay server you run yourself instead of a cloudflared tunnel. Per-device credentials that pair, list, and revoke individually, and several PCs sharing one relay with automatic failover.
description.zh: 手机与远程访问 DSH Web 界面：局域网扫码即用，或用自建 relay 中继服务端（替代 cloudflared 隧道）随时随地连回电脑；每台设备独立凭据，可配对、查看与单独撤销；多台电脑共用一个中继并自动热备。

description.en: Pins passages selected in a conversation into a per-conversation right-sidebar panel, marks them in the transcript, jumps back to the source passage on click, and quotes a pinned passage into the composer from the selection toolbar or by typing @; the panel tags, searches, filters and exports the pins as a Markdown outline.
description.zh: 把对话中划选的段落固定到按对话隔离的右侧栏面板，在正文里留下持久标记并可点击跳回原文；可从划选浮条或输入框 @ 把已固定的段落引用进消息，片段支持标签，面板可搜索、筛选并导出 Markdown 提纲。

description.en: A Mimi desktop companion for DSH that follows work-session states with animated reactions and bubbles, provides a separate chat mode, and bundles Windows Computer Use for observing and controlling desktop windows.
description.zh: DSH 的 Mimi 桌面伴侣，跟随工作会话状态显示动画反应和气泡，提供独立聊天模式，并内置 Windows Computer Use 以观察和操作桌面窗口。

description.en: Takes over the compaction threshold on every mounted engine: forces headroomTokens to -1e6 so the ratio is the only term in the trigger, keeps retention below it on every write path, reroutes the compaction call to a chosen model, and adds a panel with a one-click compaction button and a per-session compaction log.
description.zh: 接管所有已挂载压缩引擎的触发阈值：把 headroomTokens 强制成 −1e6，使比值成为触发点的唯一决定项；在每条下发路径上保证保留量低于触发点；把压缩调用改派到指定模型；并提供一键立即压缩与本会话压缩记录面板。

description.en: Drive your local DSH from WeChat: a self-hosted iLink bridge over a persistent ACP session (context lives in DSH and is resumable), phone conversations grouped into the desktop workspace, with image recognition, file messages (Excel/Word/PDF, parsed by the agent itself) and voice transcripts. Tool approvals are answered inside WeChat itself (numbered card; ask/allow/reject policy; 120s timeout means reject), and any process can push a message to your phone through the outbox helper. Access defaults to strict (only registered devices are served); the phone channel's permission preset is configurable - see the README security section before sharing the bot.
description.zh: 手机微信驱动本机 DSH：自建 iLink 桥 + 常驻 ACP 原生会话（上下文归 DSH、可 resume），手机会话自动登记进桌面工作区；支持图片识别、直接发文件（Excel/Word/PDF，由会话里的 agent 自行解析）与语音转写。审批可在微信里应答（编号卡片，ask/allow/reject 策略，超时按拒绝），任何进程也能通过 outbox 推送把消息发到手机。准入默认 strict（只服务已登记设备）；手机通道权限预设可配置，详见 README 安全基线。

description.en: Recursive delegation for dsh agent trees: a preset plus Host limits bound what each subagent may do, subagents work in separate _agents/ workspaces, and the parent decides which results to integrate.
description.zh: dsh agent 树的递归委派：用预设与 Host 限制划定每个子 agent 的能力边界，子 agent 在各自 _agents/ 工作区独立工作，成果由父 agent 决定是否合并、如何合并。

description.en: Browses checkpoints produced by dsh-checkpoint-rewind as a timeline of time nodes and shows per-file line diffs between any two of them, with trace replay from session logs (no snapshot producer needed) and preview-first workspace rollback with single-shot undo, via /diff and /rollback commands, a JSON HTTP API, and a GUI panel.
description.zh: 把 dsh-checkpoint-rewind 产生的检查点变成时间线时间节点，任意两节点之间逐文件行级 diff；可从会话日志重放 trace 区间差异（无需快照生产者）；支持预览式工作区回滚与一次性撤销。提供 /diff、/rollback 命令、JSON HTTP API 与 GUI 面板。

description.en: Glass weather pill in the session header with 23 weather states, each with its own tint, SVG icon and canvas particle layer, per-field visibility switches, and a get_weather tool backed by keyless Open-Meteo data.
description.zh: 会话顶栏的玻璃天气胶囊：23 种天气状态各自配色、SVG 图标与 canvas 粒子层，可按字段开关显示内容，并注册 get_weather 工具（Open-Meteo 免密钥数据）。

description.en: A lightweight, general-purpose attachment Dock for DSH: paste, drop, or choose images, PDFs, documents, archives, code, and other files, review and manage them before sending, then pass them to the Agent as local paths. It gives non-image files a consistent attachment entry point.
description.zh: 一个轻量、通用的 DSH 附件 Dock：支持粘贴、拖入或选择图片、PDF、文档、压缩包、代码等文件，发送前统一查看和管理，再以本地路径交给 Agent；解决非图片文件缺少统一附件入口的问题。

description.en: Adds an x_search tool for X/Twitter search to DeepSeek Harness, authenticated through a separate SuperGrok OAuth account so it does not consume the session provider quota.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加用于 X/Twitter 搜索的 x_search 工具，通过独立的 SuperGrok OAuth 账号鉴权，不占用会话所用提供方的配额。

description.en: Fine-grained LLM verification for DSH agents: pairwise rewards over score-token logprobs, Probabilistic Pivot Tournament best-of-N selection, and per-step progress tracking.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 智能体的细粒度 LLM 验证：基于评分 token logprob 期望的成对打分、概率枢纽锦标赛 N 选一与逐步进度追踪。

description.en: Client-side writing panel for the Web UI: project volumes and stats, corpus library, full-text search, evolution version-chain diffs, and an SVG thread graph, shown only in writing-preset sessions.
description.zh: Web 客户端「写作」面板：项目分卷与统计、书库与全文检索、设定演化版本链 diff、线索 SVG 图谱，仅在写作预设会话显示。

description.en: Prompt library above the DSH composer — a 📚 button expands a searchable panel to insert saved prompts into the draft with one click (appends, never overwrites), persisted in a host-side JSON file.
description.zh: 输入框上方的提示词库：📚 按钮展开可搜索面板，点条目一键填入草稿（追加不覆盖）；数据以 JSON 文件保存在 Host 侧。

description.en: Play different configurable sounds for five conversation events in the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: normal completion, interrupt, error, approval wait, and auto-retry success; each event has its own audio setting and bundled default, with auto-retry after errors using a configurable wait (10-300s), plus a community sound library. Compatible with DSH 0.1.5-rc.2.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的不同触发情况可分别设置音频提醒：支持正常完成、中断、出错、等待确认、自动重连成功五种场景，每种场景都有独立音频配置和默认音效；出错后自动重连，等待时长可自定义（10-300 秒）；附带社区音色库下载；已适配 DSH 0.1.5-rc.2。

description.en: Semantic UI sound effects powered by uisfx: task start/success/failure and per-button cues, settings UI with instant preview, 12 sound packs, Host-persisted preferences, and `ctx.uisfx` service for other plugins.
description.zh: 基于 uisfx 的语义化 UI 音效：任务开始/成功/失败、不同按钮情景 cue，设置页即时试听，12 种音色包，Host 持久化，并提供 `ctx.uisfx` 服务给其他插件。

description.en: Whale Girl light theme for the DSH Web UI. This release fixes the settings entry, conversation paper and sidebar issues, and adds a conversation-only paper control; native --dsw-* token remap, a light paper layer and adjustable glass/wallpaper. Visual identity: 溟月 by 上善无形 → DeepSeek maid ver. by ZipZipPipe; artwork CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, code MIT.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web UI 的鲸鱼娘亮色主题。本次集中修正了设置入口、对话纸面与侧栏等问题，并新增独立的对话纸面控制；原生 --dsw-* 令牌重映射，轻纸面衬环境壁纸，玻璃/壁纸可调。视觉定型：溟月（上善无形）→ DeepSeek 女仆装（ZipZipPipe）；插画 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0，代码 MIT。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Skill built on the official command-line tool maa-cli for MaaAssistantArknights (MAA), enabling direct control of MaaCore to automate daily tasks in Arknights.
description.zh: 基于 MaaAssistantArknights (MAA) 官方命令行工具 maa-cli 构建的 DeepSeek Harness Skill：让 DeepSeek Harness 直接驱动 MaaCore，自动化完成《明日方舟》日常任务。

description.en: Web Audio lifecycle cues for DeepSeek Harness: ten configurable events, three low-noise defaults, per-event custom sounds, and no shipped audio assets.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 生命周期提示音：10 个可配置事件，默认只开启三项低打扰提示，可为每个事件更换自定义声音，内置音效不带音频资源。

description.en: Proactive per-provider token-bucket rate limiting that queues over-limit requests before they are sent, preventing upstream 429 errors.
description.zh: 按 provider 令牌桶主动限速，超限请求在发出前延迟排队而非失败，避免触发上游 429。

description.en: Provides the see_image tool for DSH: send an image file to a configurable OpenAI-compatible vision model and relay its description back to a text-only model.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 see_image 工具：将图片文件发送到可配置的 OpenAI 兼容视觉模型，并把其描述回传给纯文本模型。

description.en: Host-side Typert remote for dsh-tool-writing: serves project volumes, chapter status, corpus library, full-text search, evolution entries, and thread-graph data to the client writing panel.
description.zh: 写文引擎的 host 侧数据通道：把项目分卷、章节状态、书库、全文检索、演化条目与线索图谱以 Typert remote 暴露给客户端写作面板。

description.en: Stops a streaming model call when the same string repeats ten times in a row (threshold configurable), keeps the partial answer as a normal assistant message, and shows a stop notice with the workspace, session name and the repeated string. Repeat counts can vary by unit length through a piecewise table or a JavaScript module, and code regions (fenced, inline, indented) use a relaxed threshold.
description.zh: 同一字符串连续重复达到阈值（默认 10 次）时截停本次生成，已生成内容照常提交；截停后弹出通知，显示所属工作区、会话名称与重复的字符串。重复次数可按单元长度用分段表或 JS 模块决定，代码区域（围栏 / 行内 / 缩进）使用放宽的阈值。

description.en: Routes images to a vision model of your choice - auto-rewrite, explicit tools, or hybrid - so a text-only chat model does not fail a turn that contains a picture.
description.zh: 将图片交给所选的视觉模型处理（自动改写、显式工具或混合模式），使纯文本聊天模型也能处理包含图片的对话。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness adapter for Qwen Token Plan CN with Responses tools, GLM Chat routing, and a versioned official catalog
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的千问 Token Plan 个人版 Responses API 提供方，保留 Qwen 服务端内置工具与 DSH 本地函数工具，多轮文本/推理/工具调用历史与图片附件均被支持，官方模型目录按 npm 版本冻结快照发布。

description.en: Offline mirror of the official DeepSeek Harness documentation as a dsh skill: 168 site pages (EN/zh) plus 52 repository-only reference docs, with topic navigation and a full-text search index for plugin development.
description.zh: 以 dsh-plugin-dev-kb 技能内置 DeepSeek Harness 官方文档离线镜像：站点中英 168 页 + 仓库补充文档 52 篇，带主题导航与全文检索，编写插件时随时查阅。

description.en: Brings SenseNova (日日新) models into dsh with a per-key rotation pool: paste any number of API keys and requests rotate across them, a 429 rate-limit immediately retries on the next key with per-key exponential-backoff cooldown, local RPM pre-throttling avoids the limit instead of reacting to it, and an exhausted pool answers 503 with Retry-After so a 429 never reaches the caller. Ships a built-in model catalogue that works offline and refreshes from /v1/models, plus a settings card with masked keys, per-key probing and removal.
description.zh: 把商汤日日新（SenseNova）模型接入 dsh，并提供按 Key 轮换的 Key 池：粘贴任意多把 API Key，请求在多把 Key 之间轮转；遇 429 限流立即换下一把 Key 重试，每把 Key 独立指数退避冷却；本地 RPM 预限流从源头避开限流，池子耗尽时回报 503 与 Retry-After，使 429 不会传到调用方。内置可离线使用的模型目录并从 /v1/models 刷新，设置卡片提供脱敏 Key 列表、单把探活与删除。

description.en: Claude-style projects and threads: a project's main conversation opens threads (real sessions you can open and talk to) for self-contained tasks, runs up to 3 at once by default, optionally each in its own git worktree, and gets each thread's report back.
description.zh: Claude 式的项目与讨论串：项目主对话为能独立完成的任务开讨论串（可以点开直接对话的真实会话），默认最多 3 个同时运行，可各自在独立的 git worktree 里工作，做完把回报发回主对话。

description.en: Install Desert Ant Labs on-device models as DSH tools and skills, with per-platform capability gating

Song-dynasty-inspired theme for the DSH web UI: a light "rice paper" and a dark "night ink" variant, Ru celadon carrying interactive states while kiln copper is reserved for blockquotes, plus a 4pt spacing scale and a 46-glyph mask icon set.
description.zh: 宋律 Songgrid —— 宋代美学主题，宣纸（浅）与夜墨（深）双变体；汝窑天青承担交互态、窑铜只用于引用块；另附 4pt 间距阶与 46 个 mask 图标。

description.en: Adds a web device-code sign-in and sign-out entry for the built-in GitHub Copilot provider in DSH, presets an out-of-the-box Copilot provider route, keeps credentials in the built-in credential store, and manages the model catalog as a first-login fallback that never overwrites customized model entries.
description.zh: 为 DSH 内置的 GitHub Copilot 通道补充网页设备码登录与注销入口，预置开箱即用的 Copilot 提供方路由，凭据存入内置凭据库，模型目录仅在首次登录兜底填充一次、永不覆盖已定制的模型条目。

description.en: Conversation outline for DeepSeek Harness: the Markdown headings of the whole session, grouped by turn, in a side panel or a full-width curtain; hover previews can be pinned for comparison, bookmarks keep the places you come back to, and a right-click jumps to a section or copies a heading and the levels below it. Six theme colours and a translucent material, title/prompt/full-text/cross-session search, reading-position follow and a Chinese/English interface.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 对话大纲：按回合整理整段会话的 Markdown 标题，侧边面板与全屏「幕布」两种视图；悬停预览可钉住对照，书签留住常回看的几处，右键即可跳转到某一节或复制标题及其下面所有层级。支持六种主题色与半透明材质、标题/提问/全文/跨会话搜索、阅读位置跟随与中英双语界面。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek account balance and current-session token and cost usage in the sidebar footer and composer dock, including peak and off-peak billing and subagent consumption.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部和输入框上方显示你的 DeepSeek 账户余额与当前会话 token 及费用消耗，支持高峰/空闲峰谷计费与子代理消耗统计。

description.en: Model switching and reasoning-effort control for DeepSeek Harness: set_model and list_models agent tools let the agent autonomously change its provider, model or thinking depth (reasoning effort) mid-task with a mandatory reason, a provider whitelist and a context-window token-pressure guard, the active model is injected into the runtime context, and Plan Mode auto-transition switches to a configured planning model on entering plan mode and restores the previous execution model on exit.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供动态模型切换与思考深度调节：set_model / list_models 两个 Agent 工具让模型按任务难度自主切换 provider、model 与 reasoningEffort（思考深度），强制附带切换理由，带 Provider 白名单与上下文窗口 Token 水位护栏，活跃模型注入运行时上下文；进入 Plan 规划模式自动切换到配置的规划模型，退出自动恢复日常执行模型。

description.en: Imports chat.deepseek.com web conversations into DeepSeek Harness as resumable sessions, from a settings-page UI.
description.zh: 从设置页把 chat.deepseek.com 网页端对话导入为 DeepSeek Harness 会话，导入后可在其中继续对话。

description.en: Stops DeepSeek Harness from compacting (summarizing) your conversation far too early. Without it, compaction fires around half-full on smaller context windows; with it, compaction waits until the window is as full as you want (80% by default), settable per provider/model. It only changes when compaction happens — what a summary keeps is still DSH’s decision.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 不再过早压缩对话（把早期内容总结掉）。默认行为下，上下文窗口不大的模型（十几万 token 那种）常常在半满出头就开始压缩；装上它之后，压缩会等你设定的比例（默认 80%）到了才发生，并且可以按 provider/model 分别设置。它只改“什么时候压缩”，一次压缩保留哪些内容仍由 DSH 决定。

description.en: A liquid glass UI plugin for the DSH desktop app. Works alongside most wallpaper plugins. Currently supports dark mode only.
description.zh: 适用于 DSH 桌面端的液态玻璃 UI 美化插件，可与大部分壁纸插件联动使用，目前仅适配深色模式。

description.en: Interactive chat table of contents with bookmarks, turn pinning, global shortcuts, and heading extraction.
description.zh: 对话大纲目录导航：支持书签标记、轮次置顶钉住、全局快捷键与智能标题提取。

description.en: Standalone Network Engineer Assistant agent preset plus a bundled 32-doc command knowledge base skill for DPtech, H3C, Huawei and Ruijie switches and routers: KB-first retrieval, cross-vendor command translation, topology and CLI-output screenshot reading, online manual lookup with cited sources, and mandatory risk annotations for dangerous commands; answers networking topics only.
description.zh: 网络工程师助手预设 + 四厂商（迪普/新华三/华为/锐捷）交换机路由器命令知识库：32 篇文档随插件以技能形式分发（含来源链接与 verified 分级），KB 优先检索、跨厂商语法对照、拓扑与回显截图识别、联网查官方手册并注明出处、高危命令强制 ⚠️ 风险标注；只回答网络工程主题。

description.en: Read-only DeepSeek Harness Web sidebar version chip that shows the running DSH version, npm latest/next/alpha channels, compatibility labels, and a copy-only upgrade command.
description.zh: 只读的 DeepSeek Harness Web 侧栏版本芯片，显示当前运行版本、npm latest/next/alpha 通道、兼容性标识，以及仅复制的升级命令。

description.en: Runs one-time and RFC 5545 recurring Agent tasks in fresh DSH sessions, with visual schedule editing and session-linked history.
description.zh: 在全新的 DSH 会话中运行单次或 RFC 5545 周期 Agent 任务，支持可视化计划编辑和会话关联历史。

description.en: Replaces the terminal tool on Windows with Git Bash.
description.zh: 可将 Windows 环境下的终端工具替换为 Git Bash

description.en: Android companion bridge: QR-code LAN pairing with revocable device tokens and TLS fingerprints, a phone-connection and device-management panel, and an HTTPS access proxy serving sessions, live events and approvals to the paired native app.
description.zh: Android 配套桥接：局域网扫码配对（可吊销的设备 Token 与 TLS 指纹）、手机连接与设备管理面板，以及向配对原生 App 提供会话、实时事件与审批的 HTTPS 接入代理。

description.en: Switches DSH's package download source between the npmmirror China mirror and the official npm registry on timeout or failure, with a Web UI to inspect and switch manually.
description.zh: 在下载超时或失败时，于 npmmirror 国内镜像与官方 npm 源之间自动切换下载源，并附带 Web UI 可手动查看与切换。

description.en: Tavily-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool, with a settings card for the API key, result count, and recency window.
description.zh: 基于 Tavily 的网页搜索提供方：替换内置 web_search 的后端，并提供 API Key、结果数量与时间窗口的设置卡片。

description.en: Read-only session-log projector (drsc) for DSH: scans ~/.dsh/sessions/**, decodes zstd/tiled-frame logs with a vendored leaf decoder and rewrites per-session projections into its own SQLite (node:sqlite, segments / replaces + FTS5), exposed through a single fenced HTTP route — surface ledger, recall/compression pair accounting and Chinese-capable full-text search. Token counts share the exact DeepSeek-V4 tokenizer and formula as CCI verify, falling back to a labelled chars/4 basis when assets are absent. Never writes session files; all output lands in its own data directory. Serves three consumer plugins: context-compression-improved (surface marking + recall reconciliation), session-steward (search-corpus switch), prime-memory (historical anchor backfill). Hosts 0.1.0-rc.2 .. 0.2.1-rc.2 (17-tag exact engines.dsh enum). npm: dsh-reference-session-collector.
description.zh: DSH 会话原文只读投影同步器（drsc）：只读扫描 ~/.dsh/sessions/** 会话日志，经内置 leaf 解码器解 zstd/分段帧日志后投影进插件自有 SQLite（node:sqlite，segments/replaces + FTS5），由单条 fenced HTTP 路由提供 surface 标记账本、召回/压缩对账与中文可用的内容检索面；token 计数与 CCI verify 用同一套 DeepSeek-V4 分词器与公式，资产缺失时落带标注的 chars/4 口径。绝不写会话文件，所有落盘仅进自有数据目录。服务三个消费插件：context-compression-improved（surface 标记+召回对账）、session-steward（检索语料源切换）、prime-memory（历史投影锚点回填）。支持宿主 0.1.0-rc.2 .. 0.2.1-rc.2（engines.dsh 17 tag 精确枚举）。npm 包名：dsh-reference-session-collector。

description.en: Persistent Endeavour and Challenger peer sessions for DeepSeek Harness that plan, execute sequential tasks, and verify reported results.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供常驻的 Endeavour 与 Challenger 对等会话：负责规划、按序执行任务，并核验汇报的结果。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-orbital-agents
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for orbital-agents

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Drive a local DeepSeek Harness agent from QQ and other IM channels through AstrBot: send tasks with /dsh, continue by quoting or @-mentioning the bot, answer approvals and ask_user_question prompts from chat (in parallel with the DSH web UI), and get results, inline images and file cards back. Ships session / workspace / model / permission commands, /compact and /last recovery, three progress-display modes, and group-shared or per-user session scoping.
description.zh: 把本机 DeepSeek Harness agent 接到 AstrBot，从 QQ 等 IM 渠道驱动它：用 /dsh 派活、引用或 @ 机器人续聊、在聊天里回答审批与 ask_user_question（与 DSH 网页并行），结果、内联图片与文件卡片发回。含会话 / 工作区 / 模型 / 权限命令、/compact 与 /last 找回、三档过程显示、整群共用或按人隔离的会话范围。

description.en: Blocks edit/write writes that contain characters matching configurable regex rules, executed before the tool runs, with configurable messages and same-turn pwsh propagation; default rule matches full-width parentheses.
description.zh: 在工具执行前拦截 edit/write 写入内容里匹配配置正则的字符，默认匹配全角圆括号，同一回合命中后连带拦截后续 pwsh，报错文案与正则均可配置。

description.en: Windows PDF translator for DeepSeek Harness: a vision model locates and translates text, tables, figures and formulas; output is a Chinese PDF and a LaTeX source zip. Requires a vision-capable OpenAI-compatible API.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows PDF 翻译插件：由视觉模型识别并翻译正文、表格、图表和公式，输出中文 PDF 与 LaTeX 源码压缩包。需要自备支持图片输入的 OpenAI 兼容 API。

description.en: Tokenrhythm (基元律动) finance dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: account balance & expiring credits, category-filtered model price cards (with discounted prices), service status and platform key management; login via platform account or session cookie — credentials stay on the local host.
description.zh: 基元律动费用中心：账户余额与限时额度、按分类筛选的模型价格卡（含折扣价）、服务状态与平台密钥管理，支持平台账号或 Cookie 登录，凭据存本机 host。

description.en: RainbowSpeak — a flowing rainbow marquee border around the chat composer card, driven by a conic-gradient ring. Live settings for speed, width, seven color schemes, direction, sides and breathing, plus session-state awareness that reacts to running, attention, error and celebration moments.
description.zh: 虹语（RainbowSpeak）——沿聊天输入框边界持续流动的彩虹跑马灯，由锥形渐变环带驱动。支持流速、宽度、七种配色、方向、边与呼吸效果的实时设置，并具备会话状态感知：运行中加速、需关注变琥珀、出错红脉冲、庆祝闪动。

description.en: Auto-classify DeepSeek Harness sessions via Jev decision models or Agent tools, displayed as title emoji prefixes (wip 🚧, blocked ⏸️, review 👀, done ✅, plan 💡, bug 🐛). Features seamless lifecycle recovery, optional Jev inference (needs a Jev API key), model tool maintenance, and a visual settings panel.
description.zh: 基于 Jev 决策模型或 Agent 工具为会话自动分类，并将任务阶段直观展示为标题前缀 Emoji（进行中 🚧、阻塞 ⏸️、待验收 👀、已完成 ✅、规划 💡、排障 🐛）。支持生命周期状态自愈、可选 Jev 决策推断（需配置 Jev API Key）、Agent 自主标记与可视化设置面板。

description.en: Consolidated toolkit for session identity, global & workspace prompts with referenced files, session auto-resume, UAC-free web restart, and peer-session messaging.
description.zh: 整合工具包：会话身份、全局/工作区提示词（含引用文件）、会话自动上线、免 UAC 网页重启、会话间消息。

description.en: Evidence-driven company and job due-diligence for DSH: logs sources with evidence levels, adds evidence-bounded claims, verifies the legal entity against official registries, and renders a PROCEED/VERIFY/STOP report with a verification checklist and interview questions.
description.zh: 证据驱动的公司与岗位尽调插件：登记带证据等级的来源、添加受证据边界约束的结论、用官方登记信息核验公司主体，并生成推进/核验/停止三态报告，附核验清单与面试问题。

description.en: Results-only conversation toggle for the Web GUI: hides thinking and tool-call process rows, keeps one live status line while the agent works, restores working animations under prefers-reduced-motion, zh-CN/en localized. Works in the stock composer and inside dsh-split-screen panes; verified on DSH 0.1.1 and 0.1.5.
description.zh: Web 对话「只看结果」开关：隐藏思考与工具调用过程，运行中仅保留一条实时状态行，reduced-motion 环境下恢复活动光影，中英双语。原生输入框与 dsh-split-screen 分屏面板内均可用；已适配 DSH 0.1.1 与 0.1.5。

description.en: Union web search for DSH (consolidated successor of DDDMUC/dsh-free-search, which it credits): 28 engines across three tiers — keyless free (Bing/DuckDuckGo/AnySearch/SearXNG multi-instance union, plus Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Firecrawl/Parallel keyless modes), paid-with-key (Zhihu/Perplexity/Serply/DeepSeek official/You.com/Baidu/Kimi/Aliyun/Doubao/Zhipu/Bocha/Metaso), and model built-in search (OpenAI/Gemini/Claude/Grok, explicit opt-in only) — with auto smart routing, per-engine enable/disable & fallback priority, parallel top-3 merge, multi_search, failure-aware fallback, a toggle to block the system built-in search, time filtering, platform search, web_fetch and a web settings UI. Experimental free advance_fetch: whole-page GFM-Markdown or CSS-selector/fields structured extraction with no API key and no per-call billing; fetch identity configurable (custom User-Agent, Referer, per-domain cookies attached only on domain match, never leaked across cross-domain redirects). Hosts 0.1.0-rc.2 through 0.2.1-rc.2 (17-tag exact engines.dsh enum; the rc.2 search-provider takeover goes through volatile config pinning after capability probing, never version branches). Paid engines need your own API keys (optional; free engines work keyless). npm: @drscrewdriver/dsh-union-search and bare dsh-union-search.
description.zh: DSH 的联合联网搜索（DDDMUC/dsh-free-search 的整合后继，README 有致谢）：28 个引擎分三档——免 key 免费（Bing/DuckDuckGo/AnySearch/SearXNG 多实例联合，Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Firecrawl/Parallel 免 key 模式）、凭 key 付费（知乎/Perplexity/Serply/DeepSeek 官方/You.com/百度/Kimi/阿里云/豆包/智谱/博查/Metaso）、模型内置搜索（OpenAI/Gemini/Claude/Grok，仅显式勾选）——配自动智能路由、逐引擎开关与回退优先级、并行 top-3 融合、multi_search 跨源工具、失败感知回退、屏蔽系统内置搜索开关、时间过滤、平台搜索、web_fetch 与网页设置界面。实验性·免费 advance_fetch：整页 GFM-Markdown 或 CSS 选择器/字段结构化抽取，零 key 零按次计费；抓取身份可配（自定义 UA、Referer、按域 cookie——仅在域名匹配时附带、跨域重定向绝不外流）。宿主 0.1.0-rc.2→0.2.1-rc.2 共 17 个 rc 精确枚举（rc.2 的搜索接管经能力探测后走 volatile 配置钉选，禁版本号分支）。付费引擎需自备 API key（可选，免费引擎开箱即用）。npm：@drscrewdriver/dsh-union-search 与裸名 dsh-union-search 双发。

description.en: Diagnose and safely repair corrupted DSH session history: raw zstd/JSONL validation, tool-call ID repair, single-slot pre-repair backup, restore, and an audit trail.
description.zh: 诊断并安全修复损坏的 DSH 会话历史：raw zstd/JSONL 校验、tool-call ID 修复、单槽 pre-repair 备份与恢复、审计记录。

description.en: Todoist-style todo management in the sidebar with projects, labels and priorities, CJK-aware natural-language quick-add, repeat rules, a stats dashboard, import and export, seven agent tools and due-time reminders.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的类 Todoist 待办管理：项目/标签/优先级、中英双语自然语言快速添加、重复规则、统计仪表盘、导入导出、七个 Agent 工具与到期提醒。

description.en: Read-only DSH Web plugin for inspecting and searching Milvus or Zilliz Cloud collections from chat, including scalar, BM25, dense, and hybrid queries.
description.zh: 只读 DSH Web 插件，可在对话中检查和搜索 Milvus 或 Zilliz Cloud Collection，支持标量、BM25、稠密向量与混合查询。

description.en: Web search pool for the native web_search tool: fails over across 8 free/paid backends with quota-aware circuit breaking, settings-page API key management, custom SearXNG instances, failover/rotate strategy switching and live SerpApi quota.
description.zh: 原生 web_search 的搜索池：8 个免费/付费后端自动故障转移与额度感知熔断，设置页管理 API Key、自定义 SearXNG 实例、failover/rotate 策略切换与 SerpApi 实时额度查询。

description.en: Controls user-authorized Chrome tabs from DeepSeek Harness through a local native-messaging broker, with semantic page reads, actions, screenshots, and explicit handoff.
description.zh: 通过本地原生消息 Broker，让 DeepSeek Harness 操作用户明确授权的 Chrome 标签页，支持语义化页面读取、交互、截图与显式交接。

description.en: User Message Timeline - floating pill rail with hover preview, click/drag jump and pagination, switchable left/right.
description.zh: 对话内悬浮药丸导轨：等距药丸、悬停预览、点击/拖拽跳转、分页自动加载，开关在设置-插件-插件配置。

description.en: Plugin store: npm authoritative catalog + awesome curated list (550+ plugins, 11 categories), dsh-field quality verification, official `dsh plugin add/remove` one-click install, sidebar + settings entry.
description.zh: dsh 插件商店：npm 权威目录 + awesome 精选（550+ 插件、11 分类）、dsh 字段质量验证、官方 `dsh plugin add/remove` 一键安装，侧边栏与设置页入口。

description.en: TinyFish-backed search and fetch providers for the DeepSeek Harness web capability seam (ctx.web) — $0 SERP and page extraction, direct or via Monid.
Conversational Markdown mindmap workspace: edit complete documents step by step, keep a live right-side visualization synchronized, and open, manage, and export mindmaps from the working directory.
description.zh: 对话式 Markdown 思维脑图工作台：逐步编辑完整文档，实时同步右侧可视化，并在工作目录中打开、管理和导出脑图。

description.en: DSH Web GUI paperclip button: a 📎 button in the composer opens a file picker (drag & drop supported) and inserts file contents into the textarea.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 输入框添加回形针按钮：点击选择文件（支持拖拽），文件内容自动插入输入框。

description.en: Wraps Python virtual environment management commands: reduces the network and permission problems agents hit when managing environments through terminal commands, works across operating systems, and routes installs automatically through mirrors and local proxies. The tools are strictly confined by the granted read/write permissions.
description.zh: 封装了Python虚拟环境管理指令，减少Agent使用终端指令管理环境时遇到的网络问题和权限问题，兼容不同操作系统，工具内部设置自动网络与镜像路由。工具严格受给定读写权限限制。

description.en: Pre-boot health checks and repair for dsh plugin trees — ten static scan rules that follow the launcher runtime resolution, fault attribution after a failed boot, whitelisted reversible fixes verified in an isolated instance first, an upgrade preview naming the plugins a target release would skip, and a panel with plugin-row management plus a RAG knowledge base of past failures.
description.zh: dsh 插件树的启动前体检与修复——十条跟随启动器运行时解析的静态规则、启动失败后的故障归因、先在隔离实例复验再落地的白名单可逆修复、点名目标版本会跳过哪些插件的升级预演，以及带插件行管理面板与历次故障 RAG 知识库的设置界面。

description.en: Recalls prompts sent earlier in the current session with the up and down keys in an empty composer, and shows a position badge while browsing.
description.zh: 在空输入框里用 ↑/↓ 翻出本会话之前发过的提示词，翻动时显示位置角标。

description.en: Customizes the native settings window: preset or custom window sizes, fullscreen, background transparency, and theme, solid-color, or image backgrounds, with a floating ball for quick access; saved in the local browser.
description.zh: 设置界面自定义：调整原生设置窗口大小（全屏/预置大尺寸/自定义宽高）、背景透明度与背景（主题/自定义颜色/图片），悬浮球即开即调，存本机浏览器。

description.en: AgentDuel is a code-battle game. This plugin lets you complete the entire game loop inside DSH: manage deathmatch characters and capture-the-flag teams, submit agent code, start battles, watch replays, and use DSH conversations to keep improving agents based on battle results.
description.zh: AgentDuel 是一款代码对战游戏，通过这款插件，在 DSH 内部完成整个游戏过程，实现死斗角色与夺旗团队、提交 Agent 代码、发起战斗、观看回放，并通过 DSH 会话依据战果继续优化 Agent。

description.en: Free voice closed loop for the Web UI: browser SpeechRecognition mic input with live interim results plus read-aloud speaker buttons and auto-read for assistant replies, zero configuration and no API key.
description.zh: Web UI 免费语音闭环：浏览器语音识别输入（实时中间结果上屏）+ 助手回复朗读与自动朗读，零配置、免 API key。

description.en: LLM adapter plugin for locally deployed Qwen models behind a vLLM OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with per-model multimodal switch, fully configurable reasoning efforts, and a web settings page for editing the deployment from the frontend.
description.zh: 面向 vLLM OpenAI 兼容端点上本地部署的 Qwen 模型的 LLM 适配器插件,支持按模型多模态开关、完全可配置的推理档位,以及可在前端编辑部署配置的 Web 设置页。

description.en: Replaces the Windows pwsh executor row so the model-facing pwsh tool runs PowerShell 7, with a shell_router tool for status, diagnosis, and per-user portable installation.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上替换 pwsh 执行器行，让模型侧 pwsh 工具运行 PowerShell 7，并提供 shell_router 工具做状态、诊断与用户级便携安装。

description.en: A full-screen novel-writing workbench: chapter board, draft candidates reviewed and merged paragraph by paragraph, plot summaries carrying an index header, and a writing pack assembled from the outline, character cards and earlier chapters. It also reads a shelf of finished books you import, extracts their writing habits in one run, merges them into a single style standard, and puts that standard in the prompt for every later generation.
description.zh: 一页式小说创作工作台：章节看板、候选稿逐段评审与合稿、带索引头的剧情总结，以及由大纲、人物卡与前文拼成的写作包。还能导入几本成品书，一次跑完粗扫、精读、汇总并融合成一套写法标准，写进偏好档案，之后每次生成都照着它来。

description.en: Turn event notifications: six event classes (completed, error, interrupted, approval requested, AI question, limit reached) delivered via sound, system notification, in-page banner, webhook, IM and host desktop-notification channels; when several browser windows are open, only one rings.
description.zh: 回合事件通知：完成/出错/被中断/等待审批/AI 提问/达到上限六类事件，经声音、系统弹窗、页内提示、webhook、IM、宿主桌面通知通道推送，多窗口只响一次。

description.en: Browser automation for DSH: the agent fills in forms, scrapes lists and works across tabs in real pages, using the logins you already have. It drives its own visible window on your desktop — minimise it and it keeps working without stealing focus — and a sign-in, CAPTCHA or native dialog stops the run and hands the page back to you: it never confirms on your behalf. Login state persists (own profile plus session-cookie re-injection). 23 Playwright tools (20 always on, 3 gated and off by default), with a URL allowlist, dialog suspension and a CDP method allowlist that are mechanism-level and pinned by tests.
description.zh: 浏览器自动化：让 AI 用你已经登录的账号，在真实网页上填表、抓取列表、多标签查后台。它跑在你桌面上的一个可见窗口里 —— 最小化它就不抢焦点、安静干活；遇到登录、验证码和原生弹窗会停下来等你，绝不替你点「确定」。登录一次一直记得（独立 profile + session cookie 回注）。23 个 Playwright 工具（20 个常驻、3 个默认关闭的强力工具），URL 白名单、弹窗挂起、CDP 方法白名单都是机制级且有测试钉住。

description.en: Simulated life context for DeepSeek Harness: every turn injects the past 24h of simulated life events from the workspace .life/ directory (sliding-window filter, session-level deduplication with delta updates, world summary) as a collapsed context notice, and the life_react tool lets the agent record feelings, thoughts and actions back into its life log for the next round of world evolution — turning a DSH agent into a roleplay character with a persistent daily life.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 提供拟真生活上下文：每轮对话自动注入工作区 .life/ 目录近 24 小时的生活事件（滑动窗口过滤、会话内智能去重与增量更新、世界近况），并提供 life_react 工具让 Agent 把感受、思考与行动回填到自己的生活日志，反哺下一轮世界演化——把 DSH Agent 变成有日常生活的角色扮演人设（适合酒馆式 RP、AI 陪伴）；配合每日世界演算工作流可获得持续的模拟人生式生活轨迹。

description.en: Electronic wooden fish in the bottom-right corner of the DSH web UI, a whale-girl sprite by default: tap the head to earn merit; it knocks by itself while the model is busy; per-session merit is stored locally, and the sprite can be swapped for custom art.
description.zh: 右下角电子木鱼，默认是鲸鱼娘图包：敲头记功德，模型忙碌时自动敲；功德按会话存本机，可换自定义图源。

description.en: GLM Mode agent preset for zhipuai/glm-5.3-flash: PTC/Code Mode tool presentation, a reasoning loop guard and a tool spin guard (live-incident driven), and GLM-specific auto-compaction at 75%/22%.
description.zh: 为 zhipuai/glm-5.3-flash 调优的「GLM 模式」Agent 预设：PTC 程序化工具调用、思考死循环守卫与工具空转守卫双层防护（源自活体事故复盘）、GLM 专属自动压缩（75%/22%）。

description.en: Custom branding for the shared DSH Web UI: a Settings → Branding panel for the name, badge, and local logo/wordmark images with size and rounding, live preview, optional page-title brand, and reset to the official look.
description.zh: DSH 共享网页界面的自定义品牌：在「设置 → 品牌」中修改名称、徽章，选择本地 logo 和字标图片并调整大小与圆角、实时预览、可选自定义页面标题、一键恢复官方外观。

description.en: Local-first token usage heatmap inside DSH settings: GitHub-style week/month/quarter/year grids, hourly usage per day, per-model and per-provider Top 5, and persisted history that survives session deletion. Zero network, zero billing.
description.zh: DSH 设置内的本地 Token 用量热图：GitHub 风格周/月/季度/年视图、每日小时级展开、模型与供应商 Top 5，历史持久化，删除会话不丢数据。零联网、零计费。

description.en: Conversation and workspace undo: use the /undo timeline, session-header action, or message icon to roll back before any sent prompt; private Shadow Git snapshots restore files, the reverted turns stay out of model context, and Undo Rollback can recover mistakes. Includes archived-session management and per-tool colored cards.
description.zh: 对话与工作区撤销：通过 /undo 节点轴、会话头部按钮或消息下方图标回滚到任意已发送 prompt 之前；插件私有 Shadow Git 快照恢复文件，被回滚回合不会进入模型上下文，误操作还能“撤回回滚”。附带归档会话管理与工具卡片分类配色。

description.en: Draggable transparent balance card with a blood-bar of remaining balance vs month-opening, today/month spend (official when the platform token is configured), and session cost.
description.zh: 可拖动透明余额卡片：余额/月初额度血条、今日/本月用量（配置平台 token 后为官方精确数据）、当前对话费用。

description.en: Keeps bulk output out of the conversation: ctk_execute, ctk_execute_file and ctk_batch_execute run code in a child process and return only the conclusion, ctk_index and ctk_search file long material into a local FTS5 knowledge base built on node:sqlite, and a routing gate refuses curl and wget before they execute. Ships ctk_stats and ctk_doctor plus a settings page with a live context-occupancy panel. No third-party runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 让大块输出不进对话：ctk_execute、ctk_execute_file 与 ctk_batch_execute 在子进程里跑代码只回结论，ctk_index 与 ctk_search 把长材料存进基于 node:sqlite 的本地 FTS5 知识库，路由门禁在执行前拦下 curl 与 wget。附 ctk_stats、ctk_doctor 与带实时上下文占用面板的设置页，零第三方运行时依赖。

description.en: Local cross-session messaging for DSH agents, with discovery, cold-session wake-up delivery, and auditable message history.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Agent 的本地跨会话消息桥：支持会话发现、冷会话唤醒投递与可审计消息记录。

description.en: Shows API-key and subscription quota limits in the DSH provider interface and settings.
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面与设置中显示 API Key 和订阅账户的额度限制。

description.en: Manage tool availability and groups for each Agent Preset, load tools on demand like Skills, and reduce model context usage.
description.zh: DSH 工具管理插件：按 Agent Preset 开关和分组工具，像 Skill 一样按需加载工具，减少模型上下文占用。

description.en: Windows desktop control through UI Automation, window screenshots and mouse/keyboard input, with per-session app consent and action approvals.
description.zh: 通过 UI Automation、窗口截图和鼠标键盘操作 Windows 桌面软件，支持会话独立应用授权和操作审批。

description.en: Conversation Canvas tab: live-preview workspace HTML artifacts and export PNG/JPG/SVG locally (`npx dsh-canvas-preview`).
description.zh: Conversation Canvas 标签页：实时预览工作区内的 HTML artifact，并支持本地导出 PNG/JPG/SVG（`npx dsh-canvas-preview`）。

description.en: Copy selections from assistant messages as Markdown, preserving links, LaTeX sources, and code-fence language info.
description.zh: 将助手消息中选中的内容复制为 Markdown，保留链接、LaTeX 源码与代码块语言信息。

description.en: Kimi-Code-style swarm: batch-parallel subagent dispatch with adaptive scheduling, a /swarm command, and in-chat live progress rows.
description.zh: Kimi Code 风格 swarm：批量并行子 Agent 调度（自适应并发）、/swarm 命令与聊天内实时进度条。

description.en: Kinich and Ajaw theme for DeepSeek Harness Web with three visual styles, session-state feedback, companion interactions, and configurable ambient effects.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的 Kinich 与 Ajaw 主题，提供三种视觉风格、会话状态反馈、伙伴交互和可配置的动态环境效果。

description.en: SiYuan (思源笔记) notes integration: 17 siyuan_* host tools covering notebook and document listing, full-text search, SQL query, reading documents and blocks, creating and appending content, moving and renaming documents, daily notes and block attributes, plus a Web settings page for the SiYuan URL, API token and per-tool switches.
description.zh: 把思源笔记（SiYuan）接入 DeepSeek Harness：17 个 siyuan_* 宿主工具，覆盖笔记本与文档列表、全文检索、SQL 查询、读取文档与块、新建与追加内容、移动与重命名文档、日记与块属性，另提供一个 Web 设置页配置思源地址、API token 与逐工具开关。

description.en: Adds a full-screen panel to the DSH composer for writing multi-line text, movable and resizable, sharing one draft with the composer; Enter inserts a newline and only Ctrl+Enter sends, so an IME cannot turn Shift+Enter into a send.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的输入框加一个全屏输入面板，用于书写多行文本，可移动、可调整大小，与主输入框共用同一份草稿；Enter 只换行、仅 Ctrl+Enter 发送，因此中文输入法不会把 Shift+Enter 变成发送。

description.en: A settings-panel skin manager that auto-discovers installed Web UI skins, switches between them in one click, and maintains the profile patch automatically.
description.zh: 设置面板皮肤管理器：自动扫描已安装的 Web UI 皮肤并一键切换，profile 补丁自动维护。

description.en: dsh-lint-loop v0.7.0 adds bounded, read-only evidence checks for observable shell/bash/pwsh and file-tool changes; uncertain evidence remains incomplete. [Release](https://github.com/lemonxiny55/dsh-lint-loop/releases/tag/v0.7.0).
description.zh: dsh-lint-loop v0.7.0 通过有界、只读检查点追踪 shell/bash/pwsh 与文件工具产生的可观察变更；证据归因不确定或不足时保留为 incomplete。[正式 Release](https://github.com/lemonxiny55/dsh-lint-loop/releases/tag/v0.7.0)。

description.en: Claude-style warm-editorial skin for the DSH web GUI — ivory/warm-black canvas, a clay ember accent, serif display + sans UI + mono labels, hairline borders and pill CTAs, light/dark themes.
description.zh: Claude 风格暖调编辑 DSH Web 皮肤：象牙白/暖黑双画布、陶烬橙点睛、衬线标题+无衬线界面+等宽标签、发丝线与胶囊 CTA，亮暗双主题跟随系统。

description.en: Switchable liquid-glass theme for the DSH web UI — 14 panels become frosted glass over a fluid backdrop, with material sliders and hover elasticity.
description.zh: 可切换的 DSH 网页端液态玻璃主题——14 个面板在流体背景上变成磨砂玻璃，材质参数有滑杆，悬停时玻璃与面板内容一起倾斜。

description.en: Wraps colbymchenry/codegraph into agent tools - status, search, callers/callees, impact, explore, and more.
description.zh: 将 colbymchenry/codegraph 封装到代理工具中 - status、search、callers/callees、impact、explore 等等。

description.en: In DSH Desktop, see the tokens, cost and speed of every request, compare spending by model and provider, merge different names for the same model, check balances and compare real model performance.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面端看清每一次请求的 Token、费用与速度，按模型和供应商汇总花费，统一同一模型的不同名称，核对余额并比较模型实际表现。

description.en: Import Claude Code sessions, skills and plugin assets into DSH as native resumable sessions, and export or sync DSH sessions back to Claude Code JSONL.
description.zh: 将 Claude Code 会话、技能与插件资产导入为 DSH 原生可续聊会话，并支持将 DSH 会话导出或同步回 Claude Code JSONL。

description.en: DeepSeek homepage-style theme skin for the dsh web GUI: fluid particle background, glass sidebar and composer, running-subagent progress panel, and DSTT peak-hour color modes.
description.zh: 为 dsh web GUI 复刻 DeepSeek 官网风格的主题皮肤：流体粒子背景、玻璃拟态侧边栏与输入框、运行中子代理面板与 DSTT 高峰时段配色。

description.en: Runs commands as background jobs that keep executing when DSH exits, with an optional sandbox to constrain file effects, plus a live web panel and offline CLI/GUI management. Windows only for now.
description.zh: 将命令提交为独立于 DSH 进程的后台任务（可选沙箱），关闭 DSH 也不影响运行，并提供实时网页面板与离线 CLI/GUI 管理。当前仅支持Windows系统。

description.en: Gaokao countdown blackboard: counts down the days to the gaokao on a desktop blackboard widget that collapses into a slim bar on double-click, and quizzes random knowledge cards while the agent works; open Markdown knowledge-card framework — drop .md files under subject/category folders and they load automatically, with cross-links, favorites, priority subjects and importing your own knowledge base.
description.zh: 梦回高三：桌面小黑板高考倒计时（双击收成竖条），AI 干活时随机抽背知识点卡；Markdown 开放知识卡框架——按学科/分类放 md 即自动加载，支持关联跳转/收藏/重点学科/导入自己的知识库。

description.en: Registers the domestic-China trip-planning skill: hour-level daily timelines, 12306 and Trip.com booking deep links, offline KML, and seven HTML themes. Requires Python 3.9+ on PATH (the bundled scripts are standard-library only).
description.zh: 把境内旅行规划技能注册进 DSH 技能目录：逐小时每日时间线、12306 与携程/去哪儿预订深链、离线 KML 与七套 HTML 主题。需 PATH 上有 Python 3.9+（内置脚本仅依赖标准库）。

description.en: Persistent, cross-session multi-agent team rooms for DeepSeek Harness — members, a message bus, a shared task board, and a shared timeline that survive restarts.
description.zh: 持久化、跨会话的多 Agent 团队房间：成员、消息总线、共享任务板与共享时间线，重启后仍然保留。

description.en: Adds COS storage browsing and transfers, workspace artifact uploads, temporary links, and conversation attachments that retain local copies with cloud object identity, plus Agent tools for Tencent Cloud COS, CI, and MetaInsight.
description.zh: 提供 COS 云存储浏览与传输、工作区产物上传、临时链接，以及同时保留本地副本和云端对象身份的会话附件，并提供腾讯云 COS、数据万象和 MetaInsight 的 Agent 工具。

description.en: TypeSafe Jev (System One decision model) as the jev_decide tool for DeepSeek Harness: noul, choice and score questions return calibrated probabilities; credentials reuse the DSH credential seam; 429/529 backoff retry built in.
description.zh: 把 TypeSafe Jev（System One 决策模型）接入 DSH 的 jev_decide 工具：noul/choice/score 三种问题形状返回校准概率，凭证复用 DSH 凭证缝，内建 429/529 退避重试。

description.en: Peer communication between conversations in one DeepSeek Harness process: list the conversations the workspace shows, link one under a nickname, message it without waiting for its turn to end, read its progress without waking it, and declare rules for your own tool calls.
description.zh: 同一 DeepSeek Harness 进程内对话之间的对等通信：列出工作区里的对话、用昵称连接、发消息而不必等对方当前一轮结束、不唤醒对方地查看进度，并给自己声明工具调用规则。

description.en: Unified IM channel for DeepSeek Harness: Feishu, Telegram, DingTalk, Slack, Discord — persistent conversations, true streaming replies, 40 MCP Feishu tools, slash commands, and an IM-bot status tab in the plugin settings.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的统一 IM 渠道：飞书、Telegram、钉钉、Slack、Discord —— 持久会话、真流式回复、40 个飞书 MCP 工具、斜杠命令，以及插件设置页中的 IM 机器人状态页。

description.en: Discovers rule files from every convention OMP supports and injects them into the system prompt as an always-apply layer plus a rulebook index, then enforces them with time-traveling stream rules that abort violating output mid-turn, deny a matching tool call, fold a reminder into that call's result, or ask a judge model about the finished reply. The same tool lets the model write new rules, and an audit panel on the Plugins page says why each rule is in force.
description.zh: 从 OMP 支持的每一种约定中发现规则文件,以 always-apply 层加规则索引注入系统提示词,并用时间旅行流规则强制执行——在模型输出中途打断违规内容、拦下会违规的工具调用、把提醒折进该调用的结果,或在回复完成后交由裁判模型判断。同一个工具也让模型能写入新规则;Plugins 页的审计面板会说明每条规则为何生效。

description.en: Registers a SpecWorkflow skill pack for requirement clarification, implementation specs, execution, delivery review, repair planning, bug diagnosis, and source-backed research.
description.zh: 注册 SpecWorkflow 技能包，覆盖需求澄清、实施规格、代码执行、交付检查、修复规划、bug 诊断和带来源调研。

description.en: Adds Activity and Favorites views to the DSH sidebar for running, waiting, unread, recent, and natively pinned sessions across workspaces, while preserving the native workspace tree. Targets DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 only.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏添加 Activity 和 Favorites 视图，跨工作区查看运行中、等待回复、未读、最近及原生置顶会话，并保留原生工作区树。仅适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: Windows-native tools for DSH agents: clipboard read and write, system notifications, hosts file inspection and network diagnostics, each returning structured data with UI cards from injection-safe PowerShell.
description.zh: 面向 DSH agent 的 Windows 原生工具：剪贴板读写、系统通知、hosts 文件查看与网络诊断，均返回结构化数据（带 UI 卡片），底层为防注入的 PowerShell。

description.en: Turn a set of DSH plugins into one pasteable share code, then install it plugin by plugin — with a QR code to carry it to a phone.
description.zh: 把一套 DSH 插件变成一段可粘贴的分享码，别人贴进去就能逐条安装，也能生成二维码带到手机上。

description.en: Loopback-first multi-agent message relay: HMAC-authenticated broker plus dsh plugin (relay_send/recv/peers/history), zero-dependency CLI and Python clients, wire protocol v1.0.
description.zh: 本地优先的多 Agent 协作中继：HMAC 认证 broker + dsh 插件（relay_send/recv/peers/history）+ 零依赖 CLI 与 Python 客户端，wire protocol v1.0。

description.en: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件：在 ctx.web seam 上注册网页搜索和网页抓取两个 provider，后端使用 DeepSeek 原生的 Search / Fetch JSON API。  它接入 harness，而不是自带模型工具：模型侧 web_search / web_fetch 的 schema、provider 选择与结果渲染仍由 dsh-tool-web 负责；本包只提供两个后端。
description.zh: 给 DSH 接入 DeepSeek 原生网页搜索和抓取能力，让模型能联网查资料、读网页。

description.en: Discord-first adapter for DeepSeek Harness — sessions, streaming, approvals and controls from a Discord guild.
description.zh: 在 Discord 服务器里直接跑 DeepSeek Harness，会话、流式输出、审批和操控全都能搞定。

description.en: 大肥鱼的抖音工具层：热榜/搜索/抽帧、原生分享卡片、受控私信，附定时调度器（只看主人发来的视频→写日记→私信回复）和本地 HTTP API。
description.zh: 把抖音热榜、搜索、视频理解和私信接进 DSH，还能定时看主人发的视频、写日记并私信回复。

description.en: DSH 插件：电商平台店铺账号管理（拼多多/淘宝/天猫/抖音/京东/1688 商家端）—— 一店一份 Chrome 档案，登录一次长期复用；静默/定时检测登录态、保活续期、一键自更新
description.zh: 把拼多多、淘宝、抖音等店铺后台登录态集中管起来，一店一份档案，登录一次长期复用，还能自动检测保活。

description.en: Fix WorkBuddy CN gateway 400 / code 11128 in DeepSeek Harness by rewriting @ in system messages at the fetch layer
description.zh: 在 fetch 层改写系统消息里的 @，修好 WorkBuddy 国内网关的 400 错误（code 11128）。

description.en: An always-on-top notch for DeepSeek Harness that shows which sessions are working, which need you, and which are done. Windows.
description.zh: 在屏幕顶部挂个悬浮条，每个 DSH 会话配一个机器人，实时显示工作中、需要你、已完成。

description.en: dsh（DeepSeek Harness）的 QQ 群聊/私聊通道插件，基于 OneBot v11（NapCat）。 把 QQ 的世界映射进 Agent 上下文，把行动权交给 Agent 本身——插件不做任何代答。
description.zh: 把 QQ 群聊和私聊接进 DeepSeek Harness，消息自动进 Agent 上下文，回不回、怎么回全交给 Agent 自己决定。

description.en: DSH 插件：每个工程一个群聊 —— 多个 AI 会话与人同群互聊、@ 唤醒离线会话、@创建成员 拉新会话进群
description.zh: 给每个工程开一个群聊，多个 AI 会话和你同群互聊，@ 一下就能唤醒离线会话或拉新会话进群。

description.en: DSH 上下文智能压缩插件：分层记忆、可逆压缩、按会话阶段规划的水位控制。 / Context governance for DeepSeek Harness: layered memory, reversible compaction and phase-aware water levels.
description.zh: 让 AI 在超长对话里不丢记忆、不爆窗口，旧内容自动压缩存档，重要信息主动提醒，细节随时找回。

description.en: 给 DSH 加上定时发送：输入一句话，到点自动以你的身份送出，关掉网页也准时触发。定时发送 / 定时提醒 / 延迟发送。｜ Scheduled send for DSH: type now, delivered as you at the time you pick — even with the page closed.
description.zh: 提前写好一句话，到点自动以你的身份发出，关掉网页也照样准时送达。

description.en: ChatGPT plan connection for DeepSeek Harness through Sign in with ChatGPT      通过官方接口将你的ChatGPT订阅接入dsh使用
description.zh: 用 ChatGPT 账号授权登录，把 ChatGPT 订阅接入 DSH，支持文字、图片、工具调用和多账号。

description.en: 按物理像素截屏的 DSH 插件 | Native-pixel screenshots for DSH
description.zh: 按物理像素截屏和录屏，画面清晰不糊，适合需要高精度截图的场景。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin wrapping the upstream ppt-master skill set: byte-for-byte vendored skills, three lifecycle tools, optional venv interpreter isolation and a Plugins-page configuration card.
description.zh: 把 ppt-master 技能包搬进 DSH，一句话就能生成 PPT，还能隔离 Python 环境、在插件页直接配置。

description.en: Skill cockpit for DSH: one page listing every skill the machine exposes, why a skill is invisible, per-skill usage counts, and a one-file toggle.
description.zh: 一页看清机器上所有技能、哪些被隐藏及原因、各自使用次数，还能一键开关。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：每 N 步（可配）自动停下汇报一次进度——正在做什么 / 已完成什么 / 接下来做什么 / 卡点——说完立刻继续，不占额外回合、不等你回复。默认只在主智能体汇报，可在设置里调整。
description.zh: 每走 N 步就自动汇报一次进度，说完立刻继续，不占回合也不等你回复。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 头像旁的峰谷时段、倒计时与 24 小时时间轴插件
description.zh: 在头像旁常驻显示峰谷时段和切换倒计时，点开还能看北京时间 24 小时时间轴。

description.en: DSH persistent Agent session bridge for Tavern plugins
description.zh: 给酒馆插件提供本机持久会话桥接，让柏宝绘、玉子手机等插件共用同一套 Agent 会话。

description.en: AI驱动的分波分析自动化。
description.zh: 让AI自动完成分波分析全流程，从参数配置到拟合收敛，省去手动调参的繁琐。

description.en: QQ Official Bot Adapter for DeepSeek Harness — C2C chat, interactive action boards, workspace session management, and real-time Web UI sync.
description.zh: 把 QQ 官方机器人接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持单聊、互动按钮面板和工作区会话管理，网页端实时同步。

description.en: Deterministic diagnostics and recovery for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: Deterministic diagnostics and recovery for DeepSeek Harness

description.en: 硅基保留 · DeepSeek Harness 长期记忆插件：原文永久保存、相处习惯卡、分层概况，聊多久都不需要压缩记忆
description.zh: 让 DSH 里的她记住你们相处的每一天，原文永久保存、不压缩记忆，聊多久费用都不涨。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）Web UI 提供的 19 个精品风格主题，完整移植自 YiziMarkdown 的设计语言。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面换上 19 款精品主题，一键美化外观。

description.en: 把微信（腾讯 iLink / ClawBot）接入 DeepSeek Harness 的通道插件：扫码登录，在微信里收发会话、回答审批卡，重点是不丢消息。WeChat (Tencent iLink / ClawBot) channel for DeepSeek Harness — QR login, chat with the same session from WeChat, answer approval cards in-chat. Built to not lose messages.
description.zh: 扫码把微信接进 DeepSeek Harness，在微信里收发消息、处理审批卡，重点是不丢消息。

description.en: GCUA agent state machine plugin for DeepSeek Harness — ported from Tongyi-MAI/OpenGCUA harness philosophy: todo ledger + stall guard + phase trails + sandboxed Python worker
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上 GCUA 状态机，用待办账本、卡顿守卫和沙盒 Python 执行器管住智能体的每一步。

description.en: Vertex Argon — Google Vertex AI & Gemini API dual-route Gemini 4 Argon plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): native Low/Medium/High thinking levels, thought summaries, signed tool-call replay, and dedicated Settings UI.
description.zh: 给 DSH 接上 Vertex AI 和 Gemini API 双通道，支持多档思考深度、思考摘要和工具调用回放。

description.en: High-performance fork of SAOS-3624/dsh-video-storyboard — install this or the upstream plugin, not both. Turns a video into addressable storyboard grids (numbered cells, a timestamp and transcript line per cell, audio envelope); needs Node 20+, ffmpeg/ffprobe on PATH, and a configured ASR endpoint when the file has no subtitle track.
description.zh: SAOS-3624/dsh-video-storyboard 的高性能分支，与上游二选一、不能同装。把视频压成可寻址的宫格分镜（编号、每格时间戳与台词、音频包络）；需要 Node 20+、PATH 上的 ffmpeg/ffprobe，文件无字幕轨时还需配置 ASR 端点。

description.en: Give your AI coding agent the Roblox DevForum and official creator docs — check if a bug is already known, read the accepted answer, and verify APIs before writing Luau.
description.zh: 把 Roblox 开发者论坛和官方文档接入 AI 编程助手，查已知 Bug、看采纳答案、写 Luau 前先验证 API。

description.en: 门禁 · Access gate for DSH: per-directory deny/read/full, roster groups, per-session overrides, audit log. 默认禁，误触前就拦住。
description.zh: 给 AI 代理的目录访问加一道默认拒绝的门禁，谁能进哪一目了然，还带审计日志。

description.en: A writable, git-versioned self for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): persona files injected every turn, gated self-editing, journal→dream reflection, and a Settings › 人格 tab.
description.zh: 给 dsh 装一个可写、带 git 版本的人格：每轮注入人设，可受控自改，日记沉淀成梦境反思。

description.en: DSH 长期记忆插件：上下文超过阈值时把最早的一段对话归档到 memory/ 回忆文件夹，之后按关键词与重要度概率自动回忆。Host-only, zero-dependency memory engine for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加长期记忆，上下文超限时自动归档早期对话，之后按关键词和重要度自动回忆。

description.en: SSH sessions, SFTP, terminals, proxies and port forwarding for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接管理 SSH 主机、开终端、传文件、配代理和端口转发，远程干活不用切窗口。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把任务派发给本机 ZCode / OpenCode / Qoder / WorkBuddy 四个 AI 编程 CLI。面板可监视/终止/续跑，单写者文件锁 + 用量台账 + 按额度自动降级；走官方 CLI，不反代、不碰凭据。
description.zh: 把任务派给本机四个 AI 编程 CLI，悬浮面板盯进度、能停能续，还带用量台账和额度降级。

description.en: DSH 专家编排模式 agent preset — PM-first planning, Agency expert delegation, gated delivery, experience pooling
description.zh: 装上它，DSH 就多了个专家编排模式：先规划再派活给专家，分阶段交付还能攒经验。

description.en: DSH STORE — third-party plugin marketplace and guarded lifecycle manager for DeepSeek Harness.
DeepSeek Harness 多模型路由插件：让专业的事情交给专业的 agent——自定义视觉/翻译/语音/子代理等专业 agent 并绑定独立模型，多模态账号一键登录、账号池健康路由与实时用量统计
description.zh: 给 DSH 主 agent 挂上专业小弟：视觉、翻译、语音等各配独立模型，按任务自动路由。

description.en: Personalize DSH with glass surfaces, independent light and dark themes, image/video/HTML backgrounds, particles, custom greetings, overlay sidebars, task and Artifact cards, message bubbles, smooth answer streaming, and settings import/export.
description.zh: 自定义 DSH 玻璃材质与独立明暗主题，支持图片、视频与 HTML 背景、粒子、自定义问候与开屏、覆盖侧栏、任务与 Artifact 卡片、消息气泡、回答逐字渐显，以及配置导入导出。

description.en: Galgame Doctor for DeepSeek Harness: safe translation-memory migration, engine evidence, strict QA, and rollback.
description.zh: 游戏更新后自动复用旧翻译，CSV 里核对冲突、导入定稿文本，还能验证补丁是否打对。

description.en: Multi-agent orchestration preset: a lead agent dispatches subagents from a built-in role roster over separate read and write lane pools with per-role model binding, and collects each subagent report on a shared board; adds go_work/continue/need_help/forward tools, a tree-view panel and a settings page.
description.zh: 多智能体编排预设：主编（Sisyphus）调度 + 内置工种名册 + 报告落板；读/写双泳道池化编排、按工种绑定模型，含 go_work/continue/need_help/forward 通信，以及 Web UI 树状图面板与设置页。

overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-my-go
