description.en: dsh's tui base on nvim
description.zh: 把 Neovim 当作 dsh 的聊天界面，搜索、复制、配色和 LSP 全都能用，还能看工具卡片和审批。

description.en: 面向 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）第三方插件生态的 **Plugin Design**：发现第三方插件、检查其源码与配置、对照 DH-TP-SDK 工程化规范做静态分析、生成 `design.md`，经用户确认后对插件逐项修改并支持备份与回滚。
description.zh: 第三方插件先查源码再改，生成设计方案，确认后逐项修改，可校验、可回滚，避免 DSH 崩溃。
在 DSH 里说需求就能自动做出可继续编辑的 PPT，逐页生成还带自动检查。

description.en: Use a directory on an SSH host as a DSH workspace — hosts management, directory browser, five agent tools.
description.zh: 通过SSH方式，将远程主机的文件夹当成DSH的工作区，可以在本地DSH控制远程主机工作目录，不需要手动同步、不需要挂载驱动、不需要装任何第三方文件系统

description.en: Universal AI Agent Development Skills Hub & Cordis Plugin for Govard, Magento 2, Laravel. Works with Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot, DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为AI编程助手提供统一技能库，支持多框架与多工具，即插即用提升开发效率。

description.en: 把单一会话不可能的巨任务拆成无数可验证子系统，大规模并行有纪律执行
description.zh: 把超大任务拆成可验证的小子系统，大规模并行执行，还能挂后台任务和长期目标

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-apollo
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-apollo

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: DSH 对话流增强插件（零 DSH 源码改动，纯插件注入）。回合呈现：思考 chip（实时走秒 + 实时文字滚动）· 工具调用聚合 chip · 对话流卡片（步骤卡/总结卡）· 共享活动抽屉。正文增强：proto-tabs 可交互卡片 · diagram 流程图围栏 · 本地 HTML 内嵌预览（识别正文里的 .html 路径，host 读文件 + 同目录资源，iframe 沙箱隔离，高度自适应，1:1/等比缩放，浏览器打开）。界面与工具：会话头部对话/轨迹标签上移 · 对话截图（常驻无头浏览器渲染 markdown/shiki/mermaid 真图，可内嵌本地 HTML）· download 下载工具（实时进度条/速度/ETA）。
description.zh: 不改官方源码就给对话加交互卡片、执行大盘和记忆钉，读起来更顺、过程看得懂。

description.en: DSH STORE — third-party plugin marketplace and guarded lifecycle manager for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装插件的第三方市场，还能安全地安装、更新和卸载。

description.en: Adds a Compact context button and a New session button to the context meter panel; compact submits /compact through the same command channel, and new session starts a fresh session in the same workspace.
description.zh: 在上下文计量面板中添加「压缩上下文」与「新建会话」两个按钮：压缩按钮通过与手敲 /compact 相同的通道提交命令，新建会话按钮在同一 workspace 中开启新会话。

description.en: A marketplace plugin to quickly integrate your DeepSeek Harness into the GitHub plugin ecosystem.
description.zh: 帮你把 DeepSeek Harness 快速接入 GitHub 插件生态，装插件、管插件一步到位。

description.en: Drag a session out of the DSH sidebar and it opens in its own native OS window, showing the full standard conversation UI (Markdown, toolbar, settings) with only the sidebar trimmed away, so several sessions can be watched side by side instead of switching back and forth. Windows verified; macOS and Linux untested. Runs in the DSH desktop app (Electron).
description.zh: 把 DSH 侧边栏里的会话拖出来，即在独立的原生系统窗口中打开；窗口内是完整的标准会话界面（Markdown、工具栏、设置都在），只裁掉侧边栏，因此可以同时盯住多个会话，不必来回切换。Windows 已验证，macOS/Linux 未实测；需在 DSH 桌面端（Electron）中使用。

description.en: DSH 视频工作台：图文分镜、前端代码生成与编辑、本地 MP4 导出
description.zh: 在对话里编排分镜、生成动画代码，还能在工作台逐帧调整并导出本地 MP4。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 网页搜索插件：多个 Tavily/Exa key 按限流负载均衡，429 自动换 key，含设置页 UI 与 Tavily 额度总览。
description.zh: 给 DSH 接上 Tavily/Exa 多密钥搜索，自动轮换限流、429 换 key，还能看额度。

description.en: Unofficial DeepSeek Harness reply typography, interactive charts/tables and isolated HTML artifacts. Windows 0.2.1-rc.2 preview.
description.zh: 给 DSH 助手回复换三种排版风格，图表表格能点能操作，还能隔离运行 HTML 小作品，读起来更舒服。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for shareable session deep links
description.zh: 通过链接一键分享或直达 DeepSeek Harness 会话，方便协作与快速访问。

description.en: 使用DeepSeekHarness进行学习和笔记
description.zh: 陪你精读资料、边问边学，把内容整理成能反复回看的 Obsidian 笔记。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）网页搜索提供方插件：把内置 web_search 工具接到 OpenAI 兼容 Responses API 及其原生 web_search 工具上。
description.zh: 把 DSH 内置的网页搜索接到 OpenAI 兼容接口上，让搜索能力随你换模型。

description.en: Session-scoped AlphaSolve workflow for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把 AlphaSolve 数学解题流程接进 DSH，按会话独立运行，默认休眠、需要时再唤醒。

description.en: Git workspace enhancements for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Web GUI: worktree staging, sidebar git badges, files & diff conversation views, paseo-style PR actions
description.zh: 在 dsh 网页界面里直接管理 Git worktree、看 diff 和提交 PR，代码审查更顺手。

description.en: Agent security guardrail: intercepts and audits every tool call, requiring human confirmation on sensitive operations.
description.zh: Agent 安全护栏：拦截并审计所有工具调用，命中敏感操作就要求人工确认。

description.en: OpenCode Go model provider for DeepSeek Harness - a maintained fork that keeps the model catalog reachable and configures itself from Settings > Models
description.zh: 在 DSH 里接入 OpenCode Go 订阅模型，自动拉取模型目录、配好请求头，设置页填 Key 还能看额度。

description.en: Balanced web search plugin/MCP server for DeepSeek Harness: Keenable / Exa / Tavily round-robin with failover. / 均衡搜索插件：Keenable / Exa / Tavily 轮流调用，自动故障切换。
description.zh: 把 Keenable、Exa、Tavily 三个搜索源轮流调用，一个挂了自动换下一个，让联网搜索更稳。

description.en: Luna preset for DeepSeek Harness — a little-demon persona on the full standard tool set, composed by six deterministic rule layers (perception, understanding, state, style, regulation, memory) plus a derived vitals layer, with a gated, suppressible cross-session memory file.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的露娜预设：小恶魔人设配完整的 standard 工具面，由感知、理解、状态、表达、调节、记忆六层确定性规则驱动，外加生理派生层；跨会话记忆写入经证据门控，遗忘用抑制而非删除。

description.en: DSH 思考与工具调用聚合：回合级思考 chip（实时时长/实时文字滚动）+ 工具调用聚合 chip + 共享活动抽屉 + 对话流卡片（步骤卡/总结卡，回合结束后才出现）——自 dsh-webui 移植。零 DSH 源码改动。
毛玻璃风格DSH主题，含壁纸、字体定制与网易云音乐
Image previews for DSH sessions: read_image thumbnails plus user, assistant, Markdown and present images in a lightbox with zoom, rotate, pan, download, sidebar and native file actions.
description.zh: 统一接管 DSH 会话里的图片预览：read_image 缩略图，以及用户、助手、Markdown 和 present 图片，支持缩放、旋转、拖动、下载、侧栏和原生文件操作的 Lightbox。

description.en: Two-tier model router for DeepSeek Harness — LLM-Judge routing, multi-model fallback chains, exponential-backoff failover, and task-level orchestration (DSH adaptation of pi-shift-router)
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的两级模型路由插件，自动分配执行与评判任务，支持多模型备用链路和故障转移，让复杂任务编排更稳更智能。

description.en: TapTap Maker game-dev workbench with 150+ bundled skills, custom image lane, ChatGPT web with account rotation, CC0 SFX, web BGM, and a forced no-Maker-credit-burn policy.
description.zh: TapTap Maker 游戏开发工作台：内置 150+ 技能、自定义生图通道、ChatGPT 网页多账号轮换、CC0 音效库、网页 BGM，并强制"未经用户同意不花 Maker 额度"。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: registers a global skill that teaches agents how to discover, evaluate and install community plugins from the GitHub dsh-plugin topic, dshmarket and npm. | DSH 社区插件生态指南 skill：让 agent 学会发现、评估、安装社区插件。
description.zh: 教智能体从 GitHub、dshmarket 和 npm 发现、评估并安装社区插件，轻松扩展 DSH 生态。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 生图+生视频整合插件：统一供应商目录、三个工具、中转站实测的异步视频契约、 限流退避纪律、设置页+画廊+快车道 CLI。MIT，fork 合并自 dsh-image-generation 与 dsh-video-gen。| Unified image+video generation plugin for DeepSeek Harness (MIT, fork-merge of dsh-image-generation & dsh-video-gen)
description.zh: 一个插件搞定 AI 生图和生视频，统一供应商配置，自带画廊和命令行，开箱即用。

description.en: MUV Variable Table Editor - tavern companion plugin for DeepSeek Harness: structured table editing for UpdateVariable blocks, PolyForm-Noncommercial-Copyleft-1.0.0
description.zh: 酒馆伴生插件，用表格方式编辑 UpdateVariable 变量块，让变量管理更直观。

description.en: 增强提示词魔法棒:DSH Web 对话输入框的灵活自适应提示词增强插件
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话输入框加个魔法棒按钮，一点就把口语化、带错字的输入变成精准提示词。

description.en: 增强提示词魔法棒:DSH Web 对话输入框的灵活自适应提示词增强插件
Bring WorkBuddy's free and paid models (domestic and international) into DSH — no WorkBuddy desktop app required.
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 国内版和国际版的免费/付费模型接进 DSH —— 无需下载 WorkBuddy 桌面端。

description.en: DSHSH — a harness that harnesses your harness
description.zh: 给 harness 再套一层 harness 的递归插件，专治各种 harness 不够用的场景。

description.en: Feishu (Lark) bridge for DeepSeek Harness: one-command install, streaming progress cards with a tool panel, ask/approval button cards, attachments, and proactive feishu_send pushes.
description.zh: 飞书入口插件：一条命令安装，流式进度卡片带工具面板、提问/审批按钮卡片、附件处理与 feishu_send 主动推送。

description.en: Novel-writing console for DSH: five novel_* tools for the agent (list, read, context, save chapter, cast) plus a side panel with a book wizard, a cast/relation view and streaming chapter continuation.
description.zh: 小说创作台：5 个 novel_* 工具（列目录、读文件、取上下文、存章节、管角色），外加侧栏开书向导、人物关系图与流式续写。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a photo of a surface becomes a complete tileable PBR material set, fully local via ComfyUI (FLUX.2 Klein 4B instruction edit + deterministic PBR derivation). GUI workbench, five agent tools, and a setup tool that finds your ComfyUI and downloads its own weights.
description.zh: 一张照片就能在本地生成整套可平铺 PBR 贴图，直接拿去做游戏和 3D 材质。

description.en: Moves a plugin set between DSH profiles (web to desktop by default): diff, pre-checks, an offline script for CLI-owned profiles, and a post-restart verification. It installs nothing itself.
description.zh: 在 DSH 的各 profile 之间迁移插件（默认 web → desktop）：算差异、预检、为 CLI 管的 profile 生成离线脚本、重启后核对。它自己不安装任何东西。

description.en: Restart button at the right end of the session header that restarts the whole client: the Windows desktop app (Electron shell and Host, through the Host's own graceful shutdown) or the dsh web server. It can wait until running turns and background jobs finish, reopens the open session afterwards with one-click continue for interrupted sessions, flags plugin updates that only take effect after a restart, and shows Host uptime and memory on hover.
description.zh: 会话标题栏右端的重启按钮，可重启整个客户端：Windows 桌面版（Electron 外壳与 Host，走 Host 自身的优雅关闭流程）或 dsh web 服务。可等正在运行的回合与后台作业结束后再重启；重启后回到原会话，被中断的会话可一键继续；提示需重启才生效的插件更新；悬停显示 Host 运行时长与内存。

description.en: Free keyless Tavily web search tool for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 傻瓜式插件全家桶 - 装一个包，所有功能开箱即用

description.en: SIDOR starfield skin for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: intro animation, starfield, balance badge, settings FX, low-balance alerts
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面换上 SIDOR 星野皮肤，带开场动画、星空背景、余额徽章和低余额提醒，好看又实用。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）流程图管理插件：浏览 Archify 业务流程图目录、按 Git 附注标签阅读历史版本、保存版本。A workflow-diagram manager plugin for DSH.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里浏览 Archify 业务流程图，按 Git 附注标签翻看历史版本，还能随时保存新版本。

description.en: ACP adapter that drives DeepSeek Harness from Obsidian Agent Client (and other ACP clients): list, resume, fork and delete sessions, switch the model per session, preview a one-line summary, import external ACP sessions, and pull Obsidian Agent Client conversations into dsh native session storage. Requires DSH >= 0.1.5-rc.3.
description.zh: 在 Obsidian Agent Client（及其他 ACP 客户端）里驱动 DeepSeek Harness 的 ACP 适配器：会话 list / resume / fork / delete、按会话切换模型、一句话摘要预览、导入外部 ACP 会话，并可把 Obsidian 侧会话拉进 dsh 原生会话库。需 DSH >= 0.1.5-rc.3。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：情绪检查点与修复 —— 安抚、折叠封存争吵段、注入结论，从干净上下文继续任务 | Emotional checkpoint & repair for DSH
description.zh: 用户发火时先安抚修复关系，再把争吵折叠封存、注入结论，从干净上下文继续干活。

description.en: DNS-validated web_fetch for DeepSeek Harness behind Clash/Mihomo TUN fake-IP · 为 DSH 提供 fake-IP 环境下的 DoH 校验安全抓取，保留非公网目标拦截
description.zh: 让 DSH 的网页抓取在 Clash/Mihomo fake-IP 模式下照常能用，同时拦住内网等非公网目标。

description.en: Per-session billing plugin for DeepSeek Harness: token buckets, cache hit rate, and peak-aware cost in the session header + a price-table settings page
description.zh: 按会话实时统计 token 用量和费用，区分缓存命中与高峰计价，帮您精准掌控每次对话成本。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 文档编辑插件：在右侧栏的文档预览里就地编辑文本文件并保存，支持 Ctrl+S、冲突保护、行尾逐字节保留。In-place document editor for the DSH Sidebar preview: Ctrl+S, conflict protection, byte-exact line-ending preservation.
description.zh: 在右侧栏文档预览里直接改文本并保存，支持 Ctrl+S 和冲突保护，行尾原样保留。

description.en: ACP server for DeepSeek Harness — bridges Zed and other IDEs to dsh agents
description.zh: ACP server for DeepSeek Harness — bridges Zed and other IDEs to dsh agents

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-cnctem-dsh-acp
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-acp

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Jev-judged context compaction for DeepSeek Harness: semantic tool-result pruning + deterministic receipt compaction
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 智能压缩上下文，自动精简工具调用结果，省 token 又不丢关键信息。

description.en: DSH 活动统计：彩色时间线看什么时候在干活/改代码，每日 token 消耗按项目/日期/小时查看。
description.zh: 用彩色时间线看自己什么时候在干活，还能按项目、日期、小时查每日 token 消耗。

description.en: CDS 模式（Chen's DS）— a multi-agent development mode for DeepSeek Harness. You talk to one persona; it dispatches 56 personas that hand work to each other directly.
description.zh: 你只跟一个角色对话，它背后调度 56 个智能体互相接力干活，让多智能体协作真正跑起来。

description.en: Headroom context-compression proxy integration for DeepSeek Harness: detect/install/start Headroom, auto-configure the DeepSeek compressed route, one-click route-switch UI. Built on headroomlabs-ai/headroom (Apache-2.0).
description.zh: 一键检测安装并启动 Headroom 压缩代理，自动配好 DeepSeek 压缩路由，随时切换省 token。

description.en: dsh-research-kit 是一个 浏览器侧 DSH 插件：它维护科研资源目录、把工作流和用户参数组装成可编辑 Prompt，并由 DSH 当前会话负责实际发送与执行。
description.zh: 帮你整理科研资源目录，把工作流和参数拼成可编辑提示词，交给当前会话直接执行。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness × 飞书/Lark 双向桥接：私聊/群聊、卡片按钮、审批与提问回传、任务板、goal、定时任务；另含全程本机的语音转写（音频不出本机）与网页端播放条。Feishu/Lark bridge for DSH + fully local voice transcription.
description.zh: 把飞书/Lark 变成 DSH 的聊天入口，私聊群聊、卡片按钮、审批提问都能回传，还能本机转写语音。

description.en: dsh插件，将dsh的LLM请求路由到本机Qoder CLI，可使用Qoder credits与模型。
description.zh: 把 DSH 的模型请求转接到本机 Qoder CLI，直接用 Qoder 的额度和模型。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: Bilibili video search, metadata, and subtitle transcripts (bilibili_search / bilibili_video / bilibili_subtitles) · DeepSeek Harness 插件:B 站视频检索、元数据与字幕文稿,匿名可用,可选 SESSDATA 解锁登录字幕
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里搜 B 站视频、看元数据和字幕文稿，匿名可用，登录后还能解锁更多内容。

description.en: Multi-machine, multi-agent orchestration and control plane for DSH: discovers Agents and workspaces across devices, routes tasks by machine, repository, capability, and load to local or remote Agent runtimes, streams progress and results, forwards approvals, and recovers durable tasks after disconnections.
description.zh: DSH 的多机多 Agent 编排与控制平台：发现各设备上的 Agent 与工作区，按机器、仓库、能力和负载将任务路由到本地或远程 Agent Runtime，统一回传进度、审批与结果，并在断线后恢复持久任务。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 美化插件：背景图 + 面板半透明，设置页实时调节。Background image & translucent panels with a live settings page.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 界面换上背景图和半透明面板，设置页里实时调，好看又好用。

description.en: dsh 登录门卫插件：让只监听本机的 dsh Web UI 安全地对外开放——登录墙 + 全量反代，零依赖、零侵入。
description.zh: 给只监听本机的 dsh Web UI 加一道登录墙，登录后全量反代，让你安全地从外网访问。

description.en: deepseek harness 插件 替换会话持久化引擎为 MySQL 数据库
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的会话存储换成 MySQL，让对话记录更持久、好管理。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 工作搭档：长任务完成通知（Toast/Webhook）+ 私有知识库（kb_search）。Task-completion notifications + private knowledge base.
description.zh: 任务完成即时通知（Toast/Webhook）+ 私有知识库搜索，让 DSH 用起来更顺手。

description.en: Long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): layered memory library + session distillation + deep-sleep consolidation + settings panel. 守藏记忆插件。
description.zh: 给 DSH 助理装上跨会话长期记忆，自动沉淀、反思、召回和遗忘，数据全在本机。

description.en: Connect dsh to Notion via the official Notion MCP (OAuth + PKCE): search, read, and write pages, databases, and comments through `mcp__notion__*` tools.
description.zh: 通过官方 Notion MCP（OAuth + PKCE）把 dsh 连接到 Notion：通过 `mcp__notion__*` 工具搜索、读写页面、数据库与评论。

description.en: 把文件拖入/粘贴到 DeepSeek Harness Web：输入框原生引用气泡，随消息发送（含绝对路径），气泡渲染文件卡片。Drag/paste files into the DeepSeek Harness web GUI as native reference bubbles — absolute paths, file cards.
description.zh: 拖入/粘贴文件：输入框上方文件栏（chips）+ @文件名 光标内联插入 + 随消息发送（含绝对路径）+ 气泡文件卡片。Drag/paste files into the DeepSeek Harness web GUI and send them with your message (absolute paths included).

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 持久化、审批驱动的项目编排工作台
description.zh: 内置状态持久化与审批关卡，帮你把零散任务串成完整项目流，让复杂编排更省心。

description.en: Fully customizable keyboard shortcuts for the Web UI: 34 pre-registered features (sessions, views, clipboard, models, silent permission cycling, settings), one-click recording to bind your own, and a shortcut cheatsheet with built-in diagnostics.
description.zh: Web UI 可自定义键盘快捷键：34 个预置功能（会话、视图、剪贴板、模型、静默权限切换、设置），一键录制自定义组合键，内置快捷键速查表与诊断面板。

description.en: Startup splash for DeepSeek Harness: an animated avatar with aurora, stardust, pointer parallax and a module-assembly entrance, plus the same image as the main-UI wallpaper; both images can be swapped from a settings page that previews the animation live.
description.zh: DSH 启动动画 + 主界面壁纸：头像、极光、星尘、指针视差与模块组装入场，同一张图兼作主界面壁纸；两张图都能在设置页里更换并实时预览。

description.en: Registers six spec-driven + test-driven workflow skills for DeepSeek Harness: OpenSpec spec authoring fused with Superpowers TDD discipline into a Phase 0-4 pipeline with review gates. Zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册 6 个 SDD+TDD 工作流技能：把 OpenSpec 规格编写与 Superpowers 测试驱动纪律衔接为带审查 Gate 的 Phase 0-4 流水线，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Teach Math with Manim — 图书《用 Manim 讲好数学》官方配套开源仓库
description.zh: 用 Manim 做数学教学动画的官方配套仓库，含 60+ 案例源码和 AI 技能，拿来就能用。

description.en: 变更证明（ChangeProof）— DeepSeek Harness 插件：代码改动后确认改动的行真的被测试覆盖到
description.zh: 代码改动后，自动确认改动的行真的被测试覆盖到，避免“测试全绿但改动没被测”的假通过。

description.en: Shows a DSH session as a conversation canvas — every turn is a node, any turn forks a real child session, and a compacted context folds into one green node you can keep talking from; the left rail groups canvases by DSH workspace and renames them in step with the session titles.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话画成一张对话画布：每轮问答是一个节点，任意节点都能分叉出真实的子会话，压缩过的上下文收成一个绿色节点、可以从它继续对话；左侧栏按 DSH 工作区分组列出画布，重命名与 DSH 自己的会话标题同步。

description.en: Plan-usage pet for the DSH web GUI: a floating skeletal-animated character reports quota in a speech bubble, auto-matching the configured provider (OpenCode Go, Command Code, DeepSeek) to show a plan percentage or an account balance, and falling back to local token stats when the provider API is unavailable; draggable, wheel-scalable (90-260px), synthesized click sounds, loopback-only routes.
description.zh: DSH 网页界面的桌宠用量小窗：悬浮的骨骼动画角色用气泡报出套餐用量，按 DSH 里配置的 provider 自动匹配（OpenCode Go / Command Code / DeepSeek 官方），套餐制显示百分比、按量计费显示余额，取不到官方数字时降级为本地 token 统计；可拖动、滚轮缩放（90–260px），音效现场合成，HTTP 路由只开 loopback。

description.en: Exposes OpenCode Zen free models to DeepSeek Harness with no API key, tracking Zen gateway changes.
description.zh: 将 OpenCode Zen 免费模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，无需 API Key，并跟踪网关兼容性。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 离线打包插件 — 在联网环境下将 DSH 插件打包为离线安装包（.tgz），传输到离线 DSH 环境中加载安装。
description.zh: 在联网环境把 DSH 插件打包成离线安装包，拷到无网环境一条命令装好，不用连 npm。

description.en: Website cloning methodology skill: a real-source-first decision tree covering static sites, React/Vue/Next content sites and WebGL/Canvas-heavy fronts, mandatory verification of executable code quoted from second-hand AI analyses, and 13 zero-dependency Node scripts for CDP browser recon, asset/font harvesting, route crawling, sourcemap hunting and pixel-diff auditing.
description.zh: 网站复刻方法论 skill：以「真源码至上」决策树覆盖静态站、React/Vue/Next 内容站与 WebGL/Canvas 重前端站，强制核对二手 AI 分析里的可执行代码，内置 13 个零依赖 Node 脚本（CDP 浏览器侦察、素材/字体抓取、路由爬取、source map 挖掘、像素 diff 审计）。

description.en: Loom Chat is a DSH Web client plugin that turns linear ordinary sessions into a pannable, zoomable Loom-style canvas for parallel exploration.
description.zh: 把普通对话变成可缩放平移的无限画布，让你并行探索多个话题，聊天不再是一条线。

description.en: 缓解部分dsh性能问题的插件
description.zh: 在数据流层面合并流式输出，减少 DSH 会话事件量，缓解性能瓶颈。

description.en: DSH Plugin for Markdown like Notion experience
description.zh: 在 DSH 里用 Notion 式所见即所得体验写 Markdown，还能三栏 VS Code 工作区加 AI 提效。

description.en: Local model plugin for DeepSeek Harness: manage GGUF models in settings, auto-launch llama.cpp on first message, and auto-unload after 5 minutes of idle time to free VRAM.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 本地模型插件：在设置里管理 GGUF 模型，首条对话自动拉起 llama.cpp，空闲 5 分钟自动卸载释放显存。

description.en: Toolbox plugin for the Web UI: session/trash/subdirectory/search/preset/config management, tag grouping, long-message collapse, and a scheduled heartbeat with optional IM channel push.
description.zh: Web 界面工具箱：会话/回收站/子目录/搜索/预设/配置管理、标签分组、长消息折叠，以及支持 IM 渠道推送的定时心跳。

description.en: Ultra-lightweight Moli (Rust headless browser) web-fetch provider for DeepSeek Harness: renders complex SPAs, micro-frontends, and dynamic pages with ~60MB memory.
description.zh: 基于超轻量 Rust 无头浏览器 Moli 的 web_fetch 提供方：专为微前端与复杂 SPA 渲染设计，内存占用仅约 60MB。

description.en: GitHub sidebar workbench for DSH: remote tree plus Issues, Pull requests and Actions tabs, with create/comment/edit/close, merge/squash/rebase, and rerun or cancel CI; mounts as a better-sidebar tab or a standalone right panel.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏 GitHub 工作台：远端目录树加 Issues / Pull requests / Actions 页签，支持建 Issue/PR、评论、编辑、关闭、merge/squash/rebase 与重跑或取消 CI；挂载为 better-sidebar 页签或独立右侧面板。

description.en: DSH plugin — turn your AI conversation into a rhythm game. Start your bgm!
description.zh: 把 AI 对话变成音乐节奏游戏，边聊边打拍子，让交互更有趣。

description.en: 外贸获客插件 for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): Google 三层搜客 + WhatsApp 客服审核台 + 邮件触达闭环 (ICP 评分/跟进序列/CRM/报价PDF), 零依赖
description.zh: 外贸获客全家桶：从谷歌三层搜索抓取买家线索，到WhatsApp客服台AI草稿+人工审批，一站式搞定开发信、跟进和CRM。

description.en: "Weniger" — less, but better: a Dieter Rams-inspired theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI
description.zh: 受迪特·拉姆斯设计哲学启发的极简主题，让 DeepSeek Harness 界面更清爽、更专注。
把雪之下雪乃接入DSH，自带Live2D形象和日语音色，能主动搭话、监听任务完成并语音播报，还能当陪伴面板。

description.en: Security audit for DeepSeek Harness plugins: static permission profile with file/line evidence + a runtime sentinel gating credential access and unknown-host egress · DSH 插件安全审计：静态权限画像（附文件/行号证据）+ 运行时哨兵，触及凭证或向未知主机外发数据时先请你批准
description.zh: 运行前摸清 DSH 插件底细：静态权限画像带证据，运行时哨兵拦截敏感访问和未知外联。

description.en: DSH 会话日志导入插件:解析 /export 的 zip/jsonl,结构真实性验证 + SHA-256 指纹校验,同步模型/预设/权限等状态,导入/删除实时推送免刷新
description.zh: 把 DSH 导出的会话日志一键导入成可继续聊的新会话，还能校验真伪、同步模型和权限。

description.en: Coding workbench for DSH: docked workspace panels, a grouped project sidebar, split editor tab groups with hibernate/resume, file preview and diff views — built on parallel git worktree development with cross-session collaboration primitives.
description.zh: coding 工作台：停靠式工作区面板、项目分组侧栏、可休眠/恢复的分栏编辑器 TAB 组、文件预览与 DIFF 查看，以 git worktree 并行开发与跨会话协作为地基。

description.en: Fold completed DeepSeek Harness chat turns without replacing native renderers.
description.zh: 把已完成的对话轮次折叠起来，界面更清爽，同时不影响原有渲染效果。

description.en: dsh-llm-ollama 是一个为 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）开发的社区插件，让 Harness 通过 Ollama 原生协议（/api/chat） 接入本地 Ollama 服务。即插即用：不改动 dsh 官方任何文件，安装后自动在「设置」中多出一个 Ollama 页面，并在会话模型选择器中提供该提供方的模型。
description.zh: 让 dsh 直接连上本地 Ollama 跑模型，装完就多出设置页和模型选项，不用改官方文件。

description.en: dsh通知消息统一管理框架
description.zh: 统一管理通知消息，让插件注册自己的通知项，并在设置页配置，内置任务完成、提问、崩溃等事件通知。

description.en: SSH terminal panel & AI connection manager for DeepSeek Harness — model-driven connect/exec/list/status/disconnect tools plus an XShell-style multi-tab terminal in the Web GUI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接管理 SSH 连接，带多标签实时终端面板，操作更顺手。

description.en: DSH CSV 数据工具插件：解析/查询/统计/转换 CSV 文本（RFC 4180），零依赖状态机解析器，注册 csv 工具
description.zh: 解析、查询、过滤、统计和转换 CSV 文本，零依赖纯函数实现，适合处理表格数据。

description.en: DSH Diff 工具插件：文本/JSON/CSV/Markdown 结构化比较与 unified diff，零依赖只读，注册 diff 工具
description.zh: 快速对比文本、JSON、CSV和Markdown内容，生成统一的差异报告，帮助Agent精准定位数据变化。

description.en: DSH 编码/哈希工具插件：base64/base64url/url/hex 编解码、md5/sha1/sha256/sha512 哈希、UUID 生成，零依赖
description.zh: DSH 编码/哈希工具，支持 base64、URL、hex 编解码，MD5/SHA 哈希和 UUID 生成，零依赖纯函数。

description.en: DSH 时间工具插件：严格 ISO 8601 解析、IANA 时区转换、UTC 日历运算、固定时长差，零依赖
description.zh: DSH 时间工具插件：严格解析 ISO 8601、转换 IANA 时区、UTC 日历运算和固定时长差，零依赖纯函数，让 Agent 轻松处理时间问题。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: edit sent messages and resend (stop an in-flight reply, edit, resend), plus branch-based edit / reroll / retry and a version timeline.
description.zh: 消息发出去后也能改：停止回复、编辑重发，还能分支重试，旧版本自动归档。

description.en: 腾讯 IMA 是一个非常好的知识库应用，但是他们提供的skill版本针对公开知识库的检索方式只提供了基于文件标题的关键字检索，好一阵无语。为了补足在harness的这种知识库检索能力，基于tencent-ima-copilot-mcp迭代了对应的dsh版本。
description.zh: 让 Agent 直接按语义检索腾讯 IMA 知识库并返回带引用的答案，无需额外服务。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that lets you control Universal Robots (UR) collaborative arms directly from natural language, developed by Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd. based on the same logic as the company's own nUR MCP Server. (Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd.)
description.zh: 让 DSH 用自然语言直接控制 Universal Robots（UR）机械臂的插件，由拓德科技（Nonead）基于自研的 nUR MCP Server 同源逻辑开发。（Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd.）

description.en: A DSH plugin that distinguishes official built-in DSH plugins and user custom plugins on the external interface.It can collect and manage all your previously created custom plugins 这是一个 DSH 插件管理插件，可在web界面区分 DSH 自带插件与自定义插件，并且能够收纳用户之前的自定义插件进行管理
description.zh: 将 DSH 设置中的插件区分为官方内置和用户自定义，集中管理你创建过的所有插件，支持可视化操作与依赖自动检查。

description.en: Prompt-level wiki skill suite (wiki, wiki-ingest, wiki-query, wiki-lint, save) for dsh — pairs with dsh-plugin-wiki-tools.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一套提示词级 Wiki 技能，支持内容整理、查询、检查与保存，方便搭建个人知识库。

description.en: Native AnySearch /v1/search WebSearchProvider for DeepSeek Harness with Web UI, credentials integration, and Web/Headless support.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 AnySearch 搜索，支持网页界面和凭据配置，轻松实现联网检索。

description.en: Tencent Cloud ADP plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 深度集成腾讯云智能体平台，让你在 DeepSeek Harness 中直接发现和调用云端 AI 模型。

description.en: Desktop companion plugin and native shell for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供桌面原生外壳与配套工具，让 AI 工作流在本地更顺手、更高效。

description.en: 写书鲸：面向 DeepSeek Harness 的原生 AI 小说创作工作台插件
description.zh: 写书鲸：在 DeepSeek Harness 里和 AI 一起写小说，灵感、正文、Agent 协作全搞定，创作效率直接拉满。

description.en: DSH plugin for agent-driven span compaction: compress chosen conversation spans into self-written checkpoints instead of the official head-anchored full-context sweep.
description.zh: 让智能体自主压缩对话片段为摘要，替代官方全量扫描，节省上下文空间。

description.en: Fills missing context window, max tokens, thinking levels, and image input on custom DSH models from models.dev, and lists unmatched models for manual edits.
description.zh: 按模型名从 models.dev 补全自定义模型缺失的上下文、输出上限、思考档位和图片能力，并列出未匹配模型供手改。

description.en: Remote development over SSH: pick a directory on a registered machine as the session workspace and the file, shell, bash, and search tools run on the remote host — the agent works there with the same local tools, and no extra model-facing tools are added.
description.zh: 基于 SSH 的远程开发：把注册机器上的目录选为会话工作区后，文件、shell、bash 与搜索工具即改在远程主机上执行——agent 用与本地相同的工具在那里工作，不新增任何面向模型的工具。

description.en: dsh-plugin: floating semi-transparent market ticker for DeepSeek Harness — 上证指数 / 创业板指 / 科创50 / 恒生科技
description.zh: 页面右上角悬浮显示A股与港股核心指数，支持拖拽收起，方便工作时随时查看行情。

description.en: DSH web plugin: toggle plugins on/off from the GUI without restarting the server
description.zh: 在网页界面上直接开关插件，无需重启服务器，即改即用。

description.en: Arbitrary file upload, reading, OCR, and rendering for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中直接上传、阅读、OCR 识别并渲染任意格式文件，让文档处理更顺手。

description.en: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 任务看板插件：主机状态机 + git 调度 + 浏览器看板 UI，agent 自动执行任务、审核后自动合并回基础分支
description.zh: 把任务、Git分支和AI Agent串成流水线，看板建单后Agent自动干活，人工审核通过就能直接合入主分支。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web（`dsh --profile web`）记录**每日 LLM 调用花费**，支持按会话 / 模型 / 天多维度查看。
description.zh: 记录 DeepSeek Harness Web 每日 LLM 调用花费，按会话、模型、天多维度查看，帮你掌握成本。

description.en: 聊天流中悬挂皮鞭，甩动鞭梢（>2.0 px/ms）即向 agent 发送 go work 消息 | A whip hanging in the chat stream; flick the tip (>2.0 px/ms) to send the agent a "go work!" message
description.zh: 聊天流中悬挂皮鞭，甩动鞭梢（>2.0 px/ms）即向 agent 发送 go work 消息 | A whip hanging in the chat stream; flick the tip (>2.0 px/ms) to send the agent a "go work!" message

description.en: Custom product name and logo branding for DeepSeek Harness Web 自定义 DeepSeek Harness Web 端 logo 和产品名称
description.zh: 不改源码，轻松给 DeepSeek Harness 换上自己的产品名和 logo，让界面更贴合品牌。

description.en: see_image tool for DSH: lets text-only models 'see' images by routing them to a configurable vision model (default Zhipu GLM-4V-Flash, free)
DeepSeek Harness Workbench
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 变成你的个人工作台，集中管理多个工作区，提升日常 AI 任务效率。

description.en: Never-interrupt, resumable lifecycle for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): graceful restart + client auto-reconnect + cross-restart goal continuation.
Agnes AI image and video generation plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: Agnes AI 生图生视频插件。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 第三方 API 与自定义模型设置插件：支持请求头、User-Agent、模型列表、图像输入和思考等级 | WebUI plugin for third-party APIs and custom models with request headers, image input, and reasoning levels
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加第三方 API 和自定义模型支持，可配置请求头、图像输入和思考等级。

description.en: Three Departments and Six Ministries governance mode plugin for DeepSeek Harness | dsh 三省六部模式插件

SVN (Subversion) toolset for DeepSeek Harness: 33 agent tools (status, diff, log, blame, commit, merge, props, lock, changelist...) plus a sidebar panel with side-by-side BASE/working-copy diff, conflict resolution and AI commit logs.
description.zh: SVN（Subversion）工具集：33 个 agent 工具（status/diff/log/blame/commit/merge/props/lock/changelist 等），以及带 BASE/工作副本左右对比、冲突解决与 AI 提交日志的侧边栏面板。

description.en: Three-pane workspace layout with file-tree browsing, file editing, a non-linear conversation mindmap view, and mobile mode support.
description.zh: 三栏工作区布局，提供文件树浏览、编辑文件、非线性会话导图视图，并且支持手机模式。

description.en: Read-only trajectory review in a resizable conversation sidebar, with rule analysis, optional model explanations, evidence navigation, and same-range run comparison.
description.zh: 在可调宽的会话右侧栏中提供只读轨迹复盘、规则分析、可选模型解读、证据定位和同区间运行对比。

description.en: 🧠 Cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness backed by Hindsight. Self-contained dsh-plugin: /hindsight commands + hindsight_recall/remember/status/list/forget agent tools. Lightweight, no dsh-mnemon, no orchestrator.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上跨会话记忆，随时召回历史决策、记住新事实，让 Agent 越用越聪明。

description.en: View and manage archived sessions in DSH: browse the archive, read full transcripts (turns/reasoning/tools/markdown tables), remove records. Desktop + web.
DSH 插件市场：搜索 GitHub dsh-plugin 话题插件，一键安装到本地 dsh（agent 工具 + 设置页插件市场 tab）
description.zh: 在 GitHub 上搜罗 dsh 插件，一键装进本地，设置页和会话里都能用。

description.en: Project and session organization for DeepSeek Harness: multi-folder projects, searchable chats, attention summaries, and native folder picking.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 变成项目工作台，按项目管理会话和文件，快速切换不混乱。

description.en: Adds a draggable, position-persisted chip bar of configurable quick phrases to DeepSeek Harness, plus a /-triggered phrase menu with per-phrase pin, slash-menu, bar-visibility, and click-to-send toggles.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加可拖拽、位置会记住的快捷短语条，以及 `/` 触发的短语菜单；每条短语可单独设置置顶、斜杠菜单、是否上条和点击即发送。

description.en: DSH web plugin (dsh-better-sidebar companion): export the current .md file to standalone HTML (Mermaid inlined) or PDF - export button on the markdown toolbar
DeepSeek Harness plugin: heuristic malware vetting for installed third-party plugins
description.zh: 给已装的第三方插件做恶意行为启发式扫描，提示高权限误用，可选运行时绊线，帮你提前发现风险。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: conversation history request rail (ZCode-style) - 会话历史请求迷你滑轨
description.zh: 在对话区左侧加一条迷你滑轨，每条横线代表一次请求，悬停看摘要、点击跳转，快速定位历史对话。

description.en: deepseek harness 纯牛马 —— 多智能体数字员工指挥台插件
Piano-key style in-conversation navigation bar: one key per user message, hover preview tooltip, click-to-jump across full history. Official dual-face dsh plugin, no dsh source changes.
description.zh: 钢琴键风格的会话内导航条：每根键对应一条用户消息，悬停预览、点击跳转到完整历史的任意消息。官方双面 dsh 插件，不改 DSH 源码。

description.en: Full-featured ADB device management plugin for DeepSeek Harness - control your Android device via AI
description.zh: 通过 AI 直接管理安卓设备，支持 ADB 全功能操作，让手机控制更智能。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Codex 风格的会话消息折叠。/ Provides Codex-style session message folding for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 把连续的工具调用折叠成可展开摘要，让会话历史更清爽，只看结果不刷屏。

description.en: OpenCode Go plan usage monitor for DeepSeek Harness: real-time 5h-rolling / weekly / monthly quota in a floating web dock
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面里加个悬浮窗，实时显示 OpenCode Go 套餐的 5 小时滚动、每周和每月用量配额，并带重置倒计时。

description.en: Registers Baidu, Doubao, Tavily, and Exa backends into ctx.web so official web_search can use them, and routes web_fetch through Tavily Extract or Exa Contents when that backend is active.
description.zh: 独立安装的 DeepSeek Harness 插件集合，即插即用，轻松扩展 AI 工作流。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness web client plugin: group sidebar workspaces into a configurable three-level tree (分类→项目→会话). Sidecar YAML rules. dsh-plugin.
description.zh: 将侧边栏工作区按分类、项目、会话三级树形结构整理，让工作区管理更清晰高效。

description.en: Vault button beside the DSH composer: save keys, servers, phone numbers, addresses and URLs, auto-collected from conversations, password-protected with WebDAV backup; click to insert, Ctrl+click to send.
description.zh: 输入栏旁的保险箱按钮：保存密钥、服务器、手机号、地址与网址，自动识别会话中的敏感信息提醒收录，密码保护并支持 WebDAV 备份；点击填入输入框，Ctrl+点击直接发送。

description.en: Adds selectable animated skins to the "Deep diving..." status row, with configurable size and optional status-text replacement.
description.zh: 为“Deep diving...”状态行添加可选动态皮肤，并支持调整尺寸和可选状态文案替换。

description.en: DSH tools for reproducing and validating the ml-quant-trading protocol v1 CPU benchmark, then drafting an issue-ready report. Requires a local clone of initial-d/ml-quant-trading (set as the workspace or repoPath) plus Python and PyTorch; this plugin does not fetch the repository or install its dependencies.
description.zh: 用于复现并校验 ml-quant-trading protocol v1 CPU 基准测试，并生成可提交 issue 报告的 DSH 工具。需要本地 clone initial-d/ml-quant-trading，并将其设为 workspace 或 repoPath，同时自行准备 Python 和 PyTorch；本插件不会获取仓库或安装依赖。

description.en: Proactive multi-model scheduling plugin: multi-source signal intake with dedup and urgency ranking, a four-way execute/defer/dismiss/ask-user decision engine, DAG plan generation with parallel model execution, quality reflection with automatic retry and model switch, long-term memory for task patterns and lessons, and strategy evolution via genetic algorithms with sandboxed evaluation and canary rollout.
description.zh: 主动式多模型协同调度插件：多源信号接入（去重与紧急度排序），execute/defer/dismiss/ask-user 四级决策引擎，DAG 计划生成与多模型并行执行，质量反思自动重试与切换模型，任务模式与经验教训长期记忆，以及遗传算法策略进化（沙盒评估、金丝雀发布）。

description.en: Migrates skills from other agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and more) into DSH: scans 14 agent platforms plus the shared ~/.agents skills layer, detects duplicate names across sources, lets you pick the best source per skill, copies them into the DSH skills directory, and rolls back previously migrated skills.
description.zh: 把其他 Agent（Cursor、Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等）的技能一键搬进 DeepSeek Harness：扫描 14 个平台外加共享的 ~/.agents 技能层，识别不同来源的同名技能，可挑选每个技能的最佳来源，复制到 DSH 技能目录，支持回滚移除已迁移的技能。

description.en: Edge breathing border showing DeepSeek peak/valley hours, with flowing light and scheduled push reminders.
description.zh: DeepSeek 峰谷提醒：贴屏呼吸边框（高峰橙/低峰蓝）、流光效果与消息推送提醒。

description.en: Free web search with 10 engines (Bing/DuckDuckGo/SearXNG/AnySearch free + Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Perplexity/DeepSeek paid), automatic fallback chain, time-filtered advanced search, platform search (GitHub/Reddit), web page fetching, LRU caching, and a settings UI. No API keys required for basic use.
description.zh: 免费网页搜索，支持 10 个引擎（Bing/DuckDuckGo/SearXNG/AnySearch 免费，Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Perplexity/DeepSeek 付费）、自动回退、按时间筛选的高级搜索、平台搜索（GitHub/Reddit）、网页内容抓取、LRU 缓存和设置界面。基本使用无需 API 密钥。

description.en: 导入本地 Claude、Codex、Grok、Gemini、Copilot、OpenCode 与 CC Switch 配置。 为支持的官方供应商提供 OAuth 登录。 从 OpenAI 兼容网关的 /v1/models 与 /models 发现 CC Switch 模型。
description.zh: 一键导入本地 Claude、Codex 等编程工具登录配置，支持官方 OAuth 登录，自动发现并管理可用模型，让模型选择更省心。

description.en: DSH model-routing plugin for keyword routing and isolated image generation / DSH 关键词路由与隔离生图插件
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个智能路由，按关键词自动分配模型，还能隔离生图任务，省钱又省心。

description.en: Chat with local DeepSeek Harness agents from iPhone iMessage: switch workspaces/sessions, start new sessions, and get replies in the Messages app — no extra apps, no servers, no cloud.

description.en: 模式匹配自动注入 steering rules，不占系统上下文 - Inject rules when needed, without wasting context. Similar to oh-my-pi's "Time-traveling stream rules", but with a very simple and compact code implementation.
description.zh: 模式匹配自动注入 steering rules，不占系统上下文 - Inject rules when needed, without wasting context. Similar to oh-my-pi's "Time-traveling stream rules", but with a very simple and compact code implementation.

description.en: Minecraft theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness: block-texture background, pixel fonts, MC-style buttons with click sounds, texture import/management, music player with local music folder support.
description.zh: 给 DSH 界面换上 Minecraft 方块纹理和像素风，带音效按钮、纹理管理和内置音乐播放器，让开发环境更有游戏感。

description.en: J-Space Cognition Suite V3.6 - Inference-time cognitive control and deep reasoning plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供推理时的认知控制与深度思考能力，让模型在复杂任务中更聪明、更稳定。

description.en: Session handoff & context management: structured handoff documents (export/resume/status) so a fresh session can continue seamlessly, plus active context pruning (acp_* tools via the official compaction API with model-authored summaries).
description.zh: 会话交接与上下文管理：导出/恢复结构化交接文档，让新会话无缝续接；并集成了主动上下文裁剪（acp_* 工具，基于官方 compaction API 与模型自写摘要）。

description.en: Task-isolated long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness — remember / recall / search stay inside one task boundary.
description.zh: 给每个任务建个独立记忆库，存资料、找内容都只在当前任务内流转，彻底告别跨任务信息串扰。

description.en: Cost dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: aggregates model input/output/cache tokens across all local sessions, prices them with a builtin table (including DeepSeek peak/off-peak), and shows daily trends plus per-model and per-session tables.
description.zh: 费用看板：汇总本机全部会话的模型输入/输出/缓存 token，按内置价格表计费（含 DeepSeek 峰谷），展示每日趋势与按模型/会话明细。

description.en: Universal image generation router for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): auto-discovers image models from any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Supports SenseNova, StepFun, Agnes, Qwen, Flux, SD, Imagen and more. | DeepSeek Harness 统一绘图路由器
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 能直接调用任意 OpenAI 兼容接口的生图模型，一句话生成图片。

description.en: 给 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web 界面加一个 VS Code 风格的工作区文件浏览器：右侧文件树 + 可编辑标签页 + Markdown 阅读/编辑/分屏 + 悬浮大纲 + Quick Open 搜索。
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Claude Code-style shell integration: /! for single-command analysis and /terminal for interactive PTY sessions with on-demand history reference.

description.en: Schedule-send button and panel to the right of the composer, with smart time slots, a custom date/time picker, several queued sends at once, and localStorage persistence that restores pending tasks after a page reload.

description.en: Developer tools panel for the DSH web UI: file browser with preview, edit, and path-only file mentions; multi-tab terminals with quick commands; Git panel with commit, push, pull, and branch switching; and background job management. UI ported from pi-web-ui.
description.zh: dsh Web UI 开发者工具面板：文件浏览/预览/编辑与路径式文件提及、多终端（快捷命令）、Git 面板（提交/推送/拉取/分支）与后台任务管理。UI 移植自 pi-web-ui。

description.en: Qixi Festival Easter Egg Plugin: festive skins, bullet comments, and shareable cards.  七夕节彩蛋插件，节日皮肤、弹幕、卡片分享
description.zh: 七夕节彩蛋插件，给AI会话换上节日皮肤，还能发告白弹幕、生成分享卡片，让聊天更有仪式感。

description.en: Unofficial community fork of the Aqua glassmorphism theme for the DeepSeek Harness web UI (upstream: WYH66666666/DSH-Transparent-UI-Plugin, MIT). Adds DSH rc.7 compatibility. Not affiliated with DeepSeek.

description.en: Engineering workflow agent preset for dsh: five gated phases (requirements clarification, plan approval, TDD, parallel subagents, verified finishing) with six workflow skills adapted from obra/superpowers.
description.zh: 工程化工作流 agent preset：五阶段硬门禁（需求澄清、计划审批、TDD、子 Agent 并行、验证收尾），附 6 个改编自 obra/superpowers 的工作流技能。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness(dsh) 新增 Net Access 模式，用于解决 Windows 沙箱内 curl.exe 无法访问 HTTPS 的问题，文件写保护不变。 / Adds a Net Access mode to DeepSeek Harness(dsh): curl.exe can access HTTPS inside the Windows sandbox again, with file-write protection unchanged.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 开启网络访问模式，让 Windows 沙箱里的 curl 能正常访问 HTTPS，同时保持文件写保护不变。

description.zh: 输入框 ✨ 一键润色按钮：参考 WorkBuddy 润色（humanizer-zh）规则改写提示词与草稿（去除 AI 写作痕迹、调整句式节奏，按指令/提问/普通文本分类处理），默认使用免费的智谱 GLM-4.5-Flash，也支持任意 OpenAI 兼容 API，断网时回退到本地规则引擎。

description.en: DSH插件-模型余额显示功能

description.en: Feishu bot bridge plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把飞书机器人接入 DeepSeek Harness，在聊天里直接发消息跑任务，结果自动回传到会话。

description.en: MiniMax-powered multimodal plugin: real-time voice call mode (streaming conversation, floating dock UI), voice mode and mic voice input, plus image/video/music/speech generation and vision inspection tools.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 全局 HTTP 代理插件：undici setGlobalDispatcher + EnvHttpProxyAgent，配置化、热切换、可观测

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件（Cordis toolset）：操作本地 Obsidian 知识库（vault），提供搜索、读写笔记、双向链接 / 关系图谱、批量整理，并通过 Obsidian 的 "Local REST API" 社区插件调用高级能力（高速全文搜索、触发命令 / 模板）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的 MCP / Skill / 记忆管理工具：写入前先连接自检，连不上不写；从 Claude Code / Codex 一键迁移；可装成 dsh 插件，在 Web 里用 /mcp 命令和卡片操作。

description.zh: DSH plugin: auto-fill metadata (context length, output cap, display name, input modalities) for custom-provider models from the Model Metadata Registry (models.dev).

description.en: DSH 插件：在 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面（对话/轨迹）顶部新增「终端」Tab，内置 xterm.js + node-pty 交互式终端，让你在编码完成后即时在终端执行指令调试。

description.zh: 跨会话消息：本机任意会话都可像 Claude Code 一样列出并互发消息，基于本地心跳注册表与收件箱。

description.en: File-drag fork: drop documents as removable chips above the composer, send without typing.
description.zh: 拖放 fork：文档以可删除「文件芯片」挂在输入框上方，不打字也能发送。

description.en: Fail-closed Feishu (Lark) channel bridge: chat with a bot, get dsh agent turns back. Official-Python-SDK-only integration (exact-pinned); deny-by-default allowlist, webhook signature/timestamp/replay verification, per-chat sticky sessions; bilingual docs.
description.zh: Fail-closed 的飞书（Lark）channel 桥：和机器人聊天即驱动 dsh agent turn。仅经官方 Python SDK 集成（精确锁版）；白名单默认全拒、webhook 验签/时间窗/防重放、按 chat 粘性会话；中英双语文档。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness的一些有趣插件
description.zh: 趣味功能合集：夸夸、运势、战报、番茄钟、摸鱼提醒、沉浸氛围、成就赛季、桌宠语音、Live2D、Boss 隐身和代码花园一包集齐。

description.en: DSH 插件：让纯文本模型也能看图。Web 端直接粘贴图片即可发送，无需指定图片路径；模型自主调用视觉技能查看，多模态模型原生直通，零skill绑定。
description.zh: DSH 插件：让纯文本模型也能看图。Web 端直接粘贴图片即可发送，无需指定图片路径；模型自主调用视觉技能查看，多模态模型原生直通，零skill绑定。

description.en: Render local image paths from assistant replies inline in the message body (9 formats, click-to-zoom lightbox, adjustable size).
description.zh: 对话内联图片：LLM 回复中输出的本地图片路径在消息正文直接渲染为图片（9 种格式、点击放大灯箱、可调尺寸）。

description.en: 为deepseek harness构建的奶蛙主题，可是我觉得很神圣呀。（素材来自互联网）
description.zh: 为deepseek harness构建的奶蛙主题，可是我觉得很神圣呀。（素材来自互联网）

description.en: DSH 户外皮肤 · 山野向导（Trail Guide）
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换上徒步山野风格皮肤，带路标进度面板，纯换皮不改功能，界面更养眼。

description.en: Structured long-term memory system for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: dsh-plugin-meta-memory — DSH 插件（会话）

description.en: 滑动变祖器
description.zh: 把模型选择换成滑块，三档推理强度随心调，轻松控制回答深度。

description.en: Search, list and read past and current sessions through the harness's own `sessionQuery` service: uses the SQLite FTS5 index where a deployment enables it, and falls back to a bounded newest-first scan where it does not.
description.zh: 通过 harness 自带的 `sessionQuery` 服务搜索、列出、读取历史与当前会话：部署启用了 SQLite FTS5 索引时走索引，未启用时回退到有上限的倒序扫描。

description.en: 完美复刻 Claude Code 皮肤，纪念我的 Vibe Coding 白月光。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换上 Claude Code 同款皮肤，重温经典终端界面，致敬 Vibe Coding 白月光。

description.en: Media downloader for DeepSeek Harness. Detect and download video/audio from Bilibili, YouTube, Douyin, Xiaohongshu.
description.zh: 媒体下载：检测并下载 Bilibili/YouTube/抖音/小红书视频音频。

description.en: Steam Workshop-style plugin store for the DSH Web UI: browse, search, and one-click install community plugins with mirror acceleration, progress UI, security checks, and Chinese descriptions.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的 Steam 创意工坊式插件商店：浏览、搜索并一键安装社区插件，支持镜像加速、进度 UI、安全检测与中文描述。

description.en: VS Code-style workspace keyword search tab for dsh-better-sidebar: matches file names and content, grouped by file with line numbers, opens in the sidebar editor.
description.zh: VS Code 式工作区关键词搜索 Tab（better-sidebar 扩展）：同时匹配文件名与文件内容，结果按文件分组带行号，点击在侧栏编辑器打开。

description.en: Multi-agent orchestration for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: DSH 多 agent 编排。

description.en: SHOPLINE AI Toolkit: bridges the official SHOPLINE Developer MCP server and ships seven SHOPLINE agent skills (Admin REST, GraphQL, OAuth, webhooks, Sline) — the SHOPLINE counterpart of the Shopify AI Toolkit.
description.zh: SHOPLINE AI 工具包：接入 SHOPLINE 官方开发者 MCP 服务器，内置七个 SHOPLINE 平台技能（Admin REST、GraphQL、OAuth、Webhook、Sline），是 Shopify AI Toolkit 的 SHOPLINE 对应版。

description.en: Short-video sidebar: native player, series navigation, precise history replay.
description.zh: 侧栏短视频：原生播放器、系列导航、精确历史回放。

description.en: Self-control guard plugin for DeepSeek Harness host exit and restart workflows.
description.zh: dsh-self-control-guard — DSH 插件（编排）

description.en: dsh的罗小黑插件
description.zh: dsh的罗小黑插件

description.en: WeCom AI Bot text and image bridge for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 企业微信机器人桥接：文本+图片双通道，企业微信直接当 DSH 聊天入口。

description.en: A Cordis plugin that enables DeepSeek Harness to proactively preview and display web pages.
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Free keyless Tavily web search tool for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
description.zh: dsh-tavily-search — DSH 插件（工具）

description.en: VS Code-style three-column Explorer + Monaco editor plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI
description.zh: VS Code 风格三栏文件浏览 + Monaco 编辑器，网页版 DSH 直接变身 IDE。

description.en: Makes plain Enter insert a newline in the composer and Ctrl/Cmd+Enter submit, toggleable in settings.
description.zh: 让对话框中普通 Enter 换行、Ctrl/Cmd+Enter 提交，可在设置中开关。

description.en: Literature research toolset registering 26 model tools over PubMed, Europe PMC, OpenAlex, PubTator3 and Semantic Scholar: field-syntax search, ID conversion, bibliographic lookup, citation formatting, MeSH and related-article walking, PubTator bioconcept resolution and relation queries, Europe PMC and Semantic Scholar paging, full-text retrieval, and open-access PDF discovery with optional download. A unified search deduplicates hits across sources and orders results by cross-source hits, then relevance, then citation count; a session knowledge graph with PubTator concept enrichment commits to a persistent user graph and renders as Mermaid. Most sources need no key.
description.zh: 文献研究工具集，注册 26 个模型工具，覆盖 PubMed、Europe PMC、OpenAlex、PubTator3 与 Semantic Scholar：字段语法检索、ID 互换、残缺引文定位、引文格式化、MeSH 与相关文献追溯、PubTator 生物概念归一与关系查询、Europe PMC 与 Semantic Scholar 翻页检索、全文获取，以及开放获取 PDF 发现（可选下载）。统一检索会跨源去重，排序依次按跨源命中、相关度、被引数；会话知识图谱带 PubTator 概念富集，可提交为持久用户图谱并渲染为 Mermaid。多数数据源无需密钥。

description.en: Rearranges DSH Web into a three-column workbench with file editing, Git views, Markdown preview, and workspace terminals.
description.zh: 将 DSH Web 重排为三栏工作台，提供文件编辑、Git 视图、Markdown 预览和工作区终端。

description.en: Preset doctor for agent presets: scans home/profile `cordis.patch.yml` declarations and legacy `.agent-presets/` dirs across host lines 0.1.0→0.2.0, shows every detected preset as an official-style card (source/era badges, broken red border, per-finding details, current DSH version + era catalog), and syncs a preset to the current syntax per-card behind an explicit confirm dialog (.bak backup + atomic write; report-level findings are never written — startup scans are report-only). npm: `dsh-preset-doctor`.
description.zh: Agent 预设医生：跨宿主线（0.1.0→0.2.0）扫描 home/profile `cordis.patch.yml` 声明与遗留 `.agent-presets/` 目录，把检测到的每个预设以官方同款卡片展示（来源/代际徽章、失效红边、逐条修复项明细、当前 DSH 版本与代际目录）；卡内「同步到当前版本」走显式确认框（.bak 备份 + 原子写，需人工裁决项永不写盘，启动扫描恒只报告）。npm 包名：`dsh-preset-doctor`。

description.en: Read-only Git panel for the current workspace — branch, changed files, diffs and image before/after compare — plus three capsules above the composer (Git status, tool and skill activity, session running time) and per-session change attribution with review progress.
description.zh: 当前工作区的只读 Git 面板：分支、改动清单、差异与图片前后对比，外加输入框上方的三枚胶囊（Git 状态、工具与技能活动、会话运行时长），以及本会话改动归因与审阅进度。

description.en: Freshness gate for the agent's test, typecheck, lint and build claims: each verification run becomes a receipt on tools/post-execute, file edits are tracked, and on agent/turn-stopping a claim whose latest receipt is stale, failed or has no readable result steers one more step naming the receipt and the files edited since.
description.zh: 为智能体的测试、类型检查、lint 与构建结论提供新鲜度检查：每次验证运行在 tools/post-execute 上记录为凭据，文件修改被跟踪；在 agent/turn-stopping 时，若结论对应的最新凭据已过期、失败或没有可读结果，则引导再走一步，并指出凭据与其后被修改的文件。

description.en: Mounts the hosted Exa search MCP endpoint (https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp) through the in-box @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client bridge: web_search_exa and web_fetch_exa tools, anonymous on the free tier or with your own EXA_API_KEY.
description.zh: 通过内置的 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 桥接接入托管的 Exa 搜索 MCP 端点（mcp.exa.ai）：web_search_exa 与 web_fetch_exa 工具，免费额度匿名可用，设置 EXA_API_KEY 可解锁更高限额。

description.en: Per-workspace completion ringtones plus attention sounds for approval, question, plan-review, goal-blocked, and task-failure events, with built-in synth, voice (TTS), and custom audio.
description.zh: 按工作区定制的任务完成铃声，以及审批、提问、计划评审、目标受阻、任务失败等需要人介入事件的注意提示音，支持内置合成音、语音播报与自定义音频。

description.en: Adds a 3D model library in its own conversation tab, where agents store models built from CadQuery scripts or supplied as tessellated meshes; the library previews them with three-cad-viewer, organises them into folders and exports them to 10 formats including STEP, BREP, STL and DXF.
description.zh: 在对话界面新增「3D模型」标签页作为模型库：agent 把 CadQuery 脚本或已剖分的网格存入服务端，标签页用 three-cad-viewer 预览、按文件夹整理，并可导出 STEP、BREP、STL、DXF 等 10 种格式。

description.en: Schedule a message into a dsh chat for later: a Schedule button in the message box with a date and time picker, a sidebar panel of pending messages across chats, delivery as a normal user message even with the browser closed, and schedule_message, list_scheduled_messages and cancel_scheduled_message tools so the model can come back to a chat on its own.
description.zh: 把消息排进 dsh 会话稍后再发：消息框里带日期与时间选择器的「定时」按钮、跨会话列出待发消息的侧栏面板、浏览器关着也由宿主按时投递成一条普通用户消息，以及 schedule_message / list_scheduled_messages / cancel_scheduled_message 三个工具，模型因而能自己回到某个会话。

description.en: Forgetting-curve in-place dialogue compression for DeepSeek Harness: recent turns stay verbatim, middle turns are structurally dehydrated (zero-LLM), ancient turns fold into a bounded summary pair — unbounded conversations on a bounded memory budget.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于自然遗忘曲线的就地对话压缩：近期对话逐字保留、中期结构化脱水（零 LLM 成本）、久远对话折叠为有界摘要对——有限记忆预算上的无限对话。

description.en: Superself's self CLI as model-facing tools (project context, work units, reports, decisions) plus a /self command — cross-session, cross-project project state kept outside the code repo.
description.zh: 把 Superself 的 self CLI 暴露为模型工具（项目上下文、工作单元、报告、决策）并提供 /self 命令——跨会话、跨项目的项目状态，保存在代码仓库之外。

description.en: Group installed skills and manage MCP servers from a left-panel UI: filter the model skill catalog by enabled groups (union-deduped) and toggle MCP servers independently.
description.zh: 将已安装的技能分组管理、独立开关 MCP 服务器：按启用分组过滤模型可见的技能目录（并集去重），全部操作集中在左侧面板。

description.en: 电机AI辅助设计软件插件 · L0 层（毫秒级广筛）；共享核心逻辑 @wangxue98/dsh-motor-ai-core
description.zh: 电机 AI 辅助设计插件：需求解析 → 参数识别 → 候选矩阵 → Top10 校验。L0 纯 JS、零求解器依赖，毫秒级广筛候选并给出交给 L1/L2 精算工具的载荷；可作为本地 agent 预设与 Cordis 插件使用。L1（RMxprt）与 L2（Motor-CAD）在本版本中仅预留接口，层级总闸设为 l0 以上会立即报错。

description.en: Deterministic AST code graph and architecture intelligence tool for call hierarchies, blast radius, circular dependencies, domain slices, and full-stack API contracts.
description.zh: 确定性 AST 代码图谱与架构治理分析工具：调用链消歧、重构爆炸半径、循环依赖审计、领域切片与全栈 API 契约追踪。

description.en: Auto-repairs the messages array after a tool-dispatch crash (orphaned tool_calls / tool messages), preventing 400 INVALID_REQUEST session lock-ups.
description.zh: 工具调度崩溃后自动修复 messages 数组（孤儿 tool_calls / tool 消息），防止 400 INVALID_REQUEST 会话卡死。

description.en: Visual development studio for DSH WebUI plugins with isolated Git worktrees, live official-WebUI previews, source editing, patch inspection, builds, and validation.
description.zh: 面向 DSH WebUI 插件的可视化开发工作室，提供隔离的 Git worktree、真实官方 WebUI 预览、源码编辑、Patch 检查、构建与验证。

description.en: Three switchable low-glare themes (Warm Paper, Sage Green, Warm Grey) for the DeepSeek Harness GUI, each a full alias-token layer with a light and a dark face.
description.zh: 三套可切换的低刺激护眼配色（暖纸、豆绿、暖灰），每套都是完整的别名 token 层，含浅色与深色两副面貌。

description.en: 11 shareable workflow skills (handoff, triage, to-spec, to-tickets, wayfinder, teach, wait-what, dsh-mode-routing, ask-matt, overnight-execution, full-throttle) as an installable skill pack.
description.zh: 11 个可分享的工作流 skills（handoff、triage、to-spec、to-tickets、wayfinder、teach、wait-what、dsh-mode-routing、ask-matt、overnight-execution、full-throttle），打包为可安装 bundle。

description.en: Zhipu (GLM Coding Plan) web suite as native DSH providers and tools: rebinds the built-in web_search and web_fetch to Zhipu web search and Markdown page reading, optionally registers github_search_doc / github_get_repo_structure / github_read_file repo tools, and adds a settings card with toggles and a credential-ref field.
description.zh: 智谱（GLM Coding Plan）三件套以原生 provider 与工具接入：内置 web_search / web_fetch 后端切换为智谱联网搜索与网页 Markdown 读取，可选注册 github_search_doc / github_get_repo_structure / github_read_file 开源仓库工具，附设置卡片配置开关与凭据引用名。

description.en: Runs PowerShell scripts through base64 encoding, so quotes, $, backslashes and CJK survive as written. Same sandbox channel as the built-in pwsh tool.
description.zh: 把 PowerShell 脚本 base64 编码后执行，引号、$、反斜杠、中文全部原样传递，免去转义地狱。走与内置 pwsh 工具相同的沙箱通道。

description.en: Renders every file mutation in the web chat as one collapsed diff card with per-line highlighting — MCP filesystem edit_file/write_file and the built-in edit/write.
description.zh: 把网页对话里的每次文件改动渲染成一张折叠的 diff 卡片并逐行高亮，涵盖 MCP filesystem 的 edit_file/write_file 与内置的 edit/write。

description.en: Adds an input-modality selector to custom model settings in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的自定义模型设置添加输入模态选择器。

description.en: Tree view of a DSH conversation: editing an old message forks the thread, every version lives in one tree while the sidebar keeps a single entry, branches can be renamed, and a branch can be promoted to a session of its own.
description.zh: DSH 会话的树形视图：编辑一条旧消息即从那一刻分叉，所有版本住进同一棵树、侧栏始终只有一条，分支可以改名，也可以把某个分支提升为独立会话。

description.en: Brings WorkBuddy free/paid models (domestic + international) into DSH without the desktop app, published as @bushizhanghan/dsh-workmate. This package is a maintained fork of Faide-cyber/dsh-workbuddy (whose upstream entry is already listed in this catalogue); do NOT co-install both, as they register the same provider id "workbuddy-ai" and will collide. v1.2.7 relocates over-long system prompts past the domestic gateway channel-risk classifier, rewrites the DSH brand string, and adds a debug dump; supports dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 through 0.2.1 (incl. prereleases).
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 国内版和国际版的免费/付费模型接进 DSH，无需桌面端；以 @bushizhanghan/dsh-workmate 发布。本包是 Faide-cyber/dsh-workbuddy 的维护分支（上游条目已在目录内）；请勿与上游同装，二者共用 provider id「workbuddy-ai」会冲突。v1.2.7：跨国内网关风控——长系统提示自动搬迁、出站体改写 DSH 字样、调试落盘；支持 dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 至 0.2.1（含预发布）。

description.en: Injects durable user-set must-do and must-not requirements into the model at conversation start.
description.zh: 在会话开始时向模型注入用户设定的“必须做 / 不能做”持久要求。

description.en: Image viewer for the dock workbench: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, SVG, ICO and AVIF, with SVG rendered as image data only.
description.zh: dock 系列图片查看器：支持 PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP/BMP/SVG/ICO/AVIF 格式，SVG 仅以安全方式渲染。

description.en: Offline diagnostic for DSH: 19 checks across env, profile, and session state, with a settings "Doctor" panel and a read-only JSON API.
description.zh: 离线诊断工具：环境/Profile/会话共 19 项检查，带设置「诊断」面板与只读 JSON API。

description.en: OpenCode free models for DSH with dynamic model-list refresh, optional HTTP(S)/SOCKS proxy failover, a fail-closed tool bridge and offline agent-scoped compatibility auditing.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode 免费模型，支持模型列表动态刷新与可选的代理出口轮换，并提供默认拒绝不安全转换的工具桥与离线、按 Agent 作用域的兼容性审计。

description.en: Reads assistant replies aloud via Fish Audio API only (bring your own key): per-message read-aloud, auto-read toggle, and a settings page for model, voice reference_id, encrypted API key, and proxy.
description.zh: 朗读助手回复（仅支持 Fish Audio API，需自备 Key）：逐条朗读、自动朗读开关，设置页可配模型、音色 reference_id、加密 API Key 与代理。

description.en: Git history visualization for the dock workbench: swimlane commit graph, branch and tag management, stage/commit/push and remote operations.
description.zh: dock 系列 Git 历史可视化插件：泳道式提交图、分支/标签管理、暂存/提交/推送与远端操作。

description.en: A fully customizable theming framework for DSH UI, with Xiao from Genshin Impact as the default theme.
description.zh: 为 DSH UI 提供完全自定义的主题框架，默认主题为原神魈。

description.en: Aggregated web-search provider for the built-in web_search tool: one prioritized queue over nine providers (AnySearch, TinyFish, Tavily, Brave, Exa, Firecrawl, Jina, SerpApi, Serper), with multi-key rotation per provider, ordered fallback on failed attempts, and a live settings card.
description.zh: 聚合式网页搜索提供方：为内置 web_search 工具提供一条按优先级排序的搜索队列，覆盖 AnySearch、TinyFish、Tavily、Brave、Exa、Firecrawl、Jina、SerpApi、Serper 九家服务，每家支持多把 API Key 轮换，失败时逐级回退，并附带实时生效的设置卡片。

description.en: Codex-backed `web_search`, `image_gen`, and `image_vision` tools for DeepSeek Harness, reusing ChatGPT OAuth login state.
description.zh: 基于 Codex 的 `web_search`、`image_gen` 与 `image_vision` 工具，复用 ChatGPT OAuth 登录态为 DeepSeek Harness 提供网页搜索、生图与识图能力。

description.en: Device channel between the agent and your own phone: it sends files it just produced, and you @-reference what your phone sent back. End-to-end encrypted P2P through the SwarmDrop CLI, with no account and no public IP; node status, paired devices and QR pairing sit in a sidebar panel.
description.zh: 在 agent 和你自己的手机之间开一条设备通道：agent 把刚产出的文件发过去，手机传回来的东西可以在输入框里 @ 引用。底层经 SwarmDrop CLI 走端到端加密的 P2P，不需要账号，也不需要公网 IP；节点状态、已配对设备与扫码配对都在侧边栏面板里。

description.en: Writes local JSONL summaries of per-turn tool counts and coarse verification signals without storing prompts, tool arguments, or result text.
description.zh: 把每轮工具计数与粗粒度验证信号写入本地 JSONL，不保存提示词、工具参数或结果正文。

description.en: Structural long-term memory for DSH: supersede, decay and entity-state tracking across 15 MCP tools, automatic recall and capture hooks, and a bounded pointer index published per request instead of filling the window. Requires Python 3.10+ with torch and sentence-transformers; the first run downloads a ~470 MB embedding model.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的结构化长期记忆：15 个 MCP 工具支持取代、衰减与实体状态跟踪，带自动召回与捕获钩子，并按请求发布有界指针索引，而不是等上下文塞满再压缩。需要带 torch 与 sentence-transformers 的 Python 3.10+；首次运行会下载约 470 MB 的嵌入模型。

description.en: Concurrency guard and monitor for DeepSeek Harness: FIFO queue when concurrent model requests reach the limit, per-day persisted stats with error-kind classification, and interruption detection for abandoned streams.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 并发监控与门闩：模型请求达上限时 FIFO 排队防锁号，按天持久化统计并做异常分类，检测流被弃用的回合中断。

description.en: Vision MCP and DSH bundle for text-only DeepSeek: analyze_image, analyze_clipboard, compare_images and vision_status tools, a visual settings page, free GLM-4.6V-Flash by default, result caching and rate-limit tolerance; keys stay out of logs.
description.zh: 面向纯文本 DeepSeek 的视觉 MCP + DSH 插件：analyze_image / analyze_clipboard / compare_images / vision_status 四个工具、可视化配置页、默认免费 GLM-4.6V-Flash、结果缓存与限流容错，Key 不入日志。

description.en: Run Stata through DeepSeek Harness: the native Stata AI Skill service auto-starts with DSH (macOS/Windows binaries bundled), so you can run regressions, do-files and econometrics workflows with no manual setup.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中运行 Stata：Stata AI Skill 原生服务随 DSH 自动启动（内置 macOS/Windows 多平台二进制），无需手动配置即可跑回归、do 文件与计量工作流。

description.en: Persistent local token-usage accounting for DSH Web with automatic history discovery and compact provider/model details.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供自动发现历史记录的本地持久化 Token 用量统计与紧凑的供应商/模型明细。

description.en: Task control for DeepSeek Harness: one-click emergency stop and force-termination of stuck downloads and tool calls, download progress, stuck detection, pwsh activity monitoring, and append-condition / pause / resume with invisible recovery.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 任务控制：卡死的下载与工具调用一键急停与强制终止、下载进度、卡死识别、pwsh 运行状态检测，以及追加条件/暂停/恢复（恢复指令隐形注入，不打扰聊天）。

description.en: OpenDesign Go provider: 12 subscription models over Chat Completions, the real 5-hour and 7-day quota read from the local OpenDesign app, per-model parameters and switches, and multi-account failover.
description.zh: OpenDesign Go 模型提供方：以 Chat Completions 协议接入 12 个订阅模型，从本机 OpenDesign 客户端读取真实的 5 小时 / 7 天额度，支持每模型参数与开关、多账号失败切换。

description.en: Floating NetEase Cloud Music player for DSH Web: draggable collapsible window with mini mode, playlist discovery with search and hot lists, synced lyrics with translations, persistent playback queue, QR-code or Cookie login, colors following the DSH skin theme.
description.zh: 网易云音乐浮窗播放器：可拖拽/折叠浮窗与迷你条，歌单发现（搜索/热门歌单），逐行同步歌词与翻译，播放队列持久化，扫码或 Cookie 登录，颜色跟随 DSH 皮肤主题。

description.en: Learns what you leave unsaid in your prompts from messy turns and your own corrections, and injects the learned directives into the system prompt of every new conversation; the directives are editable in Settings and a composer button rewrites the current draft with them.
description.zh: 从不顺的轮次和你自己的纠正中学习你在提示词里没说出口的东西，并把学到的指令注入每个新对话的系统提示；指令可在设置中编辑，输入框按钮可用它们改写当前草稿。

description.en: Give agents access to files on the machine where the browser runs: user authorizes a local directory via File System Access, tool calls relay over the plugin's own WebSocket; read-only compat mode for mobile/insecure contexts.
description.zh: 让 agent 读写浏览器所在电脑上的文件：浏览器授权本地目录（File System Access），工具调用经插件自建 WebSocket 中继；移动端/非安全上下文自动降级只读兼容模式。

description.en: Draggable floating cat-or-dog companion for the dsh web GUI that changes expression with the session and is configured on a Companion settings page.
description.zh: 可拖拽的猫狗悬浮伴侣，表情随当前会话变化，在 Companion 设置页里换皮肤。

description.en: Full-screen boot animation covering the loading page until the app UI is ready. Ships a built-in video/wallpaper/audio library, accepts your own files, and adds uninstall and one-click update buttons on its settings page.
description.zh: 全屏开机动画，盖住加载页直到应用就绪再淡出。内置视频、壁纸与开机音频素材库，支持上传自己的文件；设置页内带卸载与一键更新按钮。

description.en: Cross-session reference (mention) plugin — paste @[label](dsh-session:…) into any session, including one in another workspace, and the host injects the referenced session snapshot for the model to read; includes a one-click copy-reference button.
description.zh: 跨会话引用插件：在任意会话（含其他工作区）粘贴 @[label](dsh-session:…) 引用，宿主注入被引用会话的快照供模型阅读，并提供一键复制引用按钮。

description.en: OpenAI-completions-compatible adapter for custom gateways (vLLM / LM Studio / self-hosted proxies): always role:"system", thinking driven by the model config, Qwen-style response split, and vision-model image input (single / multiple).
description.zh: 面向自定义网关（vLLM / LM Studio / 自托管代理）的 OpenAI-completions 兼容适配器：始终 role:"system"、按模型配置驱动思考、Qwen 式 response 切分，并支持视觉模型图片输入（单图 / 多图）。

description.en: Behavior-drift reports for DSH sessions: compares two session logs and reports tool-sequence alignment, tool mix, reasoning volume, timing, retries and file targets, with an optional CI threshold gate. Zero dependencies.
description.zh: DSH 会话的行为漂移报告：对比两份 session log，输出工具序列对齐、工具构成、推理量、耗时、重试与文件目标的差异，并支持可选的 CI 阈值门禁。零依赖。

description.en: Cron job board: schedules local scripts or dsh session tasks (fresh or pinned sessions) by cron expression, with centralized environment-variable management, run logs, and concurrency and timeout control.
description.zh: 定时任务看板：cron 调度本地脚本或 dsh 会话任务（每次新建/固定会话），环境变量集中管理，执行日志与并发/超时控制。

description.en: AI audio generation for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI — multi-vendor TTS, music, sound effects and voice design with a sidebar panel, model comparison, resource library and Agent tools.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的 AI 音频插件 —— 多厂商 TTS、音乐、音效与音色设计，含侧边栏面板、模型对比、资源库与 Agent 工具。

description.en: Interactive code-reading coach for DeepSeek Harness: a five-phase guided walkthrough of the source behind a paper, starting by identifying its language and framework.
description.zh: 代码研读教练：交互式引导研读论文对应的开源代码。五段研读法（锚定论文主张、地形扫描、入口追踪、核心映射、闭环验证），自动识别并告知语言的框架与架构，适合研读 AI 论文源码。

description.en: Continues numbered and bulleted lists in the DSH composer, so Shift+Enter after "1. item" starts a new line with the next marker.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框里写列表时，Shift+Enter 换行后自动补上下一个编号（1. → 2.）或项目符号。

description.en: Compaction fallback for compaction-basic: when its LLM summary throws, comes back empty or cannot fit the window, the span is compiled deterministically with a seq pointer on every line (vendored dsh-compaction-instant compiler). Adds recall and search tools, /recall and /context commands, an idle trigger at 45% of the window and an on-disk span archive. The engine mounts as one row in the agent preset (docs/dsh-integration.md).
description.zh: 为 compaction-basic 提供压缩兜底：当 LLM 摘要抛错、返回空内容或放不进上下文窗口时，改为确定性编译该区段，每行带 seq 指针（内置 dsh-compaction-instant 编译器）。提供 recall、search 工具与 /recall、/context 命令，占用超过窗口 45% 时空闲自动压缩，并将被压缩区段归档到磁盘。引擎以一行配置挂载到 agent preset（见 docs/dsh-integration.md）。

description.en: Renders pasted/uploaded images inline in the DSH Web chat and gives text-only models vision: the model-invokable visual_review tool calls any OpenAI-compatible multimodal API first, falling back to a local Qwen3-VL worker.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 聊天界面内联渲染粘贴/上传的图片，并让纯文本模型“看见”图片：visual_review 工具优先调用任意 OpenAI 兼容多模态 API，未配置时回退本机 Qwen3-VL。

description.en: Session timeline down the left of the conversation: every user message at a glance, current-message tracking, hover preview of the message and its reply, click to jump, collapsible.
description.zh: 会话左侧的短横线时间轴：整个会话的用户消息一览、当前消息定位、悬停预览消息与回复、点击跳转，可收起展开。

description.en: Liquid-glass theme for DeepSeek Harness with SVG edge refraction on the composer, bubbles, queue dock, menus and sidebar, translucent token overrides driven by live sliders for tint, opacity, blur and refraction, custom or built-in animated wallpapers, and desktop chrome extras such as a session bar merged into the system title bar and a fullscreen button.
description.zh: 适用于 DeepSeek Harness 的液态玻璃主题：输入卡片、气泡、队列坞、菜单与侧边栏带 SVG 边缘折射；半透明 token 覆盖，色调、不透明度、模糊与折射强度都有实时滑块；壁纸可自定义或使用内置动态壁纸；桌面版另把会话顶栏并入系统标题栏，并补了全屏按钮。

description.en: Self-tending living memory in one local SQLite file — a nightly patrol dedupes, merges, decays and cross-links entries on its own, with seven-signal RRF hybrid recall (FTS5 + jieba Chinese-first tokenization, optional vector KNN, graph PPR), a typed knowledge graph, conflict detection instead of silent overwrites, and web telemetry panels.
description.zh: 单文件本地 SQLite 的自整理活记忆——夜巡引擎自动去重、合并、衰减、建链，七信号 RRF 混合检索（FTS5+jieba 中文优先分词、可选向量 KNN、图谱 PPR），带类型知识图谱，冲突检测标记矛盾而非静默覆写，Web 遥测面板。

description.en: Session usage statistics panel: token and request stats at day/hour/minute granularity, an activity heatmap, bottom-bar session info takeover with per-turn cost chips, and cost estimation under multi-condition time-segmented pricing. Re-implemented from HaoyueQin/dsh-usage-statistics-panel with extensions.
description.zh: 会话用量统计面板：天/小时/分钟三粒度 token 与请求统计、活跃热力图、会话底栏信息接管与回合费用芯片、多条件分时段定价费用估算；复刻自 HaoyueQin/dsh-usage-statistics-panel 并扩展。

description.en: DSH model provider for the locally authenticated AGY CLI: Gemini/Claude model discovery, independent reasoning effort, DSH-owned tools, bounded context and tool-result handling, and Windows-safe streaming. Report problems in GitHub Issues: https://github.com/darkings/dsh-agy-provider/issues.
description.zh: 将本机已登录的 AGY CLI 接入 DSH 作为模型 Provider：支持 Gemini/Claude 模型发现、独立推理强度、DSH-owned 工具、受限上下文与工具结果管理、Windows 安全流式传输；如遇问题，请在 GitHub 提交 Issue：https://github.com/darkings/dsh-agy-provider/issues。

description.en: Fail-closed runtime tool-call loop guard for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供故障关闭式运行时工具调用循环防护。

description.en: Forge quality gates for DeepSeek Harness: task gates, read-before-edit, bash hazard interception and quality scoring, enforced by the local forge CLI through DSH's typed interception points. Requires the forge CLI on PATH; without it the plugin fails open and says so with a best-effort notice at session start, and task gates also need forge init in the project.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Forge 质量门禁：任务门禁、改前必读、危险命令拦截与质量评分，经 DSH 类型化拦截点由本地 forge CLI 执行。需本机安装 forge CLI，缺失时插件 fail-open 并在会话开始时尽力提示；任务门禁还要求项目已执行 forge init。

description.en: DFY 插件组合包：壁纸、外观、归档管理、媒体内容、图像生成、交互可视化、任务守卫和 Codex 连接。
SSH host manager for DeepSeek Harness: browse ~/.ssh/config, store AES-256-GCM encrypted passwords, run batch commands and SFTP, and open interactive PTY terminals in persistent sidebar tabs.
description.zh: DSH 的 SSH 主机管理插件：浏览 ~/.ssh/config，保存 AES-256-GCM 加密密码，执行批量命令与 SFTP，并在可保持的侧边栏标签页中打开交互式 PTY 终端。

description.en: Session-affinity routing for LLM gateways: injects the session ID into every request sent to NewApi-style gateways so the gateway can pin requests per session and raise prompt-cache hits; takes over the official pi-ai routing on install and restores it on uninstall.
description.zh: LLM 网关会话粘性路由：把会话 sessionId 注入发往 NewApi 类网关的每个请求，供网关做请求亲和以提升 prompt cache 命中，装上即接管官方 pi-ai 路由，卸载即还原。

description.en: Compaction fix for NInfer-hosted qwen3.8-27b gateways: disables thinking on dsh context-compaction and session-title calls so xhigh reasoning stops burning the whole output budget; the same idea applies to other launch methods, this package targets NInfer only.
description.zh: 针对 NInfer 托管的 qwen3.8-27b 网关的压缩修复：在 dsh 上下文压缩与会话标题调用中关闭思考，避免 xhigh 推理耗尽全部输出预算；同一思路适用于其他启动方式，本包仅面向 NInfer。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance, this session's billed spend, and today's total spend in the session-header badge; a turn-cost row in the message actions strip, a detail panel with per-model pricing and a today session-spend ranking. Official peak/off-peak pricing; balance from the real /user/balance API.
description.zh: 会话头部徽标显示 DeepSeek 账户余额、本轮对话花费与今日全部会话总花费；每轮消息操作行前置本轮花费，详情面板含按模型计价与今日会话消费排行。官方峰谷定价，余额取自 /user/balance API。

description.en: Project board: kanban card groups with custom stages, cards linked to landfill-project memory, mounted repos and existing sessions; sessions opened from a card auto-load its memory.
description.zh: 项目看板：卡片组泳道自定义阶段，卡片关联落盘项目记忆、挂载仓库与已有会话（可恢复归档）；从卡片开的会话自动读取项目记忆。

description.en: OpenCode Console (Zen) models for DeepSeek Harness: paste a Console API key under Settings → Plugins and the Console's chat models become selectable, with the catalog synced automatically, each model routed to the endpoint the official docs assign, and free *-free models hidden by default because they only run inside the OpenCode client.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenCode Console (Zen) 模型：在「设置 → 插件」填入 Console API Key 后即可选用 Console 的对话模型，模型目录自动同步，每个模型按官方文档路由到对应端点，免费 *-free 模型默认不列出（它们只能在 OpenCode 客户端内运行）。

description.en: Full vision-capability bundle for DeepSeek Harness: a vision_understand tool (OpenAI-compatible vision APIs, free Zhipu GLM-4V-Flash by default) plus paste/drag-and-drop/button entry points for image recognition.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 视觉能力全家桶：vision_understand 工具（OpenAI 兼容视觉 API，默认免费智谱 GLM-4V-Flash）+ 粘贴/拖拽/按钮三入口识图。

description.en: Multi-platform LLM balance and quota panel: configure DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Kimi, Zhipu GLM, MiniMax, NewApi or custom endpoints, poll on a schedule, draw balance and quota trend charts, and push threshold and window-reset notices through multiple channels.
description.zh: 多平台 LLM 账号余额与额度面板：配置 DeepSeek、OpenRouter、Kimi、智谱、MiniMax、NewApi 或自定义端点，定时自动查询并绘制趋势图，余额/额度阈值与窗口重置经多通道推送通知。

description.en: A fake-ip-aware ctx.web fetch provider that takes over the stock http provider id: a hostname is accepted when every DNS answer is a placeholder inside the proxy's fake-ip block (198.18.0.0/15 by default), so web_fetch works under mihomo/Clash TUN mode without disabling fake-ip or setting proxy environment variables. IP literals and private, loopback and reserved destinations stay blocked.
description.zh: ctx.web 的 fake-ip 感知抓取后端，接管官方 http provider id：当某主机名的每一条 DNS 应答都是代理 fake-ip 段（默认 198.18.0.0/15）内的占位地址时予以接受，从而在 mihomo/Clash TUN 模式下无需关闭 fake-ip、也无需设置代理环境变量即可使用 web_fetch；IP 字面量与私有、回环、保留地址仍被拒绝。

description.en: A self-evolving plugin for DeepSeek Harness: it observes how the agent runs, proposes improvements to its own assets via the LLM, validates each proposal inside a sandboxed trial agent, and applies only verified mutations — with a versioned ledger and automatic rollback on regression.
description.zh: 一个自我进化的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：观察代理的运行方式，通过 LLM 对其自身资产提出改进方案，在沙箱试运行代理中验证每个方案，只应用通过验证的变更——带版本化账本，出现性能回退时自动回滚。

description.en: Turns large text pastes into pastes/*.txt attachments with a dock above the composer and a minimal, recognisable badge in the draft.
description.zh: 大段文本粘贴自动存为 pastes/*.txt 附件,输入框上方 dock 卡片管理,草稿内只留可辨识的最小徽标。

description.en: LLM auto-approval for sandbox escalation requests, with presets and a fail-closed fallback.
description.zh: 沙箱升权申请的 LLM 自动审批：内置预设，fail-closed 兜底。

description.en: Adds an extensible Functions menu to the DSH top bar, where plugins register one-click actions with staged confirmations and submenus. Since 0.4.0 it bundles a built-in "Restart DSH" action, so no separate restart plugin is needed.
description.zh: 给 DSH 顶端加一个可扩展的「功能」栏：插件注册的一键动作都在这里，支持分级确认与二级菜单。0.4.0 起自带了「重启 DSH」功能，不再需要单独安装重启插件。

description.en: Translates DSH's private remote protocol into a versioned REST API (chat, sessions, files, devices) for trusted clients such as the Android app dsh-companion, plus a Phone-settings panel inside the DSH WebUI settings: five cards in the main list (remote access, public tunnel, devices, trash, app download) and an Advanced settings group holding authorized roots, image reading and plugins.
description.zh: 把 DSH 内核的私有 remote 协议翻译成版本化 REST 接口（聊天、会话、文件、设备），供 Android 客户端 dsh-companion 等受信任客户端使用；桌面端在 DSH 设置里提供「手机设置」面板：主列表五张卡（远程访问 / 外网隧道 / 设备 / 回收站 / App 下载），另有「高级设置」组收纳授权根目录、识图与插件三项。

description.en: Version and maintenance suite for DSH itself: detects new host releases from npm dist-tags, upgrades with one click, restarts safely, and the web page auto-recovers once the host is back.
description.zh: DSH 版本与运维一体化：自动发现新版本、一键升级、安全重启，重启后页面自动恢复。

description.en: File-change monitor and code editor for the DSH Web UI. Agent edits appear beside your conversation as real-time line-by-line diffs, with a syntax-highlighted editor, one-click revert, change history, workspace switcher, and per-session isolation.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的文件修改监视器与代码工作台。Agent 修改代码时实时浮现逐行 Diff，内置语法高亮编辑器，支持一键还原、修改历史、工作区切换与按会话隔离。

description.en: An OpenCode Go model source for DSH: it reads the opencode-go catalog from Models.dev and serves it on a separate opencode-go-live route, leaving the built-in opencode-go route in place. The catalog snapshot is cached under the DSH home and a failed refresh keeps the last successful one; its own Models settings card edits the route key and can render OpenCode Go subscription usage.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 OpenCode Go 模型来源：从 Models.dev 读取 opencode-go 目录，在独立的 opencode-go-live 路由上提供，内置 opencode-go 路由保持原样。目录快照缓存在 DSH home 下，刷新失败时沿用上一次成功的目录；插件自带 Models 设置卡片用于填写该路由密钥，并可显示 OpenCode Go 订阅用量。

description.en: Local Markdown user and project memory for DSH: pinned preferences, keyword search, soft invalidation, history and archive, and JSON migration with preview, backup and rollback.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的本地 Markdown 用户与项目记忆：置顶偏好、关键词检索、软失效、历史归档，以及带预览、备份与回滚的 JSON 迁移。

description.en: Expert manager: manage ntd-format experts and expert teams (plugin.json + Agent MD + skill sets), browse and install from a built-in market of 50+ experts, and run tasks in an expert persona via /expert-<name> without consuming model directory tokens.
description.zh: 专家管理：管理 ntd 格式的专家与专家团队（plugin.json + Agent MD + 技能集），内置 50+ 专家市场，`/expert-名称` 以专家身份执行任务，不占模型目录 token。

description.en: Manages multiple Jenkins servers and triggers jobs from a Settings page, model tools, or a per-workspace "Run Jenkins Job" entry, with a bilingual host + browser UI.
description.zh: 管理多台 Jenkins 服务器，支持从设置页、模型工具或工作区级「执行 Jenkins Job」入口触发构建，宿主 + 浏览器双端、界面中英双语。

description.en: Session management: auto-archives stale sessions on a configurable threshold, with an archive panel, unarchive, and recycle-bin deletion with restore.
description.zh: 会话管理：超期会话自动归档（阈值可配），归档面板支持取消归档，删除移入系统回收站可还原。

description.en: AI video creation and editing inside DeepSeek Harness, with conversation-driven revisions, multitrack timelines, audio waveforms, and MP4 export. Requires Node 22, FFmpeg and Chrome; audio generation calls a Qianwen MaaS endpoint only after you add an API key.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内通过对话生成与续改视频，支持多轨剪辑、音频波形和 MP4 导出。需要 Node 22、FFmpeg 与 Chrome；音频生成只有在你填入 API key 后才会调用千问 MaaS 接口。

description.en: Finishes 头歌 (EduCoder) homework over the platform JSON API, with no browser automation. educoder_sweep scans every course for homeworks that still have unfinished challenges — complete homeworks are skipped without reading a single challenge, so a full-account scan costs no model tokens — and can finish them; multiple-choice challenges also cost no model tokens, because the platform returns the answer key in any submission response, while code challenges are generated by the model, uploaded with evaluate:0 and graded once per challenge, then retried using the error report the platform returns. Three tools: educoder_sweep, educoder_homework, educoder_account.
description.zh: 走头歌（EduCoder）平台 JSON API 完成作业，无浏览器自动化。educoder_sweep 扫描所有课程中仍有未通过关卡的作业——已完成的作业直接跳过、一个关卡都不读，因此全量扫描不消耗模型 token——并可一次做完；选择题同样零 token，因为平台会在任意一次提交的响应里回吐标准答案；代码题由模型生成，以 evaluate:0 上传后每关只触发一次评测，再按平台返回的报错重试。三个工具：educoder_sweep、educoder_homework、educoder_account。

description.en: Fronts stdio MCP servers with three router tools (list_capabilities, describe_tool, call_tool) so schemas load on demand instead of riding every request; shapes every tool result through a deterministic output ladder that archives the original first (retrieve_spill reads it back); prices tool groups in tokens and can hide built-in groups per agent. Bridges to a standard-library Python router, so Python 3.9+ is required.
description.zh: 用三个路由工具（list_capabilities、describe_tool、call_tool）代理 stdio MCP 服务器，schema 按需加载，不再随每次请求发送；所有工具结果经过确定性输出阶梯压缩，有损处理前先归档原文（retrieve_spill 可读回）；按 token 为工具分组标价，并可按 agent 隐藏内置分组。桥接到纯标准库的 Python 路由器，需要 Python 3.9+。

description.en: Browse, preview and install public Agent Skills from inside the DSH web GUI, aggregating five sources (claudeskills.info, skillsmp.com, the awesome-claude-skills repository list, the official anthropics/skills repo, and skill packs shipped by installed DSH plugins). Skills install pinned to a commit rather than a branch name, so what you previewed is what lands; the panel reports provenance, whole-tree update checks and a trash instead of deleting. Before writing anything it validates the skill name and frontmatter against the rules the harness silently enforces, lists files that SKILL.md references but the fetch did not bring, flags partial fetches, and offers overwrite, rename or skip when a name is taken.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 里浏览、预览并安装公开的 Agent Skills，聚合五个来源（claudeskills.info、skillsmp.com、awesome-claude-skills 仓库坐标表、Anthropic 官方仓库、已装 DSH 插件自带的技能包）。安装按 commit 而不是分支名钉住，预览到的就是落地的；面板给出每个技能的来路、按整棵树比对的更新检查，删除是移进回收站而不是抹掉。落地之前先按 harness 实际执行的规则体检技能名与 frontmatter（名字不合法会被 harness 静默跳过），列出 SKILL.md 引用但没取回的文件，标出只取到一部分的情况，同名时给出覆盖、改名、跳过三个选项。

description.en: Bridges the CursorTouch/Windows-MCP desktop automation server into DSH through the official MCP client bridge, registering its screenshot, UI tree snapshot, mouse and keyboard input, clipboard, process and registry tools as mcp__windows__* tools for the model, and adds a windows_mcp_doctor diagnostic tool. Computer Use is off by default and is switched on from the plugin panel.
