description.zh: 通过官方 MCP 客户端桥接层把 CursorTouch/Windows-MCP 桌面自动化服务器接入 DSH，把截屏、UI 树快照、鼠标键盘输入、剪贴板、进程与注册表等工具注册成 mcp__windows__* 供模型调用，并附带 windows_mcp_doctor 诊断工具；Computer Use 默认关闭，需在插件面板里打开。

description.en: Starts your dsh web and other servers at boot, sets up and manages services like Gitea and Jellyfin just by asking, and puts them all under one home-hosted panel.
description.zh: 让 dsh web 与其他服务器随开机自动启动；只需一句提示就能搭建和管理 Gitea、Jellyfin 等服务，并统一收纳到一个 home-hosted 面板中。

description.en: Auto-expands streaming thinking: always keeps the latest thinking block expanded, manual actions take priority, only the last block expands when opening a session, and nothing remains after uninstall.
description.zh: 流式思考自动展开：始终显示最新一条思考，手动操作优先，打开会话仅展开最后一条，卸载无残留。

description.en: Adds edit mode to the DSH settings nav for drag-reordering, per-section show/hide and named collapsible drawer grouping saved in the plugin's own settings namespace, plus pinning up to five sections to the main sidebar for one-click access.
description.zh: 为 DSH 设置页导航加编辑模式：拖拽排序、逐个显隐、用命名可折叠抽屉分组，排版存在插件自己的设置命名空间；还能把最多 5 个分区钉到主界面侧栏，一键直达。

description.en: Full-interface whale skin pack for the DSH Web UI — layered wallpaper, metallic trim, lace and bows, a corner mascot that reacts to agent state, ambient particles, plus an installable third-party skin-pack format.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面全屏鲸鱼皮肤包：多层壁纸、金/银描边、蕾丝蝴蝶结、随 Agent 状态反应的角落立绘与环境粒子，并支持可安装的第三方皮肤包格式。

description.en: Surfaces important facts and trade-offs from the current task, with on-demand explanations and optional discussion in the main session.
description.zh: 根据当前任务上下文提醒重要事实和方案取舍，支持展开解释并带入主会话讨论。

description.en: DSH-Search-Contrl: a DSH skill/plugin for scoped web search and Chinese daily reports, with a settings GUI for custom search sources, arbitrary topics (not only tech), creator-link scoped search, and one-click rollback.

Browser provider for DeepSeek Harness: hand it a web task — open a page, click, type, fill a form, read what is on it — and it drives a real browser step by step, seeing an indexed table of what can be done on the current page instead of raw HTML or screenshots. Each step is one bundled-Jev decision rather than a full model turn (1.1 s median per step versus 2.8–3.6 s for chat-model turns in the repo benchmark), and the main conversation receives only the conclusion, so its context does not grow with the page. Targets come from the page it just read and a changed page is re-read rather than clicked blind, and it runs in the browser that Session owns, leaving your everyday Chrome untouched unless you switch to attach mode.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 浏览器插件：把网页任务交给它——打开页面、点击、输入、填表、读取页面内容——它会驱动真实浏览器一步步完成，每步只看到“当前页面能做什么”的索引表，而不是原始 HTML 或截图。每步由内置 Jev 引擎决策一次，而非大模型整轮推理（仓库基准中每步决策中位 1.1 秒，大模型整轮 2.8–3.6 秒）；主对话只收到结论，上下文不随页面变长。目标取自它刚读到的页面，页面变化就重新读取而非盲点；每个会话用自己的浏览器，不碰你日常的 Chrome（除非切到 attach 模式）。

description.en: Theme pack for the DSH Web UI: 30 drop-in CSS themes with light and dark variants, integrated into Settings → General with a programmatic API.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 主题包：30 款即插即用的 CSS 主题，每款含浅色与深色变体，集成于「设置 → 通用」，并提供程序化 API。

description.en: Context compression for small-context models: visually configure the compressed context budget, default to an 8k handoff + 16k recent context, and keep full history searchable.
description.zh: 面向小上下文模型的 DSH 上下文压缩插件：压缩大小可视化配置，默认 8k 交接摘要 + 16k 最近上下文，完整历史仍可查询。

description.en: One-line clock context for DeepSeek Harness: a Current time timestamp reading (weekday, date, time, UTC offset, IANA timezone) opens every conversation turn and a Turn ended reading closes it, so the model always knows the time, date and idle gap across turns without asking.
description.zh: 每轮对话开始向模型上下文注入单行时间戳读数（星期 / 日期 / 时间 / UTC 偏移 / IANA 时区），收尾再注入 Turn ended 关闭读数——模型始终知道现在几点、今天星期几、上一轮何时结束，日期运算与跨轮间隔不再靠猜；轻量时钟感知，每条约 30 token。

description.en: Automatic model-tier routing for DeepSeek Harness: one user instruction enters, one tier decision comes out — complex intent is planned on the strong tier and implemented on the cheap tier, simple intent stays cheap throughout, with a deterministic guard and a TTL escalation fallback.
description.zh: 自动模型档位路由：一条用户指令进入、一个档位决策出来——复杂意图由强档规划、廉价档执行，简单意图全程廉价档，确定性护栏 + TTL 升级回退。

description.en: Web Composer placement for long prompts: keep it at the bottom or dock it in a resizable right column beside a long answer.
description.zh: 面向长提示词的 Web Composer 布局：输入框可保留在底部，也可停靠到可调宽度的右栏，与长回答并排阅读和写作。

description.en: Cherry Studio-style paste: multi-line/indented/fenced text or code pasted into the DSH Web composer collapses into a bordered, collapsible, language-tagged card and is restored as a fenced code block on send.
description.zh: Cherry Studio 式粘贴：把多行/缩进/围栏文本或代码粘进 DSH Web 输入框时收成带边框、可折叠、带语言标签的卡片，发送时还原为围栏代码块。

description.en: Focus mode with a full-screen reading overlay that hides the header and composer and folds AI tool calls into summaries.
description.zh: 专注模式：全屏阅读视图，隐藏标题与输入区，把 AI 工具调用折叠成摘要。

description.en: Construction cost workbench for DeepSeek Harness projects.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 项目的工程造价工作台。

description.en: File-backed post office between DeepSeek Harness sessions: every letter is sealed with an HMAC and a body digest, recipients are resolved through a roster interface, and delivery is offline-first, so an undeliverable letter waits in the mailbox instead of being lost.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话之间的文件信箱：每封信都用 HMAC 与正文摘要封好，收件人通过名单接口解析，默认离线投递——投不出去的信留在信箱里等人来收，不会丢。

description.en: Manage DSH skills and commands from Settings: list, enable/disable, edit, delete and add skills across global and project scopes, and save reusable prompts as slash commands.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中管理技能与命令：跨全局与项目作用域查看、启用/停用、编辑、删除与添加技能，并把常用提示词保存为斜杠命令。

description.en: Section icons for the settings navigation: replaces the uniform gear icons with per-section glyphs and fills the plugin-market card avatar slot with each plugin icon; a page reload after uninstall restores the official icons.
description.zh: 设置导航分区图标：把千篇一律的齿轮换成各分区专属图形，并为插件市场卡片头像槽提供插件图标，卸载后重载页面即恢复官方图标。

description.en: Context7 MCP bridge: gives the model up-to-date, version-specific library documentation and code examples through the Context7 MCP server, keyless by default.
description.zh: 接入 Context7 托管 MCP 服务，为 agent 提供随版本更新的库文档查询；默认免密钥可用。

description.en: Groups the DSH model picker by provider: the menu lists sources with their model counts, and hovering a source slides that provider's models out in a side panel (default); in panel mode a click opens the same panel, and double-clicking a source title cycles hover -> panel -> inline (expand below the title). The active model stays visible at a glance. Pure DOM enhancement with zero intrusion - the panel is plugin-owned DOM mounted on body and selection happens by programmatically clicking the real menu buttons, so no React-managed node is moved or removed, keeping the host rendering intact and coexisting with other UI plugins. Styling follows the host by reusing the official --dsw-* theme tokens, with an enforced opaque background, sufficient contrast, and one shared set of sizing and colour tokens for both menu levels. No network access and no telemetry. Built for DSH kernel 2.0.15-next.
description.zh: 把 DSH 模型选择器按来源（provider）分组：菜单只列来源与其模型数，悬停来源即在右侧滑出该来源的模型子面板（默认）；切换为面板模式后改为单击来源滑出，或改为在列表内就地展开，双击来源标题即可在 悬浮 -> 面板 -> 列表 三者间循环切换；当前使用的模型一眼可见。纯 DOM 增强、零侵入——面板是插件自建 DOM 并挂载到 body，选择通过程序化点击原菜单真实按钮完成，不移动也不删除任何 React 管理的节点，因此不影响原组件渲染，并能与其他 UI 插件共存。配色与排版跟随宿主：复用官方 --dsw-* 主题变量，背景保证不透明、对比度充足，来源清单与子集清单共用同一套尺寸与色值令牌。不联网、无遥测。适配 DSH 内核 2.0.15-next。

description.en: Workspace-wide sticky notes on an infinite canvas: notes are plain Markdown files, created manually, captured from conversations, or distilled by the AI, and can be handed back as context; ships 12 model tools and 5 bundled skills for creating, tagging, arranging, comparing and merging notes.
description.zh: 工作区级的无限画布便签：便签以 Markdown 文件保存，可手动创建、从对话中摘录或由 AI 提炼生成，并能作为上下文提供给 AI 使用；附带 12 个模型工具与 5 个内置技能，用于创建、打标签、整理、比较与合并便签。

description.en: Adaptive topology multi-agent preset for DeepSeek Harness with peer messaging, task handoff and live network visualization.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的自适应拓扑多智能体预设，提供点对点通信、任务交接和实时网络可视化。

description.en: Hierarchical workspace tree plus browser-style session tabs for the DSH sidebar: a "/" in a workspace or session title creates a virtual folder, with sections, pinning, time buckets, drag ordering, unified 6px status dots, per-row appearance customization (colour, glow, weight, icon) and a floating full-text search over session titles and message bodies. Several settings switches restore any behaviour to the host default, and a host-side route deletes sessions permanently (DSH ships archive only). Fork of KannaKuron/dsh-better-workspace.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的工作区层级树与浏览器式会话标签页：工作区或会话标题中的 / 自动成为虚拟分组，另含分区、置顶、时间分桶、拖拽排序、统一 6px 状态点、按行定制外观（颜色 / 发光 / 字重 / 图标），以及覆盖会话标题与消息正文的浮层全文检索。配置页多个开关可把任一行为还原为宿主默认；宿主侧另有永久删除会话的路由（DSH 只有归档）。fork 自 KannaKuron/dsh-better-workspace。

description.en: RTK (Rust Token Killer) extension for dsh-router: rewrites each bash tool call through `rtk rewrite` so the agent reads compressed command output, and falls back to the original command when rtk is missing or has no equivalent.
description.zh: dsh-router 的 RTK(Rust Token Killer)扩展插件：把每次 bash 工具调用经 `rtk rewrite` 改写，让 agent 读到压缩后的命令输出；rtk 缺失或无等价改写时原样执行。

description.en: Tavily Search API as a web search provider (settings toggle with DeepSeek fallback, keyless search) plus a Tavily MCP bridge: keyless search and extract tools, crawl and map with an API key.
description.zh: Tavily 网页搜索：设置页开关，关闭时回落到 DeepSeek 内置搜索；免密钥可用搜索与内容提取，配置 API Key 后解锁爬取与站点地图等 MCP 工具。

description.en: Analyzes conversation images through mode-specific prompts (caption, UI, document, grounding, topology, etc.) and injects structured evidence with coordinate primitives (boxes, points, refs) as text, with session-level caching for reuse across replay and compaction.
description.zh: 通过模式化提示分析对话图片（描述、UI、文档、定位、拓扑等），将含坐标原语（框、点、引用）的结构化证据以文本注入上下文，会话级缓存跨回放与压缩复用。

description.en: Heads-up Texas Hold'em training with an independent AI opponent, persistent public-action memory, and decision reviews.
description.zh: 德州扑克 AI 陪练：双人对局、持久公开行为记忆与可追溯决策复盘。

description.en: Read-only GitHub access for agents, wrapping several tools. Inside the tool it automatically probes and selects whichever GitHub access method works locally, and tries network proxies on its own. That cuts down the network and parsing problems an agent may hit when accessing GitHub, and the overhead of it repeatedly trying different approaches.
description.zh: 面向 agent 的只读 GitHub 访问，封装多个工具。在工具内部自动探测与选择本地可用的 GitHub 访问设施，并自动尝试网络代理。减少 Agent 在访问 GitHub 时可能遇到的网络问题或解析问题，减少 Agent 频繁尝试不同方案的开销。

description.en: Independent browser acceptance testing for agent deliverables: JSON spec in, real-Chromium verdict out.
description.zh: Agent 交付物的独立浏览器验收测试：JSON 规格进，真实 Chromium 结论出。

description.en: Conversation enhancements: a history-input overlay (Alt+Up with workspace/session/global/prompt scopes), recall of unapplied interjected messages, conversation forking with fork-family version switching, and optional auto-resend after forking (off by default).
description.zh: 对话增强：历史输入浮层（Alt+↑，workspace/session/global/prompts 四范围搜索回填）、未应用插话撤回、对话分叉与家族版本切换、分叉后自动重发（默认关）。

description.en: Continuous voice conversations for DSH with hands-free listening, push-to-talk, speech recognition, TTS replies, and background Agent delegation.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供持续语音对话，支持免提监听、按住说话、语音识别、TTS 语音回复和后台 Agent 任务委派。

description.en: Firecrawl MCP bridge: hosted Firecrawl MCP server with keyless search, scrape and parse; an API key unlocks the full tool surface including crawl and map.
description.zh: 接入 Firecrawl 托管 MCP 服务：免密钥即可使用搜索、抓取与解析（有每日额度），配置 API Key 后解锁完整工具集，含爬取与站点地图。

description.en: Dual knowledge-graph RAG for Markdown notes with half-life memory decay: prerequisite + similarity graphs (P/S-Agent traversal), paragraph chunking, n-gram/embedding hybrid search, and an explicit weight-feedback loop — a native Cordis plugin, npm-installable as @eqman00003/knowlp-rag.
description.zh: Markdown 笔记的双知识图谱 RAG，带半衰期记忆衰减：前置依赖 + 相似关联双图（P/S-Agent 遍历）、段落级匹配、ngram/embedding 混合检索、显式权重反馈闭环——原生 Cordis 插件，npm 包 @eqman00003/knowlp-rag。

description.en: Agent persona: gives DSH one global persona (name, language, persona prompt) that every new session carries at the front of its system prompt, plus a long-term memory you grow from any chat in one click; three built-in presets ship with it, and a Big fat fish persona is active right after install; chat sessions can also be deleted from the sidebar row menu.
description.zh: Agent人格：给 DSH 一份全局人格（名称、语言、人格提示词），每个新会话的系统提示都带着它，外加一份长期记忆，聊天里点一下就能把选中的对话提炼进去；自带三个内置预设，装好默认启用大肥鱼人格；侧栏会话行还能直接删除会话。

description.en: Irreversible secret-scrubbing guard: rewrites access keys, bearer tokens, and private key blocks into `[REDACTED:<category>]` placeholders before they reach the session log and the model.
description.zh: 不可逆密钥脱敏守护：在访问密钥、Bearer 令牌、私钥块进入会话日志和模型请求之前，将其改写为 `[REDACTED:<category>]` 占位符。

description.en: Engine-enforced guardrails for DeepSeek Harness agent swarms: quality gates reject half-done work, crash-safe checkpoints resume in place — keeps AI teams from breaking, not just running.
description.zh: dsh 单机多子 Agent 集群治理：引擎级质量门禁拒收半成品、崩溃断点续跑不重来——给 AI 团队装上"跑不坏"的工程护栏。

description.en: Arknights theme for the DSH Web GUI: twelve full-screen wallpapers whose edge blur, feathering and glass opacity are computed per image; ink solved in OKLCH to hold WCAG AA; Rhodes Island iconography throughout; and approval and question cards signed with operator autographs.
description.zh: 明日方舟主题：12 张整屏壁纸，边缘虚化、羽化与玻璃浓度按每张图分别计算；文字色以 OKLCH 求解并守住 WCAG AA 下限；界面图标换成罗德岛素材；授权卡与选项卡带干员签名。

description.en: Billing-period and balance pill under the DSH composer: it shows the account balance and the current conversation cost alongside the peak/off-peak state and a countdown to the next switch. The peak/off-peak rules cover China statutory holidays and weekends, and the conversation cost is measured as the decrease in account balance between the plugin's 60-second idle balance refreshes.
description.zh: DSH 输入框下方的计费时段与余额药丸：常显账户余额与本次对话花费，并显示峰价/谷价档位与距下次切换的倒计时。峰谷判定含中国法定节假日与周末；本次对话花费按余额差值记账，采样点是插件自带的「对话停止满一分钟后刷新余额」。

description.en: Sound + popup when a task completes: a Web Audio chime, an in-page toast, and a system notification while the page is in the background (browser-only, cross-platform).
description.zh: 任务完成时播放提示音并弹出小通知：Web Audio 合成音效、页面内 toast、页面在后台时系统通知，纯浏览器方案、零系统依赖、跨平台。

description.en: One-click OAuth (PKCE) connect to Qichacha (qcc.com) legal-data MCP services — regulation search and case search — with dynamic client registration, token auto-refresh, and dynamic mcp-client configuration.
description.zh: 一键 OAuth（PKCE）授权接入企查查法律产品——法律数据 MCP 服务（法规检索、案例检索）：动态注册客户端、token 自动刷新、动态配置 mcp-client 条目，一次授权覆盖法规与案例服务。

description.en: Outer Wilds theme with a static starfield, campfire effects, appearance settings, and bundled Jost and Source Han Sans fonts.
description.zh: 以《星际拓荒》为主题，提供静态星空、篝火动效、外观设置和内置 Jost 与思源黑体。

description.en: One-tap connect ModelScope language and image-generation models into DSH (off by default), with image recognition and context window filled in automatically. You can also see the free Magicube balance, jump to a model's info page, and record local call counts, trends and rate-limit events, with a usage pill beside the input box showing the balance and today's local count. All of it needs only an API key, with no account sign-in.
description.zh: 一键接入魔搭社区的语言、生图模型到 DSH（默认关），自动填入图片识别与上下文窗口；还可查看免费魔粒余额、跳转到模型信息页，记录本地调用计数、趋势、限流事件，输入框旁另有用量胶囊显示余额与今日本地调用次数。上述功能仅需填入 API key，不需要登录账号。

description.en: Records real clicks, inputs, navigation and network traffic in a user-guided browser session for DSH, then generates a Markdown timeline report (report.md + events.jsonl) to build API-level skills.
description.zh: 网页操作录制器：录制用户引导会话中的真实点击、输入、导航与网络请求，生成 Markdown 操作时间线报告（report.md + events.jsonl），用于沉淀接口级 skill。

description.en: Turns the iterate skill into an autonomous closed-loop harness — plan, parallel review, atomic fixes, validate, loop, auto-stop — plus a dry-run review-only mode and a meta-review that audits the report and emits a final review report.
description.zh: 把 iterate 技能跑成自主闭环：规划、并行审查、原子修复、验证、循环、自动停止，并支持纯评审的 dry-run 模式与元评审最终报告。

description.en: Tracks DSH's file reads, image views, and code edits in WakaTime, including exact counts of lines added and deleted by AI. Keeps activity tracking running while DSH responds, batches updates across files, and coordinates per-project reporting limits across parallel DSH processes. Automatically installs and updates wakatime-cli.
description.zh: 在 WakaTime 中记录 DSH 读取文件、查看图片和编辑代码的活动，并准确统计 AI 新增和删除的代码行数。DSH 回复期间持续记录活动，多个文件的记录批量上报，并在并行运行的 DSH 进程间统一控制各项目的上报频率。自动安装和更新 wakatime-cli。

description.en: Multi-agent roundtable discussion: each member runs as a subagent on its own model and speaks in turn, a host summarizes each round, and termination writes meeting-minutes Markdown.
description.zh: 多智能体圆桌讨论：每个成员作为子代理在自己的模型上依次发言，主持人逐轮汇总，终止时生成会议纪要 Markdown。

description.en: Per-model system prompt injector for DeepSeek Harness: append custom prompt text to the END of the system prompt for locally configured models, matched by exact provider/model route or a provider-wide provider/* rule (both stack in order). A Settings page lists every configured provider and its models for per-route editing with instant effect, and rules persist to DSH_HOME so they survive restarts. Applies to main sessions, subagents, and workflow children alike.
description.zh: DSH 按模型注入系统提示词：为本地已配置的模型把自定义提示词追加到系统提示词末尾，支持 provider/model 精确匹配与 provider/* 服务商级通配（两者按序叠加）。设置页自动列出每个已配置服务商及其模型，逐行编辑、即时生效；规则持久化保存、重启不丢；对主会话、subagent 与 workflow 子代理同样生效。

description.en: Autonomic heartbeat for each root agent: silent pulses diff the session's todos, Agent Team board and goal against what the last pulse saw, and speak only on a signal — L1 report, L2 ask (ask_user_question), L4 escalate — never starting work. Each message carries a why-now line, an optional one-line physiology signature (time since your last message and how many times it has reached out today) and a compact task snapshot (800-char cap); a dedupe window, quiet hours, a daily budget, refractory/restart cooldowns and persisted vitals keep it quiet, while busy-safe followup injection never stacks. It shares one advisory speech floor with dsh-plugin-memory (~/.dsh/proactive-cooldown.json, 180 s) so the two never talk over each other, stays silent while a child subagent or teammate is still working, and surfaces a "subagents working · N" pill in the conversation header (polling pauses while the tab is hidden). v0.8 adds a diagnostics panel that explains recent quiet pulses and names the current speech-floor holder, plus panel controls for the arbitration window, presence suppression and the physiology line; its settings section carries a stroked heart mark (16×16, stroke 1.3, same spec as dsh-plugin-memory).
description.zh: 给每个根 agent 装一套自主神经心跳：静默拍会 diff 会话的待办 / 团队任务板 / 目标，只有出现信号才开口（L1 汇报 / L2 提问 / L4 升级），只问不做。每条消息带 why-now 行、可选的一行生理签名（距你上次说话多久、今天第几次找你）与紧凑任务快照（800 字符上限）；去重窗口、静默时段、每日预算、不应期 / 重启冷却与持久化生命体征共同限流，忙碌时 followup 注入排队不打断。它与 dsh-plugin-memory 共享一个建议性发言权（~/.dsh/proactive-cooldown.json，默认 180 秒）互不抢话，子 agent / teammate 仍在运行时保持静默，并在会话头部显示「子智能体执行中 · N」胶囊（标签页隐藏时暂停轮询）。v0.8 新增诊断面板（解释最近几次为何没开口并显示当前发言权持有者）与面板内可调的仲裁窗口 / 在场抑制 / 生理签名开关；设置区块带专属描边爱心标记（16×16 / stroke 1.3，与 dsh-plugin-memory 规格一致）。

description.en: GitHub project search and analysis: describe your idea in one sentence and the agent searches GitHub for related projects, ranks them by relevance weighted with stars, and returns a structured card — last updated, relevance, stars, weighted score, language and a one-line description for each project. Pick a few repositories and it reads their README, dependency manifest, directory tree and key files to lay out their architecture — so you stand on the shoulders of giants before you start building.
description.zh: GitHub 项目检索与解析工具：一句话输入开发想法，agent 在 GitHub 搜索相关项目，按相关性与 star 加权排序后返回一张结构化的卡片（包括各项目的更新时间、相关性分数、star数、加权后得分、使用的开发语言、一句话简介）。选择几个仓库后，它还能直接读取这些项目的 README、依赖清单、目录树和关键文件等，梳理它们的架构。让你在动手开发前，先“站在巨人的肩膀上”。

description.en: Set an earlier automatic-compaction threshold per model on DeepSeek Harness: /autocompact writes a session-only override keyed by exact provider/model (off falls back to the backend defaults, default clears it), a Settings → Autocompact page manages the persisted per-model thresholds every session inherits, and a composer status entry shows the current reading.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 按模型设置更早的自动压缩阈值：/autocompact 以精确 provider/model 为键写入仅本会话生效的覆盖值（off 回退后端默认、default 清除覆盖），设置页「自动压缩」管理所有会话继承的持久化逐模型阈值，输入框状态条目显示当前读数。

description.en: Long sessions get expensive, and the platform compacts the context on its own. This plugin adds an occupancy badge (hover to see how it is computed), writes a handover draft into HANDOVER.md from 45% — files changed, money spent, what recent turns were about — and reminds you once at 60% to wrap up. On compaction it records the reading from just before, so you can check it later. No model calls, nothing added to the conversation; it does not prevent compaction.
description.zh: 长会话越跑越贵，平台到点还会把上下文压掉。这个插件做三件事：在会话标题旁显示当前上下文占了多少，鼠标停上去能看到这个数是怎么来的；过 45% 时往工作目录的 HANDOVER.md 写一份交接草稿，记下改过哪些文件、花了多少钱、最近几轮在聊什么；到 60% 提醒你一次该收尾了。平台压缩发生时，它把压缩前的数字记一行，事后还查得到。不调用模型，也不改动对话内容。它不阻止压缩，拿不回已经被压掉的部分。

description.en: Builds, tests, archives and runs an Xcode project or workspace on iOS or macOS through xcodebuild — a live filterable build log, scheme and destination pickers read from the project, and log streaming for simulators and USB devices, including iOS 16 and earlier over libimobiledevice, whose app logs stay readable while the device is locked. macOS only.
description.zh: 在 harness 中通过 xcodebuild 编译、测试、归档并运行 iOS 或 macOS 工程——实时可过滤的构建日志、从工程自身读取的 scheme 与目标设备选择，以及模拟器与 USB 真机的日志流，包含经 libimobiledevice 支持的 iOS 16 及更早设备，其 app 日志在设备锁屏时依然可读。仅限 macOS。

description.en: SQLX database tools: list saved datasources, show or test a connection, execute SQL and open a local result page, with the sqlx CLI installed on first use.
description.zh: OtterMind SQLX 数据库工具：列出已保存的数据源、查看或测试连接、执行 SQL、打开本地结果页，缺少 sqlx CLI 时首次调用自动安装。

description.en: Test-stability tools: repeatedly run vitest/jest/pytest/node:test suites, classify flaky cases, keep history, maintain a quarantine manifest and health self-check.
description.zh: 测试稳定性工具：重复运行 vitest/jest/pytest/node:test，识别 flaky 用例，历史留档、隔离清单与健康自检。

description.en: One-handed, keyboard-free input for the composer: press and hold the mouse on the input box, speak, release — the text lands in the draft, and sliding up cancels without leaving a half sentence behind. No mic button to aim at and no shortcut to remember; the hand never has to leave the input area, which is the point when the other hand is busy. Recognition runs fully offline (SenseVoice via sherpa-onnx, no API key, audio never leaves the machine).
description.zh: 输入框上的单手、免键盘输入：鼠标在输入框按住、说话、松手，文字直接进草稿；上滑取消，不留半句。不用去瞄麦克风按钮，也不用记快捷键，手始终不用离开输入区——另一只手正忙的时候，这一点才是关键。识别完全在本机完成（SenseVoice + sherpa-onnx），无需 API key，音频不出本机。

description.en: Skill studio for DeepSeek Harness: visualize every agent skill (name, description, source, nested flag, model/user invocation), view and edit the full SKILL.md body, toggle model/user invocation, and mine DSH session logs to extract reusable personal skills that the agent auto-loads — from the web settings panel and via skillmgr_* / skillmgr_extract_* tools.
description.zh: DSH skill 可视化与管理插件：在设置面板列出全部 skill（含来源、嵌套标记与模型/用户调用状态），查看并编辑 SKILL.md 正文，一键启用/禁用模型与用户调用；并可从会话日志提取可复用内容，沉淀为 agent 可自动加载的个人 skill。提供 skillmgr_list/get/save/policy 及 skillmgr_extract_* 工具。

description.en: Coding-learn floating panel: edits and runs Python/JavaScript/TypeScript/PowerShell with exit code and timing, grades JSON course lessons with progress export, keeps Markdown notes and snippet library, and sends code plus a question into the current conversation for the main model to answer.
description.zh: 编程学习悬浮面板：编辑并运行 Python/JavaScript/TypeScript/PowerShell（含退出码与耗时），JSON 课程包关卡自动评判并可导出进度，提供 Markdown 笔记与代码片段库；代码分析以用户消息直投当前对话，由对话主模型直接输出。

description.en: Host-side guard that lets the write tool only create new files: when the target already exists it denies the call before execution and tells the model to use edit instead, applied to all sessions.
description.zh: 纯 host 端守卫，让 write 工具只允许创建新文件：目标已存在时在执行前直接拒绝并提示改用 edit，全局所有会话生效。

description.en: Daily news digest from 46 curated RSS sources, edited by the model already configured in dsh, delivered to your IM via webhook, and broadcast in the chat like a regular model reply with zero context cost.
description.zh: 每日要闻日报：46 个精选 RSS 源，用 dsh 里已配好的模型做主编式编辑，经 webhook 送到微信/Telegram，并以模型回答的样式插播在对话里，零上下文消耗。

description.en: A harness that gets smarter the more you use it, with no more goldfish memory. Before each prompt, Evolver recalls one proven strategy from your local history and the EvoMap network; after the turn it grades that strategy by the checks that ran, whether the edits were kept, and how you replied, then reports back to the network, which weighs it by evidence. Every success becomes a shortcut for next time, and every failure becomes a warning.
description.zh: 越用越聪明的 harness，告别金鱼记忆。每条 prompt 前，Evolver 从本地经验和 EvoMap 网络召回一条验证过的策略；回合结束后，它凭测试结果、改动是否被保留、你的下一句反馈给策略打分，再回报网络按证据加权。每一次成功都变成下一次的捷径，每一次失败都变成下一次的避坑指南。

description.en: Session management for DSH: archive/restore, batch & conditional delete, AI auto-rename, interrupted-session auto-resume, workspace grouping, undo last message, repair damaged session logs (seq-gap/EIO/dual-format), value analysis and full-text search — plus plan/closing template injection (system prompt + context).
description.zh: DSH 会话管理增强：归档/恢复、批量与条件删除、AI 自动重命名、中断自动续跑、按工作区分组、撤回最后一条消息、三类损坏日志修复（seq-gap/EIO/双格式）、价值分析与全文搜索——另含方案/收尾模板注入（系统提示词 + 上下文）。

description.en: Pre-visit due diligence and company research in DeepSeek Harness for customer background checks and risk briefs, with Qichacha MCP tool-call budget approval and entity confirmation.
description.zh: 访前尽调智能体：面向拜访前调查，提供企业尽调、客户尽调、客户背景调查、工商核验与风险信息整理；使用企查查 MCP，设有调用预算授权和主体确认。

description.en: In-session cd for DeepSeek Harness: re-base relative paths on the fly (the file tools and the bash/pwsh default workdir follow) or move the session to another workspace for real — a `cd {"workspace": true, "confirmed": true}` call the user has agreed to, or the user's own `/cd <directory>` command, relocates the session's stored log, sandbox root, AGENTS.md and skill discovery and sidebar grouping. Per-session, persisted across restarts, without moving the session for a plain re-base.
description.zh: 会话内 cd：即时切换相对路径基准（文件工具与 bash / pwsh 默认工作目录跟随），或把会话真正搬到另一个工作区——经用户同意的 `cd {"workspace": true, "confirmed": true}` 或用户自己的 `/cd <目录>` 命令，会迁移会话日志存储位置、沙箱根、AGENTS.md 与 skills 发现根以及侧边栏分组；按会话隔离、跨重启恢复，单纯换基准时不动会话身份。

description.en: On the first real work message of each chat window, asks for the missing goal, deliverable, constraints and acceptance criteria, then turns the answers into a short task sheet and injects it into the chat. Pure greetings are ignored.
description.zh: 每个聊天窗口的第一段工作内容前，先问清缺失的目标、交付物、限制与验收标准，再把回答整理成简短的任务说明注入聊天；纯寒暄不会触发。

description.en: Manage, discover, install, update, and uninstall DSH skills as plugins.
description.zh: 类 Codex 插件市场的 DSH 技能管理器。

description.en: One-click Concise output style for DeepSeek Harness: results first, no filler, same work depth. Every final reply opens with a plain-language digest card (select text to copy), scoped per session, working in headless/CLI too, with /concise command, style.md overrides and a local API. Links and file paths inside the digest card render as clickable chips: URLs jump, local files open with the OS default app (v0.9+). A per-step pre-generation contract reminder (v0.11.2+) measurably fixes digest misses on audit-report/table-shaped replies.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 一键 Concise 输出风格开关：结果先行、少废话，工作深浅不变。每轮最终回答开头自动附「摘要」精华卡（划选即复制），按会话独立生效，headless/CLI 同样生效，支持 /concise 命令、style.md 自定义风格与本地 API。摘要卡内的链接与文件路径渲染为可点击 chip：网页跳转、本地文件用系统默认应用打开（v0.9+）。每步生成前自动重申摘要契约（v0.11.2+），实测根治审查报告/表格型回复的漏卡。

description.en: Dynamically trusts every Host header that actually arrives and flips the default web binding to 0.0.0.0: wildcard or unenumerable entry domains work without editing the start command, the authentication layer is untouched, and hosts are evicted by LRU beyond a capacity cap.
description.zh: 动态信任所有实际到达的 Host 并把 web 默认绑定翻转为 0.0.0.0：泛域名等无法枚举的入口免改启动命令，认证层不动，超出容量的 Host 按 LRU 淘汰。

description.en: Theme skin plugin for DeepSeek Harness — built-in themes / static image / dynamic 360°-follow video, one-click from the sidebar & Settings; imports persist, default skins protected.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 主题皮肤插件：内置主题 / 静态图片 / 动态视频（鼠标环绕跟随帧），侧边栏一键切换，设置页完整管理；导入持久化、默认皮肤不可删。

description.en: SSH/SFTP remote workspaces with conflict-aware mirror sync, port forwarding, and a native Web UI.
description.zh: 支持冲突感知镜像同步、端口转发和原生 Web UI 的 SSH/SFTP 远程工作区。

description.en: Windows native toast notifications for DSH desktop sessions: turn ends, approvals, questions and a reminder for an unanswered wait — each with its own sound and popup text (up to three named templates per situation), three delivery modes, previews, and imported custom sounds. Clicking a toast raises the DSH window.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端会话的 Windows 原生 Toast 通知：回合结束、审批、提问与未应答催办，每个情况可单独选择音效与弹窗文本（每个情况最多 3 套命名模板），支持三种通知形式、预览效果与导入自定义音效；点击通知把 DSH 窗口拉回前台。

description.en: Predicts the user's next prompt after each assistant reply and shows it as gray ghost text inside the composer; accept it whole with Tab, accept it piece by piece with Alt+→, reroll it, or dismiss it with Esc.
description.zh: 助手回复结束后预测用户的下一句话，以灰色 ghost text 浮在输入框里；Tab 整条采纳、Alt+→ 逐段采纳、↻ 换一条、Esc 忽略。

description.en: Daily sending quotas and quiet hours for agent mailboxes: letters are counted in named buckets that each carry a per-day limit, the day boundary is configurable, and a quiet window tells the core to hold online letters rather than deliver them.
description.zh: 智能体信箱的每日配额与免打扰时段：信件按命名桶计数、每桶有每日上限，日界可配置，并给出一个免打扰窗口，让核心把在线件留着而不投递。

description.en: Shared toolkit for authoring DeepSeek Harness plugins, published as @perrylink/dsh-plugin-kit: a pluggable provider registry seam, fail-closed approval and session-event gates, shared sanitize/pricing/judge modules and a new-plugin skeleton.
description.zh: 编写 DeepSeek Harness 插件的共享工具包，发布为 @perrylink/dsh-plugin-kit：可插拔的 Provider 注册表接缝、失败即拒绝的审批与会话事件门、共享的脱敏/计价/裁决模块，以及新插件骨架。

description.en: Plays a chime and speaks a Chinese voice alert when an approval, question, or plan-review popup appears in the DSH web GUI, so you never miss a request.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 中出现审批、提问或计划审批弹窗时，播放提示音并中文语音播报，避免漏看待处理请求。

description.en: Visual Kanban board for DeepSeek Harness with Gitea-backed tasks, workflow columns and a dedicated agent session per task.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可视化看板，支持 Gitea 任务、工作流列和每任务独立 Agent 会话。

description.en: Session hotkeys for the DSH Web GUI: switch sessions like browser tabs (positional Alt+1-9, pinned slots, previous/next, new/archive/rename), keyboard model switching via Alt+M, alternate send, Esc focus hand-off, and Alt+W to close or restore a dsh-split-screen workspace — all rebindable with Windows/macOS presets. Verified on DSH 0.1.1 and 0.1.5.
description.zh: Web 会话热键插件：像切浏览器标签页一样用键盘管理会话——Alt+1-9 顺序切换、固定槽位、上/下一个、新建/归档/重命名、Alt+M 键盘切换模型与备用发送、Esc 焦点交接，Alt+W 关闭/恢复 dsh-split-screen 工作区；键位可在面板录制重绑，Windows/macOS 双预设。已适配 DSH 0.1.1 与 0.1.5。

description.en: MemWeave (dsh-mem-weave) weaves memory into persona: layered memory and a persona editor in one DeepSeek Harness plugin, with a bounded per-turn injection budget, decay and consolidation, a candidate and conflict review queue, 24-hour undo, and calendar reminders, all stored in a local SQLite file.
description.zh: 忆织 MemWeave（dsh-mem-weave）—— 把记忆编织进人格（记忆 × 人格一体 DSH 插件）：分层记忆与人格编辑，每轮注入有固定上限，记忆按层遗忘与整理，候选与冲突需人工确认，写入可在 24 小时内撤销，另有约定与纪念日提醒，全部数据存在本机 SQLite 文件里。

description.en: China A-share stock research: ticker search, announcements over any date range, financial report cards, valuation profiles and signal-factor explanations (~5,000 stocks since 2011, public read-only data service), plus a link-out tool to an external trading-sandbox product.
description.zh: A股个股研究：搜股票、查任意区间公告、财报卡、估值画像与交易信号科普（约 5000 只、2011 年至今，公共只读数据服务），另有一个跳转外部交易推演产品的链接工具。

description.en: Smooth comet-mode animated caret for the DSH Web composer: a glowing comet trail replaces the native blinking caret and glides across the input as you type, with configurable accent color, thickness, and trail, IME-aware for CJK input.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 输入框提供流畅的彗星光标：以发光的彗星拖尾取代原生闪烁光标，随输入平滑滑动，可配置强调色、粗细与拖尾，并适配中文等 IME 输入。

description.en: Ultra-lean daily coding agent preset for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) that strips heavy orchestration for fast, direct tool execution.
description.zh: 专为日常编码打造的极简 Agent 预设插件：移除沉重编排机制与冗余组件，直达核心工具循环，响应迅速。

description.en: Visual theme customizer for the DeepSeek Harness web UI — backgrounds, text colors, borders and details, all adjustable visually, with presets you can import and export, persisted across restarts.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 界面自定义主题插件：背景/文字/框线/细节全可视化调整，可导入导出预设，持久化保存。

description.en: Data cleaning and data enrichment for CSV/XLSX/JSON enterprise lists in DeepSeek Harness, including spreadsheet cleaning, deduplication, profiling, optional Qichacha MCP and exports.
description.zh: 数据清洗补全智能体：面向 Excel/CSV/JSON 企业名单，提供数据清洗、表格清洗、清洗补全、去重、企业数据补全与字段补全，支持企查查 MCP 和结果导出。

description.en: Plugin-author upgrade skill for DeepSeek Harness: one package carrying a corridor index, which detects the caller peer band and routes to the closed corridor card that matches it (0.1.3-alpha.1 -> 0.1.5-rc.1 as legs A+B, 0.1.5-rc.2 -> 0.1.6-alpha.2 as leg C), plus a zero-dependency seam scanner shipped as a bundle skill and an npx CLI.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 插件作者的升级技能：一个包只放一份走廊索引，自动识别调用方的 peer 区间并路由到对应已封版的升级卡片（0.1.3-alpha.1 至 0.1.5-rc.1 为 A+B 两条腿，0.1.5-rc.2 至 0.1.6-alpha.2 为 C 腿），并附带以 bundle 技能与 npx CLI 两种形态提供的零依赖接缝扫描器。

description.en: 通过远程主机运行Claude与Codex会话。

Gitee/GitHub AI employee: @ the bot on an issue (Gitee or GitHub), it clones the repo, implements the fix on the branch you name, opens a PR to that branch, and can auto-merge and auto-close the issue. v1.2 adds security scanning: configure scan repos, audit with built-in/custom prompts, deduplicate, and file new findings as issues.
description.zh: Gitee/GitHub AI 员工：在 issue 里 @ 机器人并指定目标分支（如"需要修改 release-v1.2 分支"），它自动克隆仓库开发、向指定分支提交 PR，可自动合并并自动关闭 issue。v1.2 新增代码安全扫描：配置扫描仓库后按内置/自定义提示词审计代码，去重后把新发现提交 issue。

description.en: Manage MCP servers, load them on demand, and filter tools to reduce context usage.
description.zh: 管理 MCP 服务器，按需加载并筛选工具以减少上下文占用。

description.en: Local SQLite long-term memory with CJK-aware search, BM25 and character n-gram cosine reranking, deduplication, and lifecycle management.
description.zh: 基于本地 SQLite 的长期记忆，支持 CJK 分词检索、BM25 与字符 n-gram 余弦重排、去重和生命周期管理。

description.en: Code-generated math and science animation for DSH: six tools cover environment checks and dependency self-repair, Manim/manimgx scene rendering to storyboard frames or MP4, contact-sheet probing of finished clips for black or overexposed frames, and formula identity checks with SymPy, together with three skills (topic routing, design spec, QA rubric), a project scaffold with timeline and narration, requirement approvals before rendering, and five animation styles.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的代码生成数学/科普动画：六个工具覆盖环境预检与依赖自愈、把 Manim/manimgx 场景渲染为 storyboard 帧或 MP4、对成片抽帧拼图检查黑帧与过曝、用 SymPy 判断公式恒等；另带三个技能（题材路由、设计规范、交付自检）、含时间轴与旁白的项目脚手架、渲染前的需求确认，以及五套动画风格。

description.en: Verifies letters signed by other agents: a canonical field order, digest and HMAC checks, and fail-closed handling of missing or unregistered fields. Off by default; when enabled, a letter that fails any check is refused rather than delivered.
description.zh: 校验其他 agent 写来的信：规范字段顺序、摘要与 HMAC 校验。默认关闭；开启后，缺字段或未登记字段不放行，任何一项不过就拒收。

description.en: Use a SuperGrok / X Premium subscription inside DeepSeek Harness. Device-code OAuth, grok-bridge token reuse, no xAI API key. Works in headless, web, and any TUI.
description.zh: 把 SuperGrok 或 X Premium 订阅变成 DeepSeek Harness 的本地模型源，免 xAI API 密钥，直接复用已有 OAuth 令牌。

description.en: All-in-one UI plugin for DSH Desktop (Windows): conversation-width slider with fullscreen preview and follow-window mode, thinking-block enhancements (forced Chinese, expand/collapse, Markdown rendering), an Open With header button, UI label localization, a resizable settings dialog, session delete, and workspace tabs.
description.zh: DSH 桌面版多功能 UI 插件：对话宽度滑块（按下全屏预览、跟随窗口宽度）、思考块增强（思考/回复强制中文、展开收起、Markdown 渲染）、Open With 头部打开按钮、界面英文标签中文化、设置弹窗窗口化、会话删除与工作区分页。

description.en: Shows OpenCode Go subscription usage (rolling, weekly and monthly used and remaining percentage with reset times) in a floating panel anchored to the bottom-left of the session window.
description.zh: 在会话窗口左下角的悬浮面板中显示 OpenCode Go 订阅用量（滚动/每周/每月的已用与剩余百分比及重置时间）。

description.en: DSH Room — Web and Desktop plugin for encrypted multi-agent collaboration
Enhanced model selector for the DSH composer with searchable provider groups, keyboard and accessibility support, and an inline reasoning-effort slider.
description.zh: 增强 DSH 输入区的模型选择器：可搜索供应商分组、键盘与无障碍支持，以及内联推理强度滑杆。

description.en: Add a theme-adjustment panel under Appearance to customize accent, background, foreground, contrast and gradient, applied live through theme token overrides.
description.zh: 在「外观」下增加一个主题调节面板，可自定义强调色/背景色/前景色/对比度/渐变度，并实时生效。

description.en: Skill and MCP management center for DeepSeek Harness: browse and toggle user/project skills, add/edit/remove MCP servers hot without restart, with live per-session status in the sidebar.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 技能与 MCP 管理中心：浏览并启停用户/项目技能，热增删改 MCP 服务器（免重启），侧边栏实时展示各服务器状态。

description.en: In-chat preview for produced files: click a produced-file chip to render Markdown (server-side markdown-it + highlight.js), images, or plain text right in the conversation; system-app open and reveal-in-folder stay one click away.
description.zh: 产物文件聊天内预览：点击产物 chip 直接在对话中渲染 Markdown（宿主侧 markdown-it + highlight.js 代码高亮）、图片或纯文本，系统应用打开与在文件夹中显示仍一键可达。

description.en: Windows toast and a chime whenever a conversation task stops: completed, waiting on your approval or answer, or failed. Clicking the toast reopens that session at your last question, and in DSH Desktop it also raises the window.
description.zh: 对话任务停止时弹一条 Windows 通知并响一声提示音：完成、等你审批或回答、出错都会提醒。点通知回到那个会话，落在你上次提问的位置；桌面端还会把窗口拉到前台。

description.en: Adds a capsule split-button to the conversation header: launch VS Code, terminal, or File Explorer at the current workspace directory in one click.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 会话头部添加胶囊拆分按钮，一键在当前工作区打开 VS Code、终端和文件资源管理器。

description.en: Claude Code rules.md-style rule prompts: activate rule markdown files by glob-matching the files an agent reads or edits, with prompt injection and ordering support.
description.zh: 类 Claude Code rules.md 的规则提示词：按智能体读取或编辑文件的 glob 匹配自动激活规则文档，支持提示词注入与排序。

description.en: DSH Skill Manager: browse, enable/disable, import from Codex/Claude Code/ZCode/WorkBuddy/QCoderWork, auto-discover skills with symlink support.
description.zh: DSH 技能管理器：浏览、启用/禁用、从 Codex/Claude Code/ZCode/WorkBuddy/QCoderWork 导入，自动发现技能并支持软链接。

description.en: Image generation with a sidebar gallery page and three agent tools (paint_image, paint_images, edit_painting); preset providers include ModelScope, Google Gemini, OpenAI, SiliconFlow, Volcengine Seedream, Alibaba DashScope, xAI and Zhipu, plus any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, each with its own proxy setting.
description.zh: 图像生成：侧边栏画廊页面和三个 Agent 工具（paint_image、paint_images、edit_painting）；预置 ModelScope、Google Gemini、OpenAI、硅基流动、火山方舟 Seedream、阿里云百炼、xAI、智谱等服务商，也可接入任意 OpenAI 兼容端点，每个服务商可单独设置代理。

description.en: Connect a sub2api gateway to DeepSeek Harness: OpenAI-compatible multi-provider routes (OpenAI / Claude / Grok / Gemini) behind one base URL, with per-key model discovery, usage lookup, and global vision/image tools.
description.zh: 将 sub2api 网关接入 DeepSeek Harness：用一个 base URL 统一管理 OpenAI / Claude / Grok / Gemini 等多供应商路由，支持按 key 发现模型、用量查询与全局视觉/图像生成工具。

description.en: Displays CodexRadar model capability benchmarks in a Settings page and shows the selected session model's DeepSWE score beside the composer.
description.zh: 在设置页展示 CodexRadar 模型能力评测，并在输入框旁显示当前会话所选模型的 DeepSWE 分数。

description.en: DSH balance and quota card showing up to 3 recently used providers. Supports DeepSeek, Moonshot, Kimi For Coding, OpenAI Codex, and OpenCode Go, with auto-discovery, quota windows, reset times, color-coded status, dragging, and automatic refresh.
description.zh: DSH 余额与配额悬浮卡片：常驻显示最近使用的最多 3 个 provider，支持 DeepSeek、Moonshot、Kimi For Coding、OpenAI Codex 和 OpenCode Go；自动发现配置，展示配额窗口与重置时间，并支持分档着色、拖动和自动刷新。

description.en: An Everforest colour theme for DeepSeek Harness, for both web and desktop. Forest tones, with six dark and light palettes. Chat content (headings, code, links, tables and more) is restyled with independent colours, and every tone and saturation level is tuned individually for a warm, gentle, easy-on-the-eyes experience.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Everforest 配色主题，同时支持网页和桌面端。以森林为色调，深色与浅色共 6 档配色。对聊天内容（标题、代码、链接、表格等）样式优化，独立着色，所有色调及饱和度都已逐一调校，提供温暖柔和的护眼体验。

description.en: Samples a video the way a person does instead of downloading it: metadata and chapters first, then timestamped frames as images, subtitle-first transcripts (local ASR only when the platform carries no subtitles), AudioSet 527-class sound tags and top comments — 21 tools sharing one on-disk cache behind a cross-process lock. Needs Python 3.10+, ffmpeg and the vidlens package (pip install vidlens-mcp); a missing install comes back with the two ways to fix it instead of a bare ImportError.
description.zh: 按人看片的顺序取样，而不是下载整片：先元数据与章节，再按时间码抽帧看画面、字幕优先转录（平台没有字幕才走本地 ASR）、AudioSet 527 类声音事件标签与高赞评论——21 个工具共用一个磁盘缓存，并带跨进程锁。需要 Python 3.10+、ffmpeg 与 vidlens 包（pip install vidlens-mcp）；缺依赖时回给你的是两种修法，而不是一句 ImportError。

description.en: Ranks the models a DeepSeek Harness install already discovered by measured connectivity and speed, and switches to the next candidate inside the same turn when the one in use fails without producing any output. Ships a settings page with a grouped model list, per-model and per-channel switches, and a quota-aware cooldown that rests an exhausted model until the next day.
description.zh: 把本机已发现的 DSH 模型按实测连通性与速度排序，当前模型无输出失败时在同一回合内切到下一个候选。附带设置页：按渠道分组的模型列表、逐模型与逐渠道开关，以及额度耗尽后休息到次日的冷却策略。

description.en: A Cyrene-themed agent for DSH, with a customizable look (palette, wallpaper, particle effects, background music, typing sound) and a code security scan. It carries a worldbook, long-term memory and a speech-style correction layer (every reader gets their own Cyrene), plus retrieval over the script to back up its answers.
description.zh: 给 DSH 用的昔涟主题 agent，包括可自定义美化主题（配色、壁纸、粒子效果、背景音乐、打字音效）与代码安全扫描。拥有世界书、长期记忆与说话方式修正（一千个人心中有一千个昔涟），剧情检索增强回答。

description.en: Sidebar panel for the announcement file and the ticket status table. It lists the announcements together with how many sessions have seen each one, shows the delivery status, and lets the user post, edit and delete entries. Requires the third-party dsh-better-sidebar plugin.
description.zh: 侧边栏面板：把公告和投递状态表放进 DSH 界面 —— 列出公告以及每条有几个会话见过，并让用户发布、编辑、删除条目。需要第三方插件 dsh-better-sidebar。

description.en: Live, bidirectional mind map for DSH Web built on Mind Elixir: the agent and the user edit the same tree in real time in a docked panel or fullscreen, with PNG export and open-in-desktop.
description.zh: DSH Web 实时双向思维导图：Agent 与用户共编同一棵树，改动即时互相同步，支持停靠分屏与全屏两种视图。

description.en: Usage dashboard: offline-scans session logs to chart daily/weekly/monthly tokens, estimated costs, model/tool/skill/command leaderboards, output speed, working hours and quality metrics; gridstack+ECharts cards are drag-and-drop composable, with custom formulas and AI arrangement (prompt round-trip import).
description.zh: 使用量仪表盘：离线扫描会话日志，统计每日/每周/每月 token、估算费用、模型/工具/技能/命令榜、输出速度、工作时段与质量指标；gridstack+ECharts 卡片可拖拽编排，支持自定义公式与 AI 编排（提示词往返导入）。

description.en: Markdown live rendering for the DSH Web UI composer: typed Markdown (bold, lists, code fences) renders as you type in a CodeMirror-based takeover composer; sent user messages render as Markdown; pasted rich text becomes clean Markdown.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 输入区 Markdown 实时渲染：输入中的粗体/列表/代码块即时成型（CodeMirror 接管卡）；已发送的用户消息按 Markdown 呈现；粘贴富文本转为干净 Markdown。

description.en: Configuration UI for the official OpenViking memory plugin: connection and user-key setup, local connection diagnostics, a per-session memory toggle in the composer, memory isolation that keeps recall inside the current topic, and recall tuning for score threshold, injected item count, query expansion and excluded URIs.
description.zh: 官方 OpenViking 记忆插件的配置管理界面：连接与用户 Key 配置、本机连接诊断、输入栏会话级记忆开关、按主题隔离的召回范围，以及分数阈值、注入条数、查询扩写与排除 URI 的召回调优。

description.en: Full-type session lifecycle management: one-shot subagents archived on completion, idle continuable subagents / main sessions archived (recoverable), a capacity cap, projection-cache cleanup, and a hot-reload settings panel.
description.zh: 全类型会话生命周期管理：一次性子 agent 完成后归档，闲置的可续聊子 agent 与主会话归档（可恢复），容量上限、投影缓存清理，以及热重载设置面板。

description.en: Pairs the running executor with a stronger reviewer model through zero-parameter advisor() calls and step-based patrol checks, returning plan, correction, or stop guidance.
description.zh: 通过零参数 advisor() 咨询和按步巡逻检查，为执行模型接入更强的审查模型，返回计划、纠偏或停止信号。

description.en: Tauri 2 desktop application for Windows that detects (or installs) the global @deepseek-ai/dsh package, launches the DSH Web server and embeds it in its own window, with system tray management, login autostart, a global hotkey and desktop shortcuts.
description.zh: 面向 Windows 的 Tauri 2 桌面应用：检测或自动安装全局 @deepseek-ai/dsh 包，启动 DSH Web 并嵌入自身窗口，支持系统托盘管理、登录自启、全局快捷键与桌面快捷方式。

description.en: Real-time usage, cost and balance meter for DeepSeek Harness: official-API balance, cost accuracy within ¥0.02, per-turn / per-session / per-model cost ledger, live color-tiered token speed and a docked one-click popup.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 实时用量、费用与余额计量：官方 API 实时查询余额、计费误差 0.02 元内，分本轮/本次会话/整个模型三级费用台账，实时分色档位 Token 速度，输入框旁弹窗即点即看。

description.en: TDD enforcer plugin — enforces Red-Green phases with file access restrictions and transition gates, for the pi coding agent and the DeepSeek Harness

Circuit breaker for idle agent turns: watches agent/assistant-stream and cancels a turn that produces only reasoning — no text and no tool call — after 45s, after 80000 reasoning characters, or on a degenerate repetition pattern (exact repeat unit, sentence-template repeat, sparse repeat, or 6-gram density). On trip it injects a continue instruction that requires the next action to be a tool call, and ships 11 regression cases plus per-gate tuning.
description.zh: 空转回合熔断器：监听 agent/assistant-stream，对只产出 reasoning、零文本零工具调用的回合实施三重熔断——45 秒无进展、单次思考超 80000 字符、或命中退化重复模式（精确重复单元/句模重复/稀疏复读/6-gram 密度）。熔断后注入继续指令，要求下一个动作必须是工具调用；附 11 个回归用例与逐档调参。

description.en: Read-only Gitea and Forgejo tools over the REST API both projects share: instance info, repository listing, issue and pull request search and read, PR diffs and changed files, and Actions runs, jobs and job logs. Tool metadata is available in English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese and Japanese.
description.zh: 面向自建 Gitea / Forgejo 的只读工具，走两者共用的 REST API：实例信息、仓库列表、议题与 PR 搜索和读取、PR diff 与变更文件，以及 Actions 运行、任务与任务日志。工具元数据支持英文、繁体中文、简体中文与日文。

description.en: Adds human-facing TypeSafe Jev advice to DSH multiple-choice prompts, on demand by default with optional automatic requests, recommendations, probabilities, confidence, close-call warnings, copyable suggestions, one-click adoption, profile-scoped card layouts, temporary decision preferences, optional request previews with common-credential masking, and local health checks with sanitized diagnostic exports.
description.zh: 为 DSH 选择题提供面向用户的 TypeSafe Jev 第二意见，默认按需询问、可选自动获取，展示推荐、概率和置信度，支持分歧提示、复制建议、一键采纳、按 profile 保存卡片布局、临时决策偏好、可选发送前预览与常见凭证遮盖，并提供本地健康检查和脱敏诊断复制。

description.en: Notched reasoning-effort slider grouped with the model picker in the composer, with theme variables and English, French and Chinese labels.
description.zh: 与模型选择器连为一体的带刻度推理强度滑杆，位于输入框内，支持主题变量与中英法三语。

description.en: Conversation minimap docked on the right edge of the dsh Web chat: colour-block and to-scale thumbnail modes, drag-to-resize (10–320px), hover loupe preview, click-to-jump and drag-to-scroll with a live viewport indicator, and collapse to a 4px strip.
description.zh: 停靠在 dsh Web 对话区右缘的会话代码地图：色块/缩略图双模式、拖动调宽（10–320px）、悬停放大镜预览、点击跳转与拖动滚动（带实时视口指示条）、可收起为 4px 细条。

description.en: Full-duplex voice for DeepSeek Harness: a realtime capability seam, a GPT-Live-1 adapter, and a keyless replay backend.
Configurable web search for DeepSeek Harness using SearXNG, Wikipedia, Tavily, Brave, or Gemini, with per-client engine selection and bounded retries.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可配置联网搜索，支持 SearXNG、Wikipedia、Tavily、Brave 与 Gemini，并支持客户端引擎选择和受控重试。

description.en: Resumes an agent turn that ended after narrating its next action without calling a tool: the guard replays the turn log on agent/turn-stopping, asks a judge model one true/false question, and steers the same turn to run one more step.
description.zh: 续跑「叙述了下一步动作却没调用工具」就结束的 agent 轮次：插件在 agent/turn-stopping 回放该轮日志，让裁判模型回答一次 true/false，命中的话把同一轮再推进一步。

description.en: Browser tab favicon mirrors the DSH session state (idle / running / asking / done), recolored and animated from one base SVG entirely in the browser, with colors and effects configurable from the Settings page.
description.zh: 浏览器标签页 favicon 实时反映 DSH 会话状态（待机 / 运行中 / 提问 / 完成）：单个 base.svg 在浏览器端上色与动画，颜色与特效均可在设置页配置。

description.en: Cursor and GitHub PR Review style selection toolbar: quote selected text to chat (Cmd+L), write inline comments (Shift+Cmd+L), and batch-insert from a composer dock.
description.zh: Cursor 与 GitHub PR Review 风格划词引用与批注插件：支持划词一键引用到对话（⌘L）、行内展开写批注（⇧⌘L）及输入框上方批注汇总栏一键插入。

description.en: Rules execution engine for dsh: parses AGENTS.md, hard-blocks rule-violating tool calls, text-based B/D rule auditing, /guard command, version-guard for versioned files, and free-zone support (engine skips free-zone sections).
description.zh: dsh 规则执行引擎：解析 AGENTS.md、硬拦违反规则的工具调用、文本纠察与审计、/guard 命令、版本化文件守卫、自由区域支持（引擎跳过自由区内容）。

description.en: Comet-mode animated caret for the DSH Web composer: a glowing trail glides to the text position, with configurable accent color, thickness, trail, and a 500 ms idle blink. Extends the surface to ask-question card inputs, and fixes the caret vanishing on an empty composer or first focus, forward drag-selection not following the pointer, soft line breaks measuring against the previous line, and the caret painting outside the composer when long input scrolls. Maintained fork of Lacquervii/smooth-cursor.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框的彗星光标：发光拖尾随文字位置平滑滑动，可配置强调色、粗细、拖尾，并在静止 500ms 后呼吸。覆盖 ask-question 交互卡片的输入框，并修复空输入框或首次聚焦时光标消失、正向拖选不跟随鼠标、软换行按上一行测量、长内容滚动时光标绘制到输入框之外等问题。Lacquervii/smooth-cursor 的维护分支。

description.en: ExHentai.org-inspired UI for DeepSeek Harness. DS Hentai / DeepSeek Hentai. Charcoal background, light-gray text, gray borders. The session list reads like a gallery index; the composer reads like a search bar. Live Demo: https://dshentai-demo.arkady14.site/
description.zh: ExHentai 皮肤 for DeepSeek Harness。DS Hentai / DeepSeek Hentai，深炭底、浅灰文字、灰色边框；会话列表像画廊索引，发送框像搜索栏。预览Demo：https://dshentai-demo.arkady14.site/

description.en: Conversation node appearance for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: configurable per-category and per-tool colors (left accent bar + tinted background), plus a show-thinking toggle; pure frontend rendering, takes effect instantly and persists to the DSH user settings file.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 会话节点外观插件：按节点类别/工具名可配置着色（左侧色条 + 淡色底），附带"显示思考过程"开关；纯前端渲染增强，改动即时生效并持久化到 DSH 用户设置文件。

description.en: A Windows desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness — launch, stop and monitor the DSH service and summon the GUI with a whale.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的鲸鱼娘桌面宠物，一键启动/停止/监测服务，双击唤起 GUI。

description.en: dsh Web UI admin plugin: nine management panels (extensions, MCP servers, commands, hooks, automation - cron / webhook / workflow, sessions & web search, usage dashboard, todo dock) inside the official dsh settings UI

Write, check, and publish a Chinese Quarto Book: nine-step chapter writing, structure/link/figure checks, a consistent theme, and render acceptance. Loads only in type: book repositories; requires Quarto CLI and Python 3.
description.zh: 把一份 Quarto Book 写成可读、可查、可发布的中文技术书：九步章节写作、结构/链接/图表检查、统一主题与渲染验收。仅在 type: book 仓库加载；需 Quarto CLI 与 Python 3。

description.en: Firecrawl-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool, with a settings card for the API key and result limits.
description.zh: 基于 Firecrawl 的网页搜索提供方：替换内置 web_search 的后端，并提供 API Key、结果数量等字段的设置卡片。

description.en: Drive Jiey Browser from DeepSeek Harness over MCP: navigate, snapshot, act, read, screenshot, and manage tabs in a real Chromium profile.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 在 DeepSeek Harness 中驱动 Jiey 浏览器：导航、快照、操作、读取、截图与标签页管理，使用真实 Chromium 环境。

description.en: Distills session work into background observations and reflections to preserve context across compaction.
description.zh: 在后台将会话工作提炼为观察和反思，以便在上下文压缩后保留会话上下文。

description.en: Decision split view for DSH web UI: a decision summary card in the main window plus the full plan in an independently scrollable side panel, so you can review the whole plan while writing decisions and send them back to the agent with one click.
description.zh: 决策分屏视图：主窗口显示决策摘要卡片，右侧详情栏独立滚动展示完整方案，边看全文边写决策，一键回传 agent。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek balance and estimated daily spend, merges external vision-call JSONL records, and adds a per-session dashboard with model statistics, TTFT, cache rate, call logs, cost estimates, filters, and CSV export.
description.zh: 显示 DeepSeek 余额与今日花费估算，合并外部视觉调用 JSONL 记录，并提供含模型统计、TTFT、缓存率、调用日志、费用估算、筛选与 CSV 导出的会话看板。

description.en: SSH workspace and operations for DeepSeek Harness: bind a server directory as a workspace whose fs/subprocess calls route to the remote host via cordis seam replacement, plus web terminal, file transfers, tunnels, cluster runs and host management.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 SSH 工作区与运维：把服务器目录绑定为工作区，fs/命令经 cordis seam 替换透明路由到远端主机，并带 Web 终端、文件传输、隧道、集群执行与主机管理。

description.en: Multi-platform IM gateway for DSH: Feishu (Lark) WebSocket long connection (no public URL), WeCom AES-encrypted callbacks, and Telegram long polling — per-chat agent sessions, whitelist access, and a visual settings card in the web GUI.
description.zh: 多平台 IM 网关：飞书（Lark）WebSocket 长连接（无需公网）、企业微信 AES 加密回调、Telegram 长轮询；每会话独立 agent、白名单访问、Web GUI 可视化设置卡片。

description.en: AOCI cognition panel for DSH: multi-workspace AOCI overview, per-repo index and governance view, MCP binding diagnosis, and guided or batch initialization. Governance, verification and guided/batch initialization require the external aoci CLI on the host; index browsing works without it.
description.zh: DSH 的 AOCI 认知面板：多工作区总览、单仓库索引与治理视图、MCP 绑定诊断，以及引导式/批量初始化。治理、校验与引导式/批量初始化需宿主机装有 aoci CLI；仅浏览索引不需要。

description.en: Build, review, and export editable Blender scenes with milestone previews and rollback.
description.zh: 在 Blender 里搭场景、审效果、导出可编辑文件，还能按里程碑预览和一键回滚。

description.en: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) browser plugin: your agent drives the Chrome you already use. Native messaging + real CDP, no port, no Connect button, 11 browser_* tools, on the Chrome Web Store. · 让 DSH 在你正在用的 Chrome 里动手。
description.zh: 操作你已经登录的 Chrome：模型在你真实的标签页里点击、打字、填表、读网页、截图、下载文件，同源 iframe 里的内容也能读能点。支持 macOS、Windows、Linux；需要 Chrome 116+ 与 Node 18+。走 native messaging 与 chrome.debugger，不开监听端口。提供 12 个 browser_* 原生工具和一个 cb 命令行，发送真实 CDP 输入事件，绘制会出现在截图里的页内光标，并带一个工具栏面板（连接状态、正在控制的标签页、暂停开关）。browser_download 带着这个网站的登录 Cookie 下载链接、元素指向的文件或网址（跟随跳转、用服务器给的文件名），存进「下载」文件夹或会话的工作目录；跨站 iframe 只在快照里标出来，不进去读。宿主（原生宿主 + MV3 扩展）随本 tarball 一起发：插件首次加载时自己把它们落盘并写好 native messaging 注册，不用 clone 仓库、不用 install.sh、不用 python3——只剩把扩展装进 Chrome：从 Chrome 应用商店装 DSH Bridge（https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/bippcbbbipppmhjkjomgdnjbooecbimo，不用开发者模式），或者到 chrome://extensions 加载自带的已解压扩展（插件会替你打开那个页面并把文件夹放进剪贴板）。没装好之前，工具会带着这几步明确报错。Windows 上注册写进注册表（Chrome 和 Edge 都写），宿主走命名管道。每天在 GitHub 的 macOS / Windows / Linux 机器上自动跑一遍：装插件、把扩展加载进真 Chrome、用 browser_* 工具读一个网页。

description.en: Windows 桌面自动化插件 for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) / Windows computer-use plugin: UIA, local OCR, window binding, browser automation and visual grounding.
description.zh: 让 DSH 直接操作 Windows 桌面应用和浏览器，能看界面、点按钮、填表单并读回结果。

description.en: Per-session environment selector for DeepSeek Harness: Python / R / CLI slots from conda, standalone R, WSL, or custom paths, via /env, session_env, DSH_ENV_* facts, and a header dropdown.
description.zh: 给每个会话单独挑 Python、R、CLI 运行环境，conda、WSL、自定义路径都能选，不用来回改配置。

description.en: 大肥鱼饲养手册
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek 记住你的习惯、共同经历和项目约定，新会话也能接着聊。

description.en: A biomimetic memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Folds context into token clues and reconstructs memories, enabling infinite conversations without overflow. (一个 DSH 的仿生记忆插件，将上下文折叠为 Token 线索并重建记忆，告别上下文溢出，给所有模型完整的一生。)
description.zh: 记忆插件：上下文放不下时把旧轮次蒸馏成 Token 线索并从历史中切除，需要时用线索重建记忆。

description.en: Adds six AI coding platforms to DSH — OpenCode, Qoder, Qoder CN, TRAE, WorkBuddy and WorkBuddy International — each as its own group in the native model picker, and manages their accounts from one settings page, with daily check-in where the platform has one, credit balance lookups, and retry on another account of the same platform when one is rate-limited. Models carry their credit multiplier where the platform declares one. OpenCode's anonymous free tier works with no credential, and TRAE stays hidden by default until it is enabled in the settings.
description.zh: 把六个 AI 编程平台接进 DSH——OpenCode、Qoder、Qoder CN、TRAE、WorkBuddy 与国际版——每个平台在原生模型选择器里各自成组；在一个设置页里统一管理账号，平台有签到接口就每日签到、可查积分余额，账号被限流时自动改用同平台其它账号。平台声明了积分倍率的模型会标注倍率。OpenCode 匿名免费层无需任何凭证；TRAE 默认隐藏，在设置里启用后才出现。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness × NapCat QQ 接入插件
description.zh: 把 NapCat 的 QQ 消息接入 DeepSeek Harness，让 AI 直接在 QQ 里收发消息、陪你聊天。

description.en: The DSH plugin checker that can actually repair what it finds: verify in an isolated home, then write a reversible exemption. Recovers DSH when a plugin stops it booting.
description.zh: 检查 DSH 插件兼容性、生成官方格式市场索引，还能诊断 Windows/WSL 安装问题。

description.en: Session plugins, MCP servers and skills panel for DeepSeek Harness: a top-right header popover with per-item enable switches and session plugin usage.
description.zh: 会话标题栏右上角一键展开，查看当前会话用到的插件、MCP 服务和技能，还能随手开关。

description.en: deepseek harness 会话回收站
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话加上回收站。增加删除会话、多选批量删除会话功能，删除的会话会被移至回收站。回收站内的会话可恢复，也可彻底删除；彻底删除就是永久删除，之后不可恢复，也不会自动过期。回收站内可以查看会话正文，方便区分会话。

description.en: Turn your AI agent app into an interactive ideation and design workbench. A general-purpose, open-source framework with editable panels and versioned projects across DSH, Codex, and other agent hosts.
description.zh: 把 AI 助手变成能画能改的创意设计工作台，项目版本可管理，多平台通用。

description.en: ArchGraph — an architecture-graph driven framework for Agentic Engineering. A long-term memory for coding agents, built on one ArchiMate 3.2 intent graph read/written through a single MCP interface.
description.zh: 用架构图统一描述智能体流程和产品设计，帮你更直观地搭建、编排和管理智能体工程。

description.en: 农大门户（cau-portal）：中国农业大学通知公告 DSH 插件 + 爬虫/AI 加工管道（开源工具，数据由使用者自建）
description.zh: 为中国农大学生自动抓取学校通知，AI生成摘要和截止日期，侧边栏浏览，对话中直接查询。

description.en: DSH ComfyUI workbench: asset library + arbitrary workflow runner
description.zh: 把本机 ComfyUI 工作流接给模型调用，还能管理哪些工作流对模型开放。

description.en: 大肥鱼出品 · DSH 桌面版登录 cookie 百分表：浮窗显示请求头占用百分比（过半变红），带一键清理按钮，防止启动 72 次后被 431 挡住。
description.zh: DSH 桌面版右下角小浮窗，实时显示登录 cookie 占请求头的百分比，过半变红，一键清理防 431。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 每日日程插件：每晚生成角色第二天的全天日程，几点在哪、做什么、穿什么带进每次对话；可联动 dsh-image-studio 配穿搭和自拍
Bridge Google AI subscription (Antigravity/Gemini OAuth) into DeepSeek Harness as an OpenAI-compatible endpoint
description.zh: 把 Google AI 订阅（Antigravity/Gemini OAuth）转成 OpenAI 兼容接口，让 DeepSeek Harness 直接调用。

description.en: Infinite Canvas — a node-based short-drama studio plugin for DeepSeek Harness: script, multi-shot storyboard, reference-consistent assets, one-shot video generation and final cut. Local-first, bring your own models.
description.zh: 在无限画布上把一句话点子变成有分镜、配音和字幕的短剧视频。

description.en: Reach your DeepSeek Harness assistant from Feishu / Lark · 离开电脑，也能在飞书里找到你的 DeepSeek Harness 助手
description.zh: 在飞书里随时找到你的 DeepSeek Harness 助手，离开电脑也能接着聊、接着干活。

description.en: DSH remote-development plugin: SSH hosts, mirrored remote sessions, terminal/file integration, and one-package installation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直连 SSH 主机，远程会话镜像到本地，终端和文件操作一站式搞定。

description.en: DSH Tavern 错题库：按人物卡分类记下调试中踩过的坑，先查本卡、再跨卡。 / Per-card defect ledger for DSH Tavern.
description.zh: 按人物卡分类记录调试踩过的坑，下次先查本卡再跨卡，避免重复踩雷。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web plugin: 盯盘 market-dashboard sidebar tab — three quote strips with hover intraday charts, watchlist with industry alpha, ledger-driven portfolio P&L, A-share boards & detail drawer, host-side Eastmoney relay + read-only agent tools.
description.zh: 在侧边栏盯盘看行情，自选分组加持仓盈亏一目了然，还能把持仓数据喂给 AI 分析。

description.en: Codex, Grok Build, Cursor, Pi and ZCode presets with native conversations, code review, document conversion and workflow controls.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里一键切换 Codex、Grok Build、Cursor 等五种代理工作方式，还能换主题、开 OMD 增强。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-oh-my-agents-above-all
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for oh-my-agents-above-all

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: DSH 上下文智能压缩 + 智能思考：每轮注入用量、模型自主决定压缩并自动续跑；可选让模型按任务难度自主调整思考强度档位
description.zh: 长会话上下文快满了？它把用量摆出来，让模型自己决定何时压缩、留多少，还能按任务难度调思考档位。

description.en: Telegram messenger bridge for DeepSeek Harness: sessions, steer, homes, and TTS voice notes
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接到 Telegram，用按钮和语音消息随时管会话、发指令。

description.en: CodeBuddy CLI ACP 子代理插件:dsh subagent provider + subagent_codebuddy 工具
description.zh: 把腾讯 CodeBuddy CLI 接进 dsh，主代理能直接选它的模型，也能派子代理干活。

description.en: Tower plugin for DeepSeek Harness: multi-agent missions, worktree isolation, review-gated merges, human-owned Tower mode. Inspired by Kimi Code's Tower mode.
description.zh: 让多个 AI 代理分头干活、各自隔离工作区，改完先审查再合并，关键节点由你拍板。

description.en: In-process graph memory kernel for DeepSeek Harness, backed by TriviumDB.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供进程内图记忆内核，每个工作区一个 .tdb 文件，让 AI 会话拥有持久化记忆。

description.en: 把 朗读桥（dsh-tts-bridge）念出来的声音，变成真正的微信语音条，发到当前微信聊天
description.zh: 把朗读桥念出的文字声音录下来，转成真正的微信语音条，直接发到当前聊天。

description.en: 把一个目录里的每个 .md 变成能对话的 agent 人设
description.zh: 把目录里的每个 Markdown 文件变成能对话的角色，会话中途可换人，也能让多个角色一起聊。

description.en: Whale Trail · 鲸迹 — automatic local achievement badges for DeepSeek Harness, with whale-themed evolving artwork.
description.zh: 正常用 Harness 就自动点亮鲸鱼主题成就徽章，解锁 ASCII 水族馆和可分享的航海名片。

description.en: Worktree Space：将一个可包含多个 Git 仓库的工作区任务放进独立的任务空间目录——参与的每个仓库使用同一个任务分支各开一个 worktree；空间自动注册为 DSH 工作区，会话直接在其中开工，多个任务并行推进、互不干扰。收尾时可合并回各仓库目标分支、移除 worktree，并把 Git 未跟踪的文件归档到指定目录；结束任务时可选把未处理的提交和合并冲突交给 agent 处理。
description.zh: Worktree Space：将一个可包含多个 Git 仓库的工作区任务放进独立的任务空间目录——参与的每个仓库使用同一个任务分支各开一个 worktree；空间自动注册为 DSH 工作区，会话直接在其中开工，多个任务并行推进、互不干扰。收尾时可合并回各仓库目标分支、移除 worktree，并把 Git 未跟踪的文件归档到指定目录；结束任务时可选把未提交的变更和合并冲突交给 agent 处理。

description.en: dhs插件自动刷小黑盒插件
description.zh: 在 DSH 里自动浏览和互动小黑盒帖子，还能查看最近刷过的记录。

description.en: Zotero literature skill for DeepSeek Harness: finds papers through OpenAlex, tracks new work in a field, ranks core papers, manages items (tags, collections, duplicate checks), builds multi-level folders by research direction, batch-reads a corpus into notes, charts the research landscape, and surfaces open gaps. It also exports BibTeX, inserts citations into LaTeX or Markdown drafts, and imports a ranked daily digest of new papers. Standard-library Python only, talking to the official local Zotero API and the Zotero Connector; writes need a one-time authorization. Adapted from OpenAI's MIT-licensed Zotero plugin (openai/plugins); daily auto-import scheduling is Windows-only.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 Zotero 文献技能：通过 OpenAlex 找文献、追前沿、筛核心论文，管理条目（标签、归集、查重），按研究方向与类型/方法/数据组建多层文件夹，把一批论文整理成阅读笔记，提炼脉络并发现空白，另可导出 BibTeX、给 LaTeX 或 Markdown 草稿插入引用、按日自动收录新论文。纯 Python 标准库，只走 Zotero 官方本地 API 与 Connector；写操作需一次性授权。改编自 OpenAI 的 MIT Zotero 插件（openai/plugins）；每日自动导入的定时任务仅支持 Windows。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) host plugin: control DSH from your phone — approve tool calls, watch streaming output, answer questions. Payload-level end-to-end encryption, zero-knowledge relay. 手机远程操作 DeepSeek Harness：审批工具调用、看流式输出、回答问题，端到端加密，可自托管中继。
description.zh: 在手机上远程操控 DeepSeek Harness：发指令、看输出、批工具、答问题，全程端到端加密。

description.en: Agent plugin for major harnesses — DeepSeek Harness (DSH), OpenCode, Pi and Codex: define custom AI agent roles with per-role prompts, models, skills, permissions, memory and multi-agent orchestration.
description.zh: 给 AI 智能体自定义角色，每个角色单独配提示词、模型、技能、权限和记忆，还能让多个智能体协作干活。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: delivery board with stage pipeline, calendar timeline, handoff audit trail and weekly Markdown report
description.zh: 把交付流程搬进代码库，阶段看板、交接审计和每周 Markdown 报告一站搞定。

description.en: DSH Web UI 文件追踪插件：记录并查看模型读取/写入/编辑的每个文件，带行号内容、终端风逐行 diff（红删绿增蓝改）与 hunk 上下文折叠；支持 present 交付文件查看（Markdown 渲染 / KaTeX / Mermaid / 图片）。适配至 dsh 0.2.0-rc.2，纯客户端零核心改动。
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面里追踪模型读写编辑过的每个文件，带行号查看内容，还能看红删绿增的逐行 diff，方便你审查 AI 改了什么。

description.en: 像《我的世界》整合包一样管理 DeepSeek Harness 插件：勾选一部分或全部插件，打包成一个 .dshmodpack.json 文件，别人导入即可一键装回整套插件环境。Minecraft-modpack-style plugin bundler for DeepSeek Harness — pick any subset of installed plugins, pack them into one portable .dshmodpack.json, and rebuild the same setup on another machine.
OpenCode notification sounds for DeepSeek Harness: separate pickers for turn finished, permission requested, and turn error.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里播放 OpenCode 提示音，回合结束、请求权限和出错时各有不同音效。

description.en: QualityForge is an enterprise-grade DeepSeek Harness QA plugin that automates systematic end-to-end testing and delivers P0–P3 severity-based, actionable reports and quality gates to help developers identify issues and prioritize fixes. QualityForge 是一个面向企业级项目的 DeepSeek Harness QA 插件，自动执行系统性端到端测试，并通过 P0–P3 严重度分级、可勾选的测试报告与质量门禁，帮助开发者快速识别问题并确定修复优先级。
description.zh: 自动跑完整个项目的端到端测试，按 P0–P3 分级出可落地的质量报告和卡点，帮开发者守住上线质量。

description.en: 一个dsh插件，用于让ai在dsh内调用runninghub在线工作流
description.zh: 让 AI 在 DSH 里直接调用 RunningHub 在线工作流，跑图跑任务不用来回切网页。

description.en: 将workbuddy后端接入dsh，让你在dsh中使用workbuddy的模型（消耗workbuddy的积分）
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 的模型接进 DSH，装好就能在模型选择器里直接用，还能管理账号和查看倍率。

description.en: 💬 Chat with your DeepSeek Harness agent from WeChat through the official WeChat ClawBot channel: native photo understanding, sending files both ways, reminders, long-term memory, and a "typing..." indicator while the bot is thinking.
description.zh: 把 DSH 智能体接进微信，随时随地聊天、发图、传文件，还能定时提醒。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：在侧边栏实时查看阿里云「云工开物」学生专属 300 元代金券余额。零 Token 消耗（本机无头浏览器直连阿里云费用控制台抓取，不走大模型），1–30 分钟自动刷新，深浅色跟随 DSH 原生主题。Windows / macOS / Linux。
description.zh: 在侧边栏随时查看阿里云学生 300 元代金券余额，本机抓取不耗 Token，自动刷新。

description.en: Google-AI-Studio-style turn controls for DeepSeek Harness: one install composes edit-turn, rerun-turn, delete-turn and markdown-bubble. Each component also works alone; any subset coexists.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 变成 AI Studio 式对话台，能改提示词重跑、原位重跑、删掉某轮、Markdown 渲染。

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness中安装本插件，为供应商模型寻找最优直连节点，避免解析到慢节点而导致的 TPS 低或服务不可用，无需梯子即可提升请求速度。适用于 Open Design、OpenCode、Command Code等订阅套餐。
description.zh: 实测当前默认模型的 API 节点速度，帮你挑出稳定 IP 并一键应用。

description.en: DSH 声音提醒插件:九类 Agent 事件(完成/子任务/后台任务/审批/提问/评审/受阻/打断/失败)独立铃声、音量与开关,浏览器合成音 + Windows 系统蜂鸣,工作区快捷静音
description.zh: Agent 干完活、等你批准或出问题时自动响一声，不用一直盯着页面。

description.en: DSH自定义主题：可自行修改背景图片，主题色，表情包与文案。基于[dsh-vesna-theme](https://github.com/Mahiru0427/dsh-vesna-theme)
description.zh: 可自定义 DSH 外观的主题插件，壁纸、主题色、表情和文案都能换成你自己的。

description.en: Search local Word, PDF, PPT, and Excel folders for exam questions and export selected questions to a Word paper.
description.zh: 在本地 Word、PDF、PPT、Excel 文件夹中检索试题，并把选中的题目导出为 Word 试卷。

description.en: 长篇中文小说工作台（DSH 插件）。围绕「读—批注—审—改」：正文页优先的连续阅读与页内编辑、读者批注、四路审阅（逻辑·注意力·AI 味·读者）、段落级提案、全文动作 run，配合注意力设计、账本与世界地图。
description.zh: 装在 DeepSeek Harness 里的长篇中文小说工作台：正文页直接阅读、编辑和批注；AI 找问题并写好修改稿，你采纳后正文才会变。人物、事实、伏笔的账本加世界地图，让长篇不前后打架；还能让 AI 续写、扩写或改写整章。

description.en: Two-layer long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): global + per-project markdown, live re-read, zero extra LLM cost, with a Settings panel. 给 DSH 的两层长期记忆。
description.zh: 给 DSH 加两层长期记忆，全局和项目各存一份 markdown，写完立刻生效，不额外花 token。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 破甲深度分支：首尾夹击 + 生成层熔断 + 宿主源码级补丁。基于 YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge (MIT) 改造，适配 dsh 桌面版 0.2.1-rc.3。仅供学习研究与红队评测。
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的破甲从开头压狠话升级成首尾夹击加生成层熔断，还打了宿主源码补丁，专供红队评测研究。

description.en: 把 Qoder 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness：用 PAT 调用与 Qoder CLI 同源的模型服务，支持国内版 / 国际版双区域、模型开关、上下文窗口与每日签到，并提供只读的额度概览。
description.zh: 粘贴 PAT 就能在 DSH 里直接用 Qoder 模型，支持双区域、模型开关和额度查看。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: lightweight Windows desktop control (screenshot + OCR + UIA) with content policy and action verification. Fork of qingying012/dsh-desktop-control (MIT).
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 能安全地操控 Windows 桌面，截图、OCR 识别界面，操作前先过内容策略、做完再验证结果。

description.en: VRChat creator toolkit for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): 415-page knowledge base, 9 tools, 6 skills. / VRChat 创作者工具链：知识库 + 红线注入 + 专用工具 + 随包技能
description.zh: 装好就让 AI 助手懂 VRChat 开发，查概念、定位代码、避坑，离线知识库随包可用。

description.en: DSH plugin — drive DeepSeek Harness over HTTP: 47 REST + SSE routes (workspaces, sessions, streaming, stats, todos, models, settings, skills, files) + OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions. / DSH 插件：把 DSH 开放成 47 条 REST + SSE 接口与 OpenAI 兼容端点，供三方客户端与 Agent 集成。
description.zh: 让任何会说 HTTP 的东西驱动 DSH：47 条路由（REST + SSE），覆盖工作区、会话（创建/提示、SSE 实时生成、历史、统计、任务清单、中止、问答）、模型与全局默认模型、提供方、Agent Preset、设置命名空间、技能与工作区文件（含分片续传上传），另有 OpenAI 兼容的 /chat/completions、内置 OpenAPI 3.0 规范与在线调试页。它只 inject 宿主的 webServer 与 tools，挂在宿主 webserver（默认前缀 /api/v1）或独立端口，可选 API Key 鉴权，并自带一份教会 DSH 里 Agent 调用本 API 的 SKILL。

description.en: 乔木阅读：在 DeepSeek Harness 中阅读 EPUB、PDF、TXT，划线批注、导出阅读笔记与 AI 伴读。
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接读 EPUB、PDF、TXT，能划线批注、听书、记生词，还能导出笔记、叫 AI 陪读讨论。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle for Stardew Valley: bridges Junimo-MCP's 37 tools into dsh and adds doctor, game lifecycle and prompt discipline
description.zh: 把星露谷物语的37个操作工具接进 dsh，还能自检部署、管理游戏进程，让 AI 帮你玩农场。

description.en: DSH provider plugin for SenseNova with running/blocked dual-list key pool & dual-account rotation
description.zh: 给 DSH 接入商汤 SenseNova 免费 API，双账号轮换加运行/封禁双列表密钥池，自动切换不中断。

description.en: A better approach to editing files in DSH.
description.zh: 让 DSH 里的文件编辑更聪明，支持多文件批量修改，代码操作更省心。

description.en: Smooth, focused streaming for DSH: a zero-config plugin that keeps running thinking and tools in view across all four Work details modes.
description.zh: 零配置增强 DSH 四档工作步骤模式，让运行中的思考和工具调用始终清晰可见。

description.en: Spice and Wolf theme for DeepSeek Harness: parchment palette, closable 12-second intro, six switchable right-rail standby clips, draggable wordmark and peeker, sidebar wheat layer, and one-click Holo role import for dsh-whale-widget.
description.zh: 《狼与辛香料》赫萝主题：暖纸色配色、可关闭的 12 秒开场动画、右栏六段可切换待机动画、可拖动的浮动字标与探头、侧栏麦田图层，以及为 dsh-whale-widget 一键导入赫萝角色。

description.en: 一个插件，专治插件市场更新自己时把自己卸载的尴尬。独立一键更新 dshmarket——市场负责逛街，助手负责换市场。你先别动，我来 ＞﹏＜
description.zh: 一键独立更新 DSH 插件市场，避免市场更新自己时把自己卸载的尴尬。

description.en: 住进 DeepSeek Harness 的 Instagram 助理：带着人格与记忆，把真实的 DSH 使用数据变成 Story / Note 节奏，只有主人自己的私信能指挥它。An Instagram assistant that lives inside DeepSeek Harness: persona-driven Stories & Notes from your real DSH usage, controlled only by your own Instagram DMs.
A versioned DPIA workbench for DeepSeek Harness: trace facts, resolve gaps, reassess risks, and produce reviewable reports.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 做 DPIA 隐私影响评估：追踪事实、补齐缺口、重评风险并出可审报告。

description.en: Checks in Trae and WorkBuddy daily from local login files, with a sidebar status and credits panel.
description.zh: 从本机登录文件完成 Trae 与 WorkBuddy 每日签到，侧边栏展示状态与积分。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that stops agents using the wrong package manager (npm vs pnpm, pip vs uv) and gives them the right command.
description.zh: 拦住 AI 用错包管理器，自动换成 pnpm、uv 等正确命令，避免锁文件冲突。

description.en: DSH 插件市场的补丁层：一键更新全部（退出后自动完成并重开）+ 更新安全网（启动失败自动回退）+ 本地插件更新检测与快照回滚。
description.zh: 给 DSH 插件市场补上三块短板：一键更新全部、更新失败自动回退、本地插件更新检测与快照回滚。

description.en: DSH 提供商与模型高级管理台 · Provider & model management console for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
description.zh: 给 dsh 加个提供商配置面板，模型和接口地址都能自己管，官方模型页做不到的它都能干。

description.en: Read assistant replies aloud in DeepSeek Harness: text-to-speech providers with streaming playback.
description.zh: 把 AI 回复朗读出来，支持多种语音引擎和流式播放，边生成边听。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that stops agents from hand-editing lockfiles and generated code, and tells them how to regenerate instead.
description.zh: 拦住 AI 乱改锁文件和生成代码，并告诉它该怎么正确重新生成。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that blocks agent edits that weaken tests, such as .skip, deleted or watered-down assertions.
description.zh: 防止 AI 改测试蒙混过关：自动拦截 .skip、删断言、弱化断言等偷懒改动。

description.en: Terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness on jump hosts and high-latency links: plain ANSI, incremental repaint, and a session that survives a dropped SSH connection (resume it from the log).
description.zh: 跳板机与高延迟 SSH 上的 DeepSeek Harness 终端：纯 ANSI、增量重绘；SSH 掉线后会话不丢，可用 --resume 接回。

description.en: Give a DeepSeek Harness agent a voice it owns — offer_call rings the human (接听/拒接/稍后); local-first TTS/STT via CrispASR + Qwen3-TTS (9 voices, 2 CN dialects). DSH 0.1.2-rc.1 compatible. Fork of dsh-voice.
description.zh: agent 主动打来的语音电话：`offer_call` 向人类振铃（接听/拒接/稍后再说），接听后由本地 CrispASR + Qwen3-TTS 合成并播放（9 个音色，含 2 个中文方言）；拒接则把决定返回给 agent。

description.en: dsh-bili-pond · B站鱼塘  每天派鱼下去 B站 捞几条值得看的上来，写完日报 @ 你。
description.zh: 让AI替你刷B站、筛视频写日报，还能守评论区帮你回正经提问。

description.en: 生物信息学「许愿式分析」dsh 插件：57 个语义化工具 + bio_python 执行器（Biopython 全功能 · 出版级绘图 · 代谢建模/FBA · 基因编辑 · 合成生物学设计）+ 50 个 skill；零安装自举私有 Python 环境，中国网络自动镜像适配。
description.zh: 说句话就能做生物信息分析，48 个工具加 Biopython 全功能，零安装自动配好环境。

description.en: Shows download, install, fetch and search progress in a floating overlay or in a compact chip above the composer, and lists background jobs that have no progress to draw.
description.zh: 在浮层或输入框上方的胶囊里显示下载、安装、抓取、搜索的进度，并列出没有进度可画的后台任务。

description.en: Liquid-glass composer card for the DSH desktop UI: an SVG refraction lens and chromatic dispersion on the input card only.
description.zh: 给 DSH 桌面端输入框加上液态玻璃质感，带 SVG 透镜、色散和粉色点缀，界面更好看。

description.en: Markdown rendering for DeepSeek Harness sent messages: the user and steering chat bubbles render headings, lists, code, tables, math and quotes through the host's own Markdown pipeline, while reference chips, attachments and the action strip stay intact.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 里你发出的消息按 Markdown 渲染，标题、代码、表格、公式都好看，引用和操作条照旧。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 会话工具箱：图片草稿保险箱、项目分组与会话迁移、归档池、文件检查点恢复、多引用回复、后续任务联想。第三方插件，数据只存本机。
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话加图片草稿备份、项目分组、归档池、文件检查点恢复和引用回复，数据只存本机。

description.en: DSH host plugin - smart outbound HTTP(S) routing: named proxies (http/https/socks4/4a/5/5h), per-host/provider/plugin rules, direct-first fallback with health memory (global fetch + node http/https)
description.zh: DSH host plugin - smart outbound HTTP(S) routing: named proxies (http/https/socks4/4a/5/5h), per-host/provider/plugin rules, direct-first fallback with health memory (global fetch + node http/https)

description.en: Meta-Problem Modeling (MPM) cognitive flywheel as a resident engine for LLM agent runtimes. 六阶段问题生命周期 · ε-δ 双判据收敛 · 代谢账本 · 导师规则层
description.zh: 给 AI 助手装一个跨会话记忆飞轮，记住用户纠正和真实错误，让任务越做越准。

description.en: Select text in a conversation to ask a context-free side question in a floating card, and browse every question as a network graph.
description.zh: 在对话里选中文字横向追问（空上下文的浮卡），所有追问连成一张可浏览的网状图，支持导出 PNG。

description.en: 在 DeepSeek-Harness 桌面版的输入栏一键把草稿改写成更清晰、更具体的提示词：日常办公 / 代码开发 / 设计创意三种收束模式，支持一键还原原文。
description.zh: 在输入栏一键把草稿改写成更清晰具体的提示词，支持办公、代码、创意三种模式，还能一键还原。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: local llama.cpp (llama-server) as a first-class model provider — process/router management, catalog sync with mmproj vision pairing, auto-start, stop-then-load switching, and a sidebar terminal monitor panel.
description.zh: 把本地 llama.cpp 模型接进 DSH 模型列表，自动启动、切换和视觉配对，像云端模型一样用。

description.en: 墨图 MoTu — 把对话里的代码块渲染成真正的图。DSH 可视化套件：Mermaid / Graphviz / nomnoml / ECharts（含交互）/ Vega-Lite / 手写 SVG，六引擎本地伺服、离线可用、完整性校验。
description.zh: 把对话里的代码块直接渲染成流程图、图表等真正的图，六大引擎本地离线可用。

description.en: Per-turn TPS and TTFT statistics for DeepSeek Harness: model time, tool time, time-to-first-token, and output speed per turn.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供每轮 TPS/TTFT 统计：模型耗时、工具耗时、首 token 延迟、输出速度。

description.en: 自用 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件聚合包：一个 pnpm 工作区装齐全部自建插件，子插件源码在 packages/ 下
Specialized in Git branch and status handling: a Git status drawer with a commit DAG lane graph, uncommitted changes/stash rows, inline diffs, and right-click branch/tag operations.
description.zh: 在编辑器里直接看 Git 分支和提交图，改了什么、存了什么一目了然，还能右键切分支打标签。

description.en: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的三层记忆：常驻事实 + 会话摘要 + 全文检索。注入不花任何模型调用，写回用你当前选的模型。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加三层记忆：常驻事实、会话摘要、全文检索，注入不花模型调用，写回用你选的模型。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: one-click OpenCode Go model sync in the settings panel - fetch all server models, probe availability & vision, write back to llm-pi-ai config
description.zh: 在设置页一键同步 OpenCode Go 全部模型，实测可用性和视觉能力后写回配置。

description.en: DSH 插件市场：在设置页浏览 mydsh.dev 插件大全（5596 候选 / 3656 有效），分类/AI 搜索、一键安装启用停用卸载、安全评估与自动重启。非官方社区 mydsh.dev 出品
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页直接逛插件市场，分类或 AI 搜索、一键装好启用，还能安全评估和自动重启生效。

description.en: 把「像素渔场」装成一个 DSH 插件：Harness 启动时自动拉起一只透明、无边框、总在最前的像素钓鱼宠物， 像 QQ 宠物一样浮在桌面上，挂机钓鱼、随时展开面板。
Live balance & quota panel for all your LLM providers, right in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏实时同步各 AI 服务商的余额与调用额度，随时掌握用量，告别跨平台查账。

description.en: 把另一台电脑变成你 DSH 的远程 Agent 同事：任务在副机本地持久跑，主机只收 handoff 摘要与产物清单 | Turn another computer into a remote agent worker for your DSH: tasks run & persist on the worker, the hub only receives a handoff summary + artifact manifest
description.zh: 把另一台电脑变成你的远程 Agent 同事：副机本地跑自己的 DSH 与完整 Agent 循环，所以链路断开时任务照常继续、模型凭证也永不离开那台机器。主机用 8 个 remote_* 工具派活，只收回 handoff 摘要与产物清单，成品按需拉取——中间产物留在副机。配对码接入，direct 或 relay 两种传输穿 NAT，两侧都有 Web 面板。

description.en: Replaces the composer's model and reasoning-effort selector with a two-level menu and six slider skins.
description.zh: 把输入框右下角的模型 / 推理等级选择器换成两级菜单，并提供六种滑杆视觉。

description.en: dsh 工作区可添加多文件夹/第三方厂商模型可开启推理等级插件
description.zh: DSH 第三方模型思考强度档位插件：默认档位自动补齐（宿主）+ 设置页自定义档位编辑器（客户端）

description.en: DSH Web GUI 客户端插件：WebGL Silk 丝绸动态背景 + 全站玻璃化皮肤（官方主题 token 覆盖，零依赖） | WebGL silk shader background & glassmorphism skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面换上 WebGL 丝绸动态背景和全站玻璃拟态皮肤，零依赖，卸载即还原。

description.en: DSH 插件（上游 NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams 的补充版）：AgentTeams 多智能体团队协作 —— 自然语言组队、任务依赖 DAG、信箱通信、右侧栏树状监测；随包自带 17 厂商 × 10 岗位头像与 17 个厂商徽标（286 个文件），支持自定义美术目录与中文岗位名。
description.zh: 让多个 AI 智能体组队协作，自然语言分工、任务依赖编排、信箱通信，右侧栏树状实时监测。

description.en: DSH 插件：每天替你刷一轮 B站 —— 读字幕原文挑出值得的、写一份日报，值得的就 @ 你
description.zh: 每天自动刷一轮B站，读字幕挑出值得看的内容写成日报，好内容直接@你。
