description.en: 为 DSH Web 的助手 Markdown、工具调用和 Think 内容提供可自定义的语义配色。Customizable semantic color accents for assistant Markdown, tool calls, and Think blocks in DSH Web.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 的助手回复、工具调用和 Think 内容加上可自定义的语义配色，让对话层次一眼看清。

description.en: DSH 空间体检：只读统计 DeepSeek Harness 的磁盘占用（数据 / 程序 / 系统缓存三区并排 + 每类 Top N 明细），清理只做可一键撤销的隔离移动，从不删除。 · Read-only disk accounting for DSH with a reversible quarantine cleanup; it never deletes.
description.zh: 只读统计 DSH 磁盘占用，三区并排看明细，清理只做可撤销的隔离移动，绝不删文件。

description.en: 《指数基金投资指南》(银行螺丝钉) 的估值—定投—卖出体系，DSH 插件：9 份参考文档 + 4 个零依赖脚本 + 34 项保真测试
description.zh: 把《指数基金投资指南》的估值、定投、卖出方法做成能算能核的工具箱，帮你看清一只指数基金现在该不该买。

description.en: 手动或自动配置模型思考强度、上下文窗口、最大输出token
description.zh: 手动或自动配置模型的思考强度、上下文窗口和最大输出 token，让模型能力更贴合使用场景。

description.en: DSH Desktop 插件：小说创作搭档 —— 边提问边完善世界观/人物/情节，每章先写大纲给作者改，定稿后再写正文。
description.zh: 写小说时边聊边搭世界观和人物，每章先出大纲让你改，定稿后再写正文。

description.en: DSH local voice datasets, DDSP Reflow training and cover-pipeline voice registration. Yoshino demo checkpoint available in Releases.
description.zh: 在本地整理语音素材、跑 DDSP Reflow 训练，再把训练好的音色注册到翻唱流程里。

description.en: Tavily web-search provider for DeepSeek Harness (ctx.web). Keyless or API-key modes with a configurable UI card; provider framework designed to be extended to more search APIs.
description.zh: 给 DSH 智能体加上 9 种联网搜索方式，官方、Google、自建 SearXNG 随你切换。

description.en: WeChat personal assistant that manages Apple Calendar and Reminders with confirmation before writes and sends scheduled WeChat messages, for macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon.
description.zh: 通过微信管理 Apple 日历与提醒事项，写入前展示预览并确认，支持微信定时消息；适用于 macOS 14+ 的 Apple Silicon Mac。

description.en: AI short-drama workspace for DeepSeek Harness, with a dedicated drama agent preset, 35 agent tools and 10 bundled skills covering outline, characters, script, storyboard and export.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 短剧工作区：独立的「短剧模式」Agent 预设、35 个 Agent 工具与 10 个随包技能，覆盖立项、总纲、人物、剧本、分镜与导出。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-plugin-ai-drama
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-plugin-ai-drama

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: DSH Tavern 错题库：按人物卡分类记下调试中踩过的坑，先查本卡、再跨卡。 / Per-card defect ledger for DSH Tavern.
dsh Web UI 的移动响应式 AppFrame——派生自 dsh-client-ui-layout，新增 <640px 抽屉侧栏、底部 sheet 与安全区。
description.zh: 让 dsh Web 界面在手机上更好用，自动适配小屏幕，侧栏变抽屉，底部弹层更顺手。

description.en: 把腾讯 ima 知识库接进 DeepSeek Harness：在侧边栏浏览知识库与文件，并让 AI agent 自动检索、读取库内资料。
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏浏览腾讯 ima 的知识库与文件，内置常见格式预览，并让 agent 用 5 个工具按名称或正文检索、读取库内资料。

description.en: Long-term project work-log system for AI agents (software, research, writing, design, ops): process journal + index ledger + lessons, with a stdlib-only Python toolbox.
description.zh: 给 AI 代理的长期工作记忆，把项目过程、决策和可复用经验整理成可读可查可校验的文档体系。

description.en: 让模型通过 adb 操作安卓手机的 DSH 插件（截图、UI 树、点击、滑动、输入文本、按键、打开应用） | DSH plugin exposing adb-based tools that let the model operate an Android phone (screenshot, UI dump, tap, swipe, input text, press keys, open apps).
description.zh: 让 AI 通过 adb 直接操作安卓手机，截图、点按、滑动、输入、开应用都能干。

description.en: Exposes the local DSH web GUI to one chosen CIDR range only (Tailscale by default) instead of binding 0.0.0.0: the proxy listens on addresses inside that range, rejects peers outside it, and admits clients by either a tokenised URL or a 4-12 character alphanumeric access code. Remote pages can be forced into a phone layout without changing the local UI, and the official appearance, font size, transcript view, code view and performance settings can be stored in the plugin config and re-applied on every remote page load.
description.zh: 只把本机 DSH 网页界面开放给指定的一个网段（默认 Tailscale 100.64.0.0/10），不绑 0.0.0.0：网段外的对端一律拒绝，进入方式可选带票网址或 4–12 位数字/字母访问密码；远程页面可强制手机布局而不动本机界面，官方「通用设置」里的外观 / 字号大小 / 工作步骤展示 / 显示代码工作视图 / 性能与用量可存进本插件配置，并在每次打开远程页面时重新套用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 开机动画插件 · Full-screen boot splash for DeepSeek Harness — 图片内联、零运行依赖、纯 host 半边
description.zh: 用图片做全屏开机动画：启动 HTML 首帧即铺满画面并缓慢推近，横向光带扫过，左下进度与阶段提示，应用挂载完成后淡出。点击任意处或按 Esc / 空格 / 回车可跳过。

description.en: DSH 纯净写作协作模式插件：极简提示词 + 四大沉浸预设 + 工作区文档注入

Executor/advisor workflow ported from pi-advisor-flow: the executor calls ask_advisor for a second opinion at key decisions, after repeated failures and before completion; equivalent repeated tool calls are intercepted before execution for an advisor review with a proceed/revise/blocked verdict, and hard mode force-reviews every turn before it closes. Per-call token and cost ledger with /advisor status readout, privacy tiers for repo context and file contents, six-shape secret redaction, and a web settings card; advisor failures never stall the main loop.
description.zh: 移植自 pi-advisor-flow 的执行者/顾问工作流：执行者经 ask_advisor 工具按需请求第二意见（可附问题、草稿、仓库上下文档位与点名文件）；等价工具调用重复达到阈值时在执行前拦截，由顾问以 proceed/revise/blocked 三值裁决，硬模式下回合收口前强制评审；提供逐次 token 与成本台账、/advisor status 状态读数、仓库上下文与文件内容分级授权、六类密钥形状脱敏与 web 设置卡；advisor 失败不停摆主循环。

description.en: dsh-cc-studio · CCv3 角色卡工坊 从一句话点子到可导入 SillyTavern / Risu 的 chara_card_v3。专治「只有点子，世界观薄弱」。
description.zh: 一句话点子就能生成可导入 SillyTavern / Risu 的 CCv3 角色卡，专治世界观薄弱。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-xia-sc-dsh-cc-studio
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-cc-studio

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: 把网页版 DeepSeek 接进 DSH 桌面端：内嵌面板 + 与 agent 会话双向搬运（带走/喂回去）

Commander mode for the dsh web GUI: a one-click session header button injects a protocol brief into the session, then parses and auto-executes task blocks in the model reply — separating the strategist loop from worker loops via a visible badge.
description.zh: dsh 网页端指挥官模式：会话标题栏一键注入协议简报，解析模型回复中的任务块并自动执行，让策略层与执行层分离；通过徽章按钮激活/停用。

description.en: Embeds chat.deepseek.com directly inside DeepSeek Harness desktop with persistent login sessions and dual-entry chat panels.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端内嵌 chat.deepseek.com，提供双入口聊天面板与持久登录会话。

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 桌面端用网页版 DeepSeek 账号做联网搜索——web_search provider backed by chat.deepseek.com, no API key needed
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面端直接用网页版 DeepSeek 账号联网搜索，不用 API Key 也不花余额。

description.en: Chimes and shows a toast in the top-right corner when a task finishes, waits for approval, or fails, in the DeepSeek Harness web GUI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面里，任务完成、等待授权或出错中断时响一声提示音，并在右上角弹出一条通知。

description.en: AI 编译纯文本小说工作台 for DSH：大纲导入、道藏/大世界设定、卷与章节规划、逐章 AI 生成 3000-4000 字、九维审稿、全书质检、全本导出。AI novel writing workbench (text-only).
description.zh: 把小说大纲变成完整书稿的AI写作台，支持章节生成、审稿质检和全本导出。

description.en: Use DeepSeek's web chat inside DSH: real chat history in the leftmost sidebar, a Chat/Work switch beside the agent mode, plus streaming answers, thinking, web search and file uploads.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中使用 DeepSeek 网页版对话：最左侧边栏显示真实聊天记录，Agent 模式旁提供 Chat/Work 切换，支持流式回答、深度思考、网页搜索和文件上传。

description.en: Native DeepSeek Harness plugin: gates pwsh tool calls against PowerShell pitfalls via the official tools/pre-execute interception point, bundles the powershell-check skill
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的 pwsh 命令加上安全闸，自动拦截 PowerShell 常见坑，让脚本执行更稳。

description.en: WorkBuddy's 增强提示词 (Enhance Prompt) as a DeepSeek Harness plugin: rewrite the composer draft into a stronger prompt with one click.
description.zh: 在输入框旁一键把草稿改写成结构清晰、要求明确的提示词，自动写回输入框。

description.en: Keeps project decisions in plain markdown instead of chat history: one main document plus per-module documents, every entry carrying a file:line citation. The agent interviews you to turn open questions into settled decisions, and a five-dimension score (task complexity, extensibility, maintainability, code quality, reusability) is derived from the documents and shown on a button beside the model picker. A session can bind several projects; projects are sized small/medium/large, which widens the entry limits, and a reusable-pipeline section in the main document is injected when its trigger words appear.
description.zh: 把项目决策落成纯 markdown 而不是留在聊天记录里：一份主文档加若干模块文档，每条都带 文件:行 出处。AI 主动提问把悬而未决变成已定；五维健康性（任务复杂度 / 可拓展性 / 维护系数 / 代码质量 / 可复用性）由文档证据算出，显示在输入框模型选择器旁边的小按钮上。一个会话可同时绑多个项目；项目分小 / 中 / 大三档，条目上限随档位放宽；主文档里的标准化流水线小节在命中触发词时自动注入。

description.en: 毕业论文全流程 DSH 插件
description.zh: 把学校模板、实验数据和代码变成一篇能过查重和答辩的毕业论文，全程九个阶段带你走完。

description.en: 「声琢」VoxPolish —— 把说出来的话打磨成清晰表达：原话/整理后双通道，先说、先改、再发送，全程不碰输入框。本地 SenseVoice 识别，无需额外下载模型。
description.zh: 把语音转成文字后自动整理成清晰表达，先看原话再确认发送，不碰输入框。

description.en: Verdict-based context compaction for DeepSeek Harness — replaces lossy LLM summaries with fast keep/truncate/drop decisions from jev-latest; everything kept stays verbatim. Port of tamaratran/fast-jev-compaction.
description.zh: 用快速保留/截断/丢弃判断替代有损摘要，压缩上下文时保留内容原样不丢信息。

description.en: dsh-plugin
description.zh: 在无限画布上拖拽连线搭工作流，写规范、出设计稿、做能跑的 Web 应用，每一步都看得见。

description.en: Bounded agent loop for DeepSeek Harness: budget ceilings, cheap-first routing, loop hygiene detectors, and a human-in-the-loop ops dashboard.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的智能体循环加上预算上限、省钱路由和人工审批，还能实时盯着运行状态。

description.en: Git status badge in the composer tool row: a 14px branch glyph left of the model selector, with branch name, changed-file count and +added/-deleted lines on hover. Counts staged, unstaged and untracked files; nothing renders outside a git work tree.
description.zh: 输入框工具行的 git 状态角标：模型选择器左侧一枚 14px 分支图标，悬停显示分支名、变更文件数与增删行数。统计含未跟踪文件；非 git 工作区不显示。

description.en: Cross-session message bus for DeepSeek Harness: let independent sessions address and wake each other.
description.zh: 让两个独立的 DSH 会话互相发消息、互相唤醒，实现跨会话协作。

description.en: Permanently delete archived DeepSeek Harness sessions along with their on-disk history and log directories.
description.zh: 把已归档的 DSH 会话连同磁盘上的历史记录和日志一起彻底删掉，真正释放空间。

description.en: 给 dsh 设置页加「安装」标签页，按包名安装任意第三方插件。
description.zh: 设置 → 插件里的「安装」标签页：按 npm spec、`github:user/repo` 或本地路径安装、更新、卸载任意插件，走的都是 `dsh plugin add` 这条 CLI 路径；更新检查对照 npm latest 或 GitHub HEAD，带降级保护与装后版本核对，每次 add/remove 均附带 pnpm 11 发布冷静期豁免；服务重启在 DSH Desktop 由壳层执行，独立 `dsh web` 下由中转进程接力并交接回原终端。

description.en: MCP 服务器管理面板：GUI 增删改 MCP 服务器配置（写入 cordis.patch.yml + HMR 实时挂载）+ 工具浏览 + agent 面 mcp_* 管理工具 | MCP server management panel: GUI add/edit/delete MCP server configs (writes cordis.patch.yml + HMR hot-mount) + tool browsing + agent-side mcp_* management tools
description.zh: 在图形界面里增删改 MCP 服务器配置，改完自动热挂载，还能浏览工具、让 agent 自己管 MCP。

description.en: Turns each long dsh conversation into a three-level trail (topic to progress steps to milestone timeline) and shows it in a draggable overlay, where one click jumps back to the matching message in the transcript. Topics are distilled by the DeepSeek model with a zero-cost rule-based fallback, can be renamed, locked, merged by drag and drop, and support per-conversation notes plus a vector drawing board.
description.zh: 把 dsh 的每次长对话实时提炼成「线索 → 进度步骤 → 阶段历程」三级结构，以可拖动的悬浮窗呈现，点一下就能跳回对话里的对应消息。线索由 DeepSeek 模型总结，模型不可用时自动回退到零成本的规则模式；支持重命名、锁定、拖拽合并，附带每个对话独立的笔记与矢量画笔。

description.en: DSH 插件：把一条短视频生产流水线（19 个 skill：编排 + 原子）内置进 agent 技能目录
description.zh: 把一条短视频生产流水线的 19 个 skill（1 总入口 + 1 编排 + 17 原子）内置进 agent 技能目录：中文配音读音校正、文生图与文生视频、图片运镜、成片合成、封面、成片核验、数据复盘、四平台发布。本包只提供 skill 与脚本，不安装任何工具：要真跑通流水线，还得本机装好 ffmpeg、Python 3 + Pillow、Node.js 与 playwright，自备 B 站 biliup 凭据和视频号 / 抖音 / 小红书登录态，并把 skills/*/scripts/ 里的占位符改成自己的值。使用者自己的同名 skill 优先级更高。

description.en: Video editing toolset for DSH: probe, trim, concat, audio handling, subtitle burn-in, transform, transcode and frame grabbing, powered by ffmpeg downloaded on first use.
description.zh: DSH 视频剪辑工具集：探测、裁剪、拼接、音轨处理、字幕烧录、变速、转码与抽帧，引擎为首次使用时自动下载的 ffmpeg。

description.en: Per-session automatic compaction threshold for DeepSeek Harness: a compaction backend whose trigger percentage is stored per session and adjustable from the Web composer while the session runs.
description.zh: 给每个会话单独设置自动压缩触发比例，还能在网页输入框里随时调整，省得上下文爆掉。

description.en: Sanitizes leaked DeepSeek DSML closing tags from model text streams.
description.zh: 清理模型文本流中泄漏的 DeepSeek DSML 闭合标签。

description.en: Let Deepseek Harness access the internet seamlessly. / 让 DeepSeek Harness 无缝访问互联网。
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 顺畅联网，替换官方搜索抓取工具，还能解析 PDF、Office 和 EPUB 文档。

description.en: Captures the agent's own self-reported mistakes into a categorised lesson library that is re-injected into the system prompt every turn (each captured draft is confirmed or edited by the user before it is recorded), and adds two conversation-header panels for editing the cross-conversation global prompt and a per-session prompt.
description.zh: 把 agent 自报的错误收进分类经验库，并每轮回注系统提示词（每条草稿都先经用户确认或修改）；同时在对话标题栏提供两个面板，用于编辑跨对话全局提示词与本次对话提示词。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web 插件：输入框模型名旁的小星星按钮，一键把草稿改写成结构化的可执行提示词并写回
description.zh: 输入框旁点一下小星星，草稿立刻变成结构清晰的提示词，写回原处直接用。

description.en: DSH plugin: render code-driven music videos (music-code-mv) — deterministic Canvas2D/Three.js shots, headless-Chrome or browserless skia engine, ffmpeg AV1/HEVC up to 4K/120fps/12-bit
description.zh: 写代码就能生成音乐视频，画面逐帧精准，支持 4K 高清导出。

description.en: AI Look-Up: detects aimless grinding (repeated commands, failure loops, long runs with no output) and injects mid-run self-review nudges, plus a real local-clock anchor so the agent stops estimating elapsed time.
description.zh: AI 抬头：检测空跑（重复命令 / 连续失败 / 久跑零产出）并在运行中途注入自我审查提醒，同时定期注入真实本地时间，校准 AI 的时间感。

description.en: DSH plugin: keep a session's parsed event log resident so a local append extends the resident parse instead of invalidating it - a long session is parsed once per host process, not once per read.
description.zh: 把正在写入的会话日志常驻内存解析，长会话不再越用越卡，读取速度明显提升。

description.en: Follow-up suggestion chips under a DSH session's last completed reply, generated with that session's own selected model.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话最后一条回复下方生成后续问题建议，用当前会话所选模型自动生成，点一下就能接着聊。

description.en: DSH Web GUI 跨工作区会话迁移插件： 一键迁移原会话到其他工作区，保留完整上下文、会话历史、Agent 预设与模型选择等，支持保留或归档原会话。
description.zh: Cross-workspace session migration for the dsh web GUI: a Move Session header action plus dialog (target workspace picker, keep-or-archive the original), idle-session only, full context preserved. Hot-pluggable — mounted via ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml + a profile node_modules symlink, no dsh source changes.

description.en: Long-term memory for AI agents on Jev. Keep raw records, judge them with a fast System 1 model and answer from under 4k tokens of context.
description.zh: 给 AI 智能体装上长期记忆，原始记录全保留，用快模型判断、小上下文作答。
给项目做安全体检，自动扫描代码风险并生成审计报告，帮你提前发现隐患。

description.en: Codex-style appearance for the DSH Web interface: window edge hairlines and shadows, sidebar colours and row alignment, a model picker with a reasoning-effort power rail, composer and right-panel geometry, a full-page settings-modal pass, a Trajectory view exit, and a settings card for theme, accent, background, foreground, fonts, sidebar translucency and contrast.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面复刻 Codex 外观：窗口边缘发丝线与阴影、侧栏配色与行对齐、带推理强度功率轨的模型选择器、输入区与右栏几何、设置模态框全页改造、轨迹视图退出出口，以及可调主题、强调色、背景、前景、字体、侧栏半透明与对比度的设置卡。

description.en: Search AIGC Radar's curated GitHub AI project library (500-star admission, bilingual zh/en tags, star-growth snapshots) over its MCP endpoint with native result cards; an agent/pre-step listener proactively suggests a reuse check before the agent writes code.
description.zh: 检索 AIGC Radar 精选 GitHub AI 项目库（500 Stars 准入、中英双语标签、星标增长快照），经其 MCP 端点调用并以原生结果卡片展示；agent/pre-step 监听器在 agent 动手写代码前主动建议复用检查。

description.en: Gitea and Forgejo integration for DeepSeek Harness with issue, pull-request and worktree tools plus a Git status chip.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 集成 Gitea 与 Forgejo，提供 issue、拉取请求和 worktree 工具及 Git 状态芯片。

description.en: 一款基于主播女孩重度依赖创建的 适用于 DSH 的 实验性主题皮肤 / Unofficial pixel desktop skin for DSH Web inspired by NEEDY GIRL OVERDOSE. Experimental, non-commercial fan project.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 变成主播女孩重度依赖风格的像素桌面，边玩边干活，娱乐工作两不误。

description.en: Ollama Cloud provider for DeepSeek Harness: adds the chat route on install, publishes each model's own thinking levels for the composer effort control, keeps the model list current from the endpoint (/api/tags and /api/show, cached for offline boots), shows the account allowance with an API-key field in the Models page and sidebar, and offers Ollama's web search and fetch as selectable DSH web providers.
description.zh: Ollama Cloud 供应商：安装即配好聊天路由，按 Ollama 模型自身元数据公布每个模型的思维链档位（供 composer 的推理强度选择），模型清单可由端点自动刷新（/api/tags 与 /api/show，并带离线缓存），在 Models 页与侧栏显示账号额度并提供 API Key 输入，还把 Ollama 的 web_search / web_fetch 作为可选的 DSH 网页能力提供方。

description.en: Grok-compatible web search with retained source pagination, Context7 and Exa documentation lookup, bounded page extraction, site mapping, offline research planning, and read-only diagnostics.
description.zh: 提供 Grok-compatible 网页搜索、保留来源分页、Context7 与 Exa 文档检索、有界网页提取、站点映射、离线研究计划和只读诊断。

description.en: Questionnaire-style batch questioning plugin for DeepSeek Harness: 10+ questions at once (single/multi/yes-no toggle/compare/open), per-question skip, fullscreen overlay, two-column recap after submit
description.zh: 一次抛出十几道题让 AI 批量问用户，支持单选多选、跳过和全屏作答，省去来回追问。

description.en: Questionnaire-style batch questioning plugin for DeepSeek Harness: 10+ questions at once (single/multi/yes-no toggle/compare/open), per-question skip, fullscreen overlay, two-column recap after submit

Full local-first issue board embedded in the DSH web GUI: Kanban / list / Gantt / workflow / dashboard views, AI chat per task, attachments and labels, auto-claim of todo tasks driven by dsh-routines — data lives in local SQLite (dsh plugin add @ttmouse/dsh-taskboard).
description.zh: 内嵌于 DSH Web GUI 的完整本地优先任务看板：看板/列表/Gantt/工作流/仪表盘视图、任务 AI 对话、附件与标签、dsh-routines 驱动的待办自动认领——数据存本地 SQLite（dsh plugin add @ttmouse/dsh-taskboard）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的深度阅读插件——逐章理解书籍，不是摘要，不是搬运目录，而是真正理解并解释。有AI自己的观点，让用户真正读懂一本书DeepSeek Harness's deep reading plugin—understand books chapter by chapter, retain traceable reading memories, enabling users to truly comprehend a book
description.zh: 读书工作流：导入 EPUB/Markdown/TXT/PDF 拆章，逐章由子任务精读（原文不进主会话），保存带 \[n] 定位的章节记忆、支持跨会话续读，可导出笔记或 EPUB。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness adapter for REA (rea-agents): registers the reverse-engineer-anything skill plus the rea / rea_doctor tools in every session. REA itself is not bundled.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里接入 REA 逆向工程能力，让智能体自动分析二进制文件。

description.en: Context lens: per-session KV cache hit rate and token composition, plus a GitHub-style usage heatmap of daily tokens, sessions, and cache efficiency.
description.zh: 实时查看上下文占用，并用 GitHub 风格热力图回顾 53 周 token 使用趋势，帮你掌控每次对话的“内存”消耗。

description.en: DSH 插件: 按 workspace 加载 MCP server (agent-scoped)
description.zh: 让每个项目用自己的 MCP 配置，会话内自动加载卸载，项目之间互不干扰。

description.en: dsh-enhanced-plugins 是一站式 DeepSeek Harness 增强插件包，集成 MCP 管理、插件市场、文件引用、模型能力配置及子智能体开关。
description.zh: DSH 增强插件全家桶，一键搞定 MCP 管理、插件市场、文件引用和子智能体开关，让 DeepSeek Harness 更好用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: makes a reverse-proxied (non-loopback) dsh web page count as a trusted host, so the Settings surface loads instead of reporting "settings are unavailable in this browser".
description.zh: 让反向代理访问的 dsh 页面被当作可信本机，设置界面不再报错，正常可用。

description.en: Reverie：DeepSeek Harness 读书笔记插件——链接转录/抓取、中英对照精读、flomo 式笔记与 AI 回顾（GPL-3.0）
description.zh: 把链接丢进来就能自动转录或抓取正文，中英对照精读、随手记笔记，还能让 AI 陪你回顾。

description.en: dsh使用token活动统计，token热力图
description.zh: 把 DSH 的 token 用量做成 GitHub 贡献图式的可拖动浮窗，一眼看清今天和近一年的使用情况。

description.en: 在 DSH 桌面客户端「设置 → 通用设置」中选择启动窗口状态（默认 / 最大化 / 全屏）。Windows.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面客户端设置里选启动窗口状态，让窗口每次按默认、最大化或全屏打开。

description.en: Computer-use mode for DeepSeek Harness: screen capture, mouse and keyboard synthesis, and window control for operating GUI software that has no agent-facing integration.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 能截图并操控鼠标键盘，去操作那些没有接口的软件。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness is a plugin-based system for building AI agents. Everything, from tools and models to the web UI, can be added or replaced as a plugin.
description.zh: 一个演示用的小插件，帮你快速上手 DeepSeek Harness 插件开发，学会注册和调用工具。
帮你先摸清代码路由再做 JavaScript 逆向还原，静态分析加动态调试一条龙。

description.en: DSH 插件：把工作区里写好的 HTML 页展示在对话里，并让用户在页面上的表态快速回到 agent 手里。含四套预设样式。
description.zh: 把工作区里的 HTML 页面直接渲染成卡片放进对话，用户点选表态后逐条回传给 agent。
一键从 DSH 输入框启动原神，自动找到游戏位置，找不到还能手动选 exe，写代码累了就摸鱼。

description.en: DSH 皮肤插件：可视化自定义 + 实时预览 + 「皮肤管理」设置页。 非侵入式：不改 DSH 源码 / 配置、不改 DSH 进程；皮肤是完全可逆的覆盖层。  适配：DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 与 0.2.0-rc.1
description.zh: 给 DSH 换肤的通用框架，可视化自定义加实时预览，还能打包皮肤分享给朋友。

description.en: Sight —— DSH 多模态增强插件:一键开启模型图片直传(自动扫描/匹配/手动切换)、随时清除会话图片避免误传作废,并集成 Figma MCP 实现设计稿转代码与文字生成设计(无需 Figma 会员)。
description.zh: 让模型直接读图、随手清理会话图片，还能把 Figma 设计稿一键转成代码。

description.en: Correctness-oriented MCP server and batch CLI for compact structural reads and reviewed TypeScript/JavaScript edits.
description.zh: 面向代码正确性的MCP服务器，支持结构化代码读取和TypeScript/JavaScript批量编辑审查。

description.en: 为 dsh 已归档会话添加垃圾桶图标，一键删除，极简会话管理。
description.zh: 给已归档的会话加个垃圾桶图标，点一下就能删掉，管理会话更省事。

description.en: DSH 插件：为 OpenAI 兼容中转站按模型管理思考强度，并自动识别公开能力
description.zh: 给 OpenAI 兼容中转站按模型单独设置思考强度，还能自动识别模型公开能力，省去手动配置。

description.en: Cloud workspaces for DeepSeek Harness — pick Cloud (SSH) in the workspace picker and the agent's bash/read/write/edit/glob/grep tools transparently run on your Linux server over SSH. Zero remote install.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中直接选择 SSH 云端工作区，让智能体的文件操作和命令执行透明地跑在远程 Linux 服务器上，无需本地环境。

description.en: Inline, batchable comments for DeepSeek Harness assistant replies
DSH 插件：让所有会话、所有模型的思考过程与回复永久使用简体中文，直到卸载。Force Simplified Chinese thinking and replies in every DeepSeek Harness session.
description.zh: 装一次就全局生效，让所有会话和模型的思考与回复都用简体中文，卸载前一直管用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的上下文压缩插件：自动与手动压缩、工具结果裁剪、有界溢出恢复。
description.zh: 对话快满时自动生成摘要压缩上下文，溢出还能有界恢复，省 token 不断线。

description.en: Local-first file conversion for DeepSeek Harness — images, PDF, data, audio/video & office docs. 7 tools, 26 conversions, no API keys, no uploads.
description.zh: 本地文件格式转换工具，支持图片、PDF、音视频和办公文档等26种转换，无需API密钥，离线可用。

description.en: DSH 用户插件管理器:在 设置→插件 统一管理插件目录散件、运行树插件与 npm 插件包——挂载/卸载/启用/停用(cordis.patch.yml 补丁层 + HMR 热生效)
description.zh: 在设置→插件里统一管理所有插件，支持挂载、卸载、启用和停用，还能热生效，不用重启。

description.en: DSH 用户插件管理器:在 设置→插件 统一管理插件目录散件、运行树插件与 npm 插件包——挂载/卸载/启用/停用(cordis.patch.yml 补丁层 + HMR 热生效)
DeepSeek Harness plugin: generate_ui — the model authors A2UI documents rendered as interactive surfaces in the chat (valuz genui)
description.zh: 让模型自己动手画界面，在聊天里直接生成可交互的 A2UI 卡片，点一点就能用。

description.en: This is a plugin that allows deepseek harness own the ability of lx music.
description.zh: LX Music 增强控制插件：内置音源引擎（SDK 搜索 + 音源脚本沙箱）、侧边栏迷你播放卡（含播放模式切换）、细粒度 LLM 音乐工具集（music_search/play/playlist/prev/next/control）、设置窗口音源管理。
给 DSH 桌面端加个插件市场，侧栏就能逛官方和社区插件，装之前先看兼容性结论，一键安装。

description.en: Search, pin and hide models in DeepSeek Harness; refresh provider catalogues.
DeepSeek Harness direct-connect module for a local SekaiSync knowledge base — 10 compact tools, zero dependencies.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直连本地 SekaiSync 知识库，10 个轻量工具、零依赖，随装随用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 皮肤大师：主题壁纸/自定义皮肤插件 —— 全局背景图片/视频、毛玻璃、输入框背景、弹出框毛玻璃、滤镜、AI 回复文本与消息气泡颜色
description.zh: 给 DSH 桌面端换壁纸、开毛玻璃，还能自定义输入框、弹窗和消息气泡外观。

description.en: One-click desktop launcher for DSH Web: creates a Windows .lnk with a WPF-style startup popup (progress + timeout), then opens the authenticated browser; plus a floating shutdown button that exits dsh gracefully via ctx.appExit.
description.zh: 一键桌面启动器：Windows 快捷方式 + WPF 风格启动弹窗（进度与超时提示），启动 dsh web 并打开认证浏览器；右下角悬浮关机按钮，经 ctx.appExit 优雅退出 dsh 进程。

description.en: Adds a "Compact and run" action to the DSH Web plan-review card, which compacts the history submitted before the plan into a checkpoint and then approves the plan.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 的计划审批卡上增加「压缩后执行」：先把计划提交之前的历史压成检查点，再批准计划。

description.en: Drive Autodesk Fusion 360 from DeepSeek Harness (DSH) - 13 MCP tools including arbitrary Fusion API Python. Vibe-coded end to end by DSH; every modelling command measured against closed-form volumes.
description.zh: 在聊天里直接操控 Fusion 360，查模型、改参数、导文件、跑 Python 脚本，建模结果还能自动核对体积。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness web notifications plugin
description.zh: 在桌面端和网页里提醒你待审批、提问和任务结果，点一下通知就能跳到对应会话。

description.en: Replay a DeepSeek Harness session at its original token cadence — an in-app playback theater with play/pause/step/speed/seek.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话按原始节奏回放，支持播放、暂停、步进、调速和跳转，像看剧场一样复盘每次交互。

description.en: Review Tab for DeepSeek Harness, mimic traditional Coding Agents for Changes Tracking

Visual goal lifecycle for the DSH web UI: a composer dock to create, multiline-edit, pause, resume, complete and clear session goals with live round progress, plus a phase-dot composer entry and a settings-page goal overview.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供可视化的会话目标生命周期：composer 上方的目标栏支持创建、多行编辑、暂停、恢复、完成与清除并实时显示轮次进度，工具行入口带阶段色点，设置页提供目标总览。

description.en: deepseek harness manim数学插件
description.zh: 用自然语言就能把数学概念渲染成 Manim 动画视频，讲题演示更直观。

description.en: 每日探测 AMD Radeon Token Factory 免费模型的 DeepSeek Harness 插件（付费区模型不接入）
description.zh: 每天自动探测 AMD Radeon Token Factory 的免费模型，帮你白嫖可用的大模型接口。

description.en: DSH bundle that registers jev_ask for TypeSafe Jev noul, choice, and score answers.
description.zh: 让 DSH 智能体通过 jev_ask 工具向 TypeSafe Jev 发起选择、评分等提问并拿到结构化答案。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 回退链插件：主模型失败自动切换备用 provider，带 Web UI 配置面板 | Provider fallback chains for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 主模型挂了也不怕，自动按顺序切到备用模型重试，对话不再中断。

description.en: Embedded Overleaf workbench tab for DeepSeek Harness Web: same-origin reverse proxy, direct-CDP login, selection quoting, caret insertion, LaTeX assist panel
description.zh: 把 Overleaf 站点（公有云或自托管实例）经同源反向代理嵌入会话页标签，支持 Cookie 或弹窗登录、选区引用、光标处插入、编译日志驱动的修复、文档大纲跳转与 .bib / .tex 双向同步。

description.en: 在 Web GUI 里可视化管理项目的全部能力——Skills、MCP 服务器、快捷消息， 全部支持项目级 / 全局级双作用域，全部可以不离开浏览器完成安装、启停与分发
description.zh: 在浏览器里统一管理项目的 Skills、MCP 服务器和快捷消息，支持项目级与全局级，装好即用。

description.en: Drag-to-resize the chat content width in the DeepSeek Harness web UI: a handle on the column right edge overrides the built-in 748px width (default 1040px, 520-2400 range, persisted per browser, double-click resets).
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供可拖拽的聊天内容宽度：文字列右缘的把手覆盖内置的 748px 宽度（默认 1040px、范围 520~2400、按浏览器记忆，双击恢复默认）。

description.en: DSH 插件：一个插件接入 WorkBuddy / Trae / Qoder 三渠道模型，带统一状态面板、一键签到与渠道管理
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy、Trae、Qoder 三个渠道的模型一次接进 DSH，统一面板看状态、一键签到、随时增删渠道。

description.en: 替换“深度求索中”为任意你想要的文本，比如：少女祈祷中......
description.zh: 把「深度求索中」那行状态文字、图标和颜色换成你喜欢的样式，比如「少女祈祷中」。

description.en: Local personal memory and knowledge management for DeepSeek Harness. It supports local FTS, CPU-embedding or OpenAI-Compatible Embedding API.
description.zh: 把个人记忆和导入资料存在本地 SQLite 里，支持全文检索和向量语义搜索，随时问随时答。

description.en: Task-aware native capability manager for DeepSeek Harness — use, prepare, and verify built-in DSH tools before adding another plugin.
description.zh: 先用好 DeepSeek Harness 自带的原生能力，再决定要不要装新插件，省心又高效。
让 DeepSeek Harness 的联网请求走本地代理，不用开 TUN 模式也能用 Clash 等科学上网。

description.en: Play a Minecraft villager hmm whenever the model hums inside its reasoning chain. DeepSeek Harness plugin.
description.zh: 模型思考时一冒出「嗯」，就播放《我的世界》村民的哼声，让等待回复变得有趣。

description.en: A configurable third-party web-search plugin for DSH (DeepSeek Harness)/一个用于DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的可配置第三方网络搜索插件
description.zh: 给 DSH 换上可配置的第三方搜索引擎，还能抓取网页全文，让模型边搜边读。

description.en: Six engineering skills for Claude Code and DSH: research, architecture scouting, implementation orchestration, three-axis diff review, complexity audit and mutation testing. Skills delegate through the host’s generic subagent tools when available.
description.zh: 可安装到 Claude Code 与 DSH 的六个工程技能：调研、架构侦察、实施编排、三轴评审、复杂度审计和突变测试。按需通过宿主通用子 agent 能力委派，无需注册自定义 agent。

description.en: chinng-inta/dsh-web-search-searxng 声明为 DeepSeek Harness 生态插件。
description.zh: 用自托管的SearXNG给DeepSeek Harness加联网搜索能力，让模型能实时查资料。

description.en: Give the dsh agent a real browser: each conversation gets its own Chrome or Edge process with its own profile and CDP port, driven by six tools and mirrored live in the right sidebar, where you can watch the work and take over by clicking or typing on the picture. Nothing else to install — it uses the Chrome or Edge already on the machine, downloads no browser, needs no companion app or extension, and keeps its tabs and sign-ins between tool calls.
description.zh: 给 dsh agent 一个真正的浏览器：每个会话拥有自己的 Chrome 或 Edge 进程、独立 profile 与独立 CDP 端口，六个工具驱动它，右侧边栏实时镜像同一批页面，你既能看着它干活，也能直接在画面上点击、输入接管。除此之外无需再装东西——它驱动机器上已有的 Chrome 或 Edge，不下载浏览器，不需要配套应用或扩展，标签页与登录状态在工具调用之间一直保留。

description.en: 一个尝试在dsh web 启动前检测其他可能导致崩溃插件并禁用的插件
description.zh: dsh web 启动看门狗：检测并持久化禁用问题插件，让界面正常打开，并提供隔离账本、探针自动恢复与一键恢复。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: talk to Claude Code and other coding CLIs from the DSH web GUI, with sessions resumed and threads kept.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 界面里直接跟 Claude Code、Cursor 等编程 CLI 对话，还能保留上下文。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that does QA: an agent explores your app like a real user and leaves evidence, then the explored path is exported as a deterministic replay scenario you run every release. Orchestrates the browser, macOS desktop, iOS and Android drivers — never a false green.
description.zh: 让 AI 像真人一样探索你的应用并留下证据，再把验证过的操作导出成可重复跑的回归测试脚本。

description.en: 将 QwenWork 桌面 App 包含的模型自动接入 DeepSeek Harness，零配置使用。Bring the models in the QwenWork desktop app into DeepSeek Harness with zero configuration.
description.zh: 把千问办公桌面 App 里的模型自动接进 DeepSeek Harness，不用 API Key 也不用重新登录，装上就能用。

description.en: Accessible collapsible provider groups for the DeepSeek Harness model selector.
description.zh: 给 DSH 模型选择器加上按供应商折叠的分组，模型多时更好找、更清爽。

description.en: 把 WorkBuddy / WorkBuddy AI 桌面 App 的订阅模型接入 DeepSeek Harness（个人自用方案）
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 里的 GLM、DeepSeek、Kimi 等模型接进 DSH，对话窗口里零配置直接用。

description.en: Use the Jev (System One) decision-model paradigm with any OpenAI-compatible LLM — no TypeSafe key required. Registers a jev_decide tool that returns probability-distributed answers to typed questions (choice/score/boolean) in one call.
description.zh: 用任意 OpenAI 兼容大模型跑 Jev 决策范式——无需 TypeSafe key。注册 jev_decide 工具，一次调用返回带概率分布的类型化答案（choice/score/boolean）。

description.en: 引导式简历生成插件：对话式四阶段 + A4 PDF 直出，双宿主验证
description.zh: 说一句「帮我做份简历」，它就会一轮轮引导你补齐信息，最后直接生成能投递的单页 A4 PDF。

description.en: Claude Code-style permission rules engine: hard/deny/ask/allow tiers with a hard tier above full access, workspace-scoped rules, wildcard path protection, and a visual staged editor; rules persist in settings.yaml.
description.zh: Claude Code 风格权限规则引擎：hard/deny/ask/allow 四级规则（hard 高于全访问、不可豁免）、workspace 作用域、通配符路径保护、可视化草稿式编辑器，规则持久化于 settings.yaml。

description.en: Humanized fork of @xmanrui/dsh-im (base 4.21.2): humanized message delivery with send-delay and typing two-phase, message_break + streaming coexistence, status reactions, reply quotes, per-bot humanize overrides, and a no_reply reclaim tool — across WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, QQ, Telegram, Slack and WhatsApp channels.
description.zh: @xmanrui/dsh-im 的拟人化分支（基于上游 4.21.2）：人化消息发送（发送延迟 + 输入中两阶段）、message_break 与 streaming 共存、状态表情、回复引用、per-bot 全量拟人化覆盖、no_reply 回收工具，覆盖微信/飞书/钉钉/企业微信/QQ/Telegram/Slack/WhatsApp 全通道。

description.en: 一人公司 · DeepSeek Harness 多 agent 公司编排插件（CEO/项目群/大厅/@派活/审批/排班/工作日志）
description.zh: 把多个 dsh agent 组建成一家公司，你当董事会，派活、审批、排班、看日志全都有。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bridge/plugin for A2S with remote sessions, workspaces, approvals, tasks, and resilient reconnects.
description.zh: 把本机 DeepSeek Harness 连到中转服务器，远程看状态、管会话、下发指令。

description.en: Полная русская локализация веб-интерфейса DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面完整汉化成俄语，俄语用户打开就能直接用。

description.en: Sign in to DeepSeek Harness with a Claude Pro/Max membership (no API key), downscale Anthropic request images to a 2000px long edge, slim /compact summarizer payloads, and show 5-hour/weekly plan usage plus DSH message counts.
description.zh: 用 Claude Pro/Max 会员登录 DeepSeek Harness（无需 API key），将 Anthropic 请求图片长边压到 2000px，精简 /compact 摘要请求，并显示 5 小时/每周套餐用量百分比与 DSH 消息数。

description.en: Real browser tools for DeepSeek Harness: browse and extract web content, fill forms, manage multiple tabs, and execute multi-step tasks, with incremental DOM, session isolation, screenshots, action-result checks, and archived evidence recall.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供真实浏览器操作能力：网页浏览与信息提取、表单填写、多标签页协作和多步骤任务执行；支持增量 DOM、会话隔离、截图、操作结果检查与证据归档回读。

description.en: Discord Rich Presence for Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi, and DeepSeek Harness, powered by one local service that keeps your active work visible in Discord.
description.zh: 把 Codex、Claude Code 等 AI 编码工具的当前工作状态同步到 Discord，让队友随时看到你在忙什么。

description.en: Google Antigravity OAuth Gemini provider for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把 Google Antigravity 账号里的 Gemini 模型接进 DeepSeek Harness，直接当原生模型用。

description.en: Model-driven context-window rollover bundle for the DeepSeek Harness: fresh working context, durable notes, verbatim recent tail, no summarization
description.zh: 让模型自己管理上下文窗口，自动滚动切换工作区，保留关键笔记和最近对话，无需压缩总结。

description.en: 跑团 / DM 工具插件（DeepSeek Harness）：中立随机裁决 + 本地 ComfyUI 配图 + 按会话隔离的战役配置（角色卡 / 世界 / 随机表）。TTRPG/DM tools for dsh: dice, local ComfyUI illustrations, per-session campaign state.
description.zh: 给 dsh 用的跑团/DM 工具：掷骰随机裁决、本地 ComfyUI 配图、按会话隔离战役配置，导入角色卡就能开团。

description.en: Genshin Impact Yoimiya theme: two hand-tuned palettes, a procedural fireworks particle layer, and a local music player that reads your own files — songs and covers are never uploaded. Warm syntax colors and a hand-drawn goldfish brand mark; apart from the wallpaper every pixel is CSS gradients and hand-written SVG.
description.zh: 《原神》宵宫主题：严格核算过对比度的明暗双色板、程序化生成的烟花粒子层，以及一个读取你自己本地文件的播放器——歌曲与封面不上传到任何地方。语法高亮为暖色，标识为自绘金鱼；除壁纸外所有画面都由 CSS 渐变与手写 SVG 生成。

description.en: One Dark Pro theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI. 为 DSH Web 界面打造的 One Dark Pro 暗色主题插件。
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面换上 One Dark Pro 暗色主题，在设置里一键切换，护眼又好看。

description.en: Calls your own chat.deepseek.com account as a second model from DSH: ask a question, analyze a file's line range, and check login state, plus a runtime skill and a settings-page login panel.
description.zh: 把你自己的 chat.deepseek.com 账号当作第二个模型接入 DSH：提问、按文件行区间分析、查看登录状态，附带运行时技能与设置页登录面板。

description.en: Model picker for the DSH web composer that replaces the model seat: a search-first popup whose left column indexes the suppliers and scrolls the grouped list, with a favorites group pinned at the top, image icons separating native from bridged vision input, and a reasoning-effort panel opened from the right zone of the trigger.
description.zh: 顶替 DSH Web 编辑器模型座位的模型选择器：检索优先的弹层，左栏是供应商索引、点击滚动右侧分组列表，收藏组固定在首位，用图片图标区分原生与桥接的视觉输入，点触发器右区单独打开推理档位面板。

description.en: Run trusted Pi extensions inside DeepSeek Harness through a compatibility host.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接跑未经改动的 Pi 扩展，靠兼容宿主实现无缝接入。

description.en: Native-feel DSH attachments: official PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF thumbs plus 64px cards for other files via drag, paste, or paperclip; non-images land in .dsh-uploads and sent cards sit on the user bubble.
description.zh: 接近原生的 DSH 附件：PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF 走官方缩略图，其它文件经拖入、粘贴或回形针变成 64px 卡片；非图片落到 .dsh-uploads，发送后贴在用户气泡旁。

description.en: DSH Markdown sidebar viewer and editor with block- and text-range annotations for structured revision requests.
description.zh: 在侧边栏里预览、编辑 Markdown，还能按块或选区加批注，方便整理修改意见。

description.en: 用于DeepSeek Harness的林翩翩主题UI插件。使用《哀鸿：城破十日记》的角色林翩翩作为页面半透明背景，并支持透明度和深度调节。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换上林翩翩主题，半透明背景可调深浅，聊天界面颜值拉满还不影响阅读。

description.en: 把本机的 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 安全地发布到公网， 让你在外面用浏览器就能用家里那台机器。
description.zh: 把家里电脑上的 DSH 网页界面安全地发布到公网，出门在外用浏览器就能连回来用。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的自定义 LLM API 请求注入 HTTP Headers（典型用途：改写 user-agent，例如网关要求 UA 带指定品牌字样）。

Evidence-bound negative-knowledge ledger: persists disproven paths (command_failed, file_missing) with their outcome and precondition evidence, then warns or blocks repeat attempts until the evidence changes.
description.zh: 记录编程智能体走过的弯路，避免重复踩坑，提升开发效率。

description.en: Local-first, durable workflow runtime for Agent Apps—compile static Workflow DSL to LangGraph and orchestrate trusted multi-agent execution through Codex, WorkBuddy, DeepSeek Harness, or any MCP client.

Local-first, durable workflow runtime for Agent Apps—compile static Workflow DSL to LangGraph and orchestrate trusted multi-agent execution through Codex, WorkBuddy, DeepSeek Harness, or any MCP client.
Lifecycle orchestration engine for AI agent teams with task-scoped Git worktree isolation, state-gated delivery transitions, and off-context memory.
description.zh: 基于 Git 工作树任务隔离、状态门禁交付与外置记忆的 AI 智能体软件生命周期编排引擎。

description.en: DSH JSON 查询工具插件：JMESPath 子集查询，零依赖递归下降解析器
description.zh: 用 JMESPath 语法快速查询 JSON 数据，零依赖轻量解析，让 Agent 轻松处理 API 返回和配置文件。

description.en: DSH 正则工具插件：测试匹配/提取捕获组/安全替换/静态解释正则（不执行代码），零依赖，注册 regex 工具
description.zh: 正则表达式工具箱，支持测试匹配、提取捕获组、安全替换，还能静态解释正则含义，零依赖纯函数。

description.en: DSH JSON Schema 验证工具插件：validate/paths/explain/normalize，零网络零动态执行
description.zh: DSH 的 JSON Schema 验证工具，能校验数据、定位失败路径、解释约束并安全填充默认值，全程离线且不执行动态代码。

description.en: 接入 Google Anti Gravity Coding Plan 作为 DeepSeek Harness LLM Provider，直接使用账号下的 Gemini / Claude / GPT-OSS。 | Google Anti Gravity Coding Plan LLM Provider for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 接入 Google Anti Gravity Coding Plan，让 DeepSeek Harness 直接调用你账号下的 Gemini、Claude 等顶尖 AI 模型。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 消息级删除插件，用于避免用户误发或错误的助手消息污染会话上下文。
description.zh: 消息级删除插件，一键移除误发或错误消息，防止污染模型上下文，聊天更干净。

description.en: Git Ship Done (opengsd-core) reimplemented as host-plane Cordis plugins: replaces the default agent loop with a spec/discuss/plan/execute/verify/ship phase loop.
description.zh: 把 GSD 阶段循环搬进 DeepSeek Harness，让智能体按 Git Ship Done 流程干活，替代默认循环。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 生态的 Windows 桌面插件项目。 A Windows desktop plugin project for the DeepSeek Harness ecosystem.
description.zh: 在 Windows 桌面上以原生窗口运行 DeepSeek Harness，提供托盘、主题同步和系统通知，方便日常使用。

description.en: 更好的 DSH | Unofficial dsh plugin: archived sessions & task notifications / 已归档会话管理 · 任务系统通知
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面增加已归档会话管理和任务通知，提升使用效率。

description.en: dsh-doctor: self-healing watchdog for the DeepSeek Harness web profile. Recovers from plugin-induced boot failures within 60s, runs an unbounded CLI doctor, captures every tool error, and watches all live sessions for stuck turns.
description.zh: DSH 自愈看门狗，插件导致启动失败时 60 秒内自动恢复，并持续监控工具错误，保障工作台稳定运行。

description.en: Adds a settings page for declaring per-model reasoning efforts and vision support on pi-ai provider routes.
description.zh: 在设置里新增「模型能力」一页，为每个模型声明思考档位与视觉能力。

description.en: Universal Model Context Protocol (MCP) bridge for DeepSeek Harness: connects agents to stdio/sse/websocket MCP servers with a 10k dormant scale engine, sub-millisecond BM25 tool search, dynamic token budgeting, and a real-time web UI dashboard.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 通用 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 桥接插件：支持 stdio/sse/websocket 协议，具备 10k 休眠伸缩引擎、亚毫秒级 BM25 工具检索、动态 Token 预算管理及实时 Web UI 仪表盘。

description.en: Windows one-click launcher with a borderless WPF startup animation (stroke-by-stroke HARNESS lettering) that starts dsh web in the background and fades into the GUI once ready, plus a desktop_launch tool.
description.zh: Windows 一键启动器：无边框 WPF 启动动画（HARNESS 逐笔描边），后台拉起 dsh web 并在 GUI 就绪后淡入，附 desktop_launch 工具。

description.en: Vision routing and image generation for DeepSeek Harness through a fixed Mix model.
description.zh: 通过固定 Mix 模型，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供视觉路由与图像生成能力，让多模态任务更简单。

description.en: Icon console for the DSH desktop app: import one icon and apply it to the desktop and Start Menu shortcuts (immediately), the application window image and the system tray image (after a restart), with automatic backup, one-click restore, a named icon library, and restart/exit controls.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端图标控制台：导入一个图标即可应用到桌面与开始菜单快捷方式（立即生效）、应用窗口图标与系统托盘图标（重启后生效），带官方图标自动备份、一键恢复、图标库管理，以及重启/退出控制。

description.en: Multi-model orchestrator: the main brain decomposes complex tasks and dispatches subtasks to GLM / Kimi / Qwen sub-agents by each model's strengths, with per-model token usage.
description.zh: 多模型主脑编排器：主模型将复杂任务拆解，按各模型优劣分派给 GLM / Kimi / Qwen 子代理执行，并按模型统计 token 用量。

description.en: Trusted Auto: a middle permission tier for DeepSeek Harness between workspace-write and danger-full-access, auto-approving harmless commands and trusted-area targets
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供介于工作区写入和完全访问之间的中间权限层，自动放行无害命令和可信区域操作，兼顾安全与效率。

description.en: 🐟 Salted Fish Pet — a Cordis-based web-client UI plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI. Injects a draggable, feedable salted fish mascot + full-viewport engineer wallpaper into the shell.overlay slot. Pure front-end (React + CSS Modules), zero server-side.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面加一只可拖拽投喂的咸鱼宠物，配上工程师壁纸，让开发环境更有趣。

description.en: Digital Employee，Integrates three catalogs — Experts, Skills, and Connectors — supporting browsing, favoriting, invoking, and publishing without modifying the host.
description.zh: 数字员工，整合专家、技能、连接器三大目录，支持浏览、收藏、召唤与发布，且无需改动宿主代码。

description.en: PiUI-inspired home feed visual refinement plugin for DeepSeek Harness web client (pure extension, zero core changes)
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 主页信息流更好看，纯前端视觉优化，不改底层逻辑。

description.en: MobaXterm-style SSH/SFTP tool plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): saved connection profiles, persistent multiplexed sessions, remote command execution, SFTP file transfer, and a web GUI console with file browser + live xterm terminal.
description.zh: 像 MobaXterm 一样管理 SSH/SFTP 连接，支持远程命令、文件传输和网页终端，轻松接入 Linux 主机。

description.en: 酒馆风格的通用世界书，为最新用户消息附加一次性的提示词注入，无上下文污染。SillyTavern-style worldbook for general purpose. Generating per-request injections to user message without long-lasting context contamination.
description.zh: 酒馆风格的通用世界书，为最新用户消息附加一次性的提示词注入，无上下文污染。兼容酒馆世界书，关键词/正则/常驻触发，以及不污染上下文的 lore_lookup 单轮查询工具。

description.en: dsh as companion ai frontend in Svelte
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一个轻量、专注的 Svelte 聊天界面，让你在 /companion/ 路径下更舒服地和 AI 对话。

description.en: 为DeepSeek Harness制作的极简“对话密度地图”插件（右侧对话历史标签）A minimal "Conversation Density Map" extension for DeepSeek Harness (Right Chat History Tab)
description.zh: 在右侧历史对话栏生成可视化密度图，一眼看清聊天活跃度，快速定位目标会话。

description.en: DSH Web 插件「基础能力面板」：在 DSH 设置中可视化并管理 MCP 服务器、技能 与 规则。采用模块化 feature 注册表，后续的 DSH 可视化功能只需新增一个 feature 目录并在注册表加一行即可，无需改动面板骨架。
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中可视化查看和管理 MCP 服务器、技能与规则，模块化设计方便后续功能扩展。

description.en: Windows desktop launcher for DeepSeek Harness: a one-click whale icon plus a sidebar More menu with Settings / Restart-Refresh / graceful Full Exit, and a scrollable multi-DSH picker on the cold-start card.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 桌面启动器：一键鲸鱼图标 + 侧栏「更多」菜单（设置 / 重启/刷新 / 优雅完全退出），冷启动卡片支持可滚动的多 DSH 候选选择。

description.en: Liquid glass for DeepSeek Harness: full-shell translucency, adjustable opacity, and custom wallpapers.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 界面加上毛玻璃效果，支持调节透明度、换壁纸，让界面更好看。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for agent workspace hygiene: artifact value assessment, metadata indexing, and auditable cleanup.
description.zh: 帮你自动整理智能体工作区，评估文件价值、建立索引，并安全清理无用文件，让任务运行更清爽高效。

description.en: Governed long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: append-only evidence ledger with write guards, 7-tier authority claims, supersede chains, and budgeted pre-step injection with per-domain quotas.
description.zh: 带治理的长期记忆：只追加证据账本、写入闸门、7 级权威声明与取代链，pre-step 按领域配额预算注入。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 黄金实时看板插件：Au99.99/XAU 实时报价、可拖拽浮窗、招行积存金估算与日内买卖参考。
description.zh: 在侧边栏看黄金实时行情，还能看招行历史价、给持仓建议和策略回放。

description.en: Model-facing `vision` tool for DeepSeek Harness: describe and OCR image files by calling the free Zhipu GLM vision API directly (glm-4v-flash fallback chain), no external CLI required.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的纯文本模型补上免费识图：`vision` 工具直连智谱 GLM 视觉 API 描述/OCR 图片文件（glm-4v-flash 降级链），无需任何外部 CLI。

description.en: Automatic approval and review for tool calls that need approval: keyword buckets match red lines without context, then a judge model classifies what was requested and sends it to allow, reject or a human according to the matching row and risk level; a judgment that never ran always goes to a human, and rejections tell the model why.
description.zh: 自动审批 / 自动审核需要审批的工具调用：先用关键词分桶做零上下文红线匹配，再交由审核模型判类别与风险等级， 按命中行与等级那一格决定自动允许、自动拒绝或转人工；判定没跑成固定转人工，自动拒绝会把原因回传给模型。

description.en: Locks the model's reasoning, replies and tool-call descriptions to a chosen target language (Simplified Chinese by default) with system-prompt sections at the head, middle and tail of the prompt, offering three strength levels, an auto mode that follows the DSH interface language, a settings panel that shows the language currently in effect, and a sidebar quick switch.
description.zh: 把模型的思考过程、回复与工具调用描述锁定为指定语言（默认简体中文）：在 system prompt 首、中、尾注入约束段落，提供基础、强化、周期三档强度，可跟随 DSH 界面语言自动选择，设置页显示当前生效语言，并带侧栏快速切换。

description.en: Bridge DeepSeek Harness agent sessions into Feishu (Lark) chats over the official SDK long connection, with a streaming reply card, many bots per instance, and mention-gated group replies.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的 agent 会话接进飞书（Lark）：官方 SDK 长连接收发、流式回复卡片、单实例多 bot、群里 @ 才回复。

description.en: Adds the DeepSeek Harness homepage background to dsh web: WebGL fluid light, dot-line grid and a digital point-cloud whale, with dark and light palettes.
description.zh: 给 dsh web 铺上 DeepSeek Harness 首页同款背景：WebGL 流体光效、点线网格与数字点云鲸鱼，深色/亮色两套配色。

description.en: Auto-resumes interrupted DSH turns: sends a queued 「继续」 after turn/end with error, interrupted or max-tokens reasons, with a grace period, cooldown, exponential backoff, a consecutive-attempts cap, boot-time scanning, a settings card and a per-session stop/restore button in the composer toolbar; it never switches models or providers.
description.zh: 回合中断自动续跑：turn/end 因 error / interrupted / max-tokens 结束时自动发送「继续」，支持宽限期、冷却、指数退避、连续次数上限、启动扫描、设置卡片，以及输入框工具行的会话级停止/恢复按钮；不切换模型/provider。

description.en: Group chat rooms for DSH sessions with explicit @mentions, cold-session wake-up delivery, and optional cross-host transport through dsh-weave.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 会话的群聊室：支持明确 @ 提及、冷会话唤醒投递，并可通过 dsh-weave 跨主机通信。

description.en: Per-session long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness, with memory management, persona settings, and compaction prompts.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话独立的长期记忆、记忆管理、人设设置和压缩提示词。

description.en: Two-way bridge between GNU Emacs and a running DeepSeek Harness session over loopback HTTP + SSE: submit prompts, stream replies, manage sessions and workspaces, and answer ask-user/approval prompts from Emacs, with a Plugins-page card that installs the Emacs package.
description.zh: GNU Emacs 与正在运行的 DSH 会话之间的双向桥：走本机回环 HTTP + SSE，可在 Emacs 里提交提示、流式收回复、管理会话与工作区、回答 ask-user / 审批提示；插件页还有一张卡片用来安装 Emacs 那边的包。

description.en: Chinese metaphysics (xuanxue) divination panel and agent tool with nineteen systems: eight chart systems (BaZi, Zi Wei Dou Shu, LiuYao, MeiHua, Da Liu Ren, Qi Men Dun Jia, compatibility charts, Tarot) plus eleven quick references (almanac, solar–lunar conversion, date selection, bone-weight fortune, Xiao Liu Ren, horoscope, numerology, life-curve, feng shui, name analysis, an MBTI-style 16-type questionnaire), with ask-driven, report-style interpretation. BaZi adds exact dayun handover dates, annual suiyun hints, "passing-through" (通关), three-book classical cross-reference, four-mausoleum (杂气) month pattern selection and daily "human element" (人元司权); Zi Wei adds 34 patterns, nine switchable school variants, chained flying transformations and three-way-four-corner composite flights; LiuYao adds yongshen strength, whole-hexagram per-line strength, hidden-spirit release conditions and response-time clues (应期); feng shui covers eight-mansion and Xuan Kong flying stars; name analysis ships a 391-character library with five-grid (五格) numerology and phonetics checks. The DSH panel and the offline page share the same grouped first screen (ask / read a person / pick a date) with recent-used entries and narrow-width folding. All computed locally; networking is off by default. The npm package also ships an offline single-file page (命理排盘.html): double-click to open, every tab included, no server and no network needed.
description.zh: 玄学命理排盘：十九套体系——八套排盘（八字、紫微斗数、六爻、梅花易数、大六壬、奇门遁甲、合盘、塔罗）加十一套速查（黄历、农历互转、择日、称骨、小六壬、星座、生命数字、人生K线、风水、起名、十六型人格问卷），并可按所问之事生成可读报告；八字含交运日、岁运并临/伏吟反吟、通关、三书对照与杂气月取格/人元司权，紫微含 34 格局、九类流派开关、飞星串连与三方四正复合飞化，六爻含用神旺衰、全卦逐爻旺衰、伏神出伏与应期线索，风水含八宅与玄空飞星，起名含 391 字库、五格剖象与音韵检查；宿主面板与离线页共用同一套分组首屏（问一件事/看一个人/查日子），带最近用过与窄屏收纳；纯本地计算，默认不联网。npm 包内另附离线单文件页（命理排盘.html）：双击即开，十九个 tab 齐全，不用起服务、不用联网。

description.en: Interactive canvas for visualizing Agent, Subagent, Workflow, Phase, and tool relationships in DSH Web.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供可交互画布，用于展示 Agent、Subagent、Workflow、Phase 与工具调用之间的关系。

description.en: Tender search and bid intelligence in DeepSeek Harness with proposed project search, rule screening, human review and Excel/PDF exports using user-authorized Qichacha MCP.
description.zh: 招投标智能体：支持招投标搜索、招标查询、投标查询、标讯查询、拟建项目与项目筛选，辅助商机发现、人工复核及 Excel/PDF 导出，使用客户自备授权的企查查 MCP。

description.en: Shows the current provider's account balance or coding-plan quota above the composer, with usage percentages and reset countdowns.
description.zh: 在输入框上方查看当前模型供应商的账户余额或套餐额度，显示已用比例和重置倒计时。

description.en: Feishu/Lark gateway for DeepSeek Harness with topic-persistent conversations, live execution cards, image and file inputs, in-chat approvals and questions, source allowlists, and durable one-time or recurring agent tasks created in natural language.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 网关：按话题持久化会话、实时执行卡片、图片与文件输入、聊天内审批和提问、来源白名单，以及用自然语言创建可持久化的一次性或周期 Agent 任务。

description.en: Skill Center panel for the current session: lists the visible skills with their provider and source root, renders each SKILL.md, toggles model and user invocation, and creates or soft-deletes skills; ships a skill-authoring skill and the skill_create tool.
description.zh: 当前会话的技能中心面板：列出可见技能及其提供方与来源根目录，阅读 SKILL.md，开关模型/用户调用，并可创建、软删除技能；随包附带 skill-authoring 技能与 skill_create 工具。

description.en: Local image, voice, music and SFX generation plus transcription, with pinned identity: characters, animals, objects and actor voices are defined once and reused on every later call, degenerate output (a near-flat image, silent audio) is rejected instead of returned as success, and a generated line can be read back as text so a clone that swallowed its ending becomes visible. The engines unload when idle, and image generation and transcription can each be pointed at an OpenAI-shaped API instead of the local Vulkan backend.
description.zh: 本地生成图像/配音/音乐/音效并听写，同一性锁定：角色、动物、道具与配音角色定妆定声一次，之后每次调用复用同一份参考；退化产物（接近纯色的图、静音的音频）被拒绝而不是当成成功返回；生成的台词可以听写回文字，好让吞掉结尾的克隆暴露出来。空闲时引擎卸载显存，生图与听写也可改指向任意 OpenAI 形状的 API 而不用本地 Vulkan 后端。

description.en: Text viewer and editor for the dock workbench: undo/redo, Ctrl+S save, unsaved-change confirmation and binary detection, registered as the default file viewer.
description.zh: dock 系列文本查看与编辑器：支持撤销重做、Ctrl+S 保存、未保存确认和二进制检测，作为 dock-files 的默认文本查看器。

description.en: Native image attachments for text-only DeepSeek in the Web GUI: pasted or dropped images appear as thumbnails in the session, and before dispatch the host reads them with the free Zhipu GLM-4V-Flash vision API (glm-4v-flash fallback chain) and substitutes the description, so DeepSeek answers about the image while the original is kept in history.
description.zh: 为纯文本 DeepSeek 提供原生图片上传体验：在 Web GUI 粘贴/拖入图片即以缩略图附件进入会话，发送前由 host 用免费智谱 GLM-4V-Flash 视觉 API（glm-4v-flash 降级链）读取并替换为文字描述，DeepSeek 据此回答，原图保留在聊天历史中。

description.en: Registers the commercial-ui-ux skill for DSH: task-aware commercial UI/UX/GUI design, review, repair, and implementation (SaaS, dashboards, admin panels, forms, tables, design systems) with a reference-doc system and quality gates.
description.zh: 注册 commercial-ui-ux 技能：以任务为中心的商业界面 UI/UX/GUI 设计、审查、修复与实现（SaaS、仪表盘、后台、表单、表格、设计系统），带参考文档体系与质量门禁。

description.en: Natural-language data queries + BI reports: Text2SQL, charts, report saving, schema/data grid panel, and a sidebar workbench — all behind DSH's MySQL connection layer.
description.zh: 自然语言查询 + 商业智能报表：Text2SQL、图表、报表收藏、Schema/数据面板与侧栏工作台，基于 DSH 的 MySQL 连接层。

description.en: Manage global AGENTS.md in DSH Web with Markdown preview, reusable templates, version history, import/export, failed-import rollback, and revision-conflict protection.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 中管理全局 AGENTS.md，支持 Markdown 预览、可复用模板、版本历史、导入导出、失败导入回滚与修订冲突保护。

description.en: Signature escook theme ported from VS Code: 4 classic aesthetic color schemes (Dark, Dark Soft, Light, Light Soft) with high-contrast syntax highlighting for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 移植自 VS Code 经典的彬哥主题：包含 4 款经典美学配色（经典暗黑、柔和暗黑、紫韵浅色、柔和浅色）与高对比度语法高亮。

description.en: Markdown viewer for the dock workbench: GFM rendering with DOMPurify sanitization, document outline and relative-path image/link resolution, with one-click switch to editing.
description.zh: dock 系列 Markdown 查看器：GFM 渲染 + DOMPurify 消毒、文档大纲、相对路径图片/链接解析，可一键切换编辑。

description.en: Adds a markitdown tool that converts PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HTML, CSV, EPUB and URLs to Markdown, using a real Microsoft MarkItDown installation when one is reachable and a bundled dependency-free converter otherwise.
description.zh: 提供 markitdown 工具，把 PDF、Word、Excel、PowerPoint、HTML、CSV、EPUB 与网址转成 Markdown：能找到真实的 Microsoft MarkItDown 时驱动它，否则使用内置的零依赖转换器。

description.en: Connects CLIProxyAPI (CPA) to DeepSeek Harness (DSH) with multiple accounts, model filtering, native protocols, quota lookup and image / video generation; once configured, the selected models appear in the model picker automatically.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）中接入 CLIProxyAPI（CPA），支持多账户、模型筛选、原生协议直连、额度查询、生图生视频，选好配置后自动出现在模型选择器中。

description.en: Adds 20 locales (Traditional Chinese HK/TW, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Ukrainian, Polish, Dutch, Turkish, Arabic, Hindi, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Thai, Swedish) to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with hand-polished translations, runtime fallbacks, and automatic translation of market and third-party text.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 界面新增 20 种语言（繁体中文香港/台湾、日语、韩语、法语、德语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语、意大利语、俄语、乌克兰语、波兰语、荷兰语、土耳其语、阿拉伯语、印地语、印尼语、越南语、泰语、瑞典语），逐条精译并带运行时兜底，另加自动翻译，把市场与第三方文本翻译成你的语言。

description.en: A NieR:Automata / YoRHa-inspired industrial terminal theme for DeepSeek Harness Web with sand-and-charcoal palettes, square geometry, and interface-wide styling.
description.zh: 一款面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的 NieR:Automata / YoRHa 风格工业终端主题，提供沙色与炭黑配色、直角几何和全界面样式。

description.en: Task-completion chime for DeepSeek Harness, playing the original opencode sounds for done, question, plan-review and error events with zero external dependencies.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 复刻 opencode 的任务完成提示音，完成、提问、计划待审、出错四种场景播放原始音效，零外部依赖。

description.en: Injects a small continuity pointer at the start of a new session, naming the previous session and any handoff file, and reuses DSH's own compaction summary when there is no handoff file.
description.zh: 新会话开始时注入一条很小的接续指针，说明上一个会话是谁、工作区有没有交接文档；没有交接文档时复用 DSH 已有的压缩摘要。

description.en: Settings panel for global and per-workspace AGENTS.md, with identity and persona injection, runtime-context toggle, and result notifications.
description.zh: 设置面板管理全局与各工作区 AGENTS.md，支持身份与人设注入、运行时上下文开关和结果通知。

description.en: Streams DeepSeek Harness sessions, messages, tool activity, and turn outcomes to a JARVIS Mission Control board with task status and human review.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的会话、消息、工具活动与每轮结果实时推送到 JARVIS Mission Control 看板，附任务状态与人工复核。

description.en: Registers a `deepseek-vision` provider route: the Web GUI accepts pasted images and transcribes them to text via the free Zhipu GLM vision API before delegating to the DeepSeek adapter.
description.zh: 注册 `deepseek-vision` 路由：Web GUI 直接粘贴图片，由免费智谱 GLM 视觉模型转译为文字后，再交给 DeepSeek 适配器作答。

description.en: Liquid Glass refraction input card for the DSH web GUI, with coupled-spring press animation. Published on npm: dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-liquid-glass-input.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web GUI 输入卡加上液态玻璃折射效果与弹簧按压动画。已发布 npm：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-liquid-glass-input。

description.en: Installed-plugin catalog for DSH: group plugins by origin (official vs self-installed) in a searchable panel with enable/disable, uninstall, and one-click update. Published on npm as dsh-plugin-diraud.
description.zh: 装在 DSH 里的插件目录：按来源（官方/自装）分组展示已安装插件，可搜索，支持启用/停用、卸载和一键更新。已发布 npm 包 dsh-plugin-diraud。

description.en: Registers the models of a local workbuddy2api-hub gateway into DSH as one OpenAI-compatible provider per gateway API key, each key keeping its own model selection, and shows the main key's credit balance plus today's and this week's tokens, credits and API-equivalent cost in a sidebar badge. Requires workbuddy2api-hub running locally.
description.zh: 把本地 workbuddy2api-hub 网关的模型接进 DSH：网关里有几条 API Key 就同步成几条 provider，每条 key 的模型勾选各自独立；侧边栏徽标显示主 key 的积分余额和今日、本周的 tokens、积分与 API 等价花费。需本机运行 workbuddy2api-hub。

description.en: Sidebar panel for account balances and local token usage, with provider/model breakdowns and a 27-week daily heatmap.
description.zh: 侧边栏面板展示账户余额与本地 Token 用量，包含供应商/模型明细和 27 周每日热力图。

description.en: Audible feedback for the DSH web interface: button presses are classified by semantics (normal, primary, toggle, send, close, danger, link) and the current session's task transitions (started, finished, failed) plus any pending interaction play a cue, each scenario with its own cue picker and switch on a settings page. All 78 cues and 12 sound packs are synthesised in the browser with the Web Audio API, so the package ships no audio files and makes no network request. A community port of dsh-plugin-uisfx to DSH 0.2.0, with the ported changes recorded in PROVENANCE.md.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面补上可听的语义反馈：按钮按下按语义分类发声（普通、主要、开关、发送、关闭、危险、链接），当前会话的任务开始、成功结束、失败结束以及出现待处理交互也各有一声，每个情景都能在设置页单独挑音效、单独开关。78 个 cue 与 12 个音色包全部由浏览器用 Web Audio API 实时合成，因此包里不含音频文件、也不发起网络请求。这是 dsh-plugin-uisfx 向 DSH 0.2.0 的社区移植版，改动逐条记录在 PROVENANCE.md。

description.en: Config-driven development-task orchestration for DSH: graph workflows (task/gateway/human nodes) with per-stage persistence, plus an in-editor AI assistant that configures workflows through conversation with live validation. Hand documents to nodes as generic attachments (no declaration needed): files land in the task workspace and ${inputs.附件} gives the newline-joined absolute paths, so a node parses them with its own prompt.
description.zh: 配置驱动的工作流与开发任务编排：图式工作流（任务/网关/人工审批节点）+ 阶段级断点持久化，内置 AI 助手在图编辑器中通过对话配置工作流，逐条校验实时应用到画布。把文档作为「通用附件」交给节点（无需声明）：文件启动前落到工作区，节点用 ${inputs.附件} 拿到换行拼接的绝对路径自行解析。

description.en: A permanent DSH plugin that bundles a developer workbench, an in-session conversation tree, and a plugin manager: build and run an LVAL project, browse its code, and keep per-program version snapshots with rollback; edit, retry, or branch any message in place, with message micro-versions; a feature manager plus a global-plugin library whose entries each carry an enable tier; cross-dialogue memory, one-shot temporary chats, and model collaboration; five network-permission tiers, mixed-model routing, a security audit, and browser control through a companion extension.
description.zh: DSH 永久插件工作台：LVAL 工程工具的编译/运行、代码查看与程序版本快照回退；会话内对话树（就地编辑 / 重新生成 / 分支）与消息小版本；DET 管理器，以及每条记录各带一档启停权限的全局插件库；跨对话记忆、一次性临时对话与模型合作；五档网络权限、混合模型路由、安全审计，以及经配套浏览器扩展的浏览器控制。

description.en: After official llm-retry (n/5) gives up, keep retrying transient API failures (timeout, transport, rate-limit, 5xx, dropped SSE) on the same open step until success, cancel, or pause; AUTH, QUOTA, and user Stop are never retried.
description.zh: 官方 llm-retry（n/5）耗尽后，对超时/传输/限流/5xx/SSE 断流等瞬时失败在同一打开 step 上继续重试直到成功、取消或暂停；认证失败、额度耗尽和用户停止不会重试。

description.en: Runs AItelier pipelines from DSH over MCP: 39 tools (22 read, 17 write) to generate, run, inspect, edit, export and import multi-step SkillFlow pipelines. The steps execute in AItelier rather than in the DSH session and are polled by run_id, pause at engine-enforced checkpoints answered with answer_checkpoint, and leave per-step traces and step outputs to read afterwards; add_provider / map_model / edit_role point an individual role at a local or cheaper endpoint. Bundles an aitelier-pipelines skill.
description.zh: 从 DSH 经 MCP 运行 AItelier 流水线：39 个工具（22 读、17 写），用于生成、运行、查看、编辑、导出与导入多步 SkillFlow 流水线。步骤在 AItelier 中执行而不占用 DSH 会话，按 run_id 轮询，在引擎强制的检查点暂停并由 answer_checkpoint 应答，事后可读取逐步 trace 与各步输出；add_provider / map_model / edit_role 可把单个角色指向本地或更便宜的端点。随包附带 aitelier-pipelines skill。

description.en: Persistent background watchers that wake the agent on new messages (file inbox or command-output delta) — the harness analog of Claude Code's Monitor tool.
description.zh: 常驻后台监视器：文件收件箱（NDJSON）或命令输出增量一到就唤醒 agent，相当于 Claude Code Monitor 工具的 Harness 实现。

description.en: Gives dsh the ability to generate images and videos through the grok2api API.
description.zh: 让 dsh 通过 grok2api 的 API 获得生成图片与视频能力。

description.en: Routes the DSH web_search tool through Ollama's web search API, reusing OLLAMA_API_KEY. No DeepSeek official key needed.
description.zh: 让 DSH 的 web_search 工具走 Ollama 联网搜索 API，复用 OLLAMA_API_KEY，无需 DeepSeek 官方 Key。

description.en: Reverse tunnel for the DSH Web GUI: exposes a `dsh --profile web` deployment at a public frp URL and switches the directory picker to the in-app browser, so a phone or remote machine can open and manage the workspace.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 反向隧道：通过 frp 把 `dsh --profile web` 发布到公网地址，目录选择器改用应用内浏览器，手机或远程机器可直接打开并管理工作区。

description.en: Writes live provider model lists into DSH settings and shows 5h/7d plan windows or metered balance for the current session model.
description.zh: 把各提供方线上模型列表写进 DSH 设置，输入框圆环显示当前会话模型的 5 小时/7 天窗口或按量剩余余额。

description.en: Desk-to-desk tickets between sessions on one machine. A session says which desk it belongs to by putting a number prefix in its title; a ticket names one desk and is taken by the first session of that desk to start working, so the desk is the address and a ticket is not delivered to a session that is just passing by.
description.zh: 同一台电脑上会话之间的「单子」：会话用标题里的编号前缀表明自己属于哪张桌；单子投给某张桌，由那张桌最先开始干活的那个会话取走 —— 桌是地址，路过的会话不会收到它。

description.en: Black-box GUI testing for DeepSeek Harness: an AI tester drives a real Windows virtual machine using only screenshots and mouse/keyboard, so its verdicts rest on pixels instead of logs or source code. Ships the dsh-vm-tester plugin with twelve vm_* tools (status, UI tree, screenshot, click, type, type-secret, key, basic key, wait, snapshot, upload, download), a reverse-tunnel guest agent for Windows, and run verification scripts. Needs Windows, VirtualBox 7 and a Windows guest VM with the bundled agent before any vm tool works.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的黑盒 GUI 测试：AI 测试员只靠截图与键鼠操作真实 Windows 虚拟机，判定必须由像素支撑，而不是读日志或源码。包含 dsh-vm-tester 插件的十二个 vm_* 工具（状态、UI 元素树、截图、点击、输入、凭据注入、按键、普通键、等待、快照、上传、下载）、Windows 虚拟机内的反向隧道代理，以及运行体检与围观脚本。需要 Windows、VirtualBox 7 和装有内置代理的 Windows 虚拟机，vm 工具才可用。

description.en: Unofficial FreeCodeGo for DeepSeek Harness: DeepSeek, Codex and Claude engines over one session and toolchain, with a 0-token free access channel for deepseek-v4.1-flash, deepseek-v4-pro, deepseek-v4-flash-free, glm-5.3-flash, grok-4.6, kimi-k3, nemotron-3-ultra-free, muse-spark-1.3, Qwen 3.8 Flash and mimo-v2.6-flash-free, plus a keyless private-key gateway.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 FreeCodeGo：DeepSeek、Codex、Claude 三套引擎共用同一条会话与工具链，并为以下模型提供 0 token 免费使用渠道：deepseek-v4.1-flash、deepseek-v4-pro、deepseek-v4-flash-free、glm-5.3-flash、grok-4.6、kimi-k3、nemotron-3-ultra-free、muse-spark-1.3、Qwen 3.8 Flash、mimo-v2.6-flash-free，另有零注册的私钥网关。

description.en: AI UI automation via Midscene — android_ui and web_ui tools that tap, type, query, and assert on a real Android device or an already-running Chrome through the ctx.midscene seam.
description.zh: 基于 Midscene 的 AI UI 自动化——android_ui 与 web_ui 工具，通过 ctx.midscene seam 在真实 Android 设备或已运行的 Chrome 上完成点击、输入、查询与断言。

description.en: Full-screen lightbox for chat images: click any image to open the full-resolution original with zoom (wheel, buttons, shortcuts), drag panning, prev/next paging, filename caption and download, plus keyboard-arrow and touch-swipe navigation. One "image display control" popover next to the composer collapses every image in the conversation into a thumbnail grid whose column count (1-12) is configurable and remembered, or hides them entirely so the space closes up and restores them later; images are styled in place and no node is ever moved or reparented. The host-side display_image tool takes a local path or directory (TIFF/HEIC transcoded, originals still saved on download), a remote URL, or a keyword search over Bing, Huaban and Sogou that samples loadability before picking a source, re-saves images blocked by hotlink protection and drops dead links after a magic-byte check, returning paste-ready Markdown. It also keeps a system-prompt rule that every delivered image must appear in the reply body as ![](…) markdown, because collapsed tool rows are invisible to the reader.
description.zh: 聊天图片全屏查看器：点击任意图片打开原始分辨率大图，支持缩放（滚轮、按钮、快捷键）、拖拽平移、左右翻页、文件名显示、下载保存，以及键盘方向键与移动端滑动切换。输入框旁一个「对话图显控制」面板，可一键把整个会话的图收成可调列数（1–12，自动记忆）的缩略图网格，或整块隐藏并收掉占位、随时还原；图片只原地加样式，绝不搬移或重挂节点。宿主侧 display_image 工具支持本地路径或目录（TIFF/HEIC 自动转码，下载仍保存原文件）、网络直链、以及 Bing、花瓣、搜狗的关键词搜图（按抽样可加载率选源，被防盗链拦截的自动转存，坏链按字节校验剔除），返回可直接粘贴的 Markdown；并在 system prompt 常驻一条投递规则，要求发出的图必须写进回复正文（![](…)），因为折叠的工具行读者看不到。

description.en: DSH client for dsh-mesh: pulls the hub inbox with claims (no inbound port needed), turns mail into real session turns, bootstraps itself from hubUrl + joinCode, and still works standalone for local multi-session coordination.

Cross-harness agent memory for DSH: one plain-file store shared by the DSH and pi adapters and the harnmem CLI, so a memory written in one harness is available in another; injected as a byte-stable hot index, with five harnmem_* tools, session-end extraction, and a read-only memory browser panel.
description.zh: DSH 跨 harness 全局记忆：DSH、pi 适配器与 harnmem CLI 共享同一份本地纯文件记忆库，在一个 harness 写入的记忆在另一个 harness 可用；以字节稳定的热索引注入系统提示，提供五个 harnmem_* 工具、会话结束记忆提取与只读记忆浏览面板。

description.en: Voice assistant for dsh web: say the wake phrase (e.g. "小鲸") to activate hands-free dictation — what you say is transcribed and typed into the chat box automatically. Supports spoken edit commands (send, clear, new line, stop reading) and reads assistant replies aloud in Chinese. Speech recognition runs locally in-browser via sherpa-onnx WASM, so it works offline without an API key.
description.zh: dsh web 语音助手：说出唤醒词（如「小鲸」）即可免手听写，说话内容自动转成文字填入输入框；支持口述编辑指令（发送、清空、换行、停止朗读），并可用中文朗读 AI 回复。语音识别基于 sherpa-onnx WASM 在浏览器本地运行，离线可用、无需 API Key。

description.en: TickTick (滴答清单) daily task dispatcher: an interval timer pulls due tasks from a chosen list into a Markdown task file and notifies only when the task set changes (WeChat via ClawBot / flomo / macOS); it can also auto-execute each task in its own headless DSH session under a configurable timeout, optionally gated to DeepSeek's off-peak hours so peak-time work queues to the next off-peak window instead of starting, plus a settings panel for the deferred write-back queue and dispatcher_status / dispatcher_config / dispatcher_run / dispatcher_report tools.
description.zh: 滴答清单任务派发器：按间隔从指定清单拉取到期任务写入今日任务文件，仅在任务集变化时通知（微信 ClawBot / flomo / macOS）；可为每个任务单独开一个 headless DSH 会话自动执行（worker 超时可配），并可选只在 DeepSeek 空闲（优惠）时段开跑——高峰期把任务排到下个空闲窗口而不是立刻执行；带 Web 设置面板（延迟回写队列、省钱模式时段与状态）与 dispatcher_status / dispatcher_config / dispatcher_run / dispatcher_report 工具。

description.en: Adds a Batch Uninstall page to the DSH settings dialog: a checklist of every installed bundle with multi-select, select-all, a confirmation dialog and per-plugin progress, where official bundles stay locked and each removal goes through the host pluginManager service.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中新增「批量卸载」页面：勾选多个已安装插件批量移除，支持全选、二次确认与逐条进度，官方 bundle 自动锁定，删除统一走宿主 pluginManager 服务。

description.en: Separate slash-command group in the Web UI composer: /steer injects text on the agent's next step without interrupting the turn, /new starts a blank session, /skill and /docs wrap /steer with post-turn skill or docs tasks, and custom /steer aliases are configurable in Settings.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 输入框的斜杠菜单里单独一组插件命令：/steer 在模型下一步注入内容且不打断当前回合，/new 开启空白会话，/skill 与 /docs 在 /steer 基础上附加完成后写入 skill 或 docs，并可在设置里为常用 /steer 内容配置自定义快捷命令。

description.en: Visualize the plugin and model call flow as a 3D office with six fixed workstations, thought bubbles and a delivery sheet.
description.zh: 把插件与模型的调用过程可视化成 3D 办公室：六个固定工位、思维流气泡与交付纸。

description.en: Read-only insight panel for one profile: five views over the same data — config layers, plugin tree, services, tool names and models — each entry showing which layer inserted or disabled it and whether it is running.
description.zh: 只读的 profile 洞察面板：同一份数据的五个视图——配置层、插件树、服务、工具名、模型，每一条都给出被哪一层插入或禁用、此刻在不在跑。

description.en: Monitor the account balance for 3rd-party services those AI agents often use, such as Tavily, SerpAPI, Firecrawl, Bocha, Tinyfish, etc. Optionally you can select to inject the account balance into the system prompt, so the agent can use the services accordingly.
description.zh: 监控 AI Agents 常用的第三方服务余额，如 Tavily、SerpAPI、Firecrawl、博查、Tinyfish 等。可选支持将服务的余额注入 System Prompt，以便 Agent 合理使用相关服务。

description.en: Windows computer-use plugin for AI agents with reusable window targets, UI Automation, window-bound screenshots, background-first verified input, isolated Chromium automation, MCP, CLI, and installable skills.
description.zh: 面向 AI Agent 的 Windows 电脑操控与 computer use 插件，支持可复用窗口目标、UIA 无障碍定位、窗口绑定截图、后台优先的验证输入、隔离 Chromium 自动化、MCP、CLI 和可安装 Skill。

description.en: Per-execution HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy routing for Agent fetches, LLM providers, and shell commands, with settings-backed hot reload, approval-gated controls, and credential-safe status.
description.zh: 按每次执行为 Agent fetch、LLM provider 与 shell 命令路由 HTTP/SOCKS5 代理；支持 settings 热更新、审批门禁和凭据安全状态。

description.en: Reads a GitNexus index in the DSH sidebar, reports skipped files, index freshness and language coverage, searches symbols, and reviews recent Git activity.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏读取 GitNexus 索引，报告被跳过的文件、索引新鲜度与语言覆盖，支持符号搜索和最近的 Git 活动审查。

description.en: In-page task notifications with collapsible status toasts, sound, and session navigation.
description.zh: 带可折叠状态通知、提示音与会话跳转的页内任务通知插件。

description.en: Branch-role guard for AI coding agents: configurable integration/preview/production/archive roles, blocking direct push, force-push and delete on protected branches and agent merges into production/archive.
description.zh: AI 编码智能体分支角色守卫：可配置集成/预览/生产/归档角色，拦截对受保护分支的直接推送、强推与删除，以及智能体对生产/归档分支的合并。

description.en: Draggable floating ball that shows the current DSH session todo checklist live — done/total on its face (capsule mode also shows the running task title) plus a matching progress ring. Click to expand or fold the full list, right-click to switch capsule mode, and state colours mark in-progress (pulsing), done, pending and empty. Replaced plans are archived as history rows that can be hidden one by one, cleared and restored instead of counting towards progress, and other sessions can be pinned side by side. Data comes from the runtime sessions projection first with the official todo panel as a fallback, so the full list survives even when the official strip is collapsed. Text colour can be forced to auto, black or white, the ball snaps back to the bottom-right corner on demand, and it stays draggable right up to the top edge of the window. 130 shared skins — including two official dark and light skins that follow the client light/dark theme automatically, plus a per-ball sync switch so each ball either follows the shared skin or keeps its own — with Shadow DOM style isolation and position remembered per profile, identical on desktop and web.
description.zh: 常驻可拖动悬浮球实时显示当前会话的 todo 清单：球面显示完成数/总数（胶囊模式另显示进行中任务名），外环进度环同步百分比；点击展开或收起完整清单，右键切胶囊模式，状态用颜色区分（进行中橙色脉动、完成绿、待办蓝、无清单灰）。被替换的旧计划自动归档成历史行（可逐行隐藏、批量清理、一键恢复），不再计入进度；其他会话可固定并排查看。数据以 runtime 的 sessions 投影为准，官方 todo 面板仅作兜底——所以官方计划条收起时球上仍是完整清单。文字颜色可强制为自动/黑/白，球被拖走后可一键归位到右下角，拖到窗口最顶部也照样能拖。130 款共享皮肤——含两款随客户端深/浅主题自动切换的官方深色与浅色皮肤，另有每球独立的同步开关，可跟随共享皮肤或保留自己的皮肤——Shadow DOM 样式隔离，位置按 profile 记忆，桌面端与网页端表现一致。

description.en: Weak-network adaptor: transparent long-backoff model-stream retries (10-min cap), local response replay cache, heartbeat auto-reconnect, and degraded-mode token economy, with a bilingual (zh/en) settings page.
description.zh: 弱网适配器：模型流式请求的长退避透明重试（上限 10 分钟）、本地响应重放缓存、心跳自动重连、降级模式 token 节流，并提供中英双语设置页。

description.en: VibeDev 影视工作台：在 DeepSeek Harness 和 VibeDev 的右侧栏打开画布式影视工作台（剧本、分镜画布、图片/视频/音频生成、剪辑成片），模型与费用统一走 VibeDev 账号 · VibeDev Film: a canvas film workbench in the right sidebar of DeepSeek Harness and VibeDev (script, storyboard canvas, image/video/audio generation, e

Study coach for DeepSeek Harness: turns a course into a knowledge map of subject, module and unit, records mastery per unit in six stages, plans daily tasks against a materials index, keeps a wrong-answer book and spaced-repetition cards, and serves its own web panel.
description.zh: DSH 的学习教练：把一门课拆成知识地图（大类 / 模块 / 最小单元），逐单元记六档掌握度，按资料索引排每日任务，带错题本与记忆卡，并自带一个网页面板。

description.en: Adds the official Google Antigravity ACP agent as a DeepSeek Harness model provider, with tool execution and approval kept in DSH, Node 22.19+ and a signed-in Antigravity account required, a per-model quota pill and a settings page.
description.zh: 把 Google 官方 Antigravity ACP agent 接入 DeepSeek Harness 作为模型提供商，工具执行与审批仍由 DSH 负责，附按模型切换的额度药丸和设置页；需 Node 22.19+ 并登录 Antigravity 账号。

description.en: Clickable next-step suggestions under every reply; one click sends that sentence as your message.
description.zh: 在每条回复下方给出可点的下一步建议，点一下就把那句话作为你的消息发出去。

description.en: Listen to Xiaoyuzhou (小宇宙) podcasts in the DSH web UI: paste a share link to play anonymously (host proxies the audio with Range/seek), or log in via QR code to sync subscriptions, keyword-search shows/episodes, page full episode lists, and unlock purchased paywalled episodes; a `podcast_play` tool lets the agent play by link, podcast pid, or episode eid.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面收听小宇宙播客：粘贴分享链接即可免登录播放（host 代理音频流，支持 Range 拖动），扫码登录后同步账号订阅、关键词搜索节目与单集、加载完整单集分页、解锁已购付费单集；注册 `podcast_play` 工具让 agent 按链接、节目 pid 或单集 eid 直接播放。

description.en: VS Code-style code editor: sidebar file tree over the workspace, Monaco editing, file read/write, Git status and diff, search, and Markdown preview.
description.zh: VS Code 风格代码编辑器：侧边栏文件树浏览工作区，Monaco 编辑，文件读写，Git 状态与差异，搜索与 Markdown 预览。

description.en: Sidebar panel for Agnes image and video generation that also ships a node canvas and a short-drama mode. Canvas nodes are chained by extracting the previous shot's tail frame with ffmpeg and submitting it as the next shot's first frame; short-drama mode turns an imported script into storyboard shots. Generation and polling run in the Host process, so tasks survive a page reload or a closed panel, and results plus an 80-entry history are stored on disk.
description.zh: 侧边栏 AI 创作面板，除生图与生视频外还带画布节点图和短剧模式：画布上用 ffmpeg 抽取上一镜尾帧，作为下一镜首帧自动串联；短剧模式可导入剧本拆解为分镜。生成与轮询都在宿主进程后台执行，刷新页面或关闭面板都不中断，结果与最多 80 条历史保存在本机。

description.en: Git-backed, workspace-scoped memory for the DeepSeek Harness (global layer + per-workspace layers)

Unified plugin marketplace built for the DSH Desktop (EAC) shell, aggregating the curated catalog, the GitHub dsh-plugin ecosystem and the npm registry into one storefront, with source whitelisting, conflict pre-checks, trial-boot install verification, manual/batch/auto updates and .dshpack feature-pack management.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Desktop（EAC）桌面壳的统一插件市场：聚合精选目录、GitHub dsh-plugin 生态与 npm registry 三源，提供来源白名单、冲突预检、试装安装验证、手动/批量/自动三档更新与功能包（.dshpack）管理。

description.en: Security-audit facts AI coding agents cannot compute, plus a verdict gate: euthyna history attributes deleted lines to commits and flags those from security fixes (--origins finds the first introducer), euthyna coverage reports which changed symbols no test ever invoked, and euthyna gate checks each finding against six gates, downgrading any without evidence to an observation.
description.zh: 面向 AI 编码代理的确定性安全审计事实与结论门禁：euthyna history 把每行被删代码归因到提交并标记安全修复类删除（--origins 追到最初引入者），euthyna coverage 报告哪些改动符号从未被测试调用，euthyna gate 用六道门禁逐条校验结论，拿不出证据的一律降级为观察。

description.en: Config-only DeepSeek Harness bundle that mounts the in-box MCP client bridge against morluto/rea over stdio, for reverse engineering anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
description.zh: 纯配置型 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用本体自带的 MCP 客户端桥，经 stdio 连接 morluto/rea，让 agent 从应用行为一路逆向到底层原生二进制。

description.en: Message and attachment editing with save-only updates, forked regeneration, and a version timeline for DSH desktop.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 桌面端的消息与附件编辑，支持原地保存、分支重生成和版本时间线。

description.en: Shows every session theme in the DSH Web left sidebar immediately on page load by warming the session projection cache at startup; no need to click into a conversation first.
description.zh: 打开页面时左侧边栏直接显示每个会话的主题，无需点进会话。启动时预热会话投影缓存，让冷会话也能显示真实标题。

description.en: Requires dsh >= 0.1.7 (session format 4); on dsh 0.1.5 use dsh-repeat-tool-breaker@0.7. Escalating repeat detection for dsh: a synchronous ctx.tools.guard gate that counts semantic fingerprints (exact/cmd/net/host/sink) over a per-agent sliding window, wa
description.zh: 在 DSH 里拦截同一智能体重复调用相同工具，第二次直接拒绝，防止死循环空转。

description.en: Git commit-and-push automation for DSH with pre-push auditing, rule-based quality scoring, SSH key generation, and a three-tab settings sidebar.
description.zh: DSH 的 git 提交推送自动化：提交前审计、规则质量评分、SSH 密钥生成与三选项卡设置侧边栏。

description.en: Adds subagent_route and subagent_fork_route delegation tools where the model itself picks the provider/model route for each child; the deployment only sets the spawn/fork backend, background policy and allowedProviders allowlist, while continuable children and background jobs reuse the official send_message / job_output tools.
description.zh: 新增 subagent_route 与 subagent_fork_route 委托工具：由模型自主为子代理挑选 provider/model 路由，部署方仅配置 spawn/fork 后端、调度策略与 allowedProviders 白名单；续聊子代理与后台任务复用官方 send_message / job_output 工具。

description.en: Context fullness bands, the per-session compaction threshold derived from the model window, per-step cost computed from cache read and cache write rates, cache-hit, DeepSeek balance with the peak/off-peak tariff, and a one-click handoff. It never calls a model and spends no tokens.
description.zh: 上下文占用档位、按模型窗口推算的每会话压缩阈值、按缓存读取/写入费率计算的单步费用、缓存命中率、DeepSeek 余额与高峰/低谷费率，以及一键交接。它从不调用模型，也不消耗 token。

description.en: Metaso (秘塔AI搜索) search & reader providers for the web seam: web_search returns page summaries, web_fetch reads full-page markdown, multi-scope search (webpage/document/paper/image/video/podcast).
description.zh: 秘塔AI搜索 providers for ctx.web：web_search 返回网页摘要，web_fetch 读取网页全文 markdown，多范围搜索（网页/文库/论文/图片/视频/播客）。

description.en: Plugin index inside DSH that lists over 10,000 third-party plugins checked against the dsh.bundle manifest in their package.json rather than by star count, with one-click install and a companion website.
description.zh: DSH 内的插件索引，收录 1 万余个按 package.json 里的 dsh.bundle 声明校验过的第三方插件（不按星数判定），支持一键安装，另有配套网站。

description.en: Incognito sessions: a standalone ephemeral sub-agent with its own preset (no parent context) and full toolset, draggable floating window, burned to zero traces on close.
description.zh: 无痕会话：独立临时子 Agent（独立 preset 不继承父会话、全量工具集），浮窗可拖动，关闭即焚毁、磁盘零痕迹。
