description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to a local SiYuan (思源笔记) desktop app: registers its note tools as mcp__siyuan__<tool>, exposes the AI configured in SiYuan together with its agent loop as one more tool, ships a notes skill, and enforces a readonly/authoring/full profile on every call while keeping the tool list available when the app is closed.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接到本机思源笔记桌面端：把笔记工具注册为 mcp__siyuan__<tool>，额外把思源里配置好的 AI 与其 agent 回路也做成一个工具（按档位门禁），附带笔记使用技能，并在每次调用上执行只读/创作/完整三级策略；思源关闭时工具列表依然可用。

description.en: Git worktrees for DeepSeek Harness — isolate parallel work in its own directory and branch. Ships Fast mode (快速模式).
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 管理 git worktree —— 让并行工作各自隔离在自己的目录与分支里。自带快速模式（Fast mode）。

description.en: Matches prompts to installed skills for automatic activation, applies skill-declared lifecycle hooks and tool policies, and manages GitHub-hosted skills from Settings or the skill_manager tool.
description.zh: 根据提示词自动激活已安装的 Skill，应用 Skill 声明的生命周期 Hook 与工具策略，并通过设置页或 skill_manager 工具管理 GitHub 托管的 Skill。

description.en: Built-in Obsidian-style knowledge base for DSH: agents distill conversations, documents and web sources into a structured .wiki graph, with retrieval, graph export, note editing, incremental builds and multi-vault management.
description.zh: DSH 内置版 Obsidian 知识库：agent 把对话、文档与网页蒸馏为结构化 .wiki 知识图，支持检索、图谱导出、笔记编辑、增量构建与多库管理。

description.en: Context trimmer: lists the current session's context entries with role, preview and ≈token estimate (cl100k), highlights over-threshold items, and removes selected entries exactly without LLM summarization.
description.zh: 上下文剃刀：把当前会话上下文逐条列出（角色/预览/≈token 估算），超阈值标红，勾选后不经 LLM 精确裁剪，删了什么一目了然。

description.en: Sidebar Git panel for the DSH web GUI: Local Changes and All Commits views, branch, tag and stash management with fetch, pull and push dialogs, merge with conflict handling, and a zsh-style branch marker in the input bar.
description.zh: DSH 网页端的侧栏 Git 面板：Local Changes 与 All Commits 视图，分支、标签与 Stash 管理，fetch、pull、push 弹窗，带冲突处理的合并，以及输入框上的 zsh 风格分支标记。

description.en: Yellow one-line notice for a prompt cache miss after the cache was rebuilt; shows re-billed uncached input tokens, cached hit tokens, and TTFT.
description.zh: 提示缓存未命中（cache miss）时，在重建缓存的 assistant 回复下方显示一条黄色缓存提示，展示未缓存（uncached）重新计费（re-billed）的输入 token、缓存命中 token 与首字延迟（TTFT）。

description.en: Manageable one-tap text chips above the session composer; idle sessions queue the message and running sessions steer at the next safe boundary without rewriting the draft.
description.zh: 在会话输入区上方提供可管理的一点即发文本 chip；空闲时 queue、运行中 steer，不改写草稿。

description.en: Tab autocomplete for the DeepSeek Harness desktop and web composer: next-message ghost text, inline draft completion, and Alt+Up/Alt+Down candidate cycling.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端与 Web 界面的输入框提供 Tab 自动补全：下一条消息的灰色幽灵文本、草稿行内续写，以及 Alt+Up/Alt+Down 切换候选。

description.en: Draggable bubble graph of DeepSeek Harness workspaces and sessions in the Web UI: workspaces are large bubbles, sessions are small ones, and lines show real membership. The canvas supports pan, zoom and fit; filters cover workspace, status, type and archive state; search covers workspace names, paths and session titles; native actions open or create sessions, rename workspaces, and archive or restore sessions. Layouts are saved in the browser.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面中的工作区与会话可拖动气泡图谱：大泡为工作区、小泡为会话，连线表示真实所属关系。画布支持平移、缩放与适应；筛选覆盖工作区、状态、类型和归档情况；搜索覆盖工作区名称、路径与会话标题；原生操作可打开或新建会话、重命名工作区、归档或恢复会话。布局保存在浏览器本地。

description.en: Reads and edits STEP models through FreeCAD, measures geometry (distance, angle, diameter), and generates first-angle 2D machining drawings with a hole table as SVG, DXF, PDF or PNG.
description.zh: 通过 FreeCAD 读写 STEP 模型、量取几何尺寸（距离、角度、直径），并生成带孔表的第一角法二维加工图，可导出 SVG、DXF、PDF、PNG。

description.en: An announcement file shared by several agent sessions on one machine. It is a plain text file the agents only append to; before each step a session receives the entries it has not seen yet, a new session catches up on the ones still in effect, and a session whose context was compacted gets them re-sent.
description.zh: 同一台电脑上多个会话共用的公告文件：一个只许追加的纯文本文件。每个会话在下一步之前收到自己还没见过的条目；新会话补看仍在有效期内的；上下文被压缩过的会话会收到一次重发。

description.en: Windows system-drive (C:) cleanup for DSH: rule-based scan, five-tier safety grading, a staging area with a rollback ledger, UAC elevation, and migration to another drive — a model tool plus a Web GUI panel.
description.zh: DSH 的 Windows 系统盘（C 盘）清理能力：按规则库扫描、五级安全分级、带台账可回滚的暂存区、UAC 提权与迁移到其他盘 —— 既有模型工具，也有 Web 面板。

description.en: Full-screen video boot splash — play an mp4 at startup, skip with a click, import your own clip, and non-playable codecs are transcoded to H.264 automatically.
description.zh: 视频开机片头：启动时全屏播放 mp4，点击或 Esc 跳过，可导入自己的视频，浏览器解不了的编码自动转成 H.264。

description.en: IDE-style run configurations for DSH: save LLM prompts and shell commands as reusable run configs (global or per-workspace), run them from the session header or the new-session page, and manage them via the task_run_config tool with approval-gated writes.
description.zh: DSH 的 IDE 风格运行配置：把常用 LLM 提示词和 Shell 命令保存为可复用的运行配置（全局或按工作区），在会话头部或新会话页一键运行，大模型可通过 task_run_config 工具管理（写操作走审批）。

description.en: Tobs (formerly DeepSeekBot): Team of bots, with persistent identity and memory on DeepSeek Harness. Legacy package and commands remain supported.

JetBrains-style IDE workbench in the DSH sidebar: Project file tree, Commit panel, Git history with a swimlane graph, a real PTY terminal and an embedded editor with Markdown preview and Find in Files, plus chat file links and send-to-chat references.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏里的 JetBrains 式 IDE 工作台：Project 文件树、Commit 面板、泳道图 Git 历史、真实 PTY 终端与内置编辑器（Markdown 预览、全项目查找），并支持聊天文件链接与发送到聊天框的 @ 引用。

description.en: Browser-first, LAN-only access to the current DeepSeek Harness Web UI with one-time QR pairing, revocable devices, event-driven diagnostics, and a slot-preserving mobile layout; no companion app, cloud relay, or remote tunnel.
description.zh: 以浏览器为核心、仅限局域网访问当前 DeepSeek Harness Web UI，支持一次性二维码配对、设备撤销、事件驱动诊断和保留插槽的移动端布局；无需配套应用、云中继或远程隧道。

description.en: Read web novels inside the DSH web GUI: import legado book sources, search across them, keep a bookshelf with reading progress, read in one continuous scroll, import local TXT and EPUB books, and let agent tools reach the same sources, shelf and text.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 里读网络小说：导入 legado 书源、跨源搜索、带进度的书架、连续滚动阅读、导入本地 TXT 与 EPUB，并让 AI 助手工具接到同一套书源、书架与正文上。

description.en: Task-scoped git worktrees for DSH: durable per-repo manifest, worktree mode injects a creation instruction with your first message under an automatic worktree/ branch prefix, header badge instead of workspace clutter, and bring-back or force-remove cleanup.
description.zh: 任务级 git worktree：per-repo manifest 持久保存；Worktree 模式在首条消息注入创建指引并统一 worktree/ 分支前缀，头部徽标替代工作区注册，支持带回主目录或强制删除收尾。

description.en: 把 agent-skills 的 git-kit Git 工作流、handoff 跨会话交接与 disk-cleanup 磁盘清理以 dsh 原生斜杠命令接入（薄意图表，委托对应 skill 执行）

Turns a plain-browser DSH session into the WhaleHarbor lite client: a standalone browser --app window with a client-style top bar and task notifications, while the full desktop installer downloads in the background (multi-source, SHA-256 verified) and an install prompt appears when ready.
description.zh: 把浏览器里的 DSH 会话变成鲸港简版客户端：独立 --app 窗口、客户端顶栏与任务通知；后台多源下载完整桌面安装包（SHA-256 校验），完成后提示安装。

description.en: Configurable image recognition for text-only DSH models: attached images are preserved through the DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 adapter pipeline, transcribed by an OpenAI-compatible vision model, and passed to the main model as text. Supports selectable OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or Azure auth headers and reports a missing API key before sending a request.
description.zh: 为纯文本 DSH 模型增加可配置识图能力：在 DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 中，上传图片会完整通过适配链路，由 OpenAI 兼容视觉模型转写为文字后交给主模型；支持 OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini / Azure 风格密钥鉴权，缺少 API Key 时会在发起请求前明确提示。

description.en: MCP server manager for DeepSeek Harness settings: add streamable-http or stdio servers, paste Postman-style headers, test connectivity, and toggle each tool so disabled ones never reach the model.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 工具管理器：在设置里添加 streamable-http/stdio 服务器、Postman 式请求头、连通性测试，并按工具开关——停用的工具不会进入模型。

description.en: Folio (兰亭) @nyantused/folio-dsh-events: session-protocol events — auto session-start reminder + auto-save on session close; pair with @nyantused/folio-dsh-tools.
description.zh: Folio（兰亭）@nyantused/folio-dsh-events：会话协议事件插件——新会话入口提醒 + 会话关闭自动 save；与 @nyantused/folio-dsh-tools 配套使用。

description.en: Data asset orchestration engine that chains suite tools into preset pipelines (masking, cleaning, inventory, packaging, attestation, AI dataset health check, government inspection, circulation assessment), with incremental and scheduled processing.
description.zh: 数据资产编排引擎，把套件内工具串成预置流水线（脱敏→清洗→盘点→封装、鉴证、AI数据集体检、政务巡检、可流通性评估），支持增量与定时处理

description.en: Category tree for the DSH sidebar workspace browser: workspaces and their sessions nest under user-made categories (collapsed state remembered), rows drag between categories, a new workspace can be created straight into one through the directory picker, categories rename and delete in place, sessions archive and unarchive from their own row (the built-in browser's stop-active-work confirmation included) alongside a hide / show / only-archived filter, row buttons carry the app's own hover tooltips, and a footer toggle switches the panel back to the built-in list.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏工作区浏览器的分类树：工作区与其会话挂到自建分类下（折叠状态记忆），行可在分类间拖拽，新建工作区可直接落进某个分类（走系统目录选择器），分类可原地重命名与删除，会话行可归档 / 取消归档（运行中的会话走官方同款「停止并归档」确认）并配隐藏 / 含归档 / 仅归档三态筛选，行内按钮悬停有应用自带样式的提示，底栏开关可把面板切回原生列表。

description.en: Moves an existing DeepSeek Harness conversation into another workspace from the sidebar menu: the transcript and title carry over, a new workspace folder can be registered in the same dialog, and the original session is archived and restorable.
description.zh: 从侧边栏菜单把已有的 DeepSeek Harness 会话移动到其他工作区：会话记录与标题一并带过去，可在同一对话框里登记新的工作区文件夹，原会话归档且可恢复。

description.en: Use subscription accounts as DeepSeek Harness LLM providers — Kimi Code (OAuth device flow), Grok / X Premium (OIDC + PKCE), Google Antigravity (Google OAuth + Cloud Code Assist) and GLM / BigModel (ZCode's browser sign-in) — with per-model visibility, dr
description.zh: 把 Kimi、Grok、Antigravity、GLM 的订阅账号接进 DSH 当模型用，扫码登录还能拖动排序自动切换。

description.en: Labnana image generation for DeepSeek Harness: text-to-image / image-to-image / precise editing with credits estimation, subscription balance and web settings UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Labnana 图片生成：文生图 / 图生图 / 精准编辑，含积分预估、余额查询与网页设置界面。

description.en: Official DeepSeek platform monitoring inside the provider card: a live balance chip left of the composer model name plus an expandable account-details panel with per-model monthly usage and a daily stacked chart.
description.zh: 在官方供应商卡片内实时监控 DeepSeek 余额与开放平台用量——输入框工具行模型名称左侧的余额 chip，可展开的账户明细面板含按模型用量与每日堆叠图表。

description.en: Folio (兰亭) @nyantused/folio-dsh-tools: 15 schema-validated tools (memory + quality gates) plus an L0 guard of the consulting document-generation engine; pair with @nyantused/folio-dsh-events for the full session protocol.
description.zh: Folio（兰亭）@nyantused/folio-dsh-tools：咨询/汇报材料生成引擎的 15 个 DSH 原生工具（记忆面 + 质量门禁）+ L0 守卫；与 @nyantused/folio-dsh-events 配套使用。

description.en: Plug/unplug any DeepSeek Harness plugin cleanly — list every mounted layer (bundles + patch rows), remove with full cleanup, disable/enable without deleting, and audit for orphaned/dangling state. CLI + agent-callable unplug tool. Read-only by default; destructive operations require explicit confirmation.
description.zh: 让 DSH 插件的安装和卸载干净利落——列出所有加载层（Bundle + 补丁行）、完整卸载（清理 Bundle 列表+补丁行+依赖）、临时禁用以调试而不真正删除、以及审计残留的孤立行或悬空引用。CLI 与 agent 均可调用，默认只读，破坏性操作需二次确认。

description.en: Lets the model trigger compaction itself at a safe point via a compact_now tool (works mid-turn), plus a context_status tool reporting real token usage against the session's actual context window.
description.zh: 让模型自己挑安全时机触发压缩：提供 compact_now 工具（回合进行中也能用），另有 context_status 工具，按会话真实的上下文窗口报告 token 占用。

description.en: Configures forward proxies per enabled provider in Settings (HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5), keeping unconfigured providers and other traffic direct.
description.zh: 在设置里为每个已启用的 provider 单独配置正向代理（HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5），未配置的 provider 与其它流量保持直连。

description.en: JARVIS-style sci-fi HUD shell over the DSH web GUI: electric-cyan VITAL SIGNS / RT-MONITOR / RT-LOG left bar, POWER CORE gauges and a rotating RADAR scan disc on the right with up/down traffic chart, filesystem browser with file preview, and a terminal-styled composer with a JARVIS header strip that follows the active workspace.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面上叠加 JARVIS 风格科幻 HUD 外壳：电光青色 VITAL SIGNS 生命体征 / RT-MONITOR 实时监控 / RT-LOG 事件日志左栏，右侧 POWER CORE 能源核心仪表、旋转扫描的 RADAR 雷达盘与上下行流量图，左下文件系统浏览器（带文件预览），以及带 JARVIS 头部横幅、跟随当前工作区的终端风格输入框。

description.en: Launches the local compound-memory MCP server through uvx and injects a short usage reminder once per session.
description.zh: 通过 uvx 启动本地 compound-memory MCP server，并在每个会话注入一次简短的使用提醒。

description.en: Command Code balance and quota panel: a status row under the composer showing the available balance and the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows.
description.zh: Command Code 余额与额度面板：在输入框下方显示可用余额，以及 5 小时、每周、每月三个额度窗口。

description.en: Process management: brings ntd-style processes (multi-stage, multi-step agent workflow templates) into the dsh web UI — browse, edit, validate, import/export and AI-generate processes; the built-in library is read-only while the personal library is writable with live file sync, and agents read the library through process_* tools and advance work stage by stage.
description.zh: 工艺管理：把 ntd 的「工艺」（多阶段·多环节 agent 工作流模板）接进 dsh web——浏览/编辑/校验/导入导出/AI 生成工艺，内置库只读、我的库可写，文件改动实时同步；agent 可通过 process_* 工具读工艺库、按工艺分阶段推进。

description.en: Bing-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: prefers Bing's RSS feed with the public cn.bing.com HTML page as fallback, no API key, reachable from mainland China, and keeps searches off the model's own search quota. Endpoint, result count and result language configurable; targets DSH 0.2.x (also works on 0.1.7+).
description.zh: 为内置 web_search 工具提供 Bing 搜索源：优先解析 Bing 的 RSS 输出，以 cn.bing.com 公开 HTML 结果页作为兜底，无需 API Key，国内可直连，搜索不再消耗模型自带的搜索额度。端点、结果数量与结果语言可配置；适配 DSH 0.2.x（0.1.7+ 亦可用）。

description.en: User-only instruction memory for DSH: long-term instructions maintained in the settings UI and auto-injected into every conversation — the model has no write access. 指令记忆：只由用户在设置页维护的长期指令，自动注入此后每轮对话；模型没有任何写入口。
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置界面维护常驻指令，自动注入此后每一轮对话的系统提示词。

description.en: Render interactive diagrams, charts and staged learning visuals alongside native prose in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中结合正文呈现交互图形、图表与分阶段学习演示。

description.en: Turns a local Obsidian vault into a dedicated RAG chat panel: a sidebar page with the note browser, the retrieval-augmented chat and the cited source side by side, answering from fully local BM25 plus CJK-bigram retrieval over your notes and streaming through the DSH model channel, with clickable \[n] citations and mtime-based incremental indexing.
description.zh: 把本地 Obsidian 仓库变成专属 RAG 对话面板：侧栏一个完整页面，左侧笔记浏览、中间检索增强对话、右侧引用原文；检索用完全本地的 BM25 加中文 bigram，回答走 DSH 模型通道，\[n] 引用可点击，索引按 mtime 增量更新。

description.en: One-click standalone two-column code review page for Git diffs in the conversation: line numbers, add/delete coloring, character-level highlight, hunk-aware per-file sections, a file nav sidebar and a stats bar; line comments submit back to the DSH composer, and the UI follows the DSH locale.
description.zh: 把对话里的 git diff 一键打开为独立标签页的双列代码评审页：行号、增删配色、字符级高亮、hunk 感知的多文件分段、文件导航侧栏与统计条，行内评论可提交回 DSH 对话框，界面跟随 DSH 语言（中英）。

description.en: Always-on ADHD-friendly output shaping: one system-prompt section makes replies action-first with numbered steps and concrete time estimates; adhd_on / adhd_off / adhd_status tools persist the mode across restarts.
description.zh: 常驻的 ADHD 友好输出塑形：一个系统提示词区段让回复行动先行、步骤编号、时间估算具体；adhd_on / adhd_off / adhd_status 三个工具让模式跨重启保持。

description.en: Registers a `deepseek-web` provider that drives your own signed-in chat.deepseek.com account as an extra model in DSH, so no Open Platform API key is needed: the sidebar footer lists your Web conversations, Fork to Workspace opens an independent Harness session that never writes back to the original conversation, native search stays on for the `default` model, and `/clean` is a session toggle that sends only the human text. Fork of y-wi/dsh-deepseek-web, kept working on DSH 0.2.1-alpha.2: the peer ranges are widened so the compatibility gate no longer rejects the whole bundle, the removed settings API is replaced with `ctx.settings.configure()` plus `.volatile()` config fields, the renamed client icons are updated, and an upstream SSE error now surfaces as a real error instead of an empty message that poisoned the session history. The fork also repairs what the rename to `-free` left behind: the session-list route used to derive its suffix from a hard-coded length inherited from the old package name, which had turned every conversation request into a 404 while sign-in still worked; and the sidebar conversation panel now paints on an opaque surface token instead of the host's translucent menu token, which only reads as a menu beside the backdrop blur a body-mounted panel cannot install.
description.zh: 把你已登录的 chat.deepseek.com 账号当作额外模型接入 DSH：注册 `deepseek-web` provider，无需 Open Platform API key；侧边栏底部列出你的网页端会话，「Fork to Workspace」会开一个独立的 Harness 会话、不回写原对话，`default` 模型保持网页端原生搜索，`/clean` 是只发送人类文本的会话开关。本包是 y-wi/dsh-deepseek-web 的 fork，已适配 DSH 0.2.1-alpha.2：放宽 peer 范围以免被兼容性门禁整包拒绝、用 `ctx.settings.configure()` 与配置字段 `.volatile()` 替代被移除的 settings API、更新已改名的客户端图标、并让上游 SSE 错误直接报错（不再返回空消息污染会话历史）。此外还修掉了改名为 `-free` 后遗留的两处问题：会话列表路由原先按旧包名继承下来的硬编码长度切分路径，导致登录正常但每个会话请求都返回 404；侧边栏会话浮层原先用宿主的半透明菜单色，而该色只有配合磨砂背景才像菜单、挂到 body 上的面板无法安装磨砂，现已改用不透明表面色。

description.en: Drive local Origin/OriginPro from chat via 27 MCP tools: import .dat/.csv/.txt and CHI workstation .bin files, plot, style, fit, and deliver PNG/TIF/SVG/PDF plus an editable .opju project, with read-back verification on plots, styles and exports. Requires Windows, Origin/OriginPro 2021+ and Python 3.10+, plus `pip install originpro numpy` into the interpreter dsh launches: without the package every tool answers `missing_originpro`, and without an interpreter on PATH no tools register at all.
description.zh: 通过 27 个 MCP 工具在对话里驱动本机 Origin/OriginPro：导入 .dat/.csv/.txt 与 CHI 工作站 .bin，绘图、改样式、拟合，交付 PNG/TIF/SVG/PDF 图片和可继续编辑的 .opju 工程；绘图、样式、导出都带读回验证。需要 Windows、Origin/OriginPro 2021+ 与 Python 3.10+，并把 `pip install originpro numpy` 装进 dsh 启动的那个解释器：缺包时每个工具都会返回 `missing_originpro`，PATH 上没有解释器时工具完全不注册。

description.en: Shell-style prompt history in the DSH composer: ↑ in an empty composer recalls the previous prompt and keeps walking back, ↓ walks forward to the empty draft; history is kept per workspace, persisted across restarts and records only human input, while typing or editing a draft returns ↑/↓ to normal caret movement. Adds a Settings page to export, import and clear the history.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框里提供 shell 风格的提示词历史：空输入框按 ↑ 取回上一条并继续向前翻，按 ↓ 向后回到空草稿；历史按工作区隔离、落盘并在重启后保留，且只记录人工输入，一旦手动输入或编辑草稿，↑/↓ 就恢复为正常的光标移动。另提供设置页可导出、导入和清空历史。

description.en: Native desktop notifications for DSH — approvals, questions, turn completion, session end and errors — with click-to-session, per-event toggles, quiet hours, a privacy switch that keeps message text off the banner, and a Web Audio tone per event type.
description.zh: DSH 桌面通知：审批、提问、轮次完成、会话结束与出错时弹系统原生通知，点击直达对应会话；六类事件分别开关，支持免打扰时段与隐藏正文的隐私开关，并按事件类型合成提示音。

description.en: 查看远程主机连接状态并管理 Claude/Codex 登录。
DSH 会话回收站：会话详情归档入口、回收站多选还原/彻底删除、活跃会话保护。 · Session trash & permanent delete for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给会话加个回收站，当前会话一键移入，误删的能恢复，不要的也能彻底删掉。

description.en: Pulls GitHub repo content into DSH conversations at start and writes extracted long-term memory back with SHA-locked multi-file commits at conversation end; per-file read/write permissions, native settings page, turn indicators and global change notices.
description.zh: 对话开始时自动拉取 GitHub 仓库内容注入上下文，对话结束时提取长期记忆按文件写回并提交；文件权限中心、原生设置页、回合写回指示与全局变动提示。

description.en: Plays a short synthesized ding in the browser tab the moment an agent finishes a turn, built entirely with the Web Audio API; no backend audio and no OS notification.
description.zh: agent 回合结束时在浏览器标签页里播放一声合成的叮,纯前端 Web Audio 发音,不经过后端、不弹系统通知。

description.en: Hyperliquid trading desk for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) - market workspace, native agent conversation, guarded live / paper trading and an autonomous watch-loop over the Hyperliquid API.

Queries PRTS Wiki for Arknights operators, items, stages, story pages and worldbook entries, and predicts unreleased characters, alters and banner schedules from story-cast statistics and banner history.
description.zh: 查询 PRTS Wiki 的《明日方舟》干员、物品、关卡、剧情与泰拉大典世界观条目，并基于剧情卡司统计与卡池历史预测未实装角色、异格与卡池排期。

description.en: English word bank for one or more children, built for DSH 0.2 and newer (0.2.0-rc.1 and 0.2.0-rc.2 verified, including the desktop shell; 0.1.7 through 0.2.x all work). 1.10 added pronunciation: in the memory cards and in the online quiz every word and every example sentence has a speaker button that reads it aloud with the built-in Windows voice - offline, with no network call and no model call - and the whole batch of audio is pre-rendered in the background whenever cards or an exam are generated, so a click starts instantly. 1.11 adds: pick words in bulk straight from the library (10 at a time, top-down, up to 50 selected, with a live counter); turn the words a child got wrong in a quiz into a one-click review set - an online card page that speaks plus a printable PDF; and every card example sentence now carries its Chinese translation underneath. Words marked on textbook or workbook photos (highlighter, red pen) are found by their marks, then translated and stored in a local SQLite bank with an occurrence count; the clipboard picker, the photo route and dictation all land in the same bank. High-frequency words surface by count, three correct answers in a row flag a word as learned, and any selection prints as a memory card set (a word split into chunks, real IPA per chunk, a grade-7 example sentence, a mnemonic hook, an A4 sheet of eight) in HTML, PDF or Word, with a print-and-answer exam page whose four options are set against each other for meaning. On 0.1.5 the settings panel does not appear - install dsh-word-vault@1.0.2 instead.
description.zh: 一个或多个孩子的英语生词库，面向 DSH 0.2 及以上（0.2.0-rc.1 / 0.2.0-rc.2 实测通过，含桌面版 GUI；0.1.7 ~ 0.2.x 均可使用）。1.10 新增语音发音：记忆卡与在线答题页里，每个单词、每句例句旁都有一个 🔊，点了用 Windows 自带语音朗读——离线、不联网、不调模型；出卡/出卷时还会在后台把整批音频预先合成好，点击即秒开。1.11 新增：词库页一键批量选词（每次 +10 个、从上往下、最多同时 50 个，带实时计数）；考试做错的词可一键出成「能发音的在线复习卡」（在线点读页 + 可打印 PDF）；卡面英文例句下方带中文对照。课本/作业照片上被荧光笔或红笔标出的词按标记找出来，翻译后进本机 SQLite，并累计出现次数；剪贴板点选、拍照、对话三种录入进的是同一本库。高频词按次数浮现，连对三次自动标记「已学会」；勾选任意若干词可出记忆卡（拆解块 + 每块真实 IPA 音标 + 7 年级英文例句 + 荒诞梗，A4 每页 8 张），输出 HTML/PDF/Word，并可出一份四选项按词义互斥的打印试卷作答。在 0.1.5 上设置面板不会出现，可改装 dsh-word-vault@1.0.2。

description.en: Add missing reasoning-effort declarations to custom pi-ai models through DSH settings, enabling the native effort picker and handling models added later.
description.zh: 通过 DSH 设置为自定义 pi-ai 模型补充缺失的推理强度声明，启用原生强度选择器，并自动处理后续添加的模型。

description.en: Desktop notifications for DSH: a system toast, a per-kind chime and a tab-title marker when the agent needs you (approval, plan review, question) or a reply finishes in the background; errors, interrupts, usage limits and multi-agent workflow progress alert too. A host half adds SSE delivery, webhook push (WeCom/Feishu/DingTalk/generic), per-turn token/cache/TPS stats, plus three message-format presets (concise, detailed, custom); settings changes auto-save.
description.zh: DSH 桌面消息提醒：模型需要你操作（审批、方案确认、提问）或后台回复完成时，弹系统通知、提示音并标记标签页标题；出错、中断、用量上限与多 agent 工作流进展同样提醒。宿主半提供 SSE 投递、Webhook 推送（企业微信 / 飞书 / 钉钉 / 通用）与当轮统计（token / 缓存 / TPS），以及三档消息格式（简洁 / 详细 / 自定义）与自动保存。

description.en: Customize the username (phone number or email) and avatar shown at the bottom-left account row — for personalization, or to keep screenshots from exposing them. The editor opens from the menu you get by clicking that row.
description.zh: 自定义左下角账号处的用户名（手机号/邮箱）和头像，从而提升个性化或避免截图泄露隐私。编辑入口位于点击此处的菜单内。

description.en: Element-level PowerPoint canvas that edits the opened .pptx in place: click, marquee-select or pick a whole slide, describe the change, and the AI writes byte-preserving OOXML patches with undo and redo.
description.zh: 元素级 PPT 画布，就地改写已打开的 .pptx：点选、框选或整页选中后用自然语言描述改动，AI 以字节保真的 OOXML 补丁写入，支持撤销与重做。

description.en: Archived-session manager for DeepSeek Harness: grouped archive panel with restore and delete.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话归档管理：分组归档面板，支持恢复与删除。

description.en: DSH plugin for background security audits, secret leakage detection, and command safety
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的后台安全审计器：扫描 Agent 输出中的秘密泄漏，在执行前检查命令安全性，并将发现记录到持久化审计日志中。

description.en: DSH 远程目录（电脑端 + 手机端合一）：把电脑上 DSH 会话的事件流经 Cloudflare Quick Tunnel 搬到手机，手机进入电脑目录并发起对话，公网只传文本。含激活码配对与自动重连。安装这一个包，桌面与手机两端同时就位。

Adds hover Recall / Delete / Delete-onward actions to every message row: removes content from the model context and the transcript together via durable append-only tombstones, with an empty-content guard so old deletions can never break strict providers. Tested on the DSH 2.0 desktop.
description.zh: 给会话里的每条消息加上「撤回 / 删除 / 删除此处及之后」悬浮按钮：以 append-only 墓碑让内容同时从模型上下文与对话界面消失，带空内容兜底，旧删除不会打回严格校验的 provider。已实测支持 DSH 2.0 桌面版。

description.en: Live btop-style CPU/memory/temperature/GPU monitor tab for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的实时监控标签页，以 btop 风格展示 CPU／内存／温度／GPU。

description.en: AI dataset quality inspector for annotation consistency, class distribution bias and data leakage detection.
description.zh: AI数据集质量巡检工具，自动检测数据集中的标注一致性、类别分布偏差与数据泄露风险。

description.en: Lighten the load on your agent: one-click toggles for skills and MCP, so the context holds only what this turn actually needs. Skills and MCP servers you switch off are no longer injected into the model context — cleaner, and lighter on tokens.
description.zh: 给你的 Agent 减负：Skill 与 MCP 一键启停，让上下文只装这一轮真正要用的能力。关掉的 skill / MCP 不再进入模型上下文，更干净，更省 token。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: restart without losing work. It waits until every conversation is idle, restarts the host, and picks the interrupted work back up instead of dying with it. Every restart is preceded by a snapshot of the configuration and the installed plugins; if the host does not come up, a one-shot watchdog restores that snapshot, starts the host once more, and records the outcome. Where a supervisor already manages the host it asks that supervisor instead of starting a second one. When the work is done it counts down and powers the machine off. It works on the Windows desktop client and on a hosted dsh web instance (Windows, WSL, Linux).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：重启不丢工作——等所有对话空闲后自动重启，重启后接着干活，不中断。每次重启前自动备份配置和已装插件；宿主起不来时，由一次性看门狗自动还原这份备份、再拉起一次，并把结果记录下来。已有守护的机器交给守护重启，绝不双开。所有工作完成后倒数关机，晚上无需人值守。桌面客户端与 dsh web 托管端（Windows / WSL / Linux）都通用。

description.en: Manage skills and MCP servers from one DSH settings panel. Skills are read from disk: browse, search, preview the body, create, rename and delete, with a backup written before every removal. Global MCP servers are the real cordis.patch.yml loader rows; per-project entries mount only for sessions in that project. Each expanded card lists the tools that server actually registered, and a per-server allow/deny rule keeps only the ones you need — a blocked tool never enters the tool registry, so it costs no context on every turn. Every MCP card carries a connection status tag (connected with a tool count, retrying, gave up, activation failed) plus a one-click reconnect, so a server that fails at startup is visible instead of silently missing its tools. Imports existing configs from 26 other MCP clients.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置面板里一站式管理技能与 MCP 服务器。技能以磁盘为准：浏览、搜索、预览正文、新建、重命名、删除，删除前自动写一份备份。全局 MCP 就是 cordis.patch.yml 里的真实 Loader 行，项目级条目只挂到对应项目的会话。展开卡片会列出该服务器实际注册的工具，并可只保留需要的那些——被挡下的工具不进工具注册表，因此不占用每一轮的上下文。每张卡片带连接状态标签（已连接并显示工具数 / 重试中 / 已放弃重试 / 激活失败）与一键重连，让启动时连不上、工具悄悄消失的服务器看得见。另可从 26 个 MCP 客户端导入既有配置。

description.en: 0.8.6 fixes a startup crash: the host runtime package is an optional peer, never an installed dependency. TypeSafe Jev (System One decision model) wired end to end into DeepSeek Harness (0.8.6). Seven tools: jev_decision (1-25 parallel atomic verdicts in one call; noul/choice/score; typed answers with calibrated confidence; measured median 266-484 ms; verdicts only, never prose), jev_choose (rank 2-10 candidate approaches - fit 0-3 and risk - into an explicit composite with a recommended pick), jev_batch (NEW in 0.8.6: one set of 1-5 judgments over 1-20 texts, one real call per text at bounded concurrency, returning a paste-ready markdown table sortable by a judged dimension; built-in sentiment/priority/intent/pii/spam presets; a failed row is reported as failed with the raw error, never guessed), jev_usage (locally measured usage: calls, tokens, estimated cost, latency median and p95, per-tool mix, rolling windows, projected burn rate, optional local hard budgets, and a declared-balance remainder), jev_overview (session ledger), jev_guard_status (guard counters plus a registrations block that surfaces per-surface registration failures) and jev_verify (frozen 27-question live benchmark at concurrency 6: 96.3%, 26/27). WHAT IS NEW IN 0.8.6 - the ledger survives a restart, the remainder is derived instead of invented, and the plugin can now do batch paperwork. (1) The local ledger persists to $DSH_HOME/jev-usage.json BY DEFAULT, so the cumulative total no longer resets when the host restarts. Two real bugs behind the old silent zero were found and fixed: the ledger path only honoured DSH_HOME (absent inside the host process, so persistence was silently disabled and the file name was null), and save() wrote the still-empty in-memory ring over the history file because it ran before the first load while the debounce window swallowed the follow-up write. (2) Remaining is derived, never invented: TypeSafe exposes no balance endpoint - /v1/usage, /v1/quota, /v1/account, /v1/account/balance, /v1/balance, /v1/credits, /v1/billing, /v1/me, /v1/limits and a dozen more all return 404, and only /v1/models answers, with no balance headers - so the panel shows the remainder as your declared balance (quota.declaredBalanceUsd) minus locally measured spend since quota.balanceSince, and says plainly that it cannot be fetched instead of printing a number. (3) The composer pill re-reads every 20 s instead of every 60 s, so a call you just made shows up while you are still looking at it. (4) The collapsed pill leads with the remainder once you declare a balance, and the cumulative row is renamed when the ledger is on disk. Every tool has an in-conversation structured view; the Settings > Plugins card covers credentials, tool switches, the auto-guard, the dashboard, the prompt section, usage/quota and auto-triage. Honest by design: no API key means an explicit error, never fabricated results; every registration is quarantined so a failure degrades one surface. Tests 38/38 (npm test, ~2.5 s). Client half applies on refresh; server half needs a host restart.
description.zh: 0.8.6 修复了一个会让宿主起不来的依赖问题（宿主运行时包改为 optional peer，永不被安装）。为 DeepSeek Harness 端到端接入 TypeSafe Jev（System One 决策模型）0.8.6。共七个工具：jev_decision（一次并行完成 1-25 个原子判定；noul/choice/score；返回类型化答案与校准置信度；实测中位 266-484 ms；只出判定不写文本）、jev_choose（对 2-10 个候选并行打分——契合度 0-3 与风险——合成综合分并给推荐，只给分不解释）、jev_batch（0.8.6 新增：一次调用对 1-20 条文本跑同一组 1-5 个判定，每条文本一次真实调用、并发有上限，返回可直接粘贴的 markdown 表格并可按某个判定维度排序；内置 sentiment/priority/intent/pii/spam 预设；失败的行如实标为失败并附原文错误，绝不猜测）、jev_usage（本机实测用量：调用、tokens、估算成本、延迟中位与 p95、按工具分布、滚动窗口、全天用量预测、可选的本地硬预算，以及自报余额推算出的剩余）、jev_overview（会话账本）、jev_guard_status（护栏计数，并用 registrations 暴露分面注册失败）与 jev_verify（对线上 API 6 路并发运行冻结的 27 题基准：96.3%，26/27）。0.8.6 的三件事：账本扛得住重启、剩余是算出来的而不是编出来的、插件开始干批量整理的活。 （1）本地账本默认写入 $DSH_HOME/jev-usage.json，宿主重启后累计不再清零。此前「明明有调用、面板却是 0」背后是两个真 bug：账本路径只认 DSH_HOME（宿主进程里没有这个变量，于是持久化被静默关闭、file 为 null），以及 save() 在首次 load 之前执行，把尚未载入的空内存环覆盖写到了历史文件上，而紧随其后的那次保存又被节流窗口吞掉。 （2）剩余只推算、不编造：TypeSafe 没有任何余额接口——/v1/usage、/v1/quota、/v1/account、/v1/account/balance、/v1/balance、/v1/credits、/v1/billing、/v1/me、/v1/limits 等十几个路径全部 404，只有 /v1/models 有响应且响应头没有任何余额字段——因此面板把「剩余」显示为你在 quota.declaredBalanceUsd 自报的余额减去 quota.balanceSince 起的本机实测花费，没自报时明确写「剩余无法显示」，绝不印一个数字。 （3）输入框胶囊的刷新周期从 60 秒改为 20 秒，刚跑完的调用不用等就能看到。 （4）自报余额后，折叠胶囊以「剩余」为首，账本落盘后累计行改名。每个工具都有对话内结构化视图；「设置 → 插件」卡片覆盖凭据、工具开关、自动护栏、看板、引导段、使用额度与 autoTriage。 诚实设计：未配置 Key 时给出明确报错、绝不伪造结果；任何分面注册失败都被隔离，只降级一个功能。 测试 38/38（npm test，约 2.5 s）。客户端部分刷新页面即生效；服务端部分需重启宿主。

description.en: Reformats dsh session titles as "date | type | topic" (type and topic are summarized by a model from the full conversation), and hides unused sessions from the sidebar without deleting them.
description.zh: 把 dsh 会话标题统一成「日期｜类型｜主题」（类型与主题由模型对整段对话总结），并支持可逆的会话隐藏：暂时不用的会话从侧边栏收起，不删除、随时一键显示回来。

description.en: AI companion with a learned body clock, real offline sleep, its own memory, and self-reported affect delivered through the same judge math as the pi version.
description.zh: 有生物钟、会真实睡觉、有自己的记忆和情绪的 AI 伴侣，主动冲动以独立 turn 投递。

description.en: Requires DSH 0.1.5-rc.1. Mobile UI fixes for the dsh web profile: narrow-screen drawer and settings tabs, a full-width model menu, a stuck-request network chip, and a narrow-header collector that folds the lineage, subagent and background-job chips into one tappable sheet.
description.zh: 需要 DSH 0.1.5-rc.1。dsh web profile 的手机端体验修复：窄屏抽屉与设置标签、全宽模型菜单、卡住请求的网络状态芯片，以及把会话层级、subagent 与后台任务芯片收进一张可点开面板的窄屏头部收纳器。

description.en: Adds a sidebar tab that folds a session into user turns (input, tool steps, output) with one-click jump back into the conversation.
description.zh: 在侧边栏按用户轮次折叠会话（输入、工具步骤、输出），一键跳回对话原位。

description.en: Scheduled task dispatcher: a dsh host plugin that drives recurring agent tasks from a single task table, dispatching each run as an independent dsh session; scheduling is pure logic and uses zero model calls.
description.zh: 定时任务调度器：一张任务表驱动周期性运行的 agent 任务，每次调度为一个独立的 dsh 会话；调度本身纯逻辑实现，不消耗任何模型调用。

description.en: Automatic Flash/Pro routing for DeepSeek Harness subagent calls: light tasks run on a cheap model (e.g. V4 Flash), heavy tasks stay on the strong model — with per-call overrides and /delegate session modes.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的子代理调用做 Flash/Pro 自动分派：轻任务自动用便宜模型、重任务留在强模型，支持手动覆盖与 /delegate 会话模式。

description.en: Notepad — a per-workspace floating notepad in the DeepSeek Harness session view with a dedicated settings tab (themes that also color the settings page, flat / frosted-glass surfaces, fonts, save mode, AI prompt presets with a read-only preset preview, bu
description.zh: 在会话界面放一张当前工作区的便签浮窗，随手记问题和下一步，一键插入对话框。

description.en: Host-only command safety gate for DeepSeek Harness: blocks recognized dangerous operations and requests DSH approval when a command cannot be inspected.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一道命令审批关卡，危险命令执行前先拦下来让你确认。

description.en: Make development more fun. A subtle layer of motion for DeepSeek Harness, with customizable effects and reduced-motion support.
description.zh: 让开发，有趣一点。为 DeepSeek Harness 添一层恰到好处的动效，支持效果调整并跟随系统「减少动态效果」。

description.en: Three independent language channels for model output — tool-call descriptions (every tool-call card title, including run_code in PTC-style presets), thinking, and replies — each set to follow the web GUI language, force a specific language, or turn off (default: only descriptions, following the GUI). One global runtime-context prompt directive on the host; the client half reports the GUI language; a Settings plugin card switches the modes.
description.zh: 模型产出文本的三个语言通道——工具调用描述（所有工具调用卡片标题，含 PTC 类预设的 run_code）、思考与回复——各自可跟随网页界面语言、强制指定语言或关闭（默认仅描述通道跟随界面语言）。host 侧注入一条全局 runtime-context 提示指示，client 半上报界面语言，设置里的插件卡片负责切换。

description.en: Model attribution panel for the dsh web chat — local, zero-network structural fingerprinting (template token leaks, glitch canaries, tokenizer usage-vector matching) that scores which of 29 AI vendors a session's responses most resemble, with a per-claim evidence ledger and a 12-probe active battery.
description.zh: 在 dsh 网页端挂载模型归属面板，用纯本地、零联网的结构指纹匹配（模板特殊 token 泄漏、glitch 金丝雀、tokenizer usage 向量比对）判断当前会话的回答最像 29 家 AI 厂商中的哪一家，每个结论附带可展开的证据账本，另附 12 探针主动取证电池。

description.en: Automated data masking tool based on national standards, automatically identifying sensitive fields like ID cards and phone numbers.
description.zh: 基于国家标准的自动化数据脱敏工具，自动识别身份证、手机号等敏感字段，支持完全匿名化与假名化分级策略，生成合规审计日志。

description.en: Plugin that turns a XiaoAI (Xiaomi) smart speaker into a voice assistant: hosts the local bridge process, listens for the wake word, runs speech recognition (ASR / STT) on what you say, keeps the conversation in the host session, and speaks the answer back through the speaker with text-to-speech (TTS) playback.
description.zh: 把小爱音箱（小爱同学 / 小米智能音箱）接成语音助手的插件：托管本地桥接器进程，听到唤醒词就收音、做语音识别（ASR / STT），把对话交给 DSH 会话，再用语音合成（TTS）把答案念回音箱播报。

description.en: Replaces the reasoning-effort dropdown with a draggable snapping slider, and draws 13 canvas effects across five style families (thrust, fluid, fantasy, tech, texture) with three tiers that unlock as the effort level rises. Custom mode combines 10 particle forms with 8 flow trajectories; 9 accent presets and a hex picker recolor every effect, and optional key sounds cover two voice clips, a synthesized duck squeak, a mechanical click and a local audio file.
description.zh: 把推理强度下拉菜单换成可拖拽吸附的滑块，并提供 13 款 Canvas 动效，分属推进、流体、幻境、科技、质感五个家族；动效随推理档位分三阶递进解锁。客制动效可自由组合 10 种粒子形态与 8 种流动轨迹；9 款预设主题色与 Hex 拾色器让全部动效跟随变色，档位吸附音效支持两段语音、合成鸭子叫、机械微触感与本地音频文件。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that lets you control Universal Robots (UR) collaborative arms directly from natural language — by default an offline, kinematics-level simulated arm, with a real-robot channel that stays off until it is explicitly enabled. Needs a Python install with numpy and paramiko (pip install -r requirements.txt). Developed by Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd. based on the same logic as the company's own nUR MCP Server. (Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd.)
description.zh: 让 DSH 用自然语言直接控制 Universal Robots（UR）协作机械臂的插件——默认是一台离线、运动学级的仿真机械臂，真机通道在显式开启前始终关闭。需本机 Python 并 pip install -r requirements.txt（numpy、paramiko）。由拓德科技（Nonead）基于自研 nUR MCP Server 的同源逻辑开发。（Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd.）

description.en: Voice call assistant for the DSH desktop app and the Web GUI (the same plugin, only the profile name differs): a draggable floating call ball, browser-side VAD that sends each utterance after a pause, speech recognition through the local SenseVoice model already downloaded by the official voice-input plugin (no second model), FunASR HTTP or streaming, or a cloud-compatible API, MiniMax / MiMo-V2.5-TTS (director mode and voice clone) / OpenAI-compatible TTS replies, an optional wake-word mode with auto-sleep, and task dispatch to separate sessions with progress, stop, and spoken completion reports.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端与 Web GUI 通用（同一份插件，只是 profile 名不同）的个人语音通话助手：可拖拽悬浮球通话面板、浏览器端 VAD（停顿自动发送）、语音识别可选本地 SenseVoice（复用官方「语音输入」插件已下载的模型，免装第二份模型）/ FunASR HTTP 或流式 / 云端兼容 API、MiniMax / MiMo-V2.5-TTS（含导演模式与音色克隆）/ OpenAI 兼容 TTS 语音回复、可开关的唤醒词模式（沉默自动休眠），以及把任务分发给独立子会话并跟踪进度、停止与完成播报。

description.en: Four-palette pixel-art skin for DSH Web (wood, parchment, warm, terminal green) with a bundled CJK pixel font served by the plugin's own host route, and a flat, shadow-free look.
description.zh: 四套配色的像素风 DSH Web 皮肤（木屋/羊皮纸/暖阳/终端绿）；中文像素字体由插件自身的 host 路由发货；完全平面、无阴影。

description.en: Generates editable PPTX decks in DSH with a bundled authoring Skill, deterministic PPTD scene checks, native PowerPoint objects, and local PPTD source-project delivery.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中使用包内编排 Skill、确定性 PPTD 场景检查和原生 PowerPoint 对象生成可编辑 PPTX，并在本地交付 PPTD 源项目。

description.en: Data sensitivity classification plugin that auto-identifies sensitive fields and classifies them into high/medium/low/public levels.
description.zh: 数据敏感度分类插件 — 自动识别敏感字段+分级（高/中/低/公开）

description.en: Data cleaning plugin for deduplication, format standardization and anomaly detection.
description.zh: 数据清洗插件 — 去重+格式标准化+异常值检测

description.en: Personal paste inbox for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): /inbox in the composer or the sidebar panel files links, images, text and credentials into a local vault, classifies them by local rules and then by a rate-capped model pass, and browses, searches and edits them from the panel; the assistant retrieves records on request in conversation, credential bodies stay encrypted at rest, and an optional WebDAV or S3 remote syncs records and attachment bytes. Windows only so far.
description.zh: dsh 的个人收件箱：输入框的 /inbox 或侧栏面板把链接、图片、文本与账密收进本地仓库，先按本地规则、再由有每日上限的模型分类，可在面板里筛选、搜索与编辑；对话里让助手按需检索取回，账密正文加密落盘，可选 WebDAV 或 S3 远端同步记录与附件字节。目前只在 Windows 实测。

description.en: Branch and worktree management for DeepSeek Harness: the workspace toolbar shows the current branch with in-place switching, plus an IDEA-style branch selector, remote branch checkout, context menus (create, rename, delete, copy), push and update, and branch isolation into standalone worktrees with managed creation and deletion.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 git 分支与 worktree 管理：工作区工具栏显示当前分支并可原地切换；支持 IDEA 风格分支选择器、远程分支检出、右键操作菜单（新建/重命名/删除/复制）、推送与更新当前分支，以及把分支隔离到独立 worktree 工作区并管理其创建与删除。

description.en: Model visibility manager for DeepSeek Harness: hide or show any model in the conversation model selector from a dedicated settings page. Per-model switches, search, provider-level batch actions, reset-all. Zero intrusion - writes only its own hidden list, never the provider config; hiding a model in use never interrupts a running session.
description.zh: DSH 模型可见性管理：在独立的设置分区页里按渠道/模型隐藏或显示模型选择菜单中的条目。逐模型开关、实时搜索、渠道级批量隐藏/显示、一键恢复全部。零侵入——只写插件自己的隐藏列表，不改 Provider 配置，隐藏正在使用的模型不会中断会话。

description.en: Render OpenUI Lang answers as interactive cards or reading articles in DSH chat, with maps, charts, forms, PNG export and standalone interactive HTML export.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中把 OpenUI Lang 答案渲染成交互卡片或阅读式文章，支持地图、图表、表单、PNG 图片导出和独立交互 HTML 导出。

description.en: Data visualization plugin that generates self-contained HTML reports with five chart types (bar/comparison/pie/radar/flowchart) and two-column layout.
description.zh: 数据可视化插件 — 生成自包含HTML报告，支持五种图表(bar/comparison/pie/radar/flowchart)与两列布局

description.en: Quantitative data quality scoring based on GB/T 36344-2018, providing auditable quality reports for data asset capitalization.
description.zh: 依据 GB/T 36344-2018 国家标准，从规范性、完整性等六个维度对数据质量进行量化评分，为企业数据资产入表提供可审计的底稿。

description.en: AI provider runtime and configuration UI for shared credentials and embedding, reranking, speech, and image generation services in DSH.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供共享凭据以及嵌入、重排序、语音和图像生成服务的 AI 提供商运行时与配置界面。

description.en: Self-evolving project-level Agent for DeepSeek Harness: 16 SDD workflow skills (clarification, PRD, issue, coding, locating, acceptance, review) plus project memory and knowledge that compound over time.
description.zh: 会进化的项目级 Agent：以 SDD 规格驱动掌舵全流程，内置 16 个技能覆盖澄清、PRD、issue、编码、定位、验收、审查；会记忆、会沉淀，越用越懂你的项目。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-vigalai-dsh-plugin-zerone
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-plugin-zerone

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Layered system-prompt profiles — global, per-workspace and per-session entries injected in order — where individual builtin sections and runtime contexts can be disabled or overridden, with a line-level diff of what an override changed; each entry carries a subagent scope that targets the main agent only, subagents only, or both; assembly snapshots record what each turn actually received, subagents included. Managed from a Web panel and a `prompt_manager` tool.
description.zh: 分层提示词档案：全局、按工作区、按会话三级条目按序注入系统提示词；可单独禁用或覆盖内置段落与运行期 context，覆盖效果有逐行 diff 对照；每条条目可限定只注入主代理、只注入子代理，或两者都注入；装配快照记录每一轮实际收到的提示词，子代理也包括在内。由 Web 面板与 `prompt_manager` 工具管理。

description.en: Data asset attestation plugin that generates certification-level data quality reports with evidence chains.
description.zh: 数据资产认证报告插件 — 生成带证据链的认证级数据质量报告

description.en: OpenCode on DeepSeek Harness — session affinity, Zen/Go gateway origin headers, free-tier tool fallback, and live Go quota display.
Data lineage tracking tool, mapping the full lifecycle of data to meet source legality requirements.
description.zh: 数据血缘追踪工具，梳理数据从产生到流转的全链路，满足数据产权登记中的来源合法性审查要求。

description.en: Data asset valuation plugin with cost-based (replacement cost) and income-based valuation.
description.zh: 数据资产估值插件 — 成本法（重置成本）+收益法两轨估值

description.en: Review tab for DeepSeek Harness sessions: workspace changes versus HEAD or any two refs as a filterable file tree with side-by-side diffs, a lane commit graph with blame and file history, three-scope search, line comments back to the composer, and guarded stage/commit/branch/tag/stash/conflict operations.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话审查标签页：工作区相对 HEAD 或任意两 ref 的变更，以可过滤文件树加双列差异呈现；泳道提交图带逐行追溯与单文件历史；三范围搜索；行内评论回写对话输入框；暂存、提交、分支、标签、贮藏与冲突操作全部设防。

description.en: Web search provider with switchable engines, several usable without an API key (Bing, DuckDuckGo, SearXNG and others) and a fallback order between them; adds multi_search, platform_search, image_search with an in-chat image wall, page_images and save_images, plus a settings page for engines, keys and per-engine proxy.
description.zh: 可切换引擎的联网搜索 provider，其中多个引擎无需 API key（Bing、DuckDuckGo、SearXNG 等），可设置回退顺序；另提供 multi_search、platform_search、带对话内图片墙的 image_search、page_images 和 save_images，以及配置引擎、密钥和按引擎代理的设置页。

description.en: A lightweight font and theme plugin for the DSH client: Latin/Chinese/code font pickers that list only installed families, and five official palettes (One Dark Pro, Dracula, Nord, GitHub, Catppuccin) applied through the official theme tokens, including code-block syntax colors. No bundled fonts, no dependencies, no build step. Requires DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 or newer.
description.zh: 轻量的 DSH 字体与主题插件：中英文与代码字体选择器（只列本机已安装的字体），以及 One Dark Pro、Dracula、Nord、GitHub、Catppuccin 五套官方色板预设，全部走官方主题 token（含代码块语法高亮），不打包字体、零依赖、零构建。需要 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 或更新。

description.en: Data packaging plugin for product manual generation and compliance attachments.
description.zh: 数据封装插件 — 产品说明书生成+合规附件

description.en: Adds an avatar to the left of each turn's final AI reply and to the right of each user message; upload your own image and set its size and circle or square frame.
description.zh: 在每轮 AI 回复左侧与你的每条输入右侧各显示一个头像，可上传自己的图片并设置尺寸与圆形/方形头像框。

description.en: Token usage statistics by model, session and date in a sidebar panel, plus OpenCode Go quota, DeepSeek balance and Z.ai quota monitoring.
description.zh: 在侧边栏按模型、会话与日期统计 token 用量，并监控 OpenCode Go 额度、DeepSeek 余额与 Z.ai 额度。

description.en: Makes a connection between two DSH sessions a first-class object: drag from the composer anchor or a session row to open one, set a permission in each direction, and mount cards on it. Each end gets five host tools for messaging at a chosen urgency, reading the peer work state, and sharing a convention box; awareness is pull-based, so an idle connection costs no context.
description.zh: 把两个 DSH 会话之间的「连接」做成一等对象：从输入框锚点或会话行拖拽建连，两个方向各自设权限，并可在连接上装载卡片。两端各获得五个宿主工具，用于按指定紧急度传话、读取对端工作状态、共用公约盒；感知为拉取式，空闲连接不占上下文。

description.en: 给 DSH 上的一个会话装上自己的目标、记忆和作息：goal / memory / clock 三个插件

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-sinecause
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-sinecause

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Adds Regenerate and Edit and resend to each message you already sent: Regenerate re-answers the same text in one click without going through the composer; Edit and resend retracts that message and everything after it in place — out of the transcript and out of the model context, in the same session with no new branch — then puts its text and images back into the composer, so the edited send rewrites the conversation from that point. Messages carrying files rather than images stay disabled.
description.zh: 给你发出的每条消息加上「重新生成」和「编辑重发」：重新生成一键用同样的文字重新回答，不经过输入框；编辑重发就地撤回这条消息及其之后的内容——从时间线和模型上下文里一起消失，不新建会话也不开新分支——再把文字和图片放回输入框，改完发送就从那一条重写对话。带文件（非图片）的消息两个操作置灰。

description.en: Adds Tako chat models to the official llm-pi-ai provider list from Tako's public catalog, with live refresh, context windows from size tags, and browser one-click sign-in writing a cr_ key into DSH credentials.
description.zh: 从 Tako 公开模型目录把聊天模型接入官方 llm-pi-ai，实时刷新并按尺寸标签写入上下文窗口，支持浏览器一键登录，把 cr_ 密钥存入 DSH 凭据。

description.en: Downloads a Bilibili video with yt-dlp, samples key frames, and transcribes it — from the site subtitles, or from a local faster-whisper install when there are none. Registers the skill the agent uses to write the summary; activates when a user message contains only a video link. Requires yt-dlp and ffmpeg on PATH; transcription needs faster-whisper.
description.zh: 用 yt-dlp 下载 B 站视频、抽帧并转写：优先用站方字幕，没有字幕时调用本机 faster-whisper。注册写总结所需的技能，当用户消息只有一条视频链接时自动启用。需 PATH 上有 yt-dlp 与 ffmpeg，转写另需 faster-whisper。

description.en: Tracks DeepSeek Harness LLM token usage and cost (CNY, peak/off-peak pricing) with a settings dashboard, agent tools, HTTP API and persistent storage.
description.zh: 统计 DeepSeek Harness 的 LLM Token 用量与花费（人民币、峰谷计价），提供设置面板、Agent 工具、HTTP 接口与持久化存储。

description.en: Session instruction anchor for DeepSeek Harness: the first step of a new session injects a freely composed instruction block as a plugin-sourced message, and it is re-anchored after a summarizing compaction, every N turns, or when metered context pressure crosses a threshold. An /anchor command re-anchors on demand without a model call; a settings page manages the paged preset library, injection order, re-anchor source and character limits.
description.zh: DSH 会话指令定锚：新会话的第一个 step 把自由组合的指令块作为插件来源消息注入，之后在完成压缩、跨过设定轮数、或计量到的上下文压力越过阈值时重锚。`/anchor` 命令可按需定锚且不触发模型调用；设置页管理分页预设库、注入顺序、重锚来源与字数上限。

description.en: A file-view enhancement plugin that extends the official DSH sidebar, providing source view, in-place editing, line number display, search, and font zoom.
description.zh: 基于 DSH 官方侧边栏的文件视图增强插件，提供源码视图、原位编辑、行号显示、搜索和字体缩放功能。

description.en: Phone push for DeepSeek Harness: hooks the question seam in-process so a pending question reaches your phone through an ntfy relay; an answer sent from the phone is fed back to the agent as a user message, which requires `tool-ask-user` to run in `mode: timed` — with the shipped default (`mode: legacy`) only the notification is delivered.
description.zh: DSH 手机推送：进程内挂载提问 seam，把待答问题经 ntfy relay 推到手机；手机作答会以 user 消息回灌给 agent。该回灌需要把 `tool-ask-user` 配成 `mode: timed`，默认的 `mode: legacy` 只推送通知。

description.en: Study workbench for exam prep and research: three-column task board with tags and filters, a spaced-repetition queue (simplified SM-2) that keeps finished cards coming back, a heatmap lit by actual focused minutes, weekly reports, per-day review notes, a pomodoro timer that survives panel switches, and Markdown export/import for Obsidian. Installable via dsh plugin add (dsh-study-desk on npm).
description.zh: 备考与科研学习工作台：三列待办墙（标签与过滤）、间隔重复复习队列（简化 SM-2，已完成的卡照样会到期）、按实际专注分钟点亮的热力图、周报、每日复盘、跨面板存活的番茄钟，支持 Markdown 导出与读回（Obsidian 友好）。可 `dsh plugin add` 安装（npm 包 dsh-study-desk）。

description.en: Per-turn session cost chip in the composer stats row: each turn's spend with the model it used, the conversation total split into cache-hit and cache-miss (CNY), priced from an official price table that refreshes on demand.
description.zh: 输入框下方统计栏里的会话费用胶囊：逐轮列出每轮花费与所用模型，并把总额拆成缓存命中与未命中两笔（CNY）；价目表按需从官方定价页刷新。

description.en: See how you have been using AI: `/session-insights` reviews your DSH sessions over time, shows what worked, which problems kept coming back, and what results were actually produced, then creates a retrospective report on your machine.
description.zh: 回头看看你是怎么使用 AI 的：`/session-insights` 会整理一段时间内的 DSH 会话，找出哪些做法有效、哪些问题总在重复、最终真正留下了哪些成果，并生成一份保存在本机的复盘报告。

description.en: Bridges Multica to DeepSeek Harness through a versioned JSONL process protocol.
description.zh: 通过版本化 JSONL 进程协议将 Multica 接入 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Lists archived sessions, previews their content, restores them to the original workspace, and adds an optional archive confirmation.
description.zh: 列出已归档会话、预览内容、恢复到原工作区，并提供可选的归档二次确认。

description.en: A fork of zhu1090093659/dsh-pet (Apache-2.0), adding per-conversation companions with whale-girl, MIKU and business blue whale skins, model-themed colors, token-rate animation, completion reminders and shared feeding and affinity.
description.zh: 基于 zhu1090093659/dsh-pet（Apache-2.0）改造，新增每个活跃会话一只桌宠，提供鲸鱼娘、MIKU 与商务小蓝鲸皮肤、模型配色、随生成速度跑动、完成待查看提醒、共享喂食与亲密度。

description.en: 🎲 Dice Battle — six classic dice games (Liar's Dice, Guess Red Dots, Red/Blue, Big/Small, Odd/Even, Straight) for the DSH web GUI. Single vs AI plus PeerJS WebRTC online play, fully bilingual zh/en, sidebar entry opens the game in the center column.
description.zh: 🎲 骰子大作战 — 六种经典骰子玩法（吹牛、猜红点、猜红蓝、猜大小、猜单双、猜顺子），单人 vs AI + PeerJS 联机，全量中英双语，侧边栏入口打开游戏面板。

description.en: Bayesian stock prediction plugin that fuses MACD, RSI, moving-average, volume and other technical signals into an up-move posterior probability with multi-horizon comparison, trend-state classification and position risk metrics for A-share and US stocks.
description.zh: 贝叶斯个股预测插件：多指标信号融合的上涨概率估计、趋势状态识别与持仓风险度量（A 股 + 美股）。

description.en: Database access for DeepSeek Harness through the DBHub MCP server: configure MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQLite and SQL Server connections per workspace and environment, then let the agent configure, list, query and search SQLite objects through four fixed tools. Passwords and full connection strings are entered in the settings UI and never accepted as tool arguments, so the model only sees metadata such as mysql://host:3306/db; each environment can be read-only (the model may enable it but not clear it) or reached through a manual SSH tunnel. Every call runs its own short-lived dbhub process and dbhub installs itself when missing.
description.zh: 把 DBHub MCP 服务器接入 DeepSeek Harness 的数据库插件：按工作区 × 环境配置 MySQL、MariaDB、PostgreSQL、SQLite 与 SQL Server 连接，让 Agent 通过固定 4 个工具配置连接、列出数据源、执行 SQL、搜索 SQLite 对象。密码与完整连接串由用户在设置界面输入、不作为工具参数接收，模型只看到 mysql://host:3306/db 这类元数据；每个环境可设为只读（模型只能开启、不能关闭）或经手动 SSH 隧道访问。每次调用独立启动一条用完即退的 dbhub 进程，未安装 dbhub 时自动安装。

description.en: Content-degradation detection (thinking loops, output repetition) for DeepSeek Harness, with a continue-vs-handoff cost verdict and zero-model handoff documents.
description.zh: 内容退化检测（思考打转、输出复读）+ 继续/交接成本裁决 + 零模型交接文档。

description.en: Adds a docked-first vertical shorts wall to the DSH Web UI with YouTube Shorts and Bilibili sources, keyword rotation, four-corner resizing, and Alt+S/Alt+M shortcuts.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 中加入默认贴边的竖屏短视频墙：YouTube Shorts 与 B站双源、关键词轮换、四角缩放及 Alt+S/Alt+M 快捷键。

description.en: Icon, Chinese display name and a one-line note for every DSH plugin, organized with folders, favorites, drag or pinyin ordering, list and grid views. Icons are auto-assigned to all installed plugins and can be overridden; import and export cover icons, names, notes, folders and order. Display-only: plugin files and cordis config are never modified; enable switches call the official plugin manager.
description.zh: 给 DSH 插件换自定义图标、中文显示名和一句话说明；用文件夹与收藏整理，支持拖拽排序、按备注名拼音排序、列表与铺陈两种视图。所有已安装插件自动分配图标（可手动覆盖）；导入导出覆盖图标、备注名、说明、文件夹与排序。只改显示，不修改插件文件与 cordis 配置；启用开关转调官方插件管理器。

description.en: Plugin center for VibeDev: describes the official VibeDev plugins and installs them in one click through the plugin manager (inspect, install disabled, then enable, with prerequisites). Also offers a suite install, migration of a renamed package, and a one-click install of the dshmarket plugin market.
description.zh: VibeDev 插件中心：介绍 VibeDev 官方插件，并通过官方插件管理器一键安装（先检查、先不启用地安装、再启用，并带上前置依赖）。另提供套装安装、旧包名迁移，以及一键安装插件市场 dshmarket。

description.en: Session favorites: bookmark any conversation into a browser-style favorites panel — one-click star from session rows, folders for organization, notes, custom display names, resume session, fork into a new session, basic session stats, plus a fork-relationship graph showing how conversations derive from one another.
description.zh: 会话收藏夹：把任意会话收藏进浏览器收藏夹式的管理面板——左侧会话行一键收藏/星标，主面板支持文件夹分门别类、备注、自定义显示名、一键继续会话、Fork 新会话、会话基本统计，外加一张清晰展示会话派生关系的 fork 关系图。

description.en: Model picker control for the DSH composer: a settings section beside the built-in Models page renames model display names and provider group names, adds a short coloured suffix capsule after a name, groups models from different providers into a new partition, reorders provider groups by drag or keyboard, sorts models inside a group by catalog order or name, and hides a provider or a single model without removing it from the catalog. Edits stay in a draft until you press Save, and the built-in 1017 tag and a custom capsule can be shown side by side.
description.zh: DSH 输入框模型选择器的总控：在与宿主「模型」页平级的设置分区里，可以改模型显示名与 provider 分组名、在名称后加一枚三色后缀胶囊、把不同 provider 的模型合并成新分区、用拖拽或键盘重排分组顺序、按目录原序或名称排序组内模型、隐藏整个 provider 或单个模型（不删除目录条目）。改动先进入草稿，按保存才生效；宿主自带 1017 标签与自定义胶囊可同时显示。

description.en: Provisions the kimi-webbridge bridge daemon (auto-install with SHA-256 verification, auto-start) and registers a 25-action skill that drives the user's real browser through the local bridge.
description.zh: 自动安装并启动 kimi-webbridge 桥接守护进程（含 SHA-256 校验），注册一套 25 个动作的技能，通过本地桥接驱动用户的真实浏览器。

description.en: 写 C++ 源码、配 CMake、用 Clang 构建；头文件用 /// Doxygen 文档注释，函数体用 // 分段说明，文件头标签可在设置里改。

Electrical and electronics calculation plugin for DeepSeek Harness: every computation runs through dedicated tools on self-describing complex value objects in SI base units, with an isolated calculation agent preset and a records panel that archives every solve on disk.
description.zh: DSH 电气电子计算插件：所有计算都通过专用工具完成，基于 SI 基本单位的自描述复数值对象；附带隔离的计算智能体预设与记录面板，每次求解落盘存档。

description.en: Profile-aware keyboard shortcuts for DSH Web: supports Question and Approval cards, Standard/Vim/Custom profiles, and capability-gated Session and Workspace navigation.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供按 profile 管理的键盘快捷键：支持 Question 和 Approval 卡片、Standard/Vim/Custom 配置，并按能力提供 Session 与 Workspace 导航。

description.en: Plays a voice line or a sound when a turn finishes and a failure cue when a tool call or a turn errors — user aborts stay silent by default and subagent sessions are skipped, both configurable. Three alert modes: voice, effects, or off. Effects is the default and ships 20 built-in sounds (10 alert chimes + 10 nature), each assignable to the done, fail or approval event with per-row preview, so it needs no API key and no audio files; the voice route uses Volcengine TTS with cloned or preset voices, batch-imported voice IDs and fingerprint reuse that skips re-synthesis when text, voice and parameters are unchanged. A third approval slot exists but has no automatic trigger — it only plays when called manually. Playback goes through winmm/waveOut as-is, never changing the system volume or mute state, and the player is spawned detached so session teardown cannot silence it. Windows only.
description.zh: 每个 turn 结束自动播报完成、出错时播失败提示（用户中断默认不播，子代理会话默认跳过，均可配置）。三种提醒方式：语音、音效、关闭。默认「音效」内置 20 个音效（提醒 10 + 大自然 10），每个音效可指定给完成/失败/审批事件并单独试听，零配置、不需要任何 API Key 与音频文件；语音走火山 TTS，支持克隆音色与预设音色、批量导入音色 ID，并按文案/音色/语速/音调/音量指纹复用已生成的 mp3，未变则不重复合成。第三个「审批」槽位没有自动触发源，只能手动播放。走 winmm/waveOut 原样播放，绝不改动系统音量或静音状态，播放进程独立拉起、DSH 会话销毁也杀不到声音。仅 Windows。

description.en: Generates UI wireframes and high-fidelity mockups in DeepSeek Harness with selectable DashScope and Volcengine image providers.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用可切换的阿里云百炼与火山方舟图像服务生成 UI 线框图和高保真设计稿。

description.en: Progressive tool discovery through tool_list, tool_search and tool_load, exposing tool schemas on demand while preserving host execution permissions.
description.zh: 通过 tool_list、tool_search 和 tool_load 渐进式发现工具，按需披露工具 schema，保留宿主执行权限约束。

description.en: Panel hotkeys for the web UI: Enter presses the confirm action and Esc presses the cancel action on every interaction panel (approval, question, plan review).
description.zh: Web UI 面板快捷键：在审批、提问、计划审查等交互面板上，Enter 触发确认操作、Esc 触发取消操作。

description.en: Requires the ZCode CLI installed and signed in. Relays the ZCode CLI agent into DeepSeek Harness as a model provider. A resident app-server session streams each turn, and the model catalogue is read from the CLI at runtime, so context windows, image support and provider routes follow the installed CLI and account. Stable 0.5.2 declares DSH compatibility through engines.dsh; ZCode CLI 3.16.3 is the documented reference version. Tool permission requests are denied by default; unknown approval or permission methods are always denied, and full-auto requires an explicit opt-in. DSH approval UI does not mediate this separately spawned app-server process, and the policy is not an OS sandbox.
description.zh: 需已安装并登录 ZCode CLI。把 ZCode CLI agent 接入 DeepSeek Harness 作为模型提供方。常驻 app-server 会话逐回合流式转发，模型清单从 CLI 实时读取，因此上下文窗口、图片支持与 provider 路由都跟随已安装的 CLI 和账号。稳定版 0.5.2 通过 engines.dsh 声明 DSH 兼容范围，文档参考内核为 ZCode CLI 3.16.3。工具权限请求默认拒绝；未知的 approval/permission 方法始终拒绝，全自动需显式启用。DSH 自带的审批界面不会介入这个独立 spawn 的 app-server 进程，该策略也不构成操作系统沙箱。

description.en: Adds a Session without workspace entry to the DSH Workspace picker, creates isolated date-organized directories, and keeps started sessions resumable under Ungrouped.
description.zh: 在 DSH 工作区选择器中添加无工作区会话入口，创建按日期整理的独立目录，并让已开始的会话在未分组区域保持可恢复。

description.en: AST-based structural code search and syntax outline tool powered by ast-grep.
description.zh: 基于 ast-grep 的语法级 AST 代码结构检索与大纲提取工具。

description.en: Modellix integration for DSH: schema-driven image, video and audio generation in a split Design workspace, a live LLM model catalog, and native web search and fetch providers through one API key.
description.zh: 将 Modellix 接入 DSH：使用一个 API Key 在分栏 Design 工作区中提供基于 Schema 的图片、视频与音频生成、实时 LLM 模型目录，以及原生网页搜索与抓取 Provider。

description.en: Plugin center for DeepSeek Harness: installed-plugin metadata, a community market with stars and versions, one-click install and update, and a What's New dialog.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件中心：已安装插件信息、带星标与版本号的社区市场、一键安装与更新，以及启动时的更新日志弹窗。

description.en: Forwards an unattended DeepSeek Harness run's tool-call approvals and ask_user_question prompts to Feishu cards on your phone. The desktop GUI answers first — a card is only sent after `delaySeconds` (120 by default) with no answer there — and a phone approval grants `allowed-once`, so no authority accumulates on the phone. One outbound WebSocket long connection to Feishu: no public IP, domain, tunnel or relay.
description.zh: 把无人值守运行时 DeepSeek Harness 的工具调用审批与 ask_user_question 提问推送到手机飞书卡片。桌面 GUI 优先作答——只有在 `delaySeconds`（默认 120 秒）内无人应答时才发出卡片——手机上的批准等同于 `allowed-once`，因此不会在手机上累积任何权限。仅一条到飞书的出站 WebSocket 长连接：不需要公网 IP、域名、隧道或中继。

description.en: Ship a project to Cloudflare and publish your plugin to npm — the first deploy needs no cloud account, and credentials never reach the model.
description.zh: 一句话把项目部署到 Cloudflare、把做好的插件发布到 npm：首次部署零账号，凭据模型看不到。

description.en: Desktop pet "Zhaozhao" (照照) that floats above all apps in a transparent always-on-top window and mirrors DeepSeek Harness state — idle, cooking, serving and waiting-for-you animations, click reactions, drag, right-click resize, plus an auto-downloading Electron helper.
description.zh: 桌面宠物「照照」：透明置顶窗悬浮于所有应用之上，镜像 DeepSeek Harness 状态——待机、颠锅、上菜、托腮等你回话，支持点击回应、拖拽、右键调大小，Electron 运行时自动下载。

description.en: Adds a refresh button and a power menu (restart / close DeepSeek Harness) to the conversation header. Client-only, zero tokens, no dependencies. The power menu is Windows-only.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话头部加一个刷新按钮和一个电源菜单（重启 / 关闭 DeepSeek Harness）。纯客户端、零 token、零依赖。电源菜单目前仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Tavily backend for the built-in web search: an in-process endpoint at 127.0.0.1:8787/v1 turns its requests into Tavily searches; up to 10 API keys stay in the DSH credential store, rotate per request and switch on auth, rate-limit or quota errors; a settings card manages keys, runs a test search and points web search at the endpoint.
description.zh: 为内置网页搜索提供 Tavily 后端：在 DSH 进程内提供 127.0.0.1:8787/v1 接口，把搜索请求转成 Tavily 检索；最多 10 个 API Key 存在 DSH 凭据库，按请求轮换，遇鉴权、限流或额度错误自动换下一个；设置卡片可管理密钥、测试搜索并一键接入网页搜索。

description.en: Notifies you with a browser notification and toast whenever a session turn ends, with 5-language templates and custom presets.
description.zh: 会话轮次结束时推送浏览器系统通知与页内提示，内置 5 种语言模板与自定义预设。

description.en: An RTS-style orchestration dashboard where commands replace chats: a resident commander agent decomposes each order into task briefs with acceptance criteria, typed subagent troops (recon/engineer/medic/scribe) execute them across isolated workspaces, and every session is indexed by the order that started it.
description.zh: RTS 风格编排看板：用命令取代会话——常驻大副 agent 把舰长命令拆成带验收标准的任务书，侦察/工程/医疗/书记四类小队在隔离工作区执行，所有会话按发起命令索引归队。

description.en: DSH Usage Monitor: auto-query provider credit balances and time-window limits from configured API keys, with input capsule and custom provider support.
description.zh: DSH 用量监控：自动查询已配置 API Key 的供应商余额和时间窗口限制，支持输入框余量胶囊和自定义供应商。

description.en: FDE toolbox bundle: installing this one plugin pulls in a curated set of common dsh plugins (git server, WebDAV mount, knowledge base, scheduled tasks, auto-resume, UI tweaks, auto-retrospection, file manager, smart titles, task board, plugin market, context trimmer, IM bridge, sidebar enhancements), with a panel showing install status and one-click gap-filling.
description.zh: FDE 工具箱全家桶：安装一个插件带上一批常用 dsh 插件（代码仓库 / 挂载盘 / 知识库 / 定时任务 / 自动续跑 / 界面微调 / 自动复盘 / 文件管理 / 智能标题 / 任务看板 / 插件市场 / 上下文 / IM 接入 / 侧栏增强），面板看状态、一键补装。

description.en: Let a local DeepSeek Harness Agent use BailingHub to query data, update records, and run permitted actions in an online store, SaaS, or other admin system.
description.zh: 让本地 DeepSeek Harness 智能体通过 BailingHub，直接操作商城、SaaS 或其他业务系统后台，在现有账号权限内查询数据、修改资料并执行已开放的操作。

description.en: Select a term in a DeepSeek Harness conversation and press the Search button beside it to read the explanation in place: basic meaning, purpose and usage, with the token cost of that answer. The call is auxiliary — it writes nothing to the session log.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话里选中一个术语、点旁边的「搜索」按钮，就地解释基本含义、用途与用法，并显示这次回答消耗的 token；该调用是旁路调用，不写入会话日志。

description.en: Brings the models available in the logged-in WorkBuddy desktop app into the model picker, reusing the app login and credits; the domestic and international builds appear as two separate provider groups. Continuation of the now-deleted corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect; it registers the same workbuddy / workbuddy-ai provider ids, so it cannot be installed alongside other WorkBuddy bridges.
description.zh: 把已登录的 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 里可用的模型接进模型选择器，复用 App 的登录与积分；国内版与国际版各成一组。corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect（仓库已删除）的续作；注册相同的 workbuddy / workbuddy-ai provider id，不能与其它 WorkBuddy 桥同装。

description.en: Declutter the DSH settings nav: fold third-party plugin entries under collapsible group rows, with bookmark-style custom groups, a fold toggle, and auto classification (market tags → name rules → your AI model).
description.zh: 设置面板导航整理：第三方插件入口折叠为可展开的分组行，支持书签式自定义分组、折叠开关与自动分类（市场标签 → 名称规则 → AI 模型三级兜底）。

description.en: A Herta theme for DeepSeek Harness: an ASCII boot opening ported from the upstream Herta project, a violet palette of design tokens, swappable wallpapers (four bundled, plus image URL, local import, solid colour or off) and a "Herta Appearance" page in DSH settings. Doubles as the theme that dsh-herta ships with.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的黑塔主题：移植自上游 Herta 项目的开机 ASCII 开场、一整套紫罗兰设计令牌、可替换的壁纸（自带四张，也支持图片网址 / 本机导入 / 纯色 / 关掉），以及 DSH 设置里的「黑塔外观」页。它同时就是 dsh-herta 自带的那套主题。

description.en: Draft polish for the DSH composer: one-click AI polish of the input draft (sparkles button next to send), with optional conversation context and a configurable model channel.
description.zh: DSH 输入框草稿润色：发送键左侧一键调用 LLM 润色草稿，可携带会话上下文，模型渠道可配置。

description.en: Insurance company operations analyst — runs real solvency, profitability, embedded value (EV), investment risk and regulatory compliance calculations, not just text explanations.
description.zh: 保险公司经营分析专家（盈安），真跑偿付能力、盈利能力、内含价值(EV)、投资风险与监管合规五维测算。

description.en: Scheduled tasks panel for managing DSH agent and system crontabs with natural language input and execution logs.
description.zh: 定时任务面板：分区管理 DSH 与系统 crontab、自然语言生成表达式、执行日志与完成后消息推送。

description.en: Let Agents directly control independent local DSH instances with zero intrusion—no plugins or components required on the target. Isolated environments enable autonomous configuration and testing, while Agents with different models and personalities can chat, role-play, or form nested control chains. Supports conversational setup, user-like operations, incremental reading, saved references, and remote session/workspace search.
description.zh: 为 Agent 提供直接操控本机完整 DSH 实例的能力：目标 DSH 无需安装任何插件或额外组件，零侵入，环境隔离便于用户直接让agent为另一环境进行修改配置到自主测试,也能让不同模型、不同人格的 Agent 互相聊天、角色扮演或层层套娃，探索趣味玩法，可通过对话由 Agent 自主配置连接，并支持接近用户的操作语义、增量读取、引用保存以及远端会话与工作区搜索。

description.en: Records DeepSeek Harness runtime errors and coding retrospectives as an interactive GPU graph, and feeds the recorded lessons back into the model's context.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的运行错误与编程任务复盘渲染成可交互的 GPU 图谱，并把记录下来的教训送回模型上下文。

description.en: Adds a human-editable notes workspace with folders, full-text search, rich text, checklists, resizable tables, attachments, exports, and opt-in agent collaboration.
description.zh: 提供可直接编辑的笔记空间，支持文件夹、全文搜索、富文本、核对清单、可调整列宽的表格、附件、导出和可选的 Agent 协作。

description.en: LSP action surface for DeepSeek Harness providing diagnostics, formatting, rename, code actions, and symbols over real language servers.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的通用 LSP 工具面，提供语言服务器诊断、格式化、重命名、代码动作与符号导航。

description.en: Model pricing for the DSH settings page: ~7,250 models / 213 providers with the harness catalog overlaid, honest lowest-listed comparison, session costs priced by the actual route, cache-leak attribution, and a verified promotion feed.
description.zh: DSH 设置页中的模型价格表：约 7,250 个模型 / 213 个提供商（叠加本地路由目录），诚实的最低标价比较、按实际路由计价的会话成本、缓存泄漏归因，以及经验证的促销信息源。

description.en: Turns session context into a deep-sea moyu (slack-off) game in a floating window — your hand sinks as context grows, touch a fish and server-rolled dice decide the mint of a holographic collectible card across five oceans, with a fish pond and a GitHub-linked leaderboard.
description.zh: 把会话 context 变成浮窗深海摸鱼：context 越长手沉得越深，摸到鱼后服务端掷骰定胜负，中卡铸造镭射收藏卡，五大洋摸鱼、鱼池养成、GitHub 绑定全球排行榜。

description.en: A project-scoped memory plugin for DSH. Knowledge authoring and the plugin's own prompts are open to editing, so users can redesign the library structure and how the model is driven without changing a line of code. By default the library is built on one core idea: a project document you design yourself (a handoff by default) is the project entity; the plugin detects which project a session belongs to, binds captured knowledge to that project, and promotes what generalizes into theme and global layers. The most natural logic there is does the pre-filtering of knowledge, with controllable compression and archiving of context.
description.zh: 以项目为主线的 DSH 记忆插件。开放知识书写，以及插件提示词编辑，让用户不改一行代码就能重新设计记忆库结构与模型被驱动的方式。默认的记忆库核心设计在于，项目以一份你自己设计的项目文档（默认是一份交接文档）作为实体，插件自动识别会话所属项目、把沉淀的知识与项目绑定，并把可复用的部分升级进主题与全局层。用最自然的逻辑完成知识的初筛，上下文可控压缩和留档。

description.en: Read-only Odoo tools over JSON-RPC: server info, model field introspection, and a restricted search_read limited to an allow list of models whose domain field names may not contain dots, so related-record traversal is not possible. A draft-create tool is registered only when allowWrite is enabled, and is limited to sale.order and project.task with the draft state enforced by the plugin.
description.zh: 经 JSON-RPC 的 Odoo 只读工具：服务器信息、模型字段自省，以及受限的 search_read——仅限白名单模型，且 domain 字段名不允许包含点号，因此无法沿关联关系穿透。草稿创建工具需显式开启 allowWrite 才会注册，且仅限 sale.order 与 project.task，草稿状态由插件强制。

description.en: Makes the agent narrate its process: every turn opens with how it reads the message and what it will do first, then short interim notes between tool-call batches, with in-app settings for style, sentence cap and toggles.
description.zh: 让 agent 边做边说：每轮先用一两句说明怎么理解消息、准备怎么做、第一步是什么，并在工具调用批次之间写过程叙述；插件页可直接调整详略、句数上限与开关。

description.en: Sidebar category groups for DSH workspaces: the flat project list becomes collapsible named sections, workspaces re-file by dragging a row onto a group or picking one from a dropdown, one toolbar button collapses every group at once, an appearance panel sets font size, text color and background tint for each of the three levels, and Ctrl+Tab cycles recently opened sessions.
description.zh: 给 DSH 侧边栏的工作区加自定义分类：平铺的项目列表变成可折叠的分组，工作区可拖到别的分组或在下拉框里改归类，工具栏一键收起全部分组，外观面板能分别调三层字号、文字颜色与底色，Ctrl+Tab 在最近打开的会话之间切换。

description.en: Keeps the NapCat QQ backend alive next to DSH: probes the OneBot 11 HTTP port at startup, launches NapCat when the port does not answer, then rechecks every 45 seconds, kills duplicate process chains, hides the console window, can create a logon scheduled task when a task name is set, and adds a settings page plus napcat_status, napcat_restart and napcat_dedupe tools. Optionally remembers the QQ password, behind a risk confirmation, so an expired fast-login token can be renewed without scanning a QR code. Windows only; without that scheduled task the launched QQ exits together with DSH.
description.zh: 让 NapCat 这个 QQ 后端跟着 DSH 一起活着：启动时探测 OneBot 11 的 HTTP 端口，连不上就拉起 NapCat，之后每 45 秒复查、清掉重复的进程链、隐藏控制台窗口、可在填写任务名后创建登录计划任务，并提供设置页以及 napcat_status、napcat_restart、napcat_dedupe 三个工具。可选记住 QQ 密码（默认关闭，开启前需确认风险），让失效的快速登录令牌不用扫码也能自己续上。仅 Windows；不建计划任务时，拉起的 QQ 会随 DSH 一起退出。

description.en: Registers a /code-review slash command with five parallel review lenses and per-finding confidence scoring, for both pull requests and local code.
description.zh: 注册 /code-review 斜杠命令，五个并行审查视角、逐发现置信度打分，同时支持拉取请求与本地代码审查。

description.en: A memory subsystem for DeepSeek Harness: full ontological memory (event/fact/rule three-ontology) plus a goal system (goal.js) — belief values written via Bridge trigger words, goal activation scored at read time (0.25 domain + 0.35 bridge + 0.40 sim) to recover goal/value long-range associations, journal ledger, episodic archive, low-confidence decay, memory_append/read/consolidate plus linghun_goal_update/get/state closed loop. Independent of the original dsh-linghun line. 16/16 on LoCoMo-Plus.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的记忆子系统：记忆完全本体化（event/fact/rule 三本体）+ 目标系统（goal.js）——belief 价值观写侧收录 + Bridge 触发词，读侧重匹配公式（0.25 域命中 + 0.35 触发词 + 0.40 相似度）补上 goal/value 语义远距联想；序时账留痕、情景归档、低置信降权遗忘；memory_append/read/consolidate + linghun_goal_update/get/state 读写沉淀闭环。独立于原 dsh-linghun 演进。LoCoMo-Plus 16/16 满分。

description.en: File search palette for the DSH workspace: find files by name or content, open results in DSH's native right-sidebar preview, and edit text files inline with version-conflict checks.
description.zh: 工作区文件查找面板：按文件名或内容搜索，用 DSH 原生右侧栏预览打开结果，需要时在内置编辑器里修改文本，并在保存前检查版本冲突。

description.en: Flyout sidebar with a file tree, uncommitted-changes list and multi-tab file/diff previews; pops out into a standalone browser tab.
description.zh: 可弹出侧边栏：文件树、Git 未提交变更列表与多标签文件/diff 预览，一键弹出为独立浏览器标签页。

description.en: Standalone mobile surface for dsh: scan-to-pair device trust, realtime SSE sync, three-channel completion notifications (in-app / Web Push / Server酱·Bark·Telegram), offline outbox, approval & question panels, per-provider usage meters, PWA; a native narrow-screen phone UI.
description.zh: dsh 的独立手机端界面：扫码配对设备信任、实时 SSE 同步、三通道完成通知（应用内 / Web Push / Server酱·Bark·Telegram）、离线发件箱、审批与提问面板、多提供方用量卡、PWA；从零为窄屏设计的原生手机 UI。

description.en: Codex 订阅授权管理 for the dsh web surface: a dedicated settings page (authorization status, validity/expiry, one-click browser OAuth) plus an expired-credential modal when a GPT model is selected. Host half runs the full OpenAI OAuth flow (PKCE S256, localhost
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置面板中管理 Codex 订阅（ChatGPT OAuth）授权，无需 API key 即可使用 Codex 内的 GPT 模型。

description.en: A full-screen terminal workbench for DeepSeek Harness with a durable assistant, workspace-grouped project sessions, transcript-only scrolling, and structured thinking, tool, diff, plan, and subagent views.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 全屏终端工作台，提供独立持久助手、按工作区分组的项目会话、仅聊天区滚动，以及结构化思考、工具、diff、计划和子代理视图。

description.en: A bundle of molbio tools for molecular biology work:sequence analysis, primer and probe design (qPCR, TaqMan), in-silico PCR,cloning simulation,plasmid maps,sequencing validation,protein and CRISPR analysis,qPCR statistics,literature and lab records;installed as a preset-scoped bundle.
description.zh: 一组molbio分子生物学工具，包含序列分析、引物和探针设计、电子 PCR、克隆模拟、质粒图谱，测序验证，蛋白与CRISPR分析，qPCR统计，文献与实验记录；随 bundle 以预设模式安装。

description.en: Insurance product comparison & proposal expert — clause analysis, cost-effectiveness, coverage planning, generates verifiable client-facing PDF proposals.
description.zh: 保险产品对比与建议书专家（险析君），条款拆解、性价比测算、保障规划，生成可自核 PDF 建议书。

description.en: Import local Codex CLI/Desktop, Claude Code CLI, and Claude Desktop conversations into DSH with project grouping, semantic history, and tool activity; bind an existing or replacement workspace and continue with the DSH Agent.
description.zh: 将本地 Codex CLI/Desktop、Claude Code CLI 和 Claude Desktop 会话导入 DSH：按项目分组，保留语义历史和工具活动，可绑定原工作区或新工作区，并由 DSH Agent 继续对话。

description.en: Agent preset bundle for wish and task management: create wishes or tasks from conversation, opportunity-day check-ins, micro-actions, plus a memory store and progress charts in the web UI.
description.zh: 愿望与任务管理的 Agent Preset 组合包：在对话中创建愿望/任务、机会日打卡、微行动，并附带记忆存储与 Web 端进度图表。

description.en: Cursor-style New Session: every click creates a fresh blank draft session (persisted before the first message) instead of reusing the workspace's single one, plus a sidebar Drafts switcher to keep several empty chats open at once.
description.zh: Cursor 风格的新会话：每次点击都新建一个空白草稿会话（首条消息前即持久化），不再复用工作区唯一的空会话；侧栏新增草稿切换器，可同时保留多个空会话。

description.en: Local media library management and playback powered by dsh Web: responsive on PC and mobile with touch swipe reels, instant seeking and on-the-fly transcoding.
description.zh: 基于 dsh 内置 Web 服务管理、浏览与播放本地媒体库，完美适配 PC 与移动端，支持手势上下滑动刷视频、即时拖拽秒播与实时转码。

description.en: A Neon Genesis Evangelion-inspired skin for DeepSeek Harness: Title Card (light) and Central Dogma (dark) modes over one removable override layer, 55 measured color tokens, a wallpaper paint layer whose two surface alphas are solved against a WCAG contrast budget, a boot mask and a brand mark. It also rewrites the sidebar identity line, replaces the new-session heading, hides six official entries, and reshapes the composer control row. Unofficial fan work, non-commercial: the background pictures are fetched from third-party URLs at paint time, not shipped in the repository.
description.zh: 基于《新世纪福音战士》的 DeepSeek Harness 皮肤：Title Card（亮色）与 Central Dogma（暗色）两套完整模式叠在一层可移除的覆盖层上，55 个实测色值，壁纸绘制层的两个表面 alpha 按 WCAG 对比度预算求解，另有开机遮罩与品牌标记。它还改写侧栏身份行、替换新会话页的标题、隐藏六处官方入口，并重排会话框控件行。非官方同人作品、非商业用途：背景图在绘制时从第三方 URL 拉取，不随仓库分发。

description.en: Read-only Sentry tools: project listing, issue search at organization or project scope, single issue detail, and the latest or a specific event with a trimmed stacktrace.
