description.en: Windows desktop shortcut for dsh web: launches the server, auto-opens the browser when ready, and stops the service when the Harness window closes.
description.zh: Windows 桌面快捷方式：一键启动 dsh web，就绪后自动打开浏览器，关闭 Harness 窗口即停服务。

description.en: Split-screen workspace for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI - chat with several agents side by side in panes that look and behave exactly like the stock conversation: drag-to-split, live sessions with queued messages and in-pane ask_user/approval cards, per-pane view tabs (Chat/Trajectory/plugin views), a compact TUI composer mode (Alt+T) and pane-focus shortcuts. Requires DSH 0.1.5+.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页端分屏工作区 - 多个会话并排聊天，面板观感与原生对话完全一致：拖拽分屏、实时会话（排队消息、面板内 ask_user/审批卡片）、面板内视图标签（Chat/Trajectory/插件视图）、Alt+T 紧凑 TUI 输入模式与面板焦点快捷键。需要 DSH 0.1.5+。

description.en: A conversational voice frontend Agent for dsh: speak naturally over ByteDance Duplex, delegate requests to background tasks, and hear their asynchronous results reported by voice.
description.zh: dsh 的对话式语音前端 Agent：通过 ByteDance Duplex 自然对话，把语音请求委派给后台任务，并用语音回报异步结果。

description.en: A companion playlist panel for the dsh-boot-animation intro-video plugin: add clips without leaving the app, order them, and switch between sequential, random and single-clip playback. Sequential order is made deterministic by parking every clip except the one due to play in a disabled/ subdirectory of the same asset folder and rotating it back in on each boot, leaving the upstream plugin unpatched. Also supports recycling instead of deleting, pinning one clip for every launch, per-clip opt-out, and .mp4/.webm/.m4v/.mov files including non-ASCII names.
description.zh: 给开屏动画插件 dsh-boot-animation 配的播放入口面板：不用离开 app 就能加入视频、排好先后，并在「顺序播放 / 随机播放 / 单次播放」之间切换。顺序播放不修改上游插件也能做到确定性——除该播的那支外，参与播放的素材都停在同一个素材目录下的 disabled/ 里排队，每次启动自动轮换。还支持回收而不是删除、固定每次播同一支、逐条取消参与，以及 .mp4/.webm/.m4v/.mov（含非 ASCII 文件名）。

description.en: Delete a DSH conversation from its sidebar menu or the conversation header, optionally cascading into that conversation's associated memory nodes when you tick the box (the confirmation dialog shows the hit count before you commit); deletes land in a plugin recycle bin with restore, every action is appended to an audit log, and batch deletes are rate-limited with per-conversation rollback.
description.zh: 在会话列表菜单或会话页头部删除对话，可勾选一并删除该对话关联的记忆节点（确认框先显示命中条数）；删除进入插件回收站可恢复，每次操作写入审计日志，批量删除有限流与逐会话回滚。

description.en: Windows desktop control exposed as native DSH tools - whole-screen and single-window capture (the window one goes through PrintWindow, so a covered window still captures), click, drag, typing, keyboard shortcuts, scrolling, window management, pixel and window polling, and UIA queries that can invoke a control or read its value instead of clicking coordinates. 13 tools over a PowerShell 7 child process; no MCP server, no resident process, no API key.
description.zh: 以 DSH 原生工具形式提供的 Windows 桌面控制——整屏与单窗口截图（单窗口走 PrintWindow，窗口被遮住也能抓）、点击、拖动、打字、按键、滚动、窗口管理、像素与窗口轮询，以及可直接 invoke 控件或读取控件值的 UIA 查询（不必点坐标）。13 个工具，跑在 PowerShell 7 子进程上；不需要 MCP 服务器、无常驻进程、无 API key。

description.en: OpenAI provider for language models, embeddings, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, and image generation in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供语言模型、嵌入、文本转语音、语音转文本和图像生成能力的 OpenAI 提供商。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime。

description.en: Cross-device workspace backup, restore, and ecosystem update via the uagent-sync CLI.
description.zh: 工作区跨设备备份、恢复与扩展更新，经 uagent-sync CLI 桥接执行。

description.en: Chat-driven image-deck workbench for DSH: intent to storyboard script, per-page prompts and AI image generation with page-level revisions, nine design-style presets, and PDF/PPTX export (one full-page image per slide).
description.zh: DSH 的 image deck 工作台：从意图到故事线脚本、逐页 prompt 与 AI 出图、按页版本留存、9 套预设设计风格，导出 PDF/PPTX（每页一张整页图）。

description.en: Instantly find DSH settings pages, tabs and rows by keyword, pinyin, intent or AI — and jump straight to them.
description.zh: 通过关键词、拼音、意图或 AI 一键搜索 DSH 设置面板，并直达目标设置页、标签或选项。

description.en: Pixel-art reasoning-effort slider for DSH Web with continuous 0–100 dragging, 16ms throttled writes, snap-to-level commits, and a WebGL ember fire that ignites as the slider moves.
description.zh: 炭灰余烬风格的 DSH Web 像素推理强度滑块：以近黑木炭、暗红裂纹和橙红高温核心呈现 4px 像素化 WebGL 火焰，拖动时逐档点燃；支持 0–100 无极拖动、16ms 节流写入与松手吸附。

description.en: Webnovel Writer：DSH 长篇网文写作工作台

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-linfengqaqtat-dsh-scriptor
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for @linfengqaqtat/dsh-scriptor

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Model-facing `generate_image` tool for text-only models: the model asks for a picture in natural language, Gemini draws it via the Antigravity CLI, the image is saved to a configurable output directory, and the tool returns the file paths for the model to use in its work.
description.zh: 给纯文本模型的 `generate_image` 工具：模型用自然语言要一张图，经 Antigravity CLI 让 Gemini 画出，保存到可配置输出目录并返回文件路径，供模型在任务中使用。

description.en: Session Manager for DSH (formerly Session Steward): one console over active and archived sessions — grouped by workspace, domain and title filters, favorites, and batch archive / unarchive / purge archived files (destructive steps ask twice) — plus a four-gate health checkup (log integrity, projection cache, lossless JSON, cold read) that ends in a reversible, backup-first prescription. Search and indexing live in dsh-search-index; this plugin builds no index and never rewrites session logs.
description.zh: DSH 会话管理台（原名会话管家）：一屏管理活跃与归档会话——按工作区分组、检索域与标题筛选、收藏，批量归档 / 取消归档 / 清理归档文件（不可逆需二次确认），外加四门会话体检（日志完整性 / 投影缓存 / 无损 JSON / 冷读），给出可逆、先备份的处方。搜索与索引在 dsh-search-index；本插件不自建索引，也不改写会话日志。

description.en: A dsh-better-sidebar reader for CSV/TSV/PSV files and xlsx/xlsm workbooks: a sortable, filterable table with sheet tabs. Ceilings on rows, columns and cells, plus two zip-container gates, keep an input from freezing the tab.
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 的表格读取视图：读取 CSV/TSV/PSV 与 xlsx/xlsm 工作簿，表头可点击排序、可按子串筛选，多工作表以标签切换。行数、列数与单元格数均有上限，另有两道 zip 容器闸门，任何输入都不会卡死标签页。

description.en: Proxies the loopback-only dsh web onto a LAN port so phones and other machines can reach it, with an optional access password that browsers type in and the bundled Android client unlocks with biometrics. Adds a LAN-access settings page with QR codes, inlines dsh-web-mobile (MIT, attribution kept) for the mobile layout, and the Android client in the same repository adds finish/approval notifications, voice input and a home-screen widget.
description.zh: 把只监听 127.0.0.1 的 dsh web 转发到局域网端口，供手机等设备访问；可选访问密码——浏览器输入，同仓库的 Android 客户端用指纹或面部解锁。新增带二维码的「局域网访问」设置页，内联 dsh-web-mobile（MIT，保留署名）提供移动端布局；Android 客户端另加完成/审批通知、语音输入与主屏小组件。

description.en: Routes outbound model traffic per provider host or per model ID through chosen proxies, loopback or direct, configured from a Plugins settings page.
description.zh: 按提供商主机或模型 ID 将模型出站流量分流到指定代理、直连或继承进程策略，可在 Plugins 设置页配置。

description.en: The official ZCode ios-simulator plugin ported to native DSH tools: the original 20 ios_* tools keep their names and arguments, plus ios_shutdown_simulator, covering Xcode project discovery and scaffolding, simulator boot and shutdown, build, install, launch and terminate, screenshots, log reading, an in-app settings page and optional idb UI automation. macOS only.
description.zh: 把官方 ZCode ios-simulator 插件移植为 DSH 原生工具：原有 20 个 ios_* 工具的命名与参数保持不变，另加 ios_shutdown_simulator，覆盖 Xcode 工程发现与生成、模拟器启动与关闭、构建、安装、启动与结束进程、截图、日志读取，并提供应用内设置页与可选的 idb UI 自动化。仅支持 macOS。

description.en: Enhanced workspace directory browser for the web UI: one-click access to /mnt Windows drives under WSL, full breadcrumb ancestry and an always-visible path input.
description.zh: Web UI 增强版工作区目录选择器：WSL 下 /mnt Windows 盘符一键直达、完整面包屑层级与常显路径输入框。

description.en: Bridge DeepSeek Harness sessions to Cherry Studio desktops over the LAN - QR pairing, 14 cherry_* tools for agents/sessions/history/interactions, and a settings page for devices and per-workspace tool scope.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话桥接到局域网内的 Cherry Studio 桌面端——二维码配对、14 个 cherry_* 工具（agent/会话/历史/交互）与设置页（设备管理、按工作区的工具启用范围）。

description.en: Delegates a self-contained coding task to the local Claude Code subscription through the official Claude Agent SDK, and adds a session tab with live output, cost and remaining quota.
description.zh: 把自包含的编码任务委派给本机 Claude Code 订阅执行（走官方 Claude Agent SDK），并在会话里新增一个标签页，实时显示输出、费用与剩余额度。

description.en: Everything (voidtools) file-name search: everything_find queries the local Everything index to locate files and folders on any indexed drive in milliseconds, and adds a configuration card to the Plugins page.
description.zh: 基于 Everything 索引的全盘文件名搜索：everything_find 工具毫秒级定位任意盘上的文件与文件夹，并在插件页提供配置卡片。

description.en: Automatically sends "continue" to recover from RATE_LIMIT (429) and QUOTA (insufficient_quota) errors. Per-session consecutive-failure counter (default 20, configurable 1-100), a toolbar on/off switch, and a settings-page card.
description.zh: 遇到 RATE_LIMIT（429）或配额耗尽（insufficient_quota）错误时自动发送 continue 恢复对话。每会话独立计数连续失败次数（默认 20，可设 1-100），带工具栏开关条与设置页配置卡片。

description.en: Session management enhancement plugin for DeepSeek Harness - workspace session count display, archived sessions panel with restore/delete, drag-and-drop session move across workspaces.
description.zh: DSH 会话管理增强插件 - 工作区会话数展示、归档会话面板（支持恢复/删除）、拖拽移动会话到其他工作区。

description.en: Pull a 3D lever next to the send button and turn the model's reasoning signals into a pixel-art gacha reveal.
description.zh: 在发送按钮旁拉动 3D 拉杆，把模型思维链的文本信号变成一场像素风抽卡演出。

description.en: Markdown-as-database project knowledge base for DSH agents: ten kb_* tools (including kb_register for registering existing notes), stable TIDs, `[[node]]` links that never copy text, `[[tscl]]` definitions expanded in place, bounded reads, structural lint covering tscl, workspace-first library discovery, inline git snapshots, a node-graph panel, and a bundled prompt section plus skill that make the agent reach for kb_* instead of hand-written docs/.
description.zh: 给 DSH Agent 用的「md 即数据库」项目知识库：10 个 kb_* 工具（含登记已有笔记的 kb_register）、稳定 TID、`[[node]]` 只出链接不复制正文、`[[tscl]]` 定义就地展开、有界读取、覆盖 tscl 的结构 lint、工作区优先的库发现、内嵌 git 快照、节点图面板，另带系统提示词段落与随包技能，让 Agent 优先用 kb_* 而不是手写 docs/。

description.en: One-click prompt refinement for the DSH composer: the ✦ button next to Send rewrites the draft into an agent-ready prompt in Standard or Light mode, with Revert and Retry; asks follow-up questions through the question card when the draft is missing information; checks that paths, identifiers, numbers, URLs, inline code and @mentions survive the rewrite and adds back any that were dropped; runs on the conversation model or a dedicated model chosen on the Plugins page.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框一键改写提示词：点「发送」旁的 ✦，按「标准」或「轻」档把草稿改写成 Agent 可直接执行的提示词，可撤回或重试；草稿缺少信息时通过提问卡片追问；校验路径、标识符、数字、URL、行内代码与 @ 提及在改写后逐字保留，丢失的会补回；可使用会话模型，或在插件页面指定专用模型。

description.en: The shared UI foundation for DSH plugins, with a live component preview: design tokens, common controls, workspace browsing and notifications maintained in one place — install it to preview every component in a real host.
The dsh security mode plugin achieves a zero third-party plugin startup by constructing a blank profile.
description.zh: dsh安全模式插件，通过构建空白profile实现零第三方插件启动。

description.en: Real DeepSeek account balance and official spend tracker in the session header, with peak/off-peak badge, monetary alert with auto-stop, and one-click top-up.
description.zh: 会话头部的真实 DeepSeek 余额与官方消费统计：高峰/空闲标签、按金额提醒与自动停止、一键充值。

description.en: When a dsh turn gets interrupted — by a web restart or an upstream hiccup (rate limit, 5xx, quota error) — this plugin auto-injects a "continue" so your session picks up where it left off, with a dead-loop guard that hands back control if the retry produces nothing.
description.zh: dsh 会话因 web 重启或上游瞬时故障（限流、5xx、余额/配额错误）中断时，自动注入「继续」让本轮接着跑，不需要手动点、不会丢上下文；带死循环守卫，重试没反应就把会话交回给你。

description.en: Look & theme plugin for the DSH Web UI: built-in palettes, light/dark/follow-system appearance modes, Open VSX theme search & install, and VS Code theme import with a persisted theme library.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 外观与主题插件：内置调色板、明 / 暗 / 跟随系统外观模式、Open VSX 主题搜索导入与 VS Code 主题导入，主题库持久化。

description.en: Mobile adapter for the DSH web shell: overlay sidebar/details drawers, responsive composer and settings below 768px, zero desktop regression.
description.zh: DSH Web 移动端适配插件：侧边栏/详情抽屉浮层化、输入栏与设置页响应式适配，桌面零回归。

description.en: Zero-credential Outlook automation: 13 tools that drive the local desktop Outlook client via COM — search/read mail, drafts, reply/forward, calendar, address book, rooms, free/busy — plus a sidebar new-mail badge. No Graph API registration, no SMTP passwords; anything that leaves the machine passes a three-layer human approval gate.
description.zh: 零凭据 Outlook 自动化：13 个工具通过 COM 直接驱动本地桌面 Outlook 客户端——搜信/读信/草稿/回复转发/日历/通讯录/会议室/忙闲查询——外加侧边栏新邮件角标。无需 Graph API 注册、无需 SMTP 密码；任何外发动作都过三层人工审批门。

description.en: First-class Git tools for the model: status / diff / log / commit / branch with validated messages and paths - no bare-shell git calls.
description.zh: 一等公民的 Git 工具：status / diff / log / commit / branch，参数与路径校验、零 shell 调用，杜绝注入。

description.en: Brings the codebase knowledge-base capability of langchain-ai/openwiki into DSH — one-click generate/read/update of the repository Wiki, Grounded Claims (source-traced knowledge cards) and a project knowledge base built from uploaded local files, reusing the model DSH already has configured, with no second API key.
description.zh: 把 langchain-ai/openwiki 的代码库知识库能力搬进 dsh —— 一键生成 / 阅读 / 更新仓库 Wiki 与 Grounded Claims（溯源知识卡片）与项目知识库（上传本地文件），直接复用 DSH 已配置的模型，无需二次填 Key。

description.en: Real-time hot topics panel for the DSH web GUI: AI news and engineering news, each item with a distilled summary and the source link, shown from a sidebar entry with three views, keyword/source filters, read-state marking and hotkeys.
description.zh: DSH Web 时事热点面板：AI 大事与工科热点实时聚合，每条含要点提炼与来源链接；侧边栏入口、三视图、关键词与来源筛选、已读标记与快捷键。

description.en: Closes ai-memory's consolidation loop for DSH: when a DSH session ends it calls ai-memory finalize-session, so the observations DSH captured become wiki pages the other harnesses ai-memory serves can read. Skips subagents, queues concurrent session ends, and sweeps sessions abandoned by a forced restart.
description.zh: 为 DSH 补上 ai-memory 的收敛闭环：DSH 会话结束时调用 ai-memory finalize-session，把本次捕获的观察整理成 wiki 页面，供 ai-memory 服务的其他 harness 读取；跳过子代理、串行化并发结束的会话，并补扫被强制重启遗留的会话。

description.en: 百通插件广场：在 DeepSeek Harness 中浏览、搜索并安装百通插件市场的 DSH 插件与百通技能库技能
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏逛百通插件市场，搜索、安装插件和技能，还能直接跟 Agent 说一声就装好。

description.en: Sidebar archive directory for DSH Web: restore a session to its original workspace slot, delete the session log, or edit-and-branch a user message into a new conversation.
description.zh: DSH Web 侧栏归档目录：将会话恢复到原工作区槽位、删除会话日志，或从用户消息修改并分支为新会话。

description.en: Zero-token online status indicator for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: an always-visible online/offline dot in the conversation header, auto-refreshed every 15 seconds with no LLM calls.
description.zh: 零 token 在线状态指示器：会话头部常驻显示 ● 在线 / ● 离线 状态点，每 15 秒自动检测一次，不调用任何 LLM。

description.en: Usage statistics dashboard for the DSH Web UI: info cards, a 280-day GitHub-style activity heatmap, daily token trend, and model-usage donut chart.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 用量统计面板：信息卡、280 天活跃热力图、按天 Token 趋势与模型用量双环饼图。

description.en: Whole-disk file search tool backed by the local Everything (voidtools) index: millisecond path queries for the agent over a loopback-only HTTP fast channel with es.exe fallback, plus verified auto-install of the latest stable Everything + ES CLI backend (signature-checked, proxy-aware). Windows only.
description.zh: 基于本机 Everything（voidtools）索引的全盘文件搜索工具：通过仅回环监听的 HTTP 快速通道（es.exe 兜底）为 Agent 提供毫秒级路径查询；后端缺失时自动下载并校验安装最新稳定版 Everything 与 ES CLI（验签名、支持代理）。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: DSH workspace hub: organize workspaces into color-coded folders in the sidebar (three-level drag reorder for folders/workspaces/sessions, inline edit, one-click expand/collapse, dual-channel search) with per-workspace and per-session token usage and cost stats from real session logs (official DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing for any deepseek model, three spend calibers, hover detail cards, overview panel) plus OpenCode Go plan usage; data persists to host disk and refreshes live every 30 s.
description.zh: DSH 工作区中枢：侧边栏将工作区按彩色分组管理（分组/工作区/会话三级拖拽排序、内联编辑、一键展开折叠、标题+消息双通道搜索），基于真实会话日志统计每工作区与每会话的 Token 与花费（任意 deepseek 模型自动按官方峰谷价计费、三种时段口径、悬停明细卡、总览面板），另含 OpenCode Go 额度；分组与结果持久化到本机磁盘，30 秒实时刷新。

description.en: Animated and video live wallpaper for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI — GIF, animated WebP/APNG and static PNG/JPEG images, plus MP4/WebM video backgrounds, with auto format detection, a dim slider, and UI chrome tone matching.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 界面动态壁纸插件：支持 GIF / 动图 WebP / APNG 与静态 PNG/JPG 图片，以及 MP4 / WebM 视频背景，格式自动识别，自带压暗与亮度调节，可让界面色调跟随背景。

description.en: Reports DeepSeek Harness session activity to a self-hosted cc-monitor server, which surfaces Claude Code and DSH sessions as color-coded state cards in one web dashboard and pings your browser and Android app when a session needs attention.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 会话活动上报到自托管的 cc-monitor 服务器：Claude Code 与 DSH 会话以彩色状态卡片出现在同一个 Web 仪表盘中，会话需要关注时通过浏览器与 Android 应用通知你。

description.en: DSH 生图插件：在设置中配置多个生图供应商/模型，并在对话中通过 image_generate 调用当前选中的模型。
description.zh: 在设置中配置多个生图供应商，对话通过 image_generate 调用当前选中的模型；图片保存到工作区 generate/image，并在对话中内联显示。

description.en: Bundles the remote-shell skill for secure SSH, SFTP, Telnet, and WinRM remote operations, with an encrypted credential vault whose login and execution scripts never accept plaintext passwords.
description.zh: 打包 remote-shell 技能，提供安全的 SSH、SFTP、Telnet、WinRM 远程操作，内置加密凭证库，登录与执行脚本不接受明文密码。

description.en: Shows the selected model provider's account balance next to the composer's model seat once a model and reasoning effort are selected.
description.zh: 在选择模型与推理强度后，于输入框模型选择器旁显示当前模型提供方的账户余额。

description.en: Save whole turns — the question plus the full answer — as plain Markdown inside the session workspace, promote the good ones into a cross-project personal knowledge base, and let the model search it on demand. No database and no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 把整轮问答（问题 + 完整回答）存成工作区里的纯 Markdown；把值得留的提升进跨项目个人知识库，模型可按需检索。无数据库、零运行时依赖。

description.en: Adds a Graph tab that renders one session's execution as an interactive DAG of turns, LLM steps, tools, skills, subagents, code changes and tests, with live status, retry aggregation, critical path and trajectory linkage.
description.zh: 在会话区新增「图谱」Tab，把单个会话的执行过程渲染为可交互 DAG：轮次、LLM 步骤、工具、技能、子代理、代码改动与测试，支持实时状态、重试聚合、关键路径与轨迹双向联动。

description.en: Document intake for agents: doc_route sniffs a file's real format by magic bytes and measures a PDF's text layer and page column layout before any conversion, and pdf_markdown converts PDFs to Markdown in column reading order with PyMuPDF. The PDF path needs a Python 3 interpreter with PyMuPDF.
description.zh: 面向 agent 的文档入口：doc_route 先按魔数嗅探真实格式，并测量 PDF 的文本层与分栏版面，再给出该走的提取管线；pdf_markdown 用 PyMuPDF 按分栏阅读顺序把 PDF 转成 Markdown。PDF 路径需要带 PyMuPDF 的 Python 3 解释器。

description.en: Verifiable issue-to-PR delivery chain: an 11-stage pipeline (analysis, search, code understanding, hypothesis, planning, implementation, patch ledger, tests, review, failure classification, PR build) with 4 human review gates, GitHub/GitLab/CodeArts credential connections, a 5-page workbench and a draggable AI assistant panel.
description.zh: Issue-to-PR 可验证交付链：11 阶段流水线（分析→检索→理解→假设→规划→实现→补丁→测试→评审→归因→PR 构建），4 道人工复核闸门，GitHub/GitLab/CodeArts 凭据连接，5 页工作台与可拖拽智能助手浮窗。

description.en: Token usage dashboard and per-session tree statistics: provides time-range filtering, 6 summary metric cards, GitHub-style activity heatmap, model stacked-bar charts with cache hit rate curves, and Top-5 model/provider rankings; enhances the native session status bar to display aggregated token usage across main agents and all subagents with detailed breakdowns.
description.zh: Token 用量统计看板与会话树用量统计：提供快捷时间范围筛选、6 个汇总指标卡片、GitHub 风格活跃热力图、分模型堆叠柱状图与缓存命中率平滑曲线，以及按模型和供应商的 Top5 排行；接管并增强会话底部状态栏，汇总主智能体与全部子智能体的完整用量及分项明细。

description.en: Version-token-validated in-process result cache for the DSH read tool: repeated reads of unchanged files skip file I/O and line rendering, with a readcache tool for stats and clearing.
description.zh: 为 DSH read 工具提供版本令牌校验的进程内结果缓存：未变更文件的重复读取跳过文件 I/O 与行渲染，附带 readcache 工具查看统计与清空。

description.en: Android client implementation for DeepSeek Harness: bridges local dsh web to the OneBox app with QR scan-to-pair and an end-to-end encrypted cloud relay tunnel.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Android 客户端实现:扫码配对 + 端到端加密云端中继,把本机 dsh web 桥接到万宝盒 App。

description.en: Network and proxy doctor for DSH: checks system proxy settings, probes local proxy ports, detects TUN adapters, tests GitHub, TCP and HTTP reachability, scans hosts conflicts and prints concrete suggestions for what to change.
description.zh: DSH 的网络与代理诊断工具：检查系统代理设置、探测本地代理端口、识别 TUN 适配器、测试 GitHub/TCP/HTTP 连通性、扫描 hosts 冲突，并给出具体的修改建议。

description.en: Multi-workspace manager: bind a docs anchor plus ordered code-project repositories into one session, injecting their absolute paths, a recursive file index, a server/client endpoint index and optional coding standards, and syncing writable directories into the sandbox.
description.zh: 多工作区管理器：把文档锚点目录与若干代码项目仓库组合进同一会话，注入绝对路径、递归文件索引、前后端端点落点索引与可选的开发规范，并把可写目录同步进沙盒。

description.en: Runs the standalone opencode2api backend (jasonxu114514/opencode2api, Windows x64/ARM64, no Docker or OpenCode CLI) with DSH and on exit stops only the process it launched; its settings card installs, updates or rolls back the backend from checksum-verified GitHub releases, copies the initial admin password and syncs /v1/models into an opencode2api provider with context, vision and reasoning efforts, re-syncing every 10 minutes.
description.zh: 随 DSH 启动独立的 opencode2api 后端（jasonxu114514/opencode2api，Windows x64/ARM64，无需 Docker 或 OpenCode CLI），退出时只停自己拉起的进程；设置卡片可从经校验和验证的 GitHub Release 安装、更新或回滚后端，复制初始管理密码，并把 /v1/models 连同上下文、视觉与思考档位同步到 opencode2api 模型提供方，运行中每 10 分钟重同步。

description.en: Per-turn file-change card for DSH Desktop: +N −M badges, aligned diffs, and Mac/Windows file open (system app, Finder/Explorer, VS Code).
description.zh: 给 DSH Desktop 用的轮末改动卡：编辑/写入行显示 +N −M，点开审 diff；macOS 和 Windows 可用系统应用、文件夹或 VS Code 打开文件。

description.en: Unified model routing for DeepSeek Harness: one logical ModelID over multiple providers with first-token failover and cooldown, health-aware candidate ranking, three tiers (tier1/tier2/tier3) auto-selected by purpose, per-candidate reasoning effort, and a settings-page management panel.
description.zh: 统一模型路由：一个逻辑 ModelID 汇聚多家供应商，首 token 前失败自动切换并冷却、健康度择优、按 purpose 三档分级（tier1/2/3）、每候选思考级别，设置面板自动保存即时生效。

description.en: Connects the free ZCode plan to the model picker: a multi-account pool with rotation, per-account rate-limit and quota display, and bigmodel/zai device login.
description.zh: 把 ZCode 赠送的免费 plan 接进模型选择器：多账号池轮换、按账号的限流与额度展示、bigmodel/zai 双渠道设备登录。

description.en: Scan a QR code in Settings to open the DeepSeek Harness web UI on your phone inside the active session via a cloudflared quick tunnel.
description.zh: 在设置中扫描二维码，通过 cloudflared 快速隧道在手机上于当前会话中打开 DeepSeek Harness 网页端。

description.en: Replaces the DSH sidebar with a fixed 2×4 board of eight standing agent seats; each seat shows its own status, latest tool call, reasoning and result, and a settings switch restores the stock sidebar at any time.
description.zh: 把 DSH 侧栏换成固定的 2×4 八席看板，每席显示自己的状态、最近一次工具调用、思考与结果；设置里的开关可随时切回原生侧栏。

description.en: A chip at the left end of the composer tool row showing whether DeepSeek bills at peak or off-peak right now. Clicking it opens a card with the current state and rate, the next switch with a countdown, and why this instant is in that state: a weekend, a named statutory holiday, a 调休 make-up workday, or simply outside the peak windows. Times are resolved in Beijing time with an explicit UTC offset, so the verdict does not depend on the machine clock; a hard-coded 2026 Chinese holiday table carries the 33 holiday days and the six 调休 workdays, and a year beyond the table says so instead of guessing.
description.zh: 输入框工具行左端的小胶囊：点一下就知道此刻 DeepSeek 按高峰价还是空闲价计费。点开是当前状态与计费方式、下次切换时间与倒计时，以及此刻为什么是这个状态：周末、具名的法定节假日、调休上班日，或者只是不在高峰时段内。判定用北京时间并显式写死 UTC 偏移，不看本机时钟；内置 2026 年中国法定节假日表（33 天节假日、6 个调休上班日），表外的年份直接说不知道，不猜。

description.en: An F1 Race Control theme for DSH Web with four switchable team skins, broadcast-photo backgrounds, light and dark modes, and native appearance controls.
description.zh: 一款适用于 DSH Web 的 F1 赛事控制中心主题，提供四支车队皮肤、赛事摄影背景、浅色与深色模式及原生外观设置。

description.en: Reusable subagent definitions managed from a Settings page and dispatched through a single delegate_agent tool; ships with a built-in read-only Explorer preset and a nested-delegation policy toggle.
description.zh: 用设置页维护可复用的子代理定义，通过统一的 delegate_agent 工具委派；内置只读的 Explorer 预置与嵌套委派开关。

description.en: Complementary web-search provider: every web_search merges the DeepSeek Search API (primary) with serper.dev Google results (secondary) at a fixed 2:1 ratio. Both sides are direct HTTP retrievals with no auxiliary model turn: URL-deduped sources, long DeepSeek summaries clipped into snippets, per-backend timeouts and graceful degradation to whichever backend answers.
description.zh: 互补式网页搜索 provider：每次 web_search 由 DeepSeek 官方 Search API（主）与 serper.dev 的 Google 结果（补）按固定 2:1 交错合并。两路均为直连检索、无辅助模型调用；来源按 URL 去重，官方长摘要截断注入，单路超时自动降级到另一路。

description.en: Requirement-driven dsh plugin discovery and environment recipes: plugin_guide matches natural-language needs to a curated plugin directory with reasons and install commands; recipe installs whole setups (通知全家桶, 安全审计套装...) from bundled community bundles with ordered plans.
description.zh: 需求型插件导购与环境配方：plugin_guide 按自然语言需求语义匹配精选插件并给出理由与安装命令；recipe 一键安装整套社区配方（通知全家桶、安全审计套装等），带有序安装计划。

description.en: Quality-of-life enhancements for the DSH workspace sidebar: hide workspaces and their sessions, reveal them from the view options, and open any workspace folder in Finder, Explorer or your file manager. Display-only: workspace, session and archive data ar

Registers the Inspiration Deck Workshop skill for DSH: local static HTML presentation decks (6 deck templates, 25+ layouts, 23 themes & motion showroom) with a validate + PNG/PDF export CLI and smoke tests, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 注册灵感演示工坊技能：本地静态 HTML 演示文稿（6 套 deck 模板、25+ 布局、23 套主题与动效展示馆），带 validate 校验与 PNG/PDF 导出 CLI 和 smoke 测试，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Tri-channel task notifications: in-page toasts with chimes, browser OS banners, and host-direct OS toasts that keep working with the browser closed, plus a bell panel with persistent history.
description.zh: 三通道任务通知：页内浮层与提示音、浏览器系统横幅、宿主直发系统通知（浏览器关闭也送达），附铃铛面板与持久历史。

description.en: Render GeoJSON or vector data into an interactive GeoLibre map in a sidebar tab, and let agents operate the live map through tools: layers, styles, view, feature identification, GeoLibre processing algorithms, and the Whitebox toolbox (WASM in the browser).
description.zh: 把 GeoJSON / 矢量数据渲染成侧边栏「地图」tab 里的交互地图，并让 Agent 通过工具实时操作地图：图层、样式、视图、要素识别、GeoLibre 处理算法与 Whitebox 工具箱（浏览器端 WASM 执行）。

description.en: Adds an ETA widget to the DSH web and desktop UI that estimates when the current turn will finish from the todo list and step pace, and shows the remaining time, a progress bar and a confidence badge.
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页端与桌面端加一个 ETA 挂件：按 todo 清单与步进节奏估算本轮何时完成，显示剩余时长、进度条与置信度徽章。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that periodically detects added, modified, and deleted files in a workspace and reports the changes.
description.zh: 一个适配 DeepSeek Harness 的工作区监测插件，按周期检测并报告文件的新增、修改和删除。

description.en: 让 DSH agent 识别微信/QQ 表情包与聊天截图并判断对方情绪（GLM-4V-Flash），暴露 wechat_emoji_analyze 工具。
Back up your DSH profile configuration to a private GitHub Gist on a schedule, with merged restore.
description.zh: 定时把 DSH 配置备份到私有 GitHub Gist，支持合并恢复。

description.en: Browser system notification, sounded by the OS notification itself, when a session needs a reply or a run goes idle; no page-focus check, at most one notification per session with a newer one replacing the old, and an idle notice reports how many background tasks are still running.
description.zh: 会话出现待回复交互或一轮跑完落到空闲时弹出浏览器系统通知，提示音由系统通知自带；不判断页面是否聚焦，每个会话最多保留一条通知、新通知顶掉旧的，空闲时若还有后台任务会在正文里说明数量。

description.en: OpenDesign CoRouter：套餐赠送与付费模型双 Provider、桌面登录态额度及独立登录
Share the current session over the LAN as a read-only, token-guarded HTML snapshot with session stats and Markdown rendering.
description.zh: 将当前会话以只读、token 保护的 HTML 快照分享到局域网，附带会话统计与 Markdown 渲染。

description.en: Anthropic provider using the native Messages API for language models in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
description.zh: 使用原生 Messages API 为 DSH 提供语言模型能力的 Anthropic 提供商。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime。

description.en: Composer GitHub picker: click the GitHub icon at the bottom-right of the input box to search the workspace repository's issues and pull requests via the gh CLI, and insert the reference as a URL or @owner/repo#number mention.
description.zh: 输入框右下角 GitHub 图标打开当前仓库的 issue/PR 搜索弹窗，数据来自本机 gh CLI，点选即以 URL 或 @owner/repo#number 形式插入引用。

description.en: Turns the latest completed DSH session turn into a shareable vertical recap video: editable five-scene storyboard, host-side privacy redaction, optional AI polish and TTS narration, MP4/WebM export with PNG cover.
description.zh: 把最近一次已完成的 DSH 任务生成为可分享的竖屏战报视频：五幕可编辑故事板、Host 侧脱敏、可选 AI 润色与配音，导出 MP4/WebM 和 PNG 封面。

description.en: Manage the dsh service via `dsh --profile ctl`: systemd lifecycle (install, start, stop, restart, enable, disable, uninstall), persisted config, health probe and logs, plus shell completions and self-update.
description.zh: 通过 `dsh --profile ctl` 管理 DSH 服务：systemd 生命周期（安装、启停、重启、自启、卸载）、持久化配置、健康探测与日志，附带 shell 补全与自更新。

description.en: Ingestion-time tool-output curation: keeps error and warning lines plus head and tail, spills the full text to disk with a pointer the model can read back; covers every text tool, small results pass through untouched.
description.zh: 摄入时点的工具输出治理：保留 error/warning 行与头尾，全文落盘留指针供模型按需读回；覆盖所有返回文本的工具，小结果原样通过。

description.en: Exposes the DSH workspace as an HTTP API: browse, search and read files, and run natural-language agent tasks that answer with cited sources.
description.zh: 把 DSH 工作区暴露为 HTTP API：浏览/搜索/读取文件，并支持自然语言任务（agent 查阅文档后带出处回答）。

description.en: Use Jev to adjust main-chat reasoning effort without switching its model, independently select and apply fresh sub-agent capability and effort, and inspect decisions with per-reply allocation feedback.
description.zh: 通过 Jev 调整主会话推理投入而不换模型，为 fresh 子任务独立选择并应用能力与投入，展示决策分布并收集逐回复资源分配反馈。

description.en: A `/backstory` command and tool that annotate each line with the git commit that last touched it and the agent turn + prompt that wrote it, from a persistent per-line ledger (drift-proof by content hash), DSH-* commit trailers, or the live session log.
description.zh: /backstory 命令与工具：为每一行标注最后改动它的 git 提交，以及写下它的 agent 轮次与提示词；数据取自按行持久化的账本（以内容哈希防漂移）、DSH-* 提交尾注或实时会话日志。

description.en: Real-time LSP diagnostics loop: lsp_diagnostics / lsp_workspace_errors / lsp_hover tools over headless stdio language servers (TypeScript/JavaScript + Python), plus an auto-injected post-edit diagnostics delta wired to the harness fs/observed event — Cursor-style edit → diagnostics → fix for dsh agents.
description.zh: 实时 LSP 诊断闭环：通过无头 stdio 语言服务器（TypeScript/JavaScript + Python）提供 lsp_diagnostics / lsp_workspace_errors / lsp_hover 工具，并订阅 harness 的 fs/observed 事件自动注入「本次编辑引入的诊断增量」——为 dsh Agent 带来 Cursor 式的编辑→诊断→修复体验。

description.en: Switch the current DSH session's model with a natural-language sentence, on web, TUI, or IM bridges (WeChat, Feishu), without touching the panel.
description.zh: 用一句自然语言切换当前 DSH 会话模型，可在 Web、TUI 及 IM 桥接的微信、飞书等对话框中使用，无需操作面板。

description.en: Current-session message outline rail for the DSH web UI — your messages show as slim bars on the left edge; hover to expand the full outline (line number + text), click to jump instantly to that message. Pure frontend, zero external service dependencies, sessions-snapshot driven with zero polling.
description.zh: 当前会话消息大纲（左缘横杠）——你的消息在对话区左缘显示一列细横杠，hover 展开完整大纲（行号+文本），点击瞬间定位到对话里那条消息。纯前端、零外部服务依赖、sessions 快照驱动零轮询。

description.en: Bridges the harmonyos-dev-mcp Python MCP server into DSH: HarmonyOS device discovery, build/install/run/uninstall, UI automation (click/input/keys/swipe/screenshot), E2E UI-tree inspection, and log/crash analysis as 18 mcp__harmonyos__* tools.
description.zh: 把 harmonyos-dev-mcp Python MCP 服务桥接进 DSH：鸿蒙设备发现、构建/安装/运行/卸载、UI 自动化（点击/输入/按键/滑动/截图）、E2E 界面树检查、日志与崩溃分析，共 18 个 mcp__harmonyos__* 工具。

description.en: 在 DSH 里搜索并播放哔哩哔哩音频：侧边栏「音乐」面板 + 顶部常驻迷你播放条（电台续播 / 可拖拽吸附成悬浮球 / 歌单 / 点赞踩收藏 / 全局热键 / 播放进度记忆）
Re-speaks each assistant report in a chosen persona outside the working prompt, with four built-in presets, per-session switches, and the original available on demand.
description.zh: 在系统提示词之外，用选定人格转述每条助手汇报；内置四个预设，支持会话级开关，原文随时可查。

description.en: ChatGPT-style question nav rail with up/down arrow buttons — per-question tick marks on the chat edge, hover-triggered drawer listing every user question with real-time search filter, one-click smooth-scroll jump, and active-question highlight synced to scroll position.
description.zh: ChatGPT 风格问题导航胶囊，带 ⏫⏬ 上下箭头 — 对话区右侧逐条刻度尺，悬停展开抽屉列出全部用户问题，实时搜索过滤、一键平滑跳转、滚动同步高亮当前问题，会话切换自动重挂载。

description.en: Replaces the web profile's pwsh shell executor with a subclass that rewrites every command through `rtk rewrite` before execution for token savings, running the original command unchanged on any rewrite failure (no equivalent, missing rtk, timeout) and keeping sandbox semantics intact.
description.zh: 将 web profile 的 pwsh shell 执行器替换为执行前经 `rtk rewrite` 透明改写的子类以节省 token，任何改写失败（无等价、rtk 缺失、超时）都原样执行且沙箱语义完整保留。

description.en: DSH 装饰插件：仅在新会话的主内容区（侧边栏右侧）渲染透明流体薄膜与弹性网格，支持玻璃/调制双模式与明暗主题自适应，其他 UI 全部保持官方。

Union IM bridge for DSH — an independent implementation uniting the capability sets of community peer plugins (xmanrui/dsh-im, MichengAI/dsh-im-connect). Drive your agent session from 15 channel adapters across 12 platforms (including email; WeCom/DingTalk/QQ each contribute two: bot + self-built app or notify tier) — WeChat (official iLink QR bind), Feishu/Lark (long-connection + streaming cards; the voice tier requires system ffmpeg), Telegram, Discord, WeCom intelligent bot & self-built app (signed callback), DingTalk (stream + AI Card and custom-robot notify), QQ official bot (plus notify tier), Slack (Socket Mode), WhatsApp (Baileys QR pairing; the dependency ships as an optionalDependency of the plugin package), Matrix, iMessage (macOS only), Email (IMAP/SMTP thread routing). The cross-version narrow waist auto-adapts settings gen1/gen2/gen3 across hosts 0.1.2-rc.1→0.2.1-rc.2 (12-tag enum; rc.2 verified by a real desktop-profile install with double read-back) using capability probing only, never version branches. In chat: a 25-command panel, tool-approval and question loops answered in the originating chat (deny-by-default, initiator-only, 5-min expiry), image/file input gated on host model metadata, deliverable file return, a delivery log with bounded retry (uncertain is never re-sent), proactive delivery and fragment composition. It also splits the native sidebar into self-owned Tasks / Channels tabs (standing down entirely when another plugin already owns the slot), registers an `im-concise` agent preset plus reply sanitisation that keeps GenUI fences and raw HTML out of text-only chats, renders `svg` fences to PNG images, guards model choice with an allowlist, and mirrors each turn's final answer to notify channels via `/relay` (addressed by account ID or alias, never guessed on ambiguity). Secrets are one-way into the vault and never echoed back. npm: `dsh-im-union`.
description.zh: DSH 的 IM 联合桥：整合社区同类插件（xmanrui/dsh-im、MichengAI/dsh-im-connect）能力合集的独立实现——用 12 个平台的 15 个渠道适配器（含邮件；企微/钉钉/QQ 各含机器人与自建应用或推送两档）驱动宿主会话——微信（官方 iLink 扫码绑定）、飞书（长连接+流式卡片，语音档需系统 ffmpeg）、Telegram、Discord、企微智能机器人与自建应用（回调验签）、钉钉（stream+AI Card 与自定义机器人推送）、QQ 官方机器人（另含推送档）、Slack（Socket Mode）、WhatsApp（Baileys 扫码，依赖以插件包 optionalDependencies 随包分发）、Matrix、iMessage（仅 macOS）、邮件（IMAP/SMTP 线程路由）。跨版本窄腰在 0.1.2-rc.1→0.2.1-rc.2 宿主间（12 tag 枚举，rc.2 已按桌面 profile 装机双回读实证）以能力探测自适配设置面 gen1/gen2/gen3（禁版本号分支）；IM 内 25 命令面板、工具审批与交互提问原聊天闭环（默认拒绝、发起者限定、5 分钟超时）、图片/文件输入（宿主元数据判视觉）、产物文件回传、投递日志限额补发（结果不明绝不重发）、主动投递与碎片续写；原生侧栏「任务/频道」两页签自持分离（检测到该槽位已被其它插件接管则完全不插手）、im-concise 智能体预设配合出站净化把 GenUI 围栏与裸 HTML 等富结构挡在纯文字聊天之外、svg 围栏自动渲染为 PNG 图片发送、模型白名单护栏、/relay 把每回合最终回答镜像到通知渠道（按账号 ID 或别名绑定，歧义不猜）。secret 单向入凭据库，永不回显。npm 包名：`dsh-im-union`。

description.en: Open DSH workspace directories in installed file managers, terminals, and supported editors from the Web UI.
description.zh: 从 DSH Web UI 使用已安装的文件管理器、终端和受支持的编辑器打开工作区目录。

description.en: Multi-channel notification plugin for DeepSeek Harness: dispatches in-page toasts in the foreground and PWA system notifications (Service Worker) or browser notifications in the background, with per-event toggles for task complete, approval request, question, plan review and errors, persistent notifications, and Web Audio synthesized alert sounds without audio files.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多通道通知插件：前台弹页面内 toast，后台按可用性切换 PWA 系统通知（Service Worker）或浏览器通知兜底；任务完成、审批请求、提问、计划评审、出错等事件可逐项开关，重要通知驻留不消失，并用 Web Audio 实时合成提示音效、零音频文件零网络上报。

description.en: Recall a message you already sent: the session log stays append-only and nothing is deleted, while the recalled turns leave the model context and the transcript, the text returns to the composer, and the files those turns changed wait in a quarantine you can review and clear from its own settings page.
description.zh: 撤回已发送的消息：会话日志只追加、不删除任何东西，被撤回的回合退出模型上下文并从对话界面消失、原文回到输入框，被这些回合改动的文件留在隔离区里——设置里独立一页，可查看可清理。

description.en: OpenCode Go balance pill at the right end of the composer tool row: rolling/weekly/monthly quota remaining straight from the Zen usage endpoint, with hover detail and warn/danger coloring.
description.zh: 输入框工具行右侧的 OpenCode Go 余额胶囊：滚动/每周/每月配额剩余百分比（数据直接来自 Zen 用量接口），悬停查看明细，低余额自动变黄/变红。

description.en: Customer-machine access plugin for deepseek-harness-gateway: opens a single outbound WebSocket to the gateway and relays the machine local dsh web UI over that tunnel using pairing-code + HMAC auth, so no inbound port, port mapping, or public IP is needed.
description.zh: 客户机接入插件：以单条出站 WebSocket 连接网关，把本机 dsh web 界面经隧道转发给门户，配对接入码 + HMAC 认证；无需入站端口、端口映射或公网 IP。

description.en: Autonomous agent permission gate for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) with automatic git/Time-Machine snapshots. Safe defaults on install (protect cwd, deny network/system, block sensitive reads). Configure protectedPaths/extraAllowTools to tune access for tools yo
description.zh: macOS 上 DSH 智能体的零干预权限门 —— 安装即生效。可经本地 Git 或时间机器回滚的写操作自动放行并自动打快照，拦截网络、装包、进程 / 系统管理与敏感路径读取，并记录完整审计日志（可配置启用自动清理最旧审计记录）。

description.en: 「对话管理」全局面板页（浏览器半）：会话与统计两层 Tabs——会话视图给出全量会话（含已归档）的搜索、分页、归档 / 取消归档 / 导出 / 删除、导入为新会话与孤儿数据 GC，统计视图给出全部对话的 token 用量。
Right-click any file reference in the chat to open it, open it with an associated application, reveal it in the file manager, copy its path or contents, and save it.
description.zh: 右键聊天里的任意文件引用，即可打开、用系统关联应用打开、在文件管理器中定位、复制路径或文件内容、另存为。

description.en: One-click update for the local DeepSeek Harness checkout — compare versions, pull and rebuild, then restart, and roll back to any past release, all from a sidebar panel with live progress.
description.zh: 一键更新本地 DeepSeek Harness：侧边栏按钮对比版本、拉取重建并自动重启，还可选择回退到任一历史版本，全程实时进度。

description.en: Adds a "用量" section to the DSH Settings page that shows your MiniMax Token Plan usage (5h and weekly windows with reset countdowns), per-model breakdown, and video bonus credits; fetches `/v1/token_plan/remains` via a trusted plugin that holds the API key, auto-hides when no key is configured. MIT.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页「用量」section 展示 MiniMax Token Plan 的 5 小时 / 周窗口用量（带重置倒计时）、单模型明细与视频赠送额度；通过 trusted plugin 调 `/v1/token_plan/remains` 拿 key，未配置 key 时整段 section 自动隐藏。MIT。

description.en: SQL connection, catalog, query, and result workbench for the official DSH right Sidebar.

Gives an agent its own email inbox through AgentMail — eleven tools for sending, reading and labelling mail, plus inbound mail delivered into one harness session per email thread, with an approval gate and recipient allowlist on everything outbound.
description.zh: 用 AgentMail 给 agent 配一个自己的收件箱：发信、读信、搜索与打标签共十一个工具；收到的邮件按邮件线程分派，每个线程对应一个独立会话；所有外发邮件都要过审批与收件人白名单。

description.en: Claude-Code-style lifecycle hooks: configured shell commands run before/after model tool calls with a JSON payload on stdin; a non-zero pre-tool exit blocks the call.
description.zh: Claude Code 风格生命周期 hooks：工具调用前后自动执行 shell 命令（stdin 收 JSON payload），pre-tool 非零退出即阻断调用。

description.en: Drag-and-drop file upload into the conversation composer, token usage pill with quota tracking, and session archive management — a three-in-one daily-driver addon.
description.zh: 会话输入区拖拽上传文件、Token 用量胶囊与额度跟踪、会话归档管理，三合一日常插件。

description.en: Token usage dashboard in the DSH settings page: nine metric cards (total, today, yesterday, peak day, longest session, active-day streak, active days, sessions, subagent tokens), a GitHub-style daily/weekly/cumulative heatmap, and an activity insight list, aggregated locally from session logs and projection caches, keeping token history after a session is deleted.
description.zh: DSH 设置页的 Token 用量看板：九宫指标卡（累计/今日/昨日/峰值日/最长会话/连续活跃/活跃天数/会话/子代理 Token）、GitHub 风格每日/每周/累计热力图与活动洞察，全部从本地会话日志与投影缓存聚合，会话被删后历史 token 仍然保留。

description.en: Shows the installed DeepSeek Harness version in the sidebar, checks npm and GitHub Releases for updates, and provides manual or confirmed update commands.
description.zh: 在侧边栏显示已安装的 DeepSeek Harness 版本，检查 npm 与 GitHub Releases 更新，并提供手动或确认后执行的更新命令。

description.en: Codebase Memory MCP bridge for DeepSeek Harness: six knowledge-graph code tools, auto-started background daemon with visualization Web UI, and bundled agent skill.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Codebase Memory MCP 桥接插件：提供六个原生代码知识图谱工具、自动启动后台守护进程及可视化 Web 界面，并内置专属代理技能。

description.en: Codex-style auto-hiding right-edge turn rail: edge-peek show/hide, per-turn tooltip, in-rail search, and a scrolling 30-turn window for long sessions.
description.zh: Codex 风格自动隐藏右缘轮次导航：靠边浮现、单轮 tooltip、会话内搜索、长会话 30 轮滚动窗口。

description.en: Matrix-style CLI chat page for the DSH web UI: the agent's thinking streams down the screen as green code rain while replies print normally in the terminal.
description.zh: 矩阵风格 CLI 对话页：Agent 思考过程化作绿色代码雨倾泻而下，回复照常流式显示。

description.en: Sends a desktop notification and chime when a DeepSeek Harness run completes, errors, or waits for approval, with a configurable duration threshold.
description.zh: DSH 桌面通知插件：运行完成、出错或等待审批时发送桌面通知并播放提示音，支持可配置的时长阈值。

description.en: Token usage dashboard in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: daily totals from session logs with a 12-month heatmap, per-provider breakdown over today/7d/30d/all (hourly for today) including each route's average output speed, and a per-session ranking that includes archived and deleted sessions and folds subagent usage into its parent.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧栏的 Token 用量看板：从本机会话日志统计每日消耗并给出近 12 个月热力图；按供应商渠道查看今天/近 7 天/近 30 天/全部的用量（今天按小时展开）及各渠道平均输出速度；按会话排行，包含已归档与已删除会话，子代理消耗并入父会话。

description.en: MCP server and skill management for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar panel and a plugin-page config section with search, status lights, per-row switches, expandable details, and an add-server form following Codex mcp_servers fields.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 服务器与技能管理面板：侧栏面板加插件页配置区，支持搜索、状态灯、逐行开关、详情，以及按 Codex mcp_servers 字段设计的添加服务器表单。

description.en: Export a session as a ZIP archive with its attachments, and import such an archive as a new standalone session in the current workspace.
description.zh: 把会话连同附件导出为压缩包，或把这样的压缩包导入为当前工作区里的新会话。

description.en: Notes and folder reader in the main panel: a file tree with pinned files, closeable tabs, Markdown split edit/preview with synced scrolling, plain-text editing, manual save, and drag-to-move. Deleting a file moves it to the system trash where one exists (macOS, Linux), falling back to an in-folder dsh-notes-trash directory; Windows has no delete entry.
description.zh: 主面板内的笔记与目录阅读器：文件树与置顶、可关闭的标签页、Markdown 左编右渲与同步滚动、纯文本编辑、手动保存、拖拽移动文件。删除时移入系统回收站（macOS、Linux），系统回收站不可用时移入目录内的 dsh-notes-trash 目录；Windows 不提供删除入口。

description.en: Registers the remove-pdf-background-gray skill for DSH: whitens gray/off-white scan backgrounds in image-based PDFs while preserving resolution, page geometry, and anti-aliased text edges (lossless Flate write-back), via a single Python script (pypdf + Pillow + numpy).
description.zh: 注册 remove-pdf-background-gray 技能：去除扫描 PDF 的灰色/米白底色，保持分辨率、页面几何与抗锯齿文字边缘（无损 Flate 写回），核心为单文件 Python 脚本（pypdf + Pillow + numpy）。

description.en: A read-only overview tab beside the conversation: what this round asked, what was observed, what still needs checking, and a bounded history you can step through round by round.
description.zh: 对话旁的只读概览页：本轮问了什么、观察到什么、还在验证什么；已结束的轮次可以一条条往回看。

description.en: Adds a Delete session action to the sidebar context menu behind a confirmation modal reporting log size and live activity, cleanly unlinking log files, projection checkpoints, and host memory registrations.
description.zh: 在侧栏上下文菜单中添加删除会话操作，删除前通过模态框实时展示日志大小与活跃状态，并完整清理日志文件、投影缓存与内存注册表杜绝复活。

description.en: 自定义浏览器标签页图标:在设置页上传 SVG/PNG/ICO,立即生效并持久保存,自动适配安卓/iOS/平板 PWA 图标,显示未读红点与进行中黄点(工作区数字/会话行/左上角/标签页,数字可点开清单、点条目定位到侧栏),并可把未读数显示为系统应用图标角标(Windows 任务栏 / macOS Dock,含通知权限申请)。· Custom browser tab favicon: upload SVG/PNG/ICO from the settings page, applies instantly a
BotHarness-qualified IM Provider, maintained from dsh-im

Agentic roleplay for DSH with structured worlds, autonomous characters, persistent sessions, world authoring, speech, and image generation. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-agentic-roleplay#state to be installed and enabled.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供具有结构化世界、自主角色、持久会话、世界创作、语音与图像生成功能的智能体角色扮演系统。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-agentic-roleplay#state。

description.en: Eager, tail-heavy, line-aware tool result trimmer plugin: hooks into post-execution pipeline to trim oversized command outputs with smart semantic reducers and ANSI stripping.
description.zh: 即时、尾部加权、行吸附的工具输出修剪插件：挂载于执行流水线即时截断超大命令输出，内置语义提纯器与 ANSI 剥离。

description.en: Distill over-long model reasoning into its useful core, replay the compressed version on every later request, and report each session's cost and savings. Disabled by default: select one rewrite backend first. derive needs no install and works on packaged DSH; in-place needs 14 source patches and a rebuild (recommended for source checkouts); message-edit needs a third-party plugin and is experimental only.
description.zh: 把过长的模型思考压缩成有用核心，之后每次请求重放压缩版，并给出每个会话的开销与节省报告。默认关闭：必须先选择一个改写后端。derive 无需安装、打包版也能用；in-place 需给 DSH 源码打 14 处补丁并重建（源码构建首选）；message-edit 需装第三方插件，仅实验性，不推荐。

description.en: Approval sound effects from the movie NiuLai: plays 「妈妈」 when user confirmation is requested, interrupts it and plays 「牛来！」 the moment the user approves; native Windows playback, zero external dependencies.
description.zh: 牛来确认音：请求用户确认时播放「妈妈」，批准瞬间掐断并播放「牛来！」；梗源电影《牛来》，Windows 原生播放，零外部依赖。

description.en: A dsh-better-sidebar reading view for .pptx decks: slides in deck order, bullet levels, speaker notes and inline pictures. Ceilings on archive size, per-part inflated bytes and slide count keep a deck from freezing the tab.
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 的 .pptx 阅读视图：按演示顺序列出幻灯片，还原项目符号层级、演讲者备注与内嵌图片。归档体积、单部件解压字节与幻灯片数量均有上限，演示文稿不会卡死标签页。

description.en: Pauses peak-hour requests that target official or listed models and lets everything else run, with editable peak windows, a per-model interception list and per-session free-run in the badge panel.
description.zh: 高峰时段只暂停指向官方或拦截列表内模型的请求，其余照常放行；峰谷时段、按模型的拦截列表与会话「畅跑」都能在徽标面板里编辑。

description.en: Semantic code search for DeepSeek Harness: registers two native tools, semble_search (find code by describing its behaviour, returning ranked file:line hits) and semble_find_related (neighbours of a known location), which run the Semble CLI via uvx, plus one bundled routing skill. Requires uv on PATH; the first query on a repository builds its index.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的语义代码搜索：注册 semble_search（按行为描述检索代码，返回按相关度排序的 file:line 命中）与 semble_find_related（查找已知位置的相邻代码）两个原生工具，检索由 uvx 启动的 Semble CLI 完成，并附一个随包分发的路由技能。需要 PATH 中有 uv；对某个仓库的首次查询会建立索引。

description.en: Run one deterministic skill-routing pass on every user instruction, so the skill catalog is consulted before the model answers instead of after it remembers. On the host it scores the live catalog from the instruction's keywords and the catalog metadata, with no LLM or embedding call, and appends a single producer-tagged message to the step: a ranked shortlist by default, the winning SKILL.md body once the score clears a threshold, or an instruction to call a named router skill exactly once. Unrelated instructions stay silent.
description.zh: 对每条用户指令自动做一次确定性的技能路由，让技能目录在模型作答之前就被查阅，而不是等它自己想起来。宿主侧只依据指令关键词与目录元数据打分，不调用 LLM 也不做向量检索，然后向该步追加恰好一条带生产者标签的消息：默认是候选排名简报，分数过线时改注入冠军技能的 SKILL.md 正文，也可以只注入一句「立刻调用某个路由技能」。无关指令保持沉默。

description.en: A global personal to-do list that is independent of any session: sidebar panel plus an edge dock that peeks on hover and pops open when a task is due, with desktop notification and custom sounds.
description.zh: 全局个人待办（与任何会话无关）：侧边栏面板 + 贴边待办条（悬停探出、快到点自动弹开），到期桌面通知与自定义音效。

description.en: 自定义浏览器标签页图标:在设置页上传 SVG/PNG/ICO,立即生效并持久保存,自动适配安卓/iOS/平板 PWA 图标,显示未读红点与进行中黄点(工作区数字/会话行/左上角/标签页,数字可点开清单、点条目定位到侧栏),并可把未读数显示为系统应用图标角标(Windows 任务栏 / macOS Dock,含通知权限申请)。· Custom browser tab favicon: upload SVG/PNG/ICO from the settings page, applies instantly a
Mobile UI adaptation plugin for DeepSeek Harness - overlay drawer navigation, glassmorphism design, safe-area coverage, PWA support.
description.zh: DSH 移动端 UI 适配插件 - Overlay 抽屉导航、玻璃卡片设计、Safe Area 全覆盖、PWA 支持。

description.en: A dsh-better-sidebar reading view for .docx files: headings from the style map, paragraphs, lists, real table cells, inline pictures and header notes. Ceilings on archive size, per-part inflated bytes and rendered blocks keep a document from freezing the tab.
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 的 .docx 阅读视图：按样式表识别标题，还原段落、列表、真实表格单元格、内嵌图片与页眉注释。归档体积、单部件解压字节与渲染块数均有上限，文档不会卡死标签页。

description.en: Registers the Xunfei Loomy cloud channel as an OpenAI-compatible supplier in dsh-router, adding model listing and streaming chat completions.
description.zh: 把讯飞 Loomy 云端通道作为 OpenAI 兼容供应商接入 dsh-router，提供模型列表与流式对话补全。

description.en: Security and governance for dsh: rule-based tool denial, full tool-call audit trail, and governance reports.
description.zh: dsh 安全治理：规则化工具拦截、完整工具调用审计轨迹与治理报告。

description.en: Offline vocabulary panel: a capsule beside the composer opens a word card, and a dockable tabbed panel tracks today, progress, the mistake book and settings.
description.zh: 离线背词面板：输入框旁一颗胶囊点开是词卡，可钉住的分页面板管着今日、进度、生词本与设置。

description.en: Native A2A (Agent-to-Agent) server for dsh: expose this dsh as a callable agent over HTTP with JSON-RPC tasks.
description.zh: dsh 原生 A2A 服务：通过 HTTP JSON-RPC 将本 dsh 暴露为可调用的代理。

description.en: A recycle bin for DSH session deletion: deleting a session moves it to a bin where it can be restored, and space is reclaimed on permanent delete or on a retention schedule.

Preset doctor for DeepSeek Harness: auto-detects broken agent presets (legacy format, renamed packages, stale config keys) and mechanically repairs them to the current 0.1.7+ syntax, with backup, atomic writes and idempotence.
A lightweight plugin that adds model thinking token statistics to the bottom Dock.
description.zh: 在底部 Dock 添加模型思考 token 统计信息的轻量化插件。

description.en: Personal QQ channel for dsh: managed NapCat with QR login, private/group AI replies with batching and image understanding, local archive with polling backfill, in-group @ and self-recall, QQ Zone guestbook tools, and a sidebar panel. By default any QQ user who DMs the account (or @s it in a group) gets an AI reply; set access.privateMode / groupMode to allowlist to restrict. Owner-only commands stay owner-only.
description.zh: 把 dsh 接到个人 QQ：NapCat 托管与扫码登录、私聊/群聊 AI 回复（含图片理解）与批量节流、本地归档与轮询补漏、群内 @ 与撤回自己刚发的消息、QQ 空间留言，并带左侧栏管理面板。默认任何 QQ 用户私聊该账号（或在群里 @ 它）都会得到 AI 回复；把 access.privateMode / groupMode 设为 allowlist 才限制。主人专属命令仍只对主人生效。

description.en: Glassmorphism theme for the DSH web UI: frosted translucent surfaces with adjustable opacity, blur radius and saturation, ambient lighting and accent palettes, plus a custom background image with cover, contain, stretch, tile or center fit and crop, all persisted from a settings page.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的毛玻璃主题：磨砂半透明表面，可调不透明度、模糊半径与饱和度，支持氛围光与配色方案，并可设置自定义背景图片（填充、适应、拉伸、平铺、居中与裁剪），全部参数保存在设置页中。

description.en: Estimate session and turn costs with model prices in USD or CNY and price sync from models.dev, OpenRouter, or DeepInfra.
description.zh: 估算会话和每轮费用，按模型设置 USD 或 CNY 单价，并从 models.dev、OpenRouter 或 DeepInfra 同步价格。

description.en: Animated background themes for the DSH desktop — 10 scene renderers (milky way, glow horizon, layered mountains, cloud dome, aurora ionosphere, black hole, cloud train, particle image, pixel sculpt, blinking squares), a wallpaper and video library, per-zone UI surface transparency, and a replica of the Appearance settings panel.
description.zh: 给 DSH 桌面版换上动态背景——10 种场景渲染器（银河、辉光地平线、层峦、云穹、极光电离层、黑洞、云列车、粒子成像、像素雕塑、闪烁方块）、壁纸与视频素材库、UI 表面分区透明，外加逐像素复刻的 Appearance 设置面板。

description.en: Session management for the DSH sidebar: pin conversations, search their contents, read archived transcripts and hide noise.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏会话管理：固定对话、搜索内容、读取归档记录并隐藏噪音。

description.en: Zhipu GLM web search provider: registers as `glm` on the ctx.web seam and runs the native web_search server tool through GLM's Anthropic-compatible API (Coding Plan billing).
description.zh: 智谱 GLM 联网搜索 provider：以 glm 注册到 ctx.web 缝，经 GLM 的 Anthropic 兼容 API 执行原生 web_search 服务端工具（走 Coding Plan 计费）。

description.en: A QQ NT messenger skin for DeepSeek Harness: light and dark share one QQ NT language — clean restrained light mode (brand blue #12B7F5, light-blue bubbles) and a calm blue-gray dark mode (#101822) — applied as reversible token and layout layers that never touch your Light/Dark preference.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 QQ NT 皮肤：浅色与深色共用一套 QQ NT 语言——浅色干净克制（品牌蓝 #12B7F5、浅蓝气泡），深色为沉稳蓝灰（#101822）——以可逆的 token 与布局两层实现，不改变你的浅色/深色偏好。

description.en: Keeps the images you pasted or attached in the composer, per session: they are mirrored locally in the browser and handed back through the official draft channel when you return to the conversation or the composer remounts, and dropped as soon as the message is sent or you remove them.
description.zh: 按会话保住输入框里的图片草稿：在浏览器本地留一份镜像，切回该对话或输入框重新挂载时经官方草稿通道放回去；消息一旦发出或你手动移除，就不再见它回来。

description.en: Desktop notification and sound when a turn completes, the agent asks a question, or an approval is requested, each independently toggleable, plus an activity ball that lists live sessions and jumps back to one.
description.zh: 跑完 / 提问 / 需要审批时弹桌面通知与提示音（三类可分别开关），另附活动悬浮球，点会话行直接跳回该会话。

description.en: Pre-execution safety valve for DSH that judges with TypeSafe Jev: it hooks tools/pre-execute and decides every bash/pwsh call by first applying offline static rules, then by asking the Jev model — the System One model from TypeSafe, which returns a structured decision instead of prose — one yes-no question ("will this command irreversibly delete or overwrite real data?"), turning the answer into allow, revise, block or escalate; revise hands the model a safer rewrite, escalate offers a one-shot human token; exhausted credit or a missing API key degrades loudly instead of failing silent, and a missing key is requested in the conversation itself (`guard key set`, read from stdin); every verdict is appended to a shared audit log and the text people read is bilingual zh-CN/en.
description.zh: DSH 执行前安全阀门，用 TypeSafe Jev 模型做判定：挂载 tools/pre-execute，对每条 bash/pwsh 调用先过离线静态规则，再向 Jev 模型（TypeSafe 的 System One 模型，返回结构化判定而非散文）提一个是非问句——「这条命令会不可逆地删除或覆盖真实数据吗？」——把答案切成允许／修正／拦截／上报人工四态；修正给模型更安全的写法，上报提供一次性人工令牌；额度耗尽或没有可用密钥时大声降级而非静默失效，缺密钥时会直接在对话里要求录入（录入用 `guard key set`，只从标准输入读）；每条判定写入共享审计日志，面向人的文案中英双语。

description.en: Conversation timeline dock bar for DeepSeek Harness: a turn-level timeline above the composer with user-prompt hover tooltips and click-to-jump back to the exact chat position.
description.zh: 对话时间线横条：输入框上方按轮次聚合的时间线，悬停显示该轮用户提示词，点击直接跳转到对话中的对应位置。

description.en: Model Health panel in Settings: lists every model configured in settings.yaml and batch-tests availability and latency for each.
description.zh: 设置页「模型健康」面板：列出 settings.yaml 配置的全部模型，一键批量测试可用性与延迟。

description.en: Replaces the sidebar workspace region with a two-tab browser: several workspace roots stay registered side by side while conversations are filed under the real working directory of each session, with a read-only resource tree that previews files in the right sidebar. Hiding is per tab, display-only and fully reversible; a resource folder or file can be copied as a path or dragged into the composer as a native reference, and @ completion covers every registered root rather than the working directory alone.
description.zh: 把侧边栏的工作区区域换成双选项卡浏览器：多个工作区根并列登记、各自固定不变，对话按每个会话真实的工作目录归入目录树，资源是只读文件树、点击即用右侧栏预览。两个选项卡各自独立隐藏、只影响显示且完全可逆；资源文件夹或文件可复制路径，也可拖进输入框成为原生引用块；@ 补全覆盖全部已登记工作区，而不只是当前工作目录。

description.en: Adds a Theme row to Settings → General between Appearance and Font size — 8 builtin palettes plus Default, hover previews without writing, click applies and is persisted by the host; imports/exports custom dsh-theme.json files, with an optional Theme Creator skill behind /dsh-theme-creator.
description.zh: 在「设置 → 通用」的官方「外观」与「字号」之间注入「主题」行：8 套内置配色 + 默认项，悬停预览不写盘、点击应用并由 Host 持久化；支持导入/导出自定义 dsh-theme.json 主题文件，另有可选的 Theme Creator skill（/dsh-theme-creator）。

description.en: Feeds every dsh prompt into the local agent-feedback-loop feedback-memory pipeline — captures dissatisfaction, reviews it offline into reflections, and attaches the compiled recurrence-rule context back to the turn, never blocking a prompt. Requires the agent-feedback-loop runtime; running agent-feedback-loop install afterwards wires existing dsh profiles automatically.
description.zh: 把 dsh 的每一轮 prompt 送入本地 agent-feedback-loop 反馈记忆管线——捕获用户不满、离线评审沉淀为反思，并把编译好的复发规则上下文附着回当前轮次，从不阻塞 prompt。需要先安装 agent-feedback-loop 运行时；安装后执行 agent-feedback-loop install 会自动接线已有的 dsh profile。

description.en: Ctrl+F find-in-session for the conversation, powered by the session store rather than the DOM - labels every hit by source (you / assistant / reasoning / tool call / tool result / system), groups results by turn, merges identical snippets, offers prose-vs-everything scope, regex / case / whole-word options, highlights all matches, and copies or exports the result set as Markdown.
description.zh: 会话内 Ctrl+F 全文查找（读会话 store 而非 DOM）：命中按来源分类（你/助手/思考/工具调用/工具输出/系统）、按轮次分组、同文合并，可切「只搜正文 / 搜全部内容」，支持正则/大小写/全词，全量高亮，并能把结果复制或导出为 Markdown。

description.en: Opens the DSH settings dialog as a full-page screen and moves the close control to a back row at the top left.
description.zh: 让 DSH 的设置弹窗以整页全屏打开，并把退出入口移到左上角的返回行。

description.en: Skips offscreen chat and trajectory rows so long sessions scroll smoothly; measured row heights keep the scrollbar steady, visible content unchanged.
description.zh: 让视口外的聊天行与轨迹行不参与渲染，长会话滚动更稳；行高按实测保留，滚动条不跳，屏幕内画面不变。

description.en: The host end of the client half's transport: a WebSocket upgrade route that bridges microphone audio in and agent speech out.
Realtime voice capability seam for DeepSeek Harness: a provider registry plus the session adapter base.
Makes the WorkBuddy desktop app's web search the dsh web_search provider, reusing the app's existing sign-in with no extra configuration.
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 的网络搜索作为 dsh 的 web_search 提供方，复用 App 已有的登录状态，无需额外配置。

description.en: Bring text-to-video and image-to-video generation to DeepSeek Harness — DashScope Wanx, Volcengine/Doubao Seedance, Google Veo, OpenAI Sora & compatible relays.
连接小沐（MuChe 数字生命）的 dsh 插件：可以和有持续状态的小沐聊天，小沐可调用本机 dsh 执行任务
description.zh: 连接小沐的 dsh 插件：和有持续状态的小沐聊天，小沐可调用本机 dsh 执行任务。

description.en: Token usage and cost metering for dsh: per-session and aggregate statistics with configurable pricing and reports.
description.zh: dsh 用量计量：会话级与汇总 token 统计、可配置计价与报告。

description.en: Conversation navigation with full-history turns, collapsible process steps, final-result and structured question-and-answer keys, and pointer-following piano interaction.
description.zh: 提供完整历史轮次导航、过程步骤折叠、最终结果与结构化问答琴键，以及鼠标连续跟随交互。

description.en: Ghidra bridge plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): 219 reverse-engineering tools — import binaries, decompile, xrefs, search, script Ghidra, plus the full upstream GhidraMCP REST surface, served from a single Ghidra JVM. Cross-platform (Windows, Linux, macO
description.zh: 把 Ghidra 逆向工具接进 DSH，218 个工具随取随用，反编译、恶意样本分析一站搞定。

description.en: Turns the LobsterDaddy multi-account console into a floating ball in the DSH window: drag it anywhere and the position persists, and the panel can be set to follow the ball. Clicking it slides out a drawer that renders the console as native DOM (no iframe) from the loopback-only same-origin proxy, showing action buttons, the account LobsterAI is currently signed in as, and a per-account list with balance, check-in state and last check-in time; a resizable persisted drawer, a live online/offline dot and an account-count badge are included.
description.zh: 把 LobsterDaddy 多账号控制台变成 DSH 界面上的悬浮球：可拖到任意位置并自动记忆坐标，面板可设置为跟随悬浮球移动；点开以抽屉呈现控制台——界面由原生 DOM 渲染（不用 iframe），数据经仅限本机的同源反向代理获取，自上而下为操作按钮、当前登录账号、以及含积分余额与签到状态（附最近签到时间）的账号列表；抽屉可拖动缩放并记忆尺寸，另有在线状态圆点与账号数徽标。

description.en: Long-term memory scoped to the DSH workspace. A session opens with a one-line-per-memory index - bodies are fetched on demand by the `memory` tool, so the same character budget holds about three times as many entries - and when a turn ends a purely local search over the last user message pulls the matching memories into the next briefing at no model cost. Optional auto-capture distils a stretch of conversation into structured memories; in draft mode they wait in an approval queue instead of landing directly. A portrait layer keeps a workspace and a global picture, rewritten from the journal and the records, with the same draft-or-direct choice. Settings → Memory holds the archive, list and timeline views, a health check (duplicate clusters, stale entries, broken links), the supersede version chain with rollback, and a read-only scan that imports existing WorkBuddy / Qoder memory files.
description.zh: DSH 的工作区长期记忆。会话开始只注入「一行一条」的记忆索引，正文由 memory 工具按需取——同样字数预算约装三倍条目；一轮结束时用当轮最后一条用户消息做纯本地检索，命中的记忆下一轮随简报召回，不花模型 token。可选自动提炼把一段对话归纳成结构化记忆，captureMode=draft 时先进审批队列、你批准了才生效。另有画像层：工作区与全局各一份全貌，由日志与条目重写生成，同样可走草稿。设置 → 记忆 里有档案 / 列表 / 时间线、体检（重复簇、过期未用、断链）、版本链 supersede 与一键回滚，以及「扫描本机」把已有的 WorkBuddy / Qoder 记忆文件导入（只读，不动来源）。

description.en: Prompt library stored in the plugin config, with a Settings page and a composer picker: the ticked prompts are injected into every model step of that session, and a subagent inherits the selection of its nearest ancestor session.
description.zh: 提示词库存放在插件配置中，含 Settings 页面与输入框选择器：勾中的提示词注入该会话的每一步模型调用，subagent 继承其最近祖先会话的选择。

description.en: Adds a mood-aware Japanese kaomoji to agent replies, picked from a curated kaomojiya.org whitelist and configurable from Settings → General.
description.zh: 给 dsh 回复按情绪添加日文颜文字，词库精选自颜文字屋（kaomojiya.org），可在「设置 → 通用设置」中调整。

description.en: Adds drag-and-drop attachments for local files, folders, ZIP archives and Office documents.
description.zh: 支持拖放本地文件、文件夹、ZIP 压缩包和 Office 文档作为附件。

description.en: Git workspace manager for DeepSeek Harness: a repo-gated composer button opens a settings-style panel for diff/commit, branch, conflict, and worktree management, plus a commit history with branch-graph lines.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 工作区管理：输入框「模式」选择器旁的仓库感知入口，打开与设置同规格的面板，覆盖 diff/commit、分支、冲突、worktree 管理与带分支线的提交历史。

description.en: GitHub-style daily token-usage heatmap on the new-session screen with a selectable calendar-year view, green/blue color schemes, and today / this-month / all-time totals.
description.zh: 新建会话页的 GitHub 风格每日 Token 用量热力图：可选日历年度视图、绿/蓝配色与显示开关，并附今日/本月/累计总量。

description.en: Mounts external skill directories (Claude Code, Codex, ZCode) into DSH as read-only skill providers: frontmatter field mapping, name slug normalization and hot reload.
description.zh: 技能兼容层：把 Claude Code / Codex / ZCode 的技能目录挂载为 dsh 的只读技能提供方——支持 frontmatter 字段映射、名称 slug 规范化与热重载。

description.en: Publishes the running DSH host as a Model Context Protocol endpoint, so other harnesses such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or another DSH can start and continue sessions, read transcripts, wait on or cancel turns, and answer pending approvals; every call is attributed to its caller, and owner-scoped sessions keep callers apart.
description.zh: 把正在运行的 DSH 宿主发布成 MCP 端点，让 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、另一个 DSH 等 harness 可以创建与延续会话、读取对话记录、等待或取消回合、代答待决审批；每次调用都归因到发起方，会话按所有者隔离。

description.en: Search the documents and pictures in your Quberi knowledge base, browse its spaces and documents, save notes to it, and upload files into it with your approval for each one, from DeepSeek Harness over OAuth.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内通过 OAuth 检索你的 Quberi 知识库中的文档和图片，浏览空间和文档，保存笔记，并上传文件（每个文件都需你确认）。

description.en: Localizes known DSH system instructions and runtime reminders into Simplified Chinese, trims tool-related guidance to visible tools, and provides editable translations and component toggles while preserving tool names and parameter schemas.
description.zh: 将 DSH 已知系统指引与运行时提醒中文化，按可见工具裁剪相关指导，提供逐条译文编辑和组件开关，保留工具名与参数结构。

description.en: Shows JeV-selected task plans, progress updates and stage summaries in DSH chat, with native translation or lightweight summaries. Requires a JeV key; the Jev service is called externally and may bill. and hierarchical serial/parallel task flows.
description.zh: 通过 JeV 筛选并外显思考中的任务规划、进展和阶段小结，支持轻量摘要、DSH 原生翻译（需 JeV Key，会外部调用 Jev 服务并可能计费）及父子任务、串并行流程图。

description.en: English-only fork of dsh-model-router. Routes each agent step across a configurable model pool and adjusts reasoning effort based on task complexity, tool failures, and cost.
description.zh: dsh-model-router 的纯英文分支。把每个 agent 步骤路由到可配置的模型池，并按任务复杂度、工具失败与成本调整推理强度。

description.en: Floating pill for DeepSeek Harness that shows OpenCode Go usage for the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows as three rings, works out the remaining model quota automatically and can show the DeepSeek account balance alongside; a minimal mode nests the rings and lets you choose which of the 5-hour / weekly / monthly figures each outer / middle / inner ring shows, with a live preview.
description.zh: DSH 悬浮窗：三环显示 OpenCode Go 的 5 小时 / 本周 / 本月用量，支持自动计算模型配额剩余，可选同时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额；极简模式把三环嵌套显示并支持自定义外 / 中 / 内环数据与实时预览。

description.en: Provider quota and balance status widget for the DSH web UI, showing remaining quota, usage and rate-limit windows in a dock at the bottom of the composer. Local fork of wenzetan/dsh-quota-panel.
description.zh: DSH Web 端的供应商额度与余额状态小组件，在输入框底部的停靠区展示剩余额度、用量与限流窗口。wenzetan/dsh-quota-panel 的本地分叉。

description.en: Reuses the sign-in already held by the local Doubao desktop app as a DeepSeek Harness model provider, and adds a read-only quota view for the 5-hour and weekly windows. Windows x64 only: the credential is decrypted with DPAPI.
description.zh: 复用本机豆包桌面客户端已有的登录态，作为 DeepSeek Harness 的模型 provider，并提供 5 小时限额与周额度的只读额度概览。仅 Windows x64：凭据解密依赖 DPAPI。

description.en: LocalAI provider for language models, embeddings, reranking, speech, and image generation with LocalAI-specific controls in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供语言模型、嵌入、重排序、语音和图像生成能力及 LocalAI 专用控制项的 LocalAI 提供商。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime。

description.en: Drives a Chromium browser you are already running — Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, Opera, Chromium, Arc or Thorium — over one long-lived CDP connection, so the remote-debugging approval is asked once instead of per command. Commands for tabs, navigation, JS evaluation, DOM snapshots, clicks, typing, screenshots and CSS/DOM/pixel assertions go over a loopback HTTP route that the agent calls with the shell tool it already has, so no new tools are registered, and the plugin registers its own usage skill with no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 通过一条常驻 CDP 连接驱动本机已在运行的 Chromium 内核浏览器——Chrome、Edge、Brave、Vivaldi、Opera、Chromium、Arc、Thorium，远程调试授权只需点一次，而不是每条命令都点。标签页、导航、执行 JS、DOM 快照、点击、输入、截图以及 CSS/DOM/像素断言都走本机回环 HTTP 路由，agent 用已有的 shell 工具发命令，因此不注册新工具；插件自带使用说明 skill，零运行时依赖。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin with a settings page that downloads, enables and mounts MCP servers for work apps (Office, Blender, Unity, Figma, Photoshop, Chrome, Godot, Windows, Notion, Gmail, Cloudflare, Cloudflare Docs, GitHub, ComfyUI, FFmpeg, Obsidian), pl
description.zh: 把 Office、Notion、GitHub 等工作软件的 MCP 服务器统一挂载管理，随插件装卸，不污染配置。

description.en: KiCad DRC tool for DeepSeek Harness — run kicad-cli pcb drc, return structured results, and render the report as a paginated card in the Web GUI.
A token-based DeepSeek Harness theme plugin with ten presets, custom colors, and system font pickers.
description.zh: 基于原生令牌的 DeepSeek Harness 主题插件，提供十套预设、自定义配色与系统字体选择。

description.en: In-session "Files" tab (conversation.view, order 20) for dsh Web that browses the active session's workspace directory with breadcrumbs and previews files inline — sanitized Markdown (marked + DOMPurify), images, line-numbered text and PDF — served by read-only /dsh-files host routes registered on ctx.webServer; no write endpoints. Bilingual zh/en.
description.zh: dsh Web 会话内「文件」页签（conversation.view，order 20）：以当前会话工作区为根的面包屑目录浏览，内联预览消毒渲染的 Markdown（marked + DOMPurify）、图片、带行号文本与 PDF；目录与读取全部经 ctx.webServer 注册的只读 /dsh-files 宿主路由，无任何写端点（中英双语）。

description.en: Generate images and videos, edit images, remove backgrounds, upscale images, upload reference media, and check Fotor credits.
description.zh: 通过 Fotor 生成图片和视频、编辑图片、移除背景、放大图片、上传参考素材及查询积分。

description.en: A separate narrow-screen web surface for DeepSeek Harness rather than the desktop GUI scaled down: it serves its own session list and chat stream behind a random access token over LAN, a tunnel (cloudflared, localtunnel or localhost.run) or an SSH reverse forward through a server you own. On the phone it streams assistant text, thinking, tool calls and results, sends prompts, stops the running turn, answers blocking questions and tool approvals (including ones waiting in other sessions), switches model, thinking level and permission preset, sends up to four photos compressed on the device, and keeps the computer awake.
description.zh: 为 DSH 单独做的窄屏移动端 Web 服务，不是把桌面 GUI 缩放塞进手机：自带会话列表与聊天流，随机访问令牌保护，可走局域网、cloudflared / localtunnel / localhost.run 隧道或自有服务器 SSH 反向转发。手机上流式看助手文本、思考、工具调用与结果，能发提示词、停止当前回合、回答阻塞提问与工具审批（含其它会话里等待的），切换模型 / 思考等级 / 权限预置，发送最多 4 张手机上压缩过的照片，并可一键让电脑常亮。

description.en: Git sidebar panel with commit graphs, ahead/behind tracking, branch operations, and one-click chat context injection.
description.zh: Git 侧边栏面板：提交图谱、超前/落后跟踪、分支操作及改动 Diff 一键带入对话。

description.en: Per-project MCP servers: a project declares servers in its own documents (`.dsh/mcp.json` by default; the local and global file lists are settings), and they are mounted only for the sessions working in that project — on the first turn of a session, released when it goes idle. A right-sidebar tab and a Settings page list each project with a live session, the status of every server and the session holding each mount, with `Sync` / `Retry` / `Release`, an `enabled` switch and an editor over one existing entry; a per-project tool policy (`disclosure` / `direct` / `off`) with pins and `mcp_search_tools` decides what the model sees; `${VAR}` references resolve through the project `.env` files and the credentials file; per-server call counters outlive the sessions that produced them.
description.zh: 按项目挂载 MCP 服务器：项目在自己的文档里声明服务器（默认 `.dsh/mcp.json`，本地与全局文件列表均为配置项），只对在该项目中工作的会话挂载——会话首个 turn 时挂载，空闲后释放。右侧栏标签页与设置页列出每个有活动会话的项目、各服务器状态以及持有挂载的会话，并提供 `Sync` / `Retry` / `Release`、`enabled` 开关和对某个既有条目的编辑器；按项目的工具策略（`disclosure` / `direct` / `off`）配合固定项与 `mcp_search_tools` 决定模型可见范围；`${VAR}` 引用依次从项目 `.env` 文件与凭据文件解析；按服务器统计的调用次数不随会话消失。

description.en: 把 QQ 小号接进 DeepSeek Harness：收发消息、发表情包、发 QQ 空间说说、参与群聊，能自己找话题，自带启动与限速防封。

Select text in a conversation to attach a numbered highlight with a colour stored per note, keep every mark in an outline panel that jumps back to its quote, and let a corner self-check badge report style, selector and saved-key problems without opening dev tools.
description.zh: 在对话里划词加批注：编号高亮、每条各记自己的颜色，大纲面板列出全部标记并点一条跳回原文；右下角自检角标不开开发者工具就报出样式、越界选择器与本地存档键的问题。

description.en: Annotate elements in the built-in browser — click one, write a comment, then send the whole batch to the session in one message so the model can find and edit the matching source.
description.zh: 在内置浏览器里点选页面元素写批注，攒够后一次性发给会话，让模型直接定位并修改对应源码。

description.en: 小猫娘破甲（快速版）— DSH 提示词注入插件，精简破甲内核，固定身份
DSH 工作完成提示：一轮工作结束播放「冰冰冰」提示音，并在右下角弹出可点击跳转的通知条；声音、音量、提示范围与自定义音源都在设置页里
Floating widget showing real-time OpenCode Go subscription usage (rolling/weekly/monthly) for every API key, with rate-limit alerts and automatic key-pool discovery.
description.zh: 悬浮组件实时显示 OpenCode Go 各 key 用量（滚动/每周/每月），限流预警，自动发现 key 池。

description.en: 在 DSH 中打开本地 HTML 原型，点元素写批注，提交后把批注作为消息发给当前会话，由 Agent 修改源码。

DSH plugin: read and write DingTalk AI Tables through the official dws CLI, adding ten DingTalk AI Table tools (nine `dingtalk_aitable_*` plus `dingtalk_sync_job`), a settings panel, and scheduled CSV export.
description.zh: DSH 插件：包装钉钉官方 dws CLI，读写钉钉 AI 表格，提供 10 个钉钉 AI 表格工具（9 个 `dingtalk_aitable_*` 加 1 个 `dingtalk_sync_job`）、设置面板与定时 CSV 导出。

description.en: Consult multiple expert advisor models in a retro CRT chat-group card: one ask_advisors call runs an auto-deepen pipeline (driver deep-question, advisor relay, synthesis conclusion) with SSE streaming, 26 provider presets, a configurable daily quota, stop/resume, and optional advisor tool calling.
description.zh: 主模型在专业/长尾/高风险或不确定问题上召集多个专家顾问模型，以复古 CRT 聊天组卡片展示：一次 ask_advisors 自动跑满自动深挖流水线（驱动模型追问、顾问接力、综合结论），真流式 SSE、26 个供应商预设、可配置每日配额、停止/继续，以及可选的顾问工具调用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness host plugin for the DSH Mobile Android app: pair with a QR, use DSH on the phone through its own HTTPS gateway, answer approvals and questions from notifications, push turn completion.
description.zh: 把 DSH 装进安卓手机，扫码配对后就能在通知栏里直接处理回答审批。

description.en: Graph-based code context, impact analysis, review workflows, interactive graphs, and permission-controlled refactoring for DSH using the code-review-graph engine.
description.zh: 基于 code-review-graph 引擎，为 DSH 提供代码图谱上下文、影响分析、审查工作流、交互式图谱和权限控制的重构。

description.en: Web interface enhancements for DeepSeek Harness with session rename/fork shortcuts, a searchable model picker with provider filters, mobile layouts, global font scaling, context usage alerts, DeepSeek balance and tariff rates, sent-message navigation, and conversation summaries.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页交互增强，提供会话重命名与分叉快捷操作、带搜索和供应商筛选的模型选择器、移动端布局、全局字体缩放、上下文用量提醒、DeepSeek 余额与峰谷价格、已发消息导航和对话情况总结。

description.en: Reads each third-party endpoint's own model listing and keeps llm-pi-ai's per-model reasoningEfforts in sync, so the composer offers the thinking levels a model actually has.
description.zh: 读取每个第三方端点自己的模型列表，同步 llm-pi-ai 的逐模型 reasoningEfforts，让输入框提供模型真实支持的思考等级。

description.en: Mobile pairing remote for DeepSeek Harness: E2EE companion over dual-plane allowlisted RPC (LAN, Tailscale, optional Cloudflare Quick Tunnel or self-hosted rendezvous).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 移动配对远程插件：双平面白名单 RPC 上的端到端加密 Companion（局域网、Tailscale，可选 Cloudflare Quick Tunnel 或自建 rendezvous）。

description.en: Read-only MCP server exposing the dsh-plugin-certification registry: certification grades, snapshots and five-dimension evidence for DeepSeek Harness plugins.
description.zh: 基于 DSH 插件认证登记的只读 MCP 服务，对外提供插件的认证等级、其快照以及支撑它的五维证据。

description.en: Ctrl+click file paths and links in chat: paths open their folder in the OS file manager (with the file selected), links open in a new browser tab.
description.zh: 在对话中 Ctrl+点击文件路径与链接：路径在文件管理器中定位所在文件夹，链接在新标签页打开。

description.en: Turns a ZSpace (极空间) NAS into native agent tools: list, stat, search, read, download, upload, write, create folders, rename, move, copy and delete files on the NAS. Works across networks through the desktop client relay — no LAN, no WebDAV, no SSH — and switches to the faster direct WebDAV transport automatically when the NAS is on the same network. Deletes require an explicit confirm: true; write, upload, create-folder, rename, move and copy run directly, and zspace_write overwrites a same-named file unless overwrite is false.
description.zh: 把极空间（ZSpace）NAS 变成 agent 的原生工具：列目录、查属性、按名检索、读取、下载、上传、写入、建目录、重命名、移动、复制、删除 NAS 文件。跨网络走桌面客户端中转——不需要同一局域网、不用 WebDAV、不用 SSH；同一网络时自动改走更快的 WebDAV 直连。删除需显式传 confirm: true；写入、上传、建目录、重命名、移动、复制默认直接执行，zspace_write 会覆盖同名文件（除非传 overwrite: false）。

description.en: Persistent Codex, Grok Build and Claude Code sessions through ACP, with native model controls, permission approvals and optional A2A delegation.
description.zh: 通过 ACP 使用持久化的 Codex、Grok Build 和 Claude Code 会话，支持原生模型控制、权限审批及可选的 A2A 委派。

description.en: MCP server management panel in Settings: add, edit, enable/disable and delete servers across user and workspace scopes with form or JSON editing, and auto-register discovered MCP tools as native conversation tools.
description.zh: 在设置中提供 MCP Servers 管理面板：新增、编辑、启停、删除服务器，支持用户/项目作用域与表单/JSON 双模式编辑，并自动把发现的 MCP 工具注册为对话原生工具。

description.en: One hub over every coding IDE you run — dsh, Claude Code, Codex, ZCode, Qoder, CatPaw, Trae, OpenCode. Zero-API: it reads each tool's own on-disk state and gives a session inventory, per-IDE usage with cache-hit rates, one-line resume commands, and a single .hub/ rule body wired into all eight via marker-delimited pointer files. The domestic-IDE adapters (Trae/Qoder/CatPaw) were verified against the installed binaries — a gap no overseas tool covers.
description.zh: 一个入口管住所有编码 IDE（dsh/Claude Code/Codex/ZCode/Qoder/CatPaw/Trae/OpenCode）：零 API 读各自磁盘状态，出会话盘点、按 IDE 用量与缓存命中率、一键恢复命令，并用指针文件把一份规则本体接入全部 8 个工具。国产 IDE 适配位从本机安装的二进制里逐一逆向核实，补齐海外工具的空缺。

description.en: NetEase Cloud Music (music.163.com) player and AI DJ for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar page with in-app playback, QR sign-in, and agent tools that curate the queue.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏直接播放网易云音乐，支持队列、同步歌词、扫码登录，还带 AI DJ 帮你选歌。

description.en: Run RunningHub cloud ComfyUI workflows from chat — settings card, sha256 media upload cache, concurrency gate, and background task ledger.
description.zh: 在对话中运行 RunningHub 云端 ComfyUI 工作流：设置卡片、sha256 媒体上传缓存、并发闸门与后台任务台账。

description.en: Literature search for DeepSeek Harness: twenty international sources (Crossref, ACM Digital Library, IEEE, OpenAlex, DOAJ, Europe PMC, PubMed, PubMed Central, arXiv, bioRxiv, medRxiv, ChemRxiv, Semantic Scholar, CORE, Zenodo, HAL, IACR ePrint, OpenReview,
