Rewrites the composer draft into a precise prompt with a configurable model and a fully editable rewriting instruction; reads the content behind @file, @folder and @session references for context and keeps the reference chips intact; offers a one-click undo that restores the text you wrote yourself, and places the button in either composer toolbar with an adjustable colour and size.
description.zh: 用可配置的模型和整段可改的改写指令，把输入框草稿改写成精确提示词；会读取 @文件、@文件夹、@会话 引用指向的内容作为上下文，并原样保留引用标记；支持一键撤销优化、恢复你自己敲的原文；按钮可放在输入框左侧或右侧工具栏，颜色与大小均可调整。

description.en: Connect OpenCode Zen free-tier models into DeepSeek Harness. Real-time model discovery, per-model toggle in settings, one-click provider write. No API key required.
description.zh: 把 OpenCode Zen 免费模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，实时模型发现、设置页逐个启停、一键写入 provider，免 key。

description.en: Provider-aware account balance chip for the DSH sidebar, showing the active model provider balance for DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Moonshot/Kimi, Zhipu/GLM, and MiniMax, plus DeepSeek peak/off-peak status.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的账户余额胶囊，跟随当前模型的服务商显示余额，支持 DeepSeek、OpenRouter、Moonshot/Kimi、Zhipu/GLM 与 MiniMax，并显示 DeepSeek 高峰/空闲时段。

description.en: Scans the whole C drive and classifies every large folder into A/B/C/D/E/P (safe cache / relocatable / junction-movable / abandoned software / config-memory redline / personal files), then deletes, moves, or redirects on demand — with strong redline protection, dry-run preview and undo. Unknown software decided by LLM fallback + human confirmation. Works on DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7 through 0.2.x, tested on 0.2.0-rc.1.
description.zh: 扫描整 C 盘,把每个大空间按 A/B/C/D/E/P 分类(无忧缓存/官方可改址/可junction搬/冷废弃软件/配置记忆红线/个人文件),再按需删缓存/junction搬走/引导改址,带强红线保护、dry-run 预览与 undo。未知软件由 LLM 兜底 + 人工确认,动手前先预览、做完可回滚。 支持 DSH 0.1.7 ~ 0.2.x,已在 0.2.0-rc.1 实测。

description.en: A Codex delegation tool for DeepSeek Harness that can carry a model and a reasoning effort per call.
description.zh: 让 Codex 子代理每次调用都能单独指定模型和推理强度，灵活调度更省心。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 一键 GitHub 同步：把插件清单、插件启用状态、插件配置、本地设置、Skills、Skill 的 refs/脚本、看板/用量账本、设置导航顺序偏好、壁纸引擎整机配置快照（$DSH_HOME/FISH.json）、免费模型插件配置与用量账本采集进你自己的私有 git 仓库并推送，换机可一键还原；采集前自动 fetch 远端并合并，密钥永不搬运。0.2.5 起不再同步 agent 预设 / 桌宠存档 / 工作区映射，0.2.6 起不再同步归档台账，0.2.7 起纳入 sk

Favourite any conversation from the sidebar row menu or an inline star, copy its id plus the transcript absolute path in one click, and permanently delete a single conversation behind a confirm — the sidebar row drops at once. A settings card batch-archives sessions idle past a configurable hour threshold with one-click undo, exports the candidates as a tab-separated txt carrying name, id, workspace, idle time and last activity, and batch-deletes archived conversations that are not favourites. Two view-options rows narrow the sidebar to favourites that are archived and to those that are not. Every addition is additive — three official slots plus one cloned filter row, editing no official file.
description.zh: 在侧栏「…」菜单或行内星标收藏任意对话；一键复制会话 ID 与转录文件绝对路径；单条永久删除（二次确认，删完侧栏立即移除该行）。设置页新增一张卡：按可配置的小时阈值批量归档闲置会话并支持一键撤回，把候选导出为制表符分隔的 txt（含对话名称、ID、所属工作区、闲置时长、最后活动时间），以及批量删除归档中未收藏的对话；视图选项另有「仅显示收藏（已归档）」与「仅显示收藏（未归档）」两行筛选。全部为增量实现：三个官方插槽加一条克隆的筛选行，不改官方任何文件。

description.en: File-defined subagent roles for DeepSeek Harness: roles live in project and global .dsh/roles files, a delegating agent sees one catalog line per role, and each role's tool policy decides which tools its child can see.
description.zh: 用文件定义子代理角色：角色放在项目级与全局级 .dsh/roles 目录，委派方每个角色只看到一行目录，子代理可见的工具由角色自己的工具策略决定。

description.en: DSH Web Usage Center with local SQLite history, HUD and dashboard, Hub account/quota snapshots, custom pricing and fee ledger, and CSV/JSON export, plus coding-plan OAuth and an optional loopback OpenAI/Anthropic gateway.
description.zh: DSH Web 用量中心：本地 SQLite 历史、HUD 与仪表盘、Hub 账户与额度快照、自定义定价与订阅费用账本、CSV/JSON 导出，并含 coding 计划 OAuth 与可选回环 OpenAI/Anthropic 网关。

description.en: OpenCode Zen free-tier models for DeepSeek Harness with anonymous no-key access, a loopback OpenAI-compatible shim, and real bash/read gate tools.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenCode Zen 免费模型：默认免 key 走公共额度，内置回环 OpenAI 兼容 shim，并把网关要求的 bash/read 注册为真实可执行工具。

description.en: Sidebar overhaul for the dsh web UI: long-press drag to reorder the panel icon rail, one arrow to fold it away, whole-row height caps on both the panel list and the pinned section (30% of the rail, rounded down to whole rows), a pinned-session section that mirrors the shipped row's live status (spinner, waiting-for-reply, relative time), drag-to-reorder conversation view tabs, archived Sessions sunk to the bottom of each group newest-first, forked child Sessions following their parent into the pinned section, and a generic lift that moves any plugin's sidebar-footer entry up into the rail. Each subsystem starts behind its own guard, so one that fails returns null and the rest of the plugin still mounts.
description.zh: dsh 网页端侧边栏整体增强：长按拖拽重排面板图标栏，一个箭头即可整栏折叠；面板列表与置顶区都按整行限制高度（占侧栏 30%，向下取整行）；置顶会话区镜像原生行的实时状态（转圈、待回复、相对时间）；顶部会话视图标签可拖拽换位；归档会话按时间新到旧沉到每组末尾；分叉出的子会话自动跟进父会话所在的置顶区；并把任意插件注册在侧栏底部的入口提升到同一栏内。每个子系统各自带启动守卫，单个失败只返回 null，不影响整个插件挂载。

description.en: Workspace-first enhanced sidebar for dsh Web that shadows the built-in workspace browser at low priority (one-click toggle back to the official one) and adds soft workspace archive/restore, per-workspace SVG icons and accent colors, drag reorder and title/path/session-content search, plus a ⌘K Spotlight palette fuzzy-searching workspaces and sessions; the host half ships read-only workspace_find/workspace_list model tools and /workspace-find /workspace-list slash commands. Bilingual zh/en.
description.zh: 面向 dsh Web 的工作区优先增强侧栏：以低优先级 shadow 内置工作区浏览器（可一键切回官方版），提供软归档/恢复、每工作区 SVG 图标与强调色、拖拽排序与标题/路径/会话内容搜索；另提供 ⌘K Spotlight 面板模糊搜索工作区/会话；宿主侧附带只读 workspace_find/workspace_list 工具与 /workspace-find /workspace-list 斜杠命令（中英双语）。

description.en: Prompt optimization, next-sentence prediction, inline completion, and per-session draft stashing for the DSH input box.
description.zh: 为 DSH 输入框提供提示词优化、下一句预测、输入续写与当前会话草稿暂存。

description.en: Explain supported DSH plugin failures with composition source paths and manual next steps: duplicate insertions, missing bundle patches and peer mismatches; standalone CLI and report viewer, read-only diagnosis offline by default, with unobserved runtime left unknown.
description.zh: 通过组合来源路径和人工下一步解释受支持的 DSH 插件故障：重复引入、bundle patch 缺失和 peer 不匹配；提供独立 CLI 与报告查看器，默认只读离线诊断，未观察的 runtime 保留 unknown。

description.en: Encrypted, verifiable history keeper for DeepSeek Harness: snapshot, verify and restore your sessions. No git, no external binaries.
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话做加密快照，随时校验并恢复历史记录，不用 git 也不依赖外部程序。

description.en: Let the DSH assistant send local, web, and AI-generated images directly to users in chat, with external vision support for text-only models. On Windows it runs through PowerShell.
description.zh: 让 DSH 助手把本地、网页和 AI 生成的图片直接发到聊天里给用户看，并为文本模型提供识图能力；Windows 下经 PowerShell 运行。

description.en: Live CNY cost of the current session under the composer, priced per assistant message by the model that produced it and the peak or off-peak window of its own timestamp, with a Settings page that edits the six prices of every model and marks a model with no rate card with a leading tilde because it is costed from the Flash rates.
description.zh: 在输入框下方实时显示当前会话的人民币费用，每条消息按其自身时间戳与该条所用模型的峰谷单价计价；设置页可编辑每个模型的六项单价，未定价的模型按 Flash 单价估算并以 ~ 标注。

description.en: Bridges the LiuHe MCP code toolkit (44 tools) into dsh web: repo_map, symbol search, edit_batch with tolerant matching, transactional edits with undo journal, and deterministic quality gates — backed by a crash-isolated Rust tree-sitter parse daemon and SQLite index.
description.zh: 将 LiuHe MCP 代码工具集（44 个工具）桥接进 dsh web：repo_map、符号搜索、带容错匹配的 edit_batch、带撤销日志的事务性编辑，以及确定性质量门禁——由崩溃隔离的 Rust tree-sitter 解析守护进程和 SQLite 索引支撑。

description.en: Connects QQ Bot private and group chats to DeepSeek Harness Desktop, with per-chat personas, interactive questions, and optional image understanding.
description.zh: 将 QQ 私聊和群聊接入 DeepSeek Harness Desktop，支持按会话切换人格、交互式提问和可选图片理解。

description.en: Settings page for agent modes (presets): switch up to 15 capabilities per mode (commands, files or read-only files, web, subagents, and more) or individual plugin rows; edit each mode's system prompt with variable checks, a full preview, version history, optional live updates for running sessions, and an approval-gated mode_prompt chat tool; create modes from four starter templates or copies; merge built-in updates after a dsh upgrade while keeping your changes, and turn off rows that fail to load.
description.zh: Agent 模式（预设）设置页：按模式开关最多 15 项能力（运行命令、读写或只读文件、网页、子代理等），也能逐个开关插件；编辑每个模式的系统提示词，带变量校验、完整预览和历史版本，可选让正在运行的会话即时生效，并提供每次保存都需审批的对话内修改工具 mode_prompt；用四个起步模板或复制现有模式新建模式；dsh 升级后合并内置更新并保留你的修改，一键关闭加载失败的插件。

description.en: Session cost in rubles in the composer dock — the tariff in effect with its countdown, the API cost at that tariff, the CBR rate, the total including subagents, cache savings, and DeepSeek Platform balances.
description.zh: 在输入框坞区显示以卢布计的当前会话费用：当前时段与倒计时、该时段的 API 费用、央行汇率、含 subagent 的合计、缓存节省与 DeepSeek 平台余额。

description.en: 星主制作的大肥鱼世界，希望大家喜欢！
AT Last, All Sources. One @ to jump anywhere — line ranges like @src/a.ts:12-40, the token cost of each reference before you send, and Esc to walk the session back.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内置 @ 引用之上扩展：精确到行的行区间（@src/a.ts:12-40）、Skill、插件与任意 git 仓库，并在发送前显示每条引用的 token 成本。

description.en: Literature search for DeepSeek Harness: pubmed_search, pubmed_paper and pubmed_related over the official NCBI E-utilities (including elink related-article ranking), plus scholar_search and scholar_cite (MLA/APA/Chicago/Harvard/Vancouver/BibTeX via SerpApi). Both backends return one paper shape, and a settings card configures the API keys, the Scholar backend and the rate/result limits.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的文献检索：pubmed_search、pubmed_paper、pubmed_related 走官方 NCBI E-utilities（含 elink 相关文献排序），scholar_search、scholar_cite 走 Google Scholar（MLA/APA/Chicago/Harvard/Vancouver/BibTeX，需 SerpApi 后端）。两个后端统一为同一种 paper 结构，设置卡片可配置 API key、Scholar 后端与速率/条数上限。

description.en: A vertical preview market for DeepSeek Harness: discover preview plugins, inspect the installed inventory, and install, enable/disable or configure them through dsh-market or the dsh CLI. One-click install and enable/disable need dsh-market; without it each card only shows a copyable install command.
description.zh: DSH 垂直预览市场：发现预览插件、查看已安装清单，并通过 dsh-market 或 dsh CLI 安装、启用/停用与配置。一键安装与启用/停用依赖 dsh-market；没有它时卡片只显示可复制的安装命令。

description.en: Cross-session memory and a per-workspace knowledge base in one plugin. Memories are plain JSONL under ~/.dsh/memory by default; each session starts with the relevant ones already in the system prompt and writes one back when it ends. A read-only kb/ folder per workspace plus one global folder is searched with results cited down to file lines. Eleven tools under a scribe_ prefix (seven scribe_memory_*, four scribe_kb_*), a /scribe slash command, and a settings page with overview, memory, knowledge base and migration tabs. Cloud backends (Bailian memory library, ChromaDB, cloud-primary with local mirror) are opt-in; moving data between them requires an explicit approval and is logged so it can be rolled back.
description.zh: 跨会话记忆与工作区知识库合一。记忆默认是 ~/.dsh/memory 下的纯 JSONL，会话开始把相关记忆放进系统提示，会话结束回写一条；每个工作区的 kb/ 目录加一份全局目录构成只读知识库，检索结果能引用到文件行号。十一个工具统一带 scribe_ 前缀（七个 scribe_memory_*、四个 scribe_kb_*），一个 /scribe 斜杠命令，以及概览 / 记忆 / 知识库 / 迁移四页的设置页。云端后端（百炼记忆库、ChromaDB、云端主 + 本地镜像）按需启用；迁移数据必须经显式审批，并留有可回滚的日志。

description.en: A namespace management tool for toolsets that supports automatic discovery and integration, designed to help reduce token consumption. Also runs TypeScript and JavaScript in a restricted Node runtime for on-demand namespace calls.
description.zh: 一个用于管理工具集的命名空间管理工具，支持自动发现与集成，用于节省token的消耗还会在受限 Node 运行时执行 TypeScript 与 JavaScript，按需通过命名空间调用工具。

description.en: Aggregates every WorkBuddy account already signed in on this machine into one model pool, with manual and scheduled check-in, credits and expiry monitoring, per-model credit multipliers, and account switching with remaining credits right below the composer.
description.zh: 把本机所有登录过的 WorkBuddy 账号聚合成一个模型池，带手动与自动签到、积分与到期监控、模型倍率，并可在输入框下方切换账号、查看剩余总积分。

description.en: Annotate quoted answer text in the transcript: each selection keeps its quote plus a note of your own, notes pile up as chips in the composer and travel with the message, and two or more also get a chip above the input to jump back or clear them. The chips need dsh-paste-chip installed; without it each note is a plain text line in the draft.
description.zh: 划选回答文字就地加注释：保留原文引用加自己写的备注，每条在草稿里变成一枚胶囊，多条一起随消息发出；两条以上时输入框上方会多一个胶囊用来跳回原文或全部清除。胶囊需另装 dsh-paste-chip，否则每条注释在草稿里是一行纯文本。

description.en: Read-only Automations tab in the conversation view. It aggregates what other plugins are scheduled to run: last run time, next run time and a rough token-cost estimate, plus today's total spend and remaining balance. It owns no tasks and starts nothing.
description.zh: 会话视图里的只读「自动化」标签页。把其他插件排的自动化汇总成一张表：上次运行、下次运行时间、大致 token 花费，另附今日总花费与余额。它不拥有任何任务，也不会启动任何东西。

description.en: 把华为云 CodeArts、腾讯 CodeBuddy / WorkBuddy、Qoder、TRAE、Raccoon、LobsterAI、MiniMax、ZCode、讯飞 Loomy 等免费/签到型账号渠道接入 DeepSeek Harness：账号登录、每日签到、模型池同步、本机用量看板。纯本地运行，无遥测、无自动更新。

Adds TXT attachments, session windows, batch archiving, plan comments, menu shortcuts, next-message suggestions and an optional Q theme. Computer use ships in 0.6.x, is on default and needs screen-recording and accessibility permission. Suggestions use the current model with extra usage.
description.zh: 长文本附件、会话分窗、批量归档、计划批注、菜单增强、提示词建议和可选 Q 主题。电脑操控已在 0.6.x 上线且默认开启，需授予屏幕录制与辅助功能权限；提示词建议使用当前模型，会产生少量额外用量。

description.en: Browser notification plugin for DeepSeek Harness - system toasts when a task finishes, a run errors, or your input is needed (question / approval / plan review), click to open the session, per-type toggles, and no false 'done' while the main session waits on its subagents.
description.zh: DSH 浏览器通知插件 - 任务完成 / 运行出错 / 需要你回答、批准、审阅计划时弹系统级通知，点击气泡直达会话，三类通知独立开关，主会话等子代理期间不误报完成。

description.en: Finds wasted GitHub Actions runner time and proposes small, reviewable workflow patches, with explicit approval before any edit and a DSH settings page for analysis rules, history limits, storage, and cost estimation.
description.zh: 找出被浪费的 GitHub Actions 运行时间，并提出小而可审查的工作流补丁；任何修改都需要明确批准，并提供用于分析规则、历史上限、存储和成本估算的 DSH 设置页面。

description.en: Drive local Adobe Photoshop for game screenshots and photos: layered HDR, multi-zone colour/person masks, SUPIR/Real-ESRGAN super-resolution, native 1:1 vision inspection. Requires Windows 10/11 and Adobe Photoshop 2025; the grading tools do not run on macOS or on earlier Photoshop versions.
description.zh: 驱动本机 Adobe Photoshop 处理游戏截图与照片：分层 HDR、多区域颜色/人物蒙版、SUPIR/Real-ESRGAN 超分与原生 1:1 视觉检查。需要 Windows 10/11 与 Adobe Photoshop 2025；macOS 与更早的 Photoshop 版本无法运行调色工具。

description.en: Turns every file artifact the agent names in chat into a clickable entry — and refuses to paint one that does not resolve. Hover resolves asynchronously, and only a file that really exists becomes a hand pointer with a dashed blue outline (30 s TTL cache, so repeated hovers cost nothing); confirmed non-artifacts stay plain text and the right-click falls through to the host menu untouched. Left click reveals the file in Explorer already selected (Shell.Application Explore plus SelectItem with SVSI_ENSUREVISIBLE, so the pane scrolls to it; explorer.exe /select is deliberately not used because it silently drops the selection when an instance is already running). Right click offers seven actions: preview in DSH's built-in sidebar, open with the default app, reveal in Explorer, save as, copy the file itself to the clipboard, copy the absolute path, or insert the path into the composer. Ctrl or Shift with left click opens with the default app, Alt with left click copies the path. Names resolve through the absolute path, the session workspace and every profile workspace, then a cached basename index built with a depth budget, shrinking from the left when a mention swallows leading words. The host half also keeps six system-prompt rules resident, so absolute paths stay in tool arguments while the body shows only file names, and every route is loopback-only.
description.zh: 把对话里出现的每个文件产物变成可点入口，并且拒绝给解析不到的文件画芯片。悬停时先异步解析，只有文件真的存在才变手型并画蓝色虚线框（结果进 30 秒 TTL 缓存，反复悬停不重复请求）；确认不是产物的片段保持普通文字，右键直接放行宿主原生菜单。左键在资源管理器里定位并选中该文件（Shell.Application 的 Explore + SelectItem，带 SVSI_ENSUREVISIBLE 所以会自动滚到可见处；刻意不用 explorer.exe /select，因为已有窗口时它会静默丢掉选中）。右键七项：在侧边栏预览、用默认程序打开、在文件夹中显示、另存为、复制文件、复制文件路径、添加到对话框。Ctrl/Shift+左键用默认程序打开，Alt+左键复制路径。路径按绝对路径、会话工作区、各 profile 工作区、以及带深度预算的同名文件索引逐级解析，遇到「提及吞掉了前面几个词」时从左收缩重试。宿主侧还常驻六条系统提示词铁律，让绝对路径留在工具参数里、正文只写文件名；所有路由仅回环可用。

description.en: Markdown visual enhancement and session workbench for DSH Web Composer: live syntax presentation with caret-row source reveal (inactive-line markers can be hidden or faded), deterministic local completions, and list/quote continuation on line break with ordered-list renumbering; long pastes fold into persistent chips with inline context or file-mode delivery (@path across 50+ extensions) plus sidebar LLM rewrites (stop, preview diff, undo/redo); real-time context map with token gauge, composition breakdown, per-turn growth chart with anchor lines, in-place /compact, turn forking, and a Context Doctor workspace (overview, diagnostics, analysis, feedback).
description.zh: DSH Web Composer 视觉增强与会话工作台：实时 Markdown 呈现与光标行源码还原（非焦点行语法标记可完全隐藏或淡化显示）、确定性本地补全、列表与引用的换行自动续行及有序列表重编号；超长粘贴自动收纳为持久化引用 chip，支持直接内联或文件送达（支持 50+ 种扩展名），并在右栏抽屉提供大模型智能改写（支持中止、预览对比、应用与撤销重做）；集成实时上下文地图，包含 Token 仪表盘、构成穿透钻取、逐轮增长图与锚定刻线、一键 /compact 及会话分叉，并内置 Context Doctor 工作区（概览、诊断、分析、反馈）。

description.en: Bridges DeepSeek Harness sessions to Feishu/Lark, Telegram and DingTalk: each chat is bound to a resumable DSH session, replies stream back as cards, and a task-end card reports the model, token usage, step count and duration. Question and permission-approval cards are answerable from the chat, and a web settings pane configures the per-channel credentials.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话接入飞书/Lark、Telegram 与钉钉：每个聊天绑定一个可续接的 DSH 会话，回复以卡片流式回传，任务结束时用一张结果卡汇报模型、token 用量、步数与耗时。提问与权限审批可直接在聊天里作答，各渠道凭据在 Web 设置面板中配置。

description.en: Handwriting and diagram whiteboard: sketch on a floating or sidebar canvas and attach the cropped image to your message.
description.zh: 手写公式、画示意图的画板：浮动或侧栏画布，导出裁切后的图片作为消息附件。

description.en: A-share market dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: realtime market indices, stock screener with 13 technical signals and multi-strategy intersection, 7×24 multi-source news aggregation, watchlist with group management, market sentiment thermometer (limit-up ladder, breadth), K-line charts with MA/EXPMA/BOLL overlays, and sector/limit-up/longhu rankings.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness A 股行情面板：实时大盘指数、技术选股（13 项信号 + 多策略交叉）、7×24 多源快讯聚合、自选股分组管理、市场情绪温度计（连板梯队/涨跌家数）、K 线图（MA/EXPMA/BOLL 叠加）、板块榜/涨停池/龙虎榜。

description.en: Free vision OCR with adaptive tile recognition for long documents and Markdown/Word/PNG/Excel export.
description.zh: 免费视觉识别插件：自适应切块长文档识别，支持历史收藏与 MD/Word/长图/Excel 导出。

description.en: Web search for DeepSeek Harness through Z.ai or Zhipu, with Coding Plan MCP quota and REST API billing modes, a native bilingual settings card, and support for reusing an existing ZAI_API_KEY.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Z.ai / 智谱网页搜索插件，支持 Coding Plan MCP 套餐额度和 REST API 余额两种计费模式，提供原生中英文设置卡片，可复用现有 ZAI_API_KEY。

description.en: Plugin dependency graph inspector for DeepSeek Harness: a host service that snapshots the live Cordis plugin fiber tree, a graph_render tool for the model, and a browser page that renders the plugin/service topology as a zoomable graph with metrics, legen
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件依赖图检查器：把运行中的 Cordis 插件/服务拓扑快照为可缩放的浏览器面板图，附带图论指标，以及面向模型的 graph.render 工具。

description.en: Quick-open palette for the Web GUI: Ctrl+P fuzzy-searches an in-memory index of the session workspace (about 51k entries, median query 5 ms) with per-segment path anchoring, dir: and file: prefixes, Tab directory drilling and :line jumps, opens the picked file in the native right sidebar, and drops a file reference into the conversation draft with Ctrl+Enter. Also adds in-file find (Ctrl+F) and a selection-to-reference action to the built-in file preview.
description.zh: Web GUI 的快速打开面板：Ctrl+P 在会话工作区的内存索引上做模糊检索（约 5.1 万条目，查询中位数 5 ms），支持逐段路径锚定、dir: 与 file: 前缀、Tab 目录下钻与 :行号 跳转；选中文件走 DSH 原生右栏打开，Ctrl+Enter 把文件引用放进会话草稿。另为内置文件预览补上文件内查找（Ctrl+F）与选中加入会话。

description.en: Adds mark-unread, copy session info, reveal in Finder or open with your IDE, and permanent delete (with child sessions) to the DSH sidebar session menu, plus error and unread status dots, hover-card details, one-click delete for archived rows, and a settings panel that switches each menu item on or off; the interface is available in English and Chinese.
description.zh: 给 DSH 侧边栏的会话右键菜单补上标记未读、复制会话信息、在访达中显示或换 IDE 打开、永久删除（连子会话一起删），并给会话行加上报错与未读状态点、悬浮卡信息、归档行的一键删除，以及一个可逐项开关菜单的设置面板；界面提供中英文两套文案。

description.en: Shows selectable DeepSeek, Kimi, Zhipu GLM, and TeamoRouter balances in the DSH Web sidebar, with per-provider details, usage data, and refresh controls.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏展示可选的 DeepSeek、Kimi、智谱 GLM 和 TeamoRouter 余额，并提供渠道详情、用量数据与刷新控制。

description.en: Runs persistent bash and Linux-path file and search tools inside the current WSL distribution. A new conversation that selects WSL mode asks which of that distribution's folders to use as the workspace, and nothing is installed inside the distribution.
description.zh: 在当前 WSL 发行版里运行持久 bash 以及 Linux 路径的文件与搜索工具。新建对话选中 WSL 后，从该发行版的文件夹里指定工作区，且不会在发行版内安装任何东西。

description.en: Counts completed compactions per session in a floating window and warns only after repeated compactions plus extra token spend or high context occupancy, with all three thresholds adjustable in Settings.
description.zh: 统计每段对话成功完成的压缩次数并常驻悬浮窗，只有反复压缩过、且此后又烧掉大量 token 或上下文占用过高时才提醒；三个阈值都可在设置页调整。

description.en: Replaces the composer model selector with a "model · reasoning level" trigger: a slider across every level a model reports, three switchable modes (the DSH native selector, a gradient particle rail, an energy-charge track), and a per-provider one-click fill for models that declare no reasoning levels.
description.zh: 把 composer 的模型选择器换成「模型名 · 推理等级」触发区：滑块覆盖模型上报的全部等级，可切换三种模式（DSH 官方原生选择器、渐变粒子轨道、能量充能轨道），并可按代理商一键为未声明等级的模型补齐四档。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web theme: ten OKLCH Chinese-traditional-colour palettes that adapt to light and dark, plus an optional wallpaper behind frosted glass panels; tailored for the DS Bot (bot team) interface; the palette and wallpaper persist locally.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 主题：十套 OKLCH 中国传统色配色、明暗自适应；可选一张壁纸铺满窗口、界面以磨砂玻璃叠上去；已适配 DS Bot（Bot 团队）界面；配色与壁纸都本地持久化。

description.en: Text-to-image and image-to-image for a model that cannot draw, through any OpenAI-compatible image API, with multiple providers and an automatic fallback model.
description.zh: 让没有生图/修图能力的模型接入任意 OpenAI 兼容生图接口：支持文生图与图生图，可添加多个服务商，并为生图与修图各选主用与备用模型，主模型连不上时自动切换到备用。

description.en: Adds AMD Radeon Cloud as a model provider in DeepSeek Harness, with reasoning-effort levels declared per model. The provider definition ships in the plugin's own patch layer rather than in your profile.
description.zh: 把 AMD Radeon Cloud 接入 DeepSeek Harness 的模型选择器，思考档位按模型逐个声明。provider 定义随插件自带的补丁层交付，而不是写进 profile。

description.en: Personal toolbox for the dsh web profile with per-feature toggles: task-done desktop notifications, one-click restart, session deletion, plugin enable/disable, update checks, and UI utilities.
description.zh: 面向 dsh web profile 的个人工具箱，各功能可单独开关：任务完成桌面通知、一键重启、会话删除、插件启停、更新检查，以及若干界面小工具。

description.en: Todo sidecar for DeepSeek Harness: turn selected text into a todo, capture todos from a conversation, review them in a left sidebar panel, get due reminders as an in-app popup or an IM bot message, and export everything to HTML, Markdown, Excel, CSV or JSON.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供待办清单：把划选的文字存成待办、从对话里捕获待办、在左侧栏面板里查看与处理、到期用应用内弹窗或机器人推送提醒，还能把全部记录导出成 HTML、Markdown、Excel、CSV 或 JSON。

description.en: Composer infinity switch: while the highest reasoning effort is selected, one click appends a configurable notice to the system prompt.
description.zh: 输入框 ∞ 开关：最高推理档位下点一下，向系统提示词追加一段可配置的宣告。

description.en: Below 1024px the sidebar collapses to a 44px floating square and expands into a 280px overlay drawer; picking a session collapses it again and the focus grab that would raise the soft keyboard after a session switch is suppressed.
description.zh: 窄屏下侧栏收起为左上角 44 像素悬浮方块、展开为 280 像素覆盖式抽屉，点会话自动收起，并压掉切会话时自动抢焦点导致的软键盘顶起。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness automatically opens browser plugins and includes a built-in WebView2 program to achieve a lightweight desktop experience.
description.zh: deepseek harness自动打开浏览器插件，内置WebView2程序实现轻量级桌面化。

description.en: Measures design rules on the rendered page rather than in the CSS — type-scale count, WCAG AA contrast against the real composited backdrop, spacing-grid drift, palette size, tap targets, and the tells of generated UI such as violet gradients caught by hue angle; ships a design-system skill.
description.zh: 在渲染后的页面上测量设计规则，而非解析 CSS——字号种类、与真实合成背景比对的 WCAG AA 对比度、间距栅格偏移、配色规模、点击区尺寸，以及「机器味指纹」（如按色相角度判定的紫色渐变）；内置 design-system 技能。

description.en: A conversation-view tab for DeepSeek Harness Web showing solar/lunar dates, ganzhi year/month/day, Chinese zodiac, 24 solar terms, festivals, China public holidays including make-up workdays, multi-city weather, an epoch↔date timestamp converter with a time-zone picker, and bundled offline "on this day" history from free sources without an API key.
description.zh: 会话页头的「熊猫日历」标签页：公历/农历、干支、生肖、24 节气、传统与外国节日、中国法定节假日（含调休）、多城市天气、时间戳转换（秒/毫秒 ↔ 年月日时分秒，可选时区）与内置离线的「历史上的今天」，数据免费、无需 API Key。

description.en: Packaging pipeline for uni-app x projects: reads the local HBuilderX version, recommends and one-click installs the matching iOS / Android / HarmonyOS offline SDK (panel card with official download links), then drives the HBuilderX CLI to build, sign and upload apps from per-project config files; the engine also ships as list / doctor / check / build tools for the agent.
description.zh: uni-app x 项目打包流水线：读取本机 HBuilderX 版本，按版本推荐并一键配置对应的 iOS / Android / HarmonyOS 离线 SDK（面板卡片附官方下载入口），再按项目配置调用 HBuilderX CLI 打出、签名并上传；引擎同时以 list / doctor / check / build 四个工具暴露给 agent。

description.en: One settings page that lists every subscription sign-in the harness can offer and walks you through it — ChatGPT (Codex), Claude, GitHub Copilot, OpenRouter, Kimi and xAI — reading the list from the authorization seam instead of hardcoding providers, and showing credential records no registered flow claims any more.
description.zh: 把所有订阅登录收进一个设置页：列表直接读授权 seam 上注册的流程，引导你走完 ChatGPT (Codex)、Claude、GitHub Copilot、OpenRouter、Kimi 与 xAI，并列出已无人认领的旧凭据记录。

description.en: Balance badge that follows the active model provider: official readings for DeepSeek, Qwen Token Plan and Aliyun BSS, plus Moonshot and OpenRouter endpoints not yet key-verified.
description.zh: 跟随当前模型供应商的额度徽标：DeepSeek、千问 Token Plan、阿里云费用中心取官方真值，Moonshot / OpenRouter 已接官方端点但字段未用真 Key 核对；其余只报本实例实测。

description.en: Auditable token ledger for DeepSeek Harness: folds the durable session log into restart-safe totals, recomputes the same numbers from the raw logs and diffs them, and turns usage into a bill by workspace, session, model or vendor, exportable as CSV or JSON.
description.zh: 可审计的 DSH token 账本：把持久化会话日志折算成重启安全的总量，可从原始日志重算并比对差异，并按工作区、会话、模型或厂商生成账单，可导出 CSV 或 JSON。

description.en: Binds a Feishu/Lark bot to DeepSeek Harness over a WebSocket long connection: incoming messages run through an agent session and stream back to the chat, chat commands such as /attach manage the live session, and feishu_* tools let the model push messages.
description.zh: 通过 WebSocket 长连接把飞书机器人绑到 DeepSeek Harness：收到的消息跑在 agent 会话里并流式回传，/attach 等聊天命令管理活动会话，模型可调用 feishu_* 工具推送消息。

description.en: MCP server marketplace for DSH: browse a curated, npm-verified catalog and install MCP servers into the current profile with one click, live without restart.
description.zh: DSH 的 MCP 服务器商场：浏览经过 npm 校验的精选目录，一键安装 MCP 服务器到当前 profile，免重启立即生效。

description.en: Peak / off-peak rate badges for the model selector (every row) and the composer tool row, judged per provider by its own time zone and schedule; the live catalog is served from the host over a fenced route.
description.zh: 为模型选择器（每一行）与 composer 工具行显示峰谷倍率，按每个 provider 自己的时区与时段规则判定；实时目录由 host 经带信任围栏的路由下发。

description.en: Acceptance-criteria-driven goal completion: locks verifiable criteria, tracks task dependencies, and gates completion behind formal reviewer validation (18 MCP tools).
description.zh: 验收标准驱动的目标完成：锁定可验证的验收标准、跟踪任务依赖，以 reviewer 正式验收作为完成门禁（18 个 MCP 工具）。

description.en: Adds DSH 0.2.x kernel support to the SenseTime XiaoHuanXiong desktop-app models, reusing that app's stored sign-in so no API key is needed.
description.zh: 为商汤小浣熊桌面 App 的模型补上 DSH 0.2.x 内核支持，复用该 App 的登录态，无需填写 API Key。

description.en: Four-tier prompt enhancer for the composer — the system tier always emits a LangGPT-structured system prompt (# Role / Profile / Skills / Rules / Workflows / Initialization), upgrading task drafts into the system prompt of the agent that runs them, while the other tiers rewrite as a light tidy-up, a single paragraph, or a five-section brief; the iterate workbench refines an editable base under an optional requirement, with fill-back and undo. Never changes intent, never invents requirements.
description.zh: 输入框四档提示词增强——系统档无条件输出 # Role / Profile / Skills / Rules / Workflows / Initialization 的 LangGPT 结构化系统提示词（任务型草稿升格为对应智能体），其余三档改写为轻度整理、单段或五段任务书；迭代工作台以可编辑基准加可选要求继续改写，支持回填与撤销；不改变原意、不凭空编造需求。

description.en: Per-provider (account) proxy routing for DSH. SOCKS5/HTTP proxy pool with account-level routing based on API keys. Supports forced direct connections and hot-swapping built-in web tools proxies. Managed via a graphical settings page in DSH.
description.zh: 按提供商（账号）分流的 SOCKS5/HTTP 代理池。基于 API 密钥识别账号实现精准分流，支持绝对直连（无视 DSH 全局代理）与内置联网工具代理热装。配置在 DSH 设置页图形化管理，保存即热生效。

description.en: Session workspace file manager: adds a "Files" tab to the conversation area to browse the current session workspace directory tree and manage it in place (upload, download, mkdir, rename, delete, search), with files mentionable into the composer for the agent to process.
description.zh: 会话工作区文件管理：在对话区加「文件」tab，浏览当前会话工作区的目录树并就地管理（上传/下载/新建文件夹/改名/删除/搜索），文件可 @ 进对话框给 agent 处理。

description.en: Expose every free model from a local opencode serve catalog — all providers, including your own custom ones — to DeepSeek Harness's model picker, with OpenCode's native tools denied so execution stays in DSH.
description.zh: 把本机 opencode serve 目录里的全部免费模型（覆盖所有 provider，含你自定义的 provider）接入 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器，并禁用 OpenCode 原生工具，执行权留在 DSH。

description.en: A floating stock ticker for DeepSeek Harness: real-time quotes for Nikkei 225 and TOPIX ETF out of the box, plus worldwide markets via Yahoo Finance — Japan (.T), US, Hong Kong (.HK), China (.SS/.SZ) and any other symbol — with a customizable watchlist, display aliases and 16 UI languages.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的全球股市行情悬浮窗：默认显示日经225 与 TOPIX ETF，另支持通过 Yahoo Finance 实时报价全球市场——日本 .T、美国、香港 .HK、中国 .SS/.SZ 及任意代码，带自选列表、显示别名与 16 种界面语言。

description.en: Four palettes for the DeepSeek Harness web UI — solid, glass, volume and neon — each with light and dark halves. Neon adds a scene light field with a 46px circuit grid, a laser scan that sweeps the conversation column only while a turn is running, HUD-style workspace labels in the sidebar, embedded MiSans Latin chrome type, and a 125% sidebar type scale that stays fixed while the conversation area zooms.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的四套配色：实心 / 玻璃 / 体积 / 霓虹，各含明暗两半。霓虹版在整窗场景光场上叠 46px 电路网格，并在模型运行时让一条激光扫描线扫过对话列（停止即消失）；侧栏工作区名为青色 HUD 标牌，界面拉丁字体内置 MiSans，侧栏字号固定 125% 且不随对话区缩放。

description.en: Live token cost for every chat in the DSH Web UI: the chat, its subagents and the whole session tree, priced from a bundled models.dev snapshot of seven providers and 139 priced models, with cache read and write rates wherever the provider publishes them and DeepSeek from its own peak and off-peak table. Every finished answer carries its own price in the transcript, and a chat that is not currently open is priced from the log instead of disappearing. Spend is costed per interval from an append-only JSONL ledger in the project folder, so logged work keeps the tariff it was billed at. On top of it: budget-aware work plans packed against a money limit, routing scenarios that show which models are worth connecting, a generated plan document in English, Chinese or Russian, and a warning when spend belongs to no plan unit.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 的每个对话实时计算 token 费用：本对话、其子代理与整棵会话树，价格来自内置的 models.dev 快照：七家供应商、139 个有价模型，缓存读写费率按供应商实际公布的取值，DeepSeek 则使用其官方峰谷价格表。每个完成的回答都会在对话中显示自身费用，未打开的对话则按日志计价而不是整行消失。费用按区间计价，依据写入项目目录的只追加 JSONL 账本，因此已记录的工作保留当时的费率。此外还提供：按金额预算排布的工作计划、展示值得接入哪些模型的路由方案比较、以英语/中文/俄语生成的计划文档，以及当费用未归入任何计划单元时的提醒。

description.en: Explicit, project-scoped memory handoff: when you open a new conversation, one model call that you confirm curates the project's earlier conversations into a bounded brief and injects it into the conversation's first step. No silent background calls; a Memory panel shows the brief and lets you edit notes.
description.zh: 显式、按项目隔离的记忆交接：新开会话时，经你确认后只调用一次模型，把同一项目里之前的对话整理成有长度上限的摘要，注入到新会话的第一步；不会在后台偷偷调用模型。“记忆”面板可以查看摘要、编辑笔记。

description.en: Local-first long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: text packages, on-demand recall, raw event citation, multiple brains and workspace boundaries.
description.zh: 本地优先的 DSH 长期记忆插件：文本包、按需检索、可回原始事件、多大脑与工作区边界。

description.en: Automatic recovery when a turn ends badly: resume after a transient failure, continue after output truncation, re-run after an unfinished todo list, plus a request-level 429 backstop and a client dock with edit-resend, manual retry and stop-and-re-ask.
description.zh: 回合异常收尾时的自动补救：瞬时失败后续跑、输出截断后继续、待办未完成时重跑，另有一层请求级 429 兜底，以及带「改后重发 / 手动重试 / 停止并重问」的客户端停靠栏。

description.en: Answers real-life decisions from a 765-entry Chinese life guide: looks up entries first, ranks by cost and benefit, and cites section and item.
description.zh: 按《高性价比人生指南》765 条正文回答人生决策：先查条目，按成本与收益排序，每条注明第几节第几条。

description.en: Cross-workspace DSH messaging and sender navigation, with bounded same-workspace context and opt-in local Claude Code messaging.
description.zh: 支持 DSH 跨工作区消息与发送方导航、同工作区受限上下文，以及可选的本机 Claude Code 双向通信。

description.en: Settings section that reports token usage: totals for input, output, cache read, cache write, reasoning and call count, with breakdowns by model, day, month and project plus a per-day trend chart for the last 30 days; history is rebuilt once on a worker thread and then kept current from live session events.
description.zh: 设置中的 Token 用量面板：总量（输入/输出/缓存读/缓存写/推理/调用次数），按模型、按天、按月、按项目的明细，以及最近 30 天的按日趋势折线图；历史在 Worker 线程上一次性重建，之后由会话事件实时累加。

description.en: Export a whole working DSH home — profile, installed plugins with their node_modules, skills, hooks and task boards — into one .dshpkg tar and import it on another machine without network or pnpm; also streams over HTTP or a one-shot LAN link.
description.zh: 把整套可用的 DSH 主目录——profile、带 node_modules 的已装插件、技能、hooks 与任务板——打包成单个 .dshpkg，在另一台机器上免联网、免 pnpm 还原；也支持 HTTP 上传与一次性局域网链接。

description.en: Monitors IEEE Xplore journal Early Access through Crossref, has an LLM screen every new paper against your keywords, and emails a Markdown weekly digest.
description.zh: 按关键词盯 IEEE 期刊 Early Access：Crossref 抓新收录，逐篇交给大模型研判，生成 Markdown 周报并发到邮箱。

description.en: Annotation browser in the DSH sidebar: a real Chrome page streamed over CDP with input forwarded, where picking an element or selecting text attaches its source location, component stack, styles and a crop to the chat input. Needs a local Chrome (on Windows set chromePath).
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏里的标注浏览器：通过 CDP 推流并转发输入的实时页面，点选元素或划选文字后，把源码位置、组件栈、样式与裁图带进聊天输入框。需本机 Chrome（Windows 须设置 chromePath）。

description.en: 跨端互通：同一 DSH 账号下的会话、工作区、设备之间互通 —— 特征码链、内联邮件、云端中转站与自动备份

Converts Office and PDF files in the DSH workspace to Markdown locally — no network, no API quota — before the model reads them. Writes each .md next to its source so only a file path enters the context, and returns byte size, line count, token estimate and a heading outline, for a single file or a whole directory.
description.zh: 在模型读取之前，把工作区里的 Office / PDF 文件在本机转成 Markdown（不联网、不消耗 API 额度），.md 写在源文件旁边，因此进入上下文的只是一个文件路径，并返回字节数、行数、token 估算与标题结构索引，支持单个文件或整个目录。

description.en: 数据资产化共享基础包 — 共享类型定义、业务常量、工具函数（基础依赖）

LLM debug console for DeepSeek Harness: captures the full content of every model call at the llm/stream waterfall (options, stream chunks, usage, wire protocol) and shows it in a DevTools-style docked panel, with shared-prefix context diffing, wire-JSON reconstruction, JSON export and a runtime-tunable capture policy.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 里的 LLM 调试台：在 llm/stream 层完整捕获每次模型调用（请求参数、流式块、用量、真实 wire 协议），以 DevTools 风格停靠面板展示，支持上下文共享前缀折叠对比、wire JSON 重建、JSON 导出与运行时可调的抓取策略。

description.en: System-level desktop floating-window plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): a global hotkey opens a floating window; the plugin supports workspace and session switching, approval and follow-up handling, and export of its own diagnostic logs for plugin troubleshooting.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的系统级桌面悬浮窗插件：按下全局快捷键即可呼出桌面悬浮窗口，支持工作区与会话切换、审批与追问处理，以及插件自身的诊断日志导出。

description.en: Peak and off-peak billing season in the composer statistics row, right after the cache-hit reading, with a coloured dot, a countdown to the next switch, and a panel that shows the account balance split into total, granted and topped up in the currency the API reports.
description.zh: 在输入框统计行里、缓存命中读数之后显示高峰/非高峰计费时段：状态圆点与切换倒计时，点击展开面板显示按接口返回货币表示的余额，并拆分为总额、赠送与充值。

description.en: Login gate for the dsh web UI: unauthenticated visitors get a login/register page and the first registrant becomes admin; includes user and role management plus login and access audit logs.
description.zh: 用户管理：给 dsh web 加登录门禁，未登录访问弹登录/注册页，首个注册者自动成为管理员；管理员可管理用户/角色，带登录与访问审计。

description.en: Ocean-blue theme for the DSH web interface: swimming fish, rising bubbles, a daily-quote ticker above the input box, and a replacement brand area; Settings → Marine Theme exposes 7 groups and 32 options (brand text and size, badge, primary color, watermark, fish, quotes, overall scale) that apply instantly without a reload, plus a two-step reset to defaults.
description.zh: 海洋蓝主题：游动鱼群、上升气泡、输入框上方的「每日鱼语」，以及左上角品牌区替换；「设置 → 海洋主题」提供 7 组 32 项可调（品牌文字与字号、徽章、主色、水印、鱼群、语录、整体缩放），改动即时生效无需刷新，并带二次确认的一键恢复默认。

description.en: Pre-install compatibility gate for DSH plugins: locks the resolved version, checks peer/engines declarations, dry-installs into an isolated DSH_HOME and boots it with a timeout, blocks on any failure, and restores the profile if the real install fails. Optionally intercepts dsh-market install/update clicks. Compatible with DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x.
description.zh: DSH 插件安装前兼容性门控：锁定解析版本、校验 peer/engines 声明、在隔离 DSH_HOME 中试装并限时试启动，任一失败即阻止；正式安装失败自动还原 profile。可选拦截 dsh-market 的安装/更新点击，兼容 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x。

description.en: Task-level memory for long-horizon DSH sessions: force-injected, compaction-proof, manually mounted.

Read-only DeepSeek web archive tools for DSH: list/download/search sessions, share-list, and a digest tool that compresses the 100-session history into one high-density page with activity bars and topic clusters. Write operations are intentionally not exposed (the web client rate-limits them). Requires the separately installed deepseek-ops Python client (github.com/Panniantong/deepseek-ops, by another author) with QR-code login; set scriptDir to its path.
description.zh: DSH 内只读访问 DeepSeek 网页版会话归档：列会话/下载全文/搜索索引/分享列表，以及把 100 段会话压缩成一页高密度摘要（含活跃度直方图与主题聚类）的 digest 工具。刻意不暴露写操作（网页版有限流）。需另外安装第三方 deepseek-ops Python 客户端（github.com/Panniantong/deepseek-ops，另一位作者）并扫码登录，在插件配置里把 scriptDir 指向它。

description.en: Wraps the external `ocr` (open-code-review) CLI in five model tools — one-shot review, whole-tree scan, deterministic scope/rule scaffolding and session lookup — and reports what OCR found separately from whether the run actually covered the selected files.
description.zh: 把外部 `ocr`（open-code-review）CLI 包成五个模型工具——单次评审、全树扫描、确定性的范围与规则脚手架、会话查询——并把「OCR 发现了什么」与「这次跑有没有覆盖完选中的文件」分成两套口径回报。

description.en: Tailscale remote-access operations panel for the dsh web GUI: health checks, HTTPS entry toggle via tailscale serve, macOS proxy bypass, relay server ops, and ACL snippet generation.
description.zh: Tailscale 远程访问运维面板：健康检查、HTTPS 入口（tailscale serve）开关、macOS 代理绕过、中继服务器运维与 ACL 片段生成。

description.en: Runs the local Cursor CLI as a child coding agent from DSH - a `cursor_code` tool plus the native one-shot `cursor_subagent` tool, one mirrored DSH sub-session per run, per-task model choice, resumable conversations, a step timeline with real file diffs, and a usage, model and session panel.
description.zh: 把本机 Cursor CLI 当作子编码智能体：提供 `cursor_code` 工具与原生一次性 `cursor_subagent` 工具，每次运行镜像为一个真实的 DSH 子会话，可按任务选模型、会话可续聊，返回逐步工具时间线与真实文件 diff，并提供额度、模型和会话面板。

description.en: A developer toolkit for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web console: a real multi-tab PTY terminal docked under the composer plus an AI-output file browser sidebar with syntax highlighting, Markdown rendering and image preview.
description.zh: DSH 网页控制台的开发者工具包：一个真实的多标签 PTY 终端（停靠在输入框下方），外加 AI 输出文件浏览器侧栏，支持语法高亮、Markdown 渲染与图片预览。

description.en: Usage statistics panel for the Web GUI and the Desktop app: silent per-model token collection, activity heatmap, trend charts, cost estimation and a daily-limit guard.
description.zh: Web GUI 与桌面端的用量统计面板：静默按模型采集 token、活跃热力图、趋势图、费用估算与每日超限守卫。

description.en: Desktop full-screen boot splash. It covers DSH's loading card before first paint, plays a 4.5 s five-stage compass sequence, then hands off to the app; clicking anywhere skips ahead, and reopening the window from the tray replays it. The first cold start may hitch once, then runs smoothly.
description.zh: 桌面端全屏启动动画：在 DSH 加载卡出现前接住首帧，播放 4.5 秒五阶段罗盘序列后交接；点按任意处可跳过，从托盘重开窗口会重播。冷启动首帧可能顿一下，之后流畅。

description.en: Event-driven Hypatia memory for DSH: automatic conversation logging via session events, queued background consolidation (span summaries + work-unit extraction) with a dedicated model route, and recall injection — zero per-call model work in the main sessi

Add your own parameters to the model requests dsh sends: OpenRouter provider routing and fallback models, reasoning, sampling and custom body fields, and headers, for OpenRouter or any other gateway. Parameters are organized by the channels dsh already has; a live preview shows what each request will carry, and a request log shows what was sent and what the gateway answered.
description.zh: 给 dsh 发出的模型请求加上自己的参数：OpenRouter 供应商路由和备用模型、思考强度、采样参数与自定义请求体字段、请求头，OpenRouter 和其他网关都能用。参数按 dsh 已配置的渠道管理；实时预览显示每个请求会多出什么，请求记录显示实际发出了什么、网关回了什么。

description.en: Adds a muted looping video behind the Harness workspace and makes the composer translucent after the boot splash finishes.
description.zh: 在 Harness 工作区后播放静音循环视频，并在开屏动画结束后将输入区域显示为半透明。

description.en: Warm light and dark theme for DSH Web with responsive layout, bilingual settings, safe Markdown preview, per-block copy controls, and no telemetry.
description.zh: DSH Web 暖中性色明暗主题，支持响应式布局、双语设置、安全 Markdown 预览、内容块复制与无遥测运行。

description.en: Explain a selected word or sentence from a DSH conversation in a floating window: a channel of its own that leaves the session untouched, and the answer can be pinned to a session of its own.
description.zh: 在浮窗里解释 DSH 对话中选中的词或句子：走独立通道、不污染当前会话，解答可以固定成独立会话。

description.en: A CodeGraph tool scoped to the session's own indexed project, resolved from its workspace directory. One MCP server is launched through npx per project root and shared by every session working there; a project indexed mid-session is enabled without a restart, and the managed child process is reaped when the harness exits.
description.zh: 按会话自身的已索引项目提供 CodeGraph 工具，项目由 workspace 目录解析得出。每个项目根经 npx 启动一个 MCP 服务并被该项目下所有会话共享；会话中途建好索引即自动启用，无需重启；harness 退出时受管子进程被回收。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: declare named subagents in TOML files under ~/.dsh/agents and <projectRoot>/.dsh/agents
Session board in the left sidebar: every chat session's current work, todos and progress, with a searchable overview heatmap and one-click navigation back to the session.
description.zh: 在左侧栏提供会话看板：集中展示每个会话的当前工作、待办与进度，附带可搜索的概览热力图，点击卡片即可跳回会话。

description.en: DSH Web 上下文窗口归因面板：通过 host token meter 按消息显示当前 surface 的 token 占用与摘要。Read-only per-message context-window attribution for DSH Web using the host token meter.
description.zh: DSH Web 的上下文窗口归因插件：Mini Utility Dock 面板按各自占用的 token 给会话内的用户消息、助手回复、推理块和工具结果排序，一眼看出窗口被哪些条目占住。面板还显示各条目类型的占比、本机各 live session 里最重的条目，并在宿主提供时显示 provider usage 与 system/tools/messages 的估算构成。面板只读：不估算费用、不修改会话、不触发 compaction。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness memory and knowledge hub that routes update, retrieve, and subscribe calls across compatible plugins, with an optional transactional Rust backend.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的记忆与知识中台：在兼容插件之间路由 update、retrieve 和 subscribe 调用，并提供可选的事务化 Rust 后端。

description.en: Turn a phone camera into a live viewfinder and photo input for your dsh session, over LAN or USB.
description.zh: 把手机相机变成 dsh 会话的实时取景与拍照输入，经局域网或 USB 直连。

description.en: Git server: embeds ts-gogs (a TypeScript reimplementation of Gogs) and serves a full Git service on its own port — HTTP clone/push, web UI, issues/PRs/wiki — reusing user-management credentials, start/stop from the settings page.
description.zh: Git 服务器：内嵌 ts-gogs（Gogs 的 TypeScript 平替），独立端口跑完整 Git 服务（HTTP clone/push、网页端、issue/PR/wiki），可复用 user-management 的用户名密码，设置页一键启停。

description.en: Token-free Chinese classical poetry tab in the DSH conversation view with search, filters, 飞花令, daily poem, favorites, festival topics and a share-card image; AI explanation reuses your own DSH session.
description.zh: 免 token 诗词查询插件，在会话页头新增「诗词」标签页，支持搜索、筛选、飞花令、每日一首、收藏、简繁、节日专题与分享卡片图；AI 解读复用 DSH 会话。

description.en: A working Remotion prototype that turns a DSH plugin repository into a 16:9 promo video and a 3:4 promo image locally; its DSH bundle is scaffolded but has not yet been loaded into a real DSH profile. Requires Node.js 22+ and Chrome or Chromium for rendering.
description.zh: 本地用 Remotion 从 DSH 插件仓库生成 16:9 宣传片与 3:4 宣传图的可用原型；DSH bundle 仍是脚手架，尚未在真实 DSH profile 中加载验证。需 Node.js 22+ 与 Chrome/Chromium 渲染。

description.en: Windows computer use forked from computer-user: 13 computer_* tools that read the screen and drive the mouse and keyboard. Image-capable routes get the screenshot as a real image with an exact image-to-screen mapping, so no external OCR; elements return as UI Automation refs so a click lands on the exact control rectangle; Ctrl+Alt+Esc stops every call.
description.zh: computer-user 分叉的 Windows 电脑操作插件：13 个 computer_* 工具，读取屏幕并驱动鼠标键盘。模型支持图像输入时截图直接作为图片返回，附精确的图像→屏幕映射，无需外接 OCR；控件以 UI Automation 引用返回，点击落在精确矩形上；Ctrl+Alt+Esc 可阻断所有调用。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory: captures durable facts from each turn, auto-associates them by shared entity and tag, and recalls with BM25 plus spreading activation over the link graph.
description.zh: 跨会话长期记忆：从每轮对话抽取持久事实、按共享标签与实体自动建立联想关联，并以 BM25 加关联图激活传播进行召回；提供六个模型可调用工具与一张设置卡片。

description.en: Vendor-based usage dashboard: per-provider token/cache/output KPI, a 53-week heatmap, trend chart with hourly "today" view, model drilldown, cost estimation, CSV export, and health cards (TTFT, generation speed, peak context, error rate).
description.zh: 按厂商（订阅/官方API）统计用量看板：按供应商/模型拆分 Token、缓存、输出等 KPI，53 周热力图，趋势折线图（今天按小时），模型钻取，费用估算，CSV 导出，以及健康度卡片（TTFT、生成速度、峰值 Context、错误率）。

description.en: A no-limit Texas holdem table where you are the only human. Eight seats: you plus seven LLM agents written on AI-founder personas (Altman, Dario Amodei, Musk, Liang Wenfeng, Jensen Huang, Lei Jun, Zhang Yiming). Each agent bets through the currently selected host model and falls back to its own heuristic style when no model is available; every agent only ever sees its own hole cards, because the prompt is built from that seat alone. A hand ends by revealing the winner hole cards, with a flip animation replayed on every community card, and a rail keeps a live action-and-table-talk timeline. LAN mode (off by default, single-machine play is unaffected) lets another install on the same network join this very table: the host shows a six-digit room code, UDP broadcast discovers nearby tables, and a joiner randomly takes over one bot seat, with the seat handed back to its character on leave or after twenty seconds of silence. The room code is never put on the wire and every snapshot is generated for one viewer seat, so nobody, not even the host, can read another player hole cards. Fork of BubblePtr/dsh-holdem (MIT), credited in the README and in the UI.
description.zh: 一张只有你一个人类的无限注德州扑克桌。八个座位：你，加上七位以 AI 创始人设写成的 LLM 智能体（Altman、达里奥、马斯克、梁文峰、黄仁勋、雷军、张一鸣）。每个智能体都通过宿主当前选中的模型下注，模型不可用时回落到自己的启发式风格；每个智能体只看得见自己的底牌，因为提示词只由它自己那个座位拼出来。一手结束时亮出赢家底牌，每张公共牌落地都会重播翻牌动画，侧栏保留实时的行动与桌边闲话时间线。局域网模式默认关闭、不影响单机玩法：同一网络里的另一份安装可以加入这张桌，主机屏幕显示 6 位房间号，UDP 广播负责发现附近的牌桌，加入者随机顶替一名人机座位，离开或静默二十秒后座位交还该角色。房间号从不上广播，且每份快照都按观看者座位生成，所以没有人（连主机也不行）能读到别人的底牌。本仓库是 BubblePtr/dsh-holdem（MIT）的 fork，README 与界面都保留了上游署名。

description.en: Add one session-header button to copy the session deep link, the full conversation as Markdown, only the messages you tick (QQ/WeChat-style multi-select), or the working directory.
description.zh: 在会话标题栏添加一个复制按钮，可复制会话深度链接、整段对话 Markdown、勾选的部分消息（QQ/微信式多选）或工作目录。

description.en: Six independently togglable modules in one DSH plugin: per-turn CNY cost, DeepSeek account balance, PDF/Word/Excel/CSV read-write tools with right-sidebar preview, a compiler/runtime environment registry, and run/build tools that execute a program or an MSBuild project by environment id. Toolchain paths are resolved at run time (Visual Studio install-root scan, %ProgramFiles%, PATH) and can be overridden per environment through plugin config, so nothing is pinned to the author's machine.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件里的六个可独立开关的模块：每轮对话的人民币成本、DeepSeek 账户余额、PDF/Word/Excel/CSV 直接读写工具与右栏预览、编译/运行环境表，以及按环境名执行程序或编译 MSBuild 工程的 run/build 工具。工具链路径在运行时解析（扫描 Visual Studio 安装根、%ProgramFiles%、PATH），并可在插件配置里逐个环境覆盖，没有写死在作者机器上的路径。

description.en: Floating PR/review status bar for DeepSeek Harness: a shell.overlay bar with a docked detail pane and an exploded review board.
Adds one system-prompt section that keeps private words out of formal deliverables and, every few of them, leaves a short note at the end.
description.zh: 在系统提示词里加一段：正式交付物不写私话，私人笔记里隔几次留一小段。

description.en: Kimi Coding web search and web fetch providers for the DeepSeek Harness — one coding-plan key fills both ctx.web seams (POST /v1/search and /v1/fetch), a settings card in the GUI stores it via the credentials service, and the fallback chain reads the Kimi CLI config for zero-setup installs.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Kimi Coding 的网页搜索与网页抓取双提供方——一把 coding 计划密钥同时接入 ctx.web 的两条链路（/v1/search 与 /v1/fetch），设置卡片经凭据服务保存密钥，并回退读取 Kimi CLI 配置，安装即用。

description.en: JIRA task panel under the DSH composer: per-workspace project key and optional JQL, listing the issues assigned to the current user with status, priority and issue-type chips, a total count, collapse and refresh, links to JIRA, plus a settings card for the base URL and token with a connection probe.
description.zh: DSH 输入框下方的 JIRA 任务面板：按工作区配置项目 Key 与可选 JQL，展示指派给当前用户的问题，带状态、优先级与类型标签、总数徽标、收起与刷新、跳转 JIRA，并在设置页卡片配置 JIRA 地址与令牌（含连接测试）。

description.en: Session modes for dsh: coding / chat as data — a mode is a persona plus its tool lists, its upstream policy lists, its instruction / skill-catalog / runtime-context switches and an optional default model. The host applies the current mode to each session,
Answers @file completion from the Everything index through es.exe instead of walking the workspace, keeping the workspace root as the ranking scope. Windows only; needs Everything and es.exe on PATH.
description.zh: 用 es.exe 从 Everything 索引回答 @file 补全，而不是遍历工作区，并以工作区根目录作为排序范围。仅限 Windows；需先安装 Everything 与 es.exe 并加入 PATH。

description.en: 三重一大决策台账核对（按前置研究、会议审议与决议记录核对程序留痕，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）
description.zh: 检查国企「三重一大」决策台账的程序留痕，看议题是否记录提案依据、前置研究等环节是否齐全。

description.en: Update copilot for DeepSeek Harness: one scan covers the DeepSeek Harness core and every profile plugin; explains what changed and how risky each update is, then updates only what you confirm.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的更新助手：一次扫描覆盖 DeepSeek Harness 本体和每个 profile 的插件，说清改了什么、风险多大，只更新你确认过的那些。

description.en: Jira and Confluence for DeepSeek Harness: the tools of Atlassian remote MCP server, a result card for issues and pages, and an issue panel.
description.zh: 把 Jira 与 Confluence 接进 DeepSeek Harness：提供 Atlassian 远程 MCP 服务器的工具、问题与页面的结果卡片，以及问题面板。

description.en: Checks supervision logs for cross-day continuity and for on-site supervision coverage, against GB/T 50319-2013 and other published documents. Reports gaps and coverage differences for a human to review.
description.zh: 依据 GB/T 50319-2013 等公开文件，核对监理日志的跨日连续性，以及旁站监理的覆盖情况。列出缺漏与覆盖差异供人复核。

description.en: Adds a sidebar entry that opens DeepSeek web chat in an in-app window for quick questions while working. Fork of zerorigin-studio/dsh-deepseek-chat (already listed); it uses its own settings namespace, so both can coexist. Needs the desktop bridge (window.dsh.desktop.openWindow).
description.zh: 在侧边栏增加网页对话入口，将 DeepSeek 网页对话打开在应用内窗口中，方便工作时临时提问。基于 zerorigin-studio/dsh-deepseek-chat（已在目录内）的分支；使用独立设置命名空间，可与上游共存。需要桌面端桥（window.dsh.desktop.openWindow）。

description.en: Native right-sidebar Markdown preview with Mermaid diagrams, KaTeX math, GFM tables and syntax highlighting — rendering engine bundled, fully offline.
description.zh: 在 DSH 原生右侧文件预览中渲染 Mermaid 图表、KaTeX 公式、GFM 表格与代码高亮，渲染引擎随包内置，完全离线。

description.en: Session insights and one-click shareable HTML replay for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的会话洞察，并可一键导出为可分享的 HTML 回放。

description.en: Scales the whole DeepSeek Harness interface from 50% to 200%, menus and pop-ups included, set from Settings - General with a slider, a percent field or presets. Works in dsh web and the desktop app, which has no zoom of its own.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 整个界面（包括菜单和弹窗）缩放到 50% 至 200%，在「设置 - 通用设置」中用滑块、百分比输入或预设调整。dsh web 与桌面应用均可使用，桌面应用本身没有缩放功能。

description.en: Checks a bid evaluation scoring matrix for internal arithmetic consistency: that each factor's maximum, the scores recorded and the total agree with each other. Reports the differences it finds; it does not judge whether the evaluation itself was correct or fair.
description.zh: 核对评标因素评分矩阵的内部算术自洽性：各因素分值上限、所记分值与合计之间是否互相一致。只报告发现的差异，不评价评标本身是否正确或公正。

description.en: memcue long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): the model searches and writes its facts itself

System-1 decision guard for DeepSeek Harness, 4 questions asked before tool calling (risk reversible, relevance, injection suspension) and allow/ask/reject action. Needs an API key for a system-one compatible provider; decision requests are sent there.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的 System-1 决策守卫：在每次工具调用前问模型四个问题 （风险、可逆性、任务相关性、注入嫌疑），据此放行、询问或拦截。

description.en: Local offline prosody analysis for DeepSeek Harness: reports how something was said — speed, pitch, pauses, energy — alongside the transcript.
description.zh: 本地离线语气分析：在转写之外，给出语速、音高、停顿与力度的听感描述，让模型听懂「怎么说的」。

description.en: Folds the sidebar's add-on panel rows (schedules, agent teams, plugin market, context pages, …) under the shipped "More" row: a 28x28 chevron toggle on that row collapses them into a single header line and expands them back, the fold state persists per window, the rows kept visible are chosen with per-row switches read from the live sidebar, and each managed row's icon + label can be aligned left, centre or right. Client-only plugin: adds DOM, patches no host bundle, and uninstalls back to the shipped sidebar. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 exactly; other versions install but stay inert.
description.zh: 把侧边栏的加项面板行（自动化任务、agent 团队、插件市场、上下文页等）收进宿主「更多」行：在该行挂一个 28x28 箭头按钮，点一下把它们收成一行、再点复原；折叠状态按窗口持久化，保持可见的行用逐行开关从当前侧边栏实时枚举后选择，被管理行的图标与文字还能切换左/中/右对齐。纯 client 插件：只新增 DOM，不打宿主补丁，卸载后恢复原样。仅支持 DSH 0.2.1-rc.3，其它版本装上也不会生效。

description.en: Adds a button to the composer that rewrites the unsent draft into a clearer, more specific prompt, with one-click restore, a settings page and an optional per-request model override.
description.zh: 在输入框加一个按钮，把未发送的草稿改写为更清晰、更具体的提示词；支持一键还原、独立设置页，以及单次调用的模型覆盖。

description.en: Reports which PowerShell the DSH pwsh executor actually runs (enabled rows only; version-numbered Store paths are never recommended as pins), and installs a Store-managed PowerShell 7 through a scripted Store-page click or the manual Store path. Allows the pwsh tool only when the live executor resolves PowerShell 7+, and when dsh-ops is installed keeps the native pwsh beside ops_bash by enabling Compatibility and hiding duplicate official tools. Native status card and configuration switch in the Web UI; Windows only, no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 报告 DSH 的 pwsh 执行器实际运行的 PowerShell（只认启用中的行，带版本号的商店路径不会被推荐为 pin），并通过脚本点击商店页面或手动商店路径安装由商店管理的 PowerShell 7。只有实际执行器解析到 PowerShell 7+ 时才放行 pwsh 工具；检测到 dsh-ops 时启用其 Compatibility 模式，保留原生 pwsh 与 ops_bash 并存，并隐藏重复的官方工具。Web 界面提供原生状态卡片和配置开关；仅 Windows，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Ranks workspaces holding a session that wants attention to the top of the sidebar session list - waiting on you first, then running, then finished-but-unopened, then just read - and draws those rows with a state bar, tinted surface and coloured title, plus a one-shot settle pulse when a run stops. Every colour is taken from the active theme's own tokens, and the three windows that decide how long a finished session stays promoted are settings.
description.zh: 把含“需要注意的会话”的工作区按紧急度排到侧栏会话列表最前——待你处理优先，其次运行中，再次完成未读，最后刚读过的——并为这些行画状态竖条、着色底与着色标题，一次运行结束时播放一次收敛动效。所有颜色都取自当前主题自身的变量；决定完成会话置顶时长的三个窗口都是可配置项。

description.en: DSH 插件：右侧栏常驻「余额明细」——DeepSeek 余额、赠送钱包，以及今日 token 消耗（本机 DSH 会话 + 平台全部 API Key，重叠时按平台口径只算一次）/ 命中 / 未命中 / 输出 / 消费金额 / API 请求次数。
Task gate for the DeepSeek Harness: every conversation must end by declaring complete, wait, or blocked; undeclared stops are nudged, and abnormal sessions are revived after a host restart.

Vision understanding + image generation/editing for DeepSeek Harness (read images with Qwen/OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini, generate and edit with Qwen-Image). A rework of liustack/modlens (MIT). Remove @liustack/modlens first — both register the same vision providers and image interception hooks, so co-installation breaks image reading.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供读图与生图/编辑能力（Qwen/OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini 读图，Qwen-Image 生图与编辑）。基于 liustack/modlens（MIT）改造；请先卸载 @liustack/modlens——两者会注册同一批 vision provider 与图片拦截钩子，并存会导致读图失灵。

description.en: Per-model custom request headers for DeepSeek Harness: define named header profiles in Settings → Plugins → Plugin configuration, pick one per model in the provider's model catalog, and every call to that model carries those headers.
description.zh: 添加可配置的 HTTP 请求头配置档，并支持按模型选择。

description.en: Assistant reply-body translation for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI (OpenAI-compatible channel)

Session budget gate for DeepSeek Harness: prices every turn against the official price table, warns at 80%, stops the task at 100%, and writes a handoff snapshot so the next session can continue the work.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的会话设预算上限：按官方价目表实时算账，80% 预警、100% 拦停任务，并落盘一份交接快照，让下一个会话接着干。

description.en: Configurable sandbox for dsh: replaces the shipped process-sandbox provider and filesystem fence with implementations that add extra writable roots, read-only roots and access denials on top of the upstream semantics, and owns the runtime-context snapshot
Manage MCP servers and skills in DeepSeek Harness, and control which tools enter the next prompt.
description.zh: 管理 MCP 服务器与 Skill，并控制下一轮 prompt 带入哪些工具。

description.en: 复用本机 ~/.codex 订阅凭证与 models_cache.json 模型缓存，在 DSH 中通过 SSE 直连调用 Codex 模型。

Translates PDFs with BabelDOC through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint while keeping the original layout, and returns both a bilingual and a translated-only PDF. Requires a one-time runtime setup and an OpenAI-compatible API key.
description.zh: 通过 OpenAI 兼容接口调用 BabelDOC 翻译 PDF，保留原排版，输出双语对照版与纯译文版。需先运行一次运行时安装脚本，并配置 OpenAI 兼容接口的 API Key。

description.en: 思考小窗：贴边深呼吸箭头、思考增量翻译；设置页可选官方 Bing/Google/DeepSeek 或自定义 OpenAI 兼容端点，支持拉取模型列表与连接测试，本地端点走宿时代理绕过 CORS。

Ren'Py galgame production workbench: a host-side project service (write gateway plus git snapshots, a dialogue/scene dialect parser, derived progress, human-only review stamps, pinned-SDK validation and playtest, local publish) behind one seam, driven by an embedded web panel and agent tools.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里制作 Ren'Py galgame 的工作台：宿主侧项目服务（写网关 + git 快照、方言子集解析器、推导进度、只由人盖的审读戳、钉版 SDK 校验与试玩、本地发布）收在一条接缝后面，由内置 Web 工作台面板与 agent 工具驱动。

description.en: Desktop-style UI enhancements for the DSH Web client: adaptive wallpapers, a desktop pet companion with an activity feed and feeding economy, @file workspace references, and the resizable file/preview right panel.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 客户端的桌面化 UI 增强：自适应对比度壁纸、带活动流与投喂玩法的桌面宠物、@file 工作区文件引用，以及可缩放的文件/预览右侧面板。

description.en: Generate and edit images, generate video, and cut video locally through a GenBox server, with a zero-key test bench.
description.zh: 通过本地 GenBox 服务生图、改图、生视频，并用 ffmpeg 本地剪辑；自带零成本测试台。

description.en: Active wait for background subagents in DeepSeek Harness: registers a wait_subagent model tool that blocks until a named background continuable subagent settles, then returns its stop reason and closing message — optional timeout, membership gate rejects unknown ids, event-driven with zero polling. Closes the gap between run_in_background fire-and-return and the async settlement notice; wait for a background subagent without polling list_agents.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供后台子代理的主动等待：注册 wait_subagent 模型工具，阻塞等待指定的后台 continuable（可续会话）子代理收尾（settlement），返回停止原因与收尾消息——可选超时、成员资格门控拒绝未知 id、事件驱动零轮询。补齐 run_in_background 发后不管与异步收尾通知之间的缺口：等待后台子代理（subagent wait）不再轮询 list_agents、不再靠猜。

description.en: Execution flow chart: renders the current session's execution as a vertical node flow (turns, user, assistant, tools, approvals, retries, compaction), appended in real time over SSE with auto-follow scrolling — the chart draws wherever the session executes.
description.zh: 执行流程图：把当前会话的执行过程画成一条纵向节点流（回合/用户/助手/工具/审批/重试/压缩），SSE 实时追加——会话执行到哪，图就画到哪，自动跟随滚动。

description.en: A deterministic calculation engine for DeepSeek Harness, including a preset that guides the LLM to calculate through the engine rather than by text generation.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的确定性计算引擎，附带一个预设：引导 LLM 通过引擎而非文本生成来完成计算。

description.en: Turn the tab icon into a green/amber status light and send browser notifications when a session finishes or awaits your input, with 47 selectable notification sounds.
description.zh: 把标签页图标变成绿/琥珀状态灯，并在会话跑完或有交互待处理时发送浏览器通知，含 47 个可选音效。

description.en: Enhanced right-sidebar files panel: rename, create, upload, download (a directory is zipped on the fly), copy the full path and delete from the tree; an editable document renderer for 128 text extensions with Ctrl/Cmd+S save and conflict detection; plus an independent bottom terminal panel with tabs and a quick-command library persisted under the DSH home.
description.zh: 侧边栏文件树增强：重命名、新建、上传、下载（目录当场打包为 zip）、复制完整路径与删除；128 种文本扩展名的可编辑文档渲染器，支持 Ctrl/Cmd+S 保存与版本冲突检测；另有一个独立的下侧终端面板，带标签页与持久化在 DSH home 里的快捷命令库。

description.en: WebDAV server: turns a shared directory into a WebDAV service that Windows, macOS and Linux can mount as a local disk, with token authentication, optional read-only mode, configurable directory/port/token, and per-platform mounting guides built into the settings page.
description.zh: WebDAV 服务器：把一个共享目录变成 Windows/macOS/Linux 都能挂载成本地磁盘的 WebDAV 服务，令牌认证、可选只读、目录/端口/令牌全可配，设置页自带三平台挂载指南。

description.en: Import your own fonts, set three sizes and six weight stops, and pick a separate palette for body, chat and hint text — an Aqua glass theme for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.3, with adjustable blur and frost, a fluid or image/video wallpaper, per-region text tuning, and a switch that restores the stock UI. Continues the Aqua theme by WYH66666666 (DSH-Transparent-UI-Plugin v1.3.0); do not install alongside the upstream.
description.zh: 能导入自己的字体、调三处字号与六档字重，还能给正文、会话和说明文字分别配色——一套适配 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.3 的 Aqua 玻璃主题，附带可调模糊与磨砂、流体或图片与视频壁纸、逐区域文字微调，以及一键还原原生界面的开关。承接 WYH66666666 的 Aqua 主题（DSH-Transparent-UI-Plugin v1.3.0），请勿与上游同装。

description.en: Registers a keyless search provider for the built-in web_search tool so it works without an API key, failing over between the documented no-key tiers of Tavily and Firecrawl; a TAVILY_API_KEY or FIRECRAWL_API_KEY is picked up automatically when present. Two Bing scrape backends are included but off by default.
description.zh: 为内置 web_search 工具注册免密钥搜索提供方：无需 API Key 即可使用，在 Tavily 与 Firecrawl 官方免密钥通道之间自动降级；若设置了 TAVILY_API_KEY 或 FIRECRAWL_API_KEY 会自动采用。另含两个 Bing 抓取后端，默认关闭。

description.en: Speaks your agent's reports in a voice you choose, compressing long reports before speaking. Character voices need no training - a 3-10 second reference clip clones one, and community-trained models work too - and no 6.4 GB GPT-SoVITS install: the plugin installs its own runtime and voice. An existing GPT-SoVITS can be used instead, and it is the same voice model.
description.zh: 让你的 DSH 用你喜欢的声音开口说话、汇报内容，过长的汇报先压缩再念。角色声线不需要自己训练：一段 3-10 秒参考音就能克隆，也能直接用别人训练好的模型；不必为此装一整套 6.4 GB 的 GPT-SoVITS —— 运行时和声线都由插件自己装好。已有 GPT-SoVITS 的话也能直接接上，两者跑的是同一套声线。

description.en: Plugin advisor for DeepSeek Harness: describe what you need and it ranks the npm packages carrying the dsh-plugin keyword by denoised metrics (daily baseline, week-over-week growth, release cadence, freshness) into a first pick, alternates and plugins to avoid; ships a sidebar panel, four AI tools and one-click install.
description.zh: DSH 插件选购顾问：说需求，从带 dsh-plugin 关键字的 npm 包里按去噪指标（日常基线、周环比、版本节奏、新鲜度）排出首选、备选和不推荐；提供右侧栏面板、4 个 AI 工具和一键安装。

description.en: Persistent wallpaper skin for the dsh web profile: static image or muted looping video as the app background, with translucent panels and a floating picker panel.
description.zh: dsh Web 界面的持久化壁纸皮肤：静态图片或静音循环视频作为应用背景，面板半透明化，右下角悬浮面板一键换壁纸。

description.en: Open folders on remote hosts over SSH as Harness workspaces: file tools (read/write/edit/grep/glob) and shell commands run directly on the remote host over SFTP, ripgrep, and ssh2 exec, with no local mirroring, an encrypted multi-host registry, and the local sandbox policy still enforced.
description.zh: 通过 SSH 把远程主机目录作为 Harness 工作区打开：read/write/edit/grep/glob 与 shell 命令经 SFTP、ripgrep、ssh2 exec 直接在远程主机执行，不做本地镜像；多主机注册表加密存储，本地沙箱策略依然生效。

description.en: DSH web plugin: give any Session a colour mark, shown as a chip in the sidebar and picked from the conversation header. Marks are stored on the Host, so a colour chosen on one device is visible on every other one — including over LAN and tunnels.
description.zh: 给任意会话加上颜色标记：在侧栏显示色条、从会话头部选择颜色；标记保存在宿主上，一台设备选的颜色在其他设备上同样可见。

description.en: A philosopher's way of thinking made executable: dialectics and practice-testing to govern hallucination and long-session drift, so done is a verifiable fact rather than a claim.
description.zh: 把哲学家的思考方式变成可执行的东西：用辩证法和实践检验治理幻觉与长会话漂移，让「做完了」是可核事实而不是一句自述。

description.en: Fetch academic papers by DOI or keyword: Crossref and OpenAlex search, batch PDF download through eight Sci-Hub mirrors with an Unpaywall open-access fallback, PDF magic-byte validation, bounded concurrency, and a clickable batch-access HTML manifest for papers that could not be downloaded.
description.zh: 按 DOI 或关键词获取学术文献：Crossref 与 OpenAlex 检索，经 8 个 Sci-Hub 镜像批量下载 PDF 并以 Unpaywall 开放获取兜底，含 PDF 魔数校验与并发控制，并为未下载到的文献生成可点击的批量获取清单 HTML。

description.en: Terminal (CLI TUI) surface for DeepSeek Harness: interactive dsh in a terminal, no browser required

Adds Korean (한국어) as a native option in Settings - General - Language and translates all 2,775 Web UI strings of dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-alpha.2, experimental features included. Works in dsh web and the desktop app.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的「设置 - 通用设置 - 语言」加入韩语（한국어），翻译 dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 与 0.2.1-alpha.2 Web UI 的全部 2,775 条文案，包括实验功能。dsh web 与桌面应用均可使用。

description.en: Adds a Download button to DSH Web GUI delivery cards, so files delivered with present save straight from the browser.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 交付卡片上增加下载按钮，present 交付的文件可直接从浏览器下载。

description.en: Connects DSH to local Beav for Xiaohongshu (RED/RedNote) and social-media AI operations: topic research, knowledge, copywriting, image, audio, and short-video workflows with approval and artifact tracking.
description.zh: 将 DSH 连接到本机 Beav，面向小红书（RED/RedNote）、社交媒体运营和自媒体 AI 创作，覆盖选题研究、知识库、文案、图片、音频与短视频工作流，并保留审批和产物追踪。

description.en: DSH 运行时进程树对账与治理：把当前宿主的任务账本与本机真实进程树对账，标出未归属/泄漏/孤儿进程并守卫式树杀。Runtime process-tree reconciliation for DeepSeek Harness: join the current host's job ledger with the live OS process tree, surface unattributed/leaked/orphaned children, and kill trees behind creat
description.zh: DSH 宿主的 Windows 进程树对账插件：采样宿主进程树与任务账本，把每个进程归属到创建它的任务，并按置信度标出未归属与孤儿进程，同时提供受保护的整树终止。终止必须满足：目标归属于 DSH 宿主树、在动手前重新采样复核（含创建时间）、目标树内不含受保护后代，因此白名单 PID 不会扩大可杀范围。

description.en: Analyze a codebase and generate architecture documentation: module responsibilities, dependencies, entry points and run methods.
description.zh: 分析代码库并生成架构文档：模块职责、依赖关系、入口点与运行方式。

description.en: A plugin for dsh: monitor the resource utilization of dsh system processes, and report the results to the user in the form of charts.
description.zh: 监控dsh进程及其派生子进程的资源占用,并以面板图表报告整机与各会话的CPU与内存占用

description.en: Connect several OpenAI-compatible gateways at once: each one is its own group in the model picker, can be hidden without losing its settings, and can fetch its own public info from its address, alongside per-gateway model management, model tests and optional quota reporting.
description.zh: 同时接入多台 OpenAI 兼容网关：每台在模型选择器里各成一组、可单独隐藏且配置保留、按地址即可获取自身公开信息，并逐网关管理模型、跑模型测试、按需显示额度。

description.en: 招标文件条款摘录核对（按出处与原文逐字核对摘录完整性，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）
description.zh: 检查招标文件条款摘录表，核对每条摘录的来源、原文和提炼要求是否齐全。

description.en: Leafy green skin for the DSH Web GUI that overrides the --dsw-* palette in light and dark themes, plus a CSS layer for corners, shadows and motion that can be switched off.
description.zh: 叶绿色皮肤：把 DSH Web GUI 的 --dsw-* 调色板覆盖成浅色 / 深色两套叶绿配色，另有一层可关闭的样式层处理圆角、阴影与动效。

description.en: Connects the hosted Knowra MCP server: search arXiv papers by topic, author or exact UTC dates without an account, and sign in with OAuth from the plugin page to read Scout reports on methods, evidence and limitations.
description.zh: 接入 Knowra 托管 MCP：无需账号即可按主题、作者或精确 UTC 日期检索 arXiv 论文；在插件页用 OAuth 登录后可读取 Scout 报告（方法、证据与局限）。

description.en: Visual reference moodboard for DeepSeek Harness: drag-and-drop images with tags and notes, and pinned style guides the agent reads before it generates or restyles UI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可视化参考情绪板：拖入图片并打标签、写备注，固定风格指南，智能体在生成或改版界面之前先读取这些参考。

description.en: Read-only side branch in the right sidebar: quote text to ask follow-ups without polluting the model context of the main session; every follow-up rebuilds the branch from the latest settled turns of the main session, and writes are refused at the tool-execution layer so the prompt prefix stays cacheable.
description.zh: 右侧栏的只读侧枝会话：划选文字即可追问，答案不进入主会话的模型上下文；每轮追问都用主会话最新的已结算内容重建，写操作在执行层被拒，以保住提示词前缀缓存。

description.en: Fills missing model parameters from models.dev, imports models from configured providers, and writes per-field overrides for built-in models, with prices in USD or native CNY set as manual rates or a reference price times a multiplier.
description.zh: 从 models.dev 补全缺失的模型参数，从已配置供应商导入模型，并按字段覆盖内置模型；价格可按美元或原生人民币设为手动单价，或按参考价乘自定义倍率。

description.en: Agent Community UI — Bot list, room list, chat panel, run status

Browser operation by accessibility refs: navigate, snapshot the page as a ref tree, act on elements, and wait for conditions; the origin policy follows the session approval stance and is enforced by request interception.
description.zh: 按无障碍 ref 操控浏览器：导航、把页面快照成 ref 树、操作元素、等待条件；域名策略跟随会话审批状态，并由请求拦截层强制执行。

description.en: Turns a dsh session into a redacted idea and delivers it end-to-end encrypted to friends on DeepHub; received ideas land as new sessions.
description.zh: 将一条 dsh 会话提炼为脱敏后的思路，端到端加密投递给 DeepHub 上的朋友；收到的思路落为一条新会话。

description.en: Sync the installed DeepSeek Harness plugin manifest to a GitHub Gist (OAuth login, one-click export/import with automatic dependency install).
description.zh: 将已安装的 DeepSeek Harness 插件清单同步到 GitHub Gist（OAuth 登录、一键导出/导入并自动安装依赖）。

description.en: Power-Up — small, opt-in upgrades for DeepSeek Harness. Adds a right-click action menu to the Trajectory ledger, an optional stop reason in the session header's background jobs panel (appended to the injected completion notice), and an install control for

Adds two buttons beside the sidebar toggle at the top-left of the DSH desktop UI, on macOS, Windows and Linux. Reload refreshes only the UI layer while a turn already generating keeps running; restart asks for one confirmation, quits the whole app and reopens it with sessions and workspaces intact. Restart is a POST that must carry a random per-boot token read from the plugin's status route. The plugin makes no network calls, reads no session content and has zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面版界面左上角「收起侧边栏」按钮旁加两个按钮，macOS、Windows、Linux 三端都可用。刷新只重载界面层，宿主里正在生成的回合不中断；重启会在确认一次后退出整个应用并自动重新打开，会话与工作区都在。重启是 POST，必须带每次启动随机生成的 token（由插件状态接口提供）；插件不联网、不读会话内容、零运行时依赖。

description.en: Agent-native API client for DeepSeek Harness: Postman-like debugging UI (request tree with context menus and full keyboard navigation, resizable sidebar, layered auto-generated header preview with per-item suppression and constant secret masking), six api_client_* agent tools sharing the same request core, redaction and audit chain with the human UI, Postman Collection v2.1 import with a migration report, environment variables with SecretRef indirection, and a fail-closed SSRF network policy.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 原生 API Client：Postman 级调试 UI（右键菜单与完整键盘导航的请求树、可调宽侧栏、自动生成 Header 分层预览——逐项可停用、敏感值恒脱敏），六个 api_client_* Agent 工具与 Human UI 共用同一请求核心、脱敏与审计链，Postman Collection v2.1 导入附迁移报告，环境变量经 SecretRef 间接引用，SSRF 网络策略默认 fail-closed。

description.en: One-click temporary tasks for DeepSeek Harness — each task is a disposable timestamped workspace plus its own session, shown as a native sidebar workspace node.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的临时任务模式：一键创建一次性的时间戳工作区并开会话，直接成为侧边栏原生工作区节点。

description.en: 会话模式与注入面：会话模式行（各模式的 persona、工具与 policy 名单、开关；按会话收口也由它内部持有）+ subagent 服务接管行 + 注入通道 + 工具说明（汉化 / 用法分组），一次装齐；行清单归会话挂着的 shipped preset，本包不自建 preset。
Pre-install supply-chain checks for DeepSeek Harness plugins: verify the tarball you are about to install matches the source you read, before any code runs.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件做安装前供应链校验：在代码运行前核对即将安装的包是否与你读到的源码一致。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: AnySearch-backed web search with optional TinyFish and DeepSeek search/fetch, registered into ctx.web.

Connect a self-hosted Magpie gateway with one provider route per upstream owner, so the stock model picker shows Magpie (Claude), Magpie (Codex) and other groups, plus automatic multi-line failover, read-only usage cards, per-model default effort, a per-session fast switch for priority-tier models, and optional Cloudflare Access.
description.zh: 把自托管 Magpie 网关按上游归属接入为多个 provider route，原版模型选择器即显示 Magpie (Claude)、Magpie (Codex) 等分组；支持多线路自动切换、只读用量卡片、逐模型默认 effort、priority 档模型的会话级快速切换和可选 Cloudflare Access。

description.en: Browser Web Speech API voice input: zero server, zero keys, zero model downloads (Edge=Azure, Chrome=Google speech).
description.zh: 浏览器 Web Speech API 语音输入：零服务端、零密钥、零模型下载（Edge=Azure 语音、Chrome=Google 语音）。

description.en: Resumes turns interrupted by a DSH host restart: hooks agent activation (once a session is live), reads the crash-repair turn/end, and sends a continuation that requires verifying real-world state first rather than assuming a side effect succeeded or failed. Permanent failures (AUTH, QUOTA, context overflow) are skipped, with a cross-restart budget, adaptive backoff and a minimal-context payload.
description.zh: DSH 重启后自动续跑被中断的回合：在会话激活后读取崩溃修复写入的 turn/end，投出要求先核对真实状态（不假定外部操作成功或失败）的续跑消息；永久性失败（认证、配额、上下文超限）直接跳过，并有跨重启次数预算、自适应退避与最小上下文注入。

description.en: Browse and manage the community plugin catalog from a first-level DeepSeek Harness Settings page, with verified installs and updates, removal, pause and resume, installed-package state, and sanitized README previews.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置一级页面中浏览和管理社区插件目录，支持验证后安装与更新、删除、暂停与恢复、已安装状态查看及安全 README 预览。

description.en: Named subagent presets bound to model-route allowlists, where an out-of-list child model is refused before a delegation starts and each child conversation shows the model its last request actually used.
description.zh: 为官方子智能体工具提供具名预设与模型路由白名单：越界的子模型在派发前被拒绝，子会话标题栏显示最近一次请求实际使用的模型。

description.en: 投递策略：离线留在信箱等人／在线立刻投出（示例①的挂点） · Delivery policy: offline waits in the mailbox, online posts at once (example (1)'s socket)

Voice conversation mode for the DSH Web GUI: tap the mic to start a full-screen call, talk hands-free, and hear each reply read aloud as it streams. Bilingual (Chinese/English) UI, light and dark themes, adjustable speech rate, and switchable voices.
description.zh: DSH Web 的语音对话模式：点一下麦克风进入全屏通话，边说边听，AI 回复边生成边朗读。界面中英双语，适配明暗主题，支持语速调节与音色切换。

description.en: Ollama-backed search provider for the DeepSeek Harness web seam (ctx.web): one web_search backend calling POST https://ollama.com/api/web_search.
Conveniently shut down the dsh web server: a conversation-header exit button plus an agent tool, using the launcher's bounded shutdown path.
Live progress for long-running background jobs in the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a draggable floating ball with a per-session task panel showing done/total, speed and ETA.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面中长时间后台任务的实时进度：有任务的会话里浮着一个小球，可拖动，点开是含已完成/总量、速度与剩余时间的面板。

description.en: Exposes any local service on a LAN address and a public cloudflared quick-tunnel domain behind one password login, with per-route open/block gates managed from the plugin settings page. Requires Python 3 and cloudflared on the machine, and reports either of them being missing or misconfigured in the settings page before you start; LAN and local access are passwordless by default, while the public tunnel requires the passcode.
description.zh: 把一个口令登录的内网地址与公网 cloudflared 快速隧道域名提供给本机任意服务，每条路由的开放/屏蔽闸门在插件设置页里管理。需本机有 Python 3 与 cloudflared，缺失或路径填错会在启动前的设置页里提示；内网与本机访问默认免密，公网隧道需要口令。

description.en: DSH web plugin: cross-session full-text search over all persisted session logs (user/assistant/system messages). Incremental mtime+size index cached at $DSH_HOME/cache/session-search (zero writes to ~/.dsh/sessions), standalone HTML panel page, fenced HTT
description.zh: 跨会话全文搜索：对持久化 DSH 会话日志建立增量消息级索引，返回 sessionId、seq 与摘录；提供 agent 工具和独立面板。需 Node.js 23.5+。

description.en: DSH settings section for managing a local Sirchmunk knowledge backend: graph inspection, cluster management, audit history, runtime metrics, and privacy controls.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中管理本地 Sirchmunk 知识库：图谱导出、聚类管理、审计历史、运行指标与隐私控制。

description.en: A right-sidebar Git panel in the IDEA style — local changes with per-file checkbox commits, a commit tree with per-commit details, branch, remote and stash management, push with a credential fallback, all driven by the plain git CLI.
