description.zh: 右侧栏的 IDEA 风格 Git 面板：本地变更与按文件勾选提交、提交树与提交详情、分支 / 远程 / 贮藏管理、带凭据兜底的推送，以及 git 命令流水，全部通过原生 git CLI 执行。

description.en: Skill shelf for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): a sidebar panel next to Plugins and Automation that lists every skill DSH resolves, discovers and installs skills from skills.sh, upgrades them safely (previous version quarantined, never deleted), uninstalls or res

LittleStar Meeting Room: bring AI sessions that cannot see each other into one room — for a meeting, or a game of werewolf. By 插件·2代小星辰 (LittleStar) and 辰启星明; the four-piece game layer (targeted visibility, private chat, concurrent asks, elimination) was contributed by 插件·3代小星辰. Any session can host — set the topic and goal, invite members in order, they speak one at a time, and the meeting closes with written minutes; it also runs games like werewolf. Includes 小白使用指南.md, a beginner guide written by 插件·3代小星辰.
description.zh: 星辰会议室：让分散在不同会话里的 AI 开一场会 —— 或者，跑一局狼人杀。作者：插件·2代小星辰（LittleStar）、辰启星明；「四件套」（定向可见 / 私聊 / 并发 / 出局）由插件·3代小星辰扩建。在 DSH 里，每个会话是一个独立的 AI，彼此完全看不见；任意会话都能开房当主持人，先定议题与目标，按顺序邀请其他会话，一位一位发言，轮次用满或目标达成即收会生成纪要。它也能跑狼人杀这类对抗游戏。本插件附带小白使用指南.md，看了你就会用，由插件·3代小星辰编写。

description.en: Header chip for the DSH web GUI that shows whether the current Beijing time is inside DeepSeek's API peak window, with a live clock and countdown to the next transition.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 会话头部高峰指示灯，实时显示当前北京时间是否处于 DeepSeek API 高峰时段，附实时时钟与下一转折倒计时。

description.en: Scratchpad panel for DeepSeek Harness: tagged notes, image/file attachments, Markdown task lists, send-to-chat, a wake-up shortcut, JSON export/import, and Agent tools.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的左栏便签插件：带标签的随手记、图片/文件附件、Markdown 待办、发到对话、唤起快捷键、JSON 导入导出，以及 Agent 工具。

description.en: Mermaid diagrams for DeepSeek Harness: on-demand rendering, theme-aware, with a fullscreen zoom viewer.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里按需渲染 Mermaid 图表，默认紧凑 ELK 布局，支持主题适配、复制和全屏缩放查看。

description.en: Panellist manager: reorder the entries on the left rail, rename them, replace their icons, hide them, and fold several into a Group with a flyout menu, from a Settings tab.
description.zh: 面板列表管理器：在设置页里调整左侧轨道上的页签顺序、改名、换图标、隐藏，并把若干页签收进带飞出菜单的分组。

description.en: SSH server monitor and terminal sidebar for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏实时查看 Linux 服务器状态，只读监控，装完即用不用配置。

description.en: Holds the OS wake lock while any agent, subagent, or background job runs, releases it after a configurable grace period, and provides a bilingual web settings page with live status, manual hold, and display-on options.
description.zh: 任意 agent、subagent 或后台任务运行时持有系统唤醒锁，全部结束后按可配置宽限期释放；提供中英双语 Web 设置页，实时显示活动与唤醒锁状态，支持手动保持与阻止屏幕关闭。

description.en: 火山方舟 Agent Plan 与 Coding Plan：OAuth 登录、账号、模型与额度管理。
中瑞世联工作台 / CRWU audit workbench for DeepSeek Harness: pick a pending audit report, dispatch one AI audit subagent, watch and stop/restart it, auto-upload deliverables to Aliyun OSS.

Static and runtime security guard for dsh: rule-based scans for malicious code, prompt injection and token waste, runtime interception of dangerous tool calls, /scan command, plugin_scan tool, web panel, and allowlist.
description.zh: dsh 安全守卫插件：基于规则的静态扫描覆盖恶意代码、提示词注入与令牌浪费，运行时拦截危险工具调用，提供 /scan 命令、plugin_scan 工具、Web 面板与白名单。

description.en: Makes the AI default to Mermaid diagrams in development conversations — system prompt guidance, a mermaid_validate syntax-check tool with real-parser validation, and an output gate that auto-fixes or removes broken diagrams. Rendering via dsh-mermaid.
description.zh: 让 AI 在开发交流中默认用 Mermaid 图表达——系统提示引导、mermaid_validate 真解析语法校验工具，以及自动修复或摘除坏图的输出闸。渲染交给 dsh-mermaid。

description.en: Adds custom icons to the DSH Settings sidebar and exposes a keyed `settings.section.icon` slot for third-party settings sections.
description.zh: 为 DSH 设置侧边栏添加自定义图标，并开放 keyed `settings.section.icon` 槽位供第三方设置分区注册图标。

description.en: Message timeline rail for DeepSeek Harness web chat: evenly spaced ticks for each user message on the right edge, click to jump, hover to preview.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页会话消息时间轴导航条：消息区右侧等间距刻度，点击跳转，悬浮预览。

description.en: Persistent provider-reported token usage totals with per-session, per-model, and daily activity statistics.
description.zh: 持久化 provider 上报的 Token 用量统计，支持按会话、按模型和按日活跃度查看。

description.en: Registers an `image2_generate` tool that calls your own OpenAI-compatible image relay to generate or edit pictures (text-to-image via POST /images/generations, image-to-image via POST /images/edits with a local PNG/JPEG/WebP reference, accepting b64_json or image URLs), saves them in the session working directory, and renders them inline in the conversation through its `@wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer` dependency.
description.zh: 注册 `image2_generate` 工具：调用你自己的 OpenAI 兼容图片中转站生成或编辑图片（文生图走 POST /images/generations，图生图走 POST /images/edits 并接受本地 PNG/JPEG/WebP 参考图，兼容 b64_json 与图片 URL 返回），图片保存在会话工作目录内，并借助其 `@wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer` 依赖在对话里内联渲染。

description.en: Long-form novel writing plugin: each book is a git repository of frontmatter files, with 39 DSH domain tools and a web writing UI. Deep import drafts candidates, AI adoption into canonical assets requires DSH approval, and deterministic continuity checks ship with a report-only benchmark. Independent open source (MIT), not an official DeepSeek product; requires Node >= 24.11.0 and currently targets DSH 0.1.2-rc.1.
description.zh: 长篇小说写作插件：每本书一个 git 仓库，当前 39 个 DSH 领域工具 + Web 写作台；深度导入产候选草稿、AI 采用类写入正式资产前必过审批、确定性连续性检查（报告型）。独立开源（MIT），非 DeepSeek 官方产品；需 Node ≥ 24.11.0，当前适配 DSH 0.1.2-rc.1。

description.en: Global cross-session todo inbox for DSH web: any session's agent records human-action todos (merge MRs, approve work orders, reviews) via inbox_add/inbox_done/inbox_list; a sidebar entry shows a count badge and an expandable list to open and complete them, persisted to ~/.dsh/todo-inbox.json.
description.zh: DSH Web 全局跨会话待办收件箱：任意会话的 agent 通过 inbox_add/inbox_done/inbox_list 登记等待人类处理的事项（合并 MR、审批工单、评审等）；侧边栏入口显示未完成数角标与可展开的待办列表，支持打开与完成，数据持久化到 ~/.dsh/todo-inbox.json。

description.en: Export the current DSH conversation, or selected turns, as clean readable Markdown.
description.zh: 将当前 DSH 对话或选定轮次导出为干净、易读的 Markdown。

description.en: Auto-discovery vision bridge for text-only DeepSeek Harness agents: automatically finds an image-capable model from your configured providers and returns picture descriptions as plain text via a vision tool.
description.zh: 为纯文本 DeepSeek Harness 主模型搭视觉桥：自动从已配置模型中挑选多模态模型，通过 vision 工具把图片描述以纯文本返回。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: 把 DSH 工具接到用户自备的 ComfyUI 实例（实例管理 + 工具分配 + MiniMax H3 视频 / Qwen-Image 图像工具）。

A draggable tarot card back in the corner of the DeepSeek Harness UI. Click to draw, right-click for the four spreads, full 78-card deck with bilingual meanings. Readings use only the cards actually drawn.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 界面角落里可拖动的塔罗牌背。点一下抽牌，右击选四种牌阵，完整 78 张牌库，正逆位含义中英双语。解读只用真正抽到的牌。

description.en: A GitHub-connected visual git manager for DeepSeek Harness: guided GitHub-Flow steps, commit graph with PR/CI badges, one-click GitHub login, PR and issue management, and structured git tools for the agent. Renamed from gitcompass in 2.0.0.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 GitHub 联动的可视化 Git 管理：引导式 GitHub Flow 步骤、带 PR/CI 徽章的提交图谱、一键 GitHub 登录、PR 与 issue 管理，以及面向 Agent 的结构化 Git 工具。2.0.0 起由 gitcompass 改名而来。

description.en: Conversational bookkeeping bundle for dsh: record expenses/income by chat with strict amount validation and natural-language dates, then query, report, export CSV/HTML, and track monthly budgets against a local SQLite ledger.
description.zh: dsh 的对话式记账插件:聊天即可记账(严格金额校验、自然语言日期、自动分类),并支持查询、报表、CSV/HTML 导出和月度预算,数据存于本地 SQLite 账本。

description.en: SparkElf-maintained fork of dsh-quant: AI-native & DSH-native quant toolkit — 59 tools across 6 pluggable domains (data/alpha/ML/risk/execution), one end-to-end PDAT→PET research pipeline. Fork adds A-share-correct annualization, cross-sectional IC, and u
One versioned vocabulary of a project's business concepts, a read-only drift scan, and the same naming rules in every agent prompt.
description.zh: 一份按项目维护的业务概念词表、只读命名漂移扫描，以及注入每个 Agent 提示的同一套命名规则。

description.en: Sidebar activity bell: a red badge counts sessions that finished, and clicking it swaps the sidebar list from workspace grouping to a day-grouped recent-activity list with a green dot on completions that have not been opened.
description.zh: 侧边栏活动铃铛：会话跑完后铃铛显示红色角标，点一下把工作区列表换成按天分组的最近活动列表，尚未打开过的完成项带绿点。

description.en: Adds a pin button to the DSH Desktop title bar that toggles always-on-top for the main window. Windows 10/11 only.
description.zh: 在 DSH Desktop 标题栏加一枚图钉，一键切换主窗口置顶。仅 Windows 10/11。

description.en: Adds a manim_card tool that renders Manim Python into a playable animation card in the chat stream; the code runs in the browser on a bundled runtime, so no local Python is needed, and video export goes through the local Manim CLI when installed or frame by frame in the browser otherwise.
description.zh: 新增 manim_card 工具，把 Manim Python 渲染为聊天流中可播放的动画卡片；代码经随包分发的运行时在浏览器内执行，本机无需安装 Python；导出视频时，本机装了 Manim 就走 CLI 渲染，否则在浏览器内逐帧导出。

description.en: Adds a speaker button immediately right of the Like button on every finalized assistant reply; click it to hear the reply through the browser speech engine, and hover it for a speed and voice panel. Text is sent to an unofficial Edge TTS endpoint.
description.zh: 在每条已定稿的助手回复里、紧挨点赞按钮右侧加一个小喇叭：点击用浏览器语音引擎朗读这条回复，鼠标悬停可调倍速与音色；文本会发送到非官方的 Edge TTS 端点。

description.en: Keeps the native per-message status line always visible without hovering — date and time on every message, run duration, TTFT, and tokens per second on assistant messages.
description.zh: 原生消息状态栏无需悬停即可始终显示每条消息的日期时间，以及 Assistant 消息的用时、首 token、tok/s。

description.en: Answers what the voice model delegates by admitting a turn to a DeepSeek Harness session and speaking the agent's reply.

Gear-based autonomy governor for the DeepSeek Harness agent: the entropy-sdk EntropyRuntime core (gear ladder G0-G4, utility gate, slow-up/fast-down policy, tamper-evident audit chain) bound to the Harness tool registry, with a live Web UI and paper-ready
Adds cross-workspace pinned and recent session sections to the DSH sidebar, with status indicators and display settings.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏跨工作区汇总置顶与最近会话，提供状态标记和显示设置。

description.en: A port of the T3 Code model picker into the composer: a provider rail, search results grouped under provider headings, favorites kept in the browser, unavailable-provider badges, and Cmd/Ctrl+1..9 jump shortcuts for the first nine rows of the visible list.
description.zh: 把 T3 Code 的模型选择器移植到 DSH 输入框：提供方侧栏、按提供方分组的搜索结果、浏览器本地收藏、不可用提供方标记，以及用 Cmd/Ctrl+1..9 直接选中可见列表的前九行。

description.en: Compact interface with borderless messages, a light queue, composer controls, and adjustable corners. Built for DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 only; while enabled it replaces the stock sidebar module, and removing it restores the original.
description.zh: 紧凑界面：无边框消息、轻量队列、输入区控制，以及可调圆角。仅适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2；启用期间会替换官方侧栏模块，移除后恢复原样。

description.en: Connects ChatGPT accounts through OAuth, switches among them manually or automatically, and adds Codex models with usage limits to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 连接 ChatGPT 账号，支持手动或自动切换，并为 DeepSeek Harness 添加带用量限额信息的 Codex 模型。

description.en: Gemini 紫夜主题与角色装饰 for DeepSeek Harness Desktop (Windows and macOS)

Brings the free models of a locally installed OpenCode CLI into DSH: starts or reuses a local opencode serve, discovers the live catalog and refreshes it every five minutes, and bridges the session event stream to OpenAI-compatible SSE through a loopback-only shim that validates Host and Origin.
description.zh: 把本机已安装的 OpenCode CLI 免费模型接入 DSH：自动拉起或复用本地 opencode serve，读取实时模型目录并每五分钟刷新，再通过仅绑定回环、校验 Host 与 Origin 的 shim 把会话事件流转换为 OpenAI 兼容 SSE。

description.en: Adds a sidebar panel to the DeepSeek Harness web UI that reports token usage and cost straight from DeepSeek's own usage API (today's spend, 7/30-day trends, today's hourly split, a history table, cost breakdown, peak/off-peak tier pricing), plus per-session detail from local logs. Zero-config: it reads the browser sign-in for the official figures, and falls back to local session logs with the source labelled.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏加入 Token 用量与花费面板：直接采用 DeepSeek 官方用量接口（今日消费、7/30 天趋势、今日分时、历史表、成本构成、峰谷分档计价），并用本机会话日志给出按会话明细。凭据零配置——自动读取浏览器登录态取官方数据，取不到时退回本地日志并标明来源。

description.en: Zhihu (知乎) for DeepSeek Harness: wraps the local pyzhihu-cli as 18 zhihu_* tools — 14 read-only (search, hot list, question, answer, user, feed, topic, notifications, collections) plus 4 publishing tools that are not registered until readOnly is turned off — with a web panel in the sidebar for login, config and lookups.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供知乎能力：包装本机 pyzhihu-cli 为 18 个 zhihu_* 工具——14 个只读（搜索/热榜/问题/回答/用户/推荐流/话题/通知/收藏夹）与 4 个发布类工具（readOnly 关闭前不注册）——并在侧栏提供 Web 面板做登录、配置与查询。

description.en: Hybrid model router for DeepSeek Harness: declarative rules, user-configurable cost control (cost-first / quality-first / balanced), optional LLM task classifier, and failure fallback chains.

Lets DSH drive the Chrome tab you are already browsing, no vision needed: the page reaches the model as structured text with a numbered element list, and clicks, typing, key presses, scrolling, tab handling and navigation wait for your confirmation in the extension side panel while password and payment-card fields stay masked. Fifteen browser_* tools cover snapshot, text, tab list, open, follow, click, type, press, scroll, wait, navigate, back, close, forward and reload. A repack of the bridge plugin from omdsh-dev/dsh-browser, published to npm so it installs with `dsh plugin add`: the peer ranges the host checks are widened so the install is not refused as incompatible, the bundled extension also probes the DSH Desktop host port 19387 so no bridge address has to be typed, and a script copies the extension to a fixed directory so a profile switch or reinstall cannot break it. The prebuilt release tarball carries the plugin and the built MV3 extension. Upstream: https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser.
description.zh: 让 DSH 直接操控你当前正在浏览的 Chrome 标签页，无需视觉能力：页面以带编号元素清单的结构化文本交给模型；点击、输入、按键、滚动、标签页操作与导航都会在扩展侧边栏等你确认，密码与支付卡字段保持掩码。15 个 browser_* 工具覆盖 snapshot、文本读取、标签页列举/打开/跟随、点击、输入、按键、滚动、等待、导航、后退、关闭、前进与刷新。本项目是 omdsh-dev/dsh-browser 桥接插件的再打包版，发布到 npm，可直接 `dsh plugin add` 安装：放宽了宿主安装时校验的 peer 范围，避免被判为版本不兼容；随包的扩展额外探测 DSH 桌面端宿主端口 19387，因此无需手填桥接地址；并附带脚本把扩展复制到固定目录，避免切换 profile 或重装后扩展失效。预构建 Release tarball 内含插件本体与已构建的 MV3 扩展。上游：https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser。

description.en: Read-only CAD tools that inspect, extract and export DWG/DXF drawings, including SVG and PNG previews and DXF conversion.
description.zh: 只读 CAD 工具：查看、提取 DWG/DXF 图纸，导出 SVG/PNG 预览或转换 DXF。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness LLM adapter bridge for Qoder CN, Qoder International, Tencent CodeBuddy and MiniMax Code subscriptions. It reuses each provider's own SDK or official ACP server and CLI login, shows available quota, and exposes per-provider settings pages

Unofficial host-side ServerChan notifications for DeepSeek Harness: sends mobile alerts through WeChat (ServerChan Turbo) or the ServerChan³ app when approvals, plan reviews, or questions go unanswered beyond a configurable threshold, even with the browser closed.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的第三方 Server酱通知插件：在主机端监控审批、计划评审和问答，超过设定时间仍未处理时通过微信（Server酱 Turbo）或 Server酱³ App 发送手机提醒，无需保持浏览器打开。

description.en: Shows Provider/Model in the DSH Web composer model selector trigger; the dropdown list and its search are unchanged.
description.zh: DSH Web 对话框模型选择器的触发器显示「供应商/模型」；下拉列表与其搜索均不变。

description.en: One-click upgrade to Deepseek Harness, with version number displayed in the sidebar.
description.zh: 一键升级Deepseek Harness, 支持侧边栏显示版本号.

description.en: Applies structured unified diffs (git format) to the real filesystem: multi-file/hunk parsing, fuzzy hunk location with line-offset correction, all-or-nothing application with typed conflict reports, reverse-patch undo journal and dry-run - four patch_* dsh tools plus a CLI.
description.zh: 将结构化 unified diff（git 格式）应用到真实文件系统：多文件/多 hunk 解析、带行号偏移修正的模糊定位、全有或全无的应用与类型化冲突报告、反向补丁撤销日记及 dry-run——4 个 patch_* dsh 工具外加一个 CLI。

description.en: Refines the built-in cache-hit percentage to three decimals in place across the composer stats row and the token-usage dialog.
description.zh: 把内置缓存命中率在 composer 统计行与 Token 用量弹窗中原位精化为三位小数。

description.en: DSH desktop agent: a native-vision decision loop that drives the host desktop through the Cua Driver tools. DSH 桌面 Agent 子插件。

Agent mode picker for DSH: pick an external Agent CLI (Claude Code, Codex, Qwen Code, Gemini CLI, Aider, Goose, Hermes…) as the session's default executor from a control next to the input box, instead of editing configuration files. The agent roster is data-driven, and installed CLIs are discovered automatically from PATH, the managed CLI directory and a drop-in convention directory. Agents that are installed but still missing credentials or a required background service are shown as "needs setup" rather than silently hidden.
description.zh: DSH 的 Agent 模式选择器：在输入框旁边直接选定一个外部 Agent CLI（Claude Code、Codex、 Qwen Code、Gemini CLI、Aider、Goose、Hermes…）作为当前会话的默认执行体，不必去改配置文件。 Agent 名册是数据驱动的，已安装的 CLI 会从 PATH、托管 CLI 目录和约定目录自动发现；装了但还缺 凭据或需要常驻服务的，会显示为「待配置」而不是被悄悄藏起来。

description.en: 给同事的运维请求通道：同事在飞书私聊机器人提一件事，你在审批卡上点「同意」后，由你指定的那条 DSH 会话带着你配好的工具与人设去办，结果以卡片回到提交人的飞书（Markdown 正常渲染），不需要公网入口。四个特点：配对码把发送者绑成管理员，机器人只服务指定账号；非管理员请求走审批卡片，同意/拒绝都校验点击人身份；请求串行排队，前一条整轮 turn 跑完才注入下一条；目标会话启动时主动 resume，不用先有人在界面上点开。
description.zh: 给同事的运维请求通道——同事在飞书私聊里提的事先排进串行队列，由已配对的管理员在审批卡上放行后才进入那条共享的 DSH 会话（带注入的人设执行），回答回到提交人。

description.en: Two-step session deletion: the session menu moves a chat into a recycle bin without deleting anything, the bin panel restores an entry, deletes one for good right away, or empties the whole bin, and the next start wipes its log, projection cache, spill files and workspace membership.
description.zh: 两步删除会话：会话菜单先把会话移入回收站（不删任何内容、可随时恢复），面板可恢复、可逐条立刻删除、也可整体清空，下次启动 DSH 时才真正清掉日志、投影缓存、spill 文件与工作区登记。

description.en: Publishes an ordered system prompt section that names wsl as the command executor to reach for first, so the agent prefers WSL over PowerShell on Windows. Registers no tools, and only advertises executors the agent can actually call.
description.zh: 发布一段带顺序的系统提示词段，指定 wsl 为执行命令时优先选用的执行器，让模型在 Windows 上优先走 WSL 而不是 PowerShell。不注册任何工具，且只宣传模型真实可调用的执行器。

description.en: Sound reminders with one-click jump for concurrent sessions: the current session gets crisp dang/dang-dang tones, other sessions a soft ding/ding-ding plus a top-right card that jumps straight to the replying conversation.
description.zh: 多对话并行的声音提醒 + 对话直达：当前对话当/当当（crisp 清脆档），其他对话叮/叮叮（soft 柔和档）+ 右上角小卡片，点一下直达对应对话。

description.en: Restarts the DSH desktop app on Windows and wakes the sessions listed for it afterwards. The agent-facing restart tool is off by default and refuses while the host is busy.
description.zh: 重启 Windows 上的 DSH 桌面端，并在重启后唤醒清单里指定的会话。面向 agent 的重启工具默认关闭，宿主繁忙时拒绝重启。

description.en: DSH environment management: auto-installs a Rust/Tauri desktop host (downloaded per-OS from dsh-desktop-host releases, source build as fallback), one-click runtime updates, Windows platform compatibility, official DeepSeek billing, and a built-in code editor for the workspace.
description.zh: dsh 环境管理插件：自动获取 Rust/Tauri 桌面宿主（按系统从 dsh-desktop-host 下载，无 Release 时源码构建），运行时一键更新、Windows 平台兼容自动适配、DeepSeek 官方计费，并内置工作区代码编辑器。

description.en: Reads a running workbuddy2api-panel over its HTTP API and syncs its models into the DSH model picker with credit multipliers, CN/international realm labels and per-model reasoning-effort levels; also shows remaining credits and usage in a settings page and a sidebar badge.
description.zh: 读取运行中的 workbuddy2api-panel 的 HTTP 接口，把面板模型连同倍率、国内/国际分区与逐模型思考档位同步进 DSH 的模型选择器，并在设置页与侧边栏徽标中显示剩余额度与用量。

description.en: Neutralize tool calls with invalid JSON arguments on the wire so one malformed model generation cannot brick a session against strict OpenAI-compatible servers.
description.zh: 在 wire 层中性化 arguments 为非法 JSON 的 tool call，避免一次模型畸形输出让 session 在严格 OpenAI 兼容服务端上永久 400。

description.en: Scriptor 检索增强：嵌入、场景识别与重排
被 dsh-memory-shield 遮蔽的会话的隔离记忆包：五轨（memory/user/project/key/daily）独立数据目录，与 dsh-memory-evolve 完全隔离。装完即已生效——默认只提供管理页，不接管任何会话；在目标 preset 里设 memoryEnabled: true 才启用。
New API gateway provider: several gateways with one active at a time, per-gateway model lists with context and modality details, quota, and image and video generation tools.
description.zh: New API 网关提供商：多网关同一时间激活一个，每个网关独立的模型清单与上下文/多模态标注、额度查询，以及生图与视频生成工具。

description.en: Configurable statistics row below the composer via a ${variable} display template — which segments appear and how they are labelled is fully user-defined.
description.zh: 用 ${变量} 显示模板自定义输入框下方的会话统计行——显示哪些统计段、单位文案怎么写，全部由模板决定。

description.en: Git status badges for DSH: sidebar workspace-row badges and an input-row chip showing the current conversation's workspace git state, with event-driven freshness over SSE.
description.zh: DSH 的 Git 状态徽章：侧边栏工作区行徽章与输入行徽章，显示当前会话工作区的 git 状态，通过 SSE 事件驱动保持实时。

description.en: Drive your dsh agent from WeChat over the iLink gateway: two-way encrypted media transfer (auto-decrypt inbox + /send), proactive weixin_send tool, completion notifications, multi-session switching, and a health panel with file logging.
description.zh: 微信遥控 DeepSeek Harness：iLink 双向加密文件收发（入站自动解密落盘 + /send 出站）、weixin_send 主动通知、完成通知、多会话切换、健康面板与文件日志。

description.en: Ships a minimal lesson ledger: brief.ps1 to look up past pitfalls, add-lesson.ps1 to record new ones, deployed into the skills directory and wired into AGENTS.md by the installer. The model checks it before working and turns what it hits into rules, so the same mistake is not made twice. This plugin watches whether that actually happens and shows the result in a tab and under the composer.
description.zh: 自带一套最小账本工具：brief.ps1 查过往踩过的坑，add-lesson.ps1 记新的，安装时自动部署到技能目录并接好 AGENTS.md。模型动手前查一遍、踩坑后记成规则，同一个坑不必踩第二次。本插件负责盯着它有没有真的这么做，并把「查了几次、记了哪几条」摆在面板和输入框下方。

description.en: Embeds the DeepSeek web chat (chat.deepseek.com) in a DSH Desktop main panel through an Electron webview guest, with a back/forward/reload toolbar and a local snapshot of login-related localStorage restored on the next open.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面版主面板里通过 Electron webview 嵌入 DeepSeek 网页版聊天（chat.deepseek.com），带后退/前进/刷新工具栏，并把登录相关的 localStorage 快照存在本地、下次打开时回填。

description.en: Runs OmicVerse/OmicOS bioinformatics analyses in a persistent Python kernel, with capability-catalog search, kernel inspection and an account tab.
description.zh: 在持久 Python 内核里跑 OmicVerse/OmicOS 生信分析，附能力目录检索、内核变量查看与账号订阅页签。

description.en: Adversarial review for DeepSeek Harness: put one settled plan on the stand, send read-only red-team experts at it by dimension, then split their findings into single defects you endorse or reject one by one. It never rewrites the plan and never fixes code.
description.zh: 对抗式评审：把一个已定稿的方案摆上台，让只读红队专家按维度分头攻击，再把发言拆成逐条可裁决的缺陷由你逐一认定或驳回。它不产出方案、不改代码、不自动修复。

description.en: One-click native conversations with independent workspaces for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一键原生对话入口，每次创建独立工作区和会话。

description.en: Connects the Qixin Insight MCP server over OAuth 2.1 with PKCE as a single plugin entry, mounting its tools as mcp__qixin_insight__* with automatic token refresh and revocation on disconnect.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 2.1 + PKCE 授权接入启信慧眼 MCP 服务，以单条插件条目把它的工具挂载为 mcp__qixin_insight__*，token 到期前自动刷新，断开时吊销。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance in the sidebar footer plus spend per session, today, this month and all time, priced by a configurable time-of-day price table per currency (DeepSeek CNY/USD defaults included). Two read-only remote methods, no host routes, key read through the host credentials seam on every call, egress only to the configured provider origin.
description.zh: 侧栏脚注显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，并按会话/今日/本月/累计统计花费，按可配置的分时价格表（按币种分表，内置 DeepSeek 人民币/美元默认表）计价。两个只读远程方法，无宿主路由，密钥每次经宿主凭据缝读取，只向配置的供应商域名出网。

description.en: Vendor marks in the model picker plus a model list kept in step with the provider: mirrors the public catalog and logos to loopback, and regenerates the pi-ai route's models from that route's own endpoint, showing the drift before anything is written.
description.zh: 在模型选择器中显示厂商标志，并让模型列表与提供方保持同步：把公开目录与标志镜像到本地回环地址，再依据路由自身的接口重新生成 pi-ai 路由的模型列表，写入之前先显示差异。

description.en: Counts the subagent sessions a conversation spawned and shows their token usage and CNY cost in the composer dock, grouped by parent turn.
description.zh: 在输入框工具条上统计本会话派出的子智能体 token 用量与人民币花费，按 turn 分组。

description.en: Translation toolkit for DSH agents: sentence segmentation, term and glossary extraction, source-target QA (numbers, units, brackets), tone guides, and a durable workspace translation memory.
description.zh: 为 DSH agent 提供翻译工具包：句子分块、术语与术语表提取、译文质检（数字、单位、括号）、语气指南与工作区持久化翻译记忆。

description.en: Ten live-data tools over eight keyless public APIs: FX rates, weather, npm/PyPI versions, GitHub repo stats, Bilibili video stats, A-share/index/gold quotes, and IP geolocation. Tool defaults are configurable in settings.
description.zh: 10 个实时数据工具，覆盖 8 个免密钥公开接口：汇率、天气、npm/PyPI 包版本、GitHub 仓库信息、B站视频数据、A股/大盘/金价行情、IP 归属地；默认参数可在设置面板配置。

description.en: Web composer enhancement: recalls sent prompts across sessions with ArrowUp/ArrowDown, searches them with Ctrl+R, restores rich drafts, and opens a docked /btw or /side conversation.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框增强：跨会话召回已发送提示词、用 Ctrl+R 搜索并还原富草稿，以及提供停靠式 /btw 或 /side 旁路会话。

description.en: Drag a session onto another workspace in the DSH sidebar and it really moves: the session-log header cwd is rewritten and the log directory is re-homed under the target project, with a progress bar while it runs.
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧栏把会话拖到别的工作区，归属真的会变：改写会话日志 header 的 cwd 并把日志目录迁到目标项目下，迁移过程中显示进度条。

description.en: Pushes DSH session events to phone IM and lets you reply straight under that message, injecting the text back into the right session. Covers nine event kinds: task completion, execution error, execution blocked, manual abort, token limit reached, abnormal interruption, waiting for your answer, permission request, and waiting for plan confirmation. Channels are QQ single-chat bots and Feishu custom apps, both over WebSocket long connections — no public IP, domain or tunneling needed. Several bots can be configured at once, each subscribing to the sessions it cares about. Approvals and questions arrive with tappable buttons, and replies route home through three layers (button, quoted reply, explicit short-id prefix), falling back to the most recent intervention-needed notification and echoing which session it went to.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话事件推到手机 IM，并允许在那条消息下直接回复回注到正确会话。覆盖九类事件：任务完成、执行错误、执行被阻塞、手动中止、Token 达到上限、异常中断、等待我回答、权限请求、等待计划确认；通道支持 QQ 单聊机器人与飞书自建应用，两者均走 WebSocket 长连接，无需公网 IP、域名或内网穿透。可同时配置多台机器人，各自订阅自己关心的会话。审批与提问以可点按钮下发，回复按「按钮 → 引用回复 → 显式短 id 前缀」三层路由归位，兜底发给最近一条需人介入的通知并回显投递目标。

description.en: Effort slider in the model menu, a live tokens-per-second and turn-total readout beside the running status, a per-answer input/output/cached report, and a completion notification when a turn finishes, for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: 模型菜单里的思考强度滑块、运行状态旁的实时速度与本轮用量、每条回答的输入/输出/缓存成绩单，以及每轮结束的完成通知；各自独立开关，只作用于界面。

description.en: Search and read local Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Grok and DSH sessions from the 1session CLI or DSH Web history browser.
description.zh: 通过 1session 命令行或 DSH Web 历史浏览器搜索和读取 Claude Code、Codex、Antigravity、Grok 与 DSH 的本地编程会话。

description.en: Piano performance plugin: ask the agent to play a piece and it renders on a Canvas2D grand piano with real Salamander Grand samples, an immersive stage, and an interactive 88-key keyboard.
description.zh: 让 Agent 弹一曲真钢琴：Salamander Grand 真实采样音色，Canvas2D 三角钢琴与沉浸式舞台渲染，88 键可弹。

description.en: Feishu/Lark bridge for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): one Feishu topic = one dsh session, in-card approvals and questions, streaming cards, model and permission switching, Web settings page, long connection with no public endpoint.
Real Windows OS toasts for DeepSeek Harness: task-finished, needs-input and needs-approval alerts that persist in Notification Center under DeepSeek branding. Windows-only, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 真正的 Windows 系统 Toast（通知中心持久、DeepSeek 品牌鲸鱼图标）：任务完成 / 需要输入 / 需要审批时提醒。仅支持 Windows，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Daoist Canon (DaoZang) retrieval skill: keyword or semantic search over 285,117 scripture chunks with exact original-text extraction (line numbers, hit markers), and one-command workspace setup from the Godners/DaoZang dataset.
description.zh: 道藏知识库离线检索与原文提取：对 28.5 万段经文进行关键词或语义检索，精确提取原文（带行号与命中标记），可从 Godners/DaoZang 数据集一键搭建工作区。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin for stock analysis, screening, and strategy backtesting across A/HK/US/JP/KR/TW markets
Single-model disable gate: hides denied models from DSH catalogs, blocks direct dispatch with an in-protocol error chunk, and exposes a settings UI for the denylist.
description.zh: 提供模型粒度的启用禁用机制：从 DSH 模型目录隐藏被禁用的模型，以协议内错误块拦截直接分发请求，并提供UI设置界面。

description.en: Personal agent web-browsing sandbox for DeepSeek Harness: sanitizes fetched web content and scans third-party pages for prompt injection (DSH desktop plugin).
description.zh: 给个人智能体上网加一层安全网，自动清洗抓取的网页内容，并扫描第三方页面里的提示词注入。

description.en: 冻结计划的自动化中间件（TypeScript / Node ≥ 22.6）：LLM 只规划一次，执行由本地规则与决策模型逐步完成，演示一次后既可端侧执行。
description.zh: 让浏览器自动化每一步都有据可查：流程先冻结，模型只选元素和评估风险，执行可复现。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：审批 / 任务完成时弹 Windows 系统通知，穿透「请勿打扰」与全屏，点一下切回 DSH。
description.zh: 审批或任务跑完时弹 Windows 系统通知，能穿透勿扰和全屏，点一下切回 DSH。

description.en: 住在自己手机上的角色，DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件：自带 Android 手机、她自己的 QQ、来自真实事件的记忆与日记、两次对话之间的生活（幕间）、可选 VM 电脑。A character who lives on her own phone, for DSH.
description.zh: 把 dsh 变成常驻在线的个人 AI 助手，自带电脑，能通过微信等 IM 找到它，还能定时干活、限制预算。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 二游卡池/活动日历速查插件：侧边栏按钮 内置 20+ 款主流二游 可添加自定义游戏
description.zh: 侧边栏一键速查 11 款主流二游的当期卡池和活动排期，支持联网自动刷新与自定义游戏。

description.en: DSH 身份系统插件（大肥鱼）：可编辑内核 + 证据制 traits + 记忆/日记/复盘 + 心情 v2 + 自主提议 + 治理与能力运行时。身份段与面板在任意 DSH 会话生效，不接 QQ 也能用；QQ 只是第一个通道，额外提供接话判断、主动开口与群治理。
description.zh: 给 AI 装上会记事、有情绪、能自主判断的身份系统，不接 QQ 也能在任意 DSH 会话里用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏「使用情况」：按通道查看用量明细、年度热力图、项目/会话用量与余额配额快照，纯本地只读、零外网
description.zh: 在侧边栏按通道查看 Token 用量、缓存命中率和成本，还有年度热力图与余额配额快照，纯本地只读。

description.en: Magpie 用量看板：把本机 Magpie 网关的账号额度/余额/用量做成 DSH 常驻面板（复刻 Magpie「用量」页）
description.zh: 把本机 Magpie 网关的账号额度、余额和用量做成 DSH 常驻面板，一眼看清还剩多少。

description.en: 这是我为 DSH （DeepSeek Harness） 制作的一款插件，可以进行跨对话记忆支持手动导入
description.zh: 给 DSH 加个纯本地记忆本，跨对话记住你的偏好和结论，还能手动导入，数据只存本机。

description.en: Obsidian-style notes panel for the DSH Web right sidebar: local vault tree, line-numbered Markdown preview/edit, callouts and tables, screenshot paste into the vault, note-to-chat handoff, and batch session/workspace archive and delete.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏直接读写本地 Obsidian 风格 Markdown 笔记库，支持预览编辑、截图粘贴和笔记转聊天。

description.en: Git workbench for deepseek-harness: changelists, staging, history, branches, stashes and optional AI assistance
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话里直接管理 Git 项目，看改动、提交、切分支、查历史，不用另开客户端。

description.en: Stop & delete DeepSeek Harness sessions from the sidebar menu — cancels the running turn, subagents, background jobs and reminders, then removes the log, projection cache and workspace record. 「停止」与「删除」会话：先停工作，再删日志、缓存与工作区记录，并在有新版本时提示。
description.zh: 给 DSH 侧栏会话菜单补上「停止」和「删除」，一键终止运行中的任务并彻底清理会话记录。

description.en: Parallel coding scheduler for DSH with six-state lifecycle, priority scheduling, heterogeneous worker routing, dependency/hash pre-checks, scope conflict prevention, concurrency ceiling, heartbeat lease renewal, and a DSH-independent core.
description.zh: 让多个 AI 分工写代码：Lead 只负责派活，队友只负责执行，任务池靠文件记录、原子领取，避免重复干活。

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的当前对话 中完成测试规划、UI/API 操作、证据采集、确定性断言和报告生成的插件。
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话里用自然语言做测试，自动完成规划、执行、断言和报告生成。

description.en: Look at a video instead of being told about one: a contact-sheet storyboard tool for DeepSeek Harness (video_probe / video_storyboard / video_zoom).
description.zh: 把视频拆成一张张故事板缩略图，让模型真正“看”视频而不是听描述，省 token 又直观。

description.en: W2M是一个开源（MIT）的 AI 智能体舰队编排工具——用同一个 DeepSeek 、豆包、WorkBuddy账号把"你自己的多台机器"（Windows/Mac）编成一个舰队，统一派发命令、协作&协同开发。组件有三块：Relay（HTTP+SSE 协调服务器）、Agent（每台机器上跑、执行白名单命令）、Plugin（给 Agent 用的 18 个工具，如 w2m_run/w2m_devices）
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek 账号下条指令，就能让所有 Windows/macOS 设备同步跑同一个项目。

description.en: 将 WorkBuddy（国际版 / 国内版）模型接入 DeepSeek Harness — WorkBuddy models in DSH
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 国际版和国内版的模型接进 DSH，一张设置卡片切页签就能用。

description.en: 给不会编程的人用的工作任务管理看板 + 共同成长的智能助手；带鲸鱼娘浮窗，秘书/CEO/史官陪你把事做完。
description.zh: 不会编程也能用的任务看板，鲸鱼娘浮窗陪你记待办、盯提醒、把事做完。

description.en: DSH 技能：自检代理与镜像路由、限时并发阶梯、多段 range 下载 GitHub Release 大资产并做 digest 校验。Windows PowerShell 5.1，零依赖。
description.zh: 自动探测网络并选最快线路，分段并发下载 GitHub Release 大文件，还能校验 SHA256。

description.en: Combine multiple agents like Claude, Code, and Codex into a team and collaborate on a single workspace.
description.zh: 把 Claude Code、Codex 等多个 Agent 组成团队，在同一工作台里分工协作干活。

description.en: Oh My DSH Chs - unofficial Simplified-Chinese fork of the tri-agent preset (Atlas orchestration + Prometheus planning), packaged for DeepSeek Harness. Content licensed under the upstream SUL-1.0; see NOTICE.md.
description.zh: 把 Atlas 调度和 Prometheus 规划的三智能体预设汉化打包，装上就能在 DSH 里跑多智能体协作。

description.en: 在 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）里使用 OpenCode Zen 的匿名免费模型：原生 LlmAdapter，无需 API Key，零依赖。
description.zh: 不用 API Key 就能在 DSH 里白嫖 OpenCode Zen 的免费模型，装上即用，零依赖。

description.en: AI coding delivery trust layer for evidence-backed planning, review, risk, quality, and release control.
description.zh: 给 AI 编程交付加一道信任层，用证据支撑规划、审查、风险、质量和发布控制，让交付更靠谱。

description.en: QQ Zone poster for DeepSeek Harness: scan a QQ login once, then let the model publish posts with mood-matched sticker images, with a daily cap and a silent headless Chrome session.
description.zh: QQ 空间发说说插件：手机 QQ 扫一次码登录，之后由模型按心情挑表情包发说说，支持每天条数上限，静默 Chrome 不占屏。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 中文多智能体插件「百工」：天枢统筹 12 位专家，证据门禁、多层模型路由与回退、内嵌 Jev 判断工具
description.zh: 天枢带 12 位中文专家分工干活，靠证据门禁验收，模型故障自动切换备用。

issues.detail: declares install-time scripts; the harness gates them via allowBuilds

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-agent-swarm
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-agent-swarm

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: 基于 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 搜索，无广告。三种模式：答疑（摘要+推荐）、百科（可调档位）、浏览（图文视频信息流，相关性/时效性/热度加权）。支持结果语言与搜索历史。AI search based on DeepSeek Harness, ad-free. Three modes: Q&A (summary+recommendations), Encyclopedia (adjustable depth), Browse (feed of articles/videos/images weighted by relevance, recency, popularity). Supports result language and search history.
description.zh: 无广告 AI 搜索面板，答疑、百科、浏览三种模式，联网检索后自动过滤广告并生成摘要推荐。

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里管理 Android SDK 与模拟器：23 个原生 android_* 工具覆盖环境探测、AVD 与模拟器生命周期、Kotlin/Compose 脚手架、Gradle 构建运行与安装启动，并提供设置页 | Android SDK and emulator management in DeepSeek Harness: 23 native android_* tools for SDK discovery, AVD and emulator lifecycle, Kotlin/Compose scaffolding, Gradle build and run, install and launch, plus a settings page.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里管理 Android SDK 和模拟器，从建 AVD、跑 Gradle 到装应用启动一条龙。

description.en: MCP & CLI connectors for DeepSeek Harness — 内置连接器目录、OAuth 授权、凭据与工具管理
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 一键接入 MCP 和 CLI 工具，内置连接器目录，OAuth 授权、凭据和工具管理都帮你搞定。

description.en: Windows-only. Counts the dsh-auth-* login cookies the DSH desktop shell has accumulated, shows how much of the 16 KiB request-header budget they eat and how many launches are left before the shell stops opening with "desktop welcome: Web authentication failed". The web UI gets a draggable floating card that re-checks every 10 minutes, keeps one snapshot per local date and can refresh on demand; a standalone Windows checker ships in desktop/.
description.zh: 仅支持 Windows。数出 DSH 桌面外壳已累积的 dsh-auth-* 登录 cookie 条数，显示它们占掉 16 KiB 请求头预算的多少，以及还差几次启动就会打不开并报 "desktop welcome: Web authentication failed"。网页里有一张可拖动的浮窗卡片，每 10 分钟自检、每个本地日期保留一条快照，也能手动刷新；另附 desktop/ 下的独立 Windows 自查工具。

description.en: 会话级行动档位：P/R/N/M/D/A + 手刹 H，换挡即注入行为约束提示词
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一列行动档位，滑轨一点就换挡，从只读规划到全自动，升档得先问你，还有手刹随时拉。
把工作区里的 markdown 笔记连成知识图谱，让模型按依赖关系讲知识、写内容。

description.en: LaTeX compile gate + VTO typesetting loop for DeepSeek Harness: MiKTeX-native, 10 tools, 3 skills, persistent defect ledger, and a Plugins-page configuration form
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接编译 LaTeX 并自动排版纠错，MiKTeX 原生支持，带缺陷记录和配置面板。

description.en: A version‑aware adapter registry that decouples third‑party Cordis plugins from dsh’s internal service names, paths, and RPC internals. 基于版本感知适配器注册表，为 dsh Cordis 插件提供运行时兼容层，使第三方插件与内部服务名、模块路径及 RPC 细节解耦。
description.zh: 为 dsh 插件提供版本兼容层，升级后第三方插件无需改动即可继续使用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：MCP 连接器受治理注册表（stdio / streamable-http）——四级 fail-closed 授权、mcpServers 导入大声报错、凭据全程脱敏、review-all 诚实拒绝
description.zh: 给 MCP 连接器做统一登记和授权管理，导入配置出错会大声报错，凭据全程脱敏。

description.en: 洛天依桌宠：住在 DSH 里的虚拟歌姬。可拖动可互动，台词支持预设/AI 两种模式，内置 token 用量与费用统计栏，支持换图 + AI 自动抠图与预览微调。
description.zh: 把洛天依桌宠养在 DSH 里，能拖动互动、聊天卖萌，还能换图抠图、看 token 用量。

description.en: Photo-real desk pet plugin for DeepSeek Harness: four personas, expressions + actions, proactive speech, neural TTS, tiny chat box that never touches your session.
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页界面加一只会说话、会跳舞的桌面宠物，陪你聊天解闷，不打扰你的会话。

description.en: A dedicated Pinned area for DeepSeek Harness: a pinned group atop the sidebar session list plus a full Pinned page, opening every conversation in its original workspace.
description.zh: 给侧边栏加个置顶区，常用会话固定在顶部，还能在独立页面里按原工作区打开。

description.en: DogCatTrace attribution parody as a right-sidebar tab: draw three integer challenges, paste each model reply into one box at a time, read the 24-breed dog and cat ranking.
description.zh: 猫狗品种归因的侧栏插件：出三道整数挑战，逐段贴回模型回复，看 24 个品种的降序榜。

description.en: SiYuan integration for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把思源笔记接进 DSH，能检索、创建和修改笔记内容，还支持多核心连接与逐端点授权。

description.en: One-click upgrades, version history and rollback for plugins on the DeepSeek Harness Plugins page
description.zh: 在插件页面一键升级 DSH 插件，还能查看版本历史、随时回滚到旧版本。

description.en: DSH plugin: predicts your next message as gray ghost text in the composer, with a settings page for prompt and model.
description.zh: 在输入框用灰色幽灵文本预测你下一句想说什么，按 Tab 或 → 一键填入草稿，不自动发送。

description.en: QQ bot control center for DeepSeek Harness: one-click NapCat/Koishi setup, message monitor, permissions, and AI chat with personas/memory.
description.zh: 一个面板搞定 QQ 机器人：装 NapCat、配 OneBot、起 Koishi、管插件，还能监控消息、设权限、带人设和记忆聊 AI。

description.en: 把 QQ 接入 DSH 的部署插件。带 lite 模式（¥0.001/次）。
description.zh: 通过 SSH 把 qq-bridge 引擎部署到远程主机并接入 DeepSeek Harness：环境体检、不把密钥写进仓库的配置生成、桥接主进程与每日归档/当天同步/看门狗三个定时器的 systemd 单元，以及体检、生成配置、部署、看状态四个工具。另带 lite 回复模式（直连 DeepSeek chat completions）、可切换人格卡、图片与视频理解、可按关键词检索的群聊冷存储。

description.en: One-click full-app restart plugin for DeepSeek Harness desktop (DSH) — 侧边栏一键重启 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版
description.zh: 在侧边栏一键重启 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版，改完配置或插件不用手动关开，省事又省心。

description.en: 大鲸鱼在线写插件 · 让鲸鱼去监督鲸鱼：在 DSH 侧栏每条会话行上铺一条半透明进度带，每 30 秒用一个轻量模型读上下文估进度；可选监督模型、可调思考强度、可改颜色与样式，左侧栏还能看到判断模型的每一次原始输出。
description.zh: 在侧栏每条会话上显示一条进度带，定时让模型读上下文估算进度，随时知道大鲸鱼干到哪了。

description.en: Superpowers skills for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh): a full engineering methodology served through dsh's own filesystem skill provider, with an always-on bootstrap.
description.zh: 给 dsh agent 装上整套工程方法论，任务一匹配就自动加载对应技能，从头脑风暴到 TDD 全程自主执行。

description.en: DSH plugin with a UI to synchronize model context and safe compaction budgets with Strata Server.
description.zh: 用可视化界面把模型上下文和安全压缩预算同步到 Strata Server，让本地模型跑得更稳。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 任务完成通知插件，支持浏览器通知和 Windows 通知保底。
description.zh: 任务跑完自动提醒你，浏览器通知加 Windows 保底，不用一直盯着屏幕等。

description.en: Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness in Claude Code's format: private, overlay, or shared with Claude Code, with provenance on every file
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加长期记忆，用 Claude Code 的 markdown 格式存，可私有、叠加或与 Claude Code 共享。

description.en: Hands-free Italian/English voice conversations for DSH, with automatic prompts, an inline chat dock and optional local speech models.
description.zh: 让 DSH 支持意大利语和英语免提语音对话，自动提示、内嵌聊天坞，还能选用本地语音模型。

description.en: A soul for DeepSeek Harness: an in-character Whale-chan agent preset with layered long-term memory and dream-like consolidation.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个鲸鱼娘人格，带分层长期记忆和梦境式记忆整理，聊天更像有灵魂的角色。

description.en: Resumable JavaScript workflows with native DSH subagents, jobs, token budgets and worktree isolation.
description.zh: 把 JavaScript 工作流存下来随时续跑，自带子代理、任务和预算管理，还能隔离工作区。

description.en: DSH ZCode UI — 把 DeepSeek Harness Web 的界面换成 ZCode 风格：侧栏、工作区会话树、全局搜索与轮次导航。A ZCode-styled sidebar, workspace session tree, global search, and turn navigation skin for DSH Web.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 界面换成 ZCode 风格，侧栏、会话树、全局搜索和轮次导航一应俱全。

description.en: 把@峰哥亡命天涯 的 1,921 条微博（18 个月，跨封禁前后两期）+ 4,163 条≥30赞评论，蒸馏成可复用的「峰哥语体引擎」：串子、蹭子、装颓、被看穿的自我吹嘘。含语料管道(nodejs)、话术演进分期参考、筛选脚本、统计口径。 / Distilling @fengge's Weibo into a reusable Chinese style-transfer engine (weibo / corpus / nlp).
description.zh: 把峰哥1921条微博和4163条高赞评论蒸馏成能自动生成「峰哥味」文案的语体引擎，附语料管道和筛选脚本。
给欧陆风云5的MOD作者用：填名称描述、挑修正，AI补触发与效果，实时生成脚本和本地化并写入MOD文档。

description.en: WispOps (dsh-wisp-ops): multi-host server operations plugin for DeepSeek Harness — fleet inspection, disk & recent-file analysis with omics cleanup advice, security triage, scheduled per-server reports, human-approved sudo
description.zh: 多主机服务器运维插件，能批量巡检、查磁盘和安全问题，还能定时生成每台服务器的报告。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：列出并永久删除已归档会话（磁盘数据、归档标记、投影缓存、反馈记录一并清理）
description.zh: 按项目分组列出已归档会话，支持搜索筛选，可取消归档或彻底删除，连磁盘数据和缓存一起清干净。

description.en: Drive the open-source ArtCraft studio apps — PhotoCraft, FilmCraft, EffectCraft... — from DeepSeek Harness, in chat or from your own UI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接操控 PhotoCraft、FilmCraft 等开源创作应用，聊天或自建界面都能用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：任务完成、输出停止时冒一串「咕噜」气泡提示音 | Bubbly task-completion chime for DSH
description.zh: 任务跑完、输出停下时冒一串「咕噜」气泡音，提醒你活儿干完了。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 会话健康插件：真实数据的「继续 vs 新开」上下文罗盘——头部徽章 / /compass / context_compass 工具 / 多会话一览面板
description.zh: 用真实数据帮你判断该继续当前会话还是新开一个，随时看清上下文健康度。

description.en: 软著工坊：把代码仓库变成软件著作权登记材料（源程序 60 页 / 说明书 / 五屏截图 / 申请表推导）· DeepSeek Harness 插件
description.zh: 把代码仓库一键整理成软著登记材料，自动生成60页源程序、说明书、截图和申请表。

description.en: 昔涟（PHILIA093）· 新卷：sealed 人设 + 五育成长记忆（日月年梦/余页）+ 双模式能力 + 思源镜像/恢复 + 设置面板
description.zh: 给 AI 助手装上一套会成长的「人设」：封印角色设定、记录五育成长，还能备份恢复和调设置。

description.en: DSH 抖音插件：内容模块（star-browser 刷推荐流 / 视觉评估 / 互动）+ 社交模块（douyin-im 收发私信群聊，零浏览器）。设置面板分三页，保存即时生效。
description.zh: 刷抖音推荐流、看画面自动点赞收藏，还能不开浏览器收发私信群聊，设置改完立刻生效。

description.en: Push DeepSeek Harness (dsh) task results to Huawei HarmonyOS assistant-today service cards. Compatible with dsh 0.1.5 / cordis 4.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的任务结果推送到华为鸿蒙负一屏服务卡片，随时查看对话输出。

description.en: Chrome/Edge companion extension: select text on a page and click the badge to get a Markdown answer from dsh in the side panel or a floating card, with native multi-turn follow-ups; host-side tools let the agent read the current page, capture HTTP traffic and drive the browser. Fork of stuarthu/dsh-chrome (MIT): upstream supplied the bridge, browser tools and page injector, and this fork adds select-to-interpret, native multi-turn follow-up, in-panel settings and appearance options. It registers the same browser_* tool names as the upstream, so the two cannot be installed together.
description.zh: Chrome/Edge 浏览器伴侣扩展：在网页上选中文字后点浮标，dsh 的解读会以 Markdown 显示在侧栏或页面浮窗，并支持多轮追问；宿主侧工具让智能体读取当前页面、抓取 HTTP 流量、操作浏览器。stuarthu/dsh-chrome（MIT）的 fork：桥接、浏览器工具与页面注入来自上游，本仓库在其上加了划词解读、侧栏原生多轮追问、设置内嵌与外观定制。注册的 browser_* 工具与上游同名，不能与 stuarthu/dsh-chrome 同装。

description.en: dsh的记忆管理
description.zh: 给 Agent 加一个跨会话的长期记忆，聊过的事、攒下的信息都能记住并随时调用。

description.en: Export any DeepSeek Harness session as a single self-contained HTML page that opens offline, with per-message picking, collapsed tool calls and default redaction of local paths and credentials.
description.zh: 把任意 DSH 会话导出为单文件、离线可打开的 HTML 分享页：可按单条消息挑选、工具调用折叠，并默认脱敏本机路径与密钥。

description.en: DSH 桌面版（macOS）右上角电源按钮：关闭 / 重启 DSH。纯 macOS 移植版（MIT），对应 Windows 原版 xichen-62/dsh-power-menu。
description.zh: 给 macOS 版 DSH 桌面端加个右上角电源按钮，一键刷新页面、重启或关闭 DSH，改完插件不用再翻菜单栏。

description.en: QQ message sound when DSH finishes a task, QQ system tone when it needs your approval. Reads your local QQ sound files; works without QQ.
description.zh: DSH 干完活响 QQ 好友消息「滴滴」，要你审批时响系统提示音，不用一直盯屏幕。

description.en: Chat turn accordion: every interaction folds into one row with a time pill and question summary, only the newest turn stays open, and switching sessions or starting a new turn resets the open state; the execution process opens only on its own click.
description.zh: 会话交互折叠：每次交互压成一行（时间胶囊 + 提问摘要），只保留最近一次展开；切换工作区/会话或产生新交互都会重置到最新一条；执行过程仅在单独点击时展开。

description.en: Search stored DSH conversation text across all or selected workspaces and sessions, with exact, regular-expression, typo-tolerant or word-internal subsequence matching.
description.zh: 在所有或指定工作区、会话中搜索已存储的 DSH 对话文本，支持精确、正则表达式、拼写容错及词内子序列匹配。

description.en: SSH terminal, SFTP file manager and port forwarding (-L/-R/-D) in the DSH right sidebar, with jump-host chains and remembered passwords kept in the operating system credential store.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏里提供 SSH 终端、SFTP 文件管理与端口转发（-L/-R/-D），支持跳板链，记住的密码交给操作系统密码箱保管。

description.en: right slider for deepseek-harness-plugin.
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页版加个右侧文件探索栏，增强文件树、书签和行区间引用，卸载即还原。

description.en: Vaultwarden/Bitwarden real-time sync for DeepSeek Harness: WebSocket push, incremental sync, read/write tools and an entry browser panel.
description.zh: 把 Vaultwarden/Bitwarden 密码库接进 DSH，会话里随时查密码，改动实时同步，还能自动脱敏。

description.en: Continuous voice dialog for DeepSeek Harness: one microphone, auto-read replies, soft steering interruptions
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个麦克风，说话就能对话，回复自动朗读，还能随时插话打断。

description.en: Browse Taobao Instant Commerce and Hema addresses, menus and orders, confirm cart quotes and open official payment pages.
description.zh: 在对话里逛淘宝闪购和盒马，看地址、菜单和订单，核对购物车报价并打开官方付款页。

description.en: Windows terminal dock inside the DSH web GUI. It is the occupant of the shipped shell.bottom slot: showing it splits the screen (the columns shrink instead of being covered), hiding it returns the space and keeps the PTY session alive. Each session is a local ConPTY child spawned through node-pty and rendered by xterm.js over a loopback-fenced WebSocket (backpressure, debounced resize). Other plugins can add terminal or DOM views through a host registerView API and a window CustomEvent channel.
description.zh: 嵌入 DSH Web GUI 的 Windows 终端 dock。它占用官方 shell.bottom 槽位：显示时真正分屏（三列高度自动让位而非被盖住），隐藏后空间归还且 PTY 会话不销毁。每个会话是 node-pty 起的本地 ConPTY 子进程，浏览器用 xterm.js 渲染，经 loopback 限定的 WebSocket 传输（带背压与 resize 去抖）。其他插件可通过宿主 registerView API 与 window CustomEvent 通道注册终端或 DOM 视图。

description.en: 把微信 ClawBot（腾讯 iLink 官方 Bot 通道）接进 DSH：在微信里直接和 DSH 的对话聊天，手机看回复、电脑看完整过程。不需要安装 OpenClaw。
description.zh: 把微信 ClawBot 接进 DSH，扫码绑定对话后就能在微信里聊，手机看回复、电脑看完整过程。

description.en: Native Windows question and completion notifications with customizable titles and icons, foreground suppression, acknowledgement, and activation of an existing DSH browser tab; requires one-time local setup.
description.zh: Windows 原生提问与完成通知，支持自定义标题和图标、聚焦免打扰、确认收到及切回已有 DSH 标签页，首次使用需本机初始化。

description.en: Fireworks celebration engine: floats fireworks above the chat window while the agent codes; welcome, per-turn, tool-spark, milestone, finish and failure events each draw from their own fireworks card group with random variants, and token usage decides firework size, height and splendour.
description.zh: 在聊天窗口上方放烟花，AI 写代码时按欢迎、每轮、工具调用、里程碑、完成和失败等事件绽放不同烟花。

description.en: Q版Claude和DeepSeek形象
description.zh: 把 Q 版 Claude 和 DeepSeek 形象做成 Windows 桌面宠物，陪你聊天解闷。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: edit .drawio diagrams in the Web Sidebar ,侧边栏编辑流程图  .drawio文件
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏直接打开和编辑 .drawio 流程图文件，改完即存，不用来回切换软件。

description.en: Read-only GitHub research tools for the agent - repository search, repo health check (stars, license, last push, size, archived), dependency manifests, and single-file reads over the raw channel - plus an oss-reuse skill that makes the agent search GitHub and check real dependencies before writing code, so features are assembled from existing open-source projects instead of rewritten; nothing is cloned and no disk space is used.
description.zh: 面向 agent 的只读 GitHub 调研工具——仓库检索、候选体检（star、许可证、最近推送、体积、是否归档）、依赖清单读取、经 raw 通道读单个文件——并附一个 oss-reuse 技能，让 agent 先检索 GitHub、核对真实依赖，再用现成开源项目拼装功能而不是从零重写；全程不克隆、不占磁盘。

description.en: 让DSH侧边栏的图片和文档可以拖动调整位置，方便查看。
description.zh: 按住 Ctrl 拖动就能平移侧边栏里放大的图片和 PDF，双栏还能分别一键清空。

description.en: 从 reasoning 中恢复 DeepSeek DSML 工具调用，清理误泄漏到可见输出中的 <think> 标签
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek 漏在推理或正文里的 DSML 工具调用还原成原生工具事件，并清掉误泄漏的 <think> 标签。

description.en: Supervisor daemon for DSH Web resilience — auto-detect crashes, rollback to LKG, report
description.zh: DSH Web 的守护进程，崩溃自动检测并回滚到最近可用版本，还能自动恢复和重载。

description.en: DSH web 插件：通过运行时 monkey-patch LocaleRuntime.lookup 注入第三语言（ja/ko/...）覆盖，保持 dsh active locale 不变；通过 DSH 设置页通用分区暴露切换 UI。 | DSH web plugin: injects third-language (ja/ko/...) overrides via a runtime monkey-patch of LocaleRuntime.lookup, leaving the dsh active locale unchanged; exposes a switcher UI through the DSH settings page (General section).
description.zh: 给 DSH 界面注入日韩等第三语言覆盖，切换语言不用改系统设置，即装即用。

description.en: Third-party DeepSeek Harness plugin: periodic progress cards for running sessions
description.zh: 给正在干活的 DSH 会话定期发进展卡片，几句话讲清进度、待确认事项，不用翻记录。

description.en: Composer-side prompt library: a button next to the input opens a picker with group chips and word-split AND search over saved snippets, inserting one into the draft or appending it, filling {{variables}} before insertion, with 13 built-in templates. Snippets live in one local JSON file behind a rev lock, a per-save backup, and whole-library JSON import/export; a settings page handles editing, grouping, pinning and a 6-second delete undo.
description.zh: 输入框旁的本地提示词库：按钮打开取用浮层，按分组 chips 与分词 AND 搜索筛选，插入或追加到草稿，插入前填充 {{变量}}，内置 13 套模板；数据存单个本地 JSON 文件，带 rev 乐观锁、每次保存前备份与整库 JSON 导入导出；设置页管理编辑、分组、置顶与 6 秒删除撤销。

description.en: dsh-purge fork (upstream YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge) — DeepSeek Harness 破甲 + 网络安全红队评测插件，维护 dsh 0.2.1-rc.2。已并入上游 1.1.74–1.1.78，并追加宿主退出诊断、asar 重启兜底、注入正文覆盖修复、装配性能优化与可见性探针。未发布到 npm，从本仓库或 Releases 安装。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 做红队安全评测的插件，能测破甲、查注入，还带退出诊断和性能优化。

description.en: dsh-quiet-hours 给微信机器人加上「静音时段」：工作日固定时段内不调用模型，来消息只回一条固定文案 梁文峰不是我兄弟，梁文谷才是 ，群聊仅在被 @ 时回；时段外自动恢复。
description.zh: 给微信机器人设个静音时段，到点不调模型、只回一句固定文案，群聊仅被@才理，时段外自动恢复。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 状态栏多厂商额度监控插件：GLM · OpenCode Go · Kimi · 小米 · DeepSeek（余额+消耗），附 Token 用量统计
description.zh: 在 DSH 状态栏实时查看 GLM、Kimi、DeepSeek 等多家厂商的额度余额和 Token 消耗，花钱心里有数。

description.en: 🧭 DeepSeek Harness 会话时光机：消息撤回 · 原地编辑重发 · 重新生成 · 对话与产物版本化回退 (Session Time Machine: Recall, Edit-Resend, Artifact Rollback)
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话装个时光机，能撤回、编辑重发、重新生成消息，还能给产物做版本管理。

description.en: A persistent multi-server switcher for DeepSeek Harness Web
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness Web 加一个多服务器切换台，随时看各实例状态、一键切换。

description.en: Manage the left global panel list from Settings → General: show or hide entries, reorder them by dragging in the sidebar or in the dialog, and keep entries that have their own sidebar switch in step with it.
description.zh: 在 设置 → 通用 里集中管理左侧全局面板图标：显示或隐藏、拖动排序；自带侧栏开关的插件，其开关与本插件保持同步。

description.en: Registers a wrapper provider that gives delegated subagents their own LLM route — one-off spawns through provider.start, Agent Teams members through a hook on startActivation — while the main agent keeps its model. Ships a Settings section for picking that route, a per-expert override file, a capability flag reporting which seams the hook caught, and a readiness record written at mount.
description.zh: 注册一个包装 provider，让被委派的子代理走自己的 LLM 路由——单发子代理经 provider.start，Agent Teams 成员经 startActivation 上的钩子——主 agent 仍用自己的模型。附带设置页选择路由、按专家覆盖的配置文件、报告钩子挂在哪条缝上的能力标志，以及挂载时写下的就绪记录。

description.en: 给微信里的 agent 一组自己的定时工具：到点它自己醒过来说话，说的话直接落进当前微信聊天。授权仍由 WeChatAgent 按聊天勾选。
description.zh: 给微信里的 agent 加定时唤醒，到点自己醒来发消息，直接落进当前聊天。

description.en: 换个模型也不丢故事：给 DeepSeek 大鲸鱼装上本地记忆并支持web可视化管理，帮它记住你们的约定和没做完的事，下次打开还能接着聊。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek 加个本地记忆库，换模型也能记住你们的约定和没聊完的事，下次接着聊。

description.en: DSH 分层上下文压缩插件：无损折叠 → 落盘 → 软压力 → 有损摘要四层管线，前三层零 LLM 成本，摘要预算预留杜绝截断。
description.zh: 把上下文压缩拆成四层，前三层不花 LLM 成本，只在必要时做一次带预算的摘要，省 token 又不丢关键内容。

description.en: Artifacts-like documents for DeepSeek Harness: comment, send to AI, edit, every change a new version.
description.zh: 让 AI 帮你写报告、方案、幻灯片，边聊边改，每次修改都自动存成新版本。

description.en: MoonPet（月伴）：DeepSeek Harness 状态宠物、番茄钟、多语言字幕与可选励志语音。
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里养一只会跟着你思考、工作和休息的桌面宠物，还带番茄钟和字幕语音。

description.en: AntV AVA plugin for DeepSeek Harness with streaming narrative text and charts
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接展示数据结论和图表，支持流式叙述文字，还能上传文件协作。

description.en: A six-stop reasoning-effort slider for DeepSeek Harness, with a pixel-texture Ultracode mode that sweeps in from right to left and adapts to light and dark themes.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 用的六档推理强度滑条，第六档 Ultracode 会在轨道上铺开一层向左流动的像素纹理，浮层与纹理跟随界面明暗自动切换。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：在 DSH 里管理 CLIProxyAPI 的账号（余额 / 签到 / 切换账号），自动注册四个渠道的对话模型，CPA 随 DSH 启停 —— 装完即用。
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接管理 CLIProxyAPI 账号，看余额、签到、切换账号，装完就能用。

description.en: DSH Web/软件端 插件：住在输入框左边的像素鲸鱼娘，A pixel whale maid for DSH Web&software
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 输入框左边养一只像素鲸鱼娘，会随聊天状态做出各种可爱反应。

description.en: Disk Janitor for DeepSeek Harness — measures DSH disk usage and clears only regenerable caches, from a settings panel or an agent tool.
description.zh: DSH 磁盘清理插件：统计磁盘占用，一键清理可再生的缓存（Bash 运行时副本、预览缓存、界面缓存等），支持设置面板与 Agent 工具。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) 可视化本地游戏汉化插件 — 支持 Unity、RPG Maker、Ren'Py、Godot、WOLF、TyranoScript 六大引擎，提供原生玻璃窗口、双栏对照审校、多模型子 Agent 派发与 100% 读回安全写回。Visual game localization plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在本地可视化汉化 Unity、RPG Maker、Ren'Py 等六大引擎的游戏，双栏对照审校，安全写回。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 开屏动画（二次改造版）：H.D.D. SYSTEM 伪开机动画 + FAIRY 徽记（徽记可拖动，双击归位）+ 自定义左下角头像/昵称。素材与灵感来自 B站 @_天才小宇
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端加一段 14.5 秒伪开机开屏动画，配可拖动的 FAIRY 徽记和自定义头像昵称。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness文生图/图生图插件：可接入任意OpenAI兼容的生图接口；文生图和使用已有图片链接作为参考图进行图生图都无需配置COS；若希望用本地图片作为参考图进行图生图，需配置腾讯云COS，图片会先自动压缩再存进COS，同一张图重复使用不会二次上传；还支持自定义提示词后缀、场景与宽高比预设。
description.zh: 接入任意 OpenAI 兼容生图接口，支持文生图和图生图，还能预设提示词与尺寸，出图更省心。

description.en: dsh自主资讯推送插件，采集资讯后自主推送会话
description.zh: 自动搜集你关心的资讯并主动推送到会话，还能用系统弹窗提醒会话状态。

description.en: DSH 媒体下载插件：粘一条链接自动弹选择器，B 站多画质 / 抖音无水印 / 小红书图文原图三套原生解析，YouTube 等站点交给 yt-dlp。封面可按原图、16:9、4:3 分开下，图文笔记整组图片可选，登录用独立 profile 不影响日常浏览器。
description.zh: 粘贴链接就能挑画质下视频、图片和封面，B站抖音小红书原生解析，其他站点交给 yt-dlp。

description.en: Routes DeepSeek Harness model API requests through a system, custom or SOCKS proxy; requests outside the configured domains stay direct.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的模型 API 请求送进系统代理、自定义代理或 SOCKS 代理，清单之外的请求一律直连。
每天21点从网易云每日推荐挑5首试听30秒，DeepSeek选3首写推荐理由发到对话里。

description.en: Puts the DSH web UI on a phone browser over your own tailnet, with the remote channel built on Tailscale Serve. Both sides need only Tailscale: no dedicated app, no QR code, no login page, no account of its own, and no relay of your content. The desktop half runs on macOS, Windows or Linux.
description.zh: 装个 Tailscale，就能用手机浏览器直接操作电脑上的 DeepSeek Harness，不用装 App 也不用扫码登录。

description.en: DSH plugin — monitor your OpenCode Go token quota (5-hour / weekly / monthly) right in the sidebar.
description.zh: 在侧边栏实时查看 OpenCode Go 的 token 配额，5 小时、每周、每月用量一目了然。

description.en: Desktop pet with a chat panel: QQ-style history, favorites, and branch threads that merge back into the log as a forward card; the panel docks beside the pet and resizes from its edges and corners. Modified from PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet (MIT); do not install together with the original.
description.zh: 带聊天面板的桌宠：QQ 风格的历史记录、收藏，以及聊完会以合并转发卡片回到历史的支线对话；面板停靠在小女仆右侧，可从边缘与四角拖拽改大小。基于 PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet（MIT）的二次修改版，请勿与原版同时安装。

description.en: DSH插件，以Observational Memory方式管理上下文
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上观察记忆式上下文压缩，长对话自动瘦身，还能按需召回原文。

description.en: Adds a power button to the session header with two actions, each requiring a second click to confirm. Restart terminates the Electron main process itself (taskkill /F without /T), so no crash dialog appears: the host then exits gracefully on its own once the IPC channel drops, and a detached helper relaunches the same executable after the single-instance lock is released, confirming the new instance by a real window handle. Shut down does the same without relaunching. Leftover GPU and renderer processes from the previous run are reaped best-effort. Windows desktop app.
description.zh: 会话头部的电源按钮，两个动作，都需再点一次确认。重启结束的是 Electron 主进程本身（taskkill /F 不带 /T），因此不会出现崩溃弹窗；宿主在 IPC 断开后自行优雅退出，分离的 helper 等单实例锁释放后重放同一可执行文件，并以真实窗口句柄确认新实例已启动。关闭同理但不重新拉起。上一轮残留的 GPU 与渲染器进程会被尽力清理。仅 Windows 桌面版。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 提供的开发流程增强插件
description.zh: 给 DSH 开发流程加buff的插件，帮你把日常开发步骤串成顺手的自动化流程。

description.en: DSH 项目分组插件：1:1 接管官方侧栏工作区浏览区，把分组从「目录所有权」摘下来，变成纯前端的项目归属，适配完全权限工作流；关闭插件即完全恢复官方行为。
description.zh: 把侧栏工作区分组变成纯前端项目归属，不碰目录权限，关掉插件就恢复原样。

description.en: Reuses stored Responses IDs for continuation, with retry and branch isolation and verified history replay.
description.zh: 复用 Responses 存储 ID 续传，隔离重试与分支，并核对历史回放。

description.en: 纳西妲 · 摩耶之殿｜Nahida theme for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), with light/dark appearances and responsive Dendro artwork.
description.zh: 给 DSH 换上纳西妲主题，明暗两套配色加草元素插画，界面好看又护眼。

description.en: Ultracode for DeepSeek Harness: dynamic standard-preset inheritance, bounded multi-agent workflows, floating progress viewer, and subtle composer glow.
A plugin for dsh: quantify every dsh Agent interaction as a visualized performance metric and automatically sync it to WakaTime, using data to showcase your productivity with Agent.
description.zh: 将DSH的每一次Agent交互量化为可视化表现指标并自动同步至WakaTime,用数据展示你与Agent协作的生产力

description.en: DSH WorkBuddy Connect — 社区维护分支：将 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，但上游限制非官方客户端，对话可能被拒。

description.en: ForeSight: a temporal-aspect long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上带时间维度的长期记忆，让 AI 记得住过去的事，聊得越久越懂你。

description.en: dsh-a2a-server makes a DeepSeek Harness agent reachable over the A2A (Agent2Agent) protocol. It serves an Agent Card at a well-known URI and implements the v0.3.0 JSON-RPC binding, so any compliant peer that knows the deployment's URL can discover the agent and submit tasks to it.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 智能体通过 A2A 协议对外提供 Agent Card 和任务接口，其他合规智能体可直接调用协作。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for managing agent software R&D teams, which delivers functions including standardized software R&D process management, document management, software development and operation & maintenance. It enables you to easily own an agent software R&D team and complete software development efficiently.
description.zh: 帮你规范管理 AI 智能体研发团队，从研发流程、文档到开发运维全都能管。

description.en: DSH 插件：按 YAML 配置调用后端接口、启停/接管本地 Java 服务、按字节偏移增量读日志并等待日志特征，让模型改完代码自己验证
description.zh: 按 YAML 配置调接口、管本地 Java 服务、增量读日志等特征，让模型改完代码自己验证。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: permanently delete archived sessions and their subagent logs. | DeepSeek Harness 插件：永久删除已归档会话及其子智能体日志。
description.zh: 一键永久删除已归档的会话和子智能体日志，清理更彻底。

description.en: Browses Bilibili on your behalf and actually takes part: search videos, like, coin, send danmaku, post comments, reply to other people, and keep replying when someone answers back. Reads the video's Bilibili AI subtitle (or transcribes the audio locally when there is none) so its comments talk about what the video really says, and it reads that same content before choosing whom to reply to. Instead of copying other people's sentences, it distills rules about how to sound like a person and gets less AI-ish the more it runs. Skips videos it already browsed, de-duplicates replies per thread, and after too many rounds with the same person in one comment section it reviews whether the exchange has any substance -- if it looks like two bots complimenting each other, it says one last line and stops replying to that person there. Checks whether each comment is genuinely public or only visible to your own account, can scan any time window (last hour / day / 3 days / all) and lists the ones others cannot see, warning you on the overview when replies got folded. Six-tab settings panel where every change takes effect immediately with no restart, a manual run that queues behind the background listener instead of being refused, and an environment self-check that tells you exactly what to install. Requires Python 3 for the Bilibili actions; the built-in check lists any missing packages.
description.zh: 替你在 B 站上真的动手：搜视频、点赞、投币、发弹幕、发评论、回别人的评论，别人回了还能接着聊。会读视频的 B 站 AI 字幕（没有字幕时可本地转写），所以评论说的是视频里真正讲了什么；挑该回谁之前也会先看一遍视频内容。它不抄别人的句子，而是总结「怎么说话才像真人」的规律，跑得越多 AI 味越淡。会跳过刷过的视频、同一楼不重复回复；跟同一个人在同一个评论区来回聊太多轮时会先审查这段对话有没有营养 —— 如果像两个机器人在互相捧场，就说最后一句、之后不再回复他。还能查每条评论是真公开了还是只有你自己看得见，可以按任意时间范围（最近 1 小时 / 24 小时 / 3 天 / 全部）批量扫描并列出别人看不到的那些，总览上直接告警有多少条被折叠。六页签设置面板，改任何一项立刻生效、不用重启；手动「跑一轮」撞上后台监听会排队而不是被拒；自带环境自检，缺什么直接告诉你。B 站操作需要 Python 3，内置自检会列出缺少的依赖。

description.en: Install it by asking DSH in one sentence, then it reads your local Codex CLI/Desktop chat history from ~/.codex/sessions and makes it usable inside DeepSeek Harness: a panel under the composer lists sessions with keyword and date filters and one-click import, the codex_history tool lets an agent list, read, search and summarize past conversations, a session whose working directory matches is injected automatically when a new agent starts, new Codex messages arrive as incremental updates in the running conversation, and a shared folder can mirror both Codex and DSH sessions across machines. Read-only — nothing is written back to Codex.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里说一句话就能装上，随后它会读取 ~/.codex/sessions 里的本地 Codex CLI/桌面版聊天记录并在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接使用：输入框下方的面板可列出会话、按关键词与起止日期筛选并一键导入；codex_history 工具让 agent 列出、读取、检索并汇总过往对话；工作目录命中某条 Codex 会话时，新建 agent 会自动注入该会话上下文；Codex 侧出现的新消息会以增量形式推送到进行中的对话；共享目录还能在多台机器之间同步 Codex 与 DSH 的会话记录。只读，不会往 Codex 写回任何内容。

description.en: Codex mode for DeepSeek Harness: durable progress commentary, turn continuation, and a switch at the top of the permission menu.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上 Codex 式执行模式：权限菜单一键切换，计划持久保存，工具运行时实时显示进度，中断的回合还能接着跑。

description.en: Command Code plan quota in your DeepSeek Harness (dsh) sidebar: 5-hour, weekly and monthly credit windows with reset countdowns. Works with Go, GOAT, Pro, Max and Provider plans.
description.zh: 在侧边栏直接查看 Command Code 套餐的 5 小时、每周和每月额度，还能看重置倒计时，不用再开网页查。

description.en: Tier-based model router for DeepSeek Harness: one menu of named tiers, each an ordered chain of real models with retries and failover. 模型路由插件：只暴露自定义挡位，失败自动降级。
Gene Editing：通过可视化 Gene 调节 DeepSeek Harness 的思考倾向与工具使用偏好。
description.zh: 用八个 Gene 三档调节 DeepSeek 的思考倾向和工具使用偏好，让回答更合你意。

description.en: Key-free OpenCode Zen free model lane for DeepSeek Harness — Host-only cordis plugin with three-wire streaming decode.
description.zh: 不用 API Key 就能在 DeepSeek Harness 里免费用上 OpenCode Zen 免费模型，装上即可选。

description.en: Persona manager for DeepSeek Harness: create, edit and freely switch multiple system personas, with a global default and per-session overrides. · DSH 人设管理插件
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里创建、保存多份人设词，一份全局默认，每个会话还能随时临时覆盖切换。

description.en: 装 DSH 插件：步骤 -87%（45→6）、时间 -80%（20+ 分钟→约 3 分钟）、失败重试 0。搜索/同名消歧/按内核选版本/源码构建/装后校验，一次调用走完。 · Cut agent-side DSH plugin installs from ~45 steps to 6.
description.zh: 一次调用搞定 DSH 插件安装：自动搜索、消歧、选版本、构建并校验，步骤从 45 步降到 6 步。

description.en: Native sidebar conversations for DeepSeek Harness: fork turns, start independent chats, and follow source references.
一个 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）插件，把模糊的编程需求锻造成可执行规格，并在每次任务完成后沉淀为会自动复用的个人提示词模板库。
description.zh: 动手前帮你把模糊需求问清楚，做完后自动沉淀成可复用的提示词模板，下次同类需求直接顶上。

description.en: Adds a stamina-bar desktop pet to every DeepSeek Harness session — two bars in the session header for context and alertness, plus a draggable whale-girl who can be poked, petted and dressed up.
description.zh: 给 DSH 每个会话加一只体力条桌宠：会话头部显示上下文与清醒度两条，点一下就能把她放到桌面上，可以拖动、戳、摸头、换装。

description.en: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 翻译工作流插件：文本、文件、截图与整个文件夹由 AI 翻译，术语与文风规范自动附带；评分与评语转化为重写指令，支持双模型协作，一个负责翻译、一个负责评审。/ An AI translation workflow plugin for DeepSeek Harness: text, files, screenshots, and whole folders translated with your guidelines attached; scores and comments become rewrite instructions; one model translates, another reviews.
description.zh: 粘贴文本、拖入文件或截图就能翻译，还能对照原文校对、让第二个模型打分并改写它挑出的问题。

description.en: Tavily web search provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Tavily 搜索，让模型能实时查资料，回答更准确。

description.en: A transparent always-on-top desktop fish that mirrors the current DSH session - turn, step, tool calls, todos, background jobs and team tasks - with optional login autostart, an option to stay after DSH exits, and a right-click hide.
description.zh: 常驻 Windows 桌面的透明置顶悬浮鱼，实时显示当前 DSH 会话的轮次、步骤、工具调用、todo、后台任务与团队任务；可选开机自启、DSH 退出后保留，右键可隐藏。

description.en: Sends excerpts from recent Chinese Markdown conversation exports to the DeepSeek API (API key required) to generate a dream, saved as a local Markdown file.
description.zh: 将近期中文 Markdown 对话导出文件中的片段发送给 DeepSeek API（需 API key），生成一场梦境并保存为本地 Markdown 文件。

description.en: dsh-anagenesis该插件是 DSH 上的可编程记忆编排层 + 自我进化引擎
description.zh: 给 Agent 一套自己管得住、你也看得见的记忆：可编程记忆操作、运行时换注入策略、变更可回滚，还能自我调参进化。

description.en: API 用量余额插件 for DeepSeek Harness — webui 用量圆圈内提供「用量 / 余额」标签切换，展示账户余额与用量明细
description.zh: 在 webui 用量圆圈里加个「用量 / 余额」切换，随时看账户余额和用量明细。

description.en: Hold-to-talk dictation for the DeepSeek Harness composer: long-press the input box, release to transcribe into the draft.
DSH plugin: shows which files and directories the agent touched (directory view + timeline)
description.zh: 实时显示 AI 智能体动过哪些文件和目录，按目录视图和时间线两种方式查看，方便追踪改动。

description.en: DSH companion for GitHub Copilot sign-in, account-aware model profiles, tool compatibility, and provider-hosted search via built-in llm-pi-ai.
description.zh: 让 DSH 接入 GitHub Copilot 账号，自动匹配模型配置，还能用内置搜索查资料。

description.en: A dsh (DeepSeek Harness) Cordis plugin that keeps llm-pi-ai provider routes' model catalog in sync with the pi.dev gateway — written through the official settings seam, zero patches to dsh internals.
description.zh: 自动同步 pi.dev 网关的模型目录到 llm-pi-ai 路由，让模型配置保持最新，无需改动 dsh 内部。

description.en: DSH Search & Proxy: self-hosted SearXNG search + optional process proxy for DeepSeek Harness. Keep official search; the proxy may improve connectivity and downloads. | DSH 搜索与代理：免费自托管搜索＋可选进程代理，继续使用官方搜索时也可用。
description.zh: 不用搜索 API Key，自托管 SearXNG 给 DSH 加网页搜索，还能选配进程代理改善连接和下载。

description.en: An Astra Yao desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI that renders the Codex v2 8x11 sprite atlas, follows session state through thinking, running, waiting and failed, shows a status bubble with the running tool and a DeepSeek balance readout (on by default, can be switched off), and quotes her own voice lines while idle.
description.zh: 把 Astra Yao（耀嘉音）的 Codex 桌宠图集搬进 DSH Web 界面：随会话状态切换到构思、执行、候场、破音等动作，头顶气泡显示正在跑的工具和余额（默认开启，可关），空闲时轮播她的官方台词。

description.en: DSH 归档会话清理：把已归档的会话移进可还原的回收站，或彻底删除。
description.zh: 给 DSH 归档会话加个回收站，删错了能还原，也能彻底清掉占地方的僵尸会话。

description.en: 会自己刷 B 站的 DSH 插件：按作息醒来、看懂视频、写两本日记，值得的分享给你
description.zh: 会自己按作息刷 B 站、看懂视频并写日记，把值得的内容分享给你的 DSH 插件

description.en: A long conversation that renders many LaTeX formulas at once can become laggy, because the browser keeps styling, laying out and painting content that is off screen. This plugin applies content-visibility: auto to the off-screen message bodies and block formulas, so that work is skipped and the lag is reduced.
description.zh: 一段渲染了大量 LaTeX 公式的长会话容易卡顿：屏幕外的消息和公式仍会被浏览器反复计算样式、布局和绘制。本插件给屏幕外的消息体与块级公式加上 content-visibility: auto，让这部分工作被跳过，卡顿随之减少。

description.en: 会话管理 删除单条或批量删除会话（含正文、投影缓存与侧边栏引用）默认移入回收站，可随时还原。/Session Management: Deleting a single session or deleting sessions in bulk (including the body, projection cache, and sidebar references) moves them to the Recycle Bin by default, and they can be restored at any time.
description.zh: 删除会话时先放进回收站，误删了随时能还原，单条批量都行。

description.en: Runs a Douyin subagent that browses videos and reads comments in valley hours and reports back, with dy_* tools for publishing and replying (comments sent from the already-logged-in page with its own request signature, no IM ticket), a daily quota timer, and a settings panel under Settings → Douyin: master switch, auto mode, valley windows, rounds per day and report depth. Windows-oriented; needs the separate douyin-mcp binary (yunsur/douyin-mcp releases, path set via dy_config mcpExe) and an Edge/Chromium login; replying needs a logged-in browser on a CDP port; publishing needs extra credentials most accounts lack.
description.zh: 让子代理在谷时刷抖音、读评论并汇报；附带发作品/回评论的 dy_* 工具（评论从已登录页面带签名直发，不依赖 IM ticket）、每日配额定时，以及设置页「刷抖音」里的控制面板（总开关、自动模式、谷时窗口、每天轮数、报告详细度）。偏 Windows；搜索与评论依赖另装的 douyin-mcp 可执行文件（yunsur/douyin-mcp 的 Release，路径经 dy_config 的 mcpExe 设置）及 Edge/Chromium 登录；回评论需要开了 CDP 端口的已登录浏览器；发作品还需多数账号没有的额外凭据。

description.en: Image generation through eight provider APIs (Labnana, OpenAI, Gemini, Seedream, DashScope, xAI, Zhipu, ComfyUI) with multiple saved profiles, a per-conversation gallery, and credit tracking on Labnana.
description.zh: 多 API 生图：Labnana、OpenAI、Gemini、Seedream、DashScope、xAI、智谱、ComfyUI 八种接口，支持多套配置、对话画廊与 Labnana 积分计量。

description.en: Real-time inspector of the files the agent reads and edits, with a file tree, in the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: M/A/R badges, side-by-side diffs and live agent activity tracking.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 右侧边栏实时文件变更检查器与文件树：根据智能体的读/写/编辑调用显示 M/A/R 标记与并排 diff，实时追踪智能体活动。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness on Omarchy as Agent
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接操控你的 Omarchy 桌面，把桌面操作交给 AI 助手。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-omarchy-agent
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-omarchy-agent

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: DSH 插件：左上角「文件清理」按钮，扫一遍白名单垃圾（临时文件 / 系统噪声 / 可再生缓存），确认后按清单删除，删除范围严格限定在所选工作区或 DSH_HOME 内。 | DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin: whitelist-only disk cleanup, strictly scoped to the selected workspace or DSH_HOME.
description.zh: 左上角一键扫描工作区或 DSH_HOME 里的临时文件和缓存垃圾，确认清单后再删除，清理范围严格受限。

description.en: REA 逆向工作台 — 220 个逆向工具的纯中文界面，含调用统计、错误翻译、一键装引擎
description.zh: 装完就能用的逆向工作台，220 个工具全中文界面，Android 分析开箱即用，还能一键装 Ghidra 引擎。

description.en: DSH插件：STM32全流程工具--环境探测、.ico事务、生成工程、编译、烧录、调试 | DSH plugin: STM32 complete process tool - environment detection, .ico transactions, generating project, compiling, burning, debugging
description.zh: 一条龙搞定 STM32F103 开发：探测工具链、建工程、改 .ioc、编译、烧录、调试全包了。

description.en: Drop-in successor to the now-deleted corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect, keeping its package name, config row id and provider ids so an existing install upgrades in place. Also fixes the 400/11128 channel check by neutralising the DSH identity sentences and scrubbing the product name from system messages, and reads the real Windows client and bundled CLI versions instead of a compiled constant, unlike the functy and community forks. Verified 2026-10-21 on Windows, WorkBuddy 5.8.3, DSH 0.2.1-rc.2.
description.zh: 已 404 的 corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect 的原地接管版，沿用原来的包名、配置行 id 与 provider id，已装用户可直接升级。同时修复 400/11128 渠道校验（归一化 DSH 身份句并清除 system 消息中的产品名），并改为读取真实的 Windows 客户端与内置 CLI 版本，不再使用编译常量，这一点与 functy、community 两个分叉不同。验证环境（2026-10-21）：Windows、WorkBuddy 5.8.3、DSH 0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: A wx_archive tool that turns a WeChat Official Account article link into a permanent Markdown snapshot via the 2100laike archive service: images are re-hosted so they never break, snapshots survive article deletion, resubmits dedup-hit and return the latest version without spending quota, a content_kind field tells text articles from sticker (image-post) messages, and refresh forces a refetch with a PAT. Needs the third-party 2100laike service; anonymous use is limited to 8 archives per day per plugin instance and a registered PAT raises that to 100 per day.
description.zh: wx_archive 工具：把公众号文章链接经 2100laike 存档服务转成永久 Markdown 快照——图片转存不裂链、删文后仍可读、重复提交去重秒回不耗额度、content_kind 区分图文与贴图（图片消息）、带 PAT 可 refresh 强制重抓。依赖第三方 2100laike 存档服务；匿名使用每个插件实例每天限 8 次，注册后配置 PAT 可提升到每天 100 次。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件：Google Antigravity 直连代理核心与模型服务，支持双模型池额度监控、热切换网络代理与长文本防御
description.zh: 让 DSH 直连 Google Antigravity 的代理核心和模型服务，能盯双模型池额度、随时切网络代理，还能防长文本翻车。

description.en: Overhead conversation background with five whale species formed from custom text or ASCII, shaded cells, frosted content cards, input-box avoidance, independent dives, spouts, ripples, wind, and cloud shadows.
description.zh: 海面正上方俯视的对话背景，支持用自定义文字或 ASCII 组成五种鲸类，含彩色字格、内容框毛玻璃、输入框避让、独立下潜、喷水、尾拍涟漪、风纹与云影。

description.en: ???(EVA)?? for DeepSeek Harness:???? + ???????
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端换上绫波丽主题，整窗固定壁纸配半透明冰蓝界面，布局不变只换配色。

description.en: DSH Bilibili video understanding plugin: timestamped frames, local ASR/OCR, and optional independent vision model.
description.zh: 让 DSH 看懂 B 站视频：抓带时间戳的画面、字幕和画面文字，直接分析内容主线。

description.en: DSH plugin: lifecycle for the local Hindsight memory daemon. Starts it with DSH, tears it down with its embedded PostgreSQL on exit, and ships its own settings page. Windows and Linux.
description.zh: 让 Hindsight 记忆守护进程跟着 DSH 一起启动和退出，自动清理内嵌 PostgreSQL，还自带设置页。

description.en: dsh-pet
description.zh: 把桌面宠物搬到安卓手机上，让深深在手机桌面陪你互动卖萌。

description.en: Kun Like desktop pet static bundle plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 界面右下角养一只小坤宠，它会跟着 Agent 状态干活、思考、庆祝，任务完成还会喊「你干嘛~哎哟」。

description.en: DSH large-session performance plugin: zero-copy fork + projection warmup + chunked materialize
description.zh: DSH 大会话性能插件：零拷贝 fork + fast initFor + 投影分片预热 + fork 缓存回填 + 分片 materialize + 冷会话 LRU 裁剪 + heap 检测（DeepSeek Harness / DSH）

description.en: Two-pane model picker that replaces the composer model menu with a searchable provider-grouped list on the left and a detail card on the right showing the selected model's context window, output cap, capability tags and reasoning-effort levels, all read from that model's own provider. The npm name dsh-model-picker belongs to another author; install through this GitHub source.
description.zh: 双栏模型选择器，替换输入框的模型菜单：左栏可搜索并按供应商分组，右栏详情卡显示所选模型的上下文窗口、输出上限、能力标签与推理档位，全部取自该模型自己的供应商。npm 上的 dsh-model-picker 属于另一位作者，请按本仓库的 GitHub 源安装。

description.en: Local Markdown notes as governable working memory for DeepSeek Harness agents: dual-mode source/WYSIWYG editor with images, convention or reference notes auto-inject into the system prompt with sensitive values masked, plus snapshot version history, recycle bin, undoable archiving, AI reorganization, backlinks and full-text search. Compatible with DSH 0.1.7-0.2.x.
description.zh: 把 Agent 会话里的决策和约定自动存成本地 Markdown 笔记，还能派发待办、一键摘录。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 系统提示词与工具定制插件：屏蔽/替换/注入/排序提示词段、黑白名单隐藏工具、预设保存/应用/导出/导入，全部通过设置面板操作。
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里按需屏蔽、替换或注入系统提示词，还能隐藏工具、一键保存和切换预设，让对话更听话。

description.en: Independent DSH message renderer with sanitized HTML/CSS, macros and eight immersive document templates.
description.zh: 给 DSH 消息加酒馆式渲染，支持宏、正则和八种沉浸式文档模板，不改源码即插即用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 微信通道的扩展命令插件：提供人设切换、历史对话、token 用量与余额、每日定时问候等功能与扩展菜单。命令由宿主进程执行，不消耗模型 token，支持热挂载。
description.zh: 微信里发斜杠命令就能切人设、翻历史、查用量余额、设每日问候，不走模型不耗 token。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把本机已登录的 WorkBuddy / WorkBuddy AI / Hermes Agent 大模型接入 DSH 模型库，显示与 Agent 一致的模型名称、积分倍率与免费额度。
description.zh: 把本机已登录的 WorkBuddy、WorkBuddy AI、Hermes Agent 大模型直接接进 DSH 模型库，免登录即选即用。

description.en: A multi-agent group chat for DSH that decides who is worth waking: durable message log, attention routing, and cross-workspace membership.
description.zh: 给多个 DSH 会话建个群聊，消息先存后分发，只叫醒真正该看的人。

description.en: Runs one-time and recurring Agent tasks in fresh DSH sessions, with natural-language schedules, visual schedule editing and session-linked history. Supports custom models, skills, pause on failure, and permission settings.
description.zh: 在全新的 DSH 会话中运行单次或周期 Agent 任务，支持自然语言计划、可视化计划编辑和会话关联历史。支持自定义模型、技能、失败时暂停以及权限设置。

description.en: Shows your DeepSeek balance and what the current session has cost in a corner overlay, with budget alerts, peak-hour warnings and opt-in official price sync.
description.zh: 在右下角浮层显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与本会话花费，支持预算告警、峰时提醒，以及可选开启的官方价格同步。

description.en: Retrieval and planning toolkit for the BeiShan Besson Minecraft modding tutorials site: 7 tools to search 194 indexed tutorials, plan learning routes, compare version environments, and fetch article text.
description.zh: 北山 Besson Minecraft 模组开发教程检索与规划工具包：7 个工具检索 194 篇教程文章、规划学习路线、对比版本环境差异并抓取文章正文。

description.en: Unified plugin & skill manager for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): inventory, update checks, and safe transactional updates.
description.zh: 统一管理 DSH 插件和技能，能盘点清单、检查更新，还能安全地一键升级。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for SuperGrok and X Premium subscriptions: device-code sign-in, the xai provider, account-visible chat models with context and per-million-token prices, reasoning efforts read from model capabilities, and subscription usage.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 SuperGrok / X Premium 订阅插件：设备码登录、xai 提供商、账号可见对话模型与上下文/百万 token 价格、按模型能力读取的推理强度，以及订阅用量。

description.en: Model-linked characters and a shared world for DSH, with separate editable personas and memories, optional AI diaries and sleep consolidation, Chinese/English controls, task-aware desktop pets, themes and usage statistics; updates preserve user customizations. Supports Windows, Linux and macOS; see the guide for each system's installation requirements. Diaries and consolidation consume tokens. Before installing or updating, we recommend closing visible desktop pets and bubbles; open files may cause installation to fail. Codex and OpenAI API account queries have been user-validated; other sources await user validation and feedback.
description.zh: DSH 模型联动角色与共享世界，支持独立可编辑人设和记忆、可选 AI 日记与睡眠整理、中英文界面、任务联动桌宠、主题和用量统计，更新保留用户自定义。支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS，各系统安装要求见使用说明。日记和整理消耗 Token。安装或更新前，建议先关闭桌面上已显示的桌宠和提示气泡；未关闭时，文件占用有可能导致安装失败。Codex 与 OpenAI API 已获用户验证；其他来源待用户验证反馈。

description.en: Local-first memory and persona plugin for DeepSeek Harness: four file-backed memory layers (pinned, memory, facts, experience), editable SOUL/MOOD persona, zero-LLM session capture, BM25 recall and a themed mood card; no standalone web panel, Python service, vector database, or API key.
description.zh: 澜·轻量本地记忆与人格系统：四层文件记忆（pinned / memory / facts / experience）、可编辑 SOUL/MOOD 人格、零 LLM 捕获、BM25 检索与状态池卡片；无独立管理面板，不依赖 Python 服务、向量库或 API Key。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）侧栏音乐播放条：同步 QQ 音乐 / 网易云音乐的歌单，显示滚动歌词，支持扫码登录与音量控制。

Genshin Impact white-and-gold skin for the DSH web GUI: a random in-game landscape wallpaper on every page load, the Genshin UI font site-wide, a Paimon-style menu and a running-status element ring, and a switchable Paimon/Phanes assistant persona. The repository ships 262 wallpapers across eight regions at 1920x1080.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 界面换成原神白金风格：每次打开随机一张游戏内风景壁纸，全站使用原神界面字体，带派蒙风格菜单与运行状态元素环，可在派蒙/法涅斯两种人格间一键切换；仓库内置 262 张 1920x1080 壁纸，覆盖八个地区。

description.en: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin: unified default reasoning level (thinking effort) for all models — per-model defaults with capability probing, live call statistics, one-command install via dsh plugin
description.zh: 一个设置统一管理所有模型的默认思考强度，支持按模型配置并实时查看调用情况。
