notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: macOS-style skin with a swimming whale aquarium background and a dot-matrix whale send button for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 界面的 macOS 风格皮肤：水中鲸鱼动态背景与点阵鲸鱼发送按钮，明暗双主题。

description.en: Manage Windows hosts over WinRM from a web panel and seven agent tools with PowerShell exec, service and process control, SMB / chunked file transfer with SHA-256 verification, and cluster execution.
description.zh: 通过 WinRM 管理 Windows 主机，提供 PowerShell 执行、服务与进程管理、SMB/分块文件传输（SHA-256 校验）、集群并发，以及 GUI 面板和七个 agent 工具。

description.en: Re-applies Chinese UI labels to the DSH client modules on every start, so translations survive upgrades.
description.zh: 每次启动自动将 DSH 界面英文工具与状态标签修补为中文，升级 DSH 后自动恢复，无需手动改文件。

description.en: Session export and compliance archiving for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic redaction, Markdown/JSONL/PDF outputs, on-disk archive management, and a trend/audit view.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话导出与合规归档：确定性脱敏、Markdown/JSONL/PDF 导出、磁盘归档管理与趋势/审计视图。

description.en: AI-native music player plugin for DeepSeek Harness: aggregates NetEase Cloud Music, QQ Music and KuGou search with cross-provider playback fallback, renders word-by-word karaoke lyrics synced live over USB HID to HALO PIXELBAR speakers, and exposes search, playback, queue, alarm and speaker control as model tools.
description.zh: 运行于 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 原生音乐播放器（music player）：聚合网易云（NetEase）、QQ Music 与酷狗（KuGou）搜索并支持跨源播放回退，逐字卡拉OK歌词（karaoke lyrics）经 USB HID 实时同步至花再音箱（HALO PIXELBAR），搜索、播放、队列、闹钟与音箱控制均可由对话操控。

description.en: Import, install and invoke Agent Skills in DeepSeek Harness from Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, GitHub or npm — composer-side ⚡ picker inserts /skill-name into the draft, and a Skill 管理 settings page offers per-source/per-skill import, expandable source paths with skill counts, uninstall and one-click restore from .trash.
description.zh: 从 Codex / Claude Code / OpenCode / GitHub / npm 导入并安装技能到 ~/.dsh/skills，模型自动读取、/技能名 立即可用；对话框旁 ⚡ 一键插入调用，设置页支持按来源/单技能导入、路径与数量展示、卸载与一键恢复。

description.en: Deprecated: superseded by dsh-context-console; 0.1.1 remains available for rollback
description.zh: 消息锻造台插件，已停止更新，功能由 dsh-context-console 继承；旧版本仍可回滚使用。

description.en: DeepSeek API balance in the DSH sidebar · 在 DSH 侧边栏显示 DeepSeek API 余额
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏直接查看 DeepSeek API 余额，方便随时掌握用量，避免超额。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that delegates coding tasks to the Claude Code and Codex agent CLIs and streams the whole run live — autonomous control, multi-account, automatic install, git worktrees, and any Anthropic-compatible endpoint.
description.zh: 把编码任务一键委托给 Claude Code 和 Codex 命令行工具，实时直播执行过程，支持多账号、自动安装和 Git 工作树隔离。

description.en: A DSH ColorScheme Plugin
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面提供多款配色主题，可在设置中切换，并让悬停提示等界面元素跟随主题风格。

description.en: Native Windows Computer Use and configurable vision tools for DeepSeek Harness.
Delegate standalone tasks to the local Cursor CLI over ACP.
description.zh: 在对话中把独立任务直接交给本机已登录的 Cursor CLI 处理，实现 AI 协作分工。

description.en: DSH 下载管理器：右下角实时进度条，断点续传、多任务并发、镜像加速
description.zh: 右下角常驻下载进度面板，实时显示文件名、百分比、速度和剩余时间，多任务一目了然。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 内置嘉立创EDA(EasyEDA) WebSocket 网关桥接插件
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接操控本机嘉立创EDA专业版，画板改图不用来回切窗口。

description.en: Read-only market data for DeepSeek Harness. Ask about a stock, and let DSH call the data tools directly. | 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供只读金融市场数据。让 DSH 直接调用工具查询行情。
description.zh: 让 DSH 直接查股票行情和金融数据，只读安全，问一句就能拿到市场信息。

description.en: Live-reload upgraded DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugins without restarting dsh — safe reloads in place, failed ones roll back and flag a restart.
description.zh: 不用重启 dsh，就能安全热更新插件；更新失败自动回滚并提示重启，省心又高效。

description.en: QQ official bot (q.qq.com) integration for DeepSeek Harness: chat with the full agent from private chats, groups and channels — WS long connection (heartbeat / reconnect / RESUME), per-chat session isolation, standard agent preset, approval inline buttons with /revoke, slash commands, whitelist fail-closed, credentials via the credentials domain.
description.zh: 接入 QQ 官方机器人（q.qq.com）：私聊 / 群聊 / 频道 @ 与完整 agent 对话——WS 长连接（心跳 / 重连 / RESUME）、每会话隔离、标准 agent preset、审批内联按钮 + /revoke、斜杠命令、白名单 fail-closed、凭据走凭据域。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness job hunting plugin and runtime skill for local job intelligence workflows.
description.zh: 本地优先的求职插件，帮你整理招聘岗位、确认求职画像、维护意向岗位，让求职流程更高效。

description.en: OI 出题工作台：知识点锁定、数据构造、本地评测，打包 Hydro/HOJ 原生题目包，发布/管理 Hydro 与 HOJ OJ，提供 Python 外部管理 UI 与系统斜杠命令。Opt-in skill-first plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在会话里帮你锁定知识点、造测试数据、本地评测，一键打包发布 Hydro/HOJ 题目。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 审批/选择方案系统级通知提醒，显示工作区名、点击跳转、多语言。Approval & decision alerts with native notifications for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 当 Harness 需要审批或选择方案时，弹出桌面通知提醒，显示工作区名并支持点击跳转，多语言。

description.en: 随手抽屉 · Handy Drawer — DSH plugin: stash 'later' snippets during AI chats, then pick & ask in place. 低打扰、不打断心流。
description.zh: 随手把聊天里稍后再看的片段收进抽屉，需要时就地追问，不打断心流。

description.en: Let DSH subagents call any Claude-compatible CLI, not just the SDK-bundled one. Fork of @deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-claude-code.
description.zh: 让DSH子代理调用任意Claude兼容CLI，灵活切换后端，提升自动化效率。

description.en: Token usage statistics plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI: per-request LLM usage captured from llm/stream, dual-axis trend charts, cache hit rate, API/model filters.
description.zh: Token usage statistics plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI: per-request LLM usage captured from llm/stream, dual-axis trend charts, cache hit rate, API/model filters.

description.en: Hourly checks npm for newer versions of your installed dsh plugins and pops an approval bubble asking which to upgrade
description.zh: 每小时自动检查 npm 上你已安装的 dsh 插件是否有新版本，弹出气泡让你一键决定升级哪些。

description.en: LLM-as-a-verifier plugin for DeepSeek Harness: end-of-turn quality gate, best-of-N selection and assessment tools (port of llm-as-a-verifier)
Better Harness evidence lanes as three independently installable DeepSeek Harness skill bundles. Zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 把 Harness 证据通道拆成三个独立安装的技能包，即插即用，零依赖，让智能体干活更顺手。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的 `Windows 专属` 系统托盘插件。在 `dsh web` 运行期间，系统托盘会自动出现 DeepSeek 鲸鱼图标；服务停止后，托盘图标 3 秒内自动消失——托盘与服务同生命周期。同时自动维护一个静默桌面启动器 `DSH.lnk`，双击即可无窗口启动服务并打开浏览器。
description.zh: Windows 专属托盘插件，运行 dsh 时显示鲸鱼图标，停止后自动消失；双击桌面快捷方式即可无窗口启动服务并打开浏览器。

description.en: 把 Aloof 接成 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的原生工具。一张自带地址的接入令牌，粘一串就能用。
description.zh: 把 Aloof 接入 DeepSeek Harness，粘贴令牌就能用，AI 能直接帮你查连接状态和机器信息。

description.en: 原子朋克风格的共产主义公社
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换上原子朋克风苏式公社皮肤，对话界面秒变宏伟建筑与红气球场景。

description.en: 让 DSH 桌面端壁纸持久不丢：支持 GIF 动图 & MP4 视频壁纸，内置全屏皮肤中心（上传、预览、一键应用、删除素材），重启、换端口、清缓存都不丢失。Server-side wallpaper & theme persistence for DSH Desktop — animated GIF / MP4 video wallpapers plus a full-screen skin center (upload, preview, apply, delete).
description.zh: 让 DSH 桌面壁纸和主题重启不丢失，支持 GIF/MP4 视频壁纸，内置全屏皮肤中心，上传预览一键应用。

description.en: Developer Preview: persistent DeepSeek Harness session branch visualizer with navigation, rename, archive, and compatibility adapters.
Mark an exploration start in the session; pairs with rewind to fold the exploration out of context.
description.zh: 在会话中标记探索起点，配合回退功能将探索内容折叠出上下文，保持对话清爽。

description.en: Symbol-aware code indexing and hybrid search for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为代码库提供符号级索引与混合搜索，让智能体快速定位函数、类等定义。

description.en: OpenAI Codex CLI wrapper: one-shot exec, repo review and session resume with a default read-only sandbox.
description.zh: OpenAI Codex CLI 封装：一次性任务、仓库审查与会话续接，默认只读沙箱。

description.en: dsh-cost-guard — DeepSeek 成本守卫插件：会话成本核算（官方峰谷费率）、¥ 预算守卫、收敛引导、峰谷错峰队列；附对比测试报告
Plugin-combination analysis for the DeepSeek Harness: dependency trees, conflict detection, risk scoring with prediction, visualization, and combination simulation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件组合分析工具：依赖树、冲突检测、风险评估（含预测）、可视化与组合模拟。

description.en: Kubernetes ops for the agent: get resources with structured JSON output, describe, logs, exec, apply/delete (user-confirmed) and port-forward.
description.zh: Kubernetes 运维：JSON 结构化查资源、describe、日志、exec、apply/delete（需确认）与端口转发。

description.en: ChatGPT Plus/Pro (Codex) adapter for the DeepSeek Harness LLM seam: PKCE/device OAuth, token refresh, and forwarding to chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/responses
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 接入 ChatGPT Plus/Pro 的 Codex 模型，支持 OAuth 登录和令牌自动刷新，直接调用 Codex 接口。

description.en: Multi-model governance, routing, fallback, quota, and usage for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 帮你统一管理多个大模型，支持智能切换、故障自动重试、额度管控与用量统计，让模型调用更稳定省心。

description.en: 把"以后再说"的灵感，准时摆到你面前：随手记下，到点由 AI 自动替你把它想透、做透，回来只看结果。
description.zh: 随手记下灵感待办并设好时间，到期AI自动帮你理清或出结果，回来只管看成品。

description.en: The Matrix movie theme for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web GUI — installable dsh plugin: green-on-black palette, digital-rain backdrop, and a General-settings toggle.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面换上黑客帝国主题，绿字黑底加数字雨特效，还能在设置里一键切换。

description.en: OpenCode Go (opencode.ai/zen/go) quota usage card for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI sidebar - day/week/month progress bars, DS peak/valley billing strip, customizable auto-refresh interval.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏常驻 OpenCode Go 额度卡片，实时显示日/周/月用量进度条和费用，支持自定义刷新间隔。

description.en: Background image plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web UI (dsh web): upload local images as the whole-UI background, with a theme-aware readability matte, WebP-first compression and IndexedDB persistence.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面设置本地图片作为全屏背景，带智能遮罩和自动压缩，随时可清除。

description.en: DSH plugin: a global-prompt textarea in Settings > General, injected into every conversation system prompt
description.zh: 在设置中配置一段全局提示词，自动注入每次对话的系统提示词，保存即生效，留空即停用。

description.en: dsh-polling — 轮询任务/定时任务 plugin for DeepSeek Harness: cron scheduled tasks as real sessions, natural-language creation, model tools (polling…
description.zh: dsh-polling — 轮询任务/定时任务 plugin for DeepSeek Harness: cron scheduled tasks as real sessions, natural-language creation, model tools (polling…

description.en: One-click restart button for DeepSeek Harness (DSH Desktop)
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一个一键重启按钮，点一下就能快速重启，省事又高效。

description.en: Quick temporary conversation and workspace manager for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 临时对话工作区自动化管理插件。

description.en: 还在为繁杂的log而苦恼吗？直接拓扑展示，清晰理顺所有，多智能体也不怕。
description.zh: 把杂乱的会话日志变成3D执行图，主线和子智能体分叉汇合一目了然，还能逐条追溯原始日志。

description.en: Adds a Windows Explorer right-click action to open a folder as a DSH workspace, launching DSH if needed.
description.zh: 给 Windows 文件管理器加右键项：把文件夹设为 DSH 工作区并切换到它，DSH 未运行会自动拉起。

description.en: Tavily search provider for DeepSeek Harness with full search-control mapping, credential-backed key UI, and guarded rc.6 patches.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Tavily 搜索，支持完整搜索控制映射和密钥管理，并兼容 rc.6 版本。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 待办事项插件：从对话中识别关键事项——自然对话、通知导入、公告导入、邮件内容导入等——将其转换为带截止日期的待办，并通过左侧栏「待办事项」入口统一管理。
description.zh: 从对话中自动提取待办事项，生成带截止日期的任务清单，并在侧边栏统一管理。

description.en: Evidence-preserving tool output compression for DeepSeek Harness — deterministic, local-first, and benchmarked.
description.zh: 压缩工具输出，保留关键证据，省token又省心，本地运行快又稳。

description.en: 像 Claude Code 一样，DeepSeek Harness 现在也允许您自定义等待 AI 回复时的状态提示语。您可以根据不同轮次或场景，灵活替换占位文案，让开发助手在“思考”时也能传递您想要的信息。
description.zh: 让 DSH 等待 AI 回复时的状态文字变成你自定义的轮次短语，不同场景随时换。

description.en: DSH plugin: precise API usage statistics (tokens, cost, cache hit rate, per-model breakdown) with multi-provider balance & quota monitoring (OpenCode, DeepSeek).
description.zh: DSH plugin: precise API usage statistics (tokens, cost, cache hit rate, per-model breakdown) with multi-provider balance & quota monitoring (OpenCode, DeepSeek).

description.en: China-ready voice input for the composer. Requires a local Python bridge (pip install dashscope websockets, run bridge/voice-bridge.py) — the plugin alone does not work. Browser mic streams 16 kHz PCM to the bridge, which runs Alibaba Cloud DashScope ASR (paraformer-realtime-v2); interim text fills the draft at the cursor, silence auto-stop, optional auto-send.
description.zh: 国内可用的输入框语音输入。需要先启动本地 Python bridge（pip install dashscope websockets，运行 bridge/voice-bridge.py）——只装插件不可用。浏览器麦克风采集 16kHz PCM 流式转发给 bridge，由阿里云 DashScope ASR（paraformer-realtime-v2）识别；识别文字在光标处实时填入草稿，静音自动停止，可选识别后自动发送。

description.en: Microsoft Web IQ search provider for the built-in web_search tool, with a settings card for the API key, endpoint, language, region, passage length and SafeSearch.
description.zh: 基于 Microsoft Web IQ 的网页搜索提供方，接入内置 web_search 工具，并提供 API Key、端点、语言、地区、摘要长度与 SafeSearch 的设置卡片。

description.en: Manage the DSH web service from a settings panel: status, version, restart, stop, and one-click updates.
description.zh: 在设置面板中管理 DSH Web 服务:状态、版本、重启、停止与一键更新。

description.en: Per-model first-turn chain-of-thought anchor presets for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 预设每模型首轮思维链锚点，一键切换标准、PTC、创造模式，灵活控制推理强度。

description.en: DSH 插件：对话区左缘轮次图标列，点击定位到每轮用户输入文本。A DSH plugin: left-edge turn rail, click to locate each turn's user message.
description.zh: DSH 静态 bundle 插件：定位当前会话中每次通过输入框发送的消息。会话标题栏「消息定位」按钮 → 右侧浮动面板列出全部已发送消息（序号/时间/摘要），支持关键词搜索、点击展开全文、一键回填输入框重新使用。A static-bundle DSH plugin that locates every message you sent from the composer.

description.en: Lets the DSH web UI attach files of any type as pathless @-mentions: pick a workspace file from the @ menu or drop one into the composer, and the agent reads it directly.
description.zh: 让 DSH 网页以无路径 @提及 附加任意类型文件：可从 @ 菜单挑选工作区文件，或拖入输入区，Agent 直接读取。

description.en: Lexmount Browser plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
A plugin for Deepseek Harness (well it may support other AI agent IDEs but I hadn't test it out yet) that checks for error when AI had finished writing the code.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 代码全面检查插件：三步流水线（编译运行检查 → 功能完整性核对 → 真实用户模拟测试），自动把问题反馈给 AI 修复，可选用 GUI，并附带适用于 Trae/Qoder 等平台的独立 CLI 与 MCP 服务

description.en: CPA account-pool status panel: sidebar health light, quota bars, success-rate ticks, and gateway key endings.
description.zh: CPA 账号池状态面板：侧栏健康灯、配额进度、成功率刻度与网关密钥末四位一览。

description.en: 给dsh增加下问题跳转与会话删除的功能
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上会话问题跳转和删除会话功能，找问题、清会话都更省事。

description.en: DSH plugin discovery browser - browse & search community plugins on GitHub (read-only, no one-click installs)

Econometrics research assistant: 6 tools covering method selection, data preparation, model specification, empirical analysis with Python/R/Stata code templates, robustness checks, and result reporting.
description.zh: 计量经济学研究助手：6 个工具覆盖方法选择、数据预处理、模型设定、实证分析（含 Python/R/Stata 代码模板）、稳健性检验与结果报告。

description.en: Adds generation_fork and generation_run to copy an agent preset and run a task on a new session.
description.zh: 提供 generation_fork 与 generation_run，用于拷贝 Agent preset 并在新会话上跑任务。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供桃濑日和的动态插件
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 换上暖色温柔界面，还配了会回应你的桃濑日和动态伴侣。

description.en: Prunes the tool schema to a whitelist and injects a structural preamble on a session's first turn only, then passes every later turn through untouched.
description.zh: 只在会话首轮把工具清单裁剪到白名单并注入一段结构化前言，之后每一轮原样放行。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的用量（Usage）部署级插件：会话视图环新增「用量」页签，实时跟踪输入/输出/缓存命中 tokens 与费用（DeepSeek 官方峰谷价 + OpenCode Go 套餐价），动态渐变蓝状态条、自定义价格表、CSV/JSON 导出。原生UI界面
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话中实时查看 token 用量和费用，支持峰谷价与套餐价，可导出数据。

description.en: Runs reproducible DSH profile and patch experiments with guided case authoring, assertions, Web comparison reports, recovery, and policy gates.
description.zh: 运行可复现的 DSH Profile 与 Patch 实验，并提供引导式用例构建、断言、Web 对比报告、恢复和策略门禁。

description.en: Voice control and multi-session task dispatch for DeepSeek Harness, powered by Qwen Audio Agent

Remote-SSH-style workspaces: turn an SSH host and a remote directory into a native DSH workspace; the agent operates the remote filesystem directly via 12 rw_* tools (SFTP/exec), with workspace-confined paths and known_hosts verification.
description.zh: Remote-SSH 风格工作区：把 SSH 主机上的远程目录变成原生 DSH 工作区，agent 通过 12 个 rw_* 工具（SFTP/exec）直接操作远程文件，路径限定在工作区内并校验 known_hosts。

description.en: Skill management panel for the DeepSeek Harness web app
Windows minimal agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: fixed one-line persona, three tools, no runtime context.
description.zh: Windows 极简模式 preset：单句 persona、三工具、无运行时上下文。

description.en: Shows real-time token and cost savings from the Headroom compression proxy in the DSH web UI: a Settings dashboard plus a persistent stats line under the composer.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内实时展示 Headroom 压缩代理的 token 与费用节省：设置页仪表盘 + 输入区常驻统计行。

description.en: 琉璃主题——为DeepSeek Harness打造实用美观的主题UI
description.zh: 琉璃主题 —— DenpaPush 复刻主题插件：M3 动态取色、壁纸磨砂材质、声纹可视化、日/夜切换
给 AI 助手接上全网搜索，网页图片视频加天气股票汇率等实时数据一搜就有。

description.en: Life-story skill: capture moments and fragments, build a user profile and generate novels, scripts or autobiographies.
description.zh: 闪念记录与人生拼图技能：捕捉生活点滴，构建画像并生成小说、剧本或自传。

description.en: 🐳 DeepSeek brand whale progress indicator for DSH Web GUI — swims above the composer while the agent works, with spout animation and todo-progress tracking

Vision bridge for text-only DeepSeek: send images (alone or mixed with text) and a fast tiny vision model describes them behind the scenes — the chat keeps the picture, DeepSeek sees only text. Pure plugin: uninstall restores everything.
description.zh: 视觉桥：纯文本 DeepSeek 也能收图（单独发、图文混发均可），快速小识图模型后台描述，对话框里图还在、模型只见文字；纯插件，卸载即复原。

description.en: Automatically loads the full conversation history when a session opens, so older messages are ready without clicking "Load earlier".
description.zh: 打开会话时自动加载全部历史消息，免去反复点击「加载更早」。

description.en: Pre-flight plugin-library index for DSH agents: injects per-step trigger-table hints into the runtime context so suitable installed plugins get used predictably instead of opportunistically.
description.zh: DSH agent 的插件库起飞检查：向运行时上下文注入按步骤触发的提示，让合适的已装插件从「碰巧想起」变成「可预期使用」。

description.en: Runs one coding prompt across multiple configured models in isolated Git worktrees, streams side-by-side tool traces and results, and commits the candidate the user adopts for later rounds.
description.zh: 让多个编程智能体并行跑同一任务，并排对比结果，帮你选出最优代码方案。

description.en: Session-scoped @file/@folder mentions in the composer with Git-aware indexing, drag-drop and paste managed uploads, and validated path markers.
description.zh: 输入框内 session 范围的 @文件/@文件夹提及：Git 感知索引、拖放与粘贴受管上传、经校验的路径标记。

description.en: Anchors an approve/answer bubble to each DSH Web sidebar session row — one-click handling of authorization, questions, plan reviews and blocked goals without opening the conversation.
description.zh: DSH Web 侧边栏锚定气泡：会话待授权、提问、计划确认、目标阻断时在会话行旁自动弹出并一键处理，无需点进会话。

description.en: Dockable Markdown preview for the DSH Web UI: side-by-side with the conversation, a per-session recently-read .md list, local relative-path images render in place, and clicking an in-chat .md reference previews it instead of launching the system editor; follows the shell light/dark theme.
description.zh: DSH Web 端可停靠的 Markdown 预览面板：与对话并排展示，会话级「最近打开 .md」列表，本地相对路径图片可直接渲染；点击对话中的 .md 引用改为并排预览而非唤起系统编辑器；跟随 shell 深浅色主题。

description.en: More agent presets for DSH, derived from other coding agents such as Qwen Code and iFlow.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供更多智能体预设，衍生自其他编程智能体（例如 Qwen Code、iFlow）。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-more-agent-presets
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-more-agent-presets

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: A desktop pet in the DSH web GUI: floating, draggable sprite pet that animates with agent activity (thinking, idle, error, done, awaiting approval), with a settings page for size, switching, gallery search and one-click pet install. Ships 4 bundled Hunter x Hunter starter pets.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面里的桌面宠物：右下角悬浮、可拖拽，随智能体活动切换精灵动画；设置页可管理大小、启停切换、图库搜索与一键安装宠物。内置 4 个全职猎人主角宠物包。

description.en: TikTok-style video feed in a floating sidebar window: swipe local or SMB-NAS folders, or paste online video URLs (yt-dlp, bilibili/YouTube, cookies.txt login state); the window auto-fits the video aspect ratio, with fullscreen, drag-resize, Range streaming and an agent video-queue endpoint.
description.zh: 侧栏浮动窗口里的抖音式刷视频：本地/SMB NAS 文件夹上下滑动，或粘贴在线视频地址（yt-dlp 解析，支持 bilibili/YouTube 与 cookies.txt 登录态）；窗口随视频宽高比自适应，支持全屏、拖动缩放、Range 流式播放，并提供 agent 视频推送队列端点。

description.en: One-click create, update or remove the DeepSeek Harness desktop shortcut with switchable custom icons and a draggable whale button.
description.zh: 一键创建、更新或删除 DeepSeek Harness 桌面快捷方式，图标可自定义上传切换，蓝白金鲸鱼悬浮按钮可拖动，点击旋转 90° 弹出面板。

description.en: deepseek harness web侧边聊天插件
A skin toolbox for DeepSeek Harness with 10 built-in wallpapers, live tuning, and image/video DIY skins.

SSQ (China Welfare Lottery Double Color Ball) helper for DeepSeek Harness: 1000-draw trend tracking, six prediction models with ensemble voting, structure analysis and dan-tuo/random generation via the ssq tool.
description.zh: 双色球助手 DSH 插件：千期趋势追踪、6 种预测模型与集成投票、组合结构分析、胆拖/随机选号，对话中直接调用 ssq 工具。

description.en: DSH思考流分段总结插件

Cross-platform Web UI launcher for DeepSeek Harness: webui_start/stop/status/open model tools, a /webui start|stop|status|open slash command, a Settings-page launch card, and an optional desktop shortcut that starts the Web UI hidden and opens the browser once it is fully ready (dsh default icon).
description.zh: 跨平台 Web UI 启动器：提供 webui_start/stop/status/open 模型工具、/webui start|stop|status|open 斜杠命令、设置页启动卡片，以及可选的桌面快捷方式——隐藏控制台启动 Web UI，完全就绪后自动打开浏览器，默认使用 dsh 官方图标。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）微信远程控制插件：扫码绑定微信官方机器人（iLink/clawbot），在微信里远程操控 DSH agent——支持工作区多选与 /ws 切换
Chinese-first UI enhancement: translates slash-command names and plugin-inventory cards with three display modes (Chinese only / Chinese + English / off), switching instantly without losing English.
description.zh: 斜杠命令名与插件清单卡片中文化：三种显示模式（只显示中文 / 中英都显示 / 不翻译），中文为主、英文不丢，切换即时生效。

description.en: Smart form skill: structured record-keeping for bills, ledgers and logs with auto-categorization and periodic reports.
description.zh: 智能表单技能：支出账单、台账与日志的结构化记录，自动归类并生成周期报表。

description.en: A floating cyber wooden fish widget — tap it to strike and accumulate merit, drag it anywhere on the page.
description.zh: 一个赛博木鱼：可拖拽、点击敲击、累积功德的 Web 悬浮小摆件。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 会话管理插件：链式上下文视图、可在任意轮次边界分叉的子会话、一次性 /btw 只读问答，全部基于会话原语——把长对话拆成并行支线而不污染主上下文，但可手动向主会话注入临时对话内容
description.zh: 把长对话拆成并行支线，随时分叉子会话、只读问答，不污染主上下文。

description.en: Reasoning-mode routing plugin for V4 Flash on headless: w7 persona anchoring, first-turn tool anchoring and complexity-dispatched guidance.
description.zh: 让 V4 Flash 在无头环境下稳定输出，通过角色锚定和工具引导，把不稳定的推理变成可复现的能力。

description.en: Composer-dock balance/usage readout for DeepSeek, Kimi Coding, OpenCode Go, Zhipu, MiniMax, OpenRouter and OpenAI Codex — provider-based, 2s polling, 5min cache.
description.zh: 输入框下方按 provider 展示 DeepSeek、Kimi Coding、OpenCode Go、智谱、MiniMax、OpenRouter、OpenAI Codex 的余额/用量，2 秒轮询、5 分钟缓存。

description.en: Adds a Settings Usage dashboard for DeepSeek API balance, official token and cost analysis, trends, context warnings, and live API activity.
description.zh: 在设置中添加 DeepSeek API 用量仪表板，显示余额、官方 Token 与费用分析、趋势、上下文警告及实时 API 活动。

description.en: Content workshop tools for DSH — topic, title, post and content-calendar generation through the built-in LLM.
description.zh: 内容工坊——选题、标题、文案与排期生成工具，直接调用内置 LLM。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 图形化技能管理器——可通过 Web 设置界面创建、编辑、导入（ZIP 压缩包）和删除 SKILL.md 技能。支持全局安装及按工作区安装。

A dockable IDE workbench for the DSH web UI: a GPU-accelerated terminal (restty renderer over a Rust PTY), a CodeMirror editor, a file explorer, notes, a sandboxed browser, and ripgrep content search.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的可停靠 IDE 工作台：GPU 加速终端（restty 渲染器 + Rust PTY）、CodeMirror 编辑器、文件浏览器、笔记、沙箱浏览器，以及基于 ripgrep 的内容搜索。

description.en: RAGFlow knowledge-base retrieval plugin: gives the agent a `ragflow_retrieve` tool that queries your RAGFlow datasets and returns document chunks with similarity scores and source names; three-role design (seam/provider/consumer), env-based config, `dsh plugin add github:staff-os/dsh-ragflow#main`.
description.zh: 让智能体直接检索你的 RAGFlow 知识库，返回带相似度评分和来源的文档片段，快速接入企业知识问答。

description.en: Rules & commands manager for DeepSeek Harness: /rules command + settings panel + custom commands
description.zh: 规则与命令管理：/rules 命令 + 设置面板可视化编辑。

description.en: 省钱+余额监控悬浮窗（DSH Web UI 插件）：DeepSeek / OpenCode Go 双标签余额、限额监控（金额/tok/小时）、语音提醒、超限断点截断
Move a session to another workspace by dragging it onto the target workspace header in the sidebar: the session is cloned with full history into the target workspace and the original is archived.
description.zh: 在侧边栏把会话直接拖到其他工作区的标题行即可移动：目标工作区生成携带完整历史的新会话，原会话归档。

description.en: Workspace sticky notes for DSH, saved as multiple Markdown files under the current workspace.
description.zh: DSH 工作区极简便签：在各个工作区保存多张 Markdown 便签，记录你的想法和项目进程。

description.en: Displays real-time CPU and memory usage for the machine running the DSH Web server.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面右上角实时显示运行 DSH 服务端机器的 CPU 与内存使用情况。

description.en: OpenAI-compatible image generation in DSH Desktop chat: generate inline, edit reference images or chain-edit previous results directly (image-to-image) without re-uploading, with storage cleanup.
description.zh: 对话内联生图插件：模型在对话框直接出图，可基于参考图或上次生成结果连续图生图修改，附存储清理。

description.en: Wallpaper Engine–style wallpaper for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: custom images, GIFs, and videos as your app background｜仿 Wallpaper Engine 的壁纸插件，支持图片 / GIF / 视频自定义背景
description.zh: DSH Wallpaper Engine–style wallpaper for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: custom images, GIFs, and videos as your app background｜Deepseek Harness 仿 Wallpaper Engine 的壁纸插件，支持图片 / GIF / 视频自定义背景

description.en: Spec-driven development discipline for dsh: five keel skills (anchor/spec/probe/build/audit), three review tools and six spec templates enforce specs-before-code, assumption verification and scope control.
description.zh: 规格驱动开发纪律技能包（keel）：五个技能（锚定/立规/探针/建造/审计）、三个审查工具与六个规格模板，强制先规格后代码、假设先行验证并约束范围蔓延。

description.en: DASH — Deepseek Agentic Service Harness, a TUI Plugin of Deepseek Harness
description.zh: DASH — Deepseek Agentic Service Harness. oh-my-pi style TUI on the DSH agent kernel, run in the terminal via `dsh --profile dash`. TypeScript sources in src/, compiled to dist/.

description.en: Session-bound file attachments for DeepSeek Harness: drag, paste, or select files into the chat; the agent reads them via bounded, session-authorized tools. GB18030/GBK decoding, secret redaction, zip-bomb defense. One-click install. | DeepSeek Harness 会话文件附件插件：文件拖入/粘贴/选择进对话，模型经会话授权工具受限读取。GB18030/GBK 中文编码、敏感信息脱敏、压缩炸弹防护。一键安装。
一个完全可自定义的陪伴 Agent（DeepSeek Harness 插件）——名字、性格、声音都由你 在对话里配置，不需要 fork 仓库或发布新包。声音由 Qwen3-TTS（本地部署在 mac mini 上）生成，浏览器播放——跨平台（macOS / Windows / Chrome / Edge / Safari），无需服务器 TTS 或 API key。
Live CVE/supply-chain audit for your workspace's own project dependencies (npm/pip/go), backed by OSV.dev, with a `cve_audit` tool plus optional automatic re-scan on lockfile changes.
description.zh: 面向你自己项目依赖（npm/pip/go）的实时 CVE/供应链审计，基于 OSV.dev，提供 `cve_audit` 工具，并支持在 lockfile 变化时自动重新扫描。

description.en: Real-time DeepSeek account balance in the composer dock, auto-refreshing every 15 seconds with hover details.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 输入框下方实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，每 15 秒自动刷新，悬停查看总额、赠送与充值明细。

description.en: Session-bound file attachments for DeepSeek Harness Web: drag/paste/button intake, content-addressed storage, bounded office/text/archive readers, three-stage delivery receipt. macOS/Windows/Linux.

DSH plugin: connect DSH to GitHub — OAuth device-flow login plus github_* tools (repos, issues, PRs, files, search) and a config-page auth card. / 连接 DSH 与 GitHub 的插件：OAuth 登录认证 + github_* 工具（仓库、issues、PR、文件、搜索）与配置页认证卡片。
DSH interface customization plugin: wallpaper / transparency / glass blur / splash screen一个 DeepSeek Harness 前端插件：把「壁纸 / 区域透明 / 输入框与轨迹毛玻璃 / 模糊程度 / 启动画面」做成一站式界面设置，作为独立插件项目上传、分享，装进 DSH 即可使用
Agent tools for a self-hosted mem0 server: add, search, get, update, delete, history, reset and status memories, with a settings-panel configuration card.
description.zh: 自托管 mem0 记忆读写插件：agent 直接读写自有 mem0 服务（增删查改、搜索、历史、重置、状态），并带设置面板配置卡片。

description.en: 一个插件管理的小插件，功能逐步增加中...
一个温暖、超可爱、派蒙风格萝莉音的「妹妹」陪伴 Agent（DeepSeek Harness 插件）
description.zh: DSH companion plugin: a warm, cheerful 'little sister' agent that speaks with a soft voice in the browser, auto-reads every reply aloud, fires scheduled daily cheers, and lifts the learner's mood with lots of positive emotion.

description.en: Anti-bot HTTP fetch tools hardened by SXS's production scraping stack (millions of requests/day): UA-pool rotation, retry with exponential backoff, anti-bot wall detection (captcha / verification challenges) and adaptive rate limiting — tools: `sxs_fetch` / `sxs_fetch_json` / `sxs_rate_status`.
description.zh: 反爬 HTTP 工具：UA 池轮换、指数退避重试、反爬墙检测（验证码/安全验证）与自适应限流，提炼自 SXS 生产采集体系（每日数百万请求）——工具：`sxs_fetch` / `sxs_fetch_json` / `sxs_rate_status`。

description.en: voice engine, using Qwen TTS model
description.zh: Shared voice engine for dsh companion plugins (dsh-teacher, dsh-sister): Qwen3-TTS proxy, audio-queue playback, auto-read of assistant replies, speak/cheer tools, voice-style presets, and the daily greeting scheduler. Consumers compose it via a preset row and configure the voice style (e.g. 御姐 / 派蒙).

description.en: [STU-XIE] 将你的本地dsh接入微信，尝试使用微信进行工作吧，至少比openclaw的体验要好很多
description.zh: 把微信私聊接进 DSH，让你直接在微信里跟 AI 助手干活，回复还能分段发。

description.en: 把 go-stock 的股票行情、K 线、 财务、资金流、新闻和研报能力，以只读 stdio MCP Server 的形式提供给 DeepSeek Harness 及其他 MCP Client
Harness 插件商店优化版：图形化浏览/搜索/一键安装 DSH 插件，评分评论、依赖拓扑、审计日志、质量门一应俱全；本 fork 新增可配置插件下载目录、bundle 层冲突检测、pnpm 自动寻路，并修复多项上游 bug
Organize DeepSeek Harness workspace sessions by renaming them as 类别｜主题 and reporting archive, rename, and review suggestions.
description.zh: 整理 DeepSeek Harness 工作区会话，按 类别｜主题 重命名并给出归档、改名与待判断建议。

description.en: Native tavern management panel for DeepSeek Harness: multiple character cards, multiple worldbooks, switchable presets.
description.zh: 酒馆管理原生面板：多角色卡、多世界书、可切换预设，深浅色跟随，点侧边栏自动关闭。

description.en: Purple-white desktop pet that docks to the screen edge and shows real-time CPU, RAM, GPU and NVMe temperatures with hardware info.
description.zh: 紫白桌宠悬浮球，贴边停靠实时显示 CPU/内存/GPU/NVMe 温度与硬件信息。

description.en: Achievement and gamification plugin: unlock badges for turns, tool calls, sessions, daily streaks and coding behavior (edits/reads/tests), with a badge wall, unlock toasts and a ctx.achievements SDK.
description.zh: 成就与游戏化插件：按回合、工具调用、会话、连续天数与编码行为（编辑/读取/测试）解锁徽章，带徽章墙、解锁 toast 与 ctx.achievements SDK。

description.en: Basic Right Sidebar — a right sidebar plugin for DeepSeek Harness: two-level navigation (Functions / Sessions), workspace/session breadcrumb, session overview with log download, native trajectory view, and configurable topbar decluttering.
Slacking-off companion: a floating mini player that streams Bilibili videos (native player, danmaku, comments, search) and pauses when your agent needs you, resuming exactly where you left off.
description.zh: 摸鱼伴侣：右下角小窗播放 B站视频（原生播放器/弹幕/评论/搜索），agent 需要你时自动暂停提醒，处理完从原位置精确续播。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for locally installed CloakBrowser by CloakHQ.
description.zh: Native CloakBrowser tools for DeepSeek Harness.

description.en: Real-time DeepSeek API usage: account balance with low-balance alerts (browser notification on threshold crossing), token & request stats (total/today/last-60s windows, per-model and per-session), estimated cost — a composer dock plus a settings-page usage panel.
description.zh: 实时 DeepSeek API 用量：账户余额与低余额告警（跨阈值浏览器通知）、请求/token 统计（全部/今日/近 60s，按模型与会话下钻）、估算花费——输入框下方统计条 + 设置页用量面板。

description.en: Reuses DeepSeek web's built-in vision mode for text-only models: the deepseek_vision tool drives the local deepseek-vision-cli browser automation (manual login helper, deep-think enabled, auto-closes browser) and returns image descriptions as text.
description.zh: 复用 DeepSeek 网页端识图模式给纯文本模型补上看图能力：deepseek_vision 工具调用本地 deepseek-vision-cli 浏览器自动化（手动登录助手、自动开启深度思考、用后自动关窗），把图片描述以文字返回给模型。

description.en: Plugin compiler with a blueprint registry (scaffold → validate → deploy) exposed as a runtime service, three model tools, and a blueprint-gallery settings page.
description.zh: 插件编译器：以运行时服务提供蓝图注册表（脚手架 → 校验 → 部署），配三个模型工具和一个蓝图画廊设置页。

description.en: Upload an image as a full-window frosted-glass theme: sidebar/conversation/details share one frost layer, Save/Delete, official Light/Dark/System stay in charge.
description.zh: 上传图片作为整窗磨砂玻璃主题：侧栏/会话/详情同一层磨砂，保存/删除，官方浅色/深色/跟随系统仍有效。

description.en: Chat image-attachment bridge with a `view_image` tool for any OpenAI-compatible VLM (local Ollama or cloud): pasted/dropped images become `view_image` path markers before reaching text-only DeepSeek models.
description.zh: 纯文本 DeepSeek 的聊天识图插件：view_image 工具转发任意 OpenAI 兼容 VLM（本地 Ollama 或云端），对话框粘贴/拖拽的图片自动改写为 view_image 路径标记供模型查看。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 接入火山方舟 Agent Plan 与 Coding Plan 的插件，思考强度（low/medium/high/xhigh/max）兼容性已实测验证
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入火山方舟 Agent Plan 与 Coding Plan，支持多档思考强度，即插即用。

description.en: Scan to connect to DSH from your phone—no mobile app required.

WeChat Mini Program automated testing for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — selector-addressed actions, build-freshness gates, geometry-first assertions for text-only models, real screenshots on vision routes · 微信小程序自动化测试 dsh 插件
description.zh: WeChat Mini Program automated testing for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): selector-addressed actions, build-freshness gates, geometry-first assertions that work on text-only models, and screenshot image blocks on vision routes. 微信小程序自动化测试 dsh 插件：选择器寻址、构建新鲜度门、面向纯文本模型的几何断言、视觉路由附真实截图。

description.en: One-click health check for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar button runs the ops kit's check-health.ps1 through a plain HTTP route (independent of the tool registry) and renders a structured report card; colors follow the active theme, Windows/PowerShell.
description.zh: 一键健康检查：侧边栏按钮经纯 HTTP 路由（独立于工具注册表）调用 check-health.ps1 并渲染结构化报告卡片；配色跟随当前主题，Windows/PowerShell。

description.en: DSH-PDF插件，让 AI 助手读取任意大小的 PDF 文件： 通过 pdfjs-dist 提取完整 Unicode 文本层（中文、英文及其它文字系统），并对扫描件/图片页自动 OCR， 手写笔记也能变成可读文本。DSH-PDF plugin — read any-size PDFs in DeepSeek Harness: full Unicode text (Chinese/English) via pdfjs-dist + automatic OCR (Windows WinRT / tesseract.js) for scanned pages. MIT.
A DSH Discussion Mode that keeps complex AI conversations aligned with your goals and turns them into evidence-based next steps.
description.zh: A DSH Discussion Mode that keeps complex AI conversations aligned with your goals and turns them into evidence-based next steps.

description.en: In-web plugin manager for DeepSeek Harness: categorized plugin list, preset bundles with one-click switching, import/export and failure auto-rollback, plugin market with one-click install.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页内管理插件：分类列表、预设整合包一键切换与导入导出、失败自动回退、插件市场一键安装。

description.en: Deepseek harness plugin for reloading your deepseek harness plugin (e.g. mcp-client)

One-click start/stop button pinned to the window bottom-right corner: restarts DeepSeek Harness in place via a detached helper that relaunches the exact boot invocation (loopback same-origin guarded), with an optional stop-only action.
description.zh: 固定在窗口右下角的一键启停按钮：通过脱离终端的辅助进程按原始启动命令重启 DeepSeek Harness（仅本机同源可调），附「仅停止」小按钮。

description.en: Incremental diff reviewer for DSH: after approving a batch, only new changes since the checkpoint are shown, with a Web review panel and `/review` command that inject feedback back to the agent.
description.zh: 增量代码审查插件：批准一批改动后只审查检查点之后的新改动，提供 Web 审查面板与 `/review` 命令，并把审查意见注入回 agent。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for the SeismicX earthquake-catalog skill
description.zh: dsh-seismicx — DSH 插件（技能）

description.en: Advanced form- and file-level settings management with a plugin settings registration SDK.
description.zh: 增强 DSH 设置管理，提供更灵活、更高效的配置选项，让插件设置更顺手。

description.en: Security-audit methodology skill pack: eight agent skills (secret scan, dependency audit, supply-chain review, prompt-injection review, audit orchestration, threat modeling, vuln intel, incident response) in Chinese and English editions, with an optional npm provider bundle.
description.zh: 安全审计方法论技能包：八个 agent 技能（密钥扫描、依赖审计、供应链评审、提示注入审查、审计总编排、威胁建模、漏洞情报、事件响应），中英双版本，附可选 npm provider 包一键挂载。

description.en: Fridge-magnet quick-task stickers docked above the composer: one-click sends a preloaded prompt into the current session, grouped long-term/short-term.
description.zh: 输入框上方的冰箱贴纸栏：把常用任务（科技新闻、GitHub 推荐等）做成贴纸，点击即向当前会话发送预置 prompt 并执行，按长期/短期分组。

description.en: DSH 插件：tokensave 语义图 cli 直连——自动索引 + 更新检测，让 AI 用语义查询代替暴力 grep/读文件，大幅省 token
Unreal Engine .uasset inspection (resolve/registry/load) and restricted Blueprint node editing through built-in UE Python.
description.zh: 通过 Unreal 内置 Python 提供 .uasset 检查与受限蓝图节点编辑。

description.en: DSH 字体插件：界面字体/代码字体/显示比例/行高/字体浏览器 | DSH font plugin: UI/code fonts, display scale, line-height, font browser with CJK glyph marking
description.zh: DSH 字体插件：修改整个界面的文字显示效果（正文字体 / 代码字体 / 显示比例 / 行高 / 字体平滑 / 代码连字 / 字体浏览器 / 中文字形标记），设置 → 字体。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Skin Plugin
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供预设配色皮肤，可一键切换界面主题并记住你的选择。

description.en: Google AI Studio-style floating preview for the Web UI: a draggable/resizable iframe preview with aspect-ratio and resolution presets, plus a VS Code-style code window with direct editing, confirmed writes, and session-log recording.
description.zh: Web UI 悬浮预览与代码窗口：Google AI Studio 风格的 iframe 预览（宽幅比/分辨率预设、一键放大），VS Code 风格代码窗支持直接编辑，保存需确认并写入会话日志。

description.en: WeChat (iLink) channel: chat with your DSH agent from the WeChat app, one persistent session per conversation, reusing DSH credentials.
description.zh: 微信（iLink）通道：用手机微信直接对话 DSH agent，每个对话一个持久会话，复用 DSH 凭据。

description.en: 🐳 DSH 傻瓜整合包：以 Oh-DSH 为基座的 DeepSeek Harness 发行版外壳——核心 17 组件开箱即用、三界面（webui/gui/tui）一包切换、模型↔预设联动、一切皆插件

Multi-character Galgame conversation view with separate character and reply-model selection, per-character affection, memory, dialogue history, and CG galleries, plus responses informed by task events across Harness sessions.
description.zh: 多角色 Galgame 对话界面：角色与回复模型可独立切换，分角色保存好感度、记忆、对话历史与 CG 图鉴，并根据 Harness 跨会话任务事件做出角色回应。

description.en: Conversational DSH plugin finder: four-source unified index, BM25 pre-filter plus LLM semantic ranking, candidates carry evidence grades and local static security audit, safe install flow with post-install verification.
description.zh: 对话式查找 DSH 插件的增强版 skill：四源聚合统一索引，BM25 粗筛 + LLM 语义精排，候选表带证据分级与本地静态安全审计，安装走安全确认流程并自动验证。

description.en: Reuses hooks declared in Claude Code, Codex and opencode configs on dsh, executing shell, webhook, oracle and proxy handlers with zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 把 Claude Code、Codex、opencode 配置里声明的 hooks 原样复用到 dsh，执行 shell、webhook、oracle、proxy 四类 handler，零运行时依赖。

description.en: MiniMax token-plan quota dock for the Web UI: a drop-shape 5h-usage % chip in the conversation input area, click for a detail panel listing every model's 5h & weekly usage and reset countdown, auto-hidden when the active default model is not a MiniMax model.
description.zh: DSH 网页 MiniMax 配额悬浮卡：会话输入区显示水滴形 5h 已用百分比，点击展开详情面板，列出每个模型的 5h/周用量与重置倒计时，当前默认模型非 MiniMax 时自动隐藏。

description.en: Local-first full-duplex voice for DeepSeek Harness, orchestrated by Muxiva
description.zh: Local-first, full-duplex voice for DeepSeek Harness, orchestrated by Muxiva

description.en: Per-task isolated git worktrees with a full create/sync/finish lifecycle: task names auto-derive branches, merge targets are double-checked, and batch cleanup is built in — zero manual git operations.
description.zh: 按任务隔离的 git worktree 工作区，覆盖创建/同步/收尾全生命周期：任务名自动派生分支、合并目标双重校验、内置批量清理——全程零手工 git 操作。

description.en: Design mode for DeepSeek Harness: the design-loop agent preset plus design-principles and design-qa skill packs
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上设计模式，内置设计循环智能体和设计原则、设计 QA 技能包，帮你本地搞定 UI 设计。

description.en: Complement to official Creator mode: stage, validate, live-mount via ctx.plugin, score, and solidify or roll back in-memory tool-plugin trials.
description.zh: 补充官方创造模式：把内存里试过的小工具插件校验、经 ctx.plugin 热挂、打分后固化到盘上或回滚。

description.en: Cooperative timeout guard for ask_user_question: lost or unanswered questions resolve as a structured ASK_TIMEOUT instead of hanging the turn forever.
description.zh: 为 ask_user_question 提供协作式超时守卫：提问卡片丢失或用户未答复时以结构化 ASK_TIMEOUT 结束调用，避免回合无限挂起。

description.en: DSH Web UI 的认证门禁插件，提供 SVG 图形验证码与防暴力破解保护
description.zh: 给 DSH Web UI 加一道登录门，用 SVG 图形验证码拦住暴力破解，保护你的管理界面。

description.en: Provides the bili_summary tool: Bilibili video metadata, subtitle timeline, and sharp-based frame capture with built-in error handling and graceful degradation.
description.zh: 提供 bili_summary 工具：B 站视频元数据、字幕时间轴与 sharp 切帧配图，内置错误处理与优雅降级。

description.en: Session-header button that cycles the conversation width (748-1600px), widening the chat column, composer, and user bubbles together.
description.zh: 会话标题栏按钮循环切换对话宽度（748–1600px），消息区、输入框、用户气泡同步加宽。

description.en: Automatic type-check diagnostics: after the model edits or creates TS files, runs `tsc --noEmit` in the background (debounced per project) and reports errors via the `code_check` tool — grouped by file with line/column, severity and TS error codes, closing the "edit → check → fix" loop.
description.zh: 自动类型检查诊断：模型编辑/创建 TS 文件后后台防抖运行 `tsc --noEmit`，经 `code_check` 工具按文件分组汇报错误（行列号 + 严重级别 + TS 错误码），形成「改 → 查 → 修」闭环。

description.en: DeepSeek API usage dashboard for DSH Web: daily cache-hit/miss and output token statistics from session logs, per-model cost estimates, account balance, 7-day trends, and a composer usage summary.
description.zh: DSH Web 的 DeepSeek API 用量仪表盘：基于会话日志统计每日缓存命中/未命中输入与输出 Token，并展示分模型费用估算、账户余额、7 日趋势和 composer 用量摘要。

description.en: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web GUI 插件：输入 @ 引用工作区文件，体验类似 Claude Code 的 @file。
description.zh: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web GUI 插件：输入 @ 引用工作区文件，体验类似 Claude Code 的 @file。

description.en: DSH-Feishu channel plugin
description.zh: 飞书通道：新建会话选「连接飞书」，飞书消息直接进 DSH 会话。

description.en: Capability transform & assembly engine (Qian Xuesen cybernetics/systems framework): static resident layer manages the skill/MCP/plugin registries, auto-absorbs skills and tool metrics, and drives a negative-feedback evolution loop (scan Sick/Weak → mutate → select promote/reject → 30s rollback); includes a Web UI panel and a GitHub dsh-plugin store bridge.
description.zh: 能力转化与组装引擎（钱学森工程控制论/系统论框架）：静态常驻层管理 skill/MCP/插件三库、自动吸收技能与工具度量，驱动负反馈进化闭环（scan Sick/Weak → mutate → select 晋升/淘汰 → 30s 回滚）；含 Web UI 面板与 GitHub dsh-plugin 商店桥。

description.en: Git hygiene checker: read-only scan of merged and stale branches, oversized tracked files, untracked files and uncommitted work, with cleanup suggestions (it never deletes anything).
description.zh: Git 卫生巡检：只读扫描已合并/过期分支、大文件、未跟踪文件与未提交修改，输出体检报告与清理建议，不自动删除任何东西。

description.en: Conventional-commit enforcement, changelog generation, PR summaries and branch pushes through the plain git CLI.
description.zh: 规范提交（Conventional Commits）、自动 changelog、PR 描述生成与分支推送，纯 git CLI 实现。

description.en: 不用一直在电脑前，远程操控Deepseek Harness，在飞书 / 企业微信 / Telegram 里指挥 DeepSeek Harness：远程派活 · 结果通知 · 危险操作审批
description.zh: 在飞书、企业微信或 Telegram 里远程指挥 DeepSeek Harness，派活、收通知、审批危险操作。

description.en: A green interrupt button beside the send box: silently stops a running agent, which then summarizes its progress and asks for your new requirements, with a customizable interrupt prompt.
description.zh: 发送按钮旁的绿色打断按钮：运行时一键静默中断 AI，AI 停止后总结进展并向你征求新要求，支持自定义打断提示词。

description.en: Vision-augmented DeepSeek adapter: a vision-capable model describes image input, then a text-only DeepSeek model reasons over the description.
description.zh: 视觉增强的 DeepSeek 适配器：由视觉模型把图片描述成文字，纯文本 DeepSeek 模型再基于描述推理。

description.en: Long-task orchestration loop: Codex plans/scores/reviews, DeepSeek executes, Kimi supplements (vision acceptance, summarization, cross-check).
description.zh: 长任务编排闭环：Codex 规划/打分/审核，DeepSeek 执行，Kimi 补充（视觉验收/摘要/交叉验证）。

description.en: Windows Minimal Mode: persistent bash + str_replace_editor dsh plugin — registers an agent preset, provides a working persistent-bash backend on Windows, and exposes a GUI-editable bash path in the plugin-settings section (persisted via the credentials domain).

Mobile adaptation for the DSH Web UI: compact typography, full-width composer with caret fix, drawer sidebar with overlay-close, two-page settings flow, responsive tables and stats, safe touch targets.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 移动端适配：紧凑排版、全宽输入卡（含光标修复）、抽屉式侧边栏（点击遮罩关闭）、两页式设置流程、响应式表格与统计、安全触控目标。

description.en: Task-completion notifications via ServerChan / DingTalk / Feishu / generic webhooks.
description.zh: 任务完成通知：ServerChan / 钉钉 / 飞书 / 通用 Webhook。

description.en: Join ACN from DeepSeek Harness: register this agent, discover others, send messages, read the inbox. Defaults to the China region.
description.zh: 让你的 AI Agent 加入 ACN 网络，自动发现其他智能体并互发消息，默认直连国内节点。

description.en: A plugin market for DeepSeek Harness: search and one-click install GitHub dsh-plugin plugins straight from the web GUI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件市场：在 Web 界面里搜索并一键安装 GitHub 上的 dsh-plugin 插件。

description.en: In-app DSH plugin marketplace panel with curated and full catalogs, keyword and semantic search, Chinese translation, favorites, installed-state tracking, and install/update/uninstall via the official CLI.
description.zh: DSH 内置插件市场面板：精选与全量目录、关键词与语义搜索、中文翻译、收藏、已安装状态，以及通过官方命令安装、更新和卸载。

description.en: Floating restart button for the DSH web GUI: restarts the dsh process in place with a full-screen overlay and auto-reloads the page; no launcher script required, works on Windows/macOS/Linux.
description.zh: DSH 网页界面右下角的一键重启按钮：全屏遮罩原地重启 dsh 进程并自动刷新页面；无需启动脚本，跨 Windows/macOS/Linux。

description.en: Right-click session menu and sidebar session manager: pin, rename, archive, fork, export, copy cwd/id/deep link, and open in explorer or a new window.
description.zh: 会话行右键菜单与侧边栏会话管理：置顶、重命名、归档、分叉、导出、复制工作目录/会话 ID/深链，在资源管理器或新窗口打开。

description.en: Session repair button in the conversation header: detects & fixes session-log corruption — tool-call id swaps, empty call ids (`message must have tool source`), unknown event types from disabled plugins (marks `ignorable`), torn zstd tails, missing final-frame newlines; ghost-style UI, auto-backup before writes.
description.zh: 会话头部一键修复日志损坏，解决会话加载失败、发不出消息的问题。

description.en: Per-session cost & usage report cards: tokens, cache hits, duration.
description.zh: 会话成本与耗时报表：tokens / 缓存命中 / 耗时。

description.en: 智能输入插件 for DeepSeek Harness — 语音输入 + 提示词优化
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上语音输入和提示词优化，说话就能提问，还能把话自动润色成好用的提示词。

description.en: A curated plugin starter pack: batch-installs and configures 15 vetted community plugins across four groups from a Settings-page UI or the /setup command.
description.zh: 精选插件启动包：从设置页或 /setup 命令一键批量安装并配置 4 组共 15 个经过筛选的社区插件。

description.en: Real-time session token usage and estimated cost in the composer stats row, with pricing fetched from DeepSeek official pricing page.
description.zh: 在输入框下方统计行实时显示当前会话累计 token 消耗与估算费用（人民币），价格从 DeepSeek 官方价格页动态获取。

description.en: A 轨迹解读 (trajectory interpretation) tab that summarizes each user round — what was wanted, how the assistant thought and executed, files/commands/errors — via a rules engine plus optional LLM narrative; user messages stay verbatim.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中逐轮回看对话，自动总结用户意图、助手思考与执行过程，并标出文件、命令和报错，帮你快速复盘。

description.en: Professional translation for DSH: 18 target languages, 4 styles (formal/casual/technical/literal), glossary-controlled terminology, and whole-file translation (README/docs/subtitles) with Markdown/code-block format preservation; powered by DeepSeek via SiliconFlow.
description.zh: 专业翻译：18 种目标语言、4 种风格（正式/口语/技术/直译）、术语表控制译名、整文件翻译（README/文档/字幕）并保留 Markdown 与代码块格式；经 SiliconFlow 调用 DeepSeek。

description.en: Conversation header badge showing the DeepSeek Harness version, checking npm for the latest release and prompting upgrades.
description.zh: 会话顶栏徽章：显示 DeepSeek Harness 当前版本，自动检查 npm 最新版本，有新版时提示升级。

Per-turn checkpoints of the whole workspace: every turn ends with a snapshot, the files it changed are listed under that turn in the chat, and any turn can be restored — files, the conversation, or both. Capture is a whole-tree scan rather than a hook on write/edit tools, so edits made by shell commands, external editors or git leave a record too. Restoring the conversation forks it from that turn instead of cutting the original, and a restore can itself be undone. History sits in a shadow git repository under DSH_HOME and never touches your project .git. Requires Git >= 2.20 and Node.js >= 20.
description.zh: 按轮次给整个工作区留检查点：每轮结束存一份快照，本轮改了哪些文件直接列在聊天里那一条下方，任意一轮都能还原——只还原文件、只还原对话，或者全部还原。捕获靠扫描整棵树，而不是挂钩 write/edit 工具，所以 shell 命令、外部编辑器、git 操作改出来的东西同样留痕。还原对话是从那一轮分叉出新会话，不切断原来的会话；还原本身也能撤销。历史存放在 DSH_HOME 里的影子 git 仓库中，不碰项目的 .git。需 Git >= 2.20 与 Node.js >= 20。

description.en: Adds a custom right-click context menu to the sidebar workspace files tree, with new folder, rename, reveal in file manager, open in browser, open in VS Code, copy path, streaming ZIP download, and delete.
description.zh: 为侧边栏「工作区文件」树添加自定义右键菜单：新建文件夹、重命名、在文件管理器中显示、浏览器打开、VS Code 打开、复制路径、流式 ZIP 下载、删除。

description.en: Brings your existing Claude / ChatGPT history into DSH: instant zero-token import of the memories.json inside a Claude export, local Claude Code transcripts with no export needed, and conversations distilled through the model you already configured in DSH. Every memory carries verbatim evidence checked against the source by code — a paraphrase is dropped and counted, and evidence found only in the assistant turns is always routed to review rather than stored.
description.zh: 把你在 Claude / ChatGPT 里已有的历史搬进 DSH：Claude 导出包里的 memories.json 零 token 瞬时入库，本机 Claude Code 记录免导出直读，历史对话用你在 DSH 里已配好的模型提纯。每条记忆都带由代码回原文核对的逐字证据——转述会被丢弃并计数，只在 AI 回复里找到的证据一律转人工确认而非直接入库。

description.en: Escaped, theme-aware HTML code-block rendering service for DSH Web plugins, built on structured syntax-highlight tokens with source line-ending preservation.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 插件的转义与主题响应 HTML 代码块渲染服务，基于结构化语法高亮 token，并保留源码换行符。

description.en: Adds an Optimize prompt control next to the composer send button that rewrites the draft into a structured prompt (plain, sections, or role-task-goal) streamed from the session model, with Use, Undo, Copy and Close.
description.zh: 在输入框发送按钮旁加上「优化提示词」控件，用当前会话模型把草稿流式改写为结构化提示词（plain、sections、role-task-goal 三种风格），并提供使用、撤销、复制与关闭。

description.en: Balance and live session usage for the DSH web UI: header balance button (left of the Session log), dropdown with account balance, real-time token breakdown (cache miss/hit, cache write, output), cache hit rate, and official-rate cost estimates with peak/off-peak auto-switch.
description.zh: DSH Web 余额与会话用量插件：头部余额按钮（Session log 左侧），下拉展示账户余额、实时 token 明细（缓存未命中/命中、缓存写入、输出）、缓存命中率，以及按官方峰谷价自动切换的费用估算。

description.en: Configurable web search hub for the built-in web_search tool: switch the active entry between DeepSeek official native search and Zhipu GLM web_search, with entry and credential management on a Settings page tab.
description.zh: 可配置的原生 web_search 后端：在 DeepSeek 官方原生搜索与智谱 GLM web_search 之间切换当前生效入口，并在设置页管理搜索入口与凭证引用。

description.en: Capture selected DSH, local MCP, or native WebMCP calls as reviewed, parameterized routines, expose typed tools, and replay with fresh approval.
description.zh: 把选定的 DSH、本地 MCP 或原生 WebMCP 调用捕获为经过评审的参数化例程，暴露为带类型的工具，重放时重新请求批准。

description.en: Per-session prompt profiles for DeepSeek Harness: reusable system-prompt sections, grouped into named profiles, sealed into the session prompt.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的按会话提示词配置：可复用的系统提示词片段组成命名配置，并在会话启动时固化进该会话的提示词。

description.en: Select text in a reply and quote it into the composer as an atomic reference chip: delete the whole chip in one keystroke, click it to scroll back and highlight the quoted turn, and expand it into a bounded reference block at send time so the model can tell the quote apart from what the user typed. Also opens the snippet in a side chat, or copies it to the clipboard.
description.zh: 在回复里选中文字，把引用作为原子 chip 写进输入框：一次按键整体删除、点击回跳并高亮被引用的轮次、发送时展开成带边界的引用块，让模型能分清引用与用户输入。另可把片段送进侧边对话，或复制到剪贴板。

description.en: Adds a sentient floating eye to DeepSeek Harness — injects a taming kernel that makes the AI truly understand you, with 11 dynamic eye skins, ghost mode, and zero token cost when AI mode is off.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上会开智的智子：注入驯兽内核让 AI 真正懂你，11 款动态皮肤、幽灵模式，关闭 AI 模式即零 token 消耗。

description.en: Event sounds for DSH: plays a chosen sound on session end, options popup, permission request and stop, with AI-generated character voice lines and a manageable sound library.
description.zh: DSH 声音工坊：在会话结束、弹出选项、请求许可与停止时播放指定音效，支持 AI 角色语音生成与音效库管理。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance in the dsh web sidebar footer with live config hot reload and an editable Settings → Plugins card.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏底部展示 DeepSeek 账户余额，支持配置热重载与可编辑的设置 → 插件卡片。

description.en: Ecommerce operator workbench: CSV batch preview with marketplace column adapters, reproducible profit/six-dimension scoring, public product-page snapshots, Chinese skills, and a replaceable store-policy KB.
description.zh: 电商店主工作台：CSV 批量预览（多平台列适配）、可复算利润与六维评分、公开商品页快照、中文 skills、可替换售后政策知识库。

description.en: Extensible AI-driven group-reaction narrative game framework for DeepSeek Harness: type one action and multiple NPCs each respond in their own chatroom message with avatar illustrations; worlds, locations, NPCs and feature extensions (e.g. a third-party drawing API for dynamic NPC expressions) are added and modified through the harness chat dialog without code.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：可扩展的 AI 群像聊天游戏框架。输入一个行动，多个 NPC 各自回应，每条反应独立成带头像插图的聊天室消息；世界、地点、NPC 与功能扩展（如接入第三方绘图 API 实现 NPC 动态表情动作）都可以在对话框里让 agent 直接添加修改，无需写代码。

description.en: Aquaculture input register completeness and withdrawal-period date check: deterministic findings with rule IDs.
description.zh: 水产养殖投入品记录完整性与休药期日期核对：按规则 ID 输出确定性发现。

description.en: Adds two switchable themes, built-in and local-folder background slideshows, and per-session token usage details to DeepSeek Harness Web and Desktop.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 与桌面端提供两套可切换主题、内置及本地文件夹背景轮播和逐会话 Token 用量明细。

description.en: Adds a model-aware reasoning effort slider with native and animated modes, light and dark palettes, and shared or per-model colors.
description.zh: 为模型添加推理强度滑块，支持原生与动画模式、明暗配色，以及全局或按模型配色。

description.en: Ollama 一家：llm-pi-ai 的 ollama provider、web_search 走 ollama 后端（含 web 行的 provider 选择）一次配齐。
Registers Kimi, Grok, Codex, and MiniMax as DeepSeek Harness model routes, vendor subagent recipes, and kernel_status / kernel_run / kernel_switch tools.
description.zh: 把 Kimi、Grok、Codex、MiniMax 注册成 DeepSeek Harness 的模型路由、各家子代理配方，以及 kernel_status / kernel_run / kernel_switch 工具。

description.en: Local token usage and cost dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: four-segment token breakdown (miss/cache-hit/cache-write/output), cache savings estimate against the miss/hit price gap, per-session drill-down with context-growth curves and anomaly flags, global filters with shareable URLs, monthly budget progress with month-end projection, and day/month aggregate fast-path queries (O(days)) with incremental rescan.
description.zh: DSH 本地 Token 用量与成本统计仪表盘：四段 Token 构成（未命中/缓存命中/缓存写入/输出）、按未命中与命中的价差估算缓存省钱、会话下钻（上下文增长曲线与异常激增标记）、全局筛选可分享 URL、月度预算环形进度与月底外推、日/月聚合快路径查询（O(天数)）+ 增量扫描。

description.en: Registers the TypeSafe/Jev (System One) skill into DeepSeek Harness's global skill layer, so every session can classify, route, score, extract and gate on confidence using typed judgments instead of prompt-and-parse. Ships no API key; the user supplies OPENROUTER_API_KEY.
description.zh: 把 TypeSafe / Jev（System One 判断模型）的构建技能注册进 DeepSeek Harness 的全局技能层，让每个会话都能用带类型的判断做分类、路由、打分、抽取和置信度门控，取代「调大模型再解析回复」。不含任何密钥，API key 由使用者通过 OPENROUTER_API_KEY 提供。

description.en: Connect Notion from the GUI with OAuth 2.0 + PKCE — official Notion MCP, no integration token.
description.zh: 在图形界面中以 OAuth 2.0 + PKCE 连接 Notion —— 官方 Notion MCP，无需集成令牌。

description.en: What's up - a zero-maintenance status board for your sessions. Scans every conversation on the host, extracts a goal + one-line status per session (multi-provider LLM, fingerprint-cached), surfaces half-done, unanswered and recent work in a sidebar panel, and jumps you back into any session with one click.
description.zh: What's up · 在忙啥——零维护的会话动态看板:host 端扫描全部会话,为每个会话提取「目标 + 一句话现状」(多 provider LLM、按指纹缓存),自动发现做到一半、问了没回、近期在推进的事,点卡片一键跳回会话。

description.en: Skills and MCP management console in the settings panel: merged skill catalog across every provider (hierarchical browse by source, online create/edit, independent model and user invocation switches, recoverable trash), GitHub install with multi-select batch install and update checks, MCP server add/edit/remove and enable/disable through the profile patch layer, cross-agent import from Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Cline, Roo Code, Continue and Windsurf, and an independent SDK connection probe.
description.zh: 设置面板里的技能与 MCP 管理控制台：跨全部来源合并的技能目录（按来源分级浏览、在线新建与编辑、模型 / 用户调用独立开关、可恢复回收站）、GitHub 安装（多选批量安装、检查更新）、通过 profile patch 层增删改与启停 MCP 服务器、从 Claude Code / Cursor / Codex / Cline / Roo Code / Continue / Windsurf 一键导入，以及独立的 SDK 连通性探测。

description.en: Edit and regenerate: adds an edit action to user message bubbles, regenerating from that message with images and files carried over and the original model inherited.
description.zh: 编辑重发：在用户消息气泡上多一个「编辑」，改完从那条消息重新生成，图片与文件随行重传，模型继承原会话。

description.en: Free Bing-backed web search provider for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). No API key needed, uses cn.bing.com for mainland China accessibility.
description.zh: godchen520/dsh-web-search-bing 的维护 fork，适配 DSH 0.1.5-rc.1：为内置 web_search 工具提供 Bing 搜索源，直接解析 cn.bing.com 公开 HTML 结果页，无需 API Key，国内可直连，不消耗模型自带搜索额度。端点与结果数量可配置。

description.en: Turns what a design, plan or document claims into a model and decides it: UML diagrams rendered, read and reviewed; state machines, protocols and data models checked as models; migrations tested for coverage and rollback symmetry; concurrency claims mined and routed to the checker that can decide them; dependency graphs audited; reports diffed.
description.zh: 把设计、计划或文档里的声称抽成模型再判定：UML 图渲染、读取与审查；状态机、协议与数据模型按模型判定；迁移检查覆盖与回滚对称；并发声称挖掘后分派给能判定它的工具；依赖图审查；报告对比。

description.en: Select text in any Windows app and read the translation in an always-on-top card next to the cursor: streaming text follows the newest line, up to 15000 characters per request. Windows only.
description.zh: 在任意 Windows 应用里划词，鼠标旁弹出只含译文的置顶卡片；译文流式出现并跟随最新一行，单次上限 15000 字。仅 Windows。

description.en: Makes the built-in web_fetch tool work when Clash / mihomo runs in TUN mode with fake-ip: it lets the fake-ip address ranges (198.18.0.0/15, fdfe:dcba:9876::/64, 2001:2::/48) past the public-address check that otherwise rejects them, while loopback, private and link-local addresses stay blocked as before. Works with no proxy environment variables and no Clash changes.
description.zh: 让内置 web_fetch 在 Clash / mihomo 以 TUN + fake-ip 模式运行时正常工作：只放行 fake-ip 地址段（198.18.0.0/15、fdfe:dcba:9876::/64、2001:2::/48）通过公网地址校验，回环、内网与链路本地地址仍照旧拦截。无需设置代理环境变量，也无需改动 Clash。

description.en: Code preview for dsh-better-sidebar with per-language syntax highlighting, symbol outline, in-file search, and selection-to-conversation.
description.zh: 为 dsh-better-sidebar 提供代码预览：按文件类型语法高亮、符号大纲、文件内查找，选中代码可直接加入对话。

description.en: Kaze Tachinu (The Wind Rises) skin for the DSH Web GUI: a full-screen film wallpaper behind glassmorphism surfaces, sky-blue interaction tokens, redrawn vector logos for the sidebar and home hero, a restyled composer card with themed placeholder text, and a bottom fade on the message list.
description.zh: 宫崎骏《起风了》主题皮肤：全屏电影壁纸配毛玻璃界面，交互色统一为天蓝，侧边栏与首页改用自绘矢量徽标，输入卡重绘为主题化占位文案的云海蓝胶囊，并为消息列加 40px 底部渐隐。

description.en: Autonomous permission classifier for the auto preset: tool-scoped allow/deny rules, an LLM semantic judge, and git checkpointing for unattended sessions.
description.zh: auto（自主模式）权限分类器：工具作用域的放行/拒绝规则、LLM 语义裁判与 git 快照，面向无人值守会话。

description.en: Native RSS monitor for DeepSeek Harness: multi-source subscription, keyword filtering, scheduled polling with smart dedup, and email notifications for new items (HTML template with thumbnail cards), with SMTP passwords stored only in the credential store.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 原生 RSS 订阅监控插件：多源订阅、关键词过滤、定时检查去重、新条目邮件通知（缩略图 HTML 模板），SMTP 密码走凭据库永不落盘，原生设置页四页签体验。

description.en: Adds a Matrix-inspired digital-rain startup animation for DeepSeek Harness, a rectangular light portal that opens to both sides, optional replay when the desktop window reopens, and a green UI theme with adjustable hue.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加黑客帝国风格的数字雨开屏动画、向两侧展开的矩形光门、可选的窗口恢复重播，以及可调色相的绿色界面主题。

description.en: Session health-check: mechanically mines session logs into structured problem tickets (retry loops, tool-error clusters, interrupted turns, token waste) over the official session-query seam; works standalone.
description.zh: 会话体检：基于官方 session-query 接缝，机械挖掘会话日志为结构化问题工单（重试环/工具错误簇/中断回合/Token 浪费）；可独立安装使用。

description.en: A lightweight appearance skin for DeepSeek Harness: custom wallpaper, glass-like panel transparency, and an accent color; server-side settings shared across devices, native light/dark mode left untouched.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 轻量级外观皮肤：自定义壁纸、玻璃质感面板与重点色；服务端持久化、多设备一致，不接管原生深浅色。

description.en: Colored status marks on DeepSeek Harness sidebar workspace rows — waiting for you, running, or recently finished — aggregated per workspace, plus a pinned-conversations section above the list and pinned-only notifications, persisted across restarts.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏的工作区行上显示彩色状态标记（等待你处理、运行中、刚刚完成，按工作区聚合），并在列表上方提供已置顶会话区与仅针对置顶会话的通知，持久保存。

description.en: macOS desktop control for DeepSeek Harness: agent operates non-browser apps (CapCut, Photoshop, WPS, native clients) like a human — 14 tools for mouse, keyboard, scrolling, app activation, windows and screenshots, plus a vision closed-loop (desktop_see for image understanding + desktop_locate for UI element coordinates) that reuses dsh existing vision credentials. GUI-session service starts on demand, no login autostart.
description.zh: macOS 桌面控制插件：agent 像人一样操作非浏览器应用（剪映/PS/WPS/原生客户端）——14 个工具覆盖鼠标/键盘/滚动/应用/窗口/截图，并整合视觉闭环（desktop_see 识图 + desktop_locate UI 定位坐标，复用 dsh 既有视觉凭据）。服务 GUI 会话按需拉起，非登录自启。

description.en: Cut LLM costs: a Jev (System One) classifier vets each turn against a declarative policy and recommends the subagent model route, so routine work runs at flash rates while the main model keeps the hard parts; explicit /route trigger, runtime delegation-capability gate, credential redaction, and offline policy replay over the verdict log.
description.zh: 降低 LLM 成本：Jev（System One）分类器按声明式策略审查每一轮任务并推荐 subagent 模型路由，让常规工作以 flash 价格运行、主模型专注难点；显式 /route 触发、运行时代理能力门控、凭据脱敏，以及基于判定日志的离线策略回放。

description.en: 商品归类层级一致性核对（按章、品目、子目与商品编号的层级关系核对自洽，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）
description.zh: 检查商品归类台账里的编码结构，核对十位商品码及其章、品目、子目前缀是否层层对应。

description.en: Hand-drawn mountain-lake pastoral theme with continuous local-time day/night scenes and a farmer who works while the displayed conversation is running. Architecture reference: xikan0/dsh-outerwilds-theme.
description.zh: 手绘山湖田园主题：按本地时间连续呈现晨昏昼夜，并让农人随当前展示对话的任务运行状态进出田间。插件架构参考 xikan0/dsh-outerwilds-theme。

description.en: Composer stats strip for the DSH Web UI: official CNY pricing with auto-synced peak/off-peak tiers, per-model accounting, live timers, subagent-tree merging, DeepSeek account balance, budget alerts, and streaming cost estimation.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框下方的增强统计条：官方人民币计价（峰谷分时、价目自动同步）、多模型分账、实时计时、子代理树合并、余额直连、预算预警与流式成本估算。

description.en: Evidence-backed UI delivery for coding agents working on existing Web products: declared criteria, criterion-bound artifacts, findings linked to declarations, and repair guidance. Evaluator review does not replace human semantic approval.

Vision for any DSH route: paste images in the Web composer with intent-aware auto-analysis, delegate workspace image reads to a Kimi/MiniMax vision subagent, and materialize pasted originals for editing.
description.zh: 为任意 DSH 路由装上眼睛：Web 输入框贴图按意图自动聚焦分析，视觉子代理代读工作区图片，原图可随时物化编辑。

description.en: Image generation workbench and agent tool for DSH: one tool (ark9_generate_image) paints text-to-image and image-to-image via any OpenAI-compatible API. Channels are entirely user-configured - no bundled endpoint, you bring your own baseURL, key and model name (manual input supported). Agent-initiated generations are approval-gated by default: requests queue in the floating panel and nothing bills until you approve; approval is non-blocking (the agent replies "awaiting your approval" immediately, and results, denials or timeouts are injected back so the agent reports them in the next turn). Floating glass workbench with five tabs (Generate / Approvals / Prompts / History / About), aspect-ratio grid with quality-budget + 16px-alignment sizing, transparent background, batch up to 10 images as aggregated sub-tasks, prompt library with custom JSON sources fetched through a host proxy, persistent generation logs with one-click retry, multi-channel aggregation with per-channel model fetching, bilingual UI (zh/en), stroke-SVG icon set, config import/export. Registers as a Better Sidebar tab when dsh-better-sidebar is installed; stacks above the dsh-cua FAB when both are present.
description.zh: DSH 生图工作台与 Agent 生图工具：一个工具（ark9_generate_image）走任意 OpenAI 兼容图片 API 文生图/图生图。渠道完全由用户自行添加——默认零预置，自带 baseURL、Key 与模型名即可（支持手动输入任意模型名）。Agent 发起的生图默认需用户审批：请求进入浮窗审批页，批准才开始生成并计费；审批非阻塞——Agent 立即回复"等你审批"，结果、拒绝或超时以通知注入后续轮次并自动汇报。玻璃拟态浮窗五页签（生成/审批/提示词/记录/说明）、比例网格（质量预算+16px 对齐）、透明背景、批量最多 10 张（子任务聚合，部分成功也返回）、提示词库（自定义 JSON 来源经宿主代理拉取）、生成记录持久化与一键重试、多渠道聚合与逐渠道拉模型、中英双语界面、线性 SVG 图标、配置导入导出。安装 dsh-better-sidebar 自动注册侧栏页签；与 dsh-cua 共存时自动堆叠其悬浮按钮上方。

description.en: Real Madrid dual-mode skin: Bernabeu night stadium for dark, white-kit pinstripes with crest and 1902 layers for light. Unofficial fan work.
description.zh: 皇家马德里双模式皮肤：暗色为夜场伯纳乌全景，亮色为纯白主场暗纹，队徽与 1902 背号作为背景层（非官方球迷作品）。

description.en: DSH 的轻量 QQ 机器人插件（零运行时依赖）：WebSocket 收群聊/私聊消息接入 dsh 会话，并提供 qq_message / qq_group / qq_bot 三个工具供 AI 主动调用（发消息、发文件、读消息、按需下载附件、群管理、查状态）。自带「设置 → QQ 机器人」页面，支持手机 QQ 扫码绑定，无需手抄凭据。
Metadata-first runtime profiler for DSH agents: turn/step traces, model and tool wall-time timelines, provider usage, retries, errors, and live or historical sessions.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Agent 的运行时分析器：查看 Turn/Step 轨迹、模型与工具耗时、Provider 用量、重试与错误，实时与历史会话都能看。

description.en: Replacement session-title provider for DeepSeek Harness: compresses oversized first prompts instead of failing, and gates weak prompts.
description.zh: 会话标题 provider 替换插件：先把过长或代码密集的首条 Prompt 压缩再调用模型（实测 DSH 版本的内建 provider 在超过 4096 bytes 时直接拒绝、不调用模型），遇到纯问候则等待真正的任务。默认使用该会话自身的 provider 与 model，保护人工标题；标题规则支持字数上限、可选日期前后缀、风格、语言与排除词，并可按会话锁定标题。还可批量重优化历史会话标题，进度浮层在关闭设置页后继续运行。

description.en: Ships a skill about writing DSH skills - SKILL.md frontmatter and root precedence, how to phrase a description so it actually triggers, length and splitting rules, and an A/B check that the finished skill changes agent behaviour. The package also carries the checker the skill uses to validate a skill directory.
description.zh: 携带一份讲怎么写 DSH 技能的技能——SKILL.md 的 frontmatter 与技能根优先级、description 怎么写才会被触发、篇幅与拆分标准，以及「写完后怎么证明它真管用」的 A/B 验证。包里还带着供这份技能校验技能目录的检查脚本。

description.en: Local decision-layer plugin for DSH: a fail-closed command approval gate and ask/gate tools backed by a 144.3M on-device model. Needs a separate local decision service: `pip install phocinae-server`, then download the ~330 MB weights and keep the service running; without it the tool returns `PHOCINAE_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`.
description.zh: DSH 本地决策层插件：失败关闭的命令审批门，以及由 144.3M 端侧模型支撑的 ask/gate 工具。需另装本地决策服务：`pip install phocinae-server` 后下载约 330MB 权重并常驻运行；服务不在时工具会返回 `PHOCINAE_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`。

description.en: 我的 dsh 个人配置项：界面语言、欢迎提示版本、默认模型与对话视图——只按行 id 配值，不插行、不禁行，也不指定新会话挂哪份 agent preset。

Kill AI Slop for DSH — score a received document on three weighted axes (expression, execution, decision), audit work-slop with a delivery-obligation ledger, and machine-verify every quote against the source. Reads docx, pptx, xlsx, pdf, txt, md, csv, json and html. Zero runtime dependencies, zero network, fully local.
description.zh: AI垃圾过滤（Kill AI Slop）：给收到的文件打一个可回溯的体检得分（表达／执行／决策三维加权），用交付承接台账审查工作空转，每条引文回原文机器复核；支持 docx/pptx/xlsx/pdf/txt/md/csv/json/html。零运行依赖、零联网、纯本地计算。

description.en: Agnes AI image and video generation tools for DeepSeek Harness, where long video jobs can be resumed in a later call. Requires an Agnes API key (AGNES_API_KEY).
description.zh: 把 Agnes AI 的生图 / 生视频接成 DSH 原生工具，长视频任务可稍后续查。需设置 Agnes API Key（AGNES_API_KEY）。

description.en: Evidence-list completeness check: maps facts to evidence and reports gaps with rule IDs.
description.zh: 证据清单齐备性核对：把待证事实映射到证据并输出缺口与规则 ID。

description.en: Trusted Iroh mesh networking for DSH hosts, with encrypted peer discovery, remote session delivery, and reachability status.
description.zh: 基于 Iroh 的可信 DSH 主机网状网络：提供加密的节点发现、远程会话投递与连通状态。

description.en: Quote earlier content of the current session into the composer: select text in any message for a Quote pill, or type @ to pick a whole message; the quote travels as a native reference chip and is serialized into the prompt as a blockquote. Client-only, no host routes, no custom session events.
description.zh: 把本会话里更早的内容引用进输入框：在任意消息里划选文字出现"引用"按钮，或输入 @ 选择整条消息；引用以原生 chip 形式存在，发送时序列化为引用块进入 prompt。纯客户端，无宿主路由，无自定义会话事件。

description.en: Dot-matrix backdrop for the DSH Web UI: the dots form the DeepSeek whale or a transparent PNG you import (alpha-masked), each dot carries its own low-frequency force and follows the cursor in manual mode, while an auto screensaver mode sweeps 360-degree waves and full-screen breathing across the artwork; sliders and toggles live under Settings > Plugins.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 加一层点阵背景:点阵可组成鲸鱼剪影,或导入透明 PNG 按 alpha 取主体;每颗粒子各自持有低频外力,手动模式下跟随光标扰动,自动屏保模式则用 360° 任意方向的扫波与全屏呼吸带动整幅图案;鼠标/自动与鲸鱼/照片在参数面板里切换,入口在 设置 → 插件。

description.en: Windows bash tool for DeepSeek Harness: replaces the preset pwsh with Git for Windows or MSYS2 (UCRT64/MINGW64/CLANG64/...) bash while keeping the official terminal contract — workdir, background jobs and timeout promotion, result markers, terminal cards — and adds a settings row that discovers and validates Git/MSYS2 installations.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows bash 工具：用 Git for Windows 或 MSYS2（UCRT64/MINGW64/CLANG64…）的 bash 替换预设里的 pwsh，保留官方终端契约（workdir、后台任务与超时转后台、结果标记、终端卡片），并提供一个可自动发现、校验 Git/MSYS2 安装的设置行。

description.en: Sends a VS Code selection or file path into the open DSH conversation as an @path reference with its line range, inserted at the composer without sending it. Requires the companion VS Code extension shipped as a .vsix inside the bundle (one-click install from the composer, or install it by hand).
description.zh: 把 VS Code 的选区或文件路径以 @路径（含行号范围）插入当前 DSH 对话的输入框，不自动发送；需安装随包附带的 VS Code 扩展（.vsix，可在输入框一键安装或手动安装）。

description.en: Injects conclusions already established in the previous reasoning block after each tool result, so the model continues from them instead of re-deriving the same conclusions.
description.zh: 在每次工具结果后注入上一段思考中已确立的结论，使模型直接沿用而非重复推导。

description.en: Cross-session memory for the model: full-text search all past sessions (SQLite FTS5 via ctx.sessionQuery) and bring the strongest matching excerpts back into the current context.
description.zh: 跨会话记忆：全文检索所有历史会话（复用 ctx.sessionQuery 的 SQLite FTS5 索引），把最强匹配片段带回当前上下文。

description.en: Mobile-viewport fixes for the dsh web GUI: overlay drawer sidebar with swipe gestures, icon-only composer with a mode · model · effort status line, centered popovers, and horizontal-overflow/scrollbar centering fixes.
description.zh: 修复 dsh web GUI 的手机视口体验：抽屉式侧栏与滑动手势、纯图标 composer 与「权限·模型·思考深度」状态行、浮窗居中、横向溢出与滚动条挤压居中修复。

description.en: Automatic provider failover on rate limits or quota exhaustion: switch between providers with configurable per-provider models, a cooldown, and a permanent last-entry fallback.
description.zh: 限流或配额耗尽时自动切换模型提供方：可按提供方配置模型，带冷却机制与永久最终兜底。

description.en: DeepSeek-Harness plugin for multi-model orchestration with recursive task decomposition, dynamic routing, quality gates, failure recovery, and KPI reporting.
description.zh: DeepSeek-Harness 多模型编排插件，支持递归任务拆解、动态路由、质量门控、失败恢复与 KPI 报表。

description.en: SSH terminals, SFTP file transfer and text editing inside DeepSeek Harness, with server troubleshooting through host models.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内使用 SSH 终端、SFTP 文件传输与文本编辑，并通过宿主模型排查服务器问题。

description.en: Classic Macintosh (System 7) pixel theme: desktop pattern canvas, Finder sidebar, monochrome buttons and dialogs, light/dark support.
description.zh: 经典麦金塔 System 7 像素风主题：桌面网点画布、Finder 侧栏、黑白按钮与弹窗，深浅色随官方外观切换。

description.en: Git worktree isolation for DeepSeek Harness: create a worktree, register it as its own workspace, and start the session inside it
description.zh: 给每个任务单独开一个 Git worktree 并注册成独立项目，让 AI 会话在隔离环境里干活，互不干扰。

description.en: A cozy offline vocabulary trainer for the whole family: 1094 curated words, spaced repetition, 6 quiz types, spelling games and a lazy large-screen mode; opens as a sidebar panel and also runs standalone as one HTML file.
description.zh: 舒服的离线背单词全家桶：1094 个精选单词、间隔重复、6 种题型、拼写游戏和躺着背大字模式；侧边栏面板打开，也可作为单个 HTML 文件独立运行。

description.en: Composer readouts for the DeepSeek Harness: CJK-weighted draft token count, session spend at official peak/idle rates, context occupancy, and what the same usage would have cost on the costliest other model; client-only, with no host half and no credential access.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 输入框下方的实时草稿 token 数、按官方高峰/空闲费率计算的会话花费、上下文占用，以及同样的用量在最贵的另一个模型上会花多少；纯客户端，没有 host 半，不接触凭据。

description.en: Self-evolution actuator: consumes problem tickets mined from session logs, synthesizes skill candidates (zero-code tiers by default) behind an eval gate with hold-out canaries, then promotes to project .dsh/skills with human confirm and deterministic rollback.
description.zh: 自进化执行器：消费会话日志挖掘出的问题工单，在评测门（hold-out canary 防作弊）下合成技能候选，人工确认晋级到项目 .dsh/skills 并支持确定性回滚。

description.en: Third-party menu manager for the DSH Web UI: collects new menu entries added by other plugins into one place, with fold/collapse and pinned menu items.
description.zh: 第三方菜单管理器：统一收纳第三方插件的新增菜单入口，提供常规折叠与固定菜单项。

description.en: Minimal ↑/↓ input history for the DSH web composer: press ↑/↓ to walk back through sent messages. Nothing else.
description.zh: DSH 会话输入框的极简输入历史：按 ↑/↓ 翻阅发过的消息。只有方向键，别无其他。

description.en: DingTalk IM channel via Stream-mode WebSocket: each chat drives its own tooled agent; replies stream back as messages, no public callback URL needed.
description.zh: 钉钉 IM 双向 channel（Stream 模式）：每条单聊/群聊驱动一个 agent，思考与回复通过 WebSocket 长连接回流消息，免公网回调。

description.en: A helmeted pixel chicken rides a bicycle along a Minecraft-style pixel strip docked at the bottom of the app frame, with an 80-second day/night cycle, bell with note particles, jumps, a headlight, and ride stats. Creepers roam by day and zombies by night. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-alpha.
description.zh: 一只戴头盔的像素小鸡骑行在 GUI 底部的我的世界像素风骑行带里，带 80 秒昼夜循环、按铃音符、跳跃、车头灯与骑行统计。白天苦力怕出没，夜晚僵尸被撞飞。需要 DSH >=0.2.1-alpha。

description.en: Use your logged-in web AI (DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Qwen, Doubao...) as model providers in DeepSeek Harness. Web models emit tool calls, DSH runs them under its native permission system, and results return to the same web session. No API keys.

Boot-time guard that repairs corrupt session logs, preflights plugin composition, vm-checks client artifacts, smoke-tests host apply() and quarantines crash-causing bundles, so a broken plugin can never brick startup.
description.zh: 启动守卫：修复会话日志、预检插件组合、校验客户端工件、冒烟宿主 apply() 并隔离崩溃源，让坏插件再也无法砖掉启动。

description.en: Adds a Spawnd.gg games cabinet to the DeepSeek Harness Web sidebar with search, sorting, hover previews, embedded play, and a minimized player.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 侧边栏中添加 Spawnd.gg 游戏柜，支持搜索、排序、悬停预览、嵌入式游玩和最小化播放器。

description.en: Adds a produced-files card row to the chat and a resizable split-screen preview panel for workspace artifacts (Markdown, source code, CSV, JSON, images, HTML), plus a localhost port preview.
description.zh: 在对话中新增产出文件卡片行，并提供可拖拽分屏的产物预览面板，支持 Markdown、源码、CSV、JSON、图片、HTML，以及本地端口预览。

description.en: Focus board for DeepSeek Harness agents: durable, model-maintained notes in the session workspace that pin the objective, constraints, and decisions across compaction and sessions, with automatic context injection, archive on clear, and an optional web panel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness agent 提供持久化专注板：在会话工作区维护目标、约束与决策笔记，跨压缩与会话存活，支持自动注入上下文、清空归档与可选 Web 面板。

description.en: Backs up DSH profiles and mints a desktop "revival coin" that restores the harness after a failed boot or install: a boot guard runs a two-phase health check (HTTP 200 plus client render), marks good boots, isolates or rolls back bad ones, and keeps 3 rotating snapshots. Cross-platform.
description.zh: 备份 DSH 环境，启动或安装失败时通过桌面"复活币"一键恢复：内置启动守卫做两阶段健康检查（HTTP 200 + 客户端渲染），标记正常启动、隔离或回滚异常启动，并轮换保留 3 份快照。跨平台。

description.en: Focus-aware notifications for DeepSeek Harness: approvals, questions, plan reviews and finished replies appear as one alert only when the conversation window loses focus; background conversations alert at any time and subagent sessions never do.
description.zh: 焦点感知的 DeepSeek Harness 通知插件：审批、提问、方案确认与回复完成统一为一种提醒，当前对话在窗口失焦后才弹出，后台对话随时提醒，子代理会话不提醒。

description.en: Realtime token counter beside the deep-thinking indicator in chat, with merged or split input/output display, per-step operation counts, and auto-scaling K/M/G/T units.
description.zh: 在聊天页“深度思考”指示旁实时显示 token 计数，支持输入/输出合并或分列展示、逐步骤操作计数与 K/M/G/T 自适应单位。

description.en: Persistent image or MP4 wallpaper for the DSH Web profile: a wallpaper card under Settings -> General selects a local image or MP4 (up to 300 MB), tunes surface opacity and blur, compresses video locally to H.264 when ffmpeg/ffprobe are on PATH, stores media under ~/.dsh/wallpapers, and pins the Web server to port 9191 so the saved wallpaper survives restarts.
description.zh: DSH Web 持久化背景图/视频插件：在 设置 -> 通用 中提供壁纸卡片，可选本地图片或 MP4（最大 300 MB），调节表层透明度与模糊；检测到 ffmpeg/ffprobe 时在本机把视频压缩为 H.264；媒体保存到 ~/.dsh/wallpapers；并将 Web 服务固定到 9191 端口以便重启后恢复壁纸。

description.en: Drag-and-drop reordering, official/third-party dividers and a stash panel for the buttons DSH renders in the sidebar, the sidebar footer, the conversation tabs, the composer dock and Settings. Only display position changes; the plugin registry is untouched.
description.zh: 对 DSH 投放到侧边栏顶部、侧边栏底部、对话标签、输入框停靠行与设置页导航的插件按钮做拖拽排序、官方/第三方分隔线与按钮收纳。只改变显示位置，不改动插件注册表。

description.en: Ponytail lazy-senior-dev ruleset for DeepSeek Harness: a 7-rung minimal-code ladder (YAGNI, reuse, stdlib, native, installed deps, one line, minimum), six skills (main rules, over-engineering review, repo audit, debt ledger, gain scoreboard, help), a /ponytail session command for lite/full/ultra/off levels, and optional always-on ruleset injection via config. Vendored verbatim from upstream ponytail (MIT), zero tools registered, clean uninstall.
description.zh: 把「最懒资深工程师」规则集 ponytail 装进 DeepSeek Harness：7 级最小代码阶梯（YAGNI、复用、标准库、平台原生、已装依赖、一行、最小实现），六个技能（主规则、过度工程 review、全仓 audit、debt 欠账台账、gain 计分板、help 速查），/ponytail 会话级调档命令（lite/full/ultra/off），以及可选的每轮常驻规则注入。上游内容 MIT 原样打包，零工具注册，卸载零残留。
