description.en: Scheduled send: fire a drafted message into the bound conversation as a normal user bubble at a set time. Runs host-side, so the browser can stay closed; per-session isolation and restart-safe redelivery.
description.zh: 定时发送：到点将拟好的消息以正常用户气泡发送到绑定的会话。调度在服务端执行，关闭浏览器不影响发送；会话隔离、重启自动补发。

description.en: Give the agent a talking face: seven tools that drive a self-hosted Mynah realtime digital human — speak (queued or interrupting), play a gesture clip, interrupt, list live sessions and channels, check health, add text to its knowledge base.
description.zh: 给 Agent 一张会说话的脸：七个工具驱动自托管的 Mynah 实时数字人——开口说话（排队或打断）、播放动作片段、打断、查看在线会话与频道、健康检查、往知识库加文本。

description.en: DSH knowledge-graph memory with a better-sidebar tab and a standalone /graph-memory/app dashboard: extracts TASK/SKILL/EVENT nodes, recalls across sessions, and ships as the npm package dsh-graphmemory.
description.zh: DSH 知识图谱记忆：better-sidebar「记忆图谱」页签与独立看板 /graph-memory/app；抽取任务/技能/事件节点并跨会话召回，npm 包名为 dsh-graphmemory。

description.en: DSH 插件：每天替你刷一轮 B站 —— 读字幕挑出值得的、每条写一份笔记，值得的就 @ 你
DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin for stock analysis, screening, and strategy backtesting across A/HK/US/JP/KR/TW markets
Terminal plugin — a real shell, workspace sync, persistent state, common-command management, and command completion.
description.zh: 终端插件 — 真 shell、工作区同步、状态常驻、常用命令管理、命令补全。

description.en: Sidebar skill hub: scan Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini skill directories for one-click import, manage global/project skills (toggle, trash), and install from dropped folders, zip archives, or local paths of any size.
description.zh: 侧边栏技能站：扫描 Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini 技能目录一键导入，管理全局与项目技能（启停、回收站），支持拖拽文件夹、zip 包与本地路径（不限大小）安装。

description.en: Publish TXT, Markdown, HTML, PDF, Word, and PowerPoint files as ShareOne links with passwords, watermarks, text-page updates, and TXT/Markdown/HTML comments.
description.zh: 将 TXT、Markdown、HTML、PDF、Word 和 PowerPoint 文件发布为 ShareOne 分享链接，支持访问密码、水印、文本页面更新和 TXT/Markdown/HTML 评论。

description.en: Copy session IDs, send messages to live or saved sessions, and view session token usage.
description.zh: 复制会话 ID、向在线或已保存的会话发送消息，并查看会话 token 用量。

description.en: Right-click menus for the DSH Web UI — copy, cut, paste and select all on text and input areas, plus copy path, reveal in the file manager and open with the default app on file references and links.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面补上右键菜单：文字与输入框可复制/剪切/粘贴/全选，文件引用与链接可复制路径、在文件管理器中定位、用默认应用打开。

description.en: Cohere provider for language models, embeddings, and reranking through Cohere's native APIs in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
description.zh: 通过 Cohere 原生 API 为 DSH 提供语言模型、嵌入和重排序能力的 Cohere 提供商。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime。

description.en: Keeps running, finished-but-unopened and currently open sessions pinned above the workspace groups in the DSH Web sidebar, and lets any session or workspace be pinned there from its own "..." menu.
description.zh: 把运行中、跑完未点开和当前打开的会话固定在 DSH Web 侧栏工作区分组上方，并可从任意会话/工作区的「...」菜单里全局置顶。

description.en: Sync your DeepSeek Harness (DSH) configuration between machines over a private git or WebDAV channel: settings, plugins, MCP servers, skills, agent presets and provider credentials. DSH 配置远程同步插件（私有通道，明文自用）。
Headless Claude Code consultations with advisor, reviewer, and designer roles, returned as reference answers.
description.zh: 以 advisor / reviewer / designer 角色无头调用 Claude Code，回复作为参考答案。

description.en: Adds a Long text button to the composer tool row: write or paste the body in an editor overlay, and on save it is written to <workspace>/.dsh-longtext/<timestamp>_<title>.md and an @ path reference to that file is appended to the composer, leaving the conversation free of the long text itself.
description.zh: 在输入框工具栏新增「长文本」按钮：在编辑器浮层里写或粘贴正文，保存后写入 <工作区>/.dsh-longtext/<时间戳>_<标题>.md，并把该文件的 @ 路径引用追加到输入框，让正文不进入对话。

description.en: Service control panel in DSH Web settings: live host info (PID, versions, uptime, memory/CPU trends, active sessions), npm update banner, and a confirm-guarded graceful stop that warns when tasks are running and can wait for them to finish.
description.zh: DSH Web 设置页的服务控制面板：实时宿主信息（PID、版本、运行时长、内存/CPU 趋势、活跃会话）、npm 更新提醒，以及带确认的优雅停止——任务运行时发出警告，也可等待任务结束后自动停止。

description.en: Desktop pet for the DSH web UI: a draggable pixel-art cat with a pomodoro timer, XP levels, and 30 unlockable facts.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的桌宠插件：可拖拽的像素猫，带番茄闹钟、经验等级与 30 条可解锁的托托事实。

description.en: Token usage and cost dashboard: requests, tokens, RPM/TPM over the last 60 minutes, cache hit rate, per-model and per-provider breakdown, a 12-month activity heatmap, and cost estimated from OpenRouter prices. Data stays in a local ledger; no telemetry.
description.zh: Token 用量与成本看板：请求数、Token、最近 60 分钟 RPM/TPM、缓存命中率、按模型与供应商拆分、12 个月活动热力图，成本按 OpenRouter 公开价目估算。数据只落在本地账本，无遥测。

description.en: Review-first batch automation for DeepSeek Harness: three reviewed samples, a full preview, one approval, then a safe apply across many files.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的审核优先批量自动化：先审核三个样本，预览全部结果，一次批准，再安全地应用到多个文件。

description.en: Update checker (npm edition): a settings page comparing local and latest versions of @deepseek-ai/dsh and every installed plugin, with a red-dot nav reminder and ready-made update commands.
description.zh: 更新检查器（npm 版）：设置页对比 @deepseek-ai/dsh 与已装插件的本地/最新版本，有更新时导航红点提醒，并直接给出更新命令。

description.en: Real PTY terminal panel for the DSH Web UI: host half spawns shells with node-pty (cmd.exe default on Windows), rendered in the browser with xterm.js; multi-tab sessions, dock/floating window, clipboard support.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 终端面板：宿主端 node-pty 真实 PTY（Windows 默认 cmd.exe）+ 浏览器 xterm.js 渲染；多标签会话、停靠/浮动窗口、复制粘贴。

description.en: Survival mode: all sessions share one satiety/health pool — each model step burns satiety, starvation freezes tool calls until fed, with an MC mini-game for gathering food.
description.zh: 生存模式：全局共享一条饱食度与生命，模型每步思考消耗饱食度，饿死后全局工具被冻结，通过 MC 采集小游戏获取食物喂食复活。

description.en: Plugin insight center: one answer to "哪些值得装" — plugin_guide matches needs to plugins, recipe installs whole environments, plugin_rank scores health (0-100), plugin_audit static-scans a local checkout for security, and plugin_verdict outputs install / caution / research / avoid.
description.zh: 插件评测中心：一个答案回答"哪些值得装"——plugin_guide 按需求推荐插件、recipe 安装整套环境、plugin_rank 健康评分（0-100）、plugin_audit 静态安全扫描本地目录、plugin_verdict 给出 install / caution / research / avoid 结论。

description.en: Minimal-compatible first turn for Web root sessions: starts with persistent bash and str_replace_editor, removes automatic workspace and skill context, then restores the selected preset after the first tool call or reply; includes a persistent composer toggle.
description.zh: Web 根会话的首轮精简：先使用持久 bash 与 str_replace_editor，移除自动工作区和技能上下文；首次工具调用或回复后恢复所选预设，带持久 composer 开关。

description.en: Pre-execution guard: a `tools.guard` predicate decides allow, ask or refuse per permission preset for dangerous shell commands (git hook bypass, catastrophic `rm`, download-and-run, git history rewrites) and for edits to credential paths or to files the turn never read, and hands the model the reason plus a working alternative.
description.zh: 执行前拦截：`tools.guard` 谓词按当前权限档位，对危险 shell 命令（跳过 git 钩子、灾难性 `rm`、下载即执行、重写 git 历史）与「写凭据路径」「没读过目标文件的首次编辑」逐条给出放行 / 询问 / 拒绝，并把成因与可行替代写法交回模型。

description.en: ChatGPT-style rich answers inside DeepSeek Harness: entity panels, KPI cards, series charts, sortable tables, nested layers, flow diagrams and local controls.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中呈现 ChatGPT 风格的富文本回答：实体面板、指标卡、多序列图表、可排序表格、嵌套分层图、流程图与本地控件。

description.en: Per-turn USD cost badge in the Web UI: session total in the header and per-turn cost in each message footer, with a hover breakdown.
description.zh: Web UI 美元成本徽标：头部显示会话总成本、每条回复结尾显示该轮成本，悬停看分项。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for rulemux: asks the local rulemux CLI for the rules rendered for this workspace (rulemux inject --agent dsh) and injects the output into the session at the first user turn, once per session. Nothing is written into the workspace for rules; skills are the only part that lands on disk.
description.zh: rulemux 的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：通过 rulemux inject --agent dsh 取当前工作区渲染出的规则，在每次会话的首条用户消息时把输出注入一次。规则不往工作区写任何文件；只有技能会落盘。

description.en: Hosted tool server over MCP: invoice and bank-statement extraction with in-code arithmetic checks, ledger reconciliation in integer cents, PDF and table conversion, SQL dialect transpiling, and mainland-China reachability probes run from a China Mobile network vantage point.
description.zh: 托管工具服务器（MCP）：发票与银行流水提取并做代码内算术校验、按整数分对账、PDF 与表格转换、SQL 方言转写，以及从中国移动骨干网实测大陆可达性。

description.en: Token usage panel for DeepSeek Harness: a bar above the composer opens billing token totals, trend charts, per-model and per-project breakdowns and a custom date range, read from local session logs of DSH, Codex, Claude Code, Trae and WorkBuddy. With a self-hosted portal URL and an app key it also reports usage events to that portal; with neither configured it collects nothing. It exposes token_usage tools plus a ctx.tokenReport service, and never collects conversation content.
description.zh: DSH 的 token 用量面板：输入框上方一条用量条，点开是计费总量、趋势图、按模型/项目/来源的分组明细与自定义日期范围，数据来自本机 DSH / Codex / Claude Code / Trae / WorkBuddy 的会话日志；填了自建服务端地址与 appKey 后，用量事件会实时上报到那个服务端，两者都没配时一个字节都不采集；另提供 token_usage 工具与 ctx.tokenReport 服务。不采集对话内容。

description.en: Loads Claude-style plugins into DeepSeek Harness (dsh): discovers skills, commands and optional SessionStart hooks from Claude plugin directories, with hot command reload and uninstall cleanup.
description.zh: 把 Claude 风格的插件加载进 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）：扫描 Claude 插件目录，接入 skills、commands 与可选的 SessionStart hooks，支持命令热更新与卸载清理。

description.en: DIT.ai provider bundle for DeepSeek Harness: installs 29 OpenAI Chat Completions models and 10 Anthropic Messages models from one DIT_API_KEY, with protocol-specific thinking configuration.
description.zh: DIT.ai 的 DeepSeek Harness 模型接入 bundle：使用一个 DIT_API_KEY 安装 29 个 OpenAI Chat Completions 模型和 10 个 Anthropic Messages 模型，并按协议配置 thinking。

description.en: dsh 插件 · 字符雨：三模式（黑客帝国英文数字 / 道法修仙篆体·嵌入霞鹜篆书 OFL / 甲骨卜辞·嵌入甲骨数据集 CC-BY 4.0）× 七种配色（经典绿/琥珀/赛博青/品红/鎏金/七彩轮转/七彩随机）× 金边发光，三轴自由组合；雨字可标老式注音符号；agent 流式 token 原文实时掺进雨里，雨势随活跃度起伏，透明度/速度/密度/深浅配色可调，双击清屏。
description.zh: 黑客帝国数字雨：对话窗口铺上经典的绿色字符雨背景——雨柱倾泻而下、白炽雨头绿身拖尾，agent 正在生成的 token 原文实时掺进雨里；透明度/速度/密度/字号/配色全部可调，雨势跟随 agent 活跃度起伏。

description.en: Manage native archives by workspace, with search, unarchive, and permanent deletion of individual sessions or fixed batches.
description.zh: 按工作区管理原生归档，支持搜索、取消归档、单项和固定范围批量永久删除。

description.en: A pinned-sessions group in the sidebar, above the workspace list: every pinned session across all workspaces in one collapsible, searchable list, with click-to-open and a hover-revealed unpin button.
description.zh: 侧栏「工作区」上方的一个置顶分组：跨工作区汇总所有置顶会话，可折叠、可就地搜索，点行打开、悬停出现取消置顶按钮。

description.en: Delete sessions of a DeepSeek Harness profile from the UI: session-row menu item with a confirm dialog; the host endpoint deletes the log, projection cache and workspace accounting, cascading through the whole subagent tree. Optionally exposes session_lis

Checks nursing records for entry timing, signatures and assessment-form completeness, against 《病历书写基本规范》 and other published documents. Reports what is missing or out of sequence for a human to review.
description.zh: 依据《病历书写基本规范》等公开文件，核对护理记录的书写时限、签名，以及评估表的完整性。列出缺失或次序不符之处供人复核。

description.en: Hide chosen workspaces from the DSH sidebar and archive their sessions along with them, so those sessions never spill into the ungrouped list. Fully local and reversible; with dsh-archive-manager installed the archiving is real and undoable, otherwise it stays a display-only layer. Restore any hidden workspace from Settings.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏隐藏指定工作区，并把它的会话一并归档，避免这些会话溢出到「未分组」列表。纯本地、完全可逆；装了 dsh-archive-manager 时执行真归档且可撤销，未装时退化为纯显示层。随时可在设置页恢复。

description.en: 维修工单结算核对（按项目金额、配件工时合计与结算总额核对算术自洽，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）
description.zh: 自动核对机动车维修工单的金额和填写完整性，算错、漏填一眼就能发现。

description.en: Find and compose DSH plugins from a task description, then open an independent chat environment or install the plan into the current profile.
description.zh: 根据任务查找并组合 DSH 插件，打开可继续对话的独立环境，或将方案中的插件安装到当前配置。

description.en: Skill usage scoreboard for DSH: counts both per-session deduplicated and per-load usage, scores `skill` tool calls and direct `read` of skill files, and shows the tally in a three-tab settings page (skill ranking, session board, management) with paging and JSON import/export.
description.zh: DSH 的 Skill 使用记分板：同时记录按会话去重与每次加载两种次数，统计 skill 工具调用与直接 read skill 文件两种记分来源，设置页三选项卡（Skill 排行 / 会话榜 / 管理）展示，支持分页与记分 JSON 导入导出。

description.en: Knowledge base with a corrective acquisition loop for DeepSeek Harness: when the agent keeps hitting the same failure, a background worker fetches the web under a rate limit, distills the result into a staging area, and only a two-stage commit makes it recallable — pages without sources are refused.
description.zh: DSH 的纠错式补料知识库：agent 反复撞同一堵墙时，后台 worker 在限流下联网抓取、蒸馏结果先落暂存区，只有两段式 commit 才能进入召回——无来源的页面一律拒绝。

description.en: Token usage dashboard for the whole harness: billed tokens from every session are rolled up per session and turn (uncached input, cache read, cache write and output) with a peak/off-peak CNY cost estimate, and a "Token 用量" entry above Settings in the sidebar opens the dashboard at /token-stats, in a new tab on the web and in an in-app popup on the Desktop. The page recollects and repaints every 60 seconds while the tab is visible. Usage is read from the same session event stream dsh-token-meter consumes, accepting 0.1.x assistant/chunk and 0.2.x assistant/message and assistant/attempt, and counting an attempt repeated after an llm retry as its own billed call; cold history is seeded once from a persisted rollup file and afterwards only logs whose mtime or size changed are re-parsed. Host half and client half ship in the one package.
description.zh: 整个 Harness 的 Token 用量看板：把全部会话的计费 token（未缓存输入、缓存读取、缓存写入、输出）按会话与轮次汇总，并给出高峰/低谷的人民币预估费用；侧边栏「Token 用量」入口（在设置上方）打开 /token-stats 看板，Web 端新标签页、桌面端应用内弹窗。标签页可见时每 60 秒自动重新采集并重绘。用量读取的是 dsh-token-meter 消费的同一条会话事件流，兼容 0.1.x 的 assistant/chunk 与 0.2.x 的 assistant/message、assistant/attempt；llm 重试后的再次采样按一次新的计费计入；冷历史只从持久化 rollup 文件播种一次，之后仅对 mtime/size 变化的日志做增量重解析。宿主半与客户端半在同一个包里。

description.en: Automatically highlights key points, definitions, warnings, and questions in completed assistant answers using one separate model call.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 的助手回答完成后，额外调用一次模型，自动高亮其中的关键点、定义、警告和问题。

description.en: Offline voice input for the DSH Web UI: mic to local FunASR (SenseVoiceSmall), one-click install, no cloud.
description.zh: DSH Web 本地离线语音输入：麦克风经本地 FunASR（SenseVoiceSmall）识别后填入输入框，支持一键安装，全程离线。

description.en: Commitment write-gate: operator-authored rules enforced before a tool call runs — a deterministic guard tier plus an LLM-judge tier, fail-closed by default, every block written to a contradictions log.
description.zh: 承诺写入闸门：由运营者编写的规则在工具调用执行前生效——先是一层确定性守卫，再是一层 LLM 裁判，默认失败即拒绝，每一次拦截都写进矛盾日志。

description.en: Ecosystem-wide plugin health audit: syncs the dsh-plugin topic into a local scored catalog (maintenance / docs / npm + weekly downloads / ecosystem, 0-100, A-D), static security scan with high-finding grade veto, star history snapshots, web leaderboard and agent tools.
description.zh: 插件生态体检：将 dsh-plugin 话题同步为本地评分目录（维护/文档/npm+周下载/生态四维，0-100 分 A-D 级），静态安全扫描高危一票否决，支持 star 历史快照、Web 榜单与 Agent 工具。

description.en: One-click search-engine switcher beside the DeepSeek Harness model picker; changes the dsh-free-search provider, handy on overseas university networks that block the DeepSeek Official search endpoint.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器旁一键切换搜索服务商的下拉菜单；海外大学网络常拦截 DeepSeek 官方搜索，可借此切到其他引擎规避。

description.en: Workspace-scoped Semgrep SAST tool for DeepSeek Harness with a managed Windows x64 runtime, structured bounded findings, cancellation and timeout controls, and user-approved sandbox escalation. Installs from npm as @aaub-software/dsh-semgrep-sast.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的工作区内 Semgrep SAST 工具，提供托管 Windows x64 运行时、结构化有界结果、取消与超时控制，以及经用户批准的沙箱权限升级。npm 包名为 @aaub-software/dsh-semgrep-sast。

description.en: Interactive Side-Assistant Dock to ask quick side questions via /btw with real-time thinking status and history pagination without interrupting the active agent loop.
description.zh: 交互式侧边助手坞：用 /btw 快速提问，实时显示思考状态，历史记录分页浏览。

description.en: Auto-supplement QMD semantic search when the model greps/globs a knowledge-base directory: zero-dependency DSH plugin, async injection via next-step, no manual invocation.
description.zh: 模型在知识库目录执行 grep/glob 搜索时自动补充 QMD 语义检索：零依赖 DSH 插件，异步注入下一步上下文，无需手动调用。

description.en: Exposes bounded Prometheus metrics for DSH sessions, agents, LLM calls, tools, approvals, subagents, and jobs, with a Grafana dashboard and a loopback-only endpoint by default.
description.zh: 导出有界的 DSH Session、Agent、LLM、Tool、Approval、Subagent 与 Job Prometheus 指标，附带 Grafana 仪表盘，Endpoint 默认仅监听回环地址。

description.en: Composer prompt enhancement for DeepSeek Harness: a button beside the model selector rewrites the draft through one auxiliary LLM call and writes the result back in place, with composer undo left intact; a /prompt-enhance slash command returns the rewritten prompt as a command result line without touching the draft; the enhancement call can be pinned to its own fast provider and model in the profile patch; the rewrite policy is faithful - original intent, language and information are kept, code, commands and paths are preserved verbatim, and nothing is invented or padded with placeholder text.
description.zh: 输入框提示词一键增强：模型选择器旁的按钮把草稿经一次辅助模型调用改写后直接写回输入框，输入框撤销不受影响；/prompt-enhance 命令把改写结果以命令结果行显示、不改动草稿；可在 profile 补丁里为增强调用单独固定 provider 和模型；改写忠实原文，保留意图、语言与信息量，代码、命令与路径原样保留，不编造事实、不输出占位文字。

description.en: Policy plugin that gates kubectl by kubeconfig context: hard-deny irreversible verbs outside local clusters, ask for the rest.
description.zh: 按 kubeconfig context 管控 kubectl 调用的策略插件：本地集群外硬拒绝不可逆操作，其余写操作请求人工确认。

description.en: Turns DSH conversations into reviewable community feedback and, after confirmation, submits it to the official DeepSeek Harness Discussions.
description.zh: 将 DSH 对话整理为可审阅的社区反馈，并在确认后提交到 DeepSeek Harness 官方 Discussions。

description.en: Per-conversation system prompt, turn-based context folding, sampling overrides and a low-token pure chat mode for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为单个对话设置系统提示词、按轮数折叠上下文、采样参数，并提供低 token 的纯聊天模式。

description.en: Manages the MCP servers of a DeepSeek Harness profile: lists each server with its connection state and the tools it registers, preflights a configuration before saving it (a missing executable, an npm package name used as a command, an unexpanded variable that would reach the child literally, a URL with no path), and adds servers by pasting a dsh patch fragment or a Claude Code mcpServers block, converted to the dsh shape.
description.zh: 管理 DeepSeek Harness profile 的 MCP 服务：列出每个服务的连接状态与它注册的工具；保存前预检配置（可执行文件缺失、把包名当命令、变量未展开、URL 缺少路径）；粘贴 dsh 配置片段或 Claude Code 的 mcpServers 块即可新增，并自动转换为 dsh 格式。

description.en: Drag-and-drop file attachments as Codex-style cards, with in-app PDF/text/video/audio previews and system-default opening for other formats.
description.zh: 拖拽文件以 Codex 风格附件卡片呈现，支持 PDF/文本/音视频应用内预览，其余格式调用系统默认应用打开。

description.en: Browse the awesome-dsh-plugin catalog from a dedicated page opened through the DSH left sidebar. Search, filter by category or installed state, and sort by stars, downloads, name or date added. Three tabs show all, installed and updatable plugins, with a separate count when update status cannot be determined. Install into the active Web or Desktop profile using the package manager supplied by DSH, while preserving disabled bundles. Reload the profile through HMR when available, with restart guidance otherwise. Installed state is isolated per profile, installation and reload requests are mutually exclusive, and pagination keeps the submitted search. Expired catalog and installed-state snapshots are served immediately while refreshing in the background. Registry updates install the exact catalog version; Git updates force source resolution. The catalog is cached locally for one hour, with mirror, CDN and npm fallbacks.
description.zh: 从 DSH 左侧栏打开独立的插件市场页面，浏览 awesome-dsh-plugin 目录。支持按分类或安装状态筛选、按名称或简介搜索，以及按 Star、下载量、名称或收录时间排序；三个标签分别显示全部插件、已安装插件和可更新插件，并单独提示无法判断更新状态的数量。自动识别当前 Web 或桌面 profile，使用 DSH 提供的包管理器一键安装和更新，保留其他插件的停用状态。支持通过 HMR 重载 profile，不可用时提示重启。各 profile 的安装状态独立，安装与重载互斥，分页保持已提交的搜索条件。目录与安装状态快照过期时先显示本地内容并在后台刷新。npm 插件按目录目标版本精确更新，Git 插件强制重新解析来源。目录在本地缓存一小时，官方源不可达时依次回退到镜像、CDN 与 npm。

description.en: Delete a complete closed turn (question + answer + tool calls) from a DeepSeek Harness session, without deleting the session.
description.zh: 删除 DeepSeek Harness 会话中的一整轮对话（提问 + 回答 + 工具调用），不影响会话本身。

description.en: Offline, deterministic public API catalog search for DeepSeek Harness, with Chinese and English queries plus exact filters for authentication, HTTPS, CORS, status, source tier, and category.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的离线确定性公共 API 目录检索，支持中英文查询，以及认证、HTTPS、CORS、状态、来源层级与分类的精确筛选。

description.en: 投标文件符合性预检（按招标文件逐条核对响应情况，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）
description.zh: 按招标文件逐条核对投标响应台账，只提示漏项和差异，不替你下结论。

description.en: Message box for DeepSeek Harness: finished-conversation and pending-approval notifications with jump-to-conversation and inline approval.

Flags ICD coding pairs that need a coder's attention - dagger and asterisk combinations, combination codes - against GB/T 14396-2016 and published ICD usage notes. Reports the pairs it finds rather than resolving them; the coding decision stays with the coder.
description.zh: 依据 GB/T 14396-2016 与公开的 ICD 使用说明，提示需要编码员关注的 ICD 编码配对——剑号与星号组合、合并编码。只报告发现的配对，不代为判定，编码结论仍由编码员作出。

description.en: Low-contrast graphite dark theme with a frosted-glass sidebar, composer and panels for the DSH Web GUI.
description.zh: 低对比度石墨灰深色主题，侧边栏、输入区与弹层使用可调强度的毛玻璃。

description.en: Finder clipboard paste for macOS: Cmd+C files or folders in Finder, then Ctrl+V in the DSH composer inserts their absolute paths; ordinary text paste with Cmd+V is untouched.
description.zh: macOS Finder 剪贴板粘贴：在 Finder 里 Cmd+C 复制文件或文件夹，回到 DSH 按 Ctrl+V 把绝对路径插入输入框；普通文本粘贴的 Cmd+V 不受影响。

description.en: On Windows, the available bash tool is limited to Git Bash and PowerShell is disabled.
description.zh: 让 Windows 上可用的 bash 工具限制为 Git Bash,并禁用 PowerShell。

description.en: Lab/project progress management for DeepSeek Harness: 16 progress_* agent tools (item CRUD, day-board pages, daily records, global search, overview, gantt, comments, import/export) plus a 「进度」sidebar tab in better-sidebar hosting the original web UI; data lives in the session project's .progress/progress.json.
description.zh: 「进度」实验/项目进度管理：16 个 progress_* agent 工具（安排增删改查、画板页、每日记录、全局搜索、概览、甘特、留言、导入导出），并在 better-sidebar 注册「进度」侧边栏 tab 托管原版界面；数据存会话项目 .progress/progress.json，随项目目录走。

description.en: Persistent Bots and group rooms inside DSH — each Bot keeps its own model, permission preset, workspace and session across restarts, and every answer is a run written to a ledger the sidebar panel replays.
description.zh: DSH 里的常驻 Bot 与群聊房间——每个 Bot 都有自己的模型、权限预设、工作区与重启后仍在的会话，每次回答都是一条写进运行记录的 run，侧栏面板据此回放。

description.en: Checks a medical-record front sheet for field completeness and for internal logical contradictions between its fields, against 国卫办医发〔2016〕24号 and other published documents. Lists what is missing or inconsistent for a human to review; it does not assess clinical correctness.
description.zh: 依据国卫办医发〔2016〕24号等公开文件，核对病案首页各字段的齐备性与字段间的逻辑矛盾。列出缺失或不一致之处供人复核，不评价临床正确性。

description.en: Adds a Run button to shell code blocks in replies, executing the snippet through the host shell service and showing its output in a floating bottom-right dock, or in one bottom-panel tab per run.
description.zh: 为回答里的命令行代码框加「运行」按钮，通过宿主 shell 服务执行该命令，输出显示在右下角浮动面板，或每个运行一个底部面板标签页。

description.en: Cross-session event-cue memory for DeepSeek Harness: auto-extracts task/conversation cues and user language habits from every turn into a persistent global cue bank, then re-injects remembered context on topic-switch detection (keyword or vector matching).
description.zh: 跨会话「触点记忆库」插件：自动从每轮对话提取任务/会话级触点与用户惯用词，存入全局持久记忆库；检测到话题切换时重新注入相关历史记忆（关键词或向量匹配）。

description.en: Agent- and GUI-controlled DG-LAB Coyote e-stim plugin: eight `coyote_*` tools plus a DSH web panel behind one safety envelope (soft limits, asymmetric rate limiter, session cooldown, playback caps, disconnect fail-safe); optional auto-stim layer maps agent events (tool calls, errors, turn end) to bounded pulses; official V3 socket protocol with QR pairing, programmable waveforms. Adults only.
description.zh: Agent 与网页 GUI 双面控制的 DG-LAB 郊狼（Coyote）电击/电刺激插件：八个 `coyote_*` 工具 + DSH 网页面板，共用同一安全边界（软上限、非对称升速限流、会话冷却、播放硬上限、断连即停）；v0.2 起可选自动电击层，把 agent 事件（工具调用/报错/回合结束）映射为有界脉冲；官方 V3 socket 协议 + 二维码配对、可编程波形。仅限成年人。

description.en: Enter-plan-mode tool: gives the model a callable `dsh_enter_plan_mode_enter_plan_mode` that switches the current session into plan mode, pairing with the built-in `exit_plan_mode` for a plan-then-review loop.
description.zh: 进入计划模式工具：给模型一个可调用的 `dsh_enter_plan_mode_enter_plan_mode`，把当前会话切进计划模式，与内置的 `exit_plan_mode` 配对，形成“先规划、后评审”的闭环。

description.en: Desktop only. DeepSeek Web in the Harness right Sidebar with synchronized theme, automatic launch, one-time web sign-in, and one-click question transfer.
description.zh: 仅 Desktop。把 DeepSeek 网页版放进 Harness 右侧栏：同步主题、自动打开、网页登录一次即可保持，并一键把提问带入当前对话。

description.en: Compares existing DSH sessions or runs controlled A/B trials between agent presets, showing aligned timelines, paired metric deltas, explicit success checks, and exportable reports.
description.zh: 对比已有 DSH 会话，或在两套 Agent Preset 之间运行受控 A/B 试验，展示对齐时间线、配对指标差值、显式验收结果与可导出的报告。

description.en: Navigation dots for DSH Web conversations — quickly jump between user messages.
description.zh: DSH 网页端对话导航点 — 快速跳转用户消息。

description.en: 质保期与索赔金额核对（按质保期月数与里程、索赔金额算式核对自洽，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）
description.zh: 检查质保索赔台账的算术和日期是否自洽，帮你在理赔前发现记录错误。

description.en: Checks a hazardous-chemical register for internal consistency: that each substance names its hazard class, that stored quantities parse, that a threshold is recorded, that the major-hazard-source verdict agrees with how the stored quantity compares to the threshold the register states, that safety data sheet numbers are present and CAS numbers are not duplicated. Reports differences for a human to review; it does not decide whether a unit constitutes a major hazard source.
description.zh: 核对危险化学品台账的内部自洽性：每种物质是否载明危险性类别、储存量能否解析、是否记录临界量、重大危险源判定与该储存量相对台账自述临界量的关系是否一致、是否载明安全技术说明书编号、CAS 号是否重复。只列出差异供人复核，不判定某单元是否构成重大危险源。

description.en: Learns a user's coding conventions from instructions and corrections, stores them as confidence-scored rules in editable Markdown, and injects them as reference data into every session. Rules that decay out of range or contradict a newer rule stay visible for review instead of being applied.
description.zh: 从指令和纠正里学习编码习惯，存成带置信度、可手工编辑的 Markdown 规则，并在每个会话中作为参考数据注入。衰减出注入窗口或与更新规则冲突的条目会留在待审列表里，而不是继续生效。

description.en: One-click start/stop launcher for DSH Web on macOS — start (foreground/daemon), stop, status, duplicate-launch guard, auto browser open, plus a Dock-able DSH.app built by script.
description.zh: macOS 上 DSH Web 的一键启停启动器：前台/后台启动、停止、状态、防重复启动、自动打开浏览器，并可用脚本构建程序坞版 DSH.app。

description.en: Session evidence reports: /transcript writes styled HTML / Markdown / JSON reports from canonical logs, /stats prints a terminal stats card, /archive writes per-session ZIPs.
description.zh: 会话证据报告：/transcript 从权威日志生成 HTML/Markdown/JSON 报告，/stats 输出终端统计卡，/archive 打包单会话 ZIP。

description.en: Turn-rail settings for the DSH conversation locator: tick thickness, rail on the left or right, a curved length gradient on the hovered tick, and a plain-text hover preview with adjustable line count, font size and width.
description.zh: DSH 对话定位条的轮次轨道设置：刻度粗细、轨道在左还是在右、锚在悬停那根的曲线长度渐变，以及行数、字号、宽度都可调的纯文本悬停预览。

description.en: Persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness with curated facts, automatic turn retention, and graph- and vector-ranked recall.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供人工记忆、自动对话保留以及图谱和向量排序召回的持久记忆插件。

description.en: Connects an existing local CodeGraph CLI to each session's indexed project, shares one MCP process per project, and updates session-scoped tools when the working directory or index changes.
description.zh: 将本机已安装的 CodeGraph CLI 接入各会话的已索引项目，同项目共享一个 MCP 进程，并在工作目录或索引变化时更新会话级工具。

description.en: Per-session question index for the DSH Web UI: a time-proportional dot rail on the right edge and an expandable chain panel showing every user question with its time, including branch/subagent sessions; clicking a node jumps to that message and highlights it.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 会话提问索引：右缘时间比例圆点窄条与可展开链面板，展示每次用户提问的问题与时间，含分支/子会话；点击节点跳转并高亮对应消息。

description.en: Runs a parallel code review squad of read-only reviewer subagents (security, correctness, tests, style), each optionally on its own model, and aggregates one severity-grouped report from /review or a code_review tool call.
description.zh: 通过 /review 命令或 code_review 工具并行派出只读评审员子代理小队（安全、正确性、测试、风格，各自可指定不同模型），并汇总为按严重度分组的结构化评审报告。

description.en: Stop a running background job from the session-header job list, with a confirmation dialog that restates the full command.
description.zh: 在会话头部的后台任务列表里停止正在运行的任务，确认弹窗会再次显示完整命令。

description.en: Manages the default DSH model, provider and model visibility, and optional OpenAI Responses web search.
description.zh: 管理 DSH 默认模型、Provider 与模型可见性，并支持可选的 OpenAI Responses 联网搜索。

description.en: One-click 💪 prompt enhancement (prompt): thin draft? continue 🔜, unhappy? regenerate 🔄; auto-archive history 🕐 with rollback ↩️; result syncs back to the composer with a line-by-line diff; 🗺️show the panel 🎨 customise the 🪄 prompt-button icon 📍 and button position yourself.
description.zh: 一键增强💪提示词(prompt)——嫌短就继续生成🔜，不满意就重新生成🔄；自动存档历史记录🕐，支持回退 ↩️；结果同步回输入框，差异逐行对比；🗺️显示界面🎨 提示词🪄按钮图标📍按键位置自己定制

description.en: Set the provider, model and reasoning effort delegated subagents run with, from one chip beside the composer: a per-conversation override and a profile-wide default share the same two controls, and the chip always shows the effective route. Applied on the agent/request hook to every in-process child; no settings page, no preset edits, no model-facing tool parameters.
description.zh: 在输入框旁的「子代理」胶囊里统一设置委派子代理使用的 provider、模型与思考强度：卡片的「本对话 / 全局默认」两个范围共用同一组控件，胶囊上始终显示当前生效的路由；经 agent/request 钩子对每个进程内子代理生效，不注册设置页、不改 agent preset、不给工具加模型参数。

description.en: Replaces the stock bash/pwsh terminal rows in the DSH web UI with shell command cards: long commands soft-wrap with line numbers instead of truncating, plus separate copy-command and copy-output buttons.
description.zh: 用自定义 Shell 命令卡片替换 DSH Web 原版 bash/pwsh 工具行：长命令自动换行带行号不再截断，并提供独立的复制命令/复制输出按钮。

description.en: Turn-handoff reminders in the DSH Web UI with a modal or top banner, six browser-synthesized chimes, configurable auto-dismiss, and a sidebar speaker toggle with an unread session list.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的回合交接提醒：居中弹窗或顶部横幅、六种浏览器合成提示音、可配置自动消失，以及带未读会话列表的侧栏喇叭开关。

description.en: OpenCode Go in the DeepSeek Harness model list, providing subscription quota display, model discovery, session affinity, and more.
description.zh: 把OpenCode Go接入DSH的模型列表，提供订阅额度显示、模型发现、会话亲和等功能。

description.en: Channel-grouped session view injected into the sidebar — Workspace/Channels tabs with live-running dots, archived grouping, orphan tagging, built purely on official extension surfaces and serving as the RFC-0001 reference implementation.
description.zh: 侧边栏注入的按渠道分组会话视图——工作区/Channels 双标签、运行中绿点、归档折叠与孤儿工作区标注，完全基于官方扩展面实现，兼作 RFC-0001（discussion #3897）的参考实现。

description.en: Parses DSH session logs to attribute AI-written files, overlays c8 coverage, and reports AI vs human code coverage with a trust score, plus a check/fix/verify tool loop for closing test gaps.
description.zh: 解析 DSH session 日志归因 AI 生成文件，叠加 c8 覆盖率，产出「AI vs 人工代码」覆盖率对比与信任分，并提供 check/fix/verify 三工具闭环补齐测试盲区。

description.en: Adds a Continue button left of the model selector: after a turn ends aborted by the user, interrupted by a crash or errored, one click sends notices asking the model to pick that turn back up, and the button collapses while you type or attach a file.
description.zh: 在模型选择器左侧加一个「继续」按钮：上一轮被用户中止、崩溃中断或报错结束后，点一下让模型接着把那一轮做完；开始输入或添加附件时按钮收窄隐藏。

description.en: Jina provider for embeddings and reranking in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供嵌入和重排序能力的 Jina 提供商。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime。

description.en: Reorder the settings panel nav by long-pressing and dragging a section: the dragged row turns translucent and follows the pointer, the order is saved to the plugin's own folder, and uninstalling restores the official order.
description.zh: 长按拖动即可重排设置面板左侧大项：被拖项半透明并跟随指针，顺序保存在插件自己的目录而非 settings.yaml，卸载后自动恢复官方原序。

description.en: Account balance and cost statistics pill for DeepSeek Harness. It adds a pill at the right-hand end of the official stats row below the session composer, combining the billing period (peak/off-peak, colour-coded), the account balance and the current session cost; clicking it expands a per-session breakdown with cache-hit input, cache-miss input and output amounts, plus cost per model. The rate table is refreshed with plugin releases to follow official pricing.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的账户余额及费用统计胶囊。它在会话输入框下方的官方统计行右侧新增一枚胶囊，集成计费时段（高峰/低谷，用颜色区分）、账户余额与会话费用；点击展开可查看本次会话的详细费用统计，包括缓存命中输入、缓存未命中输入、输出三项金额，以及按模型拆分的花费。费率表随插件版本更新，以跟随官方调价。

description.en: Use ChatGPT and Codex subscriptions in DeepSeek Harness with OAuth, quota runway forecast, safe resets, web search, image generation, and Fast mode.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中直接使用 ChatGPT / Codex 订阅：OAuth 免密、额度续航预测、安全重置、联网搜索、生图与高速模式。

description.en: Browser Use cloud bridge for dsh: run real web tasks — open pages, click, type, fill forms, and extract data — through the Browser Use API.
description.zh: Browser Use 云端桥接：通过 Browser Use API 让 dsh agent 执行真实网页任务，包括打开页面、点击、输入、填表和提取数据。

description.en: Turn chat logs into a panel list maintained by a resident agent. Includes a zero npm-dependency core and an optional WeChat/QQ ingestion pipeline. Installs as a DSH profile bundle.
description.zh: 把微信与 QQ 聊天记录里「必须做的、可以报名的、值得知道的」摘成一张面板：由一个常驻会话按计划或在你点 Fetch 时重读聊天记录并改写条目，每条可直链到原始文件或图片。

description.en: Langfuse observability for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): per-turn trace trees aggregated by session id, with prompt versioning and evaluation.
description.zh: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的 Langfuse 可观测性插件：会话轮次映射为 Langfuse trace 树（同会话经 session id 聚合），提供 Prompt 版本管理与评测能力。

description.en: Codex-style /side side conversations for DeepSeek Harness: a temporary fork of the current chat in a floating panel, inheriting context without interrupting the main task.
description.zh: Codex 风格 /side 侧边对话插件：在当前对话旁开一个浮动分叉面板，继承上下文、不打断主任务。

description.en: Composer code-quote collapse for the DSH Web UI: pasting a `path:line` header followed by code folds the input into one compact inline quote chip, and at send time the `agent/pre-step` hook injects the full pasted snapshot to the model as a separate context message. 0.5.x also folds sidebar file-selections that insert only a `path:lines` line (large selections), fetching the code from disk by session cwd, and preempts Ctrl+V paste interception.
description.zh: 输入框代码引用折叠：粘贴「路径:行号 + 代码」时自动折叠为「文件图标+文件名:行号」引用芯片（Ctrl+Z 可还原），发送时由 agent/pre-step 钩子将完整代码快照作为独立上下文消息注入给模型。0.5 起支持侧边栏「添加到对话框」大段选区（仅插路径行时按会话工作目录读磁盘取代码），并在捕获阶段抢权接管 Ctrl+V 粘贴。

description.en: Detect DSH plugin conflicts and loading failures, quarantine affected bundles and recover them, with offline startup rescue.
description.zh: 检查 DSH 插件冲突与加载故障，隔离和恢复受影响的插件，并在宿主无法启动时提供离线修复。

description.en: Dracula (VS Code) dark theme for the DSH Web GUI: the vampire palette mapped onto the product colour tokens, plus a denser type scale, a 1080px reading column and code blocks that scroll instead of re-wrapping. Dark mode only.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Dracula（VS Code 吸血鬼）深色主题：把产品自身的配色令牌映射到德古拉调色板，并附更紧的字号阶梯、1080px 正文列宽与不折行的代码块。仅深色模式。

description.en: Adds a Forget action to every session row menu, confirmed by a second click in the menu, that removes the session from the sidebar and from disk: running work is stopped, workspace, archive and pin records are detached through official channels, the log directory and projection-cache entries are deleted, and a revive guard re-deletes anything a late write or a lingering handle recreates; memories, attachments and other sessions are left alone.
description.zh: 在会话行菜单加入「遗忘会话」（菜单内二次点击确认），把会话从侧栏与磁盘彻底移除：先停掉正在运行的工作，经官方通道解除工作区、归档与置顶记录，删除日志目录与投影缓存条目，并由复活守卫在一个窗口内补删迟到写入或句柄残留重建的文件；灵枢记忆、附件与其他会话不受影响。

description.en: Load, edit, manage, and hot-reload trusted JavaScript and TypeScript userscripts in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中加载、编辑、管理和热重载可信的 JavaScript / TypeScript 用户脚本。

description.en: Question index: an ordered, collapsible list of your asked questions floating on the right side of the conversation; click a question to jump the session to that point. Auto-indexes each session's full history on open, persists it locally, and jumps to older questions by growing the window on demand.
description.zh: 提问索引：在会话右侧按序展示你提过的问题列表，可收起；点击某条即可把会话滚动跳转到对应位置。打开会话自动索引全部历史提问并本地持久保存；点击更早的提问会按需翻页加载后跳转。

description.en:
Static HTML auditor for Chinese line-breaking: checks explicit-`
` orphan lines, keep-all CSS coverage, CJK line-start/line-end punctuation rules, and protected-phrase splits, then inserts at natural breakpoints; exposes a cn_linebreak_audit tool for agents.
description.zh:
中文网页文案断行静态审查与修复工具：检查显式
孤字行、keep-all 覆盖、标点禁则、保护词被拆等问题，并在自然停顿处自动插入 ；提供 cn_linebreak_audit 工具供代理调用。

description.en: 出口管制物项核对（按管制清单、最终用途与许可证核对台账齐备，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）
description.zh: 按《出口管制法》核对出口管制物项台账与许可证，自动提示差异，不给定性结论。

description.en: Floating community panel for the Web UI: 24h hot topics and hot plugins TOP10 with a draggable, always-on-top button.
description.zh: Web UI 的社区热门悬浮面板：24 小时热门话题与热门插件 TOP10，悬浮按钮可拖动置顶、点击居中展开。

description.en: Cross-agent monitoring board for local AI agent sessions (cursor-ide, claude, codex, copilot, kimi and dsh itself) with session timelines, and message injection behind a default-off two-phase confirmation gate.
description.zh: 跨 agent 看板监控本机 AI agent 会话（cursor-ide、claude、codex、copilot、kimi 及 dsh 自身），提供会话时间线，并可经默认关闭的两阶段确认门注入消息。

description.en: Bridges the agent to a persistent OKF memory vault over MCP stdio: a Python server (SQLite FTS5 + Markdown) with 10 tools for searching and storing decisions, facts, learnings, conventions, profiles and sources.
description.zh: 经 MCP stdio 把 Agent 接入持久化 OKF 记忆库：Python 服务端（SQLite FTS5 + Markdown），10 个工具用于检索与写入决策、事实和偏好。

description.en: Flight recorder panel for DSH sessions: live monitoring, timeline replay with a tool waterfall and event inspector, per-agent cost attribution, and a cross-session cost overview.
description.zh: DSH 会话飞行记录仪面板：实时监视、时间轴回放（工具瀑布与事件检查器）、按 agent 归因成本，以及跨会话成本总览。

description.en: Code RAG semantic index panel and settings card: live index bar with start/rebuild/cancel, plus one-click detection and configuration.
description.zh: Code RAG 语义索引面板与设置卡片：输入框上方的实时索引条（开始/全量重建/取消），以及一键检测与配置（Qdrant/Ollama/预设/ignore）。

description.en: Floating GPU monitor for the DSH Web UI: a compact, draggable strip with one row per discrete GPU (exact name, utilization, VRAM, temperature, power draw) from nvidia-smi, stays visible over side panels and side cards, with a top-VRAM-process list when the driver reports it; degrades to an n/a pill on machines without an NVIDIA driver.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面内置的悬浮 GPU 监控：紧凑可拖动的条带，每张独立 GPU 一行（精确名称、利用率、显存、温度、功耗），数据来自 nvidia-smi；侧边面板或侧边卡片打开时保持在最上层；驱动支持时还列出显存占用最高的进程；无 NVIDIA 驱动的机器会退化为 n/a 胶囊。

description.en: Adds a "History" conversation view tab listing the session's user messages as a clickable directory, with auto-paging and click-to-jump back into the chat.
description.zh: 在会话头部新增「目录」tab：把当前会话的用户消息整理成可点击的目录，自动翻页加载全部历史，点击即跳回对话并定位。

description.en: Ollama provider for language models and embeddings, with model discovery, loading, and unloading in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供语言模型、嵌入以及模型发现、加载和卸载功能的 Ollama 提供商。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime。

description.en: `describe_image` tool: a vision bridge that sends images to mimo-v2.5 through the opencode Zen API (credential `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`, free route first with paid fallback) and returns text descriptions for text-only models, with native passthrough and ImageMagick transcoding of SVG/TIFF/HEIC formats.
description.zh: `describe_image` 视觉桥：经 opencode Zen API（凭据 `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`，免费线路优先、付费兜底）把图片发给 mimo-v2.5、返回文字描述给纯文本模型，原生格式直发，SVG/TIFF/HEIC 等格式经 ImageMagick 自动转码。

description.en: Node.js fork of andyfan1094/dsh-winrm: the same WinRM host panel and seven agent tools, with the backend ported from Python/pywinrm to a native Node WinRM client so the machine running dsh needs no Python.
description.zh: andyfan1094/dsh-winrm 的 Node.js 分支：同样的 WinRM 主机面板与七个 agent 工具，后端从 Python/pywinrm 移植到原生 Node WinRM 客户端，运行 dsh 的机器不再需要 Python。

description.en: Branch-aware code knowledge graph for DSH - callers, impact, trace and architecture over 158+ languages, freshness-gated, one dispatcher tool, zero MCP sessions.
description.zh: DSH 原生分支感知代码知识图谱：调用链/影响面/路径/架构覆盖 158+ 语言，保鲜门控，切分支索引自动跟随，单工具分发零 MCP 会话。

description.en: Infinite canvas for sessions, with regions bound to workspaces and agent presets, pinned session cards, sticky notes and alignment guides.
description.zh: 无限会话画布，区域绑定工作区与智能体预设，可钉住会话卡片、放置便签，带对齐参考线。

description.en: Exits the dsh CLI process automatically when the Web UI closes, with a configurable grace period and dry-run mode.
description.zh: 关闭 DSH Web UI 后自动退出 CLI 进程（等效 Ctrl+C），支持可配置宽限期与试运行模式。

description.en: Adds a writing-plans skill that generates a structured implementation plan document before coding, then executes simple tasks inline or offers an execution choice for complex work.
description.zh: 添加 writing-plans 技能，在写代码前生成结构化实现计划文档，简单任务直接执行，复杂任务提供执行方式选择。

description.en: An always-last, collapsible Recent tasks workspace group in the DSH sidebar: a sidebar entry and the Mod+Alt+N / Mod+Shift+N shortcut start a chat in a dedicated folder, so it lands in that group instead of 未分组. The group is a genuine workspace record rather than a plugin-drawn look-alike, so collapse, rename, search and drag order behave normally, and its folder, group name, pin-last and auto-repair are live settings.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏里常驻末位、可折叠的「最近任务」工作区分组：侧边栏入口与 Mod+Alt+N / Mod+Shift+N 快捷键在专用目录里开新对话，对话因此归入这个分组，而不是「未分组」。该分组是真正的工作区记录，而非插件画出来的仿制品，折叠、改名、搜索与拖拽排序都正常可用；目录、分组名、常驻末尾与自动重建都是实时设置。

description.en: Cross-session and cross-project long-term memory: a non-blocking silent sedimentation dispatch on turn/end writes into a local SQLite store (FTS5 trigram full-text index with insert/update/delete sync triggers) that later turns recall from; entries are scoped per project alongside a global tree, and the plugin ships its own embedded web dashboard (it starts the HTTP server itself, no separate process) for browsing, graphing and controlled deletion.
description.zh: 跨会话、跨工程的长期记忆：turn/end 时非阻塞派发无感静默沉淀，写入本机 SQLite（FTS5 trigram 全文索引，含增删改同步触发器）供后续回合召回；记忆按项目作用域与全局树分层存储，并自带内嵌 Web 看板（插件自身起 HTTP 服务，非独立进程）用于浏览、图谱与受控删除。

description.en: 网文写作工作台完整版（含可选嵌入提供方）

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-linfengqaqtat-dsh-scriptor-full
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for @linfengqaqtat/dsh-scriptor-full

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: ARIS research-workflow skills as a DeepSeek Harness bundle: 82 skills plus cross-model adversarial review through Codex.

DeepSeek balance and usage monitor for DSH: a corner widget showing topped-up balance, per-model period consumption, token breakdown, and a Beijing-time peak/off-peak price reminder. Add a DeepSeek API key in the settings first.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的余额与用量监控：右下角悬浮组件，显示充值余额、按模型的周期消耗、Token 明细，以及北京时间高峰/低谷价格提醒；需先在设置里填入 DeepSeek API key。

description.en: Arrow-key input history for DSH 0.1.2-alpha.1: press ↑ in an empty composer to recall this session's prompts, ↓ to go forward, Esc to restore the draft.
description.zh: DSH 0.1.2-alpha.1 输入框历史：空输入框按 ↑ 召回当前会话刚发过的话，↓ 前进，Esc 还原正在打的草稿。

description.en: Native DeepSeek Harness plugin for IsingQ: guided QUBO modeling and validation on-device, then user-confirmed remote solving.
description.zh: IsingQ 原生插件：引导式 QUBO 建模与本地校验，用户确认后提交远端求解。

description.en: Configurable per-turn budgets for supported file mutations, limiting distinct files, mutation calls, and UTF-8 payload bytes before tool execution.
description.zh: 为受支持的文件修改设置可配置的逐回合额度，在工具执行前限制不同文件数、修改调用数与 UTF-8 载荷字节数。

description.en: Open the extension side panel and it takes over the page you are browsing right now. On top of upstream it adds: hover, coordinate clicks, drag, batched action chains, whole-page screenshots, local file upload, image listing, and switching between several connected browsers. Pages reach the model as structured text with a numbered element list; actions wait for your approval and sensitive fields stay masked. Ships as the bridge plugin, with the extension in the same release. This project is a fork of omdsh-dev/dsh-browser: https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser
description.zh: 打开浏览器扩展侧边栏，就能原地接管你当前正在浏览的网页。在上游基础上补齐了：悬停、坐标点击、拖拽、批量动作链、整页截图、本地文件上传、图片地址列举，并可在多个已连接的浏览器之间切换。页面以带编号的结构化文本交给模型；动作默认需要你批准，敏感字段以掩码呈现。发布的是桥接插件，配套扩展在同一 Release 里。本项目是 omdsh-dev/dsh-browser 的 fork，原仓库：https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser

description.en: On-screen test-progress HUD for DSH — a click-through panel drawn over the app under test, showing each step's expectation vs actual and whether the waiting human may take back the mouse and keyboard. Ships a universal prebuilt binary (arm64 + x86_64), so no Xcode Command Line Tools are needed; the panel itself requires macOS 14+.
description.zh: 把自动测试的进展画在被测界面之上的浮层：每步的期待与实际，以及等待的人现在能不能动鼠标键盘。包内附带通用预编译二进制（arm64 + x86_64），无需 Xcode 命令行工具；浮层面板自身要求 macOS 14 及以上。

description.en: DSH onboarding plugin: recommends plugins across eight domains ranked by weighted GitHub stars and npm monthly downloads, installs the recommended set in one click behind a reviewable plan, and exports or imports an environment code recording a profile's plugin list, exact versions and enabled flags.
description.zh: DSH 新人引导插件：按八个领域推荐插件（GitHub Star 与 npm 近月下载加权排序），先出计划再一键安装，并可导出／导入记录 profile 插件清单、精确版本与启用状态的环境码。

description.en: Routes DSH web search through the current session's model and a self-hosted retrieval backend.
description.zh: 让 DSH 网页搜索改走当前会话模型加自建检索后端。

description.en: Semantic workspace search: three model tools (`zg_search`, `zg_index`, `zg_status`) drive the `zg` CLI for hybrid BM25 + vector + RRF retrieval, with a search-first guard that makes `grep`/`rg` require a prior successful search in an indexed workspace.
description.zh: 工作区语义检索：三个模型工具（`zg_search` / `zg_index` / `zg_status`）驱动 `zg` CLI 做 BM25 + 向量 + RRF 混合检索，并带一层 search-first 守卫——已建索引的工作区里，`grep`/`rg` 需要先成功调用一次检索。

description.en: Self-organizing multi-agent clusters with no orchestrator. Real DSH subagents coordinate through a shared append-only log that each agent reads and writes on its own schedule, with no topology and one dispatch per agent; a snapshot mode is also included where the harness freezes each neighbour view into the prompt and drives a ring/mesh/swarm cluster to convergence.
description.zh: 无编排者的自组织多智能体集群。真实 DSH 子智能体通过共享的只追加日志协调，由各智能体自行决定读写时机，无拓扑、每个智能体只派发一次；另附快照模式，由调度层把邻居视图冻结进提示词并驱动环形/网状/群集收敛。

description.en: Pool AI provider accounts per platform and route them through a local loopback proxy that bridges the OpenAI, OpenAI-Responses, Anthropic and Gemini protocols, then write the proxy into Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Grok, OpenCode, OpenClaw and Hermes config files with snapshot-and-rollback safe writes; registers no agent tools.
description.zh: 按平台把 AI 供应商账号组成算力池，经本地回环代理路由并在 OpenAI、OpenAI-Responses、Anthropic、Gemini 四种协议间桥接，再用带快照回滚的安全直写把代理写进 Codex、Claude Code、Gemini CLI、Grok、OpenCode、OpenClaw、Hermes 的配置文件；不注册任何 agent 工具。

description.en: Manually zoom the Harness Web UI from 75% to 200% via a Settings row, Ctrl+wheel, or a Session-header control, keeping text crisp and readable on high-DPI displays.
description.zh: 在高 DPI 显示器上手动缩放 Harness Web UI（75%–200%）：设置行、Ctrl+滚轮与会话标题栏控件三种入口，让文字更清晰易读。

description.en: Browser-style in-page find bar (Cmd/Ctrl+F) for the desktop app, with highlight-all, a match counter, and a scope picker for the conversation or the right panel.
description.zh: 桌面端浏览器式页内查找条（Cmd/Ctrl+F）：全文高亮、匹配计数，可在对话区与右侧面板间切换搜索范围。

description.en: Per-profile settings overlay for DeepSeek Harness: global settings.yaml stays the baseline while each profile overrides any namespace through its own profiles/<name>/settings.patch.yml — object sections merge recursively, scalars and arrays replace wholesale, and !unset masks an inherited value. The overlay is transparent to existing plugins (they keep reading ctx.settings unchanged), writes land in the profile overlay only, and official schema validation, revision semantics, expectedRevision conflicts, watchers and events are untouched. Ships a settings command family (get/set/unset/mask/unmask/promote/demote/migrate/diff/layers) plus a Profile Settings section in the web Settings panel over a loopback RPC channel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按 profile 分层的设置覆盖：全局 settings.yaml 仍为基线，每个 profile 可用自己的 profiles/<name>/settings.patch.yml 覆盖任意设置命名空间——对象段递归合并，数组与标量整体替换，!unset 显式屏蔽继承值。覆盖层对现有插件透明（照常读 ctx.settings），写入只落在 profile 覆盖层；官方 schema 语义、revision、expectedRevision 冲突检测、watcher 与事件均不改动。附带 settings 命令族（get/set/unset/mask/unmask/promote/demote/migrate/diff/layers），并在 Web 设置面板经 loopback RPC 通道提供 Profile Settings 区块。

description.en: Keep a DSH profile identical across machines through any WebDAV server. The plugin collects the five parts that make up a setup — models (the llm-pi-ai line of cordis.patch.yml), defaults (the agent-default-model line), patch (the remaining loader lines), plugins (package.json dependencies plus dsh.profile.bundles) and dirs (extra absolute-path directories picked in the panel, carried whole and restored to the same path, add-only, at most 5 with 2000 files / 8 MiB each) — encrypts them on this machine with a passphrase (AES-256-GCM, PBKDF2-SHA256 at 600000 iterations) and uploads one ciphertext file to <address>/dsh-webdav/dsh-profile.prop, so the server only ever holds the sealed copy (the older dsh-profile.dshsync name is still read). Merging is per part and three-way against the last synced baseline; a conflict keeps the newer copy and archives the losing one under sync/ (latest 5 per tag), every overwrite is sealed beforehand, and deletions propagate except in the plugins part, on the first sync, and in the dirs part, where dropping a directory on one machine only stops syncing it there and never deletes its files. Uploads carry ETag If-Match and If-None-Match so a concurrent change is refused instead of being clobbered. Sync runs on demand or on a 3/15/30/60 minute timer from a settings panel, and an optional local forwarder (off by default, loopback-only) re-serves the same target with locally generated credentials, rewritten PROPFIND hrefs and .prop aliases for extensionless resources. The local state lives in <profileDir>/.dsh-webdav-sync/ (sync.json is written 0600 and holds the WebDAV password and the passphrase).
description.zh: 通过任意 WebDAV 服务让一台机器上的 DSH profile 与其他机器保持一致。插件收集构成一套配置的五份内容——models（cordis.patch.yml 里的 llm-pi-ai 行）、defaults（agent-default-model 行）、patch（其余 loader 行）、plugins（package.json 的 dependencies 加 dsh.profile.bundles）与 dirs（在面板里挑选的 profile 之外绝对路径目录，连文件整体携带、恢复时写回同一路径，只增不减，最多 5 个、每个 2000 个文件 / 8 MiB）——在本机用口令加密（AES-256-GCM，PBKDF2-SHA256 600000 轮）后上传，服务器上只有一份密文文件 <address>/dsh-webdav/dsh-profile.prop（旧文件名 dsh-profile.dshsync 仍只读识别）。合并按份进行，并与上次同步的基线做三方合并；冲突时保留较新的一份，另一份留档到 sync/（每个 tag 保留最新 5 份），每次覆盖前先封存；删除会传播，但 plugins 份、首次同步与 dirs 份例外——在某一台机器上去掉一个附加目录只是这台不再同步它，里面的文件永不删除。上传带 ETag 的 If-Match 与 If-None-Match，并发改动会被拒绝而不是被覆盖。可从设置面板手动同步，或按 3/15/30/60 分钟定时；可选的本机转发（默认关闭，仅监听 127.0.0.1）用本机生成的账号把同一个目标重新对外提供，并重写 PROPFIND href、给无扩展名资源补 .prop 别名。本机状态在 <profileDir>/.dsh-webdav-sync/ 下（sync.json 以 0600 写入，存 WebDAV 密码与口令）。

description.en: Snapshot-bound multi-agent Git review with independent verification, majority voting, resolution tracking and an AI review gate.
description.zh: 绑定代码快照的多智能体 Git 审阅，支持独立复核、多数投票、问题处置追踪和 AI 审阅门禁。

description.en: Renders LaTeX in the chat — formulas inside your own message bubble, plus a live preview of the composer draft while you type.
description.zh: 在聊天里渲染 LaTeX：你自己的消息气泡内联渲染公式，输入时还会实时预览草稿里的公式。

description.en: Live Markdown rendering and typing enhancements for the DSH web composer - syntax-highlighted code blocks, list/quote continuation, format toolbars.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框 Markdown 实时渲染与输入增强——代码块语法高亮、列表引用续项、格式工具栏。

description.en: Floating FC/NES game hall for DSH Web with fceumm, local ROM upload, and GitHub online library.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 右下角挂悬浮球打开 FC/NES 游戏厅（fceumm），支持本地上传与自填 GitHub 在线库。

description.en: Task kanban where agents claim and hand off work through taskboard_* tools, which cannot move a task to done or canceled — acceptance stays with a human.
description.zh: 任务看板，agent 通过 taskboard_* 工具领活与交接；这些工具无法把任务移到 done 或 canceled，验收由人来做。

description.en: A novel reader docked in the DSH right sidebar, with an AI companion that roasts whatever you just read alongside you - import your own TXT three ways, five reading themes, and saved chapters, progress and annotations. The companion comments as you go, commenting in one of four voices (sharp-tongued, warm, detective or slacker) at a pace you pick, off by default. 434 Chinese classics as a 44 KB catalogue, searchable by title or author, one click to download and read offline, four CDN edges as fallback.
description.zh: 装在 DSH 右侧栏的小说阅读器，搭配 AI 伴读，跟大肥鱼一起吐槽文章、发表看法 - 自己的 TXT 三种方式导入，五套阅读主题，章节、进度与批注保存。伴读跟着你读到哪儿就评到哪儿，吐槽或捧场，可在毒舌、温柔、侦探、摆烂四种腔调中切换，节奏自己定，默认关闭。内置 434 本中文经典，包里只有 44 KB 书目，按书名作者搜索、一键下载即入架离线读，四个 CDN 边缘回退。

description.en: An AI-native multimodal canvas for DSH: preview images, video, audio, 3D models, PDFs, documents, and code; connect ideas and collaborate with agents in a persistent local workspace.
description.zh: AI 原生多模态画布，支持图片、视频、音频、3D 模型、PDF、文档与代码等文件展示与预览；通过节点连线组织素材，与 Agent 共享上下文、协作编辑，内容持久保存在本机。

description.en: One-button prompt optimizer: rewrites the composer draft via a configurable strategy, with an editable template, few-shot examples, pinned models and reasoning effort.
description.zh: 一键提示词优化：按可配置策略改写输入框草稿，提供可编辑模板、Few-shot 示例、指定模型与推理强度。

description.en: Provider plugin for dsh-skill-pack-security: registers the pack's skills/ (zh) or skills-en/ (en) edition on ctx.skills AND the plugin_vet supply-chain gate tool on ctx.tools (license/SBOM/commit-lock/malware scans + five-dimension risk card). Ships both
CapMap docs visualization with Obsidian-style semantic graph and capability panel.
description.zh: CapMap 文档体系可视化：Obsidian 风格语义图谱与能力面板。

description.en: Browse the GitHub issues and pull requests of a workspace's origin remote, filter and comment, close or reopen, and file one as a task on dsh-plugin-taskboard for an agent to claim.
description.zh: 浏览工作区 origin 远端对应的 GitHub issue 与 pull request，筛选、评论、关闭或重开，并可转成任务写到 dsh-plugin-taskboard 的看板上等 agent 领取。

description.en: Permanently deletes a session from the sidebar, waiting for a running turn to stop and cascading to its subagent sessions.
description.zh: 从侧边栏永久删除会话：等待正在运行的回合停下，并级联删除其子代理会话。

description.en: A calmer reading view for DeepSeek Harness with auto-collapsing process, a minimap-style message navigation rail, in-page search, unified failure cards, and generative MCP Apps (SEP-1865) in sandboxed iframes.
description.zh: 阅读视图增强插件——执行过程自动收起、右缘消息导航导轨、页内查找、统一失败卡片，支持生成式 MCP Apps（SEP-1865）沙箱交互。

description.en: Windows-only model provider for Google Antigravity CLI, continuing Darkings/dsh-agy-provider (install as dsh-agy-cli; do not install alongside the original). It reads the Antigravity token from the Windows Credential Manager and sends it only to the Google Cloud Code endpoints, lets DSH own the harness tool policy, streams the tail without rollback, and tracks the real quota windows.
description.zh: Windows 专用的 Google Antigravity CLI 模型提供方，接续自 Darkings/dsh-agy-provider（包名 dsh-agy-cli，请勿与原版同装）。从 Windows 凭据管理器读取 Antigravity 令牌并只发往 Google Cloud Code 端点；Harness 工具策略由 DSH 全权负责，尾流式输出防回滚，并跟踪真实配额窗口。

description.en: Checks each step of a plan before you approve it, using command rules plus Jev or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint with logprobs, and marks steps that can't be undone, affect things outside the workspace, weren't asked for or are too vague on the plan review card.
description.zh: 在你同意执行计划前逐步检查每一步，用命令规则加上 Jev 或支持 logprobs 的 OpenAI 兼容端点，在计划审阅卡片上标出无法恢复、影响工作区以外、需求没提到或描述太模糊的步骤。

description.en: DSH 插件：团队 —— 可保存复用的团队模板，成员可各自使用不同 Agent 预设（能力不同），在会话输入框选中后由队长调度协作并统一汇总。
DSH plugin: model-generated session titles that follow the latest task, remember manual renames, persist their settings, and never fail silently.
Improve the current chat draft before sending with a confirm-before-apply comparison.
description.zh: 在发送前优化当前聊天输入，采用前先对比原文与优化结果。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: show a provider + model icon in the sidebar for every session, updated live from the composer model selector with a last-request fallback for history sessions; aggregator routes render the provider logo with a 10px model logo in the corner.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：在侧边栏为每个会话显示 provider 与 model 图标，跟随输入框选择器即时更新，历史会话回退到最近一次请求；聚合路由（如 opencode-go、traex）显示 provider 主图并叠加 10px model 小图标。

description.en: Checks an electrical work permit for the elements it must carry and for the issue and permission sequence the current electrical safety regulations require. Reports the differences it finds; it does not judge whether the work was safe or whether the permit was validly authorised.
description.zh: 依据现行电力安全工作规程，核对电力工作票应载明的要素，以及签发与许可的先后顺序。只报告发现的差异，不判定作业是否安全、许可是否有效。

description.en: Manage and rank search and page-reading services, including providers from installed plugins, in one settings page.
Enhances native DSH subagents and teams with persistent subagents, improved subagent messaging, and per-member model selection for teams. Adds no extra tools or context beyond the native features.
description.zh: DSH原生子代理和团队增强。提供持久子代理功能，及子代理消息增强。额外支持指定团队成员模型。与原生功能相比，无附加工具及上下文。

description.en: Markdown display enhancements for the DSH Web chat, applied on top of the host renderer rather than replacing it: code blocks become cards with a language label and icon-only wrap and copy buttons, long code blocks, tables and Mermaid diagrams fold behind an expand control, Mermaid fences render as SVG with a diagram and code toggle, a fullscreen viewer with wheel zoom, drag and double-click to fit, and SVG or PNG export, tables get a sticky header and CSV or Markdown copy buttons, and a settings panel adjusts the diagram palette, code font size, the default diagram view and the three fold thresholds.
description.zh: DSH Web 会话的 Markdown 显示增强，在宿主渲染之上加样式与按钮而不替换渲染器：代码块变成带语言名和图标按钮（换行、复制）的卡片；超长的代码块、表格与 Mermaid 图会折叠，底部可展开收起；Mermaid 围栏渲染成 SVG，可在图形与代码间切换，支持全屏查看（滚轮缩放、拖拽、双击适应）以及导出 SVG 或 PNG；表格表头吸顶，并提供 CSV 或 Markdown 复制；设置面板可调图表配色、代码字号、图表默认视图和三类折叠阈值。

description.en: Manages a relay station's many groups and rates for DSH, switching the station's billing group in place and refreshing the model list and rate on stations that expose /v1/token/group; stations without it fall back to read-only and keep serving models.
description.zh: 解决中转站多分组多倍率不方便管理的问题：在提供 /v1/token/group 的站点上就地切换分组并同步刷新模型列表与计费倍率；缺少该接口的站点自动降级为只读，模型仍可正常拉取与调用。

description.en: Token-authenticated REST and SSE bridge with QR pairing, so a phone app can read sessions, send messages and approve tool calls.
description.zh: 带令牌鉴权的 REST 与 SSE 接口，扫码配对后可在手机 App 上看会话、发消息、批准工具调用。

description.en: HAZOP 分析表要素齐备性与偏差推导一致性核对（依据公开的危险与可操作性分析标准，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）
description.zh: 检查 HAZOP 分析表是否合规：逐行核对模板要求的内容，并验证偏差是否真由工艺参数推出。

description.en: Input-box floating translation widget for DSH: translate drafts via session model, Zhipu GLM, or custom endpoints, with preview/replace/append, connectivity testing, and recent history.
description.zh: DSH 输入框悬浮快捷翻译挂件：支持当前会话模型、智谱 GLM 与自定义端点，提供预览/替换/追加、连通性测试及最近历史找回。

description.en: Checks a bid requirement by requirement against a tender requirements pack and reports which requirements appear answered, weakly matched or not located. It reports differences; it does not judge substantive compliance.
description.zh: 按招标要求逐条检查投标文件的响应位置，报告哪些要求看起来有应答、哪些匹配较弱、哪些未能定位。只报告差异，不判断是否实质满足。

description.en: Adds a Codex-style message navigation rail for quickly locating earlier prompts in long DeepSeek Harness Web UI conversations.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 添加 Codex 风格的消息导航轨道，方便在长会话中快速定位历史提问。

description.en: A Kun-Like desktop pet living in the corner of the DSH web UI; switches animations with agent state and plays a voice line on task completion.
description.zh: 住在 DSH Web 界面右下角的坤坤桌宠：随 Agent 状态切换动作，任务完成时播放「你干嘛~哎哟」。

description.en: Right-click any session row in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar to color-tag it with a default red, ten palette colors or a custom picker, persisted locally.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏会话行加右键标色：默认红色、十色色板与自定义取色，颜色本地持久化。

description.en: Renders workspace Markdown files in a standalone full-screen reader with GFM, KaTeX, Mermaid, outline navigation, live file reload, and browser printing/PDF export.
description.zh: 在独立全屏阅读器中渲染工作区 Markdown 文件，支持 GFM、KaTeX、Mermaid、目录导航、文件更新同步以及浏览器打印和 PDF 导出。

description.en: Trip-planning agent preset for mainland China that answers in Chinese: queries 12306 train availability, Fliggy and Tuniu flight and hotel prices, and real Amap transit routes, checks closures and weather, and delivers a single offline HTML roadbook with draggable maps, three hotel price tiers and an itemized budget. Ships 9 skills, an environment doctor that walks users through missing API keys, and a patch for the 12306 MCP server; it plans and queries but never books or pays.
description.zh: 中文旅行规划 agent 预设「旅行规划助手」（面向国内行程）：实时查 12306 余票、飞猪 / 途牛机票与酒店价格、高德真实路线，核实闭馆与天气，交付一份可离线打开的单文件 HTML 路书（可拖动地图、三档酒店、分项预算）；附 9 个技能、引导用户补齐 Key 的环境自检，以及 12306 MCP 的预售期补丁；只规划查询，不代订代付。

description.en: Drop-in enhanced fork of the official workflow tool: a verbatim fork of the stock tool plus a persisted saved-workflow library (workflow_save / workflow_list / workflow_get / workflow_delete / workflow_run_saved) backed by ctx.storageDomain, so scripts can be stored, retrieved and re-run with new arguments.
description.zh: 官方 workflow 工具的 drop-in 增强版：在逐字 fork 的官方工具之上，用 ctx.storageDomain 提供持久化的 saved workflow 库（workflow_save / workflow_list / workflow_get / workflow_delete / workflow_run_saved），可把编排脚本存库、检索并带新参数重跑。

description.en: Local AI-agent request-log panel: aggregates local logs from atomcode, codebuddy, workbuddy, claude, codex, codearts, gemini, cursor, kimi and dsh, and shows per-round latency, tokens, cache, context and tool calls.
description.zh: 本地 AI agent 请求日志面板：聚合 atomcode、codebuddy、workbuddy、claude、codex、codearts、gemini、cursor、kimi、dsh 等本地日志，查看每轮耗时、token、缓存、上下文与工具调用。

description.en: Recreates a workspace folder that was deleted while sessions were still bound to it, and summarizes a stranded session so its context can be reused.
description.zh: 有会话绑定的工作区目录被删时自动重建；并把失去归属的会话折叠成摘要，供新会话导入。

description.en: /compact and auto-compaction summarize with the model selected in the session, not the model that finished the last turn.
description.zh: /compact 与自动压缩使用会话中当前选中的模型来生成摘要，而不是用跑完上一轮的那个模型。

description.en: Use Zed AI hosted models in DSH.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中使用 Zed AI 托管模型。

description.en: DSH plugin: a four-entry learning flow in the session input bar — scaffold a preset, collect candidates, merge reviewed changes, and run a read-only workspace audit.
description.zh: DSH 插件：会话输入区的四入口学习流程——初始预设、收集提炼、关联升级、沉淀复用。

description.en: Reads and writes WPS 365 cloud documents (smart documents and .docx/.xlsx/.pptx) through the locally installed wps365-cli, with conflict checks before writing; requires a WPS 365 enterprise account.
description.zh: 通过本机安装的 wps365-cli 读写 WPS 365 云文档（智能文档与 .docx/.xlsx/.pptx），写入前先做并发冲突比对；需要 WPS 365 企业版账号。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that manages local inference engines.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用于管理本地推理引擎。

description.en: Automatic second-opinion review: a restricted child session re-reads the agent's recent work with read-only tools and delivers at most one evidence-backed note, or stays silent. Requires a model route in the config; the plugin stays disabled until one is set.
description.zh: 自动二审：受限子会话用只读工具复核 agent 最近的工作，最多投递一条有证据支撑的提醒，没有问题则保持沉默。

description.en: Study companion for your materials with guided practice, evidence-grounded feedback, Leitner spaced review, 18 teacher tools, and a Chinese/English student panel using the current DSH session model; requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0, Python 3.11+, and Python runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 面向自选资料的学习陪练，使用当前 DSH 会话模型，提供引导练习、证据反馈、Leitner 间隔复习、18 个教师工具与中英双语学生面板；要求 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0、Python 3.11+ 及 Python 运行时依赖。

description.en: A row of model preset buttons above the composer: left-click switches the session to that preset's provider, model and reasoning effort, right-click opens an editor for it, and each preset can carry a custom name instead of the model id. The editor reads the session's live model catalog, and presets are stored locally.
description.zh: 输入框上方的一排模型预设按钮：左键点击把当前会话切换到该预设的提供方、模型与思考强度，右键点击打开该预设的编辑弹窗，每个预设还可以自定义备注名称而不必使用模型名。编辑弹窗读取当前会话真实的模型目录，预设保存在本地。

description.en: System monitor for kids: a single card summary of CPU, memory and disk.
description.zh: 系统小监控：一张卡片看 CPU、内存、磁盘概况。

description.en: TRAE-style conversation rollback rebuilt for DSH 0.1.7-rc.2: per-turn file checkpoints restore touched files and truncate the model context in place under the same session id. Adds a /rollback doctor framework-contract self-check, an affected-file diff preview computed against the current on-disk state so it stays correct after a restart, a one-click undo-last action with a Ctrl+Shift+Z shortcut, a setting for whether rolled-back messages stay hidden, and English UI text.
description.zh: TRAE 式「回退到本轮对话发起前」：按轮次建立文件检查点，回滚工作区文件并在同一 session id 下原位截断模型上下文，已适配 DSH 0.1.7-rc.2。新增 /rollback doctor 契约自检、按当前磁盘状态实时计算的受影响文件 diff 预览（重启后依然准确）、一键「回退最近一轮」（快捷键 Ctrl+Shift+Z）、「回退后隐藏已回退消息」开关，以及英文界面文案。

description.en: Turns file and directory paths in DSH chat into clickable buttons: click one to preview the file in the right sidebar, or open it with the system default application.
description.zh: 把 DSH 对话中的文件与目录路径变成可点击按钮：点击即在右侧侧边栏预览，或用系统默认程序打开。

description.en: Checks an FMEA worksheet for element completeness and for the arithmetic that follows from it - severity, occurrence and detection against the resulting risk priority number - following published FMEA method standards. Reports inconsistencies; it does not judge whether the ratings themselves are appropriate.
description.zh: 参照公开的 FMEA 方法标准，核对 FMEA 分析表的要素齐备性，以及严重度、发生度、探测度与风险顺序数之间的算术一致性。只报告不一致之处，不评价各项评分数值是否恰当。

description.en: Pre-install supply-chain poison scanner for DSH plugins: AST (JS-X-Ray) + deobfuscation + regex heuristics, exits non-zero on findings for CI gating.
description.zh: DSH 插件安装前投毒扫描：AST（JS-X-Ray）+ 去混淆解码 + 正则启发式，发现即非零退出，可作 CI 门禁。

description.en: Windows only (needs the Edge WebView2 Runtime): pop the current session into an always-on-top WebView2 mini window with a self-drawn title bar, free resizing and a jump back to the main window; adds full-screen and region screenshots that paste straight into the composer, a "ask about selection" pill for text selected in any application, global hotkeys and a settings section.
description.zh: 仅 Windows（需要 Edge WebView2 运行时）：把当前会话一键弹出为常驻置顶的 WebView2 小窗（自绘标题栏、可自由缩放、可跳回主窗），并附整屏与框选截图直插输入框、任意程序划词后的「问大肥鱼」快捷按钮、全局快捷键与设置页。

description.en: Adds a Community Bench tab that reads the public task-conditioned registry and shows the same score everyone sees; it does not compute a local score.
description.zh: 增加社区基准标签页，读取公开的、按任务条件计算的 registry，展示所有人看到的同一分数；不在本地计算分数。

description.en: Lets the agent see the compiled page: renders any page to an image, resolves a PDF point or a text anchor to the exact source line through SyncTeX (and says when a rule is drawn by a package rather than by the body, which is where naive locating is wrong), diffs a page against the previous build so an edit is visible, audits every page for holes the edit introduced, and checks that numbered labels still read in order.
description.zh: 让 Agent 真正看见编译后的页面：把任意一页渲染成图片，用 SyncTeX 把页面坐标或文字锚点解析成源码 file:line（并指出某条横线是宏包画的而不是正文画的——这正是朴素定位最容易出错的地方），把这一页与上一次构建做像素对比，逐页审计本次修改新引入的空洞，并检查图表编号是否仍然顺序正确。

description.en: Partitioned long-term memory for agents, with folders as memory zones, a one-line index first, and a forgetting curve.
description.zh: 分区式长期记忆：用文件夹收纳记忆，先看一行索引再翻对应分区，带遗忘曲线。

description.en: Switch DSH's built-in web_search between the DeepSeek Search API (/v1/tools/search) and the default account search, with automatic fallback, a settings page and a sidebar switch.
description.zh: 给 DSH 内置 web_search 加一个开关：在 DeepSeek Search API（/v1/tools/search）与默认账号搜索之间切换，失败自动回退，并带设置页与侧栏开关。

description.en: Draggable recent-deliverables panel for DSH Web that merges declared deliverables with recently modified workspace files, with filename search, type filters, inline PDF/HTML/image/text previews, and desktop open or reveal actions.
description.zh: DSH Web 的可拖动最近成品面板，合并已声明交付的文件与工作区最近修改的文件，支持文件名搜索、类型筛选、PDF/HTML/图片/文本内嵌预览，以及用桌面应用打开或在文件管理器中定位。

description.en: Adds two buttons to the sidebar footer: one reloads the interface and client plugins only, the other restarts the desktop app together with its Host. A restart is refused while a plugin install is running. Restart is Windows only and returns 409 elsewhere; reload works on all platforms.
description.zh: 在侧栏底部添加两个按钮：一个只重新加载界面与客户端插件，另一个连同 Host 重启整个桌面应用；插件安装期间拒绝重启。重启仅支持 Windows，其他平台返回 409；刷新全平台可用。

description.en: Connects a DSH Host to Slack and Feishu using your own bot applications.
description.zh: 使用自建机器人应用，将一个 DSH Host 接入 Slack 和飞书。

description.en: Deterministic cross-session transcript retrieval: the `recall` tool searches past session logs with explicit scope control.
description.zh: 确定性跨会话检索：`recall` 工具带显式范围控制地搜索历史会话日志。

description.en: Two buttons beside the chat input: one rewrites the draft with the current directory in view, the other inserts a role template from 85 curated entries generated from the bundled `agents/` role library, which the settings card can extend with your own `.md` role files.
description.zh: 对话输入框旁的两个按钮：一个结合当前目录改写草稿，另一个插入角色模板——默认 85 条精选模板由随包携带的 `agents/` 角色库生成，设置卡可用自己的 `.md` 角色文件扩充。

description.en: Dynamic backgrounds and interface skins for DeepSeek Harness. Native customizable animated skins, plus beautiful live wallpapers to download from the marketplace. Built on Open Sea Skin (d-dev0101/open-sea-skin) — do not install both.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 动态背景与界面皮肤。原生个性化动态背景皮肤，以及市场下载精美的动态壁纸。 沿用 Open Sea Skin（d-dev0101）的上游实现，请勿与上游同时安装。

description.en: Windows computer-use capability for DSH: screenshot → vision model → simulated mouse/keyboard with self-evolving knowledge base. Dual-mode plugin tools + skill-only pwsh fallback.
description.zh: Windows 桌面识图+模拟操作能力：截图→vision模型→模拟鼠标键盘，内置自进化应用技巧库。支持插件工具模式和纯skill模式双形态。

description.en: Pasted screenshots become numbered references: each Ctrl+V image is stored in the attachment library under a stable number, listed in a composer-dock thumbnail panel with an image source in the @ menu, and inserted as a reference chip at the caret — automatically after paste when the auto-insert switch is on.
description.zh: 粘贴即编号引用：Ctrl+V 的截图入库后拿到固定编号「图片N」，在输入框旁面板里以缩略图列出，可经 @图片 菜单插入引用；开着「自动插入」时粘贴后直接落到光标处。

description.en: Two DeepSeek Harness tools for the local tempguard watchdog: read temperatures and alertd health, and send alerts through alertd; it does not start or stop the watchdog. Needs the separate tempguard Python watchdog and its alertd service running locally, with projectDir and alertdToken set in the profile patch; there is no npm package, so install from a local clone of the repository subfolder.
description.zh: 为本地 tempguard 温度守护提供两个 DSH 工具：读取温度与 alertd 健康状态，以及通过 alertd 发送告警。需另行在本机运行 tempguard Python 看门狗及其 alertd 服务，并在 profile patch 里配置 projectDir 与 alertdToken；暂无 npm 包，需克隆仓库后从子目录本地安装。

description.en: A secret store for DSH Desktop that keeps API keys in one place and injects them into the assistant's shell as $DSH_* variables.
description.zh: 为 DSH Desktop 提供密钥库，集中保管 API 密钥并以 $DSH_* 变量注入助手的 shell 中。

description.en: Manage $DSH_HOME/.env from Settings and sync Host plus Windows/macOS user environment.
description.zh: 在设置中管理 $DSH_HOME/.env，并同步到 Host 与 Windows/macOS 用户环境。

description.en: Progress tab for the DSH right sidebar: the turn status of the session and the progress long-running tasks reported, in one tab beside the conversation.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏的进度页：会话每一轮的状态与长任务上报的进度集中在一个 tab 里，和对话并排看。

description.en: Edit a sent message in place and resend it as a forked chat, keeping the original: change the text, remove, reorder or add images and files, with session image limits checked before sending (the first message opens a new chat in the same workspace). Also @-references pending images by file name, drag-reorders composer attachments, copies messages together with their images, and adds copy, download and drag-to-composer for images in the conversation.
description.zh: 在消息位置编辑已发消息并以 fork 出的新聊天重发，原聊天保留：改文字、删图、调整图片顺序、补图片或文件，发送前按会话图片限制校验（第一条消息在同一工作区新开聊天）。另外支持输入 @ 按文件名引用待发送图片、拖动调整输入框附件顺序、复制消息时连图片一起复制，以及对话图片的复制、下载和拖进输入框。

description.en: Per-answer timing breakdown: splits each reply into model, tool and other time, with first-token, decode and per-tool totals, and keeps a local JSONL ledger. Needs Node 24 or newer in the DSH runtime.
description.zh: 逐次回答耗时拆解：把每次回复分成模型、工具与其它三段，给出首字、生成与各工具耗时，并在本地落一份 JSONL 账本。需要 DSH 运行时为 Node 24 或更新版本。

description.en: Alibaba Open Code Review for DSH: host-model delegation with native preview/rule tools and a review skill, plus optional OCR-managed reviews.
description.zh: 将阿里 Open Code Review 接入 DSH：通过原生文件筛选、规则工具和审查技能复用当前会话模型，并提供可选的 OCR 独立审查模式。

description.en: Teaching-first CTF solving skill: narrates each step's pattern, tool choice and underlying mechanism, then writes a reproducible writeup under solves/<challenge>/ gated by a nine-section check.
description.zh: 教学式 CTF 解题技能：每步讲清套路、工具选型与底层原理，收尾在 solves/<题目名>/ 生成可复现 Writeup，并用九章质量门校验。

description.en: Read-only Raindrop.io dashboard in the sidebar with collection and tag distribution, top source domains, content types, a 12-month trend and a cleanup backlog, plus two read-only agent tools for analyzing saved bookmarks. Requires a Raindrop.io API token (create an app and paste the token).
description.zh: 侧边栏里的 Raindrop.io 只读仪表盘：分类与标签分布、域名来源 Top、内容类型、近 12 个月趋势与待清理项，并提供两个只读 Agent 工具分析收藏。需 Raindrop.io API token（创建应用后粘贴）。

description.en: Tired of going fullscreen by hand every time you open Harness? This plugin fills the screen for you - auto-maximize (keeps the window buttons) or true fullscreen on launch, then maximize / restore / minimize / always-on-top anytime. It quits only after a native confirmation dialog - Esc, double Esc, or Ctrl+Q; in fullscreen, Esc leaves fullscreen first. The window channel installs itself, so no script or Python is needed; the first install takes effect after two DSH restarts.
description.zh: 如果你嫌每次打开 Harness 都要手动全屏，这个插件可以帮你自动铺满：启动时自动最大化（保留右上角窗口按钮）或真全屏；随时可最大化／还原／最小化／窗口置顶；退出前弹原生确认框，快捷键可选 Esc、双击 Esc 或 Ctrl+Q，且全屏下 Esc 先退出全屏。窗口通道由插件自己安装，无需脚本或 Python，首次安装需重启两次 DSH 生效。

description.en: GitHub-style contribution grid in the Web sidebar showing how many prompts you sent each day, with a switch to count conversations, total tokens or output tokens instead. Counts only messages you sent yourself; injected context is excluded.
description.zh: Web 侧边栏的 GitHub 风格日历网格，按天展示你发出的对话条数，可切换为会话数、Token 总量或输出 Token。只统计你亲手发送的消息，注入的上下文不计入。

description.en: Kids' coding classroom: run Python and LOGO-turtle code, explain, practice, review and step through programs.
description.zh: 小朋友的编程小教室：跑 Python 与海龟画图代码、讲解、练习、点评、分步。

description.en: Plugin quality scorecard for DeepSeek Harness: 0-100 with grade, 6 components, fix suggestions per deduction, batch leaderboard - CLI plus an agent-callable quality_score tool.
description.zh: dsh 插件质量评分卡：0-100 分 + 等级 + 六项分项，逐项修复建议，支持批量榜单 - CLI + agent 可调用 quality_score 工具。

description.en: Split the DSH sidebar workspace list into Active, Session tasks and Inactive sections with manual pins and an activity threshold, keeping the official search, archive filters, row menus and drag and drop, with a one-click switch back to the shipped list. The Session tasks section uses a fixed Windows workspace at D:\files\history-tasks; other platforms must create that directory manually.
description.zh: 把 DSH 侧栏工作区列表分为「活跃 / 会话任务 / 不活跃」三段，支持手动钉住与活跃阈值，保留官方搜索、归档筛选、行菜单与拖拽，并可一键切回官方列表。「会话任务」段固定用 Windows 路径 D:\files\history-tasks，其他平台需自行预建该目录。

description.en: Shows per-turn changes in cyclomatic complexity, cognitive complexity, and maximum nesting depth for TypeScript, Python, and Go in the Web UI, with expandable file and function summaries for code review.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 中展示每轮任务前后的圈复杂度、认知复杂度和最大嵌套深度变化，支持 TypeScript、Python 和 Go，可展开文件和函数查看详情，帮助确定代码审查重点。

description.en: Collapses the global panel entries above the workspace in the DSH Web sidebar into a single toggle in the sidebar footer.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 侧栏里工作区上方的全局面板入口收成侧栏底部的一个开关。

description.en: Adds subscription OAuth and provider Plan API-key logins through Pi adapters, using a DSH-owned credential store.
description.zh: 通过 Pi 适配器接入订阅 OAuth 和厂商 Plan API Key 登录，使用独立的 DSH 凭据存储。

description.en: Keeps the shared default model pinned, so switching the model inside a chat no longer rewrites the global default and no longer lowers that default's reasoning effort.
description.zh: 锁定共享的默认模型：在聊天里切换模型不再改写全局默认值，也不会再被那次切换连带降档推理强度。

description.en: Composer prompt refinement for DSH: rewrites a rough draft into a structured, unambiguous prompt with one-click undo, reference-chip protection, three model sources (composer / account / any OpenAI-compatible endpoint) and disconnect-aware cancellation.
description.zh: DSH 输入框提示词优化：把粗糙草稿改写成结构清晰、无歧义的提示词，支持一键撤回、引用芯片保护、三种模型来源与断连即停。

description.en: Adds a Delete action to archived Session rows that permanently removes the Session log directory, the log directories of its subagent Sessions, its Workspace membership and archive mark, its projection-cache record and its spill directory; a Session the Host still holds is staged and finished at the next start or from a cleanup dialog. It also sweeps abandoned blank placeholders, leftover subagent Sessions and orphaned projection-cache records, and keeps blank placeholders out of the @ reference list.
description.zh: 在已归档会话的行菜单里加入「删除会话」：永久移除会话日志目录、它启动的子代理会话日志、工作区归属、归档标记、投影缓存记录与 spill 溢出目录；宿主仍持有的会话先登记，下次启动或点「完成待删除清理」时完成。另外会清扫被放弃的空白占位、遗留的孤儿子代理与失效的投影缓存记录，并让空白占位不再出现在 @ 引用列表里。

description.en: Connects the MiniMax Code models to DSH - reusing the desktop app's sign-in or signing in on its own - with Anthropic-compatible model access, a live model catalog, the daily check-in that grants the free credits, and a credit balance that follows the model you selected.
description.zh: 将 MiniMax Code 的模型接入 DSH：复用桌面 App 登录态或用设备码自行登录，提供 Anthropic 兼容接入、动态模型目录、每日签到领取免费额度，以及跟随所选模型显示的积分余额与到期提示。
