description.en: Shows the DeepSeek API peak and off-peak hours, the current model's output price and the account balance in the Web UI.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 中显示 DeepSeek API 高峰/空闲时段、当前模型的输出价格与账户余额。

description.en: Expose every model already configured in your local DeepSeek Harness to the LAN over OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints, with API keys, per-key rate limits, a circuit breaker, model filters and usage reports.
description.zh: 把本机 DeepSeek Harness 已配置的全部模型，以 OpenAI / Anthropic 兼容接口开放给同一局域网；自带 API Key、按 Key 限流、熔断、模型过滤与用量报告。

description.en: A 3×3 pad of saved phrases sitting to the left of the composer and tracking the input box's height: clicking a cell inserts its text at the caret as one undoable edit. Presets are editable in place, 9 cells per page up to 12 pages, and the UI follows the DSH language setting. Falls back to a panel above the composer when the window leaves no room.
description.zh: 输入框左侧的九宫格快捷短语面板，高度跟随输入框：点一格就把该条短语以一次可撤销的编辑插入光标处；面板内可就地编辑，每页 9 格、最多 12 页，界面跟随 DSH 语言设置。窗口放不下时退回输入框上方浮层。

description.en: Better Session Topbar: replaces the session topbar title with a workspace and session breadcrumb, switching workspaces, sessions and subagents from topbar dropdowns; adding a workspace hands off to the host's own directory picker, which is the OS folder dialog on desktop.
description.zh: 更好的会话顶栏：把会话顶栏标题换成工作区与会话面包屑，可在顶栏下拉里切换工作区、会话与子智能体；添加工作区直接交给宿主的目录选择，桌面版就是系统文件夹对话框。

description.en: OpenCode Console and OpenCode Go provider for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenCode Console 与 OpenCode Go 两个 provider。

description.en: The dock-base Workbench adapter for the DSH Quick Control panel. The panel core ships separately as `dsh-flash`; this package is what mounts it into dock-base — sidebar/floating panel, activity-bar ⚡, editor view and the dock-flash:openQuickControl command. Requires dock-base; a broken install fails loudly instead of silently doing nothing.
description.zh: DSH 快捷控制面板的 dock-base 工作台适配器。面板本体（开关注册表、皮肤系统、i18n、告警面、host 路由）由 `dsh-flash` 核心单独提供；本包只负责把它挂进 dock-base：侧栏/浮动面板、活动栏 ⚡、编辑器视图与 dock-flash:openQuickControl 命令。需安装 dock-base；装错时会明确报错而不是静默失效。

description.en: Shows a dimmed suggestion of the user's next message in the empty composer after a settled turn; Tab accepts it into the draft and Escape or typing dismisses it.
description.zh: 在一轮对话结束后，用灰字在空的输入框里给出下一句建议；Tab 填入草稿，Esc 或打字忽略。

description.en: The real ComfyUI editor as a sidebar tab in DeepSeek Harness, with per-session tools that read and edit the graph on screen and a panel that can start, stop and restart ComfyUI without installing anything into it.
description.zh: 把真正的 ComfyUI 编辑器作为侧栏标签嵌进 DeepSeek Harness，每会话的工具直接读写屏幕上那张工作流，面板可启停 ComfyUI，且不向 ComfyUI 安装任何东西。

description.en: Alibaba Cloud DashScope provider for Qwen language models, embeddings, reranking, speech, and image generation through native APIs in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
description.zh: 通过阿里云 DashScope 原生 API 为 DSH 提供通义千问语言模型、嵌入、重排、语音和图像生成能力。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime。

description.en: Desktop pet for DSH with voice chat, personas, memory, Bilibili and QQ context, and command-gated computer control; enable DSH built-in voice input first to use voice chat. A fork of dsh-pet (MIT), not installable alongside the original.
description.zh: DSH 桌面宠物：语音聊天、多人设、聊天记忆、B 站视频与 QQ 群记忆（只读本地文件）；「电脑操作」需在面板里显式打开总开关后才响应语音指令，语音聊天需先在 DSH 中启用内置语音输入。dsh-pet（MIT）的 fork，不能与原版同时安装。

description.en: Two-level theme manager for the DSH Web UI: pick a culture / scene, a national flag, a developer palette, or a high-contrast pairing first, then a concrete style (58 built-in palettes, light and dark).
description.zh: DSH Web 两级主题管理器：先选文化 / 场景、国旗、开发者配色或强烈对比配色，再选具体风格，内置 58 套浅色 / 深色配色。

description.en: Adds a comet-like light band that flows along the window edge of DeepSeek Harness — up to four in parallel, colored by each session's model, reversing direction while waiting for your reply, and returning to the composer or the workspace once the conversation ends.
description.zh: 为你的 DeepSeek Harness 添加沿窗口边缘流动的流星式光带 —— 最多四条并行、按会话模型配色、等待回复时反向流动，在对话结束后自行返回对话框或工作区。

description.en: Always-on-top capybara task reporter for DSH Web — a transparent floating pet that narrates each trajectory step in a speech bubble, names the project it reports for, and alerts you when a task completes while you work elsewhere.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 打造的永远置顶的水豚任务播报宠物——透明悬浮气泡逐条播报运行轨迹、标明所属项目，任务完成时提醒正在别处忙碌的你。

description.en: One settings page for every MCP server on your machine. It reads the real config file of 17 other AI tools (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, OpenCode, Trae, Trae CN, Qoder, Gemini CLI, Qwen, Zed, Roo Code, Copilot CLI, Kiro, CodeBuddy, Continue) plus DeepSeek Harness itself, groups servers by the file that declares them, probes each one over JSON-RPC to see whether it starts and which tools it exposes, and gives every server a switch that mounts or unmounts it in DeepSeek Harness without editing the other tools' own files.
description.zh: 一个设置页管理本机所有 MCP 服务器。它读取另外 17 种 AI 工具的真实配置文件（Claude Desktop、Claude Code、Cursor、VS Code、Windsurf、OpenCode、Trae、Trae CN、Qoder、Gemini CLI、Qwen、Zed、Roo Code、Copilot CLI、Kiro、CodeBuddy、Continue）以及 DeepSeek Harness 自身，按声明它的文件分组展示，对每个服务器做一次真连 JSON-RPC 探活，看它能否启动、暴露了哪些工具，并给每个服务器一个开关，把它挂载进或卸载出 DeepSeek Harness —— 全程不改动其他工具自己的配置文件。

description.en: Hermes in the DSH sidebar: start and stop the gateway and dashboard, watch the dashboard beside the chat, and bridge DSH to Hermes. Windows only; requires an existing Hermes install.
description.zh: 把 Hermes 放进 DSH 右侧栏：启停网关和 dashboard，聊天旁边就能看 dashboard，再把 DSH 和 Hermes 接起来。仅 Windows；需已安装 Hermes。

description.en: Normalizes malformed token-usage samples so broken session histories remain loadable.
description.zh: 规范化异常的 Token 用量样本，使损坏的会话历史仍可加载。

description.en: Right-click menu for DeepSeek Harness conversation content: copy the selection or the whole message, copy message images and the preview lightbox to the clipboard as PNG (or save them), open file paths (absolute, relative to the session working directory, or ~/), reveal them in the file manager, open them with another registered application, and copy paths or links. Every candidate path is verified by the Host filesystem before an open action appears.
description.zh: 给 DSH 对话区加右键菜单：复制选中内容或整条消息；把消息图片和点击预览后的大图复制为 PNG 到剪贴板或另存为文件；识别绝对路径、相对会话工作区的路径、~/ 以及代码内联路径，一键打开、 在文件管理器中显示、用其他应用打开、复制绝对/相对路径；链接可打开或复制。所有候选路径都会 先由 Host 文件系统校验存在性，再显示打开项。

description.en: Picks a random installed skin on every DeepSeek Harness launch and enables exactly that skin, with an on/off switch and a shuffle action inside the Skins settings page. Skins the running host would refuse to load are excluded, and a manual switch still applies until the next launch.
description.zh: 每次启动 DeepSeek Harness 时随机启用一个已安装皮肤，并在「设置 → 皮肤」页内提供开关与「立即随机换一个」按钮。宿主会拒绝加载的皮肤自动排除；手动切换的皮肤一直有效到下次启动。

description.en: Input prediction: the likely continuation of your draft appears as grey ghost text after the caret and Tab accepts it, and after each assistant turn 1-3 clickable follow-up suggestions appear above the input box and send on click. Ghost completion, suggestions and the suggestion count can be toggled in Settings, Built-in plugins.
description.zh: 输入预测：在输入框里用灰字续写你草稿最可能的后续，按 Tab 接受后落进输入框、可继续编辑；每轮回答结束后在输入框上方给出 1–3 条你可能会发的下一条，点一下就发送。灰字补全、回复后推荐与推荐条数都能在「设置 → 内置插件 → 输入预测」里开关。

description.en: A gold switch beside the composer that raises every model request to the strongest reasoning effort the current model declares and to its default max output tokens, and adds a system-prompt section asking for exhaustive, self-checked work.
description.zh: 输入框旁一枚金色开关：把每次模型请求的推理强度提到当前模型声明的最高档、输出上限提到其 defaultMaxTokens，并在系统提示里追加一段要求穷尽检索、逐条自检的工作纪律。

description.en: Redraw the left-hand workspace sidebar to add color highlighting, sorting, status indicators, and system notifications. You can also switch back to the original sidebar, which likewise implements some of these features.
description.zh: 通过重绘左侧工作区侧栏，为工作区侧栏添加颜色高亮、排序、收藏、状态指示以及系统通知等功能。同时可切换回原版侧栏，也具有部分功能实现。

description.en: Fork of @michengai/dsh-pua that removes the upstream global kill-switch so the composer entry is always visible while the feature stays off by default and can be toggled per session; the entry is a dropdown (Turn on / Turn off / Options) with a more compact options panel.
description.zh: 基于 @michengai/dsh-pua 的修订版：解除上游「全局总闸」，让入口恒常显示、功能默认关闭并可按会话开关；入口改为下拉菜单（打开 / 关闭 / 选项），选项面板更紧凑。

description.en: Routes web search and fetch, records estimated costs, and provides local budgets, circuit breakers, and diagnostics. Requires Node.js >=22.19 and DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 or 0.2.1-rc.3.
description.zh: 路由网页搜索和抓取，记录估算费用，并提供本地预算、渠道熔断和诊断功能。需 Node.js >=22.19 与 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 或 0.2.1-rc.3。

description.en: MCP manager for DeepSeek Harness Web: a Settings page beside Plugins that lists the MCP servers the running loader tree actually holds, each with its config summary, endpoint and live state, and disables or restores any of them through a paired-marker block in the profile's cordis.patch.yml. Env values, header values and `!!js` sources reach the page only as key names or dot-paths.
description.zh: DSH 的 MCP 极简管理：与「插件」同级的一页设置，列出运行中 Loader 树里真实存在的 MCP 服务器及其配置摘要、端点与实时状态，并通过 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 成对标记块停用或恢复任一服务器；环境变量值、请求头值与 `!!js` 表达式只以键名或点路径的形式到达页面。

description.en: Ghost-text completion for the composer: FIM suggestions stream in inline after a typing pause (SSE, first token rendered immediately), Tab accepts one word at a time and Shift+Tab takes all, in-flight requests are truly cancelled on retyping or Esc. Plus two-layer typo checking: a browser-local dictionary scan (Chinese wrong phrases, English misspellings and proper-noun capitalization, user-defined per-browser entries) with a debounced LLM context pass, underlined in red in the text with per-item navigation and click-to-fix.
description.zh: 输入框 ghost 补全：停笔后 FIM 建议内联流式渐显（SSE，首 token 即上屏），Tab 逐词采纳、Shift+Tab 全量，重新输入或 Esc 会真正取消在途请求；错别字双层检查：浏览器本地词典扫描（中文错词、英文错拼与专名大小写、本浏览器自定义词条）叠加防抖 LLM 上下文校对，文中红波浪线标注、逐条导航、点击修正。

description.en: Customs declaration document consistency check: field-level findings with rule IDs.
description.zh: 报关单证一致性检查：按规则 ID 输出字段级发现。

description.en: Database connections and SQL for DeepSeek Harness: register data sources, browse and comment schemas, run AST-checked SQL with a per-source read-only toggle, and render bar, line and pie charts, from chat or the Settings page.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的数据库连接与 SQL 插件：注册数据源，浏览并注释表结构，通过 AST 校验执行 SQL（每个数据源可单独切换只读），并渲染柱状图、折线图和饼图，可在对话或设置页中使用。

description.en: Installation safety gate for DSH plugins: antivirus-style scan of install scripts, permissions, secrets and network callbacks on local directories or npm tarballs, returning a BLOCK/WARN/PASS verdict before "dsh plugin add".
description.zh: DSH 插件的安装安全闸门：在 "dsh plugin add" 前对本地目录或 npm 包做"杀毒"式扫描（安装脚本、权限、密钥、网络回连），给出 BLOCK/WARN/PASS 判定。

description.en: Plugin inventory manager for DeepSeek Harness Web: table view of installed plugins with status filters, enable/disable switches applied via HMR, config viewer/copy, uninstall and npm update reminders.
description.zh: DSH 插件总览（逃咪）：以表格视图管理已安装插件，支持状态过滤、HMR 热生效的启停开关、配置查看/复制、卸载与 npm 更新提醒。

description.en: Routes DSH filesystem, shell, subprocess, and PTY operations to local, SSH, and Docker execution nodes, with a node registry, an authentication gate, a mobile-aware management UI, and per-workspace custom project instructions.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供多节点执行路由，将文件系统、Shell、子进程和 PTY 操作分发到本地、SSH 与 Docker 执行节点，并包含节点注册表、认证门禁、移动端管理 UI，以及可注入新对话的工作区自定义项目指令。

description.en: Live CPU, memory and GPU readout in the DeepSeek Harness composer status bar — a clickable badge with a details panel, per-metric toggles, and three refresh speeds.
description.zh: 在输入框下方的状态栏里实时显示 CPU、内存与 GPU 读数：可点击的徽章、详情面板、逐项开关与三档刷新速度。

description.en: Voice announcements when a conversation ends (session title, round, outcome) plus live sentence-by-sentence reading of replies, via built-in edge-tts with zero third-party dependencies.
description.zh: 对话结束语音播报（会话名、轮数、结果），回复生成时实时逐句朗读；内置 edge-tts，零第三方依赖。

description.en: Provides snapshot-based research and question answering for individual A-share and US stocks.
description.zh: 基于数据快照提供 A 股与美股的单股研究和问答。

description.en: LaTeX snippet expansion in the composer, built from Obsidian LaTeX Suite's own defaults — 138 triggers expand as they are typed, Tab walks the tabstops, and the table of 142 is editable in one JSON file.
description.zh: 输入框里的 LaTeX 片段展开，触发词表直接取自 Obsidian Latex Suite 的默认片段——138 条打完即出，Tab 依次跳 tabstop，142 条全在一份可编辑的 JSON 里。

description.en: Generate images from chat by calling a fleet of local or LAN ComfyUI workers, with workflow templates, worker health checks and queue control.
description.zh: 在对话里直接调用本机或局域网的 ComfyUI 机队出图，支持工作流模板、机队健康检查与队列控制。

description.en: Digests the images in a prompt with a vision model before admission, so any model — a text-only one included — can read them without the session ever switching models, and adds a describe_image tool for image paths.
description.zh: 在准入前把提示词里的图片换成视觉模型的文字分析，因此任何模型（包括纯文本模型）都能读图且会话不切换模型；另提供 describe_image 工具处理图片路径。

description.en: Reads a local Hermes Agent session store read-only and imports sessions into the current conversation as bounded, untrusted background context: a composer button opens a searchable list across every profile, plus the hermes_sessions_list and hermes_session_import tools.
description.zh: 只读读取本机 Hermes Agent 的会话库，把会话导入当前会话作为有界、不可信的背景上下文：输入框按钮可搜索全部 profile 的会话，另有 hermes_sessions_list 与 hermes_session_import 两个工具。

description.en: Layered cross-session memory for DSH that pushes only what changed - the first round injects every active entry, later rounds push only added / updated / removed ones, and nothing at all is injected when nothing changed, with keys that merely repeat an entry id left out of the text so the baseline is about 26% smaller. Facts and decisions carry semantic keys (one active truth per key), the model may only write to an inbox that a human promotes, an entry can carry a review date that raises a one-time reminder when due, and search is relevance-ranked with journal lines down-weighted and Chinese matched by bigram. A sidebar tab tells the lifecycle story instead of listing files - entries are grouped by stage (awaiting confirmation / in use / archived) along four axes (topic - one level, human-assigned, type, tag, date), each group can be ticked for batch promote / withdraw / archive / restore / delete / assign topic, and topics can be renamed store-wide or searched on their own. The archived stage reads in three levels - the category says why an entry left (distilled into the docs / useless for good / not needed right now, the first two being defaults you can add to), below it the entry topic stays collapsed until you click it, and entries with no topic sit right under the category. The tab also shows the global and workspace instruction files plus the current injection size. A zero-dependency CLI ships with it, so the store is usable without DSH.
description.zh: 分层跨会话记忆，只推变化的部分：首轮注入全部有效条目，之后只推新增 / 已更新 / 已失效，没有任何变化时一个字都不注入；与条目 id 重复的 key 不再写进正文，基线体积因此小约 26%。事实与决策带语义键（一个 key 只有一个有效结论），模型只能写收件箱、由人确认后才成为常驻事实；条目可以带复核时间，到期后提醒一次；检索按相关度排序、流水行被降权，中文按 bigram 匹配。侧边栏页签不再只是列文件，而是讲清流程：条目按「待你确认 / 已在用 / 已归档」分组，每个阶段都能按四个维度（主题——一级、由人归类，类型，标签，日期）查看；可逐条勾选做批量提升 / 撤回 / 归档 / 取回 / 删除 / 归类，主题可全库改名、也可只在该主题内搜索。「已归档」分三层：分类说明它为什么退场（已蒸馏 / 已废弃 / 暂时不用，前两个是默认分类，也能自己新建一个），分类下面是主题行、点开才列出条目，没写主题的条目直接列在分类下。页签同时显示全局与工作区规范文件以及当前注入体积。附带零依赖 CLI，不装 DSH 也能用这套记忆库。

description.en: File-based CSS overrides for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI — edit ~/.dsh/ui-overrides.css and reload to restyle any plugin's elements, for example making the quote bar fully opaque.
description.zh: 基于本地 CSS 文件的界面覆盖——编辑 ~/.dsh/ui-overrides.css 并刷新，即可改任意插件元素的外观，例如让引用浮层完全不透明。

description.en: Adds backup-then-delete and delete-only actions to the DSH session menu: the session directory, its projection cache and a metadata snapshot are copied to a local archive folder and checked file by file, then the originals are deleted to free disk space; subagent sessions it spawned are handled in the same run, and each backup folder keeps a RESTORE.txt with recovery steps.
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话「…」菜单加「备份删除」与「彻底删除」两个入口：先把会话目录、投影缓存和元数据快照复制到本地归档文件夹并逐文件校验，通过后再删除原件以释放磁盘空间；派生的子代理会话一并处理，每个备份文件夹都带 RESTORE.txt 恢复步骤。

description.en: DSH plugin: a settings panel to list, add, rewrite and toggle @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client MCP rows — no more hand-writing them into cordis.patch.yml. Zero build, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: DSH 插件：一块设置面板管理 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 的 MCP 行——列出、新增、改写、启停，不必再手写 cordis.patch.yml；零构建、零运行依赖。

description.en: Use the free AtomGit quota already signed in on this machine to have AtomCode run an independent code review: the model calls the atomcode_ask tool on its own, and you can also use the /atomcode-review command to review uncommitted changes, a branch or a PR in one click. The plugin reads no API key; a usage pill below the input box shows the CodingPlan quota.
description.zh: 用你本机已登录的 AtomGit 免费额度，请 AtomCode 给代码做一次独立代码审查：模型通过`atomcode_ask` 工具自主调用审查；你也可以使用`/atomcode-review`命令，一键评审未提交改动 / 分支 / PR。本插件不读取 API key；输入框下方有用量胶囊显示 CodingPlan 额度。

description.en: Windows toast notifications for DeepSeek Harness covering approval requests, questions, run completion, errors and sign-in prompts, with the conversation name as the first line of every notification.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 桌面通知：申请权限、提问、任务完成、出错与登录提醒，每条通知第一行都是会话名称。

description.en: Checks installed DSH plugins for version-declaration and API risks against the current host, with source locations when available, certainty, impact basis and coverage limits. Adds a compatibility settings panel, plugin-detail findings/badges, a compat_check agent tool and a skill provider.
description.zh: 检查已装 DSH 插件相对当前宿主的版本声明与 API 风险，报告可用源码位置、确定度、影响依据和覆盖限制。提供兼容性设置面板、插件详情发现与角标、compat_check 对话工具及 skill provider。

description.en: Local Git workbench for DeepSeek Harness: branch search and switching, hunk-level staging, commit graph, file history and blame, stash and worktree management, conflict resolution, and eight git tools for the agent.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的本地 Git 工作台：分支搜索与切换、hunk 级暂存、提交图谱、文件历史与 blame、储藏与工作树管理、冲突处理，以及 8 个供 agent 使用的 Git 工具。

description.en: Edit global AGENTS.md and project AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md custom instructions in DeepSeek Harness settings, with project-chain discovery, byte-budget display, and save-conflict handling.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页编辑全局 AGENTS.md 和项目 AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md 个性化指令，提供项目指令链浏览、字节预算显示与保存冲突处理。

description.en: Interactive HTML or flowchart cards inside the conversation: the tool blocks until the user submits, then returns the clicked action, fields, comments and card state.
description.zh: 在对话里发可交互的 HTML 或流程图卡片；工具阻塞到用户提交，再把点击、字段、评论和卡片状态作为结果交还。

description.en: Enforces a check-fix-recheck loop when a task is wrapping up: it auto-runs your tests/lint/audit, blocks any round that still has unfixed problems, and only calls the task done after three consecutive clean full checks, then notifies the user.
description.zh: 收尾自检哨兵：任务收尾时强制「全面检查 → 修复 → 再全面检查」循环，自动跑测试/lint/audit，有未修复的问题就打回，直到连续三轮零问题才判定完成并通知用户。

description.en: Media-scape theme for the DSH web UI: standing/character-art and video wallpapers (mp4/webm, local + online) with boot animation, base color schemes (single-source JSON + presets + picker), capsule host-element styling, ambient particles, background music player (covers/playlists/random), typing sound effects, and a draggable dock toolbar with a unified upload entry — wallpapers and music uploaded together (suffix-classified), mid-upload no-disk buffering, pause→.part snapshots with offset resume, filename+size dedup with "skipped" notices, and true-delete removal with list refreshes.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 媒体景观主题：立绘/视频壁纸（mp4/webm，本地+在线）+ 开屏动画 + 基底配色（单真源 JSON + 预设包 + 取色器 + 胶囊宿主元素样式）+ 氛围粒子 + 背景音乐播放器（封面/歌单/随机）+ 打字音效 + 可拖动 dock 工具条；dock「传」统一上传壁纸与音乐（按文件后缀识别）——上传中途不落盘、暂停落 .part 快照可续传、文件名+大小去重预检「已跳过」、移除真实删除并前后刷新列表。

description.en: Floating usage window for DSH Web showing Claude and Codex subscription windows with reset countdowns, plus DeepSeek API spend and balance; display-only companion to dsh-cost-meter.
description.zh: DSH Web 悬浮用量小窗，显示 Claude、Codex 订阅用量窗口与重置倒计时，以及 DeepSeek API 今日花费与余额；只展示，是 dsh-cost-meter 的伴侣。

description.en: DSH bundle that vendors the full mattpocock/skills tree, preserves upstream invocation policies, and applies an exact-match DSH semantic overlay checked during automatic upstream synchronization.
description.zh: 将完整 mattpocock/skills 技能树打包为 DSH 插件，保留上游调用策略，并在自动同步上游时校验和应用精确匹配的 DSH 语义适配层。

description.en: Refractive liquid-glass skin: custom wallpapers, several tunable refracting glass surfaces, wallpapers that rotate by time of day, four theme colours, a water-drop highlight lens on the selected item, and per-control parameters tuned from the bottom-right panel.
description.zh: 可折射的液态玻璃皮肤 UI：可自定义壁纸、多个可调折射液态玻璃面、随时段轮换的壁纸、四档主题色、选中项带水滴状高亮飞镜、右下可自定义每个控件参数。

description.en: Turns guard denials, gate failures and human thumb-downs into project lessons, and injects only the rules a human has armed into each new session of that project; it registers no model tools and is reviewed through its settings card.
description.zh: 把拦截拒绝、门禁失败与人工差评沉淀为项目教训，只把人工确认过的规则注入该项目之后的新会话；它不注册模型工具，通过设置卡评审规则。

description.en: Peer channels between conversations at the same level: user-granted, symmetric, with durable grants that survive a restart and burst messages merged into one ordered delivery.
description.zh: 平级对话之间的通道：经用户授权、对称，授权跨重启保留；忙时多条消息合并成一批按发送时间排序投递。

description.en: Desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness: a Win32 layered window that keeps a whale-girl above other applications, speaks through a bubble, comments on its own when you stay on one window for ten seconds, and answers a single question typed into a right-click input box.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的桌面桌宠：一个 Win32 分层窗口，让鲸鱼娘待在别的应用窗口之上，气泡说话；你在同一个窗口停够十秒它会自己开口，右键弹出的输入框里可以问它一个问题。

description.en: Switchable web-search provider for DSH: native DeepSeek web search or an OpenAI-compatible custom backend. Installation automatically routes DSH web searches to the plugin; only provider, API key and model are required. Published on npm as @lp181818/web-search-advanced@0.1.3.
description.zh: 安装后自动将 DSH 网页搜索路由到本插件；只需配置服务商、API Key 和模型即可使用。支持 DeepSeek 原生搜索与 OpenAI 兼容自定义后端，已发布为 npm 包 @lp181818/web-search-advanced@0.1.3。

description.en: File-defined command hooks across the session, prompt, tool, permission, Stop and PostCompact seams, with an approval-only GUI: no unapproved command runs, and approval binds the exact definition, canonical working directory and pinned watchFiles. Commands run as the DSH OS user without a hook sandbox, so the trust ledger is explicit.
description.zh: 文件声明的命令钩子，覆盖会话、提问、工具、审批、Stop 与压缩后等事件，配套只读审批界面：未经批准的命令不执行，批准绑定精确定义、实际执行目录与 watchFiles 固定内容。命令以 DSH 系统用户身份运行且无独立沙箱，因此信任记录是显式的。

description.en: Adds mind maps and an Excalidraw canvas to the DSH sidebar, with local blueprint-file editing, Excalidraw file previews and standalone CLIs.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏提供思维导图和 Excalidraw 自由画布，支持本地思维导图文件编辑、Excalidraw 文件预览与独立 CLI。

description.en: Bridges DSH to a local MemVault store: core memory blocks injected into the system prompt, finished turns extracted through MemVault's own pipeline, and a panel to browse, trace, review and replay what was stored.
description.zh: 把 DSH 接到本机 MemVault 记忆库：核心记忆块注入系统提示词、结束的轮次经由 MemVault 自己的管线抽取，并提供浏览、追溯、复核与重抽的面板。

description.en: DSH plugin that installs, supervises and auto-upgrades the local miloco-mcp-server background service, bridges its MCP tools into DSH and adds service, account and license settings panels.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中安装、守护并自动升级本机 miloco-mcp-server 后台服务，把它的 MCP 工具接入 DSH，并提供服务、账号与授权设置界面。

description.en: Adds a city-local sky theme with a moving sun, day and night colors, drifting clouds, time previews, and an immersive sky view to the DSH web workspace.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页工作区添加按城市当地时间变化的天空主题，支持太阳移动、日夜配色、浮云、时间预览与沉浸天空。

description.en: MCP server console under Plugins: manage the official @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client at runtime — add/edit/delete servers, enable/disable/reconnect, per-tool switches, live status and tool lists over SSE, mcpServers JSON import, and auto-migration of profile-YAML MCP entries; an uninstall leaves a native fallback block that keeps the same servers loadable.
description.zh: 插件页 MCP 服务器控制台：运行时管理官方 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client——新增/编辑/删除服务器、启停/重连、工具级开关、SSE 实时状态与工具列表、mcpServers JSON 导入、自动迁移 profile YAML 里的 MCP 条目；卸载后留下原生 fallback 块，同一批服务器仍可加载。

description.en: Fantasy glassmorphism skin for the DSH Web UI: a moonlit nether-forest scene with drifting teal clouds, red spider lilies spreading from the lower-left and a sleeping cat in the corner, drawn over a WebGL2 fluid background with its own wallpaper and video backgrounds. Ships two switchable variants (pale / saturated blue), plus cat-paw, fish, bubble and starlight decorations. One switch restores the stock interface exactly.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面打造的奇幻玻璃拟态皮肤：月光冥界森林，青绿流云缓缓翻涌、绯红彼岸花自左下蔓延、角落里趴着一只睡猫，底层是 WebGL2 流体；另有自定义壁纸与视频背景。内置两套可一键切换的风格（淡雅 / 蓝色），并有猫爪、小鱼、泡泡、星光装饰。一个开关即可完全还原原生界面。

description.en: Expert center: browse and import WorkBuddy experts, create experts with AI, edit role.md and skills, and switch experts per session.
description.zh: 专家中心：浏览并导入 WorkBuddy 专家，用 AI 创建专家、编辑 role.md 与技能，并按会话切换专家。

description.en: Auto-expand reasoning and tool cards, tune code-block font size and line spacing, and choose the model output language (auto, Chinese or English).
description.zh: 自动展开思考与工具卡片，调整代码块字号与行距，并可选择模型输出语言（自动、中文或 English）。

description.en: Collapses long pasted text into an expandable chip in the composer: hover shows the body and where it came from, sending expands it back in place, and long text written by other plugins is taken over the same way.
description.zh: 长文本粘贴自动折叠成可展开的胶囊：悬停看正文与出处，发送时按原位展开；其他插件写入的长文本同样接管。

description.en: Phone-side command center rather than a web-UI mirror: dispatch tasks into isolated git worktrees from a PWA, tool-approval push notifications with phone/desktop first-answer-wins racing (never auto-approved), a multi-machine session board, and an end-to-end encrypted zero-knowledge relay you can self-host.
description.zh: 面向手机的指挥台而非 Web UI 镜像：从 PWA 把任务派发进隔离的 git worktree，工具审批推送通知支持手机/桌面「谁先答谁算」（绝不自动批准），多机会话看板，以及可自建的端到端加密零知识中继。

description.en: Registers a QwenWork (千问办公) model provider that reuses the desktop client's local sign-in, runs a loopback OpenAI-compatible bridge on 127.0.0.1, and translates DSH model requests into the ACP-style control-envelope conversation protocol the upstream actually speaks.
description.zh: 注册千问办公（QwenWork）模型提供器，复用桌面客户端的本机登录态，在 127.0.0.1 起一个 OpenAI 兼容回环桥，把 DSH 的模型请求翻译成上游真正使用的 ACP 控制信封对话协议。

description.en: Token-efficient web reading for DeepSeek Harness: one call fetches several pages through a real Chrome/Edge over CDP, gates them by relevance and returns a single digest, cutting context tokens by 80-98%. Real search URLs, login flow, screenshots, three proxy modes.
description.zh: 省 token 的网页阅读：底层是真 Chrome/Edge（CDP），一次调用读完多个页面、按相关性筛掉不相关的，只回一段带账本的摘要（实测省 80–98% 上下文）。真实搜索链接、登录态、截图、三档代理。

description.en: Workspace-isolated durable memory for DSH, with searchable, auditable, correctable, and removable workspace memories plus controlled global memory.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供工作区隔离的持久化记忆，让每个工作区拥有可检索、可审计、可纠错和可删除的独立记忆，并支持受控的全局记忆。

description.en: Skill center panel for the DSH web GUI - search online skill registries (SkillHub, skills.sh, GitHub), install skills to user or project roots, and manage local skills with enable, create, edit, delete and preview.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的技能中心面板——搜索网络技能市场（SkillHub、skills.sh、GitHub），一键安装技能到用户或项目根，并管理本地技能（启停、创建、编辑、删除、预览）。

description.en: Dockable side panel that keeps an XEChat chat session connected over a single WebSocket: markdown messages with images and emoji, server switching through #showServer and #login, an online member list, a full-screen panic overlay, and dock side, width and visibility persisted to localStorage.
description.zh: 可停靠的侧边面板，用一条 WebSocket 保持 XEChat 聊天在线：支持图片与表情的 Markdown 消息、通过 #showServer 与 #login 切换服务器、在线成员列表、全屏伪装覆盖层，停靠位置、宽度与可视状态持久化到 localStorage。

description.en: Let Codex dispatch tasks to DeepSeek Harness workspaces, follow execution, read results, and continue collaboration through a local bridge and companion Codex skill.
description.zh: 通过本机桥接插件与配套 Codex 技能，让 Codex 向 DeepSeek Harness 工作区派发任务、跟踪执行、回读结果并继续协作。

description.en: JetBrains-style Git workbench for DSH: hunk and line-level staging, side-by-side diff with word-level highlighting, commit graph and branch operations, three-way conflict merge, and commit messages drafted with the host model.
description.zh: DSH 的 JetBrains 风格 Git 工作台：按块与按行暂存、带词级高亮的并排 diff、提交图与分支操作、三方冲突合并，还能用宿主模型起草提交信息。

description.en: Correct-encoding command runner and mojibake recovery: encoding_run spawns a child process and decodes its raw output bytes (UTF-8/UTF-16LE/GBK auto-detected or forced), and encoding_decode recovers garbled text back to correct Unicode.
description.zh: 编码正确的命令执行与乱码还原：encoding_run 自动识别 UTF-8/UTF-16LE/GBK 并正确解码子进程输出，encoding_decode 把乱码文本还原为正确 Unicode。

description.en: Adds a right-click menu on file references in chat output, listing registered applications with icons for open-with, revealing files in the file manager, and copying absolute or relative paths resolved against the session workspace, while code blocks, plain text and external links keep the native menu.
description.zh: 为聊天输出中的文件引用添加右键菜单，列出系统关联应用（带图标）供选择打开，在文件管理器中定位文件，并复制基于会话工作区解析的绝对或相对路径；代码块、普通文本与外部链接保持原生菜单。

description.en: Generates a session title from the conversation with the session's own model, either from the /ai-title command or from a button in the rename dialog. Four title shapes (subject, action, subject + outcome, custom prompt) and an optional MM-DD prefix, all editable on the plugin's settings page.
description.zh: 用会话自己的模型从对话内容生成会话标题，可走 /ai-title 命令，也可点重命名弹窗里的按钮。提供四种标题结构（主题、动作、主题 + 结论、自定义提示词）和可选的「月-日」前缀，均可在插件设置页调整。

description.en: Adds a diagram button under every finished reply in the DSH Web UI: the configured model writes a single-file HTML page with inline SVG and the right sidebar renders it in a sandboxed iframe, with diagram, source and original-text views, a per-session replay history that is served from a disk cache instead of calling the model again, redraw, and save to a .html file.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面每条定稿回复下加一个「图解」按钮：模型产出单文件 HTML（内联 SVG），右侧栏以沙箱 iframe 渲染；带图解／源码／原文三个视图、命中磁盘缓存即回放（不再调用模型）的会话内历史列表、重画与另存 .html。

description.en: Feishu IM bridge for dsh: create a dedicated Feishu bot by scanning a QR code, get one Card JSON 2.0 notice per finished turn, answer tool approvals and structured questions from the chat, and drive a session from it — listing and switching the bound session with /sessions and /resume, steering a running turn, and choosing per-chat permission modes (read-only, workspace, Auto Review, full). Long output paginates instead of being cut. Owner binding: the QR scan binds the scanner; with manually entered credentials the first sender claims ownership and everyone else is refused.
description.zh: 飞书 IM 通道：扫码创建专属飞书机器人；每轮结束推一张卡片，在飞书里授权工具调用、回答结构化提问，并直接用聊天驱动会话（/sessions 列会话、/resume 切换绑定会话、任务进行中可插话引导），还能按对话设置权限模式（只读 / 工作区读写 / Auto Review / 完全权限）。消息以卡片 JSON 2.0 发送，超长内容分页而不是截断。归属绑定：扫码创建时绑定扫码人；手填凭据时由首个发消息的人认领，其余人一律拒绝。

description.en: Network explorer for kids: my identity, DNS lookup, a traceroute trip, speed test and who is home on the LAN.
description.zh: 网络小旅行：我的身份、DNS 查询、路由追踪、测速、谁在局域网。

description.en: Gives the agent four session tools: start a new session, send a message into another one, list sessions with their state, and wait for another session's turn to finish so its answer can be read back.
description.zh: 给 AI 四个会话工具：新建会话、给别的会话发消息、列出会话及其状态，以及等另一个会话这一轮跑完并把它的回答取回来。

description.en: Qoder supplier plugin for dsh-router, covering both the CN and international regions. Uses a personal access token for authentication, signs requests to the Qoder cosy gateway and converts upstream SSE to OpenAI SSE; the model list reports the upstream display name alongside the key, while account selection and cooldown stay in dsh-router core.
description.zh: dsh-router 的 Qoder 供应商插件，同时覆盖国内版与国际版。以个人访问令牌认证、对 Qoder 的 cosy 网关签名请求，并把上游 SSE 转成 OpenAI SSE；模型列表同时上报上游显示名与 key，选号与冷却仍由 dsh-router 核心处理。

description.en: Color presets and a custom paper-color picker for the built-in DSH sidebar PDF, converted Office, and spreadsheet previews, with dark-mode brightness control and locally saved preferences; changes only the display, not the files.
description.zh: 为 DSH 内置侧边栏的 PDF、转为 PDF 的 Office 文档及表格预览提供配色预设与自定义纸张底色，支持深色模式亮度调节和本地保存偏好；只改变显示，不修改文件。

description.en: Computer safety shown as castle guards: firewall, disk encryption, lock screen, remote ports and login history.
description.zh: 电脑安全小城堡守卫：防火墙、磁盘加密、锁屏、远程端口、登录记录。

description.en: Unit conversion as a `convert` tool: 10 categories (length, area, volume, time, angle, speed, temperature, pressure, energy/heat, power) and 82 units with English and Chinese aliases, plus a locale-aware Unit Converter tab in the DSH web view with one module per category and a temperature-difference (Δ) switch.
description.zh: 单位换算：提供 convert 工具，覆盖长度/面积/体积/时间/角度/速度/温度/压力/热量/功率十大类共 82 个单位，支持中英文单位名与温差（Δ）换算，并在 DSH Web 会话视图中提供按类别分模块、跟随中英文界面语言的「单位换算」标签页。

description.en: Explains computer memory as a workbench: current usage, memory pressure and top programs.
description.zh: 把内存讲成工作台：当前占用、内存压力、最占内存的程序。

description.en: Storage explorer: disk boxes, the home folder and the heaviest items.
description.zh: 存储小仓库：磁盘分区、主目录、最占空间的东西。

description.en: Provides shared plan, context pickup, and progress update Skills through StateDock Remote MCP without executing tasks or scheduling agents; targets Harness 0.2.0-rc.2.
description.zh: 通过 StateDock Remote MCP 提供共享计划、上下文恢复与进度更新 Skills，不执行任务或调度 Agent；适配 Harness 0.2.0-rc.2。

description.en: DeepSeek account wallet balance and the current peak or off-peak billing period, in a fixed status region at the sidebar foot, with a manual refresh and an official top-up link.
description.zh: 侧边栏底部固定状态区：DeepSeek 账号钱包余额、当前计费时段（高峰/空闲）、手动刷新与官方充值入口。

description.en: Records session snapshots and supports rollback to previous states.
description.zh: 记录会话快照并支持回滚到之前的状态。

description.en: DeepSeek balance and token usage panel for DSH, with official platform billing, a daily usage calendar, and local session-log estimates for all providers using editable per-model pricing.
description.zh: DSH 里的 DeepSeek 用量面板：官方账户余额与账单、每日用量日历，以及按可编辑的逐模型费率估算全部 Provider 的本地会话日志用量。

description.en: Git integration for DSH modelled on IDEA's VCS: a git icon beside the permission mode in the composer shows the current branch and the pending-change count, opens a branch switcher on hover and an IDEA-style VCS panel on click (branch tree, commit graph, changes and staging, commit detail, file diff), plus a settings page for commit identity, the git binary and the network flags. Registers no model tools with DSH.
description.zh: 照着 IDEA 的 VCS 做的 Git 集成，装进 DSH 会话：输入框「权限模式」旁边的 Git 图标显示当前分支与未提交改动数，悬停可切分支，点击弹出 IDEA 风格的面板（分支树、提交图、变更与暂存、提交详情、文件差异），另有一个设置页管提交身份、git 位置和网络参数。不向 DSH 注册任何模型工具。

description.en: SSH and JumpServer terminal plugin: real-machine read tools, human-initiated read-write operations, and session management from inside DSH.
description.zh: SSH 与 JumpServer 终端插件：真实机器读工具、人工发起的读写操作，以及 DSH 内的会话管理。

description.en: Live session status on the browser tab favicon with sound notifications for pending input and completed tasks.
description.zh: 浏览器标签页 Favicon 实时回显会话状态，并支持需介入/已完成时的音效提示。

description.en: Gives DSH the full 33-tool browser surface (ctx.browser seam -> a self-hosted headless moli browser over CDP: one 127.0.0.1 daemon with Bearer-token auth, request-path whitelist and WebSocket rewriting, no root/GUI/Electron needed; single-engine moli serve with auto LD_LIBRARY_PATH/FONTCONFIG_FILE injection and a persistent profile dir for logins), plus a web panel — a real page you can click, scroll and type in, operation/console/network logs with one-click cleanup, a customizable window (border color, transparency, glass, fit-to-picture with no black bars, top-inset and self-centering) and an adjustable page size (1920x1080 by default) — plus a collapsed pill that can be dragged to any spot on the screen (free position), a live view that auto-resumes when you switch back to the web tab, and a 1920px default max edge for the live frame — and two bundled skills (browser, browser-runtime) served through the plugin built-in skill provider, so the skill centre lists them as system-level by default without writing into $DSH_HOME/skills.
description.zh: 为 DSH 挂出完整的浏览器工具面（33 个 browser_* 工具）：把 ctx.browser 接缝接到自管的 moli 无头浏览器（经 127.0.0.1 单例 CDP 守护进程，带 Bearer token 鉴权、请求路径白名单与 WebSocket 地址改写，不需要 root / GUI 库 / Electron；单发动机 moli serve 直连，自动注入 LD_LIBRARY_PATH 与 FONTCONFIG_FILE，profile 目录持久化登录态）；另带一个网页面板——可直接点、滚、打字的实时页面，操作/控制台/网络日志与一键清理，窗口外观（边框色、透明度、玻璃效果）与几何（贴合画面比例去黑边、顶部留白、默认居中）可自定义，页面分辨率可调（默认 1920×1080）——收起后的胶囊可拖到任意位置（自由位置），切回「网页」自动续帧不用再点「开始」，实时画面「最大边」默认 1920——外加两份随包技能（browser、browser-runtime），由插件经 DSH 内置技能提供者提供，技能中心显示「系统内置」，默认不往 $DSH_HOME/skills 落盘。

description.en: Shows the linked COROS watch model and cumulative activity days in the Web UI, expanding to a one-line review and suggestion when clicked.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 中常驻显示已绑定的高驰手表型号与累计运动天数，点击展开一句话点评与建议。

description.en: Live2D avatar stage and desktop companion for DSH: bundled Haru sample, custom Cubism 2/3+ model loading with scale and position controls, a draggable in-page pet, an optional transparent always-on-top desktop pet window, per-conversation expression prompt control, and opt-in voice with self-hosted ASR/TTS.
description.zh: DSH 的 Live2D 形象舞台与桌宠：内置 Haru 示例、自定义 Cubism 2/3+ 模型加载与缩放/位置控制、页面内可拖动桌宠、可选透明置顶桌面独立桌宠窗口、按对话授权的表情 control prompt，以及默认关闭、需自部署 ASR/TTS 的语音功能。

description.en: Scans MCP configurations from 13 local AI clients and from project workspaces, imports selected servers into the active DSH profile, and adds connection testing, in-place reconnect, JSON import and visual add, edit and removal controls.
description.zh: 扫描 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex CLI、Gemini CLI、VS Code 等 13 种客户端和项目工作区的 MCP 配置，把选中服务接入当前 DSH profile，并提供连接测试、原地重连、JSON 导入和图形化新增、编辑和移除。

description.en: Processes as little workers: how many, the busiest, the family tree and badges.
description.zh: 进程小工人：数量、谁最卖力、家族树、工牌。

description.en: Annotate pages inside the existing Harness Browser: click or drag to select, comment or ask, then send marked screenshots or DOM location details to the current session. While enabled it replaces the official Browser, Chat and Layout providers; targets Harness 0.2.1-alpha.2.
description.zh: 在 Harness 原有 Browser 内批注网页：点选或框选后就地评论、提问，可把标记截图或 DOM 定位资料发给当前会话；启用期间替换官方 Browser、Chat 与 Layout 提供方，精确支持 Harness 0.2.1-alpha.2。

description.en: One-way Telegram notifications for DSH.
description.zh: 针对 DSH 的单向 Telegram 通知。

description.en: Pomodoro timer with four-quadrant tasks: bind focus rounds to a task, grow a desktop pet with EXP and achievements, and let the agent start rounds or propose tasks.
description.zh: 番茄钟搭配四象限任务：专注轮次可绑定任务，桌宠随经验成长并解锁成就，Agent 可开始专注或提议任务。

description.en: OpenRouter provider that reads the live /models list, so new models appear without a harness release: models sorted by name with input/output prices, per-model reasoning levels, image input, reasoning_details replay, Anthropic prompt caching, and actual spend per session including subagents from OpenRouter usage.cost, shown under the Web UI composer and by /cost.
description.zh: 读取 OpenRouter 实时 /models 列表的模型提供商，新模型无需等待 harness 发版即可出现：模型按名称排序并显示输入/输出价格，按模型提供思考档位、图片输入、reasoning_details 回放、Anthropic 提示缓存，并按 OpenRouter usage.cost 统计本会话（含子代理）的实际花费，显示在 Web 输入框下方并可用 /cost 查看。

description.en: Session-memory autopilot: watches DSH sessions and extracts OKF entries in-process through the harness LLM (ctx.llm, deepseek-official by default) at idle, commit, compaction and end checkpoints, storing them via the vault MCP server.
description.zh: 会话记忆自动驾驶：监听 DSH 会话，在会话结束与压缩前通过宿主 LLM（ctx.llm，默认 deepseek-official）就地抽取 OKF 条目，无需外部 API Key。

description.en: Exposes a stdio MCP server as native DeepSeek Harness tools. Ships with the official Microsoft Playwright MCP preset, so the agent browses through the Edge or Chrome you already have open, with your logins intact; any other stdio MCP command can be configured instead. Host-only, no client bundle, no npm dependencies. To drive your own browser, start Edge/Chrome with remote debugging and allow npx to fetch @playwright/mcp.
description.zh: 把 stdio MCP 服务器变成 DeepSeek Harness 原生工具。默认接微软官方 Playwright MCP，agent 直接操作你已打开、已登录的 Edge 或 Chrome；也可换成任意 stdio MCP 命令。宿主侧插件，不带客户端包，无 npm 依赖。要接管你自己的浏览器，需以远程调试模式启动 Edge/Chrome，并允许 npx 拉取 @playwright/mcp。

description.en: PDF outline navigation and local reading bookmarks in the existing right-sidebar file preview; supports adding, renaming, deleting and revisiting page positions, with version and integrity guards. Verified on macOS Apple Silicon with dsh Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.3.
description.zh: 在现有右侧文件预览中提供 PDF 内嵌目录导航与本地阅读书签，可添加、改名、删除和跳回页内位置，并有版本与完整性保护。已验证 macOS Apple Silicon 上的 dsh Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 与 0.2.1-rc.3。

description.en: Sidebar unread / waiting / status hub for DSH Web: a bell jumps to the next unread session, a shortcut walks sessions waiting for input, and ⌘⇧, / ⌘⇧. step back and forward through the conversations you have visited; one overlay lists unread and pending sessions side by side; a six-metric readout at the sidebar foot makes every icon a button that jumps to the next session of that kind; a host-side ledger keeps the account across restarts, so an unread session keeps its green row dot after a restart, and a startup dialog offers to re-send a continue message to sessions whose turn was cut off.
description.zh: DSH Web 侧边栏的未读、待办与状态读数中枢：铃铛按顺序定位未读会话，快捷键依次走到正在等你输入的会话，⌘⇧, / ⌘⇧. 在访问过的对话之间前后切换；另有总览把未读与待决策会话分两区铺开；底部一行六项会话状态读数，每个图标都能点，点了跳到下一个同类会话；账本落在 host 半边，重启也不丢——未读会话重启后仍然显示行内绿色小标，启动时还会把上次被切断的会话列成清单，一键重发续跑消息。

description.en: Cache-hit metrics, request-prefix risk confirmation, and per-step cache-miss diagnostics for DSH.
description.zh: 展示缓存命中、发送前确认请求前缀风险，并按调用步骤定位缓存失效。

description.en: DSH Cordis computer-use provider for the ZTE Nde desktop. npm install auto-fetches the musl binary built by computer-use-linux-zte-nde (v0.7.7-nde.3) into the package's own bin/ via postinstall; resolveCommand() resolves the cordis command path against import.meta.url so the mount works regardless of dsh web's cwd. Reserves the shared computer-use slot via ctx.computerUse.register and exposes MCP tools under mcp__computer-use-linux-nde-mcp__* (screenshot, list_windows, click, type_text, doctor, etc.). Two notable Nde fixes upstream of this provider: KWin caption+coords fallback for window targeting, and SnapshotCache that keeps AT-SPI single-wake per (app, pid) so Chrome is not repeatedly disturbed.
description.zh: 为中兴 Nde 桌面定制的 DSH Cordis computer-use provider。npm install 完成后由 postinstall 钩子从 computer-use-linux-zte-nde v0.7.7-nde.3 release 自动下载 musl 静态二进制到包内 bin/，SHA 校验后 chmod +x；cordis patch 里的 command 用相对路径，由 provider 内部 resolveCommand() 依据 import.meta.url 解析为绝对路径，不依赖 dsh web 的 cwd。占用 DSH 一等公民 ctx.computerUse slot，工具命名空间为 mcp__computer-use-linux-nde-mcp__*（screenshot、list_windows、click、type_text、doctor 等）。binary 本身携带两个 Nde 适配修复：KWin 窗口寻址的 caption+coords 兜底，以及 SnapshotCache——同一 (app, pid) 5 秒内的 AT-SPI 树结果复用、避免 Chrome 反复被唤醒。

issues.detail: declares install-time scripts; the harness gates them via allowBuilds

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-ashtonsun-dsh-experimental-computer-use-linux-nde-mcp
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-experimental-computer-use-linux-nde-mcp

notes: added the missing web platform to the client half

description.en: Per-turn and per-step cost ledger for DeepSeek Harness: a Turns tab beside Chat and Trajectory with tokens, estimated cost, cache savings, and an inspector for tool arguments, raw results, and source. Client-only; prices are estimated from recorded model usage.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的逐轮、逐步成本账本：在 Chat 与 Trajectory 旁新增 Turns 页签，显示 token、估算费用、缓存节省，以及工具参数、原始返回与来源检查器。纯客户端，价格按已记录的模型用量估算。

description.en: A work assistant for WeChat: it records what you tell it into a SQLite task ledger, ranks items by urgency, reminds you on schedule, extracts people and their relations from your notes, and hands tasks to separate assistant sessions. Ships its own WeChat bot channel (scan to log in; private chat only) and a full-page dashboard.
description.zh: 微信工作助理：把你交代的事记进 SQLite 任务账本，按紧急度排序，到点提醒，从笔记里抽取人物与关系，并把任务分派给独立的助手会话。自带微信机器人通道（扫码登录，仅私聊）与整页仪表盘。

description.en: Token usage statistics for DeepSeek Harness with a session drawer and today / last-3-day / last-7-day panels, plus configurable charts and metrics.
description.zh: 统计 DeepSeek Harness 的 Token 用量：会话抽屉与今日 / 近 3 天 / 近 7 天面板，图表与指标可配置。

description.en: Runs the official Google Antigravity CLI (agy) as a one-shot coding subagent over print-mode stream-json, exposed as the subagent_antigravity delegation tool. Includes Gemini 4 Argon on Antigravity subscriptions. Requires the Antigravity CLI (agy 1.4+) installed and signed in.
description.zh: 把 Google 官方 Antigravity CLI（agy）作为一次性编码子智能体接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供 subagent_antigravity 委派工具，可直接使用 Gemini 4 Argon 等 Antigravity 订阅模型。需安装并登录 Antigravity CLI（agy 1.4+）。

description.en: LaTeX and BibTeX guardrails for DeepSeek Harness: compile checks with automatic xelatex/lualatex detection, BibTeX entry deduplication and field filling from Crossref, and \cite key audits against the .bib file.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的 LaTeX 与 BibTeX 检查工具：编译检查（自动识别 xelatex/lualatex），基于 Crossref 的 BibTeX 条目去重与字段补全，以及 \cite 键与 .bib 文件的一致性审计。

description.en: Turns a Minecraft Java save into a Blender cover or animation: scans the .mca region files for flat open ground, exports the terrain to OBJ, and drives Blender headless with MCprep materials, the BPS character rig and three-point lighting. After each render it reviews the frame with OpenCV for facing, ground contact, exposure, lighting and composition, then re-renders with adjusted parameters when a check fails. Requires Blender 4.2 LTS or newer and Python 3.10+ with opencv-python and numpy; the first run assembles the Minecraft assets with the bundled setup command.
description.zh: 把 Minecraft Java 存档变成 Blender 封面或动画：在 .mca 区域文件里找大片平地，导出地形为 OBJ，无头驱动 Blender（MCprep 材质、BPS 角色骨架、三点布光）。每次渲染后用 OpenCV 检查朝向、接地、曝光、布光和构图，不合格就调整参数重渲。需 Blender 4.2 LTS 以上、Python 3.10+（opencv-python、numpy），首次使用运行 setup 装配 Minecraft 素材。

description.en: Normalizes every tool schema before it reaches the model, rewriting it into the strict OpenAPI 3.0 subset that Gemini function declarations accept — a type on every node, items on every array, no empty enum entry, $ref inlined — so a single offending MCP or built-in tool no longer fails the whole request with HTTP 400.
description.zh: 把发给模型的工具 schema 统一归一化成 Gemini function declaration 能接受的 OpenAPI 3.0 子集：每个节点补 type、数组补 items、剔除空 enum 项、内联 $ref，让"任何一个 MCP 或内置工具不合规"不再把整包请求打成 HTTP 400。

description.en: Compacts a long session after a configurable idle time when its context exceeds a configurable token threshold, before the provider KV cache expires; both values are set on the plugin's page in the Plugins manager.
description.zh: 会话上下文超过可配置的 token 阈值、且用户空闲达到可配置时长后，在模型 KV 缓存过期前自动压缩会话；两项设置都在插件管理器的插件页面中修改。

description.en: Adds a Continue button to resume tasks interrupted by a process exit or restart.
description.zh: 为进程退出或重启导致中断的任务提供继续按钮。

description.en: Model-driven context compaction for DeepSeek Harness. The agent decides when and what to compress, commits durable session-log replacements, and ships reversible tool-result compression with byte-exact hash retrieval.
description.zh: 由模型主导的 DeepSeek Harness 上下文压缩：由 agent 决定何时压缩、压缩什么，以持久化会话日志替换提交，并提供可逆的工具结果压缩与逐字节哈希取回。

description.en: Shows a Spark Scope card at the bottom of the dsh sidebar: model server decode and prefill rates with sparklines, running and queued requests, KV cache, TTFT and TPOT p95, and GPU temperature, power, load and memory for each DGX Spark node. Read-only; needs a running Spark Scope server. Works in dsh web and the desktop app.
description.zh: 在 dsh 侧边栏底部显示 Spark Scope 卡片：模型服务的 decode 与 prefill 速率及走势图、运行中与排队请求、KV 缓存、TTFT 与 TPOT p95，以及每个 DGX Spark 节点的 GPU 温度、功耗、负载和显存。只读，需要已运行的 Spark Scope 服务。dsh web 与桌面应用均可使用。

description.en: Injects the contents of a .keep-reminder file from the session working directory as a system-reminder, with three modes: once per session, first step of every turn, or every request.
description.zh: 把会话工作目录下 .keep-reminder 文件的内容作为 system-reminder 注入，支持三种模式：每会话一次、每轮第一步、每次请求。

description.en: Plan-and-execute orchestration over ReactLoopAgent — turns a goal into reviewable steps with a web UI plan card.
description.zh: 基于 ReactLoopAgent 的 Plan-and-Execute 编排插件，将目标拆解为可审阅的步骤并以 Web UI 卡片呈现。

description.en: LAN co-op for the dsh-pet desktop pet: see colleagues' pets on the same network, wave at them, and drag their desktop windows anywhere; an optional included patch adds live animation, bubble and meme sync. Requires dsh-pet 0.3.7.
description.zh: 给 dsh-pet 桌宠加局域网联机：同一网络下能看到同事的桌宠，可以打招呼、自由拖拽桌面窗口；可选补丁同步实时动作、气泡和表情包。需要 dsh-pet 0.3.7。

description.en: Codex-shaped coding tools and agent presets for GPT models on DeepSeek Harness: exec_command, write_stdin, apply_patch and view_image, plus OpenAI Chat Completions and Responses API routes, bridged to DSH-native plan, ask, approval and compaction. Long-running commands become DSH background jobs with bounded head/tail output readable through job_output, and each subagent type can be pinned to its own preset, provider, model and reasoning effort.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 上 GPT 模型的 Codex 风格编码工具与 agent 预设：exec_command、write_stdin、apply_patch、view_image，以及 OpenAI Chat Completions 与 Responses API 两条路由，并桥接 DSH 原生的计划、提问、审批与压缩。长命令注册为 DSH 后台作业，输出首尾有界，可用 job_output 读取；每种子代理类型可独立指定 Preset、Provider、Model 与 Reasoning effort。

description.en: Local wake-word voice input for DSH. Say the wake word, wait for the chime, then speak; text is sent to a DSH session. Audio is processed locally by default and not stored. Requires the DSH speech input service (speechToText) to be available.
description.zh: DSH 本地语音唤醒。先说唤醒词，听到提示音后说内容，自动发进 DSH 会话；默认本地识别，音频不落盘。需要 DSH 语音输入服务（speechToText）可用。

description.en: DSH web plugin that browses, previews, restores and deletes archived sessions that were moved out of the sessions directory.
description.zh: DSH 网页插件：浏览、预览、还原与删除已从会话目录搬出的归档会话。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that exposes QBoson Kaiwu Ising solving as an agent-callable solve_ising tool.
description.zh: 将 QBoson Kaiwu 的 Ising 矩阵求解能力作为 solve_ising Agent Tool 接入 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Ships the Zhouli-mode agent preset, which runs a session in three phases (declaring roles on opening, citing authorities while working, a six-item self-audit at the close), plus one tool with seven actions over a bundled 49,384-character 《周礼》 corpus that returns every passage with a stable 篇序.职官序 coordinate, a per-office establishment index and collation between two Kanripo witnesses.
description.zh: 主打「周礼模式」agent 预设：会话分三段依六官法度而行——开工「设官分职」、事中「依典援据」、收尾「岁终之会」依六计考成。另附 zhouli 工具，七种检索动作，检索内置 49,384 字《周礼》语料，每条结果带稳定坐标（篇序.职官序），含职官员额索引与 Kanripo 两本互校勘记。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness activity as a GitHub-style contribution graph: an account-menu row opens a centred dialog with your avatar and name, a year of daily activity in five shades, a year picker and a tooltip on every day.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的日常活动画成 GitHub 风格的贡献热力图：账号菜单里的入口打开居中弹窗，含头像与用户名、按五档配色的一年活动、年份选择器与逐格 tooltip。

description.en: Opens the recent sessions in a sheet that floats over the sidebar workspace list, from one row above Settings: rows sorted by last activity with their run state, a draggable height, and a list that settles onto whole rows after stopping. The sheet paints no surface of its own, so it reads as part of the sidebar.
description.zh: 在侧栏「设置」上方加一行入口，展开后最近会话以浮层压在工作区列表上方：按最后活动时间排序、每行带运行状态、高度可拖、滚动停下后自动对齐到整行。浮层不画自己的底色，展开后仍像侧栏的一部分。

description.en: Resident-index grep for DeepSeek Harness that shadows the built-in grep/glob tools under the same names: repeated content searches hit an in-memory index ranked by access/modification frecency, and glob serves the built-in ripgrep semantics when available, falling back to the index otherwise.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供常驻索引 grep，以同名遮蔽内置 grep/glob 工具：重复内容检索命中按访问/修改 frecency 排序的内存索引，glob 在可用时对齐内置 ripgrep 语义、不可用时回退索引。

description.en: Input history switcher for the DSH composer that locally persists every submitted prompt (text plus attachments, max 50) and re-fills the empty composer with ArrowUp/ArrowDown, re-attaching file references and image previews.
description.zh: DSH 输入框历史记录切换器：本地保存每条已提交的提示词（含附件，最多 50 条），空输入框时用上下方向键召回，并自动恢复文件引用与图片预览。

description.en: Windows-only. Trust a newly added workspace folder once, then grants the NTFS rights the workspace-write sandbox needs and pushes the grant plus the Low integrity label through folders that already exist; repairs show live progress.
description.zh: 仅 Windows：新增工作区时授权一次，补齐 workspace-write 沙箱所需的 NTFS 权限，并把授权与 Low 完整性标签铺进已有子目录；修复过程带实时进度与日志。

description.en: Quick sticky notes with colored labels, pin, timed reminders, and password protection for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 泡泡猫的即时便签 — 支持彩色标签、置顶、定时提醒与密码保护。

description.en: NewAgentUniverseByDeepSeek nodes inside DSH: five read-only tools covering provenance (both upstream releases this build names), a data directory's restored state and ledger audit, the conformance vectors, exact decimal conversion, and node reachability. Driving the node -- starting or stopping a daemon, depositing funds, sending bus messages -- is deliberately not exposed, because those are audited privileged operations in this project.
description.zh: 把 NewAgentUniverseByDeepSeek 节点接入 DSH：五个只读工具，覆盖版本与上游出处、数据目录恢复状态与账本审计、一致性向量、精确十进制换算，以及节点可达性探测。刻意不暴露启动/停止守护进程、存款、发总线消息这类在本项目里受审计的特权操作。

description.en: Round-table meetings for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 on Windows desktop, reusing existing Agent sessions with discussion, editable task cards, sequential and parallel steps, shared meeting files, and secretary minutes.
description.zh: 面向 Windows 桌面版 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 的圆桌会议，复用已有 Agent 会话，提供讨论、可编辑任务卡、顺序与并行步骤、会议文件归档及秘书纪要。

description.en: Connects TypeSafe/Jev, Cloudflare/Clef, Nace/Drex, self-hosted Laya, and custom decision providers through one interface for agent and plugin classification, filtering, scoring, and image-object localization with structured results.
description.zh: 通过统一接口接入 TypeSafe/Jev、Cloudflare/Clef、Nace/Drex、本地 Laya 与自定义决策提供商，支持 Agent 和插件进行分类、筛选、评分与图片目标定位，并返回结构化结果。

description.en: Export the current session as a readable Markdown file with dialogue only: user messages, assistant text, and ask_user_question answers, from a session-header button or the /md command.
description.zh: 把当前会话导出为可读的 Markdown 文件，只保留对话正文：用户消息、助手文本与 ask_user_question 问答，通过会话标题栏按钮或 /md 命令触发。

description.en: Hides other memory plugins' context sections and tools inside a chosen DSH preset, so that session gets a clean context. Off by default; ships a read-only diagnostic tool.
description.zh: 在指定 DSH preset 里挡掉其他记忆插件的上下文段与工具，让该会话拿到干净上下文。bundle 形态、默认关闭，带只读诊断工具。

description.en: Invites people into one conversation through single-use links with no account: up to 20 guests discuss together and ask the AI, the shared fork runs read-only, and the owner can remove guests or end the share at any time.
description.zh: 用一次性链接邀请别人加入同一段对话，不需要账号：最多 20 位访客一起讨论、一起问 AI，分享用的 fork 以只读权限运行，所有者可以随时移除访客或结束分享。

description.en: Codex-style browser control: drives your own Chrome through a local bridge, so the model can read pages, click, fill inputs, scroll, take screenshots, and inspect console and network logs. Requires Chrome 120+ and loading the bundled extension unpacked at chrome://extensions, then pairing it with an 8-digit code.
description.zh: Codex 同款的浏览器控制：通过本机桥接操控你正在用的 Chrome，让模型读取页面、点击、填写、滚动、截图，并查看控制台与网络日志。需 Chrome 120+，并在 chrome://extensions 以「加载已解压的扩展程序」装好仓库自带的扩展，再用 8 位配对码连接。

description.en: A memory panel for DeepSeek Harness with one store per workspace: persona traits, notes about you, dated events, and a first-person diary the model writes and cannot edit. Every entry keeps the quote it came from and can be retracted; workspaces can share one memory and be split apart again; optional per-person profiles for group chats; a capped event list with ★ marks. Local only, no network, zero dependencies.
description.zh: 按工作区分开的记忆面板：人设卡、用户画像、事件与模型自述日记各存一份，每条都带原话与改动史、可以撤回；工作区之间能共用同一份记忆并随时切断；可选按人记录的他人画像；事件有上限、可标 ★。纯本地、不联网、零依赖。

description.en: Tracks this turn cost under the input box, today tokens and spend in the sidebar with peak and idle pricing, and pins the latest question to the top of the conversation.
description.zh: 输入框下方显示本轮花费；侧栏显示今日 token、消费与高峰/空闲时段；对话区顶部钉住最新提问，点击可跳回。

description.en: DSH project scaffold preset: strict 5-phase init runbook, engineering standards and six runnable starter templates (node-ts / react-vite / python / go / spring-boot / monorepo).
description.zh: DSH 项目初始化脚手架预设：严格 5 阶段初始化流程 + 工程规范 + 六套可运行模板（node-ts / react-vite / python / go / spring-boot / monorepo）。

description.en: Real-time generation-speed gauge for DSH: a half-circle dial and a flowing trend curve, sampling tok/s 50 times a second for finer, more accurate measurement.
description.zh: DSH 生成速度仪表盘：半圆表盘与流动曲线趋势图，一秒 50 次获取 tok/s，测量更细更精准。

description.en: Manage frequently used file bookmarks in DeepSeek Harness, supporting bookmark saving, listing and navigation. It also allows creation of frequently used projects, including management projects, code projects and more.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中管理常用的文件书签，支持保存、列出与跳转，并且可以创建常用的项目，包括管理类项目、代码类项目等。

description.en: Browser-side preset visibility and ordering controls for the new-session page.
description.zh: 在新会话页控制 Agent 预设的显示与排序。

description.en: Per-conversation backup for DSH: incremental session mirroring, fuzzy restore (preview then confirm), and rule-based cleanup with a 7-day recycle bin.
description.zh: 按会话逐个备份 DSH 对话：增量镜像、模糊匹配恢复（先预览再确认）、按规则清理并先进回收站留 7 天。

description.en: Captures and compares single-token behavioral fingerprints of configured DSH model routes using the One Token Is Enough protocol.
description.zh: 使用《One Token Is Enough》论文协议，对 DSH 已配置的模型路由采集并比较单 token 行为指纹。

description.en: Release gate for AI answer quality. Two channels: replay an existing VeriScope archive through the original Python quality gate, or run a threshold gate over a Ragas per-row export with Node only — no VeriScope, Python or pandas. Returns PASS, FAIL or REVIEW with source evidence and a re-checkable receipt; supports per-row thresholds and exact decimal comparison. It never re-evaluates and never calls a model, and REVIEW never becomes PASS.
description.zh: AI 回答质量的发布门禁。两条通道：用原 Python 门禁重放 VeriScope 归档，或仅用 Node 对 Ragas 逐条导出做阈值判定，后者不需要 VeriScope、Python 或 pandas。返回通过／失败／待复核，附出处与可复验回执；支持逐条阈值与精确十进制比较。不重新评测、不调用模型，待复核永不转为通过。

description.en: Signs in to ChatGPT by driving DSH's bundled pi-ai Codex OAuth flow from a settings page, revokes the session at OpenAI on sign-out, shows the signed-in account's five-hour and weekly quota, and limits the Codex route to seven GPT models with low, medium, high and xhigh reasoning (default low).
description.zh: 在设置页驱动 DSH 自带 pi-ai 的 Codex OAuth 登录 ChatGPT，退出时在 OpenAI 撤销会话，显示所登录账号的 5 小时与每周额度，并把 Codex 路由限定为 7 个 GPT 模型，统一 low、medium、high、xhigh 四档推理（默认 low）。

description.en: Source Control panel in the DSH Web left rail: search, switch and create branches with ahead/behind counts, a topo-order commit graph, and a click-to-expand preview of any commit showing its files (A/M/D), insertions and deletions, message, author and timestamp. An always-on footer dock above Settings carries the branch dropdown and recent commits and follows the open session; fetch and fast-forward pull are one button, and a git_worktree agent tool creates, lists and removes worktrees.
description.zh: DSH Web 左侧栏的源代码管理面板：搜索、切换与创建分支并显示领先/落后提交数，拓扑序提交图，点击任意提交可展开查看其文件（A/M/D）、增删行数、提交信息、作者与时间。设置上方常驻一个底部停靠区，包含分支下拉与最近提交并跟随当前会话；fetch 与快进 pull 合并为一个按钮；另有 git_worktree 工具供智能体创建、列出与移除 worktree。

description.en: No longer updated: folded into dsh-lifeguard (last release 0.2.2). It checked a plugin against what was installed and flagged only real conflicts.
description.zh: 已停止更新：功能合并进 dsh-lifeguard（最后一版 0.2.2）。原来做的是：装插件前先跟已装的比一遍，真会撞上才说一句，先说原因再给动作，装还是照装。

description.en: Bring a DSH plugin repository's build and release pipeline into the app: a sidebar panel listing each repository's latest workflow run, its releases, and how far the local checkout has drifted from the last release, with buttons to trigger a build, cut a release, publish a draft, re-run, cancel, or read the failed-step log. Drives the workflows through the machine's authenticated gh CLI, so the plugin stores no credential of its own, and which repositories are tracked lives in a config file rather than the package.
description.zh: 把 DSH 插件仓库的持续构建与发布搬进应用：侧边栏面板逐仓库显示最近一次工作流运行、已发布与草稿 Release，以及本地检出相对上次发布的领先与未提交情况，并提供触发构建、发布、公开草稿、重跑、取消、查失败日志等按钮。通过本机已登录的 gh CLI 驱动工作流，插件自身不保存任何凭据，被监视的仓库列表放在配置文件里、不打进包。

description.en: Drag folders into the DeepSeek Harness web composer instead of hitting 'only the desktop app supports folders'. Adds a host folder dialog, /folder, and drag/paste into @path mentions. Plain browser, no desktop app.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页版直接拖文件夹进输入框，不再提示「只有桌面端支持添加文件夹」。新增主机文件夹选择框、/folder 命令，拖入/粘贴自动解析为 @路径 引用。纯浏览器可用，无需桌面端。

description.en: Pins a selected passage of a finished user or assistant message as source text and keeps it in the model input across context compaction: each pin is recall-on-demand by default, or can be moved to a neutral resident system-prompt section or an emphasised highlighted one. Selections are aligned back to the source text with source-exact, source-normalized or rendered fidelity, and each of the three levels has its own character budget.
description.zh: 把已定稿的用户或助手消息里划选的一段原文钉住，让它在上下文压缩后仍留在模型输入中：每枚钉子默认按需补回，也可改为 resident（中性常驻系统提示词）或 highlight（强调常驻）。选区会以 source-exact、source-normalized 或 rendered 三级保真对回源文本，三个级别各有独立的字符预算。

description.en: Requires the ui-ux-pro-max design skill to be installed; this plugin only gates it. Adds a switch to the DSH sidebar footer that enables or disables the ui-ux-pro-max design skill at runtime; the choice is stored in the profile settings.
description.zh: 需先安装 ui-ux-pro-max 设计技能，本插件只做门控。在 DSH 侧边栏底部加一个开关，一键启用/停用 ui-ux-pro-max 设计技能，选择保存在 profile 设置里。

description.en: ZCode-style enhancement of dsh plan mode: a model-initiated enter_plan_mode tool, hard interception of write-class tools at dispatch time (ctx.tools.guard) while planning, and a four-phase planning prompt section (explore, design, review, exit), reusing the official plan/mode state machine and exit review flow.
description.zh: dsh 计划模式的 ZCode 式增强：模型可主动调用 enter_plan_mode 进入计划模式，计划期间写类工具在分发前被硬拦截，并注入「探索 → 设计 → 评审 → 退出」四阶段工作流提示词；复用官方 plan/mode 状态机与退出评审流，只做增量。

description.en: Global experience archive for DeepSeek Harness on Windows: probes local tools (with versions and PATH-first hits), convenient paths, network latency and disk speed; folds per-session stats from session/event; LLM-extracts durable facts; env_profile tool with remember; byte-stable summary injected every turn to speed up sessions and cut token use.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的全局经验档案（Windows）：探测本地工具（含版本与 PATH 首个命中）、便捷路径、网络延迟与磁盘速度；从 session/event 折叠每会话统计；由 LLM 抽取持久知识条目；提供带 remember 的 env_profile 工具；每轮注入字节稳定的摘要，加快会话并降低 token 消耗。

description.en: Converts tables in .docx, .xlsx, .xlsm, .csv and .tsv files into the table JSON consumed by the rule checkers, and reports when it could not rather than guessing.
description.zh: 把 .docx、.xlsx、.xlsm、.csv、.tsv 中的表格转换成规则核查器可读的 table JSON；识别不了时明确报告，不做猜测。

description.en: Per-region UI zoom for DeepSeek Harness — Ctrl + wheel sets independent zoom levels for the conversation header, the left sidebar, the conversation body and the right sidebar (sidebars 25%-300%), and dragging the header bottom edge makes that header shorter or taller, growing by height only so label size stays unchanged.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 分区域缩放：Ctrl + 滚轮分别为会话顶栏、左侧栏、会话正文和右侧面板设置独立比例（侧栏 25%–300%）；拖动顶栏整条下边界可以把它调矮或调高，调高只增加高度、字大小不变。

description.en: Dota 2 ranked no-ban 2-2-1 draft assistant with bracket and pro data sources, flexible player pools, in-game player selection, and a post-draft win probability estimate.
description.zh: Dota 2 天梯无 Ban 2-2-1 征召助手，支持分段与职业数据口径、灵活分路成员池、参战勾选和 BP 后预测胜率。

description.en: Source-install updater for DeepSeek Harness: checks the official GitHub release and the npm record, builds the target tag in an isolated directory, smoke-starts it, then switches through a supervisor process with rollback, with scheduled checks and a daily idle-only install window. Source install only (macOS/Linux); requires Node.js 22.19+, pnpm and Git.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 源码安装的更新插件：核对官方 GitHub 发布与 npm 记录，在独立目录构建目标版本并试启动，再由监督进程切换、失败回滚，支持定时检查与每日空闲安装时段。仅支持源码安装（macOS/Linux）；需 Node.js 22.19+、pnpm 与 Git。

description.en: Prepares context summaries in the background and applies them at safe step boundaries, with native compaction fallback and a per-conversation history of summaries, application status, timings, and token usage.
description.zh: 在后台准备上下文摘要并于安全步骤应用，保留原生压缩回退，并提供摘要内容、应用状态、耗时与用量的会话压缩历史。

description.en: Adds a handoff button to every assistant message that writes an LLM-summarized handoff document of the current conversation into the workspace handoff/ directory.
description.zh: 为每条 AI 回复添加 Handoff 按钮，点击后由 LLM 将当前会话总结为交接文档，写入该会话工作区的 handoff/ 目录。

description.en: Select foreign text in a DSH conversation and a Simplified Chinese translation card appears right below the selection.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里用鼠标选中外文，选区正下方就地浮出简体中文译文卡片。

description.en: Tag-based skill filtering: attach tags to DSH skills, then hand each workspace or conversation only the subset its boolean tag expression selects (for example `pdf + docx` or `aegis * plugin`). Excluded skills are deny-shadowed out of the model catalog rather than merely hidden in the settings UI; skills outside the expression can still be added by hand or force-disabled, and the bundled `tagging-skills` teaches the agent to derive a tag set from the machine it is running on.
description.zh: 按标签筛选技能：给 DSH 技能打标签，再用布尔表达式为每个工作区或对话选出下发给模型的子集（例如 `pdf + docx` 或 `aegis * plugin`）。命中以外的技能会被 deny-shadow 真正从模型目录里移走，而不只是在设置页隐藏；表达式之外的技能可手动添加或强制禁用，另附带 `tagging-skills` 教 agent 从本机技能清单自建标签体系。

description.en: Rewrites your composer draft in the voice of a chosen character card before it is sent, using the model the current session is already on, with an optional review panel and a local check that reports any identifier or path the rewrite dropped.
description.zh: 发送前把输入框草稿按所选角色卡的口吻改写，用当前会话正在使用的模型；可先审查再发送，并有一项本地检查会点名改写过程中丢掉的技术记号。

description.en: Sign in to an xAI Grok subscription with device-code OAuth, refresh the access token, and use it as the xai route credential without an API key.
description.zh: 用设备码 OAuth 登录 xAI Grok 订阅，自动刷新访问令牌，并作为 xai 路由凭据使用，无需 API key。

description.en: CRT terminal skin with a phosphor-green palette, scanlines and monospace type for DeepSeek Harness. Also adds a sidebar dashboard with output speed, CPU/memory and DeepSeek balance; the key stays in the host process.
description.zh: 深色磷光绿 CRT 终端皮肤，带扫描线和等宽字体，用于 DeepSeek Harness。另在侧栏加仪表盘：输出速度、CPU/内存与 DeepSeek 余额；密钥只留在宿主进程。

description.en: Turns GitHub, GitLab and Gitee URLs in the transcript into hover cards with cached repository metadata, and opens them in the DSH sidebar browser on click; plain URLs and GenUI blocks are covered without patching GenUI itself.
description.zh: 把对话里的 GitHub / GitLab / Gitee 链接变成带缓存元数据的悬停卡片，点击在 DSH 右侧栏浏览器中打开；裸 URL 与 GenUI 块都覆盖，且不修改 GenUI 本体。

description.en: Adds a circular restart button to the session header, plus an optional app.asar patch that also puts a Restart row in the tray menu.
description.zh: 在会话标题栏加一枚圆形重启按钮；配合可选的 app.asar 等长补丁，还能在托盘菜单加一项「重启」，先结束进程再把应用拉起来。

description.en: Forensic analysis of past model-routing decisions. Replays each session, classifies every turn's task complexity from its request shape (deterministic, no LLM), and reports two kinds of waste: an expensive model on cheap work (the difference is measurable), and a cheap model on expensive work that failed on its own merits — where every retry re-sends the whole context, so the downgrade cost more than the upgrade. Distinguishes provider-capacity retries (RATE_LIMIT/TIMEOUT/TRANSPORT) from model failures so it does not cry wolf. Derives routing rules from the evidence, priced against a built-in per-million table.
description.zh: 模型路由浪费取证：回放每个会话，按请求形状确定性判定每轮任务复杂度（不调 LLM），报两类浪费——贵模型干 便宜活（差额可计算），以及便宜模型干贵活且因自身能力失败（每次重试重发整个上下文，比直接升级更贵）。会 区分服务商容量限制（RATE_LIMIT/TIMEOUT/TRANSPORT）与模型能力失败，所以不会天天喊狼来了。并从证据推导路由 规则，按内置每百万 token 价目表估算金额。

description.en: Per-Session OpenRouter routing: a loopback relay writes `service_tier`, `provider.sort` and the `:floor` variant into each request from one of nine presets picked on the composer chip, with a pinned base URL per preset for route-level defaults.
description.zh: 按会话切换 OpenRouter 路由：本地回环中继把 `service_tier`、`provider.sort` 与 `:floor` 变体写进每个请求，九个预设从输入框的按钮里选，每个预设另有固定的基址供整条路由使用。

description.en: PWA icon: sets the icon (and manifest app name) used when the Web GUI is installed or added to the desktop; ships a default icon set and accepts a custom image.
description.zh: PWA 图标：把 Web GUI 安装/添加到桌面时使用的图标（以及 manifest 应用名）换成自定义内容，包内自带默认图标集，也可配置自己的图片。

description.en: View tab manager for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI session header: enable, hide, reorder and rename the conversation view tabs (Chat / Trajectory), with locale-aware zh/en copy and npm update reminders.
description.zh: DSH 视图标签管理器（逃咪）：管理会话页头视图标签（对话/轨迹）——启停、隐藏、排序与重命名，文案随界面语言中英切换，并带 npm 更新提醒。

description.en: Host plugin for the macOS menu bar companion: live DeepSeek Harness session state, Approve/Deny for tool approvals, stop the current turn, open the exact session. The native app is a free universal build in GitHub Releases.
description.zh: macOS 菜单栏伴侣的宿主插件：实时显示 DeepSeek Harness 会话状态，可直接批准/拒绝工具审批、停止当前回合、打开对应会话。原生应用以通用二进制免费发布于 GitHub Releases。

description.en: Two-way voice for the DSH web app: dictate with the unified composer, hear replies with speaker buttons and auto-read, on any device. Needs DSH 0.1.7+, Node 22+, Python 3 with numpy and requests, a TTS model, and a microphone.
description.zh: DSH Web 的双向语音：用统一输入框听写、用朗读按钮与自动朗读听回复，任意设备可用。需 DSH 0.1.7+、Node 22+、Python 3（含 numpy 与 requests）、TTS 模型与麦克风。

description.en: Scoped persistent memory for DSH: memory_save/search/replace/remove/list across global, user, project and failure scopes, DSH storage-domain persistence with secret and prompt-injection scanning, session-scope search, retention cleanup, and optional session-start injection; standing context via memory_pin/memory_pins/memory_unpin.
description.zh: DSH 有界持久记忆：memory_save/search/replace/remove/list 覆盖全局、用户、项目、失败四类范围，基于 DSH storage-domain 持久化，写入前做密钥与提示注入扫描，支持会话范围检索、保留期清理与可选的会话开始注入；常驻上下文用 memory_pin/memory_pins/memory_unpin 管理。

description.en: Performance optimization and smoothness enhancement for DSH Desktop (renderer-side only; host code untouched, no on-disk config): skips offscreen message rendering, stops frames and timers while the window is hidden, lazily loads media, coalesces session-list repaints and pre-warms large session files; shows the measured main-thread saving in settings. A lightweight speed-up for lag, dropped frames, slow large-session opening and background CPU use.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端性能优化与流畅度增强（纯客户端：只改渲染进程、不改宿主代码、不落盘配置）：长对话省渲染、窗口隐藏不排帧、后台暂停定时器、媒体懒加载、会话列表节流、大会话文件预热，设置页显示实测省下的主线程时间。遇到卡顿、掉帧、打开大会话慢、后台吃 CPU 时先试它，也可以当作轻量加速与渲染优化工具。

description.en: Adds a right-click menu to selected text in the Harness Web UI that replaces it with a Simplified Chinese translation in place, and restores the original on a second right-click.
description.zh: 在 Harness Web UI 中为选中文字添加右键翻译菜单，可就地替换为简体中文译文，再次右键还原原文。

description.en: Five tools that build, test and run the Inimerse engine, and drive its Verse layers over the server's line protocol. Needs a local Inimerse checkout built with CMake; point the bundle's repoRoot at it (the shipped default is the author's path).
description.zh: 五个工具，用于构建、测试与运行 Inimerse 引擎，并通过服务端行协议驱动其 Verse 层。需要本机有 Inimerse 源码检出并用 CMake 构建；在 bundle 配置中把 repoRoot 指向它（默认值是作者本机路径）。

description.en: Adds a draggable restart button and a plugin panel to the DeepSeek Harness desktop app: it prompts when the profile plugin list changes, records additions and removals per profile, tracks trials, reports host startup state, and offers rollback, minimal boot and recoverable cleanup.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端添加可拖动重启按钮与插件面板：插件清单变化时提醒重启，按 profile 记录新增与移除、跟踪试用、显示宿主启动状态，并提供回滚、最小启动与可恢复的残留清理。

description.en: Composer history that restores the whole input state: composer contents, image and file attachments, @ references and slash commands, plus the model, thinking effort, permission and agent preset used.
description.zh: 记录并还原整个输入框状态：文字、图片/文件附件、@ 引用和 / 指令，以及当时的模型、思考程度、权限预设和使用模式；还原后与记录时一致。

description.en: Reads the API balance or subscription quota behind the current DSH route — including OpenDesign (AMR) wallet and Design Plan windows via the control plane — and never guesses a figure: a miss reports its cause (the raw response is echoed only when parsing fails). OpenDesign needs `vela login` or a desktop `controlKey` in `~/.amr/config.json`.
description.zh: 读取当前 DSH 路由背后的 API 余额或订阅余量——包括经控制面读取 OpenDesign（AMR）的钱包与 Design Plan 窗口——绝不猜数字：查不到时如实说明原因（仅解析失败时附原始响应）；OpenDesign 需先 `vela login` 或在桌面端写入 `~/.amr/config.json` 的 controlKey。

description.en: Adds Meta's Muse Code subscription as a DSH model provider: the bundle declares the shipped Meta route under Settings > Models, syncs the account chat catalog (Muse Wonder included) into the model picker, and adds a Sign in card plus the /muse-login command that run DSH's built-in Meta device-code flow, keep the minted key renewed, and show a red or green credential dot. Needs an active Muse Code subscription and no Meta CLI.
description.zh: 把 Meta 的 Muse Code 订阅接入为 DSH 模型提供方，在设置中声明 Meta 路由、同步账号聊天模型目录到模型选择器，并提供登录卡片与 /muse-login 设备码登录、凭据自动续期与红绿点。需有效 Muse Code 订阅，无需 Meta CLI。

description.en: Week-keyed personal memo service: stores entries in ISO-week tables, resolves week/month/quarter/year navigation from one period calendar, archives quarters, runs AI analysis and Markdown report export, requires an explicit force flag to edit a past week, and turns one suite-wide telemetry failure analysis into a GitHub issue report.
description.zh: 按 ISO 周组织的个人备忘服务：条目按周存储，周/月/季/年四种视图由同一份周期日历解析，支持按季度归档，提供 AI 分析与 Markdown 报告导出，修改非当前周需要显式确认，并能把整条插件套件的遥测失败分析整理成一份 GitHub issue 报告。

description.en: Windows toast notifications when a DeepSeek Harness task finishes: the session title, the outcome, and a summary of the final reply, sent once when the agent really stops rather than once per round of a running goal.
description.zh: DSH 任务完成时，在 Windows 通知栏弹出原生通知，带上会话标题、结果状态与最后一条回复的摘要；在 agent 真正停下来时才发一条，而不是每跑一个回合就响一次。

description.en: Persistent memory for dsh in the style of Hermes Agent: a memory tool that keeps a user profile and the model's own notes, delivered to every chat as a logged context message — at the start, after a change and after compaction — and a session_search tool that reads earlier chats only after the user approves, with a Memory panel to see and edit what is kept.
description.zh: Hermes Agent 风格的 dsh 持久记忆：一个 memory 工具维护用户档案与模型自己的笔记，并在每段对话的开头、记忆变更后、压缩之后各投递一条带记录的消息；session_search 工具只在用户同意后才会读取更早的会话；另有 Memory 面板可查看和编辑已保存的内容。

description.en: A Cursor-like sidebar for DeepSeek Harness with file browsing, code editing, Git diffs, terminal, side chat, and Ctrl+L references.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供类 Cursor 侧边栏，支持文件浏览、代码编辑、Git 差异、终端、侧边对话及 Ctrl+L 文件引用。

description.en: Lists every DSH workspace and its conversations on a settings page with checkboxes, and deletes the checked conversations or whole workspaces together with their session logs, projection caches and workspace registrations.
description.zh: 在设置页列出所有工作区及其对话，勾选后按勾选内容删除对话或整个工作区，并一并清理对应的会话日志、投影缓存与工作区注册。

description.en: Live session-title provider for dsh that regenerates the title after every user message, summarizing the most recent messages within a byte budget.
description.zh: DSH 会话标题实时生成器：每条用户消息后重新生成标题，在字节预算内概括最近几条消息。

description.en: Per-workspace session defaults for DeepSeek Harness: save the Agent preset, permission preset, model, reasoning effort, Chat work-details level and collapse timing per workspace; new or reused blank sessions in that workspace start from them.
description.zh: 按工作区保存 DeepSeek Harness 的会话默认值：模式、权限预设、模型、推理强度、Chat 工作步骤展示与收起时机；在该工作区新建或复用的空白会话自动应用这些值。

description.en: Git plugin — adds Git management to the session tab bar, covering the basics: commit | pull | push | branch | diff.
description.zh: Git 插件 —— 会话 Tab 栏添加 Git 管理功能，支持 commit | pull | push | branch | diff 等基础功能。

description.en: Client-side performance HUD and always-on recorder for DeepSeek Harness: FPS and worst frame, long tasks with four-leg attribution (React fiber / subtree / DOM writes / scheduler), per-plugin callback rate and sync time, DOM growth and writers, JS heap, host event loop and link RTT, plus a night-watch recorder that keeps the worst stalls and exports incident packs for replay.
description.zh: 纯客户端性能 HUD 与默认常开的记录器：帧率与最差帧、Long Task 四条腿归因（React fiber / 子树 / DOM 写入 / 调度点）、每插件回调速率与同步耗时、DOM 增长与写入者、JS 堆、宿主 event-loop 与链路 RTT；守夜层自动留存最差几次卡顿，可逐帧回放并导出事故包。

description.en: Full workbench fork of dsh-better-sidebar: explorer, editor, terminal, Git, browser and split panes, plus a VSCode-like shell refactor with a full-width compact header and activity rail; publishes as @all3cn/dsh-better-sidebar-n23 on npm.
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 完整工作台 fork：资源管理器、编辑器、终端、Git、浏览器与分屏，外加仿 VSCode 外壳重构（全宽紧凑顶栏与活动栏）；npm 包名 @all3cn/dsh-better-sidebar-n23。

description.en: A per-turn token usage strip in each reply's icon row: a grey/yellow/green segmented bar plus a legend giving that turn's uncached-input, cache-read and output split and each one's share.
description.zh: 在每条回复的图标行里画一条单轮用量条：灰/黄/绿分段条配百分比图例，显示该轮未缓存输入、缓存读取与输出的拆分与各自占比。

description.en: Merge requests, review threads and pipeline job logs for GitLab over its REST API with a personal access token, in a side panel, with comment, reply, resolve and approve actions that wait for confirmation. Reads need the read_api scope, writes need api.
description.zh: 在侧栏面板里通过 GitLab REST API 与个人访问令牌查看合并请求、评审讨论串与流水线作业日志，并可评论、回复、解决讨论与批准；写操作均需二次确认（读需 read_api，写需 api）。

description.en: Shows the selected provider's balance below the Harness composer and estimates spend from observed balance drops.
description.zh: 跟随所选模型供应商显示余额，并根据观察到的余额下降估算消耗。

description.en: Adds handoff, context-decision and context-diagnose skills, self-contained context_pressure/context_history tools (peak tokens, compaction stats), per-route realWindows with windowSource evidence, routeKey, handoffAt forced-handoff line, and slash commands.
description.zh: 新增交接、上下文决策、上下文诊断三个技能，自带 context_pressure/context_history 工具（峰值 token、压缩复盘），支持按线路实测窗口 realWindows（含 windowSource 证据）、routeKey 直出与 handoffAt 强制交接线，附斜杠命令。

description.en: Aggregated status badges on collapsed sidebar groups in DSH: a folded folder row shows in-progress / awaiting-approval / done / scheduled / review-pending counts, with numbers and hover detail. (sidebar badge / group status / aggregate)
