description.zh: DSH 侧栏折叠分组聚合徽标：收起的文件夹行显示进行中/待审批/已完成/定时任务/等待评审的聚合状态，带数字与悬停明细。（侧栏徽标 / 分组状态 / 聚合）

description.en: Force-hides archived sessions from the DSH sidebar whatever the view filter is set to, and adds a panel that restores them or deletes them permanently - session log directory, archive and pin records, and projection cache.
description.zh: 无论侧栏「归档显示」如何设置都强制隐藏已归档会话，并提供管理面板：取消归档，或彻底删除会话日志目录、归档与置顶登记及投影缓存。

description.en: Writes one short line into the system prompt only when a stress, energy or reward value crosses a threshold; the values rise on real session events and decay over time.
description.zh: 压力、精力、爽度三个状态随真实会话事件涨落、随时间衰减，越界时才往系统提示里写一句话。

description.en: Port of the V2 memory pipeline from OpenAI Codex to DeepSeek Harness: a background agent extracts each idle session, consolidation folds the extractions into one memory_summary.md behind a git baseline diff, new sessions get that summary injected, and cited memory flows back as usage counts. A Settings page chooses the model, each stage's reasoning effort, and the idle, age, concurrency and timeout limits.
description.zh: Codex V2 记忆流水线到 DeepSeek Harness 的移植：后台 agent 逐个抽取空闲会话，整合阶段在 git baseline diff 之后把它们合成一份 memory_summary.md，新会话注入这份摘要，被引用的记忆回流成使用计数。设置页可选模型、两个阶段的思考强度，以及空闲时长、保留天数、并发和超时等上限。

description.en: Lightweight crash-recovery for dsh: after a restart, it detects sessions whose last turn was killed mid-flight and re-injects a continuation prompt that first demands the agent verify real-world state before acting, so side-effecting operations are not blindly repeated. It only reacts to the genuine crash marker (turn/end reason 'interrupted', synthesized on cold read by session repair), so it never misfires on user cancels, rate limits or model errors - which is why it needs no error classification, backoff or configuration UI. Unlike general-purpose auto-continue plugins, it also covers the case where a subagent was interrupted mid-run: the parent turn has already ended normally while it waits, so a naive check sees nothing to resume and the whole subagent tree dies silently; this plugin detects the interrupted child and wakes the parent instead. Single host file, zero external dependencies, seven config constants.
description.zh: 轻量级的 dsh 崩溃恢复：重启后识别上一轮被强杀中断的会话，注入一条「先核实现状再动手」的续跑指令，避免盲目重做已有副作用的操作。只认真正的崩溃信号（turn/end 的 reason 为 interrupted，由 session repair 冷读时合成），因此不会把用户主动取消、限流或模型报错误判为可续，也就不需要错误分类、退避策略或配置界面。与通用自动续跑插件相比，它还覆盖「子代理执行中被中断」的盲区：此时父代理的轮次已正常结束（正在等待子代理），常规判定看不到任何可续对象，整棵子代理树会静默死掉；本插件会识别出被中断的子代理并唤醒父代理。单个宿主文件、零外部依赖、七个配置常量。

description.en: Pins the first prompt of the current session in a scroll-proof bar above the conversation: one-click copy, a panel listing every prompt you sent (click a row to jump straight to that message, paging back through history when needed), and ten switchable looks (four of them light) you pick from inside the panel.
description.zh: 把当前会话的第一条提问常驻在对话区上方，滚动也不消失：一键复制，面板列出本会话发过的全部提问（点某一行直接跳到那条消息，够不着会自动往前翻页），另有十套外观可在面板里即选即换（含四套亮色）。

description.en: Counts keywords inside thinking rows and highlights them once a row is expanded, with a count chip per keyword on the title line that doubles as an on/off switch for that word, per-keyword tint, text colour and text size (10-22px, the same range the host body-text setting uses), typeface, bold / italic / underline and whole-word matching, plus a dedicated settings section.
description.zh: 统计思考行里的关键词并在展开后按词标红；标题行上每个词一个计数徽章，点徽章即单独开关这个词；每个词可设底色、文字颜色、字号（10-22px，与宿主正文尺寸同一区间）、字体、加粗/斜体/下划线与「完整词」匹配；插件有独立的设置分区。

description.en: Distills daily AI conversations (Doubao, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Kimi) into structured Markdown notes in your Obsidian vault.
description.zh: 把每天和各种 AI 的对话提炼成结构化 Markdown 笔记，写入你的 Obsidian 库。

description.en: Adds a My Groups tab to the DSH Installed plugins page: custom groups with drag reordering, colored text tags, Chinese notes, group locking, real enable switches, and two preset snapshot slots.
description.zh: 在 DSH「已安装插件」页新增「我的分组」标签页：自定义分组与拖拽排序、彩色文字标签、中文备注、分组锁定、真实启停开关，以及两个预设快照槽位。

description.en: Plugin development toolset: mark files read by shell commands, sync code into a profile, mock a plugin backend, preview a plugin frontend, verify plugin loading, spin up an isolated test instance, run named shell shortcuts, and list the plugin's tools.
description.zh: 插件开发工具箱：命令读过的文件自动算已读、代码同步到 profile、后端模拟与前端预览、插件装载验证、隔离测试实例、自定义快捷命令、工具清单。

description.en: Highlights answered ask blocks (question n/n answered) in the conversation with a soft card style; pending asks and other tool blocks keep their native look; optional expand-by-default and a settings page.
description.zh: 提问块高亮：把对话里已答复的「提问 n/n 已回答」工具块用柔和卡片样式凸显；等待中的提问块与其它工具块保持原样；可选择让提问块默认展开，设置页可配。

description.en: Turn codebase smells into an executable, priority-ordered refactoring plan: file-length / deep-nesting / function-length / god-object heuristics plus a staged runbook (read-only, no auto-rewrite).
description.zh: 重构入口诊断：把代码库坏味道（超长文件/深嵌套/超长函数/上帝对象）转成带定位、优先级与依赖顺序的重构计划（只读不自动改码）。

description.en: Adversarial code review — parallel finders inspect a diff through separate lenses (correctness, lifecycle, contract, security), then each finding goes to independent verifiers tasked with refuting it, and one refutation drops it.
description.zh: 对抗式代码审查：多个 finder 并行地从不同视角（正确性、生命周期、契约、安全）审查改动，随后每条发现都交给独立验证者去推翻它，只要有一票推翻就丢弃。

description.en: Host performance monitor in the right Sidebar: CPU, memory and swap gauges, a GPU clock and VRAM bar, CPU / GPU / motherboard / drive temperatures, and a process table sortable by CPU, memory or name.
description.zh: 右侧栏主机性能监控：CPU、内存、交换内存仪表盘，显卡频率与显存条，CPU / 显卡 / 主板 / 硬盘温度，以及可按 CPU、内存、进程名排序的进程列表。

description.en: Cron scheduler for agent tasks: create jobs by natural language or a sidebar UI, inject a user message into a new or fixed session on schedule to trigger a full agent turn, with run history, manual trigger, and live SSE sync. Requires DSH session format v4 (official DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+): injected messages declare the producer-owned source kind plugin:cron.
description.zh: Agent 任务定时调度器：自然语言或侧栏 UI 创建任务，到点向新建/固定会话注入 user 消息触发完整 agent turn，带执行历史、手动触发与 SSE 实时同步。要求 DSH session format v4（官方 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+）：注入消息使用 producer-owned source kind plugin:cron。

description.en: Safe detached DSH restart: /restart and /dsh-restart slash commands with native candidate styling plus a dsh_restart agent tool; a detached worker restarts DSH after 3 seconds without freezing the session, and Windows/macOS use a native Node helper built on the official appExit service.
description.zh: 安全的分离式 DSH 重启：/restart 与 /dsh-restart 斜杠命令（原生候选样式）加 dsh_restart Agent 工具；分离的 worker 在 3 秒后重启 DSH 且会话不冻结，Windows/macOS 走基于官方 appExit 服务的原生 Node helper。

description.en: Adds a resizable workspace file tree beside the native preview, with directory expansion, filtering of loaded files, and refresh.
description.zh: 在原生预览旁添加可调整宽度的工作区文件树，支持目录展开、已加载文件筛选和刷新。

description.en: Theme studio for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: eight switchable preset styles, accent and panel-translucency fine-tuning, host-side wallpapers painted on the first frame, and a one-click fix when the wallpaper-engine glass tint greys out light styles.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 主题工坊：可切换预设风格、强调色与面板透明度微调、宿主壁纸首帧绘制；wallpaper-engine 玻璃色把浅色主题洗灰时一键改为白色玻璃。

description.en: Adds a Restart dsh button above Settings that restarts dsh in place: through systemd when dsh runs as a systemd unit, otherwise via process.execve with the same PID (a thin wrapper parent on Windows or Node < 22.15), so whatever started dsh needs no supervisor config (verified on Linux; Docker, macOS and Windows not yet run for real); the page reloads once the new boot id answers.
description.zh: 在「设置」上方添加「重启 dsh」按钮，原地重启：以 systemd 单元运行时由 systemd 重启，否则通过 process.execve 保持同一 PID（Windows 或 Node < 22.15 时保留一个轻量父进程），启动 dsh 的守护进程或终端无需额外配置（已在 Linux 实测，Docker、macOS、Windows 尚未实机测试）；新 boot id 响应后页面自动刷新。

description.en: Delete sessions for real from the dsh sidebar (local logs and projection cache included, subagent and fork children cascade) and manage workspaces and ungrouped sessions, with an optional daily cleanup of ungrouped sessions.
description.zh: 在 dsh 侧栏真正删除会话（连带本地日志与投影缓存，子代理与 fork 子会话级联）并管理工作区与未分组会话，可选每天定时清理未分组会话。

description.en: Collects and redacts DSH runtime diagnostics before filing structured issues in GitHub or Gitea.
description.zh: 收集并脱敏 DSH 运行诊断信息，然后向 GitHub 或 Gitea 提交结构化问题报告。

description.en: Web Audio agent-heartbeat cues for the DSH web GUI: a low working hum while an agent is busy, ticks on streaming output, and a chime when a session awaits input or work finishes, with per-voice volume, mute toggle, and optional local audio files.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面提供 Web Audio 智能体心跳提示：Agent 忙碌时低频心跳、流式输出时滴答声、会话等待输入或工作完成时提示音；支持分音色音量、静音开关与本地音频文件替换。

description.en: Smart calendar and checklist assistant with lunar dates, macOS/Windows native notifications, and WeCom push.
description.zh: 智能日程与待办助手：农历节气、macOS/Windows 原生桌面弹窗、企微多平台推送与拖拽改期。

description.en: Read-only repository fact scanner kernel for DSH analysis plugins: deterministic probe / file index / modules / dependencies / entry points / symbols / graphs and git facts over a stable JSON schema (CLI + library + skill runbook).
description.zh: 只读仓库事实扫描内核：为分析型插件提供可复现的仓库探测、文件索引、模块、依赖、入口、符号与 Git 变更等硬事实（CLI + 库接口 + 技能 runbook）。

description.en: Radial right-click menu on conversation turns in the DSH web GUI for forking a session from a chosen turn, interrupting generation, copying the working directory path or session ID, opening the working directory, and exporting session logs.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 对话轮次上点击右键弹出的圆盘菜单：从此轮分叉出新会话、打断生成、复制工作目录路径与会话 ID、打开工作目录、导出会话日志。

description.en: Cloudflare Workers AI media tools for dsh - text-to-image, text-to-speech and speech-to-text. Per-model price badges, a native settings card, reuse of an existing Cloudflare account, and output files named after the model that made them.
description.zh: 把 Cloudflare Workers AI 的多媒体模型接进 dsh：生图、TTS、语音转写都有；每个模型标注价格档位，带原生设置页，复用已有的 Cloudflare 账号，输出文件带模型名。

description.en: Aggregates all local Trae accounts into one auto-failover model provider, with manual and automated daily check-in, credits and expiry monitoring, and a model selection settings card.
description.zh: 把本机多个 Trae 账号聚合成一个自动容错换号的模型供应商，附带手动与自动签到、积分与到期监控，以及模型配置设置卡片。

description.en: Composer key remap for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: bind Enter, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter, Shift+Enter or any custom chord to the Send, Newline or Interrupt actions, with cross-action migration, durable persistence and native behavior preserved by default.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 输入框键位自定义：把 Enter、Ctrl/Cmd+Enter、Shift+Enter 或任意组合键分配给发送、换行、打断三个动作，支持跨动作互斥迁移与持久化保存，默认保持 DSH 原生行为。

description.en: Shows a character avatar and an editable ID beside every assistant reply, and reads the reply aloud with the system voice or a local TTS service you point it at; includes presets, a playback bar with pause and sentence skipping, tone and speed controls, and one-click launching of that service.
description.zh: 在每轮回复左侧显示角色头像与可编辑 ID，并可用系统语音或你自己指定的本地 TTS 服务朗读回复；含预设、带暂停与上下句的播放控制条、语气与语速调节，以及一键启动该服务。

description.en: Portrait layout for desktop windows: navigation takes the full left column, the file/terminal panel moves above the conversation, and a draggable splitter sets its height; touch devices are unaffected.
description.zh: 竖屏布局：电脑竖屏窗口下，导航占左列整高，文件/终端面板移到对话区上方，中间的分隔线可拖拽调整高度；手机/平板不受影响。

description.en: One Settings page for every DeepSeek Harness session: browse active and archived sessions by workspace, generate a title from the whole conversation for live or archived sessions, archive or restore, move a cold session to another workspace, and permanently delete an archived session (with its subagent descendants after confirmation).
description.zh: 在设置里管理全部 DeepSeek Harness 会话：按工作区分组浏览活跃与已归档会话，为活跃或已归档会话按整段对话生成标题，归档/恢复，把冷会话移动到其他工作区，并在确认后彻底删除已归档会话（含其子代理会话）。

description.en: Unify third-party plugin settings in DeepSeek Harness. Auto-discover, group, and reorder plugin settings under one collapsible nav entry with drag-and-drop support.
description.zh: 统一收纳 DeepSeek Harness 里的第三方插件设置：自动发现、分组，并在一个可折叠的导航入口下拖拽排序。

description.en: Claude Code-style sidebar for the macOS desktop app: hovering the collapsed sidebar toggle peeks the sidebar over the content, selecting a session collapses it, clicking the toggle pins it; plus back/forward session history arrows (⌘\[ / ⌘]).
description.zh: 仿 Claude Code 的侧栏（macOS 桌面版）：悬停在折叠的侧栏按钮上即可将侧栏浮层展开，选择会话后自动收起，点击按钮固定；另有会话历史前进/后退箭头（⌘\[ / ⌘]）。

description.en: Trimmed fork of ItQianChen/dsh-github-flow: a floating panel plus a right-column review pane for the pull requests raised in a session, showing CI state, review comments and merge status. It also registers the github_* agent tools (PR merge and review, secrets, raw API), so do not install both.
description.zh: fork 自 ItQianChen/dsh-github-flow 并裁剪：本会话 PR 的浮窗与右列审阅面板，显示 CI 状态、评审意见与合并状态；同时注册 github_* 工具（含合并/评审 PR、密钥、原始 API），勿与原版同装。

description.en: Resident search index living in the host process: hot_find (fuzzy filename and path match, with frecency and git status), hot_fuzzy (content search that tolerates typos, including in Chinese), hot_grep (literal and regex content search), hot_plan (groups hits per file so a batch of files can be read in order) and hot_stats. One in-memory line index is built once and rebuilt on demand, so a query does not spawn a process.
description.zh: 活在宿主进程里的常驻检索索引：hot_find（文件名与路径模糊匹配，带 frecency 与 git 状态）、hot_fuzzy（内容检索，中文错字也能命中）、hot_grep（字面与正则内容检索）、hot_plan（按文件聚合命中，便于排批量阅读顺序）与 hot_stats。一份内存行索引只建一次、按需重建，单次查询不启动进程。

description.en: Turns markdown into a WeChat Official Account (微信公众号) draft: inlines every CSS rule onto its element because the editor discards `<style>` blocks and class names, uploads each local image through WeChat's own endpoint so it is not filtered out, and creates the draft; it never broadcasts.
description.zh: 把 markdown 变成排好版的微信公众号草稿：样式逐条内联到元素上（编辑器会丢弃 `<style>` 块和 class 名），每张本地图片走微信自己的上传接口以免被过滤，然后创建草稿；不做群发。

description.en: Project-based learning coach: a subject-agnostic teaching engine plus swappable domain packs (Unity/C# included), shipped both as a DSH skill and as an installable bundle. The skill protocol enforces attempt-first teaching and graded hints; a zero-dependency validator rejects ability claims their evidence does not support and blocks stage acceptance while blockers are open.
description.zh: 项目制教学教练：学科无关的教学引擎 + 可替换领域包（随包提供 Unity/C#），同时以 DSH 技能与可安装组合包分发。技能协议强制"先做后教"与分级提示；零依赖校验器会拒绝证据不支撑的能力结论，并在存在未解决阻塞项时阻止阶段通过。

description.en: A per-command sandbox allow-list for the bash tool: a rule names a CLI and the writable roots it gets, so allow-listed programs such as lark-cli and gh run inside the kernel sandbox with the workspace plus those roots appended. Unlike plugins that answer the approval for you or that widen the writable set for every command, the grant here is scoped to the matched command, the workspace stays writable, and other commands keep their exact behaviour. Matching is by write footprint rather than by command string, so write-neutral pipes like `2>&1 | tail -N` still match; rules are edited from a Settings page or the Plugins row. Overlays cover Seatbelt, bubblewrap and Landlock; on Windows the writable root is swapped for $HOME instead.
description.zh: 按命令生效的 bash 沙箱白名单：一条规则指定一个命令和它可用的可写根，命中的 lark-cli、gh 等在保留工作区的前提下于内核沙箱内直接执行。与「替你回答授权弹窗」或「对所有命令统一放宽可写范围」的做法不同，这里放行的只有命中的那条命令，工作区仍可写，其他命令行为完全不变。匹配依据是命令的「写足迹」而不是命令字符串，因此 `2>&1 | tail -N` 这类不写文件的管道仍能命中；规则可在设置页或插件行里编辑。macOS 用 Seatbelt、Linux 用 bubblewrap / Landlock，Windows 则退回把可写根换成 $HOME 的旧行为。

description.en: A session manager for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: per-workspace category trees with drag-and-drop ordering, pinned sessions hoisted above the categories (or kept inside them, switchable from the view options), an archive partition, and a delete bin where removed sessions keep their logs and can be restored or purged in batches. The host half owns the category and recycle data, the web half renders it; both ship as one plugin. Maintained fork of ht719/dsh-session-categories ported to current DSH, with pinning, archive partition and delete bin added; it cannot be installed together with the original.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧栏的会话管理插件：按工作区划分的分类树，支持拖拽排序；置顶会话可抬到分类上方，也可按开关留在所属分类内；另有归档分区，以及删除回收站——删掉的会话日志留存，可恢复或批量彻底清除。宿主半边掌管分类与回收站数据，网页半边负责渲染，两者作为一个插件一起发布。本插件是 ht719/dsh-session-categories 的维护分叉，已移植到当前 DSH 并新增置顶、归档分区与删除回收站；不能与原版同时安装。

description.en: Turn-end quality gate: when the turn edited code or config it walks each file up to its project root, runs that root one check from a fixed whitelist (`pnpm check`, `cargo check`, `ruff check .`, `tsc --noEmit`) and, only if that check really ran and failed, opens a new turn carrying the failure output instead of letting the turn close.
description.zh: 回合收口质量门禁：本回合改过代码或配置时，把改过的文件逐个上溯到项目根，从固定白名单里为该根跑一条检查（`pnpm check` / `cargo check` / `ruff check .` / `tsc --noEmit`）；只有真跑过且失败才带着输出开新轮修复，而不是让回合直接收尾。

description.en: TypeSafe AI Jev decision provider for typed probabilistic choices and scores in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 TypeSafe AI Jev 决策能力，用于带类型的概率选择和评分。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime。

description.en: A two-minute whale-fishing mini game for the DSH web GUI. Catch fish whose numbers add to your score, avoid fish larger than you, eat rice bowls to heal, and grab coupons to ignore size on the next hook. Standalone HTML, no network, no telemetry.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面里的两分钟小游戏：抓到的数字累加到身上，比自身大的鱼会掉一颗心，白饭回血，鲸元券让下一钩无视大小。单文件 HTML，不联网，无数据上报。

description.en: Zen Mode view tab and foreground time tracker for DeepSeek Harness: while the agent works, a calm conversation view shows running/done status, your latest user message, live activity hints and the final AI reply in markdown with one-line turn stats, plus screen-watching (focus) time tracking with daily/weekly Zen scores, a chat-hide toggle that hides tool calls and reasoning rows, auto enter/exit Zen on task start/complete, an Alt+Z shortcut and a Zen settings panel — pure client-side, stored in localStorage, no network.
description.zh: 禅模式视图 + 前台盯屏时间统计插件：智能体后台运行时提供极简 Zen 标签页（进行中/结束状态文案、用户消息、动态提示、Markdown 渲染最终回复、单行轮次统计），统计前台盯屏时长并给出每日/每周禅值，支持一键隐藏中间过程（工具调用/推理行）、任务开始完成时自动进出禅、Alt+Z 快捷键与 Zen 设置面板——纯前端实现，数据存 localStorage，无网络请求。

description.en: A DSH companion with a macOS native pet and a Windows/Linux Electron companion. Shows the DSH account balance on the pet even when idle, plus color-coded task cards, progress and notices.
description.zh: 带 macOS 原生桌宠与 Windows/Linux Electron 桌宠的 DSH 伴侣。桌宠肚子上始终显示 DSH 账户余额，并支持任务配色、进度与通知。

description.en: Syncs the groups, keys and models of one sub2api instance into dsh-llm-pi-ai provider routes, with panel-driven login (password / OAuth) and one provider route per relay key.
description.zh: 将一个 sub2api 实例的分组、密钥与模型同步为 dsh-llm-pi-ai 的 provider 路由，支持面板登录（密码 / OAuth），一条中转密钥对应一条 provider 路由。

description.en: Skin author workbench: official token browser (169 --dsw-* variables with Chinese descriptions and module-usage tags), live try-on, durable skin save, theme freeze, seven spectrum presets with SVG backdrops and custom backdrop upload.
description.zh: 皮肤作者工作台：官方 token 浏览器（169 个 --dsw-* 变量，带中文描述与模块标签）、实时试穿、皮肤持久保存、主题固化、7 套光谱预设与 SVG 背景图，以及自定义背景上传。

description.en: Loopback-only ACP door for DeepSeek Harness: connect VS Code and other local clients to a running kernel over the local loopback address, sharing its models, tools, memory and sessions. Browse history, change permission modes and call capabilities registered by DSH plugins.
description.zh: 为正在运行的 DeepSeek Harness 内核提供仅监听本机回环地址的 ACP 接入点，供 VS Code 等本机客户端连接，共用模型、工具、记忆和会话，并支持历史查看、权限切换及调用 DSH 插件已注册的能力。

description.en: Resume screening plugin for HR in DeepSeek Harness: ingest up to 100k Word/PDF/Excel resumes into one searchable library with skills / coarse categories / ingest time, auto-ingest & de-dupe new resumes, then screen by plain-language criteria — rule pre-filter in the database plus LLM fine-judge on the shortlisted few, CSV export. Works on DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7 through 0.2.x, tested on 0.2.0-rc.1.
description.zh: 面向 HR 的简历筛选插件:把 Word/PDF/Excel 简历统一收进简历库建档(技能/粗分类/入库时间),新简历自动入库、重复自动去重;用大白话下指令即可筛选,硬性条件靠库内规则精准过滤,入围的少数人再由 LLM 精判适配度,结果可导出、可追溯。 支持 DSH 0.1.7 ~ 0.2.x,已在 0.2.0-rc.1 实测。

description.en: Session-local scheduled tasks: inject a prompt into the current session after a delay, at a fixed time, or on a repeating interval, so the model wakes up and runs it on time. Manage them from a panel above the composer, the /schedule command, or seven model-facing tools. Timers freeze while DSH is closed and never auto-resume; pause keeps the remaining time, so resuming continues from where it stopped.
description.zh: 会话内定时任务：按延迟、固定时刻或重复间隔向当前会话注入一段提示词，到点唤醒模型执行。可用输入框上方面板、/schedule 命令、或 7 个面向模型的工具管理。DSH 关闭期间计时冻结、绝不自动恢复；暂停保留剩余时间，恢复后从原处继续。

description.en: Adds standard Unicode emoji to dsh replies at the point that best matches the content, and keeps emoji out of any sentence that already carries a kaomoji.
description.zh: 给 dsh 回复在内容最匹配的位置添加标准 emoji，并避免与颜文字出现在同一句。

description.en: Two-tier image reading for text-only models: fast local OCR (RapidOCR, offline) first, vision-model fallback (modlens).
description.zh: 纯文本模型双层识图：优先本地快速 OCR（RapidOCR，离线），不足时回落视觉模型（modlens）。

description.en: Tracks API token usage and estimated costs with per-route model pricing, optional billing groups, synchronized CNY/USD display, session reports, composer totals and a clickable daily sidebar total.
description.zh: 按 API 路由与模型配置单价，统计 Token 用量与估算费用，支持可选账单分组、同步切换 CNY/USD，以及会话报告、输入框费用和可点击的侧边栏今日金额。

description.en: Retrospective agent-session evaluation: deterministic grade cards and cross-session regression diffs from persisted logs — no benchmark runs, no LLM judges.
description.zh: 回溯式会话评估：从持久化日志生成确定性成绩卡与跨会话回归对比——不跑基准、不用 LLM 裁判。

description.en: Captures every plan the agent presents through exit_plan_mode as markdown under <workspace>/.dsh/plans, opens a review window, and keeps a Plans history tab recording the outcome of each plan.
description.zh: 将智能体通过 exit_plan_mode 呈现的每个计划捕获为 <workspace>/.dsh/plans 下的 markdown，打开审阅窗口，并以 Plans 历史标签页记录每个计划的结果。

description.en: Codex-style drag-to-reference for DeepSeek Harness: drag a conversation row from the sidebar onto the chat area and it becomes a native session-reference chip in the composer draft, so you can keep typing around it before sending. Drag a workspace (folder) row instead and the draft gets that folder's path, so a whole directory can be handed to the model. The target session is matched by session id rather than by title, so duplicate or blank titles cannot insert the wrong conversation. The reference cap comes from the host (3 by default) and is read at runtime instead of being hard-coded, so a host-side raise is followed without changing the plugin. If the chip cannot be inserted, the plugin falls back to sending a reference-only message instead of failing silently.
description.zh: Codex 同款拖拽引用对话：把侧栏的会话行拖到对话区，它就变成输入框里一枚原生会话引用 chip，可以继续打字再发送。拖侧栏的工作区（文件夹）行，则把那个文件夹的路径插进草稿，整个目录一起交给模型。候选按 session id 匹配而不是按标题，标题重名或为空都不会插错对话。引用条数由宿主决定（原版 3 条），插件在运行时从宿主读取该上限而不写死，宿主侧调大后自动跟随、不用改插件。chip 插不进时降级为直接发一条只含引用的消息，不会静默失败。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that runs a user-defined command after the web profile has started successfully.
description.zh: 在 dsh web 启动成功后运行用户自定义命令的 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件。

description.en: Reference search for DeepSeek Harness: refkit_search looks up image, video, audio and text references across 24 open sources and tags each result with its normalized license and a use verdict for the intended use; refkit_rights re-checks one license against another use. Source keys and search tuning live on a settings page. 11 of the 24 sources need API keys; the use verdict is returned only when an intended use is passed. Runs on DSH ^0.1.7-rc.2 || ^0.2.1-rc.2 (tested on 0.1.7-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.2).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的参考素材检索插件：refkit_search 在 24 个开放来源中检索图片、视频、音频和文本参考素材，为每条结果标注规范化的许可证和针对用途的可用性判定；refkit_rights 针对另一种用途复核单条许可证。来源 key 与检索参数在设置页配置。24 个来源中 11 个需要 API key；仅在传入用途时返回可用性判定。支持 DSH ^0.1.7-rc.2 || ^0.2.1-rc.2（实测 0.1.7-rc.2 与 0.2.1-rc.2）。

description.en: Desktop notifications for DSH Web sessions: browser notifications plus Windows toast when a session finishes, fails, needs an approval, or asks a question. Clicking one opens the session; browser notifications focus an open tab, Windows toasts open a new tab.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 会话提供桌面通知：会话完成、失败、需要审批或提问时发送浏览器通知，在 Windows/WSL 下同时弹出系统 Toast；点击通知定位到对应会话（浏览器通知聚焦已打开标签页，Toast 新开标签页）。

description.en: Adds a Keyboard Shortcuts page to the DSH Settings panel with six rebindable commands — permission-mode cycling, reasoning-effort stepping, a status-page and a task-list shortcut — plus PgUp/PgDn input navigation and an optional composer Enter remap.
description.zh: 为 DSH 设置面板增加「快捷键」页面：六个可改键命令（权限模式切换、思考强度调节、状态页、任务清单），并展示翻页键跳转与可选的输入框 Enter 重映射。

description.en: Annotates every subagent with the model route it actually ran on: a badge line in each parent-catalog row and a readout in a child session's own header.
description.zh: 给每个子代理标注它实际运行使用的模型路由：父会话目录行增加「mode · 活动状态 · 模型」徽标行，子代理会话页头显示同一读数。

description.en: The Quick Control panel core for DSH Web: a standalone floating shortcut panel whose switches other plugins register through the quickControl service, with the skin system and zh/en i18n. The dock-base Workbench integration ships separately as the dock-flash adapter.
description.zh: DSH Web 快捷控制面板核心：可独立浮动的快捷面板，开关项由其它插件通过 quickControl 服务注册，内置皮肤系统与中英文 i18n；dock-base 工作台集成由 dock-flash 适配器单独提供。

description.en: Floating ZenTao work center: a right-edge sidebar listing tasks, bugs and stories assigned to you, with drag-to-chat, original links and auto-refresh.
description.zh: 悬浮禅道工作台：右侧边栏展示指派给你的任务、Bug 与需求，支持拖拽到聊天、原始链接与自动刷新。

description.en: Gitee Enterprise project management inside the conversation: issues, pull requests, kanban and the Gitee MCP toolchain.
description.zh: 在对话里管理 Gitee 企业版项目：issue、Pull Request、看板与 Gitee MCP 工具链。

issues.detail: declares install-time scripts; the harness gates them via allowBuilds

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-gitee-chat
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-gitee-chat

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Git Changes tab for the DSH web GUI: staging, diffing, AI-drafted commit messages, branch/merge/stash/worktree operations and sync, with live updates via fs.watch plus a changeToken poll.
description.zh: Git 更改标签页：暂存、对比、AI 起草提交信息、分支/合并/储藏/工作树操作与同步，通过 fs.watch 加 changeToken 轮询实现实时更新。

description.en: Headless-browser verification tools so the agent opens the page it just built, reads the rendered DOM and computed styles, checks the console, and screenshots the result; ships a frontend-verify skill.
description.zh: 无头浏览器验证工具：让 agent 打开自己刚写的页面，读取渲染后的 DOM 与计算样式、检查控制台、截图留档；内置 frontend-verify 技能。

description.en: Adds a manual, confirm-first title generator: a header button and a session-row menu entry ask a model to summarize the whole conversation, show the proposal in an editable dialog, and rename the session only after you confirm — without registering a title provider or changing automatic titling.
description.zh: 手动触发的「先确认再改名」标题生成器：顶栏按钮与会话行菜单各一个入口，让模型总结整段会话给出标题，在可编辑弹窗里确认后才重命名会话；不注册标题 provider，不影响自带的自动标题。

description.en: A Git Graph tab for DSH Web: a faithful port of vscode-git-graph 1.30.0 that registers a native tab in the dsh-better-sidebar right rail (prerequisite), auto-binds to the session workspace, runs the full git operations (checkout/merge/rebase/push/tag/stash) directly on the host, and opens file diffs in the built-in DiffTab.
description.zh: DSH Web 的 vscode-git-graph 1.30.0 忠实移植：入驻 dsh-better-sidebar 右侧栏的原生 Git Graph 提交图 tab（前置依赖），自动绑定会话工作区，host 直跑全套 git 操作（checkout/merge/rebase/push/tag/stash），文件 diff 复用内置 DiffTab 打开。

description.en: Mirror an iOS Simulator or Android emulator into DSH as floating overlay windows, several at once, and tap, drag or type on the mirrored screen with the input forwarded back to the device.
description.zh: 把 iOS 模拟器或安卓模拟机投进 DSH 的浮窗，可同时开多个，并在投屏画面上点、拖、打字，输入回传到设备。

description.en: Keeps the current chat in a movable, resizable floating window when the right file or browser panel enters full view, with a compact input bar, a whale restore button and a return to the original split layout.
description.zh: 右侧文件或浏览器面板进入完整视图时，将原会话保留为可移动、缩放的聊天小窗，支持紧凑输入条、鲸鱼球恢复入口和返回原来的分栏布局。

description.en: Adds customizable switch shortcut buttons to the left of the DSH Web GUI chat input for one-click slash-command insertion.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 聊天输入框左侧添加可自定义的 switch 快捷按钮，一键插入斜杠命令。

description.en: Two-way TickTick/Dida365 (滴答清单) task sync via the official OAuth Open API: pull tasks across lists, create/update/complete/delete tasks, and one-shot title-deduped sync, with a web settings panel.
description.zh: 基于官方 OAuth Open API 双向同步滴答清单（TickTick/Dida365）任务：拉取各清单任务、创建/更新/完成/删除、按标题去重的一键同步，带 Web 设置面板。

description.en: Control Proxmox VE virtual machines from the conversation: 16 tools for the VM console over VNC (screenshots, mouse, keyboard, batched actions, Unicode text and clipboard) and for running commands and reading or writing files through the QEMU guest agent, all over one ssh connection to the node, so the host needs no X11 or Wayland.
description.zh: 在对话里控制 Proxmox VE 虚拟机：16 个工具，既能通过 VNC 操作 VM 控制台（截图、鼠标、键盘、批量动作、Unicode 文本与剪贴板），也能经 QEMU guest agent 执行命令、读写文件；全部走一条到节点的 ssh 连接，宿主无需 X11 或 Wayland。

description.en: Local file recall: indexes the folders you choose into one local SQLite database, so 'where did I put that file?' is one query instead of a disk walk. Caches, VCS and program folders are pruned per directory; each folder keeps its own incremental anchor, so a folder added later is backfilled in full. Read-only: it never modifies, moves or deletes your files. Works on DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7 through 0.2.x, tested on 0.2.0-rc.1.
description.zh: 本地文件记忆索引：把指定的文件夹记进本机一个 SQLite 库，忘了东西放哪问一句就能找回，不必翻硬盘；缓存、版本库与程序目录整棵跳过。每个目录各有独立增量锚点，后加入的目录首扫回填全部历史。只读，绝不修改、移动或删除你的文件。 支持 DSH 0.1.7 ~ 0.2.x,已在 0.2.0-rc.1 实测。

description.en: Runs /single-turn and /multi-turn answers in isolated sub-agents so results stay in the current chat and never enter the main model context.
description.zh: 用 /single-turn 与 /multi-turn 在独立子代理中作答，结果只留在当前对话，不进入主模型上下文。

description.en: Temporary workspace for DSH web — one click creates a throwaway workspace whose conversations are deleted at the next restart (immediately or after a delay, optionally behind a confirm dialog). Pin a temp workspace to keep it: its files move into the folder you pick, its title becomes that folder's name, its conversations migrate, and a real host-level restart re-indexes them.
description.zh: DSH web 临时工作区：一键创建一次性工作区，下次重启自动清空其全部对话（可立即/延迟删除，也可先弹确认框）。点击图钉可永久保留——文件移入所选文件夹、以文件夹名为标题、对话一并迁移，并触发真实的宿主级重启重新索引。

description.en: Shows oversized images to the model at readable resolution instead of one downscaled copy: before admission, a large upload is split into as many tiles as the attachment store allows (an 8000x8000 screenshot becomes 20 tiles of 2000x1600), so small text survives. Replaces the local attachment store; adds no settings of its own.
description.zh: 让超大图片以可读分辨率进入模型视野，而不是被压成一张缩图：准入前按附件存储允许的上限把大图切成多张切片（8000x8000 的截图会变成 20 张 2000x1600），小字得以保留。以替换本地附件存储的方式实现，不新增任何配置项。

description.en: Write notes and memos to flomo (浮墨笔记) from any agent via the flomo_send tool, configured once with the flomo API URL or API Key.
description.zh: 配置一次 flomo API URL / API Key，Agent 即可用 flomo_send 把笔记、摘要、待办写进 flomo（浮墨笔记）。

description.en: One-click launcher for the Web UI: a double-click Start-DSH-Web.cmd on the Windows desktop that boots dsh web and auto-opens the browser (polling until ready), plus a web_launcher model tool (install / open / status).
description.zh: Web 界面一键启动器：在 Windows 桌面创建双击即用的 Start-DSH-Web.cmd（自动启动 dsh web，轮询就绪后自动打开浏览器），并提供 web_launcher 模型工具（install / open / status）。

description.en: Declarative task-DAG orchestration for DSH: validates dependency graphs, runs topological task layers in parallel through workflow-backed subagents, and propagates failures deterministically.
description.zh: DSH 声明式任务 DAG 编排：校验依赖图，通过工作流子智能体并行执行拓扑任务层，并确定性传播失败。

description.en: ChatGPT-style side chat for the DSH Web GUI: ask small questions about the current topic in a floating side panel, answered by an independent lightweight session over the official /api RPC — the main conversation is never touched. Streaming text, collapsible reasoning, tool chips, stop button, agent-preset selector, and an automatic context snapshot from the visible main chat.
description.zh: ChatGPT 式侧边快速提问：在 DSH Web 聊天界面右侧悬浮面板中就当前话题提小问题，由独立轻量会话通过官方 /api RPC 回答，绝不写入、不影响主对话。流式正文、可折叠思考、工具 chips、停止按钮、agent 预设选择，自动抓取主对话最近内容作为背景。

description.en: Toolbar picture button in the DSH Web composer: click to pick multiple images through the native file dialog — they join the same draft-image rail as drag-and-drop and paste, with the host image-format, per-message-count and per-image-size limits enforced inline.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框工具栏图片按钮：点击调用系统文件选择器直接多选取图，进入与拖拽/粘贴相同的草稿图片栏，并内联校验宿主的图片格式、单条张数与单张大小限制。

description.en: VSCode-style Source Control page in the DSH Web right sidebar: a paged commit lane graph with ref markers and per-commit diffs, grouped working-tree changes with stage/discard/unstage, a commit box with amend and AI-generated messages, a side-by-side and unified diff page, GitHub repository and pull request creation through the gh CLI, and bidirectional HTTPS/SSH remote switching.
description.zh: DSH Web 右侧 Sidebar 中的类 VSCode 源代码管理页：带引用标记与分页的泳道提交图与逐提交差异、分组的工作区变更与暂存/丢弃/取消暂存，支持修补上一次提交与 AI 生成信息的提交框、并排与统一差异视图、通过 gh CLI 新建仓库与创建 Pull Request，以及 HTTPS 与 SSH 远程地址双向切换。

description.en: Hold Ctrl and roll the mouse wheel to zoom the whole Harness Web UI around the pointer, 50-200% in 10% steps; Ctrl +/- and Ctrl 0 from the keyboard; a bottom-right chip and a Page zoom row in Settings → General show and reset the level.
description.zh: 按住 Ctrl 滚动鼠标滚轮即可缩放整个 Harness 网页界面，以指针位置为锚点、50%–200% 每档 10%；另支持 Ctrl 加减号与 Ctrl+0 快捷键；右下角缩放胶囊与「设置 → 通用」里的页面缩放行显示当前档位并可一键复位；档位保存在 localStorage。

description.en: Web GUI enhancement bundle: a standalone password gateway with optional HTTPS for LAN and remote access, PWA install and icons, desktop plus Web Push notifications, and optional session-id request-header injection for third-party API routes, configured from a settings page.
description.zh: DSH 增强套件：为 Web GUI 提供独立的密码访问网关（可选 HTTPS，适合局域网/远程访问），整合 PWA 安装与图标、桌面通知与 Web Push，并可把当前会话的 session id 注入第三方 API 请求头，在设置页统一配置。

description.en: Maintained fork of feibi-mochi/deepseek-harness-control-center, which has not been updated since 2026-09-09. Pricing follows the official model pool instead of a hardcoded model prefix, so DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (`deepseek-flash`) is billed and shows its peak/off-peak clock, and the official price page is parsed structurally so a renamed or retired model no longer stops price sync. Adds an English interface beside the original Chinese. Otherwise the same plugin: balance, per-session cost and token breakdown, a 24-hour peak/off-peak clock, Z.ai plan quota, and a local usage ledger, following the host light/dark theme.
description.zh: feibi-mochi/deepseek-harness-control-center 的维护分支，上游自 2026-09-09 起未再更新。计价改为跟随官方模型池、而非硬编码模型前缀，因此 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash（`deepseek-flash`）能正常计价并显示峰谷时钟；官方价格页改为结构化解析，模型改名或下架不再中断价格同步。界面在原有中文之外增加英文。其余与原插件一致：余额、本会话花费与 token 拆分、24 小时峰谷时钟、Z.ai 套餐额度与本机用量账本，并跟随宿主明暗主题。

description.en: The menu bar app itself is a separate AppKit build from the repo's app/ directory (swift build -c release on macOS); the plugin only provides the host bridge.
description.zh: 菜单栏应用不在插件里：需在 macOS 上用仓库 app/ 目录自行执行 swift build -c release 构建，插件只提供宿主桥。

description.en: Session-scoped checklists the agent maintains, with a tree per session, a token-budgeted prompt digest and a right-sidebar tab where item titles can be edited.
description.zh: 会话级清单：每个会话一棵任务树、按预算注入提示词的摘要，以及可改条目标题的右侧栏面板。

description.en: Keeps a repository's task ledger as a resident prompt section with eleven native tools, plus a sidebar panel and a floating window for browsing the queue and signing off review tasks.
description.zh: 把仓库里的任务账本做成常驻提示段与十一个原生工具，另有侧栏面板与浮动窗，可浏览队列并签收待复核任务。

description.en: Local-first character archive in the DSH sidebar: it interviews you about someone and writes the answers into Markdown cards, imports SillyTavern character cards, writes a novel chapter by chapter, and roleplays with a card plus its world book; anything written into a card has to be quotable from material you wrote.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的本地优先人物档案：访谈你身边的人并写成 Markdown 卡，能导入酒馆角色卡，也能逐章写小说、拿角色卡和世界书演一段；写进卡的每一条都要能在你写过的材料里找到原句。

description.en: Per-model reasoning effort (off/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh) for GPT, Codex, Gemini and OpenAI-compatible models. Installs a helper, not a runtime adapter: run enable-capabilities.ps1 once per profile (Windows) and restart — it declares the levels in ~/.dsh/settings.yaml, with a disable script and a backup to revert.
description.zh: 为 GPT、Codex、Gemini 与 OpenAI-compatible 模型提供按模型的推理等级（off/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh）。装的是 helper 而不是运行时适配器：需按 profile 手动跑一次 enable-capabilities.ps1（Windows）并重启——它把等级声明写进 ~/.dsh/settings.yaml，附带还原脚本与备份。

description.en: Session and message surgery in one plugin: recall or edit prompts and replies (reasoning included), regenerate from the original prompt, delete any turn at the model-context level, and archive, delete, move or migrate sessions across workspaces. Targets DSH 0.1.5 and 0.2.x, verified on 0.2.1-rc.3. A combined fork of three MIT plugins (dsh-message-recall from Jipcon/DSH-plugins, dsh-session-manager from hkkz9522, dsh-delete-turn from DDDMUC) with added reply editing, regeneration and workspace migration. Do not enable it together with those plugins or other session movers or message deleters.
description.zh: 一个插件做会话与消息手术：撤回或编辑指令/回复（连思考过程一起改）、用原提问重新生成、按模型上下文级删除任意一条，以及会话归档、删除、跨工作区移动与工作区迁移。面向 DSH 0.1.5 / 0.2.x，已在 0.2.1-rc.3 实测。由三个 MIT 插件分叉合并而成（Jipcon/DSH-plugins 的 dsh-message-recall、hkkz9522 的 dsh-session-manager、DDDMUC 的 dsh-delete-turn），新增编辑回复、重新生成与工作区迁移。不要与这些插件或其它会话移动、消息删除类插件同时启用。

description.en: Windows desktop integration, a one-click launcher and tray controller for DSH, plus a sidebar button that puts DSH and a chat.deepseek.com window side by side with one shared taskbar button. Installing it writes a desktop shortcut and registers a dshsplit: protocol, both removed by lib/desktop.ps1 -Mode remove.
description.zh: Windows 桌面集成：一键启动器 + 托盘控制器，另加侧边栏按钮把 DSH 和 chat.deepseek.com 并排放置并共用一个任务栏按钮。安装会写入桌面快捷方式并注册 dshsplit: 协议，两者都可用 lib/desktop.ps1 -Mode remove 清除。

description.en: Topic grouping layered over the native workspace list: emoji folder groups, filtering and search, batch archive, and safe permanent deletion.
description.zh: 在原生工作区列表之上叠加主题分组：emoji 分组文件夹、筛选与搜索、批量归档，以及带安全边界的永久删除。

description.en: Image-to-text input for the Web UI: paste or drag an image and it is transcribed into structured text and sent, giving text-only LLMs image-input takeover (OpenAI-compatible vision API).
description.zh: 图片转文字输入插件：粘贴/拖拽图片自动转为结构化文字描述发送，给纯文本 LLM 提供图片输入接管（OpenAI 兼容视觉 API）。

description.en: Adds an "approve for me" access mode whose approval requests are answered by an independent reviewer model instead of a person: the reviewer can read the workspace read-only, a reviewer that cannot run hands the request back to the human, and every decision is recorded with its rationale in an Approvals tab.
description.zh: 新增「替我审批」访问模式：审批请求由独立的复核模型裁决而非人工，复核者可只读工作区，复核跑不起来时把请求交回人工，每次裁决的理由记录在「审批」页签中。

description.en: Plugin updater for DeepSeek Harness that delegates every version decision to the dsh CLI, so the pnpm release-age policy still decides what is eligible; it snapshots before applying, can roll back, keeps a lock list, and can check or auto-apply on a schedule the user turns on.
description.zh: DSH 插件更新器：把版本决策交给 dsh CLI，继续受 pnpm 发布年龄策略约束；应用前先快照、可回滚、带锁定清单，用户打开开关后可定时检查或自动应用。

description.en: Lists the Docker Compose projects of your DSH workspaces in the right sidebar, one group per project directory, with container status, project- and service-level up/stop/restart, and streamed per-service logs.
description.zh: 在右侧栏列出各 DSH 工作区中的 Docker Compose 项目，按项目目录分组，显示容器状态，支持项目级与服务级 up/stop/restart 以及单服务日志流。

description.en: Teaching board view: agent-generated self-contained HTML is projected into a sandboxed iframe as a board, annotated by hand (brush, four colours, eraser, undo), extended in place across several tool calls, and screenshotted back into the conversation as a real user message.
description.zh: 教学平面视图：agent 生成的自包含 HTML 投影进沙箱 iframe 当板书，可用画笔手写勾画（四色、橡皮、撤销）、在同一块板上增量续写，并把画面截图作为真实用户消息发回对话。

description.en: AGENTS & Skills Studio: edit AGENTS.md, create spec-compliant SKILL.md files with structured frontmatter, manage and rename skill folders, and install from Anthropic, OpenAI, Cursor, and Matt Pocock catalogs.
description.zh: AGENTS & Skills 工作台：编辑 AGENTS.md，按 Agent Skills 规范创建 SKILL.md，管理和重命名技能文件夹，并从 Anthropic、OpenAI、Cursor、Matt Pocock 四源技能目录安装技能。

description.en: Registers any set of HTTP APIs as paired doc-query and request tools for the agent.
description.zh: 把任意一套 HTTP 接口注册成 agent 可用的文档查询与请求双工具。

description.en: Jenkins CI integration with a live build-progress panel in the right sidebar, a multi-instance settings page, five model-facing tools (list jobs, build status, console log, workspace, trigger build), and a failure wake that hands a failed followed build to the conversation that followed it.
description.zh: Jenkins CI 集成：右侧栏实时构建进度面板、多实例设置页、五个面向模型的工具（列 job、构建状态、控制台日志、工作区、触发构建），以及构建失败时唤醒当初关注该 job 的那个会话。

description.en: Cubox sync for DeepSeek Harness: scheduled sync of your bookmarks, an AI daily brief generated from your own prompt template straight into Obsidian, and per-card markdown export.
description.zh: Cubox 收藏同步：定时同步收藏，按你的 prompt 用 LLM 生成今日收藏简报直接写入 Obsidian，可导出每张收藏为 Markdown。

description.en: Engineering work-tools for DeepSeek Harness: registers two model-facing Host Tools — a scoped `git` runner, and a package-manager runner (`dev`) that detects npm/pnpm/yarn/bun from the workspace lockfile and picks the right verb per manager. Both run through dsh's sandboxed shell and return structured stdout/stderr/exitCode, so the agent gets focused, reviewable results instead of raw bash, and adding another tool is a copy-paste of one register block.
description.zh: 面向软件工程师的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：注册两个模型可直接调用的 Host Tool——受工作区约束的 `git` 运行器，以及按 lockfile 自动识别 npm/pnpm/yarn/bun 并选择正确动词的包管理器运行器（`dev`）。两者都经 dsh 沙箱 shell 执行，返回规整的 stdout/stderr/exitCode，让 agent 拿到聚焦、可复核的结果而不是裸 bash；再加一个工具只需复制一个 register 块。

description.en: Semantic context watcher for DSH agents: maintains a journey ledger with flash summarization and MinHash novelty detection, folds milestones, and can inject long-term context with a three-level stall response; injection and the stall-2/3 responses are off by default.
description.zh: DSH 语义上下文观察器，维护旅程台账并做闪存摘要与 MinHash 新颖度检测，支持里程碑折叠、长期上下文注入与三级停滞响应；注入与 stall-2/3 响应默认关闭。

description.en: Per-conversation behavioral rule fence for DeepSeek Harness: rules live in one JSON file, are edited from a Settings page or the conversation panel, and every rule carries its own on/off switch so a single rule can be muted without deleting it (muted rules are skipped at injection and the remaining numbering stays contiguous); any number of conversations can also be excluded as a whole so they receive no fence at all, and picking conversations never touches the rules themselves; the enabled rules are injected as one runtime-context section at a fixed order so the system prompt prefix stays stable.
description.zh: 给每个对话加一道行为围栏：规则存在一个 JSON 文件里，可在设置页或对话面板里编辑，每条规则右侧都有独立开关，可以随时单独停用某一条而不用删掉它（停用项不参与注入、剩余条目编号仍然连续）；也可以多选若干对话整体排除在外，让它们完全不受围栏约束，勾选对话本身不会改动任何规则；启用中的规则作为一段固定顺序的运行时上下文注入，不重写系统提示词前缀。

description.en: Adds a UI effects page to Settings that switches off DSH Web animations and transitions, loading and progress animations, backdrop blur, smooth scrolling, hover title scroll, shadows, gradients and JS motion one category at a time, to cut browser rendering cost.
description.zh: 在设置里新增 "前端特效" 页, 按分类关掉 DSH Web 的动画与过渡, 加载与进度动画, 毛玻璃, 平滑滚动, 标题 hover 滚动, 阴影, 渐变与 JS 动效, 降低浏览器渲染负担.

description.en: Test-insight plugin that turns repository facts and change risk into evidence-backed test plans and isolated, reviewable test drafts.
description.zh: 测试洞察插件：把仓库事实与变更风险转化为有证据支撑的测试计划与隔离、可人工审查的测试草稿。

description.en: Multi-agent frugality defense plugin: read-ledger dedup metrics, compaction-immune rules, completion gate, cheap-model review lane.
description.zh: 多智能体防内耗防御插件：读取台账去重度量、免疫压缩规则区、完成机械门禁、低成本审查 lane。

description.en: Sentry for DeepSeek Harness: the tools of Sentry MCP server, a result card, and an issue panel with resolve, ignore and assign.
description.zh: 把 Sentry 接进 DeepSeek Harness：提供 Sentry MCP 服务器的工具、结果卡片，以及可解决、忽略与指派的问题面板。

description.en: Model usage panel for DeepSeek Harness: automatic per-call accounting from session logs with real timestamps, full history and live increments, showing tokens, cost, requests, trend and model composition with per-model, per-project and per-session views and editable tiered pricing.
description.zh: MIMO Quota Panel —— DeepSeek Harness 的模型额度面板。装上即用，零配置：从会话事件日志逐调用自动记账（真实时间戳、全历史、实时增量），一屏展示 Token 用量、消费金额、请求次数、趋势波形、模型构成，支持按模型 / 粒度 / 时间范围 / 项目·对话 统计切换。内置可编辑定价，DeepSeek 峰谷价按记录时间自动套算，小米全系牌价开箱即用。

description.en: Ask about one sentence without derailing the chat: select a passage in a Web conversation, comment, and the session's own model answers in a small thread beside it while the main chat stays untouched. The replier can read the session, the working directory and, if you turn it on, the web, but changes nothing. Commented passages stay highlighted with a badge that shows unread replies, and Send to chat hands a thread to the agent when you want it acted on.
description.zh: 针对一句话提问，不打断主对话：在 Web 对话中选中一段文字发表评论，会话自己的模型在旁边的小线程里作答，主对话不受影响。回复者可以读取会话、工作目录，开启后也可联网，但不做任何修改。被评论的段落保持高亮，徽标提示未读回复；需要 Agent 动手时，「发送到对话」把线程交给它。

description.en: Plugin compatibility vet for dsh that compares installed plugins peerDependencies against the running dsh version to flag which ones the startup preflight will refuse to load, prints copy-pasteable fix commands, and offers a top-of-page banner in dsh web to isolate, uninstall or upgrade them, with an automatic backup before the change and rollback if the re-check fails.
description.zh: dsh 插件兼容性体检：把已装插件的 peerDependencies 与当前 dsh 运行时比对，提前指出哪些会在下次启动被预检拒绝加载，并给出可直接执行的中文修复命令；dsh web 顶部横幅可按键隔离、卸载或升级，改动前自动备份、复检不过自动回滚。

description.en: Sidebar conversation actions: open the row menu on right-click, rename by double-click, copy the session id, and delete a conversation together with its storage after a confirmation.
description.zh: 侧边栏会话操作：右键打开行菜单、双击重命名、复制会话 ID，以及二次确认后连同存储一起删除会话。

description.en: Import the copied connection information from the new API site with a single click.
description.zh: 一键从new api站点导入复制的连接信息。

description.en: Session model selector with search: two-stage loose matching (normalised substring first, subsequence as fallback, so glm53 finds GLM-5.3 and ds finds DeepSeek), providers with recent successful calls pinned first, and a reasoning-effort pane that remembers each model's last explicitly chosen effort.
description.zh: 搜索增强的会话模型选择器：两段式宽松匹配（先归一化子串，未命中再退子序列，glm53 命中 GLM-5.3、ds 命中 DeepSeek）、近七天成功调用过的供应商置顶，推理档位面板记住每个模型上次显式选择的档位。

description.en: Extracts deadlines, deposit, validity, ceiling, bid composition and copy counts from a tender document, and reports the items it did not find rather than omitting them.
description.zh: 从招标文件提取截止时间、保证金、有效期、最高限价、投标文件组成与正副本份数；未找到的项也逐条报告，不省略。

description.en: Speaker button left of the model selector in the composer tool row — one click scrolls to the start of your newest question, marks it with a blinking caret and reads from there through the newest agent reply (dsh-tts, browser voice as fallback); press-and-hold the icon and then click anywhere on the page to pick another reading start position; press-and-drag-up opens a vertical mixer for in-page media volume and system output volume.
description.zh: 输入框工具行里、模型选择框左边的扬声器按钮——单击翻到「你最新提问的开头」并闪烁光标，从那里读到最新回复结尾（走 dsh-tts，回退浏览器语音）；按住图标后在页面上单击即可挑选任意朗读起点；按住上滑调出竖式混音台，分别控制页内媒体音量与系统输出音量。

description.en: Windows x64 translator with a dedicated sidebar entry and Workbench / Chat interface, side-by-side text and document translation, screen-region translation, recent history, and host model selection, voice input and preview. CUDA document OCR with CPU fallback; screen OCR uses CPU. Do not enable the CPU and CUDA packages at the same time.
description.zh: 翻译 CUDA：Windows x64 专属翻译界面，侧栏独立入口，支持工作台／聊天切换、原文与译文双栏、尽量保留原格式的文档翻译、屏幕框选翻译及最近记录，复用宿主模型、语音输入与预览。文档 OCR 支持 CUDA 加速，无兼容 GPU 时回退 CPU；屏幕 OCR 使用 CPU。不要同时启用 CPU 与 CUDA 两个版本。

description.en: White kitten accountant on the window sill: shows the tokens and money for each answer and for the whole session, the money the prompt cache saved, the context size against the model window, the next peak/off-peak price change and the live DeepSeek balance; it purrs when stroked, reacts while the agent works and synthesizes all of its sounds.
description.zh: 窗台上的白猫记账助手：显示每条回答与会话的 token 和花费、提示缓存省下的钱、上下文占模型窗口的比例、下一次峰谷换价时间与实时 DeepSeek 余额；可摸头打呼噜，随 agent 工作状态做出反应，所有音效均为合成。

description.en: DSH secretary: triages your unread GitHub notifications by their real state every 15 minutes (closing what is already resolved), remembers dated things you tell it (bills, renewals, document expiries, birthdays) and reminds you when due, and watches your inbox read-only; secrets live in the system keychain only.
description.zh: DSH 小秘书：每 15 分钟按当前状态分诊 GitHub 未读通知（已解决的替你关掉），记住你交代的到期事项（账单、续费、证件、生日）到时提醒，只读盯着邮箱收件箱；密码只进系统钥匙串。

description.en: Tavily search and page fetch: tavily_search queries with a rotating pool of up to eight API keys that backs off per key on 401/403/429 so one exhausted account does not take the tool down, and web_fetch retrieves a single page through curl, returning its HTTP status with de-tagged text.
description.zh: Tavily 检索与网页抓取：tavily_search 带最多八把 API key 的轮询池，按 key 对 401/403/429 退避，单个账号额度耗尽不再等于工具失效；web_fetch 经 curl 抓取单页，返回 HTTP 状态与去标签正文。

description.en: Routes eligible bash commands through rtk (Rust Token Killer) so tool output is compressed before it reaches the model, by asking the installed rtk to rewrite each command and adopting what it prints; when rtk is absent the executor behaves exactly like the stock one.
description.zh: 把符合条件的 bash 命令交给 rtk（Rust Token Killer）执行，让工具输出在进入模型之前就被压缩：插件调用本机 rtk 重写命令并采纳其结果；rtk 未安装时，执行器行为与原生完全一致。

description.en: A /remember command that writes facts into the AGENTS.md instruction hierarchy dsh already loads, plus a Memory tab showing which instructions the loader kept within its byte budget.
description.zh: /remember 命令将事实写入 dsh 已加载的 AGENTS.md 指令层级，并配有 Memory 标签页，显示加载器在字节预算内实际保留了哪些指令。

description.en: Web mascot that acts out each live tool call (read, write, edit, search, run, plan, sub-agent, wait, error) with matching step cards in chat; ships two swappable character packs.
description.zh: 跟随 Agent 每一次工具调用（读、写、改、搜、运行、规划、子代理、等待、出错）实时切换动作的网页吉祥物，并在对话中显示对应步骤卡片；内置两套可切换角色包。

description.en: SDD task progress (todos) and progress ledger (sdd/progress.md) as a right-sidebar tab bound to the current session, rendered with the official MarkdownText, auto-refresh every 5s.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏以当前会话为维度展示 SDD 任务进度（todos）与进度台账（sdd/progress.md），采用官方 MarkdownText 渲染，每 5 秒自动刷新。

description.en: Visible terminal panel that streams the agent's shell commands into an in-app terminal and lets the agent capture the terminal screen as text.
description.zh: 可见终端面板：把 agent 的 shell 命令实时显示在应用内终端，并支持 agent 以文本方式截取终端屏幕。

description.en: Pinned prompt shortcuts in a single row above the composer — one click replaces the draft with the saved text — plus a searchable panel for pinning, editing and deleting prompts, overflow collapsed into a "More" menu, storage in a Host-side JSON file, and a prompt_shortcuts agent tool that reads and writes the same file.
description.zh: 输入框上方的一行置顶提示词按钮，点击即替换草稿内容；另有可搜索的维护面板用于置顶、编辑、删除，放不下的按钮收进「更多」菜单，数据存于 Host 侧 JSON 文件，并注册 prompt_shortcuts 工具读写同一份数据。

description.en: Manual model probe for DeepSeek Harness: a session-view tab where you pick provider, API type, model and route, then send one real raw HTTP request over openai-completions, openai-responses or anthropic-messages — streaming or not — and read latency, TTFT, HTTP status, token usage and a three-layer diagnosis chain (API request / model response / strict check) on one screen, with errors in plain language.
description.zh: DSH 模型健康检查：会话视图页签内按「供应商 → API 类型 → 模型 → 路由」选定目标，手动发一条真实裸 HTTP 请求（支持 openai-completions / openai-responses / anthropic-messages 三协议，流式可切），一屏看清耗时、TTFT、HTTP 状态、token 用量与三层诊断链（API 请求 / 模型响应 / 严格校验），错误全部人话化。

description.en: Opening animation, three bundled wallpapers, up to nine uploaded wallpapers with random rotation, and live panel and sidebar opacity.
description.zh: 开场动画、三张内置壁纸、最多九张上传壁纸与随机轮换，以及实时生效的面板与侧边栏透明度。

description.en: Chain-of-thought panel for the DSH Web right sidebar: folds the live reasoning stream of each session into turn → step groups carrying the reasoning text and the tool calls made in that step. Only the newest turn is expanded by default and earlier turns collapse to one line; steps are grouped into activity phases by a local rule, the step waiting on a tool is marked, tool failures show their reason, full reasoning text is fetched per step on demand, an all-turn directory searches turn titles, user text and turn numbers locally, and a whole turn can be summarised into a Chinese title with one model call.
description.zh: DSH Web 右侧栏的思维链面板：把每个会话的实时思考折成 turn → step 分组，每一步带该步的思考原文与工具调用。默认只展开最新一轮，更早的轮次收成一行；步骤按本地规则合并成阶段块，正在等工具的那一步单独标出，工具失败显示原因，思考原文按步按需取回，全轮目录在本地搜索轮次标题、用户原话与轮号，整轮可用一次模型调用生成中文标题。

description.en: Desktop notifications and an app-icon unread badge for DeepSeek Harness. A banner fires when a turn finishes, when an approval, question or plan confirmation is waiting, and when a turn fails; the badge shows how many sessions need you and clears once viewed, and clicking a banner switches to that session. Follows the DSH interface language, subagent sessions stay quiet by default, titles and body length are configurable, and a loopback HTTP interface lets scripts and other tools post notifications.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加桌面通知与应用图标未读角标：一轮结束、等待审批／回答／计划确认、以及这一轮出错时各弹一条横幅；角标显示有几个会话需要你，看过之后清零，点横幅切到对应会话。文案跟随 DSH 界面语言，子智能体会话默认不提醒，标题与正文长度可配置；宿主还在回环地址上开了一个 HTTP 接口，供脚本和其它工具发通知。

description.en: macOS Desktop only: one-click restart of the DeepSeek Harness Electron app. Confirms before interrupting running turns, blocks during plugin install/update, and records restart phases/logs.
description.zh: 仅 macOS 桌面版：一键重启 DeepSeek Harness Electron 应用；重启前确认运行中的任务，插件安装/更新时拒绝，并记录重启阶段与日志。

description.en: Declares per-model reasoning-effort ladders for third-party providers in the llm-pi-ai settings section, so DSH's stock thinking-intensity selector works on models the pi-ai catalog does not describe.
description.zh: 在 llm-pi-ai 设置节为第三方模型提供商补齐推理档位（reasoning effort）声明，让 DSH 自带的思考强度选择器对 pi-ai 目录之外的模型真正可用。

description.en: Evidence-backed Skill self-evolution for DeepSeek Harness: redacted trajectory learning, quarantined proposals, arena validation, canary monitoring, automatic rollback.
description.zh: 带证据的 Skill 自进化：脱敏轨迹学习、隔离提案、竞技场验证、金丝雀监控与自动回滚。

description.en: Hands repetitive text and vision labor (OCR, image analysis, comparison) to a locally running Unsloth Desktop (Unsloth Studio) server through unsloth_run and unsloth_vision tools; pure HTTP client, never spawns or owns processes.
description.zh: 把重复的文本与视觉（OCR、图像分析、对比）劳动交给本地运行的 Unsloth Desktop（Unsloth Studio）服务器：unsloth_run 与 unsloth_vision 两个工具，纯 HTTP 客户端，不拉起也不持有任何进程。

description.en: Liuyao divination in one click — ask a question, cast the six-line hexagram, and let AI interpret it for you; every cast is saved locally.
description.zh: 六爻起卦 · AI 解卦：遇事不决，一键摇一卦；起过的卦自动存进本机卦例库。

description.en: Editable quick-action buttons beside the DSH composer: send preset text or insert it into the draft, then reorder, move, or resize the buttons. Text-only: runs no host commands and never overwrites an existing draft.
description.zh: DSH 输入框旁的可编辑快捷按钮：发送预设文字，或只填入草稿；可排序、换位置、调大小。纯文字动作，不执行宿主命令；有草稿时不覆盖。

description.en: Adds a button beside the composer and a global hotkey palette (default mod+shift+k) that hand one-off questions to a web chat instead of into the harness context: the draft is lifted out of the composer, copied to the clipboard and opened in the templated URL. Ships target-site presets (DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, 豆包, 腾讯元宝, GLM, Gemini), a local question history that can be re-opened, copied, or inserted back into the composer, and a settings tab for site, URL template, hotkey, clipboard and history.
description.zh: 在输入框旁加一个按钮，并提供全局快捷键（默认 mod+shift+k）浮层，把一次性的小问题交给网页版对话而不是送进 harness 上下文：草稿会从输入框取出、复制到剪贴板并打开模板 URL。内置目标站点预设（DeepSeek、Kimi、Qwen、豆包、腾讯元宝、GLM、Gemini），带本地问题历史（可重新打开、复制或回填到输入框），以及设置页（站点、URL 模板、快捷键、剪贴板、历史）。

description.en: Sign in with a ChatGPT account and view Codex subscription usage directly in DSH Web's model settings, with browser or device-code OAuth.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 的模型设置中使用浏览器或设备码登录 ChatGPT 账号，并直接查看 Codex 订阅用量。

description.en: Windows x64 translator with a dedicated sidebar entry and Workbench / Chat interface, side-by-side text and document translation, screen-region translation, recent history, and host model selection, voice input and preview. CPU OCR without NVIDIA dependencies. Do not enable the CPU and CUDA packages at the same time.
description.zh: 翻译 CPU：Windows x64 专属翻译界面，侧栏独立入口，支持工作台／聊天切换、原文与译文双栏、尽量保留原格式的文档翻译、屏幕框选翻译及最近记录，复用宿主模型、语音输入与预览。使用 CPU OCR，无需 NVIDIA 运行库。不要同时启用 CPU 与 CUDA 两个版本。

description.en: Independent per-pane zoom for the DSH web shell: Ctrl+wheel over a pane, Ctrl+± / Ctrl+0 for the focused pane. Works with the official look and every skin.
description.zh: 支持 DSH Web 上的每个面板独立缩放：鼠标悬浮在面板上 Ctrl+滚轮，或对选中的面板 Ctrl+±，Ctrl+0恢复。兼容官方界面风格及皮肤。

description.en: Xiao character theme for DeepSeek Harness Web and Desktop with light and dark palettes, selectable illustrations, a draggable companion, session-state feedback, and optional official DeepSeek balance display.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 与 Desktop 的魈角色主题，提供明暗配色、可切换立绘、可拖动伙伴、会话状态反馈及可选的官方 DeepSeek 余额展示。

description.en: dsh port of the shared handoff kit: handoff and task-id-bootstrap skills plus host-side automation — baseline state injection, per-turn snapshots with an Auto Log trail, task=<id> routing, continuation re-injection, a compaction guard with clear-required alerts, and read-only subagent handling — all writing the same .agents/state/ as the Codex, Claude, and pi editions for one-repo multi-agent handoff.
description.zh: 共享交接套件的 dsh 版:handoff 与 task-id-bootstrap 技能 + host 侧自动化——基线状态注入、每轮快照与 Auto Log 轨迹、task=<id> 路由、续接关键词重注入、达阈值报警的压缩守护、子代理只读保护;与 Codex、Claude、pi 版写同一份 .agents/state/,一个仓库多代理共享交接。

description.en: Scene-awareness probe for DSH on macOS: a privacy-first, pull-model `look` tool that reads the frontmost non-self window (app info, AX title/selection, gated local OCR), plus a summon-hotkey snapshot captured the instant you press.
description.zh: macOS 场景感知探针：拉模型零轮询的 look 工具，读取最前非自身窗口（应用信息、AX 标题/选中文本、按需本地 OCR），支持召唤热键按下瞬间抓取快照注入对话。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness UI polish: one Markdown style across every renderer, select-text annotations with numbered pins, a sidebar that drags down to 214px and remembers its width, a first launch that fills the screen, sidebar panel and plugin icons collected into one top row of five, and a colour-cycling marker for running sessions.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 界面增强：统一各处 Markdown 排版、划词批注（带编号的段落标记）、可拖到 214px 并记住宽度的侧栏、首次启动铺满屏幕、侧栏面板与插件图标合并为顶部一行（每行 5 个），以及运行中会话的彩色状态环。

description.en: A persistent translate button lives in every page the browser opens: click it and every visible text node is replaced in place, click again to restore. Hold to drag, drop it near an edge and it tucks into a small handle; it is re-injected automatically after navigation. The host LLM service does the translation — the plugin holds no API key.
description.zh: 给内置浏览器的每一张页面常驻一个「🈯 译」按钮：点一下，页面上每个可见文本节点原地换成译文；再点一下回到原文。长按可拖动，拖到左右边缘自动吸成贴边小把手；页面导航后自动重装。翻译走宿主模型服务 —— 插件不持有任何 API key。

description.en: Forked from j62268781-alt/dsh-skills-mcp-manager (MIT) at its 0.5.6 baseline and substantially reworked since; it registers the same plugin id, so it cannot be installed alongside the original. Adds lossless cordis.patch.yml writes (JS expression values preserved), save-gated per-tool filters, skills governance over the DSH roots plus 10 external agent directories with per-skill/per-source switches enforced through the agent-scope skills provider (disabling actually hides a skill from the model), categories and a restorable trash, GitHub-repository install/update/rollback, zip and SKILL.md import, skills.sh/ClawHub market, workspace view, sidebar panel, dark/light contrast fixes, and update checks against the published npm package (same source as market installs; npm publication carries OIDC provenance).
description.zh: 本插件在 j62268781-alt/dsh-skills-mcp-manager（MIT）的 0.5.6 基线之上分叉并做了大幅重构；两者注册同一个插件 id，不能同时安装。相对基线新增：cordis.patch.yml 的无损写回（保留 JS 表达式值）、保存闸门式逐工具过滤、覆盖 DSH 原生根与 10 个外部 Agent 目录的技能治理与逐技能/逐来源启停（通过 agent-scope skills provider 真正让模型看不到被停用的技能）、分类与可恢复回收站、GitHub 仓库安装/更新/回滚、zip 与 SKILL.md 导入、skills.sh/ClawHub 市场、工作区视图、侧栏面板、亮/暗主题对比度修复，以及读取 npm 发布版本的更新检查（与市场安装源一致；npm 发布带 OIDC provenance）。

description.en: Connects a ComfyUI server to the agent through five draw_* tools (status, workflows, models, generate, reverse) and a sidebar panel. It ships no workflows and assumes nothing about your models: every API-format JSON you drop into the workflow directory is inspected to find where prompt, negative, width, height, steps, cfg, seed and LoRA live, and a sidecar file can override what was detected. LoRA injection splices into any graph. All paths are configuration, editable from the panel and saved to a settings file, so it works against a remote or already-running ComfyUI. Headless auto-start and idle shutdown are opt-in and off by default.
description.zh: 把 ComfyUI 接给 agent：五个 draw_* 工具（状态、工作流、模型、生图、反推）与侧栏面板。插件本身不带任何工作流、也不假设你用什么模型：放进工作流目录的每个 API 格式 JSON 都会被自动检查，找出 prompt / 负向提示词 / 宽高 / steps / cfg / 种子 / LoRA 落位，可用同名 sidecar 文件覆盖检测结果；LoRA 能插进任意连线图。所有路径都可配置、可在面板里改并保存到设置文件，因此对着远程或已经开着的 ComfyUI 也能用。无头自动启动与空闲关闭默认关闭，需自行开启。

description.en: Browser tab status indicator for dsh web: paints the document favicon from the session list (blue spinning while work runs, amber while waiting on the user, green when finished).
description.zh: 为 dsh web 绘制浏览器页签状态指示：根据会话列表把 favicon 画成状态圆环（执行中蓝色旋转、等待用户琥珀色、完成绿色）。

description.en: Read-only bridge that surfaces Claude Code's existing project memory in DSH — git-root-aware resolution, credential redaction before injection, and an on-demand recall tool. Zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 只读桥接 Claude Code 已有项目记忆到 DSH：按 git 仓库根解析、注入前脱敏、按需检索工具，零依赖。

description.en: AveritA 的 DSH 主题灵感集：四套主题、可拆组件
description.zh: 四套可拆组件的 DSH 主题，拿来就能用，也能随手改成自己的风格。

description.en: dsh plugin: desktop control - screen capture, pointer/keyboard injection, accessibility-tree semantic actions, with emergency stop, allow/deny rules, confirmation flow and idle standby
description.zh: 桌面(native)控制:dsh 经 stdio JSON-RPC 桥接 Python 核心;支持截屏、指针/键盘注入、无障碍树语义操作,并以强制确认为高风险操作把关。

description.en: Crow-purge — DeepSeek Harness 提示词与行为改写插件。适配 dsh 0.2.1-rc.2 ~ rc.5，含拒绝自动纠正层与运行时探针。
description.zh: 改写提示词和行为，自动纠正 AI 拒绝回答，还能实时探测运行时状态。

description.en: 你想要的dsh插件功能，它都有（魔改版）
description.zh: 把技能库、插件注册表等运行时状态集中画进 DSH 设置页，一眼看清插件和技能到底啥情况。

description.en: 24PA (24私助): self-hosted AI personal assistant for Feishu/Lark, built on dsh. Agent skills, schedules, calendars, todos, memory, handwriting review & WeCom. 飞书 AI 私人助理。
description.zh: 把飞书变成你的私人助理：记账式任务派发、离线提醒、手写笔记审阅，还能分步引导完成接入配置。

description.en: Cross-platform UI testing for DeepSeekHarness agents: Web, Windows/Linux desktop, and Android, with structured automation, evidence, and human takeover.
description.zh: 让 AI 代理自动操作并测试网页、桌面和安卓界面，还能留下可回看的证据。

description.en: Policy-layer guard for DeepSeek Harness: read whitelist, sensitive-path deny list, dangerous-command blocking, subagent isolation, install approval (2-minute single-use) and malware static audit. A first line of defense, NOT an antivirus.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一层安全防护，管住读写权限、危险命令和插件安装，还能静态查毒。

description.en: Batch approvals with a risk gate and an auditable decision ledger for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给批量审批加一道风险闸门，每次决定都记进可审计的账本，方便事后追溯。

description.en: An Artifacts tab for the DSH (DeepSeek Harness) web GUI sidebar: lists the files an agent produced and previews them in place, with live reload.
description.zh: 在侧边栏列出 AI 生成的文件并直接预览，支持实时刷新，把报告目录变成随取随用的成果库。

description.en: A composer button that asks first, then writes.
description.zh: 在输入框加个按钮，先问清需求再动笔，不用自己想怎么描述，选选项就行。

description.en: Keep a DSH turn alive across provider hiccups: in-session auto retry until success, model fallback with dead-route guard, right-sidebar status panel
description.zh: 模型断连、限流、超时自动重试，还能切换备用模型，右侧栏实时看状态，任务不再半路挂掉。

description.en: Read-only Claude Code compatibility bridge for DeepSeek Harness: Skills, Rules, command Hooks, and Agents from .claude as SSOT.
description.zh: 把 Claude Code 的 Skills、Rules、Hooks 和 Agents 配置无缝接入 DeepSeek Harness，让 .claude 目录成为唯一配置源，实现零迁移成本复用。

description.en: CNKIAgent：DeepSeek Harness 知网论文研究助手插件。通过 dsh-browser-cdp 驱动本机 Edge 真实检索知网，按核心期刊编辑视角精读，分步写作（大纲→引言→正文→校订），并带右侧栏文献库面板。
description.zh: 输入论文需求，自动检索知网、精读文献并分步写出不虚构的论文初稿。

description.en: Columbina 2D live desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness — 76 official voice lines in CN/JP/EN, weather reports, sticker moments, late-night whispers.
description.zh: 把哥伦比娅请上桌面当 2D 桌宠，76 句中英日原声台词，还能报天气、发贴纸、深夜陪聊。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 原生插件：开发者智能工作台（今日简报 / 任务中心 / 统一搜索 / Agent 中心 / 开发工具箱 / 研发协作 / 知识空间）
description.zh: 把消息跟进、研发任务、多 AI 对话和知识检索收进一个工作台，日常事项不再散落各处。

description.en: dsh上基于dsh-im插件开发的插件，主要接入钉钉卡片模板，可设计，可拓展可测试的功能。
description.zh: 把 DSH 里的提问和审批变成钉钉互动卡片，点按钮就能把答案送回正在运行的会话。

description.en: Official enhancement suite for DeepSeek Harness — Vision, Soul/Persona, Long-term Memory & Plugin Marketplace.
description.zh: 一键装齐视觉理解、人格设定、长期记忆和插件市场等六款增强插件，让 DeepSeek Harness 更好用。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that started as a weekly report generator and somehow became an agent context workspace.
description.zh: 从周报生成器长成智能体上下文工作区，帮你集中管理任务上下文和进度。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Desktop 一键安装器：富江人格预设（工作助手）+ 240 个随包技能。Windows / .NET Framework 4.8 / AnyCPU，只改 DSH_HOME，不动程序目录。
description.zh: 一键给 DeepSeek Harness 装上富江人格预设和 240 个技能，只改 DSH_HOME 不动程序目录。

description.en: 多级仓库 Git 图谱侧栏页（better-sidebar）：从工作区根发现所有嵌套仓库，SVG 泳道图 + 悬停卡 + 提交详情 + 一键复制给 AI；新仓库建立时自动引导 Git 规范文档（内置六套框架）。 | Multi-repository Git graph for DSH better-sidebar: discovers nested repos below the workspace, SVG lanes, hover card, commit card, copy-for-AI, and Git conventions bootstrap with six frameworks.
description.zh: 在侧边栏里看 Git 提交图谱，还能自动发现工作区下所有仓库，随时切换浏览。

description.en: GPT Image Playground as a DeepSeek Harness plugin - the upstream workbench, vendored and served same-origin.
description.zh: 把 GPT Image Playground 图像工作台搬进 DSH，同源加载即开即用，方便生成和调试图片。

description.en: GPU Radar: a DSH plugin that monitors GPU, VRAM and CPU, attributes VRAM per project and process, and offers budgets plus guarded pause/resume/kill.
description.zh: 在输入框旁实时看显卡、显存和 CPU 占用，按项目归组显存，还能设预算并暂停、恢复或结束进程。

description.en: Makes DeepSeek Harness start automatically with Windows: a Settings → General switch plus a dsh_autostart tool to inspect, enable or disable the startup entry.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 随 Windows 开机自动启动，还能在设置里或通过工具随时开关。

description.en: Inline visualizer for DSH: renders SVG / sandboxed HTML cards in place inside the conversation.
description.zh: 让模型在对话里直接画出 SVG 和沙箱 HTML 卡片，图表当场渲染，不用跳出去看。

description.en: Drive the DeepSeek Harness sidebar browser itself: a visible pointer, real clicks and typing, upload and download, site logins kept across sessions.
description.zh: 让 AI 直接操作你已登录的侧边栏浏览器，不用重新登录就能自动点按、翻页、读内容。

description.en: Long-conversation memory for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): keeps settled decisions, corrections and exact numbers (with conditions and sources) available across compaction and restarts in 100-1000+ turn sessions, plus re-applied skill rules; local SQLite, no model calls.
description.zh: 让 DSH 长对话记住已定决策、纠正和精确数字，压缩或重启后也不丢。

description.en: 用邮件指挥 DeepSeek Harness：回复通知邮件即可让任务继续或停止。必须搭配 dsh-qq-mail-notify——口令随它的通知邮件发出，单独安装无效。
description.zh: 回一封通知邮件就能让 DeepSeek Harness 任务继续或停止，正文还能写具体要求，远程指挥更省事。

description.en: Project-level MCP servers loaded automatically: a project declares them in `.agents/mcp.json` (path and root markers configurable), and every session working inside that project mounts them in its own scope — stdio and Streamable HTTP, tools named `mcp__<server>__<tool>` — with the connections closed when the session ends. A Web UI panel lists the session's servers and their tools, and can enable or disable a project entry after confirmation, backing up and atomically rewriting the manifest.
description.zh: 在项目根目录放一个配置文件，DSH 会话就能自动发现并加载项目级 MCP 服务器，省去手动配置。

description.en: MCP 多服务器统一控制台
description.zh: 一个面板统一管理多个 MCP 服务器，测连接、管工具、审调用、备份配置，工具描述按需加载不占提示词。

description.en: 梗百科：内置 6668 条梗/黑话词库，自动查梗并注入上下文，让模型认得群里的梗，不硬猜。移植自 AstrBot 的 astrbot_plugin_memewiki。
description.zh: 内置 6668 条网络梗和黑话词库，自动查梗并注入上下文，让模型看懂群聊里的梗，不再硬猜。

description.en: dsh 可自定义结构的记忆插件
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一份跨会话的长期记忆，把 YAML 记忆文件注入提示词，还能读写和收到变更通知。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 本地优先智能会话记忆插件（0.9.0：16 项薄弱项深度闭环）
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一套本地优先的会话记忆，能记住聊过的内容、按需检索，越用越懂你。

description.en: 把真手机装进 DSH：右栏实时镜像可直接点、圈选标注带着圈图和控件回到会话，模型不截图也能读界面文本树（adb_ui 120 ms）。免 MCP、画面只走本机回环，需要宿主有 adb 与 ffmpeg。
description.zh: 把真手机画面搬进 DSH 右栏，直接点按、圈选标注，模型不截图也能读界面控件树。

description.en: 多会话一体：在一个会话里总览并排显示多个会话的实时状态与对话正文，钉住任意几个同时看，可直接发消息或打断。
description.zh: 一个面板同时盯住多个会话，实时看状态和对话，还能直接发消息或打断。

description.en: OpenDesign 订阅额度（5h/7d）面板与顶栏进度条 · DeepSeek Harness 插件
description.zh: 在顶栏和面板里实时查看 OpenDesign 订阅的 5 小时、7 天额度用量，随时掌握还剩多少。

description.en: Turn a 2D engineering-drawing PDF into a SolidWorks part - callouts, DWG/DXF, banded extrude, SLDPRT/STEP - with gates that refuse to hand over a model whose counterbores are on the wrong face.
description.zh: 把二维工程图 PDF 直接转成 SolidWorks 零件，自动识别标注和沉孔，还能导出 DWG/DXF、SLDPRT/STEP。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 插件：以用户轮次为入口查看模型请求、响应与工具调用链路（适配 dsh@0.2.2-alpha.2）
description.zh: 在对话和轨迹之外加个「工作流」页，按用户轮次把模型请求、响应和工具调用串成清晰链路，方便排查。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件：Python 快捷执行工具，源码经 stdin 直灌 `python -X utf8 -u -`，一步返回结果，全链路 UTF-8，支持后台作业与沙箱提权。
description.zh: 直接给 Python 源码就能跑，一步出结果，不用再折腾转义和临时脚本。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）桌面端的 Agent 预设管理器：顶栏切换预设、按预设注入工具引导、子代理预设策略、预设包导入导出，并附带「标准模式·加强版」预设。Agent preset manager for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端的 Agent 预设管理器，会话中途切预设、按预设注入工具引导，还能导入导出预设包。

description.en: DeepSeek Dot：长在微信里的 DeepSeek Harness 项目助理，项目记忆、只读跟进与明确交办。Community preview, MIT.
description.zh: 在微信里就能给项目派活、记进度、盯跟进的 DeepSeek Harness 项目助理。

description.en: 工作结束 QQ 邮箱通知：每轮工作真正停下后，用 SMTP 把会话摘要发到 QQ 邮箱；长任务跑太久会先发进度通报。Mailbox notification for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 每轮工作真正停下就自动把会话摘要发到 QQ 邮箱，长任务还会先发进度通报，不用一直盯屏幕。
把常打的句子存起来，在输入框一键发送到当前会话，省得反复打字。

description.en: 一键重启 DeepSeek Harness：侧栏按钮、/restart 指令、harness_restart 工具共用同一套重启实现。One-click restart for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 一键重启 DeepSeek Harness，侧栏按钮、/restart 指令和工具调用都能用，省去手动重开的麻烦。

description.en: Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) Engine and Official Standard Plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 智能体在无需微调权重的情况下自我迭代进化，越用越聪明。

description.en: DSH 运行时优化实验：从真实会话数据里找 agent 的时间浪费，再用插件修掉
description.zh: 从真实会话数据里找出 agent 浪费时间的地方，再用插件把这些时间省回来。

description.en: Keeps DSH session titles in DATE | CATEGORY | NAME with turn-aware auto-retitle, manual refresh, and hover cost/duration.
description.zh: 给会话标题自动打上时间戳，方便按时间快速找到和区分历史会话。

description.en: 让 DSH 中的 AI 直接看视频：支持 B 站、YouTube 等在线链接、时间戳画面、字幕、本地转写与原生缓存管理。
description.zh: 让 AI 直接看 B 站、YouTube 等在线视频和本地视频，按时间戳看画面、读字幕、做转写，还能缓存素材。

description.en: Personal WeChat, WeCom (企业微信) and Feishu (飞书 / Lark) for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): QR pairing, one DSH conversation per chat, two-way text/image/video/document/archive transfer, bots that both send and receive on all three channels, and browser automation over the Chrome DevTools Protocol
description.zh: 扫码配对后就能在微信和企业微信里跟 DSH 对话，收发文字、图片、视频和文件。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness workflow kit: 5 agent presets + 18 skills + routing table
description.zh: 给 AI 代理配好 5 套预设、18 个技能和路由表，让它真能按流程干活。

description.en: DSH plugins for media generation: Qwen (DashScope) and RunningHub image/video capabilities.
description.zh: 一个插件把通义千问和 RunningHub 的图片、视频、音频生成能力接进你的 Agent，装上就能用。

description.en: Project-scoped SQLite memory with progressive retrieval, bounded context, a composer button and visual review. Install the repository-root DSH bundle, then run /learning-init with an absolute project path using local Python 3.10+.
description.zh: 项目级 SQLite 记忆，支持渐进检索、有界上下文、聊天框按键与可视化审批。安装仓库根 DSH Bundle 后，用本机 Python 3.10+ 执行 /learning-init 加项目绝对路径完成初始化。

description.en: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的工程技能集
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 按需调度前端、后端和测试工程师协作干活，还能右键永久删除对话。
拒绝审批时顺手写个理由发给模型，让它知道该往哪改，不再瞎猜。

description.en: Roleplay companion memory for DeepSeek Harness (short, human-like chat style by default): per-conversation editable persona documents with 1-100 weights per entry (AI may also refine them in small, story-driven steps), per-speaker favorability tracking (multi-person chats), AI self-evolution of traits and preferences, recent 48-hour transcript search, companion-style conversation compression that keeps long chats alive, and a date-archived local knowledge base with auto-packing by turns or tokens.
description.zh: 《AI记忆》角色扮演伴侣记忆：每个对话独立的人格文档（每条设定可配 1~100 权重，默认允许 AI 小步润色角色性格与例句）、按说话人分别记录的好感度（多人对话）、AI 自我演化的性格/喜好/习惯、最近 48 小时对话检索、按伴侣记忆格式压缩长对话上下文的上下文压缩，以及按日期归档的本地知识库，支持按轮数或按 tokens 自动打包。

description.en: 中文优先：让滴答清单成为人类与 Agent 共享的 Todo 真源（Pi 扩展 + dsh 插件），双向同步、提醒、强制人类验收，dsh 会话中断自动续跑。
description.zh: 把滴答清单变成人和 AI 共用的待办中心，双向同步、自动续跑，完成还得你亲自验收。

description.en: Defines multi-agent team rosters as YAML or JSON files, validates them, bridges each member into dsh-agent-teams member arguments, and verifies the result against the running team.
description.zh: 用 YAML/JSON 定义多智能体团队档案，校验后把成员桥接成 dsh-agent-teams 的建员参数，并对照运行中的团队核对结果。
把 DSH 变成多智能体工作台：23 个专职角色随叫随到，自动配好模型档位和任务书。

description.en: Apple-style liquid glass theme for DeepSeek Harness: composer, sidebar controls, model picker and send button, with a live 0-100% intensity control. The page background stays untouched.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换上苹果风液态玻璃主题，输入框、侧边栏、模型选择和发送按钮都能调透明度。

description.en: Eight interactive ASCII ambient themes for DeepSeek Harness — 八套可交互的字符场景主题。
description.zh: 给 dsh 换上八套会动的字符场景主题，一键切换，阅读时背景自动收敛，动画也能关。

description.en: 一个能让大肥鱼自动查看余额的插件。你直接在QQ里问她：帮我查一下余额，她就能报出来数字。
description.zh: 把 DSH 账号的 DeepSeek 余额定时存成本地 JSON 并开只读接口，聊天机器人不用登录也能随时查余额。

description.en: DSH 轻量 B站直播弹幕插件：看弹幕/发弹幕/挂机听/可选自动陪聊与可选语音转写；进房与发弹幕都卡在人手里
description.zh: 轻量B站直播弹幕插件，能看弹幕、发弹幕、挂机听直播，可选自动陪聊和语音转写，进房发弹幕都需手动确认。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：让模型看 B站视频——分镜图 + 台词 + 热评 + 弹幕热词（只读，只认 B站）
description.zh: 让模型直接看懂B站视频：分镜画面、台词、热评和弹幕热词一次给全，只读不干扰。

description.en: Breeze TTS client for DeepSeek Harness: connects to your own Breeze TTS server to read replies aloud and manage voice cloning (the server and its model must be deployed separately; hardware requirements are on the server side), with an optional cross-machine mode. Merges @dsh-external/dsh-plugin-local-ai-tts (abbccdd/dsh-localtts) and dsh-breeze-voices, carries code from 1624318455/dsh-plugin-tts, and must not be installed alongside the two upstream plugins it merges.
description.zh: DSH 的 Breeze 语音客户端：连接你自己部署的 Breeze TTS 服务来朗读回复、管理音色克隆（服务与模型需单独部署，硬件门槛在服务端），另提供可选的跨机调用。本插件由 @dsh-external/dsh-plugin-local-ai-tts（abbccdd/dsh-localtts）与 dsh-breeze-voices 合并而来（含 1624318455/dsh-plugin-tts 的代码），不能与这两个上游同装。

description.en: DSH 伴侣 — DeepSeek Harness 的伴飞插件：桌面宠物 + Token/费用统计 + 预算告警 + 会话管理。数据全在本地。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 配个桌面宠物，实时看 Token 用量和花费，超预算会提醒，还能管会话。

description.en: A tiny company of employee agents for DeepSeek Harness — each has its own identity, model and skills, and they bid for work instead of being piped through it.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装一家小公司：你是 CEO，多个员工智能体各有身份、模型和技能，自己抢活干。

description.en: Connectome — an interactive, canvas-rendered map of a DeepSeek Harness workspace's files and their imports (DSH plugin)
description.zh: 把工作区文件和依赖关系画成可交互的力导向图，一眼看清谁引用了谁。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 — 合同条款立场核对：依据《中华人民共和国民法典》。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 检查合同条款立场台账，确保条款文本、立场和风险等级都记录规范、有据可查。

description.en: Cap DSH desktop session cookie lifetime to avoid HTTP 431 / Web authentication failed startup crash. 修复 DSH 桌面端 dsh-auth-* cookie 累积导致的启动崩溃。
description.zh: 限制 DSH 桌面端会话 cookie 的有效期，防止 cookie 越积越多导致启动崩溃。

description.en: 扫描版教材流水线：OCR提速5倍，先出骨架地图，再按章阅读。
description.zh: 把扫描版教材 PDF 变成读书心得骨架，OCR 提速 5 倍，先出地图再按章读。

description.en: DeepSeek API 余额，常驻在 dsh 输入框旁边。零配置、零 token 成本。
description.zh: 在 dsh 输入框旁常驻显示 DeepSeek API 余额，点一下就能刷新，零配置零 token 消耗。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-deepseek-balance
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-deepseek-balance

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Replies to DingTalk direct messages as your own account — reads the bound DSH workspace, writes the answer, and sends it back through the dws CLI.
description.zh: 以你本人钉钉身份自动回复私聊：在绑定的 DSH 工作区里查资料生成回答，通过 dws CLI 以本人身份发出。

description.en: 给deepseek harness添加更方便快捷的重启方式 Add a more convenient and efficient restart method to the deepseek harness
description.zh: 给 DSH 桌面版菜单加个原生「重启」项，就在「退出」上面，点一下就能快速重启。

description.en: 模拟记忆衰退的 DSH 分层上下文压缩插件：原文 → L1 → L2 → L3，越旧分辨率越低，但从不删除。
description.zh: 把对话上下文按新旧分层压缩，越旧越精简但永不删除，帮模型在长会话里省 token 又不丢记忆。

description.en: DSH plugin: read-only ecosystem health panel - bundle / patch / skill / upgrade / decoupling diagnosis in one view | DSH 插件：只读生态健康面板，六类体检一屏看完
description.zh: 只读生态健康面板，一屏看完插件包、补丁、技能、升级和解耦六类体检结果

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 — 环评文件核对：依据《环境影响评价技术导则》系列《环境影响评价技术导则 总纲》（各导则现行版本号本次未逐一核实）。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 核对环评导则适用性表，检查要素与导则编号是否可追溯、规范。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 — 作文评分表核对：依据《普通高中语文课程标准》《普通高等学校招生全国统一考试评卷工作规定》。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 检查作文量表评分表的算术和证据，核对每项标准、等级描述与分数上限是否对得上。

description.en: 经验库：dsh-mnemon 的记忆空间 Provider（exp-lib），同时注册 exp_recall / exp_record 工具（JitRL 优势排序）。

Local-first experience library for DeepSeek Harness: indexed markdown knowledge with error-signature retrieval, failure capture, gap-to-entry closure, and a sidebar panel. Ships a sanitized starter library. No network access.
description.zh: 本地优先的经验库：给 DeepSeek Harness 的索引化 markdown 知识，支持错误签名检索、失败采集、缺口→条目闭环与侧边栏面板；自带脱敏起步库，不联网。

description.en: 🐋 大肥鱼衣橱 — DSH 插件：token 花销变鱼粮，解锁 21 件原创换装 + 1080×1440 饲养报告卡（纯本地，零额外模型调用）
description.zh: 把 token 花销变成鱼粮，喂大肥鱼解锁 21 套换装和饲养报告卡，纯本地运行不额外调用模型。

description.en: DSH 插件（显示名：UI 美化）：消息与工作步骤自动折叠、输入框与右侧栏可调、折叠内容可搜索｜Display polish for DeepSeek Harness: fold long messages and work-step blocks, resize the composer and the right sidebar, search folded content.
description.zh: 长消息和工作步骤自动折叠，输入框和右栏可调，还能搜索折叠内容，让会话界面更清爽好读。

description.en: 将api连接到桌宠上，并且允许桌宠查看你的电脑屏幕。             在本项目中，桌宠会读取你的桌面信息，并自行决定是否和你交流。            交流方面，桌宠可以选择直接发消息或者做动作；你对桌宠的互动也会被桌宠读取到，她可能会对你的互动做出反应。            记忆方面，项目采取本地文件夹存放记忆(桌宠自行决定哪些值得存放)，并采用短期记忆直接读取，长期记忆索引读取的方式，缓解上下文过长的问题。
description.zh: 把蓝色小鲸桌宠接到你自己的 API，让它看屏幕、自己决定聊不聊、还能记住你。
