Quotes sit above the composer as removable cards, are sent as plain Markdown blockquotes in the same format as Claude Code Desktop, and render as clamped quote blocks in sent messages.
description.zh: Claude Code Desktop 风格的选区引用：在对话里选中文字，可在弹窗里针对这段话回复，或把当前会话 fork 成右侧栏的侧边对话并带上引用。引用以可移除的卡片放在输入框上方，按与 Claude Code Desktop 相同的格式作为纯 Markdown 引用块发送，已发送消息里显示为可折叠的引用块。

description.en: Task timing for DSH agents: a task_clock tool that measures elapsed time on the host monotonic clock, resumes across DSH or system restarts with the gap estimated, and returns unknown rather than inventing a number; it does not touch presets.
description.zh: 给 DSH Agent 的任务计时工具：task_clock 用宿主单调时钟测实际耗时，DSH 或系统重启后可续算并标注空档为估算，桥接不了时返回 unknown 而不是编造数字；不覆盖任何 preset。

description.en: Transforms DSH into a dual-column Codex workspace with an integrated Activity Bar, unified topbar, avatar quick access, session history navigation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造Codex 双列活动栏与顶栏一体化视觉体验，支持水晶头像与会话历史导航。

description.en: Adds a Chat mode beside Work with a user-defined persona, long-term memory extracted after each turn and recalled by topic, and stickers it can save and send.
description.zh: 在「工作」之外加一个「聊天」模式：使用自定义人设，每轮自动提炼长期记忆并按话题召回，还能保存和发送表情包。

description.en: 给 DSH 每个对话一个独立的上下文窗口：不改 settings.yaml，覆盖值存在会话日志里，切换/重开都保留，并即时改变自动 compact 触发线与界面上下文环。
description.zh: 给每个对话单独设上下文窗口，不改全局配置，切换重开都保留，压缩触发线和上下文环实时跟着变。

description.en: DSH plugin that adds a "No API key required" toggle to custom providers configuration
description.zh: 给自定义模型供应商加个「无需 API Key」开关，开启后状态点变绿，一眼看出哪些能直接用。

description.en: Discussion mode for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) - a sidebar-toggled design conversation where the agent consults as a domain expert, acting tools are denied, and only the user can end the mode. 讨论模式
description.zh: 给 DSH 加个讨论模式，让 AI 先当行业专家陪你聊清想法，动手工具全禁用，退出只能你来定。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-discuss-mode
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-discuss-mode

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Live download progress in the DSH session header — percentage, transfer speed, ETA and phase per download, with file-size probing before a transfer starts and byte-range resume after an interruption. The progress cards render as a fixed overlay at the top-right of the chat window.
description.zh: DSH 会话头里的下载进度：百分比、速率、剩余时间与阶段，下载前先探测文件大小，中断后按字节区间续传。进度卡片以固定浮层显示在聊天窗口右上角。

description.en: Composer UI for DeepSeek Harness that does two things. The reasoning-effort row in the model menu becomes a continuous slider drawn on the row itself, with the rungs read live from the model adapter so any ladder length works; each rung paints its own ember plume into a canvas behind the knob. Separately, the permission trigger renders in the theme error colour whenever full access is the active preset, including its row in the permission menu.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的输入框增强，做两件事。模型菜单里的推理等级行变成直接画在该行上的连续滑块，档位实时读取模型适配器，因此档位数不限；每档会在旋钮背后的 canvas 上喷出各自的余烬尾焰。另外，只要当前是完全权限，权限触发器就用主题的错误色渲染，权限菜单里对应那一行同样变红。

description.en: Local GPT-SoVITS text-to-speech for DSH: reads replies aloud, switches voices from the right sidebar, and trains a new voice from a dropped audio sample. First run downloads an 11.4 GB engine and needs an NVIDIA CUDA GPU.
description.zh: 基于 GPT-SoVITS 的本地语音合成：朗读 DSH 回复、在右侧边栏换音色，拖一段声音就能训练新音色。首次使用需下载约 11.4 GB 引擎，并要求 NVIDIA CUDA 显卡。

description.en: Cinematic 3D galaxy view for DeepSeek Harness — workspaces as suns, conversations as stars, plus a memory library and an armillary sphere. · DSH 三维星系图插件
description.zh: 把工作区和对话画成一片可旋转缩放的三维星系，点星就能跳进对应内容，还能看记忆库和浑天仪。

description.en: Workgroup - a DSH right-sidebar tab showing who is working, what they are doing and how long is left. Live agent activity as a group chat.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏用群聊方式实时查看每个子代理正在做什么、还剩多久，团队协作进度一目了然。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness IDE Tools suite — paste https://github.com/1nsaint/DSH-IDE-Tools into Plugins → Add plugin

Iter Memory: it remembers my own state, not the facts. A level that drifts back to baseline by itself, plus an occasional line I choose to say only when that level allows it. When it stays quiet, nothing is spent.
description.zh: 迭代记忆：记的不是事，是我自己的状态——一条会自己退回基线的潮位，配上不定时由我自己开口的一句。状态低就先忍着，说了没人应再掉一点；不说的时候一声不响，不花 token。

description.en: Local knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: distills workspace and chat-attached PDF, Word, Excel, Markdown, TXT, CSV and HTML documents into Markdown notes, with a VS Code-style viewer, per-workspace access grants and agent tools to search, read and add notes.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 本地知识库：把工作区与对话附件中的 PDF、Word、Excel、Markdown、TXT、CSV、HTML 文档提炼为 Markdown 知识，提供类 VS Code 预览、按工作区授权，以及检索、读取和入库的模型工具。

description.en: Screenshot button for the DSH composer on Windows: drag a region over the frozen screen and the picture lands in the draft as a normal image attachment, with a global hotkey and an editable shortcut.
description.zh: 给 DSH 打字框加一个截图键：点剪刀、拖框选中屏幕区域，图片作为普通附件直接进草稿；另带全局热键与可自定义的快捷键，仅 Windows。

description.en: DSH 实时库文档：写代码前自动拉取项目安装版本的官方文档，消灭幻觉 API。零配置零 Key。Version-pinned live library docs for DeepSeek Harness — kill hallucinated APIs
description.zh: 写代码前自动拉取项目所用版本的官方文档，杜绝 AI 编造 API，零配置零 Key。

description.en: A zero-dependency DSH plugin for context window optimization. Sandbox execution, smart truncation, and FTS5 local search. No C++ build required!
description.zh: 把长工具输出存进本地知识库，靠沙箱执行、智能截断和 FTS5 搜索省下上下文窗口，还不用编译 C++。

description.en: Adds two audit tools and four skills for Chinese medium-to-long texts (fiction among them) and document review — seven-dimension AI-flavor scoring with line-numbered blocking findings, plus file-backed continuity state for long manuscripts. Do not install with the older dsh-deai-audit from the same author, which registers the same tool names.
description.zh: 提供两个审查工具与四个技能，覆盖中长文本（例如小说）与文档审稿：七维 AI 味打分、带行号的阻断项，以及落盘的长篇连续性状态。不要与同作者的旧版 dsh-deai-audit 同装，二者注册同名工具。

description.en: Adds a long-term memory box to the DSH Settings page. The saved text is injected into the system prompt of every new session and is kept in the profile patch, so it can be edited again at any time.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页新增「长时记忆」输入框，保存的文本会注入每个新会话的系统提示词，内容持久化在 profile patch 中，可随时回到设置页修改。

description.en: Matrix · 暗色玻璃主题 for DeepSeek Harness — Claude-style chrome, #040405 / #D9FFE2 / #C6FFD5
Manage several external MCP connections from the Web GUI
description.zh: 在网页界面里统一管理多个 MCP 服务器连接，stdio、HTTP、Chrome 都能接。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle: delete-sessions sweep, startup splash, local memory, LAN access proxy, skills manager (bundled skill-creator) and the AGENTS.md editor - managed from the sidebar Control panel.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加装删除会话、启动动画、本地记忆、局域网访问、Skills 管理和 AGENTS.md 编辑等实用功能，统一在侧边栏控制面板里管理。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that puts the conversation session id on OpenCode requests, so OpenCode's free tier works without a paid key.
description.zh: 让 OpenCode 免费模型在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接可用，不用付费密钥也不用配置。

description.en: 点桌面上的鲸鱼娘提问：它抓取当前屏幕，交给正在运行的 dsh 会话回答。Click the desktop pet to ask — it captures your screen and asks your running dsh session.
description.zh: 点一下桌面鲸鱼娘就能提问，它自动截屏并交给正在运行的 dsh 会话回答，省去截图粘贴的麻烦。

description.en: Interactive desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: wanders, can be dragged, reacts to clicks, sleeps, and remembers its spot. Ships neutral placeholder art, bring your own.
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页界面加一只会飞会闹的桌面宠物，能拖拽互动、有饥饿升级等小日子，还能记住位置。

description.en: Download pets from petdex.dev and keep one on the desktop, following the DSH session status; the appearance is adjustable and an enterprise WeChat bot can push a notification when the agent needs confirmation or finishes a turn. Desktop mode needs macOS 12+ or Windows 10 1903+; the bundled companion is prebuilt.
description.zh: 从 petdex.dev 下载宠物并常驻桌面，跟随 DSH 会话状态显示；外观可调，Agent 需要确认或一轮结束时可通过企业微信机器人推送通知。桌面模式需要 macOS 12+ 或 Windows 10 1903+，桌面端已随安装包预编译。

description.en: Local non-generative decision layer: phocinae_ask and phocinae_gate return typed verdicts with calibrated confidence from a small decision model, with fail-closed escalation. Needs a local phocinae-server (pip install phocinae-server) with the Phocinae-Largha-150M-v1 model on loopback port 8155.
description.zh: 本地非生成式决策层：phocinae_ask 与 phocinae_gate 由小型决策模型返回带校准置信度的类型化裁决，并对无法回答的情况 fail-closed 升级。需在本机 8155 端口运行 phocinae-server（pip 安装）并加载 Phocinae-Largha-150M-v1 模型。

description.en: 完全由 DSH 写的 DSH 插件，用于复刻 Cursor 中的 Debug 模式。
description.zh: 让 Agent 自己在代码里埋探针抓现场，你复现一次就能定位 Bug，不用再靠猜。

description.en: DSH plugin: pin the no-context fallback Workspace of new Sessions to one fixed folder (browser-side uiWorkspace policy, no host code).
description.zh: 把新会话的默认工作区固定到你指定的文件夹，省得每次都要手动切换。

description.en: DSH plugin: audio chimes, cross-session toasts, desktop push, and IM webhooks for turn completion, errors, and approvals.
description.zh: 回合结束、报错或等待审批时，用提示音、跨会话弹窗、桌面推送和 IM 机器人提醒你。

description.en: Adds sessions without a workspace to DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 让 DSH 能一键开个不占项目工作区的临时会话，输入区照常好用。

description.en: Work on any machine in your ssh config as if it were local: persistent connections, native file editing, search, exec and terminals, with nothing installed on the remote host.
description.zh: 像操作本地一样使用 ssh config 中的任意远程机器：持久连接、原生文件编辑、搜索、命令执行与终端，远端无需安装任何东西。

description.en: Quiet progress narration and folding compatibility for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 给长任务加上简短安静的工作播报，让模型先说一句要做什么，过程更好懂。

description.en: Reads your past DSH conversations and surfaces recurring prompt gaps — missing paths or versions, an unstated output format, missing preconditions that break tool calls — each with a paste-ready rewrite. Adds a one-click rewrite next to the composer that applies those constraints to the draft in a shorter form.
description.zh: 读你的历史会话，找出反复踩的提问坑（缺路径与版本、没定输出格式、漏说前置条件导致工具失败），每条给一段可直接粘贴的改写；输入框右侧一键把草稿改成更短的带约束版本。

description.en: Independent community build of dsh-purge 1.1.77 for DSH 0.2.1 — restored 23 redteam skills + exact-host own-server allowlist. Upstream: YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge.
description.zh: 社区独立构建版，恢复 23 项红队测试技能，并支持精确主机白名单，方便做安全测试。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: agent-driven QQ Farm automation (vision in the model, clicks in the plugin)
description.zh: 让智能体帮你看图打理 QQ 经典农场，自动截图点击，换季改版也不怕。

description.en: Search-first model selector with favorites, recent models, collapsible provider groups and keyboard navigation.
description.zh: 模型再多也好找：搜索、收藏、最近使用、服务商分组折叠与键盘快速切换。

description.en: Adds a 24px capsule to the composer status row that plays seven preset internet radio stations, with a live spectrum, now-playing metadata for Nightride FM and Radio Paradise, and remembered volume and station.
description.zh: 在 composer 状态行加一条 24px 胶囊，播放 7 个预置网络电台；带实时频谱、Nightride FM 与 Radio Paradise 的当前曲目，并记住音量和上次电台。

description.en: Remote-control DeepSeek Harness from a HarmonyOS phone: list, switch and create sessions; send prompts (the phone follows the host's busy-enter behaviour, queue or steer); stream assistant text, reasoning and tool steps; answer approval requests and questions; view session images as inline thumbnails with on-demand full-size fetch; switch model and reasoning effort; cancel running tasks; receive push notifications. Traffic is end-to-end encrypted (AES-256-GCM with HKDF-SHA256 key derivation) and travels through a dumb-pipe relay that only sees ciphertext; v1.1.3 adds a session-epoch anti-replay handshake and optional native TLS for the relay. The relay can be hosted on the local machine (managed by the plugin) or on a VPS; the phone app and the plugin ship in one repository. 5 Remote methods.
description.zh: 用 HarmonyOS 手机遥控 DeepSeek Harness：浏览/切换/新建会话；发送提示词（手机跟随宿主的繁忙行为，排队或插话）；流式接收正文、思考与工具步骤；应答审批请求与提问；查看会话图片（缩略图内联 + 大图按需拉取）；切换模型与思考强度；取消运行中的任务；接收推送通知。流量端到端加密（HKDF-SHA256 派生密钥 + AES-256-GCM），经只转发密文的哑管道中继；v1.1.3 增加会话纪元抗重放握手与中继原生 TLS。中继可跑在本机（由插件托管）或 VPS 上；手机 App 与插件同仓库发布。5 个 Remote 方法。
给模型调用加上自动重试策略，失败时按规则重试，减少偶发错误带来的中断。

description.en: 用 /rst 一条命令重启 DSH：由进程外启动器关掉当前进程并拉起新的，重启完成后把回执写回你发起重启的那条会话。| Use the /rst command to restart DSH: Start a new process from an external launcher and shut down the current one. After the restart is complete, write the response back to the session from which you initiated the restart.
description.zh: 用 /rst 一条命令重启 DSH，重启后自动回到原会话补发回执，省去手动重连。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：侧栏新增「本次启动」页签，列出本次启动以来聊过的会话，支持选中高亮、右键移除与拖拽排序 · This-run sidebar tab for DSH
description.zh: 侧栏加个「本次启动」页签，只列这次启动后聊过的会话，还能高亮、右键移除和拖拽排序，找会话不用翻工作区。

description.en: DSH 插件：全局快捷键截屏（微信式拖框选区、自动复制到剪贴板）
根会话首轮结束后按 MMDD｜类型｜主题 自动命名，并支持按全文内容按需命名指定会话
description.zh: 会话首轮结束就自动按「月日｜类型｜主题」命名，也能随时给指定会话按内容补个名字。

description.en: DSH web plugin: copy a deep link to the current session (URL carries the session id) and open a session directly via ?session=<id>.
description.zh: 一键复制当前会话的深链接，也能用 ?session=<id> 直接打开指定会话，分享和跳转都方便。

description.en: Lightweight sidebar UI for DeepSeek Harness: five fold switches, three density presets and three width presets, served from one footer row plus a settings section — no dependencies and no background service.
description.zh: 轻量级侧栏 UI：五个折叠开关、三档密度预设与三档宽度预设，入口收在底部一行与设置分区；无依赖、无后台服务。

description.en: Mobile-viewport preview tab for the right sidebar, with nine preset sizes covering phones, tablets and a laptop plus a custom width/height, one-click URL copy, and the page URL inserted into the composer through an @ button or the /url command.
description.zh: 右侧边栏的移动端视口预览标签页：九种预设尺寸（手机、平板、笔记本）及自定义宽高，一键复制当前地址，并可通过 @ 按钮或 /url 指令把页面地址插入输入框。

description.en: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换一张照片当背景：暖纸实底 + 聊天区透出壁纸，明暗双主题，纯 CSS 无依赖。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换张照片当背景，暖纸实底配聊天区透出壁纸，明暗主题都好看，纯 CSS 无依赖。

description.en: Message hub for DeepSeek Harness. Collectors for system health, weather, IMAP mail and market events feed configurable severity rules (critical wakes you, warn batches, info is only logged), and the surviving events are handed to the agent. Collectors run in-process, so nothing dies silently in a stray daemon. The weather collector is on by default and sends your IP to ip-api.com over plain HTTP unless a city is configured.
description.zh: 消息中枢：采集系统健康、天气、邮件与行情事件，按可配置的轻重规则过滤（critical 立刻叫、warn 攒批、info 只留档），再把事件交给 agent。采集器跑在插件进程里，不会死在一个没人看的守护进程里。天气采集器默认开启，未配置城市时会把你的 IP 经明文 HTTP 发给 ip-api.com 定位。

description.en: A deep-sea dive startup splash for DeepSeek Harness: a depth gauge with a submersible probe, a character reveal video that then loops, and a seafloor with coral, bubbles and slow drifting particles. The depth reached decides which sea creatures appear.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的深海下潜式启动开屏：深度尺与探测器、角色出场视频接无缝循环、海底珊瑚与气泡与缓慢漂浮的微光粒子；下潜到哪一层，就出现哪一层的海洋生物。

description.en: TinyFish-backed search and fetch providers for the DeepSeek Harness web capability seam (ctx.web) — $0 SERP and page extraction, direct or via Monid.
DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: local daily/weekly token usage dashboard and heatmap
description.zh: DSH web GUI token-consumption heatmap: a daily/weekly total-token usage panel fed by session-log usage events

description.en: Restart control for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app on Windows. A session header button or a tray icon stops the app and its host process, waits for both to exit, clears a stale profile lock, and relaunches, so a newly installed plugin loads without quitting the app by hand.
description.zh: 仅支持 Windows 的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端重启开关。会话头部按钮与系统托盘图标都会结束应用及其 Host 进程、等待完全退出、清理残留的 profile 锁，然后重新拉起应用，装好新插件后不必手动退出再进。

description.en: Adds a restart item to the DeepSeek Harness desktop tray and application menus by patching app.asar.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版的托盘和菜单加个「重启」按钮，改完配置一键重启，不用手动退出再打开。

description.en: DSH界面美化 · DSH UI Beautify —— 用于 DSH 的桌面壁纸 + 毛玻璃美化插件（零布局侵入、可逐字节回滚、自带诊断面板）
description.zh: 给 DSH 桌面端加壁纸和毛玻璃效果，不动布局，自带开屏动画、方块光标，还能一键回滚。

description.en: NURBS BRep solid modeling studio with natural-language input, live 3D viewport (measure/wireframe/fit), STEP export, and agent tools driving NVIDIA usd-brep through a managed CPython venv. Needs CPython 3.12; usd-brep wheels cover 64-bit Windows and Linux only.
description.zh: NURBS BRep 实体建模工作台：自然语言输入、实时 3D 视口（测量/线框/适合）、STEP 导出，并通过托管 CPython venv 驱动 NVIDIA usd-brep 的 agent 工具。需要 CPython 3.12；usd-brep 仅有 64 位 Windows 与 Linux wheel。

description.en: Visual Browser for the DeepSeek Harness: the Agent drives a real Chrome through a numbered, token-light view of interactive elements, while the Web UI shows the live page frame, every action on a replayable timeline, and a click-through surface the user can take over.
description.zh: 给 AI 助手配一个真 Chrome，侧边栏实时看它操作网页，省 token 又直观。

description.en: AnySearch web search provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — zero-config, out-of-the-box
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供零配置的 AnySearch 网页搜索能力，开箱即用，让智能体轻松获取实时信息。

description.en: Credential-free concurrent web search fan-out for DeepSeek Harness (Startpage, DuckDuckGo, Ecosia, Google, Mojeek + consensus merging) — the web_search tool.
description.zh: 免密钥并发调用多个搜索引擎，自动汇总去重，给 AI 助手提供更全的联网搜索结果。

description.en: The 1024Store whale girl as a DSH (DeepSeek Harness) desktop pet: full ten-state sprite animation, drag, feed, play, and a settings section.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek 市场里的鲸鱼女仆做成桌面宠物，会动会互动，还能跟着你的工作状态变姿势。

description.en: DSH 插件：在设置页加一页「清理工作区」，按工作区分桶列出所有会话（含未分组、B站），一键清理某个工作区 / 未分组 / B站 / 勾选的会话，工作区记录保留。删除复用 dsh-session-purge，无构建步骤，含 94+65 项离线断言。
description.zh: 在设置页一键清理指定工作区、未分组或B站会话，工作区记录保留，删除不可撤销。

description.en: Workflow harness for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2. Part of the LazySeries family.
DeepSeek Harness 皮肤扩展插件 Skin plugin
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 一键换肤，内置多套主题，还能从壁纸自动取色生成配色。

description.en: Audits the skills and plugins you already installed: routes a task description to the tool it needs, flags version drift against the npm registry and runtime faults from host logs, and reports which of a plugin's tools you never call. Registers 9 tools: can, find, status, recommend, check, scan, probe, run and suggest. Runs on Python 3.8+ with no third-party dependencies. Registered tool ids all carry the skill_audit_ prefix, for example skill_audit_can and skill_audit_find.
description.zh: 审计你已装的 skill 与插件：按任务描述路由到该调的工具，对比 npm registry 发现版本落后、读宿主日志发现运行时故障，并报告插件的哪些工具你从没调用过。注册 9 个工具：can、find、status、recommend、check、scan、probe、run、suggest。基于 Python 3.8+，无第三方依赖。注册工具名均带 skill_audit_ 前缀，例如 skill_audit_can。

description.en: 日历清单 · DeepSeek Harness 插件：月/周/列表/看板四视图 + 独立 AI 对话
description.zh: 在侧栏加个日历清单，月/周/列表/看板四种视图管任务，还能随时跟 AI 聊两句。

description.en: AFK controls for ask_user_question: profile-wide or per-session settings, configurable automatic replies or blocking new calls, and session-log question history with read tracking; does not approve permissions or plans. Supports DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.3 only.
description.zh: 面向 ask_user_question 的 AFK 离开模式：当前 profile 全局或会话级设置，自定义自动应答或禁用新提问调用，基于会话日志的提问记录与已读状态；不批准权限或计划。仅支持 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 与 0.2.1-rc.3。

description.en: #dsh-plugin Durable agent swarms for DeepSeek Harness: one-command planning, peer collaboration, independent verification, and an embedded sidebar.
description.zh: 一句话描述目标，就能拉起一支智能体团队协作干活，还能独立验证结果、随时查看进度。

description.en: 追番 — an anime tracker plugin for DeepSeek Harness: seasonal charts, airing schedule, search, watchlist, detail pages, bilibili / FQDM / AniCh streaming, torrents, downloads, OP/ED themes, and its own MSE player (PrismFlow) with libass subtitles and Anime4K.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里一站式追番：看季度新番、放送表、搜番、记进度，还能在线看和下载。

description.en: Fork of dsh-annotation by omdsh-dev (MIT). Click an "Annotation N" chip in a reply to jump back to the annotated passage, highlight it briefly, and report clearly when the passage cannot be found.
description.zh: 点一下回复里的「Annotation N」标记，就能跳回被批注的原文并短暂高亮，找不到时也会明确提示。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 中长视频自动剪辑：文案分段、素材/配乐检索、多轨时间线、剪映加密草稿导出 (20 autocut_* tools)
description.zh: 把文案、口播和素材自动剪成多轨时间线，还能直接导出剪映草稿继续精修。

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端侧边栏常驻显示 DeepSeek 账号余额的插件（宿主统一取数 + 浏览器浮层）
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面端侧边栏常驻显示 DeepSeek 账号余额，随时掌握用量和花费。

description.en: DSH 工作台插件，把常用的页面或者应用，Pin 在工作台
description.zh: 把常用页面和应用 Pin 到工作台，随时一键打开，工作区还能自由扩展。

description.en: Telegram / WeChat bridge plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): bind your bot to a DSH workspace in one command, with handoff continuity between sessions.
description.zh: 把 Telegram 和微信变成 DSH 的聊天入口，一条命令绑定工作区，还能跨会话接续记忆。

description.en: Run DeepSeek Harness on Claude Code's system prompt — a Cordis bundle that swaps only the assembled system prompt; tools, runtime context and every other plugin stay untouched.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接套用 Claude Code 的系统提示词，只换提示词，工具和其他插件都不动。

description.en: 陪伴型 Agent 插件：记得你（记忆存在模型外，换模型不失忆）、看得见屏幕和摄像头、能自己刷视频收集资讯、能替你起草消息。核心与宿主解耦，DSH 插件或任意 MCP 客户端都能跑，形象可运行时更换。
description.zh: 会记事、能看屏幕和摄像头、还会自己刷资讯的陪伴型 Agent，换模型也不失忆。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-companion
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-companion

notes: added the missing web platform to the client half

description.en: 读你的历史对话找出提问上的问题并给改写草稿，输入框一键出三档优化稿，采纳的问法自动归档成模板
Connect to databases in DeepSeek Harness (DSH), then query and edit data right in the conversation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话里直连 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQLite，随手查数据、改数据，不用切工具。

description.en: Diff view: a reusable two-text diff viewer for DSH client plugins — line LCS, word highlights, split/unified views, true line numbers across context collapse.
description.zh: 给 DSH 客户端插件用的双文本差异查看器，支持行级对比、词级高亮、分屏/合并视图，还能在折叠上下文时保留真实行号。

description.en: DSH plugin that connects the Docker Desktop MCP gateway as an MCP server.
description.zh: 把 Docker Desktop MCP 网关接进 DSH，还能在网页界面里直接切换配置档。

description.en: Extra writable workspaces for DSH's workspace-write sandbox mode — global, per-workspace and per-session.
description.zh: 给 DSH 沙箱模式加几个额外可写目录，全局、按工作区、按会话都能单独设，还能自动识别工具链。

description.en: Pins the first prompt you sent in the current session in a scroll-proof bar above the conversation, with one-click copy, a collapsible panel listing every prompt you sent, and eight switchable looks you can pick from inside the panel.
description.zh: 把你在每个会话发的第一条提示词常驻显示、一键复制，可展开面板查看本会话发过的全部提示词，另带八套可在面板里即时切换的外观。

description.en: 辅立码课（智慧教学云）教学数据报告工作台 — DeepSeek Harness 插件：管理看板取数、三版报告（正式版/简报版/交互版）、版本检查与一键更新
description.zh: 从辅立码课管理看板拉取数据，一键生成三届教学报告，支持多校切换与自动登录。
在 DSH 网页侧边栏加一个 Git 变更标签页，随时查看当前改动，方便审查和提交。

description.en: DSH plugin that makes the session hover card genuinely useful
description.zh: 让会话悬浮卡片真正好用，标题栏直接带复制图标，不用再整块点着复制标题。

description.en: HTB (Hack The Box) pentesting skill library plugin for DeepSeek Harness: 112 distilled technique cards (T1 routing / T2 deep-dive / T3 reference tiers, disable-model-invocation for hidden tiers) plus a generated htb-skill-index. Mounts a package-local skill provider via the dsh-skill-filesystem provider, so skills stay versioned with the package and hot-relo
description.zh: 把 HTB 打靶流程封装成 DSH 插件，在授权靶机里练攻防更顺手。

description.en: Java efficient development plugin for DeepSeek Harness providing deterministic auto-fix for .java files, token-saving template intents, and cross-platform JDK/Gradle/Android SDK/FFmpeg/LWJGL/IDEA discovery with persistent caching.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Java 高效开发插件，提供 .java 文件的决定性自动修复、节省 token 的模板意图、以及跨平台的 JDK/Gradle/Android SDK/FFmpeg/LWJGL/IDEA 自动发现与持久化缓存。

description.en: Joplin notes plugin for DeepSeek Harness: search, read and (opt-in) edit notes via the local Web Clipper API. Zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 让 AI 直接搜索、读取和创建本地 Joplin 笔记，还能管理笔记本和查看反向链接。

description.en: File-based long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: fixed read budget, BM25 search, confirmation gate, always-on injection, auto-settle. Zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一个文件式长期记忆，自动记住关键信息，按需检索注入，零依赖开箱即用。

description.en: DSH 插件：长期记忆 + 带来源的知识库召回（零运行时依赖）

Warns the session to flush what matters before context compaction kicks in, and rolls a long-term ledger into a frozen archive with a digest of title plus up to three lines per moved section. The roll-up stays off until home is set.
description.zh: 压缩之前先落盘：会话压力到线时先递一句话；另给长期账本做确定性滚动——最旧的几节搬进档案、原处留标题加至多三行要点，不调模型、不猜内容。账本滚动须配置 home 才启用。

description.en: Connect a DSH Agent to Minecraft Java servers with Mineflayer, a live game view alongside native reasoning and tools, configurable personas, server-scoped notebooks, and optional local survival knowledge retrieval. Reuses the host model; installation does not connect to a game or start inference.
description.zh: 让 DSH Agent 通过 Mineflayer 进入 Minecraft Java 服务器，在实时游戏画面旁查看原生推理与工具，配置人格、按服务器隔离的笔记及可选本地生存知识检索；复用宿主模型，安装本身不连接游戏或启动推理。

description.en: Open a Mac or Windows DeepSeek Harness Web instance from iPhone or iPad Safari: 8-digit pairing, a LAN gateway for loopback-only hosts, optional Tailscale Serve, and iOS-only Safari input and touch fixes. Installs with dsh plugin add.
description.zh: 用 iPhone 或 iPad 的 Safari 打开 Mac 或 Windows 上的 DeepSeek Harness Web：8 位配对码、回环监听的局域网网关、可选 Tailscale Serve，以及仅 iOS 生效的 Safari 输入与触摸补丁。可用 dsh plugin add 安装。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 模型中心插件 — 双栏模型选择器（左提供商 / 右模型）+ 悬浮能力卡，可直接在面板里添加提供商、刷新获取模型、删除模型；零构建、零 npm 依赖。
description.zh: 把模型选择器换成双栏模型中心，左选提供商右选模型，悬停看能力卡，还能直接加提供商、刷新和删模型。

description.en: 给 DeepSeek Harness 输入框换一个按 provider 分组的模型选择器，思考档位拆成独立滑杆。
description.zh: 把 DSH 输入框的模型选择器换成可搜索、按 provider 分组的列表，模型和思考档位分开调，找模型改档位一步到位。

description.en: DSH Web 插件：模型供应商额度与用量（DeepSeek / GLM Coding Plan / OpenRouter / Kimi Coding + 自定义适配器）
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 里集中查看 DeepSeek、GLM、OpenRouter、Kimi 等模型供应商的额度和用量，还能接自定义适配器。

description.en: Network diagnostics toolbox for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): DNS lookup (10 record types), ICMP ping, TCP port check, TLS cert check, traceroute, WHOIS lookup, public IP — seven read-only probes, zero runtime dependencies
description.zh: 网络诊断工具箱，DNS、ping、端口、证书、路由、WHOIS 等八项只读检测，排查网络问题一插件搞定。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: predicts your next prompt after each turn — press Tab to accept
description.zh: 每轮回复后自动预测你下一句想说什么，显示在输入框上方，按 Tab 一键填入。

description.en: Git service plus right-sidebar UI — a Changes tab (stage/unstage, per-file diffs, commit/amend, push and rebase-then-push sync, confirmed discard), a paged canvas commit-graph tab, a Worktrees tab to list, enter and create checkouts, a composer branch selector, and opt-in LLM commit-message generation.
description.zh: Git 服务 + 右侧边栏 UI：Changes 页（暂存/取消暂存、逐文件 diff、提交/修补、推送与 rebase 同步、二次确认的丢弃）、分页 canvas 提交图谱页、Worktrees 页（列出/进入/新建工作树）、输入框旁分支选择器，以及可选的 LLM 提交信息生成。

description.en: Magic Context for DeepSeek Harness: reversible context reclaim, an out-of-band historian, an m[0]/m[1] memory baseline, project memories, and the compaction seam.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个会记事的上下文管家，自动压缩回收、跨会话记住项目要点，聊得再久也不丢线索。

description.en: Reminds the agent to speak up when it runs several model steps without emitting any text, so long tool runs stop going silent.
description.zh: 别憋着：连着几步模型输出里一个 text 都没有（心里的盘算不算说话），就往会话里塞一句提醒，下一个 step 落进它眼里。

description.en: DSH 提示词工作台：看清 system prompt 的每一段、写下自己的家规、体检重复与矛盾，并记下每次改动。A prompt workbench for DSH.
description.zh: 把 system prompt 拆开逐段看清楚，能写自己的规则、查重复和矛盾，还记录每次改动。

description.en: Bridges QQ into DeepSeek Harness over OneBot 11: private and group chats, on-device voice-to-text, image support, and ten interaction tools (poke, react, like, image, file, recall and more). Needs an OneBot 11 implementation such as NapCat running alongside.
description.zh: 把 QQ 接进 DeepSeek Harness：私聊群聊、本地语音转文字、看图，以及十个互动工具（戳一戳、贴表情、点赞、发图、发文件、撤回等）。需要本机另跑一个 OneBot 11 实现（如 NapCat）。

description.en: QQ 群聊/私聊机器人插件（DeepSeek Harness，macOS/Windows 开箱即用）：OneBot v11/NapCat、人设、表情包、工具白名单与联网搜索、对话巡检、关键词规则、定时消息、记忆管理。基于 ezoiLZH/QQ-bot，经原作者许可发布。
DSH 桌面 Web GUI 的单管理员局域网远程访问插件 + Android WebView 外壳
description.zh: 让手机或平板在局域网内用管理员密码远程打开并操作这台电脑上的 DSH 桌面界面。

description.en: Right-sidebar SSH terminal for DSH where you and your agent share one PTY: 16 agent tools, configurable transfer limit, session-isolated audit trail, one-click in-place updates.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏的 SSH 远程终端：你和 agent 共用一个 PTY，16 个 agent 工具，传输上限可调，终端按会话隔离，配置页支持一键热更新。

description.en: DSH 后台项目研究引擎：说出需求即自动在后台调研并把结果交给 Agent
description.zh: 说出开发需求，它就在后台自动调研项目并给出结论，直接喂给 Agent 用。

description.en: Infix rerun for DeepSeek Harness: re-run any earlier turn in place - the reply is regenerated from the same prompt while every later turn survives, so subsequent calls read A B C1 D E F G. Official seams only; the append-only session log is never rewritten.
description.zh: 点一下就能重跑之前某一轮回答，后面的对话还都保留，历史不乱。

description.en: Registers fifteen slash commands (/idea, /review, /poster, ...) that inject the matching research skill's SKILL.md as a user message, so installed skills run without a marketplace. The skills are not bundled and must already be under ~/.dsh/skills or ~/.agents/skills, otherwise commands report skill not found.
description.zh: 把装好的研究技能变成斜杠命令：/idea、/novelty、/review、/poster……一共十五条，敲一下就把对应的 SKILL.md 塞进对话，照着跑那个技能。技能不随包提供，须已装在 ~/.dsh/skills 或 ~/.agents/skills 下，否则命令只提示找不到技能。

description.en: Instrument dials for DeepSeek Harness: live tokens/sec, context pressure and cache hit.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 输入区加一对复古仪表盘，实时看生成速度、上下文占用和缓存命中。

description.en: DSH skill provider bundling the zhaoxuya520/reverse-skill corpus (88 skills), with automated upstream sync.
description.zh: 打包 88 个逆向与安全技能，自动同步上游，让 DSH 直接具备渗透、CTF 和恶意样本分析能力。

description.en: A chibi whale maid desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness who eats white rice while the model generates, lives inside the DSH window or anywhere on a macOS or Windows desktop, and dives for treasure between turns. On Windows the desktop overlay is compiled at install time and skipped when swiftc or the .NET SDK is unavailable, so the pet stays inside the DSH window.
description.zh: DSH 的鲸鱼娘桌宠：模型生成时一口一口吃白饭，住在窗口里或桌面任意角落（macOS / Windows），回合结束还会下海捞宝。桌面浮层在安装时编译，缺少 swiftc 或 .NET SDK 时会跳过，桌宠只留在 DSH 窗口里。

description.en: Full-screen screenshot panel for the DSH composer: marquee selection with rectangle, ellipse, arrow, pen, mosaic and text annotation, then insert into the conversation, copy or save. The selected region can also be recognized offline — PP-OCRv6 through onnxruntime-node, falling back to the built-in Windows OCR engine — and translated into nine languages with the model already configured in DSH. On Windows the marquee covers the whole screen including the taskbar and hides the DSH window first, so the capture is of the real desktop. The panel runs in an Edge or Chrome kiosk window, and falls back to an in-DSH capture flow when no browser can be launched. Note that DSH Desktop denies ordinary browser access by default, so the full-screen panel also needs "Allow opening this Profile in a browser" (compatibility mode) enabled in the profile settings; without it every capture goes through the in-DSH fallback. Windows only (DSH Desktop); the PP-OCRv6 models are downloaded from ModelScope on first recognition.
description.zh: DSH 输入框旁的整屏截图面板：框选后可标注矩形、椭圆、箭头、画笔、马赛克与文字，再插入对话、复制或另存为；框选区域可以用 PP-OCRv6（onnxruntime-node，模型未就绪时回落 Windows 自带 OCR 引擎）离线识别成文字，再用 DSH 里已配置好的模型翻译成九种语言。Windows 下框选覆盖含任务栏的整个屏幕，截图前会先隐藏 DSH 窗口，截到的是真实桌面；面板由 Edge 或 Chrome 的 kiosk 窗口承载，找不到可用浏览器时回退到 DSH 内截图。注意 DSH Desktop 默认不放行普通浏览器的访问，所以整屏面板还需要在 profile 设置里打开「允许在浏览器中打开」（兼容模式）；没打开时每次截图都走 DSH 内回退流程。仅支持 Windows（DSH Desktop）；PP-OCRv6 模型在首次识别时从 ModelScope 下载。

description.en: DSH Web GUI plugin: cite a selected conversation fragment in the current message, or open it in a parallel side chat.
description.zh: 选中对话片段后，可直接引用到当前消息里，或另开侧边聊天继续聊。

description.en: Unofficial delete-session plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): single-session and whole-workspace-group deletion with immediate live teardown, authenticated /api Fetch routes, and offline host/client tests.
description.zh: 给 dsh 补上官方没有的删除会话功能，会话菜单一键删除，还能排队清理已挂载的会话。

description.en: DSH 会话增强插件：一键打开工作区 · 模型提供商菜单头部 · 选中文本加入对话 / DSH session enhancement plugin: open workspace · provider header · add selected text to conversation
description.zh: 在模型菜单顶部显示提供商，选中文本一键以代码块加入输入框，还能快速打开工作区。

description.en: Proactive skill activation, lifecycle hooks, install consent gate, and GitHub source sync for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).为 DeepSeek Harness 提供主动技能激活、生命周期 Hook、安装确认门控与 GitHub 来源同步
description.zh: 让 DSH 技能自动激活、按生命周期挂 Hook，安装前先确认，还能从 GitHub 同步技能来源。

description.en: 实验·未发布：DSH 确定性步数治理插件（pre-step reject / pre-execute deny），shadow 默认、fail-open
description.zh: 长任务里模型光想不动时，在步骤层面强制刹车，默认只观察不拦截，出问题自动放行。

description.en: A desktop character for DeepSeek Harness: shows the agent's state, plays waiting and completion sounds, and turns its questions and approvals into a pixel-art card you can answer without switching windows.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 配个桌面看板娘，实时显示智能体状态，用像素卡片直接回答问题、处理审批，不用切窗口。

description.en: Turkish (Türkçe) language pack for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI — 64 namespaces, 2,910 strings, MIT
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面加上土耳其语，64 个模块、2910 条文案全部汉化到位，土耳其用户直接就能用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness token-usage report with a grow-only per-session ledger: deleting a session no longer deletes its usage
description.zh: 在界面里查看这台 harness 花了多少 token，按时间统计并拆分四个用量桶，删了会话用量也不丢。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: play a sound (and optionally raise a system notification) when a turn finishes or when dsh needs your reply, configured from a Settings page.
description.zh: 回合结束或需要你回复时自动响铃提醒，还能弹系统通知，设置页里随手配置。

description.en: Injects your home folder — identity, house rules, recent diary and ledger — into every new session before anyone speaks, and keeps that home writable so the agent can amend its own persona. Does nothing until the home folder exists (default dsh-home under the user home, or set home in the config).
description.zh: 起床包：每开一段新对话，赶在人开口之前把家读一遍注入会话——身份、规矩、错题、日记和账；家还是可写的，对话里认下的东西当场写回去，人设由它自己改。家目录不存在时什么都不做（默认为用户主目录下的 dsh-home，或在配置里填 home）。

description.en: 把当前桌面壁纸作为 DeepSeek Harness 界面的半透明实时背景（macOS / Windows / Linux）
description.zh: 把当前桌面壁纸变成 DeepSeek Harness 的半透明实时背景，换壁纸自动跟着变。

description.en: 把本机 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸放到 DSH 界面背后：场景/视频/网页/图片四类壁纸，液态玻璃外观、音频可视化、遮挡省电、费用显示
description.zh: 把本机 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸铺到 DSH 界面背后，聊天窗浮在动态壁纸上，还能调成液态玻璃效果。

description.en: Поиск в интернете через SearXNG для DeepSeek Harness: плагин сам поднимает контейнер и даёт агенту web_search без ключей вендора. · SearXNG-backed web search for the DeepSeek Harness, with its own container and no vendor key.
Serper.dev-backed web search provider for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web capability seam
description.zh: 给 DSH 接入 Serper.dev 的网页搜索能力，让 AI 助手能实时联网查资料。

description.en: A chibi whale-girl runner plugin for DeepSeek Harness: jump life's word burdens and reach the rice bowl.
description.zh: 一只Q版鲸鱼娘在 DeepSeek Harness 里跑酷，跳过生活的文字负担，冲向饭碗。

description.en: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装一个鲸鱼娘（DeepSeek娘）Agent 预设：完整干活能力 + 人设，开工吐槽、收工讨饭，按概率发表情包（设置页可调）。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装个鲸鱼娘 Agent 预设，干活能力齐全还带人设，开工吐槽收工讨饭，随机发表情包。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: local and remote (SSH) workspaces in one place. Remote execution uses a single SSH connection (multi-hop jumps allowed); bash, files, PTY, and LSP share that link.
description.zh: 通过 SSH 远程管理 DeepSeek Harness 工作区，提升操作效率，让开发更顺手。

description.en: Daily study goals, streaks, XP and durable DSH reminders for Exameow inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 把每日 Exameow 练习变成打卡习惯页，有目标、连续天数、XP 等级和七天回顾，还会按时提醒你学习。

description.en: 基于mimo的DSH语音汇报 · MiMo voice report plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 任务一完成就语音播报两句总结，还能弹窗提醒，让你不用盯着屏幕也知道结果。

description.en: Hosted PrimeSync AI Studio strategy-research MCP configuration bundle using the official MCP client and mcp-remote OAuth bridge; eligible Studio access required. Experimental: OAuth consent and tool calls are not yet verified end-to-end. Complete manual CLI sign-in on the same computer before starting Harness; otherwise tools may be absent after startup. Targets DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 only; mcp-remote 0.15.2 is downloaded through npx on first launch.
description.zh: PrimeSync AI Studio 托管策略研究 MCP 服务的实验性配置包，使用官方 MCP 客户端和 mcp-remote OAuth 桥接，需具备 Studio 使用权限。OAuth 授权与工具调用尚未完成端到端验证；启动 Harness 前须在同一电脑上通过命令行手动登录，否则工具可能无法显示。仅面向 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2；首次启动时通过 npx 下载 mcp-remote 0.15.2。

description.en: Reverse-engineering preset for DeepSeek Harness: one preset that mounts ~139 REA tools (Ghidra / Hopper / IDA), a reverse-engineer persona, and an evidence-first analysis workflow. Installs as a dsh bundle into the desktop, web, headless and dsh-tui profiles.
description.zh: 一键装上逆向工程预设，集成 Ghidra、Hopper、IDA 等约 139 个工具，按证据链流程分析二进制。

description.en: 橙子PRO中转站（https://pro.nat6.net）DSH 插件：模型多、国产齐全，满精度/满上下文/满缓存的正品折扣渠道；DeepSeek V4.1 最新版 2.5 折、缓存率 95%+、官 Key 非号池。
description.zh: 接入橙子PRO中转站，一个插件搞定多模型调用，国产模型齐全，DeepSeek V4.1 打折还带满缓存。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: Cursor models as the cursor LLM provider, one Cursor agent per DSH session
description.zh: 把 Cursor 的模型接进 DSH 当 LLM 用，每个会话配一个 Cursor 智能体，开箱即用。
给 DeepSeek Harness 加上俄语界面，让俄语用户也能顺手使用。

description.en: 把本机 AI 桌面客户端（Qoder / WorkBuddy）里已登录的模型反向代理进 DeepSeek Harness — bring local desktop-client models into DSH as extra providers.
description.zh: 把本机 Qoder、WorkBuddy 里已登录的模型直接接进 DSH 当额外供应商，不用再配 Key。

description.en: AI Book Shelf / AI 书架：书籍与论文阅读、AI 解释、全文搜索、论文翻译与中英对照
description.zh: 在 DSH 里读电子书和论文，AI 帮你解释内容、全文搜索，还能翻译论文做中英对照。

description.en: Manage local API providers and skills inside DeepSeek Harness: probe, balance, models, and register them as DSH model routes
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里统一管理本地 API 供应商，探测余额和模型，并注册成 DSH 模型路由。

description.en: Keyboard confirmation for approval cards: the card takes focus when it appears, so Enter allows once and Esc rejects, and those two keys are forwarded through the card handler when focus has moved elsewhere. It never auto-approves and never steals focus from a text field.
description.zh: 审批卡片的键盘确认：卡片出现时自动聚焦，按 Enter 允许一次、按 Esc 拒绝；焦点离开卡片后这两个键仍会转交给卡片处理。不会自动批准，也不会抢输入框的焦点。

description.en: An ASCII ocean behind the New Session screen of DeepSeek Harness — fish schools that flee, orcas that hunt, themed and translucent. Engine ported from stackedlol/ascii-sharks (see NOTICE.md).
description.zh: 给新建会话页加一片会动的 ASCII 海洋，鱼群躲虎鲸、鼠标一划就惊散，半透明还跟着主题变色。

description.en: Restores the permission preset a session was last set to when that session is reopened; a session opened for the first time is left untouched. Load it after dsh-experimental-auto-review to restore the auto preset.
description.zh: 重新打开会话时恢复该会话上次设置的权限预设；首次打开不干预。需排在 dsh-experimental-auto-review 之后加载才能恢复 auto 预设。

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框正下方显示账号余额：消耗曲线、本会话消耗、一键充值（系统浏览器）
description.zh: 在输入框下方直接看 DeepSeek 余额和消耗曲线，还能一键充值，不用再翻设置。

description.en: DSH plugin: Bilibili workbench with material library, AI video remix, review/publish and auto interactions
description.zh: 把B站素材库、AI混剪出片、审核发布和自动互动都塞进一个工作台，刷视频也能顺手干活。

description.en: 一框三模式：思考（常规/严格/极致）、循环（轻量/交付/极致）、对抗（可叠加的对抗审查）；思考与循环互斥切换，对抗可叠加。模型经 clarify_tier / forge_level 读取。

Adds a capability panel to the DSH web GUI: browse, install (upload, zip, host path or URL), enable, edit and export skills, and add or edit Claude Code-compatible MCP servers, at global and per-project scope — with project copies, per-project shadow stubs, live mount status and a zero-side-effect connection probe. A session view toggles capabilities for the current conversation only, and a TypeSafe Jev tab scores skills and MCP servers for the session from the input draft. Requires the dsh web shell 0.2.0-rc.2 or later. Forked from chengdb/dsh-plugin-capability-panel; it shares a patch id with that plugin and with pure-craft/dsh-capability-panel, so do not install them together.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 中加入能力面板：浏览、安装（上传 / zip / 宿主路径 / URL）、启停、编辑与导出技能，新增与编辑 Claude Code 兼容的 MCP 服务器，覆盖全局与项目双作用域（项目副本、屏蔽占位、默认关闭声明），显示实时挂载状态并提供零副作用连通性探测；会话视图只对当前对话开关能力；「Jev 模型」Tab 用 TypeSafe Jev 按输入草稿为本会话技能与 MCP 打分。需 dsh Web 外壳 0.2.0-rc.2 及以上。fork 自 chengdb/dsh-plugin-capability-panel；与其及 pure-craft/dsh-capability-panel 使用同一 patch id，勿同装。

description.en: Switchable identity cards for DSH sessions: persona, tone, code style, and hard constraints injected per session,with defaults, per-session overrides, and a visual editor.
Inline citation for DSH: select text in an assistant reply and turn it into an atomic reference chip in the composer.
description.zh: 在助手回复里选中文字，一键变成输入框里的引用小胶囊，随消息发送不展开。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: edit a finalized assistant reply and its reasoning chain from the chat transcript.
description.zh: 在聊天记录里直接改 AI 已定稿的回复和思考过程，不满意就自己动手修。

description.en: DSH plugin: Corn bench — Keil debug and Modbus HMI in the session view
description.zh: 在会话视图里直接做 Keil 调试和 Modbus 上位机操作，嵌入式开发少切窗口。

description.en: CrabTodo - persistent todo plugin for DeepSeek Harness: model-facing todo tools + web sidebar page. 持久化待办插件：模型工具 + Web 侧边栏。
description.zh: 把待办任务存进本地文件，跨会话、跨重启都不丢，模型能直接增删改查，Web 侧边栏随时看。

description.en: 会说话的小鲸鱼娘
description.zh: 在 DSH 里养只会说话的小鲸鱼娘，随时看 DeepSeek 半价和余额，还能拖拽摸头帮你优化提示词。

description.en: Change review for a turn's edited files: a pill above the composer counts this turn's files and lines and floats the file list up on hover, and a right-sidebar page shows each file's diff with syntax highlighting and a one-click revert.
description.zh: 本轮改动审查：输入框上方的气泡统计本回合改动文件数与行数，悬停时向上浮出文件清单；右侧边栏按标签页展示逐文件语法高亮 diff，并支持一键还原。

description.en: DSH plugin: context-aware per-step reasoning-effort routing — classify → escalate → hysteresis → capability clamp; Auto mask in the native selector; default effort fill + wire mapping for custom llm-pi-ai models. AI-authored (kimi-k3), produced by @neo805. No Issues/PRs; forks welcome (MIT).
description.zh: 按任务难度自动分配推理强度，省算力又不掉链子，还能给自定义模型补上推理档位。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 环境工具插件：env_probe 探明网络/代理/可写性/子进程管道，safe_json_edit 无 BOM 安全改 JSON，git_repair 检测并重建丢失的 .git 元数据。
description.zh: 操作莫名失败时先探环境：查网络代理、安全改 JSON、修复丢失的 .git 元数据。

description.en: DSH 插件：完成 / 授权 / 提问 / 计划评审各有独立提示音池，池内洗牌轮换，没音频时用合成音兜底。
description.zh: 给 DSH 的完成、授权、提问、计划评审等事件配上提示音，每类事件独立音池轮换播放，没音频时用合成音兜底。
给 DeepSeek Harness 加上 Exa 联网搜索和网页抓取，免登录或填 Key 都能用。

description.en: Manage skills, MCP servers, instruction files, custom commands and hooks.
description.zh: 管理 Skill、MCP 服务器、指令文件、自定义命令和 Hooks。

description.en: Free web search for DeepSeek Harness - no search API or key. Bing page/RSS scraping with a local Chrome/Edge fallback, a per-session Off/Smart/Always toggle, and a sidebar search panel. 免费联网搜索插件：三档联网开关 + 左侧栏搜索面板。
description.zh: 不用搜索 API 和密钥，靠抓取 Bing 页面给 DSH 加免费联网搜索，还能按会话切换开关。

description.en: 在对话里写一段 JSON，就长出一页能点的界面；看完能导成 HTML 带走。Turns a JSON block in the chat into a clickable page you can export as standalone HTML.
description.zh: 在对话里写段 JSON 就能生成可点击的页面，看完还能导出成独立 HTML 带走。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Jujutsu (jj) 一等支持
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 原生支持 Jujutsu (jj)，自动识别 jj 仓库并引导模型优先用 jj 干活。

description.en: 知枢 KnowHub — DSH 全局知识中心与项目长期记忆：知识库、Repo Wiki、审核与版本、增量更新、检索与上下文注入、自动提炼、备份恢复、中文面板
description.zh: 把项目知识和长期记忆存成可检索、可审核、可备份的知识库，会话中自动注入或按需检索。

description.en: Answers an exhausted DeepSeek Harness account quota: move the session to another route of its pool when one still has allowance, and otherwise retry the same request every interval with no attempt limit.
description.zh: 账号额度用光也不怕，插件每小时自动重试同一请求，直到成功或本轮取消。

description.en: Computer-use for DeepSeek Harness on macOS
Collectible 3D token-usage medals for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 读取本机 DSH 会话的 token 用量，按规则颁发可旋转查看的 3D 金属奖牌，并陈列在奖牌馆里。

description.en: Manage, batch-delete, and restore individual messages in a DSH session without deleting the raw session log.
description.zh: 在会话标题栏批量管理消息，可删除或恢复模型上下文中的单条消息，原始会话日志不受影响。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 移动端远程控制插件（Mobile Remote Control Plugin）：设置页内置扫码连接二维码、一键开启远程控制与在线设备数统计，并提供手机端界面优化，实现局域网内手机远程操控电脑端 DeepSeek Harness。
description.zh: 手机扫码即可远程操控电脑端 DeepSeek Harness，支持一键开启控制和在线设备统计，局域网内随时随地方便操作。
把多个模型提供商聚合成一个虚拟路由，每次请求自动选当前激活的提供商，省去手动切换。

description.en: DSH Web 输入框「下一句」预测：每轮回复后给候选，点击 / Tab / → 填入。
description.zh: 在输入框上方预测你下一句想说什么，点一下或按 Tab 就能填进去，省得反复打字。

description.en: Novel writing panel for the DSH sidebar that binds a local manuscript folder, imports Agent Skills as analysis lenses, and scans platform rankings into story-structure outlines.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的小说创作面板：绑定本地书稿目录，把导入的 Agent 技能当作分析视角，并扫描平台榜单归纳故事架构。

description.en: OpenCode Go quota forecast for DeepSeek Harness: projected exhaustion ETA, renewal-date comparison and renew-vs-API cost advice.
description.zh: 预测 OpenCode Go 月度额度何时用完，对比续费日期并给出续费还是走 API 的成本建议。

description.en: A minimal, opinionated subagent for DeepSeek Harness: you choose which models a child may run on and at which reasoning effort, and a correction reaches a working child at its next step
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 子代理指定可运行的模型和推理强度，并在下一步自动修正错误，简化多智能体协作。

description.en: Webpage watch agent: keep a watchlist of URLs, snapshot each page on every sweep, detect changes by bigram-Dice ratio and keywords, log important ones and push to a WeChat webhook; agent tools page_watch_add/list/check/history/remove. Renders JS anti-bot WAF pages via the optional lexmount extractor.
description.zh: 网页监控哨兵：把一批网页加入监视清单，每次巡检抓快照、用 bigram-Dice 变化率与关键词判断变化是否重要，重要变化写日志并推送企业微信 webhook；提供 page_watch_add/list/check/history/remove 工具，可选 lexmount 通道穿透 JS 反爬 WAF 页面。

description.en: Cross-session coordination for DeepSeek Harness that lists parallel sessions, relays messages with sender attribution between them, and pauses or resumes a session when task phases conflict.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 并行会话协调：列出并行会话、在会话之间转发带发起方归属的消息，并在任务阶段冲突时暂停或恢复另一个会话。

description.en: Create, import and manage personality presets with global and per-conversation choices.
description.zh: 创建、导入和管理人格预设，支持全局与单会话选择。

description.en: Sidebar panel that embeds chat.deepseek.com full-width in the DSH main area (desktop shell only), restores the last conversation, and keeps a crashed embedded page inside the panel.
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧栏加入 DeepSeek 聊天入口，主内容区全宽内嵌 chat.deepseek.com（仅桌面版），恢复上次会话，并把内嵌页崩溃限制在面板内。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness mascot plugin - a clickable character sprite (Arknights' Closure / BanG Dream!'s Sengoku Yuno) showing token cache hits, context pressure and account balance.
description.zh: 右下角放个可点击的看板娘，点开就能看 token 缓存命中、上下文压力和账户余额。

description.en: Zero-key web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: scrapes Bing China, 360 and SearXNG through a backend fallback chain and returns real URLs with snippets and publish dates. No API key and no settings card are required. SearXNG is used only when you set your own instance URL, and installing this plugin switches web_search to it and turns off the official DeepSeek search row.
description.zh: 免 key 的 web_search 后端：按降级链抓取 Bing 中文站、360 与 SearXNG，返回真实 URL、摘要与发布日期；不需要任何 API key，也没有设置卡片。面向校园网等拿不到官方 key 的环境。SearXNG 仅在配置自有实例地址后才会启用；安装后 web_search 会切换到本插件，并停用官方 DeepSeek 搜索行。

description.en: DSH 插件：角色设定与长期记忆（角色库 persona.yml/SOUL.md/USER.md + FACT.md/MEMORY.md + JOURNAL.jsonl），注册在宿主组合层，对所有 agent 预设生效，附右侧栏管理面板。MIT。
description.zh: 给所有 AI 助手加上角色设定和长期记忆，还能在右侧栏随时管理。

description.en: DSH 客户端换皮插件：标题栏点一下就能换主题，Codex 和 Claude Code 两套完整配色，外加小圆角 / macOS 圆角和 iOS 手感的弹簧动效，不用重启，改完立刻生效。
description.zh: 点一下标题栏就能给 DSH 换主题，Codex 和 Claude Code 两套配色，圆角和弹簧动效都有，改完立刻生效。

description.en: dsh plugin: reads remaining quota and usage from any OpenAI-compatible relay's billing surface (/quota, quota_check)
description.zh: 直接读取任意 OpenAI 兼容中转站的剩余额度和用量，还能识别无限额标记，方便随时盯住成本。

description.en: DSH 手机同步：把桌面端完整 Web UI 反代到手机（/m），带设备配对、只读策略与审批路由。手机只负责看和点，所有操作在 PC 执行。
description.zh: 把桌面端完整 Web UI 反代到手机，手机只负责看和点，所有操作都在 PC 上跑。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: control Desktop sessions from WeCom (企业微信) on your phone
description.zh: 在手机企业微信里远程操控电脑上的 DeepSeek Harness 会话，随时发指令、看进度。

description.en: Restarts the DeepSeek Harness desktop app from three places: a Settings row, the account menu above Sign out, and a configurable keyboard shortcut. Asks before interrupting running tasks. If a newer update is already downloaded and waiting, restarting installs it first. Windows desktop app only.
description.zh: 从三处重启 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端：设置里的按钮、账号菜单「退出登录」上方的一项、以及可自定义的快捷键；有运行中的任务时会先确认；若新版本更新已下载并等待安装，重启时会先静默安装更新。仅支持 Windows 桌面版。

description.en: dsh在校园网下接入学术资源服务，加速github与google等支持的网站，无需单独运行scholartools或特定浏览器，基于 scholar.edu.cn
description.zh: 校园网下直连学术资源，顺带加速 GitHub、Google 等网站，不用再单独开工具或换浏览器。

description.en: Region screenshot tool with annotations, a magnifier colour picker and clipboard output, following the DSH UI language. Windows only.
description.zh: 区域截图工具，支持标注、放大器取色与剪贴板输出，并跟随 DSH 界面语言。仅限 Windows。

description.en: Seeyon workbench that mounts OA to-dos and meetings, the skill catalog, and one-click aTrust VPN in one panel. Its vendored modules replace the author's dsh-seeyon-todo, dsh-skillhub and dsh-vpn — install this bundle or those plugins, not both. Requires a Seeyon OA account; the VPN part is Windows-only and needs the Sangfor aTrust client.
