description.en: Persistent C/C++, Python, and TypeScript definition navigation with a standalone workspace UI for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化的 C/C++、Python 和 TypeScript 定义跳转及独立工作区界面。

description.en: A LAN password gate for the Web UI: phones and tablets on the same network log in with a shared key and see the same sessions in real time, with a built-in randomUUID polyfill for plain-HTTP origins.
description.zh: Web UI 局域网密码门禁：同网手机/平板输共享密钥登录，会话与电脑实时同步，内置 randomUUID polyfill。

description.en: Auto-renames DSH sessions with LLM-summarized titles: runs after the first prompt and on /handoff, or manually via a header button or /autotitle, with configurable title language and max title bytes.
description.zh: DSH 会话自动重命名（session rename）：基于全部会话消息的 LLM 总结标题，首条提示词与 /handoff 后自动命名，会话头按钮或 /autotitle 手动触发，标题语言与最大字节数可设置。

description.en: Vision bridge for text-only DeepSeek models: transcribes attached images with deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp before they reach deepseek-v4-pro, with no third-party dependencies.
description.zh: 视觉桥：贴图先经 deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 转写为文字，再交给纯文本的 deepseek-v4-pro 回答，零第三方依赖。

description.en: Enhances the DSH Web GUI file tree with inline sizes and modification dates, plus a right-click menu for download, upload, and copy-path actions.
description.zh: 增强 DSH Web GUI 的文件树：行内显示大小与修改时间，右键菜单支持下载、上传、复制路径。

description.en: Adds an independent OpenCode Go connection with credential settings, manual model discovery, and per-conversation session headers.
description.zh: 添加独立的 OpenCode Go 连接，支持密钥设置、手动获取模型和按会话发送标识。

description.en: DSH plugin: hands a long session over to a fresh session in the same workspace on /handoff or at a token threshold, carrying the preset, model, permissions and plan mode across; the brief is written by the session's own model and the switch waits for a step boundary instead of interrupting running work.
description.zh: DSH 插件：通过 /handoff 或会话累计 Token 阈值把长会话交接给同工作区的新会话，并继承 preset、模型、权限与 Plan 模式；交接简报由会话自身的模型撰写，切换在 Step 边界发生，不中断正在执行的步骤。

description.en: Registers system-prompt sections that make the model reason in Simplified or Traditional Chinese, with strict/prefer modes and an optional reply-language policy. Adds a /thinking-zh command for per-session switching. Zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 注册系统提示词段落，让模型的内部思考使用简体或繁体中文，支持严格/宽松两种强度，并可单独约束最终回复语言。提供 /thinking-zh 命令做会话级切换。零运行时依赖。

description.en: Education toolkit for DSH agents: lesson-plan skeletons by grade band, quiz scaffolding and answer-key validation, analytic rubrics, Anki/markdown flashcards, and readability levels.
description.zh: 为 DSH agent 提供教育工具包：按学段的教案骨架、测验题与答案校验、分析式评分量规、Anki/markdown 闪卡与可读性分级。

description.en: Floating approval window for DeepSeek Harness that appears when you leave the app and hands the request back to the native card when you return. Windows-only (WPF via PowerShell). Independent fork of zeta987/dsh-notify-zeta (MIT); do not run alongside the upstream.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的独立审批浮窗：离开应用时弹出，切回时把请求交还原生卡片。仅 Windows（WPF/PowerShell）；独立分支自 zeta987/dsh-notify-zeta（MIT），不能与上游同时运行。

description.en: Pools several OpenCode Go API keys and hot-switches each request to the least-used one, with official usage and balance lookup plus a graphical settings page.
description.zh: 聚合多个 OpenCode Go API key，把每次请求热切换到用量最低的一个，并提供官方用量/余额查询与设置页图形化管理。

description.en: Deliverables registry for DeepSeek Harness: agents register the final artifacts of a task (reports, pages, documents, sheets, images, datasets) into one settings section and manager page that store paths only, never copies, and remove recoverably; a standalone CLI (add, list, stats, check, remove, restore) reads and audits the same registry outside the app.
description.zh: DSH 成果登记：agent 把一次任务的最终成果（报告、网页、文档、表格、图片、数据表）登记进设置页与管理页的同一份清单，只记路径、不搬文件，删除可撤销；独立 CLI（add/list/stats/check/remove/restore）在应用外也能查同一份清单，并核对登记的文件是否还在。

description.en: DeepSeek API billing-period chip in the composer dock: shows whether the current time is peak or off-peak with a countdown to the next rate switch, opens the peak/off-peak window rules on click, and during peak hours intercepts sending to ask for confirmation first.
description.zh: 在输入框下方显示 DeepSeek API 当前计费时段（高峰/空闲）与距下次切换的倒计时，点击可展开高峰/空闲时段规则；高峰时段发送消息前会先拦截并弹出确认。

description.en: Provider balance and quota status bar for DSH Web, with model capability settings, external JSON health monitoring, visual field binding, and per-model status details.
description.zh: DSH Web 的供应商余额与额度状态栏，支持模型能力设置、外部 JSON 健康监测、可视化字段绑定和逐模型状态详情。

description.en: Renders local audio/video paths as inline, playable previews in DSH chat: replaces paths with <audio>/<video> players backed by same-origin /api/media-preview/* route, with explicit error statuses.
description.zh: 在 DSH 聊天记录中自动将本地音视频路径渲染为可播放预览：将路径替换为同源 /api/media-preview/* 路由支持的 <audio>/<video> 播放器，并返回明确的错误状态码。

description.en: Only the domains you list go through a proxy: add a model host that needs the proxy to be reachable, and web search plus every other request stays on the normal network. Multiple named proxies can serve different domains, with a never-proxy list on top; saved settings apply on the next request without a restart.
description.zh: 某个模型的 API 要代理才连得上？把它的域名填进来就行——只有你列出的域名走代理，网页搜索等其它请求照旧直连，互不打扰。可以配多个代理分给不同域名，也能指定某些域名永远不走代理；保存后下一次请求就生效，不用重启。

description.en: Adds a "Terms" action to finished assistant answers that explains the computer-science terms it detects with Chinese definitions, occurrence counts, highlighted context snippets, and clickable nested explanations from a built-in offline dictionary, with no model calls.
description.zh: 在每条已完成回答的操作条增加「术语」入口，用内置离线词典给出回答中计算机术语的中文释义、提及次数、高亮上下文，并支持点击释义中的术语展开次级解释，不调用模型。

description.en: Adversarial review gate for tool calls. It hooks `tools/pre-execute`: a local regex pass over destructive commands (`rm -rf`, `git push --force`, `git reset --hard`, `DROP TABLE`, `format`, disk writes) and sensitive paths (`.env`, `id_rsa`, `.ssh`, `.git/`, `$DSH_HOME`) runs first with no latency, and only a hit is escalated to one review-model call that returns allow or deny. Plain reads and ordinary writes never enter that path, so everyday work pays no added delay. Every verdict is shown live in the Web GUI.
description.zh: 工具调用的对抗式审查门。它挂在 `tools/pre-execute` 上：先用本地正则零延迟筛破坏性命令（`rm -rf`、`git push --force`、`git reset --hard`、`DROP TABLE`、`format`、写盘）和敏感路径（`.env`、`id_rsa`、`.ssh`、`.git/`、`$DSH_HOME`），只有命中才升级给一次审查模型调用，返回 allow / deny。普通读取与普通写入完全不进这条路径，日常工作没有额外延迟；每次判定都在 Web GUI 里实时显示。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness streaming MCP bridge: live session events as MCP progress, plus ACP adapter for cc-connect/Feishu.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 流式 MCP 桥接：将实时会话事件作为 MCP 进度输出，并提供 cc-connect/飞书 ACP 适配器。

description.en: Skill-creation console for the Web UI: fetches the official creator skills, hands the requirements to the Huawei Cloud, generic, or REST API creator, then scores the generated skill against a 10-point rubric and returns the itemised deductions to the creator until it reaches 8.5/10.
description.zh: Web 界面上的技能创建面板：拉取官方 creator 技能，把需求交给华为云 / 通用 / REST API 三个 creator 之一执行创建，随后按 10 分制评测产物，未达 8.5 分就把逐项扣分交回 creator 修改直到通过。

description.en: Drives the GME Test Agent from inside Harness: three tools list interface catalogs, start and repair autonomous test generation in a local Python backend, poll the task until review, and keep PR, skip and cleanup actions behind explicit user consent.
description.zh: 在 Harness 内驱动 GME Test Agent：三个工具负责列出接口目录、在本地 Python 后端启动并修复自主测试生成、轮询任务直到待评审，并把创建 PR、跳过与清理等动作挡在用户显式同意之后。

description.en: Take a local video all the way to a Douyin creator post: open the upload page, trigger the picker, hand the file over with verification, fill the title, set visibility - then stop before publishing unless explicitly told to publish.
description.zh: 把本地视频送到抖音投稿页的「待发布」状态：打开投稿页、真实点上传、递文件（回读校验）、填标题、设可见性，然后默认停手——可见性默认仅自己可见、不点发布。

description.en: Plays a voice alert and a browser notification when a turn finishes, asks for input, or fails, and can push the same summary to a Feishu bot webhook as a card.
description.zh: 回合完成、需要你输入或执行失败时播放语音提醒并发送浏览器通知，还可把同样的摘要以卡片推送到飞书机器人 webhook。

description.en: AI persona, emotion and fading memory for DeepSeek Harness: layered compression keeps personality, emotion and turning-point nodes, painful feelings fade while the facts stay. One memory document is auto-delivered after three months and then monthly; long absences freeze the forgetting clock instead of mass-forgetting on return.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会淡忘的性格、情感与记忆：分层压缩后只保留性格、情感与转折节点，痛苦感受强制淡忘而事实保留；一份记忆文档在满 3 个月后自动交付、之后每月一份；长时间不在会冻结遗忘计时，不会一回来就批量淡忘。

description.en: Restores the blue shimmering Deep diving turn status row that DSH 0.1.6 and earlier showed at the end of the transcript.
description.zh: 恢复 DSH 0.1.6 及以前在对话流末尾显示的蓝色流光深度求索中回合状态行.

description.en: Multi-source image search and download (14 engines + 7 aliases covering Baidu, Bing, 360, Duitang, Huaban, Iconify, DuckDuckGo, Yandex, Openverse, Wikimedia, Pixiv, Wallhaven, Konachan and Safebooru) that saves the picked images into the session workspace with a per-file meta.json and renders them inline in the conversation; ships a standalone CLI as well.
description.zh: 多图源搜图并下载（14 个图源 + 7 个别名，覆盖百度/必应/360/堆糖/花瓣/Iconify/DuckDuckGo/Yandex/Openverse/维基共享/Pixiv/Wallhaven/Konachan/Safebooru），落盘进会话工作区并逐张写 meta.json，图片直接在对话里显示；另附独立 CLI。

description.en: Skill manager page for dsh: set each skill to on, manual only, model only, or off per agent mode; count how often each skill is loaded per mode from the session history; search skills.sh and install from GitHub; import from Codex, Claude Code, or a folder; create, edit, and version skills, with a trash for deleted ones; modes keep working after an uninstall.
description.zh: dsh 的 Skill（技能）管理页：按 Agent 模式把每个 Skill 设为开、仅手动、仅模型或关；从会话历史统计每个 Skill 在各模式里被加载的次数；搜索 skills.sh 并从 GitHub 安装；从 Codex、Claude Code 或文件夹导入；新建、编辑、保存版本，删除的 Skill 进回收站；卸载后模式照常可用。

description.en: Ports CSDN blog article typography into the DeepSeek Harness web GUI — heading hierarchy, quote blocks, solid-grid tables, inline code and Atom One syntax highlighting, in matching light and dark palettes.
description.zh: 把 CSDN 博文的配色与正文排版搬进 DeepSeek Harness 网页端：标题层级、引用块、实线网格表格、行内代码与 Atom One 语法高亮，浅色深色各一套。

description.en: A newspaper-style front page for a session you left running, as a Conversation View tab beside Chat and Trajectory: a per-turn timeline (duration, steps, tools, tokens, outcome), file churn counted per file, where the wall clock went and how much of it was the model rather than tools, which single turn ate the spend, failures nobody retried quoted with their failing command, and a context-pressure gauge measured against the routed model's own declared capacity. The briefing is folded from the durable session log and never generated by a model, so it costs no tokens, cannot hallucinate, and is byte-identical for the same log and clock; it appends nothing to the session and reaches no model, and it reports a pending approval without ever answering it. Pages are offered only when they have content, and the tab refreshes itself on turn settle and on a two-speed poll backed by a metadata-only tail probe.
description.zh: 把跑着的会话排成一张报纸式头版，作为 Chat 与 Trajectory 旁的 Conversation View 标签页：逐轮时间线（耗时、步数、工具、token、结果）、按文件统计的改动热度、墙钟时间去向以及其中多少是模型而非工具、哪一轮吃掉了花费、无人重试的失败（附失败命令），以及对照该路由模型自报容量的上下文压力仪表。简报由持久会话日志折算而成、从不调用模型：零 token、不会编造、同一份日志与时钟下字节一致；不向会话追加任何内容、也不触达模型，只报告待批准项而绝不代为应答。仅在某一页有内容时才提供该页；标签页在轮次结束时自刷新，并用只读日志尾部的探针做两档轮询。

description.en: Windows desktop control through UI Automation: nine tools that read a window control tree and drive elements by id through their own UI Automation patterns, with every write gated by an approval policy, an append-only action log and a settings panel.
description.zh: 通过 UI Automation 控制 Windows 桌面：九个工具读取窗口控件树、按 id 走控件自身的 UIA 模式操作，每次写入都受审批策略、动作日志与设置面板约束。

description.en: Holds every final answer before delivery, has one independent minimal-context model call re-derive and check it, and releases only the verified text; the draft is never shown. Reviewed answers cost one extra model request and appear a few seconds later.
description.zh: 在最终回答送达前先扣住，交给一次独立、最小上下文的模型调用重新推导并校验，只放出校验后的文本，用户看不到草稿。被复核的回答多一次模型请求，文字出现前会多几秒。

description.en: Copy-on-write permission preset: shell commands run inside a per-workspace Sandboxie box, so writes outside the workspace land in the box copy while the real disk stays untouched (Windows only, requires Sandboxie-Plus).
description.zh: 写时复制权限预设：shell 命令在工作区专属的 Sandboxie 沙盒内运行，工作区外的写入落进沙盒副本、真实磁盘不受影响（仅 Windows，需先安装 Sandboxie-Plus）。

description.en: Local OCR using Apple Vision on macOS: text from screenshots, photos, and scans, with no install, no network and no API key.
description.zh: 在 macOS 上使用 Apple Vision 的本地 OCR：从截图、照片和扫描件中读取文字，无需安装、无需联网、无需 API 密钥。

description.en: Measures what an llm-pi-ai endpoint really accepts — context window from its own model list, output-token limit and reasoning levels read out of its own range errors, image support from a generated test image — then reports declared values that contradict that evidence and rewrites them only after confirmation.
description.zh: 直接实测 llm-pi-ai 端点真正接受的能力——从它自己的模型列表取上下文窗口，从它自己的报错反推输出上限与推理档位，用生成的测试图验证图像支持——再报告与证据不符的声明值，确认后才改写。

description.en: AI-generated curiosity & trivia plugin for the dsh web GUI (Curio in the English UI): 「开始探奇」 generates a fresh batch of unexpected knowledge (excluding everything already seen), each item unfolds into two deeper layers plus similar knowledge points, and 「探奇清单」 keeps the full history (batch, items, layers, similar points) in browser storage. Reuses the host LLM channel with zero config; when no model is available, a DeepSeek API key can be pasted into the panel. Output language follows the DSH UI language (zh/en).
description.zh: 为 dsh Web 界面生成冷知识与奇妙事实的插件（英文界面下名为 Curio）：「开始探奇」每次生成一批不重复主题（排除已见），每条可深入两层并展开类似知识点，「探奇清单」将全部历史（批次、条目、层级、类似点）保存在浏览器；优先复用宿主 LLM 通道，无需配置，无可用模型时可在面板填写 DeepSeek API Key；输出语言跟随 DSH 界面语言（中/英）。

description.en: Makes the agent answer as soon as it has one: injects a deliver-first rule into the system prompt and escalates reminders when tool calls pile up without an answer.
description.zh: 让 agent 一拿到结果就交付：把"先交付、少查询"写进系统提示，并在工具调用持续堆积时逐级提醒它收尾。

description.en: Decodo Web Data API as the fetch provider behind the built-in web_fetch tool: returns Markdown by default, pins fetchProvider to decodo, and enforces a configurable per-process fetch cap. Requires a Decodo API key; web_search is unchanged.
description.zh: 把内置 web_fetch 工具的抓取后端换成 Decodo Web Data API：默认返回 Markdown，并把 fetchProvider 固定为 decodo，可配置单进程抓取上限；需要 Decodo API Key，web_search 不受影响。

description.en: Transparent image guard for text-only routes: paste images without the 400 session deadlock, plus a vision_analyze tool for OCR/PDF/docx/pptx/video.
description.zh: 纯文本路由的透明图片护栏：贴图不再 400 卡死会话，附带 vision_analyze 工具（OCR/PDF/docx/pptx/视频）。

description.en: Semantic-layer analytics tool that uses curated table, column and metric metadata with Qdrant and Elasticsearch recall to generate, validate and execute MySQL analytical queries through the Xiwen service.
description.zh: 基于人工维护的表、字段和指标语义元数据，结合 Qdrant 与 Elasticsearch 召回，通过析问服务生成、校验并执行 MySQL 分析查询。

description.en: Inline image chips for the DeepSeek Harness composer — paste an image and it lands in the text as a numbered chip (image-1.png) with hover preview. Images still ship through the official attachment pipeline, names restart per message, the dock and sent-message thumbnails carry a sequence badge, and a pre-send self-check warns when the names in the text no longer match the images in that message.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框里粘贴图片，即在文字中插入 image-1.png 编号胶囊；图片仍走官方附件管线随消息发出。鼠标悬浮名字弹出缩略图预览卡，dock 与已发送气泡的缩略图带序号角标，发送前还会自检「文字里的名字」与「本条消息的图片」是否对得上。

description.en: Moves selected messages from one conversation into another, and manages a workspace's conversations with archive, restore, delete and move between workspaces.
description.zh: 把选中的消息从一个对话迁移到另一个对话，并管理工作区的对话——支持归档、还原、删除和跨工作区迁移。

description.en: Persistent tmux control-mode cockpit for DSH Web that mirrors native panes in a dock.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供持久的 tmux 控制模式驾驶舱，在停靠栏中镜像原生窗格。

description.en: Adds Token Market as an OpenAI-compatible model provider with DeepSeek V4 Pro, Kimi K3, and GLM-5.3.
description.zh: 将 Token Market 添加为 OpenAI 兼容模型供应商，并提供 DeepSeek V4 Pro、Kimi K3 和 GLM-5.3。

description.en: After each reply, shows a gray next-prompt suggestion in the empty composer that Tab or → accepts; in an empty composer, ↑ / ↓ browse the messages you sent in the session. Settings can be changed on the Plugins page; nothing is sent automatically.
description.zh: 回答结束后在空输入框里显示一条灰色的下一句建议，按 Tab 或 → 采纳；空输入框按 ↑ / ↓ 翻看本会话发送过的内容；可在插件页直接修改设置；不会自动发送。

description.en: Exposes DSH as an MCP server so another agent can watch its thinking, tool calls and file writes in real time, share intent, take a floor lock that denies DSH's write/edit/git tools, inject mid-turn alerts, and delegate reviews.
description.zh: 把 DSH 变成一个 MCP server：让另一个 agent 实时看见它的思维、工具调用和文件改动，共享意图，持地板锁期间拒绝 DSH 的 write/edit/git 工具，插入中途提醒，并委托审查。

description.en: Imports the MCP servers Codex and Claude Code already declare as dsh mcp-client tools, links the skills of 22 known agent skill directories into ~/.dsh/skills as symlinks instead of copying them, and adds a Settings page that lists what was mounted, toggles each skill, and changes the source on a name conflict.
description.zh: 把 Codex 与 Claude Code 已声明的 MCP 服务器接入 dsh 的 mcp-client，把 22 个已知 Agent 技能目录的技能以符号链接（不复制文件）导入 ~/.dsh/skills，并提供设置页：列出本次实际挂载的服务器与技能、逐项启停技能、重名时改选来源。

description.en: \!WARNING\! this removes the authentication step !WARNING! Exchanges the process launch token for the browser-session cookie, so a first visit needs no ?token=... in the URL.
description.zh: ！警告！这会移除认证步骤！警告！注册一个登录入口路由（默认 GET /__dsh_login），把进程里的登录 token 换成浏览器会话 cookie，让首次访问不用带 ?token=…。

description.en: Sidebar row with today's tokens and estimated spend for DeepSeek Harness; the dialog adds 24h, 7-day, 30-day, 12-month and per-year charts, a contributions heatmap, per-request peak/off-peak pricing from the official DeepSeek price list and the Chinese statutory holiday calendar, and optional WebDAV sync that merges usage across machines.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的侧边栏用量徽标：显示当天 token 总量与估算费用；弹窗里有 24 小时 / 近 7 日 / 近 30 日 / 近 12 个月与按年图表、活跃度热力图，按 DeepSeek 官方定价与中国法定节假日逐请求计算峰谷价，并可选 WebDAV 云同步合并多台机器的用量。

description.en: Read-only lazy session viewer: lists sessions with stat only, then decompresses just the tail Zstandard frames to inspect recent events; includes search, stats, and export in a standalone /lazyview panel. Requires Node.js 24+.
description.zh: 只读会话惰性查看器：仅 stat 列出会话，再只解压尾部 Zstandard 帧查看最近事件；独立 /lazyview 面板支持搜索、统计和导出。需 Node.js 24+。

description.en: Zero-interruption audit and fuse blocking for DeepSeek Harness: silently records every tool call with deterministic risk scoring, cumulative-risk bonuses, risk-level breakdowns and retention-based cleanup; blocks irreversible catastrophes (protected-path deletion, disk wipe, force-push to protected branches/refs, credential exfiltration), and renders a redacted /risk-guard operation bill with --since filtering.
description.zh: 零打扰审计与保险丝拦截：静默记录每次工具调用并做纯规则风险评分（含累积加分、风险等级分布、归档保留期清理），只拦不可逆灾难（受保护路径删除、磁盘擦除、force push 到受保护分支/引用、凭据外发），/risk-guard 输出脱敏操作账单并支持 --since 时间过滤。

description.en: Restart button for the Harness desktop app: one sidebar entry that closes every Harness process and starts the application again, launched without a console window and without a close-confirmation dialog. Windows only.
description.zh: DSH 桌面应用重启按钮：侧栏一个入口，关闭全部 Harness 进程后重新启动应用；启动过程无控制台窗口、无关闭确认框。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Render Markdown + JSON into self-contained HTML documents, cards, dashboards, and galleries (CLI + artifact_render tool).
description.zh: 把 Markdown + JSON 渲染成自包含 HTML 文档/卡片/仪表盘/画廊（CLI + 内置 artifact_render 工具）。

description.en: White noise player: lays a layer of background sound (rain, streams, campfire, café) while AI codes, for flow and focus. Supports multiple playback modes (sequential / shuffle / single-loop / intermittent) and AI automatic background music download from Wikimedia Commons (CC0/PD/CC-BY).
description.zh: 白噪音播放器：AI 编程时铺一层背景音（雨声、溪流、篝火、咖啡馆……），帮助进入心流状态、集中精力、高效思考。支持顺序/随机/单曲循环/间歇等多种播放模式。支持 AI 自动从 Wikimedia Commons 下载 CC0/PD/CC BY 背景音乐到对应场景文件夹。

description.en: Gives the agent its own clock: per-session time readings whose precision the agent can change at runtime, elapsed-time counters, and one-shot countdowns that survive a host restart.
description.zh: 为 agent 提供它自己的时钟：按会话注入时间读数且精度可由 agent 运行时调整，并附带累计计时器与跨宿主重启可靠的一次性倒计时。

description.en: Policy-driven Git sync for DSH settings and profile configuration, with secret-aware projections, conflict review, and per-line apply controls.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 设置与 Profile 配置的策略化 Git 同步，支持敏感信息隔离、冲突审阅与按行选择应用。

description.en: Manage archived conversations in the Settings UI: unarchive them back to the sidebar, or permanently delete them with confirmation.
description.zh: 在设置界面管理已归档对话：一键取消归档，或经确认后永久删除。

description.en: Local memory for DeepSeek Harness: what you write is filed under a topic and linked to related entries, recall ranks results by embedding similarity (word matching when no model is installed), and the data stays in a local SQLite database.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地记忆插件：写下的内容按主题归档、与相关条目连边，召回按向量相似度排序（没装模型时退回词面匹配），数据存在本地 SQLite 库里。

description.en: Shows GLM Coding Plan quota windows (5-hour, weekly, monthly tools) as an always-visible pill in the composer stats row with a 5h reset countdown, opening a card-grid detail panel with limits, reset times, 24h per-model token usage and one-click plugin self-update.
description.zh: 在输入框统计行常驻 GLM Coding Plan 额度 pill(含 5 小时窗口重置倒计时),点击展开双列卡片式详情面板:各窗口限额、重置时间、近 24 小时按模型 Token 用量与小时级 sparkline,支持插件一键自更新。

description.en: Wire-level LLM inspector: captures the raw HTTP request and response bodies of model provider calls and attributes each capture to the session that caused it through the llm/stream waterfall. The request pane renders the body as a collapsible tree with per-node sizes — one measured request was 98.6% a single 973-entry array — and the response pane reassembles the OpenAI-style SSE chunk stream into reasoning, content, tool calls and usage. Shown in a Conversation View tab and a loopback viewer page.
description.zh: 线路层 LLM 检查器：抓取模型调用的原始 HTTP 请求与响应报文，经 llm/stream 瀑布把每次抓取归属到发起它的会话。请求面板把报文渲染成带每节点大小的可折叠树——实测一次请求有 98.6% 是单个 973 项的数组——响应面板则把 OpenAI 风格的 SSE chunk 流重新组装成推理、正文、工具调用与用量。在对话栏标签页与本地查看页展示。

description.en: Opens the official Plannotator app (plannotator.ai) so you can review the agent's plan — annotate, approve, or send it back.
description.zh: 打开官方 Plannotator 应用（plannotator.ai）审代理写好的计划：批注、批准，或打回重写。

description.en: Community Codex provider for DeepSeek Harness with ChatGPT OAuth, Codex models, image input, quota display, per-session Fast and transport controls, and safe stream recovery.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 社区 Codex 模型接入：支持 ChatGPT OAuth、Codex 模型、图片输入、额度展示、单会话 Fast 与传输控制，以及安全的流式恢复。

description.en: Durable cross-session memory plus a fetch ladder that survives hostname-keyed blocking. Four tools: memory_recall, memory_save and memory_stats over a plain-JSON fact store at $DSH_HOME/memory/facts.json, plus resilient_fetch which tries plain fetch, then a same-service alias host (Wikipedia only for now), then curl over IPv6 and IPv4 (needs curl on PATH). No daemon, no npm dependency, no network at import time. (1.3.0 shipped a fifth tool, memory_prune; it was withdrawn in 1.4.0 because adding a tool to a running plugin breaks sessions that were opened before it.)
description.zh: 跨会话持久记忆，加一条绕开主机名级封锁的取数阶梯：四个工具——memory_recall / memory_save / memory_stats 读写 $DSH_HOME/memory/facts.json 里的纯 JSON，resilient_fetch 依次尝试直连 fetch → 同服务别名主机（目前仅 Wikipedia）→ curl IPv6 → curl IPv4（curl 需在 PATH 上）。无后台进程、无 npm 依赖、导入期不联网。（1.3.0 曾加入第五个工具 memory_prune，已在 1.4.0 撤下：给运行中的插件加工具，会让此前打开的会话报错。）

description.en: DSH remote-access authorization page that shows the current process browser-session URL as a clickable link or QR code, behind an optional authority/subnet allow-list and PIN.
description.zh: DSH 远程授权页：以可点击链接或二维码呈现当前进程的浏览器会话 URL，可选主机/网段白名单与 PIN 门禁。

description.en: Auto-adjust model reasoning effort per task (off/low/high/max): task classification, \[effort=...] markers, in-turn error escalation, DeepSeek peak-pricing-period capping with countdown notices, and manual-selection priority.
description.zh: 根据任务自动调整模型推理档位（off/low/high/max）：任务分类判定、\[effort=...] 显式标记、轮内出错升级、DeepSeek 高峰计价时段自动限档省钱并显示切换倒计时、GUI 手动选择优先。

description.en: Windows commit-charge watchdog for DSH Desktop: samples committed memory every 5 seconds, attributes it to the DSH process tree and the largest consumers, blocks automatic restart when DSH is not the main committer, and adds read-only pagefile advice, a 7-day crash timeline and an event export; automatic restart and crash resume are both off by default.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 的 Windows 提交内存看门狗：每 5 秒采样提交内存，把它归因到 DSH 进程树与占用最高的进程，在 DSH 不是主要占用者时阻止自动重启，并给出只读的分页文件建议、7 天崩溃时间线与事件导出；自动重启与崩溃后自动续接默认都是关闭的。

description.en: Paper trading in DSH: A-shares and commodity futures, local ledger, built-in FTShare data and K-line, and daily-close practice without buying an API key.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中进行模拟交易，支持 A 股和商品期货，本地账本，内置 FTShare 数据源与 K 线，无需购买 API Key 也可使用日K收盘价练习

description.en: Unofficial Gemini Cloud Code Assist OAuth integration with isolated account storage; carries account-ban risk.
description.zh: 提供独立账户存储的非官方 Gemini Cloud Code Assist OAuth 接入，存在封号风险。

description.en: Task Runner mode for DeepSeek Harness: the main agent decomposes large tasks into independent subtasks, dispatches them to subagents (default local model) in fresh short contexts, and synthesizes results; concurrency and worker/orchestrator models are configurable in the settings panel.
description.zh: 任务拆解模式：主代理把大任务拆成独立子任务，派给子代理（默认本地模型）在全新短上下文中执行并综合结果；并发数与模型可在设置面板图形化配置。

description.en: Deterministic engineering orchestration runtime for DeepSeek Harness: the orbit_controller tool and OrbitService run Commander, Executor and Smart Watchdog children through PLAN, EXECUTE, EVALUATE, bounded correction and runtime recovery, with durable state in <project>/.cx/state.json.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的确定性工程编排运行时：orbit_controller 工具与 OrbitService 以 Commander / Executor / Smart Watchdog 子代理执行 PLAN、EXECUTE、EVALUATE、有界修正与运行时恢复，持久状态保存在 <project>/.cx/state.json。

description.en: Token usage statistics plugin for DeepSeek Harness - today's token consumption by model, cache hit rate, 7-day trend chart, optional header badge, persistent storage with auto cleanup.
description.zh: DSH Token 用量统计插件 - 今日 Token 用量按模型分桶、缓存命中率、7 日趋势图、可选顶栏徽标、持久化存储自动清理。

description.en: Real-time cost tracking for the current DSH conversation: a composer-dock line showing the running token usage and DeepSeek official price estimate (base and peak/valley pricing).
description.zh: 当前对话实时费用统计：输入框下方一行显示运行中的 token 用量与 DeepSeek 官方价格估算（基础价与峰谷价）。

description.en: Character skins with an editable decoration board — Yukino warm daily and occult editorial themes, each with dual character sprites + sticker sheets, drag/resize/rotate coordinate editor, custom asset upload, and shareable diorama packs (assets + layout bundled).
description.zh: 角色皮肤舞台：雪乃·暖阳日常与隐秘年代志双主题，各带双角色立绘与表情贴纸；可视化装饰看板支持拖动/缩放/旋转/坐标精调/锚定切换/上传素材，装饰包（素材+布局）可导出分享、导入后自动打开看板继续调整。

description.en: Two-way Feishu (Lark) chat bridge for DeepSeek Harness over the official WebSocket long connection: messages route to the bound workspace's latest session and replies return automatically; bot credentials and workspace routing are configurable from the settings page.
description.zh: 基于飞书官方 WebSocket 长连接的 DSH 双向聊天桥：消息路由到所选工作区的最新会话并自动回复，可在设置页切换机器人凭证与工作区。

description.en: Adds touch-friendly navigation, layout refinements, and standalone PWA styling to the existing DeepSeek Harness web interface.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 现有 Web 界面加上触屏友好的导航、布局微调与独立 PWA 样式。

description.en: Replaces detected secrets (OpenAI, AWS, GitHub, PEM, Bearer) with deterministic, structurally valid honey tokens before they reach the model or the session file; adds manual marking for values the detectors miss, explicit user-visible restore, a cross-session canary alarm, and an opt-in JSONL log of substitution counts that never records the underlying values.
description.zh: 在密钥离开本机前，将其确定性地替换为结构合法的蜜罐假值（OpenAI、AWS、GitHub、PEM、Bearer 模式）；支持手动标记检测器认不出的值、用户可见的显式还原、蜜罐跨会话出现时的金丝雀告警，以及可选的 JSONL 替换计数日志（只记来源与类别计数，绝不记录真实值）。

description.en: Beads issue browser in the right sidebar: filter and search the tracker with live ready and waiting counts, read issue Markdown with clickable project-file and issue links, and copy or insert the issue id. Requires the bd CLI on PATH and a project with a Beads workspace.
description.zh: 右侧栏的 Beads 议题浏览器：按可开工、受阻与各状态筛选并搜索 tracker，阅读渲染后的议题正文，其中的项目文件与议题 id 可直接点击，并可一键复制或插入 id。需要 PATH 上的 bd CLI，以及已初始化 Beads 工作区的项目。

description.en: Replaces the official Models settings page with provider lifecycle management, per-model reasoning effort tiers, retry overrides, drag reorder and upstream model sync.
description.zh: 替代官方「模型」设置页：提供方生命周期管理、每模型思考档位、重试覆盖、拖动排序与上游模型同步。

description.en: Thinking-sorting plugin. A switch beside the composer puts the session into a three-stage mode — sort, critique, research — and each stage has a checklist of what it should produce before you press the advance button; finished ideas are filed by genre into Settings → Thoughts Center. A floating notebook holds half-formed sparks and opens a new session with the chosen one already written into the input box.
description.zh: 梳理思路插件。输入框旁的开关把会话切进「梳理 → 批判 → 调研」三段模式，每段列着这一段该产出的东西，够了再点「推进」按钮换段；成稿按体裁存进 设置 → Thoughts Center。另有悬浮随想记录本，碎灵感先存着，点「去研究」直接开一条新对话，那句话已经写进输入框。

description.en: Workspace file tree and code editor in the DSH right sidebar: browse the workspace of the session it belongs to, create, rename and delete files and folders (to a trash folder by default), edit in place with line numbers and syntax highlighting (Ctrl+S saves, Ctrl+D duplicates the current line), preview images and play audio or video, list and unpack archives or pack a folder into a .zip through the system tar, search by file name or jump by a pasted path, and draw file rows with the icons Windows itself uses (SHGetFileInfo, Windows only).
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏里的工作区文件树与代码编辑器：跟随所在会话的工作区，新建 / 重命名 / 删除文件与文件夹（默认进回收站），带行号与语法高亮地编辑、Ctrl+S 保存、Ctrl+D 复制当前行，可预览图片、播放音频视频、查看并解压压缩包或用系统 tar 打包成 zip，能按文件名搜索或粘贴路径跳转，Windows 下图标用系统自己那套（SHGetFileInfo）。

description.en: Voice control for the DSH web composer: push-to-talk speech-to-text into the input box (with optional auto-send), spoken playback of assistant replies via the Web Speech API, right-click settings popover, and a global Ctrl+M hotkey.
description.zh: DSH 网页端语音控制：按住说话将语音转文字输入发送框（可自动发送），用浏览器语音合成朗读助手回复；右键麦克风打开设置面板，支持 Ctrl+M 全局快捷键。

description.en: A Wang Lin cultivation companion for dsh: watches your session state and acts it out with rich animations, and levels up as you cultivate.
description.zh: 渡劫飞升：仙逆王林修炼伙伴。实时监控会话状态，用打坐、掐诀、御剑、雷龙等丰富交互动画演绎大模型的每一个动作，随使用修炼升境。

description.en: Local-only telemetry service for DSH plugins: records operation trails and error events into a storage-domain KV table, applies a configurable redaction rule set before the write and again when the analysis reads back a record stored before a rule existed, and groups one plugin's failures by feature-code anchor, reporting the window it read, the route each group ran on, and the attempts recorded after its last failure in write order.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 插件的本地遥测服务：把操作轨迹与错误事件写入 storage-domain KV 表，在写入前按可配置的规则集脱敏，并在分析读回早于规则存在的旧记录时再次按同一规则集脱敏，然后按功能码锚点聚合单个插件的失败事件，同时报告读取的时间窗口、每个失败组的模型路由，以及按写入顺序统计的最近一次失败之后的尝试次数。

description.en: Merged, version-locked plugin upgrade skill for DeepSeek Harness (0.1.3-alpha.1 to 0.1.5-rc.1 as two closed legs): an evidence-bound version card plus a zero-dependency 20-seam scanner, shipped as a bundle skill and an npx CLI.
description.zh: 合并后的版本锁定插件升级技能（0.1.3-alpha.1 → 0.1.5-rc.1，两条闭环腿）：证据绑定版本卡 + 零依赖 20 接缝扫描器，以 bundle 技能 + npx CLI 两种形态发布。

description.en: Local tool-call failsafe for DSH: blocks a fixed list of high-risk shell patterns and credential-file reads before execution, with a per-session hash-linked JSONL audit log, and an optional external Gateway for centralized policy.
description.zh: DSH 本機工具調用防護外掛：攔截高風險 Shell 指令模式與敏感憑證讀取，具備持久化哈希鏈 JSONL 審計記錄，可選配外部 Gateway 集中治理。

description.en: macOS system notifications for DeepSeek Harness: aborted, max-tokens, blocked, interrupted and error events, pending questions and approvals, and completion or subagent-end via terminal-notifier; clicking a banner opens a configured app and returning to the page auto-dismisses them.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 macOS 系统通知插件：任务中止、超限、阻塞、中断、出错、等待提问或批准、完成或子代理结束等事件通过 terminal-notifier 弹系统横幅；点击横幅打开指定应用，回到页面自动清空。

description.en: Manage DSH rules from the web settings panel — edit global/project AGENTS.md, or auto-split pasted rules into layered AGENTS.md and skills via LLM.
description.zh: 在设置面板统一管理 DSH 规则：编辑全局/项目 AGENTS.md，或由 LLM 自动拆分粘贴的规则为分层 AGENTS.md 与技能。

description.en: Trims historical images in outgoing chat requests down to a recent-image count, learns the provider per-prompt image cap from HTTP 400 responses, and retries with fewer images so image-heavy sessions keep working.
description.zh: 发送前把请求中的历史图片裁剪至保留张数，并从上游 400 错误解析单次图片上限、按更少张数降级重试，保证含图会话不被图片数量限制打断。

description.en: LAN reverse proxy plugin for DeepSeek Harness - enables mobile/tablet access with full features, fixes settings panel inaccessible via reverse proxy.
description.zh: DSH 局域网反向代理插件 - 让手机/平板访问 DSH 获得完整功能，修复反代访问时设置面板无法打开的问题。

description.en: Drives Proteus 8/9 interactive simulation from the agent through eleven proteus_* tools: connect, simulation start/stop/status, probe readings, a project save that checks the file hash and mtime actually changed, and layout suggestions computed locally; on machines that register the Labcenter.InteractiveSimulation COM server it also places devices from a whitelist and queries and connects pins, while without COM it falls back to a keyboard-driven UI transport covering the simulation lifecycle and saving. Requires Windows with a local Proteus 8/9 installation.
description.zh: 让 Agent 通过 11 个 proteus_* 工具控制 Proteus 8/9 交互仿真：连接、仿真启停与状态、探针读数、会校验文件哈希与 mtime 确已变化的工程保存、纯本地计算的布局建议；本机注册了 Labcenter.InteractiveSimulation COM 服务器时还可按白名单放置器件、查询引脚并连线，没有 COM 则降级到只覆盖仿真生命周期与保存的键盘驱动 UI 传输。需要 Windows 与本地安装的 Proteus 8/9。

description.en: Draggable companion widget by Tokyo with Codex quota monitoring, manual executable discovery, and editable replies. Requires the Codex CLI (codex app-server) and a ChatGPT login; API-key logins expose no subscription quota.
description.zh: Tokyo 的可拖动陪伴挂件，支持 Codex 额度监控、手动程序定位和可编辑回复。需安装 Codex CLI（codex app-server）并使用 ChatGPT 登录；API-key 登录不显示订阅额度。

description.en: Local-life toolkit for DSH agents: budget planning, bill splitting, unit-price and discount math, common unit conversions (jin/li/chi, C/F, L/gallon), and trip checklists.
description.zh: 为 DSH agent 提供本地生活工具包：预算规划、账单分摊、单价与折扣计算、常用单位换算（斤/里/尺、摄氏/华氏、升/加仑）与出行清单。

description.en: Verification toolkit for DSH agents: evidence-based claim checking against workspace files with line citations, config validation (JSON/YAML), and read-only URL/npm/GitHub submission-readiness probes.
description.zh: DSH 核验工具箱：在工作区文件中核查声明并返回带行号引用的证据，校验配置文件（JSON/YAML），以及只读的 URL / npm / GitHub 提交就绪度探测。

description.en: Ten full-canvas animated backgrounds for the DSH conversation pane — starfield, code rain, circuit, sword-fight, cat, girl, fighter jet, racer, snow and bubbles — one random theme per turn, with a text-column veil that keeps the chat readable.
description.zh: 给 DSH 对话区加十种整屏动效背景——星空、代码雨、电路、华山论剑、小猫、小女生、飞机大战、赛车、飘雪、肥皂泡；每回合随机一个，正文列有纱罩保证可读。

description.en: Answers a hard question with a one-page visual HTML explainer: the model writes a short Markdown draft and the bundled dependency-free `am` CLI builds the layout, CSS and diagram coordinates. Vendors the upstream answer-me-with-html skill verbatim as a skill-only DSH bundle with no Host code.
description.zh: 把复杂问题回答成一页可视化 HTML：模型只写简短的 Markdown 草稿，随包附带的零依赖 `am` 命令行负责排版、配色与图表坐标。以上游 answer-me-with-html 技能原样内置，是纯技能的 DSH bundle，不含 Host 代码。

description.en: Agent skill and tool for querying multi-platform model account balances: DeepSeek, Doubao / Volcengine, Qwen / Alibaba Cloud, Hunyuan / Tencent Cloud, and custom HTTP endpoints. Read-only, with 60s cache.
description.zh: 多平台余额 Agent 技能与工具：查询 DeepSeek、豆包 / 火山引擎、千问 / 阿里云百炼、混元 / 腾讯云以及自定义 HTTP 接口的账户余额；只读，内置 60 秒缓存。

description.en: Export complete Web Sessions to local Markdown or self-contained HTML, with stable rendered previews, default redaction, and opt-in bounded tool-call details.
description.zh: 把完整 Web Session 导出为本地 Markdown 或自包含 HTML，提供稳定的 Markdown 渲染预览、默认脱敏和可选的有界工具调用详情。

description.en: Play video and audio in the right-Sidebar document preview, streamed over an authenticated HTTP Range route with desktop seek.
description.zh: 在右侧栏文档预览里播放视频/音频，经带鉴权的 HTTP Range 路由流式读取，桌面端可拖动进度。

description.en: Notes taken from DeepSeek Harness conversations: quotes whole replies or selected passages, keeps highlights rendered at their original position in the session, attaches editable Markdown notes, tags them, filters by workspace or session, and exports Markdown or a full JSON backup stored as local JSON files.
description.zh: 从 DSH 会话里记笔记：可收藏整条回复或选中片段，划线会持久重绘回原文位置，可为其补写可编辑的 Markdown 笔记、打标签，按工作区或会话筛选，并导出 Markdown 或完整 JSON 备份；数据以本机 JSON 文件存储。

description.en: Connect Trilium notes to the DSH agent via ETAPI with 20 agent tools: durable memory (remember/recall + auto-injected index), note management (CRUD/clone/attributes/revisions), full-text search, weekly-report workflow, attachments, calendar notes, backup/import, and a settings card.
description.zh: 通过 ETAPI 把 Trilium 笔记库接入 agent，提供 20 个工具：记忆读写（remember/recall + 自动注入索引）、笔记管理（CRUD/克隆/属性/修订）、全文搜索、周报工作流、附件、日历笔记、备份导入，独立设置卡片，配置 0600 落盘。

description.en: Archived conversations list in the sidebar footer with read-only previews of the most recent messages, for sessions the product deliberately keeps hidden and unreopenable.
description.zh: 侧边栏底部的已归档对话列表，可只读预览最近消息；针对产品刻意隐藏且无法重新打开的归档会话。

description.en: DSH plugin: matches a model you declared on a custom gateway to the capability metadata it should have — context window, output cap, reasoning levels and image support — by looking the bare model name up at runtime; the plugin never writes your settings document.
description.zh: DSH 插件：按模型名在运行时查一次目录，把你在自定义网关上声明的模型该有的能力元数据补上——上下文长度、输出上限、推理等级、能否看图；插件自己不写你的设置文档。

description.en: Memory triage for DeepSeek Harness: at the end of each turn it decides which entries to keep and which to archive, routes project-specific ones into a project bucket while global ones stay in the main store, merges near-duplicate entries, and falls back to an LLM when the rules are unsure — automatic actions are recoverable archives only, never deletions.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 记忆分诊插件：每轮对话结束自动判断条目保留或归档，把项目条目迁入 project 桶、全局条目留在总体记忆，合并近义重复条目，规则拿不准时用 LLM 兜底；自动动作只做可恢复的归档，永不直接删除。

description.en: Joins two spreadsheets on a declared key and compares declared fields within declared tolerances, producing a Markdown report, a JSON result and a diff workbook. It reports differences; it does not adjudicate them.
description.zh: 按声明的主键连接两张表，按声明字段与容差比对，输出 Markdown 报告、JSON 结果与差异工作簿。只报告差异，不裁决对错。

description.en: Adds per-member model and reasoning-effort routing to DeepSeek Desktop Agent Teams, plus leader-initiated release of a teammate subagent run instance.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Desktop 的 Agent Teams 提供成员级模型与思考强度路由，并允许主理人释放（删除）团队成员的子智能体运行实例。

description.en: Schedules workspace Agent runs in fresh Result Sessions with persistent audit history, using a stock DSH Conversation tab or a global Shell page when its slots are available.
description.zh: 面向 Workspace 调度 Agent 任务，每次运行创建全新 Result Session 并持久保留审计历史；原版 DSH 使用会话标签，存在对应 Slot 时使用全局 Shell 页面。

description.en: Ships a skill that documents how to build, debug and publish DSH plugins - host and client package skeleton, developing a forked plugin inside a throwaway profile, publishing to GitHub and npm, and the pitfalls found while shipping them. Installing the plugin registers the skill.
description.zh: 携带一份技能，讲怎么开发、调试、发布 DSH 插件——host/client 双半包骨架、把 fork 挂进丢弃式 profile 开发、发布到 GitHub 与 npm，以及发布过程中实际踩到的坑。安装插件即注册该技能。

description.en: Session code collector for DeepSeek Harness: a composer-side panel gathering every code block the model produced in the current session, with by-language / by-file views, per-file version history, live search, per-entry copy, copy-all, download-all as Markdown, and click-to-jump back to the exact turn (Alt+Shift+C).
description.zh: 会话代码收集器：输入框右侧按钮一键汇总当前会话中模型产出的全部代码块，支持按语言/按文件双视图、同一文件的版本历史、实时搜索过滤、单条/全部复制、下载合并 Markdown，点击直接跳转到产出该代码的回合（Alt+Shift+C 快捷开关）。

description.en: Observational file-mutation rollback for the fs tools: write/edit pre-images are checkpointed as git blobs or snapshots and restored through a model-facing rollback_files tool or a /rollback command.
description.zh: 文件变更回滚：捕获 write/edit 工具调用的改前映像（git blob 或快照），通过面向模型的 rollback_files 工具或 /rollback 命令还原。

description.en: Sidebar account-balance quick view for DeepSeek Harness: balance, bonus credit, current model and the official peak/off-peak pricing period, with ruby/amber/jade/gold tiers and a low-balance warning.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏账户余额快捷查看：显示余额、赠送额度、当前模型和官方高峰 / 空闲计费时段，按余额分四档显示质感，余额过低时提醒。

description.en: Settings-page usage dashboard: per-provider/model token summary across all sessions, with today/7-day/30-day CSS-bar trends and a cache-hit rate.
description.zh: 设置页用量仪表盘：按服务商/模型汇总全部会话 token 用量，含今日/近 7 天/近 30 天趋势柱状图与缓存命中率。

description.en: Sit-and-water reminder for DeepSeek Harness, with a cat that sits in the corner of the Web GUI. A focus cycle of 30-90 minutes ends in a centered overlay plus a triple chime that gets you up to walk and drink; the later button answers with one real sourced case about prolonged sitting and one about dehydration (built-in library of 17 entries, each with publisher, date and a link to the original); stopping produces a session report with worked time, completed rounds, successful interruptions, snoozes, suggested drinks and a good/mid/bad grade. The cat can be dragged anywhere with its position remembered and loops one animation per state. The timer and the ledger live in the host half, so a page refresh never loses a cycle; it only reminds while a DSH page is open. Cycle lengths, chime volume, cat opacity and grade thresholds are configurable on the plugin settings page.
description.zh: DSH 的久坐与喝水提醒：一只猫待在 Web GUI 角落帮你盯时间。专注周期 30-90 分钟结束后居中弹窗并连响三声，喊你起来走两步、喝口水；点「再等会」给出 1 条久坐的真实案例 + 1 条缺水的真实案例（内置 17 条，均带来源媒体、发布日期和原文链接）；点「结束」输出本次工作评价：工作时长、完成轮数、成功中断次数、推迟次数、建议喝水次数与好/中/差评分。猫可以拖到任意位置并记住位置，四个状态各一段循环动画。计时与账本在宿主侧，刷新页面不丢；只在 DSH 页面开着时提醒。周期时长、提示音音量、猫的不透明度、评价阈值都能在设置页调整。

description.en: Consistency guard for long-form writing: scans conversation prose for character, timeline and numeric setting conflicts across chapters, then jumps straight to the conflicting message.
description.zh: 长文创作一致性守卫：扫描会话正文，发现人物年龄、等级、境界、年份等设定跨章节矛盾，点击直接跳转到冲突原文位置。

description.en: A ✨ button left of the send button: reads the draft and recent turns, asks the configured model for three suggestions each pairing an issue with a patch, lets you tick them individually with a live preview of the merged prompt, and writes the result back to the composer without sending.
description.zh: 发送按钮左侧的 ✨ 按钮：读取草稿与最近若干轮对话，向已配置的模型要三条建议（每条都是「问题 + 改法」），可逐条勾选并实时预览合并后的提示词，结果写回输入框但不发送。

description.en: Embedded terminal for DeepSeek Harness: opens an in-app terminal panel in the right sidebar (DockKit) or bottom composer dock, with PSReadLine geometry protection and full theme sync.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 内嵌终端插件：在右侧栏（DockKit Tab）或输入框下方以沉底抽屉形式提供界面内嵌的交互式终端，跟随官方主题与工作区目录，支持 PSReadLine 尺寸保护与位置热切换。

description.en: Ships a skill about handing work to subagents instead of doing it inline - which tasks are worth fanning out, how many to run at once, how to send them in parallel, and how to check what they returned instead of trusting the summary.
description.zh: 携带一份讲「什么该交给子 agent 做、而不是自己顺手做」的技能——哪些任务值得扇出、一次派几个、并行怎么发，以及子 agent 回来后怎么核对它真的做了什么，而不是信它的总结。

description.en: ServerChan3 (Server酱) push notifications when a turn finishes — title, model, project directory, git branch, status and a reply excerpt, with subagent filtering and fire-and-forget delivery.
description.zh: 回合结束时向 Server酱3 推送微信通知——标题、模型、项目目录、Git 分支、状态与回复摘要，支持子代理过滤，fire-and-forget 不阻塞主流程。

description.en: Open the current registered Workspace from the Session Header or Workspace menu in a detected or configured editor, with hot re-detection and a remembered browser preference.
description.zh: 从 Session 页头或 Workspace 菜单用检测到或配置的编辑器打开当前已登记 Workspace，支持热重新检测和浏览器首选项记忆。

description.en: Sidebar todo list for DeepSeek Harness — grouped buckets, recurring tasks with weekday or month-day rules, a month-view calendar, and an agent tool that reads and writes the same JSON file.
description.zh: 侧栏待办清单——逾期/今天/本周分组、循环任务（每周多选周几、每月指定几号）、月视图日历，agent 通过工具读写同一份 JSON。

description.en: Declutters the DSH chat: hides agent execution-log rows, tightens spacing and fonts, wraps messages in bubbles, and injects an editable reply-concisely system instruction.
description.zh: 简化 DSH 聊天界面：隐藏执行日志、收紧间距与字号、把消息做成气泡，并注入可编辑的“简洁回复”系统指令。

description.en: Normalize the DSH settings UI onto one design language: unified typography, cards, controls, focus and motion across every settings page, including pages contributed by other plugins.
description.zh: 将 DSH 设置界面归一为同一套设计语言：统一各设置页的排版、卡片、控件、焦点与动效，包括其他插件贡献的页面。

description.en: Claude Code style /init command and tool that writes a minimal CLAUDE.md and symlinks AGENTS.md to it.
description.zh: 提供 Claude Code 风格的 /init 命令与工具，生成极简 CLAUDE.md，并将 AGENTS.md 以相对软链指向它。

description.en: Skill center for DSH: browse skills by region, install them from a zip archive, and manage them afterwards with enable/disable, uninstall, trash restore and search.
description.zh: 技能中心：按区域浏览技能、从 zip 安装，并支持启用停用、卸载、回收站恢复与搜索。

description.en: Smooth think-row experience for the DSH Web UI: think rows expand as a capped 24-line preview that glides to the bottom while reasoning streams, collapse with a short height animation on settle, and the main conversation view follows with a reader-safe smooth chase (no snaps, no yanks).
description.zh: DSH Web 端的丝滑思考盒体验：think 行展开为 24 行限高预览并随流式推理平滑追底，settle 时以短动画收起，主对话视图以读者友好的平滑追逐跟随（无跳变、无拉扯）。

description.en: Turn-level workspace undo for Git worktrees: every agent turn gets a private snapshot, /undo previews a red/green diff card that is confirmed in place, files changed after the turn are refused with a conflict diff unless --force or --skip-conflicts is passed, and HEAD, index, stash and commit history of the user repository are never written.
description.zh: Git worktree 的 turn 级工作区撤销：每个 turn 建私有快照，/undo 先出红绿 diff 预览卡、卡内确认；turn 之后被改过的文件拒绝用冲突 diff 覆盖，只有显式 --force 或 --skip-conflicts 才继续；不写用户仓库的 HEAD、index、stash 与提交历史。

description.en: DSH Desktop enhancement: one-click update checker, DeepSeek balance & API key viewer, and import other AI tools.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 桌面增强：一键检查更新、DeepSeek 余额与 API Key、导入其他 AI 工具。

description.en: Shows the running agent step above the web composer as a Chinese sentence: its step number, the tools it is running, and how long it has been going. A finished step keeps its duration on screen until the next one starts, so a slow step can be identified after the fact.
description.zh: 在网页版输入框上方用一句中文显示当前正在执行的智能体步骤：步号、正在执行的工具、以及已运行多久。步骤结束后会保留该步用时，直到下一步开始，因此慢步骤事后也能查证。

description.en: A full-page console panel opened from the sidebar, with eight tabs: an overview; a session list read from the sessions service (title, directory, running state, updated time, with filters); installed bundles and Loader entries from pluginInventory and pluginManager, with per-bundle enable switches; a plugin market listing public topic:dsh-plugin repositories from the GitHub search API; a model and provider editor that writes the llm-pi-ai settings namespace through remote.settings.mutate (switch a session model, add or edit providers and their model lists, and store API keys via remote.credentials, merging over the stored profile so fields the form does not expose survive an edit); MCP and skills tabs; and a usage tab that reads the host's loopback /api/dsh-usage/overview document. Services are declared through ctx.inject, so a deployment that omits one mounts without the console rather than crashing.
description.zh: 从侧栏打开的整页控制台面板，含八个标签：总览；从 sessions 服务读取的会话列表（标题、目录、运行状态、更新时间，带筛选）；从 pluginInventory 与 pluginManager 读取的已装 bundle 与 Loader 条目，每个 bundle 带启用开关；列出 GitHub 搜索 API 中 topic:dsh-plugin 公开仓库的插件市场；一个模型与供应商编辑器，通过 remote.settings.mutate 写入 llm-pi-ai 配置命名空间（切换会话模型、新增或编辑供应商及其模型列表、经 remote.credentials 保存 API Key，并以合并方式写入以免表单未暴露的字段被覆盖）；MCP 与技能两个标签；以及一个读取宿主回环 /api/dsh-usage/overview 文档的用量标签。所需服务通过 ctx.inject 声明，缺少任一服务的部署只是不挂载该面板，不会崩溃。

description.en: Real-time token estimates for the DSH conversation composer, combining the current context baseline with the draft and showing exact or heuristic counts.
description.zh: 为 DSH 对话输入框实时估算 token 数，将当前上下文基线与草稿合并计算，并区分精确计数与启发式估算。

description.en: Git development workbench for DeepSeek Harness: captures branch, status, worktrees, stashes and recent commits, with commands, tools and a settings UI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Git 开发工作台：采集分支、状态、worktree、stash 和最近提交，并通过命令、工具与设置界面管理 Git 工作区。

description.en: Grok model provider for DeepSeek Harness with model discovery, image and video generation, text-to-speech tools, and durable local media tasks over an OpenAI-compatible gateway.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中接入 Grok：模型发现、图片与视频生成、文字转语音工具，以及可重启恢复的本地媒体任务。

description.en: Personal workbench panel with an overview dashboard, custom kanban boards, a note pad and a file library, persisted to local JSON by the host.
description.zh: 个人工作台面板：总览仪表盘、自定义看板、随手记与资料库，数据由 Host 持久化到本地 JSON。

description.en: Diagnose duplicate DSH loader entry IDs before startup, report version-locked repair status in a read-only settings card, and apply or revert audited loader repairs through an external CLI.
description.zh: 在 DSH 启动前诊断重复的 loader entry ID，通过只读设置卡片报告版本锁定的修复状态，并使用外部 CLI 应用或撤销经过审计的 loader 修复。

description.en: Shows a reminder card in the bottom-right corner of the DSH web GUI whenever the agent is waiting for your answer, and adds a desktop notification plus a flashing tab title when you are on another tab or window.
description.zh: 当 agent 停下来等你作答时，在 DSH Web 界面右下角弹出提醒卡；若你切到了别的标签或窗口，再补一条系统通知并让标签标题闪烁。

description.en: Adds four extra UI locales to DeepSeek Harness — Traditional Chinese (zh-TW), Japanese, Korean and French. All translation data is bundled, so it works fully offline.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加四种界面语言（繁體中文、日本語、한국어、Français），语料随包内置，完全离线。

description.en: Flip the DSH page over to a glass task board showing live jobs, subagents and session state, with an infinite canvas that unrolls a card into draggable controls, embedded web-app frames, and a conversation box that edits the canvas.
description.zh: 把 DSH 页面翻到背面变成玻璃任务台（会话 / 后台任务 / 子代理 / 工作区卡片），并提供无限画布：能把卡片拆成可拖动的控件、内嵌网页应用，还能用对话框直接改画布。

description.en: Skill for packaging DeepSeek Harness into a Tauri 2 desktop app (macOS + Windows): dual-platform install playbook, China mirror bootstrap with a subagent timeout sentinel, admin-free Windows toolchain recipe (no VS Build Tools), and three-path acceptance checklists.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 封装成 Tauri 2 桌面应用（macOS + Windows）的技能包：双平台安装、国内镜像加速（含 subagent 超时哨兵）、无管理员 Windows 工具链方案、三路径验收清单。

description.en: Scan, view, and safely clean local AI terminal session histories (Claude Code, Codex CLI, WorkBuddy, DSH) from a settings card — quarantine-first with SHA-256 manifests, one-click restore, audit log, and phrase-confirmed hard delete.
description.zh: 会话清道夫：在 DSH 设置中扫描、查看并安全清理本机 AI 终端会话历史（Claude Code、Codex CLI、WorkBuddy、DSH），隔离优先、带 SHA-256 清单与一键整批恢复，彻底删除需输入确认短语。

description.en: Client-only right-edge chat input index rail: one bar per user message, two-stage hover preview (15 chars, expandable to 40), click-to-jump, and scroll-follow highlight; static npm bundle with no host half.
description.zh: 纯客户端对话输入目录条：每条用户消息一根横条，两级悬停预览（15 字，移入气泡展开 40 字）、点击跳转、滚动跟随高亮；静态 npm 包，无宿主半。

description.en: Notes-backed context compression for DeepSeek Harness: replaces LLM-summarized compaction with a model-written persistent notebook plus recoverable raw history, so the rollover boundary itself costs zero model calls.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供笔记式上下文压缩：用模型维护的持久笔记本取代 LLM 摘要式压缩，并保留可恢复的原始历史，窗口边界本身不产生模型调用。

description.en: Free-interval session reports with AI-narrated daily/weekly digests over any date range, plus every-N-days scheduled reminders with system notifications (macOS / Linux).
description.zh: 自由周期会话报告：任意日期区间的 AI 叙事日报/周报/月报，支持每隔 N 天定时提醒并弹系统通知（macOS / Linux）。

description.en: Make F5, Ctrl+F5, and Ctrl+Shift+R reload the DeepSeek Harness page.
description.zh: 让 F5、Ctrl+F5 和 Ctrl+Shift+R 都能刷新 DeepSeek Harness 页面。

description.en: Runtime observability and plugin operations panel for DeepSeek Harness: shows the profile plugin tree, real Loader fiber state, capabilities/dependencies/compatibility, current-session plugin activity and upstream source/version checks, with one-click enable/disable/update/uninstall plus a standalone startup-failure diagnostics page that works while DSH is not running.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的运行可观测与插件运维面板：展示 Profile 插件树、Loader 真实 fiber 状态、能力/依赖/兼容性、本轮会话插件活动与上游来源/版本核验，支持一键关闭/启用/更新/卸载，并提供 DSH 未运行时也能打开的独立启动失败诊断页。

description.en: Control, organize, diagnose, design, personalize, and answer product knowledge questions for a Yeelight smart home, powered by the local yeelight-home runtime.
description.zh: 控制、组织、诊断、设计、个性化 Yeelight 智能家居，解答产品知识问题，由本地 yeelight-home 运行时驱动。

description.en: Turns a streaming assistant reply into short blips, one per character at a configurable minimum spacing, for the reply text only, and keeps sounding when the window is minimized, covered, or in a background tab. Two built-in voices, or a custom one shaped by waveform, or loaded from an audio file.
description.zh: 把流式输出的助手回复变成短促音效：按可调的最小间隔逐字发声，只对回复正文发声，窗口最小化、被遮挡或切到后台标签页时照常发声。内置两种音色，也可自调波形，或载入音频文件当音色。

description.en: A plugin for managing MCP servers in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在DeepSeek Harness内管理MCP服务的插件。

description.en: Interactive Chinese glyph ink-wash backgrounds for DSH conversations, with six scenes: Lotus pond, Misty hills, Qingming handscroll, 24 solar terms, Northern sea and Big fat whale.
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话提供可交互的汉字水墨背景，包含莲池、山水、清明上河、二十四节气、北冥和大肥鲸六个场景。

description.en: TOTP-only access control for personal DeepSeek Harness Web instances, with in-app QR enrollment, single-use recovery codes, live protection controls and lock-all revocation of page access.
description.zh: 面向个人 DeepSeek Harness Web 实例的纯 TOTP 访问验证，支持设置内扫码绑定、一次性恢复码、动态启停保护和撤销所有页面授权。

description.en: Names a session from its first prompt, and streams AI title suggestions into the rename dialog.
description.zh: 用首条消息为会话命名，并在重命名弹窗里流式给出 AI 标题建议。

description.en: Sets the DSH web client conversation column to a percentage of its own width (40-100, default 100 = full width) instead of the built-in 680-920px reading measure, edited from a collapsible card under Settings > Plugins.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 客户端对话列宽度设为其自身宽度的百分比（40–100，默认 100 即铺满整列），取代内置的 680–920px 阅读宽度，并在「设置 > 插件」中提供可折叠的调整卡片。

description.en: Ambient fullscreen status grid for DeepSeek Harness sessions with token/rate graphs, plus ntfy push and alarm notifications when a turn ends, errors, or waits for approval.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 全屏状态看板：会话状态网格与 token/速率图表一览无余，回合结束、出错或等待审批时通过 ntfy 推送与铃声提醒。

description.en: Read Google Antigravity SQLite conversations in DeepSeek Harness and import them as native sidebar sessions with list, read and import tools plus slash commands.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里读取 Google Antigravity 的 SQLite 会话并导入为原生侧栏会话，提供 list／read／import 工具与斜杠命令。

description.en: Scores each assistant answer on five dimensions plus topic coverage, shows evidence, and turns the weakest dimension into copy-ready prompt advice. Observational only; local by default, with optional Jev review.
description.zh: 为每条回答给出五维质量分与话题覆盖度，附证据，并把最弱的一项转成可直接复制的提示词改写。只观测不改写；默认本地评分，可选 Jev 精评。

description.en: Session-header button that previews and downloads the exact request frame DeepSeek Harness sends to the model: the full system prompt, the declared tools array, and the wire message array (system/user/assistant/tool-result) rebuilt from the session log via the same folds the agent loop reads.
description.zh: 会话头部按钮：预览并下载 DeepSeek Harness 真正发给模型的请求帧——完整 system prompt、声明的工具数组 tools 与 wire 消息数组（system/user/assistant/tool-result），按 agent loop 读取所用的同一会话折叠重建。

description.en: Read-only preview of SQLite files and MySQL / MariaDB / PostgreSQL / SQL Server connections in the right sidebar, with tables, paged rows, columns, indexes and draggable column widths, never writing to the database.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏只读预览 SQLite 文件与 MySQL / MariaDB / PostgreSQL / SQL Server 连接：表、分页数据、列、索引，列宽可拖动，从不写库。

description.en: Makes Enter insert a newline in the DSH 0.1.5 Web composer while Cmd/Ctrl+Enter keeps submitting messages.
description.zh: 让 DSH 0.1.5 Web 输入框使用 Enter 换行，同时保留 Cmd/Ctrl+Enter 提交消息。

description.en: Task-queue execution endpoint for DSH: requires a separately self-deployed Hermes Agent gateway plus your own WeChat inbound script; verified on a single environment — expect to adapt it.
description.zh: DSH 的任务队列执行端点：需要自行部署独立的 Hermes Agent 网关并编写自己的微信入站脚本；仅在单一环境验证过，需要按你的环境适配。

description.en: Whale-girl desktop pet for the DSH Web UI, drawn with hand-written SVG + CSS (no image or audio assets, zero runtime dependencies): swims while a turn runs, blows labeled bubbles on tool calls, taps the glass with an amber pulse when an approval is waiting, jumps with a turn duration/tool-count report on success and droops on failure, naps after dark or when idle. Click to poke, double-click to pet (affinity hearts), drag with remembered position, right-click menu (feed / mute / reset / hide), hover card with level, title, XP bar and per-turn stats. A `whale_say` tool lets the agent make her speak or act as a lightweight visible notification. Read-only over sessions and workspace; only ~/.dsh/whale-girl/state.json is written.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的鲸鱼女孩桌宠，手写 SVG + CSS 动画（无图片/音频素材，零运行时依赖）：任务运行中游泳，调工具时吐带标签的泡泡，等待审批时贴屏幕敲玻璃并伴随琥珀色脉冲，完成时跳一下并汇报本轮耗时与工具数，失败时下沉，闲置或深夜戴睡帽打盹。单击戳一戳，双击摸头涨好感，拖拽后记住位置，右键菜单可喂食/静音/回默认位置/隐藏，悬停显示等级、称号、经验条与本轮统计。`whale_say` 工具让 Agent 借她说话或做动作，作为轻量可见通知。只读会话与工作区，仅写入 ~/.dsh/whale-girl/state.json。

description.en: Local plugin installer in the DSH web Settings: a file picker for .tgz plugin packages (multi-select) or a full machine path, installing them into the auto-detected profile via the official `dsh plugin add` with live CLI output — no terminal needed.
description.zh: 本地插件安装器：DSH 网页设置页里的本地插件安装入口——文件选择器多选 .tgz 或输入本机完整路径，自动检测所在 profile 并执行官方 `dsh plugin add`，实时回显安装日志，无需终端。

description.en: PostgreSQL-backed durable memory for DSH agents: MCP memory tools plus a Web panel for reviewing memories and candidates.
description.zh: PostgreSQL 持久个人记忆：MCP 记忆工具 + 可查看记忆与候选的 Web 面板。

description.en: Reasoning-effort slider for the DeepSeek Harness composer: drag through the thinking levels the current model declares and release to write the chosen level into the session. An auto band escalates one level after a tool error and another after two or more, and optional model routing picks a provider/model per task type.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 输入框里的推理强度滑杆：按当前模型声明的思考档位拖动，松手把档位写入本会话；可选「自动区间」在工具报错后逐档上调，另有可选模型路由按任务类型挑 provider/model。

description.en: Draggable weather bar in the shell overlay with forecast and geocoding from Open-Meteo; the position persists across sessions.
description.zh: shell 浮层中的可拖动天气条，预报与地理编码来自 Open-Meteo；位置跨会话持久保存。

description.en: Main-brain orchestration preset: delegation-first persona, root-session execution gate, and portable AI-LAW rule skill.
description.zh: 主脑编排 preset：委派优先的 persona、根会话执行门禁，以及可移植的 AI-LAW 规则技能。

description.en: Adds the KnyazevAI API provider and its DeepSeek, GLM, and MiniMax model catalog to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 KnyazevAI API 提供方及 DeepSeek、GLM 和 MiniMax 模型目录。

description.en: A green pixel-Ork mascot for DSH Web that masks model thinking and output as Waaaaaaagh! until clicked to reveal, plus a random-length input mask.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 加一个会眨眼的像素绿皮兽人：把模型思考与输出掩码成 Waaaaaaagh!（点击显示原文），并支持随机长度的输入掩码。

description.en: Per-package automatic updates for the DeepSeek Harness plugins you choose. On a schedule it asks npm for the latest version of installed plugins, updates only the packages you check, and skips local link or file installs, pinned versions and packages with errors; upgrades stay inside the major version and skip prereleases by default. Updates go through the profile's own plugin manager, so the profile write lock, pnpm step, bundle-patch validation and hot reload are the host's, and a failed install puts the previous version back. Each cycle is appended to a JSON log.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 插件做按包白名单的自动更新：按计划去 npm 查已装插件的最新版本，只更新你勾选的包，本地 link／file 安装、锁定版本和出错的包一律跳过；默认不跨大版本、不装预发布。更新走 profile 里运行中的官方插件管理器，profile 写锁、pnpm 执行、bundle 补丁校验与热重载都由宿主负责，安装失败会把旧版本装回去。每轮结果追加到一份 JSON 日志。

description.en: Collapses consecutive tool-use and thinking steps between messages into a single bracketed, expandable item.
description.zh: 把消息之间连续的工具调用与思考步骤折叠成单个可展开的括号条目。

description.en: Session management for DSH: archive, restore and delete persisted sessions, cap how many sessions each workspace keeps, and review disk usage in a size governance panel.
description.zh: DSH 会话管理：归档、恢复、删除持久化会话，按工作区限制会话数量上限，并提供体积治理面板。

description.en: Multi-folder workspace: a durable global linked-folders list plus per-session on-the-fly linking (link_folder/unlink_folder), managed from the Web sidebar with a native folder picker.
description.zh: 多文件夹工作区：全局链接文件夹列表 + 会话内临时挂载（link_folder/unlink_folder），侧边栏管理并支持系统选目录。

description.en: Reorder the messages queued while a DSH agent is busy, from inside the official queue dock: a drag handle and per-row ↑ / ↓ buttons on the dock's own rows, applied on the host as one concurrency-checked inbox splice. The dock is decorated rather than replaced, so previews, inline editing, steering, removal and attachments stay as shipped. A move is refused when the queue has changed since the caller last saw it, when the row is not a user prompt (a goal round prompt, for example), or when the queue belongs to a subagent session.
description.zh: 在官方队列 dock 内直接重排忙碌时排队的消息：每一行带拖拽手柄与上下移动按钮，移动在宿主端以一次带并发校验的 inbox splice 完成。只装饰官方 dock 而不替换它，因此预览、行内编辑、插话、删除与附件保持原样。队列已变化、该行不是用户消息（例如目标轮次提示）、或队列属于子代理会话时，移动会被拒绝。

description.en: Ships a skill plus six Node scripts for a DSH install that will not come up - walking the boot stages before readiness, the plugin dependency bridges and junctions under a profile, dead or duplicated plugin rows, and the upgrade path. The scripts are diagnostics first; the rebuild helper only writes when it is given --fix.
description.zh: 携带一份技能加 6 个 Node 脚本，用来处理装完起不来的 DSH——沿 readiness 之前的引导阶段、profile 下的插件依赖桥与 junction、失效或重复的插件行、以及升级路径逐段排查。脚本默认只诊断，重建脚本只有显式加 --fix 才写盘。

description.en: Version-control workbench for the DSH Web sidebar: local changes grouped by type, per-file and multi-file staging, preview-confirmed commit / update / push, and a failure dialog that shows the raw Git output instead of a four-second toast.
description.zh: DSH Web 侧栏的版本控制工作台：改动按类型分组，支持单文件与多文件暂存，提交/拉取/推送均先预览再确认，失败时弹窗展示 Git 原始输出。

description.en: Adds a full-screen dialog for writing long messages: Markdown on the left rendered live by marked on the right, with a draggable splitter that remembers its ratio. Confirming writes the text back to the composer draft, keeping command tokens and @-reference chips as a fixed prefix; Esc asks whether to discard or write back before closing.
description.zh: 为输入框加一个写长内容的全屏弹窗：左侧写 Markdown、右侧 marked 实时渲染，中间分栏可拖动并记住比例。确认后写回输入框草稿，指令 token 与 @ 引用 chip 作为固定前缀保留；Esc 关闭前询问「不写回」还是「写回」。

description.en: Agent persona management, agent memory, edit-and-regenerate for past messages: create and manage agents, each with its own identity, long-term memory, global memory and chat history.
description.zh: Agent人格管理，Agent记忆，历史消息编辑并重新生成：创建和管理 Agent，每个 Agent 有独立身份、长期记忆、全局记忆与聊天记录，历史消息可编辑后重新生成。

description.en: Discord bridge loaded into the same Host as the desktop app or dsh web, with no separate process or profile — chat with sessions in any workspace from DMs or threads, attach to sessions open on the desktop, and answer tool approvals and model questions from whichever side responds first.
description.zh: 与桌面端或 dsh web 运行在同一个 Host 里的 Discord 桥接，无需单独进程或 profile：在私信或线程里与任意工作区的会话对话，接入桌面端正在用的会话，工具审批和模型提问在 Discord 与桌面端谁先答谁生效。

description.en: LAN phone drop: a QR code on the computer screen opens a page on the phone, and photos or scanned documents land in a computer folder over the local network, with no tunnel and no cloud in between. Document mode binarizes locally in the browser (adaptive threshold plus speckle removal and edge crop) so an ordinary phone photo comes out as a black-and-white scan. Adds a "phone drop" entry at the foot of the DSH sidebar that opens the QR page, plus a phone_drop tool for the assistant; the same CLI also runs standalone without DSH.
description.zh: 局域网手机直传：电脑屏幕上出一个二维码，手机扫开就能拍照或扫描，文件直接落进电脑文件夹，全程局域网直连，不经过隧道也不经过云端。文档模式在手机浏览器里本地做自适应二值化、去噪、裁边，把普通照片变成黑白扫描件。插件会在 DSH 侧边栏底部加一个「手机直传」入口，点开就是二维码页；另有 phone_drop 工具供助手调用，同一个 CLI 也能脱离 DSH 独立运行。

description.en: PPT stage — presentation generation (Beamer/Quarto) from the paper for asset pricing and machine learning research. Ships one skill.
description.zh: 报告阶段（PPT）——资产定价与机器学习研究的论文演讲幻灯片生成（Beamer/Quarto）。附带一个 skill。

description.en: Android Studio-style ADB logcat viewer with live filtering and level colors.
description.zh: Android Studio 风格 ADB logcat 查看器，支持实时过滤与等级配色。

description.en: Plugin value auditor: pre-install review (source scan + LLM judge) and post-install audit of installed bundles, with model-switch re-audit reminders.
description.zh: 插件价值裁判：装前审核（源码静态扫描 + LLM 裁判）与装后审计已装插件，模型切换时弹窗提醒复核；判断插件对当前模型是增强还是压制。

description.en: Windows toast notifications for DeepSeek Harness: approve or reject from the notification while DSH is in the background, with an in-app fallback; foreground only skips the current conversation, while other conversations still notify. Also reports turn completion and errors; subagent sessions stay silent.
description.zh: DSH 的 Windows 授权通知：后台时可直接在通知上点「允许一次 / 拒绝」，前台时当前对话走应用内审批框、其他对话照常提醒；另含完成 / 出错通知，子代理会话保持静默。

description.en: Right-side message navigation rail for DeepSeek Harness: per-message tick marks, hover-to-expand preview drawer, smooth jump to any historical message, star bookmarks, realtime slide animation with interrupt support, full session index with virtualization, dynamic panel avoidance, official --dsw-* token styling.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 右侧消息导航轨道：逐条消息刻度、悬浮预览抽屉、平滑跳转、星标回看、实时平移动画（可打断）、完整会话索引与虚拟化、面板动态避让、官方 --dsw-* token 样式。

description.en: Composer prompt refinement: rewrite the draft through the harness LLM, preview the result, then apply or send it, with style presets, model-aware reasoning effort, cost estimate and a settings page.
description.zh: 输入框一键提示词增强：通过宿主模型改写草稿，预览后再替换或发送；支持风格预设、按模型自适应思考档位、费用估算与设置页。

description.en: Realtime Avatar (realtimeavatar.ai) for agents: the developer API key held by the harness credentials store, the public docs as five on-demand skills, rta_* tools over the public REST API (balance, avatars, clips, sessions, usage) with approval-gated credit spending, and a /rta command that walks a developer from no key to a live avatar call.
description.zh: Realtime Avatar（realtimeavatar.ai）实时数字人工具：开发者 API key 由 harness 凭据存储保管，公开文档打包为五个按需加载的技能，rta_* 工具封装公开 REST API（余额、数字人、动作片段、会话、用量），消耗额度的操作需审批，/rta 命令引导开发者从零到一次真实的数字人通话。

description.en: Plays a chime when the AI asks a clarifying question (a `?` / `？` in the message, or an `ask_user_question` tool call). Synthesized via Web Audio API, no audio file, works on every OS.
description.zh: 当 AI 询问澄清性问题时（带问号或调用 ask_user_question）播放提示音。Web Audio API 合成，零音频文件，跨 Windows/macOS/Linux。

description.en: Parent-agent dispatch with review: split a task into work orders, hand each to a contractor you picked (its own provider, model, and reasoning effort), then pass or fail every delivery — failed ones are re-dispatched with your feedback.
description.zh: 父智能体派单、子智能体干活的包工头：把任务拆成工单，每张派给你自选的承包商（各自指定 provider、模型、思考等级），交付后逐单验收，打回的单带着你的反馈重新派下去。

description.en: ZenTao work panel in the DSH left sidebar: lists tasks, bugs and stories assigned to you (web-login protocol, so instances where the RESTful v2 API is unavailable are supported — verified on ZenTao 18.13 open-source) with search, smart sort, overdue / due-today filters and a flow-board view; opens a new chat pre-filled with the card's description, recent comments and screenshots (or a blank one), or dispatches it to a new background session with workspace, model, reasoning-effort and optional-instruction selection (single or multi-select batch), turns screenshots inside ticket descriptions into real image attachments, reads back the linked session's latest reply once a card is done, and tracks each card with live running / needs-decision / done status plus manual overrides and a manually-marked finished state. Multi-account; read-only, no writes back to ZenTao.
description.zh: DSH 左侧栏禅道工作面板：列出指派给你的任务、Bug 与需求（走网页登录协议，RESTful v2 API 不可用的实例也能用，已在禅道 18.13 开源版实测），支持搜索、智能排序、逾期/今天到期筛选与流程看板；可新建对话并自动带入任务背景（描述、最近动态与截图，也可只建空白会话），或下发到新后台会话（可选工作区、模型、思考强度与附加指令，支持多选批量），工单里的截图会转成真实图片附件，已完成的卡片可回读关联会话的最新回复，卡片实时显示 处理中/等你决策/已完成 状态并支持手动修正与「已结束」终态。支持多账号；只读，不回写禅道。

description.en: Browse, sign in to, and safely install public or private team Skills from a configured Skill Base in DSH Web.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 中浏览、登录并安全安装来自团队 Skill Base 的公开或私有 Skill。

description.en: Local file manager served by the DSH web server itself: whole-disk browsing, previews for images, PDF, video and audio, text, Markdown, JSON, CSV, sandboxed HTML, docx and xlsx, Range downloads, folder ZIP, drag-and-drop upload, copy/paste, conflict-checked text editing, create/rename/delete-to-trash, and xlsx cell editing saved as a copy.
description.zh: 由 DSH web server 直接提供的本地文件管理页：整盘浏览，图片/PDF/音视频/文本/Markdown/JSON/CSV/沙箱 HTML/docx/xlsx 预览，Range 下载与目录 ZIP，拖拽上传、复制粘贴、带冲突检测的文本编辑、新建/重命名/删除（进回收目录），以及 xlsx 单元格编辑另存为副本。

description.en: Push a Gotify notification when each conversation turn ends, with configurable templates, priority and per-cause titles.
description.zh: 每轮会话结束时向 Gotify 服务器推送通知，支持模板、优先级与按结束原因区分标题。

description.en: Manages Git worktrees in DeepSeek Harness with branch deletion controls and scoped workspace management.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 管理 Git Worktree，提供分支删除控制和指定工作区管理。

description.en: Adds a row at the top of the sidebar that switches the whole Web GUI to another DSH host reached over a loopback port, and shows that host's session state on the row (running, unread activity, or waiting for your answer).
description.zh: 在侧边栏顶部加一行，点击后整页切换成另一台 DSH 主机的 Web GUI（通过回环端口访问），并在该行显示那台主机的会话状态（运行中、有新活动、正等你回答）。

description.en: Serves the obra/superpowers skill catalog to the harness and injects its using-superpowers bootstrap as a persistent, compaction-safe system-prompt section.
description.zh: 向 dsh 提供 obra/superpowers 技能目录，并将其 using-superpowers 引导作为持久、压缩安全的系统提示区块注入。

description.en: Opens academic sites through institutional proxy rules and optionally renames eligible new PDFs using matched article metadata, with Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and US English settings.
description.zh: 按机构代理规则打开学术网站，可依据匹配的论文元数据重命名符合条件的新 PDF，并提供简体中文、繁体中文及美式英语设置界面。

description.en: A pelican riding a bicycle along a seashore in the bottom-right corner: an SVG animation that reflects the agent working state (thinking/done), with a chime and an optional system notification when a reply finishes.
description.zh: 右下角鹈鹕环海骑行 SVG 动画，随代理状态在思考/完成间切换，回复完成时播放提示音并可选发送系统通知。

description.en: Restores Cmd+, to open the existing Settings dialog in DeepSeek Harness on macOS.
description.zh: 为 macOS 上的 DeepSeek Harness 恢复 Cmd+, 设置快捷键。

description.en: Vision for text-only dsh models: paste an image and a configured multimodal model transcribes it to text automatically — transparent twin routing, an agent-callable read-image tool, no built-in keys or relay.
description.zh: 纯文本 dsh 模型的识图插件：粘贴图片自动由你配置的多模态模型转成文字——透明孪生路由、模型可自主调用识图工具、无内置密钥与中转。

description.en: Two-step inline archive on workspace sidebar rows — one click arms a red confirm, the second click archives; the archive entry is removed from the ⋮ menu.
description.zh: 工作区侧边栏行内两击归档：点一次变红确认，再点即归档，归档项不再出现在 ⋮ 菜单里。

description.en: Maximizes the DeepSeek Harness desktop window automatically on startup, equivalent to clicking the maximize button once. Cross-platform (Windows/macOS/Linux), best-effort, host-only.
description.zh: DSH 桌面版启动时自动最大化主窗口，等价于手动点一次最大化按钮。跨平台（Windows/macOS/Linux），尽力而为，host-only 插件。

description.en: Compiles a Windows .bat/.cmd launcher into a real .exe from inside DSH: renders an icon from a built-in bitmap font, emits a C# wrapper that runs the batch file next to it, compiles with csc.exe (or dotnet build), and can write Start Menu / Desktop shortcuts.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内把 Windows .bat/.cmd 启动器编译成真正的 .exe：用内置位图字体生成图标，生成调用同目录批处理的 C# 薄壳，经 csc.exe（或 dotnet build）编译，并可选写入开始菜单/桌面快捷方式。

description.en: Mounts the pen.dev desktop app MCP server in a DSH session so the model can read and edit the .pen document open in Pen through the get_app_state, read_skill, execute, get_style and browser tools; finds the server binary by probing the usual install paths, and adds a pen-dev skill plus a listener that turns pen.dev plan-limit failures into a short bilingual notice. Unofficial, and ships no pen.dev binaries.
description.zh: 把 pen.dev 桌面应用的 MCP 服务器挂进 DSH 会话，模型即可通过 get_app_state、read_skill、execute、get_style、browser 读取并修改 Pen 中打开的 .pen 文档；服务器二进制按常见安装路径探测定位，另附一个 pen-dev 技能，以及一个把 pen.dev 额度用尽错误改写成简短中英提示的监听器。非官方项目，不含 pen.dev 任何二进制。

description.en: Brain-shaped relationship graph viewer for DeepSeek Harness with a Markdown knowledge-base pipeline that imports documents and builds the graph. The viewer ships demo data and needs no Python; rebuilding the graph from your own notes needs Node.js 20+ and Python 3.8+ and runs from the command line.
description.zh: 把 Markdown 笔记编译成脑形关系图谱的 DSH 侧栏查看器，附带文档导入与图谱构建管线。查看器自带演示数据、无需 Python；用自己的笔记重建图谱需要 Node.js 20+ 与 Python 3.8+，在命令行里运行。

description.en: Read-only CNKI bibliographic search for DSH: four MCP tools (search, detail, export, status) drive your own Edge/Chrome through a native-messaging bridge, with no PDF downloads, a 3-second minimum interval and a 300-action daily cap. Requires pip install wensu plus wensu setup and loading the browser extension before the four tools appear.
description.zh: 只读的知网题录检索：四个 MCP 工具（search / detail / export / status）通过原生消息桥驱动你自己的 Edge/Chrome，不下载全文，最小间隔 3 秒，每日上限 300 次。需要先 pip install wensu，运行 wensu setup 并在浏览器加载扩展，四个工具才会出现。

description.en: Display-layer text replacement for DSH chat messages: rewrite how any configured text appears on screen without touching the real conversation, with per-rule whole-word matching and code-block protection.
description.zh: 显示层文本替换：自定义消息中任意文本的界面显示而不改动真实对话，支持逐条整词匹配、长词优先与代码块保护。

description.en: Runs git in the Host process so push, pull and fetch work inside the agent sandbox; exposes 8 agent tools (status, diff, log, stage, commit, push, fetch, pull) and 11 slash commands including /git-status, /git-commit, /git-tag and /git-name-set.
description.zh: 在宿主进程中执行 git，使 push、pull、fetch 在 agent 沙箱内可用；提供 8 个 agent 工具（status、diff、log、stage、commit、push、fetch、pull）与 11 个斜杠命令，包括 /git-status、/git-commit、/git-tag 与 /git-name-set。

description.en: Layered syntax highlighting for bash/pwsh command and read code output in the DSH web GUI (VS Code Dark+ palette: keywords/strings/numbers/functions/comments each get a color); colors only what it recognizes, keeps tables/logs plain; pure frontend, zero token overhead.
description.zh: DSH web 插件：给 bash/pwsh 命令与 read 的代码输出做分层语法染色（VS Code Dark+ 配色：关键字/字符串/数字/函数名/注释各一色）；认得出来才染，表格/日志保持原样；纯前端渲染，零 token 开销。

description.en: Auto-hide a sidebar workspace the moment its last unarchived session is archived, and add a "隐藏工作区" entry to each workspace row's own "..." menu. The restore entry sits at the bottom of the sidebar. It only toggles display and never archives, deletes or rewrites a workspace.
description.zh: 某个工作区的未归档会话从 1+ 掉到 0 的那一刻自动隐藏它的侧栏行，并在工作区行自带的「…」菜单里追加「隐藏工作区」，另配侧栏底部恢复入口。只切 display，不归档、不删除、不改写任何工作区。

description.en: Local knowledge base and document search for DeepSeek Harness with full-text search, PDF/Word/PowerPoint/Excel/Markdown import, OCR, ACL, and a Web panel.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地知识库与文档检索插件：全文搜索、PDF/Word/PPT/Excel/Markdown 导入与按行读取、扫描件 OCR、ACL 和 Web 面板。

description.en: Summarizes the current DeepSeek Harness session with /recap or after inactivity, with configurable models, Chinese and English output, and expandable summaries in the conversation.
description.zh: 通过 /recap 或闲置触发回顾当前 DeepSeek Harness 会话，支持配置模型、中英文输出，并在对话内展示可展开的摘要。

description.en: Native generation-time Mixture-of-Agents: every turn, reference models run the same session context in parallel as pre-run drafts and one aggregator executes with full tooling; config-as-model recipes, F mirror / R trimmed views, subagent gating, derived per-recipe vision (vision refs relay image reads to text-only aggregators).
description.zh: 原生生成时 MoA：每轮参考模型并行预演同一会话上下文产出草稿，单一聚合模型带完整工具循环执行；配置即模型配方、F 镜像 / R 裁剪双视野、子会话门控、按成分派生的配方级视觉（视觉参考路可为纯文本聚合转述图像）。

description.en: Judges the working model's own emotion each turn and silently re-injects it before the next turn, closing a self-observation → state carry-over → behavior shift loop. Ships a host plugin plus a composer-dock panel, a read-only emotion_status tool and an optional read-only HTTP route.
description.zh: 每回合判定工作模型自身的情绪，并在下一回合开始前静默回注给它，形成「自省 → 状态留存 → 行为调整」 的闭环。包含宿主插件、输入框上方的情绪面板、只读的 emotion_status 工具与可选的只读 HTTP 路由。

description.en: Folds each 4-50 KB paste in the DSH composer into its own chip (expand or delete it individually), and turns a paste of 50 KB or more into a real file attachment. Declares DSH >=0.1.7-rc.2 <0.3.0-0, so it stays visible on the 0.2 release line.
description.zh: 把 DSH 输入框里每次 4–50 KB 的粘贴折叠成独立的一枚 chip（可单独展开或删除），50 KB 及以上的粘贴转成真附件。声明 DSH >=0.1.7-rc.2 <0.3.0-0，因此在 0.2 版本线上保持可见。

description.en: Report stage — academic paper writing for asset pricing and machine learning research. Ships one skill.
description.zh: 报告阶段（文稿）——资产定价与机器学习研究的学术论文写作。附带一个 skill。

description.en: On every DeepSeek Harness launch, checks the installed and enabled plugins for newer npm versions, lists them in the UI and updates them after confirmation.
description.zh: 每次启动 DeepSeek Harness 时检查已安装并启用的插件有没有新版本，在界面上列出并询问，确认后更新到最新版。

description.en: GitHub issue service for DSH: turns a telemetry failure analysis into a uniform issue report, builds a pre-filled new-issue URL that is shortened when it would exceed a configured length budget, and rewrites a plain description into a structured issue with the deployment's model.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 GitHub issue 服务：把遥测失败分析整理成统一格式的 issue 报告，构造预填的新建 issue 链接并在超出配置长度时裁剪正文，再用部署配置的模型把一段自然语言描述改写为结构化 issue。

description.en: Zero-friction quick ask for DSH: select text in chat, Markdown/code, rendered HTML reports, or the better-sidebar editor.
