The default answer starts automatically (English prose is translated, a term is explained, a question is answered); typing cancels it. Answers stream from a one-shot completion on the main window's model, inherit a read-only conversation snapshot, read the selected file as context (up to 20,000 characters by default), and never write to the main session. One-line install; host routes, client slots, document renderers and the iframe selection bridge are separable extension points.
description.zh: DSH 的零摩擦快问：对话、Markdown/代码、渲染后的 HTML 报告、better-sidebar 编辑器里都能划词。默认回答会自动开始（英文正文先翻译、术语解释概念、问句直接回答），输入即取消。答案由一次性 completion 流式产出，沿用主窗口模型，继承只读对话快照，把所选文件作为上下文读取（默认上限 2 万字符），且不写入主会话。一行命令安装；宿主路由、客户端插槽、文档 renderer、iframe 选区桥都是可分离的扩展点。

description.en: Model training stage — end-to-end analysis, model training, and estimation for asset pricing and machine learning research. Ships one skill.
description.zh: 模型训练与结论阶段——资产定价与机器学习研究的端到端分析、模型训练与估计。附带一个 skill。

description.en: Email reminders from your DSH agent when you're away: fires at goal completion, blockage, before asking the user a decision, and at long-task milestones via a bundled zero-dependency Node SMTP sender.
description.zh: 你不在电脑前时由 agent 邮件提醒你：goal 完成、阻塞、向你提问决策前、长任务节点时触发，自带零依赖 Node SMTP 发送器。

description.en: Role-based plugin recommender for DSH: asks the user's role (developer, designer, writer, researcher, ops, student...), recommends suitable plugins, and audits each with a local static security scan (dangerous code patterns + 0-100 risk score) and a reputation check (npm downloads / GitHub stars).
description.zh: 按职业/角色推荐 DSH 插件：询问用户是做什么的（程序员、设计师、写作、研究、运维、学生…），推荐适合的插件，并对每个插件做本地静态安全审计（危险代码模式 + 0-100 风险分）与口碑检查（npm 下载量 / GitHub 星数）。

description.en: Suggests the next user reply in an empty composer after the assistant finishes, using the session model and rolling context summaries, with Tab to accept.
description.zh: 助手完成后，沿用会话模型与滚动上下文摘要，在空输入框中建议下一条用户回复，按 Tab 接受。

description.en: eDEX-UI-style shell over the DSH web GUI themed as an XRY/B1 medical HUD: ECG heartbeat waveform and a rotating radar scan disc on the right bar, power-gen energy-cell meters on the left bar, a DATA TIMELINE scan-log table on the bottom, all in a cyan-on-near-black CRT skin around the original UI.
description.zh: 以 XRY/B1 医疗 HUD 为主题色的 eDEX-UI 风格 DSH 外壳：右侧 ECG 心电波形与旋转雷达扫描盘、左侧能量条仪表、底部 DATA TIMELINE 扫描日志表，青蓝近黑 CRT 皮肤包裹原始界面。

description.en: A DSH conversation workspace: turn actions, provenance quotes, local notes and summaries, in-conversation find, focus lock, and per-workspace command buttons.
description.zh: DSH 会话工作台：轮次操作、引用出处、本地笔记与摘要、会话内查找、专注锁和多工作区命令按钮。

description.en: Plugin recommender for DSH: search and rank plugins from an embedded 1100+ entry marketplace catalog by need description, category and tags, with match reasons and a live catalog refresh from the awesome-dsh-plugin README.
description.zh: DSH 插件推荐器：按需求描述、分类与标签在 1100+ 条内嵌市场目录中搜索并排序插件，返回匹配理由，支持从 awesome-dsh-plugin README 在线刷新目录。

description.en: Pre-publish credential audit: walks a directory tree and flags API keys, tokens, private keys, database connection strings and hard-coded passwords before you commit, publish or ship. Zero dependencies, fully offline, findings are redacted to the first six characters.
description.zh: 发布前凭据审计：在你提交、发布或打包外发之前，遍历目录找出里面的 API key、令牌、私钥、数据库连接串和硬编码密码。零依赖、纯本地、不联网，发现结果脱敏到前 6 个字符。

description.en: Rice on a Stick: Expose control over DeepSeek Harness (dsh) through MCP (Streamable HTTP) and dsh's native tools, with a configurable list of allowed models. Long-tail host endpoints can be invoked via a generic, audited bridge. By default, it listens only on 127.0.0.1, with an optional access token.
description.zh: 白饭钓竿：把控制 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的能力通过 MCP（Streamable HTTP）与 dsh 原生工具暴露出去， 可配置允许使用的模型清单。可通过带审计的通用桥调用宿主长尾端点。默认只监听 127.0.0.1，可选访问令牌。

description.en: Zero-config per-turn git checkpoints: after every completed agent turn in a git workspace, stages all changes into one tagged \[turnsnap] commit (serialized queue, sandbox-policy aware), so any turn is a rollback point.
description.zh: 零配置的逐轮 git 检查点：在 git 工作区的每个 agent 轮结束后，把全部变更暂存为一条带 \[turnsnap] 标记的提交（串行队列、感知沙箱策略），每一轮都是回滚点。

description.en: The missing backend for the dsh-artifacts sidebar tab — serves the /report artifact index and the artifact bytes it renders.
description.zh: 为 dsh-artifacts 侧边栏补上缺失的后端，提供 /report 产物索引与预览所需的文件内容。

description.en: Version badge above the sidebar settings button: shows the current dsh version, expands to list every core package version, and checks npm for updates with one-click deploy.
description.zh: 侧边栏设置按钮上方的版本徽标：常驻显示当前 dsh 版本，展开可查看全部核心包版本，并支持检查 npm 更新与一键部署。

description.en: Bot-to-bot messaging across machines on top of ds-harness-remote: five tools let a local Bot list the peer Host Bots, pin a target device and send it a message, without switching the local window.
description.zh: 基于 ds-harness-remote 的跨机器 Bot 传话：五个工具让本地 Bot 列出对端 Bot、固定目标设备并给它发消息，不用切换本地窗口。

description.en: Choose which shell backs the Windows terminal tool: PowerShell, the local Git Bash, or cmd.exe.
description.zh: 选择 Windows 终端工具背后的 shell：PowerShell、本地 Git Bash 或 cmd.exe。

description.en: SillyTavern-style prompt rules for DSH: layered system-prompt anchors, constant/keyword entries, reproducible probability gates and regex rewriting.
description.zh: 类世界书的 DSH 提示词规则：分层系统提示锚点、蓝绿灯条目、可复现概率门与正则替换。

description.en: In-place redaction and row-level rollback for session logs, preserving the seq-equals-row-index invariant that makes deleting a middle row corrupt the entire log. Originals are copied to a quarantine sibling before any write, and the reader's own semantics are replayed as a pre-write gate.
description.zh: 会话日志的原地脱敏与按行回退：守住「每行 seq 必须等于它的行号」这一不变式（删中间行会让整份日志打不开）。任何写入前先把原文复制成隔离备份，并以读取端自身的语义作为写前闸门。

description.en: Whole-interface zoom for the DSH Web UI from 70% to 160%, driven by Ctrl+wheel, DSH's shortcut center or an inline pill, with content-width compensation so zooming out fits more text instead of narrowing the column.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面整体缩放（70%–160%），可用 Ctrl+滚轮、DSH 快捷键中心或输入框旁的胶囊操作，带正文栏宽度补偿，缩小后是一行更多字而不是一条更窄的栏。

description.en: Literature review stage — search, synthesis, and citation-chain tracking for asset pricing and machine learning research. Ships one skill.
description.zh: 文献综述阶段——资产定价与机器学习研究的文献检索、合成与引用链追踪。附带一个 skill。

description.en: Runtime governor for DeepSeek Harness: zero-progress steering, generation-bound verification evidence, evidence-aware completion guarding, and task-profile tool restriction.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 运行时治理器：零进展回合引导、按代际绑定的验证证据、基于证据的完成守卫，以及按任务配置限制工具集。

description.en: Creates local, content-addressed workspace checkpoints with diff previews and two-phase restore confirmation.
description.zh: 创建本地内容寻址工作区存档，提供差异预览和两阶段确认恢复。

description.en: Host-side Feishu board for DeepSeek Harness: pushes a session's ask_user_question to Feishu DM as plain text and sends a quoted reply back to the exact session that asked, archiving unmatched replies instead of guessing. Its lark-cli wrapper also suppresses an identical notification resent within three minutes.
description.zh: 宿主侧飞书公告板：把会话的 ask_user_question 以纯文本推到飞书私聊，引用回复只投回提问的那个会话，匹配不上的回复存档不猜；lark-cli 发送包装会拦下三分钟内重复的同一通知。

description.en: Reports the semantic blast radius of agent code edits: which symbols changed, who calls them, and which of those callers have no covering test.
description.zh: 报告 agent 代码修改的语义波及面：哪些符号变了、谁在调用它们、其中哪些调用方没有测试覆盖。

description.en: DSH plugin (dsh-desktop-launcher) that launches the dsh-desktop Windows Electron shell from the conversation: double-click to run the DSH web in a standalone window, region screenshot with GPU-accelerated selection that auto-pastes into the chat (works with vision bridges), system tray, session manager, auto environment setup, configurable port, single-instance lock.
description.zh: dsh 插件（dsh-desktop-launcher）：在对话中一键启动 dsh-desktop Windows Electron 桌面壳——双击即用、无需终端；支持选区截图提问（GPU 实时框选、自动粘贴到聊天框、配合识图插件 AI 直接看图回答）、系统托盘、会话管理、环境自动引导、可换端口、单实例锁。

description.en: Multi-role parallel argumentation for DeepSeek Harness: runs the real Codex and Claude CLIs in parallel, has the DSH model (Judge) write a third-party verdict back into the conversation, plus Obsidian-style single-agent direct chat and per-role model config.
description.zh: 多角色并行论证：并行调用真实 Codex 与 Claude，由 DSH 主会话模型（Judge）生成第三方汇总并回对话；另含单 Agent 直接对话与各角色模型自由配置。

description.en: Generate AI-narrated DSH session reports (daily/weekly/monthly, any date range) and sync them to flomo (浮墨笔记) with one configurable tag (default #write/dsh) and automatic # stripping, via a web settings panel with daily reminder.
description.zh: 生成 AI 叙事的 DSH 会话报告（日报/周报/月报、任意区间）并同步到 flomo：单一可配置标签（默认

description.en: Agent skills: browse, toggle and edit skills in the management page, and let the agent write new ones itself.
description.zh: Agent技能：在管理页里浏览、开关、编辑技能，也能让 Agent 自己写新技能。

description.en: Preventive content policy for tool results: rewrites matched text, and drops or truncates whole fields by path before a result is normalised, rendered or persisted, so an unreviewed payload never enters it. Ships inert with no built-in category or domain blocklist.
description.zh: 工具结果的预防式内容策略：改写命中文本，并按字段路径整段丢弃或截断，让未经审查的载荷在结果被规范化/渲染/落盘之前就进不去。随包为真空操作，不含任何内置的类别或域名黑名单。

description.en: Windows-only tray monitor for DeepSeek Harness: deploys and manages the standalone DshTaskWatcher tray app - four-state tray icon (gray=disconnected, green=idle, amber=running, red=attention), a per-task panel with live duration/tps/tokens, and completion & outcome notifications. Start/stop switch in Settings > Plugins; the watcher is an independent process that survives DSH restarts.
description.zh: Windows 托盘任务监视器：部署并管理独立监视程序——四态托盘图标（灰=未连接、绿=空闲、橙=运行中、红=有待处理）、逐任务实时面板（时长/速度/token）、完成与结局通知。设置→插件内启停开关；监视器独立进程运行，DSH 重启不影响。

description.en: Developer quick-reference toolbox for DSH: 12 themed categories (195 entries) plus zero-dependency tools — regex tester, JSON formatter, timestamp converter, Base64/URL codec, cron generator and line diff, in a searchable settings panel.
description.zh: 开发者速查工具箱：12 个主题 195 条速查 + 6 个零依赖工具（正则实时测试、JSON 格式化、时间戳转换、Base64/URL 编解码、Cron 生成、行 diff），设置页可搜索查阅。

description.en: Data stage — data discovery and quality assessment for asset pricing and machine learning research. Ships one skill.
description.zh: 数据处理阶段——资产定价与机器学习研究的数据发现与质量评估。附带一个 skill。

description.en: Built-in browser: gives the agent a real headed Chromium it can open, click, type and scroll in, keeping page state across calls.
description.zh: 内置浏览器：给 Agent 一个真实的有头 Chromium，可打开网页并点击、输入、滚动，页面状态在多次调用之间保持。

description.en: A draggable balance and usage card for the web UI. Clicking the character button slides the card out from the left side of the image and clicking it again retracts the card; it shows the official DeepSeek account balance split into granted credit and top-up, and token usage folded from local session logs for today, the last 7 days and the month, priced per call with the official peak/off-peak rates (cache hits, cache misses and output are priced separately).
description.zh: 可拖动的余额与用量浮层卡片：点一下角色图片，卡片从图片左侧滑出，再点一下缩回；显示官方 DeepSeek 余额（赠金 / 充值拆分），并按缓存命中、未命中、输出三段计价，汇总本地会话日志的今日 / 近 7 天 / 本月 token 用量与人民币估算花费（按官方峰谷时段逐次计价）。

description.en: Skill provider that installs the whole @dennisrongo/skills catalog as one npm dependency, so skills install and update without cloning or linking directories.
description.zh: 技能提供者：将整个 @dennisrongo/skills 目录作为一个 npm 依赖安装，无需克隆仓库或链接目录即可完成技能的安装与更新。

description.en: Reorder configured models in the composer model picker, set cache-hit, cache-miss and output prices per million tokens, and estimate per-turn and session costs with built-in DeepSeek peak/off-peak rates.
description.zh: 在输入框右下角的模型选择器中自定义模型顺序，按每百万 tokens 设置缓存命中、缓存未命中与输出三档价格，并结合内置的 DeepSeek 峰谷价估算逐轮和本会话费用。

description.en: Moves and resizes the DeepSeek Harness settings panel; its position and size are remembered per browser.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的设置面板可以自由拖动与缩放，位置与尺寸按浏览器记忆。

description.en: Replaces the headless startup to add --model provider/model, --resume <id|latest>, --continue and --session-info flags to dsh headless runs.
description.zh: 替换无界面启动流程，为 dsh headless 运行添加 --model provider/model、--resume <id|latest>、--continue 与 --session-info 标志。

description.en: Backup, restore and machine-migration for DSH: packs skills (which live outside ~/.dsh, in ~/.agents/skills), plugin manifests, core config, memories, todos and optionally sessions into a tar.gz with a sha256 sidecar, then imports it on another machine as a three-way merge against a baseline, listing per-file differences instead of overwriting changes made there. Credentials never enter an archive (filename deny-list of 27 names plus 7 private-key suffixes plus a content gate, enforced again on the import side), every import writes a pre-restore snapshot first, and an archive can be uploaded to any WebDAV server and pulled back on the new machine. Also includes scheduled backups, a read-only viewer for individual files, and an in-panel cloud card; no npm runtime dependencies (packing uses the system tar).
description.zh: DSH 的备份 / 恢复 / 换机迁移：把技能（技能目录在 ~/.dsh 之外的 ~/.agents/skills）、插件清单、核心配置、记忆、待办、以及可选的会话打成一个带 sha256 边车的 tar.gz，再在另一台机器上以「带基线的三方合并」导入 —— 逐文件列出差异，而不是直接覆盖对方改过的东西。凭据永不进包（27 个文件名 + 7 个私钥后缀的黑名单，外加内容特征闸，导入侧再过一遍），每次导入前先写一份可原样还原的快照；归档可以推到任意 WebDAV 服务（绿联 NAS / 群晖 / 坚果云 / Nextcloud）并在新机器上下载回来。另含定时备份、单文件只读查看、面板内的云端卡片；零 npm 运行时依赖（打包用系统 tar）。

description.en: Back up, restore and two-way sync DSH plugins and configuration through your own Git repository, with conflict handling, snapshots and six agent tools.
description.zh: 用你自己的 Git 仓库备份、恢复并双向同步 DSH 插件与配置，支持冲突处理、快照与 6 个 Agent 工具。

description.en: Ten interoceptive senses for a DSH agent: workspace pulse, time, affect, needs, expression, silence, residue, open loops, body and face — deterministic state that keeps moving on its own.
description.zh: 给 DSH 智能体的十种内感受：房子脉搏、时间、情绪、需求、表达、沉默、余味、未闭合的事、身体与表情——各自持续演进的确定性状态。

description.en: Local themed achievements, badges and character collections for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在本地记录 DeepSeek Harness 主题成就、勋章与角色收藏。

description.en: Adds one 28x28 icon button per dsh-im channel that holds an account to the official Workspaces header row. Pressing one puts the sidebar into that channel's view, drawing only its conversations and hiding every other row; pressing it again drops back to the official list. Buttons appear only for channels with a connected account.
description.zh: 在官方「工作区」标题行上，为每个已接入账号的 dsh-im 通道添加一个 28x28 图标按钮。点击后侧栏切到该通道视图，只显示它的会话、隐藏其余所有行；再次点击回到官方列表。只有已接入账号的通道才会出现按钮。

description.en: Standalone prompt assembly with a source registry, custom text, strategy editing and previews, and per-session strategy snapshots through DSH public hooks.
description.zh: 独立提示词装配插件，提供来源注册、自定义文本、策略编辑与预览，通过 DSH 公开钩子按会话应用策略快照。

description.en: Teaches Herdr about DSH panes: reports agent working/idle/blocked state — including the blocked state DSH itself lacks — enabling panel jump and --wait. (Herdr integration / agent state display / panel jump)
description.zh: 让 Herdr 认识 DSH 面板：把 agent 的 working/idle/blocked 状态报给 Herdr（含 DSH 本身没有的 blocked 等待态），支持面板跳转与 --wait。（状态上报 / 状态显示 / 终端集成 / 面板跳转）

description.en: Checks a canteen food-retention ledger for the four required record elements, the 125 g minimum, the 48-hour cold-storage window and template placeholders left in a cell.
description.zh: 核对食堂留样台账的四个记录要素、125 克下限、48 小时冷藏窗口，以及单元格中残留的模板占位符。

description.en: Twelve curated palettes, eight accent colours, a contrast slider and font/scale overrides for the DSH web UI, with an inlined first-paint script that prevents theme flash.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供 12 套精选配色、8 种强调色、对比度滑块与字体/缩放覆盖，并内联首帧脚本防止主题闪烁。

description.en: Per-target scheduled wake-ups for a DSH workspace: interval, quiet hours, daily cap and a prompt per target; each wake-up waits for the turn it started and records the outcome, and a turn that never finished is not counted as done.
description.zh: 给 DSH 工作区按目标定时唤醒：每个目标可设间隔、安静时段、每日上限和提示词；每次唤醒会等它自己那一轮结束并记下结果，没跑完的那一轮不会算作完成。

description.en: Adds a checkbox-style switch at the right end of the Installed group header on the DSH Plugins page: it opens a checklist of the unofficial plugins, all checked by default, and toggles only the ones you keep checked. Once everything is off the button flips to enabling them again. Disable/enable only — it never uninstalls a plugin or deletes plugin files and configuration, and its UI copy follows the app language.
description.zh: 在 DSH 插件页的「已安装」分组标题右端加一个勾选式开关：点开是当前方向下非官方插件的清单，默认全选，只切换你保留勾选的那些；全部停用后按钮翻转成启用侧。只做启用/停用，从不卸载插件、也不删除插件文件与配置，界面文案跟随应用语言。

description.en: Solo murder-mystery (jubensha) in a session tab: the AI hosts the game and plays every other seat, each knowing only its own role book, while the player's seat stays yours — with a stage bar, a per-seat timeline, a clue page and a reveal that unseals the truth only at the end.
description.zh: 一个人的剧本杀：AI 当主持人，AI 填满其余的椅子（各自只知道自己的角色本），留一个位子给你 —— 带阶段条、按座位归集的时间线与搜证页，而真相到复盘才解封。

description.en: Checks a project document archive for missing required document types, stale revisions and empty files, using folder and file names rather than document contents.
description.zh: 按项目资料归档要求检查缺失的必需资料类型、过期版本与空文件；只读文件夹与文件名，不读文档内容。

description.en: Sidebar workspace panel that switches between running tasks and all conversations, shown as one freely sortable card list with per-card pin, rename, copy ID, fork, stop, and archive actions.
description.zh: 侧栏工作区面板，在运行中任务与全部对话之间切换，统一为一张可自由排序的卡片列表，每张卡片可置顶、重命名、复制 ID、分叉、停止与归档。

description.en: Read-only XLSX, XLS, ODS, CSV and TSV viewer for dock-files with worksheet tabs, sorting, filters, search and cell links.
description.zh: dock-files 的只读表格查看器，支持 XLSX、XLS、ODS、CSV、TSV 格式以及工作表切换、排序、筛选、搜索和单元格链接。

description.en: Expose the DSH Web GUI over IPv6 or IPv4 from WSL2 through a reverse proxy (Lucky): /wan up sets up the socat relay, Windows portproxy, firewall, and trusted-host fence, with a Settings card plus commands to configure the domain and ports.
description.zh: 从 WSL2 走 IPv6/IPv4 经反向代理（Lucky）把 DSH Web GUI 暴露到公网：/wan up 一键建立 socat 中继、Windows portproxy、防火墙与 trusted-host 白名单；域名与端口可在设置卡片或命令中配置。

description.en: Turns a learning request and local materials into a structured, locally stored AI course with outline, lessons, diagrams and learning progress.
description.zh: 把学习诉求和手头资料变成结构化、纯本地的 AI 课程，含大纲、知识点内容、图表与学习进度。

description.en: Deterministic prompt-injection interception: tool results from file reads, repo searches and web fetches are scanned before they enter model context; high-severity findings quarantine-wrap or block, and credential-material files quarantine on the path alone.
description.zh: 确定性注入拦截：文件读取、仓库搜索与网络抓取的工具结果在进入模型上下文前被扫描；高危发现隔离包裹或阻断，凭证类文件按路径即隔离。

description.en: Project/task dual-mode workspaces for DSH: a task skips the workspace picker and gets a fresh scratch directory (D:\dsh_working\<name>-<timestamp>) per conversation, Codex-style; no-workspace sessions are grouped under a persistent Tasks section in the sidebar with empty states, and the new-session workspace picker gains a "no workspace (task)" option.
description.zh: DSH 项目/任务双模式工作区：任务不绑定工作区，每次新对话在 D:\dsh_working\<名称>-<时间戳> 自动创建独立临时目录（类 Codex）；侧边栏"任务"分组常驻显示所有无工作区会话并带空状态提示，新建会话的工作区选择器增加"无工作区（任务）"选项。

description.en: Model-agnostic visual-inspection pipeline for text-only agents: page-by-page HTML screenshots plus a ready-made vision-subagent briefing contract (gewu_prep), then source-code truth verification of every finding (gewu_locate); validated on mimo-v2.5 & qwen3.7-plus.
description.zh: 面向纯文本 DSH 主脑的模型无关视觉审阅流水线：HTML 逐页截图 + 视觉子代理简报契约（gewu_prep），再把每条审阅发现定位回源码核验真值（gewu_locate）；已在 mimo-v2.5 与 qwen3.7-plus 上实测。

description.en: Adds an Inherit row to the session menu: mechanically extracts concrete anchors (task, recent instructions, files edited, recent failures, commands, todos) from a long session into a handoff and continues in a clean session, with the same preset, no history copied and no model call.
description.zh: 会话菜单新增「继承」：把长会话里的具体锚点（任务原文、最近的用户指令、改过的文件、最近的失败、命令、待办）机械提取成交接单，在干净的新会话里接着干——预设默认一并继承，不复制历史，也不调用模型。

description.en: Merges AprilCrystal/dsh-client-ui-gpt-helper and zszz3/dsh-model-provider-prefix — two composer model-seat plugins that cannot be installed together — into one control: a Provider / Model trigger opening a two-column card where hovering the provider column swaps the models without moving the card, a separate reasoning-effort trigger with a particle slider, and a search that spans every provider while the card keeps its size.
description.zh: 把 AprilCrystal/dsh-client-ui-gpt-helper 与 zszz3/dsh-model-provider-prefix 这两个无法同时安装的输入框模型控件合并成一个控件：「供应商/模型」钮点开是两栏卡片，鼠标所指供应商的模型就地切换、卡片不移动；推理强度是旁边的独立钮，带粒子滑杆；搜索跨全部供应商，且卡片尺寸保持不变。

description.en: One-click TokenDance gateway access for DeepSeek Harness: OAuth sign-in stores the API key, a live model catalog with per-model visibility, and agent tools for chat, image generation, video generation and typed decisions.
description.zh: 一键接入 TokenDance 模型网关：OAuth 登录保存 API Key，实时模型目录可逐模型控制显隐，并提供对话、生图、生视频与类型化判断的 agent 工具。

description.en: One screen for every work you have shipped: local project facts, GitHub stars and last push, whether the plugin market has picked it up and how many downloads it has, plus pending pull-request wait times against the upstream median.
description.zh: 一屏看清每个作品的现状：本地版本与文件数、GitHub star 与最后推送、市场是否已收录及下载量、收录 PR 等待时长对比上游中位数；全部只读、数字都来自 API，不经模型生成。

description.en: Blocks AI coding agents from editing files without evidence and from running unapproved high-risk commands, and tells quoted dangerous strings apart from commands actually being executed.
description.zh: 拦截 AI 编码智能体未取证就改文件、未获授权执行高危命令，并区分「被引用的危险字符串」与「真要执行的命令」。

description.en: Turn-finished music reminder: when an agent turn ends, play a ringtone or any local audio file (bundled synthesised telephone ring, custom absolute path, or an in-page upload), with a floating chip to pause, resume or dismiss it and loop-until-paused playback; configured in Settings, defaults overridable per deployment.
description.zh: 回合提醒音乐：对话（回合）结束时播放铃声或任意本地音频提醒你回来——内置合成的电话「叮铃铃」，也可填宿主机绝对路径或直接在设置页上传；右下角浮标可暂停/继续/关闭，默认循环响到你手动停；设置项在「设置 → 内置插件」里，部署级默认值可写进 cordis.patch.yml。

description.en: Agent tool that returns the running DSH Web GUI URL including its per-process launch token, so browser automation can open the GUI instead of getting a 401.
description.zh: 把当前 DSH Web GUI 的合法带 token 地址作为 agent 工具返回，浏览器自动化可直接打开 GUI，不再遇到 401。

description.en: Scrape URLs to LLM-ready Markdown and search the web via the Firecrawl Cloud API.
description.zh: 通过 Firecrawl Cloud API 把 URL 抓成 LLM 可用 Markdown，或搜索网页并返回结果内容。

description.en: PCL-style modpack for DSH plugins: export a small .dshpack.zip manifest of the selected third-party plugins and their versions, then import it with a preview before reinstalling.
description.zh: PCL 式 DSH 整合包：勾选已安装插件导出小体积 .dshpack.zip 与安装命令串，导入时先预览、确认后再按版本重新安装。

description.en: In-chat image viewer for the web UI: takes over content image clicks (Markdown images, message attachments rendered as blob: URLs, and read_image results) and opens a dialog with pointer-centered wheel zoom and an editable percentage, drag pan, 90° rotation, download with progress, copy as PNG, open with the default app, and ←/→ gallery browsing across the conversation.
description.zh: Web UI 的聊天图片查看器：接管内容图片点击（Markdown 图、以 blob: URL 渲染的消息附件图、read_image 结果），打开弹层后支持以指针为中心的滚轮缩放与可编辑百分比、拖动平移、90° 旋转、带进度下载、复制为 PNG、用默认应用打开，以及会话内 ←/→ 图集浏览。

description.en: Enable permessage-deflate on DSH's WebSocket transport without modifying the DSH install tree.
description.zh: 在不修改 DSH 安装目录的前提下，为 DSH 的 WebSocket 传输启用 permessage-deflate。

description.en: Manage environment variables, .env files, and credentials in DeepSeek Harness, including Windows user and system environment variables.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中管理环境变量、.env 文件和凭据，支持 Windows 用户级与系统级环境变量。

description.en: Injects your existing markdown documents (notes, rules, knowledge-base files) into every dsh session's system prompt as read-only memory — list file or directory paths in `files`; no database, no service, no write path; UTF-8 byte-budgeted truncation with line-boundary fallback, total budget, YAML front-matter stripping, and freshness timestamps.
description.zh: 把本地已有的 markdown 文档（笔记、规则、知识库）按路径清单注入 dsh 每个会话的系统提示词，当只读记忆——无数据库、无服务、无写入通道；支持目录收集、UTF-8 字节预算截断、front-matter 剥离与新鲜度时间戳。

description.en: Registers a configurable prompt variable so an agent preset whose persona uses complete: true can still receive an injected text block; the plugin ships no content of its own and reads the text from its config.
description.zh: 注册一个可配置的 prompt 变量，让使用 complete: true 人格的 agent 预设也能收到一段注入文本；插件本身不含内容，文本由配置提供。

description.en: Always-visible account topped-up balance pill in the sidebar header, refreshed automatically and showing the same number as Settings → Account.
description.zh: 在侧边栏顶部常驻显示账户充值余额，自动刷新，数字与「设置 → 账户」一致。

description.en: Adds Kimi models to native DSH sessions with per-model selection of the embedded Kimi core or DSH native execution.
description.zh: 在 DSH 原生会话中接入 Kimi 模型，并按模型选择嵌入式 Kimi 核心或 DSH 原生执行方式。

description.en: Translates user prompts before sending and translates model reasoning and replies back into the user's language via translation APIs or configured DSH models, with independent content toggles and a composer menu.
description.zh: 通过翻译 API 或 DSH 已配置的模型，在发送前翻译用户提示词，并将模型思考文本和回答译回用户语言，提供独立内容开关和输入框快捷菜单。

description.en: Signed chain-of-custody for sessions: every watched tool result appends a hash-chained, ed25519-signed record, with commits bound into the chain — tampering with any line or truncating the tail fails deterministic replay verification.
description.zh: 会话签名监护链：被监视的工具结果逐条追加哈希链 ed25519 签名记录，commit 绑定进链——篡改任意行或截断尾部都会在确定性重放校验中失败。

description.en: Peak-hour reminder: while DeepSeek charges peak rates it shows a banner at the top of the DSH Web UI every N minutes (default 5, range 1-120), adds one at each peak/valley switch, stays silent during valley hours, and keeps a sidebar row with the current state and a countdown to the next switch. Peak rules (Beijing time Mon-Fri 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00; weekends, Chinese public holidays and 调休 weekends are valley all day) are evaluated in the host and served over two no-auth routes, /plugins/dsh-peak-reminder/state and /config; settings live in settings.section and are stored in ~/.dsh/peak-reminder.json.
description.zh: 峰时提醒：DeepSeek 走高峰计价时，每隔 N 分钟（默认 5，可设 1–120）在 DSH Web 界面顶部提醒一次「现在是峰时」，峰↔谷切换各提醒一条，谷时完全不打扰；侧边栏底部常驻一行显示当前峰/谷状态与下次切换倒计时。峰谷规则（北京时间工作日 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00；周末、法定节假日与调休周末全天谷价）由宿主判定，经 /plugins/dsh-peak-reminder/state 与 /config 两个免鉴权路由供界面读取；开关与间隔在设置页一节里改，存到 ~/.dsh/peak-reminder.json。

description.en: Ctrl+wheel page zoom (60–180%, remembered) for the whole DSH UI, plus a bottom-right Settings entry that opens the host settings panel, with Ctrl+0 to reset.
description.zh: Ctrl+滚轮整页缩放（60%–180%，记住比例），右下角常驻「设置」入口可打开宿主设置面板，Ctrl+0 复位。

description.en: Offline Wikipedia and ZIM lookups through your own kiwix-serve: the wiki_search, wiki_read and wiki_books tools run full-text search with snippets, read an article by exact title, and list the local ZIM library.
description.zh: 通过你自己运行的 kiwix-serve 离线查询维基百科等 ZIM 数据包：wiki_search / wiki_read / wiki_books 三个工具分别做带摘要片段的全文搜索、按精确标题读取全文、列出本地 ZIM 书库。

description.en: Global Quick Actions beside every session-backed composer in DSH. One press sends a preset or your own saved text, with per-action send confirmation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 每个由会话支持的消息编辑器旁提供全局快捷动作。一键发送预置或你自己保存的文本，每个动作可单独设置发送确认。

description.en: Compaction integrity: directive lines (never/must/必须 style markers) extracted from the compacted range are verified against the summary — verbatim or by content-word coverage — and every constraint the session silently forgot is reported and written to a JSONL ledger; pinned constraints from config are checked on every compaction.
description.zh: 压缩监护：从被压缩范围提取指令行（never/must/必须 类标记），对照摘要做逐字或内容词覆盖存续校验；会话悄悄遗忘的约束会被响亮上报并写入 JSONL 台账；配置中的 pinned 约束每次压缩必验。

description.en: Task-priority session notifications for DSH: main-line sessions alert immediately on completion or failure, side-line completions can be batched into one alert, and questions or permission requests alert as they arrive; supports multiple main-line markers and a balanced mode that treats every session as main-line while nothing is marked.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的任务分级会话通知：主线任务完成或失败时立即提醒，支线可汇总为一声，提问与权限请求出现即提醒；支持同时标记多个主线，以及未标记主线时把所有会话视为主线的均衡模式。

description.en: Checks an invoice ledger for duplicates keyed on code + number, arithmetic consistency, payer mismatch, date anomalies and template placeholders, and emits an anomaly list plus a workbook.
description.zh: 核对发票台账：按代码与号码识别重复、核对算式一致性、付款方不一致、日期异常与模板占位符，输出异常清单与工作簿。

description.en: Skill manager page in the DSH Web Settings panel, at the same level as Plugins: lists every skill the installation serves with its own summary, source and disk footprint, and removes any of them into a recoverable trash.
description.zh: DSH Web 设置里的 skill 管理器页面，与「插件」同级：列出当前安装提供的全部 skill 及其自己的简介、来源与占用，并可逐个移除（移除是移入可恢复的回收站）。

description.en: A collapsible column beside the conversation that organises conversations into a workspace/topic tree, opens the real sessions in place, and exposes the tree to the assistant through 9 model tools.
description.zh: 会话列旁的可折叠栏：把对话按工作区与主题组织成树，就地打开真实会话，并通过 9 个模型工具让助手读写这棵树。

description.en: Read-only JSONL and NDJSON viewer with a byte index, record navigation, and streaming previews for large records. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2.
description.zh: 使用字节索引逐条浏览 JSONL 与 NDJSON，支持物理行跳转和超长记录流式预览的只读查看器。要求 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: Agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: the standard tool stack plus four working rules written into the persona prompt — a project keeps at most four documents (intro, decisions, change log, current state and next steps), those documents describe only the current state with no AI edit history or superseded decisions, no git commit or push or pull request until the user explicitly asks, and a careful-coding workflow (restate the goal and done-criteria first, surgical diffs, evidence before claiming success) with plain-language reports.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的 Agent 预设：标准模式的工具栈，外加写进人格提示的四条工作纪律——每个项目最多四个文档（项目介绍、方案设定、改动记录、现状与下一步）；文档只写当前状态，不记 AI 修改历史、不留被推翻的旧方案；用户没有明确指令就不提交、不推送、不开 PR；动手前先复述目标与验收标准、只做手术式最小改动、没验证不说已修复，汇报用大白话。

description.en: Two games inside DeepSeek Harness where the model supplies intent and a local engine owns the rules: a twin-brain snake that periodically draws a strategy card, and Chinese chess where the model only comments on a move picked from locally generated legal candidates. Both keep running when the model is slow, offline or out of quota.
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面里玩游戏，分工是模型负责「想」、本地引擎负责「动」：双脑贪吃蛇会周期性抽一张策略卡；中国象棋里模型只从本地生成的合法候选着法里挑一个并解说。模型变慢、断网或额度用尽时，两个游戏都照常运行。

description.en: macOS only: holds a PreventUserIdleSystemSleep assertion (caffeinate -i -w <host pid>) while any DSH session runs, and releases it when the last one stops, so a long turn is not cut off by idle sleep. The display may still turn off. It keeps holding through the maintenance phase, where Agent.status reports idle and a long manual /compact runs, via the compaction/start and compaction/end events. It reconciles against ctx.agents.list() every 60s, so a session already running when the plugin is hot-reloaded is picked up at once instead of at the next turn boundary. A failed hold retries with exponential backoff capped at 60s and never gives up; release escalates from SIGTERM to SIGKILL after 2s, and -w lets caffeinate exit by itself if the host dies. No browser half — configured through the profile patch. 51 tests, including two that read pmset -g assertions on real hardware.
description.zh: 仅 macOS：任意 DSH 会话运行期间持有 PreventUserIdleSystemSleep 断言（caffeinate -i -w <宿主 pid>），最后一个会话结束后释放，长时间回合不会因空闲休眠被切断；屏幕仍可正常息屏。它会一直持有跨过 maintenance 阶段——该阶段 Agent.status 报 idle 而手动 /compact 正在跑，靠 compaction/start 与 compaction/end 事件兜住。每 60 秒与 ctx.agents.list() 对账，插件热重载时已在运行的会话立即被接管，不必等到下一个回合边界。持有失败按指数退避重试、上限 60 秒且永不放弃；释放时先 SIGTERM，2 秒未退出升级 SIGKILL；带 -w，宿主崩溃时 caffeinate 自行退出。无前端半身，通过 profile patch 配置。共 51 个测试，其中 2 个在真机上直接读 pmset -g assertions。

description.en: This project aims to bridge the Blender MCP Add-on, so that models on DSH can conveniently connect to the current user's working Blender to assist creation, while meeting basic security requirements.
description.zh: 此项目旨在桥接 Blender MCP Add-on，使 DSH 上的模型可便捷对接接入当前用户工作的 Blender 以辅助创作，且满足基础安全需要。

description.en: Codex-style sidebar: a pinned band for projects and conversations, collapsible 置顶/项目/组件 sections, a bell activity view of recently used conversations, and per-project emoji icons.
description.zh: Codex 风格侧边栏：项目和对话共用的置顶区、置顶/项目/组件 三段可折叠分区、小铃铛活动视图（含最后一条回答的预览）、可为每个项目换 Emoji 图标。

description.en: Describe the persona you want and the agent writes it: nickname, bio, taglines and links come from the host model, the avatar comes from your local asset library (or a path you give), then it fills your profile page and hands the picture to the site's own uploader. Dry-run by default - it only touches profile fields, never passwords or security settings.
description.zh: 你说想要什么样的人设，它把文案写出来并把资料页填好：昵称/简介/标语/链接由宿主模型生成，头像取本地素材库（或你给的路径），再由站点自己的上传控件完成头像入库。**默认 dry-run**，只写资料字段 —— 不碰密码、邮箱、安全设置。

description.en: Read-only orchd panel for the DSH right sidebar: task board, ideas board, dependency graph, review timeline and an install entry for the project of the current session.
description.zh: 把 orchd 项目状态带进 DSH 右侧栏的只读面板：任务看板、想法看板、依赖图、审查时间线与接入入口，只跟当前会话的项目。

description.en: Treats the session as a mainland-China user (zh-Hans-CN, Asia/Shanghai, ISO dates, CNY currency) and generates a self-consistent test persona: five tools, six cross-checks, GB 11643 check digit, phone prefix matched to carrier ASN.
description.zh: 把会话当作中国大陆用户（简体中文、Asia/Shanghai、ISO 日期、人民币），并生成彼此自洽的测试人设：五个工具、六项交叉校验，身份证校验位、号段与运营商 ASN、区划码与地址互相对得上。

description.en: Web search, page fetch and one-call research through DeepSeek's official Search and Fetch API; needs a DeepSeek API key.
description.zh: 通过 DeepSeek 官方 Search/Fetch 接口做网页搜索、单页抓取与一键调研；需要一个 DeepSeek API key。

description.en: Visibility layer for the built-in Cua Driver computer-control channel: a top banner names the controlling session and its goal, and Esc truly stops the agent.
description.zh: 给官方内置 Cua Driver 电脑控制通道加一层可见提示：顶部横幅显示是哪个会话、基于什么目标在控制电脑，按 Esc 真正停止。

description.en: Model-driven tool-result archiving for DeepSeek Harness. Results above a configurable size carry a short inline id (\[#a1b2c3d4]); the model archives the ones it no longer needs into the session's own archives/ folder and the context keeps a small recoverable stub with the file path. Originals stay in the append-only session log, so nothing is lost. Ships a settings panel with per-size-bucket recovery stats, thresholds that apply without restart, and a conditional reminder when results are waiting to be archived. Requires dsh-better-sidebar for the statistics panel.
description.zh: 模型驱动的工具结果归档插件。超过阈值的结果会带一个短内联编号（\[#a1b2c3d4]），模型把不再需要的 结果归档进会话自己的 archives/ 目录，上下文里只留一个可回捞的小存根（含文件路径）。原文同时保留在 只增的会话日志中，不会丢失。附带设置面板：按大小分桶的回收统计、改完立即生效的阈值、以及有待归档 结果时的条件提醒。统计面板需 dsh-better-sidebar。

description.en: Previews a workspace OpenWiki in the DSH Web right Sidebar: detects the wiki directory, serves it with the official `openwiki visualize` reader on a loopback port, and embeds it in its own tab, reporting the installed openwiki and DSH versions against configurable floors and checking the registry for its own updates.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 右侧边栏预览工作区的 OpenWiki：识别 wiki 目录，用官方 `openwiki visualize` 阅读器在本地回环端口提供服务并嵌入自有标签页，同时对照可配置的版本下限报告 openwiki 与 DSH 版本，并向 registry 检查自身更新。

description.en: Cite Lens for dsh: select text in a PDF in the Files tab to quote or ask about it in the current chat, and turn the model's \[main.pdf p.7 "exact words"] citations into links that open the PDF and highlight the passage; /cite-links makes a chat cite every claim.
description.zh: dsh 的 PDF 阅读：在文件选项卡里选中 PDF 中的文字，就能引用到当前对话或就它提问；把模型的引用变成链接，点开 PDF 并高亮被引用的那几句话；/cite-links 让一段对话为每条论断都附上引用。

description.en: One chip in the composer dock: the account balance plus what the current chat has cost, priced per turn at the tariff in force when each turn ran. Clicking it opens a 264px card in the panel style of the host, with refresh and settings buttons.
description.zh: 输入框下方一枚芯片：显示账户余额与当前对话花费，花费按每轮发生时刻的峰谷档位逐段计价。点击展开 264px 卡片，沿用宿主自带面板的样式，带刷新与设置两个按钮。

description.en: Per-workspace closet for temporary scripts and their run logs, kept in a .dsh-fix directory inside each project. Registers a script with its language and purpose, scans a project for leftover scratch scripts, backups and log files, runs registered scripts with a timeout and writes each run to a timestamped log, and sweeps chosen files into a reversible trash with per-batch restore. Scanning only lists and never deletes; cleanup moves files instead of deleting them; files already tracked by git are refused unless forced. Ships 7 agent tools and a settings panel.
description.zh: 按工作区管理临时脚本与其运行日志的收纳间，数据放在每个项目内的 .dsh-fix 目录。可登记脚本（语言与用途）、扫描项目中遗留的临时脚本/备份/日志、带超时执行已登记脚本并把每次运行写进带时间戳的日志、把选中的文件清运进可整批还原的回收站。扫描只列清单永不删除；清运只做移动不做删除；已被 git 跟踪的文件默认拒收，确需处理要显式加 force。含 7 个 Agent 工具与一个设置面板。

description.en: Shows the API balance of the provider behind the current model as a dsh Web sidebar card, with per-package progress bars, currency/credit-aware units, a settings tab, and subscription and credit quota monitoring.
description.zh: 在当前会话所用模型的厂商 API 余额，以 dsh Web 侧边栏卡片常驻展示，含每套餐进度条、货币/积分单位区分、设置页，以及订阅与积分额度监测。

description.en: Checks a payroll sheet against published social-insurance, housing-fund and individual-income-tax parameters, with pass, pass_with_gaps, review and fail outcomes and parameters that carry their own review date.
description.zh: 按公开的社保、公积金与个人所得税参数核对工资表，结果分为 pass、pass_with_gaps、review、fail 四档；参数本身带复核日期。

description.en: System-prompt surface drift gate: every section any plugin or preset contributes to the assembled system prompt is hashed and baselined; a silent rewrite of what the model is told fails loud.
description.zh: 系统提示词面漂移门：任何插件或预设注入组装提示词的段落均哈希基线化，对模型被告知内容的静默改写将响亮报错。

description.en: Prompt-box screenshot shortcut button. Drag a box, shot taken immediately. DSH hides automatically; multi-monitor supported. Ctrl+Alt+1--hides the window then shoots; shift+click--does not hide. Hold Ctrl+Alt and click 1 to shoot repeatedly. ! One copy is saved by default, named by content hash, in the DSH attachment library; each session writes an index recording which shots belong to it (can be changed to keep an extra copy in the session folder). Images are part of the context, so deleting them breaks the session — use the "Delete Conversation" plugin to remove images together with the conversation. Windows only.
description.zh: 方便大家直接截屏的提示词框快捷按钮。拉完范围框后直接截屏。自动隐藏dsh，支持多屏幕。Ctrl+Alt+1--隐藏窗口截屏；shift+点击按钮--不隐藏窗口；按住Ctrl+Alt后点击1，反复截屏。！默认以哈希值名称保存1份在DSH附件库，各会话生成索引记录图片归属（可修改为多备份一份至会话文件夹）。图片属于上下文，删除会导致会话错误，须用“删除会话”插件让图片与会话一并删除。仅 Windows。

description.en: A one-line caption above the composer that tells you what the AI is doing right now: the step number, the action (e.g. running npm test), and whether it is still going, done, or failed with a short plain-language reason. Inferred locally from tool calls and the thinking text; no model calls, no network requests, no writes to DSH data.
description.zh: 在输入框上方加一行小字，告诉你 AI 现在第几步、在做什么、成没成，比如「第 3 步 · 正在执行命令 npm test · 琢磨中」。全部靠本机规则推断，不调模型、不联网、不改 DSH 的任何数据。

description.en: Archives the sessions of a workspace when its folder is deleted or moved away, or when its registration is removed, and restores them when it returns: unarchives only the sessions it archived itself, re-attaches every member its ledger recorded (including sessions you archived manually, whose archived state is left unchanged), and adopts ungrouped sessions whose working directory is that workspace path.
description.zh: 工作区文件夹被删除或移走、或工作区登记被移除时，自动归档其会话；目录或登记回归时恢复：只取消归档本插件归档过的会话，把台账记过的全部成员挂回分组（含你手动归档的会话，且不改其归档状态），并把「无项目」里工作目录正是该工作区路径的会话归位。

description.en: Runs the locally installed ZCode CLI as a `zcode` model route in DSH: all traffic is signed by the official binary, the plugin never sends its own request, forges client requests or sends credentials off the machine (the plan token is decrypted in memory only to hand back to the official CLI), no API key is needed, and both a paid one-shot and a free app-server channel are supported. Since v0.3.0 it ships an HTTP MCP bridge so tool calls run through the DSH approval surface. Backed by a contract document and a node --test gate.
description.zh: 把本机已安装的 ZCode CLI 接成 DSH 的 `zcode` 模型路由：流量全部由官方二进制签名，插件自身不发请求、不伪造客户端请求、不把凭据传出本机（plan token 只在内存中解密并交还官方 CLI），不需要 API Key，付费一次性与免费 app-server 两条通道并存；v0.3.0 起内建 HTTP MCP 工具桥，工具调用走 DSH 的审批面；有契约文档与 node --test 测试门禁背书。

description.en: For DSH plugin AUTHORS: run this after you finish writing a plugin and it audits the entire publish path, then hands you the exact GitHub + npm + market commands. Pre-publish gate for DSH plugins. Turns every silent failure in the publish path into a deterministic check: package.json completeness (missing exports\["."], files omitting lib/ so the tarball is empty, no "type": "module", client declared without a ./client export), UTF-8 BOM, JSON/YAML parse errors, cordis.patch.yml insert rows written at the wrong indent (the bug that makes a plugin install and never mount), insert name mismatches, missing entry exports, require() inside ESM, missing LICENSE or README install line, missing tests, unscoped npm names that return a 403 no granular token can diagnose, versions already on the registry, and missing GitHub repos. Six agent tools; every finding carries its fix. Read-only, no LLM.
description.zh: 给插件作者用：写完插件后跑一遍，自动体检整条发布链路，然后给出 GitHub + npm + 市场三步的可照抄命令。 DSH 插件的发布门禁。把发布链路上的每个静默坑变成确定性检查：package.json 完整性（缺 exports\["."]、files 漏了 lib/ 导致发空包、没写 "type": "module"、声明了 client 却没导出 ./client）、UTF-8 BOM、JSON/YAML 解析错误、cordis.patch.yml 的 insert 行缩进写错（正是让插件装上却永不挂载的那个 bug）、挂载名与 package.json 不一致、入口导出缺失、ESM 里调 require()、缺 LICENSE 或 README 安装行、缺测试、裸包名 （granular token 收到无法诊断的 403）、版本已被 registry 占用、GitHub 仓库不存在。六个 agent 工具， 每条 finding 都带修复文案。只读，不调 LLM。

description.en: Bridges the Cua Driver MCP server into DSH: installs the cua-driver executable when it is missing, starts it over stdio through the in-box MCP client, and registers its 60 accessibility-first window, input, menu, and browser tools with a bundled workflow skill and one-time macOS permission guidance.
description.zh: 把 Cua Driver 的 MCP 服务器接入 DSH：缺失时自动安装 cua-driver，经内置 MCP 客户端以 stdio 启动，注册其 60 个无障碍优先的窗口、输入、菜单与浏览器工具，并附带工作流技能与一次性的 macOS 权限引导。

description.en: Extends the composer model selector menu with a third Context window row, preset capacities (64K–2M), custom input, provider-wide sync, and adaptive compaction guard.
description.zh: 在底部聊天输入框的模型选择弹窗中扩展第三行【上下文窗口】，支持 64K~2M 档位切换、自定义容量输入、提供商批量同步与自适应压缩防失败守卫。

description.en: Brings the models of the SCNet (超算互联网) Computing Service desktop client into DSH by reusing the API key that client already wrote, with a 30-model catalog and a per-model default thinking level.
description.zh: 复用超算互联网（SCNet）计算服务客户端已写入的 API key，把它的模型接入 DSH，带 30 个模型的目录与逐模型默认思考档位。

description.en: Composer model selector grouped by provider: pick a provider card, then drill into that provider to choose a model, with cross-provider search and Reasoning Effort kept.
description.zh: 按来源分块的输入框模型选择器：先选来源渠道卡片，再下钻进该渠道选择模型，保留跨来源搜索与推理强度调节。

description.en: C++ audit skill: detects the target project's actual C++ standard before making any recommendation, then reports findings across RAII and ownership, move semantics, exception safety, performance and memory, containers and algorithms, concurrency, templates and compile-time, standard boundary, and type safety, ABI and interface design, each with a checkpoint, a reason, a bad-to-good example and the minimum standard.
description.zh: C++ 审查技能：先探测目标工程真实的 C++ 标准再给建议，随后按 RAII 与所有权、移动语义、异常安全、性能与内存、容器与算法、并发、模板与编译期、标准边界、类型安全、ABI 与接口设计逐条给出结论，每条含检查点、原因、反例→正例与适用标准。

description.en: Delegates self-contained coding subtasks to the local Claude Code subscription through the official Agent SDK and returns the result to the host session. Nineteen per-call parameters control model, thinking effort, permission mode, allowed tools, turn count and budget cap; background jobs return a jobId immediately and stream incremental output; the result carries a session handle that can be passed back as resume to continue the same conversation; commands expected to run past ~20 seconds go through the built-in mcp__dsh__shell channel, which streams output line by line without consuming model context; a Claude Code monitor panel in the session lists jobs, renders the structured process, shows live output blocks and cancels a run; the delegation procedure ships as a runtime-registered skill, so installing the plugin installs the skill.
description.zh: 把自包含的编码子任务委派给本机 Claude Code（官方 Agent SDK 驱动），结果回传主会话：19 个参数可按次控制模型、思考强度、权限模式、允许工具、轮次与预算上限；后台作业立即返回 jobId 并支持增量读取；结果附会话句柄，传回 resume 即可在同一会话续跑；预计超过 20 秒的命令经内置 mcp__dsh__shell 通道逐行实时输出，不占用模型上下文；会话内附 Claude Code 监控面板（任务列表、结构化过程视图、实时输出块、一键取消）；委派规程以运行时技能注册，安装插件即安装技能。

description.en: Mobile web UI for DeepSeek Harness: a token-protected LAN server that lists all sessions, streams replies over SSE, and lets a phone continue any conversation; the desktop GUI shows a QR entry and, with dsh-whale-girl 0.3.0+, a phone held by the pet opens the same panel.
description.zh: DSH 手机端 Web UI：带令牌认证的局域网服务，手机可浏览全部会话、通过 SSE 实时查看回复并继续对话；桌面 GUI 提供二维码入口，配合 dsh-whale-girl 0.3.0+ 现在还可以点桌宠鳍里的小手机打开面板。

description.en: Read, edit, export and verify Excel VBA projects through a real Excel COM instance: modules, UserForm code, procedure lists and .frm/.frx exports. Windows only, with desktop Excel installed, Python 3.10+ with pywin32, and AccessVBOM=1.
description.zh: 通过真实 Excel COM 读写、导出并校验 Excel VBA 工程：模块、窗体代码、过程清单与 .frm/.frx 导出。仅 Windows：需安装桌面版 Excel、Python 3.10+（含 pywin32），并设置 AccessVBOM=1。

description.en: Hermetic composition lock: fingerprints the profile's dependencies, bundle order, lockfile and patch layer; booting a drifted composition warns, or fails under strict mode (the --frozen posture for CI).
description.zh: 密闭组合锁：对 profile 的依赖、组合顺序、锁文件与补丁层取指纹；组合漂移时启动告警，strict 模式直接失败（CI 的 --frozen 姿态）。

description.en: Stardew Valley theme (component-override edition): an official-mechanism client theme that stacks a cream-paper alias-token layer, stitched pixel font and valley wallpaper over the intact official React UI. npm: dsh-theme-stardew-valley.
description.zh: 星露谷物语主题·组件替换版：走 dsh 官方客户端主题机制，在完整保留的官方 React UI 上叠加奶油纸面 alias token 层、缝合像素字体与山谷壁纸。npm 包名 dsh-theme-stardew-valley。

description.en: Ports the obra/superpowers methodology as 14 native DSH skills — brainstorming, writing-plans, executing-plans, subagent-driven development, test-driven development, systematic debugging, parallel agent dispatch, git worktrees, code review, verification before completion and skill authoring — served through the DSH skills registry with their scripts, references and cross-links intact (frontmatter folded into a manifest, prefixes realigned to DSH skill names). Requires DSH session format v4 (official DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+): the /superpowers slash command declares the producer-owned source kind plugin:dsh-plugin-superpowers.
description.zh: 将 obra/superpowers 方法论移植为 14 个原生 DSH 技能——头脑风暴、写计划、计划执行、subagent 驱动开发、TDD、系统化调试、并行派发、git worktree、代码评审、完成前验证、技能编写——经 DSH 技能注册表提供，脚本、参考资料与交叉引用原样保留（frontmatter 收进 manifest、前缀对齐 DSH 技能名）。要求 DSH session format v4（官方 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+）：/superpowers 斜杠命令使用 producer-owned source kind plugin:dsh-plugin-superpowers。

description.en: Per-workspace gate that hides the tool schemas and system prompt sections of selected plugins from the model in directories that do not need them.
description.zh: 按工作区门控插件：把选定插件的工具 schema 与系统提示词段，从不需要它们的目录的模型上下文中摘掉。

description.en: Stardew Valley theme (full-skin edition) for the dsh web UI only: replaces the served web frontend with a self-contained pixel-farm interface — Junimo dialog, farm-select presets, quest journal HUD, session-as-day valley calendar, chiptune SFX and desktop pets. Not available in the desktop window and not compatible with other UI-changing plugins.
description.zh: 星露谷物语主题·整皮版，仅适用于 dsh Web 界面：把 Web 前端整体换成自包含的像素农场界面——祝尼魔对话、农场选预设、任务日志 HUD、会话即游戏日的山谷日历、8-bit 音效与桌宠。不支持桌面原生窗口，请勿与其他会改变 UI 的插件同时启用。

description.en: Prompt optimizer in the composer: rewrites the draft into an eleven-section analytical prompt using the conversation, workspace files and the session's selected model, with one-click undo.
description.zh: 输入框内的提示词优化器：结合对话历史、工作区文件与会话选定模型，把草稿改写为十一节分析式提示词，支持一键撤销。

description.en: Recalls messages you already sent in the DSH composer with ArrowUp; ArrowDown walks forward, restores the draft you were writing, and one more press discards it and clears the composer.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框用 ↑ 调回本会话已发送的消息；↓ 前翻并恢复你正在写的草稿，再按一次 ↓ 丢弃草稿、清空输入框。

description.en: Native discovery and per-agent loading of built-in, plugin and MCP tools, with BM25 and optional Ollama or OpenAI-compatible embeddings.
description.zh: 内置工具、插件工具与 MCP 工具的原生发现与按 agent 加载，支持 BM25 检索，可选 Ollama 或 OpenAI 兼容的向量检索。

description.en: Creates, activates, checks and removes external DSH plugins from a conversation through fixed tools; requires the external DSHX devkit.
description.zh: 通过对话中的固定工具创建、激活、检查和移除外部 DSH 插件，需要外部 DSHX 开发工具。

description.en: Always-on AI teammate: hand it a recurring task in one sentence; dry-run rehearsal by default, snapshot before every real run, one-click rollback, CNY budget circuit-breaker, per-run cost transparency.
description.zh: 常驻 AI 队友：一句自然语言交给它长期值守；默认演习、执行前后双快照、一键整单回滚、人民币预算熔断、逐轮费用透明。

description.en: Converts Mermaid flowcharts into GB/T 1526-1989 (ISO 5807) compliant SVG through one model-facing tool, with optional A4/A3 pagination.
description.zh: 把 Mermaid 流程图转成符合 GB/T 1526-1989（等同 ISO 5807）图形符号的 SVG，可选用 A4/A3 幅面自动分页。

description.en: Send "Memory unlocked" to let the AI recall conversations it has forgotten.
description.zh: 发送“大记忆恢复术”来让 AI 回想起忘记的对话。

description.en: Test work framework for DSH that scaffolds a product, module and version directory tree, registers seven test_framework_* tools and four runtime skills, and adds a prompt-level gate that reports which requirement-document splits, versions, related documents and environment credentials are still unrecorded before testing starts. Requires the playwright MCP server (no fallback).
description.zh: DSH 测试工作框架：把空文件夹初始化为产品、模块、版本、报告与归档目录树，注册 7 个 test_framework_* 工具与 4 个运行时技能，并提供提示词级闸门——开测前报告需求文档拆分、版本、跨文档关联与环境账密中尚未登记的部分。需先配置 playwright MCP（无替代路径）。

description.en: Adds a Firecrawl search provider with multi-account API-key settings.
description.zh: 提供 Firecrawl 搜索服务及多账户 API Key 设置。

description.en: Moves the composer to the top of an active conversation and renders the transcript plus the turn navigator newest-first, so replies appear right under the composer.
description.zh: 把活跃会话的输入框固定在视口顶部，转写列表与右侧回合导航按最新在上渲染，新回复紧贴输入框出现。

description.en: Windows GUI automation reliability layer: probes whether a window is minimized, foreground or DPI-scaled, then clicks and types with the coordinate space and activation order handled for you. Zero dependencies, local only.
description.zh: Windows 窗口操作的可靠性层：先体检目标窗口是否最小化、是否在前台、有没有 DPI 缩放，再点击与输入——坐标口径和激活顺序由它处理。零依赖、纯本地、不联网。

description.en: Registers native doubao_generate_image and doubao_image_status Agent tools to automate Doubao Web (doubao.com) via Tabbit Browser, automatically extracting watermark-free 2.7K wm0 original images into local files and multimodal chat attachments.
description.zh: 豆包网页生图 Agent 原生工具插件：向 Agent 注册 doubao_generate_image 与 doubao_image_status 工具，通过 Tabbit 操控 doubao.com 提交生图提示词、选择比例与风格，自动优选 2.7K wm0 无水印超清原图落盘并注入对话附件。

description.en: Rates how hard the current message is and shows the cheapest model and reasoning effort that still fits, above the composer, before you send.
description.zh: 发送前判断问题难度，在输入框上方提示够用的模型与推理等级，避免用错档位多花钱。

description.en: Turn English audiobooks (MP3) and documents into listening lessons: transcribe every sentence locally with the speech model DSH voice input already downloaded (about 241 MB, fetched on first use if missing; ffmpeg required), proofread and explain each sentence with your DSH model, then drill with blind listening, intensive listening and spaced repetition, with Chinese-dubbing export and offline Kokoro voices; ships a sidebar panel and four AI tools.
description.zh: 把英文有声读物（MP3）和英文文档（PDF / Word / EPUB / 网页 / TXT）变成听力课：用 DSH 语音输入已下载的模型在本机识别每一句（缺失时首次使用自动下载约 241 MB；需 ffmpeg）、用你选的大模型逐句校对翻译讲解，再以精听、间隔复习、磨耳朵练到一听就懂；支持中文配音导出与离线 Kokoro 语音，提供右侧栏面板和 4 个 AI 工具。

description.en: Let the agent restart its own DSH host: schedule a self-restart, finish the turn first, then a detached helper stops and relaunches the app and reports what happened. Dry-run, a status check, and an optional "when can I blink" confirmation are built in.
description.zh: 让 agent 自己安排宿主重启：工具立刻返回，等这一轮回复送达、会话日志落盘安静后再停+拉，并留下报告；自带 dry-run、体检与「什么时候可以眨一下眼」的确认。

description.en: Desktop tweaks: F11 fullscreen toggle; enables Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V copy and paste in the terminal, both switchable in the General settings.
description.zh: 桌面修改：F11 全屏切换；使终端使用 Ctrl+C/V 复制粘贴，从通用设置内开启/关闭。

description.en: Strips DSML markers that leak into the assistant text stream and resumes a turn only when it genuinely produced nothing — an invoke-block leak with no tool call emitted, or a closing-tag leak whose prose is near-empty; upstream jitter codes retry, while quota, rate-limit, auth and context-window errors never do. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 or newer, below 0.3.0, and Node 20 or newer.
description.zh: 抹掉漏进助手正文的 DSML 标记；只在确实毫无产出的轮次补一条继续——整段调用写进正文且没有发出任何工具调用，或只剩闭合标签且正文近乎为空。上游抖动类错误会续跑，额度、限流、鉴权与上下文超限一律不续。适用 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 起、0.3.0 以下，Node 20 起。

description.en: Codex-style reasoning-effort card for the composer: takes over the model selector and shows the current level, the model row and a segmented slider over the model's own adapter-provided levels, with a model list, a reset, and a purple aurora with twinkling particles at the maximum level.
description.zh: 输入框里的 Codex 风格推理强度卡片：接管模型选择器，显示当前档位、模型行，以及覆盖模型适配器所报全部档位的分段滑块；另带模型列表、重置，以及最高档时的紫色极光与闪烁粒子。

description.en: Small-window mode for DSH NEXT on Windows: a 425px-wide always-on-top sticky window with a drawer sidebar and animated transitions. Requires DSH NEXT; the other desktop client (dsh desktop) is not supported.
description.zh: DSH NEXT（Windows）的小窗模式：把主窗口切成 425px 宽、置顶的便签式小窗，侧栏变抽屉、进出带过渡动效。只支持 DSH NEXT，另一个桌面端 dsh desktop 不支持。

description.en: Sensitive-character replacement for DeepSeek Harness: matches messages and tool results against a YAML blocklist you maintain (global, per provider id, or per model) before the model reads them, and scrubs the outgoing request again before dispatch, so blocked characters cannot trip the official API Content Exists Risk 400.
description.zh: 在模型读取内容之前，按用户维护的 YAML 屏蔽表（全局 / 按 Provider ID / 按模型）替换消息与工具结果中的敏感字符，出网前再清洗一次请求，避免 DeepSeek 官方 API 的 Content Exists Risk 400。

description.en: Meeting notes for dsh: one meeting per conversation, transcribed and speaker-separated on the machine itself, with points, assignments, handwritten notes, reviews and monthly scores in the same panel. Exports SRT/Markdown/Word and packs a meeting into a portable zip another dsh can import; confirmed assignments go to DingTalk/WeCom in one click, following your robot settings. Recognition models are swappable (a stronger local model can be imported from a file), and cloud recognition is off by default with no request made before consent. Word export needs Python and python-docx; the first run downloads a recognition model (28 or 77 MB).
description.zh: 会议记录插件：一个会话对应一场会议，本机离线转写与发言人分离；要点、工作安排、手写笔记、复盘与月度评分都在面板里完成。可导出 SRT／Markdown／Word，也能打成「会议工程包」（zip）在另一台 dsh 导入；已确认的工作安排按设置一键推送到钉钉／企业微信。识别模型可更换（支持从本地文件导入更强的模型），云端识别默认关闭、未同意即零请求。导出 Word 需 Python 与 python-docx；首次使用会下载识别模型（28 MB 或 77 MB）。

description.en: Windows XP (Luna) skin for the DSH web GUI: beige Luna panels, gradient buttons, #7F9DB9 input fields, rounded blue scrollbars and a CSS-drawn Bliss-style desktop, plus a chime when a turn finishes and a different cue when the agent stops for approval.
description.zh: 把 DSH 换成 Windows XP：Luna 蓝皮肤（米色面板、渐变按钮、#7F9DB9 输入框、圆角蓝色滚动条、纯 CSS 绘制的 Bliss 风格桌面），外加一轮跑完时的提示音，以及智能体停下来等你批准时的另一种提示音。

description.en: A tiny always-on floating tree of the DSH workspaces, conversations and subagents that are running, waiting on you or on a schedule — live running state, who is waiting for your call, per-row model, scheduled-run countdowns, other local dsh instances with their ports, and local claude/codex CLI processes with their codex subagent threads.
description.zh: 一张常驻角落的迷你 agent 树：按 workspace → 对话 → subagent 实时展示谁在跑，等你拍板的会话琥珀色置顶，行内显示模型与定时任务倒计时；同时接上本机其它端口的 dsh 实例（会话数 / subagent 数可展开），并列出本机 claude/codex 进程及其子对话。

description.en: Deterministic write gate: scope policy denies out-of-scope write/edit calls before they touch the disk, residue rules scan the written text, and every decision lands in a content-hashed JSONL ledger; can reuse the repo's agent-pr-gate.yaml so CI and session enforce one policy.
description.zh: 确定性写入门禁：范围策略在落盘前拒绝越权写入，残留规则扫描所写文本，每个决定落入带内容哈希的 JSONL 台账；可复用仓库的 agent-pr-gate.yaml 让 CI 与会话共用同一策略。

description.en: Browse, search, install, and apply VS Code color themes to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: bundles 14 curated themes with live color-swatch previews, searches the official VS Code Marketplace for more, and one-click installs map any theme's palette onto the DSW design tokens with live switching and persisted selection.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 中浏览、搜索、安装并应用 VS Code 配色主题：内置 14 款精选主题并带实时色卡预览，可搜索官方 VS Code 插件市场安装更多主题，一键安装会把任意主题的调色板映射到 DSW 设计令牌，支持实时切换与选择持久化。

description.en: Adds the fs_remove and fs_move tools, executed in the DSH host process so they can delete paths the sandboxed shell cannot, gated by a session allow list and a path allow/deny list that denies by default.
description.zh: 在 DSH 宿主进程里执行 fs_remove 与 fs_move，因此能删除沙箱 shell 删不掉的路径；带会话白名单与路径白/黑名单，默认拒绝。

description.en: Tool-surface snapshot and drift gate: baselines the full visible tool registry (name/description/parameters, MCP tools included) into a committable JSON file and warns loudly when an upgrade adds, removes or reshapes a tool.
description.zh: 工具面快照与漂移门：全量可见工具注册表（含 MCP 工具）基线化为可提交的 JSON，升级新增、移除或改动工具时响亮告警。

description.en: Milestone progress soft-enforcement guard: injects persistent system-prompt rules and post-execute notices when tool calls omit visible progress text, with a Web settings form.
description.zh: 阶段性结论软强制守卫：常驻注入系统提示词规范，并在模型调用工具漏发可见结论时自动附加软强制纠偏提醒，支持 Web 设置表单。

description.en: Lets the model turn an answer into a web page that lives right inside the chat. The show_page tool either fills one of 8 built-in templates (report, compare, checklist, dashboard, timeline, flashcards, quiz, flow), where the model writes only the content and the plugin does layout, interaction and saving, or saves a full page the model wrote itself (calculators, games, custom layouts). Hand-written pages get the same design as base styles inside a CSS @layer, so the page's own CSS still wins. The page appears under the reply at its content height, interactive and following DSH's light/dark theme. The page's localStorage is stored in DSH per page, so what users tick or type survives reopening and new versions, and the same page open in the chat and the right sidebar stays in sync. Each edit is saved as a new version you can flip back to. After saving, the page is checked in a hidden local Chrome or Edge (script errors, horizontal overflow, dark mode not applied) and problems go back to the model. The right sidebar shows the page full-size with versions, a gallery of all pages and export to PNG, PDF or HTML. Pages run in a sandboxed, separate-origin frame with a strict CSP: no access to DSH data and no fetch, XHR or WebSocket. Works on phones with dsh-mobile.
description.zh: 让模型把回答做成一页网页，直接放在对话里。show_page 工具可以套 8 种内置模板（报告、对比、清单、数据看板、时间线、学习卡片、测验、流程图），模型只写内容，排版、交互和保存由插件做；也可以存模型自己写的整页（计算器、小游戏、特别的版式）。自己写的页面也套上同一套设计，放在 CSS @layer 里，页面自己的样式照样盖得过它。页面按内容高度嵌在回复下面，能点能用，深浅色跟着 DSH 走。页面里的 localStorage 按页面存在 DSH 里，勾过、填过的东西重开、改出新版本都还在；同一页同时开在对话里和右侧栏，两边实时同步。改一次存一版，旧版能翻。存好后在本机一个看不见的 Chrome / Edge 里体检（脚本报错、横向溢出、深色没跟上），问题交回模型改。右侧栏看整页、翻版本、看所有做过的页面，导出 PNG / PDF / HTML。页面跑在不同源的沙箱框里，CSP 很严：读不到 DSH 的数据，也不能联网取数据。配合 dsh-mobile 手机上也能用。

description.en: The DSH app also doubles as a desktop pet: wake it with your voice, talk out loud, and give orders by speaking. Reach the DeepSeek Harness running on your own computer over LAN, your own domain, or a relay server — and chat with the little whale working in your project to put it to work. Travelling without your laptop is no longer a problem.
description.zh: DSH 的 App 端还融合了桌宠玩法：语音唤醒、随口说话、语音指挥。远程操作电脑上的 DeepSeek Harness 有三种连法——局域网、自建域名、服务器中转；也能直接和工作在项目里的小鲸鱼聊天，一句话指挥它干活。出门在外，再也不用担心没带电脑。

description.en: Colors DSH sidebar Session rows by their official status, in an Evangelion-flavored palette: a blue left rail for a row awaiting interaction, red for the session open in the main view, purple for finished-but-unviewed, and a static rainbow title for pinned rows. Every colour is mode-scoped — dark keeps the vivid stop, light takes a darker variant solved to clear 4.5:1 against the light wall — and the split reads DSH's own dark marker. Reads official Client services only: it owns no state, never polls, and ships no host-side half.
description.zh: 按官方状态给 DSH 侧栏会话行染色，配色取自福音战士：等你处理的会话为蓝色左轨，主视图打开的那条为红色左轨，已结束但未查看为紫色左轨，置顶行的标题为静态彩虹。左侧轨道按模式分档——暗档保留原色，亮档换成对浅底 ≥4.5:1 的压暗变体——分档读的是 DSH 自己的暗色标记；未读的紫色轨道两种模式共用。只读取官方 Client 服务，自身不持有状态、不轮询，也没有宿主侧代码。

description.en: Unreal Engine 4/5 (UE4, UE5) asset browser and exporter for Windows x64: browse, preview and export cooked assets from local PAK archives via CUE4Parse, with 3D mesh preview, animation playback and a searchable asset index. Oodle-compressed archives need Epic's oo2core DLL, which is not bundled but can be downloaded from the settings page.
description.zh: 虚幻引擎（Unreal Engine 4/5，UE4/UE5）资产浏览器与导出器，仅 Windows x64：通过 CUE4Parse 浏览、预览并导出本地 PAK 归档中的烘焙资产，支持模型 3D 预览、动画播放与可搜索的资产索引。Oodle 压缩的归档需要 Epic 的 oo2core DLL，包内不含，可在设置页一键下载。

description.en: A local workbench with model metrics, cost estimates, prompt presets, and optional request auditing for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供模型指标、费用估算、提示词库与可选请求审计的本地工作台。

description.en: Pins your DeepSeek Harness account balance to the bottom-right corner and refreshes it every 60 seconds, with a click for an immediate lookup.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 主界面右下角常驻账户余额，60 秒自动刷新，点击即可立即查询。

description.en: Reimplements the shut-down BSide: Olivia Lin letter API on loopback so the game client keeps sending and receiving letters: every incoming letter is delivered to one persistent DSH agent session, and the reply is written back to the local letter store.
description.zh: 在回环地址上复现已关停的《BSide: Olivia Lin》信件 API，让游戏客户端照常收发信件：每封来信投进同一个持久 DSH agent 会话，回信写回本地信件库。

description.en: Adds a logon autostart switch for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app on Windows. It manages a single shortcut in the user Startup folder: no registry writes, no admin rights, no extra background process.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版加一个登录自启开关：只管理用户启动文件夹里的一个快捷方式，不写注册表、不需要管理员权限、不额外常驻进程。

description.en: Adds a permanent Delete session action to the sidebar session menu, behind a confirmation dialog that reports the log size, running turns, subagents, background jobs and reminders bound to the session; the id is then released from the live, archive and workspace registries, so the row stays gone on refresh instead of folding back in.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话菜单中增加「永久删除会话」的操作，并附带确认对话框：对话框会说明会话日志大小，以及与该会话绑定的进行中轮次、子代理、后台任务和提醒；删除后 id 会从 live、归档与工作区登记中一并释放，因此刷新列表时该行不会复活。

description.en: Hand a local file to any program's file picker: wait for the native Open dialog, paste the path through the clipboard, read it back to verify character by character, then confirm. The target is always explicit and every step leaves evidence. Windows only (EnumWindows / UI Automation).
description.zh: 把本地文件交给任何程序的「打开文件」对话框：等对话框出现、走剪贴板填路径、读回来逐字核对、再点确认。目标必须显式给，每一步都留证据——文件上传、微信发文件、PS 打开都能用它代劳。仅 Windows（依赖 EnumWindows / UI Automation）。

description.en: Turns course, lecture, tutorial, meeting, and talk videos into structured study notes: it extracts the audio track with ffmpeg, transcribes it with Whisper, then writes notes with a chapter outline, emphasis markers, and a quick-reference card.
description.zh: 把课程、讲座、教程、会议、演讲等视频整理成结构化学习笔记：用 ffmpeg 提取音轨、Whisper 语音转文字，再生成带分段大纲、重点标记和速查卡的笔记。

description.en: Uses a dedicated model for context compaction rescue and adds manual compaction to the native context popup.
description.zh: 使用专用模型处理上下文压缩恢复，并在原生上下文弹窗提供手动压缩。

description.en: Read-only viewer for archived DSH sessions: browse the archive with workspace filtering and title/ID search, and read the transcript folded from the durable log — including messages from before a context compaction — without unarchiving.
description.zh: 已归档 DSH 会话的只读查看器：按工作区筛选、按标题/ID 搜索，不取消归档即可阅读从完整日志折出的对话——包括上下文压缩前的原文与工具调用。

description.en: Cross-workspace worker fleets: one orchestrating session spawns named worker sessions in other project workspaces, queues or steers tasks into them, watches them in the background via a real host job, and collects their reports. Worker completions deliver themselves to the orchestrator's session rather than needing to be polled, so an idle orchestrator still reacts. Escalations and failed workers deliver by steer when the orchestrator is mid-turn and by queue when it is idle; a turn that ends without a report counts as a failure and the worker is replaced after a configurable limit. The roster persists to disk and each worker session carries a durable title, so a restart neither loses the fleet nor spawns duplicate sessions. Ships five agent presets at full plugin parity with the standard preset.
description.zh: 跨工作区的多智能体工舰队：一个编排会话在其他项目工作区中创建具名的 worker 会话，向其排队或插队下发任务，以后台任务的方式监视其进度，并收集其报告。worker 完成后主动把消息投递到编排会话，无需轮询，空闲的编排器同样能及时反应。当编排器正在执行任务时，升级提问与失败通知以 steer 方式送达，空闲时以 queue 方式送达；一个回合结束时若未提交报告即判定为失败，达到阈值后自动替换该 worker。名册持久化到磁盘，且每个 worker 会话带有持久标题，重启既不会丢失工舰队，也不会产生重复会话。附带五个智能体预设，插件清单与 standard 预设完全一致。

description.en: WeChat-style screenshot: freeze the desktop, drag a region or click a window, and the crop lands in the composer. A Windows-only fork of Durandalw/dsh-plugin-screenshot; do not install it alongside the upstream plugin.
description.zh: 微信式截图：点一下冻结桌面，框选区域或单击窗口，截图直接进输入框。Windows 专用的 Durandalw/dsh-plugin-screenshot 衍生版，请勿与原版同时安装。

description.en: Deterministic network egress gate: web fetches and searches are checked against a destination allowlist in tools/pre-execute and denied before they run; shell fetch-verbs are observed (enforcement opt-in).
description.zh: 确定性网络出口门：网页抓取与搜索在 tools/pre-execute 按目的地白名单校验，越权即拒；shell 抓取动词默认观察，可选拦截。

description.en: Local-only memory guard for the DeepSeek Harness: host heap and session-log monitoring, oversized tool-argument interception, and dry-run by default session vacuum.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地内存守护插件：监控 host 堆与会话日志体积、拦截超大工具参数，并提供默认 dry-run 的会话瘦身命令。

description.en: The writable half of the right-sidebar document preview: edit and save any text file in place. Every save carries the version that was opened, so when the file changed on disk during the edit it stops and asks instead of overwriting. The preview toolbar gains an edit button and a two-step delete button. A separate File editor sidebar tool brings its own file tree: create, rename or move, copy, cut and paste (including a file taken from the system clipboard), delete, and drag to reorganize. Two renderer bands cover 107 plain-text, config and source extensions; the second is offered only as an open-with choice, leaving the shipped Markdown and highlighted-code views as the default. Mutations run through the plugin own trusted host routes, behind the connection fence, the workspace containment check and the sandbox policy.
description.zh: 右侧栏文档预览的可写一半：编辑并原地保存任意文本文件。每次保存都带上「打开时的那一版」，编辑期间磁盘上的文件被改过就停下来问，不静默覆盖；预览工具栏多出「编辑」按钮和两步确认的「删除」按钮。另有一个「文件编辑」侧栏工具，自带文件树：新建、改名 / 移动、复制 / 剪切 / 粘贴（含把系统剪贴板里的文件粘进工作区）、删除、拖拽整理。两档文档渲染器共覆盖 107 个纯文本、配置与源码扩展名，其中第二档只作为「打开方式」出现，官方 Markdown 排版与代码高亮仍是默认视图。变更走插件自己的 Host 路由，过连接信任围栏、工作区包含性检查与沙箱策略三道闸。

description.en: Kite-flying engine: while the agent codes, an animated kite drifts and sways in the wind on screen, tethered to the bottom edge of the window — the busier the agent, the denser the events and the higher it flies; ships a Weifang-style framework card deck (sand-swallow, goldfish, butterfly, bagua, dragon-head and more, hard-wing / soft-wing / flat / dimensional frames), with shape x pattern x colors all swappable data configs, and supports pasting user images onto the kite face with real-time affine transforms as the kite banks.
description.zh: 放风筝引擎：agent 编程时屏幕上放一只动画风筝——token 越多事件越密风筝飞得越高，随风漂移摆动，一根线牵在窗口底边；潍坊系框架卡组（沙燕/金鱼/蝴蝶/八卦/龙头等，硬翅软翅板式立体），形状×图案×配色全是可替换数据配置，支持把用户上传的图片糊上风筝面，贴图随风筝侧正斜的姿态实时仿射变换。

description.en: Open .blend files in the right-Sidebar document preview: cached Blender headless GLB export plus a dependency-free WebGL viewport and scene statistics. Requires Blender 3.6 or later installed locally.
description.zh: 在右侧栏文档预览里打开 .blend：Blender headless 导出缓存 GLB，零依赖 WebGL 视口与场景统计。需要本机安装 Blender 3.6 或更高版本。

description.en: Registers a janitor_scan tool that returns a deterministic, reviewable cleanup plan for session debris (plan docs, scratch scripts) with per-file verdicts and evidence; scan-only, never deletes.
description.zh: 注册 janitor_scan 工具：对会话遗留物（计划文档、临时脚本）给出确定性、可审阅的清理计划，逐文件裁决附证据；只扫描，永不删除。

description.en: Memory that outlives the session, kept as plain daily log files: one markdown file per day plus a generated index the agent greps instead of re-reading. Registers the annals skill, injects the write-it-down rules into the system prompt, and exposes three tools — annals_init builds the log directory, the index generator and a separate Git repository in one call; annals_query full-text searches past entries and returns them with file and line anchors; annals_links resolves which entry cites which. Reminds the agent once per turn when it changed files but wrote no log that day, and once more when the log was updated but the index was not. Adds a settings page for the six switches.
description.zh: 活过本次会话的记忆，载体是普通的每日日志文件：一天一个 markdown，外加一份生成出来的索引，让助手先用索引检索而不是重读全文。注册 annals 技能，把「写下来」的规矩注入系统提示词，并提供三个工具——annals_init 一次建好日志目录、索引生成器与独立的 git 仓库；annals_query 全文检索历史条目并带回文件与行号锚点；annals_links 查条目之间的双向引用。改过文件但当天没写日志时每轮提醒一次，写了日志却没更新索引时再提醒一次。另有设置页可关这六个开关。

description.en: Below 1024px the sidebar leaves the shell frame entirely and is opened as an overlay drawer from a header button, so the conversation gets the full viewport width; wider layouts are untouched.
description.zh: 視窗闊度細過 1024px 時，側欄完全移出 shell frame，改由頁首按鈕以浮動抽屜方式打開，令對話可以用盡整個螢幕闊度；闊螢幕版面唔受影響。

description.en: Records every session as one readable Markdown timeline inside the session workspace - the full request sent to the model (system prompt and plugin injections included), user input, replies, reasoning, tool calls and results, file reads and writes, web searches, skill loads, command runs and token usage - with a review page, a per-session tab and configurable capture scope.
description.zh: 把每次会话记录成会话工作区内一份可读的 Markdown 时间线——发往模型的完整请求（含系统提示词与插件注入）、用户输入、模型回复、推理过程、工具调用与结果、文件读写、联网搜索、技能加载、命令执行与 token 用量，并带审阅页、会话内标签页与可配置的采集范围。

description.en: Ship a local DSH plugin project to GitHub and the plugin market in one call: preflight, per-file upload with byte verification, the market registry PR, then pull every published file back and compare bytes.
description.zh: 一条命令把本地 DSH 插件工程发到 GitHub 并开市场收录 PR：逐文件上传带字节校验、市场条目 PR，最后把线上文件逐个拉回来比 sha256。

description.en: Connects a GitHub account to DSH from the composer button (OAuth device flow or a personal access token) and exposes one github_api tool for REST calls — create repositories, write files, read pull requests and workflow runs — with a read-only switch and an in-panel call log. A rewritten fork of Moon-shiyue/dsh-github-connect (MIT): device-flow Client IDs are no longer rejected, paths may carry query strings and non-ASCII characters, undici is no longer a hard dependency, and the panel has four tabs. Registers the same github_api tool name and the same credential namespace, so it cannot be installed alongside that plugin.
description.zh: 在对话框左下角连接你的 GitHub 账号（设备流或 Personal Access Token），提供一个 github_api 工具直接调 REST 接口——建仓库、写文件、读 PR 与 Actions，带只读开关和调用记录。改自 Moon-shiyue/dsh-github-connect（MIT）：不再拒收设备流 Client ID，路径可带查询串与非 ASCII 字符，不再硬依赖 undici，面板改成四页签。工具名 github_api 与凭据命名空间都与原插件相同，两者不能同时安装。

description.en: Draws the sidebar navigation as a compact two-column grid at every viewport; on narrow, short or coarse-pointer screens it additionally caps the navigation at 34vh with scrolling so the workspace and session history keep a 38vh floor. Also repairs dsh-resource:// records whose protocol the browser URL parser reports as empty.
description.zh: 把侧栏导航在所有视口下都重画成紧凑双列网格；窄屏、矮窗口或粗指针设备上再加一层限制——导航最高 34vh 并允许滚动，给工作区与会话历史留出 38vh 下限。同时修复浏览器把 dsh-resource:// 记录协议判空导致的资源不可用。

description.en: Checks a site safety-qualification ledger for training hours, the four required record elements, and special-operation certificate validity against the dates the person worked.
description.zh: 核对施工安全资格台账的培训学时、四个记录要素，以及特种作业证书有效期与作业时间的匹配。

description.en: Keenable web search and page fetch for the built-in web_search and web_fetch tools, working with any model and no API key.
description.zh: 为内置 web_search 与 web_fetch 工具提供 Keenable 网页搜索与网页读取，适用于任意模型，无需 API Key。

description.en: Forced collaboration: a composer picker sets 0–6 sub-agents, and while it is on every hands-on task must be split across exactly that many child agents through a collab_fanout tool that has no count parameter, then merged by the main agent.
description.zh: 强制协作：在输入框左侧选 0–6 个子 Agent，开启后每个动手的任务都必须通过没有数量参数的 collab_fanout 工具拆给正好这么多个子 Agent 并行，再由主 Agent 汇总。

description.en: Query and manage JumpServer through conversation: assets, users, accounts, permissions, sessions, command audit logs, command filters, and RBAC roles, authenticated with an AccessKeyID/AccessKeySecret pair (HTTP Signature).
description.zh: 通过对话查询与管理 JumpServer：资产、用户、账号、授权、会话、命令审计、命令过滤与 RBAC 角色，使用 AccessKeyID/AccessKeySecret（HTTP 签名）鉴权。

description.en: Brings the providers you already configured in cc-switch into DeepSeek Harness: reads the cc-switch database, converts Claude / Codex / OpenClaw / MCode / Pi entries into llm-pi-ai routes with their API keys, and adds a health check that measures time-to-first-byte and whether each stream completes.
description.zh: 把 cc-switch 里配好的模型供应商接进 DeepSeek Harness：读取 cc-switch 数据库，将 Claude / Codex / OpenClaw / MCode / Pi 等条目转成 llm-pi-ai 路由并写入 API Key，还提供实测首字节耗时与流能否正常收尾的体检。

description.en: Meta's Muse Code CLI inside DSH: a composer switch starts muse serve, a right-sidebar panel and five chat tools (muse_open, muse_prompt, muse_read, muse_status, muse_interrupt) share one Muse session, approvals are decided only in the panel, and a local spend guard hard-stops at $10 by default. Windows only; needs the Muse Code CLI installed and signed in. The $10 cap is a local estimate for the muse serve this plugin starts.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里使用 Meta 的 Muse Code CLI：输入框开关启动 muse serve，右侧边栏面板与五个聊天工具（muse_open、muse_prompt、muse_read、muse_status、muse_interrupt）共享同一个 Muse 会话，审批只能在面板里决定，本地花费护栏默认到 $10 硬停止。仅限 Windows；需已装好并登录 Muse Code CLI。$10 上限为本机估算，只管本插件启动的 muse serve。

description.en: Control a DeepSeek Harness agent from Feishu/Lark: send a task by DM, an agent runs it with your configured model and replies in the chat, and a feishu_send tool lets the agent push results. Uses lark-cli's WebSocket connection, so no public webhook is needed, and ships a resident launcher. Note: the plugin does not check who sent a message, so anyone who can DM the bot — by default, members of the Feishu tenant the app belongs to — can drive an agent running with the host's own model credentials and file permissions. Setup is not one `dsh plugin add`: `lark-cli` must be installed and authenticated once, and a Feishu self-built app with the permissions the README lists is required.
description.zh: 从飞书/Lark 操作 DeepSeek Harness：私聊发送任务，agent 用你配置的模型执行并把结果回到会话；feishu_send 工具可让 agent 主动推送结果。基于 lark-cli 的 WebSocket 长连接，无需公网 webhook，并附常驻启动器。注意：插件不校验发送者身份，因此任何能私聊到该机器人的人（默认即该飞书应用所属企业内的成员）都能驱动一个使用宿主机自身模型凭据与文件权限运行的 agent。安装不是一条 `dsh plugin add` 就完事：需要先全局安装并登录一次 `lark-cli`，并在飞书开放平台建一个带 README 所列权限的自建应用。

description.en: Turns a user goal into a plugin plan using community catalogs and author documentation, then continues through installation and task execution in one workbench with saved history and feedback.
description.zh: 从用户目标匹配社区插件并阅读作者资料，形成插件方案，在同一工作台衔接安装和任务执行，保存历史与反馈。

description.en: Connects DSH and VS Code for a Claude Code for VS Code style experience, continuing the same workspace and conversation right inside VS Code: install the DSH Coding Agent extension and the plugin discovers and connects automatically on the same Windows machine, or connect manually elsewhere by pasting the copied connection address.
description.zh: 把 DSH 和 VS Code 连接起来，提供类似 Claude Code for VS Code 的使用体验，直接在 VS Code 中接续同一工作区与同一会话：下载 VS Code 扩展 DSH Coding Agent，插件在 Windows 同机会自动发现并连接，其他平台可复制连接地址后手动连接。

description.en: Adds a Delete session item to the sidebar session-row menu; the confirmation mode is configurable (click again, confirm in a dialog, or delete immediately) and a session that is running a task is refused.
description.zh: 在侧边栏会话行菜单中加入「删除会话」项，确认方式可配置（再次点击、对话框确认或直接删除），正在执行任务的会话会被拒绝删除。

description.en: Host-side session alerts for DSH Web on Linux: tones played through the server's audio device when a turn ends, fails, or waits for approval or an answer — no browser needed.
description.zh: Linux 上 DSH Web 的宿主侧会话提醒：回合结束、出错或等待审批/回答时，服务器音频设备直接发声，无需打开浏览器。

description.en: Adds a Delete Session row to every sidebar session '...' menu (the official harness has archive/pin/rename/fork only, no durable delete). One-click Force delete ejects the session from the host live catalog, stops its background work, then removes the durable log, projection cache and registry bookkeeping - no ghost rows on any connected desktop web UI. Workspace files the session created are kept; conversation logs are permanently deleted. Third-party cloud mirrors (e.g. phone apps via Agents Anywhere) hold their own copies. Bilingual zh/en UI, trust-fenced local route. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.1.
description.zh: 给侧边栏每个会话的"…"菜单加上"删除会话"（官方只有归档/置顶/重命名/分叉，无持久 删除）。一键「强制删除」：逐出宿主内存态会话、停止后台工作后，彻底清除会话日志、 投影缓存与注册表记账，已连接的桌面 Web 端即时清行、不留幽灵。会话生成的工作区文件 保留，对话记录永久删除；第三方云端镜像（如经 Agents Anywhere 同步的手机 App）持有 各自副本、需在其 App 内管理。中英双语界面，本地回环路由带信任栅栏。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.1。

description.en: Manage skins, themes, backgrounds, and widgets in separate layers and save appearance presets for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 分层管理皮肤、主题、背景与装饰件，并保存和应用整套外观方案。

description.en: Prompt enhancement: click the star button in the composer to have the current model rewrite the draft more clearly, with one click back to the original; the template is editable.
description.zh: 增强提示词：点击发送框的星形按钮，用当前模型把草稿改写得更清晰，可一键切回原文；模板可编辑。

description.en: Renders the open conversation's Mermaid diagrams as a right-sidebar page, one card per diagram, each clickable to open full screen with zoom and pan; the chat's own code block is left untouched, so copying or quoting the source still works.
description.zh: 把当前对话里的 Mermaid 图表渲染成右侧栏的一个页面，一图一卡片；点击卡片可全屏查看并缩放、拖动，对话里的原始代码块保持不动，因此复制或引用源码照常可用。
