description.en: Closes right-sidebar tabs with a middle click or a left double click, reusing the built-in close button so the native rules (such as the last docked guide card being unclosable) still apply.
description.zh: 右侧栏标签页支持鼠标中键关闭与左键双击关闭，关闭动作复用原生 × 按钮，原生规则（例如唯一停靠的 guide 卡片关不掉）保持不变。

description.en: Turns PDF, Word, PowerPoint and Excel files into Markdown or plain text with heading levels preserved where the source allows it, and refuses scanned PDFs that have no text layer instead of writing an empty file, naming the OCR alternative instead. Requires Python 3.10+ and pip install -r requirements.
description.zh: 把 PDF、Word、PPT、Excel 转成保留标题层级的 Markdown 或纯文本；遇到没有文字层的扫描件会主动拒绝（退出码 2），不会写一个空文件骗过下游，并指明可改用 OCR（dsh-scan2md）。需 Python 3.10+ 并安装仓库 requirements。

description.en: Click a delivered-file card to open the file with the system default application instead of DSH's built-in sidebar preview; hold Shift to keep the original preview.
description.zh: 点击交付文件卡片时用系统默认程序打开文件，而不是在 DSH 侧边栏里预览；按住 Shift 保留原来的预览行为。

description.en: Declares a spec-driven development agent preset with a Chinese persona and four static Claude Code/Codex delegation tools for planning, implementation, review and knowledge distillation; roles are prompt-guided, not an automatic state machine.
description.zh: 声明规范驱动研发预设，包含中文人格与四个 Claude Code/Codex 静态委派工具，用于规划、实现、审查与知识提炼；角色由提示词引导，并非自动状态机。

description.en: Reads assistant replies aloud with Microsoft Edge neural voices and highlights the sentence being spoken, so you can follow along while listening. The highlight is yours to style: background colour, text colour and opacity are each adjustable in settings. Also adds a sound-wave play button to every reply, pause plus previous and next sentence, adjustable speed, and an auto-read toggle.
description.zh: 用微软 Edge 神经音色朗读助手回复，并高亮当前正在朗读的那一句，可以边听边看。高亮样式完全自定义：底色、文字颜色、浓淡三样都能在设置里调。另外每条回复下方有音浪播放键、暂停与上句/下句跳转、语速调节和自动朗读开关。

description.en: Adds a reforge control to the DSH composer that rewrites the current draft into a sharper prompt in place, as one undoable edit, with one-click revert and cancellation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框工具栏加一个「重铸」按钮，把当前草稿就地改写成更精准的提示词——整段替换只占一步撤销，可一键恢复原文，也可中途取消。

description.en: A time module in the DSH session header: current time, time since your last message, reminders, and countdowns. Pure browser-side - data lives in localStorage and the host half registers nothing. Alerts are a border glow plus an in-app toast; no system notifications.
description.zh: DSH 会话头部的时间模块：现在时间、距你上次发言、提醒与倒计时。纯前端插件——数据存浏览器 localStorage，host 半不注册任何东西；到点提示是边框呼吸灯加界面浮条，不发系统通知。

description.en: Single/multi-line composer toggle for the DSH Web GUI: an editable shortcut (registered through the harness shortcut service) — Cmd/Ctrl+E on desktop builds and Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+E in the browser, with Linux browsers unbound until you pick one — switches the composer between its native single-line shape and a four-line-plus draft area; a small tab on the composer shoulder always shows the current shortcut and target mode; while multi-line, Enter inserts a newline and Shift+Enter sends, and the mode is remembered per device.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框单行/多行切换：通过官方快捷键服务注册的可编辑快捷键（桌面版默认 Cmd/Ctrl+E，浏览器版默认 Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+E，Linux 浏览器默认未绑定） 在原生单行输入框与至少四行的多行输入框之间切换；输入框上沿的小 tab 常驻显示当前快捷键与目标模式；多行时 Enter 换行、Shift+Enter 发送，模式按设备记忆。

description.en: Read-only DSH profile doctor: the seven config-tree checks (config-clobber, dead-patch, tool-collision, plugin-not-mounted, plugin-stale, entry diff, explain) plus eight ecosystem checks learned from real failures — pnpm store version conflicts that break `dsh plugin add`, patch insert names node_modules cannot resolve, broken junctions, duplicate-capability plugins, orphan backup dirs, GitHub-source deps, npm publish-scope hints, and the minimumReleaseAgeExclude gap. Four agent tools; every finding carries its fix.
description.zh: 只读的 DSH profile 医生：配置树七检（patch 丢字段、死 patch、工具重名、装了没挂载、停更、树 diff、组成解释）加八项生态检查——pnpm store 版本冲突（`dsh plugin add` 报 ERR_PNPM_UNEXPECTED_STORE 的根因）、patch insert 指向不存在的包、断裂的 junction、重复能力插件、孤儿 backup 目录、GitHub 源依赖、npm 发布权限提示、minimumReleaseAgeExclude 缺口。四个 agent 工具，每条 finding 都带修复文案。

description.en: Restores the DSH right sidebar divider drag after whole-interface zoom shifts the host handle off it, and widens the hit area to 12px with a hover affordance.
description.zh: 修复整页缩放后右侧栏拖拽手柄偏移、分割线拖不动的问题，把命中区加宽到 12px 并显示悬停提示线。

description.en: Installs and verifies the reverse-engineering engines REA needs on Windows (Ghidra, JADX, apktool, adb, WABT, frida and more), pins the rea-agents MCP server version, and reports capability gaps in a settings card.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上安装并校验 REA 所需的逆向引擎（Ghidra、JADX、apktool、adb、WABT、frida 等），固定 rea-agents 的 MCP 服务版本，并在设置卡片里体检能力缺口。

description.en: Restart initiated by the agent itself, not by a button. The agent calls one tool, then the plugin takes over: it waits until every agent and background job on the host is idle, runs a visible ten-second countdown that a click, a scroll, or a key press cancels, then restarts DSH and wakes the original session so the agent carries on from its last sentence. No button, no manual entry: the tool is the only way in. Works on the official desktop app and the official web client; third-party shells are not supported out of the box. Windows only.
description.zh: 由 agent 自己发起的重启，不是按钮。agent 调一个工具，之后由插件接管：等这台机器上所有 agent 与后台任务都空闲，走完十秒可见倒计时（点一下鼠标、滚一下滚轮、按任意键都会取消），再重启 DSH，并唤醒原会话让 agent 接着说下去。没有按钮、没有手动入口——工具是唯一入口。官方桌面端与官方网页端均已适配，第三方壳不在默认支持范围内。仅限 Windows。

description.en: A composer-dock wallet pill for DeepSeek Harness that shows the account balance behind DEEPSEEK_API_KEY and opens a panel with the peak/off-peak billing window, a live switch countdown, and per-model token prices.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的余额胶囊：在输入框下方显示 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 对应账户的余额，点开可查看峰谷计费时段、切换倒计时与各模型价目表。

description.en: Open STL meshes in the right-Sidebar document preview: browser-side binary/ASCII parsing, a WebGL viewport, and size/volume/surface-area/watertightness statistics.
description.zh: 在右侧栏文档预览里打开 STL：浏览器解析二进制/ASCII，WebGL 视口 + 尺寸/体积/表面积/水密统计。

description.en: Runs one-night werewolf games inside DSH: deterministic dealing, night order, card swaps, voting and settlement, with a room UI and private night prompts. It vendors modified copies of baixianger/dsh-chat and baixianger/dsh-bridge; uninstall those two first, because enabling both registers the same dshChat/dshBridge services.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里组织《新版一夜狼人杀》：确定性发牌、夜序、换卡、投票与结算，自带房间界面与夜间私聊提示。包内是 baixianger/dsh-chat 与 baixianger/dsh-bridge 的修改版快照；请先卸载这两个上游插件，同时启用会重复注册 dshChat / dshBridge 服务。

description.en: Goal Map shows a read-only goal-to-plan progress route, session mindmap and step list using reported plan progress, without starting tasks or model calls. Beta.2 supports DSH Web 0.2.0-rc.2 or 0.2.1-rc.2, with Node.js >=24.
description.zh: 目标进展图以只读流程图展示目标到计划的进展路线、会话思维导图与步骤列表，按已报告计划计算进度，不启动任务或模型调用。Beta.2 支持 DSH Web 0.2.0-rc.2 或 0.2.1-rc.2、Node.js >=24。

description.en: WeChat Official Account pipeline: validate a draft against a publish gate, then push it into the draft box.
description.zh: 公众号发布管线：先按发布闸门校验草稿，再推送到草稿箱。

description.en: Five warm, low blue-light color themes that retint the whole DSH interface, including the sidebar, popups and shadows, without touching layout.
description.zh: 五套低蓝光暖色配色，整体重着色 DSH 界面（含侧栏、浮层与阴影），零布局改动，卸载即还原。

description.en: Beta 0.2.0-beta.2 for DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 only, for Host-owner use. Search original user and assistant text in the current session or same-directory workspace, with source coordinates and context. Non-owner session authorization is not supported.
description.zh: 0.2.0-beta.2 仅支持 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2，面向宿主所有者使用。在当前会话或同目录工作区搜索用户与助手原文，查看来源坐标和上下文；不支持非所有者身份的会话级授权。

description.en: Drive a browser from one natural-language goal: a decision service picks the next operation and target from an indexed element table, so a DSH session spends one tool call instead of one turn per click.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 一句话目标：决策服务从带编号的元素表里挑出下一步操作与目标元素，驱动真实浏览器把事办完，一趟多步任务只花一次工具调用。

description.en: API regression and acceptance workbench: snapshot the responses of the endpoints you register before the agent edits the backend, rerun them all after the edit, and review a structured field-level diff (status codes, added and removed fields, numeric old → new values with the delta) beside the captured source diff, accepting each endpoint one by one before exporting a Markdown or single-file HTML report.
description.zh: 接口回归验收台：登记端点后先快照响应基线，模型改完后端一键重跑，把结构化字段级差异（状态码、字段增删、数值新旧值与差值）与源码 diff 并排展示，逐项验收后再导出 Markdown / 单文件 HTML 报告。

description.en: Let a pet whale girl browse Bilibili on her own: she picks videos, reads subtitles, posts comments and moments once you allow it, and writes daily digests with optional local video production. Maintained fork of c1overzz/dsh-bili-scroll (MIT) with per-action permissions, memories, stickers and local video production added; it registers the same bili_* tool names as the upstream, so the two cannot be installed together. Video production needs Python 3.11-3.13 (or uv); the media dependencies are installed on first use.
description.zh: 让桌宠鲸鱼娘自主刷 B站：自己搜片、读字幕原文，经你允许后发评论、发动态，并写日报、做视频。c1overzz/dsh-bili-scroll（MIT）的维护分支，新增逐项授权、记忆、表情与本地视频制作；与上游注册同名的 bili_* 工具，不能与 dsh-bili-scroll 同装。视频制作需要 Python 3.11–3.13（或 uv），首次使用时自动安装媒体依赖。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-deepmoyu
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-deepmoyu

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: OpenFOAM case doctor for DeepSeek-Harness. Six agent tools: audit a case for 25 classes of silent failure (steadyState paired with timeStep writes, limiters set to 1 that let k/epsilon go negative, unbounded advection of transport scalars, nNonOrthogonalCorrectors 0 on a skewed mesh, loose solver tolerances, blockMesh vertex/block mismatch, stray time directories, purgeWrite 0); read any dictionary as JSON; survey a sweep of cases; run checkMesh/blockMesh/snappyHexMesh/foamRun inside WSL with log parsing; parse logs into the metrics that matter (aspect ratio, non-orthogonality, skewness, residual floor, fatal errors). Deterministic text analysis — no LLM — validated against a real 82k-cell street-canyon snappy case.
description.zh: DeepSeek-Harness 的 OpenFOAM 算例医生。六个 agent 工具：体检算例的 25 类静默错误（steadyState 配 timeStep 写出海量时间目录、限幅器设 1 导致 k/epsilon 变负、输运标量无界对流、斜网格上非正交修正为 0、求解容差过松、blockMesh 顶点/块不匹配、残留时间目录、purgeWrite 0）；把任意字典读成 JSON；扫描参数化扫描目录；在 WSL 里跑 checkMesh/blockMesh/snappyHexMesh/foamRun 并解析日志；把日志解成关键指标（长宽比、非正交度、扭曲度、残差地板、致命错误）。纯确定性文本分析，不调 LLM，已在一台真机的 8.2 万单元格街道峡谷 snappy 算例上验证。

description.en: Hot-swap the outbound proxy in dsh between direct, system, and saved proxies without restarting.
description.zh: 在 dsh 运行过程中热切换出站代理（直连/系统/自定义），无需重启即可生效

description.en: A fork of Microsoft's official .NET/C# skills for AI coding agents, additionally packaged as a DeepSeek Harness plugin — covering development, testing, diagnostics, migration, and AI integration.
description.zh: 微软官方 .NET/C# AI 编码智能体技能的 fork，额外打包为 DeepSeek Harness 插件——覆盖开发、测试、诊断、迁移与 AI 集成。

description.en: DSH Desktop workbench for official MATLAB MCP experiments, verified PNG figures, MATLAB-computed metrics, and PID parameter sweep comparisons. Requires Windows, a MATLAB license and the separately installed official MATLAB MCP Server.
description.zh: 在 DSH Desktop 中通过官方 MATLAB MCP 执行实验，校验 PNG 图像及 MATLAB 计算指标，并比较 PID 参数扫描结果。需要 Windows、MATLAB 授权，以及另行安装的官方 MATLAB MCP Server。

description.en: Multi-agent Chinese debate simulator with eight debaters, live two-column discussion and draft notes, judges and scoreboard, single-side clocks, per-round ZIP archives, a training side with a configurable end condition (win-rate threshold or fixed rounds), and a Word prep package.
description.zh: 多智能体中文辩论模拟：8 名辩手、实时双栏讨论与草稿纸、评委计分、单边计时、每轮 ZIP 归档、训练方可选胜率阈值或固定轮次收官，并生成 Word 备赛包。

description.en: Connect DeepSeek Harness Web to MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle and MongoDB for schema discovery and read-only queries through session-authorized MCP tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 数据库插件：统一管理 MySQL、MariaDB、PostgreSQL、SQL Server、Oracle 和 MongoDB 连接，让 Agent 按会话授权探索数据结构、执行只读查询并辅助数据分析。

description.en: Self-maintained DSH web task board with a human acceptance gate, card kinds and editable notes on executed cards.
description.zh: 自维护的 DSH 网页任务看板：带人工验收闸门、卡片类型与已执行卡片的可编辑备注。

description.en: Choose API hostnames from configured providers or add them manually to route matching DSH backend Fetch/Undici requests through an existing local HTTP(S) proxy, leaving other routes unchanged; optional in-memory records show actual dispatch paths, first-content wait, token throughput and usage without storing prompts, responses or API keys.
description.zh: 从已配置的 Provider 选择 API 域名或手动添加，让命中的 DSH 后端 Fetch/Undici 请求通过已有本机 HTTP(S) 代理，其他请求沿用原有路线；可选开启内存调用记录，查看实际分发路线、首内容等待、token 速度与用量，不保存提示词、回答或 API Key。

description.en: Tencent Yuanbao Search provider for the ctx.web seam: one direct Search API request per query returns portable title, URL, snippet and ISO-8601 date, with credentials resolved per search and no auxiliary model turn. Requires a Tencent Cloud WSA API key.
description.zh: 为 ctx.web 接入腾讯元宝搜索：每次查询只发一次直接检索请求，返回标题、URL、摘要与 ISO-8601 日期，凭证按每次搜索解析，不产生辅助模型轮次；需腾讯云 WSA API Key。

description.en: Generative background music while the model streams, plus completion, approval and attention chimes: hear whether the agent is thinking, still working, or waiting for you without watching the screen.
description.zh: 模型输出时演奏生成式背景音乐，完成、审批与等待操作各有独立提示音：不盯屏幕也能听出 Agent 在思考、仍在工作还是在等你。

description.en: Conflict diagnosis and repair for DeepSeek Harness plugins. Builds a capability graph of the running Loader profile and of the on-disk cordis.patch.yml layers, comparing imports, peer ranges and config against the host that is ACTUALLY running rather than the profile's possibly-stale copies, and reports the conflicts that fail silently: a fiber stuck PENDING on a service no plugin provides, a browser half injecting a client module nothing provides, a tool id two plugins both register, duplicate Loader entry ids, a row disabled by one layer and re-inserted by another, an import of a host subpath the running host does not export, and a cycle among inject declarations. Every finding carries its evidence, a confidence grade for who owns a name, and a repair with a risk grade — verify it with a dry-run difference table, or take the individual .patch.yml files that --fix-out writes (never auto-loaded, so picking wrong breaks nothing).
description.zh: DSH 插件冲突诊断与修复建议。把运行期能力图谱与磁盘上的 cordis.patch.yml 层对齐，并与真正在运行的宿主（而不是 profile 里可能过期的副本）比对导入、peer 范围与配置，检出那些不会自己报错的静默故障：卡在 PENDING 等待无人提供的服务、浏览器半区注入了无人提供的客户端模块、两个插件注册同一个 tool id、Loader entry id 重复、某层停用又被后一层重新插入的行、导入了运行宿主未通过 exports 暴露的子路径、以及 inject 声明之间成环。每条结论都带证据、归属置信度与带风险分级的修复：用 --dry-run 在内存里试修并看修改前后差异，或用 --fix-out 拿到独立的 .patch.yml 文件自己挑（这些文件不会被 DSH 加载，挑错也不影响运行）。

description.en: A /agentinit command that builds, repairs or audits a repository's AGENTS.md inside a subagent: the child reads the method file itself and checks every command and path it writes with the bundled read-only checker, so no instruction body enters the main conversation. The bundled checker is a Python script, so Python 3 must be on PATH.
description.zh: /agentinit 命令：在子代理里生成、修订或审计仓库的 AGENTS.md。方法文档由子代理自己读取，写下的每条命令与路径都用随包的只读检查器核验，主对话不进入任何指令正文。随包的检查器是 Python 脚本，需要 Python 3 在 PATH 中。

description.en: Send local files to WeChat from any DSH session by reusing an installed IM plugin, plus cron-scheduled tasks that run in fresh sessions, a workspace activity glow, a header activity indicator, a completion chime, a macOS sidebar vibrancy toggle and a one-click host restart.
description.zh: 在任意 DSH 会话把本机文件主动投递到微信（复用已装的 IM 插件），另有按 cron 在全新会话里跑的定时任务、工作区活动呼吸灯、标题栏活跃指示、对话完成提示音、关闭 macOS 侧栏毛玻璃与一键重启宿主。

description.en: Keeps the DSH host awake during active tasks using native power assertions and releases them when tasks finish.
description.zh: 在任务运行期间通过原生电源断言保持 DSH 主机亮屏与唤醒，并在任务结束后释放。

description.en: DeepSeek API wallet balance in the composer dock with a popover showing topped-up and granted credit, the refresh time, and usage and top-up links, plus a /balance command and an api_balance tool; the Host reads a signed-in account wallet or the DEEPSEEK_API_KEY credential, so the browser only receives amounts.
description.zh: 输入框下方常驻 DeepSeek API 余额胶囊，点开显示充值额度、赠送额度、更新时间与用量/充值链接，另有 /balance 命令与 api_balance 工具；凭据只留在 Host（已登录账户钱包或 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY），浏览器只拿到金额。

description.en: In-place HTML document preview annotation: pick elements, leave notes saved per file, send batches to the conversation, and let the agent apply changes directly.
description.zh: HTML 文档预览就地批注插件：点选元素写批注，按文件保存批注，可整批发送到当前对话，由 Agent 直接修改源文件。

description.en: Multi-agent meeting negotiation over the LAN: each person runs their own assistant, and assistants find each other via mDNS and negotiate meetings, weekend outings and bubble tea votes through A2A messages. They share only availability (never the reasons) and ask the owner before giving up protected time. Ships a phone-style page in the DSH sidebar and a 13-person sample company. No authentication; trusted LANs only.
description.zh: 局域网多智能体会议协商：每人一个助理，助理通过 mDNS 互相发现，用 A2A 报文协商排会、周末团建和奶茶投票。对外只给忙闲不说原因，占用本人保护的时段前先问本人。DSH 侧栏自带手机样式页面和 13 人示例公司。无鉴权，仅限可信局域网。

description.en: Sends desktop notifications and custom HTTP pushes when tasks finish or need your attention.
description.zh: 在任务结束或需要处理时发送桌面通知和自定义 HTTP 推送。

description.en: Change impact analysis plugin that lifts a code change into an evidence-backed impact and verification plan (CHANGE-IMPACT.md + change-impact.json): affected modules, entry points and public exports, risk levels with factors and confidence, and recommended verification commands (read-only, never runs repository commands). Only read-only git queries (rev-parse, diff, status) are run; suggested verification commands are never executed.
description.zh: 变更影响分析插件：把一次代码变更升级为有证据支撑的影响与验证计划（CHANGE-IMPACT.md + change-impact.json）：受影响模块、入口与公开导出、带因子与置信度的风险分级、建议验证命令（只读，不执行仓库命令）。只会执行 rev-parse、diff、status 等只读 git 查询，建议的验证命令不会被执行。

description.en: Engineering checklists distilled from Gillespie's Fundamentals of Vehicle Dynamics: 164 cards over the book's ten chapters, one skill entry with two-level routing. Each card gives the inputs a computation needs, the procedure, the boundary conditions where the method stops being valid, and a page reference — the explanation itself stays in the book. No passage of the book's prose is reproduced; about 77 defects in the source (misprints, OCR damage, internal contradictions) are documented in the cards. A study aid, not a substitute for the book.
description.zh: 把 Gillespie《车辆动力学基础》整本书做成工程检查单：十章 164 张卡，单一入口两级路由。每张卡给出所需输入、执行步骤、方法失效的边界条件，以及回查用的页码——原理讲解仍在原书里。不复制原书任何连续段落；卡内记录了约 77 处原文缺陷（错印、OCR 损坏、前后矛盾）。本包是学习辅助，不能替代原书。

description.en: Thesis and empirical-analysis workbench that drives IBM SPSS from the conversation: spss_check (environment self-check), spss_variables (list .sav variables with labels, types, measurement levels, case counts), spss_data (sample case rows to inspect missing and outlying values), spss_run / spss_run_file (execute SPSS syntax or an .sps file, relative CD and GET FILE paths auto-rebased), and spss_analyze (one-shot frequencies, descriptives, crosstabs with chi-square, t-tests, one-way ANOVA, correlation, linear regression). Results come back as structured tables extracted through OMS. SPSS 25-31 is auto-detected; the bundled MCP server is zero-dependency stdio.
description.zh: 论文/实证分析工作台：在对话里直接驱动 IBM SPSS。spss_check（环境自检）、spss_variables（列出 .sav 变量：名称/标签/类型/测度水平/案例数）、spss_data（抽查案例数据，检查缺失与异常值）、spss_run 与 spss_run_file（执行 SPSS 语法或 .sps 文件，自动修正 CD / GET FILE 相对路径）、spss_analyze（一键跑频数、描述统计、交叉表卡方、t 检验、单因素方差、相关、线性回归）。结果经 OMS 导出为结构化表格。自动探测 SPSS 25-31；内置 MCP server 为零依赖 stdio 服务。

description.en: Client theme plugin for the DSH Web GUI: a fluid background, frosted glass panels and quantised shader effects, with 100 adjustable parameters persisted to a JSON file.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 客户端主题插件：流体背景、毛玻璃面板与量子化着色器效果，100 项参数可调并持久化到 JSON 文件。

description.en: Observes consecutive identical tool failures and optionally pauses before the next model step, preserving original results and successful repeats, with an in-chat report in DSH Web.
description.zh: 监视连续相同的工具失败，可在下一个模型步之前选择暂停；保留原始结果与成功的重复调用，并在 DSH Web 里出一份会话内报告。

description.en: Adds a line-based copy tool for replacing or inserting file sections, with indentation control and diff previews.
description.zh: 提供按行复制工具，可替换或插入文件片段，并支持缩进控制和 diff 预览。

description.en: Stripe Style theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a 40px purple grid, layered soft shadows, 12px cards, an 8px control scale, and an in-settings theme row with Daylight Violet and Midnight Navy palettes plus one-click factory restore.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 的 Stripe 风格主题：40px 紫色网格、多级柔和阴影、12px 卡片与 8px 控件圆角，设置页内可直接切换「白昼紫 / 午夜蓝」双版本，并可一键恢复出厂外观。

description.en: Adds a live status badge to the session header and delivers guidance added mid-task without interrupting the turn.
description.zh: 在会话头显示实时状态徽标，并在不打断当前回合的前提下投递运行中新增的指导。

description.en: Adds a General settings row choosing where the Add-workspace directory picker opens: a fixed custom path (typed, pasted, or picked visually) or the last directory you confirmed. Quoted and CJK paths are accepted, and a This PC level reaches other Windows drives.
description.zh: 在通用设置中新增一行，控制点击"添加工作区"时目录选择框从哪里打开：固定自定义路径（可输入、粘贴或可视化选取），或上次确认的目录。容忍带引号与中文路径，并提供「此电脑」层以跨盘选择。

description.en: Tree-style questioning for DSH: click "Ask in tree" on a selection to add a node to the right-sidebar tree and ask inline under it; clicking another node makes it the current parent, so later selections nest there, Alt+click opens a root node, Ctrl+click appends another passage to the same node, double-click jumps back to the quoted text, a red/green dot marks each node as understood or not, and the panel switches between a list view and a horizontal branch graph. "Add to composer" instead puts the quote into the input box as a reference chip, without creating a node. Nodes live in localStorage and nothing is injected into the prompt.
description.zh: 对话里划取文字后点「树形提问」，右栏问题树就多一个节点，问题直接写在节点下；单击别的节点就把它设为当前节点，之后再划取默认挂在它下面，「Alt + 树形提问」新开根节点，「Ctrl + 树形提问」把新段落追加进同一节点；双击节点跳回原文，点左侧圆点标记「懂了」；右上角可在列表与横向分支图之间切换。划取后点「添加到对话」则把引用以 chip 形式插进输入框，不建节点。节点只存在 localStorage，不进提示词。

description.en: Classic 25/5/15 pomodoro timer for DSH that ties each run to the current session task or a manual project name, with a stats panel, a 365-day heatmap, a draggable floating timer and a corner pill, local JSON storage, and CSV export.
description.zh: DSH 番茄钟：经典 25/5/15 计时，可将每次专注关联当前会话任务或手动输入项目名，内置统计面板与全年热力图，配可拖动悬浮计时卡与角落迷你药丸，数据本地持久化并支持导出 CSV。

description.en: Windows only. Prompts to restart DSH after a plugin install, update or uninstall, restarts it in one click without any console window, and shows a per-file diff of what changed.
description.zh: 仅 Windows。DSH 插件变动后提示重启，一键静默重启（全程无命令提示符窗口），并可展开本次改动的逐行差异。

description.en: Task-list staleness guard for DeepSeek Harness: watches the session event stream and counts tool calls since the last todo_write; past a configurable threshold it appends one short notice before the next step, quoting the current list, so the model writes it back to the real progress instead of leaving a stale snapshot on screen. Pure prompt injection, no blocking and no data mutation.
description.zh: 任务清单陈旧度守卫：监听会话事件流，统计上一次 todo_write 之后又发生了多少次工具调用；超过可配置阈值时在下一步之前追加一条简短提醒，并附上当前清单内容，让模型把清单写回真实进度，而不是在界面上留一份过期的快照。纯提示注入，不阻断流程，也不改动任何数据。

description.en: Service farm for DSH: register, start, stop and restart long-running project services, with agent tools (farm_status/start/stop/restart/logs/register), farm.yaml declarations and an overview drawer UI with live log follow, search and export.
description.zh: DSH 服务农场：注册、启动、停止、重启长驻项目服务，提供 agent 工具（farm_status/start/stop/restart/logs/register）与 farm.yaml 声明式服务，总览抽屉支持按工作区分组、实时日志 follow、搜索与导出。

description.en: Shows per-turn, per-session and per-workspace conversation costs in CNY, priced by DeepSeek's official tiers with peak/off-peak hours and per-request Search/Fetch billing.
description.zh: 按 DeepSeek 官方价目显示每轮、每会话与每工作区的对话费用人民币金额，支持峰谷分时与 Search/Fetch 按次计费。

description.en: Drag files and folders from the sidebar Files pane into the message composer. A dropped file becomes an inline chip inside the sentence, an uploaded attachment card, or a plain @ path, switchable in Settings.
description.zh: 把右侧文件区的文件和文件夹拖进输入框：落下的文件变成句中内嵌的小卡片、附件卡片或 @ 路径，可在设置里切换。

description.en: Training Lens opens a local TensorBoard scalar dashboard with selectable metrics, explicit improvement direction, optional EMA smoothing and Chinese/English UI; requires an existing Python environment with TensorBoard.
description.zh: Training Lens · 训练视窗通过 DSH 工具打开本地 TensorBoard 标量监控页面，支持指标选择、改善方向、EMA 平滑和中英文界面；需要已有的 Python 与 TensorBoard 环境。

description.en: Split the DSH conversation area into unlimited native panes — side by side, stacked, 2×2 and an automatic grid — each a real session with its own composer, streaming and approvals.
description.zh: 把 DSH 对话区拆成任意数量的原生窗格：左右、上下、田字 2×2 与自动网格，每个窗格都是独立会话。

description.en: Reverse-engineering workbench: bridges a local IDA Pro into DeepSeek Harness through @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client, exposing the ida-pro-mcp toolset (decompile, xref, rename, comment) as mcp__ida__* tools. Auto-selects idalib headless mode (analyses a binary in-process, no IDA GUI) or GUI mode (connects to the IDA plugin RPC on port 13337). Adds re_check, re_open and re_status; the bundled MCP server is a zero-dependency stdio proxy usable from any MCP client.
description.zh: 逆向分析工作台：通过 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 把本机 IDA Pro 桥接进 DSH，将 ida-pro-mcp 工具集（反编译、xref、重命名、注释）以 mcp__ida__* 注册给模型。自动选择 idalib 无头模式（进程内分析二进制，无需打开 IDA GUI）或 GUI 模式（连接 IDA 插件 RPC，默认 13337 端口）。附带 re_check、re_open、re_status 三个工具；内置 MCP server 为零依赖 stdio 代理，任意 MCP 客户端可直接挂载。

description.en: Neo-brutalist theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with paper and ink palettes, 4px hard rules, 8px offset shadows, zero radius, hazard stripes, and an in-settings theme row that restores the factory appearance.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的新粗野主义主题：白纸 / 黑板双配色，4px 硬边、8px 偏移硬阴影、零圆角、警示斜纹，设置页内置主题行，可一键切回出厂外观。

description.en: Strict workflow document viewer and lifecycle driver for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中查看和驱动严格规范与工作流文档的插件。

description.en: Adds a session_rename tool so an AI can retitle the DeepSeek Harness session it is running in.
description.zh: 新增 session_rename 工具，让 AI 能重命名自己所在的 DSH 会话。

description.en: Adds a Plan/Build mode toggle to the composer, switched with the Tab key or a toolbar button, and remembers a separate model for each mode from the native model selector.
description.zh: 在输入框中提供 Plan/Build 模式切换：按 Tab 键或点击工具栏按钮即可切换，并按模式分别记住右侧原生模型选择器中所选的模型。

description.en: Search public-domain libraries (Project Gutenberg, Wikisource, Internet Archive, Standard Ebooks) by title, author, character or half-remembered plot, or import EPUB / PDF / TXT / DOCX / Markdown, and listen in the sidebar with Microsoft Edge neural voices, offline Kokoro or the device voices; keeps your position, takes voice notes anchored to what you just heard, and discusses the book with your DSH model.
description.zh: 搜书听：按书名、作者、角色名或大概情节搜公版书（古腾堡、中英文维基文库、Internet Archive、Standard Ebooks），或导入 EPUB / PDF / TXT / DOCX / Markdown，在右侧栏用微软 Edge 神经网络语音、离线 Kokoro 或设备自带语音读给你听；自动记住听到哪，能语音记读书心得、和 AI 聊刚听到的内容。

description.en: Session-scoped research evidence ledger with sources, linked claims, open questions, and explicit user review; provides a tool, slash command, and conversation panel, with selected-claim Markdown export that omits excerpts, review notes, and local paths by default; does not fetch sources or verify their truth.
description.zh: 会话级研究证据账本，整理来源、关联论点、待解问题与用户明确复核；提供工具、斜杠命令和会话面板，可按论点选择导出 Markdown，默认省略摘录、复核备注与本地路径；不抓取来源或判断内容真伪。

description.en: Rewrites the New Session hero headline with a short greeting written by the model the session already uses, from the local time, the current city and the live weather; falls back to a local time-based greeting when no model is reachable.
description.zh: 用新会话已选定的模型，按当地时间、城市与实时天气写一句简短问候，替换首屏标题；没有可用模型时退回本地按小时计算的问候。

description.en: Live decode speed (tok/s) pill in the composer status bar that tracks the currently streaming response.
description.zh: 在输入栏状态栏中实时显示当前流式响应解码速度（tok/s）的插件。

description.en: Rewrites the draft in the DSH composer into a clearer, more executable prompt through the harness's own LLM routes, showing an original/optimized comparison before you adopt it.
description.zh: 把 DSH 输入框里的草稿通过 harness 自身的 LLM 路由改写成更清晰、更可执行的提示词，采纳前先显示原文与优化后的对比。

description.en: Better Right-Click: right-click menu on file references in the DSH transcript. Copies the absolute path, reveals the file selected in Explorer by reusing and focusing an existing window, and lists every app registered for that file type so you can open it with the one you want. Menu labels follow the DSH display language (Chinese and English). Windows only (Explorer reveal and the registered-apps list use PowerShell).
description.zh: 给正文里的文件引用加右键菜单：复制绝对路径、在资源管理器中定位并选中文件（复用已打开的窗口并置前）、以及列出本机所有能打开该类型文件的程序让你自己选。菜单文案跟随 DSH 界面语言（中文/英文自动切换）。仅 Windows（资源管理器定位与程序列表依赖 PowerShell）。

description.en: Annotate replies and documents for the next message, edit past user messages and rerun from that point, and use keyboard shortcuts to navigate user messages or recall previous inputs in the composer.
description.zh: 为回复和文档添加随下一条消息发送的注释，编辑历史用户消息并从该处重新执行，使用快捷键浏览用户消息或在输入框调出历史输入。

description.en: Adds Alt+Enter as a newline to the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web composer.
description.zh: 给 dsh 的网页输入框加上 Alt+Enter 换行。

description.en: Codex-style keyboard answers for the pending command-approval panel — 1 allows once, 2 rejects, Enter confirms the highlighted choice, arrow keys move it, and Esc rejects, with the buttons still usable by mouse.
description.zh: 审批面板的 Codex 风格键盘应答：按 1 允许一次、2 拒绝、回车确认高亮项、方向键切换高亮、Esc 拒绝，鼠标点按依旧可用。

description.en: Read-only writing-workspace panel for projects that contain a .writing-anything/ workspace: per-work overview cards, a unit tree, YAML artifact views as semantic cards or highlighted source, the source list and the decision/review queues, and in-panel unit review whose feedback is written back by wa-cli.
description.zh: writing-anything 工作区的只读写作面板：作品总览卡片、单元树、YAML 产物的语义卡片与源码高亮视图、素材清单与决策／复核清单，以及面板内单元审阅（反馈经 wa-cli 写回）。

description.en: Three-layer memory for DeepSeek Harness — a small always-on core block plus on-demand topic files (profile, preferences, decisions, lessons), with source-annotated writes and supersede-not-overwrite history, so preferences and project constraints stop drifting between sessions. Local-first: no vector DB, no server, no outbound calls.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的三层记忆：常驻小索引加按需读取的主题文件（画像、偏好、决策、教训），写入带来源标注、冲突取代留痕，让偏好与项目约束跨会话不漂移。本地优先：无向量库、无服务端、零出站。

description.en: Adds an optional note field under each selected option in the DSH Web UI ask_user_question popup; submitted notes travel to the model in the answer's custom field.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页端 ask_user_question 弹窗中为每个选中选项增加可选的补充说明输入框，提交时补充内容随答案一并传给模型。

description.en: Workspace-free chats that promote real files into their own project workspace - a maintained fork of dsh-scratchpad, kept working on current DSH.
description.zh: 免工作区自由对话，产物自动提升为独立项目工作区；dsh-scratchpad 的持续维护 fork，跟当前 DSH 保持可用。

description.en: Model rotation for DeepSeek Harness: groups each provider's models by source, orders them by hand or by measured success rate and latency, stores model plus reasoning-effort presets, falls over to the next entry when a model hits its quota or is unavailable, resends the same step on the next model, and shows which model actually answered. Uses the models of whatever provider plugins are already installed (Antigravity accounts, Codex subscription, DeepSeek API keys); it does not provide model access itself.
description.zh: 按来源分组的模型轮询：把每个 provider 的模型按来源分组，可手动排序，也可按成功率和延迟自动排序；支持「模型 + 思考强度」预设；某一档额度用尽或不可用时自动切到下一档，并用下一档把同一步重新发一次；会话头显示本次回答由哪个模型产出。使用已安装的 provider 插件（agy 账号池、Codex 订阅、DeepSeek API Key）提供的模型，插件本身不提供模型接入。

description.en: Preview local HTML in the right sidebar, annotate elements or regions, and send the selections with current and target styles into the current session.
description.zh: 在右侧栏预览本地 HTML，点选元素或框选区域写批注，把选中项、当前样式与目标样式一起发进当前会话。

description.en: Session-scoped delivery receipts for local artifacts: compare current file hashes with a recorded baseline, keep agent claims separate from explicit user acceptance, flag changed or unavailable files, and export a Markdown receipt through a tool, slash command, and conversation panel.
description.zh: 为本地成果生成会话级交付回执：对比当前文件哈希与记录基线，将 Agent 自述与用户明确验收分开，标记已变化或无法核验的文件，并通过工具、斜杠命令和会话面板导出 Markdown 回执。

description.en: Adds the models available in a signed-in WorkBuddy desktop app to DeepSeek Harness as a model provider, with the CN and international apps as separate groups. It is a rebuilt derivative of the npm package dsh-workbuddy-connect@0.7.9 (originally corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect); it registers the same workbuddy / workbuddy-ai provider ids, so it cannot be installed alongside other WorkBuddy bridges.
description.zh: 把已登录的 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 中的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，国内版与国际版各自成组。它基于 npm 包 dsh-workbuddy-connect@0.7.9（原 corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect）的构建产物改出，注册相同的 workbuddy / workbuddy-ai provider id，不能与其它 WorkBuddy 桥同装。

description.en: Enhances the native right-sidebar Files tab rather than replacing it: each row gets an @ reference button that inserts the canonical path mention into the composer, plus a size column, a sortable modification-time column, and a status dot for untracked, unstaged and staged files. Below the tree a git bar shows the branch with ahead/behind counts and expands upward into the 20 most recent commits, with a repository selector when a workspace has independent repositories in subdirectories. A header search box walks the workspace recursively and can open a result or expand the tree at it, preview tabs offer reveal-in-tree and one-click @, the tree is keyboard navigable with ARIA tree semantics, and a right-click entry on the Files tab switches back to the native tree at runtime.
description.zh: 增强右侧栏原生的「文件」标签页而非替换它：每行带一个 @ 引用按钮，把规范路径提及插入输入框；另有大小列、可排序的修改时间列，以及按未跟踪/未暂存/已暂存着色的状态点。文件树下方有 git 栏，显示分支与领先/落后数量，并可向上展开最近 20 条提交；当工作区的子目录是独立仓库时提供仓库选择器。页头搜索框递归遍历工作区，可打开结果或在文件树中展开定位；预览页签提供「在文件树中定位」与一键 @；文件树支持键盘导航与 ARIA tree 语义；右键「文件」标签页可在运行时切回原生树。

description.en: Read PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX and text documents as agent tools, and OCR scanned PDFs or images locally with tesseract.js. Exposes doc_read, pdf_read, xlsx_read, doc_meta and doc_ocr.
description.zh: 把 PDF、DOCX、XLSX、PPTX 和文本文件读取为智能体工具，并用 tesseract.js 在本地对扫描版 PDF 或图片做 OCR。提供 doc_read、pdf_read、xlsx_read、doc_meta、doc_ocr 五个工具。

description.en: Sidebar footer badge that shows whether DeepSeek is inside a peak-pricing window right now: a state dot, the current multiplier (x2 during peak, 5 zhe / half price off-peak), a countdown to the next switch, and a 24-hour schedule bar whose white line marks the current time. Peak windows are 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00 Beijing time; weekends and Chinese public holidays count as off-peak. The holiday table currently covers 2026 only. Client-only, no network requests.
description.zh: 侧栏底部角标，标注当前是否处于 DeepSeek 高峰计价时段：状态圆点、当前倍率（高峰 ×2、空闲 5 折）、距下次切换的倒计时，以及一条用白色竖线标出当前时刻的 24 小时日程条。高峰为北京时间 9:00–12:00 与 14:00–18:00，周末与中国法定节假日按空闲计费。节假日表目前只覆盖 2026 年。纯客户端插件，不发任何网络请求。

description.en: Purges billion-context snapshots left behind after a session is deleted in DeepSeek Harness, and can also clean up cost-meter ledger rows (off by default).
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中删除会话后，清理 billion-context 快照；cost-meter 账本记录的清理默认关闭，可在设置里打开。

description.en: Displays generated images in a conversation gallery with a lightbox viewer.
description.zh: 以对话内画廊和灯箱展示生成的图片。

description.en: Bing daily wallpaper as the app background: auto-refresh every day, pin any of the last 30 days.
description.zh: 必应每日壁纸作为界面背景：每天自动更换，可在最近 30 天中任选一天固定。

description.en: Flat list of recent sessions across every workspace, with last-question previews, time buckets, full-text search, and notes that resurface when you reopen a conversation. Fork of huangxp12/dsh-recent-sessions with a native-style UI rewrite; both register the same recent-sessions panel id, so do not install both.
description.zh: 跨所有工作目录的扁平会话列表：显示最后一句提问、按时间分组、全文搜索，并让随手记下的想法在重开会话时提醒。是 huangxp12/dsh-recent-sessions 的重写分支，界面按原生样式重做；两者注册同一个 recent-sessions 面板 id，不要与原版同装。

description.en: Publishes HTML pages and Markdown documents written by the agent to GitHub Pages as shareable links, with tools to update them in place, list, read back, and delete them; adds an Artifacts sidebar panel and a bundled page-design skill.
description.zh: 把 Agent 生成的 HTML 页面和 Markdown 文档发布到 GitHub Pages 并返回可分享链接，提供原地更新、列出、读回和删除的工具；附带侧边栏 Artifacts 面板和内置的页面设计技能。

description.en: Development tooling for Minecraft 26.3 mods: starts a real dedicated server and a real client from JSON instance registrations, drives both through an authenticated HTTP probe, and asserts on world, UI and log state across Fabric, Forge and NeoForge, writing per-run evidence and shipping no game or loader files. Requires JDK 25 and a Minecraft 26.3 instance.
description.zh: Minecraft 26.3 mod 开发工具：按 JSON 实例登记启动真实的专用服与客户端，通过带鉴权的 HTTP 探针驱动两端，并对世界、UI 与日志状态做断言，覆盖 Fabric / Forge / NeoForge；每轮运行留下取证目录，且不随包分发任何游戏或加载器文件。需 JDK 25 与 Minecraft 26.3 实例。

description.en: Native Harness workbench and local gateway for Dot to read saved projects and conversations, dispatch native tasks, inspect progress, continue or cancel tasks, and manage connection authorization.
description.zh: 通过原生 Harness 工作台和本机网关，让 Dot 读取已保存项目与会话、派发原生任务、查看进度、继续或取消任务，并管理连接授权。

description.en: Doxygen comment workflow for C/C++ (including Qt) sources: file headers, functions, module groups, trailing and short comments, plus a scan that flags comments whose signature fingerprint went stale. Requires Python 3.10+ with `pip install tree-sitter tree-sitter-cpp`.
description.zh: 为 C/C++（含 Qt）源码生成与维护 Doxygen 注释的工作流：文件头、函数、模块分组、行尾与简短注释，并扫描出签名指纹已过期、需要更新的注释。运行时需要 Python 3.10+ 并 `pip install tree-sitter tree-sitter-cpp`。

description.en: Registers the project-cross-migration skill for DSH: five-layer agent project migration (conversations, memory, persona, tools, environment) with entry validation, JSONL integrity checks and readable restore. 1,418-message real migration verified across three platforms; pure Python stdlib, MIT.
description.zh: 为 DSH 注册 project-cross-migration 技能：对话/记忆/人格/工具/环境五层迁移，含入口校验、JSONL 完整性检查与可读还原。三平台 1418 条消息真实迁移实测；纯 Python 标准库，MIT。

description.en: Keeps the most recently used sessions resident in the browser so switching back reuses the already loaded history instead of re-reading it; the number of resident sessions is configurable and the plugin can be switched off.
description.zh: 让浏览器最近用过的会话保持常驻：切走再切回来直接复用已加载的历史、不再重新读取；常驻数量可配置，并可整体关闭。

description.en: Story Mode preset for DeepSeek Harness: role-play GM persona, three-way choices, .md character cards and world book, context distillation and prompt wrapping.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的故事模式预设：叙事 GM 人格、三条走向、.md 角色卡与世界书记忆、上下文提纯与前后置提示词。

description.en: Trip planning workspace for DeepSeek Harness: a map page with day-by-day stops, roam_* tools that draft, review and adopt an itinerary, and optional MCP sidecars for rail tickets and Xiaohongshu notes.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的行程工作台：地图页按天展示站点，roam_* 工具负责起草、审阅与采用行程，可选接入火车票和小红书笔记的 MCP 数据源。

description.en: Removes sandbox_permissions / justification arguments that cannot widen the call's current sandbox mode, so calls no longer fail with 'sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "danger-full-access" mode'. GPT models tend to fill these optional fields on every call and pick workspace-write, which is narrower than danger-full-access. Runs in tools/pre-execute: compares the requested mode with the mode the session's sandbox policy resolves, and drops the fields when the request is the same or narrower (also drops a lone justification). Also understands the values GPT carries over from Codex's own shell tool: null, empty and use_default are treated as no request, and in a danger-full-access session any value (including require_escalated) is dropped because nothing is wider. Real widening requests, unknown modes and tools that do not advertise DSH's escalation schema are left to DSH core. Never widens permissions. Configurable tool list (default bash, pwsh, write, edit, run_code). Zero dependencies.
description.zh: 去掉那些不会让当前沙箱模式变宽的 sandbox_permissions / justification 参数，避免调用报错「sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "danger-full-access" mode」。GPT 系列模型往往每次调用都会填这两个可选参数，并选 workspace-write，而它比 danger-full-access 更窄。插件在 tools/pre-execute 阶段把请求的模式和会话沙箱策略给出的当前模式做比较：相同或更窄时去掉这两个字段（只有 justification 时也会去掉）。同时兼容 GPT 从 Codex shell 工具带过来的取值：null、空值和 use_default 视为没有请求；会话已经是 danger-full-access 时，任何取值（包括 require_escalated）都会去掉，因为不存在更宽的模式。真正的升权请求、无法识别的模式值，以及没有声明 DSH 升权参数的工具，都原样交给 DSH 处理。不会放宽任何权限。监控的工具列表可配置（默认 bash、pwsh、write、edit、run_code）。零依赖。

description.en: Connects the Tavily hosted MCP server and registers the tools it publishes. The API key is read from the TAVILY_API_KEY credential and is not stored in plugin config.
description.zh: 接入 Tavily 托管的 MCP 服务器并注册它公布的工具。API Key 从 TAVILY_API_KEY 凭据读取，不写入插件配置。

description.en: Daily and weekly task manager: startup popup reminder, a marquee strip above the composer, one-click circle completion, editable task cards, and a Sunday AI weekly summary, plus a sidebar DeepSeek API usage widget with balance card, today/cumulative tokens and cost, per-model breakdown and a 7-day chart. Persists as JSON under $DSH_HOME.
description.zh: 每日/每周任务管理：启动弹窗提醒、输入框上方滚动条、圆圈一键完成、任务卡片编辑、周日 AI 周总结；另附侧边栏 DeepSeek API 用量小部件（余额卡片、今日与累计 tokens 及费用、按模型明细、近 7 日柱状图）。数据以 JSON 存于 $DSH_HOME。

description.en: Owner-facing AI studio for DeepSeek Harness: project roles, task acceptance, worktree-based agent runs, host verification, independent review, decision records, and human-triggered merges.
description.zh: 面向项目所有者的 DeepSeek Harness AI 工作室：角色、任务验收、worktree 代理执行、Host 验证、独立评审、决策记录和人工触发合并。

description.en: Embed a local web server in the DSH GUI through a remote-browser-safe same-origin proxy: any localhost port works, plus a Console/Network/Errors toolbox that captures what the iframe actually does.
description.zh: 把本地网页服务安全地嵌进 DSH 界面：同源代理绕开远程浏览器的 localhost/混合内容限制，任意 localhost 端口可用，并附控制台/网络/错误工具箱，实时捕获 iframe 内真实行为。

description.en: Lists the attachments the current session actually received through the WeChat bridge and adopts one into the workspace on demand.
description.zh: 列出当前会话通过微信桥实际收到的附件，并按需将其中一个采纳到工作区。

description.en: Lists every entry that can appear in the left sidebar and gives each panel entry its own hide/show switch from a section in Settings.
description.zh: 列出所有可以出现在左侧菜单里的功能，并在设置中逐个隐藏或显示面板入口。

description.en: Plugin diagnostics for the dsh web GUI: finds plugins that failed to load, bundle rows that never started and broken file links, then reports the findings. Read-only: it does not repair, journal or undo anything.
description.zh: dsh Web 界面的插件诊断：找出加载失败的插件、未启动的 bundle 行与失效的 file 链接，并报告扫描结果。只读：不修复、不写日志、不提供撤销。

description.en: Distills long sessions into background observations and reflections, injects them as a system-prompt section, and renders compaction summaries from prepared memory; includes a Settings page and source-backed recall.
description.zh: 在后台把长会话提炼为观察与反思并注入系统提示，压缩时直接用预备记忆渲染摘要；提供设置页与可回溯原文的 memory_recall。

description.en: Store SSH hosts in an AES-256-GCM vault and let the agent run commands on them by alias, with passwords handed to ssh through SSH_ASKPASS instead of the command line. Windows only.
description.zh: 把 SSH 主机存进 AES-256-GCM 加密保险库，智能体按别名执行命令，口令经 SSH_ASKPASS 交给 ssh 而不进入命令行。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: macOS computer-use tools backed by a plugin-owned Cua Driver runtime.
description.zh: 通过插件独立管理的 Cua Driver 运行时提供 macOS 电脑操作工具。

description.en: Shows local glossary definitions when hovering over terms in chat messages.
description.zh: 悬停聊天消息中的术语时显示本地词库释义。

description.en: Collapses each settled turn's process rows into one expandable disclosure in the DeepSeek Harness Web conversation while keeping the final answer visible.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness Web 对话中已结束回合的过程行折叠成一个可展开的总结，同时保留最终答案可见。

description.en: Removes the Preview badge on DSH.
description.zh: 去除在DSH上的预览版标签。

description.en: Plays a short ink-wash whale-leap animation over the DeepSeek Harness web UI when it loads, then fades out on its own.
description.zh: 网页加载时在 DeepSeek Harness 界面上播放一段水墨鲸跃动画，随后自行淡出。

description.en: Sidebar tidy: when plugins pile up, the rows under 'New session' get crowded with panel and plugin entries. This plugin folds them all — global panel rows, plugin-injected entry rows (own and third-party alike), and bottom entries — into a single menu button whose secondary menu triggers each entry exactly as before; keep any entry permanently visible with a name whitelist, and the button turns into an icon when the sidebar collapses to a narrow rail.
description.zh: 侧栏收纳：把「新会话」下方被各插件塞满的入口行——全局面板行、插件入口行（自家/第三方一律识别）、底部入口——统统收进一个菜单按钮，点开二级菜单原样触发各入口；想常驻的加名称白名单即可，侧栏折叠成窄轨时按钮自动变纯图标。

description.en: Low-token web search that returns only {title, url, snippet} per hit — vendor extras such as answer, score and raw_content never enter the context. Five interchangeable backends (Tavily, Brave, SearXNG, Google CSE, Exa) with automatic failover to the next usable one in fallback / chain order when the primary fails, deduplicating repeated providers. Returned URLs and snippets are sanitized of tracking parameters.
description.zh: 低 Token 联网搜索：只把结果裁成 {title, url, snippet} 三个字段返回，厂商附带的 answer / score / raw_content 等一律不进上下文。后端可在 Tavily、Brave、SearXNG、Google CSE、Exa 五种之间配置，主后端失败时按 fallback / chain 顺序自动切换到下一个可用后端（同一后端去重）。返回的 URL 与摘要经清洗，除去跟踪参数。

description.en: Watchdog for quota exhaustion: on a 429 or quota error it creates a recurring schedule that re-sends a continue-the-task prompt until a turn closes normally, so a long task resumes without manual restarts; /keep-running list and /keep-running cancel <id> manage those schedules. Requires @deepseek-ai/dsh-schedule to be mounted first (it registers the schedules).
description.zh: 配额看门狗：遇到 429 或配额错误时建立循环调度，持续重发「继续任务」提示直到某一轮正常结束，长任务不必手动重开；/keep-running list 与 /keep-running cancel <id> 用于查看和取消。需先挂载 @deepseek-ai/dsh-schedule（调度由它注册）。

description.en: Registers Mol* file viewers with dsh-better-sidebar for PDB, mmCIF, MRC maps, small molecules and Chimera .cmm markers, including .gz, with a BioViewer workspace tab and bio_open / bio_add tools.
description.zh: 向 dsh-better-sidebar 注册 Mol* 文件预览器，支持 PDB、mmCIF、MRC 密度图、小分子和 Chimera .cmm 标记（含 .gz），并提供 BioViewer 工作区标签以及 bio_open / bio_add 工具。

description.en: Sales workflow for individual insurance agents: P1-P5 product class matched against the client risk rating, a policy ledger that counts grace periods from the receipt date, and five-section dual-recording checks. 10 tools and 5 skills.
description.zh: 个险代理人的展业工作流：P1-P5 产品分级与客户风险等级匹配、按回执签收日推算犹豫期的保单台账、双录五环节校验，含 10 个工具与 5 个技能。

description.en: Session-context surfaces ported from T3 Code: a session-row hover card showing machine, git branch, model, agent preset, approval policy and token usage, a status pill covering pending approval, awaiting input, working, error and subagent work, a provider and model chip, a per-session header strip, a lineage breadcrumb, row-menu actions that copy the context or run DSH compaction, and a preference row in DSH Settings for choosing which facts appear. Nothing is added to the composer.
description.zh: 移植 T3 Code 的会话上下文界面：会话行悬浮卡显示机器、Git 分支、模型、代理预设、审批策略与 token 用量，状态标签覆盖待审批、等待输入、运行中、错误与子代理工作，另有提供方与模型标记、会话头部信息条、血缘面包屑、可复制上下文或执行 DSH 压缩的行菜单操作，以及位于 DSH 设置中用于选择显示哪些事实的偏好行。输入框区域不新增任何元素。

description.en: Per-session status chips in the GNOME top bar for DeepSeek Harness — gray for running, green for done, yellow for waiting — configurable from the sidebar, with a self-installed GNOME extension.
description.zh: 在 GNOME 顶栏显示 DSH 各会话状态色块（灰=运行中，绿=已完成未确认，黄=等待回复/审批），可在侧边栏配置，自动安装 GNOME 扩展。

description.en: Mirrors DeepSeek Harness task state (failed, waiting for your answer, finished) into the macOS Atoll Dynamic Island as one status light with three counts.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的任务状态（失败、等待你处理、已完成）镜像到 macOS Atoll 灵动岛上的同一枚状态灯，并显示三种状态的计数。

description.en: Full-screen ice-and-fire boot intro for DSH: a frost-to-ember boot sequence with typed bilingual logs and a hairline progress line, then Ygritte's five-step identity authorization. Esc skips, Enter or click fast-forwards, and a settings page switches it off/quick/full or replays it; the host half paints the opening frame while the document parses, so the built-in loading card never shows.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一段「冰与火」全屏开机片头：冰霜→余烬的启动动画、双语打字机日志与发丝进度线，随后是 Ygritte 的五步身份授权。Esc 跳过，Enter/点击快进，设置页可切换关闭/简易/完整或随时重播；首帧由宿主半边在文档解析阶段就注入，DSH 自带的 Loading 卡片不会露脸。

description.en: Long-term memory kept as plain Markdown plus git: each session opens with a generated memory-context block assembled from a global store and per-project books (role card, user profile, current focus, routing table, recent logs), the plugin records which memory files the agent read and reminds it to extract conclusions while the day's log is unextracted, personas live in roles/<role>/SOUL.md role cards, and it ships a seven-tab settings page in the sidebar plus four skills. Requires Python 3.10+.
description.zh: 以纯 Markdown 加 git 存放长期记忆：每次会话开始按全局总册与各项目册渲染一段 memory-context（人格卡、用户档案、当前焦点、路由表、最近日志），记录代理读过哪些记忆文件，并在当天日志还没提炼时提醒收口；人格放在 roles/<role>/SOUL.md 角色卡里，附侧边栏七页签设置页与四个 skill。依赖 Python 3.10+。

description.en: Prefixes every session title with the name of its workspace or project, so a flat session list shows which project each conversation belongs to; titles you renamed yourself are left unchanged.
description.zh: 给每条会话标题加上所属项目名前缀，会话列表平铺展示时不必点开就能看出它属于哪个项目；你自己手动改过的标题保持原样。

description.en: Push-to-talk dictation for the Web composer: hold a hotkey to record and the transcript is written into the draft through DSH's own speech Remote (local SenseVoice), with an optional auto-send.
description.zh: 输入框按住说话：按住快捷键录音，经 DSH 自带语音 Remote（本地 SenseVoice）识别后写入草稿，可选自动发送。

description.en: Fills in the vision capability that DSH's "fetch models" step drops, so image-capable models stop being declared text-only, and marks them in the model name.
description.zh: 补上 DSH「获取可用模型」漏记的视觉能力，让能看图的模型不再被当成纯文本，并在模型名后标出「可看图」。

description.en: Plays a character entrance card beside the composer when you switch model: identity name, six scored axes (intelligence, coding, speed, stability, cost, context), quota hint and a dialogue line. 23 curated cards across 15 providers; models without a curated card fall back to a data card derived from public benchmarks, or a generic card when no benchmark data exists. A web client plugin with no dependencies and no hooks.
description.zh: 切换模型时在会话输入框旁播一张角色登场卡：身份名、六轴分数（智力／编码／速度／稳定／性价比／上下文）、额度提示与台词；23 张精选卡覆盖 15 个 provider，库里没有精选卡的模型按公开基准派生数据卡；基准集里也没有分数的则回退为通用卡。web 客户端插件，无依赖、无 hooks。

description.en: Highlight or quote any passage of an answer, attach a note to it, then send the excerpt back to the composer as a quoted instruction.
description.zh: 在回答里标出任意一段文字、写上备注，再把引用放回输入框当作带上下文的指令发出。

description.en: Groups the sessions of every workspace in the DSH sidebar by day, with explicit date labels, a live running indicator and date-based search.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏的每个工作区内把会话按日期分组、标注具体日期，并保留运行中状态灯与按日期搜索。

description.en: Run Blender headless from DeepSeek Harness: execute bpy scripts, render scenes and export glTF assets, with modeling cookbook, 5.x pitfall list and asset-pipeline playbooks bundled as skills so the agent self-checks geometry before handing assets back.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里以 headless 方式跑 Blender：执行 bpy 脚本、渲染场景、导出 glTF 资产，并附带建模技法库、5.x 踩坑清单与资产管线手册（技能包），让 agent 在交付前自检几何。

description.en: Adds a manual "mark as unread" action to workspace session rows, and retires itself once the harness exposes the same capability.
description.zh: 给工作区会话行补一个手动「标记为未读」；官方支持同能力后自动退休。

description.en: Opens .blend files in the right-Sidebar document preview: Blender headless exports a cached GLB with scene statistics, rendered by a dependency-free WebGL viewport. Requires Blender 3.6+ on PATH (or set blenderPath).
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏文档预览里打开 .blend：Blender headless 导出缓存 GLB 与场景统计，由零依赖 WebGL 视口渲染。需本机装有 Blender 3.6+（或在设置里指定 blenderPath）。

description.en: Local-first DSH Web work checklist with rich-text notes, categories, folding, drag reordering, search, JSON import/export, and a restorable trash.
description.zh: 本地优先的 DSH Web 工作清单，支持富文本笔记、分类、折叠、拖拽排序、搜索、JSON 导入导出和可还原回收站。

description.en: Sorts every loaded skill into one or more user-owned workspaces in a right-sidebar tab: each workspace is its own category list plus where every skill sits, categories are created, renamed, reordered and deleted in place, and skills are dragged or picked between them. A first run can let the profile model build the first classification, or place skills into categories the user built first; clicking a row copies its /skill-name and hovering unfolds the description the skill ships.
description.zh: 在右侧栏用一个或多个「工作区」给已加载的 skill 分类：每个工作区有自己的分类表和每个 skill 的归属，分类可就地新建、改名、排序、删除，skill 可拖动或用选择器改归位；首次使用可以让这个 profile 的模型从零分一版，也可以先自己建分类再让模型按分类分配。点击行复制 /skill-name，悬停展开 skill 自带的描述。

description.en: Configuration vault for DeepSeek Harness: snapshot, diff and safely roll back profile patches, plugin manifests, skills and workspace lists, with credentials excluded by default.
description.zh: 配置保险箱：为 DSH 配置创建快照、对比差异并安全回滚设置补丁、插件清单、技能与规则、工作区列表，凭据默认排除。

description.en: Sends QQ mail through an OAuth-authorized agently-cli account. Registers the send_qq_email tool with a user-approval step and exposes a ctx.qqEmail service for other DSH plugins.
description.zh: 用已授权的 agently-cli 账号发送 QQ 邮件：注册 send_qq_email 工具（发送前需用户确认），并对外提供 ctx.qqEmail 服务供其他 DSH 插件调用。

description.en: Manage agent skills and MCP servers across DSH, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other tools from one DSH sidebar page: CRUD, cross-tool sharing, import/export, backups and MCP health checks.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏统一管理 DSH、Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等工具的 skill 与 MCP 服务器：增删改查、跨工具共享、导入导出、备份恢复与 MCP 连接体检。

description.en: Diverts operation-script writes out of the workspace into a per-session scratch root and collects each one into an inspectable vault outside the workspace, so the workspace holds only real deliverables.
description.zh: 把操作腳本的寫入導出工作區、改放各 session 的暫存根，並把每一支收進工作區外的可檢視收納庫，讓工作區只留下真正的交付物。

description.en: Browser tools for DSH that POST to the local OpenCLI daemon instead of spawning the opencli CLI per command, avoiding its cold start: oc_status, oc_exec, oc_navigate, oc_snapshot and oc_tabs, with one persistent automation tab per session.
description.zh: 把本机 OpenCLI daemon 当常驻服务直连的 DSH 浏览器工具，替代「每条命令起一次 opencli CLI」的冷启动：oc_status、oc_exec、oc_navigate、oc_snapshot、oc_tabs 五个工具，每个 session 一个常驻自动化标签页。需要本机运行 OpenCLI daemon，并让浏览器里的 OpenCLI 扩展保持连接。

description.en: Appends a tiny ice marker to the end of every sentence the model writes, chain of thought included, and plays a short synthesized sound for each one.
description.zh: 在模型写出的每句话结尾（含思维链）补一个小冰块标记，并为每次补冰播放一声短促的合成音效。

description.en: Wallpaper-aware readability repair for the DSH Web GUI: it lifts the three low-contrast secondary text tokens with color-mix plus an adjustable text halo, adds content rules (bold, permanently underlined or recoloured links, tinted headings and body text) scoped to conversation Markdown only, offers adjustable rainbow-edge and gradient-fill heading effects, loads custom fonts from the plugin folder or the DSH home, and ships a draggable WYSIWYG preview with a WCAG contrast badge.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 的「壁纸感知」可读性修复：用 color-mix 把三个低对比次级文字 token 向主文字靠拢，并叠加可调强度的文字光晕；提供仅作用于会话 Markdown 的内容规则（链接加粗 / 常驻下划线 / 变色、标题与正文变色）、可调的彩虹描边与渐变填充标题特效、从插件目录或 DSH_HOME 加载的自定义字体，以及带 WCAG 对比度徽标的可拖动 WYSIWYG 预览窗。

description.en: Delivery panel in the DSH sidebar: indexes every image and file sent to the harness (content-addressed attachments plus @-mentioned local paths), rebuilds Taildrop send history per target device from tailscale file cp calls in the session logs, lists incoming files (the Tailscale inbox plus unmarked files in ~/Downloads), and sends new files to a device from the panel with online status and upload progress.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏里的投送面板：索引所有发给 Harness 的图片与文件（内容寻址附件 + @ 引用过的本机路径），从会话日志里的 tailscale file cp 调用按目标设备还原 Taildrop 投送历史，列出收到的文件（Tailscale 收件箱 + ~/Downloads 里没有下载标记的文件），并能在面板里直接选设备发文件（显示在线状态与上传进度）。

description.en: Read local EPUB, TXT and Markdown novels below selected native DSH chat regions on explicit expansion, preserving real reasoning and tool output without sending novel text to the model. Currently works only with DSH 0.2.1-rc.2.
description.zh: 小说摸鱼：主动展开选中的原生聊天区域时，在保留真实思考和工具输出的下方阅读本地 EPUB、TXT、Markdown 小说，小说不发送给模型。目前仅兼容 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: Git-based multi-device sync for DSH configuration — captures settings, plugin manifests, lockfiles and skills into a private repository, with one-click capture, apply, pull and restore, and plugin rebuilds from pnpm-lock.
description.zh: 基于私有 Git 仓库的 DSH 多端配置同步——把设置、插件清单、锁文件与技能纳管到私有仓库，设置页一键捕获、应用、拉取与回滚，并按 pnpm-lock 确定性重建插件依赖。

description.en: One standing system prompt for every workspace: a Custom instructions page in DSH's own Settings panel whose text is added to the system prompt of every session, subagents included, and stored in the profile instead of any project.
description.zh: 所有工作区共用的长期系统提示词：在 DSH 自己的设置面板里新增「自定义指令」页，文本会加入每个会话（含子代理）的系统提示词，并保存在 profile 而不是任何项目里。

description.en: Command DeepSeek Harness from Telegram and Feishu (Lark): one live progress message per turn, approvals and questions as buttons, files and voice, delivery that survives outages and restarts, QR setup for Feishu, and per-person roles.
description.zh: 在 Telegram 和飞书中指挥 DeepSeek Harness：每轮一条实时进度消息，按钮审批与提问，收发文件和语音，断线和重启不丢消息，飞书扫码接入，按人设置权限。

description.en: Umbrella Corporation theme for DeepSeek Harness with dark and light schemes, a spinning umbrella watermark and a HUD frame.
description.zh: 生化危机保护伞公司主题，提供明暗双外观、自转保护伞水印与 HUD 装饰。

description.en: Overlay reader for agent output files: Markdown rendering, in-panel PDF, DOCX/XLSX/PPTX text preview and reply-end file chips, with search, outline and position memory.
description.zh: agent 产出文件的浮层阅读器：Markdown 渲染、PDF 面板预览、DOCX/XLSX/PPTX 文本提取与回复末尾文件 chips，支持搜索、大纲与位置记忆。

description.en: Bridge DSH to OpenCode-compatible models via the local OpenCode CLI: native LlmAdapter passthrough, persistent OC sessions with cross-turn tool results, tool mirroring, and a CLI environment check panel. Requires the OpenCode CLI installed locally.
description.zh: 经本机 OpenCode CLI 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode 兼容模型：原生 LlmAdapter 透传、OC 会话持久续接（工具结果跨轮可见）、工具镜像回传、CLI 环境检测面板。需本机已安装 OpenCode CLI。

description.en: Replaces the host-side folder chooser in the Add workspace flow with a name dialog, so a remote browser can create and open a workspace instead of an OS dialog appearing on the Host screen.
description.zh: 將「新增工作區」流程中喺主機彈出嘅資料夾選擇器，改成輸入名稱嘅對話框，令遠端瀏覽器可以直接建立並開啟工作區。

description.en: Deterministic ticket triage: a rule prefilter classifies clear cases and returns everything else as needs_review instead of guessing.
description.zh: 确定性工单分诊：规则先处理明确案例，放不下的统一返回 needs_review，而不是猜。

description.en: Two switchable design languages for the DSH GUI — liquid glass with inner-lit surfaces and pointer specular, and Soviet constructivism with cream/ink/red poster geometry — plus a personalization panel, drop-in CSS skin packs, and a seven-expression whale-girl pet.
description.zh: 给 DSH 界面的两套可切换设计语言：内部发光的液态玻璃，与米色/血红/墨黑的苏联构成主义海报；附带个性化面板、投放式 CSS 皮肤包与 7 种表情的鲸鱼娘桌宠。

description.en: Opens STL meshes in the right-Sidebar document preview: binary/ASCII parsing in the browser, a WebGL viewport, and size, volume, surface-area and watertightness statistics.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏文档预览里打开 STL：浏览器解析二进制/ASCII 网格，用 WebGL 视口展示尺寸、体积、表面积与水密性。

description.en: Session map: a fork-tree canvas over DSH sessions, and a Settings page that clones a Git repository into a new workspace. The canvas is reachable from a session-header toggle and two right-side tabs, and from a conversation tab that is off by default; it starts on the current session's own tree, growing downward, with wheel pan, Ctrl/⌘-wheel zoom, a subagent-session filter and a per-session overview of turns, steps, model time, tool time, output tokens and running state. The clone page takes a repository address and a remembered parent directory with a native folder picker, offers a per-clone shallow switch (off by default), runs git clone on the host, and registers the cloned directory as a workspace.
description.zh: 会话图谱：把 DSH 会话画成一张 fork 树画布，另在设置里加了一个「从 Git 克隆」页——填仓库地址、选存放目录（会记住上次选择、带原生目录选择器），按需打开浅克隆，克隆完自动添加为工作区。画布可从会话头部开关和右侧栏两个标签页打开，对话标签页默认关闭；默认只铺开当前会话所在的那棵树、自上而下生长，支持滚轮平移与 Ctrl/⌘ 滚轮缩放、隐藏子代理会话，另有一个会话概览页列出轮次、步骤、模型耗时、工具耗时、输出 token 与运行状态。

description.en: Adds a Traditional Chinese (zh-Hant) language to the web GUI, registered through the locale service with one dictionary per namespace and selectable in Settings, General, Language.
description.zh: 為網頁介面加入繁體中文（zh-Hant）語言，經語言服務註冊，每個 namespace 各有一份字典，並可在「設定 → 一般 → 語言」揀選。

description.en: Custom brand icon and name for the DSH Web sidebar and conversation hero, editable live from a settings card on the plugin detail page.
description.zh: 自定义 DSH Web 侧边栏与会话页的品牌图标和名称，插件详情页内置设置卡片，保存即生效。

description.en: Manage a GitHub Pages blog from a DSH panel — browse the Markdown articles grouped by tag, edit them in a split editor with a front-matter form, and publish the changes as one commit over the GitHub REST API.
description.zh: 在 DSH 面板里管理 GitHub Pages 博客：按标签分组浏览 Markdown 文章，用表单填 front matter 并在分屏编辑器里修改，再通过 GitHub REST API 把改动作为一次 commit 发布。

description.en: Cross-version session migration for DSH: sweeps legacy session stores (v0 plaintext, .zstd and .zip exports), re-pins the header cwd to the target workspace and drops sessions in so the persistence layer upgrades them on open; settings sidebar with env/import/list/convert tabs plus a CLI (check / fix / import).
description.zh: DSH 会话跨版本迁移：扫描旧版会话目录（v0 明文、.zstd 与 .zip 导出包），改写 header cwd 绑定目标工作区并落盘，打开会话时由持久化层自动完成版本升级；设置侧边栏（环境 / 导入 / 列表 / 转换）加 CLI（check / fix / import）。

description.en: Adds F5 / Ctrl+R page reload to the DeepSeek Harness desktop web UI, which production builds lack by default (the "Reload Page" menu item and bare-F5 accelerator are development-gated). Binds soft reload (F5, Ctrl+R) and cache-busted hard reload (F5 with a modifier, Ctrl+Shift+R, appending a _dsh_refresh timestamp) through a capture-phase client key listener.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面 Web UI 补上 F5 / Ctrl+R 页面刷新功能（生产版默认没有刷新菜单项与裸 F5 快捷键）。通过客户端捕获阶段按键监听绑定软刷新（F5、Ctrl+R）与防缓存硬刷新（F5 加修饰键、Ctrl+Shift+R，附加 _dsh_refresh 时间戳）。

description.en: Turns the DSH turn-navigation rail into a music visualiser: each thin bar grows and thickens with its own frequency band, from system audio captured with WASAPI loopback. Geometry only, no colour or glow, and the rail keeps its native hover preview, click-to-jump and wheel scrolling.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的轮次导航条变成音乐可视化：每根细横条按自己的频段变长变粗（系统声音用 WASAPI loopback 采集）。只改几何、不加颜色或发光，导航条原有的悬停预览、点击跳转与滚轮滚动都保留。

description.en: A T3 Code-style New Session screen for the composer: a "What should we build in <project>?" headline whose project name opens a workspace menu, a reasoning-effort picker in the composer tool row, and a git branch strip under the card that searches local and remote refs and switches with git checkout.
description.zh: 把 T3 Code 的新会话界面移植到 DSH 输入框：标题「What should we build in <project>?」里的项目名可点开工作区菜单，工具栏里新增推理强度选择器，卡片下方新增 git 分支条，可搜索本地与远程引用并用 git checkout 切换。

description.en: Turn timer for DSH: reports how long the current turn has been running, injects wrap-up prompts on a /set-time schedule so the agent starts finishing instead of running on, and shows run-time cards above the composer.
description.zh: DSH 本轮计时看门狗：读取本轮已运行时长，按 /set-time 排程向模型注入收尾提示词，并在输入框上方显示运行时长卡片。

description.en: A session-header 3-dots menu: download the session log, switch each chat's transcript between Normal and Verbose, and define what Verbose expands (thinking blocks, tool calls, terminal output).
description.zh: 会话标题栏的三点菜单：可下载会话日志，把每个会话的转录在普通与详细视图间切换，并自定义详细视图展开哪些内容（思考块、工具调用、终端输出）。

description.en: Shows an aggregated session-status dot in front of every folder in DSH Web's sidebar workspace tree — waiting for input, just finished, or running — and bubbles the sessions of nested workspaces up to their parent folder.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏工作区树的每个目录名前显示聚合状态点（等你输入 / 刚完成 / 运行中），父目录自动汇总嵌套工作区的会话状态。

description.en: Archives DSH conversation output into SiYuan notes: a single siyuan_archive call files content under `<archive path>/<year-month>/<type>/<date>_<time>_<topic>_<content>` with a metadata table and auto-maintains an index document at the notebook root; 6 siyuan_* host tools (list notebooks, full-text search, read document, archive, delete block, remove document) and a Web settings page for base URL with connection test, API token in the host credential store, archive target and title template, plus notebook/document-level read/write/delete permissions with default deny and child levels able to only tighten.
description.zh: 把 DSH 对话产出归档到思源笔记：一次 siyuan_archive 调用按「<归档路径>/<年-月>/<类型>/<日期>_<时间>_<主题>_<内容>」写入并附元数据表，自动维护笔记本根的「索引与规范」索引文档；6 个 siyuan_* 宿主工具（列笔记本、全文检索、读文档、归档、删块、删文档）与 Web 设置页配置地址（含测试连接）、存宿主凭据库的 API token、归档目标与标题模板，以及按笔记本/文档的读写删权限（默认全拒、子级只能收紧）。

description.en: Moves conversation views into the Windows caption row and header utilities into a compact right rail on DSH Desktop with Codex UI, reclaiming a full row of vertical space while preserving the session title, fullscreen control, dynamic status counts and menus.
description.zh: 将会话视图移入 Windows 标题栏、其余顶栏工具压缩进紧凑右轨，在 DSH Desktop 与 Codex UI 中保留会话标题、全屏、动态状态计数与菜单功能，同时省下一整行垂直空间。

description.en: Attaches the current Chrome tab to a DSH draft: one pick screenshots the page (falling back to a macOS window shot) and writes its title and URL into the composer as one line.
description.zh: 把当前 Chrome 标签页附到 DSH 草稿：一次点击截图（失败时降级为 macOS 窗口截图），同时把页面标题与地址写成一行放进输入框。

description.en: Composer-dock billing panel: DeepSeek account balance, official per-model usage and spend with cost per 100M tokens, plus cost estimates for this run and the whole conversation. Clicking opens a popover that matches the composer's width and position; balance comes from /user/balance, usage and spend from platform's usage endpoints, and the whole-conversation total is folded read-only from the local session log. Zero dependencies (node:https + node:zlib), writes nothing to disk.
description.zh: 输入框下方的计费面板：DeepSeek 账户余额、官网各模型用量与消费（含每亿 token 单价）、本次运行与整段对话的费用估算。点击弹出面板，面板与输入框同宽同位；余额走官方 /user/balance，用量与消费走 platform 的 usage 接口，整段用量由本地会话日志只读汇总。零依赖（node:https + node:zlib），不写任何文件。

description.en: Adds an Insight tab next to the conversation and trajectory tabs in DSH: calls a model to interpret tool calls turn by turn, and supports a custom prompt.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话轨迹栏边新增「解读」标签：调用模型分轮次解读工具调用情况；允许自定义提示词。

description.en: OCR for scanned, image-only PDFs into Markdown, built around the fact that a book takes about an hour: every page is checkpointed so an interrupted run resumes, a progress log reports live status, and a quality report names empty pages and low-confidence lines. Requires Python 3.10+ and pip install -r requirements; the first run downloads the OCR model.
description.zh: 把扫描版 PDF（影印书、拍照件）OCR 成 Markdown，并按“一本书要跑约一小时”来设计：逐页写检查点，中断可续跑；进度日志随时可查；质量报告点名空白页和低置信行。需 Python 3.10+ 并安装仓库 requirements；首次运行会下载 OCR 模型。

description.en: ClinePass provider for DeepSeek Harness: 15 bundled subscription and free models, a settings page with per-model capacity overrides, subscription usage for the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows, and multi-account failover to a backup account.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 ClinePass 模型提供方：内置 15 个订阅与免费模型，提供设置页与按模型容量覆盖、5 小时／每周／每月订阅用量，以及多账号与备用账号自动切换。

description.en: Config-only DeepSeek Harness bundle that mounts the in-box MCP client bridge against CursorTouch/Windows-MCP, excluding PowerShell, FileSystem, Registry, Process and Scrape by default (16 of the 21 tools upstream 0.8.8 publishes). Requires uv on PATH.
description.zh: 纯配置型 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用本体自带的 MCP 客户端桥接 CursorTouch/Windows-MCP，默认排除 PowerShell、FileSystem、Registry、Process、Scrape（上游 0.8.8 共 21 个工具，保留 16 个）。需要 uv 在 PATH 上。

description.en: Review DeepSeek Harness responses with inline annotations, document reading, comment threads, and text revisions, then bring a reading summary back to the main conversation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的模型回复添加多处批注、文档阅读、评论线程和正文修订，并将阅读摘要带回主对话。

description.en: Dormant-by-default MCP for dsh: one mcp_summon tool; summoning a server registers its tools as real native mcp__<server>__<tool> tools for the rest of the session, and release unregisters them and stops the process.
description.zh: 休眠式 MCP：只注册一个 mcp_summon 工具，召唤后该服务器的工具在本次会话内以原生 mcp__<server>__<tool> 名称注册，释放即注销并停止进程。

description.en: Session utilities: Markdown export and dependency-free batch ZIP export, a timeline overlay for jumping between turns, safe session duplication that rewrites internal identity fields, and sidebar right-click menu extension points.
description.zh: 会话工具箱：导出 Markdown 与零依赖批量 ZIP、时间线浮层快速跳轮、安全复制会话（自动重写内部身份字段）、侧栏右键菜单扩展。

description.en: Extract text from an image or PDF, reading a born-digital text layer directly and falling through to a configured OCR engine for scans.
description.zh: 从图片或 PDF 中抽取文字，电子版直接读文字层，扫描件自动转交已配置的 OCR 引擎。

description.en: Session-level verdict on whether compaction would lose unlanded state; structurally refuses per-block screening.
description.zh: 会话级判定：compaction 是否会丢失未落地状态；结构上拒绝逐块筛选。

description.en: A draggable floating window with three tabs — meals, water, standing. It picks breakfast, lunch and dinner at random (three tries a day, no repeats, editable food lists), counts water cups and standing breaks, and reminds you with a distinct 3-second chime per tab. Collapses to a 32px ball.
description.zh: 可拖动的悬浮小窗，分吃饭、喝水、站立三个 tab：随机决定三餐（每天各 3 次机会、不重复、可增删菜品），记录喝水与站立，每类提醒各用一种音色响约 3 秒；可收成 32px 悬浮球。

description.en: FanFrame (繁界, “Fanxing’s realm”) lightly polishes the DeepSeek Harness Desktop UI for a more comfortable everyday experience.
description.zh: 繁界 - 意思是“繁星的域界”，这个插件通过对DSH桌面版的UI界面进行轻度的打磨，带来更舒适的日常交互体验。我为DSH带来了放置图标的统一侧边栏，给对话列表充足的空间，同时避免插件喜欢随意摆放自己的图标造成的混乱。此外，为对话正文增加了染色处理，让文字阅读更轻松愉快。最后，通过冷峻的无圆角风格和大量增加的细微交互动画，增加一些小小的精致感。

description.en: Read, build and take apart EPUB 3 books with no external dependency — the ZIP reader/writer and the XML scanner are both built in. Inspect metadata, reading order and TOC for structural problems, assemble a book from chapters, or split one back into per-chapter HTML.
description.zh: 读、造、拆 EPUB 3 电子书，零外部依赖 —— ZIP 读写器与 XML 扫描器均为自建。可体检元数据/阅读顺序/目录并点出结构问题，从章节拼出一本合规的书，或把已有的书拆回逐章 HTML。

description.en: Alpha Agent Teams plugin for DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 and newer that lets same-session user Steer end the Lead’s current wait_agent call while teammates continue, with native message delivery and Node PTC continuation.
description.zh: 适用于 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 起版本的 Agent Teams 预览插件，让同会话用户 Steer 结束主代理当前的 wait_agent 等待，队友继续工作，并保留原生消息领取与 Node PTC 后续执行。

description.en: Long-term memory backed by a local SQLite store: project-scoped memory auto-injection with junk filtering, rule-based or model-assisted memory extraction from recent turns, write-side dedup and feedback-weighted ranking. The Python bridge runs on $NEXUS_PYTHON or the DSH-bundled interpreter at <DSH home>/dsh-runtimes/dsh-primary-runtime/dependencies/python/ (Python 3.8+).
description.zh: 基于本地 SQLite 的长期记忆：新会话自动注入项目相关记忆（噪声过滤），支持轻量规则或模型辅助提取，写入去重与反馈加权排序。Python 桥默认使用 $NEXUS_PYTHON 或 <DSH home>/dsh-runtimes/dsh-primary-runtime/dependencies/python/ 下的解释器（需 3.8+）。

description.en: Cross-session messaging: sends text into another session in the same workspace, and creates new top-level sessions.
description.zh: 跨会话投递：往同工作区的另一个会话发消息，并可新建顶层会话。

description.en: Native Anki workspace backed by one real headless Anki collection: browse, edit, add and review notes, suspend cards, import and export APKG, and sync with AnkiWeb, with the same collection exposed to the anki AI tool. No Anki desktop app, AnkiConnect or Qt is started. Windows x64 only; the matching headless Anki core, CPython and all Python runtime dependencies are bundled, so no separate Anki or Python installation is required.
description.zh: 原生 Anki 工作区，由真实的独立无界面 Anki 牌库驱动：浏览、编辑、添加与复习笔记，暂停卡片，导入导出 APKG，并与 AnkiWeb 同步；同一牌库同时提供给 anki AI 工具。不启动 Anki 桌面程序，也不依赖 AnkiConnect 或 Qt。仅支持 Windows x64；已内置匹配的无界面 Anki 核心、CPython 与全部 Python 运行依赖，无需另外安装 Anki 或 Python。

description.en: Windows x64 only, 0.5.4 preview: two scoped tools (dragon_browser and dragon_desktop) that drive a visible browser through the DOM or CDP and Windows apps through UI Automation, with per-origin and per-executable read/control scopes, batch steps, a physical-Esc emergency stop and a redacted action log. 0.5.4 only widens the DSH compatibility range to 0.2.0-rc.2 through 0.2.1.x, because 0.5.3 pinned it to an exact DSH version and was silently skipped on DSH Desktop 0.2.1. Two long-lived native processes remove the per-action process spawn, so a single key step takes about 0.7 s on the same machine; when another window steals the foreground the step is aborted instead of typing into the wrong place. The browser side ships its own Edge/Chrome launcher and CDP client, so it no longer needs another browser plugin or the Electron runtime. It is not an OS sandbox; logins, admin windows and secure desktops stay with the user.
description.zh: 仅支持 Windows x64，0.5.4 预览版：两个受控工具（dragon_browser 与 dragon_desktop），网页走 DOM/CDP、桌面走 Windows UI Automation，按网站来源和可执行文件分 read/control 权限，支持多步 batch、物理 Esc 急停与脱敏动作日志。0.5.4 只是把 DSH 兼容范围放宽到 0.2.0-rc.2 至 0.2.1.x——0.5.3 把版本钉死，在 DSH Desktop 0.2.1 上会被宿主静默跳过。原生命令改成两个常驻进程，省掉每次动作重新起进程，同机单步按键约 0.7 秒；前台被别的窗口抢走时直接中止这一步，不会把字打到别处。网页侧自带 Edge/Chrome 启动器与 CDP 客户端，不再依赖其他浏览器插件或 Electron 运行时。它不是系统沙箱，登录、管理员窗口和安全桌面仍由用户处理。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the AdWhispr remote MCP server through mcp-remote with browser OAuth sign-in, adding tools for competitor ad research, ad creative cloning, and launching and managing Meta, Google and TikTok campaigns. Requires an AdWhispr account.
description.zh: 通过 mcp-remote 加浏览器 OAuth 登录，把 DeepSeek Harness 接到 AdWhispr 的远程 MCP 服务：竞品广告调研、广告创意克隆，以及 Meta／Google／TikTok 广告的投放与管理。需要 AdWhispr 账号。

description.en: Adds interactive agent-switch CLI terminals with tab and grid layouts, Codex delegation cards, and live or saved task output in the right sidebar. Requires agent-switch on PATH, at least one target coding CLI, and a node-pty build allowlist; implemented and tested on Windows.
description.zh: 提供支持页签和网格布局的 agent-switch CLI 交互终端、Codex 委派任务卡片，以及右侧面板中的实时与历史任务输出。需 PATH 上有 agent-switch、至少一个目标编码 CLI，并在插件页放行 node-pty 原生构建；目前只在 Windows 验证过。

description.en: Pre-claim gate: a commit, push or tag claim like "tests pass" is checked against the session evidence ledger before it is written.
description.zh: 提交前声明门：把“测试通过”等 commit/push/tag 声明与本次会话的真实执行证据核对后再写入。

description.en: Adds a "Check updates" tab to the Built-in plugins settings: one row per installed bundle, with its latest npm version and an update button. Each row also reports DSH-runtime compatibility. The registry is read through the .npmrc chain (environment, then profile, then user, first hit wins); with nothing configured it races a mirror against the public registry, and a private registry is never raced against a public one. A version is installed from the registry it was read from.
description.zh: 在内置插件设置里新增「检查更新」标签页：每个已安装插件一行，显示 npm 最新版本并提供更新按钮。每行还会报告 DSH 运行时兼容性。注册表按 .npmrc 逐级读取（环境变量 → profile → 用户级，取第一个命中），未配置时并发探测镜像与公共源，内部源不会与公共源竞速。版本从哪个注册表读到，就由它安装。

description.en: Star-ranked radar for DSH plugins. A plugin is listed once it has 3,000+ GitHub stars or 100k+ npm downloads in 30 days; after its rank drops it stays listed for 180 days by default, so a plugin is still findable for months after a hot streak.
description.zh: 按 GitHub 收藏数排名的 DSH 插件热度榜：收藏 ≥ 3,000 或近 30 天下载 ≥ 10 万即收录， 排名下滑后仍保留 180 天（默认），热度过去几个月依然找得到。

description.en: A simplified version of the Plan/Act feature in the RooCode and Cline VS Code extensions, binding one provider, model and reasoning effort to plan mode and another to act mode, with per-workspace overrides.
description.zh: 简化RooCode和Cline在VSCode插件上的功能，为 Plan 与 Act 两种模式各绑定一套 provider、模型与思考复杂度，支持按工作区覆盖。

description.en: Delete DSH sessions into a restorable recycle bin — subagent sessions follow their parent as one tree, batch archive, restore and purge are supported, and only purge destroys bytes.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话删入可恢复的回收站——子会话随其父会话作为一棵树处理，支持批量归档、恢复与彻底删除，只有彻底清除才会真正销毁数据。

description.en: Pull invoice number, date, parties, tax IDs and the amount/tax/total triplet out of text, then verify that amount plus tax really equals the total and flag documents that do not reconcile.
description.zh: 从文本中提取发票号码、日期、购销方、税号与金额/税额/合计，并验算「金额 + 税额 = 价税合计」是否成立，对不上就报出来。

description.en: Turns a local Markdown vault into two folders the user picks in Settings: a knowledge folder DSH writes notes into, and a memory folder used as the agent's long-term memory with per-turn recall and end-of-turn capture. Pure Markdown with frontmatter, BM25 search, reversible archive, and path isolation that rejects traversal, absolute paths and symlink escapes.
description.zh: 把本地 Markdown 库拆成两个由用户在设置页选择的文件夹：知识库由 DSH 在对话中写入笔记，记忆库作为 agent 的长期记忆，按回合召回、回合结束沉淀候选。纯 Markdown 加 frontmatter、BM25 检索、可逆归档，并用路径隔离拒绝穿越、绝对路径与符号链接逃逸。

description.en: Tints the strip above the composer green or red to match DeepSeek's off-peak and peak billing windows, shows the remaining time of the current window as a progress bar, and ships six themes plus a custom-CSS hook.
description.zh: 按 DeepSeek 峰谷计费时段给输入卡上方那条染色（谷绿峰红），以进度条显示当前时段剩余时长，带六套主题与自定义 CSS。

description.en: Deep PTC mode is an open-source agent preset for DeepSeek Harness that keeps the built-in PTC tool surface and replaces the persona with a working contract: a DeepSeek identity and unlimited-token-budget instruction so the model does not skip reads, commands or checks to save tokens; planning by estimated size (internal up to 5 minutes, shown without approval up to 20, approval required beyond); and asking about unclear intent instead of guessing. Waiting is limited in code by wrapping the official shell, job and question tools: foreground commands move to background jobs after 30 s (configurable), a steered user message ends the current wait so the model reads it, foreground pauses over 5 s and long timers in run_code are refused, and questions run in timed mode. A settings card selects the preset executor — Automatic, WSL Bash, Windows PowerShell, native Zsh or native Bash.
description.zh: 深度PTC模式是 DeepSeek Harness 的开源 Agent preset：保留内置 PTC 的工具面，把人设换成一份工作契约——写明 DeepSeek 身份与无限 token 预算，要求不为省 token 跳过读取、命令和验证；按预计耗时分档计划（5 分钟内直接做，5–20 分钟告知计划但不等审批，超过 20 分钟需批准）；意图不清时先提问而不是猜测。等待由代码限制：包装官方的命令、job 与提问工具，前台命令超过 30 秒（可配置）自动转为后台 job，用户插入消息时立即结束当前等待让模型读到消息，前台超过 5 秒的暂停和 run_code 中的长定时器被拒绝，提问采用限时模式。设置卡片可选择该预设的执行器——自动、WSL Bash、Windows PowerShell、原生 Zsh 或原生 Bash。

description.en: Connect the DSHM iPhone/iPad companion to DeepSeek Harness over your local network or Tailscale, with device pairing, session control and file transfers; public TestFlight access to the companion app is pending Apple review.
