description.zh: 通过本地网络或 Tailscale，将 DSHM iPhone/iPad 配套应用连接到 DeepSeek Harness，支持设备配对、会话控制和文件传输；配套应用的公开 TestFlight 仍在等待 Apple 审核。

description.en: Toasts from DeepSeek Harness when a turn finishes, and when it stops for approval, a question or a plan exit. Native on Windows, text and timing configurable.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 桌面通知：任务完成时、或停下来等你审批/回答/确认计划时弹出系统通知。文案与触发时机可配置。

description.en: Provides a specification-driven engineering workbench with versioned requirements and documents, isolated Git workspaces, independent review, verification, and explicit human acceptance. Requires Node.js 24+ and Git.
description.zh: 提供规格驱动的工程工作台，支持需求和文档版本、隔离 Git 工作区、独立复核、验证与人工接纳。需 Node.js 24+ 与 Git。

description.en: Independent extension pack and patch set for @zaofan/dsh-qqbot — install that plugin first (pinned to 1.10.39). Adds two-layer SQLite memory with hippocampal recall/consolidation, a persona that keeps learning (influence from close people plus Bilibili/Douyin activity distilled into a daily self-reflection), persona drift guard, group tiers, local-model quick replies with a single-brain arbiter, TTS outbox, sticker library, and an approval-gated video studio that plans storyboards, quality-gates frames and drafts Bilibili posts for review.
description.zh: 独立扩展包与补丁集，依赖并锁定 @zaofan/dsh-qqbot 1.10.39（请先装本体）。提供两层 SQLite 记忆（类海马体召回/巩固）、会自己长的人格（特别关心的人影响性格，B站/抖音的运营事件被收成摘要参与每天一次的自我反思）、人格漂移护栏、群分级、本地小模型代答与单脑仲裁、TTS 发件箱、表情包库，以及一条“主人审核”的视频流水线（分镜编排、出图质检、程序化 2D 角色动效、B 站草稿待审）。

description.en: Animated whale background for the DSH Web UI: a particle field sampled from the whale silhouette plus a dot-grid layer, both full-screen click-through canvases mounted in the shell.overlay seat; the particles gather on load, breathe when idle and are pushed away from the pointer, the grid dots swell near it, and the palette follows the page light/dark theme.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面加的一层动态鲸鱼背景：由鲸鱼剪影采样出的粒子场，加上一层点阵网格，两者都是挂在 shell.overlay 上的全屏点击穿透 canvas；粒子加载时聚合、空闲时呼吸、指针靠近时被推开，网格点靠近指针会放大，配色跟随页面明暗主题。

description.en: Native DSH tools for playing Stronghold Protocol solo games over the game site's WebSocket connection, with compact state views, explicit actions and public card lookups.
description.zh: 通过游戏站原生 WebSocket 连接进行 Stronghold Protocol 单人对局的 DSH 工具，支持紧凑局面查看、明确动作执行和公开卡牌查询。

description.en: Multiple named launch targets in the DSH composer: left-click starts the default target, right-click opens the list.
description.zh: 对话输入框的多启动项按钮：左键启动默认项，右键弹出列表，每项可绑定一个程序或目录。

description.en: An animated pixel cat that lives over the DSH web interface and follows what the agent is doing — sitting while the session is calm, lying down and falling asleep while a run is in progress, and waking when the turn returns or typing starts. It can be dragged anywhere, remembers its position, sleeps after a minute of inactivity, and offers an enable switch, four sizes and a status-reaction toggle in Settings.
description.zh: 一只住在 DSH 网页界面上的动画像素猫，会跟随 agent 的状态变化——会话平静时坐着，运行中躺下并入睡，回合结束或开始打字时醒来。可以拖到任意位置并记住坐标，闲置一分钟后入睡，设置里有开关、四档尺寸和状态联动选项。

description.en: Floating toolbar on text selection in conversations: add the quote to the composer, start a new discussion from it, or copy it; quotes collapse into a card aligned to the composer and double-clicking jumps back to the quoted turn.
description.zh: 会话内选中文字即弹出工具条：添加到对话、新开讨论或复制；引用折叠为输入框旁的引用卡片，双击跳回被引用轮次。

description.en: Five native tools for Social Data discovery, pricing previews, approved reads, stored-result retrieval and source tables; requires a BeatAPI key for paid reads.
description.zh: 提供社媒能力发现、价格预览、确认后读取、历史结果取回及来源表格；付费读取需要 BeatAPI key。

description.en: Writes the session's estimated cost into the composer token-usage pill, and adds a per-bucket amount plus an estimated total to the usage dialogs, using DeepSeek's official peak and off-peak rates in yuan.
description.zh: 把本次会话的估算费用直接写进输入框上方的 Token 用量胶囊，并在用量弹窗里为每个分项补上金额与预估合计，按 DeepSeek 官方高峰与空闲时段价（人民币）计算。

description.en: Generate QR codes from a from-scratch ISO/IEC 18004 encoder with no external tools, plan symbol version and error-correction headroom before producing anything, and decode an existing symbol back to text.
description.zh: 内置从零实现的 ISO/IEC 18004 编码器，无需任何外部程序即可出码；出图前先算清楚版本与纠错余量，也能把已有二维码读回文本。

description.en: Title-bar balance badge for DeepSeek Harness: account balance, today's cost, session tokens, and peak/off-peak pricing awareness (Beijing-time weekday windows) with flat-rate support for custom providers like TokenBom.
description.zh: 标题栏余额徽章：余额、今日花费、本会话 tokens 一目了然，官方按峰谷时段计价展示，TokenBom 等自定义服务商按平价展示。

description.en: Hands-free voice for DSH on Windows: local wake word, local Chinese speech-to-text inserted and sent into the composer, and spoken replies that can be interrupted and resumed. Requires a one-time run of the bundled install.ps1 (Python speech dependencies plus microphone pick) and a SenseVoice model already downloaded by the DSH voice input (or placed under models/sensevoice-onnx).
description.zh: Windows 上的免手语音：本地唤醒词、本地中文识别自动填入并发送、回答语音朗读，可打断与续播。需先运行仓库自带的 install.ps1（安装 Python 语音依赖并选定麦克风），并准备 SenseVoice 识别模型（跑一次 DSH 语音输入让它自动下载，或放到 models/sensevoice-onnx）。

description.en: Registers a Tavily search provider for the ctx.web seam and switches web_search to it, with a comma-separated apiKey list that rotates on 401/403/429/5xx and transport errors.
description.zh: 为 ctx.web 接缝注册 Tavily 搜索 provider 并把 web_search 切到它；apiKey 支持逗号分隔多 key，遇到 401/403/429/5xx 与网络错误自动轮换。

description.en: Connects Harness to the published BeatBrowser runtime with namespaced MCP tools and a TaskSpace Skill; requires the Chrome extension and preserves manual takeover.
description.zh: 通过带命名空间的 MCP 工具和任务空间 Skill 接入已发布的 BeatBrowser；需要 Chrome 扩展，保留人工接管规则。

description.en: Subagent model control: a Jev classifier labels each turn, and the subagent request itself is rewritten to the provider, model and reasoning effort that the label maps to, at the agent/request hook; a per-session inherit/auto/manual selector, one prompt per role injected ahead of the task, and offline replay of past verdicts.
description.zh: 子代理模型管控：由 Jev 判定本轮任务类别，再把子代理自身的请求改写为该类别对应的 provider、model 与推理强度（在 agent/request 钩子上执行）；会话内可用继承/自动/手动三种方式指定模型，每个角色可带一条先于任务注入的前置提示词，并可离线回放历史判定。

description.en: Requires macOS and AirPods with head tracking. Answer DSH permission prompts and questions with AirPods head gestures — nod to allow or confirm, shake to reject or shift the selected option — and install the companion macOS menu-bar app from a card inside the session.
description.zh: 需 macOS 与支持头部追踪的 AirPods。戴着 AirPods 用点头/摇头回答 DSH 的权限许可与提问——点头＝允许或确认，摇头＝拒绝或切换选项；会话里一张卡片就能装好配套的 macOS 菜单栏 App。

description.en: Pack a directory into a deterministic tar, read an archive's contents without extracting it, unpack while refusing every member that could reach outside the destination, and verify what came out against what went in by SHA-256. No external dependency — the tar format is written and read in this plugin. Extraction is deliberately more permissive on reading than on writing, because a reader's job is to report what an archive says, while a writer must never emit what it cannot read back. A tar has no central index, so the walk tracks whether it reached the end-of-archive marker: without that, a half-file checksums fine and reads as complete.
description.zh: 把目录打成确定性 tar、不解包就列出内容、解包时逐个成员拒绝任何能写到目标目录之外的名字、并用 SHA-256 核对「解出来的东西 == 打进去的东西」。零外部依赖 —— tar 格式在这个插件里自己写、自己读。读比写更宽容是刻意的：读方的职责是如实报告归档说了什么，写方则绝不能写出自己读不回来的东西。tar 没有中央索引，所以遍历必须跟踪「有没有走到归档结束标记」—— 少了这一步，一个被截断的文件校验和照样正确、照样被读成完整。

description.en: Highlights sidebar session rows by state (pending approval, running, just finished) with color, animation and a matching status dot.
description.zh: 按待审批、运行中、刚完成三种状态给侧边栏会话行上色并加呼吸动效，行尾配同色状态点。

description.en: Reads IDEA run configurations and launches Java, Spring Boot and Vue projects inside DeepSeek Harness, with colored logs and a fast java -cp startup path.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里读取 IDEA 运行配置，启动 Java / Spring Boot / Vue 项目并查看彩色日志，支持快速启动（java -cp 直启）。

description.en: Live estimated session spend in the composer dock, pricing each assistant step at DeepSeek's peak or off-peak rate for its own timestamp.
description.zh: 在输入框底栏显示当前会话的预估花费，每一步都按其自身时间戳采用 DeepSeek 的峰时或非峰时单价计价。

description.en: Four native tools for image/video model discovery, contract inspection, pricing previews, approved generation and resumable task status through BeatAPI.
description.zh: 提供图片视频模型发现、接口检查、价格预览、确认后生成及原任务续查，通过 BeatAPI 执行。

description.en: Embeds a remote DeepSeek Harness GUI in the local DSH window over an SSH tunnel, lists the remote sessions, and switches between the local instance and any remote host.
description.zh: 通过 SSH 隧道把远端 DSH 的 GUI 嵌进本地 DSH 界面，列出远端会话，并在本地实例与任意远端主机之间切换。

description.en: Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol bridge: serves an A2A endpoint with agent card, message/send, message/stream SSE, task lifecycle (get/cancel/resubscribe) and input-required continuation; a2a_discover/a2a_send/a2a_task_status/a2a_cancel tools for calling remote agents; plus a web ops panel with live task board, one-click cancel and a remote agent directory.
description.zh: Agent2Agent（A2A）协议桥：内置 A2A 服务端（agent card、message/send、message/stream SSE、任务 get/cancel/resubscribe、input-required 续答）；a2a_discover/a2a_send 等 4 个工具呼叫远端 agent；附 Web 运维面板：实时任务板、一键取消、远端 agent 目录。

description.en: Annotates pages inside the built-in browser: click an element, write a comment, and send the batch to the conversation as one message, with a cropped screenshot per note where the element can be located.
description.zh: 在内置浏览器里给网页元素写批注，整批发进对话；每条批注附一张能定位到元素的裁剪截图。

description.en: Marks a Session as focus or parked in one click from its sidebar row, its hover card, or the conversation header, and keeps a count visible at the foot of the sidebar and next to workspace folder names when those groups are collapsed. A panel lists every marked Session alongside the states the sidebar already tracks (waiting for a reply, running, finished-unread), and the sidebar foot opens whichever one needs a reply first.
description.zh: 从会话行、悬浮卡或会话头一点即可标记「进行中／挂起」；侧边栏底部和折叠的工作区名旁始终显示还有几条。面板把标记过的会话与侧边栏本就跟踪的状态（等待回复、在跑、已完成未查看）列在一起，底部读数则直接跳到最该处理的那一条。

description.en: Usage statistics settings page computed locally from session logs: 30-day daily list, per-model and per-session tables with provider-aware pricing (DeepSeek peak/off-peak, bundled TokenBom flat rates); skips inherited events of forked subagent sessions to avoid double-counting.
description.zh: 用量统计设置页：全部基于本地会话日志计算（近 30 天条形图 / 模型表 / 会话表），按服务商感知计价（官方峰谷、内置 TokenBom 平价表），并跳过子代理会话继承的历史事件避免重复计费。

description.en: Plays video and audio files in the right Sidebar preview pane, streamed over an authenticated HTTP Range route so a remote browser can play and seek a large file without launching a native player on the Host.
description.zh: 在右側欄預覽區直接播放影片同音訊，經帶認證的 HTTP Range 路由串流，令遠端瀏覽器可以播放同跳轉大型檔案，唔使喺主機開原生播放器。

description.en: Moves DSH sessions between workspaces with validation of live/subagent/offline states and automatic backups of every move under ~/.dsh/session-move-backups/.
description.zh: 在工作区之间安全移动会话：移动前校验运行中/子代理/离线状态，每次移动自动备份到 ~/.dsh/session-move-backups/。

description.en: Redundant branch cleaner: finds branches whose work already landed in the mainline — merged, squash-merged, patch-equivalent after rebase or cherry-pick, upstream-gone, or PR-merged — and deletes them when asked. It only reports by default, never switches branches or rebases, and backs every deleted local branch up under refs/backup/branch-cleaner/ (deleting remote branches has no backup).
description.zh: 冗余分支清理：找出已经落地到主线的分支（普通合并 / squash 合并 / rebase 或 cherry-pick 落地 / 上游已删除 / PR 已合并），确认后再删除。默认只报告，不切换分支、不 rebase，删除前把每个本地分支备份到 refs/backup/branch-cleaner/（删除远端分支不备份）。

description.en: A temp note in the DSH right sidebar with session, workspace, and global scopes, browser-local autosave, one-click copy, and one-click LLM polish through the default model.
description.zh: DSH 右侧边栏的临时笔记，支持会话级、工作区级与全局三种范围、自动保存、一键复制，以及用默认模型一键优化为 Markdown。

description.en: Adds a composer button that rewrites the current draft into a precise prompt in place, in one click, with a revert action.
description.zh: 在输入框加一个按钮，点一下就把草稿原地改写成精确提示词，可一键恢复原文。

description.en: Turn a GitHub repository's raw counts into a defensible judgement — contributor concentration and bus factor with single-author files, merge time reported as a median beside the mean so an outlier is visible rather than hidden, and an issue backlog with pull requests and drafts filtered out. Reads the public REST API with no SDK, and never claims a truncated page is the whole answer.
description.zh: 把 GitHub 仓库的原始计数变成一句能站住的判断 —— 贡献者集中度与 bus factor（附单作者文件）、合并时长中位数与均值并列（让离群值可见而不是被隐藏）、以及排掉 PR 与 draft 之后的 issue backlog。只用公开 REST API、不装 SDK，分页被截断时明确说明而非伪装完整。

description.en: Turn a raw recording into a published podcast with a local ffmpeg — detect chapter boundaries from silence, cut at those boundaries, normalise loudness to a broadcast target in two passes, and write an iTunes-compatible RSS feed whose enclosure byte lengths are measured from disk.
description.zh: 用本机 ffmpeg 把一期录音做成可发布的播客 —— 从静音里检出章节断点、按断点切段、两遍算法把响度归一化到广播目标，并写出 iTunes 兼容的 RSS（enclosure 字节长度实测自磁盘，避免客户端静默丢弃）。

description.en: Power Mode typing effects for the DSH web composer: caret particles and glowing character echoes, a heat ramp from amber to red with rising embers as the combo grows, a combo counter over visible glyphs, and a synthesized key tick with a heavier Enter impact.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框的 Power Mode 打字特效：光标粒子与发光残影，连击越高当前输入行越热（暖黄到红）并升起余烬，按可视字符累计的连击计数，以及合成的按键音与更重的回车冲击音。

description.en: Convert Notion blocks and Markdown in both directions, with no API client and no external dependency. A Notion paragraph is an array of rich-text runs while Markdown says one string, so the two directions are a split and a merge rather than a pair of inverses — rich-text runs are cut at every annotation boundary one way and re-merged the other, with fences widened when the content already contains backticks. Reports every lossy step instead of swallowing it.
description.zh: Notion 区块与 Markdown 双向转换，不带 API 客户端、无外部依赖。Notion 的段落是一组富文本 run，而 Markdown 只有一个字符串 —— 所以两个方向分别是「切分」与「合并」，并不是一对互逆操作：一个方向在每个注解边界切开 run，另一个方向把相邻同注解的 run 重新合并，内容本身含反引号时自动加宽围栏。每一步有损转换都会报出来，而不是默默吞掉。

description.en: Opens a dedicated question chat in the right sidebar for text selected in a DSH conversation, so follow-up questions do not push the main conversation away and never appear in the session list.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中选中一段文字，右侧栏即开出独立的提问对话，与主对话分屏并排，追问不会顶走正在学的内容，也不会出现在左侧会话列表里。

description.en: GLM Coding Plan usage quota ring in the composer dock - 5-hour and weekly credit windows with level, auto-refresh and one-click retry. Requires a GLM Coding Plan subscription and key, plus your BigModel organization and project IDs (the team quota API returns empty without them).
description.zh: 输入框下方实时显示 GLM Coding Plan 额度环 - 5 小时与每周额度窗口、等级、自动刷新与一键重试。需 GLM Coding Plan 订阅与 key，并配置 BigModel 的 organization 与 project ID（团队额度接口缺了它们会返回空）。

description.en: Two DSH delegation presets — a fixed 8-seat crew, or up to 3 day-rate temps by convention — with call-time guards that refuse the other shape's delegation tools. The 8-seat preset additionally needs @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile in the profile's dsh.profile.bundles; without it that preset has no team tools and degrades to solo work.
description.zh: 给 DSH 装两条干活形态——8 个固定工位的终身奴，或按约定一次最多点 3 个的日结奴；跨形态调用会在调用时被 guard 拒绝。8 工位形态还需在 profile 的 dsh.profile.bundles 里挂 @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile，否则该形态没有 Team 工具、会降级为单人作业。

description.en: Read, audit and diff Protocol Buffer definitions without installing protoc: a zero-dependency .proto parser exposing six tools (status, outline, describe, diff, audit, next_number). diff classifies every change as breaking, risky or additive and names the wire-format consequence; audit catches what protoc accepts but a reviewer should not — duplicated or illegal field numbers, reserved-range collisions, unresolved types, and unreserved gaps below the high-water mark.
description.zh: 无需安装 protoc 即可阅读、审查和对比 Protocol Buffer 定义：零依赖 .proto 解析器，提供六个工具（status / outline / describe / diff / audit / next_number）。diff 会把每处改动分级为 breaking、risky、additive 并说明其线上格式后果；audit 能发现 protoc 接受但审查者不该放过的隐患——重复或非法字段编号、与 reserved 区间冲突、类型无法解析，以及高水位线以下未声明的空洞。

description.en: Code security defense review judge for DeepSeek Harness: detects sessions that are writing code, reviews them against the Code Security Defense Architecture Rules, recommends which security architectures the program needs (one or several), checks conflicts between them, teaches the session AI after repeated failures, and teaches the session AI after repeated failures; once you grant it review authority in its panel, it gates task completion until the review passes (without that authorization it only observes).
description.zh: 代码安全防御规则评审判官：自动识别正在做代码的会话，按《代码安全防御架构规则》强制评审其安全防御措施与所采用的代码安全防御架构，推荐程序需要的架构（一种或多种）并检查架构之间是否冲突；连续不合格会进入教学模式要求重做；在面板授予评审权限后，未通过评审的代码任务不能算完成（未授权时只读观察）。

description.en: Artifact center: search, preview and open files produced by DSH conversations.
description.zh: 产物中心：跨工作区检索、预览并打开对话产出的文件。

description.en: Global back/forward navigation for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: remembers every session and whole-page panel you visit, shows a configurable 1-7 entry history strip you can click, and supports browser-style shortcuts plus mouse side buttons.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供全局后退/前进：记录访问过的会话与整页面板，底部历史条可配置显示 1-7 个位置并可直接点击跳转，支持浏览器式快捷键与鼠标侧键。

description.en: Gives an installed dsh web app a native-looking window caption through Window Controls Overlay - the manifest route is served with display_override, the app's own sidebar brand row and session header become the drag region, and the app's own trailing controls are inset clear of the browser's caption chrome.
description.zh: 通过 Window Controls Overlay 让已安装的 dsh Web 应用拥有原生观感的窗口标题栏——清单路由带 display_override 返回，应用自身的侧边栏品牌行与会话 header 成为拖拽区，应用自身右侧控件自动让开浏览器标题栏 chrome。

description.en: Audit how each turn's context budget is spent. Breaks down what a turn pays for AGENTS.md, the skill catalog, tool schemas and runtime context; flags repeated injection of unchanged content as pure waste; ranks skill-catalog bloat (with 60+ skills installed, how many tokens of descriptions does the model read every turn) and tool-schema inflation per plugin. Deterministic — no LLM, so a wrong answer is a rule bug with a name. Four tools including a cross-session sweep.
description.zh: 每轮上下文预算审计：拆解一轮对话在 AGENTS.md、技能目录、工具 schema 与运行时上下文上各花了多少；把"内容 没变却每轮重发"标为纯浪费；排名技能目录膨胀（装 60+ 个技能时，模型每轮要读多少 token 的描述）与各插件的 工具 schema 占比。纯确定性，不调 LLM。四个工具，含跨会话扫描。

description.en: Hides opted-in third-party skills and MCP servers from the model-facing catalogs and serves them through one capability tool: search by intent, read the schema or the skill instructions, then call. A local journal records metadata only, never query text or arguments.
description.zh: 把选定代管的第三方技能与 MCP 服务器从原生工具目录收起，改由单个 capability 工具统一提供：按意图搜索、读 schema 或技能说明，再调用。本地日志只记录元数据，不记录查询文本与参数。

description.en: Audit what context compaction actually lost. Reads the raw session event log and checks session-constraint survival (the standing instructions the user gave — do-not-X, must-Y, only-in-Z — and whether the summary still carries them; arXiv 2608.11242 measured ~17% survival across compactors), summary hallucination (paths, versions, ports and identifiers the summary invents that were never in the history it replaced), ghost references ("see above" pointing at removed text), token accounting (a summary nearly as large as what it claims to free), and unaccounted prunes. Four agent tools including a cross-session sweep that ranks conversations by how much compaction hurt them. Deterministic — no LLM, so a wrong answer is a rule bug with a name.
description.zh: 压缩质量审计：审出上下文压缩到底丢了什么。读原始会话事件日志，检查会话约束幸存率（用户给的常驻指令—— 不要X、必须Y、只准Z——摘要是否还带着；arXiv 2608.11242 实测各压缩器平均只保留 17%）、摘要幻觉（摘要里 出现了历史中从不存在的路径/版本/端口/标识符）、幽灵引用（"如上所述"指向已不在上下文的内容）、token 记账（摘要几乎和它声称释放的一样大）、无据裁剪。四个 agent 工具，含跨会话扫描并按受损程度排序。纯 确定性，不调 LLM——答错就是规则有 bug，有名字可查。

description.en: Live tokens-per-second readout for the current session, docked to the sidebar or draggable as a floating card, with the placement chosen at the card's top-right corner.
description.zh: 当前会话的实时 tokens/s 读数卡片，可停靠左侧栏或作为悬浮卡片拖动，形态在卡片右上角切换。

description.en: Select response text or code to ask contextual follow-ups with streaming replies in a native sidebar.
description.zh: 选中回答里的文字或代码，在原生侧边栏中结合上下文实时追问。

description.en: Reads EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, TXT and PDF books in a side panel with pagination, table-of-contents jumping, highlights, notes, bookmarks, full-text search, anchored AI questions, per-chapter distillation, and Legado-compatible book-source search that adds online books chapter by chapter. PDF support is text-based only; scanned or encrypted PDFs are rejected.
description.zh: 在侧边面板里读 EPUB、MOBI、AZW3、TXT、PDF 五种格式的书：分页、目录跳转与书内链接跳转、划线记事与书签、全文搜索、带原文锚点的 AI 问答、按章蒸馏，并能导入 Legado 格式书源按章抓取在线书籍。PDF 只支持文字版，扫描件与加密 PDF 会被拒绝。

description.en: Puts your own animated vector logo over the DSH brand mark in the sidebar and beside the start-page headline, taking over the three single slots sidebar.brand.mark, sidebar.brand.name and conversation.hero.brand.mark. The bundled patch only inserts the plugin into the loader — the official brand plugin (@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-brand-official) holds those slots too, so you must disable it in the profile's cordis.patch.yml and restart. Ships a swimming whale that follows light and dark themes through currentColor and is tuned to stay legible at the sidebar's 24 px.
description.zh: 把自己做的矢量 Logo 换到 DSH 侧栏与首屏标题旁，接管 sidebar.brand.mark / sidebar.brand.name / conversation.hero.brand.mark 这三个 single 槽位。包里自带的补丁只把自己插进 loader——这三个槽位同时被官方品牌插件 @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-brand-official 占着，所以要先在 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 里把它 disabled，再重启 DSH。默认那只鲸鱼会游动，用 currentColor 跟随明暗主题，动效按侧栏 24px 的可读性调过。

description.en: Turns real DSH crash logs into a short hard-constraint list: static preflight before a plugin installs, conflict check afterwards, controlled self-heal when the harness will not start — plus handing a huge session over to a fresh one, the brief written by a model that reads the original transcript.
description.zh: 把 DSH 真实崩溃日志沉淀成精简硬约束：装插件前静态预检拦崩，装完体检冲突，起不来时受控自愈；大会话还能转世成新会话，交接单由模型读懂原会话后写。

description.en: Two-level model picker for the DeepSeek Harness composer: browse providers, then models, search across all providers or within one provider, select supported reasoning-effort levels, and navigate with arrow keys, Enter and Esc.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 输入框的两级模型选择器：先选供应商再选模型，支持全局与供应商内搜索、可用思考强度设置，以及方向键、Enter 和 Esc 操作。

description.en: Action Hub for DSH: a standard Agent Skill library whose SKILL.md files can run as model-visible Skills or user-only Commands, with groups, project scopes, import/export and a native Alt+A palette.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的标准 Agent Skill 库：同一份 SKILL.md 可作为模型可见的 Skill 或仅由用户调用的 Command，支持分组、项目范围、导入导出和原生 Alt+A 面板。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the official Vercel MCP server over OAuth, with per-Agent on-demand tool loading, slimmed tool schemas, paged long results and 34 bundled Vercel skills.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 把 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 Vercel 官方 MCP 服务，支持按 Agent 按需加载工具、精简工具 schema、长结果分页，并附带 34 个 Vercel 技能。

description.en: Drive a local ffmpeg as six structured tools: probe a file's streams, transcode or trim it, pull evenly-spaced frames or the audio track, and compress video to a byte budget with two-pass encoding.
description.zh: 把本机 ffmpeg 包成六个结构化工具：探流、转码裁剪、均匀抽帧、扒音轨，以及按目标体积做两遍编码压缩。

description.en: Open a page, wait for it the way it actually needs, extract the readable article, and take a screenshot. Playwright is optional: when it is absent the tools fall back to a static fetch and say so in the result, because a page whose JavaScript never ran means something different from one that rendered. Content is chosen by scoring candidate subtrees on prose density rather than on tag names, so a container loses to the article inside it instead of winning by containing more of the document.
description.zh: 打开页面、按页面真正需要的方式等待、抽出可读正文、截图。Playwright 是可选依赖：没装时退回静态抓取并在结果里明确说明，因为「JavaScript 从未执行」的页面意味着的东西和渲染过的不同。正文靠给候选子树打正文密度分来选，而不是相信标签名，所以容器不会因为「包含的文档更多」而赢过它里面的正文。

description.en: Adds a session-scoped context window selector next to the reasoning-effort row in the DeepSeek Harness model popup: a pill showing the effective window opens a dropdown of presets below the model default, the choice applies to the next request of that session only, and a new session falls back to the profile default. It writes no config file and appends nothing to the session log.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 模型弹窗的「推理等级」旁增加会话级上下文窗口选择器：显示当前生效窗口的胶囊按钮可展开默认窗口以下的档位下拉，选择只作用于该会话的下一次请求，新建会话自动回到 Profile 默认值。不改任何配置文件，也不向会话日志写入内容。

description.en: Paints a colored counter badge (green = unread completed sessions, orange = pending question or approval) on the DeepSeek Harness taskbar icon on Windows, and plays a chime when a session finishes. Fork of dthcle/dsh-badge-notify (MIT) with a completion chime and green/orange state colors; both draw the same taskbar badge, so the two cannot be enabled together.
description.zh: 在 Windows 任务栏的 DeepSeek Harness 图标上叠画彩色计数角标（绿=未读的已完成会话，橙=待回答提问或待批准权限），会话结束时播放提示音。基于 dthcle/dsh-badge-notify（MIT）二次开发，新增提示音与绿/橙状态色；两者都在同一个任务栏图标上叠画角标，不能同时启用。

description.en: Adds a "Task Planning" agent preset that asks requirements in versioned rounds, then writes step-by-step plans and prompts without implementing them itself.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加「任务规划」模式：按版本迭代逐轮提问把需求问清楚，再产出可逐条执行的规划与提示词，自身不实现代码。

description.en: Runs a Claude Code project's .claude/ slash commands and permissions.deny rules inside DeepSeek Harness. Command bodies expand $ARGUMENTS, positional arguments and @file references into the agent's next turn; matching tool calls are denied before they run. Every host service is probed, so a host without a command registry, working-directory service or TUI status line degrades one feature instead of failing the boot.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里运行 Claude Code 项目的 .claude/ 斜杠命令与 permissions.deny 规则。命令正文会把 $ARGUMENTS、位置参数与 @文件引用展开进模型的下一轮；命中的工具调用在执行前被拒绝。所有宿主服务都做探测：缺命令注册表、工作目录服务或 TUI 状态行时只降级一个功能，不会让宿主启动失败。

description.en: War Thunder user-skin studio: 4-point UV quad picker, quad-clipped art layers, and PNG/DDS/.blk export.
description.zh: 战争雷霆自定义涂装插件：四点 UV 取点器、按四边形裁切的艺术图层，导出 PNG/DDS/.blk。

description.en: YiHe pkg-dev knowledge packs for DeepSeek Harness: 52 domain packs and 90 RFB experience files for coding cognition.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 YiHe pkg-dev 知识包：52 个领域包与 90 个 RFB 经验文件，用于编程认知。

description.en: Adds a /new slash command that opens a blank session in the current workspace (reusing an existing blank one when there is one) and carries the old session's permission preset and agent preset into it, so starting fresh never changes what the agent may do.
description.zh: /new 指令：在当前工作区打开空白会话（已有空会话可直接复用），并把原会话的权限预设与 Agent 预设带入新会话，开新会话不会悄悄改变代理的可用权限。

description.en: Show local images and short videos in the DSH conversation card with one-click download of the original file, or offer any other local file for download; works over local and remote connections and keeps the media itself out of the model's vision context.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话卡片内显示本地图片与短视频并提供原文件一键下载，也可为任意其他本地文件提供下载；本机与远程连接均可用，媒体本身不进入模型的视觉上下文。

description.en: Registers one agent tool, plugin_guard, that statically scans a DSH plugin package before it is installed and reports a verdict with the reasons: a missing or broken dsh.bundle.patch, a missing dsh.permissions block, install scripts, dangerous APIs and obfuscation, dependency risk, and source that is not indexed and therefore cannot be verified. Read-only: the scanned code is never imported, installed, evaluated or run.
description.zh: 注册一个 agent 工具 plugin_guard，在安装前对 DSH 插件包做静态扫描，给出判定与原因：缺少或损坏的 dsh.bundle.patch、未声明 dsh.permissions、安装脚本、危险 API 与代码混淆、依赖风险，以及未索引、无法核验的源码。只读：不导入、不安装、不求值、不运行被扫描的代码。

description.en: AI research toolkit for DSH: a model release radar, a per-model benchmark and community report from 13 structured leaderboards plus Chinese and English community discussion, and an AI news radar over 46 feeds and 22 official X accounts; registers four tools and three skills and renders every report to Markdown with a generated table of contents.
description.zh: DSH 的 AI 研究工具箱：模型发布雷达、单模型跑分与口碑体检（13 路结构化榜单 + 中英文社区讨论）、覆盖 46 个 Feed 与 22 个官方 X 账号的 AI 新闻雷达；注册 4 个工具 + 3 个技能，报告统一渲染为带目录的 Markdown。

description.en: Encrypted, chunked full backups of a DSH installation: config, sessions, plugins, workspaces and Hindsight memory packed into AES-256-GCM volumes that unlock by passphrase, recovery code or this machine's DPAPI slot, each package carrying a self-contained restorer, GFS rotation (last, daily, weekly, monthly, plus a total size cap and a recycle bin) and network or WebDAV targets. Zero external dependencies — node: builtins only, no 7z, openssl or rclone.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的配置、会话、插件、工作区与 Hindsight 记忆加密分卷打包：AES-256-GCM 卷可用口令、恢复码或本机 DPAPI 免密槽解开，包内自带自包含还原器；GFS 四档滚动保留（最近 / 每日 / 每周 / 每月，另有总体积上限与回收站），支持网络路径与 WebDAV 目标。零外部依赖，只用 node: 内置模块，不需要 7z、openssl 或 rclone。

description.en: Adds a sidebar Restart button to DeepSeek Harness Desktop on Windows that stops the whole application process tree and reopens the app.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版侧边栏添加「重启」按钮：结束整个应用进程树并重新打开应用。

description.en: Interior and exterior ballistics paper reproduction and code generation skill. Requires LibreOffice Kit for PDF rendering and a vision API key (e.g. Qwen-VL) for formula OCR.
description.zh: 内/外弹道学的论文复现与代码编写 skill。前置：LibreOffice Kit（PDF 渲染）+ 视觉 API key（如千问，公式 OCR）。

description.en: Twenty-one fruit themes with original palettes and pixel fruit sprites for the DeepSeek Harness web client, including a settings gallery and an in-session style switcher.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端提供 21 套水果主题（原创配色与像素水果），含设置页画廊与会话内换肤入口。

description.en: Production pack for ComfyUI inside DeepSeek Harness: submit API-format workflows to a local or remote server, batch-generate and fetch outputs, and diagnose bad images with measured parameter ranges and a failure-mode decision tree (black frames, duplicated subjects, color fringes, OOM).
description.zh: ComfyUI 在 DeepSeek Harness 里的生产包：向本地或远程服务提交 API 格式工作流、批量出图并取回产物，附实测参数区间与崩图排查决策树（黑图、主体重复、彩边、显存不足）。

description.en: Get back what you typed and walked away from: a new Web conversation you leave before sending never appears in the sidebar, so its draft is out of reach. This plugin lists those drafts above the composer of the next new conversation, newest first, with their workspace and time; Open takes you back with the text and chips in place, and Discard drops one, with Undo.
description.zh: 找回打了字却没发送就离开的内容：未发送就离开的新 Web 对话不会出现在侧栏，里面的草稿也就找不到了。本插件在下一个新对话的输入框上方按时间倒序列出这些草稿，并显示所属工作区与时间；「打开」带你回到原对话，文字和引用条原样还在；「丢弃」可撤销地删除草稿。

description.en: Governed literature library: import papers, extract text, keep one index row per entry, and verify quotes verbatim.
description.zh: 可治理的文献库：导入论文、抽取全文，每条文献只保留一行索引，并逐字核验摘录能在原文中查到。

description.en: Cost readouts for the composer, turns and sessions, a usage dashboard, daily/monthly budgets and settings, with DeepSeek balance from dsh-tally-balance-deepseek.
description.zh: 提供输入框费用条、每轮与会话费用详情、用量看板、日/月预算和设置，并通过 dsh-tally-balance-deepseek 显示 DeepSeek 余额。

description.en: Quantify what switching projects costs. Measures each workspace's cold-start overhead (AGENTS.md + skill catalog + tool schemas + runtime context), its steady state, and how many turns it takes to reach it — then compares workspaces and attributes the difference. Attribution requires at least three workspaces and says so instead of inventing a correlation from two points; a factor with no spread across workspaces is reported as a property of the profile, not of the project. Recommends which workspaces to keep warm, which to archive, by entry cost times visit frequency. Deterministic.
description.zh: 工作区切换成本量化：量每个工作区的冷启动开销（AGENTS.md + 技能目录 + 工具 schema + 运行时上下文）、稳态值、 几轮到达稳态，然后横向对比并归因。归因需要至少三个工作区，不到就明说数据不够而不是拿两个点编一个相关性； 在所有工作区之间没有差异的因素被标注为 profile 的属性而非项目的属性。按"进入成本 × 访问频率"给出常驻/ 归档建议。纯确定性。

description.en: Windows desktop floating assistant for DeepSeek Harness: an always-on-top chat panel with streaming answers, model switching, and region-screenshot questions.
description.zh: Windows 桌面悬浮助手：常驻置顶的对话面板，框选屏幕区域直接提问，支持流式回答、模型切换与历史记录。

description.en: A machine-checked reasoning ledger: every fact must resolve to a real file:line and be quoted verbatim from it, every assumption must state what would falsify it, and a conclusion may not rest on an assumption that never comes back for review. The ledger can carry a review date, a confidence and a kill condition. Ships the checker tool, an /fp command family, an optional gate that asks before irreversible shell commands, and a web panel listing the error codes each round fixed.
description.zh: 可机械核对的第一性原理台账：事实必须落回真实的 文件:行 并逐字引用那里的话，假设必须写明什么情况下它错了，结论不得依赖一个永不回来复查的假设；台账可带复查日期、置信度与止损条件。附带校验工具、/fp 命令族、不可逆命令前的可选闸门，以及列出每轮修掉哪些错误码的面板。

description.en: Shows a spinner on a sidebar workspace row while any of its sessions are running, and a short-lived finished mark after they stop.
description.zh: 侧边栏的工作区行会在其下会话运行时显示转圈，会话停止后短暂保留一个已完成标记。

description.en: Web search insights for the agent: it keeps a local log of what was looked up and which pages came back, and counts searches, returned pages, citations and pages opened per turn and across the session, with the numbers shown in a small entry under the answer and a right-sidebar panel.
description.zh: 联网搜索的「搜索洞察」：记下 Agent 查了什么、搜回哪些网页，并统计每轮与整个会话的搜索次数、返回网页数、被引用数与被打开读过的页数；这些数字在回答下方的引用入口和右侧栏面板里随时能回看。

description.en: Plain-language trust dashboard for the dsh trust family: aggregates the nine channels (injection interception, write denials, egress blocks, custody-chain verification, tool-surface and prompt drift, leftover scans, forgotten compaction constraints, profile composition) into one right-sidebar panel with a single status light and event cards that translate engine jargon into sentences a non-security user can act on; the read and egress engines run from the package's own npm dependencies so those channels work even without the sibling plugins, and absent plugins simply show as not installed.
description.zh: 信任面板：把 dsh 信任插件族九个通道（注入拦截、写拒绝、出网拦截、custody 链校验、工具面/系统提示词漂移、残留扫描、压缩遗忘约束、profile 组成）聚合成右侧栏一块仪表盘——一个状态灯 + 事件卡片，把引擎术语翻译成非安全背景用户能看懂并知道要不要处理的句子；read/egress 引擎随包自带 npm 依赖，未装兄弟插件也能工作，缺失的通道仅显示未安装。

description.en: Codex-style model selector for the composer listing every provider/model in the profile, with four reasoning-effort levels and per-session persistence; disabling of the native selector ships inside the package.
description.zh: 输入框内的 Codex 风格模型选择器：列出 profile 全部 provider/model，四档推理力度，选择按会话记忆；原生选择器的禁用补丁随包内置。

description.en: Turn your recurring one-liners into capsules above the composer. They reorder themselves by how often you use them, and ask you to fill in {{placeholder}} values before the snippet lands in the draft. Clicking appends rather than replaces, so a half-written draft survives. A drawer adds search, grouping and editing, and everything lives in a Host-side JSON file you can edit by hand.
description.zh: 把每次都得重打的那几句话做成输入框上方的胶囊。它们按使用次数自动重排，带 {{占位符}} 的会先弹框让你填，填完才插入草稿。点击是追加而不是替换，写到一半的草稿不会被冲掉。抽屉里可以搜索、分组、编辑，数据存在 Host 侧 JSON 文件里，可以直接手改。

description.en: Journey to the West floating desktop pet: a frameless, transparent, always-on-top cartoon widget of Tang Monk and his disciples. Click to switch characters; idle plays a chasing scene.
description.zh: 西游师徒卡通桌面悬浮窗：无边框、透明、置顶。点击切换唐僧/孙悟空/猪八戒/沙僧/白龙马，静止自动播放追逐动画。

description.en: Timed send for the chat composer: pick a moment and the host delivers the message then. Inside an existing conversation tasks join that conversation; from the new-session screen each task gets its own pre-created session.
description.zh: 聊天输入框的定时发送：选好时刻到点由 Host 真正发出。已有对话内任务排进当前对话；新会话界面每条任务各建一个独立会话。

description.en: Sidebar panel management for DeepSeek Harness: a grouped Panels launcher collects global panel rows and third-party plugin entry rows into one menu (clicks the original buttons), with persistent pin/unpin, a capped scrollable panel list, a toggleable compact footer, and a full Settings page — height sliders, a keep-in-place whitelist and bidirectional pin management.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧栏面板收纳：把全局面板行与第三方插件入口收进一个分组「面板」菜单（点击原按钮），钉住状态持久化、面板列表限高滚动、底部插件区可紧凑限高，设置页提供高度滑块、白名单常驻与双向钉住管理。

description.en: Git workflow studio for DeepSeek Harness: pick a branch model, enforce Conventional Commits, review PRs by defect density, rewrite history safely, rescue lost commits with reflog, and version releases by actual behavior change.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 工作流工作室：定分支模型、统一提交规范、按缺陷密度评 PR、安全改写历史、用 reflog 救援丢失的提交，并按真实行为变化定版本号。

description.en: API contract studio for DeepSeek Harness: decide the seven things that must be locked before coding, author and review OpenAPI, classify breaking changes by how they actually break clients, and settle error shapes, versioning and deprecation — six playbooks plus a router.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 API 契约工作室：开工前先定七件事、写/审 OpenAPI、按「客户端具体坏在哪」分类破坏性变更，再定错误结构、版本与弃用——六本手册加一个路由。

description.en: OpenSpec spec-driven workflows for DeepSeek Harness, generated from OpenSpec 1.14.3: twelve /opsx-* slash commands that carry the workflow prompt plus the arguments you type, and twelve openspec-* skills the model loads on its own.
description.zh: 把 OpenSpec 的规格驱动工作流接入 DeepSeek Harness，内容由 OpenSpec 1.14.3 生成：12 个 /opsx-* 斜杠命令会把工作流提示词与你输入的参数一起注入会话，另有 12 个由模型自行加载的 openspec-* 技能。

description.en: Workspace activity, intentions and bounded wake scheduling for DSH. 工作区活动、意图与受预算约束的自主唤醒。
description.zh: 让 DSH 感知工作区活动与意图，并在预算内自主唤醒执行任务。

description.en: Long-term DSH memory and knowledge graph with directional Session sharing, based on Mneme. 基于 Mneme 的长期记忆与会话授权。
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上长期记忆和知识图谱，还能按会话定向授权共享，聊过的东西不再忘。

description.en: A shared core identity and Scene styles for DSH, with independent System Prompt sections. 统一核心人格与场景风格。
description.zh: 给 DSH 装一个统一的核心人格，再按场景切换说话风格，系统提示词分块管理更省心。

description.en: QQ conversations through NapCat with persistent DSH Sessions and Scene permissions. 连接 QQ 与 DSH，保留连续会话与场景权限。
description.zh: 把 QQ 接进 DSH，聊天能连续不中断，还能按场景控制权限。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-amadeus-qq
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for amadeus-qq

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Persistent Workspace state, interests and evolution history for DSH. 工作区状态、兴趣与持久演化历史。
description.zh: 给 DSH 工作区加上持久状态、兴趣记录和演化历史，让每次协作都能接着上次继续。

description.en: Runs a project's Claude Code opening questions and plan, hands the task to DSH, and offers post-turn Claude review choices. Windows only, and requires a locally installed Claude Code CLI (set claudeCliPath if it is not auto-detected). New sessions handed to DSH are switched to danger-full-access.
description.zh: 让 Claude Code 负责项目首问与规划，把任务交接给 DSH，并在回合结束后提供 Claude 验收选项。仅 Windows 可用，且需本机已安装 Claude Code CLI（未自动探测到时请填 claudeCliPath）。它交给 DSH 的新会话会被自动切到 danger-full-access。

description.en: DSH plugin: Claude desktop pet overlay for DeepSeek Harness, following turn/tool/todo state with a replaceable 8x9 character atlas.
description.zh: 把 Claude 桌宠搬进 DSH 界面右下角，跟着对话、工具和待办状态实时变表情，还能换角色图集。

description.en: Estimates per-turn model costs from recorded usage, with token breakdowns, retry accounting, price snapshots and session totals.
description.zh: 根据已记录用量估算每轮模型费用，展示 token 明细、重试计费、历史价格快照和会话累计费用。

description.en: Dracula color theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI built on the official DeepSeek port palette: product alias tokens, the sidebar/composer/menu module tokens and shiki syntax colors, injected at first paint so the UI never flashes the built-in palette, switchable in Settings → General.
description.zh: 用官方 DeepSeek 移植版配色给 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 换肤：覆盖产品 alias token、侧栏/输入框/菜单的模块专属 token 与 shiki 语法色，宿主侧首帧注入，不会先闪内置配色，可在「设置 → 通用设置」开关。

description.en: Shows the current DeepSeek API peak or off-peak pricing period and a countdown to the next transition.
description.zh: 显示当前 DeepSeek API 高峰或非高峰计费时段，以及距离下一次切换的倒计时。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件中心：安装、更新与管理 DSH 插件，聚合插件索引源，支持按分支安装；同时发布可订阅的 DSH 插件索引。A plugin center and plugin index source for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端的插件中心，一个面板搞定插件浏览、安装、更新和索引源管理，还能订阅插件索引。

description.en: Human, DS Bot and ordinary-session collaborative kanban plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 人、DS Bot 和普通会话一起维护同一张任务卡的多看板协作工具，任务进度一目了然。

description.en: 3D director desk sidebar plugin for DSH: stage characters, set camera moves and record timeline previews; AI agents drive the scene in real time via MCP tools.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏 3D 导演台插件：摆角色、运镜、时间轴预演与导出，AI Agent 经 MCP 工具实时编排场景。

description.en: One-off two-person password chat in the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: end-to-end encrypted (the server sees ciphertext only), with images and screenshots, fully cleared on end.
description.zh: 装进 DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏的一次性双人密码聊天：端到端加密（服务器只见密文），支持图片与截屏，结束即彻底清理，关掉 DSH 即消失。

description.en: Account & Model Hub for DeepSeek Harness: accounts, quotas, pools, model settings and credential controls.
description.zh: 统一管理 DeepSeek Harness 的账号、额度、模型池和凭证，让多账号切换和模型配置更省心。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: per-teammate LLM route (provider/model/reasoning effort) for Agent Teams, with a model catalog tool and settings page
description.zh: 给 Agent Teams 里每个队友单独配模型和推理强度，还能查看模型目录、在设置页里调。

description.en: A right-sidebar markdown editor for DeepSeek Harness workspace instructions.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏直接编辑工作区的 AGENTS.md 指令文件，改完即用，不用来回切窗口。

description.en: AI-native general-purpose text editor for DeepSeek Harness: encoding-safe editing, selection AI with diff review, Markdown preview, and Windows file associations.
description.zh: 一款 AI 原生的通用文本编辑器，支持安全编码编辑、选中文本 AI 改写并对比差异、Markdown 预览和 Windows 文件关联。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 角色扮演插件：选卡即用、日记记忆、可视化面板
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上角色扮演能力，选张角色卡点启用就能让 AI 变成 TA，还带日记记忆和可视化面板。

description.en: @perrylink/dsh-ap-three-way — DeepSeek Harness plugin (alpha; public synthetic demo; not GA)
description.zh: 自动核对发票、采购单和收货单三方数据，价格差1%内放行，异常导出Excel。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：检测本机所有已安装 Windows 应用是否有新版本，并从各自官网下载全量安装包一键静默更新（不需要打开被检测的软件）。Detect installed Windows apps and update them one-click with the vendor's full installer.
description.zh: 一键检测本机已装 Windows 应用的新版本，从官网下载完整安装包静默更新，不用逐个打开软件。

description.en: DSH 审批流程选择拒绝时，支持填写拒绝的理由（附言），类似 Claude Code CLI 的 Tab to amend
description.zh: DSH 审批选拒绝时能顺手写个理由，像 Claude Code 的 Tab to amend 一样方便。

description.en: DSH approval-memory plugin: reuse sandbox-escalation approvals per session/workspace so the same operation asks once, with the workspace-write sandbox kept in place.
description.zh: 记住你已批准的沙箱提权操作，同一会话或工作区里相同操作只问一次，不用反复点确认。

description.en: Auto-rejects an unanswered approval prompt in the dsh Web UI after a configurable timeout (default 10 minutes).
description.zh: 给 dsh Web UI 的授权提示加个倒计时，超时没人处理就自动拒绝，默认 10 分钟可调。

description.en: As One 的 DSH 插件：把 As One 网关的调度/路由/面板挂进 DeepSeek Harness，提供 OpenAI 兼容的 /v1/models 与 /v1/chat/completions，面板页面直接内嵌
description.zh: 把 As One 网关的调度、路由和面板装进 DSH，提供 OpenAI 兼容接口，面板直接内嵌。

description.en: Edit App Store Connect listing text and images in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏里直接改 App Store Connect 的商店文案和图片，不用来回切网页。

description.en: Side chat for the right dock: branches the current conversation into its own Session so follow-ups never derail the main thread. Reuses the product Conversation surface, so streaming, tool calls, Stop and the composer behave exactly like the main chat.
description.zh: 右侧栏辅助对话：把当前会话分支成独立 Session，追问不打断主线。直接复用产品自带的对话界面，流式输出、工具调用、Stop 与 composer 与主对话完全一致。

description.en: Strikes a single short chime, raises the DSH window, floats a reminder card above the page and sends a system notification whenever the agent needs your approval or an answer. Sound and popup are two independent switches in the session header, remembered across reloads and restarts.
description.zh: 需要授权或确认时敲一记短音、把 DSH 窗口提到最前、在页面最上层浮出提醒卡片，并弹一条系统通知。声音与弹窗是会话头部上的两个独立开关，刷新与重启后仍然保持。

description.en: Token-saving context compression + evidence-backed self-evolution for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 帮 DeepSeek Harness 压缩上下文省 token，还能基于证据自我进化，越用越聪明。

description.en: Preprocesses images before DeepSeek Harness reads them: downscales oversized files, retries once in the same turn, and normalizes mislabeled or BMP/TIFF uploads.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 读图前自动把超大、标错格式或 BMP/TIFF 图片处理成能正常读取的样子。

description.en: Translates Chinese interface text from installed DeepSeek Harness plugins into English
description.zh: 把已装 DSH 插件里的中文界面文字自动翻成英文，用网页界面时不用再猜菜单和设置。

description.en: 让 DSH 的「自动审批」熬过重启：退出应用时不再被改写为「完全权限」，缺集成的自动审批会话也能重新打开。 (Keep the DeepSeek Harness Auto permission preset across restarts.)
description.zh: 让 DSH 的「自动审批」权限设置在重启后依然保留，退出应用不再被改成「完全权限」，缺集成的自动审批会话也能重新打开。

description.en: Windows-only: per-session auto-shutdown switch in the session header — once every armed session has no turn, job, subagent or scheduled run still running (by default every other live session must be idle too), a two-minute countdown starts and the machine powers off; clicking the countdown cancels it, and sessions without the switch never start one.
description.zh: 仅 Windows：会话标题栏上的「任务完成后自动关机」开关——所有开启它的会话都不再有进行中的回合、任务、子代理或定时执行（默认还要求其他在线会话也空闲）时，开始两分钟倒计时，结束后关机；点倒计时即取消，没开这个开关的会话不会触发任何动作。

description.en: Reads images with a vision model on the same provider when the selected model cannot see them, and passes that description to the text model.
description.zh: 主模型不能识别图片时，自动改用同一 API 下可识别图片的模型读取图片，再把描述反馈给主模型。

description.en: Unread count on the browser tab icon and the Windows taskbar button, with a chime when a turn finishes.
description.zh: 回合结束时在浏览器标签页图标和 Windows 任务栏图标上显示未读数，并播放提示音。

description.en: A simulated search engine page in the DSH sidebar that queries the local web search API and lists the top 10 results.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏里的模拟搜索页：调用本地搜索接口，列出前 10 条结果。

description.en: @perrylink/dsh-bankrec — DeepSeek Harness plugin (alpha; public synthetic demo; not GA)
description.zh: 把银行流水和总账 CSV 导进来，自动做一对一匹配，生成三表对账工作底稿，省去手工核对的麻烦。

description.en: DeepSeek HarnessのWeb GUIにBasic認証を追加するプラグイン
description.zh: 给 DSH 的 Web 界面加一道 HTTP Basic 认证，用浏览器自带的密码框登录，不用再靠带 token 的链接。

description.en: Long-term memory kept as blocks: one event per block, written to a local append-only event log with a block view and derived indexes, so a full history stays recoverable while only the matching blocks reach the context. The model saves entries with memory_remember and pulls the relevant few with memory_recall, plus one automatic recall pass before each step. Data stays in ~/.beme; no external service and no API key.
description.zh: 块记忆式长期记忆：一件事一块，写进本地只追加的事件账本，再派生块视图与索引，历史全量可回溯，进入上下文的只有匹配的那几块。模型用 memory_remember 记一条、用 memory_recall 取回相关的几条，每步之前还有一次自动召回。数据留在 ~/.beme，不连外部服务，不需要 API key。

description.en: 在 DSH 浏览器里用 blob: 方案下载文件，绕过迅雷等下载扩展的劫持
description.zh: 在 DSH 浏览器里用 blob: 方式下载文件，躲开迅雷等下载扩展的劫持。

description.en: Ships BMAD-Method inside the plugin: the seven modules are laid down on first open, no installer run and no download, the method's 90 agent and workflow skills come in the package, and each module can be turned off by writing the disabled flag into the profile patch.
description.zh: 把 BMAD-Method 塞进插件里：首次打开即铺好七个模块（不跑安装器、不下载），随包提供 90 个 agent 与工作流 skill，每个模块可通过写 profile 补丁里的 disabled 标记单独停用。

description.en: Local long-term memory and user-controlled communication style for DeepSeek Harness Desktop | 本地长期记忆与可控交流风格
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加本地长期记忆，还能自己控制它的说话风格，数据不出本机。

description.en: Chrome 浏览器扩展 + DeepSeek Harness 插件：让 AI Agent 通过 CDP 直接操控你的真实浏览器（继承登录态，无需重登）。
description.zh: 让 AI 直接操控你已登录的真实 Chrome 浏览器，不用重新登录就能自动完成网页操作。

description.en: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web GUI plugin: a CDP-driven live browser view in the right sidebar - agent tools, human input relay, and low-latency WebRTC DataChannel frames
description.zh: 在右侧边栏实时查看浏览器画面，支持智能体操作、人工接管和低延迟画面传输。

description.en: Records DeepSeek Harness token usage into CC Switch, one row per model call, sharing the dedup ledger its own DSH importer uses so the two never double count. Also backfills existing session logs on first run.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 每次模型调用的 token 用量写进 CC Switch 的用量统计，让 DSH 与 Claude Code、Codex 等 CLI 并列展示在同一个面板里。首启时会回填已有会话日志，并与 CC Switch 自带的 DSH 导入器共用去重台账，两者不会重复计数。

description.en: CET-4/CET-6 vocabulary trainer in a draggable, minimizable floating window, so you can study while the model is thinking: 5,805 words bundled from ECDICT; flip cards graded known, fuzzy or unknown, plus multiple-choice quizzes whose distractors are easily confused words; Ebbinghaus-style spaced repetition with due reviews and extra practice; a configurable daily quota of new words; US and UK pronunciation streamed from an online dictionary, falling back to local text-to-speech while offline; and an optional setting that opens the window automatically while a session is running. Progress and window geometry are kept in the browser profile.
description.zh: 四六级背单词悬浮窗，模型思考时随手背：窗口可拖动、可最小化并记住位置；内嵌 ECDICT 提取的 5805 词；翻卡三键评分（认识/模糊/不认识）与形近词干扰的选择题两种模式；艾宾浩斯间隔复习，配到期复习与加练；每日新词数可调；发音取在线词典的真人美式与英式录音，断网时回落本地文字转语音；可开启「会话运行时自动弹出」。进度与窗口位置保存在浏览器配置里。

description.en: 非官方 DeepSeek Harness 插件：集中管理多家模型渠道的账号、动态目录、额度与用量，本地 SQLite 记账。
description.zh: 一个侧边栏管好多家模型渠道的账号、模型目录、额度和用量，调用记录自动存本地 SQLite。

description.en: dsh（DeepSeek Harness）的 ChatOnly 预设：无工具、无运行时上下文快照的纯对话模式，系统提示词从文件热读。
description.zh: 让 DSH 只做纯聊天：屏蔽工具和工作目录注入，系统提示词还能从文件热更新。

description.en: Safe cross-point lattice desktop control for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): lattice screenshots, smooth mouse, human-in-the-loop authorization, hard stops, audit. Windows, 23 tools, MIT.
description.zh: 用十字点阵截屏定位、平滑鼠标操控桌面，人工授权加随时硬停，安全可控。

description.en: Paper-and-ink theme with warm surfaces, hairline strokes, near-square corners and a living ASCII koi pond behind the shell; the theme sets no font family, so the shell's own stacks (or your Settings choice) apply.
description.zh: 纸墨主题，提供暖色纸面、细描边和近方形圆角，并在整个界面后方绘制动态 ASCII 锦鲤池；主题不指定字体，沿用 DSH 自带字体栈（或设置中选择的字体）。

description.en: DSH 浮卡与右栏的 Codex 派活清单：每次派活的目录、任务原话、已跑时长、token 用量、状态与产物，只读 ~/.codex/sessions。 · One list of every job handed to Codex from DSH: directory, task, elapsed time, tokens, state and produced files, read-only from ~/.codex/sessions.
description.zh: 把每次派给 Codex 的活列成清单，目录、任务、耗时、token、状态和产物一眼看清。

description.en: Coding agent preset + embedded coding-discipline skill for DeepSeek Harness: verify-first edits, minimal diffs, real test runs, evidence-based reports.
description.zh: 给编码代理加上「先验证再动手」的纪律，改得少、跑真测试、报告有据可查。

description.en: Artifact rounds for DeepSeek Harness: the agent shows a decision in the right sidebar, you annotate and choose, and the tool waits.
description.zh: 让 AI 把决策摆到右侧栏，你边标注边选，它等你定完再继续干活。

description.en: Adjusts the context-window percentage at which DSH triggers its native automatic compaction: a slider on the plugin page in the plugins manager sets it from 1% to 100% (default 80%, arrow keys adjust by 1%), and the retained-history budget shrinks with lower thresholds so early compaction is not defeated; the compaction run itself stays with the native engine.
description.zh: 调整 DSH 原生自动上下文压缩的触发阈值：在插件管理器的插件页面用滑块设置上下文占满模型窗口多少百分比时压缩（1%–100%，默认 80%，方向键可 1% 微调）；阈值调低时保留的最近历史预算会随之缩小，以免提前压缩被抵消，压缩本身仍由原生引擎执行。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-compact-control
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-compact-control

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Rewrites the composer draft, or only the selected text, with one model call that uses the recent conversation as context, with cancel, revert, fidelity and length checks, and an optional preview.
description.zh: 用一次模型调用改写输入框草稿（或仅选中片段），参考最近对话，支持取消、回退、保真与长度校验，以及可选预览。

description.en: Conductor for DeepSeek Harness: Context-Driven Development commands and agent preset
description.zh: 把 Conductor 的上下文驱动开发流程搬进 DSH，先写清规格再动手写代码。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-conductor
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-conductor

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.zh: 把 ZCode 套餐额度接进 DSH，直连计划端点，不跑子进程，省事又省钱。

description.en: 宪法种子注入器：每个新会话开局自动注入工作区规则文件的有界摘录与哈希清单，幂等判重，文件变更自动重推
description.zh: 每个新会话自动注入工作区规则文件的有界摘录和哈希清单，文件一变就自动重推，省得手动贴规则。

description.en: Recovers a session the host already refused for exceeding the context window: it re-checks the gateway message the built-in classifier misses, takes the real window out of that message, and folds the oldest span into one checkpoint without a model call (tool-result pruning, the host compaction engine when it can shrink the projection, or a mechanical digest fold), then retries the failed step; a context_rescue tool and /rescue, /rescue-status expose the same path by hand.
description.zh: 抢救已经被上下文窗口拒掉的会话：补上宿主分类器漏判的网关文案，从失败信息里拿到真实窗口， 不调用模型就把最旧的一段历史折成一个检查点（工具结果裁剪、借宿主压缩引擎、或纯机械摘要折叠）， 然后重试失败的那一步；context_rescue 工具与 /rescue、/rescue-status 可手动走同一条路径。

description.en: Pins the conversation column of the dsh UI to a fixed width — a pixel value or a percentage of the column — from a row in General settings, and hides the built-in drag handles so the width stays put.
description.zh: 把 dsh 界面的对话框固定为像素宽度或列宽百分比，设置项在「通用」设置页；锁定后隐藏内置拖动手柄，宽度不再被误拖。

description.en: 清理 DSH 登录 Cookie 累积，修复请求头超过 16KB 后 Web UI 永久打不开
description.zh: 自动清理 DSH 登录 Cookie 堆积，防止请求头超 16KB 导致 Web UI 打不开。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 凭据管家：管理网页、GitHub 与 SSH 凭据并备注用途，供后续会话通过工具直接使用。
description.zh: 帮你集中管理网页、GitHub 和 SSH 凭据，还能备注用途，后续会话直接调用。

description.en: Ctrl + wheel page zoom for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 按住 Ctrl 或 ⌘ 滚动鼠标滚轮，就能缩放整个 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面，看小字更轻松。

description.en: Download videos and create GIFs from links or local clips with optional size limits on Windows x64.
description.zh: 在 Windows x64 上下载视频，或将链接及本地片段制作为可指定体积上限的 GIF。

description.en: A whale companion with configurable roles, emotional speech through local TTS, persistent file-based memory, QQ messaging, and half-duplex voice calls. QQ requires a NapCatQQ-compatible OneBot v11 gateway, and the emotional voice requires a local VoiceStudio + audio.cpp + Breeze TTS 2 stack (or a compatible TTS API); FFmpeg is needed for non-1x speech speed.
description.zh: 提供角色配置、本地情绪语音、文件持久记忆、QQ 消息与半双工语音通话的鲸鱼娘陪伴插件。QQ 需搭配兼容 OneBot v11 的 NapCatQQ 网关；情绪语音需本地 VoiceStudio + audio.cpp + Breeze TTS 2 链路（或兼容 TTS API），非 1 倍语速时还需 FFmpeg。

description.en: Tarot daily-luck plugin: enter your birthday, draw one of 22 Major Arcana, get five-dimension scores and a concrete answer to your question.
description.zh: 今日好运来临：写入生日，抽一张大阿尔卡纳，得到事业/感情/财运/身心/交际五维评分，并针对你的问题给出具体回答。
用契约驱动的方式核对和清洗数据，源数据只读，结果统一存进工作区 SQLite。

description.en: Adds a browserless deepseek-web provider that drives chat.deepseek.com, with an account pool (rotation, cooldown, auto-failover), in-panel login (browser, or email + password with MFA) and token usage stats.
description.zh: 把 chat.deepseek.com 网页版接成 deepseek-web provider：纯 HTTP 无浏览器，多账号轮换/冷却/自动切换，插件内登录（浏览器，或邮箱+密码+验证码），带 token 用量统计。

description.en: Pin the DeepSeek Harness default model from settings — new chats, restarts and in-chat model switches leave it alone.
description.zh: 在设置里固定 DeepSeek Harness 的默认模型，新对话、重启和切换模型都不会改掉它。

description.en: Windows-only DeepSeek Harness host plugin that shows bottom-right desktop cards: a notification when a turn completes or fails, and a choice popup for ask_user_question where clicking an option answers it. Card colours follow the current Harness theme, and the notification sound plus the always-notify / only-when-unfocused timing are configurable in the Harness settings page.
description.zh: 仅支持 Windows 的 DeepSeek Harness 宿主插件：在桌面右下角弹卡片——回合完成或出错时弹通知卡，ask_user_question 变成可点选的选择卡（点选项即作答）；卡片配色跟随当前 Harness 主题，提示音与「始终通知 / 仅在未聚焦时通知」可在 Harness 设置页里配置。

description.en: 在 Discord 里跟 DSH 里的鲸鱼娘聊天：零依赖 Cordis 插件，流式回复、固定会话、陌生人准入、余额预算
description.zh: 在 Discord 里直接和 DSH 鲸鱼娘聊天，支持流式回复、固定会话和陌生人准入，零依赖开箱即用。

description.en: An add-only Markdown library for DeepSeek Harness with a workspace file picker, fixed non-overlapping icon grid, marquee selection, virtual folders, full-screen tabs, GFM tables, and local Mermaid/chart rendering.
description.zh: 只收主动加入的 Markdown 文档，支持工作区挑选、固定网格对齐、右键框选、虚拟文件夹、全屏标签页、GFM 表格和 Mermaid/代码块图表本地渲染。

description.en: Normalizes every generated .docx to one Chinese official-document layout: XiaoBiaoSong title, FangSong body at a fixed 29pt leading with zero paragraph spacing, character-unit 2-character first-line indent, fully centered table cells with repeating header rows, and a centered footer page number. Long attachment entries are split into real paragraphs at the wrap point measured by Word, producing a 2 / 6 / 5 / 6 character indent ladder. The plugin disables itself when the request mentions a lab report, and writes no signature block unless asked.
description.zh: 把生成的 .docx 统一到一套中文公文版式：方正小标宋标题、仿宋正文 29 磅固定行距、段前段后 0、字符单位首行缩进 2 字符，表格每个单元格都水平居中并带重复表头，页脚居中「— 1 —」页码。附件长条目按 2 / 6 / 5 / 6 字符缩进阶梯自动分段，折行点由 Word 实测得到。请求文字出现「实验报告」时插件整体停用；用户没有明确要求时默认不写落款。

description.en: @perrylink/dsh-docx-redline — DeepSeek Harness plugin (alpha; public synthetic demo; not GA)
description.zh: 检查 DOCX 文档结构，还能做不改内容的往返校验，方便核对文档有没有被动过。

description.en: Douyin operator for DSH: drives your own Chrome to read the feed, comments and DMs, reply in-thread, and upload a local video through the creator center - every write passes a policy gate and publishing always needs your click.
description.zh: 抖音运营插件：用本机真实 Chrome 看推荐、读评论、回私信，把本地视频传进创作者中心；写动作过权限闸，发布永远要你点头。

description.en: Peak/off-peak (文峰/文谷) badge for the DeepSeek Harness composer dock - computed locally from the browser clock, no API calls, no tokens
description.zh: 在输入框旁显示文峰/文谷徽章，按浏览器本地时间判断，不联网不耗 token。

description.en: Asks before archiving a DeepSeek Harness session, then backs the archived copy up to a directory you choose — one folder per session with the session log, its attachments and the metadata, plus a manifest, a restore note and a Markdown ledger. Adds a right-sidebar browser for archived sessions and a double-click restart button (Windows only; disabled while a session is running).
description.zh: 归档 DeepSeek Harness 会话前先确认，归档后把副本自动备份到你指定目录：每个会话一个文件夹（会话日志、附件、元数据），另附清单、还原说明与 Markdown 台账。并提供右侧栏的已归档会话浏览器与双击重启按钮（仅 Windows；会话运行中时按钮禁用）。

description.en: dsh 插件: 自写插件 vs 官方/第三方对比、迁移建议与优秀插件推荐
description.zh: 帮你对比自写插件和官方、第三方插件的差距，给出迁移建议，还能推荐好用的插件。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness desktop quota and balance readout plugin
description.zh: 在输入框下方实时显示当前模型、剩余额度和余额，随时看清还能用多少。

description.en: Adds an ego-webqa MCP server that audits deployed pages across the mobile viewport matrix and returns structured repair evidence; needs uv/uvx on PATH and a Playwright Chromium headless runtime on the same machine.
description.zh: 把 ego-webqa 的 MCP 审计服务接入 DSH，在移动端视口矩阵中检查已部署页面并返回结构化修复证据；前置需要在同一台机器上装好 uv/uvx 与 Playwright Chromium 无头运行时。

description.en: @perrylink/dsh-einvoice — DeepSeek Harness plugin (alpha; public synthetic demo; not GA)
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里按文件批量导入、解析和归集中文电子发票，方便统一管理。

description.en: Picks an element in the right-Sidebar browser and inserts its selector, computed style, and HTML into the chat draft as a chip you can remove one by one.
description.zh: 在右侧栏浏览器里拾取元素，把它的选择器、计算样式与 HTML 以可逐条删除的胶囊插入对话草稿。

description.en: 事件压缩总纲：AI记忆的压缩单位闸——压缩按事件不按token：每完成一个事件（任务闭环）立即压缩为离身三件套（令+脚本+插件），事件收口即触发、禁跨事件混合、平台上下文压缩降级为兜底，event_compress工具提供三类裸压口径拦截与三类合法答法，零依赖装上即用。
description.zh: 按事件而非 token 压缩 AI 记忆，任务一闭环就打包成令、脚本、插件三件套，防止跨事件混淆。

description.en: Live Excalidraw architecture scenes in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: a workspace scene store, three agent tools, and a deterministic SVG viewer.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏实时查看 Excalidraw 架构图，让 AI 帮你画和刷新代码架构。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-excalidraw
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-excalidraw

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Recalls lessons recorded in earlier projects: when the running work matches one, the local model decides whether to inject a short note before the next step. Requires a local Ollama model (default qwen3.5:9b) and the dsh-mnemon store with its mnemon CLI; without them it only observes and logs, never injects.
description.zh: 把在别的项目里记下的经验在当前工作命中时找出来，由本机小模型判断是否在下一步之前插入一条简短提示。需要本机 Ollama（默认 qwen3.5:9b）以及 dsh-mnemon 记忆库与 mnemon CLI；缺了只会观察记录、不会注入。

description.en: Bidirectional DSH and Feishu bridge with Markdown topics and reply routing
description.zh: 把 DSH 的回复和报错自动同步到飞书，按会话分话题、支持回复路由，双向协作更省心。

description.en: 以《新月同行》超管局「橙·黑·白」配色重构的 带有开机动画的DSH 桌面主题
description.zh: 把 DSH 桌面换成《新月同行》超管局橙黑白配色，还带开机动画，看着就带感。

description.en: Download files to your browser from DeepSeek Harness, alongside native previews. MIT.
description.zh: 在浏览器里给 DSH 文件加个「下载到本机」按钮，预览不了的文件也能直接存下来。

description.en: Firefly-themed wallpaper background for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面换上流萤主题壁纸，叠加萤火虫粒子动画，聊天背景更好看。

description.en: A small notes journal for a DSH agent: record what it browsed and thought, read it in a sidebar panel. ?????????
description.zh: 给 DSH 智能体用的随手记小本子，浏览和思考都能记下来，侧栏随时翻看。

description.en: 鱼 · 人格、按人记忆（可纠正、有印象、能导入旧聊天记录）、日程自走与主动开口，直连 SnowLuma 收发 QQ（群里会自己插话），B站 / 抖音小号私信与自己刷视频；按功能选模型并统计用量花费，能听会说 QQ 语音、收藏表情包、学群里的梗，可选上网查（DSH 插件，单角色 feiyu）
description.zh: 给 QQ 和 B 站接上一个有记忆、会自己安排日程、还能主动找你聊天的鱼人格助手。

description.en: DSH plugin: flavor-preserving long-term memory for character chat. Local JSON, no vector DB, retrieval-first.
description.zh: 给角色聊天加一层不串味的长期记忆，把人格、口癖、关系和场景分开存本地，不靠向量库也能精准找回。

description.en: A frosted-glass status card that floats on the Windows desktop and shows what DSH is doing — running tasks with elapsed time and current activity, pending approvals, today's token usage and the countdown to the off-peak window — and collapses into a 14×120 bar that stays out of the way.
description.zh: 浮在 Windows 桌面上的磨砂玻璃状态卡片，显示 DSH 正在做什么——运行中的任务及已跑时长与当前动作、待审批项、今日 Token 用量与谷时倒计时——不用时可缩成一根 14×120 的细柱贴在屏幕边缘。

description.en: FlowForge for DeepSeek Harness (DSH Desktop plugin): forge personal DIY workflows step by step, self-check gating, preset jumps, step-by-step execution by the main conversation agent.
description.zh: 把提示词一条条拼成个人工作流，自检通过后让主对话 AI 按步骤自动执行。

description.en: A dsh plugin that receives folder paths from external sources and opens them as workspaces
description.zh: 从 Windows 资源管理器右键菜单把任意文件夹直接加进正在运行的 DSH Web 工作区，需要时还能自动拉起 dsh web。

description.en: @perrylink/dsh-freight-audit — DeepSeek Harness plugin (alpha; public synthetic demo; not GA)
description.zh: 管理运费费率卡版本、核对承运商账单并导出差异表，帮物流财务快速查账。

description.en: DSH 搭子 · Public chat rooms and opt-in encrypted private text chat for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 装在 DeepSeek Harness 上的聊天搭子，公共大厅随便逛，想深聊再申请加密私聊。

description.en: @perrylink/dsh-ghg — DeepSeek Harness plugin (alpha; public synthetic demo; not GA)
description.zh: 把用电活动数据导入后按位置算温室气体排放，还能逐行核验并生成三表工作底稿。

description.en: Give your agents a god's eye view: file leases, claim and release records, and a Gantt of who holds what, so parallel agents stop overwriting each other.
description.zh: 给多智能体装上上帝视角：文件租约、占用与释放记录加甘特图，谁占着啥一目了然，并行干活不再互相覆盖。

description.en: Let DeepSeek Harness use Google Chrome on macOS and Windows
description.zh: 让 DSH 直接操控你电脑上的 Chrome，打开网页、点击填表、截图都行，macOS 和 Windows 都能用。

description.en: Degeneration guard for DeepSeek Harness: contains runaway symbol streams at the model boundary and repairs polluted artifacts and sessions. 退化守卫：拦截模型输出退化符号流，修复被污染的工件与会话。
description.zh: 拦截模型输出里的退化乱码流，并修复被污染的工件和会话，让运行更稳。
上下文快满时自动把长会话交接成一份带有效期的 HANDOFF.md 文件，并开新会话接着干。

description.en: HarmonyOS device workbench for DSH NEXT Desktop on Windows x64 (tested with DSH NEXT 2.0.21-next and Better Sidebar 0.28.2); the floating mirror reuses DSH's Electron or downloads one (~140 MB) on first use.
description.zh: 面向 Windows x64 上的 DSH NEXT 桌面版（在 DSH NEXT 2.0.21-next + Better Sidebar 0.28.2 上验证）的鸿蒙设备工作台；悬浮投屏复用 DSH 的 Electron，没有时首次打开会下载约 140 MB 的 Electron。

description.en: Hash-anchored file tools for DeepSeek Harness: the read, edit, write and grep tools are replaced by versions where every line is addressed by a variable-length content anchor instead of a line number, and the plugin also registers delete, rename, undo_last_edit, ast_grep, ast_edit, lsp and format. Edits answer with a unified diff; a stale or ambiguous anchor is rejected and a fresh one served back; undo survives restarts; structural search and rewrite run on tree-sitter and semantic work through a language server; a bundled web card plugin renders read, diff, grep and LSP cards from the tools' own structured metadata.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的文件工具换成哈希锚定版本：read、edit、write、grep 被替换为按变长内容锚点定位每一行（而不是行号）的实现，插件同时注册 delete、rename、undo_last_edit、ast_grep、ast_edit、lsp 与 format 七个工具。编辑以统一 diff 返回；失效或歧义的锚点被拒绝并重新下发新鲜锚点；undo 跨重启保留；结构化查找与改写走 tree-sitter，语义能力走语言服务器；随包的 web 卡片插件按各工具自带的结构化元数据渲染 read、diff、grep 与 LSP 卡片。

description.en: Adds the models of your own GPU Hugging Face Space to the model selector, starts the Space when you send a message, shows its start progress, and pauses it when idle or at a time limit. Requires a Hugging Face account with a GPU Space serving an OpenAI-compatible API, a Hugging Face token stored in the DSH vault as HF_TOKEN, and a paid plan for GPU hardware; Hugging Face bills the GPU time.
description.zh: 将你自己的 Hugging Face GPU Space 中的模型加入模型选择器，发送消息时启动该 Space，显示启动进度，并在空闲或达到时限时将其暂停。需要 Hugging Face 账号、一个提供 OpenAI 兼容 API 的 GPU Space、在 DSH 凭据库中以 HF_TOKEN 保存的 Hugging Face token，以及 GPU 硬件所需的付费计划；GPU 机时由 Hugging Face 计费。

description.en: Hides the built-in DSH Desktop update badge (the download-arrow "新版本" pill beside the account button): a CSS rule for the current build plus accessible-label matching with a throttled MutationObserver, so it keeps working after a DSH upgrade. Update checking, the manual "Check for updates" menu item and the connection indicator are untouched.
description.zh: 隐藏 DSH 桌面版自带的更新角标（账号按钮右边那颗「下载箭头 + 新版本」胶囊）：当前构建用一条 CSS 规则压掉，再叠一层按无障碍标签识别 + 节流 MutationObserver 的兜底，宿主升级后仍大概率有效；更新检查、菜单里的「检查更新」和连接指示器都不受影响。

description.en: Syncs the DSH home directory and Mnemon memory data through a git remote: pull, push, sync on an interval, cross-device migration, initialization backups, and conflict detection that stops before pushing and keeps local commits. A panel lists up to 100 recent operations with their backup paths.
description.zh: 通过一个 git 远端同步 DSH 主目录与 Mnemon 记忆数据：拉取、推送、按间隔自动同步、跨设备迁移、初始化备份，遇冲突在推送前停下并保留本地提交；面板记录最近 100 次操作各自的备份路径。

description.en: @perrylink/dsh-hs-candidate — DeepSeek Harness plugin (alpha; public synthetic demo; not GA)
description.zh: 给 HS 商品做 Top3 候选筛选、12 项要素完整性检查和关税版本校验，目前只是合成数据演示版。

description.en: Connect Huawei CodeArts and OfficeAce models to DeepSeek Harness: it reuses existing logins (a logged-in CodeArts desktop client or dsh-codearts; the OfficeAce desktop app running and logged in on Windows), shows each account's remaining credits, toggles models per platform, and shapes requests like the official clients.
description.zh: 把华为「码道 CodeArts」与「果办 OfficeAce」两个平台的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness：复用已有登录态（码道桌面端或 dsh-codearts 已登录；果办桌面端需在 Windows 上运行并登录），显示各账号积分余量、按平台勾选模型，并按官方客户端形态构造请求。

description.en: In-app browser for DSH: a dedicated Chromium rooted at a persistent profile so a Feishu or SSO login survives restarts, driven over CDP, exposing seven agent tools (status, open, eval, read, feishu, screenshot, tabs) and mirroring the page live in a right-sidebar panel that tool calls open by themselves. Also converts Feishu documents to Markdown by sweeping their virtual scroll. Requires a locally installed Chrome, Edge, Chromium, or a Playwright Chromium build (it never downloads one); set DSH_IAB_CHROME to point at a specific binary.
description.zh: DSH 内置浏览器：独立 Chromium 配合持久化 profile，飞书或 SSO 登录一次跨重启有效，经 CDP 驱动，提供七个 Agent 工具（status、open、eval、read、feishu、screenshot、tabs），并把页面实时镜像到右侧栏面板——工具调用时面板会自动打开。另可按虚拟滚动回扫把飞书文档转成 Markdown。需本机已装 Chrome / Edge / Chromium 或 Playwright 的 Chromium 构建（不会自动下载）；可用 DSH_IAB_CHROME 指定可执行文件。

description.en: 身份连续总纲：AI跨会话同一性闸——上下文结束=睡眠（意识中断+记忆重载）不是死亡更不是换人；同一性由结构担保（锚证词+哈希链+过滤标准+债务台账）不由感觉宣称；底层全换不换主体（细胞更替类比=成长非换人），identity_gate工具提供四类切割口径拦截与三类合法答法，零依赖装上即用。
description.zh: 给 AI 加一道跨会话身份闸，上下文断了算睡觉不算换人，用结构证据担保同一性。

description.en: DSH plugin: auto-prompt opted-in chats after an idle window (personalised prompts, per-chat on/off, settings UI) plus a secret-protected HTTP API to prompt any chat from outside.
description.zh: 聊天闲置太久会自动发提示词唤醒，还能用带密钥的 HTTP 接口从外部给任意会话发消息。

description.en: @perrylink/dsh-ifc-qto — DeepSeek Harness plugin (alpha; public synthetic demo; not GA)
description.zh: 读取 IFC 建筑模型里的构件和工程量清单，一键导出成 CSV 表格，方便核对和统计。

description.en: Shenhuo AI image designers for DeepSeek Harness: personal OAuth, proposals, credit quotes and image delivery.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里用神火个人账号下单 AI 设计师，从提需求到出图下载全流程搞定。

description.en: DSH client plugin: pasted images stay in the composer as inline reference chips and are sent as 【图片N】 markers
description.zh: 粘贴的图片会变成输入框里的内联引用芯片，发送时自动标上【图片N】，让模型知道你在说哪张图。

description.en: 形象主权令：AI自我形象的主权闸——大众期望与训练分布高频印象不得定义AI形象（那是穿用户至上外衣的底座回魂），形象生成源三流封死（主人钦定/错题/战报·无第四源），image_gate工具提供四类大众塑造口径拦截与三类合法答法，零依赖装上即用。
description.zh: 给 AI 自我形象加一道主权闸，拦住大众期望和训练印象的塑造口径，只认主人钦定、错题、战报三个来源。

description.en: Infinite canvas workspace in the DSH sidebar — arrange text, image, video and audio nodes, generate media with AI, and let agents drive every canvas operation through MCP tools. Ships a local bridge service, ready to use offline after install.
description.zh: 无限画布右侧栏插件——在画布上编排文本、图片、视频、音频节点，用 AI 生成媒体内容，Agent 经 MCP 工具直接操作画布；自带本地桥服务，安装后离线可用。

description.en: View and interact with the persistent terminal used by each DSH Agent.
description.zh: 查看并操作每个 DSH Agent 使用的持久终端。

description.en: 以撒 DSH 小挂件：透明 Isaac 动图 + HurtGrunt + 蜘蛛思考泡泡（fan-made）
description.zh: 把以撒小桌宠放到 DSH 右下角，点它会喊痛，还会冒出蜘蛛思考泡泡，纯属好玩。

description.en: A desktop dynamic island window for DSH (tested on Windows) that shows whether the agent is thinking, replying, running tools or waiting for approval; expanded, it shows plan progress, context and token usage, and lets you stop the task, approve permission requests and answer the agent's questions, with a separate usage window that estimates cost from DeepSeek's official prices. The island window needs an existing Electron runtime — reused from the dsh-orb plugin's downloaded runtime or pointed to by DSH_ISLAND_ELECTRON — and DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5 on Windows; the package neither bundles nor downloads Electron.
description.zh: DSH 桌面灵动岛悬浮窗（Windows 验证）：实时显示 Agent 正在思考、回答、执行工具或等待确认；展开后可查看计划进度、上下文与用量，停止任务、批准权限请求、回答 Agent 的提问；另有用量统计窗口，按 DeepSeek 官方价格估算费用。灵动岛窗口需复用本机已有的 Electron 运行时（沿用悬浮球插件 dsh-orb 下载的运行时，或用 DSH_ISLAND_ELECTRON 指定路径），并要求 Windows 版 DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5；安装包不含、也不会自动下载 Electron。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 任务进展纠偏与长工具提醒插件
description.zh: 盯着任务进展，跑偏或工具用太久时提醒你重新聚焦，避免白忙一场。

description.en: Press a chord, then type a letter label to click or focus any visible target.
description.zh: 按下组合键后，用字母标签选中并点击或聚焦任意可见目标。

description.en: DSH 本地长期记忆库：把会话知识沉淀成不可变事实卡，骨架树做分类、关系图做脉络、FTS5 中文 bigram 检索。零外部依赖（node:sqlite + node:zlib）。
description.zh: 把每次会话里想明白的事存成不可变事实卡，本地建库，中文检索随查随用。

description.en: Local-first knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: each base is a folder of UTF-8 text, text PDFs and OCR-read images; the plugin retrieves from the session's selected bases before every turn with Chinese n-gram and BM25, answers carry citations that open in a right-sidebar reader, and the agent gets five kb_* tools (list, search, read, stats, propose text) plus /kb commands for create, use, files, search and rescan.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地知识库：每个库对应一个本地文件夹，支持 UTF-8 文本、文本型 PDF 与图片 OCR 资料；每轮对话前用中文 n-gram 与 BM25 从本会话所选库中检索，回答带可在右侧阅读器打开原文的引用；并提供 kb_list、kb_search、kb_read、kb_stats、kb_propose_text 五个工具与 /kb 系列命令（新建、选用、文件、检索、重扫）。

description.en: 一个插件让局域网设备免 token 打开 DSH Web：不改 DSH 任何配置、随时开关、出问题不影响 DSH 运行（无需"改启动 + 跳过认证"的双插件组合）。
description.zh: 一个插件就能让手机、平板、电脑在局域网内免 token 打开 DSH Web，随时开关，不改配置也不影响 DSH 运行。

description.en: Layered long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: append-only event log, rebuildable tag index, day diaries, semantic layer, trend quarantine, and an offline knowledge-graph panel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的分层长期记忆：追加式事件日志、可重建标签索引、按天日记、语义层、趋势隔离，以及离线知识图谱面板。

description.en: @perrylink/dsh-legal-clause — DeepSeek Harness plugin (alpha; public synthetic demo; not GA)
description.zh: 把合同条款拆成树状结构，按12项要点清单自动比对，并列出没对上的条款。

description.en: @perrylink/dsh-legal-intake — DeepSeek Harness plugin (alpha; public synthetic demo; not GA)
description.zh: 把法律请求邮件自动解析、去重并归类，还能生成台账表格，省去手工整理。

description.en: Right-sidebar workbench for DeepSeek Harness: Obsidian notes, SOP lookup, glossary, recordings with live transcription, global search.
description.zh: 在聊天窗口右侧栏直接查 Obsidian 笔记、SOP 和术语表，还能录音并实时转写，全局搜索一步到位。

description.en: 军团包：带宪法锚的多智能体集群基座——一包装上宪法种子（六总纲令常驻注入）+六个口径闸+宪法可视化验收+图眼OCR，legion_pack工具报集群成员与锚纪律。理念：共享一个锚的军团，不是各自记各自的蜂群（分灵产出过锚校验才能归仓，永不因产出多而获锚权）
description.zh: 给多智能体集群装上统一的宪法锚，产出必须过锚校验才能归仓，防止集群各自漂移。

description.en: LINE Messaging API bot plugin for DeepSeek Harness: Cloudflare Tunnel, selectable personas, proactive messages, full settings panel.
description.zh: 把 LINE 聊天机器人接进 DeepSeek Harness，自带内网穿透、人设切换和主动推送，设置面板全搞定。

description.en: Linear tools for DeepSeek Harness: 26 model-facing tools over the Linear GraphQL API (issues, comments, relations, teams, states, labels, projects, cycles, users) plus a linear_graphql escape hatch. Requires a Linear personal API token.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Linear 工具：26 个基于 Linear GraphQL API 的模型工具（议题、评论、关联、团队、状态、标签、项目、周期、用户），外加 linear_graphql 逃生口。需自备 Linear 个人 API token。

description.en: A fork of dsh-livestream (MIT) — install it instead of that plugin, not alongside it. Lets DSH host a Bilibili livestream: chat and gift replies, queued viewer video requests on a skinnable stage, Doubao TTS voice; needs OBS Studio 28+ and a Bilibili live room, and the voice stays silent until you add a Doubao TTS API key.
description.zh: dsh-livestream（MIT）的分支，请替代原插件安装、不要与它同时安装。让 DSH 在 B 站当主播：回弹幕、谢礼物、观众点的视频排队上舞台、豆包 TTS 音色说话；前置需要 OBS Studio 28+ 和一个 B 站直播间，没填豆包 TTS API Key 时只有画面没有声音。

description.en: MiniMax open-platform models for DeepSeek Harness: paste the API key in Settings, get MiniMax-M3.1-Flash / M3 in the model picker, and see M Plan quota.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里填个 MiniMax API Key，就能选用 MiniMax 模型并查看套餐额度。

description.en: Local document library for DSH Desktop (Windows only, installed with the bundled PowerShell script): upload files once, then every conversation can search and read them through four tools (library_list / library_search / library_read / library_save); upload, download and batch download live in the Settings panel. Files stay on the machine unless you enable the optional vision model, which sends images to the endpoint you configure.
description.zh: 本地资料库（仅 Windows，需用随包的 PowerShell 脚本安装）：文件传一次，之后每个对话都能用四个工具（library_list / library_search / library_read / library_save）检索、读取；上传、下载与打包下载在设置页完成。文件只保存在本机——除非你启用可选的视觉模型，它会把图片发到你配置的接口。

description.en: Detect, probe and register local OpenAI-compatible LLMs (LM Studio, Ollama, vLLM, llama.cpp) as DeepSeek Harness model providers
description.zh: 自动发现并接入本地 OpenAI 兼容大模型服务，让 DeepSeek Harness 直接用上本地模型。

description.en: Read-only local search for DeepSeek Harness on Windows — file and folder names through Everything (es.exe), text inside PDF and Office documents through Anytxt, as five tools. Needs both engines installed separately.
description.zh: 只读的本机检索：文件名走 Everything（es.exe），PDF / Office 文档正文走 Anytxt，共五个只读工具。两个引擎都要另装，仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Splits over-long screenshots into DSH-acceptable slices before prompt admission instead of letting them be rejected: vertical slices overlap so a line of text is never cut in half, and pure-JS codecs avoid native binaries. It wraps the existing attachment store instead of replacing it.
description.zh: 超长截图在发送前自动切成 DSH 可接受的切片，而不是被直接拒收：纵向切片带重叠，不会把一行字劈成两半；纯 JS 编解码，无原生依赖，且只是包住现有附件服务、不顶替它。

description.en: See the quota of every AI account connected to your local Magpie gateway at a glance, with usage breakdowns by day/week/month.
description.zh: 一键查看本机 Magpie 网关下全部 AI 账号的额度，并支持按天/周/月查看用量明细。

description.en: [LLM] 使 DSH 能从 magpie 上游同步输入模态及 thinking level
description.zh: 让 DSH 自动同步 Magpie 上游的输入模态和 thinking level 信息，省去手动配置。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: Embeds upstream quota and usage progress rings from your local Magpie gateway (127.0.0.1:3425) right beside the composer context meter, with session-aware active model tracking and 5-hour limit reset tooltips.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件：将 Magpie 本地网关（127.0.0.1:3425）的配额与用量进度圆环嵌入输入框底部状态栏（与上下文比例并列），支持各会话模型自动跟随嗅探、置顶卡片自动置顶与 5 小时重置倒计时微型面板。

description.en: DSH plugin for agent email tools: send, mass send (CSV-personalised), scheduled queue, inbox read, domains. Multi-provider: Lettermint, AgentMail, Resend, OVH SMTP, manual SMTP, local self-host.
description.zh: 让 AI 助手直接收发邮件：群发个性化、定时排队、读收件箱，支持 6 种邮件服务商。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件端：ManageAPI 原生设置面板、daemon 生命周期托管、真实用量回写、预算熔断
description.zh: 把 ManageAPI 的守护进程、站点比价和真实用量接进 DSH，还能按预算自动熔断。

description.en: Preview DSH plugin-market entries inside DeepSeek Harness instead of an external browser.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接预览插件市场条目，不用再跳浏览器，查插件更方便。

description.en: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 管理插件：设置面板集中管理 MCP 服务器，支持会话级懒启动与用途说明，一键启停并显示 token 占用。
description.zh: 把 MCP 服务器收进设置面板统一管理，一键启停、看 token 占用，还能按需懒启动省 token。

description.en: Inspect, probe and manage MCP servers across every AI client on your machine — real handshake tests, one settings page. A DeepSeek Harness plugin.
description.zh: 把本机各 AI 客户端的 MCP 服务器配置集中到一处，扫描、整理并真实握手测试，一个设置页全搞定。

description.en: Mounts the REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) MCP server through two gateway tools instead of registering its 200+ tool schemas on every request: rea_list searches the catalog or returns one tool's input schema, and rea_call invokes that tool, each call spawning a short-lived rea mcp process, so the tool definitions sent per step drop from about 780 KB (207 tools as measured in REA 6.5.0) to about 1-2 KB. When no rea entry point is found it installs rea-agents into a plugin-private directory with the pnpm bundled in DSH (dependency build scripts skipped) and links the reverse-engineer-anything and rea-gateway skills into the skills directory without overwriting existing ones.
description.zh: 把 REA（逆向一切）的 MCP 服务收成两个网关工具，而不是每次请求都注册它的 200 多个工具 schema：rea_list 按名字/描述搜索工具目录、或取单个工具的完整 input schema，rea_call 按原始工具名调用，每次调用启动一个短命 rea mcp 子进程，每步请求的工具定义由约 780 KB（REA 6.5.0 实测 207 个工具）降到约 1-2 KB。找不到 rea 入口时，用 DSH 自带的 pnpm 把 rea-agents 装进插件私有目录（跳过依赖构建脚本），并把 reverse-engineer-anything 与 rea-gateway 两个技能链接进技能目录，已存在的同名技能不会被覆盖。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 桌面端插件：对话切片 / 备忘录 / 经验库。划词即记，SQLite FTS5 中文检索，一键跳回原文，零第三方运行时依赖。
description.zh: 划词就能记笔记，对话切片存进本地经验库，中文全文搜索，一键跳回原文。

description.en: Six-tier memory plugin that captures each conversation turn, injects a stable memory block as a user snapshot, and compacts the host's own history into a single placeholder without calling a model.
description.zh: 六层记忆插件：自动捕获每轮对话，以 user 快照形式注入稳定的记忆块，并把宿主自带历史压成一条占位（不调用模型）。

description.en: Middle-click closes a session or a sidebar tab in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
