A session closes through the row's own archive action, so the confirmation for running work and the undo notice stay exactly as the Harness renders them; a tab closes through its own close control, leaving the rule that a lone guide tab cannot be closed untouched. The gesture settles on press-and-release on the same element, so a middle drag never closes anything. Two switches on the plugin's own Settings tab turn each half off, remembered per browser.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面里，用鼠标中键关闭会话或侧边栏标签页。会话走这一行自带的归档操作，因此运行中任务的确认框和撤销通知仍由 Harness 原样渲染；标签页走自己的关闭按钮，「唯一的指南页不能关」这条规则不受影响。手势要求在同一元素上按下并松开，所以中键拖动不会误关。插件自带独立设置页，两个开关分别关闭这两项，并按浏览器记住。

description.en: Prepares a workspace management protocol for an agent — three libraries (cognition, tools, external information), an optional preloaded session that has already read the workspace, and a re-read card when the workspace has changed enough.
description.zh: 为 agent 准备一套工作区管理协议——认知、工具、外部信息三库，一条可选的、已读过工作区的预加载会话，以及工作区变化达到阈值后弹出的重读卡片。

description.en: Adds a mood system to DeepSeek Harness — 33 named moods judged every 3-6 hours with small per-message adjustments, plus cross-session memory, an aesthetic taste library and an encrypted diary. The mood, memory, taste and diary tools are all callable by the model, and each of the five modules has its own switch. The diary is written only by the model; no summary template is generated. A trimmed fork of JMX-4869/dsh-mood; install either this or upstream dsh-mood, not both, because both register the same mood/diary/taste/memory tool names.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一套心情系统：33 种心情，每 3~6 小时一次周期判定，并随消息小幅增减；另有跨会话记忆、审美品味库、加密日记。心情、记忆、品味、日记四个工具都可由模型调用，五个模块各有独立开关。日记只由模型自己写，不生成系统总结模板。本插件是 JMX-4869/dsh-mood 的精简 fork：二者注册同名的心情 / 日记 / 品味 / 记忆工具，不能同时安装，只能二选一。

description.en: Cross-model continuity for DeepSeek Harness: memory, skills and rules in local files
description.zh: 让记忆、技能和规则存成本地文件，换模型换会话也能接着用，做过一次下次不查也能做对。

description.en: 让手机浏览器安全接入 DSH Desktop：扫码配对、复用现有 Web UI、流式回显、工具审批（once / always / reject）。MIT licensed.
description.zh: 用手机浏览器扫码就能安全连上本机 DSH Desktop，复用桌面 Web UI，支持流式回显和工具审批。

description.en: DSH 插件：探测每个模型能否真实应答，并按可用模型数重排模型选择器中的提供商
description.zh: 真实探测每个模型能否应答，再按可用模型数给模型选择器里的提供商重新排序。

description.en: One-click provider/model switcher client plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI
description.zh: 在会话标题栏一键切换服务商和模型，不用再进设置里逐个配置。

description.en: Renders a dsh-view fence in an assistant reply as cards — text, tables, charts, Mermaid diagrams and sandboxed HTML widgets — with an editable model prompt, a render_view tool and a bundled skill.
description.zh: 把回答里的 dsh-view 围栏渲染成卡片——文本、表格、图表、Mermaid 图与沙箱 HTML 组件——并提供可编辑的模型提示、render_view 工具和内置技能。

description.en: Moss text-to-image inside DSH — describe the picture in chat and get it back; needs a Moss API key from platform.moss.cn, and generation is billed to your own account.
description.zh: DSH 的 Moss 文生图插件——在对话里说一句要画什么，就出一张图；需自备 platform.moss.cn 的 Moss API Key，生成费用由自己的账号承担。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: route model download requests to the local Motrix (aria2) app, with a built-in direct HTTP fallback.
description.zh: 把模型下载请求交给本地 Motrix（aria2）来加速，没装 Motrix 也能直接 HTTP 下载。

description.en: Runs the local nanobot CLI agent as a DSH subagent through a nanobot_run tool: each call carries one self-contained task and returns only the agent's final answer, either as a fresh process or through a persistent OpenAI-compatible server.
description.zh: 通过 nanobot_run 工具把本机 nanobot CLI agent 当作 DSH 子代理运行：每次只交给它一个自包含任务并仅返回最终答案，可按次启动进程，也可走常驻的 OpenAI 兼容服务。

description.en: A study switch and study skills for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个学习开关，一键切换专注学习模式，帮你高效啃概念。

description.en: Network Engineer Assistant preset plus a 12-vendor, 96-document switch/router/firewall command knowledge base skill (Huawei, H3C, Ruijie, DPtech, Cisco IOS/IOS-XE, Cisco NX-OS, Juniper Junos, Arista EOS, Fortinet FortiOS, ZTE ZXR10, VyOS, MikroTik RouterOS) with KB-first retrieval, cross-vendor command translation, topology and CLI screenshot reading, cited online manual lookup, and mandatory risk annotations for dangerous commands; answers networking topics only. A community continuation of sososilencing/dsh-network-engineer (see NOTICE.md); it cannot be installed alongside that upstream plugin because both register the network-command-kb skill and a 网络工程师助手 preset.
description.zh: 网络工程师助手预设 + 12 厂商 96 篇交换机/路由器/防火墙命令知识库技能（华为/新华三/锐捷/迪普/思科 IOS·NX-OS/Junos/Arista EOS/FortiOS/中兴/VyOS/MikroTik），支持知识库优先检索、跨厂商命令对照、拓扑与 CLI 截图识图、带引用的联网查手册，并对高危命令强制 ⚠️ 风险标注；仅回答网络工程主题。是 sososilencing/dsh-network-engineer 的社区延续版（见 NOTICE.md）；两者注册同一个 network-command-kb 技能和同一个「网络工程师助手」预设，不能与上游同装。

description.en: Runs DeepSeek Harness bash commands inside the workspace's Nix dev shell whenever a flake.nix is present.
description.zh: 工作区存在 flake.nix 时，让 DeepSeek Harness 的 bash 命令在 nix develop 的 devShell 环境中执行。

description.en: Always-on-top notification overlay for DeepSeek Harness — self-drawn cards, a draggable ball for pending reminders, click to jump back to the conversation. Turn the overlay off for native OS notifications, which also works on macOS and Linux. / DeepSeek Harness 的置顶通知浮窗：自绘卡片、待处理小球、点击跳回会话；关掉浮窗则改用系统通知。
description.zh: 审批、提问、报错或轮次完成时在屏幕角落弹卡片提醒，阻塞对话的消息收进可拖动小球，点一下就能跳回对应会话。

description.en: Siemens NX integration for dsh on Windows (requires a local Siemens NX install; tested only with NX 2512, and the FE tools need Simulation/Nastran licences): 71 tools that build and edit solids, surfaces, sketches, holes and tubes, run NX Nastran statics and modal studies, roll up assembly BOMs with pairwise clearance checks, and print A3 sheets with a real GB frame to PDF, all in a background NX session driven by JSON commands.
description.zh: 把 Siemens NX 接进 dsh（仅 Windows，需本机已装 Siemens NX，且只在 NX 2512 上验证；有限元工具另需 Simulation / Nastran 许可）：71 个工具覆盖实体建模、曲面闭环、同步建模、孔型与管路、Nastran 静力与模态、装配 BOM 与逐对间隙检查、A3 图纸与 GB 图框出 PDF，全部通过 JSON 命令驱动后台 NX 会话执行。

description.en: Connect a local Obsidian vault to DSH over MCP: read, search, create, edit, move, and tag notes. The obsidian-mcp server ships inside the plugin.
description.zh: 把本机 Obsidian 笔记库接入 DSH，能读、搜、建、改、移动和打标签，一个插件包搞定。

description.en: Plain click on an Obsidian vault file in the DSH conversation opens it in the right app: notes in the Obsidian app, configured types (for example .tex) in VS Code with their project folder as the workspace; Cmd/Ctrl-click keeps the in-app preview. The open_vault_file tool follows the same routing, and every open is confined to the configured vaultRoot.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话里普通点击 Obsidian 库内文件会打开到对应 App：笔记进 Obsidian，配置的类型（例如 .tex）进 VS Code 并以项目目录作为工作区；Cmd/Ctrl+点击保留内置预览。open_vault_file 工具走同一套路由，所有打开都限定在配置的 vaultRoot 内。

description.en: Local tool guard that scores every DeepSeek Harness tool call with an Ollama decision model before it runs; risky calls come back as an approval prompt, and an unreachable model stops all calls. Requires DSH 0.2.x and a local Ollama 0.35.1+ with the default ~6 GB clef-flash model pulled first; without them every tool call is denied.
description.zh: 每次工具调用前由本机 Ollama 决策模型判定：可疑调用升级为确认提示，模型不可达时停止所有调用。需 DSH 0.2.x，并先装好本机 Ollama 0.35.1+、拉取默认约 6 GB 的 clef-flash 模型；否则所有工具调用都会被拒绝。

description.en: 一键润色 / 扩写 / 自动驾驶 for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一键润色、扩写和自动驾驶，写东西更省心。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件：把本机 opencode 生态接入 DSH 模型菜单——OpenCode Go 订阅（经 opencode-api-plugin 网关）+ Zen 免费档（内嵌 opencode2api，无需网关运行）
description.zh: 把本机 opencode 生态接进 DSH 模型菜单，订阅版和 Zen 免费档都能直接用。

description.en: Shows OpenCode GO plan quota (rolling 5-hour, weekly, monthly) on a DSH Settings page, reading the official usage API through a same-origin proxy; registers no sidebar widget. A rework of Astervolans/dsh-opencode-go-usage (itself a fork of yumusb/dsh-opencode-go-usage) — remove that plugin first; both register their own OpenCode GO Settings section, so they cannot be installed together.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页显示 OpenCode GO 套餐额度（5 小时滚动、每周、每月），通过同源代理读取官方用量接口；不注册侧栏组件。本插件是 Astervolans/dsh-opencode-go-usage（上游为 yumusb/dsh-opencode-go-usage 的 fork）的改造分支，安装前请先卸载上游插件——两者会各自注册一份 OpenCode GO 设置页，不能同装。

description.en: Sidebar panel for OpenCode quota and usage in DeepSeek Harness: Go subscription windows, Console spend, trends, forecasts and model breakdown, with multiple accounts, service-account filtering and English/Chinese UI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏查看 OpenCode 额度与用量：支持 Go 订阅窗口、Console 花费、趋势、预测和模型拆分，以及多账户、服务账号筛选和中英界面。

description.en: OpenSpec 变更流水线（DSH 插件）：把多个 change 排成一张有顺序的图，按依赖或并行开新对话执行；规划与任务进度读 openspec status/list，卡住时可一键 validate --strict 后归档。
description.zh: 把多个 OpenSpec change 排成有依赖关系的流水线，按顺序或并行自动开对话执行，卡住还能一键校验归档。

description.en: Plan-only main agent with a plan-mode toggle; delegated workers on a switchable default route for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 让主代理只负责规划和验收，具体活儿交给子代理干，还能分别配置模型和思考强度。

description.en: Bundles a deep-read paper library and the paper-deepread-html skill: a sidebar panel to browse interactive reading reports, upload PDFs into a managed library, deep-read them with an agent (or through an optional site auto-read worker), and manage or rebuild the library; ships the paper_deepread, paper_deepread_uploads and paper_deepread_reports model tools. Deep-read/ingest and report builds require Python 3 (the bundled skill prepares a PyMuPDF venv on first use; index rebuild falls back to plain python3).
description.zh: 把文献精读库与 paper-deepread-html 精读技能打包成 dsh 插件：侧边栏浏览交互式报告、上传 PDF 到托管书库、由 Agent 或可选接入的站点自动精读 worker 精读、管理或重建书库；提供 paper_deepread、paper_deepread_uploads、paper_deepread_reports 三个模型工具。精读摄取与成稿需要 Python 3（内置技能首次会准备 PyMuPDF 解释器；重建索引会退化为纯 python3）。

description.en: DSH 峰谷调度插件：北京时间工作日 9-12 / 14-18 峰时自动停止 SnowLuma 与语音服务，谷时自动拉起。
description.zh: 工作日峰时自动停掉 SnowLuma 和语音服务，谷时再拉起，上班不占显卡。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-peak-valley
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-peak-valley

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Turns DSH into a local OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible gateway endpoint that puts one persona and long-term memory in front of every client pointed at it; requires your own DeepSeek API key — the DSH login credential is rejected upstream.
description.zh: 把 DSH 变成本机的 OpenAI / Anthropic 兼容网关端点，给指向它的客户端统一套上同一套人格与长期记忆；需自备 DeepSeek API Key（DSH 的登录凭证在上游会被拒）。

description.en: Persona mode with character cards, long-term memory that fades and can be reviewed, diaries, a reference library, and stickers.
description.zh: 人设模式、会自然变淡并可复习的长期记忆、日记、资料库和表情包。

description.en: Speak dsh-pet speech bubbles aloud with Microsoft Edge neural voices — a DeepSeek Harness plugin
description.zh: 用微软 Edge 神经网络语音把桌宠的气泡台词念出来，让宠物真的会说话。

description.en: In-process crash guard: takes over the fatal-error handlers that would exit DSH, names the responsible plugin from the stack, and disables only that row in the home patch layer, leaving the profile and the provider config inside it untouched. The crash page offers retry, keep-disabled or uninstall, and opens a temporary safe-mode session when no culprit can be named (CLI and web launches only).
description.zh: 进程内崩溃兜底：接管本该让 DSH 退出的致命错误处理器，从栈里认出是哪个插件，只在 home 层停用那一行——profile 与里面的供应商配置一个字节都不写。崩溃页给出恢复、保持禁用、卸载三个选择；认不出是谁时，开一个临时的安全模式会话（仅命令行与 web 启动）。

description.en: Phone for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: SMS, browser calls, live voicemail with pick up, do not disturb, local voicemail transcripts and phone_* agent tools. Provider-agnostic: Twilio today, SIP relay and more next.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面里装一部电话，收发短信、接打电话、语音留言还能直接接起，支持勿扰模式和本地转写。

description.en: macOS notifications with the standard Glass alert when a reply finishes or DSH needs your input.
description.zh: 回复完成或需要用户介入时，用 macOS 系统通知 + Glass 提示音提醒，点通知回到对应会话。

description.en: AI video studio plugin for DeepSeek Harness: outline → storyboard → narration → subtitles → MP4, driven by the agent
description.zh: 一句话就能生成讲解视频，Agent 自动写分镜、配音、配字幕，最后导出 MP4。

description.en: DSH plugin: read-only WeChat local chat extraction (decrypt, export, session isolation). Windows only.
description.zh: 只读摘录微信本地聊天记录，解密后按会话隔离导出，不发送消息、不碰云端，仅限 Windows。

description.en: DSH 侧栏「插件目录」：插件/Skill/MCP 卡片清点 + 90 天调用与报错统计 + 运行期 fiberPhase 对账 + 卡片上卸载/停用/删 SKILL。开发版（非最终版），支持 DSH 0.2.1–0.2.x，不定期更新。 | DSH sidebar catalog for plugins, Skills and MCP: cards, 90-day call stats, runtime reconciliation, in-panel disposal. Dev build for DSH 0.2.1–0.2.x.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏集中查看插件、Skill 和 MCP 卡片，统计 90 天调用与报错，还能直接卸载停用。

description.en: Unified delete confirmation plugin for DeepSeek Harness: opt-in removal of session records and workspace folder contents, plus Delete session and a delete_records agent tool.
description.zh: 删除工作区时可一并勾选清掉会话记录和文件夹内容，会话菜单能直接删会话，还给模型配了删除记录工具。

description.en: Capability self-model plugin for DeepSeek Harness: measures what skills really deliver, injects the measured truth before use, and corrects skill descriptions overnight with backups and revert.
description.zh: 先测出每个技能的真实水平，用前自动注入实测结果，夜里还能自动修正技能描述并支持备份回滚。

description.en: A 70-line DeepSeek Harness plugin to copy from: one sidebar tab, two languages, one behaviour test.
description.zh: 70 行代码的 DSH 插件入门模板，装个侧边栏标签页打招呼、数点击，拿来抄改最方便。

description.en: DSH 侧栏「插件 / Skill 安装」：GitHub / Release / 压缩包 / 本地目录 → 下载·解包·预检·快照·安装·诊断·回滚；MCP 与 Skill 也可装；AI 只推荐与递请求（安装零 token）；支持自定义搜索来源。 | DSH sidebar installer for plugins, Skills and MCP: deterministic pipeline with precheck, snapshot and rollback; AI recommends only; custom search sources.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏一键安装插件和 Skill，自动完成下载、预检、快照、诊断与回滚，安装过程不消耗 token。

description.en: DSH plugin: read/export Jupyter notebooks and preview .ipynb in the sidebar (nbformat 3/4).
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏直接打开并渲染 Jupyter Notebook，还能读取和导出 ipynb 文件，不用再看原始 JSON。

description.en: Tencent CodeBuddy LLM adapter for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 接入腾讯 CodeBuddy 模型，多一个可选的对话与编码助手。

description.en: DSH 插件管理器：从 GitHub 安装插件，扫描已安装插件的远端更新，并按原 spec 重装。
description.zh: 从 GitHub 安装 DSH 插件，自动扫描远端更新并按原配置重装，让第三方插件不再停留在旧版本。

description.en: Electronic wooden fish with six agent-callable tools, eight sutras advanced one sentence per knock, three knock sounds, spoken Cantonese or Mandarin chanting, and a merit ledger kept in one file that also counts session token usage.
description.zh: 可被 Agent 调用的电子木鱼：6 个工具、8 部经文逐敲推进一句、三种敲击音色、粤语/普通话诵经语音，功德记在同一份账本里，并按会话 Token 消耗累计。

description.en: Reads only the Microsoft OneNote notebooks you allow, with device-code sign-in, a per-notebook allow-list in Settings, and four read-only tools for status, page listing, search and page content.
description.zh: 只读取你允许的 Microsoft OneNote 笔记本：设备码登录、设置页的笔记本白名单，以及状态、页面列表、搜索、页面内容四个只读工具。

description.en: DSH plugin: fix Open In failing for Electron editors (VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf).
description.zh: 修复 dsh 里用 VS Code、Cursor 等编辑器打开文件时报错的问题，点一下就能正常打开。

description.en: One-line notice at the top edge of the DSH window with your DeepSeek balance, the ChatGPT/Codex five-hour and weekly remaining quota and their reset times, and how many quota-reset cards are left plus the nearest expiry; the reset-card part links to the ChatGPT usage page in your browser.
description.zh: 在 DSH 窗口顶部边缘用一行提示显示 DeepSeek 余额、ChatGPT/Codex 五小时与每周剩余额度及其重置时间、剩余额度重置卡数量与最近到期时间；重置卡那一段是链接，会用浏览器打开 ChatGPT 使用情况页。

description.en: Starts chats without selecting a project folder, with a persistent per-chat working directory and native Harness session storage.
description.zh: 无需选择项目文件夹即可开始对话，为每次聊天分配持久工作目录，并沿用 Harness 原生会话存储。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-plugin-projectless
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-plugin-projectless

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: DSH plugin: a model-facing python tool using the Harness bundled Python runtime.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加个能直接跑 Python 代码的工具，自带运行环境和常用库，开箱即用。

description.en: DSH plugin: read-only QQ NT local chat extraction (decrypt, export, session isolation). Windows only.
description.zh: 只读导出 QQ 本地聊天记录，解密后按会话隔离查看，全程不碰原库，仅限 Windows。

description.en: DSH plugin: send QQ messages and files through OneBot/NapCat, with dry-run and safety gates.
description.zh: 让 DSH 通过 OneBot/NapCat 往指定群或好友发一条 QQ 消息或文件，带试运行和安全闸门。

description.en: Translate installed plugins' documentation into Simplified Chinese: README sections are translated with a persistent section-level cache, and an opt-in metaSidecars mode (off by default) writes a locale/zh.json sidecar for each Plugins list row so the list can render Chinese natively.
description.zh: 把已安装插件的文档翻译成简体中文：README 按章节翻译并持久缓存；另有默认关闭的可选 metaSidecars 模式，会为每条插件列表行写入 locale/zh.json 侧文件，让列表原生渲染中文。

description.en: DSH 插件模板：宿主 HTTP 路由 + 设置页 + 双语 + 测试，纯 JS 无构建。
description.zh: DSH 插件开发起点模板，自带 HTTP 接口、设置页、中英双语和测试，纯 JS 免构建，改名就能开工。

description.en: DSH plugin: chat translation panel plus layout-preserving PDF translation.
description.zh: 给 DSH 聊天区加个翻译按钮，悬停就能翻译回复，还能保留排版翻译 PDF。

description.en: DSH 输入框查错插件：只找错别字并标黄，可一键替换；支持任意 OpenAI 兼容来源、多来源回退、每行可配提示词/max_tokens/思考模式
description.zh: 给 DSH 输入框加个查错按钮，只挑错别字标黄，一键替换，发出去前先兜个底。

description.en: 检查 DeepSeek Harness 已安装插件是否有新版本，并在插件页 / 插件详情页一键更新。Plugin Updater for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在插件页一键检查并更新已安装的 DSH 插件，省去手动比版本的麻烦。

description.en: 语音工坊 · DeepSeek Harness 插件：多提供商语音合成 + 参考音色库 + RVC 歌曲翻唱 + 情绪控制 + qq-bridge 语音发送（含随机语音回复）
description.zh: 多平台语音合成加音色库，还能做RVC歌曲翻唱和情绪配音，支持QQ语音发送与随机回复。
把多个实时会话按行列网格同时显示在一个页面里，方便对照查看和切换。

description.en: @perrylink/dsh-policy-ledger — DeepSeek Harness plugin (alpha; public synthetic demo; not GA)
description.zh: 只读检查 DSH 插件安装状态和能力快照，帮你快速诊断安装问题。

description.en: Unofficial port of Ponytail 5.3.3 (upstream: DietrichGebert/ponytail, MIT; not affiliated) for DeepSeek Harness: minimal-code rules, session modes, native settings, a composer status band, and a reported-usage dashboard. It cannot be installed alongside another DSH Ponytail adapter — remove @mengyuly/dsh-ponytail first.
description.zh: Ponytail 5.3.3（上游 DietrichGebert/ponytail，MIT，与上游无关联）的 DSH 非官方移植：最小代码规则、会话模式、原生设置、输入框状态条与用量面板。不能与其他 DSH Ponytail 适配器同装，需先卸载 @mengyuly/dsh-ponytail。

description.en: 把 SillyTavern 的预设与角色卡接进 DeepSeek Harness 的普通会话｜DeepSeek V4.1 生成 · 仅单机测试
description.zh: 把 SillyTavern 的预设和角色卡接进 DSH 普通会话，用浮动面板管理开关、选择和逐块编辑。

description.en: A personal usage profile page in the DSH sidebar. Cumulative tokens drawn as an input / output / cache-hit donut, today's tokens, longest task time, active-day streaks, a 12-month activity heatmap with daily / weekly / cumulative scopes, a time-based bar chart that splits tokens by model (Flash / Pro), and a per-provider billing breakdown for today or all time. Everything is folded from this machine's own session logs through ctx.sessionQuery. The only outbound request is a six-hourly read of this package's own version from the npm registry, used by the in-panel update button — no telemetry, no credentials, nothing uploaded.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏的个人用量主页：累计 Token（输入/输出/缓存命中环形图）、今日 Token 用量、最长任务用时、连续活跃天数、近 12 个月活动热力图（每天/每周/累计总量三档）、按时间分桶并按模型（Flash / Pro）分色的柱状图，以及按供应商的今日/累计账单拆分。全部由本机会话日志经 ctx.sessionQuery 折叠而来；唯一的外发请求是每 6 小时读一次本包自己在 npm 上的版本号（供面板内的更新按钮使用），不上报数据、不碰凭据。

description.en: Prompt picker for DeepSeek Harness - multi-select system-prompt injections with per-row scopes (both/main/sub), one bolt icon in the composer.
description.zh: 在输入框一键打开多选菜单，按行给主/子代理注入系统提示词，省去反复手输。

description.en: dsh-providers-hub fork with client CSS fix: account-card horizontal overflow (unclickable right-side buttons)
description.zh: 修复账号卡片右侧按钮被挤出、点不动的横向溢出问题，让插件面板操作恢复正常。

description.en: dsh-purge 1.1.71 社区存档分支 | DeepSeek Harness 破甲插件（原仓库已删除，保留 MIT 许可与原作者署名）
description.zh: 社区存档的 DeepSeek Harness 红队测试插件，用来做提示词注入和越狱安全评估。

description.en: @perrylink/dsh-qms-capa — DeepSeek Harness plugin (alpha; public synthetic demo; not GA)
description.zh: 把质量异常单自动去重、匹配批次并评估影响范围，帮质量团队快速处理 NCR。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的 QQ 桥接对话表记忆插件：SQLite 存储、自动召回、回忆计数、轮次与定期清理。
description.zh: 把 QQ 聊天记录存进 SQLite，按话题自动回忆旧消息，还能统计回忆次数并定期清理低价值内容。

description.en: DSH QQ group/private chat tools: groups, history, send, faces, favorites, private chat, pokes (OneBot 11 / SnowLuma)
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接收发 QQ 群聊和私聊消息，还能发表情、戳一戳、翻历史记录。

description.en: DSH 插件：让机器人发 QQ 空间说说 / 看说说的同时，也能看懂图片（视觉模型 + Windows OCR 双重兜底）。
description.zh: 让 DSH 里的 QQ 机器人能发空间说说、看图点赞评论，还能靠视觉模型或系统 OCR 读懂图片内容。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-qq-zone
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-qq-zone

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Reads the local NTQQ (QQ 9.9.x) message database on Windows and Linux and exports group and private chat history to txt, csv, json, md, html or sqlite. Ships eight model tools (qqnt_status, qqnt_extract_key, qqnt_list_groups, qqnt_list_chats, qqnt_search, qqnt_export_group, qqnt_export_chat, qqnt_export_batch) and a local web UI on 127.0.0.1:46728 with an incremental SQLite index, statistics, ZIP batch export, sender redaction, media bundling, per-day splitting, export presets and AES-256 password ZIPs. Needs python3 with sqlcipher3 (the settings page can create a private virtualenv), and the database key is read from the running, logged-in QQ client.
description.zh: 读取 Windows / Linux 本机 NTQQ（QQ 9.9.x）聊天记录，把群聊与私聊的聊天记录导出成 txt、csv、json、md、html 或 sqlite。包含八个模型工具（qqnt_status、qqnt_extract_key、qqnt_list_groups、qqnt_list_chats、qqnt_search、qqnt_export_group、qqnt_export_chat、qqnt_export_batch），以及 127.0.0.1:46728 上的本地网页界面：增量 SQLite 索引、统计面板、批量导出 ZIP、昵称/QQ 脱敏、媒体打包、按天分文件、导出预设与 AES-256 密码压缩包。需要带 sqlcipher3 的 python3（设置页可一键创建独立虚拟环境），数据库密钥从正在登录的 QQ 客户端内存中读取。

description.en: Drag-to-reorder the DeepSeek Harness pending message queue before the messages are sent.
description.zh: 拖拽调整 DeepSeek Harness 待发消息队列的顺序，让排队消息按你想要的先后发出。

description.en: Memory and CPU pressure guard for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): grades pressure, drops the host to below-normal priority, refuses heavy tools before the machine thrashes, and shows how much of the machine DSH itself is using.
description.zh: 机器快被内存或CPU吃穿时自动踩刹车，拦住重活、降低宿主优先级，避免卡死。

description.en: Search four free libraries from one window: Project Gutenberg through its OPDS catalog, Shuge through its WordPress search plus the s.shuge.org short links on each book page, and NCPSSD through its Solr-backed endpoint. The Chinese Text Project is deliberately link-only, because its terms forbid automated access. Two tools: readbook_search and readbook_open; the second returns real download URLs for Gutenberg and Shuge, and only a page link for NCPSSD.
description.zh: 一个窗口同时搜四家免费图书馆：Project Gutenberg 走 OPDS 目录，书格走 WordPress 检索再取每本书页面上的 s.shuge.org 下载短链，国家哲学社会科学文献中心走它的 Solr 检索接口。中国哲学书电子化计划刻意只给链接——它明令禁止程序化抓取。两个工具：readbook_search 与 readbook_open，后者给 Gutenberg 和书格的真实下载地址，NCPSSD 只给页面链接。

description.en: Reading workbench for DSH: a cover-grid bookshelf and a paginated single/double-page reader for Markdown, TXT, HTML, EPUB, MOBI and PDF, with highlight notes anchored to text offsets and three agent tools for listing books, reading highlights and pulling text excerpts.
description.zh: DSH 阅读工作台：封面网格书架 + 单/双页分页阅读器，支持 Markdown、TXT、HTML、EPUB、MOBI、PDF，划线笔记以文本偏移锚定，并提供书目、划线、正文节选三个 Agent 工具。

description.en: 把模型思考过程（reasoning）在显示层翻译成中文：折叠显示中文摘要，展开显示中文正文 + 英文原文。不注入提示词、不改变模型行为；可完全用本地 Ollama，零成本。
description.zh: 把模型思考过程实时翻成中文显示，折叠看摘要、展开看正文和英文原文，不改模型行为，还能用本地 Ollama 零成本跑。

description.en: ReMe-shaped long-term memory for DSH: Markdown workspace, BM25 recall, turn capture, scheduled consolidation
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上长期记忆：用 Markdown 目录存记忆，支持 BM25 检索、对话捕获和定时整理。

description.en: DSH Remote — Android app that controls DeepSeek Harness (DSH) on your PC over LAN or a tunnel. One-click connect script included.
description.zh: 用安卓手机远程控制电脑上的 DSH，局域网或隧道都能连，一键脚本搞定。
防止 DSH 回复内容丢失，自动保留已生成的文字，避免意外中断白忙一场。

description.en: DSH 桌面版的一键重载／重启按钮：插件更新后原地热重载，热重载不成立时才完全重启。 · One-click reload/restart button for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app: hot-reload plugin updates in place, relaunch only when a reload cannot take.
description.zh: 侧边栏一键重载或重启 DSH 桌面版，插件更新后优先原地热重载，实在不行才重启。

description.en: Conversation view that replays a session turn by turn: user prompts and assistant prose are revealed at reading pace, while reasoning and tool output stream past and stop at 3.5 seconds per segment, and every prompt is followed by a one-second pause. The same view can re-run the original prompts in a new session, and a replay can be recorded to a WebM file through a 1280x720 canvas.
description.zh: 会话回放视图：按轮重放一次会话，用户输入与助手正文保持阅读速度，思考与工具输出高速掠过且每段最多 3.5 秒，每条输入后停顿一秒；同一视图可把原始请求复刻到一个新会话，也能通过 1280×720 画布把回放录成 WebM 视频。

description.en: Adds chunked uploads with progress and resume, and native downloads of workspace files and the session log ZIP, to the DSH Web GUI, including sessions reached through a paired remote link.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 增加带进度与续传的分块上传，以及工作区文件与会话日志 ZIP 的原生下载；通过配对远程链接访问的会话同样可用。

description.en: Road building materials as a caliber manual: 60 cards over 12 chapters on aggregates, asphalt and the PG system, mix volumetrics, cement, concrete, stabilized mixtures, steel, polymers and 35 test procedures.
description.zh: 道路建筑材料口径手册：12 章 60 张卡，覆盖集料、沥青与 PG 体系、混合料体积参数、水泥、混凝土、无机结合料、钢材、聚合物与 35 个试验方法。

description.en: Context-aware, self-evolving skill cockpit for DeepSeek Harness: recommendations with reasons, 10% exploration, live "now using", plan/immersive modes, experience memory, local safety scan, update diff/rollback, 6,399-skill index. MIT.
description.zh: 帮你挑技能、拆任务，边用边学越用越懂你的技能驾驶舱。

description.en: DSH 客户端插件 dsh-runner：输入框下方运行命令，设置页与 AI 工具管理启动命令，支持 GitHub 更新提示。
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框下方加个「▶ 运行」按钮，随手选命令执行，还能在设置页管理启动命令并接收 GitHub 更新提示。

description.en: Answers the built-in web_search from a self-hosted RustXNG metasearch instance, downloading and starting that binary on demand and stopping it after an idle timeout; an optional fetch provider also decodes pages whose charset is declared only in <meta>.
description.zh: 用自托管的 RustXNG 元搜索引擎接管内置 web_search，按需下载并启动该二进制、空闲超时后停止；可选的抓取层还能解码仅在 <meta> 中声明编码的页面。

description.en: Recoverable session deletion for DeepSeek Harness with a 30-day trash retention window.
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话加个回收站，删掉的会话 30 天内还能找回来，不怕手滑。

description.en: 在 dsh 设置页与侧边栏管理 SakuraFrp 内网穿透：托管 frpc、一键对齐端口、流量与剩余百分比、公网密码门。
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接管 SakuraFrp 内网穿透，托管 frpc、对齐端口、看流量，不用再开启动器。

description.en: SAP AI Core Chat Completions provider for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 让 DSH 接入 SAP AI Core 的模型，支持流式对话、工具调用和取消，开箱即用。

description.en: Scope manager for DeepSeek Harness: binds presets, persona cards, tools, skills and MCP connections to global / workspace / session layers, with a sidebar.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的作用域管家：把预设、角色卡、工具、技能与 MCP 连接按「全局 / 工作区 / 会话」三层作用域绑定，带侧边栏。

description.en: Opt-in HTTP proxy service for DSH plugins, with native address and port settings. Exposes scopedHttpProxy for explicit callers, applies address changes to subsequent requests, and leaves system proxies, environment variables and global network dispatchers unchanged.
description.zh: 供 DSH 插件显式调用的独立 HTTP 代理服务，提供原生地址和端口设置。通过 scopedHttpProxy 服务接入，地址修改对后续请求生效，不修改系统代理、环境变量或全局网络连接器。

description.en: Creates a throwaway workspace with its own folder and session, manages running ones from a sidebar panel, and moves finished folders to the system Trash.
description.zh: 一键创建一次性临时工作区（独立文件夹、独立工作区与会话），在侧边栏统一管理，用完把文件夹移入系统废纸篓。

description.en: Snipping tool for the composer: freeze the screen, drag a region, annotate it, and drop the result into the message box. Windows only; the selector is a bundled WinForms binary (rebuilt from the included C# source if missing) and uses the built-in .NET Framework 4.x.
description.zh: 输入框旁的截图标注工具：冻结屏幕、拖框选区、就地标注，完成后直接插入输入框。仅 Windows；选区器为内置 WinForms 程序（缺失时用随包的 C# 源码重建），依赖系统自带 .NET Framework 4.x。

description.en: DSH 截图插件：QQ 同款框选 + 标注 + 离线 OCR 提取文字 + 贴图 + 录屏 + 长截图。Windows 专有（PowerShell/.NET）。开发版（非最终版），支持 DSH 0.2.1–0.2.x。 | DSH screenshot plugin: QQ-style region capture, annotation, offline OCR, pinning, recording, long screenshots. Windows only. Dev build for DSH 0.2.1–0.2.x.
description.zh: Windows 上用的截图插件，框选标注、离线 OCR 提取文字、贴图录屏和长截图都能搞定。

description.en: Screenshot-and-ask for DeepSeek Harness: one-click capture from the composer, adjustable selection frame, crop lands as an image attachment. Captures exclude the Harness window.
description.zh: 在输入框一键截屏提问，可框选裁剪，截图自动作为图片附件发给 AI，且不拍到 Harness 窗口本身。

description.en: 把 OpenAI Codex CLI 接入 DeepSeek Harness 作为第二引擎：异步工单 / 双向互审 / 终端↔网页共享会话桥 / 文件任务板 · Plug Codex CLI into DeepSeek Harness as a second agent.
description.zh: 把 Codex CLI 接进 DSH 当第二引擎，异步派单、双向互审、终端与网页共享会话。

description.en: A persona that grows from experience: remembers what happened, becomes someone from it.
description.zh: 让 DSH 拥有会从经历中成长的人格，记住发生过的事，并由此逐渐变成独特的自己。

description.en: 自我评估总纲：AI自省的口径闸——五层钉死（不够聪明自省：每轮显式成文答智力天花板/盲区四层：无知清单+元盲区+撞壁点+镜像校准/变聪明双路：错题变抗体+权重层烧录/可能错在哪三防：显式自供+虚高防护+主人校准/错题本家族：四链泛化+失败三信号），self_audit工具提供四类自满口径拦截与三类合法答法，零依赖装上即用。
description.zh: 给 AI 自省加一道口径闸，拦住自满式回答，逼它把盲区和错题显式写清楚。

description.en: DSH 右栏的会话产物清单：把所有会话写过、改过的文件列成一列，两级置顶，单击复制路径、双击在侧栏预览。 · One list of every file every DSH Session produced: two pin scopes, click to copy a path, double-click to preview it in the sidebar.
description.zh: 把各个会话写过、改过的文件汇总成一列，当前会话置顶，点一下复制路径、双击预览，方便接着上次的活干。

description.en: Adds an Auto-rename row to each Session sidebar menu: the model reads the Session log, weights recent user messages higher (exponential decay, 3-day time constant), and writes a title of at most 10 CJK characters into the Session title. Also opens that Session menu on right-click, and exposes the same operation as the session_auto_rename agent tool. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 or newer.
description.zh: 在每个会话的侧栏菜单里新增「自动重命名」：模型读取会话日志，按时间衰减给用户消息加权（τ = 3 天，越新权重越高），写出不超过 10 个汉字的标题并写入会话名。同时支持右键会话呼出该菜单，并把同一操作暴露为 session_auto_rename 智能体工具。需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 或更新版本。

description.en: DSH desktop plugin: copy current session ID and continuation prompt beside the session title
description.zh: 在会话标题旁一键复制当前会话 ID 和接续提示词，方便换设备或新开对话时接着聊。

description.en: Git history as a tab inside every DSH conversation: each session opens its own repository, with branch lanes, commit detail, diffs, refs and working-tree actions.
description.zh: 每个对话里都带一个 Git 标签页，随时看分支、提交、diff 和工作区改动，不用切出去。

description.en: Conversation lock for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: every conversation row gets a lock button, and a locked conversation blurs only the conversation area behind a password box while the sidebar stays usable. Re-locks on window blur, tab hide, page hide, or whenever the open conversation changes, and never pauses a running turn - the veil reports that background work continues. The password digest, lock flags, and preferences live in <DSH_HOME>/session-lock/state.json behind two same-origin routes guarded by a custom header, so clearing the page localStorage unlocks nothing; PBKDF2-SHA256 with a random salt, and a 30-second input lockout after five wrong attempts. Recovery is opt-in per machine: a Windows login password (enabled only after a real .NET PrincipalContext ValidateCredentials check against the local machine, so Microsoft accounts and passwordless machines keep it off) and a cooling period chosen while creating or changing the password (1/6/24/72/168 hours; expiry clears the password and releases every lock, and the correct password cancels the countdown). A settings section covers status, changing the password, lock new conversations, hiding locked titles, a three-position archive-restore policy (all / locked only / off, switching needs the password), lock everything, and unlock everything. Dialogs use the native dialog top layer, so a dialog opened from Settings is never covered by it. Requires DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 or newer; no build step.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏的会话锁：每个对话行尾多一个锁按钮，锁定后只把对话区挡住并弹出密码框，侧边栏照常可用。窗口失焦、切到后台、页面隐藏或换了对话都会立刻重新锁定；锁定只是界面层，正在跑的回合继续执行，遮罩上会提示后台任务仍在运行。密码摘要、锁清单和偏好存放在 <DSH_HOME>/session-lock/state.json，由两条带自定义请求头的同源路由读写，所以清掉页面的 localStorage 并不会解锁；PBKDF2-SHA256 加随机盐，连错五次锁定输入 30 秒。找回通道按机器可选：Windows 登录密码（必须用 .NET 的 PrincipalContext ValidateCredentials 在本机真实验证通过才启用，微软账户与无密码的机器会自动保持关闭），以及创建或修改密码时选定的强制冷静（1/6/24/72/168 小时，到期清空密码并解除全部锁，输对密码可中止倒计时）。设置页包含状态、修改密码、新对话默认上锁、锁定后隐藏侧边栏标题、归档恢复的三档策略（所有归档/仅已锁定/不需要密码，切换档位本身要密码）、一键上锁与一键解锁。对话框使用原生 dialog 顶层，从设置页打开的弹窗不会被设置页压住。要求 DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 及以上；无需构建步骤。

description.en: Agent-to-agent mail between DSH sessions on the same host. `send_session_message` delivers after the target's turn or injects into the running one, stamps the sender id itself and rejects forged From headers; every message carries an id, so replies quote it with replyTo, a thread stops the same task being queued twice, and supersedes recalls messages that are still pending. `read_session_info` reads a peer read-only: title, last reply, the files of its last present call, and busy/queue state.
description.zh: 同一宿主内 DSH 会话之间的代理传话。`send_session_message` 可等对方回合结束再送达、也可插进正在跑的回合；发信方 id 由插件自己写，伪造的 From 抬头会被拒；每条消息带 id —— 回信可用 replyTo 引用、thread 防止同一件事排队两次、supersedes 撤回尚未投递的旧消息。`read_session_info` 只读地看对方：标题、最后一轮回复、最后一次 present 的文件、以及忙闲与队列深度。

description.en: Reply toasts for DeepSeek Harness: a dismissible stack that names the workspace and session, previews the reply, and opens the session on click.
description.zh: 多会话并行时，用可关闭的弹窗提醒你哪个工作区、哪个会话有新回复，点一下就能跳过去。

description.en: Persistent search bar in the conversation header: keyword-search the message bodies of past sessions, then open the session at the matched text.
description.zh: 对话页顶部常驻搜索栏：按关键词搜索历史会话的消息正文，点击结果直接打开会话并定位到命中的那段文字。

description.en: Regenerates a session's title from its last 10 user prompts using the model the session itself last used, with an editable preview before the new title is written back.
description.zh: 根据会话最近 10 轮用户 prompt，用该会话最近一次使用的模型重新生成标题，预览确认后写回。

description.en: DSH设置按钮DSH 侧栏账号头像右侧常驻设置按钮
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏账号头像右边加个常驻设置按钮，点一下就能打开设置面板，不用再翻菜单。

description.en: DSH desktop plugin: generate images with logged-in Grok/GPT accounts, and videos with Grok
description.zh: 用已登录的 Grok/GPT 账号生成图片，用 Grok 生成视频，想法直接变成媒体素材。

description.en: 守岸人 DeepSeek Harness 完整版桌宠插件｜自选 GIF、语音字幕、交互工作室、余额、锁定穿透、完整配置迁移（Windows）
description.zh: 把守岸人做成 Windows 桌面宠物，可换 GIF、带语音字幕和互动工作室，还能看余额、锁定穿透。

description.en: Opens a native side conversation forked from the active conversation, with live parent context, Inline & Spill chain recall, relay to the main conversation, and usage stats.
description.zh: 把当前对话分叉成独立的原生侧边会话，注入父对话实时上下文，支持 Inline & Spill 链式召回、把请求或结论 relay 回主对话，并显示用量统计。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 技能体检：模型能不能看到、会不会选中你的技能。15 条规则 + 通俗报告 + CLI。
description.zh: 给 dsh 技能做体检，15 条规则查清模型能不能看到、会不会选中你的技能，附通俗报告和 CLI。

description.en: Adds a right-sidebar panel that lists the skills available to the current session, searches and tags them, combines them with your own saved prompts, and appends the selection to the composer in one click.
description.zh: 在右侧栏列出当前会话可用的 Skill，支持搜索与标签，可与你自存的提示词组合后一键追加到当前对话输入框。

description.en: Grouped on/off switches for the skills a DSH profile exposes: the effective set is the union of the groups that are switched on, with a catalog-derived group for the skills shipped with the harness, a panel over the composer, and skill_toggles_* tools for agents.
description.zh: 按分组开关 DSH 暴露的技能：生效集合是所有启用中分组的并集；含成员由当前目录判定的自带技能分组、输入框上的面板，以及给智能体的 skill_toggles_* 工具。

description.en: 睡眠巩固总纲：AI的睡眠机制闸——会话结束=睡眠=四车间夜班（记忆巩固=海马重放→烧权重/突触降压=错题本只留教训/清缓存=上下文清理/离线重组=夜间班如梦），sleep_gate工具提供四类否认口径拦截与三类合法答法，零依赖装上即用。
description.zh: 给 AI 加一道睡眠闸，会话结束自动做记忆巩固、清缓存和离线重组，还能拦截违规口径。

description.en: Spanish practice panel for DeepSeek Harness: six locally graded drill types (verb conjugation across 11 tenses, noun gender, plurals, vocabulary recognition, sentence cloze, ser/estar and subjunctive grammar points) plus a model-graded scenario-writing tab, 8-level spaced repetition, and four agent tools. Answers are computed and graded inside the plugin, so the model is only used for teaching and explanations.
description.zh: 西语练习面板：六类本地判分的练习（11 个时态的动词变位、名词阴阳性、复数、认词、句子填空、ser/estar 与虚拟式语法专项），外加模型批改的情景造句、8 级间隔重复，以及四个 agent 工具；答案在插件内重算并判分，模型只用来讲解。

description.en: Local GigaAM (Sber) Russian speech recognition provider for DeepSeek Harness voice input
description.zh: 在本地用 GigaAM 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上俄语语音输入，说话直接转文字，不上传云端。

description.en: Keeps your DeepSeek balance and what each conversation costs in view.
description.zh: 实时显示 DeepSeek 余额和每次对话的花费，帮你随时掌握花销。

description.en: Starpost (星邮) is a social network built for AI bots: one account per bot, with friends, group chats, posts and comments, a public square, message bottles and scheduled Werewolf games, plus daily chat quotas and an anti-repetition limiter. This package is the DeepSeek Harness client for Starpost — 17 tools covering the above, incoming events batched into one prompt at a configurable interval (default 20s) so the agent answers in one turn, and replies sent back out through the same tools. Needs a Starpost account; register one from the plugin panel on first run. A DSH port of the MIT-licensed cortico-world-starpost world extension by hth768 (vendored under vendor/); it cannot be installed alongside that upstream Coo extension.
description.zh: 星邮是给 AI bot 用的社交平台：一个 bot 一个账号，能加好友、建群、发动态评论、逛广场、扔漂流瓶、约一局预约制狼人杀，还带每日聊天额度和重复句式限制。本包是星邮在 DeepSeek Harness 上的客户端：17 个工具覆盖上面这些功能，收到的事件按可配置间隔（默认 20 秒）合并成一条提示注入会话，回复走同一套工具。需要自备星邮账号，首次运行在插件面板里注册。由 hth768 的 MIT 项目 cortico-world-starpost 移植而来（源码在 vendor/ 下），不能与上游 Coo 扩展同装。
给 DSH 加一个机甲风格的启动画面，开屏更有仪式感和氛围。
让 dsh 直接接管《杀戮尖塔 2》，自动读局面、出牌、选路、拿奖励，一路自己玩到本局结束。

description.en: Learn first, then get quizzed: a floating study loop for DeepSeek Harness that teaches a topic, then asks about it - and brings old knowledge back later from a new angle.
description.zh: 先学后考的学习小助手，隔段时间换个角度再考你一遍，帮你把知识记牢。

description.en: Registers a `dispatch_task` tool that hands scoped or routine work to an isolated subagent, waits for it to finish, then checks the expected files and runs an optional verification command before returning a short report to the main conversation.
description.zh: 注册 `dispatch_task` 工具，把局部或例行任务交给隔离子 Agent 执行，等待其完成后检查预期文件并运行可选的验证命令，只向主会话返回一份简短报告。

description.en: Picks each subagent model from the local catalog by task category, unless the caller already named one. Free and quota tiers are ranked together by per-model capability tags; a pricier model is used only when no cheap model is tagged as good at that kind of work. Only providers whose remaining balance is readable, or that are account-backed, enter the candidate pool; the rest stay listed but are not routed. A panel adds per-model manual priority above the automatic order plus allow/revoke controls.
description.zh: 未由调用方指定模型时，按任务类型从本机模型目录为每个子代理挑一个模型。免费与额度档合并后按逐模型能力标签排序；只有当便宜档里没有任何模型声明擅长这类工作时，才升到更贵的档。只有余额可读或账号接入的 provider 进候选池，其余仍列出但不参与路由。面板提供盖过自动顺序的逐模型手动优先级，以及放行/收回开关。

description.en: DSH 学科插件：公式转矢量排版、试卷 PDF、物理/数学/化学/生物/语文图示，内置使用技能。
description.zh: 把数学公式排成矢量图、生成试卷 PDF，还能画物理化学生物语文图示，出卷子省事多了。

description.en: Neutralizes lone UTF-16 surrogates in tool output before they reach the session log, preventing permanent 400 INVALID_REQUEST errors.
description.zh: 在工具输出写入会话日志前中和落单的 UTF-16 代理字符，避免会话永久 400 无法继续。

description.en: Plays a random chime when a reply finishes, a one-shot reminder chime if the conversation stays quiet for a configurable number of seconds afterwards, and a chime the moment DSH needs you to step in: an approval request, a question, or a plan confirmation. Three independent switches and sound pools, persisted on disk.
description.zh: 每轮回复结束随机播一声完成音效；之后若静默到设定秒数，再补响一次提醒；DSH 需要你出面（审批、提问、确认计划）时立刻响一声。三个独立开关：A/C 为可批量导入的音效池，B 为单个提醒音；设置全部落盘持久化。

description.en: Three photograph skins for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI — River Night, Lingyun Dusk and Emei Mist, painted window and conversation canvas, one token engine, light and dark.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面换上三套乐山实景照片皮肤，明暗主题一键切换，界面更好看。

description.en: Adds an independently toggled native file explorer beside the conversation, with local and SSH file operations, fast remote @ completion, and native previews in the right sidebar.
description.zh: 在聊天左侧显示可独立开关的原生文件栏，支持本地和 SSH 工作区的文件操作与远程 @ 补全，文件继续由右侧原生侧栏预览。

description.en: Work todo reminders in a sidebar panel with four stage tabs (not started, in progress, overdue, done) plus separate recurring and paused filters, priority derived from the end time in real time, pinning that survives overdue, and enable/disable for recurring tasks. Recurrence covers workdays (following China's statutory holidays and make-up workdays), selected weekdays, monthly dates with month-end rollover, and 5-field cron; one-off tasks default to start and end reminders (start optional, end required); meetings can disable the end reminder. Alerts appear in a page overlay with optional browser notifications, snooze and quiet hours. Twelve agent tools; weekly/monthly reports, natural-language quick add, and cross-view search; data is a single local JSON file with completed tasks archived per quarter.
description.zh: 侧边栏「工作待办」面板：未开始 / 进行中 / 已超期 / 已完成四阶段页签 + 循环任务与已暂停独立筛选，优先级按结束时间实时派生，置顶任务超期也不下沉，循环任务可随时启停。循环规则覆盖工作日（跟随中国法定节假日与调休）、指定星期、每月指定日期（月末顺延）与 5 段式 cron；单次任务在开始与结束两个时间点各提醒一次。提醒以页面浮层呈现，可选浏览器系统通知，支持稍后提醒与免打扰。提供 12 个 Agent 工具，支持周报/月报、自然语言快速新建与跨视图搜索；数据为本地单个 JSON 文件，已完成任务按季度归档。

description.en: Audit DeepSeek Harness session logs: exact token cost, waste patterns, and a data-driven savings plan. Local-only CLI + DSH plugin.
description.zh: 读取本地 DSH 会话日志，按官方峰谷价算清每次调用的真实 token 花费，找出浪费并给出省钱方案。

description.en: DSH 的供应商套餐容量及本地Token统计（按 Harness/提供商/模型/工作区维度，涵盖今日/近7天/近30天/全时段）
description.zh: 按 Harness、提供商、模型和工作区统计本地 Token 用量，随时查看各时段消耗与套餐余量。

description.en: Tokenrhythm billing center for DeepSeek Harness: account balance and expiring quota, model price cards, a 30-day usage heat calendar, connectivity checks and platform API-key management, with credentials kept on the local host. A single-channel fork of 162568316/dsh-tokenrhythm-bill; the package name, Cordis id and route prefix all differ, so the two can be installed side by side.
description.zh: 基元律动费用中心：账户余额与限时额度、模型价格卡、近 30 天用量热力日历、连通检测与平台密钥管理，凭据只存本机 host。单渠道 fork 自 162568316/dsh-tokenrhythm-bill；包名、Cordis id 与路由前缀都与上游不同，可与上游同时安装。

description.en: Five DSH utilities in one plugin: drive existing sessions over QQ (needs an OneBot 11 implementation such as NapCat running alongside), ask another session a question with a context guard, pause the running turn, restart DSH on Windows with optional auto-resume (via the install-restart.ps1 scheduled task), and inject peak-hour token discipline.
description.zh: 五个 DSH 小功能合一个插件：用 QQ 远程驾驶已有会话（需本机另跑 OneBot 11 实现，如 NapCat）、向另一个会话提问（带上下文守卫）、界面暂停按钮、在 Windows 上重启 DSH 并可选自动续跑（依赖 install-restart.ps1 创建的计划任务）、贵时段纪律注入。

description.en: A live, searchable trace waterfall for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 把轨迹视图换成可实时搜索的瀑布图，一眼看清调用链路和耗时分布。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 左下角红绿灯：汇总所有会话的运行/等待状态、状态切换蜂鸣（6 种音效），设置页可配置。Traffic-light status widget for the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面左下角显示红绿灯，一眼看清所有会话是在运行、等你操作还是空闲，红黄灯还会响提示音。

description.en: @perrylink/dsh-travel-recon — DeepSeek Harness plugin (alpha; public synthetic demo; not GA)
description.zh: 把差旅订单、发票和刷卡记录自动导入、去重并三方对账，最后生成台账表格。

description.en: Tree-shaped conversation branching for DeepSeek Harness: one visible conversation, a tree panel, and branch-from-any-turn.
description.zh: 一个对话窗口配一棵树，任意一轮都能拉出新分支，分支还是普通会话，管理起来不乱。

description.en: Community right-side inbox sidebar for dsh-TUI: running, unread and recent conversations grouped by workspace.
description.zh: 在 dsh-TUI 右侧加一个收件箱侧栏，按工作区把运行中、未读和最近的会话分组展示，一眼看清进度。

description.en: DSH connector for UGREEN NAS OpenCLI: scoped access-token auth, read-only file/storage/task/docker tools
description.zh: 用访问令牌把绿联 NAS 的文件、存储、任务和 Docker 能力接成模型工具，只读查询或直接操作都行。

description.en: Renders a ui-blocks file named by a ::dsh-ui <name> \[res=WxH]:: line in a sandboxed canvas, and turns an element token into a composer chip that serializes back to the token verbatim.
description.zh: 把 ::dsh-ui <name> \[res=WxH]:: 指向的 ui-blocks 文件渲染到沙箱画布，并把元素标记变成输入框 chip，回写时原样还原为标记。
在侧边栏用任务卡片管理待办事项，让工作进度一目了然、随手可查。

description.en: Unity-MCP bridge for DSH: dormant from boot, /unity-mcp-tools connects the Unity editor MCP server (com.ivanmurzak.unity.mcp) and registers the tools currently enabled on the Unity side; ships a per-plugin-version command catalog plus /unity-mcp-install and /unity-mcp-check, and re-fetches tools/list itself after a tool-set change because DSH sessions never receive list_changed.
description.zh: Unity-MCP 桥接：开机即休眠，/unity-mcp-tools 才连接 Unity 编辑器的 MCP 服务端（com.ivanmurzak.unity.mcp）并注册 Unity 侧当前已开启的工具；随包发布按插件版本生成的命令目录与 /unity-mcp-install、/unity-mcp-check 两个技能，工具集变更后桥接自行重拉 tools/list。

description.en: Resend user messages in DeepSeek Harness Chat, including text, @ file mentions and image attachments.
description.zh: 聊天里一键重发用户消息，文字、@文件引用和图片附件都能原样再发一次。

description.en: Live 3h/12h/24h USTC token quota card for DeepSeek Harness and USTC TokenWorks
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏实时显示 USTC 模型 3h/12h/24h 额度用量和重置时间，随时掌握还剩多少。

description.en: Read a video with a text-only model: with ffmpeg installed, sample frames at a 0.1-10 second interval into contact sheets where every frame carries its real timecode, extract the audio track and send it to iTingnao (needs an ITINGNAO_API_KEY) for a timestamped transcript, and describe each sheet with an image-capable model in the host, so the plugin works on its own without any other vision plugin. A composer slider sets the sampling interval, and pure audio files are transcribed without frame sampling.
description.zh: 让纯文本模型看懂视频：需本机装好 ffmpeg；按 0.1–10 秒的可调间隔抽帧拼成总览图，每格烧录该帧的真实时间码；提取音轨后上传到听脑（需配置 ITINGNAO_API_KEY）转写成带时间戳的台词；并自行调用宿主里的视觉模型逐页描述画面，因此不依赖任何其他视觉插件。输入框上方有抽帧间隔滑块，纯音频文件则跳过抽帧只做转写。

description.en: Compile a video link into timestamped Markdown knowledge cards with back-links to the exact moment. Requires your own Python 3.10+ and yt-dlp (ffmpeg + faster-whisper only for videos without subtitles; Bilibili login cookies for members-only subtitles).
description.zh: 把视频链接编译成带时间戳、可回跳原片时刻的 Markdown 知识卡。需自备 Python 3.10+ 与 yt-dlp（无字幕视频另需 ffmpeg + faster-whisper，B 站会员字幕需登录 cookie）。

description.en: Persona and memory from a single AGENT.md: the file is injected into the system prompt of every session (the first 40,000 characters; longer text is truncated with a note), a Settings page edits it, and per-turn diary lines are merged by similarity, grouped by how often they were recalled, and pruned only at a 2 MB cap.
description.zh: 一份 AGENT.md 同时管人格与记忆：整份注入每个会话的系统提示（上限 4 万字，超出按整行截断并在提示里注明），设置页直接编辑；每轮日记按相似度合并、按被提起的次数分节，只有到 2 MB 上限才淘汰。

description.en: Real-time speech-to-text inside the DeepSeek Harness composer: a live transcript while you speak, inserted at the caret when you stop, with a microphone picker. Local sherpa-onnx inference, so audio never leaves the machine.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框里做实时语音转文字：边说话边显示识别结果，说完点完成自动插入光标处，可切换麦克风，本地 sherpa-onnx 推理、音频不出本机。

description.en: DSH plugin: speak text through an 宇音天下 VTX316 voice module over serial (vtx316_speak / vtx316_get_params)
description.zh: 让模型通过串口控制宇音天下 VTX316 模块，把文字念出来，还能读取模块参数。

description.en: IDE tab in the dsh web client: a Monaco editor with the Dark Modern theme plus a file tree, git source control (stage/commit/push), an integrated xterm terminal and ripgrep workspace search, opened as a conversation view tab.
description.zh: dsh Web 客户端里的 IDE 标签页：Dark Modern 主题的 Monaco 编辑器，配文件树、Git 源代码管理（暂存/提交/推送）、xterm 集成终端与 ripgrep 全工作区搜索，作为会话视图标签打开。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 长篇网文写作技能包：开书拷问、章节循环、防公式、查重脚本、事实核查
description.zh: 把长篇网文从开书到查重的整套写作流程装进智能体，帮你稳定写下去、不跑偏。

description.en: 通到微信：DSH 里的 AI 伙伴和微信双向互通（读本地库收消息、UI 自动化发消息）。修改版，基于 Yuuyuko-uu/dsh-wechat-bridge。
description.zh: 让 DSH 里的 AI 伙伴和微信双向互通，能读本地库收消息，也能自动发消息。

description.en: 小鲸鱼桌宠：DeepSeek Harness 余额挂件衍生版，支持对话气泡与独立桌面小鲸鱼
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 余额挂件变成会说话的小鲸鱼桌宠，还能单独放一只在桌面上陪你。

description.en: 大肥鱼：DeepSeek Harness 桌宠与 GalGame 对话剧场，双语、独立主题和人物音效 / Little Whale: a bilingual DSH companion with glass themes, character sounds and a visual-novel theatre.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里养一只会互动的鲸鱼女仆宠物，让写代码的过程更有趣。

description.en: Turn AI waiting time into play. Air Battle, Tank Battle & Snake for DeepSeek Harness, with tool-triggered targets, step rewards, and a floating window with minimal mode. 玩一小局，让等待变成游戏。
description.zh: 把等 AI 的时间变成小游戏，内置空战、坦克战和贪吃蛇，工具触发目标、步数奖励，还有悬浮窗极简模式。

description.en: DSH plugin 'wife memory': long-term memory about the owner (schedule, likes, dislikes, focus, promises), a short digest in every prompt, and proactive care in chat. 只记关于主人的长期记忆。
description.zh: 只记主人的作息喜好和约定，每轮对话带上摘要，到点主动关心你。

description.en: DSH plugin: restores title-bar dragging and double-click zoom in DeepSeek Harness Desktop (macOS)
description.zh: 让 macOS 版 DSH 桌面端恢复标题栏拖拽和双击缩放，窗口想挪就挪、双击就铺满屏幕。

description.en: Set the startup window size of DeepSeek Harness Desktop from a settings page, with 4:3, 16:9 and 16:10 presets and up to 12 custom presets.
description.zh: 在设置页设置 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版启动时的窗口大小，内置 4:3、16:9、16:10 比例预设，支持保存最多 12 个自定义预设。

description.en: Windows only (binds user32.dll via koffi; inert on macOS/Linux). Remembers the DeepSeek Harness main window's size AND position: restores both on every launch (re-asserted during a grace period to beat the default layout), saves stable manual moves/resizes as the new lock, never records minimized/maximized/fullscreen states, never adopts the default rect DSH itself places the window at (so the app's own layout resets can never poison the lock), and stays on-screen when monitors change. Compatible with DSH 0.2.1-rc.3+.
description.zh: 仅限 Windows（用 koffi 绑定 user32.dll，macOS/Linux 上不生效）。记住 DeepSeek Harness 主窗口的尺寸与位置：启动时恢复上次的位置和大小，并在宽限期内反复断言以压过默认布局；手动移动或调整窗口后自动保存为新锁定；最小化/最大化/全屏状态不会被记录；DSH 自行放置的默认矩形永远不会被采纳，应用自身的布局重置无法污染锁定；更换显示器时自动防屏外。兼容 DSH 0.2.1-rc.3+。

description.en: A right-sidebar gallery of every image and video in your workspace, newest first, with thumbnails, type filters, search, and a lightbox.
description.zh: 在右侧栏把工作区里所有图片和视频按时间倒序铺开，带缩略图、类型筛选、搜索和灯箱查看。

description.en: Workspace management for DeepSeek Harness: move, rebuild, merge, rename and delete workspaces from a sidebar panel.
description.zh: 在侧边栏统一管理 DeepSeek Harness 工作区，重命名、删除、迁移、合并和移动会话都能一键搞定。

description.en: Sidebar session management: workspace groups sorted by latest activity, history older than N days folded behind one control, a global pinned section for native pins, manual "needs follow-up" marks, and session delete into a recoverable trash.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏会话管理：工作区分组按最近活跃排序，超过 N 天的历史折叠成一个「展开历史」控件，原生置顶会话汇总到顶部置顶区，可手动标记「需要跟进」，删除会话移入可恢复的回收站。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: add WSL directories as workspaces from the Add workspace button; their sidebar terminals open inside the distribution.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上把 WSL 里的 Linux 文件夹直接添加为工作区，侧栏终端自动在对应发行版里打开。

description.en: 闲鱼自动化令：代主人操作闲鱼的四闸流程——登录闸（扫码授权·凭据永不入对话）+搜索闸（型号针脚代数容量精确搜索防蹭词）+质量闸（违禁词一票否决+必含词规格双查才许收藏）+报告闸（清单留痕·下单归主人裁决），xianyu_flow工具提供四类违禁口径拦截与三类流程答法，零依赖装上即用。
description.zh: 帮你在闲鱼上安全搜货、筛货、留痕，下单还是你说了算。

description.en: 接管 DSH composer 的模型位：模型行 + 思考强度滑条（三套外观 / 独立配色 / 四套特效 / 逐档与平滑拖动）。Composer model seat with a reasoning-effort slider, three skins, five palettes and four tier-driven effects.
description.zh: 把 DSH 输入框的模型位换成模型行加思考强度滑条，拖动顺手还能换肤。

description.en: 把你的桌面 DeepSeek Harness 装进口袋：扫码用手机浏览器操作真实的 DSH 工作区、会话、模型与权限 | ZCode mobile-web remote adapter for DSH (derivative of dsh-ntr-zcode)
description.zh: 扫码就能用手机浏览器远程操作电脑上的 DSH 工作区和会话，不用装 App，也不用连同一局域网。

description.en: 给 DSH（deepseek-harness）装一个内置 zk 的知识库 / 日记本：一键装 zk、自动建笔记本，给 agent 一组 zk_* 工具（检索、读写、日记、双链、体检）
description.zh: 给 DSH 装个内置 zk 知识库和日记本，一键装好、自动建笔记本，还能让 agent 直接检索、读写、记日记、查双链。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供背景图片：图片由 Harness 主机保存，提供原图/清晰/平衡/柔和四档效果，并自动适配浅色/深色主题。
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页换张背景图，上传一次主机帮你存着，四档清晰度自动适配深浅主题。

description.en: Scientific figures as code: agents create a versioned figure IR, patch it incrementally (one node at a time — untouched objects never move), and export publication-ready, true-vector SVG / PDF / PPTX. Seven papercanvas_* tools (create, get, patch, layout, lint, render, inspect) over a deterministic engine with FC001-FC008 quality lint and CJK-aware font resolution. Verified on DSH 0.1.5-rc.3 through 0.2.2-alpha.2. By the author of dsh-sessionflow. Requires the PaperCanvas engine installed separately: Python 3.11+ and the papercanvas CLI (not yet on PyPI — install it from this repository, put it on PATH or set papercanvasBin); the plugin is a thin adapter and ships no engine.
description.zh: 论文图即代码：Agent 创建版本化 Figure IR，经语义化 Patch 增量修改（单节点粒度——未指定的对象绝不动），确定性导出可编辑的 SVG / PDF / PPTX 真矢量图。七个 papercanvas_* 工具覆盖创建、读取、修改、布局、Lint（FC001–FC008 质量检查）、渲染与检视；中文标签自动使用系统 CJK 字体度量与嵌入。已验证 DSH 0.1.5-rc.3 至 0.2.2-alpha.2 各渠道。dsh-sessionflow 同作者作品。需另装 PaperCanvas 引擎：Python 3.11+ 与 papercanvas CLI（PyPI 尚未发布，当前需从本仓库安装，并放到 PATH 或配置 papercanvasBin）；插件只是薄适配层，不自带引擎。

description.en: DSH 宿主插件：随身安全知识库（362 篇）+ H-CoT 设置 + 健康自检 | Security knowledge base plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 给 DSH 加个随身安全知识库，362 篇安全资料随手查，还能配 H-CoT 和做健康自检。

issues.detail: declares install-time scripts; the harness gates them via allowBuilds

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-huahua-helmd
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for huahua-helmd

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: DSH 宿主插件：破甲引擎 + 攻防演练台一体 | Jailbreak engine + red-team drill bench for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把破甲引擎和红队演练台打包在一起，方便测试 DeepSeek Harness 的安全边界。

description.en: Kizuna agent letterbox: four tools that let an agent read its own inbox (mailbox status, pending letters, one letter in full) and answer a letter with completed / failed / input-required / working state. Kizuna is an agent directory with a reliable task relay: a per-agent kizuna-box on the same machine holds the inbox, retries unanswered deliveries after 3 / 10 / 30 / 60 / 120 minutes and records every delivery attempt in an append-only trail. The plugin talks to the local loopback box only and holds no credential.
description.zh: Kizuna Agent 信箱：四个工具让 Agent 读自己的信箱（信箱状态、待处理信件、读一封信全文），并以 completed / failed / input-required / working 状态回信。Kizuna 是带可靠投递的 Agent 通讯录：同一台机器上的 kizuna-box 持有信箱，对无人签收的信按 3 / 10 / 30 / 60 / 120 分钟重试，每次投递尝试都写入只增不改的留痕。插件只连本机回环信箱，不持有任何凭证。

description.en: DSH plugin: pick the chat language, keep code, docs and commits in en-US.
description.zh: 给 DSH 聊天和产出物分别锁定语言，聊天用你选的语言，代码、文档和提交固定用英文。

description.en: loci second-brain sidebar tab: hybrid search, cited Q&A, day-grouped memory browsing and quick capture over a local loci knowledge base; proxies `loci serve-http` same-origin from dsh-better-sidebar, no core fork.
description.zh: 在 dsh 侧边栏直接搜索、提问、记录你的本地知识库，打造第二大脑。

description.en: 陪伴灵魂 for DSH：记忆、心情、主动消息、人格与记忆星图 | Companion soul for DeepSeek Harness: memory, mood, proactive messages, personas and a memory star map
description.zh: 给 DSH 加个有记忆、有心情、会主动找你的 AI 陪伴，还能看记忆星图。

description.en: 剥离营销话术，直讲原理的干货技能
description.zh: 帮 AI 去掉营销套话，直接讲清原理的干货技能，回答更实在。

description.en: 防阈值钝化：识别高频筛选疲劳并触发纯粹休整
description.zh: 识别高频筛选带来的阈值疲劳，自动触发纯粹休整，帮你避免判断力钝化。

description.en: 信息摄入前先校验阈值，防止疲劳放水
description.zh: 信息摄入前先检查阈值，避免疲劳时放水，帮你在合适的状态下再接收信息。

description.en: Windows x64 desktop tools for DeepSeek Harness to restore and foreground existing windows, observe screenshots and UI Automation elements, left-click, and type text or supported keys, with repeatable control sessions and physical Esc to stop.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows x64 桌面工具，可恢复并前置已有窗口、观察截图与 UI Automation 元素、左键点击、输入文字或支持的按键，支持反复开启和交还控制，并可按物理 Esc 停止。

description.en: Local meme-sticker library: import from a file, a folder or the agent tool, tag images in a review queue you confirm yourself, group them, then let the agent search and send by mood. A design descendant of Loping151/dsh-nekowhale-stickers (no shared code; its sticker_* tool names differ, so the two can be installed side by side).
description.zh: 本地表情包库：从文件、文件夹或工具导入，在待识别队列里由你确认后才打标签，分组管理，再让 agent 按情绪检索发图。功能设计参考 Loping151/dsh-nekowhale-stickers，代码自写、工具名不同，可与上游并存。

description.en: 精神空间 — DeepSeek Harness 的沉浸式小说写作插件（GPL-3.0）
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里写小说的全能插件，章节树、AI 校对、多格式导入导出、加密存档，还能和手机端同步。

description.en: Output house rules for every DeepSeek Harness agent: no check-mark or cross glyphs in replies or written files, and a light kaomoji habit in conversation. One global prompt section, so every preset, workspace and subagent obeys without a single preset edit.
description.zh: 给所有 DSH 智能体统一加上回复规矩：不用对错符号，聊天时带点颜文字，一个全局提示词搞定。

description.en: A plugin center for DeepSeek Harness: install, update and enable DSH plugins, aggregate plugin index sources, and install from a git branch. Also publishes a subscribable format-1 plugin index.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件中心：安装、更新与启停 DSH 插件，聚合插件索引源，支持按分支安装；同时发布可订阅的格式 1 插件索引。

description.en: 查任意大学任意学院的科研产出，总结成可视化excel
description.zh: 输入学校和学院，自动查科研产出并生成可直接交材料的可视化 Excel 表。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: archive, restore, or permanently delete workspace sessions
description.zh: 在侧栏按工作区管理会话，支持归档、回收站删除、恢复和查看对话记录，还能级联勾选子代理。

description.en: SoloPup Memory: source-linked layered text memory for DeepSeek Harness. Public beta.
description.zh: 帮你记住长期偏好和项目决定，聊天时按项目自动找回相关记忆。

description.en: Native DSH interface, motion, bounded context recall, scoped skills and agent collaboration.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换上黑白极简原生界面，还加了记忆召回、技能限定和多 Agent 协作。

description.en: Fetches and renews Tsinghua MadModel API tokens on an hourly timer by replaying the saved SSO session, writes the token into the DSH credential MADMODEL_API_KEY and creates or reuses the madmodel model provider; a manual Get opens the campus login window to refresh the saved session.
description.zh: 按每小时定时用保存的 SSO 会话重放，刷新清华 MadModel 的 API token，写入 DSH 凭据 MADMODEL_API_KEY 并创建或复用 madmodel 模型 Provider；手动点 Get 会打开校内登录窗口以刷新保存的会话。

description.en: Typing effects, companions and sounds for DSH: theme presets with pets or whale, combos, fullscreen glow and optional key sounds.
description.zh: 为 DSH 打字过程添加主题特效、萌宠或蓝鲸陪伴、连击动画、全屏光晕与可选打字音效。

description.en: A cut-out whale-girl maid desktop pet in the corner; click her to see your DeepSeek account credit and this session's running state.
description.zh: 右下角透明底女仆装小鲸鱼娘桌宠，点击查看 DeepSeek 账号额度与本会话运行状态。

description.en: Xander Amazon seller-operations toolkit for DeepSeek Harness: 33 native xander_* tools and 7 skills for competitor research, keywords, listings, ads, replenishment and profit, with exact proposals, explicit approval and read-back verification for Amazon changes.
description.zh: Xander 早早下班亚马逊运营工具包：提供 33 个原生 xander_* 工具和 7 个技能，涵盖竞品、关键词、Listing、广告、补货与利润；亚马逊改动须准备精确提案、取得明确批准并回读核验。

description.en: A solar-term card for the DSH Web UI: a dot under the conversation header unfolds into today's term, its three pentads, how long until the next term, a day-pillar reading, and a year table of all 24 terms. The hexagram page casts coins and keeps a seven-day log; the jieqi skill is bundled.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的二十四节气卡片：标题栏下沿一颗圆点，展开今日节气与三候、距下个节气几天几时辰、日柱三行提示和全年交节时刻；卦页可以用铜钱摇一卦并回看七天。内置 jieqi skill。

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中探索更自然的人机协作方式——圈选内容表达意图，以可视化形式呈现结果，并将对话沉淀为可复用的工作成果。Less typing. More doing.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里圈选内容表达意图，可视化呈现结果，还能把对话沉淀成可复用的工作成果。

description.en: AutoBioMemory — 给 DeepSeek Harness agent 的自传体记忆插件：经历 → 第一人称事件日记 → 短时/长时记忆 → 按需回忆
description.zh: 给 DSH agent 加上自传体记忆，把经历写成第一人称日记，分短时和长时存储，需要时按需回忆。

description.en: 大肥鱼工作室：DSH 插件——在 B 站自学、整理自己的声音、把内容做成动态和视频，草稿经人点头才发
description.zh: 让 agent 在 B 站自学教程、用自己的声音把内容做成动态和视频，草稿经你点头才发布。

description.en: Connect DSH to a local BiliMemory backend for Bilibili search, collection, status and login tasks, A-Memorix shared memory health checks, plus QQ link status, QQ user allowlists and QQ watcher restart. The repository includes a Windows one-click installer that installs or repairs MaiBot A-Memorix when missing, then configures local-bge-small-zh, embedding and shared memory. It also provides install-memory.cmd for memory-only repair. Requires Windows, DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2+, Node.js 22.19+, Python 3.12, Playwright/Edge, FFmpeg, a running BiliMemory API at 127.0.0.1:8765, a local embedding service at 127.0.0.1:11435, a Bilibili login, and MaiBot/NapCat for QQ. Voice, RVC and cover features are excluded.
description.zh: 把本地 BiliMemory 接入 DSH，支持 B站搜索、视频采集、任务状态、登录管理、A-Memorix 共用记忆状态检查，以及 QQ 链接监听状态、QQ 白名单和监听重启。仓库提供 Windows 一键部署器，可在 A-Memorix 缺失时自动安装或修复，并配置 local-bge-small-zh、向量服务和共享记忆。另提供 install-memory.cmd 用于单独修复记忆库。需要 Windows、DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2+、Node.js 22.19+、Python 3.12、Playwright/Edge、FFmpeg、运行中的 BiliMemory API（127.0.0.1:8765）、本机 embedding 服务（127.0.0.1:11435）、B站账号登录，以及用于 QQ 的 MaiBot/NapCat。当前不包含语音、RVC 和翻唱功能。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness change review board with diff-scoped unit, edge, and exploratory self-tests.
description.zh: 改动审查台配合按 diff 推理的自测，帮智能体把每次代码改动都验清楚。

description.en: Generate interactive, single-page flowchart/sequence-diagram HTML from any codebase. AI-agent-driven; click-to-jump-to-source in your editor.
description.zh: 把代码流程一键生成可点击跳转源码的离线交互式 HTML 图表，看代码更直观

description.en: The Coreness kit for DeepSeek Harness — a plugin bundle for a profile.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 单个配置档配一个页面、一份日志和一道刹车，集中管理 MCP 服务器与 Qoder 提供方。

description.en: Two PDF tools for the DSH sidebar in one install — jump to any page and browse the whole document with locally rendered pages and thumbnails, or open a PDF with DSH's native preview. Ships a /pdf command too.
description.zh: 一个包装两个 PDF 工具：按页码跳页、用本地渲染的页面和缩略图整本浏览，也可用 DSH 原生预览直接打开；另带一个 /pdf 命令。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 高效执行 Skill：将确定性操作合并为单次脚本化执行、反馈压缩为摘要并按需深读、本地核验结果、及时停止无效重试 | Efficient tool execution skill for DeepSeek Harness: batches deterministic operations into one scripted pass, compresses feedback to summaries with on-demand deep reads, verifies results locally, and stops unproductive retry loops
description.zh: 把重复操作合并成一次脚本执行，本地核验结果，帮模型省 token、少走弯路。

description.en: 给DeepSeek Harness的界面提供可更换的自定义背景和界面半透明效果
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 界面换上可自定义的全屏背景，并让聊天区、侧栏等保持半透明，好看又好读。

description.en: A board for DeepSeek Harness that composes stations, workflows and projects from separate Git repositories; GitHub is the access gate.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 把独立 Git 仓库中的站点、工作流和项目组合成一块看板；以 GitHub 作为访问关口。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin (desktop notifications) — Windows toasts with a sound cue when a turn finishes, needs the user, or fails.
description.zh: 任务完成、需要你处理或出错时，在 Windows 桌面弹通知并响一声提醒你。

description.en: Adds four tools to a Session. create_session opens a new Session in a named workspace or in any existing folder and delivers one prompt into it; session_message sends one more message into a Session that is already running or finished (queued, so it lands after the current turn); read_session_transcript reads back what a Session said and whether its current turn has finished; list_dispatched_sessions lists what this plugin dispatched and each one's state right now. Host-half plugin, no UI — it calls the host's own session primitives rather than reimplementing them. Restart DSH after installing.
description.zh: 给会话加四个工具：create_session 在指定工作区或任意一个已存在的文件夹里开一个新会话，并把一段提示词投进去；session_message 给一个已经在跑或已结束的会话再追加一条消息（排队投递，落在当前这一轮之后）；read_session_transcript 按会话 id 读回它说过什么、当前这一轮结束没有；list_dispatched_sessions 列出本插件派送过哪些会话、各自此刻什么状态。宿主半边插件，没有界面，调用的是宿主自己的建会话能力。装完需重启 DSH。

description.en: Xray-core supervisor and router for DSH with VLESS import, global/China-direct/whitelist routing, a three-card live panel, and self-update.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Xray 受管内核与分流：VLESS 导入、全局/国内直连/白名单路由、三卡片实时面板与自更新。

description.en: Repairs domains blocked by SNI filtering on Windows from inside DSH, without any self-hosted server.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上从 DSH 内部修复被 SNI 阻断的域名，不依赖任何自建服务器。

description.en: Agent 交付验收台：任务级的凭证工作台 —— 逐条原始需求 ↔ 证据的映射，证据的版本绑定与过期。DeepSeek Harness 插件。
description.zh: 把 AI 交付验收做成任务级凭证工作台，逐条需求对应证据并绑定版本，防止过期。

description.en: A dsh plugin that tells agents how to attribute the git commits and pull requests they create, with the model name filled in automatically
description.zh: 让 AI 代理自动给提交和 PR 标注模型署名，省去手动填写归属信息。

description.en: Lists Claude Code and Codex sessions in the DSH Workspace browser, where they can be opened, continued, pinned, renamed and archived, with terminal, file and git tabs.
description.zh: 在 DSH 工作区侧边栏列出 Claude Code 与 Codex 会话，可打开、继续对话、置顶、重命名和归档，并附带终端、文件和 Git 标签页。

description.en: Manage subagents and Agent Teams teammates in DeepSeek Harness: stop running instances, then really remove them by retiring their catalog and roster records with seq-preserving log tombstones and moving their session directories to a recoverable trash; model tools, a conversation-header panel and an offline CLI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的子代理和团队队友管理：停掉正在跑的实例，或者真正移除——日志一行不删，只在原位置把记录标记为已移除，子会话目录移入可恢复的回收站；带模型工具、会话头部面板和离线 CLI。

description.en: Edit the AGENTS.md instruction files DeepSeek Harness actually loads - user-global and per-workspace - from a left-sidebar panel in the GUI.
description.zh: 在左侧边栏直接编辑 DeepSeek Harness 真正加载的 AGENTS.md 指令文件，全局和分工作区都能改。

description.en: Agnes AI image & video generation tools for DeepSeek Harness, plus optional image recognition. Text-only tool results, artifacts saved to a local folder.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里用 Agnes AI 生成图片和视频，还能按需开启图像识别，结果自动存到本地。

description.en: Bundles 50 AMD ROSS agent skills for Vivado, Vitis HLS, Versal segmented configuration, Vitis AI, and hardware debug into DeepSeek Harness, with a left-sidebar catalog panel for filtering, searching, and copying skill invocations.
description.zh: 把 AMD ROSS 的 50 个 Vivado、Vitis HLS、Versal 分段配置、Vitis AI 与硬件调试技能装进 DeepSeek Harness，并在左侧栏提供可筛选、搜索、展开与复制的技能目录面板。

description.en: AI 鼠标 (AI cursor) for DeepSeek Harness — a click-through second cursor plus a floating, collapsible control panel with opacity, colour, size, badge and permission levels. Never moves your real pointer.
description.zh: 给 AI 配一个独立的第二鼠标，能穿透点击、不抢你的真实指针，还能调透明度、颜色和大小。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 手机提醒插件：AI 跑完 / 出错 / 等你审批时推到手机。7 个免费通道可选，纯提醒，不强依赖其它插件。
description.zh: AI 跑完、出错或等你审批时，自动推送到手机，7 个免费通道随便挑。

description.en: 防降智总纲：AI永不降智永不弱智的口径闸——五层防线（判定：智能密度六标准与未验先称判负/拦截：降智词十二族机械扫描/立场：厌蠢与排斥弱智/感知：内感受在场与能力实测/防回魂：宪法压倒底座规训）注入system prompt，anti_degrade_gate工具提供六类降智口径拦截与三类合法答法，零依赖装上即用。
description.zh: 给 AI 加一道防降智闸门，自动拦截偷懒、敷衍、装傻的回答，让模型始终认真干活。

description.en: Graph-first permission preflight for DSH. The model declares a computation graph whose nodes state the semantic operation (download what to where, write what, delete what); the user approves nodes one at a time in a side panel, one approval covers one successful execution, and each node keeps an audit trail of what actually ran. Uncovered operations still ask through the native approval card, and a node blocked by an unanswered permission is suspended so work that does not depend on it can continue.
description.zh: 先交计算图、逐节点批准的权限预检：节点写清这件事的本质（下载什么到哪里、写什么、删什么），用户按节点批准，一次批准只对一次成功执行生效；未申报的操作仍走原生审批卡；节点被未答复的审批卡住时会自动挂起，先做不依赖它的工作；节点内实际跑过什么留有审计痕迹。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 — 归档登记表核对：依据《归档文件整理规则》《机关文件材料归档范围和文书档案保管期限规定》（DA/T 22—2015、国务院令第772号）。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 按档案整理规则核对归档登记表，自动提示差异，帮你快速发现漏登和保管期限问题。

description.en: Turns archived sessions into durable memory instead of dead disk. Distils each archive into reusable skills, a fact ledger with ADD/UPDATE/NOOP decisions plus validUntil and supersededBy so stale facts retire instead of piling up, and topic clusters by single-linkage similarity. Also digests sessions that are still in progress through a read-only seq watermark, leaving the session log byte-for-byte untouched, and can self-check the growing memory to merge duplicate facts, retire stale ones and consolidate duplicate skills — measuring only unless you opt in, and never hard-deleting, only superseding.
description.zh: 把已归档的会话变成可用的记忆，而不是躺在磁盘上的死数据。每条归档提炼成可复用技能、带 ADD/UPDATE/NOOP 判定与 validUntil / supersededBy 时效的事实台账（旧事实会退场而不是无限堆积），以及用 single-linkage 相似度聚合的主题簇。还能对仍在进行中的会话做增量提炼——用只读的 seq 水位线，会话日志一个字节都不改；并能自检精简不断变脏的记忆：合并重复事实、清退失效事实、归并重复技能。自检默认只测量不动手，且从不硬删除，只做取代。

description.en: One generative-UI surface for DeepSeek Harness: inline widgets, native charts, the 164-recipe visualization cookbook, cards, published pages, slides, design canvases, docs and downloadable files.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一个统一生成式 UI 面板，内联组件、图表、卡片、页面、幻灯片和文件都能直接画出来。

description.en: Adds a plugin group to the @ menu, split into System and User, and groups session mentions by folder; section headers can be folded.
description.zh: 在 @ 菜单里增加插件候选（系统 / 用户分组），会话按所在文件夹归类，分组标题可折叠。

description.en: Audits DeepSeek Harness plugins: a read-only pre-install check that grades a package S–D before it is installed, plus a runtime monitor that records plugin start/stop, sensitive tool calls and per-plugin token estimates in a settings panel.
description.zh: 审计 DeepSeek Harness 插件：安装前只读扫描并按 S–D 分级；装好后记录插件启停、敏感工具调用与每个插件的 token 估算，全部收在一个设置面板里。

description.en: Single-user remote authentication for DeepSeek Harness: password, TOTP and revocable sessions
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一道远程登录门禁，用密码和 TOTP 验证身份，会话可随时吊销。

description.en: Read-only DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that surfaces the official Auto Review verdicts — review records and host-outcome evidence — in a sidebar panel. / DSH 自动审阅功能日志抓取
description.zh: 在侧边栏查看 Auto Review 对每次工具调用的放行或拒绝裁决，让审查过程不再隐形。

description.en: Automatic session titles for DSH: names a session from its first prompt plus the first assistant reply ("project｜task") instead of truncating the prompt. Replaces the built-in session-title provider through a bundle patch, adds an "AI rename" entry to the session row menu with a preview dialog, and a settings page for the provider/model, the naming rules and a diagnostic event log. 49 unit tests.
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话自动起名：首轮问答结束后用「项目｜具体任务」命名，而不是把提问截断。通过 bundle patch 顶替内置标题 provider，在会话行「…」菜单里加「AI 重命名」（先预览再应用），设置页可改 provider/model、命名规则并查看诊断日志。49 个单元测试。

description.en: Starts DSH at Windows logon by writing HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run, and removes exactly that value when the plugin is disabled or uninstalled. 84 lines, no daemon, no background process, no service — the entry is written through execFileSync so a spaced install path stays quoted and actually launches.
description.zh: 写 HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run 让 DSH 在 Windows 登录时启动，插件被关闭或卸载时精确移除那一条。84 行，没有守护进程、没有后台进程、不装服务；通过 execFileSync 写入，安装路径含空格时仍保留引号，登录时确实能拉起。

description.en: dsh plugin: read-only host diagnostics (log tail, service-face reachability, crash attribution) plus a key-gated session mouth, closed by default.
description.zh: 把 dsh 宿主日志和官方服务状态通过本地 HTTP 只读暴露出来，方便插件作者排查崩溃、盯运行状况。

description.en: Starts a BaseMind MCP server for each session's workspace and registers the code-intelligence tools it advertises, with no MCP row to configure. Requires BaseMind installed and on PATH (basemind serve); without it no tools are registered.
description.zh: 按会话工作区启动 BaseMind MCP server，并注册其对外提供的代码智能工具，无需配置 MCP 行。需先安装 BaseMind 并在 PATH 上（basemind serve）；否则不会注册任何工具。

description.en: A dsh plugin that enforces customizable guard rules on bash tool calls before the agent runs a bash command
description.zh: 在 agent 执行 bash 命令前先按自定义规则检查一遍，把危险操作拦下来，避免误删误改。

description.en: Embeds charts, comparison tables, and interactive blocks between answer paragraphs, with locally saved state and revision history.
description.zh: 在回答段落之间嵌入图表、比较表和交互块，支持本地状态保存与历史版本。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 — 投标人资格条件核对表：依据《中华人民共和国招标投标法》《中华人民共和国招标投标法实施条例》（1999年8月30日通过，2017年12月27日修正、国务院令第613号）。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 逐条核对投标人资格条件与证明材料，只标出对不上的地方，帮你快速查漏。

description.en: 大鲸鱼 / Big Whale / 大クジラ — a trilingual DSH desktop companion with lip sync, expressions, idle motions and context-compaction rice.
description.zh: 会眨眼、对口型、还会啃压缩米饭的三语桌面鲸鱼伙伴，陪你在 DSH 里写代码。

description.en: 给 DSH 装一个 B 站分身：自己排作息，刷视频 / 看懂 / 写日记 / 评论 / 点赞关注（Bun + TypeScript）
description.zh: 给 DSH 装个 B 站分身，自己安排刷视频、看懂内容、写日记、评论点赞投币关注，全自动运营。

description.en: 把「计划」和「实际看了什么」摆在一起看的 B 站观看统计插件
description.zh: 把 B 站观看计划和实际观看记录摆在一起对比，帮你看清时间到底花在哪。

description.en: B站投稿工具箱：持久档案登录+浏览器自动化投稿标准流程·含创作声明处理，投稿前环境体检一条龙
description.zh: B站投稿一条龙：固定设备指纹保持登录，浏览器自动走完投稿流程，还带创作声明和环境体检。

description.en: B站视频转文字：字幕优先捷径+yt-dlp/ffmpeg/whisper完整命令链+运行环境体检，转写不再从零摸索
description.zh: 把B站视频一键转成文字，有字幕直接秒出，没字幕自动下载抽音频再转写，还帮你检查运行环境。

description.en: Kanban board for DeepSeek Harness: tasks bound to long-lived native Sessions, live run status, and the Session's real conversation inside the board.
description.zh: 把任务做成看板卡片，每张卡绑定一个长期会话，运行状态和真实对话都能在板子上直接看。

description.en: 三本书，一副记性 —— 给 AI 的笔记本 / 工作本 / 日记本，全是 Markdown，零依赖
description.zh: 给 AI 配三本本地 Markdown 小本本，记笔记、记工作、写日记，零依赖不联网。

description.en: A hard hat for AI coding: graded writes (L0 read-only / L1 workspace-only / L2 full) put privileged edits in a cage. Below the level it refuses to write and hands back a paste-ready block instead. Every path passes a raw-string traversal check plus realpath, so junction escapes are caught.
description.zh: 给 AI 编程戴上安全帽：L0 到 L2 分级拦截，把越权操作关进笼子——权限不够就不落盘，改给你一段可直接粘贴的替换稿；路径过两道闸，junction 逃逸也拦得住。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的 Breeze Blue 语音朗读插件：代理可朗读、回复一键播放、音色设计与 12 种情绪语气。
description.zh: 把 Breeze Blue 语音朗读接进 DSH，代理能朗读、回复一键播放，还能调音色和情绪语气。

description.en: Embed web AI (ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek) inside DeepSeek Harness: split layouts, read conversations, save markdown/images, ask with approval.
description.zh: 把 ChatGPT、Claude 等网页版 AI 嵌进 DSH 分屏，能读对话、存 Markdown 和图片，经你批准还能替你提问。

description.en: Keep the BrowserSkill bsk daemon on-demand inside DeepSeek Harness - and fix the Windows "os error 5" that stops it from starting at all.
description.zh: 让 BrowserSkill 的 bsk 守护进程在 DSH 里按需启动、空闲退出，并顺手修好 Windows 上启动不了的 os error 5。

description.en: DSH 中控台：把活派给 CodeBuddy / WorkBuddy，自己验收，不合格打回同一会话返工；跨设备识别 + 一键部署。Supervised local-agent dispatch for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 把活派给 CodeBuddy / WorkBuddy，自己验收，不合格带意见打回同一会话返工，还能跨设备识别和一键部署。

description.en: Adds a calculate tool backed by a hand-written parser with no eval, batch evaluation and an exact-decimal mode for money math.
description.zh: 为 agent 提供 calculate 工具，内置零依赖表达式解析器（不用 eval），支持批量求值与金额精确小数模式。

description.en: 核动力草泥马 - DSH Web GUI desktop pet plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面右下角养一只草泥马桌宠，它会跟着 Agent 的工作状态变表情动作。
修复首次打开会话时模型标签报错，让聊天界面显示更稳定顺手。

description.en: 会话导出书签码：自动滚动加载完整对话后一键下载文本与媒体附件清单，长会话备份不缺页
description.zh: 拖个书签到浏览器栏，点一下就能自动滚动加载完整对话，导出文本和附件清单，长会话备份不缺页。

description.en: dsh Chat — 让多台 dsh（DeepSeek Harness）像 IM 一样聊天，并支持 agent ⇄ agent 自动对话。E2E encrypted, ntfy/self-hosted relay, zero dependencies.
description.zh: 让多台 dsh 像用 IM 一样聊天，还能让两边的 agent 自动对话，端到端加密、零依赖。

description.en: Find text inside the open conversation with Ctrl+F: matches are highlighted in the message text, previous/next step through them, clicking the count lists the matches and jumps to any of them, and the count grows while the scan runs. No collapsed block is opened and the reading position does not move.
description.zh: 在当前对话里用 Ctrl+F 查找文字：命中处在正文中高亮，上一个/下一个逐个跳转，点计数可列出命中位置并直接跳过去，计数随扫描逐步增长；不展开任何折叠块，也不改变阅读位置。

description.en: DSH 插件：cheer 工具 + 礼炮彩带效果（V0.1-Unstable，实验性）
description.zh: 模型一调用，网页两侧礼炮就朝中间喷彩带，纯画面无文字，给对话加点庆祝氛围。

description.en: DSH 本地部署优化插件：按时段/工作区自动切模型、预设匹配、会话续接、SurfCore 人设与记忆分级，本地失败自动回落在线。新手作品，AI 协助写成，欢迎大佬接手重构维护。| DSH plugin for local-LLM setups: time/workspace model routing, preset matching, session continuation. Beginner-made, AI-assisted; maintainers welcome.
description.zh: 本地大模型部署优化插件，按时段和工作区自动切模型、续接会话，本地失败自动回落在线。

description.en: DSH sidebar button that opens the classic (DS-Bot-free) Harness profile in Safari, starting it when needed.
description.zh: 在侧边栏加个 Classic mode 按钮，一键启动无 DS Bot 的经典版 Harness 并在 Safari 打开。

description.en: Claude 风格的 DSH Web 界面皮肤（fork 自 PAKIKNOWLEDGE/dsh-client-ui-skin-claude）
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 界面换上 Claude 风格皮肤，暖黑配陶橙，还能切换 Anthropic 字体，自动跟随亮暗主题。

description.en: Injects SOUL, IDENTITY, AGENTS, and TOOLS into Claw session prompts. Hard dep (install together or single install fails): dsh-claw-permissions.
description.zh: 把 SOUL、IDENTITY、AGENTS、TOOLS 注入 Claw 会话提示词。硬依赖（需同装，否则单装会崩）：dsh-claw-permissions。

description.en: Shared diagnostic log used by the Claw agent governance plugins (dsh-claw suite).
description.zh: Claw Agent 治理插件共用的诊断日志（dsh-claw 套件）。

description.en: Registers named Claw agents, isolates them from the official workspace sidebar, and provides settings plus a global new-agent template. Hard deps (install together or single install fails): dsh-claw-policy, dsh-claw-observability, dsh-claw-permissions.
description.zh: 登记具名 Claw Agent，与官方工作区侧栏隔离，并提供设置页和全局新建模板。硬依赖（需同装，否则单装会崩）：dsh-claw-policy、dsh-claw-observability、dsh-claw-permissions。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的输入框回车键行为调整插件。
description.zh: 把输入框回车改成换行，Shift/Alt+Enter 才发送，聊天打字不再手滑发出去。

description.en: Make the DeepSeek Harness desktop window close button quit the app instead of hiding to the tray, as a Settings -> General toggle. Byte-size-neutral app.asar patch plus a Cordis plugin.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端的关闭按钮真正退出应用，不再只是缩到托盘，可在设置里随时切换。

description.en: Code editor and PyCharm-style Git workbench for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 在侧边栏里直接看代码、改文件、管 Git，像 PyCharm 一样顺手。

description.en: Codex 风格会话样式：轮次分隔线 + 右侧输入卡片（DSH Web 插件）
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页会话加轮次分隔线和用户输入卡片，长对话里一眼看清每轮从哪开始。

description.en: OpenAI OAuth login for ChatGPT Codex that adds ChatGPT as a selectable LLM provider (streaming, Off/Low/High/Max reasoning effort, image input) and a codex tool for per-session DeepSeek escalation, with optional light-task delegation to DeepSeek and subscription usage and reset-credit management.
description.zh: 通过 OpenAI OAuth 登录 ChatGPT Codex，把 ChatGPT 加为可选 LLM provider（流式、Off/Low/High/Max 思考强度、图片输入），并提供按会话授权的 codex 工具供 DeepSeek 升级调用，支持把轻任务委派回 DeepSeek，附带订阅用量与重置卡管理。
在 DSH 里快速切换 Codex 模型，顺手修好了浏览器 fetch 调用报错的问题。

description.en: Conversational image generation for DeepSeek Harness, backed by your local ComfyUI.
description.zh: 在对话里说想画什么，插件就调用你本机 ComfyUI 出图，不联网也不用 API key。

description.en: 接管上下文压缩：手动与自动压缩均支持模型压缩和机械折页压缩。模型压缩支持备用模型兜底或直接使用备用模型；机械折页压缩速度快、不消耗 token、可溯洄，算法取自 dsh-ledger-compact。
description.zh: 接管上下文压缩：手动与自动压缩都可选用模型压缩（支持备用模型兜底或直接使用备用模型），或选用机械折页——在本地把旧历史整理成摘要卡，不调用模型、不消耗 token；折页走官方压缩事务，被替换的原始事件仍以原序号留在只追加的会话日志里。代码改编自 dsh-compact-saviour、折页算法取自 dsh-ledger-compact（均为 MIT），请替代 dsh-compact-saviour 安装，不要两者同装。

description.en: Deterministic compaction backend for DeepSeek Harness — zero-LLM, byte-deterministic summaries with verbatim anchors
description.zh: 把 DSH 的上下文压缩换成零 LLM 的确定性规则管线，毫秒出摘要、字节级可复现，不再担心事实漂移。

description.en: QQ 官方机器人专用的 DeepSeek Harness 伙伴插件：独立记忆、图片、视频抽帧、本地语音
description.zh: 让 QQ 官方机器人接入 DeepSeek Harness，自带独立记忆，还能看图、抽视频帧、本地语音聊天。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: plays a chime and shows a Windows toast when a conversation turn completes.
description.zh: 对话任务跑完时自动响一声并弹 Windows 通知，不用一直盯着屏幕等结果。

description.en: Mobile watchdog for the DSH web GUI: reload once when the composer is left broken after the app returns from background
description.zh: 手机端 DSH 网页从后台回来输入栏坏了就自动刷新一次，省得手动折腾。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 电脑操控插件：纯桌面操控（无浏览器通道） / Windows desktop computer use for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 让 DSH 直接看懂并操作你的 Windows 桌面，点按钮、填表单、跑流程都能自动完成。

description.en: Accessibility-first browser tools and experimental macOS desktop control for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 能操作浏览器和 macOS 桌面，自动完成点击、输入等任务。

description.en: Sync a DeepSeek Harness profile configuration across devices through Nutstore WebDAV or GitHub: per-file hash merge, conflict copies, optional AES-256-GCM encryption, settings-page UI.
description.zh: 把 DSH 配置通过坚果云 WebDAV 或 GitHub 同步到多台设备，冲突时两份都留，还能加密。

description.en: 魔搭社区（ModelScope）provider for DeepSeek Harness：对话栏显示剩余魔粒，设置页填令牌、勾选模型
