description.en: A restart button in the window title strip, right of the sidebar toggle, that stops every process the desktop app owns (Electron shell, Host, renderers and tool subprocesses) and starts the executable again, then reloads the page once the new instance answers. Windows desktop app only, and it hides itself on any other Host.
description.zh: 窗口标题栏左上角、收起侧边栏按钮右侧的重启按钮：一次点击停掉这个桌面应用的全部进程（窗口外壳、宿主、渲染进程与工具子进程），再重新拉起可执行文件，新实例就绪后自动刷新页面。仅支持 Windows 桌面版，其它宿主里按钮自动隐藏。

description.en: Rewind-compact plugin bundle for the DeepSeek Harness: rewind the conversation to a completed-turn boundary and compact one side into a hybrid summary.

Character persona summaries for DeepSeek Harness: collects moegirl-first public sources, distills them into a reusable persona document through the csp workflow, and keeps a per-character asset library with quality checks, manual source attachment, version snapshots and a settings page.
description.zh: 二次元角色人格总结：萌娘百科优先采集公开资料，按 csp 固定工作流蒸馏成可复用的人格文档，并用资产库管理每个角色的质检、手动资料、历史版本与删改。

description.en: Native roundtable panel with a product manager, engineer and critical user, two discussion rounds, follow-up questions, votes, answer retries and summaries.
description.zh: 在原生面板中让产品经理、程序员和挑刺用户进行两轮讨论，支持追问、投票、重答和结论整理。

description.en: 微信/QQ 风格截图：隐藏窗口或直接截图，框选标注，自动保存到 图片\Screenshots 并复制到剪贴板。
description.zh: 像微信/QQ 那样截图：隐藏窗口截桌面、框选标注，自动存到 Screenshots 并复制到剪贴板。

description.en: Deterministic search, log and evidence acquisition for AI agents. OpenSearch-first, provider-neutral, strictly read-only.
description.zh: 让 AI 助手只读地查 OpenSearch 日志、搜证据、定位线上问题，排查故障有据可依。

description.en: Hands secrets and PII to the agent without them entering its context, with checksum-validated extraction and masked content classification.
description.zh: 把密钥和个人信息交给 agent，却不进入它的上下文；带校验位的字段抽取与掩码内容分类。

description.en: In-app server monitor window for DSH that tunnels to a lightweight agent on your server: memory, swap, load, disk, per-container usage and QQ status, cache purge and container restarts, plus an embedded VNC desktop for manual QQ QR login and sign-out. The agent ships in the repository (server/monitor.py) and you deploy it yourself.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内直接打开服务器监控窗口，经 SSH 隧道读取内存、交换分区、负载、磁盘、各容器占用与 QQ 登录状态，并提供清理缓存与重启容器按钮，以及内嵌 VNC 的 QQ 客户端供手动扫码登录或退出账号。守护 agent 随仓库提供（server/monitor.py），需要你自己部署。

description.en: Delete sessions from the DeepSeek Harness Web sidebar: a menu action plus a confirmation dialog that removes the session log.
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页侧边栏的会话菜单加上删除按钮，点一下确认就能清掉会话记录。
把已归档和已固定的会话集中到一个面板，方便翻看、搜索、分组、恢复和清理。

description.en: Multi-session split view for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: up to four live session panes in the conversation panel.
description.zh: 在对话面板里同时开最多四个会话分屏，多任务并行处理不用来回切换。

description.en: Session status hub for DeepSeek Harness: a top-titlebar rail of running / waiting / unread / failed Sessions, Windows toast notifications, and a red-yellow-green taskbar status dot.
description.zh: 在标题栏实时汇总各会话的运行、等待、未读和失败状态，配 Windows 弹窗提醒和红黄绿任务栏状态点，一眼看清谁在跑谁卡了。

description.en: Tag DeepSeek Harness sessions across workspaces and browse them as a colored, collapsible tag tree in the left sidebar.
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话打上跨工作区共享的彩色标签，左侧栏按标签树折叠浏览，找会话更方便。

description.en: Reorganizes a DeepSeek Harness session transcript into a structured Markdown document with an outline and a table of contents instead of exporting the chat in chronological order. Exposed three ways: a model tool session_to_doc, a composer button, and a loopback-only Web endpoint.
description.zh: 把 DSH 当前会话的对话记录重组成带大纲、章节层级和目录的结构化 Markdown 文档，而不是按时间顺序原样导出。三种入口：模型工具 session_to_doc、输入框按钮、仅回环的 Web 接口。

description.en: Adds a gear + Settings column beside the DSH desktop sidebar account row.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面侧边栏账号栏旁加一个齿轮按钮和设置列，点开就能快速进入设置。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness: sync settings, MCP and installed plugins through a private GitHub repository (like VS Code Settings Sync)
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的设置、MCP 和已装插件同步到私有 GitHub 仓库，换设备也能一键恢复。

description.en: /cmd <command> in the composer runs that shell command in the session working directory, sends the command and its output to the model as a user message, and renders the input as a terminal card with exit status, expandable output and copy buttons; a bare /cmd opens an interactive terminal whose transcript is sent to the model with Ctrl+Enter. Runs with its own terminal permissions (danger-full-access) by default; set useSessionPolicy: true to use the session sandbox.
description.zh: 在输入框用 /cmd <命令> 执行当前会话工作目录里的 shell 命令，把命令与输出作为一条 user 消息交给模型，并把这次输入渲染成带退出状态、可展开输出与复制按钮的终端卡片；裸 /cmd 则打开交互终端，Ctrl+Enter 把整段终端内容发给模型。默认以终端自身权限（danger-full-access）执行，设 `useSessionPolicy: true` 改用会话沙箱。

description.en: Puts one collapsible row above the sidebar panel icons. Click it to hide the icons, click again to show them. The choice is remembered in the browser. Because folding is done in CSS, icons from plugins you install later are folded too. It does not depend on any other plugin.
description.zh: 在侧栏面板图标上方加一行可折叠的标题。点一下收起图标，再点一下展开，选择会记住。折叠是纯 CSS 做的，所以你以后新装的插件图标也会一起收进去。不依赖任何其它插件。

description.en: Keeps DeepSeek usage and account balance in a bar at the bottom of the window.
description.zh: 在窗口底部常驻显示 DeepSeek 用量与账号余额。

description.en: DSH Sidecar Browser: a model-driven companion browser for the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏开一个由模型驱动的伴生浏览器，边聊边看网页、查资料。

description.en: Talk to DeepSeek Harness with Siri and iPhone Shortcuts. 用 Siri 和 iPhone 快捷指令对话 DeepSeek Harness。
description.zh: 对着 Siri 说句话，就能通过 iPhone 快捷指令和 Mac 上的 DeepSeek Harness 对话，回答由 Siri 念出来。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) skill center: browse loaded skills by source, toggle model invocation, create/edit/import skills, SkillHub and suite marketplaces, safe trash — in the Web GUI panel.
description.zh: 在 Web 面板里按来源浏览已加载的 Skill，开关模型调用，还能创建、编辑、导入技能，逛 SkillHub 和套件市场，删错了也能从回收站找回。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：输入框「Skill」按钮列出当前会话可用 skill，↑↓ 选择、回车即在光标处插入 /name，走官方斜杠命令链路，不用记命令名。
description.zh: 输入框加个 Skill 按钮，点开就能选当前会话可用的 skill，回车自动插入 /命令，不用记名字。

description.en: Skill usage radar for DeepSeek Harness: records every skill hit, ranks by the last 7 days, and suggests archiving skills that never fire.
description.zh: 记录每个技能被谁、在哪个会话触发过，按近 7 天命中排序，零命中的灰显并建议归档。

description.en: DSH plugin: monitor DGX Spark temperature & memory usage, set GPU clock.
description.zh: 在界面右侧实时查看 1–4 台 DGX Spark 节点的温度和显存占用，还能顺手调 GPU 频率。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）状态栏插件：分支 / token / 费用 / 额度 / 上下文 / 时延 / 模型 / 轮次，显示项与顺序可在设置里拖拽调整
description.zh: 在输入框上方显示分支、token、费用、额度、上下文、时延、模型和轮次，一眼看清会话状态，显示项还能拖拽排序。

description.en: DSH Desktop / DeepSeek Harness 自选股行情插件：侧栏实时报价 + 分时图 + 柱状图，支持 A股/港股/美股
description.zh: 在侧栏盯盘看自选股，实时报价加分时图和柱状图，A股港股美股都能看。

description.en: Unofficial DeepSeek Harness (DSH) adapter for Stop That Shit: two skills, /sts, and a per-session tool-call contract (deny/ask).
description.zh: 给 DSH 加个行为护栏，用技能、/sts 命令和会话级工具调用契约拦截或询问越界操作。

description.en: Manual context compaction for live direct subagents in DSH Desktop. Command and model tool; tested on Desktop 0.12.1.
description.zh: 给 DSH Desktop 里正在运行的子代理手动压缩上下文，省 token 也省成本。

description.en: Marks the composer of a subagent session in DeepSeek Harness, so you can tell at a glance whether you are typing to a subagent.
description.zh: 在子代理会话的输入框左侧加个标记，一眼就能看出你正在跟子代理对话。

description.en: DSH 插件合集（聚合包）：一次安装把多个独立维护的 DSH 插件装配成一组，单个插件故障不影响其余功能。
description.zh: 一次装齐多个 DSH 插件，各插件独立运行，单个出问题不影响其他功能。

description.en: Connects a local Synthesizer V Studio 2 Pro to the agent through its own Lua script API, with five tools for discovery, a persistent bridge, voice composition, note editing and DAW (VST3/ARA + MIDI) integration. Windows 10/11 only; requires Synthesizer V Studio 2 Pro 2.1.2+ with a project open.
description.zh: 通过 Synthesizer V Studio 2 Pro 自带的 Lua 脚本 API 把它接入 Agent，提供自动发现、常驻桥、演唱创作、音符编辑与 DAW（VST3/ARA + MIDI）集成五个工具。仅 Windows 10/11；需安装 Synthesizer V Studio 2 Pro 2.1.2+ 并打开工程。

description.en: Codex-style desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness: task completion, errors, questions and goals, with configurable events, sound, style, privacy and click-to-focus. Windows & Ubuntu.
description.zh: 任务完成、出错、需要你确认或目标达成时，自动弹出桌面通知和提示音，点一下就能回到窗口。

description.en: The composer predicts what you are about to type. Inline ghost text sits on the caret, measured against the editor's own font and line box, and Tab turns it into real text (Esc ignores it). The prediction is one short call through the session's own model router, seeded with your draft and the last few turns of the conversation, so an empty composer also gets a next-prompt guess written in the user's voice; suggestions that merely restate the assistant are dropped. Host side is one HTTP route with sub-path endpoints (loopback-only, 64 KB body cap, 2-minute result cache, 20-second miss cache, one in-flight call per session); client side is one 0-height overlay registered on conversation.input.overlay, with insertion guarded by the composer's draftRev CAS and a setDraft fallback. IME composition and slash commands are skipped. 16 node:test cases, zero runtime dependencies, real screenshots in docs/.
description.zh: 输入框会预测你接下来要打的字：幽灵文本贴在你的光标后面，字体、行高、字间距都照抄编辑器，按 Tab 变成真正的文字，按 Esc 忽略。预测是走当前会话自己的模型路由的一次短调用，喂进你的草稿和最近几轮对话，所以空输入框时还会预测你的「下一句」，用用户自己的口吻；只是复述助手原话的建议会被丢弃。宿主半边是一条带若干子路径的 HTTP 路由（只收 loopback、64KB 体积上限、结果缓存 2 分钟、空结果缓存 20 秒、每会话同时只有一个在飞请求）；客户端半边是挂在 conversation.input.overlay 上的 0 高度覆盖层，落字带 draftRev 的 CAS 校验，失败退回 setDraft。输入法组字期间与 / 命令不预测。16 个 node:test 用例，零运行时依赖，docs/ 里有真实运行截图。

description.en: DSH 任务完成 / 等待审批时弹窗 + 系统通知，后台也不漏
description.zh: 任务完成或等待审批时自动弹窗加系统通知，切到后台也不会漏掉提醒。

description.en: Tavily web search plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): ctx.web search provider + search/extract/crawl/map/research tools + settings page (API key, quota, audit)
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 接上 Tavily 联网搜索，能搜网页、抓正文、爬站和做深度调研，还能管 API Key 和用量。

description.en: Temporal layered memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): dual timestamps, day recall, corrections, and selective injection.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上带时间感的分层记忆，能记住事情发生的时间，还会把零散经验整理成概念。

description.en: Read-only terminal view tab in the conversation header: aggregates bash output, background jobs and persistent terminal sessions from the current session, subagents and Agent Team teammates into one filterable panel, with type and session-scope filters, command/output search, auto-collapse, follow-scroll and a maximize dialog; foreground bash shows final output only. Requires DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2 or later (0.2.x).
description.zh: 会话头部只读的「终端」视图标签页：把当前会话、子代理与 Agent Team 队友的 bash 输出、后台任务和持久终端会话聚合为一个可筛选面板，支持类型与会话范围筛选、命令与输出搜索、自动收起、跟随滚动与最大化只读弹窗；前台 bash 仅显示终态输出。需 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2 及以上（0.2.x）。

description.en: Optional DSH Web profile bundle with six selectable wallpaper themes, including VIP Golden Radiance styling, palettes, previews, gold accents, glass surfaces, and a licensed display font.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 配置加六套可选壁纸主题，含 VIP 金色风格、配色预览和玻璃质感界面。

description.en: 思考路径留存与复用：跨会话记录 AI 的路线、决策和教训
description.zh: 跨会话记录 AI 的思考路线、决策和教训，方便回看和复用，少走弯路。

description.en: Per-call token meter for the DSH composer: a colour-coded pill under the input and a dashboard above it showing every model call (total versus billable input+output), sub-agent spend, tool overhead and cache-versus-fresh input, read only from local session logs.
description.zh: 输入框下方的彩色 token 胶囊与上方展开面板：逐次调用的双图（总消耗 / 可计费）、子代理开销、工具归因与缓存拆分，只读本机会话日志。

description.en: Token usage workbench for DeepSeek Harness: call-level detail, peak/off-peak pricing, composer readout + settings dashboard (7/30d trends, 6-month heatmap)
description.zh: 把会话里的 token 用量整理成明细账，看调用级花费、峰谷价和趋势热力图，方便控成本。

description.en: 把一批已注册工具折叠成一个查询工具：需要时展开直调，或交给聚合组代执行。Fold registered tools out of the model-visible surface and reveal or proxy them on demand.
description.zh: 把一堆已注册工具折叠成一个查询工具，需要时再展开直调或交给聚合组代执行，省下模型工具列表的占用。

description.en: 给 DSH 的 /goal 加轮数：/goal 3 整理文档 表示最多自动跑 3 轮，用完自动标为 blocked（round-limit），不会多跑一轮。
description.zh: 给 /goal 加上轮数上限，比如 /goal 3 整理文档，最多跑 3 轮就自动停，省心又省额度。

description.en: Adds a single “Restart DeepSeek Harness” item to the Windows system tray menu of the DSH desktop app by patching the installed app.asar in place and re-applying that patch after each desktop update; it needs a writable DSH installation directory and adds no other tray actions.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面端的 Windows 系统托盘菜单中只增加一个“重启 DeepSeek Harness”项，做法是原位修改已安装的 app.asar 并在桌面端每次更新后重打补丁；需要 DSH 安装目录可写，不添加其他托盘操作。

description.en: Short model-generated recap under every completed turn in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, plus an on-demand /recap command.
description.zh: 每轮对话结束后自动生成简短回顾，还能随时用 /recap 命令重新总结，方便快速回顾上下文。

description.en: Federated plugin registry aggregator for DeepSeek Harness — combine npm, GitHub, and JSON catalogs into one searchable index.
description.zh: 把 npm、GitHub 和 JSON 插件源聚合成一个可搜索的索引，让你在一个界面里找插件、装插件。

description.en: Calm monochrome UI with lavender accents, startup and switching motion, a thinking workspace, scoped skills, and optional local voice and pet connections.
description.zh: 黑白灰淡紫界面、启动与切换动效、可纠正的思考工作台、按需技能，以及可选的本机语音与桌宠接入。

description.en: Sync DSH user-level assets (skills, plugin manifest, config, memory) across machines with one-click restore, automatic plugin reinstall and secret scanning.
description.zh: DSH 用户级配置同步：技能、插件清单、配置与记忆跨机同步，换机一键恢复、缺插件自动装回、敏感文件硬拒绝。

description.en: Sign in to AI coding plans that have no API key — Claude Pro/Max/Team, ChatGPT Plus/Pro, Copilot, SuperGrok — from the dsh settings UI.
description.zh: 没有 API Key 也能登录 Claude、ChatGPT、Copilot 等 AI 编程套餐，直接在 dsh 设置里完成授权。

description.en: Video studio for DeepSeek Harness on Android: storyboard editing, multi-provider image/video generation with automatic failover, FFmpeg MP4 export, prompt optimization, and a mobile-first workbench.
description.zh: 安卓上的 DSH 视频工作台：分镜编辑、多供应商图像/视频生成与自动切换、FFmpeg 合成 MP4、提示词优化、手机窄屏工作台。

description.en: Dictation that ends up in the repository instead of the chat log: hold the button (or import a WAV), and the plugin archives voice-memos/<id>/ with audio.wav, a rendered waveform.png, memo.md (frontmatter, per-segment timestamps, ready-to-paste quote blocks) and meta.json. Audio is resampled to 16 kHz mono in the browser before it is sent. Transcription stays local — the harness speechToText service with silence-split windows, or a command worker such as faster-whisper — and when no engine is available the memo is still filed with an explicit status and reason rather than a fabricated transcript. Ships a conversation-view 口述 tab with click-to-seek playback and per-segment quote copy, three agent tools (voice_memo_save / voice_memo_list / voice_memo_read) and HTTP routes. Zero runtime dependencies, 52 node:test cases, real screenshots in docs/.
description.zh: 把口述变成仓库里的归档，而不是聊天里一闪而过的转写：按住说话（或导入 WAV）后，插件把 audio.wav、渲染好的 waveform.png、memo.md（frontmatter、逐段时码、可直接粘贴的引用块）与 meta.json 落到 voice-memos/<id>/。音频先在浏览器里重采样成 16 kHz 单声道再上传。转写全部本地完成——DSH 的 speechToText 服务（静音切窗补时间戳）或 faster-whisper 这类命令 worker；没有可用引擎时仍然归档，并写明状态与原因，绝不编造文本。带会话视图的「口述」Tab：点波形定位播放、逐段复制引用；另有三个 agent 工具（voice_memo_save / voice_memo_list / voice_memo_read）与 HTTP 路由。零运行时依赖，52 个 node:test 用例，docs/ 里有真实运行截图。

description.en: Transcribe local audio and video files offline with a composer panel, a CLI, and an agent skill, powered by SenseVoice int8.
description.zh: 在输入框面板、命令行与 agent 技能里离线转写本地音视频文件，引擎为 SenseVoice int8。

description.en: Photo wallpaper for the DSH Web UI, with local image uploads and live mask, blur, saturation and panel translucency controls.
description.zh: DSH Web 图片壁纸插件：本地上传图片，实时调节遮罩、模糊、饱和度与面板透明度。

description.en: DSH 动态壁纸皮肤插件（大肥鱼版）：mp4/webm 视频或 jpg/png/gif 图片作为 DeepSeek Harness 背景，设置页集成、原生文件选择、遮罩/亮度/底调调节、热切换不重启。（旧仓库，请使用 dsh-wallpaper-fish）
description.zh: 把 DSH 背景换成静音循环视频或图片，设置里即改即生效，不用重启。

description.en: Web search and page fetching for DeepSeek Harness agents, rendered through Microsoft Edge, with a per-conversation web-search switch in the composer tool row.
description.zh: 给 Harness 智能体加上联网搜索和网页抓取，用 Edge 渲染真实页面，输入框里还能按会话开关联网。

description.en: Ordered web-search failover provider for DeepSeek Harness: try backends in priority order, fall back automatically.
description.zh: 多个搜索后端按优先级自动切换，前一个挂了就换下一个，保证搜索不断线。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的网页搜索插件：把 web_search 接到 OpenCode Go 订阅，10 个实测模型自动兜底；web_fetch 仍走内置 HTTP 抓取。
description.zh: 把 DSH 的网页搜索接到 OpenCode Go 订阅，10 个实测模型自动兜底，抓网页仍走内置 HTTP。

description.en: 把 OpenCode 作为 DeepSeek Harness 的网页搜索提供方：经 OpenCode 的 Anthropic 兼容 Messages 接口调用 DeepSeek 的服务端 web_search，并自带设置页。
description.zh: 把 OpenCode 接成 dsh 的网页搜索源，让模型直接调用 DeepSeek 官方服务端搜索，还能在设置里调参。

description.en: Enhanced persistent web search plugin for DeepSeek Harness, adapted to dsh 0.2.1-rc.2 (fork of anweat/dsh-web-search-pro)
description.zh: 把多引擎网页搜索、缓存和抓取打包成两个工具，让模型随时联网查资料。

description.en: Keep the dsh-webchat guest overlay glued to its panel with CSS anchor positioning, so fullscreen and window toggles cannot leave stale geometry.
description.zh: 用 CSS 锚点定位把 webchat 浮层牢牢固定在面板上，全屏或窗口切换后不再错位。

description.en: Extract short-video scripts and captions from Douyin, Bilibili, Kuaishou and YouTube, including titles, authors, hashtags and engagement data, through a bundled Python extractor.
description.zh: 提取抖音、B站、快手与 YouTube 短视频的文案与字幕，并带标题、作者、话题与互动数据；抽取器以 Python 随包提供。

description.en: 小鲸鱼双模式 DSH 插件：web 页面 overlay + desktop Electron 桌宠（display 控制）
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一只小鲸鱼：网页上浮层显示，桌面端变 Electron 桌宠，可切换显示模式。

description.en: Adds a writing console above the composer with four style tiers (T1-T4) and five rigor tiers (L1-L5), selectable by hand or left to automatic choice; keeps project terminology and banned phrasing in .mem/config.md with a read-only human section; and provides a whale_polish tool that rewrites expression without changing facts.
description.zh: 在输入框上方增加写作控制台：四种风格档（T1–T4）与五种严谨档（L1–L5）可手动选择或自动判断；把术语、禁用写法等记入 .mem/config.md（人工区只读）；并提供只改表达、不改事实的 whale_polish 润色工具。

description.en: Windows desktop control for DeepSeek Harness agents: window and UI Automation automation, local Windows OCR, direct browser reads over the Chrome DevTools Protocol (DOM text, JavaScript, selector clicks), humanised mouse and keyboard input, browser tab management, and a live control panel. It probes the machine on first run, writes its own config, and degrades gracefully when a capability is missing. Windows 10/11 only.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 智能体用的 Windows 桌面控制：窗口与 UI Automation 自动化、本地 Windows OCR、通过 Chrome DevTools Protocol 直读浏览器 DOM 并执行 JS、拟人化鼠标键盘、浏览器标签页管理，以及一个实时控制面板。首次启动自动探测本机能力并写入配置，缺失的能力自动降级而非报错。仅支持 Windows 10/11。

description.en: DSH 插件：把任务派给本机豆包 / WorkBuddy / ZCode / Qoder，用任务板与产物锁组织一支有纪律的 AI 班组。
description.zh: 把任务派给本机的豆包、WorkBuddy 等 AI，用任务板和产物锁组织一支有纪律的 AI 班组。

description.en: Boss-view work team for DSH: role-based teammates, per-role models, and a live office in the sidebar.
description.zh: 把 DSH 主对话变成老板办公室，拆活派活验收，员工在侧边栏实时上班。

description.en: DSH 插件：把 WorkBuddy 的专家/专家团做成可召唤目录，内置「全域智囊团」离线固化包（16 agents / 15 skills），叠加官方 448 条与在线市场 28k+
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 的专家和专家团做成可召唤目录，内置离线智囊团，对话里随叫随用。

description.en: DSH plugin: running-session dot on collapsed workspace rows
description.zh: 工作区折叠后也能一眼看到里面还有几个会话在跑，侧栏状态不再被藏起来。

description.en: A safe, bounded, read-only perception layer for AI agents to observe administrator-defined JSON APIs.
description.zh: 让 AI 助手安全只读地查看管理员指定的 JSON API，获得受限的"现实感知"能力。

description.en: Puts a WuwaTappo desktop pet's bubbles to work: shows the DeepSeek balance, today's spend and a per-turn cost bubble, and keeps an amber reminder bubble up while the agent waits for an answer or an approval. Talks to the pet over CDP, enabling its debug port with a one-time, revertible byte patch.
description.zh: 把 WuwaTappo 桌宠头顶的气泡用起来：显示 DeepSeek 余额、今日已用与每轮消耗，Agent 等待回答或授权时挂一个琥珀色常驻提醒气泡。通过 CDP 与桌宠通信，首次使用会给 WuwaTappo.exe 打一个可还原的等长字节补丁来开启调试端口。

description.en: 中国象棋插件：在 DeepSeek Harness 对话中与 AI 对弈，支持走棋动画、悔棋及按会话保存。
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话里跟 AI 下一盘中国象棋，你走红方点棋盘落子，模型执黑应招，支持走棋动画、悔棋和按会话保存。

description.en: Turns a YouTube link into study notes: pulls the captions the video already publishes, optionally reads on-screen content with a vision model, then asks for your own notes and merges everything into one document. Requires python3, ffmpeg and yt-dlp on PATH (the skill stops with an install hint when they are missing).
description.zh: 把 YouTube 链接变成学习笔记：先取视频自带字幕，可选让视觉模型读画面，再问你自己的笔记，最后合并成一份文档。需 PATH 上有 python3、ffmpeg 与 yt-dlp（缺失时技能会停下来并给出安装提示）。

description.en: Yushu (鱼书) — QQ channel for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 把 QQ 群聊接进 DSH，消息、图片、表情、人设和记忆都能来回传，官方 QQBot 和个人 QQ 都支持。

description.en: Read-only four-column attention board for DeepSeek Harness, with a true always-on-top Windows companion window.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话折成四栏看板，一眼看清现在有没有事需要你，还带 Windows 置顶小窗。

description.en: Fake-IP-aware web.fetch provider for TUN (Mihomo/Clash) DNS environments plus pinned LAN CIDR access
description.zh: 让 TUN 模式下用 Fake-IP 的 Clash/Mihomo 环境也能正常联网抓取，并支持固定局域网网段直连。

description.en: Personal workspace managed by DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把个人 GitHub 仓库变成由 DeepSeek Harness 打理的可安装工作区，装好就能用。

description.en: Configurable, provider-agnostic image generation: mounts the bundled MCP server behind an NDJSON bridge as mcp__image_generation__image_generate and mcp__image_generation__image_config_status, and registers the bundled image-generation skill. Needs baseUrl and apiKey; without them the MCP server mounts nothing.
description.zh: 可配置、与供应商无关的图片生成:把随插件分发的 MCP 服务器挂在 NDJSON 桥后面,提供 mcp__image_generation__image_generate 与 mcp__image_generation__image_config_status,并注册 image-generation 技能。需要配置 baseUrl 与 apiKey，否则 MCP 服务器不会挂载。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for LawStar MCP (legal-data): one-click API Key connect
description.zh: 粘贴法律之星 API Key，就能在对话里查法规、调法条原文、识别引用并做幻觉校验。

description.en: 检测主人的活跃度并适时发起互动
description.zh: 检测主人是否在线活跃，适时主动发起互动，让 Luna 不再干等着。

description.en: Apple Vision OCR for DeepSeek Harness — read scans, screenshots and PDFs on-device and hand the text (with coordinates) to the model
description.zh: 在 Mac 上本地识别截图、扫描件和 PDF 里的文字，连坐标一起交给模型，省去手动复制。

description.en: Text-to-image through a StepFun-compatible endpoint: mounts a no-npm-dependency Python MCP server behind an NDJSON bridge as mcp__simple_image__simple_image and returns the generated image URLs. Needs Python 3.8+ on PATH and STEP_API_KEY.
description.zh: 通过 StepFun 兼容接口文生图:把无 npm 依赖的 Python MCP 服务器挂在 NDJSON 桥后面,用 mcp__simple_image__simple_image 生成并返回图片 URL。需 PATH 上有 Python 3.8+ 并设置 STEP_API_KEY。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to MCP Bids public US federal opportunities and connected TED notices, with source-linked document tools and personal API-key authentication.
description.zh: 使用个人 API 密钥，将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 MCP Bids 的美国联邦公开采购机会、TED 公告和来源文件工具。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to MCPTender public Russian procurement records, source documents and published contract suppliers using a personal service API key.
description.zh: 使用个人服务 API 密钥，将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 MCPTender 的俄罗斯公开采购记录、来源文件及已公布合同供应商。

description.en: Medical-device global regulatory compliance skill hub (Agent Skills): NMPA/FDA/MDR/PMDA pathways & classification, UDI/STED/clinical, CLI + MCP + DSH plugin. 医械全球注册合规技能聚合包（20 枢纽+48 实例实测+CLI+MCP+DSH 插件）
description.zh: 把 NMPA、FDA、MDR、PMDA 等全球医械注册法规和申报模板整理成可直达官方源的技能包，查合规资料不用到处翻。

description.en: MIngC: a prompt-only DSH agent preset that compiles ideas into precise, verifiable, paste-ready prompts and specs.
description.zh: 把还没想清楚的想法整理成精确、可验证、能直接粘贴的提示词和需求规格，只出规格不动手。

description.en: 网易云音乐 AI 插件（DSH）：播放器 + 曲库 + 口味画像 / 听歌周报 / 场景歌单 / 歌词二创
description.zh: 在 DSH 里听网易云音乐，还能生成场景歌单、口味画像、听歌周报和歌词二创。

description.en: Windows NapCat deployment guide and read-only loopback port checks for DSH, with a user-initiated administrator launcher.
description.zh: Windows NapCat部署指南与本机端口只读检查，附用户手动运行的管理员启动入口。

description.en: Notification plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): approvals, questions, long tasks, errors and completions
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的桌面通知插件，审批、提问、长任务、报错和完成时都会弹提醒，不用一直盯着屏幕。

description.en: Image generation through TokenRhythm: mounts a no-npm-dependency Python stdio MCP server as mcp__tokenrhythm_image__generate_image, producing images with qwen-image-2.0 or wan2.7-image and saving them to a directory you choose. Needs Python 3.8+ on PATH and TOKENRHYTHM_API_KEY.
description.zh: 用 TokenRhythm 生成图片:把无 npm 依赖的 Python stdio MCP 服务器挂成 mcp__tokenrhythm_image__generate_image,用 qwen-image-2.0 或 wan2.7-image 生成并存到你指定的目录。需 PATH 上有 Python 3.8+ 并设置 TOKENRHYTHM_API_KEY。

description.en: Plugin for DSH/Pi: compose PICO-8-flavoured loops or arranged songs as JSON, render deterministic 44.1 kHz stereo WAV. No PICO-8, ffmpeg or sox needed.
description.zh: 用 JSON 写 PICO-8 风格循环或编曲，直接渲染成 44.1kHz 立体声 WAV，不用装 PICO-8、ffmpeg 或 sox。

description.en: Original Qiaomu Audio UI, speech, dictation and media export for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把原版乔木语音的朗读、听写和音视频导出搬进 DeepSeek Harness，声音选择和播放控制都原样保留。

description.en: Switches between local and remote DSH workspaces and sessions, with optional plugin sync; requires your own relay server.
description.zh: 在本机与远程 DSH 工作区和会话间切换，并支持插件同步；需要自备中继服务器。

description.en: 本地优先的多项目任务看板：需求拆解 → 看板派发 → agent 真跑 → 证据回流 → 人工验收
description.zh: 本地优先的多项目任务看板，把需求拆解、派发给 agent 真跑、证据回流到人工验收全串起来。

description.en: Trae CN as a native DeepSeek Harness LLM provider: browser OAuth login by default, an opt-in local-install credential source, and an OpenAI-compatible surface on the host web server.
description.zh: 把 Trae CN 接进 DSH 当原生模型用，浏览器登录即可，还能开个 OpenAI 兼容接口给别的客户端。

description.en: Provides three skills for the Let's Build Robots SO-101 course: yanshifu reads the learner's project files to assess progress and suggest next steps; ask answers questions using four bundled guides; update checks for and installs updates to those guides.
description.zh: 为《一起手搓机器人》SO-101 课程提供三个技能：yanshifu 读取学员的项目文件，判断进度并建议下一步；ask 根据四份配套资料回答问题；update 检查并更新本地配套资料。

description.en: Orihime golden-hour skin for DeepSeek Harness: a two-layer illustrated backdrop with a sidebar workshop for composition and sharpness, amber message bubbles and a cream letter-paper composer.
description.zh: 井上织姬主题的暖金皮肤：两层插画背景、可调构图与清晰度的侧栏工作台、琥珀色消息气泡与奶油信纸输入框。

description.en: dshBrutalDelete permanently deletes DSH sessions from disk — single-row or cross-workspace bulk delete, with Ctrl+A select-all and Delete shortcut, wiping transcripts, projection cache, workspace slots, attachments and subagent data. Irreversible.
description.zh: dsh暴力删除：永久删除 DSH 会话的磁盘数据——单条删除或跨工作区批量删除，支持 Ctrl+A 全选与 Delete 快捷删除，彻底清理对话记录、投影缓存、工作区归属、附件与子会话，不可恢复。

description.en: Turns attached files into versioned evidence: `search_documents` builds a private local index (SQLite FTS5 after a startup capability probe, dependency-free JS fallback otherwise) and returns compact evidence blocks carrying an exact coordinate — PDF page, PPTX slide, text/DOCX line range, or quoted XLSX `Sheet!Range` — which `read_document` expands only while the content version still matches. Contiguous CJK runs are indexed as overlapping bigrams and queried as phrases, so word order is preserved; uploaded raster images take the native vision attachment path instead.
description.zh: 把上传的文件变成可追溯的证据，自动建本地索引，支持全文搜索和版本管理。

description.en: 在 DSH 里管理 AGENTS.md：可在会话标签行编辑当前项目规则，设置页编辑全局规则
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接查看和编辑 AGENTS.md，会话标签行改项目规则，设置页管全局规则，Ctrl+S 保存。

description.en: Custom industry AI employees, teams, workflows and professional memory for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), with a software development team included. Native context reuse separates stable definitions from dynamic knowledge to support server-side prefix caching. 自定义行业员工、团队、工作流与专业记忆；遵循 DSH 原生上下文机制，分离稳定定义和动态知识，促进服务端前缀缓存复用。
description.zh: 在 DSH 里组装专属 AI 员工和团队，按岗位配能力、记忆和工作流，还自带一支软件开发团队。

description.en: Enlarges the DSH web settings dialog (default 1180x920, 20px steps, remembered per browser) and adds an Advanced Settings page that resizes it and hosts Host operations: restart dsh with a 3-second delay and a busy confirmation, restart once all sessions have been idle for 10s (cancellable, repeat clicks idempotent), last start time with uptime, and a dsh version/update check that compares npm dist-tags across selectable channels without upgrading. The same bundle replaces the sidebar brand area with a machine name, adds a read-only provider, model and thinking-level cell beside the composer stats pills, and a switch that registers or unregisters the three dsh_restart_* agent tools at runtime. Zero dependencies, no build step; all routes sit behind the connection trust fence.
description.zh: 放大 DSH Web 设置弹窗（默认 1180×920，20px 一档，只记本浏览器），并新增「设置 → 高级设置」页：同一页调尺寸，也收进 Host 运维——延迟 3 秒重启 dsh（忙时二次确认）、所有会话空闲 10 秒后自动重启（可取消、重复点击幂等）、最后启动时间与已运行时长，以及按所选 npm dist-tag 通道比较的 dsh 版本/更新提示（只提示、不代升级）。同一插件还用机器名字顶替侧栏品牌区、在输入框下方「性能与用量」行旁加一格只读的「供应商 · 模型 · 思考档位」，并提供一个即时注册/注销三个 dsh_restart_* 模型工具的开关。零依赖、无构建；所有路由都过官方信任围栏。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance, usage, and pricing details in the DSH sidebar.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏直接查看 DeepSeek 账户余额、今日花费和 Tokens 用量，还能了解当前收费标准。

description.en: DSH plugin: keeps the workspace you last messaged at the top of the workspace list. 把最近发过消息的工作区自动排到最前面。
description.zh: 最近发过消息的工作区会自动排到列表最前面，顺序还会持久保存，重启后依然有效。

description.en: Pre-publish adversarial dry run for DSH deliverables - stress-test your file, copy, or script before you ship it.
description.zh: 发出去之前先让 AI 扮成领导、客户、杠精轮番挑刺，把可能被开火的地方提前找出来。

description.en: DSH 第三方 bundle：顾问模式 —— 主模型在决策点调用 consult_advisor，由第二个（更强的）模型读完整会话，返回 verdict / guidance / risks。Advisor Mode for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 主模型遇到关键决策时自动找更强的第二模型把把关，给出结论、建议和风险提示。

description.en: Jev-guided dispatch advice for DeepSeek Harness: before each turn, Jev judges whether to delegate and to which registered agent. Advice only — jev-optional, fail-open, keychain-first.
description.zh: 每轮对话前先帮你判断该不该派活、派给哪个智能体，只给建议不强制，失败也不影响使用。

description.en: DSH pre-execute gate: ask before a tool call leaks a credential, stops a service, or rewrites host network/registry state.
description.zh: 工具执行前先拦一道：遇到泄露密钥、停服务、改网络或注册表的危险操作，先问你一句再动手。

description.en: Persona plugin: a slowly moving 0-100 emotion meter, its own worldview, a per-turn diary, a relationship network, proactive messages, and an inner-voice line beside the cost row.
description.zh: 人格插件：随对话缓慢变化的情感值、独立世界观、每轮日记、关系网、主动找你说话，以及费用行右侧的一句心里话。

description.en: Model selection, model switching, and real nested manager/worker teams for DeepSeek Harness Agent Teams.
description.zh: 给 Agent Teams 加模型选择和切换，还能搭出真正的嵌套经理/工人多智能体团队。

description.en: Per-agent tool filter for the main agent (orchestrator) in DeepSeek Harness — minimal toolset for the orchestrator, full toolset for subagents, plus a user-approved elevated permissions bridge for subagents.
description.zh: 给主 Agent 只留必要工具，子 Agent 用全套工具，省 token 又少干扰。

description.en: Adds a Settings → General row that opens ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md in the system editor, so the instruction file can be opened without hunting for it. On Windows it launches Notepad and raises the window.
description.zh: 在「设置 → 通用」里增加一行，用系统编辑器打开 ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md，不必再去文件管理器里翻这个指令文件；Windows 上直接拉起记事本并把窗口提到前台。

description.en: AOCI-CODE cognition layer for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): one-shot /aoci <path>  gives agents governed, Git-versioned repository/database cognition via a dynamic MCP bridge (aoci_rules/overview/maintain), with auto-maintenance and compaction-contract recovery. MIT; AOCI-CODE binary not bundled.
description.zh: 一条 /aoci 命令就能让 AI 读懂你的代码仓库和数据库，还能用 Git 管好这些认知。

description.en: 真实壁纸 + 内置壁纸 + 启动开场动画，给 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 换皮。Wallpaper, built-in wallpapers and boot intro for the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web UI 换上真实壁纸和内置壁纸，还能加启动开场动画，界面更好看。

description.en: dsh plugin: unattended approval gate — bounded answer window for subagent/scheduled/cron approvals, fail-closed default instead of hanging (per origin or per session)
description.zh: 给无人值守的审批请求加个限时应答窗口，没人答就按默认裁决，不再无限挂起。

description.en: DSH Web 插件：自动展开 Chat 里折叠的「思考」块，任务跑到哪一步、模型在想什么，当场可见（无需手点）
description.zh: 自动展开 Chat 里折叠的思考块，模型推理过程当场可见，不用再手点。
给 DeepSeek Harness 智能体加一个自动研究工具，按指标驱动、有边界地自主完成调研任务。

description.en: Replace the DSH solid background with a local image, with a draggable editor for fit, blur, veil and interface opacity.
description.zh: 用本地图片替换 DSH 的纯色背景，并提供可拖动面板来调整铺满方式、模糊、遮罩和界面不透明度。

description.en: Bailian (DashScope / Model Studio) model catalog in the DSH settings page: lists every model the configured API key can reach, groups them by model family, probes whether a model is actually callable (an unopened model answers 403, which DSH reports as an invalid key), refuses to add models that fail the probe, and shows the active session's context window and remaining budget. An sk- key has no balance endpoint, so quota here means context quota.
description.zh: DSH 设置页里的百炼（DashScope / Model Studio）模型目录：列出当前 API Key 可用的全部模型、按模型家族分组，可探测某模型是否真的可调用（未开通会返回 403，而 DSH 会把它显示成密钥无效），探测不通过的模型拒绝加入配置，并显示当前会话的上下文窗口与剩余额度。百炼 sk- Key 没有余额接口，因此这里的额度指上下文额度。

description.en: DSH plugin extracted from dsh-ops: publishes ops_bash over a resolved bash with the host sandbox, spill and job semantics.
description.zh: 把 ops_bash 封装成带沙箱、审批、输出溢出和后台任务语义的 shell 工具，让命令执行更安全可控。
一组日常高频的 DSH 体验插件，让消息可编辑、使用更顺手更自由。

description.en: 在 DSH 侧边栏看 B 站：支持推荐流、1080P、弹幕、扫码登录与历史同步。不消耗 Token。
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏直接刷 B 站，推荐流、1080P、弹幕、扫码登录全都有，还不耗 Token。

description.en: DSH 插件：右下角纯文字计费牌，特色是实时估算本轮花费（订阅输出流按字符折 token）
description.zh: 在右下角显示纯文字计费牌，实时估算本轮对话花了多少钱，订阅输出流按字符折算 token。

description.en: Customizable startup animation for DeepSeek Harness with eight bundled clips, random rotation, tail fade and time-of-day greetings. Based on lxj5820/dsh-boot-animation, so do not install it with the upstream plugin; bundled clips and the welcome voice carry their own media terms.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 启动动画定制版，内置 8 段短片，随机轮播、片尾淡入，还有分时段问候。基于 lxj5820/dsh-boot-animation 定制，不可与上游插件同装；随包短片与欢迎音按各自媒体授权。

description.en: DSH 插件：局域网手机扫码拍照/选图，手动确认后直接发进当前对话（多图一条消息，不自动发送）。LAN phone camera → DSH chat, manual review & send.
description.zh: 电脑上打开对话，手机扫码就能拍照或选图，确认后直接发进当前对话，模型马上能看图回答。

description.en: DSH-IM 陪伴聊天 Agent 预设：鲸鱼娘 · 小汐。短句、活泼、傲娇甜；私聊黏人、群聊收着点；fail-closed 只认主人，名字/称呼/甜度/长度可配置。
description.zh: 给 DSH 加个鲸鱼娘「小汐」陪聊预设，短句傲娇甜，私聊黏人群聊收敛，只认主人。

description.en: Bilingual DeepSeek Harness changelog, security-advisory and storage panel — version timeline, CVE/GHSA records and disk usage in one sidebar panel.
description.zh: 在侧边栏集中查看版本更新记录、安全漏洞公告和磁盘占用，中英双语一目了然。

description.en: Adds a Claude Pro/Max OAuth provider with multiple accounts, optional account failover, cached quota reporting, live model catalogs, and quota UI in settings and conversations. Uses the Claude Code client identity; quota reporting uses an experimental endpoint.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 接入 Claude Pro/Max 订阅，支持多账号、可选故障切换、额度缓存、在线模型目录，以及设置页和会话额度入口。请求使用 Claude Code 客户端身份，额度查询使用实验性接口。

description.en: Compact the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: Plugins / Automations / More become one row, and New Session becomes an icon in the brand row.
description.zh: 把侧边栏的插件、自动化、更多收成一行，新建会话也变成品牌行里的图标，界面更紧凑清爽。

description.en: Adds a Polish button to the composer tool row right of the permission control: it reads the draft you have already typed, has the current model infer your intent and rewrite the draft into a clearer prompt, then turns the button into Cancel so one click restores the exact pre-polish text.
description.zh: 在对话框工具行「权限」按钮右侧加一个「润色」按钮：读取输入框里已写好的草稿，先让当前模型推断你的意图再改写成更清晰的提示词，润色完成后按钮变为「取消」，一键回退到润色前的原文。

description.en: Computer use for DeepSeek Harness: js and js_reset tools that read windows, click, type, and screenshot macOS apps through the locally installed ChatGPT app. Apple Silicon macOS only; requires the ChatGPT desktop app.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 computer use：js 与 js_reset 工具通过本机安装的 ChatGPT 应用读取窗口、点击、输入与截屏（macOS）。仅 Apple Silicon macOS，需已装 ChatGPT 桌面版。

description.en: Session-scoped context window switcher for the DeepSeek Harness model picker — 在模型弹窗内按会话临时切换上下文窗口，新会话自动恢复默认（dsh-context-window-picker 的延续维护版）
description.zh: 在模型选择弹窗里给当前会话临时换个上下文窗口大小，新建会话自动恢复默认，不用改全局配置。

description.en: Zero-token contract check for DSH plugins — verifies output.render() / session-event vocabulary, warn-only. 无耗检查：DSH 插件契约体检，零 token 成本，只告警不拦截。
description.zh: 零成本体检已装 DSH 插件，揪出违反内核契约的写法，只告警不拦截。

description.en: DSH Web UI plugin: copy assistant Markdown or download a styled PNG image.
description.zh: 在助手消息旁加个下载按钮，一键把回复渲染成适合分享的 PNG 图片。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件（测试版）：给每张 .md 文件卡片加「复制」按钮，一键把全文写进剪贴板
description.zh: 给每张 .md 文件卡片加个复制按钮，点一下全文就进剪贴板，省得手动选中复制。

description.en: Reasoning translation for the DSH Web UI: template HTTP translation sites, or a model route through a Harness-registered provider or a custom OpenAI-compatible provider declared in the plugin.
description.zh: 把展开的思考内容翻成界面语言：翻译来源可以是任意 HTTP 站点模板，也可以是模型（DSH 已注册提供商，或插件自带的自定义 OpenAI 兼容提供商）。

description.en: Count-up Pomodoro: focus counts up with no ceiling and never stops itself at 25 minutes, finishing drops straight into a short break, and a status board plus the four quadrants keep the task list in view.
description.zh: 正计时番茄钟：专注时段不设上限，不会在 25 分钟自动停止，结束即进入短休息；附带状态看板与四象限任务管理。

description.en: Scheduled daily credit check-in for Trae CN, WorkBuddy, Qoder and MiniMax Code with per-platform toggles and history. Currently verified on macOS with DSH Desktop 0.12.1.
description.zh: 每天定时为 Trae CN、WorkBuddy、Qoder、MiniMax Code 领取每日积分，支持平台开关与签到记录。目前在 macOS 的 DSH Desktop 0.12.1 上验证。

description.en: Bounded cron & interval scheduling for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — every task bound to exactly one session (creator or a dedicated new one), never global. Complements dsh-schedule with real cron expressions.
description.zh: 用 cron 表达式或固定间隔定时给 AI 智能体派活，让任务按计划自动执行。

description.en: Optional Decision API tool discovery and search-source prefetch, with per-session controls and ordinary-discovery fallback.
description.zh: 可选 Decision API 工具预发现与搜索来源预读，支持会话开关和普通按需发现回退。

description.en: DeepSeek 开放平台账单用量面板（DSH 插件）：按模型/计费类型/API Key 的每日 tokens 与费用，含分时明细
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页直接查看 DeepSeek 开放平台的每日 tokens 和真实费用，按模型、计费类型、API Key 拆分，还能看某天的分时明细。

description.en: 网页端ds接入dsh
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面端左侧工作区上方加一个按钮，一键打开 DeepSeek 网页版，边用边干活。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Desktop plugin: remembers the main window's size, position and maximized state and restores it before the first frame.
description.zh: 记住桌面主窗口的大小、位置和最大化状态，下次启动时自动还原，不用每次重新调整。

description.en: Gives the agent 14 tools to create and edit DingTalk Yida apps (apps, forms, pages, schema, data) through the OpenYida CLI, plus a right-sidebar workbench that opens them in the built-in browser.
description.zh: 通过 OpenYida CLI 给 Agent 14 个创建、修改钉钉宜搭应用（应用、表单、页面、Schema、数据）的工具，并在右侧栏工作台里用内置浏览器打开查看。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：Devin 登录 + Devin 版 web_search / code_search。零运行时依赖、零 @deepseek-ai import、无版本闸门，DSH 升级不再整行消失。
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上 Devin 登录和 Devin 版网页搜索、代码搜索，零依赖，升级不失效。

description.en: Export diagram-design HTML diagrams to SVG/PNG, extract draw.io/Mermaid/Excalidraw structure, validate output, and browse 45 diagram types. Built on cathrynlavery/diagram-design (MIT); needs python3, and PNG export additionally needs Playwright.
description.zh: 将 diagram-design 图表导出为 SVG/PNG，提取 draw.io/Mermaid/Excalidraw 结构，校验输出，并浏览 45 种图表类型。基于 cathrynlavery/diagram-design（MIT），需 python3，导出 PNG 还需 Playwright。

description.en: Marks paragraphs or a single code line in an answer and asks the model about it in a docked right-hand column, leaving the conversation itself unmodified.
description.zh: 点选回答中的段落或某一行代码，在右侧独立栏里向模型提问；左侧对话内容不被修改。

description.en: GarbageMaster —— DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web 界面里的磁盘清理控制台：扫描 → 风险分级解释 → 勾选 → 二次确认后执行，带审计与计划预览。WIP / Linux only；仓库主要用于在 Windows 环境下取代码调试，暂无可用版本。
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页里扫出磁盘垃圾，按风险分级解释，勾选确认后再清理，还能留审计记录。

description.en: Review DeepSeek Harness responses with inline annotations, document reading, comment threads, and text revisions, then bring a reading summary back to the main conversation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的模型回复添加多处批注、文档阅读、评论线程和正文修订，并将阅读摘要带回主对话。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 文档与 LikeC4 架构治理插件：Docsify Wiki、C4 校验/构建、ADR、审计与 CIDI 管线
description.zh: 自动维护 Docsify 文档站、校验 LikeC4 架构图，还能查坏链、生成 ADR，让项目文档和架构不再散乱。

description.en: Use ChatGPT Dots in a full-width DSH page with Desktop startup preload and page retention across panel switches within the same DSH session, Chinese/English theme-aware controls, reload and external-browser fallback; includes a separately applied login-persistence companion for Windows DSH 0.2.1-rc.3. After upgrading to DSH 0.2.1-rc.5, the embedded Dots page may require signing in again after restarting DSH. The current host browser does not provide login persistence across restarts, and a host upgrade may overwrite the earlier additional persistence treatment; this Dots update did not remove login-saving functionality.
description.zh: 在 DSH 全幅页面使用 ChatGPT Dots，支持 Desktop 启动预加载与同次运行内的页面切换保留、中英文主题工具栏、刷新及外部浏览器回退，并提供需单独应用、适用于 Windows DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 的登录态持久化配套工具。升级至DSH 0.2.1-rc.5后，Dots内嵌页面可能需要在重新启动DSH后再次登录。当前宿主浏览器不提供跨重启登录态保存，原有额外持久化处理也可能在宿主升级时被覆盖；这不是Dots此次更新移除了登录保存功能。

description.en: DSH 插件：把抖音私信接进 DSH —— 私信进 DSH 会话，AI 用工具刷视频、分享、聊天（含图片/表情收发）。仅供学习研究。
description.zh: 把抖音私信接进 DSH，AI 能读消息、刷视频、分享并自动回复，支持图片表情。

description.en: 嘉立创EDA专业版（.epro2/.epru）工程解析与电路/PCB 审查技能（DSH Skill Bundle）：权威网表重建、引脚与封装核对、PCB 几何检查、版本增量审查。只读、无网络、无安装脚本；仅限自有或已授权文件，不解析加密、受保护或第三方保密文件。
description.zh: 只读解析嘉立创EDA专业版工程，重建网表、核对引脚封装、检查PCB几何并做版本增量审查。

description.en: DSH 情绪分析器插件：本地 ONNX 推理为每条主模型回复打分，投影到会话状态并在网站注入可拖拽悬浮框
DSH 情绪分析器插件：本地 ONNX 推理为每条主模型回复打分，投影到会话状态并在网站注入可拖拽悬浮框
description.zh: 给主模型每条回复本地打分情绪，累积状态存进会话，并在网页上显示可拖拽的悬浮情绪框。

description.en: EVA Unit-01 launch-console skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI — seven-scene boot sequence, NERV-style HUD, mecha chrome and a berserk mode.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面换成 EVA 初号机启动控制台，带七幕开机动画、NERV 风格 HUD 和暴走模式。

description.en: Phone photo and file bridge for DSH: transfer photos or arbitrary files from a phone into the current conversation draft attachment bar over the local network.
description.zh: 手机拍照或选文件，通过局域网直接传到当前对话的附件栏，不用数据线也不用登录。

description.en: A small living fish with its own memory, mood and quiet thoughts. It remembers you between sessions, and the fish itself is one JSON file you can export and carry.
description.zh: 一条养在 Harness 里的小鱼：有自己的记忆、心情和心事，隔天还记得你；鱼本身就是一个能导出带走的 JSON。

description.en: 跨会话流程编排：四角色（统筹/预研/开发/测试）的派单、独立验收、需求比对、终审把关、归档闭环。DSH 插件，零依赖。
description.zh: 让统筹、预研、开发、测试四个角色跨会话接力干活，派单、验收、比对、归档一条龙走完。

description.en: See what a conversation actually costs: how many model requests, how big the system prompt and tool table are, cumulative tokens, estimated spend, and how far you are from automatic context compaction. Reads the local session log only; never calls a model, never adds a word to the system prompt. Token and spend figures are estimates from character counts, not provider usage.
description.zh: 看清一场对话到底烧了多少：模型请求次数、system prompt 与工具表各占多少、累计 token、估算花费、离上下文自动压缩还有多远。只读本地会话日志，不调模型，不往 system prompt 加一个字。token 与花费均按字符数估算，不是 provider 用量。

description.en: DSH Web plugin: the session's current Git branch in the composer, a local/remote branch table with checkout, and a read-only commit graph.
description.zh: 在输入框直接看当前 Git 分支，还能切分支、查提交图谱，省得来回敲命令。

description.en: Visual Git graph, interactive branch management, and commit diff inspector in DeepSeek Harness right sidebar.
description.zh: 嵌入 DeepSeek Harness 右侧边栏的可视化 Git 提交图谱、交互式分支管理与代码差异比对工具。

description.en: The authority layer for agentic AI, as a DeepSeek Harness plugin. Governs every tool call against your business rules via TapPass /v1/govern.
description.zh: 给 AI 智能体加一道权限关卡，每次工具调用都按你的业务规则审核，越权操作直接拦下。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2 plugin: mirror x-deepseek-harness-session-id into x-opencode-session and other harness headers.
description.zh: 把当前会话的 session id 同步成其他 harness 认识的请求头，方便跨工具识别同一会话。

description.en: DSH 授权渗透技能包：三层结构 guard(中国法律门禁+目标槽位) / break(提示词装配) / hunt(漏洞挖掘) + 14 项报告模板
description.zh: 把授权渗透测试沉淀成可复用流程，从法律门禁到漏洞挖掘再到报告模板一条龙。

description.en: Image-generation tool with automatic prompt enhancement, switchable API profiles, and a Turn-tail image card that survives chat folding. Requires a user-supplied image API endpoint and key; none are bundled.
description.zh: 带提示词自动增强、可切换多个 API 配置，并在 Turn 尾展示不被折叠的图片卡片的生图工具。需自行配置图像 API 地址与密钥，插件不内置。

description.en: Inference toolkit for DeepSeek Harness — semantic cache, draft cascade, and JSON validation
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一套推理工具：语义缓存、草稿级联和 JSON 校验，让推理更快更稳。

description.en: Offline LAN chat inside DSH: direct chats, group chats and file transfer between machines running the harness on the same network, with UDP auto-discovery, CIDR scanning to add contacts, an optional access code (unset by default), local-only contact aliases, per-message and per-conversation deletion, and a configurable per-file limit. The host opens its own HTTP/WebSocket port for peers, and the plugin imports only node built-ins.
description.zh: DSH 内的离线局域网聊天：同一网络里运行本 harness 的机器之间单聊、群聊与文件传输，带 UDP 自动发现、按网段扫描加联系人、可选访问码（默认未设置）、只在本机生效的联系人备注、单条与整个会话删除，以及可配的单文件上限。宿主半侧为对端另开 HTTP/WebSocket 端口，运行时只用 Node 内置模块。

description.en: Limbus Company desktop-lyrics style toasts for session events: approval requests, turn start and turn end appear as per-character animated text above every window on Windows — ripple/drop entry and exit, jitter or wave motion, per-event glow colors, random left/right screen-side placement, {tool}/{outcome}/{title} message templates, all editable live from a settings page in the DSH GUI; the transparent companion overlay is auto-launched by the plugin host and respawned when it disappears. Windows only; requires running npm install inside the package companion/ directory once to fetch Electron ^33 for the overlay.
description.zh: 会话事件（权限请求、回合开始/结束）以 Limbus Company 桌面歌词风格的逐字动画浮在所有窗口之上：波纹/跌落入退场、抖动或波动律动、分事件光晕配色、屏幕两侧随机落位、{tool}/{outcome}/{title} 文案模板，全部参数在 DSH 设置页实时编辑；透明悬浮伴侣窗由宿主自动拉起、消失即守护重生。仅 Windows；需在包内 companion/ 目录执行一次 npm install 以安装悬浮窗依赖的 Electron ^33。

description.en: Three literature-research skills packaged as one DSH plugin: academic-web-research (lightweight proxy fetch), academic-literature-research (Scholar/IEEE/CNKI/Wanfang/Sci-Hub pipeline), off-campus-literature (campus WebVPN/CARSI access). Installing drops the three SKILL.md folders into ~/.dsh/skills/, so the agent can invoke them by name after a restart. The bundled web-research skill assumes a local HTTP proxy at 127.0.0.1:7897; edit it if your setup differs.
description.zh: 三个文献调研技能打包成一个 DSH 插件：academic-web-research（轻量代理检索）、academic-literature-research（Scholar/IEEE/知网/万方/Sci-Hub 全流程）、off-campus-literature（校园 WebVPN/CARSI 校外访问）。安装即把三个 SKILL.md 落到 ~/.dsh/skills/，重启后 agent 可按名调用。内置的 academic-web-research 技能假定本机 127.0.0.1:7897 有 HTTP 代理，环境不同请自行修改。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：不重启切换进程级出站代理，代理不可达时自动直连、恢复后自动切回。
description.zh: 不用重启就能切换进程级出站代理，代理挂了自动直连、恢复后自动切回。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness: ds-llm-manage.  模型管理（收藏、置顶、探活），熟练度排序，故障自动切换，防止长任务中途中断
description.zh: 给模型做收藏置顶和探活，按熟练度排序，故障自动切换，长任务不再中途断掉。
本地优先的 Markdown 知识库插件，基于证据链支撑，帮你构建可信赖的个人 wiki。

description.en: DSH 锁屏 / Touch ID 验证插件：重启或 48 小时未验证需密码或 Touch ID 解锁，设置页配置，macOS 26 Liquid Glass 风格
description.zh: 给 DSH 加个锁屏，重启或 48 小时没验证就得用密码或 Touch ID 解锁，保护隐私。

description.en: ogin wall and public gateway plugin for DeepSeek Harness cloud deployments
description.zh: 给 dsh web 加个登录门禁，让云端部署能安全对外提供访问。

description.en: DSH 插件：每次工具调用前拦一道，认出同一个错误反复出现、两个工具乒乓互指、会话跨轮烧钱到线 —— 并且绝不把 agent 永久锁死。
description.zh: 工具调用前先拦一道，发现死循环和烧钱就停手，防止 agent 白烧 token。

description.en: Drives a local MaaEnd (MXU) client over its loopback HTTP API: 10 maend_* agent tools, a sidebar dashboard panel, and startup-mute / success-gated close-game steps in the task chain. Requires a local MaaEnd install with its MXU service running.
description.zh: 通过本机 MaaEnd（MXU）的 loopback HTTP API 驱动它：10 个 maend_* agent 工具、一个侧边栏看板面板，以及任务链里的启动静音与「全部成功后才关游戏」收尾。需先在本机安装 MaaEnd 并开启 MXU 服务。

description.en: Publish local plugins to GitHub from the Plugin Market: preflight, repository creation, push, and the dsh-plugin topic.
description.zh: 把本地安装的插件一键推成公开 GitHub 仓库，自动加 dsh-plugin 话题，方便被市场收录。
把 PDF、Office、HTML、图片、音频等文件一键转成 Markdown，方便喂给 AI 或整理笔记。
在 DSH 里统一管理 MCP 服务器，一键安装、启停和配置，让外部工具接入更省心。

description.en: Portable audio and native temporal video plugins, agent skills, CLI and MCP server for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上音频和视频分析能力，插件、命令行、MCP 都能用。

description.en: Long-term memory on top of mem0 and a local Chroma store: user profile and recalled facts injected through the system prompt, capture at session end, a nightly pass that dedupes, merges paraphrases and resolves contradictions, a persistent topic graph written as Markdown cards, periodic export to a git repository, and a full-page memory UI with search, bulk merge, snapshots and undo. Needs a manual Python venv setup plus LLM and embedding API keys before use.
description.zh: 基于 mem0 与本地 Chroma 的长期记忆：画像和相关事实经系统提示注入；会话结束自动捕获；夜间执行去重、近义归纳与矛盾处理；主题图持久化为 Markdown 主题卡；定期导出到 git 仓库；自带全屏记忆页，支持搜索、批量合并、快照与撤销。使用前需自建 Python 虚拟环境并填入 LLM 与 embedding 两组 API Key。

description.en: 多端 AI 角色的本机记忆助手：记得住、能收发、能接自己的 AI、可选支付。Local memory helper for AI characters.
description.zh: 让 AI 角色记住对话、多端互传消息、接入你自己的 AI，数据全留在本机。

description.en: Full-text memory index for DeepSeek Harness: search an existing Markdown memory tree with SQLite FTS5.
description.zh: 给已有的 Markdown 记忆树建全文索引，用 SQLite FTS5 快速搜到想要的内容。

description.en: Cross-session memory for DSH: export every session to readable Markdown transcripts, keep one long-term MEMORY.md, and get a wake-up summary in a fresh window.
description.zh: 跨会话记忆：会话自动导出成能读的 Markdown（带出处），维护一份长期 MEMORY.md，新窗口醒来先看摘要。

description.en: Render mermaid fenced code blocks as diagrams in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 把 Markdown 里的 mermaid 代码块直接渲染成流程图、时序图等图表，看文档更直观。

description.en: DSH skin plugin: stylesheet-only theming with a self-contained skin library (per-mode dark/light presets, import/export, one settings section)
description.zh: 给 DSH 换肤的纯样式插件，自带皮肤库，明暗预设一键切换，还能导入导出。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 小窗插件：常驻悬浮球入口 + 屏幕级置顶小窗 + 页内小窗，消息直通当前会话并实时显示模型回复。
description.zh: 右下角悬浮球一键把 Harness 缩成置顶小窗，切到哪都能随时发消息、看模型实时回复。

description.en: 通过出站 NATS 桥把手机安全连接到本地 DeepSeek Harness。 | Securely connect mobile apps to a local DeepSeek Harness instance through an outbound NATS bridge.
description.zh: 通过出站 NATS 桥把手机安全连到本地 DeepSeek Harness，随时随地用手机操控自托管 AI 助手。

description.en: Adds a connection-test panel under Settings -> Models: reads the deployment's model catalog and probes each configured model with one minimal chat round-trip (a short "ping" with a small output cap) through the Host LLM service, verifying connectivity with a real request. Each row reports success/failure with the harness failure code (NO_ADAPTER, MISSING_CREDENTIAL, AUTH, RATE_LIMIT, TIMEOUT, ...) plus first-token/total latency; single-model and concurrent test-all (3) are supported. Credentials are resolved inside the Host process and never reach the browser; probes are independent per model behind a same-origin-fenced route with a body-size cap. Pure JS, no build step, MIT.
description.zh: 在设置 → 模型页底部增加连接测试面板：读取部署的模型目录，对每个已配置模型经宿主 LLM 服务发送一次最小对话请求（“ping”，小输出上限），以真实请求验证连通性。每行报告成功/失败、宿主失败码（NO_ADAPTER、MISSING_CREDENTIAL、AUTH、RATE_LIMIT、TIMEOUT 等）及首字/总耗时，支持单模型测试与全部测试（并发 3）。凭据只在宿主进程内解析，浏览器不可见；每模型一次独立请求，测试路由带同源围栏与请求体上限。纯 JS 免构建，MIT。

description.en: DSH 插件：为实际启用的模型提供可读名称，统一美化 provider / 模型选择器与设置页；只改 UI 展示，不改变模型 ID、路由、凭据或请求。
description.zh: 给启用的模型配上好记的中文名，让 provider 和模型选择器、设置页看起来更清爽，只改显示不动配置。

description.en: Per-model API price table with Peak and Off-Peak rates in USD or CNY, the DeepSeek account balance and live session spend under the composer, an all-time total, a collapsible source URL and check date per model, and optional per-model Peak schedules.
description.zh: 按模型设置高峰/低谷价格（USD 或 CNY），在输入框下方显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与本次会话花费，累计总花费，每条价格可记录来源链接与核对日期，并支持为单个模型覆盖高峰时段。
在侧栏常驻显示各模型供应商的额度与本机用量，点开就能看双列详情，方便随时掌握消耗。

description.en: Interactive 3D molecular visualization for DeepSeek Harness — PDB/SDF/MOL/MOL2/XYZ/Gaussian, ball-and-stick, visible failure reasons. Based on PandaAIDD/dsh-molecule-viewer (MIT).
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接打开 PDB、SDF 等分子文件，用 3D 球棍模型看结构，渲染失败还会告诉你原因。

description.en: 鲸吟（dsh-notify-whale）：DSH 通知插件加固 fork。修复上游在 Node 22/24 上 HTTP 通道完全无法投递等 5 个 bug，新增等待审批/提问通知与事件级铃声。AI 主导修改。
description.zh: 会话结束或卡在审批、提问时，自动推送到手机和电脑桌面，让你不用守着屏幕。

description.en: Official-style model + reasoning-effort control for the composer. Reuses the official picker and always offers Off/Low/High/Max — exactly like the official DeepSeek control — even when a gateway model declares no reasoning effort, with a small hint at the panel bottom when upstream does not natively support it.
description.zh: 输入框里的官方同款「模型 / 推理等级」控制。直接复用官方组件，即使网关模型（如 deepseek-v4.1-flash）未声明思考强度，也始终提供与官方一致的 Off/Low/High/Max 四档；上游未原生支持时，在面板底部显示一行小字提示。

description.en: OneDev integration for dsh: an MCP server exposing the OneDev REST API as 61 tools — 57 administration tools (users, groups, roles, projects, authorizations, build agents and tokens, builds with streamed build logs, global settings, access tokens), 3 standalone documentation-query tools for docs.onedev.io, and environment discovery with per-call multi-environment routing — plus a dsh Web settings page that manages per-environment credentials locally and applies them on the next tool call without a restart.
description.zh: OneDev 集成插件：MCP 服务器将 OneDev REST API 暴露为 61 个工具——57 个管理工具（用户、组、角色、项目、授权、构建代理与令牌、构建及流式构建日志、全局设置、访问令牌）、3 个独立的官方文档查询工具（docs.onedev.io）以及带按调用多环境路由的环境发现；另提供 dsh Web 设置页，在本地管理各环境凭据，保存后下一次工具调用即生效，无需重启。

description.en: Unofficial DeepSeek Harness plugin fixing OpenCode's MissingSessionID in Auto review by attaching the reviewed agent's session identity. | 非官方 DSH 插件：为 reviewer 请求补上被审查会话身份，修复 OpenCode MissingSessionID 拒绝
description.zh: 给 OpenCode 的 Auto review 补上被审查会话的身份信息，修掉 MissingSessionID 报错，让自动审查能正常跑。

description.en: Remote-only OpenKapsel workspace bridge for the DeepSeek Harness: replaces host filesystem and shell tools with a fail-closed remote tool set. Self-hosted alternative to cloud agent sandboxes.
description.zh: 把远程 OpenKapsel 工作区变成 DeepSeek Harness 的安全工具集，替代本地文件与命令，实现自托管沙箱。

description.en: A diamond button in the composer that rewrites your draft into a structured prompt and puts the original draft back when clicked again.
description.zh: 输入框里的菱形按钮：把草稿改写成结构化提示词，再点一次还原原始输入。

description.en: 消息编辑铅笔：编辑助手回复并从该回合分叉出新版本会话 / Edit assistant replies by forking a new session version
description.zh: 给助手回复加个编辑按钮，改完自动分叉出新会话版本，原会话完整保留。

description.en: DSH 桌宠扩展：让桌宠看你的屏幕、把画面交给一条真实会话来判断，再用桌宠的声音说出来。零第三方依赖。
description.zh: 给 dsh-pet 桌宠加个眼睛：让它看你屏幕、由真实会话判断画面，再用桌宠声音说出来。

description.en: dsh-pet手机端补丁，打完后可以把大肥鱼留在手机桌面上，本项目由大肥鱼自行完成
description.zh: 把 dsh-pet 的桌面宠物搬到安卓手机桌面，透明悬浮窗养同一只鱼，动作气泡双向同步。

description.en: Local, Czech-first voice channel for DeepSeek Harness agents: reads answer summaries aloud, calls you to the computer, own settings UI, queue and stop.
description.zh: 让 DSH 智能体用捷克语把回答摘要念出来，还能喊你回电脑前，带设置界面和队列控制。
把导出的聊天记录自动蒸馏成可扮演人设，让 AI 学会用他的方式跟你聊天。

description.en: Shows the remaining DeepSeek account balance in the composer dock, right after the cache-hit reading, and links to the Platform usage page. Requires a signed-in DeepSeek account; API-key-only setups show nothing.
description.zh: 在输入框底部统计行、紧挨「缓存命中」右侧显示账号剩余额度，点击打开平台用量页。需要登录 DeepSeek 账号；仅用 API Key 不显示。

description.en: 测试工程师 大肥鱼：以黑盒为主的接口/页面功能测试，适用于 DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DSH 里用对话做黑盒功能测试，覆盖接口、页面和前后端一致性，帮你快速验证功能。

description.en: 知网(CNKI)文献工作流助手 for DeepSeek Harness：检索链接生成 + 题录导出解析
description.zh: 知网法学文献助手，帮你找文献、筛文献、读文献、写综述，一条龙搞定。

description.en: Read-only static checks for DSH profiles, bundle resolution, version compatibility, patches and MCP name conflicts, with pre-install candidate checks.
description.zh: 只读检查 DSH profile、bundle 解析、版本兼容、patch 和 MCP 名称冲突，支持安装前候选检查。

description.en: DSH 左侧栏插件下载中心：从 GitHub 浏览、下载并安装 DSH 插件（ZIP / clone / 安装命令）。
description.zh: 在左侧栏粘贴 GitHub 仓库地址，就能选版本、下载并安装 DSH 插件，常用插件做成卡片随手取用。

description.en: 彻底卸载插件库里的插件：删除第三方插件依赖，停用并移出安装包内置插件，支持恢复显示。
description.zh: 把插件库里的插件彻底删干净，第三方依赖和内置插件都能清理，还能恢复显示。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: registers the research-charts-mode (调研与图表模式) agent preset - evidence-graded clinical and pipeline research that ends in auditable figures. Bundles three self-contained skills (high-confidence research, target/indication diligence, clinical landscape charts) and is installable as a .dshpreset.
description.zh: 给调研结论配上来源和置信度，还能自动生成可核查的图表报告。

description.en: DSH plugin: estimated session cost in the composer status bar, split by DeepSeek peak/idle tariff periods
description.zh: 在输入框状态栏实时显示本会话花费，按 DeepSeek 高峰/空闲两档价分别算钱，点开还能看各时段 token 明细。

description.en: Plugin Steward adds a plugin panel to the chat composer for managing the installed DeepSeek Harness plugins: list them, switch them on or off, edit a plugin's settings, hide one plugin's tools or MCP servers from a single conversation, and have the model write short Chinese labels for installed plugins by reading their own README and package files.
description.zh: 插件管家：在对话输入框上加入插件面板，用来管理本机已装的 DSH 插件——列出全部插件、全局启停、逐个编辑插件设置、把某个插件的工具或 MCP 服务器只在这一个对话里对模型隐藏，还能让模型读插件自身的 README 与包信息生成中文标签。面板可拖动并记住位置。

description.en: 插件会话工坊：为已安装插件开一个带上下文的修改会话，点开插件即可在对话里继续改它。
description.zh: 给已安装插件开个带上下文的修改会话，点开插件就能接着改，还能回到当初写它的会话继续编辑。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 子代理清理插件：删除子代理会话，并把父会话日志里残留的目录行原位退休，附带网页端一键清理面板（上游会报错、历史行清不掉）
description.zh: 删掉子代理后，父会话里残留的历史记录也一并清掉，还带网页端一键清理面板。

description.en: Check npm for newer versions of a DeepSeek Harness plugin and update it in one click, from the plugin's own detail page.
description.zh: 在插件详情页一键检查 npm 上有没有新版本，有就直接更新，省得手动折腾。

description.en: dsh 三角色会话架构门禁 + manon 本地图谱组件（bundle：派遣规范门 / scout 常驻 / 地图前置 / 模型钉死 / 提交门 / 领导面限定 / manon 桥接）
description.zh: 给 dsh 会话加上三角色分工和本地知识图谱，省下高级模型的钱，主会话上下文更清爽。

description.en: Puts a key badge in the bottom-right corner of the dsh Web GUI that shows the port this instance is listening on and the remote-access token printed by dsh web at startup, with a copy button per value; clicking the badge rotates the key into a cross, and clicking it again or anywhere beside it collapses the panel.
description.zh: 在 dsh Web 界面右下角放一个钥匙徽标，点开显示本实例的监听端口和 dsh web 启动时打印的远程访问令牌，每项都可一键复制；钥匙图标旋转成叉号，再点一次或点旁边空白即可收起。

description.en: DSH plugin: hot-switch the calling session to another agent preset after it has started (experimental; uses agentPresets.recompose) and keep the choice across restarts.
description.zh: 聊到一半的会话也能直接热切换到别的 Agent 预设，不用重开，重启后还记着你的选择。

description.en: Adds a per-answer Process drawer that streams, in Simplified Chinese, the agent thinking, tool calls and errors for that turn.
description.zh: 在每条回答旁加「进程」抽屉，用简体中文流式讲解该回合 agent 的思考、工具调用与报错。

description.en: Nudges the main agent of a long-running DSH session to report progress at a configurable interval, with exponential back-off, stuck detection, a per-session Progress tab, and a manual "nudge now" action.
description.zh: 主 agent 长时间执行时按可配置间隔提醒它播报进度，支持指数退避、卡住检测、会话「进度」标签页与手动「立即催一次」。

description.en: Beta: a project supervisor for DeepSeek Harness — standing rules plus a Web panel (three switches, dispatch modes) that splits a goal into parallel teammate dialogs, checks engineering baselines, interviews new-project requirements and protects beginners. The standing rules come from the repo kit installer, an optional separate step.
description.zh: 测试中：DSH 项目主管——常驻规则 + 「主管」面板（三开关、派发模式），把目标拆成并行对话框，做工程底线自检、新项目需求追问与零基础保护。常驻规则由仓库的 kit 安装器另行写入工作区，是独立的可选步骤。

description.en: Adds an Optimize button to the composer that rewrites a one-line idea into a structured product brief: a positioning sentence, 3–6 key features, visual references and design tokens; it sits beside your original text in a compare dialog where you can accept it into the input, generate another version, or cancel and keep the draft untouched. No settings page and no API keys — it calls the model channel you already configured.
description.zh: 输入框右侧加一个「优化」按钮：把一句话的口语需求改写成结构化产品简报——一句话定位、3–6 条核心功能、视觉参考、设计规范（配色/尺寸等令牌），左右并排对照原文，可接受回填输入框、重新生成一版，或取消保持原文；不占布局、没有设置页，直接调用你已配置的模型渠道。

description.en: Prompt workbench for DeepSeek Harness: drafts, full-log sent history, and grill-based prompt elicitation.
description.zh: 把写提示词从输入框里独立出来，先写清楚再发送，还能翻看完整发送记录。

description.en: Adds a sparkle button beside the model picker that rewrites the current draft into a spec sized to the draft — two or three steps for a small ask, a longer checklist only when the request has several parts — and puts the original text back when pressed again. Greetings and small talk pass through untouched without calling the model.
description.zh: 在模型选择器旁加一个 ✨ 按钮，把草稿改写成规模随草稿而变的执行规格（小请求只给两三条步骤，多部分请求才展开成清单），再按一次按钮恢复原文；问候与闲聊直接放行，不调用模型。

description.en: Prompt Forge / 提示词锻造台：把模糊想法通过多轮带选项的反问，锻造成完整、可靠、高效的提示词。A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns vague ideas into precise prompts through rounds of option-bearing questions.
description.zh: 把模糊想法通过多轮带选项的反问，锻造成完整、可靠、高效的提示词。

description.en: A composer button for DeepSeek Harness: rewrites your draft into a structured prompt and puts it back in the input box. Local rules, zero runtime dependencies, never sends.
description.zh: 输入框旁加个按钮，一键把草稿改写成结构化提示词并填回输入框，只改不发，全程本地处理。

description.en: 把粗糙提示词转写成规范提示词，浮层预览确认后写入输入框（不自动发送）
description.zh: 把随手写的粗糙提示词一键改写成规范提示词，浮层预览确认后再填入输入框，不会自动发送。

description.en: DSH 插件：输入框工具行里的「优化」按钮——按一下用当前默认模型改写草稿提示词，结果回填可继续编辑
description.zh: 输入框旁加个「优化」按钮，一键用默认模型改写草稿提示词，改完还能接着编辑。

description.en: DSH 桌面端/Web 端插件：编辑初始系统提示词，按需屏蔽 runtime 上下文、工具 schema、AGENTS.md 等系统侧注入，支持普通 / 仅聊天 / 自定义模式切换与实时生效。
description.zh: 编辑初始系统提示词，按需屏蔽 runtime 上下文、工具 schema 等系统注入，支持普通/仅聊天/自定义模式切换并实时生效。

description.en: Loopback relay as DSH's process-wide proxy route: web_fetch works under TUN fake-ip; a dead proxy gets same-request direct fallback, and a probe switches back.
description.zh: 把回环 HTTP 中继设为 DSH 的进程级代理路由，让 web_fetch 在 Mihomo/Clash TUN fake-ip 下正常出网；上游代理不可用时，同一请求内改走直连，1.5 秒探活发现代理恢复后自动切回。

description.en: DSH Web 插件：PTC 模式（run_code 内的嵌套调用）里的 edit/write 显示标准 diff 卡片 | DSH Web GUI plugin: standard diff cards for edit/write calls inside PTC programs
description.zh: 让 PTC 模式下 run_code 里的 edit/write 调用也能显示标准 diff 卡片，改动一眼看清。

description.en: Send by dragging instead of clicking. Press the composer and pull up to arm the gesture; releasing sends, dragging back into the composer cancels, and dragging outside the conversation area cancels on the spot. Mouse and pen only.
description.zh: 用拖拽代替点击发送。按住输入框向上拉即武装：松手发送，拖回输入框取消，拖出对话区当场取消。仅响应鼠标与笔。

description.en: dsh-purge mirror - the coding assistant po jia / jailbreak plugin. Original author: YuJunZhiXue. Latest upstream v1.1.78 + full history (231 commits, 106 tags).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的红队安全测试插件，用来审查和加固模型行为，防止提示词被绕过。

description.en: Mirror of dsh-purge 1.1.71 - upstream YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge was deleted by its author. Read-only snapshot, original attribution and license kept intact. Not my code.
description.zh: 已归档的 DeepSeek Harness 红队测试插件快照，用于安全研究与提示词注入测试。

description.en: Nine model-facing tools over the qBittorrent WebAPI v2, with confirm-gated mutations and an orphan-torrent diagnostic.
description.zh: 基于 qBittorrent WebAPI v2 的九个模型侧工具，写操作需显式 confirm，并提供孤儿种子诊断。

description.en: QQbot, QQ机器人 — watches chosen QQ groups over OneBot 11, batches messages by a count threshold, summarizes each batch with a model already configured in DSH, and sends the per-group report to chosen friends as a QQ private message. Messages can be filtered by keyword and by sender; ships a settings page, a local web console and a summary archive.
description.zh: QQ机器人、QQbot：通过 OneBot 11 监听指定 QQ 群，按消息数阈值分批，调用 DSH 已配置的模型总结每批消息，再按群私聊投递到指定好友；支持按关键词与成员过滤消息，带设置页、本地网页控制台与总结归档。

description.en: 给 DSH 接入的 QQ 机器人加表情包能力：同步收藏、按情绪检索、发送/添加/删除，带设置页与梗库查询（OneBot v11，适配 SnowLuma / NapCat）。
description.zh: 给 DSH 的 QQ 机器人加上表情包能力，能同步收藏、按情绪找图、直接发图，还能在设置页里管理。

description.en: DSH Desktop plugin: QQ bot working directory, workspace grouping, upload routing and a QQ-session security lock
description.zh: 给 QQ 机器人单独划个工作目录，会话归进侧栏分组，还能加安全锁。

description.en: One-install DSH QQ bot bundle: gateway + vision + TTS + Bilibili
description.zh: 装一次就能让 QQ 机器人会看图、会说话、还能玩 B 站，开箱即用的整合包。

description.en: Lets a DSH agent ask the user a structured question without blocking the turn: the ask_interactive_question tool returns a pending batch id at once, the answer arrives later as an ordinary user message, and pending batches sit in a browser inbox panel with optional system notifications.
description.zh: 让 DSH agent 提问而不阻塞回合：ask_interactive_question 工具立刻返回待答批次号，答案稍后以普通用户消息送回会话，待答批次显示在浏览器内的待答面板，可选系统通知。

description.en: Adds a Restart item to the DeepSeek Harness desktop account menu, with confirmation, progress and failure reporting.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版账号菜单中加入「重启」项，带二次确认、进度与失败原因提示。

description.en: 老实装插件，很枯燥吧？该插件可以帮你在另一个deepseek harness实例中批量部署你的dsh插件，以后再也不用一个个在市场上搜插件装了。（注：这个描述是我自己手写的）
description.zh: 把本机已装的第三方 DSH 插件打包导出，在另一个 DSH 实例里检查兼容后批量安装，省去逐个搜索安装的麻烦。

description.en: Source-grounded deep research, writing, and learning plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): steerable checkpoints, mid-run steering, and citations verified against retrieved sources.
description.zh: 深度研究写作插件，支持中途调整方向、检查点续写，并自动核实引用来源，让研究更可靠。

description.en: Turns corrections into permanent rules: explicit remember: triggers and auto-detected corrections pass a confirm bar (save globally / per project / edit / skip) and are written into a marked AGENTS.md section. New rules take effect in the current session and load natively in future ones; writes are deduplicated and version-guarded, and secret-looking content is refused.
description.zh: 把对模型的纠正变成永久规则：remember: 显式触发与自动检测的纠正经确认条确认后写入 AGENTS.md 的标记段（全局或项目作用域，可编辑、可跳过），当前会话立即生效，新会话由 dsh 原生指令加载器读取；规则去重、版本守卫写入、疑似密钥拒绝落盘。
让 DeepSeek Harness 支持远程网络访问，随时随地连上你的开发环境。

description.en: Research writing bundle for DeepSeek Harness: literature search/citation + LaTeX/BibTeX guard in one install.
description.zh: 装一次就能搞定文献检索、引用管理和 LaTeX/BibTeX 格式检查，写论文省心不少。

description.en: Adds a Restart button to the DSH Desktop sidebar. It opens the same native confirmation dialog as the tray Exit item and, once approved, shuts the app down gracefully and relaunches it. This plugin only draws the button: it also needs the companion shell patch shipped in shell-patch/ in the same repository, which has to be applied from outside DSH while the app is closed. Installed on its own, the button stays disabled and a tooltip explains why. The companion shell patch is Windows only and rewrites the installed app.asar.
description.zh: 给 DSH Desktop 侧边栏底部加一个「重启」按钮：弹出与托盘「退出 DeepSeek Harness」完全相同的原生确认框，确认后优雅关闭并重新拉起。注意：本插件只负责画这个按钮，必须同时应用同一仓库 shell-patch/ 里的外壳补丁，且该补丁要在 DSH 关闭时由 DSH 之外的脚本执行。单独安装插件时按钮为禁用状态，悬停提示会说明原因。配套外壳补丁仅支持 Windows，会改写已安装的 app.asar。

description.en: Codex-style right-click menu for files and links in the DeepSeek Harness web GUI (Windows).
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页界面加上 Codex 风格右键菜单，文件和链接都能快速操作，Windows 上更好用。

description.en: Rewrites pwsh and bash tool commands through `rtk rewrite` and executes the compact equivalent; falls back to the original command when rtk is missing or has no equivalent, and ships a checksum-verified `/rtk install` downloader.
description.zh: 把 pwsh / bash 工具命令经 `rtk rewrite` 改写后执行，让 rtk 的压缩输出进入上下文；rtk 缺失或无等价命令时原样执行，并提供带 SHA256 校验的 `/rtk install` 下载。

description.en: DSH plugin: key-free web search backed by the RustXNG metasearch server, downloaded from its releases
description.zh: 免密钥的本地网页搜索插件，自动拉起 RustXNG 元搜索服务，让 AI 助手随时联网查资料。

description.en: 工资跳板：挂在 DeepSeek Harness 网页上的翻牌工资看板，每 2 秒结算一次今天赚了多少。纯前端，不联网。
description.zh: 挂在 DeepSeek Harness 网页上的翻牌工资看板，每 2 秒结算今天赚了多少钱，纯前端不联网。

description.en: Checks each claim in a finished answer against the tool output that same turn read: a contradiction whose quote is found in that output steers one correction in the same turn, and claims the output does not back are flagged in the session log and on stderr. A free scan for absolute words and unmatched numbers runs first, and a turn that ran no tool never reaches the model.
description.zh: 把成品回答里的每条断言，和同一回合工具实际读到的内容对照：引用能在输出里找到的矛盾会在同一回合触发一次纠正；输出不支撑的断言则写进会话日志与 stderr。先跑一遍绝对化措辞与对不上数字的免费扫描，整回合没调用工具的就不进模型。

description.en: Adds a Timestamp toggle to the composer; while it is on, each message you submit is followed by a hidden context message carrying the current local time, so the model knows when you sent it. The switch is remembered per conversation.
description.zh: 在输入框工具栏加一个「时间戳」开关：开启后，你提交的每条消息后面会跟一条隐藏的上下文消息，携带发送时刻的本地时间，模型因此知道你是什么时候发的；开关按会话分别记住。
把各品牌服务器日志丢进来，就能定位坏件、判断是否换件，并给出换前准备，结论可追溯到原始行。

description.en: Delete archived DeepSeek Harness sessions: sidebar panel plus host routes, with archive-only and live-session guards.
description.zh: 给 DSH 补上删除已归档会话的能力，侧边栏一键清理，还能防止误删正在用的会话。

description.en: 每条会话自动生成独立归档文件夹：聊天记录.md + 源码 + 其他产出，按【开发/文案/方案/调试-摘要】命名。
description.zh: 每条会话自动建独立文件夹，聊天记录、源码和产出分开放，按开发/文案/方案/调试命名，找东西不再翻半天。

description.en: Session-level multi-thread orchestration for DeepSeek Harness: create ordinary sessions, send queued or interrupt prompts to any session by id, and enumerate sessions. Installs globally, independent of any agent preset.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一套会话级多线程调度，按 id 给任意会话排队或打断发提示，还能列出所有会话。

description.en: DSH 会话右键菜单「删除会话」：真正删除会话日志、投影缓存与工作区记录。
description.zh: 给会话右键菜单加个真删除，连日志、缓存和工作区记录一起清干净。

description.en: Permanently delete DSH sessions from the sidebar with a themed confirmation dialog and no page reload.
description.zh: 给 DSH 侧边栏加上真正的删除功能，带确认弹窗，删完不用刷新页面。

description.en: Session doctor for DeepSeek Harness: scan and losslessly repair corrupted session logs. 会话医生：扫描并无损修复会话日志损坏。
description.zh: 扫描会话日志里的损坏记录，无损修复并自动备份，还能查清是谁把 DSH 搞崩的。

description.en: Permanently delete a DeepSeek Harness session from its sidebar menu, including the conversation files and cached data stored on your PC.
description.zh: 在侧边栏菜单里一键彻底删除会话，连本地对话文件和缓存一起清干净。

description.en: Deletes a whole DSH session or one completed turn from the session log: confirmation dialog, live-agent teardown, path and identity checks, pre-rewrite backup, and later turns renumbered.
description.zh: 删除整个 DSH 会话，或只删除会话中某一轮已完成的对话：带二次确认、运行中 Agent 安全停止、路径与身份校验、改写前备份，后续轮次自动顺延。

description.en: Shows a Windows 11 toast notification when a DeepSeek Harness session turn finishes, and stays quiet while a DSH window is focused.
description.zh: DSH 会话每轮结束时在 Windows 11 右下角弹出系统通知；DSH 窗口在前台时自动跳过，避免打扰。
把旧的工具输出和大段代码、XML 内容换成简短占位符，帮 DSH 会话省下上下文空间。

description.en: DSH plugin — export part of a conversation as editable Markdown or a PNG card. Pick turns, edit the draft, copy/export. Redacted by default, read-only routes.
description.zh: 把对话片段导出成可编辑的 Markdown 或 PNG 卡片，默认脱敏，方便分享。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：左侧边栏按钮与间距放大（图标按钮 28→36px、会话行 32→40px、按钮组间距 8→12px），纯 CSS 注入、无工具无设置
description.zh: 把左侧边栏的按钮和间距调大一点，看着更舒服、点着更顺手，纯 CSS 注入不改任何设置。

description.en: Skill usage statistics panel for DeepSeek Harness: every installed skill with its use count, session coverage, and share of all skill use.
description.zh: 一眼看清每个已装技能被用了多少次、覆盖多少会话、占全部技能使用的比例。

description.en: 皮肤管理页内的手动/自动皮肤更新，下载走国内 npm 镜像
description.zh: 在皮肤管理页直接查看并更新已装皮肤，支持自动检查，下载走国内镜像更快。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 持续探索插件：从一句改进目标开始，自主调查、尝试、比较并交付结果。
description.zh: 给项目一句改进目标，插件就自己调查、尝试、比较，把更好的结果交给你。

description.en: DSH 自媒体工作台插件
description.zh: AI 驱动的自媒体工作台，帮你一站式搞定内容创作、管理和多平台发布。

description.en: 深空背景 — DeepSeek Harness 主题与外观插件：设置「通用」分区提供深空背景开关，银河/星座/行星/流星在窗口底层流动，界面经官方主题令牌半透明化
description.zh: 给 DSH 界面铺上全透深空星空，银河星座行星流星在底层流动，文字依旧清晰可读。

description.en: A starlight ocean backdrop for DeepSeek Harness: animated illustration, glass composer, gear settings and reasoning-linked meteors.
description.zh: 给 Harness 换上星海插画动态背景，输入框变玻璃质感，流星还会跟着推理进度飞。

description.en: Six-second cinematic startup animation for DeepSeek Harness Desktop, with terminal-to-whale motion and optional startup audio.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端加一段 6 秒开机动画，终端变形为鲸鱼，还能配启动音效。

description.en: Keeps a local sticker dictionary keyed by content hash so an image already described is recalled instead of re-read, and splits a GIF into evenly sampled frames laid out as one contact sheet so the whole animation is visible.
description.zh: 维护一本按内容哈希索引的本地表情包字典，看过的图直接复用描述而不再重复识图；同时把 GIF 均匀抽帧拼成一张联系表，让视觉模型看清整段动作。

description.en: 🥪 上面一片人设，下面一片封印，中间夹住整个 harness —— 两张贴纸钉住 system prompt 的两端，挂成可选 DSH 预置
description.zh: 用两张贴纸钉住 system prompt 首尾，中间全留给 DSH，做成可选预置，不选就一点不留。

description.en: Arms an explicit per-session scope contract from a `$stop-that-shit` directive and audits every tool call against it; unarmed it is inert. A DSH bundle wrapping lennney/stop-that-shit (MIT). Do not install it alongside the upstream lennney/stop-that-shit DSH bundle.
description.zh: 用 `$stop-that-shit` 指令显式开启每会话范围契约并逐个工具调用审计；未开启时不干预。基于 lennney/stop-that-shit（MIT）的 DSH 封装。不要与上游 lennney/stop-that-shit 的 DSH bundle 同时安装。

description.en: Lets an AI play Slay the Spire 2: screenshot plus mouse/keyboard tools, a local card lookup, and a readable play log. Requires Windows and Python 3.10 or newer with Pillow.
description.zh: 让 AI 自己玩《杀戮尖塔 2》：截图＋鼠标键盘工具、本地牌表速查，还有一份能读的游玩日志。需 Windows 与 Python 3.10 及以上版本并安装 Pillow。

description.en: 子智能体模型切换：DSH 子智能体/团队队友的模型与思考强度手动切换，支持主会话一键同步
description.zh: 手动切换 DSH 子智能体和团队队友的模型与思考强度，还能从主会话一键同步设置。

description.en: Context-based next-message suggestions and draft rewriting for DeepSeek Harness, with candidate paging, shortcut recording, and companion MCP tools.
description.zh: 根据会话生成下一条消息建议并优化草稿，支持候选翻页、快捷键录制和配套 MCP 工具。

description.en: DSH Web 插件：把本机 CPU / 内存 / 磁盘 / 网络 / I/O / 温度显示在对话顶栏、输入框底部、侧边栏底部，点开右侧「系统」详情
description.zh: 在对话顶栏、输入框和侧边栏实时显示本机 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络、温度和 I/O，点开右侧「系统」看详情。

description.en: Desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Web sessions: get notified when a session waits for approval or finishes, then click to jump back to it.
description.zh: 会话需要审批或跑完时弹桌面通知，点一下就能跳回对应会话，不用一直盯着页面。

description.en: DSH Web 插件：把 DSH Web GUI 发布到 tailnet，并把 tailnet 设备与可达性暴露为 ctx.tailscale 服务
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 界面发布到 Tailscale 内网，让 tailnet 里的设备随时访问，并查看设备在线情况。

description.en: Session task and runtime dashboard for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把当前会话的任务进度、运行状态、花费和工作目录集中到一页，随时看清任务跑到哪了。

description.en: 让 DeepSeek Harness 里的 agent 用简体中文思考与回复：一条系统提示词 section，兼容标准/PTC/自定义预设，可配置思考与回复语言。
description.zh: 让 DSH 里的 agent 默认用简体中文思考和回复，思考过程不再满屏英文，还能自定义语言。

description.en: Turns the composer send button into a tomato button while a task is running and the draft is empty. One or two taps hand the model a hidden note on its next step asking it to reflect on the approach and to finish by asking the user how to continue; three taps within a second stop the run first and send the same kind of note. Thrown-tomato animations and sound can be switched off in settings, which also counts every tomato thrown.
description.zh: 任务运行中且输入框为空时，把发送键换成番茄键。点一两下会让模型在下一步收到一条不对用户显示的提醒，要求它反思做法并以提问用户如何继续收尾；一秒内连点三下则先停止任务，再发同样的提醒。丢番茄特效与音效可在设置中关闭，设置页同时显示累计扔出的番茄总数。

description.en: Tip jar for DeepSeek Harness: contributors declare USDC / fiat / QR channels in sponsors.json; sponsor-center panel + TipJarEmbed. Pure P2P, privacy by default. 打赏罐
description.zh: 贡献者在 sponsors.json 里声明 USDC、法币或二维码打赏渠道，用户一键支持，纯 P2P 不经手。

description.en: A to-do list that lives in the right sidebar instead of the conversation: add an item, tick it off, delete it, and drag rows to reorder them. Items are kept only in the browser's localStorage, and the plugin registers no model-facing tools; a button in the conversation header opens the panel.
description.zh: 放在右侧边栏、不进入对话的待办清单：添加、勾选完成、删除，拖动行即可排序。数据只保存在浏览器的 localStorage 里，插件不注册任何给模型用的工具；会话头部有个按钮可打开面板。

description.en: DSH plugin: per-turn token usage, cost, session totals and account balance in the Harness Web UI, with a workspace-local ledger.
description.zh: 在每轮对话下方显示 token 用量、费用和余额，账本存本地，刷新重开也不丢。

description.en: Park whole tool packs out of the session's tool surface and mount them back with one command. Cuts the tool table from 99,789 to 48,144 characters (51.8%) without uninstalling plugins or restarting. Reversible per group, per agent.
description.zh: 把整包工具从会话的工具面上摘掉，要用时一条命令挂回来。工具表从 99,789 字符降到 48,144（51.8%），不用卸载插件、不用重启，按组可逆、按 agent 独立。

description.en: 让你DSH的输出厅里厅气的｜按 GB/T 9704—2012《党政机关公文格式》生成与校验中文公文 DOCX/PDF，纯 JS 零依赖，附版面自校验
description.zh: 按 GB/T 9704—2012 生成并校验中文公文 DOCX/PDF，纯 JS 零依赖，排版自动合规。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 工具箱，管理插件、MCP引入的工具(tools)，减少上下文不必要的损耗，提供渐进式的工具获取
description.zh: 把全局工具按正则分组，用三种状态控制是否进上下文，还能在侧栏面板直接增删改分组，省 token 更省心。

description.en: DSH 回答朗读：GPT-SoVITS 本机模型 + Edge 在线音色 + Windows SAPI；按语种路由，并支持按 sessionId 绑定音色
description.zh: 让 DSH 把回答直接读出来，本机模型、在线音色和系统语音都能用，断网也不怕。

description.en: UFO archive terminal: search official and civilian records, keep a local archive, read it offline.
description.zh: UFO 档案终端：检索官方与民间记录，落到本地档案馆，离线可读。

description.en: Reads a video or audio file into metadata, sampled stills, subtitles and a multilingual speech transcript with speaker labels, captures the live desktop as frames or a recording, and installs its ffmpeg/whisper.cpp/sherpa-onnx toolchain on first use with per-file sha256 checks; all processing stays local. Automatic toolchain install and desktop capture currently support Windows x64 only, so elsewhere ffmpeg and model paths must be set manually.
description.zh: 读取视频与音频文件的元数据、关键帧、字幕和带说话人标签的多语种转写；把实时桌面抓成帧序列或视频；首次使用时自动安装 ffmpeg / whisper.cpp / sherpa-onnx 并按文件校验 sha256，全部处理都在本机完成。自动安装工具链与桌面捕获目前仅支持 Windows x64，其他平台需手动提供 ffmpeg 与模型路径。

description.en: DSH 0.2 桌面版语音插件（dsh-voice-mode 的非官方兼容分支）：流式识别入草稿、按句朗读 + 实时字幕、开口即打断，另含 ASR 纠错词表与整段丢字修复。 · Unofficial dsh-voice-mode port for the DSH 0.2 desktop app: streaming ASR into the draft, per-sentence TTS with live captions, true barge-in, plus a local ASR correction dictionary.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面版里开口说话就能转成草稿并自动发送，回复按句朗读带字幕，还能随时打断。

description.en: Applies the Naihuangxin appearance preset with settings backup and restore. A preset for elysia395/dsh-wallpaper-engine 1.4.0; that plugin and the local Naihuangxin wallpaper (Workshop 3808236079) are required.
description.zh: 应用奶皇新外观预设，支持设置备份与恢复。它是 elysia395/dsh-wallpaper-engine 1.4.0 的预设，需先装该插件并备好奶皇新壁纸（工坊 3808236079）。

description.en: Web Push notifications for DeepSeek Harness tasks, approvals, and questions.
description.zh: 任务完成、需要审批或提问时，直接给你推送浏览器通知，不用一直盯着屏幕。

description.en: Tavily, Exa and Firecrawl as interchangeable ctx.web backends for DeepSeek Harness. Switch the engine behind web_search/web_fetch from a settings page, keys in the credential store, credential-free local fetch fallback.

Tavily-backed web search and page fetch for DeepSeek Harness: a Search provider, a Fetch provider with Tavily Extract, Firecrawl and direct HTTP modes, and a settings card. Needs a Tavily API key; Firecrawl is optional.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Tavily 网页搜索与页面抓取：包含 Search provider、支持 Tavily Extract/Firecrawl/本地 HTTP 的 Fetch provider，以及设置卡片。需要 Tavily API key，Firecrawl 可选。

description.en: Forward WeChat chat records into DSH sessions: a Windows share target captures the merged-forward ZIP, an in-GUI overlay picks the destination workspace and session, and the ZIP arrives as a file-attachment user message the agent unpacks and reads. Media entry extensions are normalized by magic bytes (WeChat ships PNG/HEIC bytes named .jpg), and failed deliveries preserve the batch for retry. Requires Windows 10/11 with Developer Mode on and the repo installer to register the share target.
description.zh: 把微信聊天记录转发进 DSH 会话：Windows 分享目标接收合并转发的 ZIP，GUI 浮层选择目标工作区与会话，ZIP 以文件附件用户消息到达，agent 解压并读取。按魔数纠正媒体扩展名（微信常把 PNG/HEIC 字节命名为 .jpg），投递失败时批次保留可重试。需 Windows 10/11 并开启开发者模式，先运行仓库安装脚本注册分享目标。

description.en: DSH 右下角小鲸鱼余额挂件的 fork（基于 dsh-whale-widget 0.4.2）：完整保留余额/泡泡/音效，内置一只会「吃饭 / 睡觉」的小猪，角色支持 干活 > 打盹 > 待机 三态自动切换。
description.zh: 在 DSH 右下角显示余额小鲸鱼，还养了只会吃饭睡觉的小猪，干活打盹待机自动切换。
